    <script>
    window._installPrompt = null;
    addEventListener('beforeinstallprompt', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); window._installPrompt = e; window._installSync && window._installSync(); });
    addEventListener('appinstalled', function () { window._installPrompt = null; window._appInstalled = true; window._installSync && window._installSync(); });
    window._installSync = function () {
        var st = document.getElementById('install-state'), btn = document.getElementById('install-btn');
        if (!st || !btn) return;
        var standalone = window._appInstalled || (window.matchMedia && matchMedia('(display-mode: standalone)').matches);
        btn.style.display = (!standalone && window._installPrompt) ? '' : 'none';
        st.textContent = standalone ? 'Installed. You are using the EchoSpace app.'
            : window._installPrompt ? 'Ready to install on this device.'
            : 'In Chrome, open the menu (⋮) → Cast, save and share → Install page as app. If that option is missing, your school may block installing apps.';
    };
    window._installApp = async function () {
        var p = window._installPrompt;
        if (!p) return window._installSync();
        p.prompt();
        try { var r = await p.userChoice; if (r && r.outcome === 'accepted') window._appInstalled = true; } catch (_) {}
        window._installPrompt = null;
        window._installSync();
    };
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () { window._installSync(); });
    </script>

        function probe(p) {
            var t0 = Date.now();
            var ctl = typeof AbortController === 'function' ? new AbortController() : null;
            var timer = setTimeout(function () { try { ctl && ctl.abort(); } catch (_) {} }, TIMEOUT_MS);
            return fetch(p.url, { mode: 'cors', credentials: 'omit', cache: p.cache || 'no-store', signal: ctl ? ctl.signal : undefined })
                .then(function (r) { clearTimeout(timer); return { id: p.id, label: p.label, ok: true, ms: Date.now() - t0 }; })
                .catch(function (e) { clearTimeout(timer); return { id: p.id, label: p.label, ok: false, ms: Date.now() - t0, why: e && e.name === 'AbortError' ? 'timed out' : 'blocked' }; });
        }

        function runChecks() {
            if (state.running) return state.running;
            state.running = Promise.all(PROBES.map(probe)).then(function (res) {
                if (res.every(function (r) { return r.ok; })) return res;
                return new Promise(function (ok) { setTimeout(ok, 1500); }).then(function () {
                    return Promise.all(res.map(function (r, i) { return r.ok ? r : probe(PROBES[i]); }));
                });
            }).then(function (res) { state.running = null; state.results = res; return res; },
                    function () { state.running = null; return []; });
            return state.running;

        function listHtml(res) {
            return (res || []).map(function (r) {
                return '<li><span>' + r.label + '</span><span class="' + (r.ok ? 'en-ok' : 'en-no') + '">' + (r.ok ? 'OK' : r.why) + '</span></li>';
            }).join('');
        }

        function render(mode) {
            var offline = mode === 'offline';
            return '<div class="en-card" role="alertdialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="en-title">'
                + '<div class="en-icon"><span class="en-ring"></span><span class="en-ring en-ring2"></span>' + ICON_WIFI_OFF + '</div>'
                + '<h2 id="en-title">' + (offline ? "You're offline" : "EchoSpace can't connect") + '</h2>'
                + '<p class="en-sub">' + (offline ? "Your device isn't connected to the internet right now." : "The Wi-Fi you're on is blocking EchoSpace's servers, so things won't load.") + '</p>'
                + '<div class="en-school">'
                +   '<div class="en-school-title">Try a different Wi-Fi</div>'
                +   '<ol class="en-steps"><li><span>Open your Wi-Fi settings</span></li><li><span>Switch to <b>another Wi-Fi</b> if you can (a phone hotspot works too)</span></li><li><span>Come back and tap <b>Try again</b></span></li></ol>'
                + '</div>'
                + '<div class="en-actions">'
                +   '<button type="button" class="en-primary" id="en-retry">Try again</button>'
                +   '<button type="button" class="en-ghost" id="en-dismiss">Continue anyway</button>'
                + '</div>'
                + (offline ? '' : '<details class="en-details"><summary>What failed</summary><ul class="en-list" id="en-list">' + listHtml(state.results) + '</ul></details>')
                + '</div>';
        }

        function whenBodyAndGateClear(fn) {
            var gate = document.getElementById('security-gate');
            if (!document.body || (gate && !gate.classList.contains('hidden'))) { setTimeout(function () { whenBodyAndGateClear(fn); }, 300); return; }
            fn();
        }

        function show(mode) {
            if (isBot() || state.dismissed) return;
            whenBodyAndGateClear(function () {
                if (!document.getElementById('echonet-css')) {
                    var st = document.createElement('style'); st.id = 'echonet-css'; st.textContent = CSS;
                    document.head.appendChild(st);
                }
                if (!state.el) { state.el = document.createElement('div'); state.el.id = 'echonet'; document.body.appendChild(state.el); }
                if (state.mode === mode && state.el.innerHTML) {
                    var list = document.getElementById('en-list'); if (list) list.innerHTML = listHtml(state.results);
                    return;
                }
                state.mode = mode;
                state.el.innerHTML = render(mode);
                document.getElementById('en-retry').onclick = retry;
                document.getElementById('en-dismiss').onclick = function () { state.dismissed = true; hide(); };
            });
        }

        function hide() { if (state.el) { state.el.remove(); state.el = null; state.mode = null; } }

        function success(reload) {
            if (!state.el || state.celebrating) { if (reload) location.reload(); return; }
            state.celebrating = true;
            var sparks = '';
            for (var i = 0; i < 10; i++) sparks += '<span class="en-spark" style="--a:' + (i * 36) + 'deg"></span>';
            state.el.innerHTML = '<div class="en-card en-okcard" role="status" aria-live="polite">'
                + '<div class="en-icon en-okicon"><span class="en-ring"></span><span class="en-ring en-ring2"></span>' + sparks
                + '<svg class="en-check" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 12.5l4.5 4.5L19 7.5"/></svg></div>'
                + '<h2>Reconnected!</h2>'
                + '<p class="en-sub">' + (reload ? 'EchoSpace is back. Reloading so everything loads right…' : "You're back online. Everything will pick up where it left off.") + '</p>'
                + '<div class="en-bar"><i></i></div>'
                + '</div>';
            setTimeout(function () {
                if (reload) { location.reload(); return; }
                if (!state.el) return;
                state.el.classList.add('en-out');
                setTimeout(function () { state.celebrating = false; hide(); }, 400);
            }, 1650);
        }

        function retry() {
            var btn = document.getElementById('en-retry');
            if (!btn || btn.disabled) return;
            btn.disabled = true;
            btn.innerHTML = '<span class="en-spin"></span>Checking…';
            if (navigator.onLine === false) {
                setTimeout(function () { btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = 'Try again'; shake(); }, 700);
                return;
            }
            runChecks().then(function (res) {
                if (res.length && res.every(function (r) { return r.ok; })) {
                    success(state.mode !== 'offline');
                } else {
                    if (state.mode !== 'blocked') { show('blocked'); return; }
                    btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = 'Try again';
                    var list = document.getElementById('en-list'); if (list) list.innerHTML = listHtml(res);
                    shake();
                }
            });
        }

        function shake() {
            var card = state.el && state.el.querySelector('.en-card');
            if (!card) return;
            card.classList.remove('en-shake'); void card.offsetWidth; card.classList.add('en-shake');
        }

        function check(reason) {
            if (isBot() || state.dismissed) return;
            if (navigator.onLine === false) { show('offline'); return; }
            runChecks().then(function (res) {
                var bad = res.filter(function (r) { return !r.ok; });
                if (bad.length) {
                    try { console.warn('[EchoNet] can\'t reach:', bad.map(function (r) { return r.label + ' (' + r.why + ')'; }).join(', '), '— trigger:', reason); } catch (_) {}
                    show('blocked');
                } else if (state.mode && !state.celebrating) {
                    success(state.mode === 'blocked');
                }
            });
        }

        window.EchoNet = { check: check, results: function () { return state.results; } };
        window.addEventListener('offline', function () { state.dismissed = false; show('offline'); });
        window.addEventListener('online', function () { if (state.mode === 'offline') check('back-online'); });
        check('page-load');
    })();
    </script>

    <script>
    (function () {
        const LIBS = {
            hljs:        { js: 'https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/highlight.js/11.8.0/highlight.min.js',
                           css:'https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/highlight.js/11.8.0/styles/atom-one-dark.min.css',
                           ready: () => window.hljs },
            tesseract:   { js: 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/tesseract.js@5/dist/tesseract.min.js',
                           ready: () => window.Tesseract },
            qrcode:      { js: 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/qrcodejs@1.0.0/qrcode.min.js',
                           ready: () => window.QRCode },
            html2canvas: { js: 'https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/html2canvas/1.4.1/html2canvas.min.js',
                           ready: () => window.html2canvas },
        };
        const cache = {};
        window._lazyLib = function (name) {
            const L = LIBS[name];
            if (!L) return Promise.reject(new Error('unknown lib: ' + name));
            if (L.ready()) return Promise.resolve(L.ready());
            if (cache[name]) return cache[name];
            cache[name] = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
                if (L.css) {
                    const link = document.createElement('link');
                    link.rel = 'stylesheet'; link.href = L.css;
                    document.head.appendChild(link);
                }
                const s = document.createElement('script');
                s.src = L.js;
                s.onload  = () => resolve(L.ready());
                s.onerror = () => { cache[name] = null; reject(new Error(name + ' failed to load')); };
                document.head.appendChild(s);
            });
            return cache[name];
        };
    })();
    </script>
        
    
    <script>
    (function () {
        var BLANK = 'data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIAAAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAAALAAAAAABAAEAAAIBRAA7';
        function bad(v) {
            return v === undefined || v === null || v === '' ||
                   v === 'undefined' || v === 'null';
        }
        function safe(v) { return bad(v) ? (window._DEFAULT_PFP || BLANK) : v; }

        var proto = window.HTMLImageElement && HTMLImageElement.prototype;
        var d = proto && Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(proto, 'src');
        if (d && d.set) {
            Object.defineProperty(proto, 'src', {
                configurable: true,
                enumerable: d.enumerable,
                get: d.get,
                set: function (v) {
                    if (bad(v)) {
                        try { window._diag && window._diag('img-guard', 'blocked src=' + v); } catch (e) {}
                        d.set.call(this, safe(v));
                        return;
                    }
                    d.set.call(this, v);
                }
            });
        }
        var sa = proto && proto.setAttribute;
        if (sa) {
            proto.setAttribute = function (name, value) {
                if (String(name).toLowerCase() === 'src' && bad(value)) {
                    return sa.call(this, name, safe(value));
                }
                return sa.call(this, name, value);
            };
        }
    })();
    </script>
    
    <script>
    (function () {
        var buf = window.__diagBuf = window.__diagBuf || [];
        if (!window._diag) window._diag = function (tag, msg) { buf.push([tag, msg, Date.now()]); };
        window.addEventListener('error', function (e) {
            window._diag('early-error', (e.message || 'script error') + ' @ ' + (e.filename || '?') + ':' + (e.lineno || '?'));
        });
    })();
    </script>
    
    <script>
    (function () {
        'use strict';

        var COLL      = 'rule_reports';
        var MAX_ROWS  = 60;
        var RESEND_MS = 6 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
        var TOAST_MS  = 25000;
        var FLUSH_MS  = 4000;

        var seen       = Object.create(null);
        var queue      = [];
        var flushTimer = null;
        var lastToast  = 0;
        var inFlush    = false;
        var idWaitFrom = 0;

        var STORM_WINDOW_MS = 5000;
        var STORM_MIN       = 5;
        var STORM_HOLD_MS   = 15000;
        var STORM_LABEL     = 'Session dropped (many listeners denied at once)';
        var recentNew  = [];
        var stormUntil = 0;

        function isDenial(e) {
            if (!e) return false;
            if (typeof e === 'string') return /permission[-_ ]denied|Missing or insufficient permissions/i.test(e);
            if (e.name === 'NotAllowedError' || (typeof DOMException !== 'undefined' && e instanceof DOMException)) return false;
            var code = String(e.code || '');
            if (code === 'permission-denied' || code === 'PERMISSION_DENIED' ||
                code === 'storage/unauthorized' || code === 'auth/insufficient-permission') return true;
            return /permission[-_ ]denied|Missing or insufficient permissions/i.test(String(e.message || ''));
        }
        window._isRuleDenial = isDenial;

        function cut(s, n) { s = String(s == null ? '' : s); return s.length > n ? s.slice(0, n) + '…' : s; }

        function normPath(p) {
            return String(p || '').split('/').map(function (seg) {
                if (/^-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{15,}$/.test(seg)) return '{pushId}';
                if (/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{18,}$/.test(seg)) return '{id}';
                return seg;
            }).join('/');
        }

        function parseRtdbWarning(text) {
            var m = /FIREBASE WARNING:\s*(\w+)\s+at\s+(\/\S*)\s+failed:\s*([a-z_]+)/i.exec(String(text || ''));
            return m ? { op: m[1].toLowerCase(), path: m[2].replace(/^\//, ''), code: m[3] } : null;
        }

        function cleanLabel(s) {
            return String(s || '')
                .replace(/^\[\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}T[\d:.]+Z\]\s*/, '')
                .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
                .trim();
        }

        function hash(s) {
            var h = 5381, i = s.length;
            while (i) h = (h * 33) ^ s.charCodeAt(--i);
            return (h >>> 0).toString(36);
        }

        function myRole() {
            if (!window.myUID) return 'logged-out';
            if (window._myRole) return String(window._myRole);
            return window.isAdmin === true ? 'admin' : 'member';
        }

        function topFrames(err) {
            var st = (err && err.stack) || '';
            if (!st) return '';
            var lines = st.split(String.fromCharCode(10)).slice(1)
                .map(function (l) { return l.trim(); })
                .filter(function (l) { return l && l.indexOf('gstatic.com') === -1 && l.indexOf('firebasejs') === -1; });
            return cut(lines.slice(0, 4).join(' | '), 900);
        }

        function record(feature, err, meta) {
            try {
                 
                if (window._authTeardown) return;
                if (window._hasAuthUser === false) return;
                meta = meta || {};
                var role = myRole();
                var path = cut(normPath(meta.path || ''), 200);
                var op   = cut(meta.op || '', 40);
                feature  = cut(cleanLabel(feature) || 'unknown', 120);

                var key = feature + ' :: ' + (path || '?') + ' :: ' + (op || '?');
                var now = Date.now();
                if (now < stormUntil) return;

                var slot = seen[key];
                if (slot) {
                    slot.rec.count++;
                    if (now - slot.sentAt < RESEND_MS) { toast(); return; }
                } else {
                    if (Object.keys(seen).length >= MAX_ROWS) { toast(); return; }
                    recentNew = recentNew.filter(function (r) { return now - r.at < STORM_WINDOW_MS; });
                    recentNew.push({ key: key, at: now });
                    slot = seen[key] = { sentAt: 0, rec: {
                        key:      key,
                        feature:  feature,
                        path:     path,
                        op:       op,
                        code:     cut((err && err.code) || 'permission-denied', 60),
                        message:  cut((err && err.message) || String(err || ''), 300),
                        stack:    topFrames(err),
                        seenRole: role,
                        count:    1
                    } };
                }
                try { err.__ruleReported = 1; } catch (_) {}
                if (queue.indexOf(key) === -1) queue.push(key);
                if (recentNew.length >= STORM_MIN) { foldStorm(now); return; }
                schedule();
                toast();
            } catch (_) {   }
        }

        function foldStorm(now) {
            stormUntil = now + STORM_HOLD_MS;
            var hit = [];
            recentNew.forEach(function (r) {
                var qi = queue.indexOf(r.key);
                if (qi !== -1) queue.splice(qi, 1);
                var s = seen[r.key];
                if (s && !s.sentAt) {
                    hit.push(s.rec.feature + (s.rec.path ? ' ' + s.rec.path : ''));
                    delete seen[r.key];
                }
            });
            recentNew = [];
            var key = STORM_LABEL + ' :: ? :: storm';
            var slot = seen[key];
            if (slot) slot.rec.count++;
            else slot = seen[key] = { sentAt: 0, rec: {
                key: key, feature: STORM_LABEL, path: '', op: 'storm',
                code: 'permission-denied', message: cut(hit.join(' | '), 300),
                stack: '', seenRole: myRole(), count: 1
            } };
            if (queue.indexOf(key) === -1) queue.push(key);
            schedule();
            setTimeout(function () {
                if (window.myUID && window._hasAuthUser !== false && !window._authTeardown) showReconnect();
            }, 1500);
        }

        function showReconnect() {
            try {
                if (document.getElementById('echo-reconnect')) return;
                var b = document.createElement('div');
                b.id = 'echo-reconnect';
                b.setAttribute('role', 'alert');
                b.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:20px;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:2147483000;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:10px 10px 10px 16px;border-radius:14px;background:#161624;border:1px solid rgba(129,140,248,.45);color:#e8e8f0;font:600 13px/1.35 system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;box-shadow:0 12px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.5);max-width:calc(100vw - 32px)';
                var t = document.createElement('span');
                t.textContent = 'Lost connection to EchoSpace. Reload to get it back.';
                var btn = document.createElement('button');
                btn.type = 'button';
                btn.textContent = 'Reload';
                btn.style.cssText = 'flex-shrink:0;border:0;border-radius:10px;padding:7px 14px;background:#4f46e5;color:#fff;font:inherit;cursor:pointer';
                btn.onclick = function () { location.reload(); };
                b.appendChild(t); b.appendChild(btn);
                (document.body || document.documentElement).appendChild(b);
            } catch (_) {}
        }

        function toast() {
            var now = Date.now();
            if (now - lastToast < TOAST_MS) return;
            if (document.hidden) return;
            lastToast = now;
            try {
                if (typeof window.showCooldownToast === 'function') {
                    window.showCooldownToast("That didn't go through — it's been reported to the admins automatically.");
                }
            } catch (_) {}
        }

        function schedule() {
            if (flushTimer) return;
            flushTimer = setTimeout(function () { flushTimer = null; flush(); }, FLUSH_MS);
        }

        async function flush() {
            if (inFlush || !queue.length) return;
            if (!window.db || !window.myUID) { schedule(); return; }
            if (!window.myUsername) {
                if (!idWaitFrom) idWaitFrom = Date.now();
                if (Date.now() - idWaitFrom < 20000) { schedule(); return; }
            }
            inFlush = true;
            var batch = queue.splice(0, queue.length);
            try {
                var fs = await import('https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.11.0/firebase-firestore.js');
                var role = myRole();
                for (var i = 0; i < batch.length; i++) {
                    var slot = seen[batch[i]];
                    if (!slot) continue;
                    var r   = slot.rec;
                    var sig = r.key + ' :: ' + role;
                    var id  = 'd' + hash(sig);
                    try {
                        await fs.setDoc(fs.doc(window.db, COLL, id), {
                            sig: cut(sig, 400), feature: r.feature, path: r.path, op: r.op,
                            code: r.code, message: r.message, stack: r.stack,
                            role: role,
                            uid: window.myUID,
                            username: cut(window.myUsername || 'unknown', 60),
                            ver: String(window._APP_VERSION || ''),
                            url: cut((location.pathname + location.hash) || '/', 120),
                            count: fs.increment(r.count),
                            lastSeen: fs.serverTimestamp()
                        }, { merge: true });
                        slot.sentAt = Date.now();
                        r.count = 0;
                    } catch (e) {
                        if (isDenial(e)) {
                            if (!window.__ruleReportBlocked) {
                                window.__ruleReportBlocked = true;
                                (console.__origError || console.error)(
                                    '[RuleReport] cannot file reports: rules for /' + COLL + ' are not deployed.');
                            }
                            queue.length = 0;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
            } catch (_) {   }
            inFlush = false;
            if (queue.length) schedule();
        }

        window.reportRuleDenial = function (feature, err, meta) {
            if (!isDenial(err)) return false;
            record(feature, err, meta);
            return true;
        };

        window.fsWatch = function (feature, path, op, promise) {
            return Promise.resolve(promise).catch(function (e) {
                window.reportRuleDenial(feature, e, { path: path, op: op });
                throw e;
            });
        };

        ['warn', 'error'].forEach(function (level) {
            var orig = console[level].bind(console);
            if (level === 'error') console.__origError = orig;
            console[level] = function () {
                try {
                    var args = Array.prototype.slice.call(arguments), hit = null;
                    for (var i = 0; i < args.length; i++) {
                        if (isDenial(args[i])) { if (args[i] && args[i].__ruleReported) return orig.apply(console, arguments); hit = args[i]; break; }
                    }
                    if (hit && !window.__ruleReportBlocked) {
                        var label = '', rtdb = null;
                        for (var j = 0; j < args.length; j++) {
                            if (typeof args[j] !== 'string') continue;
                            if (!rtdb) rtdb = parseRtdbWarning(args[j]);
                            if (!label && args[j].length > 2) label = args[j];
                        }
                        record(label || ('console.' + level),
                               typeof hit === 'string' ? new Error(hit) : hit,
                               rtdb ? { path: rtdb.path, op: 'rtdb ' + rtdb.op } : { op: 'console' });
                    }
                } catch (_) {}
                return orig.apply(console, arguments);
            };
        });

        window.addEventListener('unhandledrejection', function (ev) {
            var r = ev && ev.reason;
            if (isDenial(r) && !window.__ruleReportBlocked) record('Unhandled rejection', r, { op: 'unhandled' });
        });

        window._ruleDenialsSeen = function () {
            return Object.keys(seen).map(function (k) { return seen[k].rec; });
        };
    })();
    </script>

    <script>
    window._activeListeners = new Map();
    
    window.registerListener = function(id, unsubscribe) {
        if (window._activeListeners.has(id)) {
            console.warn(`[Listeners] Listener "${id}" already registered, cleaning up old one...`);
            try {
                window._activeListeners.get(id)();
            } catch (e) {
                console.error(`[Listeners] Error cleaning old listener "${id}":`, e);
            }
        }
        window._activeListeners.set(id, unsubscribe);
        console.log(`[Listeners] ✓ Registered listener: "${id}"`);
    };

    window.unregisterListener = function(id) {
        if (window._activeListeners.has(id)) {
            try {
                window._activeListeners.get(id)();
                window._activeListeners.delete(id);
                console.log(`[Listeners] ✓ Unregistered listener: "${id}"`);
            } catch (e) {
                console.error(`[Listeners] Error unregistering "${id}":`, e);
            }
        }
    };

    window.cleanupAllListeners = function() {
        console.log(`[Listeners] Cleaning up ${window._activeListeners.size} listeners...`);
        for (const [id, unsub] of window._activeListeners.entries()) {
            try {
                unsub();
            } catch (e) {
                console.error(`[Listeners] Error cleaning listener "${id}":`, e);
            }
        }
        window._activeListeners.clear();
        console.log(`[Listeners] ✓ All listeners cleaned`);
    };

    window.addEventListener('beforeunload', window.cleanupAllListeners);
    </script>

    
    <script>
    window.isUltravioletReady = function() {
        return typeof __uv$config !== 'undefined' && typeof Ultraviolet !== 'undefined';
    };

    window.launchBrowser = function (targetUrl) {
        var url = String(targetUrl || '').trim();
        if (!url) { console.warn('[Browser] No URL provided'); return; }
        if (!window.EchoBrowser) { console.warn('[Browser] chrome not loaded'); return; }
        window.EchoBrowser.open(url);
    };
    </script>

           declaration here is !important so no global utility class, dark-mode
           rule, or leftover Tailwind reset can tint it either. The one exception
           is #gate-hint's `display`, which stays non-important on purpose — the
           unlock code reveals it with an inline style, and an !important rule
           here would beat that and the hint would never appear. */
        /* :not(.hidden) is load-bearing. A flat `display:block !important` here
           outranks Tailwind's `.hidden { display:none }` — which is not important —
           so the cloak could never be dismissed and sat over the whole app forever.
           Scoping the display rule to the un-hidden state lets .hidden win again. */
        #security-gate:not(.hidden) { display: block !important; }

        /* width/height are pinned in CSS on purpose. A <canvas> with no CSS size

           the viewport makes the CSS size independent of the backing store and
           breaks the loop at the source. */
        #mouse-trail {

        /* .admin-grid was declared twice — this second copy set display:grid and, being

        /* ── Full-screen lyrics (desktop) ──────────────────────────────────
           #lyrics-container is physically MOVED into #lyrics-fs-stage on open and
           moved back on close, so every existing sync path (#l-N lookups,
           scrollIntoView, spicy word ticks) keeps working with zero changes. */
        /* Kept in the layout at all times and hidden with visibility/opacity rather
           than display. Toggling `display` in the same frame as `opacity` skips the
           transition entirely, which is why open/close used to hard-cut. */

        /* ── Intro countdown ──────────────────────────────────────────────
           Sits over the lyrics during the run-up to the first line. The dots
           bob gently while there's a while to wait, then light one by one as
           the entry approaches, and bloom outward as the first lyric lands. */

            display: none; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 20px;
            pointer-events: none;
        }
        /* Faded in with a keyframe, not a transition. Going from display:none to
           displayed gives a transition no start value to run from, so pairing the
           two would snap (or, worse, stick) instead of fading. */
        #lyric-countdown.on { display: flex; animation: lcdIn 0.45s ease both; }
        @keyframes lcdIn { from { opacity: 0; } to { opacity: 1; } }
        .lcd-dot {
            position: relative;
            width: 15px; height: 15px; border-radius: 50%;
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.46);
            animation: lcdBob 2.1s ease-in-out infinite;
            /* Colour only. Sizes change via media queries, and transitioning
               width/height would relayout the row on every beat. */
            transition: background-color 0.26s ease, box-shadow 0.26s ease;
            will-change: transform;
        }
        .lcd-dot:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 0.22s; }
        .lcd-dot:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 0.44s; }
        /* The slow rise-and-fall — a held breath, not a busy spinner. */
        @keyframes lcdBob {
            0%, 100% { transform: translateY(6px); }
            50%      { transform: translateY(-10px); }
        }
        .lcd-dot.lit {
            background: rgb(var(--mus-accent-rgb, 129,140,248));
            box-shadow: 0 0 22px rgba(var(--mus-accent-rgb, 129,140,248), 0.65);
        }
        /* The ring lives on a pseudo-element. Putting it on the dot itself meant
           adding a second animation to an element already running the bob, which
           restarts the bob from frame zero — the dot visibly jumped each beat. */
        .lcd-dot::after {
            content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: 50%;
            pointer-events: none; opacity: 0;
        }
        .lcd-dot.lit-now::after { animation: lcdPop 0.62s ease-out; }
        @keyframes lcdPop {

        /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
           🔧 DEV NOTE — POLLS (UI needs full revamp + winner announcement)
           ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

           ISSUE 1 — Poll card UI needs redesign:
             Current look is basic. Suggested improvements:
             - Bigger question text, bolder presence at top of card
             - Animated fill bars (CSS transition on width change)
             - Show voter avatars/count per option (small pfp stack or "+N voted")
             - Color the winning bar differently (gold/green) while poll is active
             - Show a "CLOSED" badge + lock icon when expired
             - Show time remaining as a live countdown (e.g. "Ends in 2h 14m")
               using setInterval, not just a static endsAt timestamp

           ISSUE 2 — Poll end time is stored but never enforced:
             `poll.endsAt` is saved to Firestore but nothing checks it.
             Need to: (a) in the poll renderer, compare Date.now() to endsAt
             and if past, disable voting + show "Poll ended" state;
             (b) announce the winner via a system message when the poll closes.
             Options for (b):
               - Cloud Function triggered on endsAt (cleanest, needs backend)
               - Client-side: when any user renders the poll card and sees it
                 expired + no winner announced yet, that client sends the system
                 message and sets poll.closed = true (race condition risk,
                 add a `poll.winnerAnnounced` flag to guard it)

           ISSUE 3 — No winner announcement:
             When a poll ends there is zero notification. Fix: check on render
             if poll.endsAt < now && !poll.winnerAnnounced, find the option
             with the most voters, post a system message like:
             "📊 Poll closed! Winner: [option] with X votes"
             then set poll.winnerAnnounced = true via updateDoc.

           ISSUE 4 — Duration chip resets aren't wired to openPollModal reset:
             Already partially fixed — selectPollDuration() is called on chip
             click and _pollDurationHours is set. Confirm it resets to 0 / 
             "No limit" chip active every time the modal opens fresh.
           ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

        /* Masonry, not a grid. A grid forces every GIF into one identical box,
           which means a tall GIF and a wide GIF get the same slot — so one gets
           cropped into a band and the other floats in empty bars. Columns let
           each GIF keep its own height at full column width, which is what a
           GIF picker is supposed to look like. */
        /* Height MUST stay auto. A multi-column box with a definite height fills
           its columns and then spills into new ones sideways, which turns the
           picker into a horizontal scroller. The parent does the scrolling. */
        #gif-grid { display: block; column-count: 3; column-gap: 6px; height: auto; }

        /* ── Flagged overlay on small media ──────────────────────────────
           The overlay is inset:0 inside a wrap with overflow:hidden, so on a
           short or narrow image the badge and the "View anyway" button were
           simply cut off — leaving no way to reveal the image at all. Two
           defences: a floor on the blurred wrap so there is always somewhere
           to put a button, and progressive compaction that sheds the optional
           text before it sheds the control. The button is the one thing that
           must survive every size. */
        .emss-wrap.emss-blur {
            /* min() so the floor can never push the card wider than its bubble.
               A bare min-width would win over max-width:100% and overflow on a
               narrow phone. */

        /* ── "X is typing" indicator ─────────────────────────────────────────
           Was a flat grey strip with square corners and Tailwind's stock
           animate-bounce — three dots hopping in unison on a linear curve, which
           is the tell of a default. Now it's shaped like an actual incoming
           message: same rounded bubble with the tail corner, tinted indigo, and
           the dots travel as a WAVE (staggered, eased, scaling as they rise) so
           it reads as someone composing rather than a loading spinner. */
        #typing-bar.typing-bar { padding:2px 16px 7px; background:transparent; }
        .typing-bubble {
            display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;
            background:linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(99,102,241,.17), rgba(99,102,241,.07));
            border:1px solid rgba(129,140,248,.15);
            /* Tail on the bottom-left, matching a received message bubble. */
            border-radius:16px 16px 16px 5px;
            padding:8px 14px;
            box-shadow:0 2px 14px rgba(79,70,229,.10), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.03);
            animation:tyIn .3s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1);
        }
        @keyframes tyIn {
            from { opacity:0; transform:translateY(7px) scale(.95); }
            to   { opacity:1; transform:none; }
        }
        .typing-dots { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:5px; }
        .typing-dots > span {
            width:7px; height:7px; border-radius:50%;
            background:linear-gradient(180deg, #a5b4fc, #818cf8);
            animation:tyWave 1.3s cubic-bezier(.36,.07,.25,1) infinite;
        }
        .typing-dots > span:nth-child(2) { animation-delay:.17s; }
        .typing-dots > span:nth-child(3) { animation-delay:.34s; }
        /* Long trough, short crest — the dot spends most of the cycle at rest and
           snaps up briefly, which is what makes it a wave instead of a hop. */
        @keyframes tyWave {
            0%, 62%, 100% { transform:translateY(0) scale(.82); opacity:.45; }
            31%           { transform:translateY(-5px) scale(1); opacity:1; }
        }
        .typing-label {
            font-size:11.5px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.01em;
            color:#a5b4fc; font-style:normal;
        }
        .typing-label #typing-name { font-weight:800; color:#c7d2fe; }
        

        /* ── Chat loading skeleton ───────────────────────────────────────────
           Ghost conversation, not a spinner: avatars, alternating sides, varied
           widths and heights, ending on a live typing indicator.

           The motion is the part that matters. Each bubble shimmering on its own
           timer is the stock look and reads as cheap, so instead the bubbles hold a
           soft static gradient and ONE diagonal sheen sweeps across the whole panel
           over the top of them — the rows are lit by a single light source passing
           by. Rows also rise and fade in on mount, staggered, so the skeleton
           assembles itself rather than snapping in. */
        /* Fills the message pane. Previously the container was only as tall as its rows, so
           it stopped a third of the way down a desktop chat and the sheen — clipped to that
           short box — drew a hard rectangular edge across the panel. */
        .chat-skel {
            padding:8px 2px; position:relative; overflow:hidden;
            display:flex; flex-direction:column;
            flex:1 1 auto; min-height:0; height:100%;
        }
        /* Pinned to the bottom of the pane, so the typing bubble is always visible no matter
           how many ghost rows fit above it. */
        .chat-skel .cs-row.cs-typing { margin-top:auto; }

        /* Compact variant for "load older messages". Hugs the top of the pane rather than
           filling it — older messages arrive above, so that's where the placeholder belongs —
           and fades out at its lower edge so it reads as content continuing off-screen rather
           than a block that stops. Faster sweep, since it's on screen for half as long. */
        .chat-skel.chat-skel-more {
            height:auto; flex:0 0 auto; min-height:0; padding:2px 2px 4px;
            -webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(180deg, #000 0%, #000 62%, transparent 100%);
                    mask-image:linear-gradient(180deg, #000 0%, #000 62%, transparent 100%);
        }
        .chat-skel.chat-skel-more::after { animation-duration:.95s; }
        .chat-skel.chat-skel-more .cs-row { margin:10px 0; }
        .chat-skel .cs-row {
            display:flex; align-items:flex-end; gap:8px; margin:12px 0;
            opacity:0; transform:translateY(6px);
            animation:csRise .42s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) forwards;
        }
        .chat-skel .cs-row.cs-me { justify-content:flex-end; }
        .chat-skel .cs-row:nth-child(1) { animation-delay:.02s; }
        .chat-skel .cs-row:nth-child(2) { animation-delay:.09s; }
        .chat-skel .cs-row:nth-child(3) { animation-delay:.16s; }
        .chat-skel .cs-row:nth-child(4) { animation-delay:.23s; }
        .chat-skel .cs-row:nth-child(5) { animation-delay:.30s; }
        .chat-skel .cs-row:nth-child(6) { animation-delay:.37s; }
        .chat-skel .cs-row:nth-child(7) { animation-delay:.44s; }
        .chat-skel .cs-row:nth-child(8) { animation-delay:.51s; }
        .chat-skel .cs-row:nth-child(9) { animation-delay:.58s; }
        .chat-skel .cs-row:nth-child(10) { animation-delay:.65s; }
        @keyframes csRise { to { opacity:1; transform:translateY(0); } }

        /* Avatar puck — only on received rows, mirroring the real thread. */
        .chat-skel .cs-av {
            width:26px; height:26px; border-radius:50%; flex-shrink:0;
            background:radial-gradient(circle at 32% 28%, rgba(129,140,248,.30), rgba(99,102,241,.10) 70%);
            border:1px solid rgba(99,102,241,.12);
        }
        .chat-skel .cs-bub {
            /* --max is PER ROW. A single shared cap made every bubble pin to the same
               width on a wide screen and the varied-width illusion collapsed into
               identical bars. Each row keeps a ceiling proportional to its width, so
               the shape holds from 320px to 4K. */
            width:clamp(84px, var(--w, 60%), var(--max, 340px));
            height:var(--h, 34px);
            border-radius:16px;
            background:linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(99,102,241,.10), rgba(99,102,241,.05));
            border:1px solid rgba(99,102,241,.07);
            box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.02);
        }
        .chat-skel .cs-row.cs-me .cs-bub {
            background:linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(79,70,229,.22), rgba(79,70,229,.10));
            border-color:rgba(129,140,248,.12);
        }

        /* The single travelling sheen. blend mode keeps it reading as light falling
           across the shapes instead of a grey bar sliding over them. */
        .chat-skel::after {
            content:''; position:absolute; top:-20%; bottom:-20%; left:0; width:55%;
            pointer-events:none; mix-blend-mode:screen;
            background:linear-gradient(100deg,
                rgba(255,255,255,0) 0%, rgba(190,190,255,.05) 38%,
                rgba(199,210,254,.13) 50%, rgba(190,190,255,.05) 62%, rgba(255,255,255,0) 100%);
            filter:blur(1px);
            /* 1.5s, tuned against the open delay below: the sweep completes one full pass
               (it travels during the first ~65% of the cycle) inside the window the skeleton
               is on screen, so you always see a whole one rather than a clipped fragment. */
            animation:csSheen 1.5s cubic-bezier(.45,.05,.35,1) infinite;
        }
        @keyframes csSheen {
            0%   { transform:translateX(-110%); }
            65%  { transform:translateX(230%); }
            100% { transform:translateX(230%); }
        }

        /* Typing indicator closes the skeleton — the one element that genuinely

        /* ── "Older messages" divider ────────────────────────────────────────
           Replaces a full-width indigo slab. This is the pattern every chat app
           lands on for a reason: a hairline rule across the column with a small
           pill centred on it reads as a seam in the timeline rather than a form
           control bolted to the top of the list. The lines are gradients that
           fade out at the far edges so the rule doesn't collide with the column
           border. */

            display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; flex-shrink:0;
            font-size:11px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.02em; color:#8b8bb8;

            document.cookie = 'googtrans=; expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 UTC; path=/;';
            document.cookie = 'googtrans=; expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 UTC; path=/; domain=.' + location.hostname;

        const combo = document.querySelector('.goog-te-combo');
        if (combo) { combo.value = lang; combo.dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); }
        else { location.reload(); }
    };

<script>
(function () {
    var m = document.getElementById('trailer-modal'), v = document.getElementById('trailer-video');
    var SRC = { vertical: 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/Thatboisaywhat/course-assets@0ba6fbf/a/v/p.mp4', landscape: 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/Thatboisaywhat/course-assets@0ba6fbf/a/v/l.mp4' };
    function show(o, at) {
        m.setAttribute('data-o', o);
        m.querySelectorAll('.tm-seg button').forEach(function (b) { b.classList.toggle('on', b.getAttribute('data-o') === o); });
        v.src = SRC[o];
        if (at) v.addEventListener('loadedmetadata', function () { try { v.currentTime = at; } catch (e) {} }, { once: true });
        v.play().catch(function () {});
    }
    window._openTrailer = function () {
        m.classList.add('on');
        show(innerWidth > innerHeight ? 'landscape' : 'vertical', 0);
    };
    window._closeTrailer = function () {
        v.pause(); v.removeAttribute('src'); v.load();
        m.classList.remove('on');
    };
    m.querySelectorAll('.tm-seg button').forEach(function (b) {
        b.onclick = function () { if (b.getAttribute('data-o') !== m.getAttribute('data-o')) show(b.getAttribute('data-o'), v.currentTime || 0); };
    });
    document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) { if (e.key === 'Escape' && m.classList.contains('on')) window._closeTrailer(); });
})();
</script>

<script>
    document.getElementById('echospace-loader').style.display = 'flex';
    document.getElementById('echospace-loader').classList.remove('hidden');
    window._loaderStuckTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        const el = document.getElementById('loader-stuck-msg');
        if (el) el.classList.remove('hidden');
        window.EchoNet && window.EchoNet.check('loader-stuck');
    }, 25000);
    window._forceHideLoader = function () {
        if (window._loaderStuckTimer) { clearTimeout(window._loaderStuckTimer); window._loaderStuckTimer = null; }
        var el = document.getElementById('echospace-loader');
        if (el) {
            el.style.transition = ''; el.style.opacity = '';
            el.style.display = 'none';
            el.classList.add('hidden');
        }
        var stuck = document.getElementById('loader-stuck-msg');
        if (stuck) stuck.classList.add('hidden');
    };
</script>
<script>
(function () {
    var raf = null;
    function fit() {
        raf = null;
        var screenEl = document.getElementById('auth-screen');
        var ring = document.querySelector('#auth-screen .auth-card-ring');
        if (!screenEl || !ring || screenEl.classList.contains('hidden')) return;
        ring.style.transform = '';
        var need = ring.getBoundingClientRect().height + 24;
        var have = window.innerHeight;
        var k = need > have ? Math.max(0.62, have / need) : 1;
        ring.style.transformOrigin = 'center center';
        ring.style.transform = k < 1 ? 'scale(' + k.toFixed(3) + ')' : '';
        ring.style.margin = k < 1 ? (((k - 1) * need) / 2) + 'px 0' : '';
    }
    function queue() { if (!raf) raf = requestAnimationFrame(fit); }
    window._authFit = queue;
    window.addEventListener('resize', queue);
    window.addEventListener('orientationchange', queue);
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
        queue();
        var scr = document.getElementById('auth-screen');
        if (scr && window.MutationObserver) {
            new MutationObserver(queue).observe(scr, { attributes: true, childList: true, subtree: true, attributeFilter: ['class', 'style'] });
        }
    });
    setTimeout(queue, 400); setTimeout(queue, 1500);
})();
</script>

       The footer used hardcoded Tailwind arbitrary values (border-[#1e1e2e] and a
       bg-[#0a0a15] card). The theme engine only overrides .panel and #sidebar, so
       those two stayed near-black on EVERY theme — which read as a dark band and a

       that sit on top of whatever the panel colour currently is, so the footer
       blends on light and dark alike. !important because the theme engine's own
       rules are !important (see the theme block near the bottom of this file). */
    /* No separator line here at all — the card's own outline is enough separation,
       and anything drawn in this strip reads as a smudge under the profile card.

    #view-empty { display: none; }
    /* align-items:center (from the Tailwind classes) clips the top of the content once
       it is taller than the pane — the hero scrolled out of reach and could not be
       scrolled back to. Auto margins on the child centre it without ever clipping. */
    #view-empty.active { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-start; }
    #view-empty { position: relative; }
    /* The cursor spotlight is applied as an INLINE background-image by JS (see
       _echoHomeGlow), deliberately not as a rule in this stylesheet.
       Two things forced that:
         1. A separate glow layer has to sit under the panels but over the page
            background. Scoping it to #home-wrap (860px cap) or #view-empty clipped
            it at the 12px gutter round the sidebar and left a hard seam.
         2. The theme engine walks this document's own stylesheets and re-emits every
            painting rule as `body.echo-themed <selector>` with !important — which
            beats anything written here on both specificity and order. So a rule
            making #main-content transparent was silently repainted opaque on every
            non-default theme, burying the glow. That is why it looked fine on the
            default theme and broken on the others.
       A background-IMAGE renders above the element's own background-colour, so the
       theme keeps its colour and the glow sits on top of it; background-attachment:
       fixed anchors the gradient to the viewport so it lines up seamlessly across
       the page and the content area. Inline + !important cannot be overridden. */

                <script>
                (function(){
                    window.cgUpdateBtn = function() {
                        const name = (document.getElementById('group-name')?.value || '').trim();
                        const checked = document.querySelectorAll('.group-select:checked').length;
                        const btn = document.getElementById('cg-create-btn');
                        const badge = document.getElementById('cg-count-badge');
                        if (!btn) return;
                        btn.disabled = !(name && checked > 0);
                        if (badge) {
                            badge.textContent = checked > 0 ? checked : '';
                            badge.classList.toggle('show', checked > 0);
                        }
                    };

                    window.cgToggleFriend = function(uid, name, pfp, checkbox) {
                        checkbox.checked = !checkbox.checked;
                        const row = checkbox.closest('.cg-friend-row');
                        row.classList.toggle('selected', checkbox.checked);
                        cgRenderChips();
                        cgUpdateBtn();
                    };

                    window.cgRenderChips = function() {
                        const chips = document.getElementById('cg-chips-row');
                        if (!chips) return;
                        const checked = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.group-select:checked'));
                        chips.style.display = checked.length ? 'flex' : 'none';
                        chips.innerHTML = checked.map(c => {
                            const n = c.dataset.name || 'User';
                            const p = c.dataset.pfp || '';
                            const initial = n.charAt(0).toUpperCase();
                            const avatarHtml = p
                                ? `<img src="${p}" class="" style="width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;">`
                                : `<div class="cg-chip-avatar">${initial}</div>`;
                            return `<div class="cg-chip">${avatarHtml}<span>${window.escHtml ? window.escHtml(n) : n}</span><button class="cg-chip-remove" onclick="cgRemoveChip('${c.value}')" title="Remove">✕</button></div>`;
                        }).join('');
                    };

                    window.cgRemoveChip = function(uid) {
                        const cb = document.querySelector(`.group-select[value="${uid}"]`);
                        if (cb) { cb.checked = false; cb.closest('.cg-friend-row')?.classList.remove('selected'); }
                        cgRenderChips();
                        cgUpdateBtn();
                    };

                    window.cgFilterFriends = function(q) {
                        const rows = document.querySelectorAll('#group-friend-list .cg-friend-row');
                        const term = q.toLowerCase();
                        rows.forEach(r => {
                            const name = r.querySelector('.cg-fr-name')?.textContent.toLowerCase() || '';
                            r.style.display = name.includes(term) ? '' : 'none';
                        });
                    };
                })();
                </script>
            </div>

            <style>
              /* Pseudo-fullscreen for the games view. Not the Fullscreen API:
                 that makes the browser announce "<host> is now full screen",
                 which paints the hosting domain across the screen every time
                 anyone hits fullscreen inside a game. This covers the same
                 pixels short of the browser's own toolbar and announces
                 nothing. Driven by a postMessage from the hub. */
              #view-games.games-fs{position:fixed!important;inset:0!important;
                margin:0!important;border-radius:0!important;border:none!important;
                box-shadow:none!important;z-index:2147483000!important;
                width:100vw!important;height:100vh!important;height:100dvh!important}
              html.games-fs-on, html.games-fs-on body{overflow:hidden!important}

              /* Notifications that survive fullscreen.
                 While an element is fullscreen the browser paints ONLY that
                 element's descendants — the app's own toasts and the incoming
                 call modal live elsewhere in the tree, so inside a fullscreen
                 game they are invisible. The element we fullscreen is ours, so
                 these are parented INSIDE it and come along. */
              #games-fs-toasts{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:2147483600;
                display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:8px;
                padding:14px 12px 0;pointer-events:none}
              #games-fs-toasts .gt{pointer-events:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;
                max-width:min(430px,92%);padding:10px 14px 10px 11px;border-radius:14px;
                background:rgba(14,14,22,.72);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);
                backdrop-filter:blur(14px) saturate(1.3);
                -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px) saturate(1.3);
                box-shadow:0 14px 40px -12px rgba(0,0,0,.8);color:#fff;
                cursor:pointer;position:relative;overflow:hidden;
                animation:gtIn .32s cubic-bezier(.2,1.3,.4,1),
                          gtPulse 1.05s ease-out 3;
                animation-fill-mode:none,both}
              /* Somebody staring at a game is not looking at the top of the
                 screen. The pill pulses bright three times when it lands, then
                 settles down to the calm state -- enough to catch the eye in
                 peripheral vision without sitting there strobing for the whole
                 six seconds. A sweep of light runs across it on the same beat. */
              #games-fs-toasts .gt::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;
                border-radius:inherit;pointer-events:none;
                background:linear-gradient(105deg,transparent 30%,
                  rgba(255,255,255,.28) 48%,transparent 66%);
                transform:translateX(-120%);
                animation:gtSweep 1.05s ease-out 3}
              #games-fs-toasts .gt.out{animation:gtOut .22s ease-in forwards}
              #games-fs-toasts .gt-ic{flex:0 0 auto;width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:11px;
                display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:15px;
                background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);overflow:hidden}
              #games-fs-toasts .gt-ic img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
              #games-fs-toasts .gt-tx{min-width:0}
              #games-fs-toasts .gt-t{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.01em;
                white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
              #games-fs-toasts .gt-b{font-size:11.5px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.72);
                white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;margin-top:1px}
              /* A call is not a message: it stays until it is dealt with. */
              /* A call gets a colder, brighter pulse and keeps pulsing for
                 eight beats -- it is worth interrupting for, and it holds on
                 screen far longer than a message does. */
              #games-fs-toasts .gt.call{background:rgba(20,10,30,.8);
                border-color:rgba(147,197,253,.35);
                animation:gtIn .32s cubic-bezier(.2,1.3,.4,1),
                          gtCallPulse 1.05s ease-out 8}
              #games-fs-toasts .gt.call::after{animation:gtSweep 1.05s ease-out 8}
              #games-fs-toasts .gt.call .gt-ic{background:rgba(59,130,246,.25)}
              #games-fs-toasts .gt-go{flex:0 0 auto;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;
                text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;color:#93c5fd;
                padding-left:6px}
              @keyframes gtIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-14px) scale(.96)}
                to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
              @keyframes gtOut{to{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-10px) scale(.97)}}
              /* The flash. Border and glow do the work rather than the
                 background, so the text underneath stays readable at the peak
                 instead of washing out. */
              @keyframes gtPulse{
                0%,100%{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.14);
                  box-shadow:0 14px 40px -12px rgba(0,0,0,.8)}
                18%{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.92);
                  box-shadow:0 14px 40px -12px rgba(0,0,0,.8),
                             0 0 0 3px rgba(255,255,255,.22),
                             0 0 34px 6px rgba(255,255,255,.36)}}
              @keyframes gtCallPulse{
                0%,100%{border-color:rgba(147,197,253,.35);
                  box-shadow:0 14px 40px -12px rgba(0,0,0,.8)}
                18%{border-color:rgba(191,219,254,1);
                  box-shadow:0 14px 40px -12px rgba(0,0,0,.8),
                             0 0 0 4px rgba(59,130,246,.4),
                             0 0 44px 10px rgba(59,130,246,.6)}}
              @keyframes gtSweep{
                0%{transform:translateX(-120%)}
                55%,100%{transform:translateX(120%)}}
              /* Someone who asked the OS for less motion still needs to know
                 the phone is ringing, so the pill stays lit rather than
                 flashing: the signal survives, the strobe does not. */

                <script>
                    window.ECHO_EFFORT_LEVELS = [
                        { key: 'low',    name: 'Low',    engine: 'fast',     hint: 'Short, quick answers. Best for simple questions.' },
                        { key: 'medium', name: 'Medium', engine: 'fast',     hint: 'Even mix of speed and depth.' },
                        { key: 'extra',  name: 'Extra',  engine: 'thinking', hint: 'Thinks a bit longer and explains more.' },
                        { key: 'max',    name: 'Max',    engine: 'thinking', hint: 'Thorough. Noticeably slower to reply.' },
                        { key: 'ultra',  name: 'Ultra',  engine: 'swarm',    hint: 'Deepest thinking. Slowest to reply — save it for hard problems.' }
                    ];
                    window.getEchoEffort = () => {
                        const i = parseInt(localStorage.getItem('echoai_effort') ?? '1', 10);
                        return window.ECHO_EFFORT_LEVELS[isNaN(i) ? 1 : Math.max(0, Math.min(4, i))];
                    };
                    window.setEchoEffort = (idx) => {
                        const i = Math.max(0, Math.min(4, parseInt(idx, 10) || 0));
                        const lvl = window.ECHO_EFFORT_LEVELS[i];
                        localStorage.setItem('echoai_effort', String(i));
                        const v = document.getElementById('eff-value');
                        const h = document.getElementById('eff-hint');
                        const w = document.getElementById('eff-wrap');
                        if (v) v.innerText = lvl.name;
                        if (h) h.innerText = lvl.hint;
                        if (w) {
                            w.dataset.level = String(i);
                            const f = document.getElementById('eff-fill');
                            if (f) f.style.setProperty('--eff-pct', `calc(${(i / 4) * 100}% + ${7.5 - (i / 4) * 15}px)`);
                        }
                        try { if (typeof window.selectMode === 'function') window.selectMode(lvl.engine); } catch (_) {}
                        const ml = document.getElementById('mode-label');
                        if (ml) ml.innerText = lvl.name;
                        try {
                            if (window.myUID && window.db && window.updateDoc && window.doc) {
                                window.updateDoc(window.doc(window.db, 'users', window.myUID), { echoaiEffort: lvl.key }).catch(() => {});
                            }
                        } catch (_) {}
                    };
                    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
                        const box = document.getElementById('eff-boxes');
                        if (box && !box.children.length) {
                            for (let n = 0; n < 180; n++) {
                                const b = document.createElement('span');
                                b.className = 'eff-box';
                                b.style.animationDelay = (Math.random() * 2.6).toFixed(2) + 's';
                                b.style.animationDuration = (2 + Math.random() * 1.6).toFixed(2) + 's';
                                box.appendChild(b);
                            }
                        }
                        const i = parseInt(localStorage.getItem('echoai_effort') ?? '1', 10);
                        const r = document.getElementById('eff-range');
                        if (r) { r.value = String(isNaN(i) ? 1 : i); window.setEchoEffort(r.value); }
                    });

                    if (window.innerWidth < 768) {
                        document.getElementById('echoai-sidebar')?.classList.add('hidden');
                    }
                </script>

<script type="module">
(function () {
    function _stash(id) {
        const el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (!el || !el.parentNode) return null;
        const stashed = { el, parent: el.parentNode, next: el.nextSibling };
        stashed.parent.removeChild(el);
        return stashed;
    }
    window.__stashedAdminPanel = _stash('view-admin');
    window.__stashedSubadminPanel = _stash('view-subadmin');
})();

function escHtml(str) { return String(str ?? '').replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;').replace(/"/g,'&quot;'); }

function mdSafe(md, streaming) {
    const src = String(md ?? '');
    if (!src) return '';
    const ex = window.EchoMath ? window.EchoMath.extract(src, !!streaming) : { text: src, items: [] };
    const fill = (html) => (ex.items.length ? window.EchoMath.fill(html, ex.items) : html);
    if (typeof marked === 'undefined') return fill(escHtml(ex.text));
    const html = marked.parse(ex.text);
    if (typeof DOMPurify === 'undefined') { console.error('[mdSafe] DOMPurify missing — escaping instead'); return fill(escHtml(ex.text)); }
    return fill(DOMPurify.sanitize(html, {
        ADD_TAGS: ['details', 'summary'],
        FORBID_TAGS: ['style', 'form', 'input', 'button'],
        FORBID_ATTR: ['style', 'srcset', 'formaction']
    }));
}
window.mdSafe = mdSafe;
window.escHtml = escHtml;
function escAttr(str) {
    return String(str ?? '')
        .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
        .replace(/\\/g, '\\\\')
        .replace(/'/g, "\\'")
        .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
        .replace(/\r/g, '\\r')
        .replace(/\n/g, '\\n');
}
window.escAttr = escAttr;

const EchoMath = (() => {
    const BASE = 'https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/KaTeX/0.16.11';
    const JS_SRI = 'sha384-7zkQWkzuo3B5mTepMUcHkMB5jZaolc2xDwL6VFqjFALcbeS9Ggm/Yr2r3Dy4lfFg';
    const CSS_SRI = 'sha384-nB0miv6/jRmo5UMMR1wu3Gz6NLsoTkbqJghGIsx//Rlm+ZU03BU6SQNC66uf4l5+';
    const PH = '⁣';
    const PH_RE = /⁣EM(\d+)⁣/g;
    const cache = new Map();
    const docs = new Set();
    let loading = null;
    const esc = (s) => String(s ?? '').replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;');

    const SYMBOLS = {
        times: '×', div: '÷', cdot: '·', pm: '±', mp: '∓', le: '≤', leq: '≤', ge: '≥', geq: '≥',
        neq: '≠', ne: '≠', approx: '≈', infty: '∞', pi: 'π', theta: 'θ', alpha: 'α', beta: 'β',
        degree: '°', circ: '°', to: '→', rightarrow: '→', Rightarrow: '⇒', ldots: '…', cdots: '⋯',
        percent: '%', left: '', right: '', quad: ' ', qquad: '  '
    };

    function plain(tex) {
        const wrap = (x) => (/^[\w.]+$/.test(x.trim()) ? x.trim() : '(' + x.trim() + ')');
        let s = String(tex);
        for (let n = 0; n < 4; n++) {
            s = s.replace(/\\[dt]?frac\s*\{([^{}]*)\}\s*\{([^{}]*)\}/g, (_, a, b) => wrap(a) + '/' + wrap(b))
                 .replace(/\\sqrt\s*\[([^\]]*)\]\s*\{([^{}]*)\}/g, (_, r, a) => r + '√' + wrap(a))
                 .replace(/\\sqrt\s*\{([^{}]*)\}/g, (_, a) => '√' + wrap(a))
                 .replace(/\\(?:text|mathrm|mathbf|operatorname)\s*\{([^{}]*)\}/g, '$1');
        }
        return s.replace(/\\([a-zA-Z]+)/g, (m, name) => (name in SYMBOLS ? SYMBOLS[name] : name))
                .replace(/\^\{([^{}]*)\}/g, '^$1').replace(/_\{([^{}]*)\}/g, '_$1')
                .replace(/\\([{}$%&#_ ,;!:])/g, '$1').replace(/[{}]/g, '').trim();
    }

    function group(s, i) {
        if (s[i] !== '{') return -1;
        let d = 0;
        for (let j = i; j < s.length && j < i + 800; j++) {
            if (s[j] === '\\') { j++; continue; }
            if (s[j] === '{') d++;
            else if (s[j] === '}' && --d === 0) return j + 1;
        }
        return -1;
    }

    function inlineClose(s, i) {
        if (s[i + 1] === undefined || /\s/.test(s[i + 1])) return -1;
        for (let j = i + 1; j < s.length && j < i + 400; j++) {
            const ch = s[j];
            if (ch === '\n') return -1;
            if (ch === '\\') { j++; continue; }
            if (ch !== '$') continue;
            if (/\s/.test(s[j - 1])) return -1;
            if (/\d/.test(s[j + 1] || '')) return -1;
            const body = s.slice(i + 1, j);
            if (!/[\\^_{}=+\-*/<>()|]|^[a-zA-Z]{1,2}$|^\d+(?:\.\d+)?$/.test(body)) return -1;
            return j;
        }
        return -1;
    }

    function parenClose(s, i) {
        let d = 0;
        for (let j = i; j < s.length && j < i + 500; j++) {
            const ch = s[j];
            if (ch === '\n') return -1;
            if (ch === '\\') { j++; continue; }
            if (ch === '(') d++;
            else if (ch === ')' && --d === 0) return j;
        }
        return -1;
    }

    function extract(src, streaming) {
        const s = String(src ?? '');
        const items = [];
        const push = (tex, display) => {
            items.push({ tex: tex.trim(), display: !!display });
            return PH + 'EM' + (items.length - 1) + PH;
        };
        if (!/[$\\]/.test(s)) return { text: s, items };
        let out = '';
        let i = 0;
        const special = /[`\\$(]/g;
        scan: while (i < s.length) {
            special.lastIndex = i;
            const m = special.exec(s);
            if (!m) { out += s.slice(i); break; }
            out += s.slice(i, m.index);
            i = m.index;
            const c = s[i];

            if (c === '`') {
                const fence = s.startsWith('```', i);
                let end;
                if (fence) { const k = s.indexOf('```', i + 3); end = k === -1 ? s.length : k + 3; }
                else {
                    const k = s.indexOf('`', i + 1);
                    const nl = s.indexOf('\n', i + 1);
                    end = (k === -1 || (nl !== -1 && nl < k)) ? i + 1 : k + 1;
                }
                out += s.slice(i, end); i = end; continue;
            }

            if (c === '$') {
                if (s[i + 1] === '$') {
                    const end = s.indexOf('$$', i + 2);
                    if (end !== -1 && end > i + 2) { out += push(s.slice(i + 2, end), true); i = end + 2; continue; }
                    if (streaming) break scan;
                    out += '$$'; i += 2; continue;
                }
                const close = inlineClose(s, i);
                if (close !== -1) { out += push(s.slice(i + 1, close), false); i = close + 1; continue; }
                if (streaming && /^\$[^\s$\n][^\n$]*[\\^{]/.test(s.slice(i, i + 200)) && s.indexOf('$', i + 1) === -1) break scan;
                out += '$'; i++; continue;
            }

            if (c === '(') {
                const end = parenClose(s, i);
                if (end !== -1) {
                    const body = s.slice(i + 1, end);
                    const words = body.replace(/\\(?:text|mathrm)\s*\{[^{}]*\}/g, '').replace(/\\[a-zA-Z]+/g, '');
                    if (/\\(?:d?frac|sqrt|cdot|times|div|pm|le|ge|neq|approx)(?![a-zA-Z])/.test(body) && !/[a-zA-Z]{3,}/.test(words)) {
                        out += push(body, false); i = end + 1; continue;
                    }
                }
                out += '('; i++; continue;
            }

            const n = s[i + 1];
            if (n === '$') { out += '\\$'; i += 2; continue; }
            if (n === '(' || n === '[') {
                const end = s.indexOf(n === '(' ? '\\)' : '\\]', i + 2);
                if (end !== -1) { out += push(s.slice(i + 2, end), n === '['); i = end + 2; continue; }
                if (streaming) break scan;
            }
            const cmd = /^\\(d?frac|tfrac|sqrt|binom)(?![a-zA-Z])/.exec(s.slice(i, i + 8));
            if (cmd) {
                let j = i + cmd[0].length;
                let ok = true;
                const skipSpace = () => { while (s[j] === ' ') j++; };
                skipSpace();
                if (cmd[1] === 'sqrt' && s[j] === '[') { const k = s.indexOf(']', j); if (k === -1) ok = false; else j = k + 1; }
                for (let g = 0; ok && g < (cmd[1] === 'sqrt' ? 1 : 2); g++) {
                    skipSpace();
                    const e = group(s, j);
                    if (e === -1) ok = false; else j = e;
                }
                if (ok) {
                    while ((s[j] === '^' || s[j] === '_') && j < s.length) {
                        if (s[j + 1] === '{') { const e = group(s, j + 1); if (e === -1) break; j = e; }
                        else if (/\w/.test(s[j + 1] || '')) j += 2;
                        else break;
                    }
                    const lead = /(^|[^\w.])(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)$/.exec(out);
                    const coef = lead ? lead[2] : '';
                    if (coef) out = out.slice(0, out.length - coef.length);
                    out += push(coef + s.slice(i, j), false);
                    i = j; continue;
                }
                if (streaming) break scan;
            }
            const sym = /^\\([a-zA-Z]+)/.exec(s.slice(i, i + 16));
            if (sym && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(SYMBOLS, sym[1])) { out += SYMBOLS[sym[1]]; i += sym[0].length; continue; }
            out += '\\'; i++;
        }
        return { text: out, items };
    }

    function itemHtml(it) {
        const k = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.katex : null;
        const cls = 'echo-math' + (it.display ? ' echo-math-block' : '');
        if (!k) {
            ensure();
            return `<span class="${cls} echo-math-pending" data-tex="${esc(it.tex)}"${it.display ? ' data-display="1"' : ''}>${esc(plain(it.tex))}</span>`;
        }
        const tex = it.display ? it.tex : it.tex.replace(/\\frac(?![a-zA-Z])/g, '\\dfrac');
        const key = (it.display ? 'D' : 'I') + tex;
        let h = cache.get(key);
        if (h === undefined) {
            try {
                h = k.renderToString(tex, { displayMode: it.display, throwOnError: true, strict: 'ignore', trust: false, output: 'html', maxExpand: 200, maxSize: 30 });
            } catch (e) { h = null; }
            if (cache.size > 1000) cache.clear();
            cache.set(key, h);
        }
        return h ? `<span class="${cls}">${h}</span>` : `<span class="${cls} echo-math-fallback">${esc(plain(it.tex))}</span>`;
    }

    function fill(html, items) {
        if (!items.length) return html;
        return html.replace(PH_RE, (_, idx) => (items[idx] ? itemHtml(items[idx]) : ''));
    }

    function flush() {
        docs.add(document);
        for (const d of [...docs]) {
            try {
                if (!d || (d.defaultView && d.defaultView.closed)) { docs.delete(d); continue; }
                d.querySelectorAll('.echo-math-pending').forEach(el => {
                    el.outerHTML = itemHtml({ tex: el.getAttribute('data-tex') || '', display: el.getAttribute('data-display') === '1' });
                });
            } catch (e) { docs.delete(d); }
        }
    }

    function css(doc) {
        if (!doc || !doc.head || (doc.getElementById && doc.getElementById('echo-katex-css'))) return;
        const l = doc.createElement('link');
        l.id = 'echo-katex-css'; l.rel = 'stylesheet'; l.href = BASE + '/katex.min.css';
        l.integrity = CSS_SRI; l.crossOrigin = 'anonymous'; l.referrerPolicy = 'no-referrer';
        doc.head.appendChild(l);
        if (doc !== document) docs.add(doc);
    }

    function ensure() {
        if (window.katex) return Promise.resolve(window.katex);
        if (loading) return loading;
        css(document);
        loading = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
            const sc = document.createElement('script');
            sc.src = BASE + '/katex.min.js';
            sc.integrity = JS_SRI; sc.crossOrigin = 'anonymous'; sc.referrerPolicy = 'no-referrer'; sc.async = true;
            sc.onload = () => (window.katex ? (resolve(window.katex), flush()) : reject(new Error('KaTeX did not initialise')));
            sc.onerror = () => reject(new Error('KaTeX failed to load'));
            document.head.appendChild(sc);
        }).catch(e => { console.warn('[EchoMath]', e.message); loading = null; return null; });
        return loading;
    }

    function toHtml(text, streaming) {
        const ex = extract(text, streaming);
        return fill(esc(ex.text.replace(/\\\$/g, '$')).replace(/\n/g, '<br>'), ex.items);
    }

    return { extract, fill, toHtml, plain, ensure, css, flush };
})();
window.EchoMath = EchoMath;

let _authSettled = false;

onAuthStateChanged(auth, () => {

function _fsRefPath(ref) {
    try {
        if (!ref || typeof ref !== 'object') return '';
        if (typeof ref.path === 'string') return ref.path;
        const seg = ref._query?.path?.segments;
        if (Array.isArray(seg)) return seg.join('/');
        if (typeof ref._path?.canonicalString === 'function') return ref._path.canonicalString();
    } catch (_) {}
    return '';
}

function onSnapshot(...args) {
    const _p = _fsRefPath(args[0]);
    const _onErr = e => {
        window.reportRuleDenial && window.reportRuleDenial('Live listener', e, { path: _p, op: 'onSnapshot' });
        console.warn('[fs] listener error:', _p || '?', e);
    };
    const i = args.findIndex(a => typeof a === 'function');
    if (i === -1) {
        const obs = args[args.length - 1];
        if (obs && typeof obs === 'object' && obs.next && !obs.error) {
            args[args.length - 1] = { ...obs, error: _onErr };
        }
    } else if (typeof args[i + 1] !== 'function') {
        args.splice(i + 1, 0, _onErr);
    }

    if (_authSettled) return _fsOnSnapshot(...args);

    let unsub = null, cancelled = false;
    _authWaiters.push(() => { if (!cancelled) unsub = _fsOnSnapshot(...args); });
    return () => { cancelled = true; if (unsub) { unsub(); unsub = null; } };
}
window.onSnapshot = onSnapshot;

const _dvHash = (str) => {
    let h = 0x811c9dc5;
    for (let i = 0; i < str.length; i++) { h ^= str.charCodeAt(i); h = Math.imul(h, 0x01000193); }
    return (h >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, '0');
};

window.getDeviceId = () => {
    try {
        let id = localStorage.getItem('es_device_id');
        if (!id) {
            id = (crypto.randomUUID ? crypto.randomUUID() : String(Date.now()) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2));
            localStorage.setItem('es_device_id', id);
        }
        return 'id_' + _dvHash(id);
    } catch (_) { return null; }
};

    } catch (_) { return null; }
