window.EchoSFX = (function () {
  const AC = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
  let ctx, master, sat, comp, analyser, reverb, revGain;

  const settings = {
    enabled: true,
    volume: 0.8,
    categories: { messages:true, notifications:true, moderation:true, ui:true, alerts:true }
  };
  const CATEGORY = {
    send:'messages', receive:'messages',
    notify:'notifications',
    scan:'moderation', deny:'moderation',
    success:'ui', powerup:'ui', error:'ui', unlock:'ui', lock:'ui',
    click:'ui', pop:'ui', whoosh:'ui', open:'ui', beep:'ui', laugh:'ui',
    alarm:'alerts'
  };
  const lastPlay = {};

  function makeIR(seconds, decay){
    const rate=ctx.sampleRate, len=Math.floor(rate*seconds);
    const buf=ctx.createBuffer(2,len,rate);
    for(let ch=0;ch<2;ch++){ const d=buf.getChannelData(ch);
      for(let i=0;i<len;i++) d[i]=(Math.random()*2-1)*Math.pow(1-i/len, decay); }
    return buf;
  }
  function satCurve(k){
    const n=1024, c=new Float32Array(n);
    for(let i=0;i<n;i++){ const x=i/(n-1)*2-1; c[i]=Math.tanh(k*x); }
    return c;
  }
  function build(){
    if(ctx) return;
    ctx=new AC();
    master=ctx.createGain(); master.gain.value=0.8*settings.volume;
    sat=ctx.createWaveShaper(); sat.curve=satCurve(1.5); sat.oversample='4x';
    comp=ctx.createDynamicsCompressor();
    comp.threshold.value=-14; comp.knee.value=22; comp.ratio.value=3;
    comp.attack.value=0.003; comp.release.value=0.16;
    analyser=ctx.createAnalyser(); analyser.fftSize=2048;
    reverb=ctx.createConvolver(); reverb.buffer=makeIR(2.4,3.0);
    revGain=ctx.createGain(); revGain.gain.value=0.9;
    reverb.connect(revGain).connect(master);
    master.connect(sat); sat.connect(comp); comp.connect(analyser); analyser.connect(ctx.destination);
  }
  function unlockAudio(){ if(!ctx) build(); if(ctx && ctx.state==='suspended') ctx.resume(); }
  const now = () => ctx.currentTime;

  function tone(t, o){
    const {freq,type='sine',dur=0.25,gain=0.3,a=0.006,detune=0,unison=1,
           glideTo=null,glideDur=null,filter=null,fEnv=null,send=0.25,vibrato=null}=o;
    const amp=ctx.createGain();
    const wet=ctx.createGain(); wet.gain.value=send;
    amp.connect(master); amp.connect(wet).connect(reverb);
    amp.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001,t);
    amp.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(gain,t+a);
    amp.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001,t+dur);
    let node=amp;
    if(filter){
      const bq=ctx.createBiquadFilter(); bq.type=filter.type||'lowpass';
      bq.frequency.value=filter.f??1000; bq.Q.value=filter.q??1;
      if(fEnv){ bq.frequency.setValueAtTime(fEnv.from,t);
        bq.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(40,fEnv.to),t+(fEnv.time??dur)); }
      bq.connect(amp); node=bq;
    }
    for(let i=0;i<unison;i++){
      const osc=ctx.createOscillator(); osc.type=type;
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq,t);
      if(glideTo) osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(glideTo,t+(glideDur||dur));
      osc.detune.value = unison>1 ? (i-(unison-1)/2)*detune : detune;
      if(vibrato){
        const lfo=ctx.createOscillator(), lg=ctx.createGain();
        lfo.frequency.value=vibrato.rate; lg.gain.value=vibrato.depth;
        lfo.connect(lg).connect(osc.detune); lfo.start(t); lfo.stop(t+dur+0.05);
      }
      osc.connect(node); osc.start(t); osc.stop(t+dur+0.05);
    }
  }
  function bell(t,{freq,ratio=1.41,index=5,dur=0.8,gain=0.28,send=0.4,mallet=true}){
    const car=ctx.createOscillator(), mod=ctx.createOscillator();
    const modGain=ctx.createGain(), amp=ctx.createGain();
    const wet=ctx.createGain(); wet.gain.value=send;
    car.frequency.value=freq; mod.frequency.value=freq*ratio;
    modGain.gain.setValueAtTime(freq*index,t);
    modGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(1,freq*0.4),t+dur*0.6);
    mod.connect(modGain); modGain.connect(car.frequency);
    amp.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001,t);
    amp.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(gain,t+0.004);
    amp.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001,t+dur);
    car.connect(amp); amp.connect(master); amp.connect(wet).connect(reverb);
    car.start(t); car.stop(t+dur+0.05); mod.start(t); mod.stop(t+dur+0.05);
    if(mallet) noise(t,{dur:0.02,gain:gain*0.5,type:'bandpass',f0:freq*3,f1:freq*2,q:1,send:send*0.3});
  }
  function noise(t,{dur=0.3,gain=0.3,type='lowpass',f0=1000,f1=200,q=1,send=0.15}){
    const n=Math.max(1,Math.floor(ctx.sampleRate*dur));
    const buf=ctx.createBuffer(1,n,ctx.sampleRate); const d=buf.getChannelData(0);
    for(let i=0;i<n;i++) d[i]=(Math.random()*2-1)*(1-i/n);
    const src=ctx.createBufferSource(); src.buffer=buf;
    const bq=ctx.createBiquadFilter(); bq.type=type; bq.Q.value=q;
    bq.frequency.setValueAtTime(f0,t);
    bq.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(40,f1),t+dur);
    const g=ctx.createGain();
    g.gain.setValueAtTime(gain,t); g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001,t+dur);
    const wet=ctx.createGain(); wet.gain.value=send;
    src.connect(bq).connect(g); g.connect(master); g.connect(wet).connect(reverb);
    src.start(t); src.stop(t+dur+0.02);
  }
  function sub(t,{freq=80,dur=0.2,gain=0.4,drop=0.6}){
    tone(t,{freq,type:'sine',dur,gain,a:0.004,glideTo:freq*drop,glideDur:dur,send:0.05});
  }
  function brownBuf(dur){
    const n=Math.max(1,Math.floor(ctx.sampleRate*dur));
    const buf=ctx.createBuffer(1,n,ctx.sampleRate); const d=buf.getChannelData(0);
    let last=0;
    for(let i=0;i<n;i++){ const w=Math.random()*2-1; last=(last+0.02*w)/1.02; d[i]=last*3.2; }
    return buf;
  }
  function swoosh(t,{dur=0.5,gain=0.3,f0=300,fpeak=2500,q=6,send=0.4,brown=true,swell=0.45}){
    let buf;
    if(brown){ buf=brownBuf(dur); }
    else{ const n=Math.max(1,Math.floor(ctx.sampleRate*dur)); buf=ctx.createBuffer(1,n,ctx.sampleRate);
          const d=buf.getChannelData(0); for(let i=0;i<n;i++) d[i]=Math.random()*2-1; }
    const src=ctx.createBufferSource(); src.buffer=buf;
    const bq=ctx.createBiquadFilter(); bq.type='bandpass'; bq.Q.value=q;
    bq.frequency.setValueAtTime(f0,t);
    bq.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(fpeak,t+dur*swell);
    bq.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(60,f0*0.7),t+dur);
    const lp=ctx.createBiquadFilter(); lp.type='lowpass'; lp.frequency.value=6500;
    const g=ctx.createGain();
    g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001,t);
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(gain,t+dur*swell);
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001,t+dur);
    const wet=ctx.createGain(); wet.gain.value=send;
    src.connect(bq).connect(lp).connect(g); g.connect(master); g.connect(wet).connect(reverb);
    src.start(t); src.stop(t+dur+0.02);
  }

  const SFX = {
    unlock(){ const t=now();
      noise(t,{dur:0.03,gain:0.2,type:'bandpass',f0:2600,f1:1400,q:1.2,send:0.2});
      tone(t+0.02,{freq:659,type:'triangle',dur:0.16,gain:0.15,unison:2,detune:6,send:0.35});
      tone(t+0.11,{freq:988,type:'triangle',dur:0.4,gain:0.17,unison:2,detune:7,send:0.45});
      tone(t+0.13,{freq:1976,type:'sine',dur:0.5,gain:0.05,send:0.6}); },
    lock(){ const t=now();
      noise(t,{dur:0.025,gain:0.2,type:'bandpass',f0:2400,f1:1200,q:1.2,send:0.18});
      tone(t+0.02,{freq:880,type:'triangle',dur:0.14,gain:0.15,unison:2,detune:6,send:0.3});
      tone(t+0.1,{freq:587,type:'triangle',dur:0.3,gain:0.16,unison:2,detune:6,send:0.35});
      sub(t+0.16,{freq:110,dur:0.22,gain:0.28,drop:0.6}); },
    error(){ const t=now();
      tone(t,{freq:311,type:'triangle',dur:0.28,gain:0.15,unison:2,detune:8,glideTo:262,glideDur:0.28,filter:{type:'lowpass',f:1200,q:1},send:0.3});
      tone(t,{freq:330,type:'triangle',dur:0.28,gain:0.11,unison:2,detune:8,glideTo:277,glideDur:0.28,filter:{type:'lowpass',f:1200,q:1},send:0.3});
      sub(t,{freq:90,dur:0.24,gain:0.26,drop:0.7}); },
    success(){ const t=now();
      noise(t,{dur:0.01,gain:0.07,type:'bandpass',f0:2500,f1:1500,q:2,send:0.06});
      [523,659,784].forEach(f=>tone(t,{freq:f,type:'triangle',dur:0.5,gain:0.1,unison:2,detune:5,filter:{type:'lowpass',f:2400,q:1},send:0.35}));
      tone(t+0.12,{freq:1046,type:'triangle',dur:0.6,gain:0.11,unison:2,detune:6,filter:{type:'lowpass',f:2600,q:1},send:0.45}); },
    notify(){ const t=now();
      bell(t,{freq:784,ratio:1.41,index:4,dur:0.5,gain:0.16,send:0.35});
      bell(t+0.14,{freq:1046,ratio:1.41,index:4,dur:0.9,gain:0.15,send:0.5}); },
    click(){ const t=now();
      noise(t,{dur:0.012,gain:0.16,type:'bandpass',f0:3000,f1:2000,q:2,send:0.08});
      tone(t,{freq:1400,type:'sine',dur:0.03,gain:0.09,send:0.05}); },
    whoosh(){ const t=now();
      swoosh(t,{dur:0.55,gain:0.34,f0:250,fpeak:2800,q:5,send:0.45,brown:true,swell:0.45});
      tone(t+0.05,{freq:170,type:'sine',dur:0.42,gain:0.06,glideTo:540,glideDur:0.32,send:0.4}); },
    open(){ return SFX.whoosh(); },
    powerup(){ const t=now();
      swoosh(t,{dur:0.5,gain:0.16,f0:400,fpeak:5000,q:2,send:0.3,brown:false,swell:0.95});
      tone(t,{freq:200,type:'sawtooth',dur:0.5,gain:0.13,unison:3,detune:10,glideTo:1200,glideDur:0.48,filter:{type:'lowpass',f:400,q:6},fEnv:{from:400,to:6000,time:0.48},send:0.3});
      tone(t,{freq:80,type:'sine',dur:0.5,gain:0.18,glideTo:320,glideDur:0.48,send:0.05});
      [1046,1319,1568].forEach(f=>bell(t+0.5,{freq:f,ratio:2.0,index:3,dur:0.9,gain:0.09,send:0.55,mallet:false})); },
    pop(){ const t=now();
      tone(t,{freq:920,type:'sine',dur:0.09,gain:0.3,glideTo:230,glideDur:0.07,send:0.1});
      tone(t,{freq:460,type:'triangle',dur:0.06,gain:0.12,glideTo:180,glideDur:0.06,send:0.06});
      noise(t,{dur:0.012,gain:0.14,type:'bandpass',f0:1600,f1:700,q:6,send:0.04}); },
    send(){ const t=now();
      swoosh(t,{dur:0.18,gain:0.07,f0:1200,fpeak:4200,q:2,send:0.3,brown:false,swell:0.7});
      tone(t,{freq:660,type:'triangle',dur:0.16,gain:0.13,unison:2,detune:5,glideTo:1180,glideDur:0.14,filter:{type:'lowpass',f:3200,q:1},send:0.32}); },
    receive(){ const t=now();
      noise(t,{dur:0.006,gain:0.06,type:'bandpass',f0:2000,f1:1200,q:2,send:0.05});
      tone(t,{freq:660,type:'triangle',dur:0.2,gain:0.13,unison:2,detune:5,filter:{type:'lowpass',f:2000,q:1},send:0.35});
      tone(t+0.1,{freq:494,type:'triangle',dur:0.42,gain:0.13,unison:2,detune:5,filter:{type:'lowpass',f:1800,q:1},send:0.45}); },
    beep(){ const t=now();
      tone(t,{freq:880,type:'square',dur:0.12,gain:0.15,filter:{type:'lowpass',f:3000,q:1},send:0.25}); },
    alarm(){ const t=now();
      for(let i=0;i<4;i++) tone(t+i*0.2,{freq:i%2?740:988,type:'sawtooth',dur:0.16,gain:0.13,unison:2,detune:8,filter:{type:'lowpass',f:2500,q:6},send:0.2}); },
    scan(){ const t=now();
      tone(t,{freq:400,type:'sine',dur:0.8,gain:0.15,glideTo:2000,glideDur:0.75,vibrato:{rate:14,depth:30},send:0.6});
      noise(t,{dur:0.8,gain:0.06,type:'bandpass',f0:600,f1:4000,q:2,send:0.5}); },
    deny(){ const t=now();
      [0,0.16].forEach((off,i)=>{ const f = i?155:196;
        tone(t+off,{freq:f,type:'sawtooth',dur:0.2,gain:0.16,unison:2,detune:10,glideTo:f*0.7,glideDur:0.18,filter:{type:'lowpass',f:700,q:4},send:0.2});
        sub(t+off,{freq:f*0.5,dur:0.2,gain:0.22,drop:0.75}); }); },
    laugh(){ const t=now();
      [440,494,523,587].forEach((f,i) => tone(t+i*0.13, {
        freq:f, type:'square', dur:0.11, gain:0.16, unison:2, detune:14,
        vibrato:{rate:28, depth:40}, filter:{type:'lowpass', f:2200, q:2}, send:0.3
      }));
      tone(t+0.55, {freq:660, type:'triangle', dur:0.22, gain:0.14, unison:2, detune:8, glideTo:880, glideDur:0.2, send:0.4}); }
  };

  function play(name){
    if(!settings.enabled || !SFX[name]) return;
    const cat = CATEGORY[name];
    if(cat && settings.categories[cat]===false) return;
    const pn = performance.now();
    if(lastPlay[name] && pn-lastPlay[name] < 70) return;
    lastPlay[name]=pn;
    unlockAudio();
    if(!ctx) return;
    master.gain.value = 0.8*settings.volume;
    try { SFX[name](); } catch(e){ console.warn('EchoSFX', name, e); }
  }
  function configure(patch){
    if(!patch) return;
    if(typeof patch.enabled==='boolean') settings.enabled=patch.enabled;
    if(typeof patch.volume==='number') settings.volume=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,patch.volume));
    if(patch.categories) Object.assign(settings.categories, patch.categories);
    if(master) master.gain.value=0.8*settings.volume;
  }

  ['pointerdown','keydown','touchstart'].forEach(ev=>
    window.addEventListener(ev, unlockAudio, { once:true, passive:true }));

  return { play, configure, unlockAudio, get settings(){ return settings; }, list:Object.keys(SFX) };
})();

const GEMINI_LIVE_MODEL = 'gemini-3.1-flash-live-preview';

class GeminiLiveSession {
     
    constructor(opts) {
        this.opts = opts || {};
        this.ws = null;
        this.micStream = null;
        this.micCtx = null;
        this.micProcessor = null;
        this.micSource = null;
        this.playCtx = null;
        this.playCursorTime = 0;
        this.activeSources = [];
        this.closed = false;
        this.muted = false;
        this._inTranscriptBuf = '';
        this._outTranscriptBuf = '';
        this._outTextBuf = '';
        this._speaking = false;
        this.videoStream = null;
        this._videoEl = null;
        this._videoCanvas = null;
        this._videoFrameTimer = null;
        this._resumeHandle = null;
        this._reconnecting = false;
        this._pending = [];
        this._turnOpen = false;
        this._lastTurnMsg = null;
        this._resumeAfterTurn = false;
        this._resumeTimer = null;
        this._resumeFails = 0;
    }

    async connect() {
        this.opts.onState?.('connecting');
        if (!window.GEMINI_API_KEY) throw new Error('GEMINI_API_KEY is not set');
        if (this.closed) return;

        await this._openSocket(false);

        if (this.opts.initialHistory && this.opts.initialHistory.length) {
            this.ws.send(JSON.stringify({
                clientContent: { turns: this.opts.initialHistory, turnComplete: true }
            }));
        }

        this._initPlayback();
        if (this.opts.enableMic !== false) {
            await this._initMic();
        }
        if (this.opts.videoStream) {
            await this._initVideo(this.opts.videoStream);
        }
        this.opts.onState?.('listening');
    }

    async _openSocket(resuming) {
        const wsUrl = `wss://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/ws/google.ai.generativelanguage.v1beta.GenerativeService.BidiGenerateContent?key=${window.GEMINI_API_KEY}`;
        const ws = new WebSocket(wsUrl);
        this.ws = ws;

        await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
            let settled = false;

            const onHandshakeMessage = async (event) => {
                let data;
                try {
                    const raw = typeof event.data === 'string' ? event.data : await event.data.text();
                    data = JSON.parse(raw);
                } catch (e) { return; }
                if (data.setupComplete) {
                    settled = true;
                    ws.removeEventListener('message', onHandshakeMessage);
                    resolve();
                } else if (data.error) {
                    settled = true;
                    ws.removeEventListener('message', onHandshakeMessage);
                    reject(new Error(data.error.message || 'Gemini Live rejected the session setup.'));
                }
            };

            ws.onopen = () => {
                const modalities = this.opts.responseModalities || ['AUDIO'];
                const setup = {
                    setup: {
                        model: `models/${GEMINI_LIVE_MODEL}`,
                        generationConfig: { responseModalities: modalities },
                        systemInstruction: { parts: [{ text: this.opts.systemInstruction || '' }] }
                    }
                };
                if (this.opts.enableMic !== false) setup.setup.inputAudioTranscription = {};
                if (modalities.includes('AUDIO')) setup.setup.outputAudioTranscription = {};
                if (this.opts.voiceName) {
                    setup.setup.generationConfig.speechConfig = {
                        voiceConfig: { prebuiltVoiceConfig: { voiceName: this.opts.voiceName } }
                    };
                }
                if (this.opts.tools) {
                    setup.setup.tools = this.opts.tools;
                }
                if (!resuming && this.opts.initialHistory && this.opts.initialHistory.length) {
                    setup.setup.historyConfig = { initialHistoryInClientContent: true };
                }
                if (this.opts.autoResume) {
                    setup.setup.contextWindowCompression = { slidingWindow: {} };
                    setup.setup.sessionResumption = (resuming && this._resumeHandle) ? { handle: this._resumeHandle } : {};
                }
                ws.addEventListener('message', onHandshakeMessage);
                ws.send(JSON.stringify(setup));
            };
            ws.onerror = (e) => {
                if (settled) return;
                setTimeout(() => {
                    if (settled) return;
                    settled = true;
                    reject(new Error('WebSocket connection to Gemini Live failed (no close code received — likely blocked by the browser, an extension, or network policy before it could reach the server).'));
                }, 250);
            };
            ws.onclose = (ev) => {
                if (settled) return;
                settled = true;
                reject(new Error(`Gemini Live closed the connection before setup completed (code ${ev.code}${ev.reason ? ': ' + ev.reason : ''}).`));
            };
        });

        ws.onmessage = async (event) => {
            if (this.ws !== ws) return;
            let data;
            try {
                const raw = typeof event.data === 'string' ? event.data : await event.data.text();
                data = JSON.parse(raw);
            } catch (e) { console.warn('[GeminiLive] bad message:', e); return; }
            this._handleServerMessage(data);
        };
        ws.onerror = (e) => {
            if (this.ws !== ws) return;
            console.warn('[GeminiLive] ws error:', e);
            if (!this.opts.autoResume) this.opts.onError?.(e);
        };
        ws.onclose = (ev) => {
            if (this.ws !== ws || this.closed) return;
            if (ev && ev.code !== 1000) {
                console.warn(`[GeminiLive] socket closed unexpectedly: code ${ev.code}${ev.reason ? ' reason "' + ev.reason + '"' : ''}`);
            }
            if (this.opts.autoResume) { this._resume('close ' + (ev && ev.code)); return; }
            this.closed = true;
            this.opts.onClose?.(ev);
        };
    }

    async _resume(why) {
        if (this.closed || this._reconnecting) return;
        this._reconnecting = true;
        clearTimeout(this._resumeTimer);
        this._resumeAfterTurn = false;
        console.log('[GeminiLive] resuming session (' + why + ')' + (this._resumeHandle ? '' : ' — no handle yet, starting fresh'));
        try { this.opts.onResuming?.(); } catch (e) {}
        const old = this.ws;
        if (old) { old.onmessage = old.onerror = old.onclose = null; try { old.close(); } catch (e) {} }
        if (this._turnOpen && this._lastTurnMsg && !this._pending.includes(this._lastTurnMsg)) this._pending.unshift(this._lastTurnMsg);
        this._turnOpen = false;
        this._inTranscriptBuf = ''; this._outTranscriptBuf = ''; this._outTextBuf = '';
        for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 3 && !this.closed; attempt++) {
            try {
                if (attempt) await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1000 * attempt));
                await this._openSocket(true);
                this._reconnecting = false;
                this._resumeFails = 0;
                const queued = this._pending.splice(0);
                queued.forEach(m => this._sendOrQueue(m));
                this.opts.onResumed?.();
                return;
            } catch (e) {
                console.warn('[GeminiLive] resume attempt failed:', e?.message || e);
                this._resumeHandle = null;
            }
        }
        this._reconnecting = false;
        if (this.closed) return;
        this.closed = true;
        this.opts.onClose?.({ code: 4000, reason: 'resume failed' });
    }

    _sendOrQueue(msg) {
        if (this.closed) return;
        if (this._reconnecting || !this.ws || this.ws.readyState !== WebSocket.OPEN) {
            if (this.opts.autoResume) { this._pending.push(msg); if (this._pending.length > 5) this._pending.shift(); }
            return;
        }
        if (msg.clientContent) { this._turnOpen = true; this._lastTurnMsg = msg; }
        this.ws.send(JSON.stringify(msg));
    }

    _handleServerMessage(data) {
        if (data.error) {
            console.warn('[GeminiLive] server error:', data.error);
            this.opts.onError?.(new Error(data.error.message || 'Gemini Live server error'));
            return;
        }
        if (data.usageMetadata?.totalTokenCount != null) {
            const _t = data.usageMetadata.totalTokenCount;
            const _seen = this._usageSeen || 0;
            if (_t > _seen) {
                this._usageSeen = _t;
                try { window._echoUsageExact?.(_t - _seen); } catch (_) {}
            }
        }
        if (data.serverContent) {
            const sc = data.serverContent;
            if (sc.modelTurn?.parts) {
                for (const part of sc.modelTurn.parts) {
                    if (part.inlineData?.data && this.opts.playAudio !== false) this._playChunk(part.inlineData.data, part.inlineData.mimeType);
                    if (part.text) {
                        this._outTextBuf += part.text;
                        this.opts.onOutputText?.(this._outTextBuf, false);
                    }
                }
            }
            if (sc.inputTranscription?.text) {
                this._inTranscriptBuf += sc.inputTranscription.text;
                this.opts.onInputTranscript?.(this._inTranscriptBuf, false);
            }
            if (sc.outputTranscription?.text) {
                this._outTranscriptBuf += sc.outputTranscription.text;
                this.opts.onOutputTranscript?.(this._outTranscriptBuf, false);
            }
            if (sc.turnComplete) {
                if (this._inTranscriptBuf) this.opts.onInputTranscript?.(this._inTranscriptBuf, true);
                if (this._outTranscriptBuf) this.opts.onOutputTranscript?.(this._outTranscriptBuf, true);
                if (this._outTextBuf) this.opts.onOutputText?.(this._outTextBuf, true);
                this._inTranscriptBuf = '';
                this._outTranscriptBuf = '';
                this._outTextBuf = '';
                this._turnOpen = false;
                try { this.opts.onTurnComplete?.(); } catch (e) {}
                if (this._resumeAfterTurn) this._resume('goAway, after answer');
            }
            if (sc.interrupted) {
                this._stopPlayback();
            }
        }
        if (data.sessionResumptionUpdate?.resumable && data.sessionResumptionUpdate.newHandle) {
            this._resumeHandle = data.sessionResumptionUpdate.newHandle;
        }
        if (data.goAway) {
            console.warn('[GeminiLive] server sent goAway, session ending soon', data.goAway.timeLeft || '');
            if (this.opts.autoResume && !this._reconnecting) {
                const leftMs = (parseFloat(data.goAway.timeLeft) || 5) * 1000;
                clearTimeout(this._resumeTimer);
                this._resumeTimer = setTimeout(() => this._resume('goAway deadline'), Math.max(0, leftMs - 1500));
                if (this._turnOpen) this._resumeAfterTurn = true;
                else this._resume('goAway');
            }
        }
        if (data.toolCall && Array.isArray(data.toolCall.functionCalls)) {
            for (const fc of data.toolCall.functionCalls) {
                this.opts.onToolCall?.(fc);
            }
        }
    }

    sendToolResponse(id, name, response) {
        if (this.ws && this.ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
            this.ws.send(JSON.stringify({
                toolResponse: { functionResponses: [{ id, name, response }] }
            }));
        }
    }

    sendText(text) {
        const trimmed = (text || '').trim();
        if (!trimmed) return;
        this._sendOrQueue({
            clientContent: {
                turns: [{ role: 'user', parts: [{ text: trimmed }] }],
                turnComplete: true
            }
        });
    }

    setMuted(muted) {
        this.muted = !!muted;
    }

    async _initMic() {
        this.micStream = this.opts.micStream || await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: { channelCount: 1 } });
        const AudioCtx = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
        this.micCtx = new AudioCtx({ sampleRate: 16000 });
        this.micSource = this.micCtx.createMediaStreamSource(this.micStream);
        this.micProcessor = this.micCtx.createScriptProcessor(4096, 1, 1);
        this.micProcessor.onaudioprocess = (e) => {
            if (!this.ws || this.ws.readyState !== WebSocket.OPEN || this._reconnecting) return;
            if (this.muted) return;
            const input = e.inputBuffer.getChannelData(0);
            const pcm16 = new Int16Array(input.length);
            for (let i = 0; i < input.length; i++) {
                const s = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, input[i]));
                pcm16[i] = s < 0 ? s * 0x8000 : s * 0x7fff;
            }
            const b64 = _int16ToBase64(pcm16);
            this.ws.send(JSON.stringify({
                realtimeInput: { audio: { data: b64, mimeType: 'audio/pcm;rate=16000' } }
            }));
        };
        this.micSource.connect(this.micProcessor);
        const mute = this.micCtx.createGain();
        mute.gain.value = 0;
        this.micProcessor.connect(mute);
        mute.connect(this.micCtx.destination);
    }

    async _initVideo(stream) {
        this.videoStream = stream;
        this.videoMode = this.opts.videoMode === 'onDemand' ? 'onDemand' : 'continuous';
        this._videoEl = document.createElement('video');
        this._videoEl.muted = true;
        this._videoEl.playsInline = true;
        this._videoEl.srcObject = stream;
        await this._videoEl.play().catch(() => {});
        this._videoCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');

        const track = stream.getVideoTracks?.()[0];
        if (track) {
            track.onended = () => { this.opts.onScreenShareEnded?.(); };
        }

        if (this.videoMode === 'continuous') {
            this._videoFrameTimer = setInterval(() => this._sendVideoFrame(), 1000);
        }
    }

    setVideoMode(mode) {
        this.videoMode = mode === 'onDemand' ? 'onDemand' : 'continuous';
        if (this.videoMode === 'continuous') {
            if (!this._videoFrameTimer && this._videoEl) {
                this._videoFrameTimer = setInterval(() => this._sendVideoFrame(), 1000);
            }
        } else if (this._videoFrameTimer) {
            clearInterval(this._videoFrameTimer);
            this._videoFrameTimer = null;
        }
    }

    captureFrame() {
        this._sendVideoFrame();
    }

    _grabFrameB64() {
        if (!this._videoEl || this._videoEl.readyState < 2) return null;
        const w = this._videoEl.videoWidth, h = this._videoEl.videoHeight;
        if (!w || !h) return null;

        const maxDim = 1024;
        const scale = Math.min(1, maxDim / Math.max(w, h));
        this._videoCanvas.width = Math.round(w * scale);
        this._videoCanvas.height = Math.round(h * scale);
        const ctx = this._videoCanvas.getContext('2d');
        ctx.drawImage(this._videoEl, 0, 0, this._videoCanvas.width, this._videoCanvas.height);

        const dataUrl = this._videoCanvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.6);
        return dataUrl.split(',')[1] || null;
    }

    _sendVideoFrame() {
        if (!this.ws || this.ws.readyState !== WebSocket.OPEN || this._reconnecting) return;
        const b64 = this._grabFrameB64();
        if (!b64) return;
        this.ws.send(JSON.stringify({
            realtimeInput: { video: { data: b64, mimeType: 'image/jpeg' } }
        }));
    }

    askAboutScreen(text) {
        const trimmed = (text || '').trim();
        if (!trimmed) return null;
        const b64 = this._grabFrameB64();
        const parts = b64
            ? [{ inlineData: { mimeType: 'image/jpeg', data: b64 } }, { text: trimmed }]
            : [{ text: trimmed }];
        this._sendOrQueue({ clientContent: { turns: [{ role: 'user', parts }], turnComplete: true } });
        return b64;
    }

    askWithImages(text, images) {
        const parts = (images || []).filter(i => i && i.data)
            .map(i => ({ inlineData: { mimeType: i.mime || 'image/jpeg', data: i.data } }));
        parts.push({ text: String(text || '').trim() || 'Answer the question in this image.' });
        this._sendOrQueue({ clientContent: { turns: [{ role: 'user', parts }], turnComplete: true } });
    }

    _initPlayback() {
        const AudioCtx = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
        this.playCtx = new AudioCtx();
        this.playCursorTime = this.playCtx.currentTime;
    }

    _playChunk(base64Data, mimeType) {
        const rateMatch = /rate=(\d+)/.exec(mimeType || '');
        const rate = rateMatch ? parseInt(rateMatch[1], 10) : 24000;
        const pcm16 = _base64ToInt16(base64Data);
        const float32 = new Float32Array(pcm16.length);
        for (let i = 0; i < pcm16.length; i++) float32[i] = pcm16[i] / 0x8000;

        const buffer = this.playCtx.createBuffer(1, float32.length, rate);
        buffer.copyToChannel(float32, 0);

        const source = this.playCtx.createBufferSource();
        source.buffer = buffer;
        source.connect(this.playCtx.destination);

        const startAt = Math.max(this.playCursorTime, this.playCtx.currentTime);
        source.start(startAt);
        this.playCursorTime = startAt + buffer.duration;
        this.activeSources.push(source);

        if (!this._speaking) { this._speaking = true; this.opts.onState?.('speaking'); }
        source.onended = () => {
            this.activeSources = this.activeSources.filter(s => s !== source);
            if (this.activeSources.length === 0 && this.playCursorTime <= this.playCtx.currentTime + 0.05) {
                this._speaking = false;
                this.opts.onState?.('listening');
            }
        };
    }

    _stopPlayback() {
        this.activeSources.forEach(s => { try { s.stop(); } catch (e) {} });
        this.activeSources = [];
        if (this.playCtx) this.playCursorTime = this.playCtx.currentTime;
        this._speaking = false;
    }

    sendAudioStreamEnd() {
        if (this.ws && this.ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
            this.ws.send(JSON.stringify({ realtimeInput: { audioStreamEnd: true } }));
        }
    }

    close() {
        this.closed = true;
        clearTimeout(this._resumeTimer);
        this._pending = [];
        this._stopPlayback();
        if (this.micProcessor) { try { this.micProcessor.disconnect(); } catch (e) {} this.micProcessor = null; }
        if (this.micSource) { try { this.micSource.disconnect(); } catch (e) {} this.micSource = null; }
        if (this.micStream) {
            if (!this.opts.micStream) this.micStream.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop());
            this.micStream = null;
        }
        if (this.micCtx) { try { this.micCtx.close(); } catch (e) {} this.micCtx = null; }
        if (this._videoFrameTimer) { clearInterval(this._videoFrameTimer); this._videoFrameTimer = null; }
        if (this._videoEl) { try { this._videoEl.pause(); } catch (e) {} this._videoEl.srcObject = null; this._videoEl = null; }
        if (this.videoStream) {
            if (!this.opts.videoStreamBorrowed) this.videoStream.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop());
            this.videoStream = null;
        }
        if (this.playCtx) { try { this.playCtx.close(); } catch (e) {} this.playCtx = null; }
        if (this.ws) { try { this.ws.close(); } catch (e) {} this.ws = null; }
    }
}

function _int16ToBase64(int16arr) {
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(int16arr.buffer);
    let binary = '';
    for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i++) binary += String.fromCharCode(bytes[i]);
    return btoa(binary);
}
function _base64ToInt16(b64) {
    const binary = atob(b64);
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(binary.length);
    for (let i = 0; i < binary.length; i++) bytes[i] = binary.charCodeAt(i);
    return new Int16Array(bytes.buffer);
}

async function _checkUserTimeout() {
    if (!window.myUID) return { blocked: false };
    if (window._timedOutUntil !== undefined) {
        return (window._timedOutUntil && window._timedOutUntil > new Date())
            ? { blocked: true, until: window._timedOutUntil }
            : { blocked: false };
    }
    try {
        const snap = await getDoc(doc(db, 'users', window.myUID));
        if (!snap.exists()) return { blocked: false };
        const val = snap.data().timedOutUntil;
        if (!val) return { blocked: false };
        const until = val.toDate ? val.toDate() : new Date(val);
        if (until > new Date()) return { blocked: true, until };
    } catch(e) {}
    return { blocked: false };
}
function _fmtTimeoutRemaining(until) {
    const secs = Math.max(0, Math.round((until - Date.now()) / 1000));
    if (secs < 60)  return `${secs}s`;
    if (secs < 3600) return `${Math.ceil(secs/60)}m`;
    return `${Math.ceil(secs/3600)}h`;
}
function _fmtTimeoutRemainingFull(until) {
    let secs = Math.max(0, Math.round((until - Date.now()) / 1000));
    const d = Math.floor(secs / 86400); secs -= d * 86400;
    const h = Math.floor(secs / 3600);  secs -= h * 3600;
    const m = Math.floor(secs / 60);    secs -= m * 60;
    const parts = [];
    if (d) parts.push(`${d}d`);
    if (d || h) parts.push(`${h}h`);
    if (d || h || m) parts.push(`${m}m`);
    parts.push(`${secs}s`);
    return parts.join(' ');
}

    });
}

function _startTimeoutTamperWatch() {
    if (window._timeoutTamperObserver) return;
    const watchedIds = new Set(['timeout-lockdown-overlay','message-input','send-btn','file-input','doc-file-input','voice-record-btn','poll-create-btn','game-create-btn']);
    const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
        if (!window._isTimedOut()) return;
        for (const mut of mutations) {
            if (mut.type === 'childList' && [...mut.removedNodes].some(n => n.id && watchedIds.has(n.id))) { _showTimeoutMockery(); return; }
            if (mut.type === 'attributes' && mut.attributeName === 'disabled' && mut.target.id && watchedIds.has(mut.target.id) && mut.target.disabled === false) { _showTimeoutMockery(); return; }
        }
    });
    observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true, attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['disabled'] });
    window._timeoutTamperObserver = observer;
}
_startTimeoutTamperWatch();

function spamGuard(key, maxCalls, windowMs) {
    const now = Date.now();
    if (!_spamCounters[key]) _spamCounters[key] = [];
    _spamCounters[key] = _spamCounters[key].filter(t => now - t < windowMs);
    if (_spamCounters[key].length >= maxCalls) return false;
    _spamCounters[key].push(now);
    return true;
}
window.spamGuard = spamGuard;

function sanitizeText(text) {
    if (typeof text !== 'string') return '';
    return text
        .replace(/<script[\s\S]*?>[\s\S]*?<\/script>/gi, '')
        .replace(/javascript\s*:/gi, '')
        .replace(/data\s*:\s*text\/html/gi, '')
        .trim();
}

function enforceMaxLength(text, max, label) {
    if (text.length > max) {
        showCooldownToast(`${label} too long (max ${max} chars)`);
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

const servers = { get iceServers() { return window.ECHO_ICE_SERVERS; }, iceCandidatePoolSize: 4 };

window.callDiag = async function (ms) {
    ms = ms || 8000;
    const gather = (cfg) => new Promise((res) => {
        const r = { host: 0, srflx: 0, relay: 0, errors: [] };
        let pc;
        try { pc = new RTCPeerConnection(cfg); } catch (e) { return res({ fatal: e.message }); }
        pc.onicecandidate = (e) => {
            if (!e.candidate) return;
            const t = (e.candidate.candidate.match(/typ (\w+)/) || [])[1];
            if (r[t] !== undefined) r[t]++;
        };
        pc.onicecandidateerror = (e) => {
            const m = (e.url || '?') + ' → ' + e.errorCode + ' ' + (e.errorText || '');
            if (!r.errors.includes(m)) r.errors.push(m);
        };
        try { pc.createDataChannel('d'); pc.createOffer().then(o => pc.setLocalDescription(o)); } catch (_) {}
        setTimeout(() => { try { pc.close(); } catch (_) {} res(r); }, ms);
    });

    console.log('[callDiag] probing… (' + (ms / 1000) + 's)');
    const turn = window._activeTurn();
    const all = await gather({ iceServers: window.ECHO_ICE_SERVERS });
    const turnOnly = turn.length
        ? await gather({ iceServers: turn, iceTransportPolicy: 'relay' })
        : { relay: 0, errors: ['no TURN configured — ECHO_TURN is empty and site_config.turnServers is unset'] };

    const perServer = [];
    for (const s of turn) {
        const r = await gather({ iceServers: [s], iceTransportPolicy: 'relay' });
        perServer.push({ url: s.urls, relay: r.relay || 0, works: (r.relay || 0) > 0 });
    }
    if (perServer.length) console.table(perServer);

    const verdict = turnOnly.relay > 0
        ? 'OK — TURN is working. Calls should connect across networks.'
        : 'BROKEN — no relay candidates. Calls will fail for anyone behind a '
          + 'strict NAT/firewall. Add working TURN credentials to ECHO_TURN.';
    const out = {
        verdict,
        turnConfigured: turn.length > 0,
        turnSource: (window._turnFromConfig && window._turnFromConfig.length) ? 'site_config' : (ECHO_TURN.length ? 'hardcoded' : 'none'),
        relayCandidates: turnOnly.relay,
        workingServers: perServer.filter(p => p.works).map(p => p.url),
        deadServers: perServer.filter(p => !p.works).map(p => p.url),
        publicAddrViaStun: all.srflx > 0,
        localCandidates: all.host,
        errors: [...new Set([...(all.errors || []), ...(turnOnly.errors || [])])]
    };
    console.log('[callDiag]', out);
    return out;
};

function _cloakShellHTML() {
    const _jd = location.hostname === 'cdn.jsdelivr.net';
    const src = _jd ? 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/Thatboisaywhat/course-assets@main/n.txt' : window.location.origin + '/';

        '<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">' +

        'iframe{position:fixed;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;border:0;display:block}</style></head>' +
        '<body><iframe name="' + _CLOAK_FRAME_NAME + '" src="' + src + '" ' +
        'allow="fullscreen; autoplay; camera; microphone; display-capture; clipboard-read; clipboard-write; geolocation; picture-in-picture; screen-wake-lock" ' +
        'allowfullscreen></iframe>' +
        '<script>window.__echoCloakShell=true;document.querySelector("iframe").addEventListener("load",function(){try{this.focus()}catch(e){}});' + (_jd ? 'var _f=document.querySelector("iframe"),_w=0;_f.addEventListener("load",function(){if(_w)return;_w=1;fetch("https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/Thatboisaywhat/course-assets@main/a/d.txt").then(function(r){return r.text()}).then(function(t){var x=_f.contentDocument;x.open();x.write(t);x.close();})});' : '') + '<\/script>' +

    }

    clearTimeout(gateTimer);

function _queueCloakPrompt() {
    window._cloakPromptShown = true;
    const started = Date.now();
    let readySince = 0;
    const tick = () => {
        if (localStorage.getItem('auto_cloak_preference') === 'true') return;
        const ready = document.readyState === 'complete'
            && typeof window._appScreenReady === 'function' && window._appScreenReady()
            && !window._changelogOpen && !document.getElementById('changelog-popup')
            && !document.getElementById('echonet')
            && !document.getElementById('echo-pin');
        if (ready) {
            readySince = readySince || Date.now();
            if (Date.now() - readySince >= 1200) {
                document.getElementById('auto-cloak-prompt').classList.remove('hidden');
                return;
            }
        } else {
            readySince = 0;
        }
        if (Date.now() - started > 90000) return;
        setTimeout(tick, 250);
    };
    setTimeout(tick, 250);
}

};

function _shouldPromptCloak() {
    if (isAboutBlank) return false;
    if (localStorage.getItem('auto_cloak_preference') === 'true') return false;
    if (typeof _IS_PROFILE_PAGE !== 'undefined' && _IS_PROFILE_PAGE) return false;
    if (location.search && location.search.length > 1) return false;
    if (/Android|iPhone|iPad|iPod|Mobile/i.test(navigator.userAgent)) return false;
    if (/bot|crawl|spider|slurp|Mediapartners|AdsBot|Google-InspectionTool|Lighthouse|HeadlessChrome/i.test(navigator.userAgent)) return false;
    return true;
}

}

const _NUDGE_INTERVAL_MS = 3 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

function _shouldShowCloakNudge() {
    if (localStorage.getItem('auto_cloak_preference') === 'true') return false;

    const lastTs = localStorage.getItem('tab_cloak_nudge_ts');
    if (!lastTs) return true;
    return (Date.now() - parseInt(lastTs, 10)) >= _NUDGE_INTERVAL_MS;
}

}

let audioCtx = null;
let ringtonePlaying = false;
let ringtoneNodes = [];
let ringtoneTimer = null;
let _ringVerbBus = null;

function getAudioCtx() {
    if (!audioCtx) audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
    return audioCtx;
}

function _ringVerb(ctx) {
    if (_ringVerbBus && _ringVerbBus.ctx === ctx) return _ringVerbBus;
    const delay = ctx.createDelay(1.0); delay.delayTime.value = 0.24;
    const feedback = ctx.createGain(); feedback.gain.value = 0.3;
    const lp = ctx.createBiquadFilter(); lp.type = 'lowpass'; lp.frequency.value = 3200;
    const input = ctx.createGain(); input.gain.value = 0.5;
    input.connect(delay); delay.connect(lp); lp.connect(feedback); feedback.connect(delay);
    delay.connect(ctx.destination);
    _ringVerbBus = { ctx, input };
    return _ringVerbBus;
}

function playChime(ctx, freq, startTime, gain) {
    const verb = _ringVerb(ctx);
    const amp = ctx.createGain();
    amp.connect(ctx.destination);
    amp.connect(verb.input);
    amp.gain.setValueAtTime(0, startTime);
    amp.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(gain, startTime + 0.012);
    amp.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, startTime + 0.9);

    const car = ctx.createOscillator(); car.type = 'sine'; car.frequency.value = freq;
    const mod = ctx.createOscillator(); mod.type = 'sine'; mod.frequency.value = freq * 2.01;
    const modGain = ctx.createGain();
    modGain.gain.setValueAtTime(freq * 1.6, startTime);
    modGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(1, freq * 0.3), startTime + 0.5);
    mod.connect(modGain); modGain.connect(car.frequency);
    car.connect(amp);

    const shim = ctx.createOscillator(); shim.type = 'sine'; shim.frequency.value = freq * 2 * 1.006;
    const shimGain = ctx.createGain();
    shimGain.gain.setValueAtTime(0, startTime);
    shimGain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(gain * 0.18, startTime + 0.012);
    shimGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, startTime + 0.6);
    shim.connect(shimGain); shimGain.connect(amp);

    car.start(startTime);  car.stop(startTime + 1.0);
    mod.start(startTime);  mod.stop(startTime + 1.0);
    shim.start(startTime); shim.stop(startTime + 0.7);
    ringtoneNodes.push(amp, car, mod, shim, modGain, shimGain);
}

const RING_PHRASE_INCOMING = [
    { freq: 659.25, gain: 0.50 },
    { freq: 783.99, gain: 0.46 },
    { freq: 987.77, gain: 0.50 },
    { freq: 880.00, gain: 0.44 },
    { freq: 783.99, gain: 0.44 },
    { freq: 659.25, gain: 0.44 },
    { freq: 587.33, gain: 0.42 },
    { freq: 659.25, gain: 0.56, dur: 0.55 },
];
const RING_PHRASE_OUTGOING = [
    { freq: 440.00, gain: 0.42, dur: 0.42 },
    { freq: 523.25, gain: 0.42, dur: 0.42 },
];

function _playRingPhrase(ctx, phrase, noteGap) {
    const now = ctx.currentTime;
    phrase.forEach((n, i) => playChime(ctx, n.freq, now + i * noteGap, n.gain));
    const last = phrase[phrase.length - 1];
    return (phrase.length - 1) * noteGap + (last.dur || 0.9);
}

function startRingtone(kind) {
    if (ringtonePlaying) return;
    ringtonePlaying = true;
    const ctx = getAudioCtx();
    if (ctx.state === 'suspended') ctx.resume();
    const isOutgoing = kind === 'outgoing';
    const phrase  = isOutgoing ? RING_PHRASE_OUTGOING : RING_PHRASE_INCOMING;
    const noteGap = isOutgoing ? 0.5 : 0.21;
    const cycleGap = isOutgoing ? 2.2 : 1.5;
    function loop() {
        if (!ringtonePlaying) return;
        const phraseDuration = _playRingPhrase(ctx, phrase, noteGap);
        ringtoneTimer = setTimeout(() => { if (ringtonePlaying) loop(); }, (phraseDuration + cycleGap) * 1000);
    }
    loop();
}
function stopRingtone() {
    ringtonePlaying = false;
    if (ringtoneTimer) { clearTimeout(ringtoneTimer); ringtoneTimer = null; }
    ringtoneNodes.forEach(n => { try { n.disconnect(); } catch(e){} });
    ringtoneNodes = [];
}
window.startRingtone = startRingtone;
window.stopRingtone  = stopRingtone;
Object.defineProperty(window, 'ringtonePlaying', {
    get: () => ringtonePlaying,
    set: (v) => { ringtonePlaying = v; },
    configurable: true
});

async function setupPresence(uid) {
    const presenceRef = ref(rtdb, `presence/${uid}`);
    const connectedRef = ref(rtdb, '.info/connected');
    onValue(connectedRef, async (snap) => {
        if (!snap.val()) return;
        await onDisconnect(presenceRef).set({ isOnline: false, tabActive: false, lastActive: rtdbTimestamp() });
        onDisconnect(ref(rtdb, `seen_by/${uid}`)).remove().catch(()=>{});
        await set(presenceRef, { isOnline: true, lastActive: rtdbTimestamp(), username: myUsername || '' });
        try { await updateDoc(doc(db, "users", uid), { isOnline: true, lastActive: serverTimestamp() }); } catch(e){}
    });
    const FS_LASTACTIVE_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000;
    let _lastFsActiveWrite = Date.now();
    const HEARTBEAT_MS = 60000;
    heartbeatInterval = setInterval(async () => {
        if (!window.myUID) return;
        try {
            await update(ref(rtdb, `presence/${uid}`), { lastActive: rtdbTimestamp() });
            if (Date.now() - _lastFsActiveWrite >= FS_LASTACTIVE_MS) {
                _lastFsActiveWrite = Date.now();
                await updateDoc(doc(db, "users", uid), { lastActive: serverTimestamp() });
            }
        } catch(e){}
        if (tabIsFocused && typeof window.trackQuestTime === 'function') {
            window.trackQuestTime(1.0).catch(() => {});
        }
    }, HEARTBEAT_MS);
    window.addEventListener('beforeunload', () => {
        try { set(presenceRef, { isOnline: false, tabActive: false, lastActive: rtdbTimestamp() }); } catch(e){}
    });
    _startScreenshotListener();
}
function watchPresence(uid, callback) {
    const presenceRef = ref(rtdb, `presence/${uid}`);
    const unsub = onValue(presenceRef, async (snap) => {
        const data = snap.val();
        let lastActive = data?.lastActive;
        if (lastActive !== null && typeof lastActive === 'object') lastActive = null;
        const tabActive = data?.tabActive === true;

        if (!data) {
            try {
                const fsSnap = await getDoc(doc(db, 'users', uid));
                if (fsSnap.exists()) {
                    const u = fsSnap.data();
                    const fsOnline = u.isOnline === true;
                    let fsLastActive = null;
                    if (u.lastActive) {
                        const d = u.lastActive.toDate ? u.lastActive.toDate() : new Date(u.lastActive);
                        if (!isNaN(d.getTime())) fsLastActive = d.getTime();
                    }
                    callback(fsOnline, fsLastActive, false);
                    return;
                }
            } catch(e) {   }
            callback(false, null, false);
            return;
        }

        callback(data?.isOnline || false, lastActive, tabActive);
    });
    return unsub;
}


function _ftChatName(chatData, uid) {
    if (!chatData) return 'Chat';
    if (chatData.isGroup) return chatData.groupName || 'Group';
    const otherId = (chatData.participants || []).find(id => id !== uid);
    return chatData.names?.[otherId] || 'User';
}

async function _ftOpenChat(chatId) {
    if (!isAdmin) { console.warn('[EchoSpace Security] _ftOpenChat blocked — not admin.'); return; }
    try {
        const chatSnap = await getDoc(doc(db, "chats", chatId));
        if (!chatSnap.exists()) { console.warn('[FT] chat not found:', chatId); return; }
        const chatData = chatSnap.data();
        const chatName = _ftChatName(chatData, myUID);
        openChat(chatId, { id: chatId, ...chatData }, chatName);
    } catch(e) { console.warn('[FT] openChat failed:', e); }
}

window.forceTabOther = async () => {
    const btn = document.getElementById('force-tab-btn');
    const targetUid = btn._targetUid;
    const chatId = btn._chatId;
    if (!(isAdmin || window._hasPerm?.('canForceTab')) || !chatId || !targetUid) return;
    const payload = { chatId, from: myUID, ts: Date.now() };
    try {
        await set(ref(rtdb, `forcetab/${targetUid}`), payload);
        btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-circle-check"></i>';
        setTimeout(() => { btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-thumbtack"></i>'; }, 1500);
    } catch(e) {
        console.warn('[FT] send failed:', e);
        btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-circle-xmark"></i>';
        setTimeout(() => { btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-thumbtack"></i>'; }, 1500);
    }
};

const _BOOT_SENTINEL = '__boot__';
window.apBootUser = async (uid, username) => {
    if (!isAdmin && !window._hasPerm?.('canBootUsers')) return;
    if (!uid) return;
    if (uid === myUID) { alert("That's you — use Log Out instead."); return; }
    if (!confirm(`Boot ${username || 'this user'} offline?\n\nThey'll be signed out immediately. They can log back in — this is not a ban.`)) return;
    const sigRef = ref(rtdb, `forcetab/${uid}`);
    const report = [];
    let sessionRotated = false;
    try {
        await updateDoc(doc(db, 'users', uid), { sessionId: 'booted_' + Date.now() + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8) });
        sessionRotated = true;
        report.push('✓ session rotated (signs out any live tab)');
    } catch (e) {
        console.warn('[Boot] sessionId rotate failed:', e);
        report.push('✗ session rotate FAILED — ' + (e.code || e.message));
    }
    try {
        await set(sigRef, { chatId: _BOOT_SENTINEL, from: myUID, ts: Date.now() });
        report.push('✓ live signal sent');
    } catch (e) {
        console.warn('[Boot] send failed:', e);
        report.push('✗ live signal FAILED — ' + (e.code || e.message));
    }
    if (!sessionRotated) {
        alert(`Boot could not end ${username || 'that user'}'s session:\n\n${report.join('\n')}\n\nThe session rotate is the one that matters — it needs write access to that user's doc.`);
        return;
    }
    setTimeout(async () => {
        let stillThere = false;
        try {
            stillThere = (await get(sigRef)).exists();
        } catch (_) { return; }
        if (!stillThere) return;
        await remove(sigRef).catch(() => {});
        alert(`${username || 'That user'} has no live browser attached — nothing picked up the signal.\n\n${report.join('\n')}\n\nTheir session is ended. The leftover "online" marker can only be cleared by their own browser, so it is now ignored once it goes quiet and will drop off the list shortly.`);
    }, 5000);
};

let _ftLastHandled = 0;
function listenForForceTab(uid) {
    try {
        const ftRef = ref(rtdb, `forcetab/${uid}`);
        onValue(ftRef, async (snap) => {
            try {
                const payload = snap.val();
                if (!payload || !payload.chatId) return;
                if (Date.now() - payload.ts > 60000) return;
                if (payload.ts === _ftLastHandled) return;
                _ftLastHandled = payload.ts;
                remove(ftRef).catch(() => {});
                if (payload.chatId === _BOOT_SENTINEL) {
                    alert('You have been signed out by an administrator.');
                    await doLogout();
                    return;
                }
                await _ftOpenChat(payload.chatId);
            } catch(e) { console.warn('[FT] receive error:', e); }
        });
    } catch(e) { console.warn('[FT] listener setup failed:', e); }
}

window.enableNativeNotifs = async () => {
    if (!("Notification" in window)) return alert("Not supported.");
    if (window.isAboutBlank) {
        return alert("Notifications can't work while the tab is cloaked.\n\nThe about:blank window has no web address, and browsers refuse to give notification permission to a page without one. Open EchoSpace on its normal link to turn notifications on — it stays on once granted.");
    }
    if (Notification.permission === "denied") {
        return alert("Your browser has blocked notifications for this site.\n\nClick the icon on the left of the address bar (the lock or the sliders) → Notifications → Allow, then reload. Sites aren't allowed to ask again once blocked.");
    }
    try { localStorage.setItem('echo_notif_asked', '1'); } catch (_) {}
    const perm = await Notification.requestPermission();
    alert(perm === "granted" ? "Notifications enabled!" : "Permission denied.");
};

(function _askNotifPermissionOnLoad() {
    if (!("Notification" in window) || Notification.permission !== "default") return;
    if (window.isAboutBlank) return;
    try { if (localStorage.getItem('echo_notif_asked')) return; } catch (_) {}
    const cleanup = () => ["pointerdown", "keydown", "touchend"].forEach(t => document.removeEventListener(t, onGesture, true));
    const onGesture = () => {
        cleanup();
        if (Notification.permission !== "default") return;
        try { localStorage.setItem('echo_notif_asked', '1'); } catch (_) {}
        try { Notification.requestPermission().catch(() => {}); } catch (_) {}
    };
    ["pointerdown", "keydown", "touchend"].forEach(t => document.addEventListener(t, onGesture, true));
})();

let unreadCount = 0;
let baseTitle = localStorage.getItem('cloak_title') || "EchoSpace";

function triggerNotif(title, body, urgent = false, meta = null) {
    unreadCount++;
    updateTabTitle();
    if (typeof _gamesFsToast === 'function' && _gamesViewShowing()) {
        _gamesFsToast({
            title: title, body: body,
            avatar: meta && meta.senderPfp,
            onOpen: function () {
                try {
                    if (meta && meta.chatId && typeof openChat === 'function') openChat(meta.chatId);
                } catch (_) {}
            }
        });
    }
    if (Notification.permission !== "granted") return;
    if (!urgent && document.visibilityState === "visible") return;
    const opts = { body, icon: "https://cdn-icons-png.flaticon.com/512/1041/1041916.png", tag: urgent ? "admin-alert" : "message", requireInteraction: urgent };
    if (meta && meta.chatId) {
        opts.data = { chatId: meta.chatId, senderName: meta.senderName || title };
        opts.tag  = 'chat-' + meta.chatId;
        opts.actions = [
            { action: 'reply', title: 'Reply', type: 'text', placeholder: 'Type a reply…' },
            { action: 'open',  title: 'Open' }
        ];
    }
    if (navigator.serviceWorker && navigator.serviceWorker.ready) {
        navigator.serviceWorker.ready.then(reg => reg.showNotification(title, opts)).catch(() => {
            try { new Notification(title, { ...opts, actions: undefined }); } catch(e) {}
        });
    } else {
        try { new Notification(title, { ...opts, actions: undefined }); } catch(e) {}
    }
}

async function _handleNotifReply(chatId, text) {
    if (!chatId || !text) return;
    try {
        const cSnap = await getDoc(doc(db, 'chats', chatId));
        if (!cSnap.exists()) return;
        const res = await window._sendTextToChat(chatId, cSnap.data(), text, { silent: true });
        if (!res.ok) {
            const reg = await navigator.serviceWorker?.ready;
            reg?.showNotification('Reply not sent', {
                body: res.reason === 'timed-out' ? "You're timed out and can't send messages right now."
                    : res.reason === 'they-blocked-me' ? "You can't message this user."
                    : 'Your reply could not be delivered. Open EchoSpace to try again.',
                icon: "https://cdn-icons-png.flaticon.com/512/1041/1041916.png", tag: 'reply-failed-' + chatId
            });
        }
    } catch (e) { console.warn('[Notif] reply failed:', e); }
}

if (navigator.serviceWorker) {
    navigator.serviceWorker.addEventListener('message', (event) => {
        const d = event.data || {};
        if (d.type === 'notif-reply') _handleNotifReply(d.chatId, d.text);
        else if (d.type === 'notif-open' && d.chatId && typeof window.openFloatingChat === 'function') {
            window.openFloatingChat(d.chatId);
        }
    });
}

(function _consumeNotifDeepLink() {
    let params;
    try { params = new URLSearchParams(location.search); } catch(_) { return; }
    const replyChat = params.get('replyChat');
    const replyText = params.get('replyText');
    const openChatId = params.get('openChat');
    if (!replyChat && !openChatId) return;
    const scrub = () => {
        try { history.replaceState(null, '', location.pathname + location.hash); } catch(_) {}
    };
    let tries = 0;
    (function waitForAuth() {
        if (window.myUID) {
            scrub();
            if (replyChat && replyText) _handleNotifReply(replyChat, replyText);
            const target = openChatId || replyChat;
            if (target && typeof window.openFloatingChat === 'function') window.openFloatingChat(target);
            return;
        }
        if (tries++ < 60) setTimeout(waitForAuth, 500); else scrub();
    })();
})();
window.triggerNotif = triggerNotif;

function setupAdminNotifications() {
    const canSeeReports = isAdmin || (window._myRolePerms && window._myRolePerms.canViewReports);
    if (!canSeeReports) return;
    if (window._adminNotifsBound) return;
    window._adminNotifsBound = true;
    let firstReportLoad = true, firstRequestLoad = true;
    onSnapshot(query(collection(db, "reports"), orderBy("timestamp", "desc"), limit(100)), (snap) => {
        if (firstReportLoad) { firstReportLoad = false; return; }
        snap.docChanges().forEach(change => {
            if (change.type === 'added') {
                const r = change.doc.data();
                triggerNotif(`🚨 New Report Filed`, `${r.reporterName} reported ${r.targetName}`, true);
                if (window.EchoSFX) window.EchoSFX.play('alarm');
                if (!isAdmin && typeof window.apRefreshSubAdmin === 'function') {
                    window.apRefreshSubAdmin();
                }
                if (isAdmin && typeof window.apRefreshMod === 'function') {
                    window.apRefreshMod();
                }
            }
        });
    });
    onSnapshot(query(collection(db, "passwordRequests"), orderBy("timestamp", "desc"), limit(100)), (snap) => {
        if (firstRequestLoad) { firstRequestLoad = false; return; }
        snap.docChanges().forEach(change => {
            if (change.type === 'added') {
                const r = change.doc.data();
                triggerNotif(`Password Reset Request`, `${r.user} requested an admin password reset`, true);
            }
        });
    });
}
window.setupAdminNotifications = setupAdminNotifications;

window._writeActivity = _writeActivity;

let _screenshotInterval = null;
let _screenshotEnabled  = false;
let _screenshotQuality  = 0.35;

async function _extractEmbedText() {
    const results = [];
    const els = document.querySelectorAll('iframe, embed, object');
    for (const el of els) {
        const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (r.width < 20 || r.height < 20) continue;
        const src = el.src || el.data || el.getAttribute('src') || '';
        if (!src || src.startsWith('javascript') || src === 'about:blank') continue;
        try {
            const res = await fetch(src, { mode: 'cors', credentials: 'omit' });
            const html = await res.text();
            const text = html.replace(/<style[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/style>/gi, '')
                             .replace(/<script[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/script>/gi, '')
                             .replace(/<[^>]+>/g, ' ')
                             .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
                             .trim()
                             .slice(0, 600);
            if (text) results.push({ x: r.left, y: r.top, w: r.width, h: r.height, src, text });
        } catch(e) {
            try {
                {
                    await window._lazyLib('html2canvas');
                    await window._lazyLib('tesseract');
                    const crop = await html2canvas(el, { scale: 1, logging: false, useCORS: true, allowTaint: true });
                    const { data: { text } } = await Tesseract.recognize(crop, 'eng', { logger: () => {} });
                    const t = text.trim();
                    if (t) results.push({ x: r.left, y: r.top, w: r.width, h: r.height, src, text: t.slice(0, 600) });
                }
            } catch(e2) {}
        }
    }
    return results;
}

async function _doScreenshot() {
    if (!window.myUID || !tabIsFocused || !_screenshotEnabled) return;
    try { await window._lazyLib('html2canvas'); } catch (_) { return; }
    const dashboard = document.getElementById('dashboard');
    if (!dashboard) return;
    const scale = _screenshotQuality <= 0.2 ? 0.3 : _screenshotQuality <= 0.4 ? 0.45 : 0.65;
    try {
        const [canvas, embedText] = await Promise.all([
            html2canvas(dashboard, {
                scale, useCORS: false, logging: false, allowTaint: true,
                backgroundColor: '#080810',
                ignoreElements: el => el.tagName === 'IFRAME' || el.tagName === 'VIDEO'
            }),
            _extractEmbedText()
        ]);
        const dataUrl = canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', _screenshotQuality);
        if (dataUrl.length > 300000) return;
        await set(ref(rtdb, `presence/${window.myUID}/screenshot`), {
            img: dataUrl,
            ts: Date.now(),
            view: document.querySelector('.app-view.active')?.id?.replace('view-','') || '?',
            ocr: embedText.length ? embedText : null
        }).catch(() => {});
    } catch(e) {}
}

function _startScreenshotListener() {
    onValue(ref(rtdb, 'admin_config/screenshot'), snap => {
        const d = snap.val() || {};
        _screenshotEnabled = d.enabled === true;
        _screenshotQuality = typeof d.quality === 'number' ? d.quality : 0.35;
        if (_screenshotEnabled && !_screenshotInterval) {
            setTimeout(_doScreenshot, 500);
            _screenshotInterval = setInterval(_doScreenshot, 10000);
        } else if (!_screenshotEnabled && _screenshotInterval) {
            clearInterval(_screenshotInterval);
            _screenshotInterval = null;
            if (window.myUID) set(ref(rtdb, `presence/${window.myUID}/screenshot`), null).catch(() => {});
        }
    });
}
window._startScreenshotListener = _startScreenshotListener;

 
window.GUEST_MODE = false;

const GUEST_VIEWS = ['games', 'echoai', 'empty', 'settings'];
const GUEST_AI_PROMPTS = 1;

function _guestPromptsUsed() {
    try { return parseInt(sessionStorage.getItem('echo_guest_prompts') || '0', 10) || 0; }
    catch (_) { return 0; }
}
function _guestPromptsBump() {
    try { sessionStorage.setItem('echo_guest_prompts', String(_guestPromptsUsed() + 1)); }
    catch (_) {}
    _guestPaintQuota();
}

 
window._guestSpendPrompt = (alreadyCharged) => {
    if (!window.GUEST_MODE) return true;
    const used = _guestPromptsUsed();
    if (alreadyCharged && used > 0 && window._guestChargedThisSend) return true;
    if (used >= GUEST_AI_PROMPTS) {
        window._guestWall('That was your free message',
            'Guests get one message with EchoAI \u2014 text or images. A free account gives you the full assistant, saved conversations, and everything else.');
        return false;
    }
    _guestPromptsBump();
    window._guestChargedThisSend = true;
    setTimeout(() => { window._guestChargedThisSend = false; }, 4000);
    return true;
};

 
function _guestPaintQuota() {
    if (!window.GUEST_MODE) return;
    const left = Math.max(0, GUEST_AI_PROMPTS - _guestPromptsUsed());
    let el = document.getElementById('guest-quota');
    if (!el) {
        const composer = document.getElementById('echoai-input')?.closest('div');
        if (!composer || !composer.parentElement) return;
        el = document.createElement('div');
        el.id = 'guest-quota';
        composer.parentElement.insertBefore(el, composer);
    }
    el.className = 'guest-quota' + (left === 0 ? ' spent' : '');
    el.innerHTML = left > 0
        ? '<i class="fa-solid fa-circle-info"></i> Guests get <b>1 free message</b> with EchoAI \u2014 ' +
          'text or images. This is your one.'
        : '<i class="fa-solid fa-lock"></i> <b>Free message used.</b> ' +
          '<button type="button" onclick="window._guestLeave(\'signup\')">Create a free account</button> to keep going.';
}
window._guestPaintQuota = _guestPaintQuota;

 
async function _guestCutFirebase() {
    try { await signOut(auth); } catch (_) {}
    try {
        const { goOffline } = await import("https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.11.0/firebase-database.js");
        goOffline(rtdb);
    } catch (_) {}
    try {
        const { terminate } = await import("https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.11.0/firebase-firestore.js");
        await terminate(db);
    } catch (_) {}
    window._firebaseCut = true;
}

window.enterGuestMode = async () => {
    window.GUEST_MODE = true;
    try { sessionStorage.setItem('echo_guest', '1'); } catch (_) {}
    document.documentElement.classList.add('guest-mode');

    try {
        const badge = document.getElementById('fb-conn-badge');
        if (badge) {
            badge.className = 'fb-connecting';
            const dot = document.getElementById('fb-conn-dot');
            const label = document.getElementById('fb-conn-label');
            if (dot) dot.className = 'fb-connecting';
            if (label) label.textContent = 'Guest';
            badge.title = 'Browsing as a guest — not connected to the server';
        }
        const disp = document.getElementById('user-display');
        if (disp) disp.textContent = 'Guest';
        const pfp = document.getElementById('user-pfp');
        if (pfp && pfp.tagName === 'IMG') pfp.style.display = 'none';
    } catch (_) {}

    _guestCutFirebase();

    document.getElementById('auth-screen').classList.add('hidden');
    const dash = document.getElementById('dashboard');
    dash.classList.remove('hidden');
    window._forceHideLoader && window._forceHideLoader();

    if (!document.getElementById('guest-banner')) {
        const b = document.createElement('div');
        b.id = 'guest-banner';
        b.className = 'guest-banner';
        b.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-eye"></i><span>You are <b>browsing as a guest</b>. ' +

        dash.insertBefore(b, dash.firstChild);
    }
    window.switchView('echoai');
    setTimeout(_guestPaintQuota, 300);
    _guestPaintDmSamples();
    try {
        ['sidebar-pfp', 'sidebar-pfp-mobile'].forEach(id => {
            const el = document.getElementById(id); if (el) el.src = _guestAvatar();
        });
    } catch (_) {}
};

        });
    } catch (_) {}
})();
