function _guestAvatar() {
    const p = _gp();
    if (p.pfp) return p.pfp;
    const name = p.username || 'Guest';
    let h = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < name.length; i++) h = (h * 31 + name.charCodeAt(i)) >>> 0;
    const colors = window.AVATAR_COLORS || ['#6366f1'];
    return window.makeDefaultAvatar(colors[h % colors.length], 'letter', name);
}

 
function _guestRenderProfile() {
    const p = _gp();
    const set = (id, txt) => { const el = document.getElementById(id); if (el) el.innerText = txt; };
    set('profile-page-name', p.username || 'Guest');
    set('profile-page-handle', '@' + (p.username || 'guest').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9_.]/g, ''));
    set('profile-page-followers', '0');
    set('profile-page-following', '0');
    set('profile-page-views', '1');
    set('profile-page-seen', 'Active now');
    set('profile-page-joined', 'Not saved anywhere');
    const pfp = document.getElementById('profile-page-pfp');
    if (pfp) pfp.src = _guestAvatar();
    document.getElementById('profile-page-status')?.classList.add('hidden');
    document.getElementById('profile-page-mutuals')?.classList.add('hidden');
    document.getElementById('profile-page-online')?.classList.add('visible');
    document.getElementById('profile-page-url')?.classList.add('hidden');
    window._renderProfileBio({ bio: p.bio });
    ['profile-page-badge-verified', 'profile-page-badge-owner', 'profile-page-badge-admin',
     'profile-page-badge-role'].forEach(id => document.getElementById(id)?.classList.add('hidden'));
    const streaks = document.getElementById('profile-page-streak-badges');
    if (streaks) streaks.innerHTML = '';

    try { applyProfileCustomization(p, false, null); } catch (_) {}

    const actions = document.getElementById('profile-page-actions');
    if (actions) {
        actions.innerHTML =
            '<button class="btn-primary text-sm" onclick="openPCM()"><i class="fa-solid fa-pen"></i> Customize Profile</button>' +
            '<button class="btn-ghost text-sm" onclick="window._guestSaveProfile()"><i class="fa-solid fa-cloud-arrow-up"></i> Save this profile</button>';
    }
    _guestPaintProfileNotice();
}

 
function _guestPaintProfileNotice() {
    const anchor = document.getElementById('profile-page-actions');
    if (!anchor || !anchor.parentElement) return;
    let el = document.getElementById('guest-profile-notice');
    if (!el) {
        el = document.createElement('div');
        el.id = 'guest-profile-notice';
        el.style.cssText = 'margin-top:14px;background:rgba(99,102,241,.08);border:1px solid rgba(99,102,241,.25);' +
            'border-radius:12px;padding:11px 14px;font-size:11.5px;color:#8a8ab0;line-height:1.6;max-width:640px;';
        anchor.parentElement.insertBefore(el, anchor.nextSibling);
    }
    el.innerHTML =
        '<i class="fa-solid fa-triangle-exclamation" style="color:#fbbf24"></i> ' +
        '<b style="color:#e8e8f0">This profile is not saved.</b> It only exists in this tab — ' +
        'refresh, close it, or leave guest mode and it is gone for good. ' +
        '<button type="button" onclick="window._guestSaveProfile()" ' +
        'style="background:none;border:none;padding:0;color:#818cf8;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:underline;">' +
        'Keep it by making a free account</button>.';
}

window._guestOpenProfile = () => {
    const profilePage = document.getElementById('profile-page');
    const dashboard = document.getElementById('dashboard');
    if (!profilePage) return;
    profilePage.style.display = 'flex';
    profilePage.classList.add('open');
    if (dashboard) dashboard.classList.add('hidden');
    document.title = (_gp().username || 'Guest') + ' — EchoSpace';
    _guestRenderProfile();
};

 
function _guestPrepPCM() {
    const p = _gp();
    document.querySelectorAll('#pcm-tabs .pcm-tab').forEach(t => {
        const isServerTab = /music|effects/i.test(t.textContent || '');
        t.style.display = isServerTab ? 'none' : '';
    });
    const starsRow = document.getElementById('pcm-stars-row');
    if (starsRow) starsRow.style.display = 'none';

    const about = document.getElementById('pcm-about');
    if (about && !document.getElementById('pcm-guest-id')) {
        const box = document.createElement('div');
        box.id = 'pcm-guest-id';
        box.innerHTML =
            '<div style="background:rgba(99,102,241,.08);border:1px solid rgba(99,102,241,.25);border-radius:10px;' +
                 'padding:9px 12px;font-size:11px;color:#8a8ab0;line-height:1.55;margin-bottom:14px;">' +
              '<i class="fa-solid fa-eye" style="color:#818cf8"></i> <b style="color:#e8e8f0">Guest preview.</b> ' +
              'Everything you change here is kept in this tab only and vanishes on refresh.' +
            '</div>' +
            '<div class="pcm-label" style="margin-top:0;">Display name</div>' +
            '<input id="pcm-guest-name" class="inp" maxlength="20" placeholder="Guest" style="width:100%;">' +
            '<div class="pcm-label">Profile picture</div>' +
            '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;">' +
              '<img id="pcm-guest-pfp-preview" style="width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;background:#0d0d18;">' +
              '<input type="file" id="pcm-guest-pfp-input" accept="image/*" class="hidden">' +
              '<button type="button" class="pcm-draw-tool" onclick="document.getElementById(\'pcm-guest-pfp-input\').click()">Upload picture</button>' +
              '<button type="button" class="pcm-draw-tool text-[#f87171]" onclick="window._guestClearPfp()">Remove</button>' +
            '</div>' +
            '<div id="pcm-guest-pfp-msg" style="font-size:11px;color:#555566;margin-top:6px;"></div>' +
            '<div style="height:1px;background:#1a1a2e;margin:16px 0;"></div>';
        about.insertBefore(box, about.firstChild);
        document.getElementById('pcm-guest-pfp-input').addEventListener('change', async (e) => {
            const file = e.target.files[0];
            const msg = document.getElementById('pcm-guest-pfp-msg');
            e.target.value = '';
            if (!file) return;
            if (!file.type || !file.type.startsWith('image/')) { msg.innerText = 'Must be an image.'; msg.style.color = '#f87171'; return; }
            msg.innerText = 'Processing…'; msg.style.color = '#818cf8';
            try {
                const dataUrl = await _compressImage(file);
                _gp().pfp = dataUrl;
                document.getElementById('pcm-guest-pfp-preview').src = dataUrl;
                msg.innerText = 'Picture set — press Save Changes.'; msg.style.color = '#22c55e';
            } catch (err) {
                msg.innerText = 'Error: ' + err.message; msg.style.color = '#f87171';
            }
        });
    }
    const nameEl = document.getElementById('pcm-guest-name');
    if (nameEl) nameEl.value = p.username === 'Guest' ? '' : (p.username || '');
    const prev = document.getElementById('pcm-guest-pfp-preview');
    if (prev) prev.src = _guestAvatar();
    const bioInput = document.getElementById('pcm-bio-input');
    if (bioInput) { bioInput.value = p.bio || ''; pcmSavedBio = bioInput.value; window.pcmBioCount(); }
    const bannerToggle = document.getElementById('pcm-banner-disabled-toggle');
    if (bannerToggle) { bannerToggle.checked = !!p.bannerDisabled; _pcmUpdateBannerContent(!!p.bannerDisabled); }
}

window._guestClearPfp = () => {
    _gp().pfp = '';
    const prev = document.getElementById('pcm-guest-pfp-preview');
    if (prev) prev.src = _guestAvatar();
    const msg = document.getElementById('pcm-guest-pfp-msg');
    if (msg) { msg.innerText = 'Picture removed — press Save Changes.'; msg.style.color = '#8a8ab0'; }
};

 
function _guestSavePCM() {
    const p = _gp();
    const msg = document.getElementById('pcm-msg');
    if (pcmPendingBg) p.profileBg = pcmPendingBg;
    if (pcmPendingBanner) p.profileBanner = (pcmPendingBanner === '__reset__') ? null : pcmPendingBanner;
    if (pcmPendingBannerDisabled !== null) p.bannerDisabled = pcmPendingBannerDisabled;
    const bioInput = document.getElementById('pcm-bio-input');
    if (bioInput) p.bio = bioInput.value.trim().slice(0, window.MAX_BIO_LEN);
    const nameEl = document.getElementById('pcm-guest-name');
    if (nameEl) p.username = nameEl.value.trim().slice(0, 20) || 'Guest';
    pcmPendingBg = null; pcmPendingBanner = null; pcmPendingBannerDisabled = null;
    pcmPendingMusic = null; pcmMusicRemove = false; pcmPendingStars = null;
    _guestRenderProfile();
    try {
        ['sidebar-pfp', 'sidebar-pfp-mobile'].forEach(id => {
            const el = document.getElementById(id); if (el) el.src = _guestAvatar();
        });
    } catch (_) {}
    if (msg) {
        msg.innerHTML = 'Saved for this tab only — <b>it will not survive a refresh</b>.';
        msg.classList.remove('hidden'); msg.style.color = '#fbbf24';
        setTimeout(() => { msg.classList.add('hidden'); closePCM(); }, 1600);
    }
}

 
const _GUEST_CARRY_KEY = 'echo_guest_profile_carry';
const _GUEST_CARRY_MAX = 700000;

window._guestSaveProfile = () => {
    const p = _gp();
    const carry = {};
    if (p.bio) carry.bio = p.bio;
    const avatar = _guestAvatar();
    if (avatar && avatar.length < 200000) carry.pfp = avatar;
    if (p.profileBg) carry.profileBg = p.profileBg;
    if (p.profileBanner) carry.profileBanner = p.profileBanner;
    if (p.bannerDisabled) carry.bannerDisabled = true;
    if (p.username && p.username !== 'Guest') carry._suggestedName = p.username;
    try {
        const json = JSON.stringify(carry);
        if (json.length <= _GUEST_CARRY_MAX) sessionStorage.setItem(_GUEST_CARRY_KEY, json);
        else sessionStorage.setItem(_GUEST_CARRY_KEY, JSON.stringify({ bio: carry.bio || '', _suggestedName: carry._suggestedName }));
    } catch (_) {}
    window._guestLeave('signup');
};

 
function _guestCarryToast(text) {
    try {
        const t = document.createElement('div');
        t.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);bottom:24px;z-index:1200;' +
            'max-width:min(560px,92vw);background:#0d0d18;border:1px solid rgba(34,197,94,.35);border-radius:12px;' +
            'padding:12px 16px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:#e8e8f0;line-height:1.55;' +
            'box-shadow:0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.55);';
        t.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-circle-check" style="color:#22c55e"></i> ' + window.escHtml(text);
        document.body.appendChild(t);
        setTimeout(() => t.remove(), 9000);
    } catch (_) {}
}

 
window._guestCarryApply = async (uid, uData) => {
    let carry = null;
    try {
        const raw = sessionStorage.getItem(_GUEST_CARRY_KEY);
        if (!raw) return;
        carry = JSON.parse(raw);
    } catch (_) { return; }
    try { sessionStorage.removeItem(_GUEST_CARRY_KEY); } catch (_) {}
    if (!carry || !uid) return;
    const suggested = carry._suggestedName;
    delete carry._suggestedName;
    if (!Object.keys(carry).length) return;

    const d = uData || {};
    const isFresh = !d.bio && !d.pfp && !d.profileBg && !d.profileBanner;
    if (!isFresh && !confirm('Apply the profile you designed as a guest? This replaces your current bio, picture, background and banner.')) return;

    try {
        await updateDoc(doc(db, 'users', uid), carry);
        if (carry.pfp) {
            myPfp = carry.pfp; window.myPfp = carry.pfp;
            ['sidebar-pfp', 'sidebar-pfp-mobile', 'settings-pfp-preview'].forEach(id => {
                const el = document.getElementById(id); if (el) el.src = carry.pfp;
            });
            document.querySelectorAll('img[data-my-pfp]').forEach(el => { el.src = carry.pfp; });
        }
        const note = suggested && suggested.toLowerCase() !== (d.username || '').toLowerCase()
            ? ' Your display name stayed "' + (d.username || 'your username') + '" — usernames here are unique, change it in Settings.'
            : '';
        _guestCarryToast('Your guest profile was saved to your account.' + note);
    } catch (e) {
        console.warn('[guest carry] could not apply guest profile:', e);
    }
};

window.switchView = (id) => {
    if (id === 'settings' && window._pinRefreshStatus) { try { window._pinRefreshStatus(); } catch (_) {} }
    if (window.GUEST_MODE && GUEST_VIEWS.indexOf(id) === -1) {
        window._guestWall('Create a free account',
            'Chats, friends, Spaces and the global feed all need an account. They are free and take about ten seconds.');
        return;
    }
    if (id === 'empty' && currentChatId && !window._allowSwitchEmpty) {
        return;
    }
    window._allowSwitchEmpty = false;
    if (id === 'settings' && typeof window._tfaRefreshSettings === 'function') window._tfaRefreshSettings();
    document.querySelectorAll('.app-view').forEach(el => { el.classList.remove('active'); el.hidden = true; });
    const target = document.getElementById('view-' + id);
    if (target) { target.classList.add('active'); target.hidden = false; }
    document.querySelectorAll('.nav-btn[data-view]').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active-nav'));
    const activeBtn = document.querySelector(`.nav-btn[data-view="${id}"]`);
    if (activeBtn) activeBtn.classList.add('active-nav');
    if (id !== 'chat' && window.innerWidth < 768) closeMobileDmOverlay();
    if (id === 'echoai') { document.title = "EchoAI"; } else { updateTabTitle(); }
    if (id === 'schools' && typeof window.sbLoadSchools === 'function') window.sbLoadSchools();
    if (id === 'games') {
        const gf = document.getElementById('games-frame');
        if (gf && !gf.src) {
            gf.src = window.ARCADE_ORIGIN + '/home#k=' + window._arcadeKey() +
                     (window.GUEST_MODE ? '&guest=1' : '');
            gf.addEventListener('load', () => {
                try {
                    gf.contentWindow.postMessage(
                        { __echo: true, kind: 'hello', theme: window._echoThemePayload || null },
                        window.ARCADE_ORIGIN);
                } catch (_) {}
            });
        }
    }
    try {
        document.getElementById('dashboard')?.classList.toggle('home-glow', id === 'empty');
        window._echoHomeGlow && window._echoHomeGlow(id === 'empty');
    } catch (_) {}
    if (id === 'empty') { try { window._echoHomeRefresh && window._echoHomeRefresh(); } catch (_) {} }
    if (id === 'music' && !window._musicSuggestionsLoaded) {
        window._musicSuggestionsLoaded = true;
        if (typeof loadSuggestions === 'function') loadSuggestions();
    }
    const _activityMap = {
        global: 'Global Chat', friends: 'Searching the Web', requests: 'Notifications',
        browser: 'Searching the Web', games: 'Playing Games', music: 'Listening to Music',
        echoai: 'EchoAI', live: 'Live', watch: 'Watching YouTube', settings: 'Settings', admin: 'Admin Panel',
        chat: 'Chatting', 'create-group': 'Creating a Group', 'group-mgmt': 'Group Settings'
    };
    if (id !== 'chat') {
        _writeActivity(_activityMap[id] || id);
    }
    if (typeof window.updateMiniPlayer === 'function') window.updateMiniPlayer();
};
window.handleBackBtn = () => {
    currentChatId = null; currentChatData = null; window.currentChatId = null; window.currentChatData = null;
    window._allowSwitchEmpty = true; switchView('empty');
    if (window.innerWidth < 768) openMobileDmOverlay();
};

    if (menu && btn && !menu.contains(e.target) && !btn.contains(e.target)) {
        menu.style.display = 'none';
    }
});

};
window.filterMobileDmList = (query) => {
    const q = query.toLowerCase().trim();
    const list = document.getElementById('mobile-dm-list');
    if (!list) return;
    Array.from(list.children).forEach(el => {
        const text = el.innerText?.toLowerCase() || '';
        el.style.display = (!q || text.includes(q)) ? '' : 'none';
    });
};
window.openMobileDmOverlay = () => document.getElementById('mobile-dm-overlay').classList.remove('hidden');
window.closeMobileDmOverlay = () => document.getElementById('mobile-dm-overlay').classList.add('hidden');

const floatVid = document.getElementById('floating-video');
const handle = document.getElementById('drag-handle');
const resizeHandle = document.getElementById('resize-handle');
let isResizing = false, resizeStart = { x: 0, y: 0, w: 0, h: 0 };
let isDragging = false, dragOffset = [0, 0];
handle.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
    if(e.target.tagName === 'BUTTON') return;
    isDragging = true;
    floatVid.classList.add('is-dragging');
    dragOffset = [floatVid.offsetLeft - e.clientX, floatVid.offsetTop - e.clientY];
    e.preventDefault();
});
document.addEventListener('mouseup', () => { isDragging = false; isResizing = false; floatVid.classList.remove('is-dragging', 'is-resizing'); });
document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
    if (isDragging) {
        const newLeft = Math.max(0, Math.min(window.innerWidth - floatVid.offsetWidth, e.clientX + dragOffset[0]));
        const newTop = Math.max(0, Math.min(window.innerHeight - floatVid.offsetHeight, e.clientY + dragOffset[1]));
        floatVid.style.left = newLeft + 'px';
        floatVid.style.top = newTop + 'px';
        floatVid.style.right = 'auto';
    }
    if (isResizing) {
        const newW = Math.max(240, Math.min(800, resizeStart.w + (e.clientX - resizeStart.x)));
        const newH = Math.max(340, Math.min(window.innerHeight * 0.9, resizeStart.h + (e.clientY - resizeStart.y)));
        floatVid.style.width = newW + 'px';
        floatVid.style.height = newH + 'px';
    }
});
resizeHandle.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
    isResizing = true;
    floatVid.classList.add('is-resizing');
    resizeStart = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY, w: floatVid.offsetWidth, h: floatVid.offsetHeight };
    e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation();
});
let isExpanded = false;
window.toggleExpandCall = () => {
    isExpanded = !isExpanded;
    floatVid.style.width = isExpanded ? '640px' : '400px';
    floatVid.style.height = isExpanded ? '480px' : '460px';
};
window.togglePiP = async () => {
    const video = document.getElementById('remote-video');
    if (document.pictureInPictureElement) {
        await document.exitPictureInPicture();
    } else if (document.pictureInPictureEnabled && !video.disablePictureInPicture) {
        try { await video.requestPictureInPicture(); } catch(e) { console.warn(e); }
    }
};

const _LUMIN_GAME_RE = /^lm\.[a-z0-9._-]{1,57}$/;
function _gameMeta(game) {
    game = String(game || '');
    if (!ECHO_BOARD_META[game] && _LUMIN_GAME_RE.test(game)) {

}
const _isDerivedBoard = (m) => !!(m && m.byPlays);

const _SCORE_RULES = {
    '2048':           { max: 4000000 },
    'snake':          { max: 20000,   int: true },
    'block-breaker':  { max: 2000000 },
    'space-rocks':    { max: 5000000 },
    'endless-runner': { max: 2000000 },
    'tower-defense':  { max: 20,      int: true },
    'ping-pong':      { max: 100000,  int: true, modes: ['casual', 'even', 'sharp', 'brutal'] },
    'memory':         { max: 1000,    int: true, modes: ['classic', 'quick', 'strict'] },
    'spike-jumper':   { min: 5,       max: 36000 }
};
function _scoreOk(board, value) {
    const [game, mode, extra] = String(board).split(':');
    const r = _SCORE_RULES[game];
    if (!r || extra !== undefined) return false;
    if (r.modes ? !r.modes.includes(mode) : mode !== undefined) return false;
    if (!isFinite(value) || value < (r.min || 0) || value > r.max) return false;
    if (r.int && Math.floor(value) !== value) return false;
    return true;
}

const _myBestCache = new Map();

async function _echoSubmitScore(msg) {
    if (!myUID) return;
    const board = String(msg.board || '').slice(0, 120);
    if (!board || !_gameMeta(board.split(':')[0])) return;
    const meta = _boardMeta(board);
    if (_isDerivedBoard(meta)) return;
    const value = Number(msg.value);
    if (!_scoreOk(board, value)) { console.warn('[arcade] score refused:', board, msg.value); return; }
    const better = (a, b) => meta.dir === 'low' ? a < b : a > b;

    try {
        const ref = doc(db, 'leaderboards', _boardDocId(board), 'scores', myUID);
        if (!_myBestCache.has(board)) {
            let existing = null;
            try {
                const snap = await getDoc(ref);
                if (snap.exists() && typeof snap.data().score === 'number') existing = snap.data().score;
            } catch (_) {   }
            _myBestCache.set(board, existing);
        }
        const prev = _myBestCache.get(board);
        if (prev !== null && prev !== undefined && !better(value, prev)) return;

        await setDoc(ref, {
            uid: myUID,
            username: myUsername || 'unknown',
            pfp: (myPfp && myPfp.length < 30000) ? myPfp : '',
            score: value,
            dir: meta.dir,
            game: String(msg.game || board.split(':')[0]).slice(0, 60),
            updatedAt: serverTimestamp()
        });
        _myBestCache.set(board, value);
    } catch (e) {
        window.reportRuleDenial && window.reportRuleDenial('Arcade — submit score', e,
            { path: `leaderboards/${_boardDocId(board)}/scores/${myUID}`, op: 'set' });
        console.warn('[arcade] score submit failed:', e?.code || e);
    }
}

 
const _PLAY_LAST_KEY = 'echo_play_last_v1';
const _RELAUNCH_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000;
const _STRIKE_WINDOW_MS = 60 * 60 * 1000;
const _BAN_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000;
const _relaunchGap = new Map();

function _playLastLoad() {
    try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(_PLAY_LAST_KEY) || '{}') || {}; } catch (_) { return {}; }
}
function _playLastTouch(game, counted) {
    try {
        const all = _playLastLoad();
        const prev = all[game] || {};
        all[game] = { t: Date.now(), c: counted === undefined ? !!prev.c : counted };
        for (const k in all) if (Date.now() - (all[k].t || 0) > 86400000) delete all[k];
        localStorage.setItem(_PLAY_LAST_KEY, JSON.stringify(all));
    } catch (_) {}
}

const _PROTECT_DEFAULTS = { 'retro-bowl': true };
let _protectCache = null;
async function _echoProtection() {
    if (_protectCache) return _protectCache;
    let games = {};
    try {
        const s = await getDoc(doc(db, 'game_config', 'protection'));
        if (s.exists()) games = s.data().games || {};
    } catch (_) {}
    _protectCache = Object.assign({}, _PROTECT_DEFAULTS, games);
    return _protectCache;
}
const _banRef = (uid, game) => doc(db, 'game_bans', uid + '__' + game);

async function _echoGameOpened(game, reply) {
    if (!game) return;
    const prev = _playLastLoad()[game];
    const gap = prev ? Date.now() - (prev.t || 0) : Infinity;
    const quick = !!(prev && prev.c && gap >= 0 && gap < _RELAUNCH_MS);
    if (quick) _relaunchGap.set(game, gap); else _relaunchGap.delete(game);
    _playLastTouch(game);

    if (!myUID || window.GUEST_MODE) return;
    const prot = await _echoProtection();
    if (!prot[game]) return;
    let b = {};
    try { const s = await getDoc(_banRef(myUID, game)); if (s.exists()) b = s.data(); } catch (_) {}
    const now = Date.now();
    if ((b.until || 0) > now) { reply({ kind: 'ban', game, until: b.until }); return; }
    if (!quick) return;

    const warnedRecently = (b.strikes || 0) >= 1 && b.lastStrike && now - b.lastStrike < _STRIKE_WINDOW_MS;
    const next = {
        uid: myUID, game, username: myUsername || 'unknown',
        strikes: warnedRecently ? (b.strikes || 1) + 1 : 1,
        lastStrike: now,
        until: warnedRecently ? now + _BAN_MS : (b.until || 0)
    };
    console.info('[arcade] quick relaunch of', game, '—', Math.round(gap / 1000) + 's after last play;',
        warnedRecently ? 'banned 5 min' : 'warned');
    try { await setDoc(_banRef(myUID, game), next, { merge: true }); }
    catch (e) {
        window.reportRuleDenial && window.reportRuleDenial('Arcade — strike', e,
            { path: `game_bans/${myUID}__${game}`, op: 'set(merge)' });
    }
    reply(warnedRecently ? { kind: 'ban', game, until: next.until } : { kind: 'warn', game });
}

}

 
const _PREFS_FAV_MAX = 100, _PREFS_RECENT_MAX = 16;

function _prefsClean(list, max) {
    const out = [];
    (Array.isArray(list) ? list : []).forEach(g => {
        g = String(g || '').slice(0, 60);
        if (g && _gameMeta(g) && !out.includes(g)) out.push(g);
    });
    return out.slice(0, max);
}
async function _echoPrefs() {
    if (_prefs && _prefsUid === myUID) return _prefs;
    _prefs = { favs: [], recent: [] }; _prefsUid = myUID;
    if (!myUID || window.GUEST_MODE) return _prefs;

        const s = await getDoc(doc(db, 'game_prefs', myUID));

            _prefs.favs = _prefsClean(s.data().favs, _PREFS_FAV_MAX);
            _prefs.recent = _prefsClean(s.data().recent, _PREFS_RECENT_MAX);
        }
    } catch (_) {}
    return _prefs;
}
function _echoPrefsSave() {
    if (!myUID || window.GUEST_MODE || !_prefs) return;

                favs: _prefs.favs, recent: _prefs.recent, updatedAt: serverTimestamp()
            });
        } catch (e) {

async function _echoPrefsRecent(game) {

}

async function _echoRecordPlay(msg) {
    if (!myUID) return;
    const game = String(msg.game || '').slice(0, 60);
    if (!_gameMeta(game)) return;
    const secs = Math.min(Math.max(Math.round(Number(msg.seconds) || 0), 0), 3600);
    if (!secs) return;
    const relaunch = !!msg.newSession && _relaunchGap.has(game);
    if (relaunch) _relaunchGap.delete(game);
    const newPlay = !!msg.newSession && !relaunch;
    _playLastTouch(game, msg.newSession ? true : undefined);
    try {
        if (newPlay || relaunch) {
            const stat = { game, lastPlayed: serverTimestamp() };
            if (newPlay) stat.plays = increment(1);
            if (relaunch) stat.relaunches = increment(1);
            await setDoc(doc(db, 'game_stats', game), stat, { merge: true });
        }
        await setDoc(doc(db, 'game_stats', game, 'players', myUID), {
            uid: myUID,
            game,
            username: myUsername || 'unknown',
            plays: increment(newPlay ? 1 : 0),
            relaunches: increment(relaunch ? 1 : 0),
            seconds: increment(secs),
            lastPlayed: serverTimestamp()
        }, { merge: true });

        const bmeta = _gameMeta(game);
        const delta = (bmeta?.byPlays && newPlay) ? 1 : 0;
        if (delta > 0) {
            await setDoc(doc(db, 'leaderboards', _boardDocId(game), 'scores', myUID), {
                uid: myUID,
                username: myUsername || 'unknown',
                pfp: (myPfp && myPfp.length < 30000) ? myPfp : '',
                score: increment(delta),
                dir: 'high',
                game,
                updatedAt: serverTimestamp()
            }, { merge: true });
        }
    } catch (e) {
        window.reportRuleDenial && window.reportRuleDenial('Arcade — record play', e,
            { path: `game_stats/${game}`, op: 'set(merge)' });
        console.warn('[arcade] play record failed:', e?.code || e);
    }
}

    });

}

const _ECHO_OWNER_EMAIL = 'gavinwllms8@gmail.com';
const _isSiteOwner = () => !!(auth.currentUser && auth.currentUser.email === _ECHO_OWNER_EMAIL);
let _admSess = null;

function _admB64(buf) {
    const u = new Uint8Array(buf); let s = '';
    for (let i = 0; i < u.length; i += 0x8000) s += String.fromCharCode.apply(null, u.subarray(i, i + 0x8000));
    return btoa(s);
}
const _admUnB64 = (s) => Uint8Array.from(atob(String(s || '')), c => c.charCodeAt(0));
const _admNonce = () => _admB64(crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(18)));
async function _admEnc(key, obj) {
    const iv = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(12));
    const ct = await crypto.subtle.encrypt({ name: 'AES-GCM', iv }, key, new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(obj)));
    return { iv: _admB64(iv), ct: _admB64(ct) };
}
async function _admDec(key, m) {
    const pt = await crypto.subtle.decrypt({ name: 'AES-GCM', iv: _admUnB64(m.iv) }, key, _admUnB64(m.ct));
    return JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(pt));
}

async function _echoAdminMessage(d, reply) {
    if (!crypto?.subtle) return;
    try {
        if (d.kind === 'role-hello') {
            _admSess = null;
            const kp = await crypto.subtle.generateKey({ name: 'ECDH', namedCurve: 'P-256' }, false, ['deriveKey']);
            const hubPub = await crypto.subtle.importKey('jwk', d.pub, { name: 'ECDH', namedCurve: 'P-256' }, false, []);
            const key = await crypto.subtle.deriveKey({ name: 'ECDH', public: hubPub }, kp.privateKey,
                { name: 'AES-GCM', length: 256 }, false, ['encrypt', 'decrypt']);
            const owner = _isSiteOwner();
            const n2 = _admNonce();
            if (owner) _admSess = { key, n1: String(d.n1 || ''), n2, token: null };
            reply({ kind: 'role-offer',
                    pub: await crypto.subtle.exportKey('jwk', kp.publicKey),
                    ...(await _admEnc(key, { role: owner ? 'owner' : 'member', n1: d.n1, n2 })) });
            return;
        }
        if (!_admSess || !_isSiteOwner()) return;
        const m = await _admDec(_admSess.key, d);
        if (d.kind === 'role-proof') {
            if (_admSess.token || m.n2 !== _admSess.n2) { _admSess = null; return; }
            _admSess.token = _admNonce();
            reply({ kind: 'role-ok', ...(await _admEnc(_admSess.key, { n3: m.n3, token: _admSess.token })) });
            return;
        }
        if (!_admSess.token || m.token !== _admSess.token) return;
        let res;
        try { res = { rid: m.rid, ok: true, data: await _admOp(m.op, m.args || {}) }; }
        catch (e) { res = { rid: m.rid, ok: false, error: String(e?.code || e?.message || e) }; }
        reply({ kind: 'adm-res', ...(await _admEnc(_admSess.key, res)) });
    } catch (e) { console.warn('[arcade] settings channel:', e); }
}

const _admId = (s) => { s = String(s || ''); if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9_:.-]{1,120}$/.test(s)) throw new Error('bad id'); return s; };
const _admNum = (n) => { n = Math.round(Number(n)); if (!isFinite(n) || n < 0) throw new Error('bad number'); return n; };
const _admMs = (t) => (t && typeof t.toMillis === 'function') ? t.toMillis() : (typeof t === 'number' ? t : 0);

async function _admNames(rows) {
    const need = [...new Set(rows.filter(r => !r.username || r.username === 'unknown').map(r => r.uid))].slice(0, 100);
    const names = {};
    await Promise.all(need.map(async uid => {
        try { const s = await getDoc(doc(db, 'users', uid)); if (s.exists()) names[uid] = s.data().username || ''; } catch (_) {}
    }));
    rows.forEach(r => { if (names[r.uid]) r.username = names[r.uid]; if (!r.username) r.username = 'unknown'; });
    return rows;
}

async function _admOp(op, a) {
    switch (op) {
    case 'game.load': {
        const game = _admId(a.game);
        const [st, pl, bn, prot] = await Promise.all([
            getDoc(doc(db, 'game_stats', game)),
            getDocs(query(collection(db, 'game_stats', game, 'players'), orderBy('plays', 'desc'), limit(200))),
            getDocs(query(collection(db, 'game_bans'), where('game', '==', game), limit(200))),
            _echoProtection()
        ]);
        const s = st.exists() ? st.data() : {};
        const players = [];
        pl.forEach(d => { const v = d.data(); players.push({ uid: d.id, username: v.username || '', plays: v.plays || 0,
            relaunches: v.relaunches || 0, seconds: v.seconds || 0, lastPlayed: _admMs(v.lastPlayed) }); });
        const bans = [];
        bn.forEach(d => { const v = d.data(); bans.push({ uid: v.uid, username: v.username || '', strikes: v.strikes || 0,
            lastStrike: v.lastStrike || 0, until: v.until || 0 }); });
        await _admNames(players.concat(bans));
        return { game, tracked: !!_gameMeta(game), byPlays: !!_gameMeta(game)?.byPlays,
                 plays: s.plays || 0, relaunches: s.relaunches || 0, protect: !!prot[game],
                 players, bans, now: Date.now() };
    }
    case 'game.setTotals': {
        const game = _admId(a.game);
        await setDoc(doc(db, 'game_stats', game), { game, plays: _admNum(a.plays), relaunches: _admNum(a.relaunches) }, { merge: true });
        _topGamesCache = null;
        return true;
    }
    case 'game.setProtect': {
        const game = _admId(a.game);
        await setDoc(doc(db, 'game_config', 'protection'), { games: { [game]: !!a.on } }, { merge: true });
        if (_protectCache) _protectCache[game] = !!a.on;
        return true;
    }
    case 'game.setHidden': {
        const game = _admId(a.game);
        await setDoc(doc(db, 'game_config', 'hidden'), { games: { [game]: !!a.on } }, { merge: true });
        if (_hiddenCache) _hiddenCache[game] = !!a.on;
        return true;
    }
    case 'player.set': {
        const game = _admId(a.game), uid = _admId(a.uid);
        await setDoc(doc(db, 'game_stats', game, 'players', uid),
            { uid, game, plays: _admNum(a.plays), relaunches: _admNum(a.relaunches) }, { merge: true });
        return true;
    }
    case 'player.reset': {
        const game = _admId(a.game), uid = _admId(a.uid);
        await setDoc(doc(db, 'game_stats', game, 'players', uid),
            { uid, game, plays: 0, relaunches: 0, seconds: 0 }, { merge: true });
        return true;
    }
    case 'ban.set': {
        const game = _admId(a.game), uid = _admId(a.uid);
        const mins = Math.min(Math.max(_admNum(a.minutes), 1), 10080);
        await setDoc(_banRef(uid, game), { uid, game, username: String(a.username || '').slice(0, 60),
            strikes: 2, lastStrike: Date.now(), until: Date.now() + mins * 60000 }, { merge: true });
        return true;
    }
    case 'ban.clear': {
        await deleteDoc(_banRef(_admId(a.uid), _admId(a.game)));
        return true;
    }
    case 'lb.load': {
        const board = _admId(a.board);
        const meta = _boardMeta(board);
        const snap = await getDocs(query(collection(db, 'leaderboards', _boardDocId(board), 'scores'),
            orderBy('score', meta.dir === 'low' ? 'asc' : 'desc'), limit(200)));
        const rows = [];
        snap.forEach(d => { const v = d.data(); rows.push({ uid: d.id, username: v.username || '', score: v.score }); });
        await _admNames(rows);
        return { board, dir: meta.dir, unit: meta.unit, rows };
    }
    case 'lb.set': {
        const board = _admId(a.board), uid = _admId(a.uid);
        await updateDoc(doc(db, 'leaderboards', _boardDocId(board), 'scores', uid), { score: _admNum(a.score) });
        return true;
    }
    case 'lb.del': {
        await deleteDoc(doc(db, 'leaderboards', _boardDocId(_admId(a.board)), 'scores', _admId(a.uid)));
        return true;
    }
    }
    throw new Error('unknown op');
}

const _esPending = new Map();
let _esWalletUnsub = null, _esCosUnsub = null, _esRatesUnsub = null, _esCreating = false, _esStreakTried = -1;
let _esActiveMs = 0, _esLastInput = Date.now(), _esLoop = null;
['pointerdown', 'keydown', 'wheel', 'touchstart', 'mousemove'].forEach(ev =>
    addEventListener(ev, () => { _esLastInput = Date.now(); }, { passive: true, capture: true }));

const _esWalletRef = (uid) => doc(db, 'wallets', uid);
const _esFmt = (n) => Number(n || 0).toLocaleString();

async function _esLoadConfig() {
    let rates = null;
    try { const s = await getDoc(doc(db, 'economy_config', 'rates')); if (s.exists()) rates = s.data(); } catch (_) {}
    if (!rates && _isSiteOwner()) {
        rates = Object.assign({}, ES_DEFAULT_RATES);
        try { await setDoc(doc(db, 'economy_config', 'rates'), rates); } catch (e) { rates = null; console.warn('[shards] rates seed failed', e?.code || e); }
    }
    ES.rates = Object.assign({}, ES_DEFAULT_RATES, rates || {});
    ES.ratesLive = !!rates;
    const items = {};
    try { const snap = await getDocs(collection(db, 'shop_items')); snap.forEach(d => { items[d.id] = d.data(); }); } catch (_) {}
    const missing = _isSiteOwner() && window.EchoCosmetics ? window.EchoCosmetics.CATALOG.filter(it => !items[it.id]) : [];
    if (missing.length) {
        const b = writeBatch(db);
        missing.forEach(it => {
            const v = { name: it.name, type: it.type, rarity: it.rarity, price: it.price, active: true, order: window.EchoCosmetics.CATALOG.indexOf(it) };
            b.set(doc(db, 'shop_items', it.id), v); items[it.id] = v;
        });
        try { await b.commit(); } catch (e) { console.warn('[shards] catalogue seed failed', e?.code || e); }
    }
    ES.items = items;
}

function _esTx(make, logItem) {
    const ref = _esWalletRef(ES.uid);
    return firestoreRunTransaction(db, async (tx) => {
        const s = await tx.get(ref);
        if (!s.exists()) throw new Error('No wallet yet');
        const cur = s.data();
        const upd = make(cur);
        if (upd) {
            tx.update(ref, upd);
            if (logItem != null) _esLogRow(tx, upd.op, logItem, upd.balance - cur.balance);
        }
        return upd;
    });
}
function _esLogRow(tx, op, item, amount, to, toName) {
    tx.set(doc(collection(db, 'shard_log')), {
        uid: ES.uid, username: String(window.myUsername || '').slice(0, 40), op, item: item || '', amount,
        to: to || '', toName: toName || '', at: serverTimestamp()
    });
}

async function _esCreateWallet(uid) {
    if (_esCreating) return;
    _esCreating = true;
    try {
        await setDoc(_esWalletRef(uid), {
            uid, username: String(window.myUsername || '').slice(0, 40),
            balance: 0, lifetime: 0, day: _esDay(), earnedToday: 0, lastEarnAt: serverTimestamp(),
            streak: 0, streakDay: 0, schoolDay: 0, schoolToday: 0,
            lastSchoolPost: '', lastSchoolAt: serverTimestamp(),
            owned: {}, op: 'create', item: ''
        });
    } catch (e) { console.warn('[shards] wallet create failed', e?.code || e); }
    _esCreating = false;
}

async function _esMaybeStreak() {
    const w = ES.wallet, r = ES.rates, today = _esDay();
    if (!w || !ES.ratesLive || (w.streakDay || 0) >= today || _esStreakTried === today) return;
    _esStreakTried = today;
    try {
        const u = await _esTx(cur => {
            if ((cur.streakDay || 0) >= today) return null;
            const n = cur.streakDay === today - 1 ? (cur.streak || 0) + 1 : 1;
            const bonus = Math.min(r.streakBase + r.streakStep * (n - 1), r.streakMax) * _esBoost();
            return { balance: cur.balance + bonus, lifetime: cur.lifetime + bonus, streak: n, streakDay: today, op: 'earn-streak' };
        }, '');
        if (u) _esToast('+' + (u.balance - w.balance) + ' Shards', u.streak > 1 ? u.streak + '-day streak' : 'Daily bonus');
    } catch (e) { console.warn('[shards] streak', e?.code || e); }
}

async function _esEarnTick() {
    const w = ES.wallet, r = ES.rates;
    if (!w || !ES.ratesLive || !ES.uid) return;
    const active = document.visibilityState === 'visible' && document.hasFocus() && Date.now() - _esLastInput < 120000;
    if (active) _esActiveMs += 30000;
    const need = r.timeEveryMin * 60000;
    if (_esActiveMs < need) return;
    const today = _esDay(), bx = _esBoost(), amt = r.timeAmount * bx, cap = r.timeDailyCap * bx;
    if ((w.day === today ? w.earnedToday : 0) + amt > cap) return;
    const last = w.lastEarnAt && w.lastEarnAt.toMillis ? w.lastEarnAt.toMillis() : 0;
    if (Date.now() - last < need) return;
    try {
        const u = await _esTx(cur => {
            const et = cur.day === today ? cur.earnedToday : 0;
            if (et + amt > cap) return null;
            return { balance: cur.balance + amt, lifetime: cur.lifetime + amt, day: today,
                     earnedToday: et + amt, lastEarnAt: serverTimestamp(), op: 'earn-time' };
        });
        _esActiveMs = 0;
        if (u) _esBump('+' + amt);
    } catch (_) {   }
}

ES.start = async (uid) => {
    if (!uid || ES.uid === uid) return;
    ES.stop();
    ES.uid = uid;
    await _esLoadConfig();
    _esWalletUnsub = onSnapshot(_esWalletRef(uid), (s) => {
        if (!s.exists()) { _esCreateWallet(uid); return; }
        ES.wallet = s.data();
        _esCheckGift(ES.wallet);
        _esPaintMine();
        _esMaybeStreak();
        if (document.getElementById('view-shop')?.classList.contains('active')) ES.renderShop();
    }, (e) => console.warn('[shards] wallet listener', e?.code || e));
    _esCosUnsub = onSnapshot(doc(db, 'cosmetics', uid), (s) => {
        ES.cos = Object.assign(_esEmpty(), s.exists() ? s.data() : {});
        _esCache.set(uid, ES.cos);
        _esPaintMine();
        if (document.getElementById('view-shop')?.classList.contains('active')) ES.renderShop();
    }, () => {});
    _esRatesUnsub = onSnapshot(doc(db, 'economy_config', 'rates'), (s) => {
        if (!s.exists()) return;
        ES.rates = Object.assign({}, ES_DEFAULT_RATES, s.data());
        ES.ratesLive = true;
        if (document.getElementById('view-shop')?.classList.contains('active')) ES.renderShop();
    }, () => {});
    clearInterval(_esLoop);
    _esLoop = setInterval(_esEarnTick, 30000);
    const tab = document.getElementById('ap-tab-shards');
    if (tab) tab.style.display = _isSiteOwner() ? '' : 'none';
};
ES.stop = () => {
    if (_esWalletUnsub) { _esWalletUnsub(); _esWalletUnsub = null; }
    if (_esCosUnsub) { _esCosUnsub(); _esCosUnsub = null; }
    if (_esRatesUnsub) { _esRatesUnsub(); _esRatesUnsub = null; }
    clearInterval(_esLoop); _esLoop = null;
    ES.uid = null; ES.wallet = null; ES.cos = _esEmpty(); _esActiveMs = 0;
    _esPaintMine();
};

ES.buy = async (id) => {
    const it = ES.items[id];
    if (!it || !it.active) throw new Error('That item is not for sale.');
    const price = _esPrice(id);
    return _esTx(cur => {
        if (cur.owned && cur.owned[id]) return null;
        if (cur.balance < price) throw new Error('Not enough Shards yet.');
        return { balance: cur.balance - price, ['owned.' + id]: true, item: id, op: 'buy' };
    }, id);
};
ES.equip = async (type, id) => {
    const next = Object.assign(_esEmpty(), ES.cos, { [type]: id || '' });
    await setDoc(doc(db, 'cosmetics', ES.uid), { uid: ES.uid, ring: next.ring || '', nameFx: next.nameFx || '', banner: next.banner || '', tag: next.tag || '' });
};

ES.gift = async (itemId, username) => {
    const it = ES.items[itemId];
    if (!it || !it.active) throw new Error('That item is not for sale.');
    const name = String(username || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!name) throw new Error('Type their username.');
    const us = await getDocs(query(collection(db, 'users'), where('lower_username', '==', name), limit(1)));
    if (us.empty) throw new Error('Nobody is called that.');
    const to = us.docs[0].id, toName = us.docs[0].data().username || name;
    if (to === ES.uid) throw new Error('You can buy it for yourself instead.');
    const id = (crypto.randomUUID ? crypto.randomUUID() : String(Date.now()) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)).replace(/-/g, '');
    const mine = _esWalletRef(ES.uid), theirs = _esWalletRef(to);
    await firestoreRunTransaction(db, async (tx) => {
        const [a, b] = [await tx.get(mine), await tx.get(theirs)];
        if (!a.exists()) throw new Error('No wallet yet.');
        if (!b.exists()) throw new Error(toName + ' has to open EchoSpace once before they can get gifts.');
        const me = a.data(), them = b.data();
        if ((them.owned || {})[itemId]) throw new Error(toName + ' already has ' + it.name + '.');
        const price = _esPrice(itemId);
        if (me.balance < price) throw new Error('Not enough Shards yet.');
        tx.update(mine, { balance: me.balance - price, gift: { id, to, item: itemId, toName: String(toName).slice(0, 40) }, op: 'gift-send' });
        _esLogRow(tx, 'gift-send', itemId, -price, to, String(toName).slice(0, 40));
        tx.update(theirs, { ['owned.' + itemId]: true, gift: { id, from: ES.uid, item: itemId, fromName: String(window.myUsername || '').slice(0, 40) }, op: 'gift-receive' });
    });
    return toName;
};
function _esCheckGift(w) {
    if (!w || w.op !== 'gift-receive' || !w.gift || !w.gift.id) return;
    let seen = '';
    try { seen = localStorage.getItem('es_gift_seen') || ''; } catch (_) {}
    if (seen === w.gift.id) return;
    try { localStorage.setItem('es_gift_seen', w.gift.id); } catch (_) {}
    const it = window.EchoCosmetics && window.EchoCosmetics.byId(w.gift.item);
    _esToast((w.gift.fromName || 'Someone') + ' gifted you ' + (it ? it.name : 'an item') + '!', 'Equip it from the Shop.');
}

ES.onSchoolPost = async (schoolKey, postId) => {
    const r = ES.rates;
    if (!ES.ratesLive || !ES.uid || !schoolKey || !postId) return;
    try {
        const ps = await getDoc(doc(db, 'schools', schoolKey, 'posts', postId));
        const createdAt = ps.exists() ? ps.data().createdAt : null;
        if (!createdAt) return;
        const today = _esDay();
        const u = await _esTx(cur => {
            const n = cur.schoolDay === today ? (cur.schoolToday || 0) + 1 : 1;
            if (n > r.schoolDailyMax) return null;
            const amt = r.schoolAmount * _esBoost();
            return { balance: cur.balance + amt, lifetime: cur.lifetime + amt,
                     schoolDay: today, schoolToday: n, lastSchoolPost: schoolKey + '/' + postId, lastSchoolAt: createdAt, op: 'earn-school' };
        }, '');
        if (u) _esToast('+' + (u.balance - (ES.wallet ? ES.wallet.balance : 0)) + ' Shards', 'Thanks for sharing to Schools');
    } catch (e) { console.warn('[shards] school reward', e?.code || e); }
};

 
function _esGet(uid) {
    if (!uid) return Promise.resolve(_esEmpty());
    if (_esCache.has(uid)) return Promise.resolve(_esCache.get(uid));
    if (_esPending.has(uid)) return _esPending.get(uid);
    const p = getDoc(doc(db, 'cosmetics', uid))
        .then(s => { const c = Object.assign(_esEmpty(), s.exists() ? s.data() : {}); _esCache.set(uid, c); return c; })
        .catch(() => { const c = _esEmpty(); _esCache.set(uid, c); return c; })
        .finally(() => _esPending.delete(uid));
    _esPending.set(uid, p);
    return p;
}
ES.decorateName = (el, uid) => {
    if (!el || !uid || !window.EchoCosmetics) return;
    _esGet(uid).then(c => {
        if (!el.isConnected) return;
        if (c.nameFx) window.EchoCosmetics.applyName(el, c.nameFx);
        if (c.tag) _esPlaceTag(el, c.tag);
    });
};
function _esPlaceTag(nameEl, id) {
    const EC = window.EchoCosmetics;
    const parent = nameEl && nameEl.parentNode;
    if (!EC || !parent) return;
    parent.querySelectorAll(':scope > .es-tag').forEach(t => t.remove());
    const el = id ? EC.tagEl(id) : null;
    if (!el) return;
    let at = nameEl.nextSibling;
    while (at && !(at.nodeType === 1 && (at.matches('.gc-time, button, time') || /time/.test(at.className || '')))) at = at.nextSibling;
    parent.insertBefore(el, at);
}
ES.placeTag = _esPlaceTag;

ES.decorateAvatar = (img, uid) => {
    if (!img || !uid || img.dataset.esDone || !window.EchoCosmetics) return;
    img.dataset.esDone = '1';
    _esGet(uid).then(c => {
        if (!c.ring || !img.isConnected) return;
        const size = img.offsetWidth || parseInt(getComputedStyle(img).width, 10) || 20;
        const R = size / 2, pad = Math.max(8, Math.round(R * 0.9));
        const holder = document.createElement('span');
        holder.className = 'es-av';
        holder.style.width = holder.style.height = size + 'px';
        img.parentNode.insertBefore(holder, img);
        const cv = document.createElement('canvas');
        cv.className = 'es-av-ring';
        holder.appendChild(cv);
        holder.appendChild(img);
        const m = window.EchoCosmetics.mountRing(cv, { id: c.ring, R, small: size < 48, pad });
        cv.style.left = cv.style.top = (-pad) + 'px';
        m && (holder._esRing = m);
    });
};
function _esDecorateIn(root) {
    if (!root || !root.querySelectorAll) return;
    root.querySelectorAll('img[data-es-uid]:not([data-es-done])').forEach(img => ES.decorateAvatar(img, img.getAttribute('data-es-uid')));
    root.querySelectorAll('[data-es-name]:not([data-es-named])').forEach(el => {
        el.setAttribute('data-es-named', '1');
        ES.decorateName(el, el.getAttribute('data-es-name'));
    });
}
{
    let _esQueued = false;
    const flush = () => { _esQueued = false; _esDecorateIn(document.body); };
    new MutationObserver(() => { if (!_esQueued) { _esQueued = true; requestAnimationFrame(flush); } })
        .observe(document.documentElement, { childList: true, subtree: true });
}

let _esProfRing = null, _esProfBanner = null, _esProfRO = null;
ES.applyProfile = async (uid, ownerAura) => {
    ES.clearProfile();
    if (!uid || !window.EchoCosmetics) return;
    let c = await _esGet(uid);
    if (_esTry && uid === ES.uid) c = Object.assign({}, c, { [_esTry.type]: _esTry.id });
    const EC = window.EchoCosmetics;
    const nameEl = document.getElementById('profile-page-name');
    if (nameEl && c.nameFx) EC.applyName(nameEl, c.nameFx, nameEl.textContent);
    if (nameEl && c.tag) _esPlaceTag(nameEl, c.tag);
    const wrap = document.querySelector('#profile-page .profile-avatar-wrap');
    const img = document.getElementById('profile-page-pfp');
    if (c.ring && ownerAura && window._stopOwnerElectricAura) window._stopOwnerElectricAura();
    if (wrap && img && c.ring) {
        const R = (img.offsetWidth || 124) / 2;
        const cv = document.createElement('canvas');
        cv.className = 'es-ring-canvas';
        _esProfRing = EC.mountRing(cv, { id: c.ring, R, small: false });
        cv.style.left = cv.style.top = (R - _esProfRing.size / 2) + 'px';
        wrap.insertBefore(cv, wrap.firstChild);
        _esProfRing.el = cv;
    }
    const banner = document.getElementById('profile-banner');
    if (banner && c.banner) {
        const cv = document.createElement('canvas');
        cv.className = 'es-banner-canvas';
        banner.insertBefore(cv, banner.firstChild);
        _esProfBanner = EC.mountBanner(cv, c.banner, banner.clientWidth || 640, banner.clientHeight || 168);
        _esProfBanner.el = cv;
        if (window.ResizeObserver) {
            _esProfRO = new ResizeObserver(() => { if (_esProfBanner) _esProfBanner.resize(banner.clientWidth || 640, banner.clientHeight || 168); });
            _esProfRO.observe(banner);
        }
    }
};
ES.clearProfile = () => {
    if (_esProfRing) { _esProfRing.destroy(); _esProfRing.el?.remove(); _esProfRing = null; }
    if (_esProfBanner) { _esProfBanner.destroy(); _esProfBanner.el?.remove(); _esProfBanner = null; }
    if (_esProfRO) { _esProfRO.disconnect(); _esProfRO = null; }
    const nameEl = document.getElementById('profile-page-name');
    if (nameEl && window.EchoCosmetics) window.EchoCosmetics.applyName(nameEl, '');
    if (nameEl) _esPlaceTag(nameEl, '');
};

 
let _esSideRing = null;
function _esPaintMine() {
    const bal = document.getElementById('es-side-balance');
    if (bal) bal.textContent = ES.wallet ? _esFmt(ES.wallet.balance) : '0';
    const chip = document.getElementById('es-side-chip');
    if (chip) chip.style.display = ES.uid ? '' : 'none';
    const mob = document.getElementById('es-mob-bal');
    if (mob) {
        const b = ES.wallet ? ES.wallet.balance : 0;
        mob.textContent = ES.uid && ES.wallet ? (b >= 10000 ? Math.floor(b / 1000) + 'k' : b >= 1000 ? (b / 1000).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, '') + 'k' : String(b)) : '';
    }
    const EC = window.EchoCosmetics;
    if (!EC) return;
    const cv = document.getElementById('es-side-ring');
    if (cv && !_esSideRing) _esSideRing = EC.mountRing(cv, { id: '', R: 16, small: true, pad: 16 });
    if (_esSideRing) {
        _esSideRing.set(ES.cos.ring || '');
        cv.style.display = ES.cos.ring ? 'block' : 'none';
    }
    const me = document.getElementById('user-display');
    if (me) {
        EC.applyName(me, ES.cos.nameFx || '', window.myUsername || me.textContent);
        const row = me.nextElementSibling;
        if (row) {
            row.querySelectorAll(':scope > .es-tag').forEach(t => t.remove());
            const t = ES.cos.tag ? EC.tagEl(ES.cos.tag) : null;
            if (t) { t.style.marginLeft = '0'; row.appendChild(t); }
        } else _esPlaceTag(me, ES.cos.tag || '');
    }
}

ES.repaint = _esPaintMine;
ES._seed = (uid, c) => _esCache.set(uid, Object.assign(_esEmpty(), c));

function _esBump(text) {
    const chip = document.getElementById('es-side-chip');
    if (!chip || chip.offsetParent === null) return;
    const b = document.createElement('span');
    b.className = 'es-bump'; b.textContent = text;
    chip.appendChild(b);
    setTimeout(() => b.remove(), 1400);
}
function _esToast(title, sub) {
    let el = document.getElementById('es-toast');
    if (!el) { el = document.createElement('div'); el.id = 'es-toast'; document.body.appendChild(el); }
    el.innerHTML = '<span class="es-gem"></span><div><div class="es-toast-t"></div><div class="es-toast-s"></div></div>';
    el.querySelector('.es-toast-t').textContent = title;
    el.querySelector('.es-toast-s').textContent = sub || '';
    el.classList.add('on');
    clearTimeout(_esToast._t);
    _esToast._t = setTimeout(() => el.classList.remove('on'), 4200);
}

 
let _esShopTab = 'ring', _esShopMounts = [], _esShopMsg = '', _esSort = 'featured', _esFilter = 'all';
const _esTabs = [['ring', 'Rings'], ['nameFx', 'Name effects'], ['tag', 'Name tags'], ['banner', 'Banners']];
function _esEsc(s) { return String(s == null ? '' : s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;' }[c])); }
function _esItemsOf(type) {
    const EC = window.EchoCosmetics;
    if (!EC) return [];
    return EC.ofType(type).map(x => {
        const live = ES.items[x.id];
        return Object.assign({}, x, live ? { price: live.price, active: live.active !== false, order: live.order } : { active: !!ES.ratesLive },
            { now: _esPrice(x.id), sale: _esSaleOn(x.id) });
    }).filter(x => x.active).sort((a, b) => (a.order ?? 0) - (b.order ?? 0));
}
ES.renderShop = () => {
    const root = document.getElementById('es-shop');
    if (!root || !window.EchoCosmetics) return;
    _esShopMounts.forEach(m => m.destroy());
    _esShopMounts = [];
    const EC = window.EchoCosmetics, w = ES.wallet, r = ES.rates, today = _esDay();
    const owned = (w && w.owned) || {};
    const timeToday = w && w.day === today ? w.earnedToday : 0;
    const schoolToday = w && w.schoolDay === today ? w.schoolToday : 0;
    const streakDone = w && w.streakDay === today;
    const pct = (a, b) => Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Math.round((a / Math.max(1, b)) * 100)));
    const bx = _esBoost();
    let items = _esItemsOf(_esShopTab);
    const bal = w ? w.balance : 0;
    if (_esFilter === 'owned') items = items.filter(it => owned[it.id]);
    else if (_esFilter === 'afford') items = items.filter(it => !owned[it.id] && it.now <= bal);
    else if (_esFilter === 'sale') items = items.filter(it => it.sale);
    if (_esSort === 'low') items.sort((a, b) => a.now - b.now);
    else if (_esSort === 'high') items.sort((a, b) => b.now - a.now);
    else if (_esSort === 'name') items.sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
    const anySale = _esItemsOf(_esShopTab).some(it => it.sale);
    root.innerHTML = `

      </div>
      ${ES.ratesLive ? '' : '<div class="es-note">The shop opens soon. Shards start counting once it does.</div>'}
      ${bx > 1 ? `<div class="es-boost"><i class="fa-solid fa-bolt"></i><span><b>${bx}x Shards</b> on everything you earn right now. Ends in ${_esLeft(_esMs(r.boostEnds))}.</span></div>` : ''}
      <div class="es-earn">
        <div class="es-earn-card">
          <div class="es-earn-top"><span><i class="fa-solid fa-clock"></i> Active time</span><b>${timeToday} / ${r.timeDailyCap * bx}</b></div>
          <div class="es-bar"><i style="width:${pct(timeToday, r.timeDailyCap * bx)}%"></i></div>
          <div class="es-earn-sub">${r.timeAmount * bx} Shards for every ${r.timeEveryMin} minutes you're active</div>
        </div>
        <div class="es-earn-card">
          <div class="es-earn-top"><span><i class="fa-solid fa-fire"></i> Daily streak</span><b>${w ? (w.streak || 0) : 0} day${w && w.streak === 1 ? '' : 's'}</b></div>
          <div class="es-bar"><i style="width:${streakDone ? 100 : 0}%"></i></div>
          <div class="es-earn-sub">${streakDone ? 'Claimed today. Come back tomorrow to keep it going.' : 'Claimed automatically when you log in each day.'}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="es-earn-card">

function _esModal(html) {
    document.getElementById('es-modal')?.remove();

    m.id = 'es-modal'; m.className = 'es-modal';

function _esTryBar() {
    document.getElementById('es-try-bar')?.remove();
    if (!_esTry) return;
    const EC = window.EchoCosmetics, it = EC.byId(_esTry.id), id = _esTry.id;
    const has = ES.wallet && ES.wallet.owned && ES.wallet.owned[id];
    const price = _esPrice(id), afford = ES.wallet && ES.wallet.balance >= price;
    const bar = document.createElement('div');
    bar.id = 'es-try-bar';
    bar.innerHTML = `<span class="es-try-dot"></span><span class="es-try-txt">Previewing <b>${_esEsc(it.name)}</b> on your profile. Only you can see this.</span>
      <span class="es-try-acts">${has ? '' : `<button class="es-try-buy" ${afford && ES.ratesLive ? '' : 'disabled'} onclick="EchoShards.tryBuy()">${afford ? 'Buy for ' + _esFmt(price) : 'Need ' + _esFmt(price - (ES.wallet ? ES.wallet.balance : 0)) + ' more'}</button>`}
      <button class="es-try-back" onclick="EchoShards.endTryOn()">Back to shop</button></span>`;

ES.openHistory = async (tab) => {
    if (tab) _esHistTab = tab;
    const m = _esModal(`<div class="es-modal-card">
        <div class="es-modal-head"><span>History &amp; gifts</span><button class="es-x" onclick="EchoShards.closeModal()"><i class="fa-solid fa-xmark"></i></button></div>

    const box = m.querySelector('.es-hist');

        rows.sort((a, b) => _esMs(b.at) - _esMs(a.at));
        if (!document.body.contains(box)) return;
        box.innerHTML = rows.length ? rows.map(r => _esHistRow(r, _esHistTab === 'got')).join('')
            : `<div style="color:#6b6b85;font-size:13px;padding:10px 0">${_esHistTab === 'got' ? 'No gifts yet.' : 'Nothing yet. Buys, gifts, streak bonuses and Schools rewards show up here.'}</div>`;
    } catch (e) { box.innerHTML = '<div style="color:#f87171;font-size:12px">Could not load your history. Try again in a moment.</div>'; }

function _esHistRow(r, got) {
    const EC = window.EchoCosmetics, it = r.item && EC && EC.byId(r.item), name = it ? it.name : (r.item || '');
    const when = r.at && r.at.toDate ? r.at.toDate().toLocaleString([], { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', hour: 'numeric', minute: '2-digit' }) : '';
    let icon = 'fa-gem', text = '';
    if (got) { icon = 'fa-gift'; text = `<b>${_esEsc(r.username || 'Someone')}</b> gave you ${_esEsc(name)}`; }
    else if (r.op === 'buy') { icon = 'fa-bag-shopping'; text = 'Bought ' + _esEsc(name); }
    else if (r.op === 'gift-send') { icon = 'fa-gift'; text = `Gave ${_esEsc(name)} to <b>${_esEsc(r.toName || 'someone')}</b>`; }
    else if (r.op === 'earn-streak') { icon = 'fa-fire'; text = 'Daily streak bonus'; }
    else if (r.op === 'earn-school') { icon = 'fa-school'; text = 'Posted to Schools'; }
    const amt = got ? '' : `<span class="es-amt" style="color:${r.amount >= 0 ? '#34d399' : '#f87171'}">${r.amount >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${_esFmt(r.amount)}</span>`;
    return `<div class="es-hist-row"><i class="fa-solid ${icon}"></i><div><div>${text}</div><div class="es-when">${_esEsc(when)}</div></div>${amt}</div>`;
}

function _esAdmSales() {

function _esAdmBoostNow() {
    const el = _esAdm('ap-es-boost-now');
    if (!el) return;
    const b = _esBoost();

window.apShardsSale = async () => {
    if (!_isSiteOwner()) return;
    const EC = window.EchoCosmetics, v = _esAdm('ap-es-sale-item').value;
    const pct = Math.max(5, Math.min(90, Math.round(Number(_esAdm('ap-es-sale-pct').value) || 0)));
    const hrs = Math.max(1, Math.min(720, Number(_esAdm('ap-es-sale-hrs').value) || 0));
    const ids = v === '*' ? EC.CATALOG.map(x => x.id) : v.startsWith('type:') ? EC.ofType(v.slice(5)).map(x => x.id) : [v];
    const ends = new Date(Date.now() + hrs * 3600000);
    try {
        const b = writeBatch(db);
        ids.forEach(id => {
            const base = (ES.items[id] && ES.items[id].price != null) ? ES.items[id].price : EC.byId(id).price;
            b.set(doc(db, 'shop_items', id), { salePrice: Math.max(0, Math.round(base * (1 - pct / 100))), saleEnds: ends }, { merge: true });
        });
        await b.commit();
        window.logAdminAction && window.logAdminAction('shards_sale', { items: ids.length === 1 ? ids[0] : ids.length + ' items', pct, hours: hrs });
        await _esLoadConfig(); _esAdmSales();
        _esAdmMsg(pct + '% off ' + (ids.length === 1 ? EC.byId(ids[0]).name : ids.length + ' items') + ' for ' + hrs + 'h.', true);
    } catch (e) { _esAdmMsg('Sale failed: ' + (e.code || e.message), false); }
};
window.apShardsEndSale = async (id) => {
    if (!_isSiteOwner()) return;
    const EC = window.EchoCosmetics;
    const ids = id === '*' ? EC.CATALOG.map(x => x.id).filter(x => ES.items[x] && ES.items[x].salePrice != null) : [id];
    if (!ids.length) return _esAdmMsg('No sales to end.', true);
    try {
        const b = writeBatch(db);
        ids.forEach(x => b.set(doc(db, 'shop_items', x), { salePrice: deleteField(), saleEnds: deleteField() }, { merge: true }));
        await b.commit();
        window.logAdminAction && window.logAdminAction('shards_sale_end', { items: ids.length });
        await _esLoadConfig(); _esAdmSales();
        _esAdmMsg('Sale ended.', true);
    } catch (e) { _esAdmMsg('Failed: ' + (e.code || e.message), false); }
};

        await _esLoadConfig(); _esAdmBoostNow();
        _esAdmMsg(x + 'x boost on for ' + hrs + 'h.', true);
    } catch (e) { _esAdmMsg('Boost failed: ' + (e.code || e.message), false); }
};

window.apShardsSaveConfig = async () => {
    if (!_isSiteOwner()) return;
    try {
        const rates = {};
        Object.keys(ES_DEFAULT_RATES).forEach(k => { rates[k] = Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(_esAdm('ap-es-rate-' + k).value) || 0)); });
        if (rates.timeEveryMin < 1) rates.timeEveryMin = 1;
        const b = writeBatch(db);
        b.set(doc(db, 'economy_config', 'rates'), rates, { merge: true });
        window.EchoCosmetics.CATALOG.forEach((x, i) => {
            b.set(doc(db, 'shop_items', x.id), {
                name: x.name, type: x.type, rarity: x.rarity, order: i,
                price: Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(_esAdm('ap-es-price-' + x.id).value) || 0)),
                active: !!_esAdm('ap-es-active-' + x.id).checked
            }, { merge: true });
        });
        await b.commit();
        window.logAdminAction && window.logAdminAction('shards_config', { rates });
        await _esLoadConfig();
        _esAdmMsg('Saved.', true);
    } catch (e) { _esAdmMsg('Save failed: ' + (e.code || e.message), false); }
};
window.apShardsFind = async () => {
    if (!_isSiteOwner()) return;
    const name = String(_esAdm('ap-es-user').value || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const out = _esAdm('ap-es-userbox');
    if (!name || !out) return;
    out.innerHTML = '<div style="color:#555566;font-size:12px">Looking up…</div>';
    try {
        const us = await getDocs(query(collection(db, 'users'), where('lower_username', '==', name), limit(1)));
        if (us.empty) { out.innerHTML = '<div style="color:#f87171;font-size:12px">No user called that.</div>'; return; }
        const u = us.docs[0];
        const ws = await getDoc(_esWalletRef(u.id));
        const w = ws.exists() ? ws.data() : null;
        _esAdmUser = { uid: u.id, username: u.data().username || name };
        const owned = w && w.owned ? Object.keys(w.owned) : [];
        out.innerHTML = `
          <div style="font-size:13px;color:#e8e8f0;margin-bottom:6px"><b>${_esEsc(_esAdmUser.username)}</b> <span style="color:#555566">${_esEsc(u.id.slice(0, 10))}</span></div>
          <div style="font-size:12px;color:#888899;margin-bottom:10px">Balance <b style="color:#ede9fe">${_esFmt(w ? w.balance : 0)}</b> · earned all-time ${_esFmt(w ? w.lifetime : 0)} · streak ${w ? w.streak || 0 : 0} · owns ${owned.length ? _esEsc(owned.join(', ')) : 'nothing'}${w ? '' : ' · no wallet yet'}</div>
          <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center">
            <input class="admin-input" type="number" id="ap-es-amount" placeholder="Amount (negative removes)" style="width:210px">
            <input class="admin-input" type="text" id="ap-es-reason" placeholder="Reason (required)" style="flex:1;min-width:180px">
            <button class="btn-primary" style="font-size:12px;padding:7px 14px" onclick="apShardsGrant()">Apply</button>
          </div>`;
    } catch (e) { out.innerHTML = '<div style="color:#f87171;font-size:12px">Lookup failed: ' + _esEsc(e.code || e.message) + '</div>'; }
};
window.apShardsGrant = async () => {
    if (!_isSiteOwner() || !_esAdmUser) return;
    const amt = Math.round(Number(_esAdm('ap-es-amount').value) || 0);
    const reason = String(_esAdm('ap-es-reason').value || '').trim();
    if (!amt) return _esAdmMsg('Enter an amount.', false);
    if (!reason) return _esAdmMsg('Give a reason; it goes in the audit log.', false);
    try {
        const ref = _esWalletRef(_esAdmUser.uid);
        await firestoreRunTransaction(db, async (tx) => {
            const s = await tx.get(ref);
            if (!s.exists()) {
                const bal = Math.max(0, amt);
                tx.set(ref, { uid: _esAdmUser.uid, username: _esAdmUser.username, balance: bal, lifetime: bal, day: _esDay(),
                    earnedToday: 0, lastEarnAt: serverTimestamp(), streak: 0, streakDay: 0, schoolDay: 0, schoolToday: 0,
                    lastSchoolPost: '', lastSchoolAt: serverTimestamp(), owned: {}, op: 'grant', item: '' });
            } else {
                const cur = s.data();
                const bal = Math.max(0, (cur.balance || 0) + amt);
                tx.update(ref, { balance: bal, lifetime: (cur.lifetime || 0) + Math.max(0, amt), op: 'grant' });
            }
        });
        window.logAdminAction && window.logAdminAction('grant_shards', { target: _esAdmUser.username, amount: amt, reason });
        _esAdmMsg((amt > 0 ? 'Gave ' : 'Took ') + Math.abs(amt) + ' Shards ' + (amt > 0 ? 'to ' : 'from ') + _esAdmUser.username + '.', true);
        window.apShardsFind();
    } catch (e) { _esAdmMsg('Failed: ' + (e.code || e.message), false); }
};
window.apShardsTop = async () => {
    const box = _esAdm('ap-es-top');
    if (!box || !_isSiteOwner()) return;
    box.innerHTML = '<div style="color:#555566;font-size:12px">Loading…</div>';
    try {
        const snap = await getDocs(query(collection(db, 'wallets'), orderBy('lifetime', 'desc'), limit(20)));
        const rows = [];
        snap.forEach(d => rows.push(d.data()));
        box.innerHTML = rows.length ? rows.map((w, i) =>
            `<div class="es-adm-row"><span style="width:26px;color:#555566">#${i + 1}</span><span style="flex:1">${_esEsc(w.username || w.uid)}</span>
             <span style="width:120px;color:#888899">earned ${_esFmt(w.lifetime)}</span><span style="width:110px;color:#ede9fe">has ${_esFmt(w.balance)}</span>
             <span style="width:90px;color:#555566">streak ${w.streak || 0}</span></div>`).join('')
            : '<div style="color:#555566;font-size:12px">No wallets yet.</div>';
    } catch (e) { box.innerHTML = '<div style="color:#f87171;font-size:12px">Could not load: ' + _esEsc(e.code || e.message) + '</div>'; }
};

function _gamesViewShowing() {

function _gamesToastHost() {
    const vg = document.getElementById('view-games');
    if (!vg) return null;
    let host = document.getElementById('games-fs-toasts');
    if (!host) {
        host = document.createElement('div');
        host.id = 'games-fs-toasts';
        vg.appendChild(host);
    } else if (host.parentElement !== vg) {
        vg.appendChild(host);
    }
    return host;
}
function _gamesFsToast(opts) {
    try {
        if (!_gamesViewShowing()) return false;
        const host = _gamesToastHost();
        if (!host) return false;
        const o = opts || {};
        const esc = (t) => String(t == null ? '' : t)
            .replace(/[&<>"]/g, c => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;' }[c]));
        const el = document.createElement('div');
        el.className = 'gt' + (o.kind === 'call' ? ' call' : '');
        const icon = o.avatar
            ? '<img src="' + esc(o.avatar) + '" alt="">'
            : (o.emoji || '\uD83D\uDCAC');
        el.innerHTML =
            '<div class="gt-ic">' + icon + '</div>' +
            '<div class="gt-tx"><div class="gt-t">' + esc(o.title) + '</div>' +
            (o.body ? '<div class="gt-b">' + esc(o.body) + '</div>' : '') + '</div>' +
            '<div class="gt-go">' + (o.kind === 'call' ? 'Answer' : 'Open') + '</div>';

        let done = false;
        const close = () => {
            if (done) return;
            done = true;
            el.classList.add('out');
            setTimeout(() => el.remove(), 240);
        };
        el.onclick = async (ev) => {
            try { ev && ev.stopPropagation(); } catch (_) {}
            if (el._opening) return;
            el._opening = true;
            close();
            try {
                const gf = document.getElementById('games-frame');
                await _echoGamesFullscreen(false, gf && gf.contentWindow, window.ARCADE_ORIGIN || '*');
            } catch (_) {}
            if (document.fullscreenElement || document.webkitFullscreenElement) {
                await new Promise(r => {
                    const done = () => { document.removeEventListener('fullscreenchange', done); r(); };
                    document.addEventListener('fullscreenchange', done);
                    setTimeout(done, 600);
                });
            }
            await new Promise(r => requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(r)));
            try { if (typeof o.onOpen === 'function') o.onOpen(); } catch (_) {}
        };
        host.appendChild(el);
        while (host.children.length > 3) host.firstElementChild.remove();
        setTimeout(close, o.kind === 'call' ? 32000 : 6500);
        return true;
    } catch (_) { return false; }
}

async function _echoGamesFullscreen(on, source, origin) {
    const vg = document.getElementById('view-games');
    if (!vg) return;
    const tell = (real) => {
        try { source && source.postMessage({ __echo: true, kind: 'fs-state', on: !!on, real: !!real }, origin); } catch (_) {}
    };
    vg.classList.toggle('games-fs', on);
    document.documentElement.classList.toggle('games-fs-on', on);
    try {
        if (on) {
            const req = vg.requestFullscreen || vg.webkitRequestFullscreen || vg.msRequestFullscreen;
            if (req) { await req.call(vg, { navigationUI: 'hide' }); tell(true); return; }
        } else if (document.fullscreenElement || document.webkitFullscreenElement) {
            const ex = document.exitFullscreen || document.webkitExitFullscreen || document.msExitFullscreen;
            if (ex) { await ex.call(document); tell(true); return; }
        }
    } catch (_) {
    }
    tell(false);
}

 
document.addEventListener('fullscreenchange', () => {
    if (document.fullscreenElement) return;
    const vg = document.getElementById('view-games');
    if (!vg || !vg.classList.contains('games-fs')) return;
    vg.classList.remove('games-fs');
    document.documentElement.classList.remove('games-fs-on');
    const gf = document.getElementById('games-frame');
    try { gf && gf.contentWindow.postMessage({ __echo: true, kind: 'fs-state', on: false, real: false }, window.ARCADE_ORIGIN); } catch (_) {}
});


window._arcadeKey = function () {
    var SECRET = 'e5p4c3-res-v1';
    var s = SECRET + ':' + Math.floor(Date.now() / 3600000);
    var a = 5381, b = 2166136261, i;
    for (i = 0; i < s.length; i++) a = ((a * 33) ^ s.charCodeAt(i)) >>> 0;
    for (i = 0; i < s.length; i++) { b ^= s.charCodeAt(i); b = (b * 16777619) >>> 0; }
    return a.toString(36) + b.toString(36);
};

window.addEventListener('message', async (ev) => {
    if (ev.origin !== window.location.origin && ev.origin !== window.ARCADE_ORIGIN) return;
    const d = ev.data;
    if (!d || d.__echo !== true) return;
    const _replyTo = ev.origin;
    const reply = (m) => { try { m.__echo = true; ev.source && ev.source.postMessage(m, _replyTo); } catch (_) {} };
    try {
        if (d.kind === 'fs') {
            _echoGamesFullscreen(!!d.on, ev.source, _replyTo);
            return;
        }
        if (d.kind === 'guest-blocked') {
            window._guestWall('Sign up to play',
                'The games are free with an account \u2014 scores, play time and the leaderboards all need somewhere to save.');
            return;
        }
        if (d.kind === 'proxy-open') return;
        if (d.kind === 'view') {
            const fab = document.getElementById('game-req-fab');
            if (fab) fab.style.display = d.playing ? 'none' : 'flex';
            return;
        }
        if (d.kind === 'game-open')  {
            const g = String(d.game || '').slice(0, 60);
            _echoPrefsRecent(g);
            await _echoGameOpened(g, reply);
            return;
        }
        if (d.kind === 'bans-req') {
            const [bans, hidden, prefs] = await Promise.all([_echoMyBans(), _echoHiddenGames(), _echoPrefs()]);
            reply({ kind: 'bans', bans, hidden });
            reply({ kind: 'prefs', favs: prefs.favs, recent: prefs.recent });
            return;
        }
        if (d.kind === 'fav') { await _echoPrefsFav(String(d.game || '').slice(0, 60), !!d.on); return; }
        if (d.kind === 'role-hello' || d.kind === 'role-proof' || d.kind === 'adm') {
            await _echoAdminMessage(d, reply);
            return;
        }
        if (d.kind === 'score')      { await _echoSubmitScore(d); }
        else if (d.kind === 'play')  { await _echoRecordPlay(d); }
        else if (d.kind === 'lb-req') {
            if (!myUID) return reply({ kind: 'lb-res', board: d.board, error: 'Log in to see the leaderboard.' });
            try {
                const r = await _echoFetchBoard(d.board);
                reply({ kind: 'lb-res', board: d.board, rows: r.rows, dir: r.dir, unit: r.unit });
            } catch (e) {
                reply({ kind: 'lb-res', board: d.board, error: 'Could not load the leaderboard.' });
            }
        }
        else if (d.kind === 'top-req') {
            if (!myUID) return;
            try { reply({ kind: 'top-res', rows: await _echoFetchTopGames() }); } catch (_) {}
        }
    } catch (e) { console.warn('[arcade] bridge error:', e); }
});

const _RL_KEY = 'echo_rl_v1';
function _rlLoad() {
    try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(_RL_KEY) || '{}') || {}; } catch (_) { return {}; }
}
function _rlSave(o) { try { localStorage.setItem(_RL_KEY, JSON.stringify(o)); } catch (_) {} }

const _RL_STEPS = [0, 0, 0, 15000, 30000, 60000, 300000, 900000];
function _rlCheck(bucket) {
    const all = _rlLoad();
    const b = all[bucket];
    if (!b) return { ok: true };
    if (b.until && Date.now() < b.until) {
        return { ok: false, wait: Math.ceil((b.until - Date.now()) / 1000) };
    }
    return { ok: true };
}
function _rlFail(bucket) {
    const all = _rlLoad();
    const b = all[bucket] || { n: 0, until: 0 };
    b.n++;
    const step = _RL_STEPS[Math.min(b.n, _RL_STEPS.length - 1)];
    b.until = step ? Date.now() + step : 0;
    all[bucket] = b;
    _rlSave(all);
    return step ? Math.ceil(step / 1000) : 0;
}
function _rlClear(bucket) {
    const all = _rlLoad();
    delete all[bucket];
    _rlSave(all);
}
function _rlFmt(secs) {
    if (secs >= 60) return Math.ceil(secs / 60) + ' minute' + (secs >= 120 ? 's' : '');
    return secs + ' second' + (secs === 1 ? '' : 's');
}

const SIGNUP_PER_DAY = 4;
async function _claimSignupSlot() {
    const tokens = (typeof window.getDeviceTokens === 'function') ? window.getDeviceTokens() : [];
    const token = (tokens && tokens[0]) || 'anon_' + (localStorage.getItem('_dvId') || Math.random().toString(36).slice(2));
    const ref = doc(db, 'signup_throttle', token);
    const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    let count = 0;
    try {
        const snap = await getDoc(ref);
        if (snap.exists() && snap.data().day === today) count = snap.data().count || 0;
    } catch (_) {   }
    if (count >= SIGNUP_PER_DAY) {
        return { ok: false, token, count };
    }
    await setDoc(ref, { day: today, count: count + 1, updatedAt: serverTimestamp() });
    return { ok: true, token, count: count + 1 };
}

const _STAFF_ROLES = ['owner', 'admin', 'moderator'];
window._isStaffData = (u) => !!u && (_STAFF_ROLES.includes(u.role) || u.adminAccount === true || u.ownerAccount === true);

window._staffGuard = async (uidOrData, newRole) => {
    if (window._iAmSiteOwner()) return;
    let u = uidOrData;
    if (typeof uidOrData === 'string') {
        try { const sn = await getDoc(doc(db, 'users', uidOrData)); u = sn.exists() ? sn.data() : null; } catch (_) { u = null; }
    }
    if (window._isStaffData(u)) throw new Error('Only the owner can do that to a staff account.');
    if (newRole && _STAFF_ROLES.includes(newRole)) throw new Error('Only the owner can give out staff roles.');
};

function _noEmailAddr(username) {
    const lower = String(username || '').toLowerCase();
    if (/^[a-z0-9_-]+(\.[a-z0-9_-]+)*$/.test(lower)) return lower + '@echo.local';
    const clean = lower.replace(/[^a-z0-9_-]+/g, '_').replace(/^_+|_+$/g, '').slice(0, 40) || 'user';
    const tail = Array.from(crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(3)), b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    return clean + '.' + tail + '@echo.local';
}

async function resolveLoginEmail(input) {
    let email = input;
    if (!input.includes('@')) {
        let foundEmail = null;
        try {
            const idxSnap = await getDoc(doc(db, "usernames", input.toLowerCase()));
            if (idxSnap.exists()) foundEmail = idxSnap.data().email || null;
        } catch(_e) {}
        if (!foundEmail) {
            try {
                const uSnap = await getDocs(query(collection(db, "users"), where("lower_username", "==", input.toLowerCase()), limit(1)));
                if (!uSnap.empty) foundEmail = uSnap.docs[0].data().email || null;
            } catch(_e2) {}
        }
        email = foundEmail || formatEmail(input);
    }
    try {
        const aliasSnap = await getDoc(doc(db, "emailAliases", email.toLowerCase()));
        if (aliasSnap.exists() && aliasSnap.data().realEmail) email = aliasSnap.data().realEmail;
    } catch(_e3) {}
    return email;
}
