const _SU_TRANSIENT = [
    'auth/network-request-failed', 'auth/timeout', 'auth/too-many-requests',
    'auth/internal-error', 'unavailable', 'deadline-exceeded', 'aborted',
    'resource-exhausted', 'cancelled', 'internal', 'unknown',
];
const _suIsTransient = e => {
    const c = String(e && e.code || '');
    if (_SU_TRANSIENT.includes(c)) return true;
    return /network|timeout|offline|unavailable|failed to (get|fetch)/i.test(String(e && e.message || ''));
};

async function _suRetry(label, fn, attempts = 3) {
    let last;
    for (let i = 0; i < attempts; i++) {
        try { return await fn(); }
        catch (e) {
            last = e;
            if (!_suIsTransient(e) || i === attempts - 1) throw e;
            console.warn(`[Sign-up] ${label} failed (${e.code || e.message}) — retry ${i + 1}/${attempts - 1}`);
            await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 600 * Math.pow(2, i)));
        }
    }
    throw last;
}

async function _suAwaitToken(user) {
    await user.getIdToken(true);
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
        try {
            await getDocs(query(collection(db, 'users'), where('lower_username', '==', '\u0000__probe__'), limit(1)));
            return true;
        } catch (e) {
            if (String(e.code) !== 'permission-denied') throw e;
            await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250 + i * 150));
            try { await user.getIdToken(true); } catch (_) {}
        }
    }
    return false;
}

async function _suLogFailure(stage, err, extra) {
    try {
        await setDoc(doc(db, 'signup_failures', Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)), {
            stage,
            code: String(err && err.code || '').slice(0, 80),
            message: String(err && err.message || err || '').slice(0, 300),
            ua: String(navigator.userAgent || '').slice(0, 200),
            online: navigator.onLine !== false,
            lang: String(navigator.language || '').slice(0, 20),
            tz: (() => { try { return Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone || ''; } catch (_) { return ''; } })(),
            ver: String(window._APP_VERSION || ''),
            at: serverTimestamp(),
            ...(extra || {})
        });
    } catch (_) {   }
}

const _SU_WIFI_MSG = "Sign-up didn't go through — you're probably on the wrong Wi-Fi. Some Wi-Fi networks block EchoSpace. Switch to a different Wi-Fi if you can (a phone hotspot works too), then try again.";
function _suFriendly(e) {
    switch (String(e && e.code || '')) {
        case 'auth/email-already-in-use':
            return 'That email already has an account. Log in instead, or use Forgot Password.';
        case 'auth/invalid-email':      return "That email address doesn't look right.";
        case 'auth/weak-password':      return 'Password is too short — use at least 6 characters.';
        case 'auth/too-many-requests':
            return "Too many sign-ups from this Wi-Fi. Switch to a different Wi-Fi if you can, or wait a few minutes and try again.";
        default:
            window.EchoNet && window.EchoNet.check('signup-error');
            return _SU_WIFI_MSG;
    }
}

const _suEgg = (() => {
    let taps = [], sassy = false, timers = [], idx = 0;
    const LINES = [
        'can you not wait 10 seconds for the account to be created',
        "clicking it again doesn't make it faster",
        "it's literally still loading bro",
        'the button is gone. you are clicking a box.',
        'every click adds one more second. (it does not, but still)',
        'bro',
        'ok now you are just staring at me',
        'I am going as fast as I can',
        'this is the fastest I have ever made an account, promise',
        'fine. keep clicking. I will wait.',
    ];
    const el = () => document.getElementById('su-egg');
    const txt = () => document.getElementById('su-egg-txt');
    function say(str) {
        const t = txt();
        if (!t) return;
        t.textContent = str;
        t.style.animation = 'none'; void t.offsetWidth; t.style.animation = '';
    }
    function note(html) {
        const n = document.getElementById('su-egg-note');
        if (!n) return;

        n.classList.remove('hidden');
    }
    function goSassy() {
        if (sassy) return;
        sassy = true;
        say(LINES[idx++]);
        note('<i class="fa-solid fa-wifi"></i> btw if it fails: you’re probably on a Wi-Fi that blocks EchoSpace — switch to another one if you can.');
        timers.push(setInterval(() => { if (idx < LINES.length) say(LINES[idx++]); }, 4000));
    }
    const PENALTY_STEP = 3, PENALTY_MAX = 15;
    let penalty = 0, counting = false;
    function addPenalty() {
        if (penalty >= PENALTY_MAX) { say('no. you have maxed out the punishment. sit there.'); return; }
        penalty = Math.min(PENALTY_MAX, penalty + PENALTY_STEP);
        say('alright. I will legit wait ' + penalty + ' seconds now.');
    }
    function hold() {
        if (!penalty || !el()) { penalty = 0; return Promise.resolve(); }
        counting = true;
        const b = el();
        if (b) b.classList.add('trolling');
        const dots = el() && el().querySelector('.su-egg-dots');
        if (dots) dots.style.display = 'none';
        return new Promise((resolve) => {
            let left = penalty;
            const tick = () => {
                if (!el()) { counting = false; penalty = 0; return resolve(); }
                if (left <= 0) {
                    say('fine. account ready.');
                    counting = false; penalty = 0;
                    return setTimeout(resolve, 700);
                }
                say('I said I would wait. ' + left + ' second' + (left === 1 ? '' : 's') + ' left.');
                left--;
                timers.push(setTimeout(tick, 1000));
            };
            tick();
        });
    }
    function start() {
        const btn = document.getElementById('signup-btn');
        if (!btn || el()) return;
        taps = []; sassy = false; idx = 0;
        const box = document.createElement('div');
        box.id = 'su-egg';
        box.innerHTML = '<span id="su-egg-txt">Making your account…</span>'
            + '<span class="su-egg-dots"><i></i><i></i><i></i></span>'
            + '<div id="su-egg-note" class="hidden"></div>';
        let lastAdvance = 0;
        box.addEventListener('click', () => {
            const now = Date.now();
            taps = taps.filter(t => now - t < 2500).concat(now);
            if (taps.length >= 3) goSassy();
            else return;
            if (counting) { say('clicking during the countdown does nothing. that is the point.'); return; }
            if (now - lastAdvance < 400) return;
            lastAdvance = now;
            if (idx < LINES.length) say(LINES[idx++]);
            else addPenalty();
        });
        btn.parentNode.insertBefore(box, btn);
        btn.style.display = 'none';
    }
    function stop(failed) {
        timers.forEach(t => { clearTimeout(t); clearInterval(t); });
        timers = [];
        const b = el();
        const btn = document.getElementById('signup-btn');
        if (!b) { if (btn) btn.style.display = ''; return; }
        if (failed) {
            say('That didn’t work.');
            note('<i class="fa-solid fa-wifi"></i> If this fails, you’re probably on a Wi-Fi that blocks EchoSpace — switch to another one if you can.');
            b.classList.add('failed');
            const dots = b.querySelector('.su-egg-dots'); if (dots) dots.remove();
            setTimeout(() => { const x = el(); if (x) x.remove(); if (btn) btn.style.display = ''; }, 9000);
        } else {
            b.remove();
            if (btn) btn.style.display = '';
        }
    }
    return { start, stop, hold };
})();
window._suEgg = _suEgg;

document.getElementById('signup-btn').addEventListener('click', async () => {
    const emailVal = document.getElementById('email').value.trim();
    const usernameVal = document.getElementById('username-reg').value.trim();
    const passVal = document.getElementById('password').value;
    if (!usernameVal || !passVal) { showAuthError("Pick a username and a password."); return; }

    if (emailVal && !/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]{2,}$/.test(emailVal)) { showAuthError("That email address doesn't look right. You can also leave it empty."); return; }

    const looksGibberish = emailLower.includes('@') && /^(test|fake|asdf|qwerty|xxx|none|nobody|idk|null|na)[0-9]*@/.test(emailLower);
    if (emailLower.includes('@') && (disposableDomains.includes(domainPart) || looksGibberish)) {
        showAuthError("That looks like a fake or throwaway email. Accounts made with fake emails get permanently banned and the device blocked from making new ones — use a real one.");
        return;
    }
    const _rlSignup = _rlCheck('signup');
    if (!_rlSignup.ok) {
        showAuthError(`Too many sign-up attempts. Try again in ${_rlFmt(_rlSignup.wait)}.`);
        return;
    }
    let _slot;
    try {
        _slot = await _claimSignupSlot();
    } catch (_slotErr) {
        _suLogFailure('slot', _slotErr, { username: String(usernameVal || '').slice(0, 40) });
        window.EchoNet && window.EchoNet.check('signup-slot-error');
        showAuthError(_SU_WIFI_MSG);
        return;
    }
    if (!_slot.ok) {
        showAuthError("This device has made too many accounts today. Try again tomorrow, or contact an admin if you need another.");
        return;
    }

    let _suRescued = false;
    _suEgg.start();
    try {
        isSigningUp = true;
        let cred;
        try {
            cred = await _suRetry('create account',
                () => createUserWithEmailAndPassword(auth, acctEmail, passVal));
        } catch (createErr) {
            if (String(createErr.code) !== 'auth/email-already-in-use') throw createErr;
            let signedIn = null;
            try {
                signedIn = await signInWithEmailAndPassword(auth, acctEmail, passVal);
            } catch (_) {   }
            if (!signedIn) { await _suLogFailure('create', createErr); throw createErr; }
            const existing = await getDoc(doc(db, 'users', signedIn.user.uid)).catch(() => null);
            if (existing && existing.exists()) {
                await signOut(auth).catch(() => {});
                isSigningUp = false;
                showAuthError('You already have an account with that email — switch to Log In.');
                return;
            }
            console.warn('[Sign-up] adopting an orphaned Auth account with no profile — completing sign-up');
            await _suLogFailure('rescued-orphan', createErr, { uid: signedIn.user.uid });
            cred = signedIn;
            _suRescued = true;
        }
        const emojiPfp = selectedSignupEmoji
    ? `data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 64 64'%3E%3Crect width='64' height='64' rx='32' fill='%230d0d18'/%3E%3Ctext x='32' y='46' text-anchor='middle' font-size='36'%3E${encodeURIComponent(selectedSignupEmoji)}%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E`
    : '';
        await _suAwaitToken(cred.user);

            () => getDocs(query(collection(db, "users"), where("lower_username", "==", usernameVal.toLowerCase()), limit(1))));
        if (!usernameCheck.empty) {
            if (!_suRescued) { try { await cred.user.delete(); } catch(_) {} }
            await signOut(auth);
            isSigningUp = false;
            showAuthError("That username is already taken. Choose another.");
            return;
        }
        let needsApproval = window.signupsRequireApproval !== false;
        try {
            const cfgSnap = await getDoc(doc(db, "site_config", "main"));
            if (cfgSnap.exists()) {
                needsApproval = cfgSnap.data().requireApproval !== false;
                window.signupsRequireApproval = needsApproval;
            }
        } catch (_cfgErr) {   }
        const newSessionId = Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).substr(2);
        await _suRetry('profile write', () => setDoc(doc(db, "users", cred.user.uid), {
            uid: cred.user.uid, username: usernameVal, lower_username: usernameVal.toLowerCase(),

            onboardingVersion: 1,
            signupToken: _slot.token,
            ...(needsApproval ? {} : { sessionId: newSessionId })
        }));
        try { await setDoc(doc(db, "usernames", usernameVal.toLowerCase()), { email: acctEmail, uid: cred.user.uid }); } catch(_) {}
        try { await _pwvStore(cred.user.uid, passVal); } catch(_) {}
        selectedSignupEmoji = null;

        _suEgg.stop(false);
        try {

            await _rkReveal(rk, { noEmail: _isNoEmail(acctEmail) });
        } catch (_rkErr) { console.warn('[Sign-up] recovery key not created:', _rkErr); }
        if (needsApproval) {
            await signOut(auth);
            showAuthError("Account requested! Waiting for Admin approval.", "text-green-400 border-green-900/20 bg-green-950/40");
            isSigningUp = false;
        } else {
            localStorage.setItem('echo_session', newSessionId);
            isSigningUp = false;
            try {
                await signOut(auth);
                await signInWithEmailAndPassword(auth, acctEmail, passVal);

                console.warn('[Sign-up] auto-login after open signup failed:', _reErr);
                showAuthError("Account created! Log in to continue.", "text-green-400 border-green-900/20 bg-green-950/40");
            }
        }
    } catch(e) {
        console.error("[Sign-up] Error code:", e.code, "| Message:", e.message, "| Full error:", e);
        _rlFail('signup');
        _suLogFailure('signup', e, { username: String(usernameVal || '').slice(0, 40) });

        try {
            const u = auth.currentUser;
            if (u && !_suRescued) await u.delete();
        } catch (_) {   }

        try { await signOut(auth); } catch(_) {}
        isSigningUp = false;
        _suEgg.stop(true);
        showAuthError(_suFriendly(e));
    }
});

document.getElementById('login-btn').addEventListener('click', async () => {
    const emailVal = document.getElementById('username-reg').value.trim();
    const passVal = document.getElementById('password').value;
    if (!emailVal || !passVal) { showAuthError("Enter your username and password."); return; }
    const btn = document.getElementById('login-btn');
    const _rlBucket = 'login:' + emailVal.toLowerCase().slice(0, 60);
    const _rlLogin = _rlCheck(_rlBucket);
    if (!_rlLogin.ok) {
        showAuthError(`Too many failed attempts. Try again in ${_rlFmt(_rlLogin.wait)}.`);
        return;
    }
    const prevErr = document.getElementById('auth-error');
    prevErr.classList.add('hidden'); _preserveAuthError = false;
    btn.disabled = true; btn.innerText = 'Logging in...';
    try {
        const newSessionId = Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).substr(2);
        localStorage.setItem('echo_session', newSessionId);
        const loginEmail = await resolveLoginEmail(emailVal);

        let _persistDeferred = false;
        try {
            await setPersistence(auth, inMemoryPersistence);
            _persistDeferred = true;
        } catch (_pErr) {
            console.warn('[2FA] could not defer persistence:', _pErr);
        }
        localStorage.setItem('echo_face_pending', '1');
        window._faceGateInFlight = true;

        let cred;
        try {
            cred = await signInWithEmailAndPassword(auth, loginEmail, passVal);
        } catch (_signErr) {
            let _alt = null;
            if (!emailVal.includes('@')) {
                try {
                    const _ix = await getDoc(doc(db, "usernames", emailVal.toLowerCase()));
                    if (_ix.exists() && _ix.data().pendingEmail && _ix.data().pendingEmail !== loginEmail) _alt = _ix.data().pendingEmail;
                } catch (_) {}
            }
            if (!_alt) throw _signErr;
            cred = await signInWithEmailAndPassword(auth, _alt, passVal);
        }
        localStorage.setItem('echo_face_pending', cred.user.uid);
        _rlClear(_rlBucket);
        try { window._rsHavePassword && window._rsHavePassword(passVal, cred.user.uid); } catch (_) {}

        try { await updateDoc(doc(db, "users", cred.user.uid), { sessionId: newSessionId }); } catch(e) {}

        const _tfaCacheKey = 'echo_2fa_' + cred.user.uid;
        let _tfaOn;
        try {
            let _tfaSnap = null, _tfaLastErr = null;
            for (let _try = 0; _try < 3; _try++) {
                try { _tfaSnap = await getDoc(doc(db, "users", cred.user.uid)); break; }
                catch (e) {
                    _tfaLastErr = e;
                    await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400 * (_try + 1)));
                }
            }
            if (!_tfaSnap) throw _tfaLastErr || new Error('2FA flag unreadable');
            _tfaOn = _tfaSnap.exists() && _tfaSnap.data().twoFactorFace === true;
            localStorage.setItem(_tfaCacheKey, _tfaOn ? '1' : '0');
        } catch (_tfaErr) {
            _tfaOn = localStorage.getItem(_tfaCacheKey) === '1';
            console.warn('[2FA] flag read failed, using cached hint =', _tfaOn, _tfaErr);
        }

        if (_tfaOn) {
            if (typeof window._tfaRunGate !== 'function') {
                await signOut(auth);
                localStorage.removeItem('echo_session');
                localStorage.removeItem('echo_face_pending');
                window._faceGateInFlight = false;
                showAuthError("Face verification is required but unavailable. Use your recovery key.");
                btn.disabled = false; btn.innerText = 'Log In';
                return;
            }
            window._authGateActive = true;
            let passed = false;
            try { passed = await window._tfaRunGate(cred.user.uid); }
            catch (_gateErr) { passed = false; console.warn('[2FA] gate threw:', _gateErr); }
            finally { window._authGateActive = false; }
            if (passed !== true) {
                await signOut(auth);
                localStorage.removeItem('echo_session');
                localStorage.removeItem('echo_face_pending');
                window._faceGateInFlight = false;
                showAuthError("Face verification cancelled. Use your recovery key if you can't scan.");
                btn.disabled = false; btn.innerText = 'Log In';
                return;
            }
        }

        localStorage.removeItem('echo_face_pending');
        window._faceGateInFlight = false;
        if (_persistDeferred) {
            try {
                await setPersistence(auth, browserLocalPersistence);
                const _persisted = Object.keys(localStorage)
                    .some(k => k.indexOf('firebase:authUser:') === 0);
                if (!_persisted) {
                    console.warn('[2FA] persistence did not migrate; re-establishing session');
                    await signInWithEmailAndPassword(auth, loginEmail, passVal);
                }
            } catch (_pErr) {
                console.warn('[2FA] could not restore persistence:', _pErr);
            }
        }

        try {
            let _h = 5381;
            for (let i = 0; i < passVal.length; i++) _h = ((_h * 33) ^ passVal.charCodeAt(i)) >>> 0;
            const _pwKey = 'echo_pwsyncv2_' + cred.user.uid;
            if (localStorage.getItem(_pwKey) !== String(_h)) {
                if (await _pwvStore(cred.user.uid, passVal)) localStorage.setItem(_pwKey, String(_h));
            }
        } catch(_pcErr) {}
    } catch(e) {
        console.error("Login error:", e.code, e.message);
        localStorage.removeItem('echo_session');
        localStorage.removeItem('echo_face_pending');
        window._faceGateInFlight = false;
        if (e.code === 'auth/invalid-credential' || e.code === 'auth/wrong-password' || e.code === 'auth/user-not-found') {
            const _w = _rlFail(_rlBucket);
            showAuthError(_w
                ? `Wrong username/email or password. Too many tries — wait ${_rlFmt(_w)}.`
                : "Wrong username/email or password.");
        } else if (e.code === 'auth/too-many-requests') {
            showAuthError("Too many failed attempts. Try again later or reset your password.");
        } else if (e.code === 'auth/network-request-failed') {
            showAuthError("Network error. Check your internet connection and try again.");
            window.EchoNet && window.EchoNet.check('login-network-error');
        } else {
            showAuthError("Login failed: " + (e.message || e.code));
        }
        btn.disabled = false; btn.innerText = 'Log In';
    }
});


const ECHO_USER_SCOPED_KEYS = [
    'app_friends_cache', 'echospace_history', 'echospace_watch_history',
    'echospace_liked_songs', 'echospace_playlists', 'echospace_queue',
    'echospace_recently_played', 'echospace_mp_pos', 'echo_usage',
    'echo_gc_layout', 'live_previews', 'live_publish_thumb', 'sp_active',
    'echo_changelog_seen', 'rk_nudge_at', 'echoai_chats_v12'
];
const ECHO_USER_SCOPED_PREFIXES = ['my_user_profile_', 'echo_read_marked_', 'echoai_chats_v12::', 'echoai_deleted::'];


function _echoPurgeUserLocalData(keepUid) {
    try {
        ECHO_USER_SCOPED_KEYS.forEach(k => { try { localStorage.removeItem(k); } catch (_) {} });
        const doomed = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < localStorage.length; i++) {
            const k = localStorage.key(i);
            if (!k) continue;
            if (!ECHO_USER_SCOPED_PREFIXES.some(p => k.startsWith(p))) continue;
            if (keepUid && k.endsWith(keepUid)) continue;
            doomed.push(k);
        }
        doomed.forEach(k => { try { localStorage.removeItem(k); } catch (_) {} });
    } catch (_) {}
}

function _echoAdoptLegacyData(uid) {
    try {
        const legacy = localStorage.getItem('echoai_chats_v12');
        if (legacy === null) return;
        const target = 'echoai_chats_v12::' + uid;
        if (localStorage.getItem(target) === null) localStorage.setItem(target, legacy);
        localStorage.removeItem('echoai_chats_v12');
    } catch (_) {}
}

function _echoClaimLocalStorage(uid) {
    if (!uid) return;
    let prev = null;
    try { prev = localStorage.getItem('echo_storage_owner'); } catch (_) {}

    if (prev === null) {
        _echoAdoptLegacyData(uid);
    } else if (prev !== uid) {
        _echoPurgeUserLocalData(uid);
    }
    try { localStorage.setItem('echo_storage_owner', uid); } catch (_) {}
    try { window._echoaiReloadForUser && window._echoaiReloadForUser(uid); } catch (_) {}
}

function _echoWipeChatUI() {
    try {
        const box = document.getElementById('chat-box');
        if (box) box.innerHTML = '';
        const nameEl = document.getElementById('chat-header-name');
        if (nameEl) nameEl.textContent = '';
        const pfp = document.getElementById('chat-header-pfp');
        if (pfp) { pfp.src = ''; pfp.style.display = 'none'; }
        ['dm-list', 'mobile-dm-list', 'group-friend-list'].forEach(id => {
            const el = document.getElementById(id); if (el) el.innerHTML = '';
        });
        window.currentChatId = null; window.currentChatData = null;
        currentChatId = null; currentChatData = null;
        window._friendUIDs = new Set();
        window._fcAutoPopSeen = {}; window._fcAutoPopReady = false;
        if (typeof window.closeFloatingChat === 'function') { try { window.closeFloatingChat(); } catch (_) {} }
    } catch (_) {}
}

function _echoAssertChatIdentity(data) {
    const live = (typeof auth !== 'undefined' && auth) ? auth.currentUser : null;
    if (!live || !live.uid) return false;
    if (!myUID || live.uid !== myUID) return false;
    if (data && Array.isArray(data.participants) && !data.participants.includes(live.uid)) return false;
    return true;
}

    listeners.forEach(u => u()); listeners = [];

    try { window.cleanupAllListeners && window.cleanupAllListeners(); } catch (_) {}
    myUID = ""; myUsername = ""; myPfp = ""; isAdmin = false;

    window._initHumanGate && window._initHumanGate();
};

    const SEC_STRIP = `<div class="ep-sec"><img src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/Thatboisaywhat/course-assets@0ba6fbf/a/i/d.png" alt=""><span>Secured by <b>EchoSpace</b></span><i class="ep-dot"></i>`
        + `<svg viewBox="0 0 48 48" width="12" height="12"><path fill="#4285F4" d="M45 24c0-1.6-.1-2.7-.4-4H24v7.5h12c-.2 2-1.5 5-4.4 7l6.7 5.2C42.2 36 45 30.6 45 24z"/><path fill="#34A853" d="M24 46c5.9 0 10.9-2 14.5-5.3l-6.9-5.4c-1.9 1.3-4.4 2.2-7.6 2.2-5.8 0-10.7-3.8-12.5-9.1l-7.1 5.5C8 41.2 15.4 46 24 46z"/><path fill="#FBBC05" d="M11.5 28.4c-.5-1.4-.8-2.9-.8-4.4s.3-3 .7-4.4l-7-5.5C2.9 17 2 20.4 2 24s.9 7 2.4 9.9l7.1-5.5z"/><path fill="#EA4335" d="M24 10.6c3.3 0 5.5 1.4 6.8 2.6l5.9-5.8C33 4 29 2 24 2 15.4 2 8 6.8 4.4 14.1l7.1 5.5C13.3 14.4 18.2 10.6 24 10.6z"/></svg>`
        + `<span><b>Google</b></span></div>`;
    const $ = (s) => el.querySelector(s);
    const setDots = () => el && el.querySelectorAll('.dots i').forEach((d, i) => d.classList.toggle('on', i < entry.length));
    const say = (title, sub) => { $('h3').textContent = title; $('p').textContent = sub; };
    const bad = (msg) => { el.classList.add('bad'); $('p').textContent = msg; setTimeout(() => { if (!el) return; el.classList.remove('bad'); entry = ''; setDots(); }, 450); };
    function build() {
        if (el) return;
        el = document.createElement('div');
        el.id = 'echo-pin';
        el.innerHTML = `<style>${css}</style><div class="pc"></div>`;
        el.addEventListener('click', (e) => { const b = e.target.closest('[data-k]'); if (b) press(b.dataset.k); });
        document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey, true);
        document.body.appendChild(el);
    }
    function showPad(title, sub, forgot) {
        $('.pc').innerHTML = `<img src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/Thatboisaywhat/course-assets@0ba6fbf/a/i/d.png" alt="EchoSpace Security"><h3></h3><p></p>
            <div class="dots"><i></i><i></i><i></i><i></i></div>
            <div class="keys">${[1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9].map(n => `<button data-k="${n}">${n}</button>`).join('')}<button class="ghost" data-k="out" title="Log out"><i class="fa-solid fa-right-from-bracket"></i></button><button data-k="0">0</button><button class="ghost" data-k="del" title="Delete"><i class="fa-solid fa-delete-left"></i></button></div>
            ${forgot ? '<button class="lnk" data-k="forgot">Forgot PIN?</button>' : '<button class="lnk" data-k="skip">Not now</button>'}
            ${SEC_STRIP}`;
        entry = ''; say(title, sub); setDots();
    }
    function showAsk() {
        mode = 'ask';
        $('.pc').innerHTML = `<img src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/Thatboisaywhat/course-assets@0ba6fbf/a/i/d.png" alt="EchoSpace Security"><h3></h3><p></p>
            <div class="ask"><button class="pri" data-k="setup">Set up a PIN</button><button data-k="skip">Not now</button><button class="ghost" data-k="never">Don't ask me again</button></div>
            ${SEC_STRIP}`;
        say('Protect your account', 'Add a 4-digit PIN so nobody can open your EchoSpace on a computer you left logged in.');
    }
    function onKey(e) {
        if (!el || mode === 'ask') return;
        if (/^[0-9]$/.test(e.key)) press(e.key);
        else if (e.key === 'Backspace') press('del');
        else return;
        e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation();
    }
    function finish() {
        document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey, true);
        if (el) el.remove();
        el = null;
        idleKick();
        setTimeout(() => {
            const vis = (id) => { const x = document.getElementById(id); return x && !x.classList.contains('hidden') && getComputedStyle(x).display !== 'none'; };
            if (window.myUID && !vis('dashboard') && !vis('auth-screen') && !vis('echospace-loader') && !vis('shutdown-screen')
                && !vis('auto-cloak-prompt') && !vis('click-to-enter-gate') && !vis('security-gate')) {
                console.warn('[EchoPin] blank screen after unlock, revealing app');
                window._bypassLoader && window._bypassLoader();
            }
        }, 7000);
        const d = done; done = null;
        if (d) d();
    }
    async function signOutNow() {
        document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey, true);
        try { await doLogout(); } catch (_) { try { await signOut(auth); } catch (__) {} location.reload(); }
    }
    const status = (enabled, dontAsk) => setDoc(doc(db, 'pin_status', uid), { enabled, dontAsk });
    async function press(k) {
        if (busy || !el) return;
        if (k === 'out') return signOutNow();
        if (k === 'forgot') {
            try { sessionStorage.setItem('echo_pin_reset', uid); } catch (_) {}
            return signOutNow();
        }
        if (k === 'skip') return finish();
        if (k === 'never') { busy = true; try { await status(false, true); } catch (e) { console.warn('[EchoPin]', e); } busy = false; return finish(); }
        if (k === 'setup') { mode = 'set'; return showPad('Choose a 4-digit PIN', "You'll enter it every time you open EchoSpace.", false); }
        if (k === 'del') { entry = entry.slice(0, -1); return setDots(); }
        if (!/^[0-9]$/.test(k) || entry.length >= 4) return;
        entry += k; setDots();
        if (entry.length < 4) return;
        busy = true;
        try {
            if (mode === 'set') {
                first = entry; mode = 'confirm';
                setTimeout(() => { entry = ''; setDots(); }, 150);
                say('Confirm your PIN', 'Type the same 4 digits again.');
            } else if (mode === 'confirm') {
                if (entry !== first) { mode = 'set'; first = ''; say('Choose a 4-digit PIN', ''); bad("PINs didn't match. Try again."); return; }
                const h = await pinHash(entry);
                const b = writeBatch(db);
                b.set(doc(db, 'user_pins', uid), { hash: h });
                b.set(doc(db, 'pin_status', uid), { enabled: true, dontAsk: false });
                await b.commit();
                try { sessionStorage.removeItem('echo_pin_reset'); } catch (_) {}
                try { window._rsHavePin && window._rsHavePin(entry, uid); } catch (_) {}
                armIdle();
                finish();
            } else {
                if (tries >= MAX) return signOutNow();
                say('Enter your PIN', 'Checking...');
                const h = await pinHash(entry);
                await setDoc(doc(db, 'pin_attempts', uid), { n: tries + 1, at: serverTimestamp() });
                tries++;
                try {
                    const b = writeBatch(db);
                    b.set(doc(db, 'pin_unlock', uid), { hash: h, at: serverTimestamp() });
                    b.set(doc(db, 'pin_attempts', uid), { n: 0, at: serverTimestamp() });
                    await b.commit();
                    tries = 0;
                    try { window._rsHavePin && window._rsHavePin(entry, uid); } catch (_) {}
                    armIdle();
                    finish();
                } catch (err) {
                    if (err?.code !== 'permission-denied') throw err;
                    if (tries >= MAX) { say('Too many wrong PINs', 'Log in with your password to try again.'); setTimeout(signOutNow, 1600); return; }
                    bad(`Wrong PIN. ${MAX - tries} ${MAX - tries === 1 ? 'try' : 'tries'} left.`);
                }
            }
        } catch (err) {
            console.error('[EchoPin]', err);
            bad(err?.code === 'permission-denied' ? 'Slow down a little and try again.' : "Couldn't check your PIN. Check your connection.");
        } finally { busy = false; }
    }
    async function gate(u, uData) {
        if (window.GUEST_MODE) return;
        user = u; uid = u.uid; entry = ''; first = ''; tries = 0;
        let st = null, att = 0;
        try {
            const tok = await u.getIdTokenResult();
            fresh = Date.now() - new Date(tok.authTime).getTime() < 9 * 60 * 1000;
        } catch (_) { fresh = false; }
        for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            try {
                const [s, a] = await Promise.all([getDoc(doc(db, 'pin_status', uid)), getDoc(doc(db, 'pin_attempts', uid))]);
                st = s.exists() ? s.data() : {};
                att = a.exists() ? (a.data().n || 0) : 0;
                break;
            } catch (e) {
                if (i === 2) { console.warn('[EchoPin] status read failed', e); st = {}; }
                else await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1000 * (i + 1)));
            }
        }
        if (st.enabled) { try { await status(false, !!st.dontAsk); st.enabled = false; } catch (_) {} }
        const resetReq = (() => { try { return sessionStorage.getItem('echo_pin_reset') === uid; } catch (_) { return false; } })();
        return new Promise((resolve) => {
            done = resolve;
            try { document.getElementById('auth-screen').classList.add('hidden'); document.getElementById('auto-cloak-prompt').classList.add('hidden'); } catch (_) {}
            build();
            if (st.enabled && fresh && (resetReq || att >= MAX)) {
                setDoc(doc(db, 'pin_attempts', uid), { n: 0, at: serverTimestamp() }).catch(() => {});
                mode = 'set';
                showPad('Choose a new PIN', "You'll enter it every time you open EchoSpace.", false);
            } else if (st.enabled) {
                if (att >= MAX) { build(); $('.pc').innerHTML = '<h3></h3><p></p>'; say('Too many wrong PINs', 'Log in with your password to try again.'); setTimeout(signOutNow, 1800); return; }
                tries = att; mode = 'enter';
                showPad('Enter your PIN', 'Welcome back' + (uData?.username ? ', ' + uData.username : '') + '.', true);
            } else if (!st.dontAsk) {
                showAsk();
            } else { finish(); }
        });
    }
    const IDLE_MS = 10 * 60 * 1000;
    let idleTimer = null, idleArmed = false;
    const idleKick = () => { if (!idleArmed || el) return; clearTimeout(idleTimer); idleTimer = setTimeout(relock, IDLE_MS); };
    function armIdle() {
        if (idleArmed) return;
        idleArmed = true;
        ['mousemove', 'mousedown', 'keydown', 'touchstart', 'scroll', 'wheel', 'focus'].forEach(ev =>
            window.addEventListener(ev, idleKick, { passive: true, capture: true }));
        idleKick();
    }
    async function relock() {
        if (el || !uid || window.GUEST_MODE) return;
        try { if ((typeof _callIsLive === 'function' && _callIsLive()) || window._gcActive || window._liveActive) { idleTimer = setTimeout(relock, 60000); return; } } catch (_) {}
        entry = ''; first = ''; mode = 'enter';
        try { const a = await getDoc(doc(db, 'pin_attempts', uid)); tries = a.exists() ? (a.data().n || 0) : 0; } catch (_) { tries = 0; }
        if (tries >= MAX) tries = 0;
        build();
        showPad('Locked', 'You were away for a while. Enter your PIN to get back in.', true);
    }
    window._echoRelock = relock;

    const _pinMsg = (text, ok) => {
        const m = document.getElementById('pin-set-msg');
        if (!m) return;
        m.textContent = text;
        m.classList.remove('hidden');
        m.style.color = ok ? '#34d399' : '#f87171';
    };
    async function _pinRefreshStatus() {
        const st = document.getElementById('pin-set-status');
        if (!st || !window.myUID) return;
        try {
            const snap = await getDoc(doc(db, 'pin_status', window.myUID));
            const on = snap.exists() && snap.data().enabled;
            st.textContent = on ? 'PIN is ON for this account.' : 'No PIN set — anyone with this computer can open your account.';
            st.style.color = on ? '#34d399' : '#fbbf24';
        } catch (_) { st.textContent = ''; }
    }
    async function _pinReauth(pw) {
        const u = auth.currentUser;
        if (!u) throw new Error('not signed in');
        const { EmailAuthProvider, reauthenticateWithCredential } = await import("https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.11.0/firebase-auth.js");
        await reauthenticateWithCredential(u, EmailAuthProvider.credential(u.email, pw));
        await u.getIdToken(true);
        return u;
    }
    window._pinSettingsSave = async () => {
        const pw = document.getElementById('pin-set-password').value;
        const a = document.getElementById('pin-set-new').value.trim();
        const b = document.getElementById('pin-set-confirm').value.trim();
        if (!pw) return _pinMsg('Enter your account password.', false);
        if (!/^[0-9]{4}$/.test(a)) return _pinMsg('The PIN has to be exactly 4 digits.', false);
        if (a !== b) return _pinMsg("The two PINs don't match.", false);
        _pinMsg('Saving...', true);
        try {
            const u = await _pinReauth(pw);
            uid = u.uid;
            const batch = writeBatch(db);
            batch.set(doc(db, 'user_pins', uid), { hash: await pinHash(a) });
            batch.set(doc(db, 'pin_status', uid), { enabled: true, dontAsk: false });
            await batch.commit();
            try { window._rsHavePassword && window._rsHavePassword(pw, uid); window._rsHavePin && window._rsHavePin(a, uid); } catch (_) {}
            ['pin-set-password', 'pin-set-new', 'pin-set-confirm'].forEach(i => document.getElementById(i).value = '');
            armIdle();
            _pinMsg('PIN saved. You’ll be asked for it next time EchoSpace opens.', true);
            _pinRefreshStatus();
        } catch (e) {
            console.error('[EchoPin] save failed', e);
            _pinMsg(e?.code === 'auth/invalid-credential' || e?.code === 'auth/wrong-password'
                ? 'That password is wrong.' : 'Could not save the PIN: ' + (e?.code || e?.message || e), false);
        }
    };
    window._pinSettingsRemove = async () => {
        const pw = document.getElementById('pin-set-password').value;
        if (!pw) return _pinMsg('Enter your account password to remove the PIN.', false);
        _pinMsg('Removing...', true);
        try {
            const u = await _pinReauth(pw);
            uid = u.uid;
            const batch = writeBatch(db);
            batch.delete(doc(db, 'user_pins', uid));
            batch.set(doc(db, 'pin_status', uid), { enabled: false, dontAsk: true });
            await batch.commit();
            document.getElementById('pin-set-password').value = '';
            try { window._rsDropSeal && window._rsDropSeal(); } catch (_) {}
            _pinMsg('PIN removed.', true);
            _pinRefreshStatus();
        } catch (e) {
            console.error('[EchoPin] remove failed', e);
            _pinMsg(e?.code === 'auth/invalid-credential' || e?.code === 'auth/wrong-password'
                ? 'That password is wrong.' : 'Could not remove the PIN: ' + (e?.code || e?.message || e), false);
        }
    };
    window._pinRefreshStatus = _pinRefreshStatus;

    return { gate };
})();
window.EchoPin = EchoPin;

onAuthStateChanged(auth, async (user) => {
    window._hasAuthUser = !!user;
    if (user) window._authTeardown = false;
    if (isSigningUp) return;
    if (user) {
        if (localStorage.getItem('echo_face_pending') && !window._faceGateInFlight) {
            localStorage.removeItem('echo_face_pending');
            localStorage.removeItem('echo_session');
            try { await signOut(auth); } catch (_sErr) {}
            try { window._forceHideLoader && window._forceHideLoader(); } catch (_lErr) {}
            showAuthError("Face verification wasn't completed. Please log in again.");
            return;
        }
        myUID = user.uid;
        window.myUID = user.uid;
        _echoClaimLocalStorage(user.uid);
        setTimeout(() => { try { _rkSyncFlag(); } catch (_) {} }, 6000);
        let uData = null;
        try {
            const loginBtn = document.getElementById('login-btn');
            if (loginBtn) { loginBtn.disabled = false; loginBtn.innerText = 'Log In'; }
            await user.getIdToken(true);
            await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 150));
            const uDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, "users", user.uid));
            if (uDoc.exists()) {
                uData = uDoc.data();
                localStorage.setItem('my_user_profile_' + user.uid, JSON.stringify(uData));
            } else {
                showAuthError("Account not found in database.");
                doLogout();
                return;
            }
        } catch(e) {
            console.error("Firestore getDoc error:", e.code, e.message);
            try {
                await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 2500));
                try { await user.getIdToken(true); } catch(te) {}
                const uDoc2 = await getDoc(doc(db, "users", user.uid));
                if (uDoc2.exists()) {
                    uData = uDoc2.data();
                    localStorage.setItem('my_user_profile_' + user.uid, JSON.stringify(uData));
                } else {
                    showAuthError("Account not found in database.");
                    doLogout(); return;
                }
            } catch(e2) {
                console.error("Firestore retry failed:", e2.code, e2.message);
                const cachedProfile = localStorage.getItem('my_user_profile_' + user.uid);
                if (cachedProfile) {
                    uData = JSON.parse(cachedProfile);
                } else {
                    const errDetail = e2.message || e2.code || "Could not reach database.";
                    showAuthError("Login failed: " + errDetail);
                    doLogout(); return;
                }
            }
        }
        
        window._echoMemory = uData?.echoaiMemory || null;

        if (uData?.status === 'pending') { showAuthError("Account pending Admin approval.", "text-orange-400 border-orange-900/20 bg-orange-950/40"); doLogout(); return; }
        if (uData?.status === 'rejected') { showAuthError("Account request denied by Admin."); doLogout(); return; }
        if (uData?.status === 'banned' || uData?.role === 'banned') {
            showAuthError(uData?.banReason
                ? `Account banned: ${uData.banReason}`
                : "This account has been banned.");
            doLogout(); return;
        }
        const _dvTokens = window.getDeviceTokens();
        if (_dvTokens.length) {
            try {
                const hits = await Promise.all(_dvTokens.map(t => getDoc(doc(db, "bannedDevices", t))));
                const hit = hits.find(s => s.exists());
                if (hit) {
                    const d = hit.data();
                    showAuthError(d?.reason
                        ? `This device is blocked: ${d.reason}`
                        : "This device has been blocked from EchoSpace.");
                    doLogout(); return;
                }
            } catch (e) { console.warn('Device-ban check failed, allowing login:', e); }
            const _known = Array.isArray(uData?.deviceTokens) ? uData.deviceTokens : [];
            const _newTokens = _dvTokens.filter(t => !_known.includes(t));
            if (_newTokens.length) {
                try {
                    await updateDoc(doc(db, "users", user.uid), {
                        deviceTokens: arrayUnion(..._newTokens),
                        lastDeviceAt: serverTimestamp()
                    });
                } catch (_) {}
            }
        }
        if (uData?.lower_username && uData?.email) {
            const _uidxKey = 'echo_uidx_' + user.uid + '_' + uData.lower_username + '_' + uData.email;
            if (localStorage.getItem(_uidxKey) !== '1') {
                try {
                    await setDoc(doc(db, "usernames", uData.lower_username), { email: uData.email, uid: user.uid });
                    localStorage.setItem(_uidxKey, '1');
                } catch(_) {}
            }
        }
        if (uData?.suspendedUntil) {
            const suspendDate = uData.suspendedUntil?.toDate ? uData.suspendedUntil.toDate() : new Date(uData.suspendedUntil);
            if (suspendDate > new Date()) { showAuthError(`Suspended until ${suspendDate.toLocaleString()}`); doLogout(); return; }
            try {
                await updateDoc(doc(db, "users", user.uid), { suspendedUntil: deleteField() });
                delete uData.suspendedUntil;
                localStorage.setItem('my_user_profile_' + user.uid, JSON.stringify(uData));
            } catch (e) { console.warn('Could not clear expired suspension:', e); }
        }
        if (uData?.pendingPassword) {
            try {
                const { updatePassword } = await import("https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.11.0/firebase-auth.js");
                await updatePassword(user, uData.pendingPassword);
                await updateDoc(doc(db, "users", user.uid), { pendingPassword: null });
                try { await _pwvStore(user.uid, uData.pendingPassword); } catch(_) {}
                try { window._rsHavePassword && window._rsHavePassword(uData.pendingPassword, user.uid); } catch(_) {}
                try { await _rkReseal(uData.pendingPassword); } catch(_) {}
            } catch(e) { console.warn("Could not apply pending password:", e); }
        }
        try { await EchoPin.gate(user, uData); } catch (_pinErr) { console.error('[EchoPin] gate failed', _pinErr); }
        if (uData?.systemMessage) {
            document.getElementById('system-msg-text').innerText = uData.systemMessage;
            document.getElementById('system-msg-modal').classList.remove('hidden');
        }
        let localSession = localStorage.getItem('echo_session');
        if (!localSession) {
            localSession = Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).substr(2);
            localStorage.setItem('echo_session', localSession);
            try { await updateDoc(doc(db, "users", user.uid), { sessionId: localSession }); } catch(e){}
        }
        window._sessionVerified = false;
        async function _verifySessionNow() {
            const local = localStorage.getItem('echo_session');
            if (!local) { window._sessionVerified = true; return true; }
            let live = null;
            for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
                try {
                    const fresh = await getDocFromServer(doc(db, 'users', user.uid));
                    live = fresh.exists() ? (fresh.data().sessionId || null) : null;
                    break;
                } catch (e) {
                    if (i === 2) { console.warn('[Session] could not verify, deferring to the live listener:', e?.code || e); window._sessionVerified = true; return true; }
                    await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400 * (i + 1)));
                }
            }
            if (live && live !== local) {
                console.warn('[Session] this session was replaced by another device — not loading chats');
                try { alert('Your account was logged into from another device. Logging out.'); } catch (_) {}
                doLogout();
                return false;
            }
            window._sessionVerified = true;
            return true;
        }

        let sessionCheckReady = false;
        setTimeout(() => { sessionCheckReady = true; }, 3000);
        listeners.push(onSnapshot(doc(db, "users", user.uid), (docSnap) => {
            if(docSnap.exists()) {
                const liveData = docSnap.data();
                const curSession = localStorage.getItem('echo_session') || localSession;
                if(sessionCheckReady && !window._authGateActive && liveData.sessionId && liveData.sessionId !== curSession) { alert("Your account was logged into from another device. Logging out."); doLogout(); return; }
                if(liveData.status === 'pending' || liveData.status === 'rejected') { showAuthError(liveData.status === 'pending' ? "Account returned to pending state." : "Account denied."); doLogout(); return; }
                const toVal = liveData.timedOutUntil;
                const toUntil = toVal ? (toVal.toDate ? toVal.toDate() : new Date(toVal)) : null;
                window._timedOutUntil = (toUntil && toUntil > new Date()) ? toUntil : null;
                if (typeof window._applyTimeoutLockdown === 'function') window._applyTimeoutLockdown();
                if (typeof window._syncPublicProfile === 'function') window._syncPublicProfile(user.uid, liveData);
                if (typeof window._applyLiveRoleChange === 'function') window._applyLiveRoleChange(liveData);
            }
        }));
        myUsername = uData?.username || "User";
        window._myInterests = Array.isArray(uData?.interests) ? uData.interests : [];
        if (typeof window._loadPlaylistsFromCloud === 'function') window._loadPlaylistsFromCloud(uData);
        if (typeof window._loadLikedSongsFromCloud === 'function') window._loadLikedSongsFromCloud(uData);
        const rawPfp = uData?.pfp || window._DEFAULT_PFP;
        if (rawPfp === '__chunked_gif__') {
            myPfp = window._DEFAULT_PFP;
            ['sidebar-pfp','sidebar-pfp-mobile','settings-pfp-preview'].forEach(id => {
                const el = document.getElementById(id);
                if (el && window._attachPfpFallback) window._attachPfpFallback(el, user.uid, true);
            });
            window.loadChunkedGif(user.uid).then(gif => {
                myPfp = gif;
                window.myPfp = gif;
                document.getElementById('sidebar-pfp').src = gif;
                document.getElementById('sidebar-pfp-mobile').src = gif;
                document.getElementById('settings-pfp-preview').src = gif;
                document.querySelectorAll(`img[data-my-pfp]`).forEach(el => {
                    el.src = gif;
                    if (window._attachPfpFallback) window._attachPfpFallback(el, user.uid, true);
                });
                if (typeof _syncGlobals === 'function') _syncGlobals();

        if (!await _verifySessionNow()) return;

                window._updateDmLiveIndicators();

        document.getElementById('dashboard').classList.add('hidden');

        }

window.AVATAR_COLORS = [
    '#6366f1', '#8b5cf6', '#ec4899', '#ef4444', '#f97316',
    '#f59e0b', '#22c55e', '#14b8a6', '#0ea5e9', '#64748b'
];

 
window.makeDefaultAvatar = (color, mode, letter) => {
    const c = /^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/.test(color || '') ? color : window.AVATAR_COLORS[0];
    const dark = _avatarShade(c, -28);
    const inner = (mode === 'person' || !letter)
        ? '<circle cx="20" cy="15" r="7" fill="#ffffff" fill-opacity="0.93"/>' +
          '<ellipse cx="20" cy="34" rx="12" ry="8" fill="#ffffff" fill-opacity="0.93"/>'
        : '<text x="20" y="21" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central" ' +
          'font-family="Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" ' +
          'font-weight="700" fill="#ffffff">' + _avatarEsc(letter.slice(0, 1).toUpperCase()) + '</text>';
    const svg =
        '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 40 40" width="96" height="96">' +
          '<defs><linearGradient id="g" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">' +
            '<stop offset="0" stop-color="' + c + '"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="' + dark + '"/>' +
          '</linearGradient></defs>' +
          '<rect width="40" height="40" fill="url(#g)"/>' + inner +
        '</svg>';
    return 'data:image/svg+xml,' + encodeURIComponent(svg);
};

function _avatarEsc(t) {
    return String(t).replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;')
                    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
}

function _avatarShade(hex, amt) {
    const n = parseInt(hex.slice(1), 16);
    const ch = [(n >> 16) & 255, (n >> 8) & 255, n & 255]
        .map(v => Math.max(0, Math.min(255, v + amt)));
    return '#' + ch.map(v => v.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
}

let _avPickColor = null;
let _avPickMode  = 'letter';

window.toggleDefaultAvatarPanel = () => {
    const panel = document.getElementById('defavatar-panel');
    if (!panel) return;
    const showing = panel.style.display !== 'none';
    panel.style.display = showing ? 'none' : 'block';
    if (!showing) {
        if (!_avPickColor) {
            const seed = (window.myUsername || 'user').charCodeAt(0) || 0;
            _avPickColor = window.AVATAR_COLORS[seed % window.AVATAR_COLORS.length];
        }
        _avRenderPanel();
    }
};

function _avRenderPanel() {
    const sw = document.getElementById('defavatar-swatches');
    if (sw) {
        sw.innerHTML = window.AVATAR_COLORS.map(c =>
            '<button type="button" onclick="window._avPick(\'' + c + '\')" title="' + c + '" ' +
            'style="width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;cursor:pointer;background:' + c + ';' +
            'border:2px solid ' + (c === _avPickColor ? '#ffffff' : 'transparent') + ';"></button>'
        ).join('');
    }
    ['letter', 'person'].forEach(m => {
        const b = document.getElementById('defavatar-mode-' + m);
        if (b) {
            b.style.background = _avPickMode === m ? 'rgba(99,102,241,.18)' : 'transparent';
            b.style.borderColor = _avPickMode === m ? 'rgba(99,102,241,.55)' : '#1e1e2e';
            b.style.color = _avPickMode === m ? '#c7d2fe' : '#666680';
        }
    });
    const prev = document.getElementById('defavatar-preview');
    if (prev) prev.src = window.makeDefaultAvatar(_avPickColor, _avPickMode, window.myUsername || 'U');
}

window._avPick = (c) => { _avPickColor = c; _avRenderPanel(); };
window._avMode = (m) => { _avPickMode = m; _avRenderPanel(); };

const applyPfpUrl = async (url) => {
    await updateDoc(doc(db, "users", myUID), { pfp: url });
    const snap = await getDocs(query(collection(db, "chats"), where("participants", "array-contains", myUID)));
    await Promise.all(snap.docs.map(d => updateDoc(doc(db, "chats", d.id), { [`pfps.${myUID}`]: url })));
    myPfp = url;
    document.getElementById('sidebar-pfp').src = url;
    document.getElementById('sidebar-pfp-mobile').src = url;
    document.getElementById('settings-pfp-preview').src = url;
};


async function _compressImage(file, maxBytes = 32000) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const img = new Image();
        const url = URL.createObjectURL(file);
        img.onload = () => {
            URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
            const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
            let { width: w, height: h } = img;
            const MAX_DIM = 176;
            if (w > MAX_DIM || h > MAX_DIM) {
                if (w > h) { h = Math.round(h * MAX_DIM / w); w = MAX_DIM; }
                else       { w = Math.round(w * MAX_DIM / h); h = MAX_DIM; }
            }
            canvas.width = w; canvas.height = h;
            canvas.getContext('2d').drawImage(img, 0, 0, w, h);
            let quality = 0.85;
            let dataUrl = canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', quality);
            while (dataUrl.length > maxBytes && quality > 0.2) {
                quality -= 0.1;
                dataUrl = canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', quality);
            }
            resolve(dataUrl);
        };
        img.onerror = reject;
        img.src = url;
    });
}

function _fileToBase64(file) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const r = new FileReader();
        r.onload = () => resolve(r.result);
        r.onerror = reject;
        r.readAsDataURL(file);
    });
}

async function _saveGifChunked(uid, dataUrl) {
    const _pfpVer = Date.now();
    const CHUNK = 700000;
    const chunks = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < dataUrl.length; i += CHUNK) {
        chunks.push(dataUrl.slice(i, i + CHUNK));
    }
    const BATCH_SIZE = 10;
    for (let start = 0; start < chunks.length; start += BATCH_SIZE) {
        const batch = writeBatch(db);
        const end = Math.min(start + BATCH_SIZE, chunks.length);
        for (let i = start; i < end; i++) {
            batch.set(doc(db, 'pfp_chunks', uid, 'chunks', `chunk_${i}`), { data: chunks[i], index: i, v: _pfpVer });
        }
        if (end === chunks.length) {
            batch.set(doc(db, 'pfp_chunks', uid, 'chunks', 'meta'), { total: chunks.length, v: _pfpVer });
        }
        await batch.commit();
    }
    await updateDoc(doc(db, 'users', uid), { pfp: '__chunked_gif__', pfp_chunked: true, pfp_chunk_count: chunks.length });
    const snap = await getDocs(query(collection(db, 'chats'), where('participants', 'array-contains', uid)));
    await Promise.all(snap.docs.map(d => updateDoc(doc(db, 'chats', d.id), { [`pfps.${uid}`]: '__chunked_gif__' })));
}

const _pfpGifInFlight = {};
window.loadChunkedGif = (uid) => {
    if (window._gifCache && window._gifCache[uid]) return Promise.resolve(window._gifCache[uid]);
    return _pfpGifInFlight[uid] || (_pfpGifInFlight[uid] = _loadChunkedGifNow(uid).finally(() => { delete _pfpGifInFlight[uid]; }));
};
async function _loadChunkedGifNow(uid) {
    try {
        const metaSnap = await getDoc(doc(db, 'pfp_chunks', uid, 'chunks', 'meta'));
        if (!metaSnap.exists()) return window._DEFAULT_PFP;
        const { total, v } = metaSnap.data();
        const _chunk = async (ref) => {
            if (v) { try { const c = await getDocFromCache(ref); if (c.exists() && c.data().v === v) return c; } catch (_) {} }
            return getDoc(ref);
        };
        const parts = await Promise.all(
            Array.from({ length: total }, (_, i) =>
                _chunk(doc(db, 'pfp_chunks', uid, 'chunks', `chunk_${i}`))
            )
        );
        const dataUrl = parts.map(p => p.data().data).join('');
        if (!window._gifCache) window._gifCache = {};
        window._gifCache[uid] = dataUrl;
        return dataUrl;
    } catch(e) { return window._DEFAULT_PFP; }
}

window._whenVisible = function (el, fn) {
    if (!el || typeof IntersectionObserver === 'undefined') { fn(); return; }
    const io = new IntersectionObserver((ents) => {
        if (ents.some(e => e.isIntersecting)) { io.disconnect(); fn(); }
    }, { rootMargin: '200px' });
    io.observe(el);
};

window.resolvePfp = async (pfpValue, uid) => {
    if (pfpValue === '__chunked_gif__') return await window.loadChunkedGif(uid);
    return pfpValue || window._DEFAULT_PFP;
};

(function _initPfpFallbackSystem() {
    const _attempts  = new WeakMap();
    const MAX        = 3;
    const DELAYS     = [1500, 4000, 9000];

    async function _retry(el) {
        if (!el || !el.isConnected) return;
        const n = (_attempts.get(el) || 0);
        if (n >= MAX) { el.src = window._DEFAULT_PFP; return; }
        _attempts.set(el, n + 1);

        await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, DELAYS[n]));
        if (!el.isConnected) return;

        const uid        = el.dataset.pfpUid  || '';
        const isChunked  = el.dataset.pfpGif  === '1';
        const rawSrc     = el.dataset.pfpSrc  || '';

        if (isChunked && uid) {
            if (window._gifCache) delete window._gifCache[uid];
            const gif = await window.loadChunkedGif(uid).catch(() => window._DEFAULT_PFP);
            if (el.isConnected) el.src = gif;
        } else if (rawSrc && rawSrc !== window._DEFAULT_PFP && !rawSrc.startsWith('data:')) {
            el.src = rawSrc + (rawSrc.includes('?') ? '&' : '?') + '_r=' + Date.now();
        } else if (uid) {
            const resolved = await window.resolvePfp(el.dataset.pfpRaw || '', uid)
                .catch(() => window._DEFAULT_PFP);
            if (el.isConnected) el.src = resolved;
        } else {
            el.src = window._DEFAULT_PFP;
        }
    }

    function _attach(el) {
        if (!el || el._pfpWatched) return;
        el._pfpWatched = true;
        el.addEventListener('error', () => _retry(el));
    }

    window._attachPfpFallback = function(el, uid, isChunked, rawSrc) {
        if (!el) return;
        if (uid)      el.dataset.pfpUid = uid;
        if (isChunked) el.dataset.pfpGif = '1';
        if (rawSrc && !rawSrc.startsWith('data:') && rawSrc !== '__chunked_gif__')
            el.dataset.pfpSrc = rawSrc;
        _attach(el);
    };

    function _scanNamed() {
        [
            'sidebar-pfp','sidebar-pfp-mobile','settings-pfp-preview',
            'profile-page-pfp','chat-header-pfp','live-stream-pfp',
            'incoming-caller-pfp','acf-my-pfp','acf-their-pfp'
        ].forEach(id => { const el = document.getElementById(id); if (el) _attach(el); });
        document.querySelectorAll('img[data-my-pfp], img.gc-pfp, img[data-pfp-uid]')
            .forEach(_attach);
    }

    function _healthCheck() {
        document.querySelectorAll('img').forEach(el => {
            if (el.complete && el.naturalWidth === 0
                && el.src && el.src !== window._DEFAULT_PFP
                && !el.src.startsWith('data:image/svg')
                && el._pfpWatched) {
                _retry(el);
            }
        });
    }

    new MutationObserver(mutations => {
        for (const m of mutations) {
            for (const node of m.addedNodes) {
                if (node.nodeType !== 1) continue;
                if (node.tagName === 'IMG') _attach(node);
                node.querySelectorAll?.('img.gc-pfp, img[data-my-pfp], img[data-pfp-uid]')
                    .forEach(_attach);
            }
        }
    }).observe(document.documentElement, { childList: true, subtree: true });

    setTimeout(() => {
        _scanNamed();
        setInterval(_healthCheck, 30000);
    }, 3000);
})();

document.getElementById('pfp-input').addEventListener('change', async (e) => {
    const file = e.target.files[0];
    if (!file || !myUID) return;
    const msg = document.getElementById('pfp-msg');
    if (!file.type?.startsWith('image/')) {
        msg.innerText = "Must be an image."; msg.className = "text-red-500 text-xs mt-2"; msg.classList.remove('hidden'); return;
    }
    msg.innerText = "Processing..."; msg.className = "text-indigo-400 text-xs mt-2"; msg.classList.remove('hidden');
    e.target.value = '';
    try {
        const dataUrl = await _compressImage(file);
        await applyPfpUrl(dataUrl);
        document.getElementById('profile-page-pfp').src = dataUrl;
        document.querySelectorAll('img[data-my-pfp]').forEach(el => el.src = dataUrl);
        myPfp = dataUrl;
        msg.innerText = "Profile picture updated!"; msg.className = "text-green-500 text-xs mt-2";
        setTimeout(() => msg.classList.add('hidden'), 3000);
    } catch(err) {
        msg.innerText = "Error: " + err.message;
        msg.className = "text-red-500 text-xs mt-2";
    }
});

    const file = e.target.files[0];

    }
});

window.updateUsername = async () => {
    const newName = document.getElementById('new-username').value.trim();
    const msg = document.getElementById('settings-msg');
    if (!newName) return;
    if (!cooldownCheck('update_username', 30000)) {
        msg.innerText = 'Wait before changing your username again.';
        msg.className = 'text-yellow-500 text-sm mt-2 font-bold';
        msg.classList.remove('hidden');
        return;
    }
    if (!enforceMaxLength(newName, 32, 'Username')) return;
    try {
        const uCheck = await getDocs(query(collection(db, "users"), where("lower_username", "==", newName.toLowerCase()), limit(1)));
        if (!uCheck.empty && uCheck.docs[0].id !== myUID) {
            msg.innerText = "That username is already taken."; msg.className = "text-red-500 text-sm mt-2 font-bold"; msg.classList.remove('hidden'); return;
        }
        const oldLowerUsername = myUsername ? myUsername.toLowerCase() : null;
        await updateDoc(doc(db, "users", myUID), { username: newName, lower_username: newName.toLowerCase() });
        try { await setDoc(doc(db, "usernames", newName.toLowerCase()), { email: auth.currentUser?.email || formatEmail(newName), uid: myUID }); } catch(_) {}
        if (oldLowerUsername && oldLowerUsername !== newName.toLowerCase()) {
            try { await deleteDoc(doc(db, "usernames", oldLowerUsername)); } catch(_) {}
        }
        const snap = await getDocs(query(collection(db, "chats"), where("participants", "array-contains", myUID)));
        await Promise.all(snap.docs.map(d => updateDoc(doc(db, "chats", d.id), { [`names.${myUID}`]: newName })));
        myUsername = newName;
        if (!document.getElementById('user-display-tw-cursor')) document.getElementById('user-display').innerText = myUsername;
        msg.innerText = "Username updated!"; msg.className = "text-green-500 text-sm mt-2 font-bold"; msg.classList.remove('hidden');
        setTimeout(() => msg.classList.add('hidden'), 3000);
    } catch(e) {
        msg.innerText = "Error: " + e.message; msg.className = "text-red-500 text-sm mt-2 font-bold"; msg.classList.remove('hidden');
    }
};

window.requestEmailChange = async () => {
    const newEmail = document.getElementById('new-email-input').value.trim();
    const msg = document.getElementById('email-change-msg');
    if (!newEmail) { msg.innerText = "Please enter a new email address."; msg.className = "text-red-500"; msg.classList.remove('hidden'); return; }
    if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(newEmail)) {
        msg.innerText = "Please enter a valid email address."; msg.className = "text-red-500"; msg.classList.remove('hidden'); return;
    }
    if (_isBlockedEmail(newEmail)) {
        msg.innerText = _BLOCKED_EMAIL_MSG; msg.className = "text-red-500"; msg.classList.remove('hidden'); return;
    }
    if (!cooldownCheck('email_change_request', 60000)) {
        msg.innerText = 'Please wait before submitting another request.'; msg.className = 'text-yellow-500'; msg.classList.remove('hidden'); return;
    }
    try {
        const eCheck = await getDocs(query(collection(db, "users"), where("email", "==", newEmail), limit(1)));
        if (!eCheck.empty && eCheck.docs[0].id !== myUID) {
            msg.innerText = "That email is already in use by another account."; msg.className = "text-red-500"; msg.classList.remove('hidden'); return;
        }
        await updateDoc(doc(db, "users", myUID), {
            pendingEmailChange: newEmail,
            pendingEmailChangeAt: serverTimestamp()
        });
        document.getElementById('new-email-input').value = '';
        msg.innerText = "Email change request sent! An admin will review and process it soon.";
        msg.className = "text-green-500";
        msg.classList.remove('hidden');
        setTimeout(() => msg.classList.add('hidden'), 5000);
    } catch(e) {
        msg.innerText = "Error: " + e.message; msg.className = "text-red-500"; msg.classList.remove('hidden');
    }
};

window.dismissSystemMsg = async () => {
    document.getElementById('system-msg-modal').classList.add('hidden');
    try { await updateDoc(doc(db, "users", myUID), { systemMessage: null }); } catch(e){}
};

let _shownAnnouncementIds = new Set();
let _pendingAnnouncements = [];

function listenForAnnouncements() {
    listeners.push(onSnapshot(query(collection(db, "system_announcements"), where("active", "==", true), orderBy("timestamp", "asc")), (snap) => {
        const activeIds = new Set(snap.docs.map(d => d.id));
        _pendingAnnouncements = _pendingAnnouncements.filter(q => activeIds.has(q.id));
        snap.docs.forEach(d => {
            if (_shownAnnouncementIds.has(d.id)) return;
            if (document.querySelector(`.at-row[data-id="${d.id}"]`)) return;
            if (_announcementScreenReady()) {
                _shownAnnouncementIds.add(d.id);
                _addAnnouncementRow(d.id, d.data().message);
            } else if (!_pendingAnnouncements.some(q => q.id === d.id)) {
                _pendingAnnouncements.push({ id: d.id, message: d.data().message });
            }
        });
        document.querySelectorAll('.at-row').forEach(row => {
            if (!activeIds.has(row.dataset.id)) _dismissAnnouncementRow(row.dataset.id);
        });
    }, (error) => { console.warn("Announcements error:", error); }));
    listenForFlashAnnouncements();
    listenForForceRefresh();
}

let _shownLoginPingIds = new Set();
let _loginPingSince = 0;
let _loginPingsListening = false;

function listenForLoginPings() {
    if (_loginPingsListening) return;
    _loginPingsListening = true;
    _loginPingSince = Date.now();
    listeners.push(onSnapshot(query(collection(db, "login_events"), orderBy("at", "desc"), limit(10)), (snap) => {
        snap.docChanges().forEach(chg => {
            if (chg.type !== 'added') return;
            const d = chg.doc, data = d.data();
            if (_shownLoginPingIds.has(d.id)) return;
            _shownLoginPingIds.add(d.id);
            if (data.uid === window.myUID) return;
            const ts = data.at?.toMillis ? data.at.toMillis() : Date.now();
            if (ts < _loginPingSince - 10000) return;
            if (_announcementScreenReady()) _addLoginPingToast(data.username || 'Someone');
        });
    }, (error) => { console.warn("Login ping error:", error); }));
}

function _addLoginPingToast(username) {
    let stack = document.getElementById('login-ping-stack');
    if (!stack) {
        stack = document.createElement('div');
        stack.id = 'login-ping-stack';
        stack.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);bottom:26px;' +
            'z-index:9998;display:flex;flex-direction:column-reverse;align-items:center;gap:9px;' +
            'pointer-events:none;max-width:92vw;';
        document.body.appendChild(stack);
    }
    const pill = document.createElement('div');
    pill.style.cssText = 'display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;padding:12px 20px 12px 16px;' +
        'border-radius:999px;background:rgba(12,12,22,0.94);border:1px solid rgba(34,197,94,0.28);' +
        'box-shadow:0 6px 26px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);font-family:"DM Sans",sans-serif;font-size:14.5px;' +
        'font-weight:600;color:#e8e8f2;white-space:nowrap;opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px);' +
        'transition:opacity .3s ease,transform .3s ease;';
    const dot = document.createElement('span');
    dot.style.cssText = 'width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:#22c55e;flex-shrink:0;' +
        'box-shadow:0 0 9px rgba(34,197,94,0.85);';
    const text = document.createElement('span');
    text.innerText = username + ' logged in';
    pill.appendChild(dot);
    pill.appendChild(text);
    stack.appendChild(pill);
    requestAnimationFrame(() => { pill.style.opacity = '1'; pill.style.transform = 'translateY(0)'; });
    setTimeout(() => {
        pill.style.opacity = '0';
        pill.style.transform = 'translateY(10px)';
        setTimeout(() => {
            pill.remove();
            if (stack && !stack.children.length) stack.remove();
        }, 320);
    }, 6000);
}

let _forceRefreshSince = 0;
let _forceRefreshFired = false;

function listenForForceRefresh() {
    _forceRefreshSince = Date.now();
    listeners.push(onSnapshot(doc(db, "site_config", "main"), (snap) => {
        try { window._applyTurnConfig && window._applyTurnConfig(snap.data()?.turnServers); } catch (_) {}
        const at = snap.data()?.forceRefreshAt;
        if (typeof at !== 'number') return;
        if (at <= _forceRefreshSince) return;
        if (_forceRefreshFired) return;
        _forceRefreshFired = true;
        _runForceRefreshCountdown(5);
    }, (error) => { console.warn("Force-refresh listener error:", error); }));
}

function _runForceRefreshCountdown(seconds) {
    let el = document.getElementById('force-refresh-overlay');
    if (!el) {
        el = document.createElement('div');
        el.id = 'force-refresh-overlay';
        el.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:99999;display:flex;flex-direction:column;' +
            'align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:14px;background:rgba(8,8,16,0.82);' +
            'backdrop-filter:blur(6px);font-family:"DM Sans",sans-serif;color:#fff;opacity:0;' +
            'transition:opacity .35s ease;';
        el.innerHTML = `
            <div style="font-size:34px;color:#818cf8;"><i class="fa-solid fa-rotate fa-spin"></i></div>
            <div style="font-size:17px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:0.01em;">Updating EchoSpace</div>
            <div id="fr-count" style="font-size:13px;color:#9999aa;font-weight:600;"></div>`;
        document.body.appendChild(el);
        requestAnimationFrame(() => { el.style.opacity = '1'; });
    }
    const label = el.querySelector('#fr-count');
    let left = seconds;
    const tick = () => {
        if (label) label.innerText = left > 0 ? `Refreshing in ${left}…` : 'Refreshing…';
        if (left <= 0) { location.reload(); return; }
        left--;
        setTimeout(tick, 1000);
    };
    tick();
}

let _shownFlashIds = new Set();
let _flashSince = 0;

function listenForFlashAnnouncements() {
    _flashSince = Date.now();
    listeners.push(onSnapshot(query(collection(db, "flash_announcements"), orderBy("timestamp", "desc"), limit(5)), (snap) => {
        snap.docChanges().forEach(chg => {
            if (chg.type !== 'added') return;
            const d = chg.doc;
            if (_shownFlashIds.has(d.id)) return;
            const data = d.data();
            const ts = data.timestamp?.toMillis ? data.timestamp.toMillis() : Date.now();
            if (ts < _flashSince - 10000) { _shownFlashIds.add(d.id); return; }
            _shownFlashIds.add(d.id);
            if (_announcementScreenReady()) _addAnnouncementRow(d.id, data.message);
        });
    }, (error) => { console.warn("Flash announcements error:", error); }));
}

function _appScreenReady() {
    const gateGone = document.getElementById('security-gate').classList.contains('hidden');
    const shutdownGone = document.getElementById('shutdown-screen').classList.contains('hidden');
    const authVisible = !document.getElementById('auth-screen').classList.contains('hidden');
    const dashVisible = !document.getElementById('dashboard').classList.contains('hidden');
    const loaderEl = document.getElementById('echospace-loader');
    const loaderGone = !loaderEl
        || loaderEl.classList.contains('hidden')
        || getComputedStyle(loaderEl).display === 'none';
    return gateGone && shutdownGone && loaderGone && (authVisible || dashVisible);
}
window._appScreenReady = _appScreenReady;

function _announcementScreenReady() {
    if (window._changelogOpen) return false;
    return _appScreenReady();
}

function _addAnnouncementRow(id, message) {
    const container = document.getElementById('announcement-toast-container');
    const rows = document.getElementById('at-rows');
    if (!container || !rows) return;
    const row = document.createElement('div');
    row.className = 'at-row entering';
    row.dataset.id = id;
    row.innerHTML = `
        <div class="at-row-text"></div>
        <button class="at-row-dismiss" title="Dismiss">✕</button>
        <div class="toast-progress"></div>`;
    row.querySelector('.at-row-text').innerText = message;
    row.querySelector('.at-row-dismiss').onclick = (e) => { e.currentTarget.classList.add('punched'); _dismissAnnouncementRow(id); };
    rows.appendChild(row);
    if (typeof _gamesFsToast === "function") {
        _gamesFsToast({ title: "📢 Announcement", body: message, emoji: "📢" });
    }
    row._timer = setTimeout(() => _dismissAnnouncementRow(id), 10000);
    _updateAnnouncementHeader();
    container.classList.remove('hidden');
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        container.classList.add('show');
        requestAnimationFrame(() => row.classList.remove('entering'));
    });
}

window._adminToast = (message, opts) => {
    try {
        const o = opts || {};
        const host = document.getElementById('admin-action-toasts');
        if (!host) { console.warn('[adminToast] host missing:', message); return; }
        if (host.parentElement !== document.body) document.body.appendChild(host);
        const row = document.createElement('div');
        row.className = 'aat-row';

        const iconEl = document.createElement('i');
        const rawIcon = o.icon || 'fa-solid fa-shield-halved';
        if (/^[\p{Emoji}‍️]+$/u.test(rawIcon)) {
            iconEl.className = 'aat-emoji';
            iconEl.textContent = rawIcon;
        } else {
            iconEl.className = rawIcon;
        }
        if (o.color) { iconEl.style.color = o.color; row.style.borderLeftColor = o.color; }
        row.appendChild(iconEl);

        const textEl = document.createElement('span');
        textEl.className = 'aat-text';
        textEl.innerText = String(message);
        const who = document.createElement('span');
        who.className = 'aat-who';
        who.innerText = o.sub || 'Only visible to you';
        textEl.appendChild(who);
        row.appendChild(textEl);
        host.appendChild(row);
        while (host.children.length > 4) host.firstElementChild.remove();
        const kill = () => {
            if (row._done) return;
            row._done = true;
            row.classList.add('leaving');
            setTimeout(() => row.remove(), 300);
        };
        row.onclick = kill;
        setTimeout(kill, 4500);
    } catch (e) { console.warn('[adminToast] failed:', e); }
};

function _dismissAnnouncementRow(id) {
    const row = document.querySelector(`.at-row[data-id="${id}"]`);
    if (!row) return;
    if (row._timer) clearTimeout(row._timer);
    row.classList.add('leaving');
    setTimeout(() => {
        row.remove();
        _updateAnnouncementHeader();
        const rows = document.getElementById('at-rows');
        const container = document.getElementById('announcement-toast-container');
        if (rows && container && !rows.children.length) {
            container.classList.remove('show');
            container.classList.add('closing');
            setTimeout(() => {
                container.classList.remove('closing');
                container.classList.add('hidden');
            }, 450);
        }
    }, 550);
}

function _updateAnnouncementHeader() {
    const rows = document.getElementById('at-rows');
    const suffix = document.getElementById('at-count-suffix');
    if (!rows || !suffix) return;
    const n = rows.children.length;
    suffix.innerText = n > 1 ? `s (${n})` : '';
    suffix.style.animation = 'none';
    void suffix.offsetWidth;
    suffix.style.animation = '';
}

window.dismissAnnouncement = (id) => _dismissAnnouncementRow(id);

window._flushAnnouncementIfPending = () => {
    if (!_announcementScreenReady() || !_pendingAnnouncements.length) return;
    const toShow = _pendingAnnouncements;
    _pendingAnnouncements = [];
    toShow.forEach(a => { _shownAnnouncementIds.add(a.id); _addAnnouncementRow(a.id, a.message); });
};

window._changelogStatus = () => {
    const pub = PENDING_CHANGES.filter(c => !c.admin).length;
    return {
        version: APP_VERSION,
        pending: PENDING_CHANGES.length,
        pendingPublic: pub,
        threshold: CHANGELOG_RELEASE_THRESHOLD,
        untilRelease: Math.max(0, CHANGELOG_RELEASE_THRESHOLD - pub),
        readyToRelease: pub >= CHANGELOG_RELEASE_THRESHOLD
    };
};
