function _verCmp(a, b) {
    const pa = String(a).split('.').map(n => parseInt(n, 10) || 0);
    const pb = String(b).split('.').map(n => parseInt(n, 10) || 0);
    for (let i = 0; i < Math.max(pa.length, pb.length); i++) {
        const d = (pa[i] || 0) - (pb[i] || 0);
        if (d) return d > 0 ? 1 : -1;
    }
    return 0;
}

function _publicChanges(entry) {
    return (entry && entry.changes || []).filter(c => !c.admin);
}

window._changelogOpen = false;

window._maybeShowChangelog = function () {
    try {
        const latest = CHANGELOG[0];
        if (!latest) return;
        const seen = localStorage.getItem('echo_changelog_seen');
        if (seen === latest.version) return;
        if (seen && _verCmp(seen, latest.version) >= 0) {
            localStorage.setItem('echo_changelog_seen', latest.version);
            return;
        }
        if (!_publicChanges(latest).length) {
            localStorage.setItem('echo_changelog_seen', latest.version);
            return;
        }
        let waited = 0;
        const tryShow = () => {
            if (_appScreenReady()) { window._showChangelogPopup(latest, true); return; }
            if ((waited += 250) > 30000) return;
            setTimeout(tryShow, 250);
        };
        tryShow();
    } catch (_) {   }
};

window._showChangelogPopup = function (entry, autoClose) {
    const ICON = { added: '✨', improved: '⚡', fixed: '🔧' };
    const COLOR = { added: '#4ade80', improved: '#818cf8', fixed: '#fbbf24' };
    document.getElementById('changelog-popup')?.remove();

    const wrap = document.createElement('div');
    wrap.id = 'changelog-popup';
    wrap.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:10050;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:rgba(3,3,10,0.72);backdrop-filter:blur(5px);padding:18px;font-family:\'DM Sans\',sans-serif;animation:clFade .25s ease;';
    wrap.innerHTML = `
        <div style="width:100%;max-width:440px;max-height:80vh;overflow-y:auto;background:#0b0b16;border:1px solid rgba(99,102,241,0.28);border-radius:20px;padding:22px;box-shadow:0 26px 80px rgba(0,0,0,0.65);">
            <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;">
                <span style="width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:11px;background:rgba(99,102,241,0.15);color:#818cf8;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:15px;"><i class="fa-solid fa-rocket"></i></span>
                <div style="flex:1;min-width:0;">
                    <div style="font-size:15px;font-weight:900;color:#e8e8f0;">What's New</div>
                    <div style="font-size:11px;color:#555566;font-weight:700;">v${entry.version} · ${entry.date}</div>
                </div>
                <button id="cl-close" style="background:none;border:none;color:#555566;font-size:18px;cursor:pointer;line-height:1;padding:2px 4px;">&times;</button>
            </div>
            <div style="margin-top:16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px;">
                ${_publicChanges(entry).map(c => `
                    <div style="display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:flex-start;">
                        <span style="font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;flex-shrink:0;">${ICON[c.type] || '•'}</span>
                        <span style="font-size:12.5px;color:#c8c8d8;line-height:1.5;">${window.escHtml(c.text)}</span>
                    </div>`).join('')}
            </div>
            <div id="cl-timer-wrap" style="margin-top:18px;height:2px;border-radius:2px;background:#14141f;overflow:hidden;${autoClose ? '' : 'display:none;'}">
                <div id="cl-timer" style="height:100%;width:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#4f46e5,#818cf8);"></div>
            </div>
        </div>`;
    document.body.appendChild(wrap);
    window._changelogOpen = true;

    let closed = false;
    const close = () => {
        if (closed) return;
        closed = true;
        window._changelogOpen = false;
        try { localStorage.setItem('echo_changelog_seen', entry.version); } catch (_) {}
        wrap.remove();
        window._flushAnnouncementIfPending && window._flushAnnouncementIfPending();
    };
    wrap.querySelector('#cl-close').onclick = close;
    wrap.onclick = (e) => { if (e.target === wrap) close(); };

    if (autoClose) {
        const bar = wrap.querySelector('#cl-timer');
        if (bar) {
            bar.style.transition = 'width 30s linear';
            requestAnimationFrame(() => { bar.style.width = '0%'; });
        }
        setTimeout(close, 30000);
    }
};

function _changelogDiscordText(entry) {
    const HEAD = { added: '✨ Added', improved: '⚡ Improved', fixed: '🔧 Fixed' };
    const pub = _publicChanges(entry);
    let out = `## 🚀 EchoSpace v${entry.version}\n*${entry.date}*\n`;
    ['added', 'improved', 'fixed'].forEach(t => {
        const rows = pub.filter(c => c.type === t);
        if (!rows.length) return;
        out += `\n**${HEAD[t]}**\n` + rows.map(c => `> ${c.text}`).join('\n') + '\n';
    });
    return out;
}

window._apRenderChangelog = function () {
    const box = document.getElementById('ap-changelog-body');
    if (!box) return;
    const e = CHANGELOG[0];
    const pub = _publicChanges(e), hidden = (e.changes || []).length - pub.length;
    box.innerHTML = `
        <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-bottom:8px;">
            <span style="font-size:13px;font-weight:900;color:#e8e8f0;">v${e.version}</span>
            <span style="font-size:11px;color:#555566;">${e.date}</span>
            <span style="margin-left:auto;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;color:#818cf8;">${pub.length} public${hidden ? ` · ${hidden} admin-only hidden` : ''}</span>
        </div>
        <pre id="ap-changelog-pre" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-word;font-size:11px;line-height:1.55;color:#c8c8d8;background:#07070f;border:1px solid #1e1e2e;border-radius:10px;padding:11px;margin:0;max-height:260px;overflow-y:auto;font-family:ui-monospace,monospace;">${window.escHtml(_changelogDiscordText(e))}</pre>`;
};

window._apCopyChangelog = function (btn) {
    const txt = _changelogDiscordText(CHANGELOG[0]);
    const done = () => { const o = btn.innerHTML; btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-check"></i> Copied'; setTimeout(() => { btn.innerHTML = o; }, 1800); };
    if (navigator.clipboard?.writeText) {
        navigator.clipboard.writeText(txt).then(done).catch(() => {
            const t = document.createElement('textarea'); t.value = txt; document.body.appendChild(t); t.select();
            try { document.execCommand('copy'); done(); } catch (_) {}
            t.remove();
        });
    }
};

window._openWhatsNew = function () {
    if (!CHANGELOG.length) return;
    window._showChangelogPopup(CHANGELOG[0], false);
};

let _liveSearchToken = 0;
document.getElementById('live-search').addEventListener('input', async (e) => {
    const val = e.target.value.trim().toLowerCase();
    const res = document.getElementById('search-results');
    const myToken = ++_liveSearchToken;
    if (!val) { res.innerHTML =`<div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;padding:28px 20px;gap:10px;"><div style="width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(99,102,241,0.08);border:1px solid rgba(99,102,241,0.15);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:22px;opacity:0.6;">👤</div><div style="font-size:13px;font-weight:800;color:#555566;">Start typing to search</div><div style="font-size:11px;color:#333345;">Find people by their username.</div></div>`; return; }
    const snap = await getDocs(query(collection(db, "users"), where("lower_username", ">=", val), where("lower_username", "<=", val + "\uf8ff"), limit(10)));
    if (myToken !== _liveSearchToken) return;
    const reqSnap = await getDocs(query(collection(db, "requests"), where("senderId", "==", myUID)));
    const pendingUIDs = new Set(reqSnap.docs.map(d => d.data().receiverId));
    const seen = new Set();
    const searchDocs = [];
    snap.forEach(d => {
        if (d.id !== myUID && !d.data().isBot && !seen.has(d.data().lower_username)) {
            seen.add(d.data().lower_username);
            searchDocs.push(d);
        }
    });
    try {
        const ownerSnap = await getDocs(query(collection(db, "users"), where("role", "==", "owner"), limit(5)));
        ownerSnap.forEach(d => {
            const u = d.data();
            const uname = (u.lower_username || u.username || '').toLowerCase();
            if (d.id !== myUID && uname.startsWith(val) && !seen.has(uname) && !searchDocs.some(sd => sd.id === d.id)) {
                seen.add(uname);
                searchDocs.push(d);
            }
        });
    } catch(e) {}
    let html = '';
    for (const d of searchDocs) {
        const udata = d.data();
        const isFriend = window._friendUIDs && window._friendUIDs.has(d.id);
        const isPending = pendingUIDs.has(d.id);
        let actionBtn;
        if (isFriend) {
            actionBtn = `<button class="btn-ghost px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-green-400 border-green-900/40 cursor-default" disabled>✓ Friends</button>`;
        } else if (isPending) {
            actionBtn = `<button class="btn-ghost px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-yellow-400 border-yellow-900/40 cursor-default" disabled><i class="fa-solid fa-hourglass-half"></i> Pending</button>`;
        } else {
            actionBtn = `<button onclick="sendRequest('${d.id}','${window.escAttr(udata.username)}',this)" class="btn-primary px-4 py-1.5 text-xs">Add</button>`;
        }
        const isOwnerRow = udata.ownerAccount === true || udata.role === 'owner';
        const myInt = (window._myInterests || []).map(t => t.toLowerCase());
        const theirInt = Array.isArray(udata.interests) ? udata.interests : [];
        const shared = theirInt.filter(t => myInt.includes(t.toLowerCase()));
        const sharedHtml = shared.length
            ? `<div class="flex flex-wrap gap-1 mt-1.5">${shared.slice(0,4).map(t => `<span class="int-chip-shared">✨ ${window.escHtml(t)}</span>`).join('')}</div>`
            : '';
        const resolvedPfp = await window.resolvePfp(udata.pfp || '', d.id);
        if (myToken !== _liveSearchToken) return;
        html += `
        <div class="fu-row ${isOwnerRow ? 'fu-row-owner' : ''} flex justify-between items-center p-3 bg-[#0a0a15] border border-[#1e1e2e] rounded-xl gap-2">
            <div class="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0 cursor-pointer" onclick="openProfilePage('${d.id}')">
                <img src="${resolvedPfp}" class="${isOwnerRow ? 'fu-owner-avatar' : ''} w-9 h-9 rounded-full object-cover bg-[#1e1e2e] flex-shrink-0" style="box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #0a0a15, 0 0 0 3px rgba(99,102,241,0.35);">
                <div class="min-w-0">
                    <div class="min-w-0 flex items-center gap-1">
                        <span class="${isOwnerRow ? 'fu-owner-name' : ''} text-white font-bold text-sm hover:text-indigo-400 transition truncate">${window.escHtml(udata.username)}</span>
                        ${isOwnerRow ? '<span class="fu-owner-crown flex-shrink-0">👑</span>' : (window._roleBadgeHtml ? window._roleBadgeHtml(udata.role) : '')}
                    </div>
                    <div class="text-[#555566] text-xs truncate">${isOwnerRow ? 'EchoSpace Owner' : (udata.customStatus ? window.escHtml(udata.customStatus) : 'EchoSpace member')}</div>
                    ${sharedHtml}
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="flex gap-2 flex-shrink-0">
                <button onclick="openProfilePage('${d.id}')" class="btn-ghost px-3 py-1.5 text-xs">Profile</button>
                ${actionBtn}
            </div>
        </div>`;
    }
    if (myToken !== _liveSearchToken) return;
    res.innerHTML = html;
});
window.findByInterests = async () => {
    const res = document.getElementById('search-results');
    const btn = document.getElementById('match-interests-btn');
    if (!res) return;
    const myToken = ++_liveSearchToken;

    const mine = (window._myInterests || []).filter(Boolean);
    if (!mine.length) {
        res.innerHTML = '<p class="fu-empty">Add a few interests in Settings first, then come back — ' +
            'this matches you with people who share them.</p>';
        return;
    }

    const liveEl = document.getElementById('live-search');
    if (liveEl) liveEl.value = '';
    if (btn) { btn.disabled = true; btn.classList.add('is-loading'); }
    res.innerHTML = '<p class="fu-empty">Finding people…</p>';

    try {
        const mineLower = mine.map(t => t.toLowerCase());
        const variants = [...new Set(mine.flatMap(t => {
            const lo = t.toLowerCase();
            return [t, lo, lo.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + lo.slice(1)];
        }))].slice(0, 30);
        const snap = await getDocs(query(
            collection(db, 'users'),
            where('interests', 'array-contains-any', variants),
            limit(40)
        ));

        const rows = [];
        snap.forEach(d => {
            const u = d.data();
            if (d.id === myUID || u.isBot) return;
            const theirs = Array.isArray(u.interests) ? u.interests : [];
            const shared = theirs.filter(t => mineLower.includes(String(t).toLowerCase()));
            if (shared.length) rows.push({ id: d.id, u, shared });
        });
        rows.sort((a, b) => b.shared.length - a.shared.length);

        if (myToken !== _liveSearchToken) return;
        if (!rows.length) {
            res.innerHTML = '<p class="fu-empty">Nobody else has added these interests yet. ' +
                'Try adding a few more common ones.</p>';
            return;
        }

        let html = '';
        for (const { id, u, shared } of rows.slice(0, 25)) {
            const isFriend = window._friendUIDs && window._friendUIDs.has(id);
            const isOwnerRow = u.ownerAccount === true || u.role === 'owner';
            const actionBtn = isFriend
                ? '<button class="btn-ghost px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-green-400 border-green-900/40 cursor-default" disabled>✓ Friends</button>'
                : `<button onclick="sendRequest('${id}','${window.escAttr(u.username || '')}',this)" class="btn-primary px-4 py-1.5 text-xs">Add</button>`;
            const pfp = await window.resolvePfp(u.pfp || '', id);
            if (myToken !== _liveSearchToken) return;
            html += `
            <div class="fu-row ${isOwnerRow ? 'fu-row-owner' : ''} flex justify-between items-center p-3 bg-[#0a0a15] border border-[#1e1e2e] rounded-xl gap-2">
                <div class="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0 cursor-pointer" onclick="openProfilePage('${id}')">
                    <!-- Raw, not escAttr'd: pfps are data: URLs and escAttr turns their & into
                         &amp;, which breaks the src. Matches how the username-search rows do it. -->
                    <img src="${pfp}" class="w-10 h-10 rounded-full object-cover flex-shrink-0 bg-[#1e1e2e]"
                         onerror="this.src=window._DEFAULT_PFP">
                    <div class="min-w-0">
                        <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                            <span class="${isOwnerRow ? 'fu-owner-name' : ''} text-white font-bold text-sm truncate">${window.escHtml(u.username || 'User')}</span>
                            ${isOwnerRow ? '<span class="fu-owner-crown flex-shrink-0">👑</span>' : (window._roleBadgeHtml ? window._roleBadgeHtml(u.role) : '')}
                            <span class="fu-match-count">${shared.length} shared</span>
                        </div>
                        <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-1 mt-1.5">
                            ${shared.slice(0, 4).map(t => `<span class="int-chip-shared">✨ ${window.escHtml(t)}</span>`).join('')}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="flex gap-2 flex-shrink-0">
                    <button onclick="openProfilePage('${id}')" class="btn-ghost px-3 py-1.5 text-xs">Profile</button>
                    ${actionBtn}
                </div>
            </div>`;
        }
        if (myToken !== _liveSearchToken) return;
        res.innerHTML = html;
    } catch (e) {
        console.warn('[Interests] match failed:', e);
        res.innerHTML = '<p class="fu-empty">Could not load matches right now. Try again in a moment.</p>';
    } finally {
        if (btn) { btn.disabled = false; btn.classList.remove('is-loading'); }
    }
};

window.sendRequest = async (tid, tname, btn) => {
    if (!cooldownCheck('send_request', 5000)) {
        showCooldownToast('Wait before sending another request.');
        return;
    }
    if (!spamGuard('send_request_spam', 10, 60000)) {
        showCooldownToast('Too many requests sent. Slow down.');
        return;
    }
    const oldText = btn.innerText, oldClass = btn.className;
    btn.innerText = "Sending…"; btn.disabled = true;
    const pfpSafe = (typeof myPfp === 'string' && myPfp !== '__chunked_gif__' && !(myPfp.startsWith('data:') && myPfp.length > 8000)) ? myPfp : "";
    try {
        await setDoc(doc(db, "requests", `${myUID}_${tid}`), { senderId: myUID, senderName: myUsername || 'Someone', senderPfp: pfpSafe, receiverId: tid });
        btn.innerText = "Sent ✓"; btn.className = "btn-ghost text-xs px-4 py-1.5";
    } catch (e) {
        console.warn('[sendRequest] failed:', e);
        try { window.reportRuleDenial?.('Friend request', e, { path: `requests/${myUID}_${tid}`, op: 'create' }); } catch (_) {}
        btn.innerText = oldText; btn.className = oldClass; btn.disabled = false;
        showCooldownToast(e?.code === 'permission-denied'
            ? "Couldn't send that request — permission denied."
            : "Couldn't send that request. Try again.");
    }
};
window.renderInterestChips = () => {
    const box = document.getElementById('interests-chips');
    if (!box) return;
    const list = window._myInterests || [];
    box.innerHTML = list.length ? '' : '<p class="text-xs text-[#333345]">No interests added yet.</p>';
    list.forEach(tag => {
        box.innerHTML += `<span class="int-chip">${window.escHtml(tag)}<button onclick="window.removeInterest('${window.escAttr(tag)}')">✕</button></span>`;
    });
};
window.addInterest = async () => {
    const input = document.getElementById('interest-input');
    const val = input.value.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
    const msg = document.getElementById('interests-msg');
    const show = (text, ok) => { msg.innerText = text; msg.className = `text-xs mt-2 font-bold ${ok ? 'text-green-400' : 'text-red-400'}`; msg.classList.remove('hidden'); };
    if (!val) return;
    window._myInterests = window._myInterests || [];
    if (window._myInterests.length >= 10) return show("Max 10 interests. Remove one to add another.", false);
    if (window._myInterests.some(t => t.toLowerCase() === val.toLowerCase())) return show("Already added.", false);
    window._myInterests.push(val);
    window.renderInterestChips();
    input.value = '';
    try {
        await updateDoc(doc(db, "users", myUID), { interests: arrayUnion(val) });
        show("Added!", true);
    } catch(e) { show("Couldn't save — try again.", false); }
};
window.removeInterest = async (tag) => {
    window._myInterests = (window._myInterests || []).filter(t => t !== tag);
    window.renderInterestChips();
    try { await updateDoc(doc(db, "users", myUID), { interests: arrayRemove(tag) }); } catch(e) {}
};

function listenForRequests() {
    listeners.push(onSnapshot(query(collection(db, "requests"), where("receiverId", "==", myUID)), (snap) => {
        const reqBox = document.getElementById('requests-list');
        reqBox.innerHTML = snap.empty ? `
            <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;padding:28px 20px;gap:10px;">
                <div style="width:60px;height:60px;border-radius:20px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(99,102,241,0.14),rgba(99,102,241,0.04));border:1px solid rgba(99,102,241,0.18);box-shadow:0 6px 18px -8px rgba(99,102,241,0.45);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:23px;color:#6366f1;"><i class="fa-solid fa-bell"></i></div>
                <div style="font-size:13px;font-weight:800;color:#555566;">No alerts right now</div>
                <div style="font-size:11px;color:#333345;">Friend requests will show up here.</div>
            </div>` : '';
        document.getElementById('req-badge').classList.toggle('hidden', snap.empty);
        snap.forEach(d => {
            const data = d.data();
            reqBox.innerHTML += `
                <div class="flex justify-between items-center p-3 bg-[#0a0a15] border border-[#1e1e2e] rounded-xl gap-3">
                    <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
                        <img id="req-pfp-${d.id}" src="${data.senderPfp || window._DEFAULT_PFP}" class="w-9 h-9 rounded-full object-cover bg-[#1e1e2e]">
                        <span class="font-bold text-sm text-white">${window.escHtml(data.senderName)}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="flex gap-2">
                        <button onclick="acceptRequest('${d.id}','${data.senderId}','${window.escAttr(data.senderName)}')" class="btn-primary text-xs px-3 py-1.5" style="background:linear-gradient(135deg,#16a34a,#22c55e);">Accept</button>
                        <button onclick="rejectRequest('${d.id}')" class="btn-danger text-xs px-3 py-1.5">Reject</button>
                    </div>
                </div>`;
        });
        snap.forEach(d => {
            const data = d.data();
            if (data.senderPfp || !data.senderId) return;
            getDoc(doc(db, 'users', data.senderId)).then(async (u) => {
                if (!u.exists() || !u.data().pfp) return;
                const url = await window.resolvePfp(u.data().pfp, data.senderId);
                const el = document.getElementById(`req-pfp-${d.id}`);
                if (el && url) el.src = url;
            }).catch(() => {});
        });
    }));
}
window.acceptRequest = async (rid, sid, sname) => {
    const sDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, "users", sid));
    const sPfpRaw = sDoc.exists() ? (sDoc.data().pfp || "") : "";
    const sPfp = (typeof sPfpRaw === 'string' && sPfpRaw !== '__chunked_gif__' && !(sPfpRaw.startsWith('data:') && sPfpRaw.length > 8000)) ? sPfpRaw : "";
    const myPfpSafe = (typeof myPfp === 'string' && myPfp !== '__chunked_gif__' && !(myPfp.startsWith('data:') && myPfp.length > 8000)) ? myPfp : "";
    await setDoc(doc(db, "chats", [myUID, sid].sort().join('_')), {
        participants: [myUID, sid], names: { [myUID]: myUsername, [sid]: sname },
        pfps: { [myUID]: myPfpSafe, [sid]: sPfp }, isGroup: false, lastActivity: serverTimestamp()
    });
    await deleteDoc(doc(db, "requests", rid));
    if (typeof window.trackQuestAction === 'function') {
        window.trackQuestAction('friendsAdded', 1).catch(() => {});
    }
};
window.rejectRequest = async (rid) => deleteDoc(doc(db, "requests", rid));

const _dmPresenceUnsubs = {};

window._pfpHealInFlight = window._pfpHealInFlight || new Set();
window.healChatPfp = function(chatId, otherId, onResolved) {
    if (!chatId || !otherId) return;
    const key = `${chatId}_${otherId}`;
    if (window._pfpHealInFlight.has(key)) return;
    window._pfpHealInFlight.add(key);
    getDoc(doc(db, 'users', otherId)).then(async (uSnap) => {
        if (!uSnap.exists()) return;
        const live = uSnap.data().pfp || '';
        if (!live) return;
        const resolved = await window.resolvePfp(live, otherId);
        if (typeof onResolved === 'function') onResolved(resolved);
        updateDoc(doc(db, 'chats', chatId), { [`pfps.${otherId}`]: live }).catch(() => {});
    }).catch(() => {}).finally(() => window._pfpHealInFlight.delete(key));
};

function buildDmItem(cid, data, chatName, isMobile) {
    const actualCid = typeof cid === 'string' ? cid : cid?.id;

    if (!data || !Array.isArray(data.participants)) return null;

    const div = document.createElement('div');
    const otherId = data.participants.find(id => id !== myUID);
    let pfpSrc = (data.pfps?.[otherId]) || window._DEFAULT_PFP;
    const isChunked = pfpSrc === '__chunked_gif__';
    if (isChunked) pfpSrc = window._DEFAULT_PFP;
    const presenceDotId = `presence-dot-${actualCid}`;
    const lastSeenId = `last-seen-${actualCid}`;
    const presenceDot = data.isGroup ? '' : `<span id="${presenceDotId}" class="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full flex-shrink-0 border-2 border-[#08080f] bg-[#444455]" style="margin-left:-8px;margin-bottom:-4px;align-self:flex-end;"></span>`;
    const smallPfpHtml = data.isGroup
        ? `<div class="w-9 h-9 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0" style="border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#4f46e5,#7c3aed);color:#fff;font-size:13px;"><i class="fa-solid fa-user-group"></i></div>`
        : `<div class="relative flex-shrink-0" data-other-uid="${otherId}"><img src="${pfpSrc}" data-es-uid="${otherId}" class="live-ring w-9 h-9 rounded-full object-cover bg-[#1e1e2e]" style="border:2px solid transparent;" onerror="this.src=window._DEFAULT_PFP">${presenceDot}</div>`;
    const presenceDotMobile = data.isGroup ? '' : `<span id="${presenceDotId}" class="w-3 h-3 rounded-full flex-shrink-0 border-2 border-[#08080f] bg-[#444455]" style="margin-left:-10px;margin-bottom:-4px;align-self:flex-end;"></span>`;
    const mobilePfpHtml = data.isGroup
        ? `<div class="w-11 h-11 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0" style="border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#4f46e5,#7c3aed);color:#fff;font-size:17px;"><i class="fa-solid fa-user-group"></i></div>`
        : `<div class="relative flex-shrink-0" data-other-uid="${otherId}"><img src="${pfpSrc}" class="live-ring w-11 h-11 rounded-full object-cover bg-[#1e1e2e]" style="border:2px solid transparent;" onerror="this.src=window._DEFAULT_PFP">${presenceDotMobile}</div>`;
    const hasUnread = Array.isArray(data.unreadBy) && data.unreadBy.includes(myUID);
    const badgeHtml = hasUnread ? `<span class="notif-dot w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full flex-shrink-0"></span>` : '';
    const _streakV = !data.isGroup ? getStreakVisual(data.streak?.count) : null;
    const streakHtml = _streakV ? `<span style="font-size:10px;font-weight:800;color:${_streakV.color};flex-shrink:0;white-space:nowrap;${_streakV.glow ? `text-shadow:0 0 5px ${_streakV.color}99;` : ''}">${_streakV.emoji}${data.streak.count}</span>` : '';
    const mobilePreviewId  = `mobile-preview-${actualCid}`;
    const desktopPreviewId = `dm-preview-${actualCid}`;
    let mobilePreviewText;
    if (data.lastMessageDeleted && data.lastMessageText === 'Deleted message') {
        mobilePreviewText = '<i class="fa-solid fa-ban" style="font-size:9px;opacity:.7"></i> <i>Deleted message</i>';
    } else if (data.lastMessageText) {
        const prefix = data.lastMessageSenderId === myUID ? 'You: ' : '';
        mobilePreviewText = window.escHtml(prefix + data.lastMessageText);
    } else {
        mobilePreviewText = data.isGroup ? 'No messages yet' : 'Say hi 👋';
    }
    if (isMobile) {
        div.className = 'dm-item' + (hasUnread ? ' dm-item-unread' : '');
        div.innerHTML = `${mobilePfpHtml}<div class="flex-1 min-w-0"><div class="font-bold ${hasUnread ? 'text-white' : 'text-[#d6d6e8]'} text-[15px] truncate flex items-center gap-1.5">${window.escHtml(chatName)}<span class="live-label" style="display:none;font-size:8px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:0.06em;color:#f87171;text-transform:uppercase;flex-shrink:0;">● LIVE</span>${streakHtml}</div><div id="${mobilePreviewId}" class="text-[12.5px] ${hasUnread ? 'text-[#b4b4cc]' : 'text-[#666677]'} truncate mt-0.5">${mobilePreviewText}</div></div>${badgeHtml}`;
    } else {
        div.className = 'flex items-center gap-2.5 px-2 py-1.5 rounded-lg cursor-pointer transition w-full text-sm text-[#888899] hover:text-white hover:bg-[#14141f] border border-transparent hover:border-[#1e1e2e]';
        div.innerHTML = `${smallPfpHtml}<div class="flex-1 min-w-0"><div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;min-width:0;"><div class="dm-name-fit font-bold ${hasUnread ? 'text-white' : 'text-[#e8e8f0]'}" style="flex:1;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;">${window.escHtml(chatName)}</div><span class="live-label" style="display:none;font-size:8px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:0.06em;color:#f87171;text-transform:uppercase;flex-shrink:0;">● LIVE</span>${streakHtml}${badgeHtml}<span id="${lastSeenId}" class="text-[10px] text-[#555566]" style="flex-shrink:0;white-space:nowrap;"></span></div><div id="${desktopPreviewId}" class="dm-preview ${hasUnread ? 'unread' : ''}">${mobilePreviewText}</div></div>`;
    }
    if (!data.isGroup && otherId && !isChunked && (!data.pfps || !data.pfps[otherId])) {
        window.healChatPfp(actualCid, otherId, (resolved) => {
            const imgEl = div.querySelector(`[data-other-uid="${otherId}"] img`);
            if (imgEl) imgEl.src = resolved;
        });
    }
    div.onclick = () => {
        if (!data.isGroup && otherId) {
            try {
                window.get(window.ref(window.rtdb, `live_streams/${otherId}`)).then(snap => {
                    if (snap.val()?.active) {
                        _showLiveOrProfileChoice(otherId, chatName, data.pfps?.[otherId] || window._DEFAULT_PFP, actualCid, data);
                    } else {
                        closeMobileDmOverlay(); openChat(actualCid, data, chatName);
                    }
                }).catch(() => { closeMobileDmOverlay(); openChat(actualCid, data, chatName); });
            } catch(e) { closeMobileDmOverlay(); openChat(actualCid, data, chatName); }
        } else {
            closeMobileDmOverlay(); openChat(actualCid, data, chatName);
        }
    };

    if (isChunked && otherId) {
        window._whenVisible(div, () => window.loadChunkedGif(otherId).then(gif => {
            const img = div.querySelector('img');
            if (img) img.src = gif;
        }));
    }

    if (!data.isGroup && otherId) {
        const prevUnsub = _dmPresenceUnsubs[actualCid];
        if (typeof prevUnsub === 'function') { try { prevUnsub(); } catch(e){} }

        const unsub = watchPresence(otherId, (isOnline, lastActive) => {
            const dot = document.getElementById(presenceDotId);
            const lsEl = document.getElementById(lastSeenId);
            if (dot) dot.style.background = isOnline ? '#22c55e' : '#444455';
            if (lsEl) {
                if (isOnline) {
                    lsEl.innerText = 'Online';
                    lsEl.style.color = '#22c55e';
                } else if (lastActive && typeof lastActive === 'number') {
                    const d = new Date(lastActive);
                    if (isNaN(d.getTime())) { lsEl.innerText = 'Offline'; lsEl.style.color = '#555566'; return; }
                    const now = new Date();
                    const todayStr = now.toDateString();
                    const timeStr = d.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
                    let label;
                    if (d.toDateString() === todayStr) label = timeStr;
                    else {
                        const yesterday = new Date(now); yesterday.setDate(now.getDate() - 1);
                        label = d.toDateString() === yesterday.toDateString()
                            ? 'Yest'
                            : d.toLocaleDateString([], { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' });
                    }
                    lsEl.innerText = label;
                    lsEl.style.color = '#555566';
                } else {
                    lsEl.innerText = 'Offline';
                    lsEl.style.color = '#555566';
                }
            }
        });
        _dmPresenceUnsubs[actualCid] = unsub;
    }
    return div;
}

window._chatsReady = new Promise(res => { window._resolveChatsReady = res; });

function loadChats() {
    window._friendUIDs = new Set();
    window._fcAutoPopSeen = {};
    window._fcAutoPopReady = false;

    listeners.push(onSnapshot(query(collection(db, "chats"), where("participants", "array-contains", myUID)), (snap) => {
        const list = document.getElementById('dm-list'); list.innerHTML = '';
        if (window._resolveChatsReady) { window._resolveChatsReady(); window._resolveChatsReady = null; }
        window._friendUIDs = new Set();
        if (snap && snap.docs) snap.docs.forEach(d => {
            const data = d.data();
            if (!data.isGroup && Array.isArray(data.participants)) {
                data.participants.forEach(id => { if (id !== myUID) window._friendUIDs.add(id); });
            }
        });
        const mobileList = document.getElementById('mobile-dm-list'); mobileList.innerHTML = '';
        const groupList = document.getElementById('group-friend-list'); groupList.innerHTML = '';
        let totalUnread = 0;
        
        if (snap && snap.docs && snap.docs.length > 0) {
            try {
                localStorage.setItem('app_friends_cache', JSON.stringify(snap.docs.map(d => ({ id: d.id, data: d.data() }))));
            } catch(e) {}
        }

        if (snap && typeof snap.docChanges === 'function' && window.myUID) {
            window._fcAutoPopSeen = window._fcAutoPopSeen || {};
            const firstRun = !window._fcAutoPopReady;
            snap.docChanges().forEach(ch => {
                if (ch.type === 'removed') return;
                const d = ch.doc.data();
                if (!d || d.ephemeralCall) return;
                const cid = ch.doc.id;
                const ts = d.lastActivity?.toMillis ? d.lastActivity.toMillis()
                         : (typeof d.lastActivity === 'number' ? d.lastActivity : 0);
                const prev = window._fcAutoPopSeen[cid] || 0;
                window._fcAutoPopSeen[cid] = Math.max(prev, ts);
                if (firstRun) return;
                if (!ts || ts <= prev) return;
                if (d.lastMessageSenderId === window.myUID) return;
                if (!Array.isArray(d.unreadBy) || !d.unreadBy.includes(window.myUID)) return;
                const chatViewOpen = !!document.getElementById('view-chat')?.classList.contains('active');
                if (chatViewOpen && window.currentChatId === cid) return;
                const fcOpen = !document.getElementById('floating-chat')?.classList.contains('hidden');
                if (fcOpen && window._fcCurrentChatId && window._fcCurrentChatId !== cid) return;
                const otherId = (d.participants || []).find(id => id !== window.myUID);
                const nm = d.isGroup ? (d.groupName || d.name || 'Group') : (d.names?.[otherId] || null);
                if (typeof window.openFloatingChat === 'function') window.openFloatingChat(cid, d, nm);
            });
            window._fcAutoPopReady = true;
        }

        if (typeof window._gcAttachAllGroupListeners === 'function') window._gcAttachAllGroupListeners();

        let cached = null;
        try { cached = localStorage.getItem('app_friends_cache'); } catch(e) {}
        const rawDocs = (snap && snap.docs && snap.docs.length > 0) ? snap.docs : (cached ? JSON.parse(cached) : []);

        const entries = rawDocs.map(d => {
            const data = typeof d.data === 'function' ? d.data() : d.data;
            if (!data || !Array.isArray(data.participants)) return null;
            let ts = 0;
            if (data.lastActivity?.toMillis) ts = data.lastActivity.toMillis();
            else if (typeof data.lastActivity === 'number') ts = data.lastActivity;
            return { id: d.id, data, ts };
        }).filter(Boolean);

        entries.sort((a, b) => {
            const aUnread = Array.isArray(a.data.unreadBy) && a.data.unreadBy.includes(myUID);
            const bUnread = Array.isArray(b.data.unreadBy) && b.data.unreadBy.includes(myUID);
            if (aUnread !== bUnread) return aUnread ? -1 : 1;
            return b.ts - a.ts;
        });

        window._myDmChatsCache = entries.filter(e => !e.data.isGroup);

        try { window._spRender && window._spRender(entries); } catch (e) { console.warn('[spaces] render failed:', e); }

        entries.forEach(({ id: docId, data }) => {
            if (data.ephemeralCall) return;
            if (data.isSpace || data.spaceId) return;
            if (Array.isArray(data.unreadBy) && data.unreadBy.includes(myUID)) totalUnread++;
            const otherId = data.participants.find(id => id !== myUID);
            
            if (!data.names?.[otherId] && cached) {
                try {
                    const localBackup = JSON.parse(cached).find(c => c.id === docId);
                    if (localBackup && localBackup.data) {
                        data.names = localBackup.data.names || {};
                        data.pfps = localBackup.data.pfps || {};
                    }
                } catch(e) {}
            }

            const chatName = data.isGroup ? (data.groupName || 'Group') : (data.names?.[otherId] || 'User');
            
            const desktopItem = buildDmItem(docId, data, chatName, false);
            const mobileItem = buildDmItem(docId, data, chatName, true);
            if (list && desktopItem) list.appendChild(desktopItem);
            if (mobileList && mobileItem) mobileList.appendChild(mobileItem);
            
            if (!data.isGroup && groupList && otherId) {
                const rawPfp = data.pfps?.[otherId] || '';
                const initial = (chatName || 'U').charAt(0).toUpperCase();
                const row = document.createElement('div');
                row.className = 'cg-friend-row';
                row.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="cg-fr-avatar" id="cg-av-${otherId}">${initial}</div>
                    <span class="cg-fr-name">${window.escHtml(chatName)}</span>
                    <div class="cg-fr-check">✓</div>
                    <input type="checkbox" value="${otherId}" class="group-select" data-name="${window.escAttr(chatName)}" data-pfp="">
                `;
                groupList.appendChild(row);
                window.resolvePfp(rawPfp, otherId).then(resolved => {
                    if (!resolved || resolved === window._DEFAULT_PFP) return;
                    const placeholder = row.querySelector('#cg-av-' + otherId);
                    if (placeholder) {
                        const img = document.createElement('img');
                        img.className = 'cg-fr-pfp';
                        img.src = resolved;
                        img.alt = '';
                        placeholder.replaceWith(img);
                    }
                    const cb = row.querySelector('.group-select');
                    if (cb) cb.dataset.pfp = resolved;
                });
                row.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    const cb = row.querySelector('.group-select');
                    window.cgToggleFriend(otherId, chatName, cb.dataset.pfp || '', cb);
                });
            }
        });
        
        unreadCount = totalUnread;
        updateTabTitle();
        window._applyLiveRings && window._applyLiveRings();
        setTimeout(() => window._applyLiveRings && window._applyLiveRings(), 200);
        setTimeout(() => window._applyLiveRings && window._applyLiveRings(), 600);
    }));
}

const _PRIVACY_KEY = 'echo_privacy_mode';
window.setPrivacyMode = function (on) {
    on = !!on;
    document.body.classList.toggle('privacy-mode', on);
    try { localStorage.setItem(_PRIVACY_KEY, on ? '1' : '0'); } catch (e) {}
    const cb = document.getElementById('privacy-mode-toggle');
    if (cb) cb.checked = on;
    const badge = document.getElementById('privacy-mode-badge');
    if (badge) badge.style.display = on ? '' : 'none';
};
window.isPrivacyMode = () => document.body.classList.contains('privacy-mode');
(function _initPrivacyMode() {
    let on = false;
    try { on = localStorage.getItem(_PRIVACY_KEY) === '1'; } catch (e) {}
    const apply = () => window.setPrivacyMode(on);
    if (document.body) apply();
    if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', apply, { once: true });
})();

window.createGroup = async () => {
    const name = document.getElementById('group-name').value.trim();
    const checked = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.group-select:checked'));
    if (!name || checked.length === 0) return alert("Enter a name and select friends.");
    if (!cooldownCheck('create_group', 30000)) {
        return alert("Wait before creating another group.");
    }
    if (!spamGuard('create_group_spam', 5, 3600000)) {
        return alert("You've created too many groups recently.");
    }
    if (!enforceMaxLength(name, 50, 'Group name')) return;
    if (checked.length > 49) return alert("Groups can have at most 50 members.");
    const participants = [myUID, ...checked.map(c => c.value)];
    const names = { [myUID]: myUsername };
    const safePfp = (v) => (typeof v === 'string' && v !== '__chunked_gif__' && !(v.startsWith('data:') && v.length > 8000)) ? v : "";
    const pfps = { [myUID]: safePfp(myPfp) };
    checked.forEach(c => { names[c.value] = c.dataset.name; pfps[c.value] = safePfp(c.dataset.pfp); });
    try {
        await addDoc(collection(db, "chats"), { participants, names, pfps, isGroup: true, groupName: name, owner: myUID, lastActivity: serverTimestamp() });
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('[createGroup] failed:', e);
        return alert("Couldn't create the group: " + ((e && e.message) || e));
    }
    document.getElementById('group-name').value = '';
    const chips = document.getElementById('cg-chips-row');
    if (chips) { chips.innerHTML = ''; chips.style.display = 'none'; }
    const search = document.getElementById('cg-friend-search');
    if (search) search.value = '';
    window.cgUpdateBtn && window.cgUpdateBtn();
    switchView('empty');
};

let editingMsgId = null;

function _embAutoGrow(el) {
    if (!el) return;
    el.style.height = 'auto';
    el.style.height = Math.min(el.scrollHeight, 168) + 'px';
}
function _embSyncSave() {
    const inp = document.getElementById('edit-message-input');
    const btn = document.getElementById('edit-message-save');
    if (!inp || !btn) return;
    const v = inp.value.trim();
    btn.disabled = (!v || v === _editOriginalText.trim());
}
function _embHighlight(msgId, on) {
    try {
        const el = document.querySelector('[data-msg-id="' + msgId + '"]') ||
                   document.getElementById('msg-' + msgId);
        if (el) el.classList.toggle('msg-editing', !!on);
    } catch (_) {}
}

window.startMessageEdit = (msgId, currentText) => {
    editingMsgId = msgId;
    _editOriginalText = currentText || '';
    const bar = document.getElementById('edit-message-bar');
    const inp = document.getElementById('edit-message-input');
    const orig = document.getElementById('edit-message-original');
    if (orig) orig.textContent = _editOriginalText;
    bar.classList.remove('hidden');
    bar.classList.add('on');
    inp.value = _editOriginalText;
    _embAutoGrow(inp);
    _embSyncSave();
    _embHighlight(msgId, true);
    inp.focus();
    try { inp.setSelectionRange(inp.value.length, inp.value.length); } catch (_) {}
};
window.cancelMessageEdit = () => {
    _embHighlight(editingMsgId, false);
    editingMsgId = null;
    _editOriginalText = '';
    const bar = document.getElementById('edit-message-bar');
    bar.classList.remove('on'); bar.classList.add('hidden');
    try { document.getElementById('message-input').focus(); } catch (_) {}
};
window.submitMessageEdit = async () => {
    if (!editingMsgId || !currentChatId) return;
    const newText = document.getElementById('edit-message-input').value.trim();
    if (!newText) return;
    try {
        await updateDoc(doc(db, `chats/${currentChatId}/messages`, editingMsgId), { text: newText, edited: true, editedAt: serverTimestamp() });
    } catch(e) {
        window.reportRuleDenial && window.reportRuleDenial('Chat — edit message', e,
            { path: `chats/${currentChatId}/messages/${editingMsgId}`, op: 'update(text,edited)' });
        console.warn('Edit failed:', e);
    }
    window.cancelMessageEdit();
};
document.getElementById('edit-message-input').addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) { e.preventDefault(); window.submitMessageEdit(); }
    if (e.key === 'Escape') { e.preventDefault(); window.cancelMessageEdit(); }
});
document.getElementById('edit-message-input').addEventListener('input', function () {
    _embAutoGrow(this); _embSyncSave();
});

window.toggleReaction = async (msgId, emoji) => {
    if (!msgId || !currentChatId) return;
    if (window._isTimedOut && window._isTimedOut()) { showCooldownToast('⏳ You are timed out and cannot react right now.'); return; }
    if (currentChatData?.isGroup && !isGroupOwner()) {
        if (!cooldownCheck('reaction', 2000)) {
            showCooldownToast('Slow down!');
            return;
        }
    }
    try {
        const msgRef = doc(db, `chats/${currentChatId}/messages`, msgId);
        const snap = await getDoc(msgRef);
        if (!snap.exists()) return;
        const data = snap.data();
        const reactions = data.reactions || {};
        const users = reactions[emoji] || [];
        let added = false;
        if (users.includes(myUID)) {
            reactions[emoji] = users.filter(u => u !== myUID);
            if (reactions[emoji].length === 0) delete reactions[emoji];
        } else {
            reactions[emoji] = [...users, myUID];
            added = true;
        }
        await updateDoc(msgRef, { reactions });
        if (added && window.EchoSFX) window.EchoSFX.play('pop');
        if (added && typeof window.trackQuestAction === 'function') {
            window.trackQuestAction('reactionsGiven', 1).catch(() => {});
        }
    } catch(e) {
        window.reportRuleDenial && window.reportRuleDenial('Chat — reaction', e,
            { path: `chats/${currentChatId}/messages/${msgId}`, op: 'update(reactions)' });
        console.warn('Reaction failed:', e);
    }
};


window._lastMsgVisible = false;

let _readObserver = null;
function _attachReadObserver(box) {
    if (_readObserver) { _readObserver.disconnect(); _readObserver = null; }
    if (!box) return;
    _readObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
        for (const entry of entries) {
            window._lastMsgVisible = entry.isIntersecting;
            if (entry.isIntersecting && tabIsFocused && currentChatId) {
                markChatRead(currentChatId);
            }
        }
    }, { root: box, threshold: 0.5 });
    const wraps = box.querySelectorAll('.msg-wrap');
    if (wraps.length) _readObserver.observe(wraps[wraps.length - 1]);
}

window._chatLastMsgKey = window._chatLastMsgKey || {};
window._chatLastMsgMine = window._chatLastMsgMine || {};
let _readMarked = {};
try { _readMarked = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('echo_read_marked_' + myUID) || '{}'); } catch (_) {}

function _persistReadMarked() {
    try { localStorage.setItem('echo_read_marked_' + myUID, JSON.stringify(_readMarked)); } catch (_) {}
}

function markChatRead(cid, msgKey) {
    if (!cid || !myUID) return;
    if (!tabIsFocused) return;
    if (!window._lastMsgVisible) return;

    const key = msgKey || window._chatLastMsgKey[cid];
    if (!key) return;
    if (_readMarked[cid] === key) return;

    _readMarked[cid] = key;
    _persistReadMarked();

    if (window._chatLastMsgMine[cid]) return;

    updateDoc(doc(db, "chats", cid), { [`readBy.${myUID}`]: serverTimestamp() }).catch(()=>{});
    set(ref(rtdb, `seen_by/${myUID}/${cid}`), { seenAt: Date.now(), tabActive: true }).catch(()=>{});
}

function _onTabFocusReadCheck() {
    if (tabIsFocused && window._lastMsgVisible && currentChatId) {
        markChatRead(currentChatId);
    }
}

window.openProfilePage = async (uid) => {
    if (window.GUEST_MODE) { window._guestOpenProfile(); return; }
    if (!uid) return;
    const profilePage = document.getElementById('profile-page');
    const dashboard = document.getElementById('dashboard');

    profilePage.style.display = 'flex';
    profilePage.classList.add('open');
    if (dashboard) dashboard.classList.add('hidden');

    const _isOwner = window._myRole === 'owner' || window.isAdmin === true;
    const _debugBar  = document.getElementById('profile-debug-bar');
    const _debugDot  = document.getElementById('profile-debug-dot');
    const _debugText = document.getElementById('profile-debug-text');
    function _dbShow(msg, state) {
        if (!_isOwner || !_debugBar) return;
        _debugBar.style.display = 'flex';
        _debugText.textContent = msg;
        const colors = { loading: '#818cf8', ok: '#22c55e', warn: '#fbbf24', error: '#f87171' };

        if (_debugBar) _debugBar.style.display = 'none';
    }

            return;
        }

        const uData = uSnap.data();

        const _fx = uData.profileEffects || {};
        const _fxKeys = Object.keys(_fx);
        if (_isOwner && uData.ownerAccount) {
            if (_fxKeys.length === 0) {
                _dbShow(`⚠️ profileEffects is EMPTY in Firestore — effects not saved yet. Go to Customize Profile → Effects → Save Changes.`, 'warn');
            } else {
            }

                    onlineDot.classList.add('visible');

                                : d.toDateString() === yesterday.toDateString()

        } else if (myUID === uid) {
            actionsEl.innerHTML = `<button class="btn-primary text-sm" onclick="openPCM()"><i class="fa-solid fa-pen"></i> Customize Profile</button>
                <button class="btn-ghost text-sm" onclick="window._toggleMyQuestList()"><i class="fa-solid fa-compass"></i> Quests</button>`;

            if (uData.ownerAccount && window._startProfilePageUsernameTW) {
                window._startProfilePageUsernameTW(uData.username || '');
            }
        } catch(e) {
            _dbShow(`❌ USERNAME TYPEWRITER ERROR — ${e.message}`, 'error');
        }

        try {
            document.getElementById('profile-page-badge-verified').classList.toggle('hidden', !uData.verifiedBadge);
            document.getElementById('profile-page-badge-owner').classList.toggle('hidden', !uData.ownerAccount);

window.closeProfilePage = () => {
    const profilePage = document.getElementById('profile-page');
    const dashboard = document.getElementById('dashboard');
    profilePage.classList.remove('open');
    profilePage.style.display = '';
    if (dashboard) dashboard.classList.remove('hidden');
    if (window._stopProfilePageTitleTW) window._stopProfilePageTitleTW();
    if (window._stopProfilePageUsernameTW) window._stopProfilePageUsernameTW();
    if (window._stopOwnerElectricAura) window._stopOwnerElectricAura();
    document.title = 'EchoSpace';
    try { window.EchoShards && window.EchoShards.clearProfile(); } catch (_) {}
    try { window.EchoShards && window.EchoShards.endTryOn(true); } catch (_) {}
    const _debugBarEl = document.getElementById('profile-debug-bar');
    if (_debugBarEl) _debugBarEl.style.display = 'none';
    window._applyProfileStars && window._applyProfileStars(false);
    const _audio = document.getElementById('profile-music-audio');
    if (_audio) { _audio.pause(); _audio.src = ''; }
    _stopVisualizer();
    const _bar = document.getElementById('profile-music-bar');
    if (_bar) _bar.classList.remove('visible');
    const _btn = document.getElementById('profile-music-toggle');
    if (_btn) {
        const _pi = document.getElementById('pm-icon-play');
        const _pp = document.getElementById('pm-icon-pause');
        if (_pi) _pi.style.display = '';
        if (_pp) _pp.style.display = 'none';
    }
    const _art = document.getElementById('profile-music-art');
    if (_art) _art.classList.remove('spinning');
    const _prog = document.getElementById('profile-music-progress-wrap');
    if (_prog) _prog.classList.remove('active');
    if (window._musicCache) window._musicCache = {};
    if (_profilePageUnsub) { try { _profilePageUnsub(); } catch(e){} _profilePageUnsub = null; }
};

window.copyProfileUrl = (ev) => {
     
    const handle = (document.getElementById('profile-page-handle')?.innerText || '').replace(/^@/, '').trim();
    const url = handle
        ? location.origin + location.pathname + '?profile=' + encodeURIComponent(handle)
        : location.href;
    const btn = ev?.currentTarget || document.querySelector('.pv-copy-btn') || document.querySelector('.profile-url-copy');
    const done = (ok) => {
        if (!btn) return;
        const was = btn.innerHTML;
        btn.innerHTML = ok ? '✓ Copied' : 'Press Ctrl+C';
        setTimeout(() => { btn.innerHTML = was; }, 2000);
    };
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(url).then(() => done(true)).catch(() => done(false));
};

async function _autoOpenProfile(slug) {
    window.open(`?profile=${encodeURIComponent(slug)}`, '_blank');
}

async function checkIsFollowing(targetUid) {
    if (!myUID) return false;
    try {
        const snap = await getDoc(doc(db, "follows", `${myUID}_${targetUid}`));
        return snap.exists();
    } catch(e) { return false; }
}

window.toggleFollow = async (targetUid, btn) => {
    if (!window.myUID) return;
    const isNowFollowing = btn.classList.contains('following');
    btn.disabled = true;
    try {
        const followDocId = `${myUID}_${targetUid}`;
        const targetRef = doc(db, "users", targetUid);
        const myRef = doc(db, "users", myUID);
        if (isNowFollowing) {
            await deleteDoc(doc(db, "follows", followDocId));
            const tSnap = await getDoc(targetRef);
            if (tSnap.exists()) {
                const cur = tSnap.data().followersCount || 1;
                await updateDoc(targetRef, { followersCount: Math.max(0, cur - 1) });
            }
            const mSnap = await getDoc(myRef);
            if (mSnap.exists()) {
                const cur = mSnap.data().followingCount || 1;
                await updateDoc(myRef, { followingCount: Math.max(0, cur - 1) });
            }
            btn.innerText = 'Follow'; btn.classList.remove('following');
        } else {
            await setDoc(doc(db, "follows", followDocId), { followerId: myUID, followingId: targetUid, createdAt: serverTimestamp() });
            const tSnap = await getDoc(targetRef);
            if (tSnap.exists()) {
                const cur = tSnap.data().followersCount || 0;
                await updateDoc(targetRef, { followersCount: cur + 1 });
            }
            const mSnap = await getDoc(myRef);
            if (mSnap.exists()) {
                const cur = mSnap.data().followingCount || 0;
                await updateDoc(myRef, { followingCount: cur + 1 });
            }
            btn.innerText = 'Following ✓'; btn.classList.add('following');
        }
    } catch(e) { alert('Error: ' + e.message); }
    btn.disabled = false;
};

async function startDmWith(uid, name, pfp) {
    if (!window.myUID) return;
    const cid = [myUID, uid].sort().join('_');
    const chatData = {
        participants: [myUID, uid],
        names: { [myUID]: myUsername, [uid]: name },
        pfps: { [myUID]: myPfp, [uid]: pfp },
        isGroup: false, lastActivity: serverTimestamp()
    };
    await setDoc(doc(db, "chats", cid), chatData, { merge: true });
    openChat(cid, chatData, name);
}

let blockTargetId = null, blockTargetName = '';
window.confirmBlockUser = () => {
    if (!currentChatData || currentChatData.isGroup) return;
    blockTargetId = currentChatData.participants.find(id => id !== myUID);
    blockTargetName = currentChatData.names?.[blockTargetId] || 'this user';
    document.getElementById('block-confirm-text').innerText = `Block "${blockTargetName}"? They won't be able to send you messages.`;
    document.getElementById('block-confirm-modal').classList.add('open');
};
window.closeBlockModal = () => document.getElementById('block-confirm-modal').classList.remove('open');
window.executeBlockUser = async () => {
    if (!blockTargetId) return;
    try {
        const blockedList = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(`blocked_${myUID}`) || '[]');
        if (!blockedList.includes(blockTargetId)) blockedList.push(blockTargetId);
        localStorage.setItem(`blocked_${myUID}`, JSON.stringify(blockedList));
        await updateDoc(doc(db, "users", myUID), { blockedUsers: blockedList });
        window.closeBlockModal();
        renderBlockedUsersList();
        alert(`"${blockTargetName}" has been blocked.`);
    } catch(e) { alert('Error blocking: ' + e.message); }
};
window.unblockUser = async (uid, name) => {
    if (!confirm(`Unblock "${name}"?`)) return;
    const blockedList = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(`blocked_${myUID}`) || '[]');
    const updated = blockedList.filter(u => u !== uid);
    localStorage.setItem(`blocked_${myUID}`, JSON.stringify(updated));
    try { await updateDoc(doc(db, "users", myUID), { blockedUsers: updated }); } catch(e){}
    renderBlockedUsersList();
};
async function renderBlockedUsersList() {
    const box = document.getElementById('blocked-users-list');
    if (!box) return;
    const blockedList = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(`blocked_${myUID}`) || '[]');
    if (blockedList.length === 0) { box.innerHTML = '<p class="text-xs text-[#333345]">No blocked users.</p>'; return; }
    box.innerHTML = '';
    for (const uid of blockedList) {
        try {
            const snap = await getDoc(doc(db, "users", uid));
            const name = snap.exists() ? snap.data().username : uid.substring(0, 8);
            box.innerHTML += `<div class="flex justify-between items-center p-3 bg-[#0a0a15] border border-[#1e1e2e] text-sm" style="border-radius:14px;"><span class="font-bold text-white">${window.escHtml(name)}</span><button onclick="unblockUser('${uid}','${window.escAttr(name)}')" class="text-xs text-green-400 hover:text-green-300 font-bold">Unblock</button></div>`;
        } catch(e) {}
    }
}

window.updateCustomStatus = async () => {
    const status = document.getElementById('status-input').value.trim();
    const msg = document.getElementById('status-msg');
    if (!status) return;
    if (!enforceMaxLength(status, 80, 'Status')) return;
    if (!cooldownCheck('update_status', 10000)) {
        msg.innerText = 'Wait before updating your status again.';
        msg.className = 'text-yellow-500 text-xs font-bold';
        msg.classList.remove('hidden');
        return;
    }
    try {
        await updateDoc(doc(db, "users", myUID), { customStatus: status });
        msg.innerText = 'Status updated!'; msg.className = 'text-green-500 text-xs font-bold'; msg.classList.remove('hidden');
        setTimeout(() => msg.classList.add('hidden'), 3000);
    } catch(e) { msg.innerText = 'Error: ' + e.message; msg.className = 'text-red-500 text-xs font-bold'; msg.classList.remove('hidden'); }
};
window.clearCustomStatus = async () => {
    const msg = document.getElementById('status-msg');
    try {
        await updateDoc(doc(db, "users", myUID), { customStatus: '' });
        document.getElementById('status-input').value = '';
        msg.innerText = 'Status cleared.'; msg.className = 'text-[#888899] text-xs font-bold'; msg.classList.remove('hidden');
        setTimeout(() => msg.classList.add('hidden'), 3000);
    } catch(e) {}
};

let cachedMessages = [];
window.openChatSearch = () => {
    document.getElementById('search-overlay').classList.add('open');
    window.runChatSearch('');
    document.getElementById('chat-search-input').focus();
};
document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.key !== 'Escape') return;
    const ov = document.getElementById('search-overlay');
    if (ov && ov.classList.contains('open')) { e.stopPropagation(); window.closeChatSearch(); }
}, true);
window.closeChatSearch = () => { document.getElementById('search-overlay').classList.remove('open'); document.getElementById('chat-search-input').value = ''; document.getElementById('chat-search-results').innerHTML = ''; };
window.runChatSearch = (query) => {
    const res = document.getElementById('chat-search-results');
    if (!query.trim()) {
        res.innerHTML = '<div class="search-empty"><i class="fa-solid fa-magnifying-glass"></i>' +
            'Search this conversation</div>';
        return;
    }
    const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    const hits = cachedMessages.filter(m => m.text && m.text.toLowerCase().includes(q));
    if (hits.length === 0) {
        res.innerHTML = '<div class="search-empty"><i class="fa-regular fa-face-frown"></i>' +
            'No messages found</div>';
        return;
    }
    res.innerHTML = hits.slice(0, 50).map(m => {
        const sname = currentChatData?.names?.[m.uid] || 'User';
        const timeStr = m.timestamp?.toDate ? m.timestamp.toDate().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }) : '';
        const highlighted = window.escHtml(m.text).replace(new RegExp(window.escHtml(q), 'gi'), match => `<span class="search-highlight">${match}</span>`);
        return `<div class="search-result-item" onclick="jumpToMessage('${m.id}'); closeChatSearch();">
            <div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
                <span class="text-xs font-bold text-indigo-400">${window.escHtml(sname)}</span>
                <span class="text-[10px] text-[#333345]">${timeStr}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="text-sm text-[#aaa]">${highlighted}</div>
        </div>`;
    }).join('');
};
window.jumpToMessage = (msgId) => {
    const el = document.getElementById(`msg-${msgId}`);
    if (el) { el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' }); el.style.background = 'rgba(99,102,241,0.15)'; setTimeout(() => { el.style.background = ''; }, 1500); }
};

window.openGroupManagement = async () => {
