function renderTransferOwnershipList() {
    const box = document.getElementById('transfer-ownership-list');
    const emptyEl = document.getElementById('transfer-ownership-empty');
    if (!box || !currentChatData) return;
    box.innerHTML = '';
    if (currentChatData.owner !== myUID) {
        box.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:12px;color:#444455;padding:6px 0;">Only the group owner can transfer ownership.</div>';
        if (emptyEl) emptyEl.classList.add('hidden');
        return;
    }
    const others = currentChatData.participants.filter(u => u !== myUID);
    if (others.length === 0) {
        if (emptyEl) emptyEl.classList.remove('hidden');
        return;
    }
    if (emptyEl) emptyEl.classList.add('hidden');
    others.forEach(uid => {
        const name = currentChatData.names?.[uid] || 'User';
        const pfp = currentChatData.pfps?.[uid] || window._DEFAULT_PFP || '';
        const row = document.createElement('div');
        row.style.cssText = 'display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:10px 12px;background:#0a0a15;border:1px solid #1e1e2e;border-radius:12px;';
        row.innerHTML = `
            <img src="${window.escHtml(pfp)}" style="width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;background:#1e1e2e;" onerror="this.src=window._DEFAULT_PFP">
            <span style="flex:1;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:#e8e8f0;">${window.escHtml(name)}</span>
            <button onclick="transferGroupOwnership('${uid}','${window.escAttr(name)}')" style="font-size:11px;font-weight:700;padding:5px 12px;border-radius:8px;background:rgba(251,191,36,0.15);color:#fbbf24;border:1px solid rgba(251,191,36,0.3);cursor:pointer;transition:all 0.12s;" onmouseover="this.style.background='rgba(251,191,36,0.25)'" onmouseout="this.style.background='rgba(251,191,36,0.15)'"><i class="fa-solid fa-crown"></i> Transfer</button>
        `;
        box.appendChild(row);
    });
}
async function renderGroupMembers() {
    const box = document.getElementById('group-members-list');
    if (!box || !currentChatData) return;
    box.innerHTML = '';
    const isOwner = currentChatData.owner === myUID;
    for (const uid of currentChatData.participants) {
        const name = currentChatData.names?.[uid] || 'User';
        const pfp = currentChatData.pfps?.[uid] || window._DEFAULT_PFP;
        const ownerTag = uid === currentChatData.owner ? '<span class="text-[9px] bg-yellow-500/20 text-yellow-400 px-1.5 rounded ml-1 font-bold uppercase">Owner</span>' : '';
        const kickBtn = (isOwner && uid !== myUID) ? `<button onclick="kickMember('${uid}','${window.escAttr(name)}')" class="text-xs text-red-400 hover:text-red-300 font-bold transition ml-2">Kick</button>` : '';
        box.innerHTML += `<div class="flex items-center gap-3 p-3 bg-[#0a0a15] border border-[#1e1e2e] rounded-xl">
            <img src="${pfp}" class="w-8 h-8 rounded-full object-cover bg-[#1e1e2e]">
            <div class="flex-1 flex items-center gap-1"><span class="font-bold text-white text-sm">${window.escHtml(name)}</span>${ownerTag}</div>
            ${kickBtn}
        </div>`;
    }
}
window.kickMember = async (uid, name) => {
    if (!cooldownCheck('kick', 3000)) { showCooldownToast('Wait a moment before kicking again.'); return; }
    if (!confirm(`Kick "${name}" from the group?`)) return;
    try {
        const newParticipants = currentChatData.participants.filter(u => u !== uid);
        const newNames = { ...currentChatData.names }; delete newNames[uid];
        const newPfps = { ...currentChatData.pfps }; delete newPfps[uid];
        await updateDoc(doc(db, "chats", currentChatId), { participants: newParticipants, names: newNames, pfps: newPfps });
        await addDoc(collection(db, `chats/${currentChatId}/messages`), { type: 'system', text: `${name} was removed from the group.`, uid: 'system', timestamp: serverTimestamp() });
        currentChatData = { ...currentChatData, participants: newParticipants, names: newNames, pfps: newPfps };
        renderGroupMembers();
    } catch(e) { alert('Error: ' + e.message); }
};
window.deleteGroup = async () => {
    if (!currentChatId || !currentChatData?.isGroup) return;
    if (currentChatData.owner !== myUID) return alert("Only the group owner can delete this group.");
    if (!confirm(`Delete "${currentChatData.groupName || 'this group'}"? All messages will be permanently lost.`)) return;
    try {
        const msgSnap = await getDocs(collection(db, `chats/${currentChatId}/messages`));
        const batch = writeBatch(db);
        msgSnap.forEach(d => batch.delete(d.ref));
        await batch.commit();
        await deleteDoc(doc(db, "chats", currentChatId));
        currentChatId = null;
        currentChatData = null;
        window._allowSwitchEmpty = true; switchView('empty');
    } catch(e) {
        alert('Failed to delete group: ' + e.message);
    }
};


function renderInviteFriendsList() {
    const listEl = document.getElementById('invite-friends-list');
    const emptyEl = document.getElementById('invite-friends-empty');
    if (!listEl || !currentChatData) return;
    listEl.innerHTML = '';

    let allChats = [];
    try {
        const cached = localStorage.getItem('app_friends_cache');
        if (cached) allChats = JSON.parse(cached);
    } catch(_) {}

    const alreadyIn = new Set(currentChatData.participants || []);
    const friends = [];

    allChats.forEach(c => {
        const data = typeof c.data === 'function' ? c.data() : c.data;
        if (!data || data.isGroup) return;
        const otherId = (data.participants || []).find(id => id !== myUID);
        if (!otherId || alreadyIn.has(otherId)) return;
        friends.push({ chatId: c.id, uid: otherId, name: data.names?.[otherId] || 'User', pfp: data.pfps?.[otherId] || '' });
    });

    if (friends.length === 0) {
        emptyEl && emptyEl.classList.remove('hidden');
        return;
    }
    emptyEl && emptyEl.classList.add('hidden');

    friends.forEach(f => {
        const row = document.createElement('div');
        row.style.cssText = 'display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:10px;background:#0f0f1a;border:1px solid #1e1e2e;border-radius:10px;';
        row.innerHTML = `
            <img src="${f.pfp || window._DEFAULT_PFP}" onerror="this.src=window._DEFAULT_PFP" style="width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;background:#1e1e2e;flex-shrink:0;">
            <div style="flex:1;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;color:#e8e8f0;">${window.escHtml(f.name)}</div>
            <button class="invite-send-btn" style="background:linear-gradient(135deg,#4f46e5,#6366f1);color:#fff;border:none;padding:7px 16px;border-radius:8px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;">Invite</button>`;
        row.querySelector('.invite-send-btn').onclick = async (e) => {
            const btn = e.target;
            btn.disabled = true; btn.innerText = 'Adding...';
            try {
                const chatSnap = await getDoc(doc(db, "chats", currentChatId));
                if (!chatSnap.exists()) { btn.innerText = 'Error'; return; }
                const chatData = chatSnap.data();
                if (chatData.participants?.includes(f.uid)) { btn.innerText = 'Already in'; return; }
                await updateDoc(doc(db, "chats", currentChatId), {
                    participants: [...(chatData.participants || []), f.uid],
                    [`names.${f.uid}`]: f.name,
                    [`pfps.${f.uid}`]: f.pfp || ''
                });
                await addDoc(collection(db, `chats/${currentChatId}/messages`), {
                    type: 'system', text: `${f.name} was added to the group.`,
                    uid: 'system', timestamp: serverTimestamp()
                });
                btn.innerText = 'Added ✓';
                btn.style.background = '#22c55e';
                currentChatData = (await getDoc(doc(db, "chats", currentChatId))).data();
            } catch(e) { btn.disabled = false; btn.innerText = 'Invite'; alert('Error: ' + e.message); }
        };
        listEl.appendChild(row);
    });
}

async function sendGroupInviteDM(dmChatId, friendUID, friendName) {
    try {
        let token = currentChatData.inviteToken;
        if (!token) {
            token = Math.random().toString(36).slice(2) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2);
            await updateDoc(doc(db, "chats", currentChatId), { inviteToken: token });
            currentChatData = { ...currentChatData, inviteToken: token };
        }
        await addDoc(collection(db, `chats/${dmChatId}/messages`), {
            type: 'group_invite',
            uid: window.myUID,
            timestamp: serverTimestamp(),
            groupId:    currentChatId,
            groupName:  currentChatData.groupName || 'Group',
            memberCount: (currentChatData.participants || []).length,
            inviteToken: token,
            senderName: myUsername,
            targetUID:  friendUID
        });
    } catch(e) {
        alert('Failed to send invite: ' + e.message);
    }
}

window.acceptGroupInvite = async (groupId, inviteToken, msgId, dmChatId) => {
    try {
        const chatSnap = await getDoc(doc(db, "chats", groupId));
        if (chatSnap.exists() && chatSnap.data().participants?.includes(myUID)) {
            openChat(groupId, chatSnap.data(), chatSnap.data().groupName || 'Group');
            return;
        }
        await addDoc(collection(db, `chats/${dmChatId}/messages`), {
            type: 'group_accept',
            uid: window.myUID,
            timestamp: serverTimestamp(),
            groupId: groupId,
            inviteToken: inviteToken,
            username: myUsername,
            pfp: myPfp || '',
            dmChatId: dmChatId,
            inviteMsgId: msgId
        });
        await updateDoc(doc(db, `chats/${dmChatId}/messages`, msgId), { accepted: true })
            .catch(e => window.reportRuleDenial && window.reportRuleDenial('Invite — accept', e,
                { path: `chats/${dmChatId}/messages/${msgId}`, op: 'update(accepted)' }));
        const groupName = chatSnap.exists() ? (chatSnap.data().groupName || 'Group') : 'Group';
        alert('Request sent! You will be added to ' + groupName + ' shortly.');
    } catch(e) {
        alert('Could not send acceptance: ' + e.message);
    }
};

window.declineGroupInvite = async (msgId, dmChatId) => {
    await updateDoc(doc(db, `chats/${dmChatId}/messages`, msgId), { declined: true })
        .catch(e => window.reportRuleDenial && window.reportRuleDenial('Invite — decline', e,
            { path: `chats/${dmChatId}/messages/${msgId}`, op: 'update(declined)' }));
};

async function generateGroupInviteLink(regen = false) {
    const linkEl = document.getElementById('group-invite-link-text');
    if (!linkEl || !currentChatId) return;
    linkEl.innerText = 'Generating...';

    try {
        let token;
        if (!regen) {
            const snap = await getDoc(doc(db, "chats", currentChatId));
            token = snap.exists() ? snap.data().inviteToken : null;
        }
        if (!token || regen) {
            token = Math.random().toString(36).slice(2) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2);
            await updateDoc(doc(db, "chats", currentChatId), { inviteToken: token });
        }
        const base = window.location.origin + window.location.pathname;
        const link = `${base}?join=${currentChatId}&t=${token}`;
        linkEl.innerText = link;
        linkEl.dataset.link = link;

        renderGroupQrCode(link);
    } catch(e) {
        linkEl.innerText = 'Error generating link';
        console.warn('generateGroupInviteLink failed:', e);
    }
}
window.copyInviteLink = () => {
    const linkEl = document.getElementById('group-invite-link-text');
    if (!linkEl) return;
    const link = linkEl.dataset.link || linkEl.innerText;
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(link).then(() => {
        const btn = document.querySelector('[onclick="copyInviteLink()"]');
        if (btn) { const prev = btn.innerText; btn.innerText = 'Copied!'; setTimeout(() => btn.innerText = prev, 2000); }
    }).catch(() => alert(link));
};
window.regenerateInviteLink = async () => {
    const btn = document.querySelector('[onclick="regenerateInviteLink()"]');
    if (btn) { btn.disabled = true; btn.innerText = 'Regenerating...'; }
    await generateGroupInviteLink(true);
    if (btn) { btn.disabled = false; btn.innerText = '↻ Regenerate Link'; }
};

async function renderGroupQrCode(link) {
    const container = document.getElementById('group-qr-code');
    if (!container) return;
    container.innerHTML = '';
    try { await window._lazyLib('qrcode'); }
    catch (_) { container.innerText = 'QR library not loaded'; return; }
    new QRCode(container, {
        text: link,
        width: 180,
        height: 180,
        colorDark: '#000000',
        colorLight: '#ffffff',
        correctLevel: QRCode.CorrectLevel.M
    });
}
window.downloadQrCode = () => {
    const canvas = document.querySelector('#group-qr-code canvas');
    const img = document.querySelector('#group-qr-code img');
    let src = '';
    if (canvas) { src = canvas.toDataURL('image/png'); }
    else if (img) { src = img.src; }
    if (!src) { alert('QR code not ready yet.'); return; }
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = src;
    a.download = 'echospace-invite-qr.png';
    a.click();
};


async function checkInviteLink() {
    if (!window.myUID) return;

    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    let joinChatId = params.get('join') || sessionStorage.getItem('pending_join');
    let joinToken  = params.get('t')    || sessionStorage.getItem('pending_join_token');
    if (!joinToken && sessionStorage.getItem('pending_join_token'))
        joinToken = sessionStorage.getItem('pending_join_token');

    if (params.get('join')) {
        sessionStorage.setItem('pending_join', params.get('join'));
        if (params.get('t')) sessionStorage.setItem('pending_join_token', params.get('t'));
    }
    if (!joinChatId) return;

    window.history.replaceState({}, '', window.location.pathname);
    sessionStorage.removeItem('pending_join');
    sessionStorage.removeItem('pending_join_token');

    try {
        const chatSnap = await getDoc(doc(db, "chats", joinChatId));
        if (!chatSnap.exists()) {
            showInviteError('This invite link is invalid or the group no longer exists.', 'INVALID_LINK'); return;
        }
        const data = chatSnap.data();
        if (!data.isGroup) {
            showInviteError('This invite link is not for a group.', 'NOT_A_GROUP'); return;
        }
        if (data.inviteToken && joinToken && data.inviteToken !== joinToken) {
            showInviteError('This invite link has expired. Ask the group owner to share a new one.', 'TOKEN_EXPIRED'); return;
        }

        if (data.participants && data.participants.includes(myUID)) {
            setTimeout(() => openChat(joinChatId, data, data.groupName || 'Group'), 500);
            return;
        }

        let joinedDirectly = false;
        try {
            await updateDoc(doc(db, "chats", joinChatId), {
                participants: [...(data.participants || []), myUID],
                [`names.${myUID}`]: myUsername,
                [`pfps.${myUID}`]: myPfp
            });
            await addDoc(collection(db, `chats/${joinChatId}/messages`), {
                type: 'system', text: `${myUsername} joined via invite link.`,
                uid: 'system', timestamp: serverTimestamp()
            });
            joinedDirectly = true;
        } catch (writeErr) {
            if (writeErr.code !== 'permission-denied') throw writeErr;
        }

        if (joinedDirectly) {
            const freshSnap = await getDoc(doc(db, "chats", joinChatId));
            const freshData = freshSnap.exists() ? freshSnap.data()
                : { ...data, participants: [...(data.participants||[]), myUID],
                    names: { ...data.names, [myUID]: myUsername },
                    pfps:  { ...data.pfps,  [myUID]: myPfp } };
            showJoinSuccessScreen(data.groupName || 'Group', joinChatId, freshData);
            return;
        }

        const reqId = `${joinChatId}_${myUID}`;
        try {
            await setDoc(doc(db, "joinRequests", reqId), {
                chatId:    joinChatId,
                uid:       myUID,
                username:  myUsername,
                pfp:       myPfp,
                token:     joinToken || '',
                groupName: data.groupName || 'Group',
                owner:     data.owner || '',
                status:    'pending',
                createdAt: serverTimestamp()
            });
        } catch (reqErr) {
            showInviteError(
                'Your Firestore rules are blocking this join. Please add the joinRequests rule shown below to your Firebase console, then try again.',
                'RULES_NOT_SET',
                'Add to Firestore Rules:\n\nmatch /joinRequests/{id} {\n  allow read, write: if request.auth != null;\n}\n\nmatch /chats/{chatId} {\n  // Also allow write if a valid joinRequests doc exists for this user\n  allow update: if request.auth != null\n    && request.auth.uid in resource.data.participants == false\n    && exists(/databases/$(database)/documents/joinRequests/$(chatId + "_" + request.auth.uid));\n}'
            );
            return;
        }

        showJoinPendingScreen(data.groupName || 'Group', joinChatId, reqId);

    } catch(e) {
        console.warn('Invite join failed:', e);
        let userMsg = 'Something went wrong joining the group.';
        let code = 'UNKNOWN';
        if (e.code === 'unavailable' || e.message?.includes('network')) {
            userMsg = 'Network error — check your connection and try again.';
            code = 'NETWORK_ERROR';
        } else if (e.code === 'not-found') {
            userMsg = 'The group could not be found. The invite link may be outdated.';
            code = 'NOT_FOUND';
        }
        showInviteError(userMsg, code, e.message);
    }
}

function showJoinPendingScreen(groupName, chatId, reqId) {
    const overlay = document.createElement('div');
    overlay.id = 'invite-pending-overlay';
    overlay.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;inset:0;background:#000;z-index:9999;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:"DM Sans",sans-serif;animation:joinFadeIn 0.4s ease;';
    overlay.innerHTML = `
        <style>@keyframes joinFadeIn{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:1}}@keyframes joinFadeOut{from{opacity:1}to{opacity:0}}@keyframes spin{100%{transform:rotate(360deg)}}</style>
        <div style="text-align:center;padding:32px;max-width:400px;">
            <div style="font-size:52px;margin-bottom:16px;">⏳</div>
            <h1 style="color:#fff;font-size:20px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:10px;">Waiting for owner…</h1>
            <p style="color:#555566;font-size:13px;line-height:1.7;margin-bottom:6px;">
                Your request to join <span style="color:#818cf8;font-weight:700;">${window.escHtml(groupName)}</span> has been sent.<br>
                The group owner needs to be online to accept it.
            </p>
            <div id="join-pending-status" style="font-size:11px;color:#333345;margin-top:8px;font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;">Checking… (<span id="join-pending-secs">15</span>s)</div>
            <div style="margin-top:24px;display:flex;gap:10px;justify-content:center;">
                <button id="join-pending-cancel" style="background:#1e1e2e;color:#888899;border:1px solid #2a2a3a;padding:8px 20px;border-radius:10px;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;">Cancel</button>
            </div>
        </div>`;
    document.body.appendChild(overlay);

    let secs = 15;
    const secsEl = overlay.querySelector('#join-pending-secs');
    const statusEl = overlay.querySelector('#join-pending-status');
    let settled = false;

    const reqRef = doc(db, "joinRequests", reqId);
    const finish = () => {
        if (settled) return true;
        settled = true;
        clearInterval(tickTimer);
        if (unsubReq) { try { unsubReq(); } catch (_) {} }
        return false;
    };

    const unsubReq = onSnapshot(reqRef, async (snap) => {
        if (settled) return;
        if (snap.exists()) {
            if (snap.data().status === 'rejected') {
                if (finish()) return;
                fadeRemoveOverlay(overlay);
                showInviteError(`That invite link is no longer valid for "${groupName}". Ask for a fresh one.`, 'INVITE_EXPIRED');
            }
            return;
        }
        if (finish()) return;
        fadeRemoveOverlay(overlay);
        try {
            const chatSnap = await getDoc(doc(db, "chats", chatId));
            showJoinSuccessScreen(groupName, chatId, chatSnap.exists() ? chatSnap.data() : {});
        } catch (_) {
            showJoinSuccessScreen(groupName, chatId, {});
        }
    }, () => {   });

    overlay.querySelector('#join-pending-cancel').onclick = () => {
        finish();
        deleteDoc(reqRef).catch(() => {});
        fadeRemoveOverlay(overlay);
    };

    const tickTimer = setInterval(() => {
        secs--;
        if (secsEl) secsEl.innerText = secs;
        if (secs > 0) return;
        if (finish()) return;
        if (statusEl) statusEl.innerText = 'Timed out. The owner may be offline.';
        fadeRemoveOverlay(overlay);
        showInviteError(
            `Your join request was sent but the owner of "${groupName}" isn't online right now. Ask them to open EchoSpace — your request will process automatically when they do.`,
            'OWNER_OFFLINE'
        );
    }, 1000);
}

function listenForJoinRequests() {
    if (!window.myUID) return;
    const q = query(
        collection(db, "joinRequests"),
        where("owner", "==", myUID),
        where("status", "==", "pending")
    );
    const unsub = onSnapshot(q, async (snap) => {
        for (const change of snap.docChanges()) {
            if (change.type !== 'added') continue;
            const req = change.doc.data();
            const reqDocRef = doc(db, "joinRequests", change.doc.id);

            try {
                await updateDoc(reqDocRef, { status: 'processing' });
            } catch (_) { continue; }

            try {
                const chatSnap = await getDoc(doc(db, "chats", req.chatId));
                if (!chatSnap.exists()) { await deleteDoc(reqDocRef); continue; }
                const chatData = chatSnap.data();

                if (chatData.inviteToken && req.token && chatData.inviteToken !== req.token) {
                    await updateDoc(reqDocRef, { status: 'rejected', reason: 'token_expired' });
                    continue;
                }
                if (chatData.participants?.includes(req.uid)) {
                    await deleteDoc(reqDocRef); continue;
                }

                await updateDoc(doc(db, "chats", req.chatId), {
                    participants: [...(chatData.participants || []), req.uid],
                    [`names.${req.uid}`]: req.username,
                    [`pfps.${req.uid}`]:  req.pfp
                });
                await addDoc(collection(db, `chats/${req.chatId}/messages`), {
                    type: 'system', text: `${req.username} joined via invite link.`,
                    uid: 'system', timestamp: serverTimestamp()
                });
                await deleteDoc(reqDocRef);

            } catch (e) {
                console.warn('Error processing join request:', e);
                await updateDoc(reqDocRef, { status: 'pending' }).catch(() => {});
            }
        }
    });
    listeners.push(unsub);
}

function showInviteError(msg, code = '', rawErr = '') {
    document.getElementById('invite-error-overlay')?.remove();

    const overlay = document.createElement('div');
    overlay.id = 'invite-error-overlay';
    overlay.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.97);z-index:9999;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:"DM Sans",sans-serif;animation:joinFadeIn 0.3s ease;';

    const codeHtml = code ? `<div style="font-size:10px;color:#333345;font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;margin-top:6px;letter-spacing:0.05em;">ERR: ${window.escHtml(code)}</div>` : '';
    const detailHtml = rawErr ? `<details style="margin-top:12px;text-align:left;max-width:320px;"><summary style="font-size:11px;color:#333345;cursor:pointer;">Technical details</summary><pre style="font-size:10px;color:#444455;margin-top:6px;white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all;">${window.escHtml(rawErr)}</pre></details>` : '';

    overlay.innerHTML = `
        <style>@keyframes joinFadeIn{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:1}}@keyframes joinFadeOut{from{opacity:1}to{opacity:0}}</style>
        <div style="text-align:center;padding:32px;max-width:400px;width:100%;">
            <div style="font-size:52px;margin-bottom:20px;">❌</div>
            <h1 style="color:#f87171;font-size:20px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:10px;">Invite Failed</h1>
            <p style="color:#888899;font-size:14px;line-height:1.6;">${window.escHtml(msg)}</p>
            ${codeHtml}
            ${detailHtml}
            <div style="display:flex;gap:10px;margin-top:24px;justify-content:center;">
                <button id="invite-err-dismiss" style="background:#1e1e2e;color:#888899;border:1px solid #2a2a3a;padding:8px 24px;border-radius:10px;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;">Dismiss</button>
                <button id="invite-err-retry" style="background:linear-gradient(135deg,#4f46e5,#6366f1);color:#fff;border:none;padding:8px 24px;border-radius:10px;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;">Try Again</button>
            </div>
            <div id="invite-err-timer" style="font-size:10px;color:#222233;margin-top:14px;">Auto-dismissing in <span id="invite-err-countdown">8</span>s</div>
        </div>`;
    document.body.appendChild(overlay);

    overlay.querySelector('#invite-err-dismiss').onclick = () => fadeRemoveOverlay(overlay);
    overlay.querySelector('#invite-err-retry').onclick = () => { overlay.remove(); window.location.reload(); };

    let secs = 8;
    const countdown = overlay.querySelector('#invite-err-countdown');
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
        secs--;
        if (countdown) countdown.innerText = secs;
        if (secs <= 0) { clearInterval(timer); fadeRemoveOverlay(overlay); }
    }, 1000);
}

function fadeRemoveOverlay(el) {
    el.style.animation = 'joinFadeOut 0.3s ease forwards';
    setTimeout(() => el.remove(), 300);
}

function showJoinSuccessScreen(groupName, chatId, chatData) {
    const overlay = document.createElement('div');
    overlay.id = 'join-success-overlay';
    overlay.style.cssText = `
        position: fixed; inset: 0; background: #000; z-index: 9999;
        display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
        font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; animation: joinFadeIn 0.4s ease;
    `;
    overlay.innerHTML = `
        <style>
            @keyframes joinFadeIn { from { opacity: 0; } to { opacity: 1; } }
            @keyframes joinFadeOut { from { opacity: 1; } to { opacity: 0; } }
            @keyframes joinCheck { from { transform: scale(0); opacity: 0; } to { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; } }
        </style>
        <div style="text-align:center; padding: 32px;">
            <div style="font-size: 56px; animation: joinCheck 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.175,0.885,0.32,1.275) 0.2s both;">✅</div>
            <h1 style="color: #ffffff; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; margin-top: 20px; letter-spacing: -0.01em;">
                You have been successfully added to the group.
            </h1>
            <p style="color: #444455; font-size: 14px; margin-top: 10px; font-weight: 500;">
                Opening <span style="color:#818cf8; font-weight:700;">${window.escHtml(groupName)}</span>...
            </p>
        </div>
    `;
    document.body.appendChild(overlay);

    setTimeout(() => {
        overlay.style.animation = 'joinFadeOut 0.4s ease forwards';
        setTimeout(() => {
            overlay.remove();
            openChat(chatId, chatData, chatData.groupName || groupName);
        }, 400);
    }, 1800);
}

window.exportChatAsText = async () => {
    if (!currentChatId || !currentChatData) return alert('Open a chat first.');
    try {
        const snap = await getDocs(query(collection(db, `chats/${currentChatId}/messages`), orderBy("timestamp", "asc")));
        let lines = [`EchoSpace Chat Export — ${new Date().toLocaleString()}\n`];
        lines.push(`Chat: ${currentChatData.isGroup ? currentChatData.groupName : Object.values(currentChatData.names || {}).filter(n => n !== myUsername).join(', ')}\n`);
        lines.push('─'.repeat(40) + '\n');
        snap.forEach(d => {
            const m = d.data();
            const time = m.timestamp?.toDate?.()?.toLocaleString() || '';
            if (m.type === 'system') { lines.push(`[${time}] [System] ${m.text}\n`); return; }
            const sender = currentChatData.names?.[m.uid] || 'User';
            const editTag = m.edited ? ' (edited)' : '';
            lines.push(`[${time}] ${sender}: ${m.imageBase64 ? '[Image]' : m.text}${editTag}\n`);
        });
        const blob = new Blob([lines.join('')], { type: 'text/plain' });
        const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        const a = document.createElement('a'); a.href = url; a.download = `echospace-chat-${Date.now()}.txt`; a.click();
        URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    } catch(e) { alert('Export failed: ' + e.message); }
};

window.echoSummarizeCurrentChat = async () => {
    if (!currentChatId || !currentChatData) return alert('Open a chat first.');
    if (cachedMessages.length === 0) return alert('No messages to summarize.');
    switchView('echoai');
    const lines = cachedMessages.slice(-80).filter(m => m.text && !m.imageBase64).map(m => {
        const sender = currentChatData.names?.[m.uid] || 'User';
        return `${sender}: ${m.text}`;
    }).join('\n');
    const chatName = currentChatData.isGroup ? currentChatData.groupName : Object.values(currentChatData.names || {}).filter(n => n !== myUsername).join(', ');
    const inputEl = document.getElementById('echoai-input');
    if (inputEl) {
        inputEl.value = `Please summarize this conversation from "${chatName}":\n\n${lines}`;
        document.getElementById('btn-echoai-send').click();
    }
};

window.openChat = async (cid, data, name, loadMore) => {
    if (window._echoAssertChatIdentity && !window._echoAssertChatIdentity(data)) {
        window._echoWipeChatUI && window._echoWipeChatUI();
        return;
    }
    if (window._reportSel && cid !== window.currentChatId) window.cancelReportSelection();
    if (!loadMore && window.currentChatId !== cid && window.EchoSFX) {
        window.EchoSFX.play('open');
    }
    _chatMsgLimit = loadMore ? _chatMsgLimit + CHAT_PAGE_SIZE : CHAT_PAGE_SIZE;

    if (loadMore) {
        const _box = document.getElementById('chat-box');
        if (_box) window._chatLoadMoreAnchor = { h: _box.scrollHeight, top: _box.scrollTop };
    }
    window.currentChatId = cid;
    window.currentChatData = data;

    if (window._fcCurrentChatId === cid && typeof window.closeFloatingChat === 'function') {
        window.closeFloatingChat();
    }

    if (!data) {
        if (localStorage.getItem('app_friends_cache')) {
            try {
                const cached = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('app_friends_cache'));
                const found = cached.find(c => c.id === cid);
                if (found) data = found.data;
            } catch(e) {}
        }
        if (!data) {
            try {
                const chatSnap = await getDoc(doc(db, 'chats', cid));
                if (chatSnap.exists()) data = { id: cid, ...chatSnap.data() };
            } catch(e) {
                console.warn('[openChat] Could not fetch chat data:', e);
            }
        }
        if (!data) {
            console.warn('[openChat] No chat data found for', cid, '— aborting open');
            return;
        }
        window.currentChatData = data;
        if (!name) {
            name = data.isGroup
                ? (data.groupName || 'Group')
                : (Object.values(data.names || {}).find(n => n !== window.myUsername) || 'Chat');
        }
    }

    if (data && Array.isArray(data.participants) && !isAdmin) {
        if (!data.participants.includes(myUID)) {
            console.warn('[EchoSpace Security] openChat blocked — UID not in participants. chatId:', cid);
            return;
        }
    }

    if (!data && localStorage.getItem('app_friends_cache')) {
        const cached = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('app_friends_cache'));
        const found = cached.find(c => c.id === cid);
        if (found) data = found.data;
    }

    currentChatId = cid; currentChatData = data;
    window._lastMsgVisible = false;
    document.getElementById('current-chat-name').innerText = name;
    const hPfp = document.getElementById('chat-header-pfp');
    const hEmoji = document.getElementById('chat-header-emoji');
    if (hPfp && hEmoji) {
        if (data?.isGroup) {
            hPfp.style.display = 'none'; hEmoji.style.display = 'block'; hEmoji.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-user-group"></i>';
        } else {
            const otherId = data?.participants?.find(id => id !== myUID);
            const pfpUrl = data?.pfps?.[otherId] || '';
            if (pfpUrl && pfpUrl !== '__chunked_gif__') {
                hPfp.src = pfpUrl; hPfp.style.display = 'block'; hEmoji.style.display = 'none';
            } else {
                hPfp.style.display = 'none'; hEmoji.style.display = 'block'; hEmoji.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-comment-dots"></i>';
                if (otherId && pfpUrl !== '__chunked_gif__') {
                    window.healChatPfp(cid, otherId, (resolved) => {
                        if (currentChatId !== cid) return;
                        hPfp.src = resolved; hPfp.style.display = 'block'; hEmoji.style.display = 'none';
                    });
                }
            }
        }
    }
    clearReply();
    window.cancelMessageEdit();
    switchView('chat');

    const _isGrp = !!data?.isGroup;
    const _tBtn = document.getElementById('active-threads-btn');
    if (_tBtn) { _tBtn.classList.toggle('hidden', !_isGrp); _tBtn.style.display = _isGrp ? 'flex' : ''; }
    window.closeThreadView && window.closeThreadView();
    window._activeThreadsData = _isGrp ? { ...(data?.activeThreads || {}) } : {};
    typeof _refreshThreadsBadge === 'function' && _refreshThreadsBadge();
    _writeActivity('Texting ' + (name || 'someone'));
    clearTyping();
    watchTyping(cid);

    if (_seenUnsub) { try { _seenUnsub(); } catch(e){} _seenUnsub = null; }
    if (data && !data.isGroup) {
        const otherId = data.participants.find(id => id !== myUID);
        if (otherId) {
            _seenUnsub = onValue(ref(rtdb, `seen_by/${otherId}/${cid}`), async (snap) => {
                const val = snap.val();
                const allMyWraps = document.querySelectorAll('.msg-wrap[data-sender="me"]');
                const lastWrap = allMyWraps[allMyWraps.length - 1];
                if (lastWrap) {
                    let receiptEl = lastWrap.querySelector('.read-receipt');
                    const isRtdbSeen = val && typeof val.seenAt === 'number' && (Date.now() - val.seenAt) < 30 * 60 * 1000;
                    const isSeen = isRtdbSeen;
                    if (isSeen) {
                        if (!receiptEl) {
                            receiptEl = document.createElement('span');
                            receiptEl.className = 'read-receipt';
                            lastWrap.appendChild(receiptEl);
                        }
                        receiptEl.textContent = 'Seen ✓✓';
                        receiptEl.classList.remove('sent');
                    } else {
                        if (receiptEl) {
                            receiptEl.textContent = 'Sent ✓';
                            receiptEl.classList.add('sent');
                        }
                    }
                }
            });
        }
    }

    if (data && !data.isGroup) {
        _renderChatHeaderStreak(data.streak);
        _checkStreakExpiry(cid, data);
        window._streakOnChatOpen(cid, data);
    } else {
        const sb = document.getElementById('chat-streak-badge'); if (sb) sb.style.display = 'none';
    }

    const isGroup = data?.isGroup;
    const mgmtBtn = document.getElementById('group-mgmt-btn');
    if (isGroup && (data.owner === myUID || data.spaceId)) { mgmtBtn.classList.remove('hidden'); } else { mgmtBtn.classList.add('hidden'); }
    const blockBtn = document.getElementById('block-btn');
    if (isGroup) { blockBtn.classList.add('hidden'); } else { blockBtn.classList.remove('hidden'); }
    const ftBtn = document.getElementById('force-tab-btn');
    if (isAdmin) {
        ftBtn.style.display = 'block';
        ftBtn._targetUid = isGroup ? null : (data.participants.find(id => id !== myUID) || null);
        ftBtn._chatId = cid;
    } else {
        ftBtn.style.display = 'none';
    }

    document.getElementById('btn-echoai-export').classList.remove('hidden');
    document.getElementById('btn-echoai-summarize').classList.remove('hidden');

    if (data.unreadBy && data.unreadBy.includes(myUID)) {
        updateDoc(doc(db, "chats", cid), { unreadBy: data.unreadBy.filter(id => id !== myUID) }).catch(()=>{});
        if (unreadCount > 0) { unreadCount--; updateTabTitle(); }
    }
    if (data.isGroup) {
        document.getElementById('call-btn-voice').style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('call-btn-video').style.display = 'none';
        const gcBtn = document.getElementById('group-call-btn');
        if (gcBtn) gcBtn.classList.remove('hidden');
        document.getElementById('chat-status').innerText = data.owner === myUID ? "Group Owner" : "Group Chat";
        document.getElementById('chat-status').className = "text-xs text-indigo-400 font-bold";
        if (typeof window._gcListenForCallState === 'function') window._gcListenForCallState(cid);
        if (typeof window._gcAttachAllGroupListeners === 'function') window._gcAttachAllGroupListeners();
        if (typeof window._gcRefreshBannerForChat === 'function') window._gcRefreshBannerForChat(cid);
    
    } else {
        document.getElementById('call-btn-voice').style.display = 'block';
        document.getElementById('call-btn-video').style.display = 'block';
        const gcBtn2 = document.getElementById('group-call-btn');
        if (gcBtn2) gcBtn2.classList.add('hidden');
        if (typeof window._gcHideCallBanner === 'function') window._gcHideCallBanner();
        const fid = data.participants.find(id => id !== myUID);
        if (_chatPresenceUnsub) { try { _chatPresenceUnsub(); } catch(e){} _chatPresenceUnsub = null; }
        _chatPresenceUnsub = watchPresence(fid, (isOnline, lastActive) => {
            const el = document.getElementById('chat-status');
            if (isOnline) { el.innerText = "🟢 Online"; el.className = "text-xs text-green-500 font-bold"; }
            else {
                if (lastActive && typeof lastActive === 'number') {
                    const d = new Date(lastActive);
                    if (!isNaN(d.getTime())) {
                        const now = new Date();
                        const todayStr = now.toDateString();
                        const dStr = d.toDateString();
                        const timeStr = d.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
                        let dateLabel;
                        if (dStr === todayStr) dateLabel = 'Today';
                        else {
                            const yesterday = new Date(now); yesterday.setDate(now.getDate() - 1);
                            dateLabel = dStr === yesterday.toDateString() ? 'Yesterday' : d.toLocaleDateString([], { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' });
                        }
                        el.innerText = `⚫ Last seen ${dateLabel} at ${timeStr}`;
                    } else {
                        el.innerText = "⚫ Offline";
                    }
                } else {
                    el.innerText = "⚫ Offline";
                }
                el.className = "text-xs text-[#555566]";
            }
        });
    }
    if (chatUnsub) chatUnsub();
    const _chatBoxReset = document.getElementById('chat-box');
    if (_chatBoxReset && loadMore) {
        _chatBoxReset.innerHTML =
            '<div class="chat-skel chat-skel-more">' +
            [['', 58, 300, 34], ['cs-me', 46, 240, 34], ['', 66, 340, 34]]
                .map(([side, w, mx, h]) =>
                    `<div class="cs-row ${side}">` +
                    (side ? '' : '<div class="cs-av"></div>') +
                    `<div class="cs-bub" style="--w:${w}%;--max:${mx}px;--h:${h}px"></div></div>`)
                .join('') +
            '</div>';
    } else if (_chatBoxReset) {
        _chatBoxReset.innerHTML =
            '<div class="chat-skel">' +
            [['', 62, 330, 34], ['cs-me', 48, 250, 34], ['', 74, 400, 52],
             ['cs-me', 56, 290, 34], ['', 40, 205, 34], ['cs-me', 66, 320, 34],
             ['', 52, 275, 34], ['cs-me', 44, 230, 52], ['', 68, 360, 34]]
                .map(([side, w, mx, h]) =>
                    `<div class="cs-row ${side}">` +
                    (side ? '' : '<div class="cs-av"></div>') +
                    `<div class="cs-bub" style="--w:${w}%;--max:${mx}px;--h:${h}px"></div></div>`)
                .join('') +
            '<div class="cs-row cs-typing"><div class="cs-av"></div>' +
            '<div class="cs-bub cs-typebub"><span></span><span></span><span></span></div></div>' +
            '</div>';
    }
    let notifiedMsgIds = new Set();
    let renderedMsgIds = new Set();
    let prevLastMyMsgId = null;
    cachedMessages = [];
    let _isInitialChatLoad = true;

    clearTimeout(window._chatAttachTimer);
    const _attach = () => {
    chatUnsub = onSnapshot(query(collection(db, `chats/${cid}/messages`), orderBy("timestamp", "asc"), limitToLast(_chatMsgLimit)), (snap) => {
        const box = document.getElementById('chat-box');
        if (!box) return;
        if (snap.docs.length) {
            const _newest = snap.docs[snap.docs.length - 1];
            window._chatLastMsgKey[cid] = _newest.id;
            window._chatLastMsgMine[cid] = _newest.data().uid === myUID;
        }
        const _skel = box.querySelector('.chat-skel');
        if (_skel) _skel.remove();
        if (window._isTimedOut && window._isTimedOut()) {
            box.innerHTML = `<div style="margin:auto;text-align:center;padding:40px 20px;color:#555566;">
                <div style="font-size:40px;margin-bottom:12px;">⏳</div>
                <div style="font-size:15px;font-weight:800;color:#e8e8f0;margin-bottom:6px;">You're Timed Out</div>
                <div style="font-size:12px;line-height:1.6;max-width:260px;margin:0 auto;">You can't send or see messages until your timeout ends.</div>
            </div>`;
            renderedMsgIds = new Set();

        }
        cachedMessages = [];

        const snapIds = new Set();
        let lastMyMsgId = null;
        snap.forEach(docSnap => {
            const m = docSnap.data();

            if (m.uid === myUID && m.type !== 'system') lastMyMsgId = docSnap.id;

        for (const oldId of renderedMsgIds) {
            if (!snapIds.has(oldId)) {

        const atBottom = box.scrollHeight - box.scrollTop - box.clientHeight < 80;

        snap.forEach(docSnap => {
            const m = docSnap.data(); const isMe = m.uid === myUID;
            if (m.uid !== 'system' && m.type !== 'system') cachedMessages.push({ id: docSnap.id, ...m });

            if (m.type === 'system') {
                if (!renderedMsgIds.has(docSnap.id)) {
                    const sysEl = document.createElement('div');

                    sysEl.className = 'flex justify-center w-full my-1';
                    sysEl.innerHTML = `<div class="bubble-system">${window.escHtml(m.text)}</div>`;
                    box.appendChild(sysEl);
                    renderedMsgIds.add(docSnap.id);
                }
                return;
            }

            if (m.type === 'group_accept') {
                if (m.uid !== myUID && !renderedMsgIds.has(docSnap.id)) {
                    (async () => {
                        try {
                            const groupSnap = await getDoc(doc(db, "chats", m.groupId));
                            if (!groupSnap.exists()) return;
                            const gd = groupSnap.data();
                            if (gd.participants?.includes(m.uid)) return;
                            if (gd.inviteToken !== m.inviteToken) return;
                            await updateDoc(doc(db, "chats", m.groupId), {
                                participants: [...(gd.participants || []), m.uid],

                                [`pfps.${m.uid}`]: m.pfp || ''
                            });
                            await addDoc(collection(db, `chats/${m.groupId}/messages`), {

            }

            if (m.type === 'group_invite') {
                const isTarget = m.targetUID === myUID;

                    cardContent = m.accepted

                    existingGI.innerHTML = giHtml;
                } else {
                    const giEl = document.createElement('div');
                    giEl.id = 'gi-' + docSnap.id;
                    giEl.className = `flex w-full my-2 ${isSender ? 'justify-end' : 'justify-start'}`;
                    giEl.innerHTML = giHtml;
                    box.appendChild(giEl);
                    renderedMsgIds.add(docSnap.id);
                }
                return;
            }

            if (m.type === 'space_invite') {
                const isSenderSI = m.uid === myUID;
                const isMemberSI = typeof window._spIsMember === 'function' && window._spIsMember(m.spaceId);
                const btnSI = isMemberSI
                    ? `<button onclick="spGoToSpace('${window.escAttr(m.spaceId)}')"
                        style="width:100%;margin-top:10px;background:rgba(34,197,94,0.1);border:1px solid rgba(34,197,94,0.25);color:#22c55e;padding:8px;border-radius:8px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;"><i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right"></i> Go to channels</button>`
                    : (isSenderSI
                        ? `<div style="font-size:11px;color:#444455;margin-top:8px;text-align:center;">Waiting for them to join...</div>`
                        : `<button onclick="spRedeemCode('${window.escAttr(m.code || '')}')"
                            style="width:100%;margin-top:10px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#4f46e5,#6366f1);color:#fff;border:none;padding:8px;border-radius:8px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;"><i class="fa-solid fa-circle-check"></i> Join space</button>`);

                const siHtml = `<div style="background:#0d0d1a;border:1px solid rgba(99,102,241,0.3);border-radius:14px;padding:14px 16px;max-width:260px;${isSenderSI ? 'margin-left:auto;' : ''}">
                    <div style="font-size:10px;color:#4f46e5;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0.08em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:6px;"><i class="fa-solid fa-layer-group"></i> Space Invite</div>
                    <div style="font-size:15px;font-weight:700;color:#e8e8f0;">${window.escHtml(m.spaceName || 'Space')}</div>
                    <div style="font-size:11px;color:#555566;margin-top:2px;">${m.memberCount || 0} member${m.memberCount === 1 ? '' : 's'} · ${m.channelCount || 0} channel${m.channelCount === 1 ? '' : 's'}</div>
                    <div style="margin-top:8px;background:#08080f;border:1px solid #1e1e2e;border-radius:8px;padding:6px;text-align:center;color:#818cf8;font-family:monospace;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:0.1em;">${window.escHtml(m.code || '')}</div>
                    ${btnSI}
                </div>`;

                const existingSI = document.getElementById('si-' + docSnap.id);
                if (existingSI) {
                    existingSI.innerHTML = siHtml;
                } else {
                    const siEl = document.createElement('div');
                    siEl.id = 'si-' + docSnap.id;
                    siEl.className = `flex w-full my-2 ${isSenderSI ? 'justify-end' : 'justify-start'}`;
                    siEl.innerHTML = siHtml;
                    box.appendChild(siEl);
                    renderedMsgIds.add(docSnap.id);
                }
                return;
            }

            if (m.type === 'poll') {
                const poll = m.poll || {};
                const total = poll.totalVotes || 0;
                const myVoteIdx = (poll.options || []).findIndex(o => (o.voters || []).includes(myUID));
                const hasVoted = myVoteIdx !== -1;
                const winnerVotes = hasVoted ? Math.max(...(poll.options || []).map(o => (o.voters || []).length)) : 0;
                const senderNamePoll = data.names?.[m.uid] || 'User';
                const isMePoll = m.uid === myUID;
                const buildPollHtml = (p, t, mv, hv, wv) => {
                    const optsHtml = (p.options || []).map((opt, i) => {
                        const votes = (opt.voters || []).length;
                        const pct = t > 0 ? Math.round((votes / t) * 100) : 0;
                        const iv = i === mv; const iw = hv && votes === wv && votes > 0;
                        return `<div class="poll-option${iv?' voted':''}" onclick="window.votePoll('${docSnap.id}','${cid}',${i})">
                            <div class="poll-option-bar${iw?' winner':''}" style="width:${hv?pct:0}%"></div>
                            <div class="poll-option-inner">
                                ${iv?'<span class="poll-option-check">✓</span>':''}
                                <span class="poll-option-label">${window.escHtml(opt.text)}</span>
                                ${hv?`<span class="poll-option-pct">${pct}%</span>`:''}
                            </div>
                        </div>`;
                    }).join('');
                    return `<div class="poll-bubble" id="poll-card-${docSnap.id}">
                        <div class="poll-badge"><i class="fa-solid fa-chart-simple"></i> Poll</div>
                        <div class="poll-question">${window.escHtml(p.question || 'Poll')}</div>
                        ${optsHtml}
                        <div class="poll-meta">${t} vote${t!==1?'s':''}${hv?' · tap to change':' · tap to vote'}</div>
                    </div>`;
                };
                const pollSenderLine = !isMePoll
                    ? `<div style="font-size:10px;font-weight:700;color:#555566;margin-bottom:4px;margin-left:2px;">${window.escHtml(senderNamePoll)}</div>` : '';
                const pollCardHtml = buildPollHtml(poll, total, myVoteIdx, hasVoted, winnerVotes);
                if (!renderedMsgIds.has(docSnap.id)) {
                    const pollEl = document.createElement('div');
                    pollEl.id = 'poll-wrap-' + docSnap.id;
                    pollEl.className = `flex w-full my-2 ${isMePoll ? 'justify-end' : 'justify-start'}`;
                    pollEl.innerHTML = isMePoll ? pollCardHtml + pollSenderLine : pollSenderLine + pollCardHtml;
                    box.appendChild(pollEl);
                    renderedMsgIds.add(docSnap.id);
                    if (!window._pollWatchers) window._pollWatchers = {};
                    if (!window._pollWatchers[docSnap.id]) {
                        window._pollWatchers[docSnap.id] = true;
                        (async (mid, chatId) => {
                            const { onSnapshot: oS, doc: fsDoc } = await import('https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.11.0/firebase-firestore.js');
                            const unsub = oS(fsDoc(db, `chats/${chatId}/messages`, mid), (ps) => {
                                if (!ps.exists()) return;
                                const pm = ps.data(); if (pm.type !== 'poll') return;
                                const pp = pm.poll || {}; const pt = pp.totalVotes || 0;
                                const myV = (pp.options||[]).findIndex(o=>(o.voters||[]).includes(myUID));
                                const hv2 = myV !== -1;
                                const wv2 = hv2 ? Math.max(...(pp.options||[]).map(o=>(o.voters||[]).length)) : 0;
                                const card = document.getElementById(`poll-card-${mid}`);
                                if (!card) return;
                                card.querySelector('.poll-meta').textContent = `${pt} vote${pt!==1?'s':''}${hv2?' · tap to change':' · tap to vote'}`;
                                const optEls = card.querySelectorAll('.poll-option');
                                (pp.options||[]).forEach((opt, i) => {
                                    const el = optEls[i]; if (!el) return;
                                    const v = (opt.voters||[]).length;
                                    const p = pt > 0 ? Math.round((v/pt)*100) : 0;
                                    const iv2 = i === myV; const iw2 = hv2 && v === wv2 && v > 0;
                                    el.className = `poll-option${iv2?' voted':''}`;
                                    el.querySelector('.poll-option-bar').style.width = hv2 ? p+'%' : '0%';
                                    el.querySelector('.poll-option-bar').className = `poll-option-bar${iw2?' winner':''}`;
                                    el.querySelector('.poll-option-inner').innerHTML = `${iv2?'<span class="poll-option-check">✓</span>':''}<span class="poll-option-label">${window.escHtml(opt.text)}</span>${hv2?`<span class="poll-option-pct">${p}%</span>`:''}`;
                                });
                            });
                            window.registerListener && window.registerListener(`poll-${mid}`, unsub);
                        })(docSnap.id, cid);
                    }
                }
                return;
            }

            if (m.type === 'game') {
                const isMeGame = m.uid === myUID;
                const existingG = document.getElementById('game-wrap-' + docSnap.id);
                const cardHtml = window._gameCardHtml
                    ? window._gameCardHtml(docSnap.id, m.game || {}, data)
                    : '';
                if (existingG) {
                    window._gameSwapCard(existingG, cardHtml, m.game);

                    gEl.id = 'game-wrap-' + docSnap.id;

            const existingWrap = document.getElementById('msg-' + docSnap.id);

                    ? ` data-giflib="${window.escHtml(m.gifLibId)}" data-gifchunks="${m.gifLibChunks || 0}" data-gifsrc="${window.escHtml(m.gifUrl)}"` : '';

                    <img id="${_gImgId}" src="${_gInitial}"${_gLib}${_gAspect} class="max-w-full mt-1 cursor-pointer gif-msg-img" alt="" loading="lazy"

                </div>`;
                if (m.gifLibId) setTimeout(() => window._hydrateLibGifs && window._hydrateLibGifs(), 0);
                else setTimeout(() => {

            } else if (m.voiceBase64) {

                if (!window._voiceCache) window._voiceCache = {};
                window._voiceCache[docSnap.id] = m.voiceBase64;
                if (m.voiceTranscript) {
                    window._transcriptCache = window._transcriptCache || {};
                    window._transcriptCache[docSnap.id] = m.voiceTranscript;
                }
                const _tSafe = m.voiceTranscript ? (window.escHtml ? window.escHtml(m.voiceTranscript) : m.voiceTranscript) : '';
                const _tDone = m.voiceTranscript ? 'true' : '';
                const _tHtml = m.voiceTranscript
                    ? `<div class="vm-transcript-text">${_tSafe}</div><div class="vm-transcript-copy" onclick="window._copyTranscript('${docSnap.id}')">Copy</div>`
                    : '';

                    <button class="voice-play-btn" data-audio="${audioId}" onclick="playVoiceMessage(this,'${audioId}')" title="Play"><i class="fa-solid fa-play"></i></button>

                    <span class="voice-duration">${durStr}</span>

                </div>

                    <button id="transcribe-btn-${docSnap.id}" class="vm-transcribe-btn" onclick="window.transcribeVoiceMessage('${docSnap.id}')">${m.voiceTranscript ? 'Hide' : 'Transcript'}</button>

                </div>`;
            }

            const editTag = m.edited ? `<span class="edit-indicator">(edited)</span>` : '';
            let timeStr = '';
            if (m.timestamp?.toDate) { const td = m.timestamp.toDate(); timeStr = td.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour:'2-digit', minute:'2-digit' }); }
            const timeHtml = `<span class="text-[10px] text-[#333345] mt-0.5 px-1">${timeStr}${editTag}</span>`;

            const isLastMyMsg = isMe && docSnap.id === lastMyMsgId;
            const readReceiptHtml = isLastMyMsg ? `<span class="read-receipt sent">Sent ✓</span>` : '';

            const reactions = m.reactions || {};
            const reactEmojis = Object.entries(reactions).filter(([, users]) => users.length > 0);
            const reactionsHtml = reactEmojis.length > 0
                ? `<div class="reactions-row">${reactEmojis.map(([emoji, users]) => `<button class="reaction-chip ${users.includes(myUID)?'mine':''}" title="${window.escAttr(window.reactionLabel(emoji))}" onclick="toggleReaction('${docSnap.id}','${window.escAttr(emoji)}')">${window.reactionHtml(emoji)} ${users.length}</button>`).join('')}</div>` : '';

            const editBtn = (isMe && m.timestamp?.toDate && (Date.now()-m.timestamp.toDate().getTime() < 5*60*1000) && !m.imageBase64)
                ? `<button class="action-icon-btn" onclick="startMessageEdit('${docSnap.id}','${window.escAttr(m.text)}')" title="Edit">✏</button>` : '';
            const deleteBtn = isMe ? `<button class="action-icon-btn" onclick="deleteMessage('${docSnap.id}','${cid}','${window.escAttr(senderName)}')" title="Delete" style="color:#444455;">✕</button>` : '';
            const _replyLabel = m.gifUrl ? '[GIF]' : (m.text || '[Image]');

            const threadActionBtn = data.isGroup ? `<button class="action-icon-btn thread-action-btn" id="thread-toggle-${docSnap.id}" onclick="openThreadView('${docSnap.id}','${cid}','${window.escAttr(m.text||'[Image]')}','${window.escAttr(senderName)}')" title="Open thread" style="position:relative;">${threadCount>0?`<span class="thread-count-badge">${threadCount}</span>`:''}🧵</button>` : '';
            const translateBtn = (m.text && !m.imageBase64 && !m.gifUrl && !m.voiceBase64)
                ? `<button class="action-icon-btn" onclick="window._translateMessage('${docSnap.id}','${window.escAttr(m.text)}')" title="Translate">🌐</button>` : '';
            const actionBar = `<div class="msg-action-bar ${isMe?'bar-right':'bar-left'}" id="abar-${docSnap.id}">
                ${window.quickReactions().map(t => `<button class="action-emoji" title="${window.escAttr(window.reactionLabel(t))}" onclick="toggleReaction('${docSnap.id}','${window.escAttr(t)}')">${window.reactionHtml(t)}</button>`).join('')}
                <button class="action-emoji" onclick="openEmojiPicker('${docSnap.id}',this)" title="More reactions">⊕</button>
                <div class="action-sep"></div>
                ${replyBtn}${threadActionBtn}${translateBtn}${editBtn}${deleteBtn}
            </div>`;
            const msgInner = `${replyBlock}<div class="${isMe?'bubble-me':'bubble-them'} px-3.5 py-2 text-sm">${contentHtml}</div>`;
            const threadHtml = data.isGroup ? `
                <div id="thread-${docSnap.id}" class="thread-container">
                    <div class="thread-input-row">
                        <input class="thread-input" placeholder="Reply in thread…" maxlength="1000"
                            onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter'&&!event.shiftKey){event.preventDefault();sendThreadReply('${docSnap.id}','${cid}',this);}">
                        <button class="thread-send-btn" onclick="sendThreadReply('${docSnap.id}','${cid}',this.previousElementSibling)">↑</button>
                    </div>
                </div>` : '';

            if (existingWrap) {
                const existingReactions = existingWrap.querySelector('.reactions-row');
                if (reactionsHtml) {
                    if (existingReactions) { existingReactions.outerHTML = reactionsHtml; }
                    else {
                        const timeEl = existingWrap.querySelector('.text-\\[10px\\]');
                        if (timeEl) { const rDiv = document.createElement('div'); rDiv.innerHTML = reactionsHtml; existingWrap.insertBefore(rDiv.firstChild, timeEl); }
                    }
                } else if (existingReactions) { existingReactions.remove(); }

                const timeEl = existingWrap.querySelector('.text-\\[10px\\]');
                if (timeEl) timeEl.innerHTML = `${timeStr}${editTag}`;

                const bubbleEl = existingWrap.querySelector('.bubble-me, .bubble-them');
                if (bubbleEl && !m.imageBase64 && !m.gifUrl && !m.voiceBase64) {
                    const newContent = `${replyBlock}<div class="${isMe?'bubble-me':'bubble-them'} px-3.5 py-2 text-sm">${contentHtml}</div>`;
                    if (bubbleEl.outerHTML !== `<div class="${isMe?'bubble-me':'bubble-them'} px-3.5 py-2 text-sm">${contentHtml}</div>`) {
                        bubbleEl.innerHTML = contentHtml;
                    }
                }

                const ttBtn = existingWrap.querySelector(`#thread-toggle-${docSnap.id}`);
                if (ttBtn) {
                    let badge = ttBtn.querySelector('.thread-count-badge');
                    if (threadCount > 0) {
                        if (!badge) { badge = document.createElement('span'); badge.className = 'thread-count-badge'; ttBtn.insertBefore(badge, ttBtn.firstChild); }
                        badge.textContent = threadCount;
                    } else if (badge) { badge.remove(); }
                }

                if (isMe) {
                    let receiptEl = existingWrap.querySelector('.read-receipt');
                    if (isLastMyMsg) {
                        if (!receiptEl) { receiptEl = document.createElement('span'); receiptEl.className = 'read-receipt sent'; existingWrap.appendChild(receiptEl); }
                        if (!receiptEl.textContent.includes('Seen')) receiptEl.textContent = 'Sent ✓';
                    } else if (receiptEl) {
                        receiptEl.remove();
                    }
                }
            } else {
                const wrapEl = document.createElement('div');
                wrapEl.id = 'msg-' + docSnap.id;
                wrapEl.dataset.msgid = docSnap.id;
                if (isMe) {

                    wrapEl.dataset.sender = 'me';
                } else {
                    wrapEl.className = 'msg-wrap flex flex-col w-fit max-w-[80%] items-start mb-2 mt-1';
                }
                wrapEl.innerHTML = `${actionBar}${senderLine}${msgInner}${reactionsHtml}${timeHtml}${readReceiptHtml}${threadHtml}`;
                box.appendChild(wrapEl);
