                wrapEl.addEventListener('touchstart', () => { touchTimer = setTimeout(() => wrapEl.classList.add('touched'), 400); }, { passive: true });
                wrapEl.addEventListener('touchend', () => { clearTimeout(touchTimer); setTimeout(() => wrapEl.classList.remove('touched'), 2000); }, { passive: true });

                if (!isMe) {
                    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                        window.resolvePfp(rawSenderPfp, m.uid).then(resolved => {
                            const pfpEl = document.getElementById(senderPfpId);
                            if (pfpEl && resolved && resolved !== window._DEFAULT_PFP) pfpEl.src = resolved;
                        });
                    });
                }

                if (!_isInitialChatLoad && !snap.metadata.hasPendingWrites && !isMe && !notifiedMsgIds.has(docSnap.id)) {
                    triggerNotif(name, m.text, false, { chatId: cid, senderName: name });
                    if (window.EchoSFX) {
                        window._echoSfxLastMsgAt = window._echoSfxLastMsgAt || {};
                        const _sfxNow = Date.now();
                        if (!window._echoSfxLastMsgAt[cid] || _sfxNow - window._echoSfxLastMsgAt[cid] > 1000) {
                            window._echoSfxLastMsgAt[cid] = _sfxNow;
                            const isActiveChat = tabIsFocused && currentChatId === cid;
                            window.EchoSFX.play(isActiveChat ? 'receive' : 'notify');
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            notifiedMsgIds.add(docSnap.id);
        });
        _isInitialChatLoad = false;

        if (prevLastMyMsgId && prevLastMyMsgId !== lastMyMsgId) {
            const oldLastWrap = document.getElementById('msg-' + prevLastMyMsgId);
            if (oldLastWrap) {
                const oldReceipt = oldLastWrap.querySelector('.read-receipt');
                if (oldReceipt) oldReceipt.remove();
            }
        }
        prevLastMyMsgId = lastMyMsgId;

        let loadOlderBtn = document.getElementById('load-older-msgs-btn');
        if (snap.size >= _chatMsgLimit) {
            if (!loadOlderBtn) {
                loadOlderBtn = document.createElement('button');
                loadOlderBtn.id = 'load-older-msgs-btn';
                loadOlderBtn.type = 'button';
                loadOlderBtn.className = 'lo-divider';
                loadOlderBtn.innerHTML =
                    '<span class="lo-line"></span>' +
                    '<span class="lo-pill">' +
                        '<i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-long lo-arrow"></i>' +
                        '<span class="lo-label">Older messages</span>' +
                    '</span>' +
                    '<span class="lo-line"></span>';
                loadOlderBtn.onclick = () => {
                    loadOlderBtn.classList.add('is-loading');
                    loadOlderBtn._loadStartedAt = Date.now();
                    loadOlderBtn._restoreQueued = false;
                    const lbl = loadOlderBtn.querySelector('.lo-label');
                    if (lbl) lbl.innerHTML = 'Loading<span class="lo-dots"><span></span><span></span><span></span></span>';
                    window.openChat(cid, window.currentChatData, null, true);
                };
            } else if (loadOlderBtn.classList.contains('is-loading') && !loadOlderBtn._restoreQueued) {
                loadOlderBtn._restoreQueued = true;
                const LOAD_MORE_MIN_MS = 1100;
                const elapsed = Date.now() - (loadOlderBtn._loadStartedAt || 0);
                const btnRef = loadOlderBtn;
                setTimeout(() => {
                    btnRef.classList.remove('is-loading');
                    btnRef._restoreQueued = false;
                    const l = btnRef.querySelector('.lo-label');
                    if (l) l.textContent = 'Older messages';
                }, Math.max(0, LOAD_MORE_MIN_MS - elapsed));
            }
            if (box.firstChild !== loadOlderBtn) box.insertBefore(loadOlderBtn, box.firstChild);
        } else if (loadOlderBtn) {
            loadOlderBtn.remove();
        }

        const _anchor = window._chatLoadMoreAnchor;
        if (_anchor) {
            window._chatLoadMoreAnchor = null;
            box.scrollTop = _anchor.top + (box.scrollHeight - _anchor.h);
        } else if (atBottom) {
            box.scrollTop = box.scrollHeight;
            box.querySelectorAll('img:not([data-scroll-fix-bound])').forEach(img => {
                img.setAttribute('data-scroll-fix-bound', '1');
                if (!img.complete) {
                    img.addEventListener('load', () => {
                        if (box.scrollHeight - box.scrollTop - box.clientHeight < 200) box.scrollTop = box.scrollHeight;
                    }, { once: true });
                }
            });
        }
        window._lastMsgVisible = false;
        _attachReadObserver(box);
        const allWraps = box.querySelectorAll('.msg-wrap');
        if (allWraps.length && box.offsetParent !== null) {
            const lastRect = allWraps[allWraps.length - 1].getBoundingClientRect();
            const boxRect = box.getBoundingClientRect();
            window._lastMsgVisible = lastRect.bottom <= boxRect.bottom + 20 && lastRect.top >= boxRect.top - 20;
        }
        markChatRead(cid);
    });
    };

    const CHAT_OPEN_DELAY_MS = 1500;
    const LOAD_MORE_DELAY_MS = 850;
    const _sameChatReopen = window._lastAttachedChatId === cid;
    window._lastAttachedChatId = cid;
    window._chatAttachTimer = setTimeout(
        _attach,
        loadMore ? LOAD_MORE_DELAY_MS : (_sameChatReopen ? 0 : CHAT_OPEN_DELAY_MS)
    );
};

window.openProfileFromChat = async (uid) => {
    if (!uid) return;
    openProfilePage(uid);
};

window.setReplyTo = (msgId, senderName, text) => {
    replyToMsg = { id: msgId, senderName, text };
    document.getElementById('reply-preview-name').innerText = senderName;
    document.getElementById('reply-preview-text').innerText = text;
    document.getElementById('reply-preview-bar').classList.remove('hidden');
    document.getElementById('message-input').focus();
};

window._translationCache = window._translationCache || {};
async function _translateInto(msgId, rawText, anchorEl) {
    const noteEl = document.createElement('div');
    noteEl.className = 'msg-translation';
    noteEl.style.cssText = 'font-size:11px;color:#818cf8;margin-top:4px;font-style:italic;line-height:1.4;';

    if (window._translationCache[msgId]) {
        noteEl.textContent = '🌐 ' + window._translationCache[msgId];
        anchorEl.insertAdjacentElement('afterend', noteEl);
        return;
    }

    noteEl.textContent = 'Translating…';
    anchorEl.insertAdjacentElement('afterend', noteEl);

    try {
        const result = await window._geminiCallWithFallback('gemini-2.5-flash-lite', {
            system_instruction: { parts: [{ text: 'You are a translator. Detect the language of the given message. If it is Spanish, translate it to English. Otherwise, translate it to Spanish. Reply with ONLY the translated text — no quotes, no labels, no explanation.' }] },
            contents: [{ role: 'user', parts: [{ text: rawText }] }],
            generationConfig: { temperature: 0.2, maxOutputTokens: 300 }
        });
        if (!anchorEl.isConnected) return;
        if (!result.ok) { noteEl.textContent = 'Translation unavailable right now.'; return; }
        const translated = result.data?.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts?.[0]?.text?.trim();
        if (!translated) { noteEl.textContent = 'Translation unavailable right now.'; return; }
        window._translationCache[msgId] = translated;
        noteEl.textContent = '🌐 ' + translated;
    } catch (e) {
        if (anchorEl.isConnected) noteEl.textContent = 'Translation failed.';
    }
}
window._translateMessage = function(msgId, rawText) {
    const wrap = document.getElementById('msg-' + msgId) || document.querySelector(`[data-msgid="${msgId}"]`);
    if (!wrap) return;
    const existing = wrap.querySelector('.msg-translation');
    if (existing) { existing.remove(); return; }
    const bubble = wrap.querySelector('.bubble-me, .bubble-them');
    if (!bubble) return;
    _translateInto(msgId, rawText, bubble);
};
window._translateGlobalMsg = function(msgId, rawText) {
    const div = document.getElementById('gcmsg-' + msgId);
    if (!div) return;
    const existing = div.querySelector('.msg-translation');
    if (existing) { existing.remove(); return; }
    const textEl = div.querySelector('.gc-text');
    if (!textEl) return;
    _translateInto(msgId, rawText, textEl);
};

document.getElementById('message-input').addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) { e.preventDefault(); sendMessage(); }
});
document.getElementById('send-btn').addEventListener('click', sendMessage);
function _fmtFileSize(bytes) {
    if (!bytes && bytes !== 0) return '';
    if (bytes < 1024) return bytes + ' B';
    if (bytes < 1024*1024) return (bytes/1024).toFixed(1) + ' KB';
    return (bytes/1024/1024).toFixed(1) + ' MB';
}
function _fileIconFor(mime) {
    mime = mime || '';
    if (mime.startsWith('video/')) return '🎬';
    if (mime.startsWith('audio/')) return '🎵';
    if (mime === 'application/pdf') return '📕';
    if (mime.includes('zip') || mime.includes('compressed')) return '🗜️';
    if (mime.startsWith('text/')) return '📃';
    return '📄';
}
const _IMG_EXTS = ['jpg','jpeg','jfif','pjpeg','pjp','png','apng','gif','webp','avif','bmp','svg','ico','tif','tiff','heic','heif'];
const _VID_EXTS = ['mp4','m4v','mov','webm','ogv','mkv','avi','3gp','3g2','hevc','mts','m2ts'];
const _AUD_EXTS = ['mp3','wav','ogg','oga','m4a','aac','flac','opus','weba','wma','mid','midi','amr'];
function _fileExt(name) { const m = /\.([a-z0-9]+)$/i.exec(name || ''); return m ? m[1].toLowerCase() : ''; }
function _isImageFile(name, mime) { return (mime || '').startsWith('image/') || _IMG_EXTS.includes(_fileExt(name)); }
function _isVideoFile(name, mime) { return (mime || '').startsWith('video/') || _VID_EXTS.includes(_fileExt(name)); }
function _isAudioFile(name, mime) { return (mime || '').startsWith('audio/') || _AUD_EXTS.includes(_fileExt(name)); }

window._renderFileCard = function (name, size, type, opts) { return _renderFileCard(name, size, type, opts); };
function _renderFileCard(name, size, type, opts) {
    const safeName = window.escHtml(name || 'file');
    const attrName = window.escAttr ? window.escAttr(name || 'file') : (name || 'file');

    const isImg = _isImageFile(name, type);
    const isVid = !isImg && _isVideoFile(name, type);
    const isAud = !isImg && !isVid && _isAudioFile(name, type);
    if (isImg || isVid) {
        const srcAttrs = opts.url
            ? `data-src="${opts.url}"`
            : `data-chatid="${opts.chatId}" data-msgid="${opts.msgId}"`;
        return `<div class="_media-card _media-pending" data-kind="${isVid ? 'video' : 'image'}" data-name="${attrName}" ${srcAttrs}>
            <div class="_media-thumb-wrap">
                <div class="_media-loading">${isVid ? '🎬' : '🖼️'}<span>Loading preview…</span></div>
            </div>
            <div class="_media-foot">
                <span class="_media-foot-name">${safeName}</span>
                <span class="_media-foot-meta">${_fmtFileSize(size)}</span>
                <button class="_media-dl" title="Download" onclick="event.stopPropagation();window._mediaCardDownload(this)">⬇</button>
            </div>
        </div>`;
    }

    if (isAud) {
        const srcAttrs = opts.url
            ? `data-src="${opts.url}"`
            : `data-chatid="${opts.chatId}" data-msgid="${opts.msgId}"`;
        return `<div class="_media-card _audio-card" data-kind="audio" data-name="${attrName}" ${srcAttrs}>
            <div class="_audio-row">
                <button class="_audio-play" onclick="window._audioCardToggle(this)"><i class="fa-solid fa-play"></i></button>
                <div class="_audio-mid">
                    <div class="_audio-name">${safeName}</div>
                    <div class="_audio-track" onclick="window._audioCardSeek(event, this)"><div class="_audio-track-fill"></div></div>
                    <div class="_audio-time"><span class="_audio-cur">0:00</span><span class="_audio-dur">${_fmtFileSize(size)}</span></div>
                </div>
                <button class="_media-dl" title="Download" onclick="event.stopPropagation();window._mediaCardDownload(this)">⬇</button>
            </div>
        </div>`;
    }

    const icon = _fileIconFor(type);
    const inner = `<span style="font-size:20px;">${icon}</span>
        <span style="min-width:0;flex:1;">
            <span style="display:block;font-size:12px;color:#e2e2f0;font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;">${safeName}</span>
            <span class="_file-card-sub" style="display:block;font-size:10px;color:#555566;">${_fmtFileSize(size)} · tap to download</span>
        </span>`;
    const boxStyle = `display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:#101020;border:1px solid #1e1e2e;border-radius:16px;padding:9px 12px;margin-top:2px;max-width:260px;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);`;
    if (opts.url) {
        return `<a href="${opts.url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener" style="${boxStyle}">${inner}</a>`;
    }
    return `<div class="_file-card" style="${boxStyle}" onclick="window.downloadChunkedFile('${opts.chatId}','${opts.msgId}','${attrName}', this.querySelector('._file-card-sub'))">${inner}</div>`;
}

const ECHO_KEEP_MESSAGES  = 300;
const ECHO_RETENTION_ON   = true;
const ECHO_TRIM_MARGIN    = 50;
const ECHO_TRIM_MAX       = 400;
const ECHO_TRIM_COOLDOWN  = 6 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
const ECHO_TRIM_PAGE      = 400;
const ECHO_TRIM_MAX_PAGES = 12;

window._echoPickDoomed = async function (fetchPage, myUid, target) {
    const doomed = [];
    if (!myUid || !(target > 0)) return doomed;
    let cursor = null;
    for (let page = 0; page < ECHO_TRIM_MAX_PAGES && doomed.length < target; page++) {
        const docs = await fetchPage(cursor);
        if (!docs || !docs.length) break;
        cursor = docs[docs.length - 1];
        for (const d of docs) {
            if (d.data().uid === myUid) {
                doomed.push(d.ref);
                if (doomed.length >= target) break;
            }
        }
        if (docs.length < ECHO_TRIM_PAGE) break;
    }
    return doomed;
};

window._maybeTrimChat = async function (chatId, opts) {
    opts = opts || {};
    if (!ECHO_RETENTION_ON && !opts.force) return { skipped: 'disabled' };
    if (!chatId || !window.myUID) return { skipped: 'no-chat' };
    const key = `echo_trim_${chatId}`;
    if (!opts.force) {
        try {
            const last = +(localStorage.getItem(key) || 0);
            if (Date.now() - last < ECHO_TRIM_COOLDOWN) return { skipped: 'cooldown' };
        } catch (_) {}
    }
    const coll = chatId === 'global_chat'
        ? collection(db, 'global_chat')
        : collection(db, `chats/${chatId}/messages`);
    try {
        const mineTotal = (await getCountFromServer(query(coll, where('uid', '==', window.myUID)))).data().count;
        if (mineTotal <= ECHO_KEEP_MESSAGES + ECHO_TRIM_MARGIN) return { skipped: 'under-cap', mineTotal };
        try { localStorage.setItem(key, String(Date.now())); } catch (_) {}

        const target = Math.min(mineTotal - ECHO_KEEP_MESSAGES, ECHO_TRIM_MAX);
        const doomed = await window._echoPickDoomed(async (cursor) => {
            const parts = [orderBy('timestamp', 'asc'), limit(ECHO_TRIM_PAGE)];
            if (cursor) parts.splice(1, 0, startAfter(cursor));
            const snap = await getDocs(query(coll, ...parts));
            return snap.docs;
        }, window.myUID, target);
        if (!doomed.length) return { mineTotal, deleted: 0 };
        let deleted = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < doomed.length; i += 400) {
            const batch = writeBatch(db);
            doomed.slice(i, i + 400).forEach(ref => batch.delete(ref));
            await batch.commit();
            deleted += Math.min(400, doomed.length - i);
        }
        console.log(`[retention] ${chatId}: I had ${mineTotal} messages, deleted my oldest ${deleted}`);
        return { mineTotal, deleted };
    } catch (e) {
        console.warn('[retention] trim failed for', chatId, e);
        return { error: e.message || String(e) };
    }
};

window._retentionSweep = async function (opts) {
    opts = opts || {};
    if (!ECHO_RETENTION_ON && !opts.force) return;
    if (window._retentionSwept && !opts.force) return;
    window._retentionSwept = true;
    if (!window.myUID) return;
    try {
        const snap = await getDocs(query(collection(db, "chats"), where("participants", "array-contains", window.myUID)));
        const ids = snap.docs.map(d => d.id).concat('global_chat');
        let totalDeleted = 0;
        for (const id of ids) {
            const r = await window._maybeTrimChat(id);
            if (r && r.deleted) totalDeleted += r.deleted;
            await new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, 400));
        }
        if (totalDeleted) console.log(`[retention] sweep done — deleted ${totalDeleted} of my old messages`);
    } catch (e) {
        console.warn('[retention] sweep failed:', e);
    }
};

window._sendTextToChat = async function (chatId, chatData, rawText, opts) {
    opts = opts || {};
    const fail = (reason, toast) => {
        if (toast && !opts.silent) showCooldownToast(toast);
        return { ok: false, reason };
    };
    let text = String(rawText || '').trim();
    if (!text || !chatId) return fail('empty');
    if (!chatData) return fail('not-ready', '⚠️ Chat not ready yet, try again in a second.');

    const _toCheck = await _checkUserTimeout();
    if (_toCheck.blocked) {
        return fail('timed-out', `⏳ You are timed out for ${_fmtTimeoutRemaining(_toCheck.until)}. You cannot send messages.`);
    }

    text = sanitizeText(text);
    if (!text) return fail('empty');
    if (!enforceMaxLength(text, 4000, 'Message')) return fail('too-long');
    if (!spamGuard('send_msg_spam', 8, 5000)) return fail('spam', '🚫 Slow down! You\'re sending too fast.');
    if (!cooldownCheck('send_msg', 600)) return fail('cooldown', '⏳ Slow down!');

    if (!chatData?.isGroup) {
        const fid = (chatData.participants || []).find(id => id !== myUID);
        const myBlockedList = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(`blocked_${myUID}`) || '[]');
        if (myBlockedList.includes(fid)) return fail('i-blocked-them', "You've blocked this user.");
        try {
            const BLOCK_TTL = 60000;
            window._blockCheckCache = window._blockCheckCache || {};
            const cached = window._blockCheckCache[fid];
            let blockedMe;
            if (cached && Date.now() - cached.at < BLOCK_TTL) {
                blockedMe = cached.blocked;
            } else {
                const theirDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, "users", fid));
                blockedMe = theirDoc.exists() && (theirDoc.data().blockedUsers || []).includes(myUID);
                window._blockCheckCache[fid] = { blocked: blockedMe, at: Date.now() };
            }
            if (blockedMe) return fail('they-blocked-me', "You can't message this user.");
        } catch(e){}
    }

    const msgData = { text, uid: window.myUID, timestamp: serverTimestamp() };
    if (opts.replyTo) msgData.replyTo = opts.replyTo;
    if (!chatData?.isGroup) {
        remove(ref(rtdb, `seen_by/${myUID}/${chatId}`)).catch(()=>{});
    }
    const _metaWrite = updateDoc(doc(db, "chats", chatId), {
        unreadBy: (chatData.participants || []).filter(id => id !== myUID),
        lastActivity: serverTimestamp(),
        lastMessageText: text.length > 100 ? text.slice(0, 100) + '…' : text,
        lastMessageSenderId: myUID
    }).catch((e) => console.warn('[send] chat meta update failed:', e));
    await addDoc(collection(db, `chats/${chatId}/messages`), msgData);
    _metaWrite.then(() => { try { window._maybeTrimChat?.(chatId); } catch (_) {} });
    if (window.EchoSFX) window.EchoSFX.play('send');
    if (!chatData?.isGroup) _updateStreakOnSend(chatId, chatData);
    if (typeof window._onOnboardingMessageSent === 'function') window._onOnboardingMessageSent(chatId, chatData, text);
    if (typeof window.trackQuestAction === 'function') {
        window.trackQuestAction(chatData?.isGroup ? 'groupMessagesSent' : 'messagesSent', 1).catch(() => {});
    }
    return { ok: true, text };
};

async function sendMessage() {
    const inputEl = document.getElementById('message-input');
    const text = inputEl.value.trim();
    if (!text || !currentChatId) return;
    if (!currentChatData) {
        console.warn('[sendMessage] currentChatData is null — chat not fully loaded yet');
        showCooldownToast('Chat not ready yet, try again in a second.');
        return;
    }
    const replyTo = replyToMsg
        ? { id: replyToMsg.id, text: replyToMsg.text, senderName: replyToMsg.senderName }
        : null;
    const chatId = currentChatId, chatData = currentChatData;
    inputEl.value = '';
    clearTyping();
    const res = await window._sendTextToChat(chatId, chatData, text, { replyTo });
    if (!res.ok) {
        if (!inputEl.value) inputEl.value = text;
        return;
    }
    clearReply();
}

let _fcChatId = null, _fcChatData = null, _fcUnsub = null, _fcUnread = 0, _fcRenderedIds = new Set();
let _fcLastSig = '';

const _fcEl = id => document.getElementById(id);

function _fcMessageHtml(msgId, m, chatData, isMe) {
    const esc = window.escHtml;

    if (m.type === 'system') {
        return { system: true, html: `<div class="fchat-system">${esc(m.text || '')}</div>` };
    }

    if (m.type === 'game') {
        return { card: true, html: window._gameCardHtml ? window._gameCardHtml(msgId, m.game || {}, chatData) : '' };
    }

    if (m.type === 'space_invite') {
        const isMemberSI = typeof window._spIsMember === 'function' && window._spIsMember(m.spaceId);
        const innerSI = isMemberSI
            ? `<button onclick="spGoToSpace('${window.escAttr(m.spaceId)}')" style="width:100%;margin-top:9px;background:rgba(34,197,94,0.1);border:1px solid rgba(34,197,94,0.25);color:#22c55e;padding:7px;border-radius:8px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;"><i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right"></i> Go to channels</button>`
            : (isMe
                ? `<div style="font-size:10px;color:#444455;margin-top:7px;text-align:center;">Waiting for them to join…</div>`
                : `<button onclick="spRedeemCode('${window.escAttr(m.code || '')}')" style="width:100%;margin-top:9px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#4f46e5,#6366f1);color:#fff;border:none;padding:7px;border-radius:8px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;"><i class="fa-solid fa-circle-check"></i> Join space</button>`);
        return { card: true, html: `<div style="background:#0d0d1a;border:1px solid rgba(99,102,241,0.3);border-radius:14px;padding:12px 14px;max-width:230px;${isMe?'margin-left:auto;':''}">
            <div style="font-size:9px;color:#4f46e5;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0.08em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:5px;"><i class="fa-solid fa-layer-group"></i> Space Invite</div>
            <div style="font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:#e8e8f0;">${esc(m.spaceName || 'Space')}</div>
            <div style="font-size:10px;color:#555566;margin-top:2px;">${m.memberCount || 0} member${m.memberCount === 1 ? '' : 's'} · ${m.channelCount || 0} channel${m.channelCount === 1 ? '' : 's'}</div>
            <div style="margin-top:7px;background:#08080f;border:1px solid #1e1e2e;border-radius:8px;padding:5px;text-align:center;color:#818cf8;font-family:monospace;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:0.09em;">${esc(m.code || '')}</div>
            ${innerSI}</div>` };
    }

    if (m.type === 'group_invite') {
        const done = m.accepted || m.declined;
        let inner = '';
        if (done) {
            inner = m.accepted
                ? `<div style="font-size:12px;color:#22c55e;font-weight:700;text-align:center;"><i class="fa-solid fa-circle-check"></i> Joined!</div>`
                : `<div style="font-size:12px;color:#555566;font-weight:700;text-align:center;">Declined</div>`;
        } else if (m.targetUID === window.myUID) {
            inner = `<div style="display:flex;gap:6px;margin-top:9px;">
                <button onclick="acceptGroupInvite('${m.groupId}','${m.inviteToken}','${msgId}','${_fcChatId}')" style="flex:1;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#4f46e5,#6366f1);color:#fff;border:none;padding:7px;border-radius:8px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;"><i class="fa-solid fa-circle-check"></i> Join</button>
                <button onclick="declineGroupInvite('${msgId}','${_fcChatId}')" style="flex:1;background:#0f0f1a;color:#888899;border:1px solid #1e1e2e;padding:7px;border-radius:8px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;">✕ No</button>
            </div>`;
        } else if (isMe) {
            inner = `<div style="font-size:10px;color:#444455;margin-top:7px;text-align:center;">Waiting for them to respond…</div>`;
        }
        return { card: true, html: `<div style="background:#0d0d1a;border:1px solid rgba(99,102,241,0.3);border-radius:14px;padding:12px 14px;max-width:230px;${isMe?'margin-left:auto;':''}">
            <div style="font-size:9px;color:#4f46e5;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0.08em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:5px;"><i class="fa-solid fa-user-group"></i> Group Invite</div>
            <div style="font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:#e8e8f0;">${esc(m.groupName || 'Group')}</div>
            <div style="font-size:10px;color:#555566;margin-top:2px;">${m.memberCount || 0} member${m.memberCount === 1 ? '' : 's'}</div>
            ${inner}</div>` };
    }

    if (m.type === 'poll') {
        const p = m.poll || {};
        const total = p.totalVotes || 0;
        const myVote = (p.options || []).findIndex(o => (o.voters || []).includes(window.myUID));
        const voted = myVote !== -1;
        const winner = voted ? Math.max(...(p.options || []).map(o => (o.voters || []).length)) : 0;
        const opts = (p.options || []).map((opt, i) => {
            const votes = (opt.voters || []).length;
            const pct = total > 0 ? Math.round((votes / total) * 100) : 0;
            const mine = i === myVote, win = voted && votes === winner && votes > 0;
            return `<div class="poll-option${mine?' voted':''}" onclick="window.votePoll('${msgId}','${_fcChatId}',${i})">
                <div class="poll-option-bar${win?' winner':''}" style="width:${voted?pct:0}%"></div>
                <div class="poll-option-inner">${mine?'<span class="poll-option-check">✓</span>':''}<span class="poll-option-label">${esc(opt.text)}</span>${voted?`<span class="poll-option-pct">${pct}%</span>`:''}</div>
            </div>`;
        }).join('');
        return { card: true, html: `<div class="poll-bubble" id="poll-card-${msgId}-fc">
            <div class="poll-badge"><i class="fa-solid fa-chart-simple"></i> Poll</div>
            <div class="poll-question">${esc(p.question || 'Poll')}</div>
            ${opts}
            <div class="poll-meta">${total} vote${total!==1?'s':''}${voted?' · tap to change':' · tap to vote'}</div>
        </div>` };
    }

    let content = esc(m.text || '');
    if (typeof window._emss_seed === 'function') window._emss_seed(msgId, m);

    if (m.imageGrid?.length) {
        content = typeof window._emss_renderGrid === 'function'
            ? window._emss_renderGrid(m.imageGrid, msgId)
            : m.imageGrid.map(b => `<img src="${b}" style="max-width:100%;border-radius:12px;margin-top:3px;">`).join('');
    } else if (m.imageBase64) {
        content = `<img src="${m.imageBase64}" style="max-width:100%;max-height:190px;border-radius:12px;margin-top:2px;cursor:pointer;display:block;" onclick="window._openInlineImageLightbox(this)">`;
    } else if (m.fileChunked) {
        content = _renderFileCard(m.fileName, m.fileSize, m.fileType, { chatId: _fcChatId, msgId });
    } else if (m.fileURL) {
        content = _renderFileCard(m.fileName, m.fileSize, m.fileType, { url: m.fileURL });
    } else if (m.gifUrl) {
        const _lib = m.gifLibId ? ` data-giflib="${window.escHtml(m.gifLibId)}" data-gifchunks="${m.gifLibChunks || 0}" data-gifsrc="${window.escHtml(m.gifUrl)}"` : '';
        content = `<img src="${m.gifPreview || m.gifUrl}"${_lib} loading="lazy" style="max-width:100%;max-height:170px;border-radius:12px;margin-top:2px;cursor:pointer;display:block;" onclick="window.open('${m.gifUrl}','_blank')">`;
        if (m.gifLibId) setTimeout(() => window._hydrateLibGifs && window._hydrateLibGifs(), 0);
    } else if (m.voiceBase64) {
        const audioId = 'voice-audio-' + msgId + '-fc';
        const secs = m.voiceDuration || 0;
        const dur = Math.floor(secs / 60) + ':' + String(secs % 60).padStart(2, '0');
        window._voiceCache = window._voiceCache || {};
        window._voiceCache[msgId] = m.voiceBase64;
        const bars = Array.from({ length: 18 }, () => 6 + Math.random() * 14)
            .map(h => `<div class="voice-waveform-bar" style="height:${h}px;"></div>`).join('');
        content = `<div class="voice-msg-bubble">
            <button class="voice-play-btn" data-audio="${audioId}" onclick="playVoiceMessage(this,'${audioId}')" title="Play"><i class="fa-solid fa-play"></i></button>
            <div class="voice-waveform">${bars}</div>
            <span class="voice-duration">${dur}</span>
            <audio id="${audioId}" class="voice-audio-player" src="${m.voiceBase64}" preload="none" style="display:none;"></audio>
        </div>`;
    }

    const reply = m.replyTo
        ? `<div class="reply-quote-block"><div class="reply-quote-name">${esc(m.replyTo.senderName)}</div><span class="reply-quote-text">${esc(m.replyTo.text || '[Image]')}</span></div>`
        : '';
    return { card: false, html: reply + content };
}

async function _fcResolveMeta(chatId, data) {
    if (data?.isGroup) return { name: data.groupName || data.name || 'Group', pfp: data.groupPfp || window._DEFAULT_PFP };
    const otherId = (data?.participants || []).find(id => id !== window.myUID);
    if (!otherId) return { name: 'Chat', pfp: window._DEFAULT_PFP };
    try {
        const snap = await getDoc(doc(db, 'users', otherId));
        const u = snap.exists() ? snap.data() : {};
        let pfp = window._DEFAULT_PFP;
        try { pfp = (await window.resolvePfp(u.pfp, otherId)) || window._DEFAULT_PFP; } catch(_) {}
        return { name: u.username || 'Chat', pfp, uid: otherId };
    } catch(_) { return { name: 'Chat', pfp: window._DEFAULT_PFP, uid: otherId }; }
}

window.openFloatingChat = async function (chatId, data, name) {
    if (!chatId || !window.myUID) return;
    const win = _fcEl('floating-chat');
    if (!win) return;

    const sameChat = _fcChatId === chatId;
    _fcChatId = chatId;
    window._fcCurrentChatId = chatId;
    win.classList.remove('hidden', 'fchat-min');
    _fcUnread = 0; _fcSetUnread();

    if (!sameChat) {
        if (_fcUnsub) { try { _fcUnsub(); } catch(_) {} _fcUnsub = null; }
        _fcRenderedIds = new Set();
        _fcLastSig = '';
        _fcEl('fchat-body').innerHTML = '<div style="color:#55556a;font-size:12px;text-align:center;padding:16px 0;">Loading…</div>';
        _fcEl('fchat-name').textContent = name || 'Chat';
        _fcEl('fchat-sub').textContent = '';
    }

    if (!data) {
        try {
            const cSnap = await getDoc(doc(db, 'chats', chatId));
            data = cSnap.exists() ? cSnap.data() : null;
        } catch(_) {}
    }
    if (!data) { _fcEl('fchat-body').innerHTML = '<div style="color:#f87171;font-size:12px;text-align:center;padding:16px 0;">Couldn\'t open that chat.</div>'; return; }
    _fcChatData = data;

    const meta = await _fcResolveMeta(chatId, data);
    if (_fcChatId !== chatId) return;
    _fcEl('fchat-name').textContent = name || meta.name;
    _fcEl('fchat-sub').textContent  = data.isGroup ? `${(data.participants||[]).length} members` : 'Direct message';
    _fcEl('fchat-pfp').src = meta.pfp || window._DEFAULT_PFP;

    if (!sameChat) _fcStartListener(chatId);
    try { markChatRead(chatId); } catch(_) {}
    setTimeout(() => _fcEl('fchat-input')?.focus(), 60);
};

function _fcStartListener(chatId) {
    if (_fcUnsub) { try { _fcUnsub(); } catch(_) {} _fcUnsub = null; }
    _fcUnsub = onSnapshot(
        query(collection(db, `chats/${chatId}/messages`), orderBy('timestamp', 'desc'), limit(30)),
        (snap) => {
            if (_fcChatId !== chatId) return;
            const body = _fcEl('fchat-body');
            if (!body) return;
            const docs = snap.docs.slice().reverse();
            if (docs.length) {
                window._chatLastMsgKey[chatId] = docs[docs.length - 1].id;
                window._chatLastMsgMine[chatId] = docs[docs.length - 1].data().uid === window.myUID;
            }
            const atBottom = body.scrollHeight - body.scrollTop - body.clientHeight < 60;
            const first = _fcRenderedIds.size === 0;

            const minimized = !!_fcEl('floating-chat')?.classList.contains('fchat-min');
            docs.forEach(d => {
                if (!first && !_fcRenderedIds.has(d.id) && d.data().uid !== window.myUID && minimized) _fcUnread++;
                _fcRenderedIds.add(d.id);
            });

            if (!docs.length) {
                body.innerHTML = '<div style="color:#55556a;font-size:12px;text-align:center;padding:16px 0;">No messages yet — say hi.</div>';
                _fcSetUnread();
                return;
            }

            const sig = docs.map(d => {
                const m = d.data();
                return d.id + ':' + (m.edited ? 1 : 0) + ':' +
                       (m.type === 'game' ? JSON.stringify(m.game || {})
                        : m.type === 'poll' ? JSON.stringify((m.poll?.options || []).map(o => (o.voters || []).length))
                        : m.type === 'group_invite' ? `${m.accepted ? 1 : 0}${m.declined ? 1 : 0}`
                        : '');
            }).join('|');
            if (sig === _fcLastSig) { _fcSetUnread(); return; }
            _fcLastSig = sig;

            body.innerHTML = '';
            let lastUid = null;
            docs.forEach(d => {
                const m = d.data();
                const isMe = m.uid === window.myUID;
                if (_fcChatData?.isGroup && !isMe && m.type !== 'system' && m.uid !== lastUid) {
                    const s = document.createElement('div');
                    s.className = 'fchat-sender';
                    s.textContent = _fcChatData?.names?.[m.uid] || '';
                    if (s.textContent) body.appendChild(s);
                }
                lastUid = m.uid;
                const built = _fcMessageHtml(d.id, m, _fcChatData, isMe);
                if (built.system) {
                    const s = document.createElement('div');
                    s.innerHTML = built.html;
                    body.appendChild(s.firstElementChild);
                    lastUid = null;
                } else if (built.card) {
                    const row = document.createElement('div');
                    row.className = 'fchat-card-row ' + (isMe ? 'me' : 'them');
                    row.innerHTML = built.html;
                    body.appendChild(row);
                } else {
                    const b = document.createElement('div');
                    b.className = 'fchat-bubble ' + (isMe ? 'me' : 'them');
                    b.innerHTML = built.html;
                    body.appendChild(b);
                }
            });
            if (atBottom || first) body.scrollTop = body.scrollHeight;
            _fcSetUnread();
            if (!_fcEl('floating-chat')?.classList.contains('fchat-min')) {
                try { markChatRead(chatId); } catch(_) {}
            }
        },
        (e) => {
            console.warn('[FloatChat] listener error:', e);
            const body = _fcEl('fchat-body');
            if (body) body.innerHTML = '<div style="color:#f87171;font-size:12px;text-align:center;padding:16px 0;">Lost connection to this chat.</div>';
        }
    );
}

function _fcSetUnread() {
    const el = _fcEl('fchat-unread');
    if (!el) return;
    el.textContent = _fcUnread > 99 ? '99+' : String(_fcUnread);
    el.classList.toggle('has', _fcUnread > 0);
}

window.closeFloatingChat = function () {
    if (_fcUnsub) { try { _fcUnsub(); } catch(_) {} _fcUnsub = null; }
    _fcChatId = null; _fcChatData = null; _fcUnread = 0; _fcRenderedIds = new Set(); _fcLastSig = '';
    window._fcCurrentChatId = null;
    _fcEl('floating-chat')?.classList.add('hidden');
};

window.popOutCurrentChat = function () {
    if (!window.currentChatId) { showCooldownToast?.('Open a chat first.'); return; }
    const nameEl = document.getElementById('current-chat-name');
    window.openFloatingChat(window.currentChatId, window.currentChatData, nameEl?.textContent?.trim());
};

async function _fcSend() {
    const input = _fcEl('fchat-input');
    const btn   = _fcEl('fchat-send');
    const text  = (input?.value || '').trim();
    if (!text || !_fcChatId) return;
    if (btn) btn.disabled = true;
    input.value = '';
    input.style.height = 'auto';
    const res = await window._sendTextToChat(_fcChatId, _fcChatData, text);
    if (btn) btn.disabled = false;
    if (!res.ok && !input.value) input.value = text;
    input?.focus();
}

(function _fcWire() {
    const win = document.getElementById('floating-chat');
    if (!win) return;
    document.getElementById('fchat-btn-close').onclick = () => window.closeFloatingChat();
    document.getElementById('fchat-btn-min').onclick = () => {
        const min = win.classList.toggle('fchat-min');
        document.getElementById('fchat-btn-min').textContent = min ? '▢' : '–';
        if (!min) { _fcUnread = 0; _fcSetUnread(); if (_fcChatId) { try { markChatRead(_fcChatId); } catch(_) {} } }
    };
    document.getElementById('fchat-btn-full').onclick = () => {
        if (!_fcChatId) return;
        const id = _fcChatId, data = _fcChatData, nm = document.getElementById('fchat-name').textContent;
        window.closeFloatingChat();
        if (typeof window.openChat === 'function') window.openChat(id, data, nm);
    };
    document.getElementById('fchat-send').onclick = _fcSend;
    const input = document.getElementById('fchat-input');
    input.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
        if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) { e.preventDefault(); _fcSend(); }
    });
    input.addEventListener('input', () => {
        input.style.height = 'auto';
        input.style.height = Math.min(input.scrollHeight, 88) + 'px';
    });
    (function bindDrag(tries) {
        if (typeof window._makeElDraggable === 'function') {
            window._makeElDraggable(win, document.getElementById('fchat-drag-handle'));
        } else if (tries > 0) {
            setTimeout(() => bindDrag(tries - 1), 150);
        }
    })(20);
})();

 

window.STREAK_TIERS = [
    { max: 3,        key: 'spark',     name: 'Spark',     color: '#f97316', glow: '#fdba74' },
    { max: 7,        key: 'gold',      name: 'Gold',      color: '#facc15', glow: '#fde68a' },
    { max: 14,       key: 'ice',       name: 'Ice',       color: '#38bdf8', glow: '#bae6fd' },
    { max: 30,       key: 'violet',    name: 'Violet',    color: '#a78bfa', glow: '#ddd6fe' },
    { max: 60,       key: 'legendary', name: 'Legendary', color: '#f472b6', glow: '#fbcfe8' },
    { max: 100,      key: 'inferno',   name: 'Inferno',   color: '#fb7185', glow: '#fecdd3' },
    { max: 200,      key: 'mythic',    name: 'Mythic',    color: '#fbbf24', glow: '#fde68a' },
    { max: Infinity, key: 'eternal',   name: 'Eternal',   color: '#f0abfc', glow: '#f5d0fe' }
];
window.streakTier = (n) => window.STREAK_TIERS.find(t => (n || 0) < t.max) || window.STREAK_TIERS[0];

const _saHex  = (h) => { const n = parseInt(String(h).slice(1), 16); return [(n >> 16) & 255, (n >> 8) & 255, n & 255]; };
const _saRgba = (c, a) => 'rgba(' + c[0] + ',' + c[1] + ',' + c[2] + ',' + a + ')';
const _saMix  = (a, b, t) => [Math.round(a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * t),
                              Math.round(a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * t),
                              Math.round(a[2] + (b[2] - a[2]) * t)];

 
function _saSprite(rgb) {
    const S = 64, c = document.createElement('canvas');
    c.width = c.height = S;
    const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
    const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(S / 2, S / 2, 0, S / 2, S / 2, S / 2);
    g.addColorStop(0,   _saRgba(rgb, 1));
    g.addColorStop(.45, _saRgba(rgb, .38));
    g.addColorStop(1,   _saRgba(rgb, 0));
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, S, S);
    return c;
}

function _saInjectCss() {
    if (document.getElementById('streak-anim-css')) return;
    const st = document.createElement('style');
    st.id = 'streak-anim-css';
    st.textContent = _SA_CSS;
    document.head.appendChild(st);
}

 
function _saFire(canvas, opts) {
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    const reduced = false;
    let W = 0, H = 0, cx = 0, baseY = 0;
    const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);

    const fromTier = opts.fromTier || opts.tier;
    const toTier   = opts.tier;
    const WHITE = [255, 244, 216], ASH = [104, 108, 124];

     
    const RAMP = 14;
    let ramp = [];
    function buildRamp(tierRgb, glowRgb) {
        ramp = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < RAMP; i++) {
            const u = i / (RAMP - 1);
            const c = u < 0.34 ? _saMix(WHITE, glowRgb, u / 0.34)
                    : u < 0.7  ? _saMix(glowRgb, tierRgb, (u - 0.34) / 0.36)
                               : _saMix(tierRgb, ASH, (u - 0.7) / 0.3);
            ramp.push(_saSprite(c));
        }
    }
    buildRamp(_saHex(fromTier.color), _saHex(fromTier.glow));

    function resize() {
        W = canvas.clientWidth; H = canvas.clientHeight;
        canvas.width = Math.floor(W * dpr); canvas.height = Math.floor(H * dpr);
        ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
        cx = W / 2;
        baseY = H * 0.53;
    }
    resize();
    window.addEventListener('resize', resize);

    const parts = [];
    const rnd = (a, b) => a + Math.random() * (b - a);
    const bell = () => (Math.random() + Math.random() - 1);

    let dead = false, burst = 0, evolveAt = -1, morph = 0;
    let health = 1, breaking = false;
    let intensity = 0;
    const started = performance.now();

    function spawn(n) {
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            const long = Math.random() < 0.13;
            parts.push({
                x: cx + bell() * opts.width, y: baseY + rnd(-4, 8),
                vx: bell() * 20, vy: rnd(-76, -38),
                life: 0, max: long ? rnd(1.3, 1.7) : rnd(0.85, 1.3),
                size: rnd(30, 70) * (long ? 0.78 : 1),
                seed: Math.random() * 99, spark: false
            });
        }
    }
    function spawnSparks(n) {
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2, s = rnd(120, 430);
            parts.push({
                x: cx, y: baseY - opts.height * 0.34,
                vx: Math.cos(a) * s, vy: Math.sin(a) * s * 0.7 - 50,
                life: 0, max: rnd(0.55, 1.15), size: rnd(5, 12),
                seed: Math.random() * 99, spark: true
            });
        }
    }

    let last = performance.now();
    function frame(now) {
        if (dead) return;
        const dt = Math.min((now - last) / 1000, 0.05); last = now;

        intensity = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (now - started) / 620));
        if (breaking) health = Math.max(0, health - dt / 1.5);

        if (evolveAt > 0 && morph < 1) {
            morph = Math.min(1, (now - evolveAt) / 800);
            buildRamp(_saMix(_saHex(fromTier.color), _saHex(toTier.color), morph),
                      _saMix(_saHex(fromTier.glow),  _saHex(toTier.glow),  morph));
        }

        spawn(Math.round((42 + burst * 30) * intensity * health));
        if (burst > 0) burst = Math.max(0, burst - dt * 2.2);

        for (let i = parts.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            const p = parts[i];
            p.life += dt;
            if (p.life >= p.max) { parts.splice(i, 1); continue; }
            const t = p.life / p.max;
            const heat = Math.max(0, (1 - t) * (p.spark ? 1 : health));
            if (p.spark) {
                p.vy += 250 * dt; p.vx *= 0.985;
            } else {
                p.vy -= (78 + 205 * heat) * dt;
                p.vy *= (1 - 0.36 * dt);
                p.vx += Math.sin(now * 0.0013 + p.seed) * 34 * dt;
                p.vx += Math.sin(now * 0.0061 + p.seed * 3) * 17 * dt * heat;
                p.vx += (cx - p.x) * 1.25 * dt;
            }
            p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt;
        }

        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
        for (const p of parts) {
            const t = p.life / p.max;
            const heat = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (1 - t) * (p.spark ? 1 : health)));
            const inOut = Math.min(1, t / 0.14);
            if (p.spark) {
                ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
                ctx.globalAlpha = inOut * 0.95;
                const s = p.size * (1 - t * 0.5);
                ctx.drawImage(ramp[0], p.x - s / 2, p.y - s / 2, s, s);
                continue;
            }
            const idx = Math.min(RAMP - 1, Math.floor((1 - heat) * RAMP));
            const smokey = heat < 0.22 && health < 0.92;
            ctx.globalCompositeOperation = smokey ? 'source-over' : 'screen';
            ctx.globalAlpha = inOut * (smokey ? 0.14 * (1 - t) : 0.62 * heat * heat);
            const s = p.size * (0.6 + t * (smokey ? 2.2 : 0.55));
            ctx.drawImage(ramp[idx], p.x - s / 2, p.y - s / 2, s, s);
        }

        if (health > 0.02) {
            ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
            ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
            const r = Math.max(1, opts.width * 2.8 * intensity);
            const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, baseY, 0, cx, baseY, r);
            g.addColorStop(0, _saRgba(_saMix(_saHex(toTier.glow), ASH, 1 - health), 0.34 * health * intensity));
            g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
            ctx.fillStyle = g;
            ctx.fillRect(cx - r, baseY - r, r * 2, r * 2);
        }

        ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
        ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
        requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    }
    if (!reduced) requestAnimationFrame(frame);

    return {
        evolve() { evolveAt = performance.now(); burst = 1; spawnSparks(70); },
        pulse()  { burst = 0.6; },
        die()    { breaking = true; },
        stop()   { dead = true; window.removeEventListener('resize', resize); }
    };
}

 
window.playStreakAnimation = function (opts) {
    opts = opts || {};
    const broken  = opts.kind === 'break';
    const evolved = opts.kind === 'evolve';
    const to = opts.to || 0, from = opts.from || 0;
    const tier     = window.streakTier(broken ? from : to);
    const fromTier = window.streakTier(broken ? from : (from || to));

    _saInjectCss();
    document.getElementById('streak-anim')?.remove();

    const wrap = document.createElement('div');
    wrap.id = 'streak-anim';
    wrap.className = (broken ? 'sa-broken ' : '') + (window.STREAK_FORCE_MOTION ? 'sa-force' : '');
    const c = _saHex(broken ? '#6b7280' : tier.color);
    wrap.style.setProperty('--sa-bg1',    _saRgba(c, broken ? .16 : .3));
    wrap.style.setProperty('--sa-glow-a', _saRgba(c, .5));
    wrap.style.setProperty('--sa-glow-b', broken ? '#8b8ba7' : tier.glow);

    wrap.innerHTML =
        '<canvas id="sa-canvas"></canvas>' +
        '<div class="sa-stage">' +
          (broken ? '<div class="sa-crack"><i class="fa-solid fa-heart-crack"></i> STREAK LOST</div>' : '') +
          '<div class="sa-count" id="sa-count">' + (broken ? from : (from || to)) + '</div>' +
          '<div class="sa-days">' + (broken ? 'days gone' : (to === 1 ? 'day' : 'days')) + '</div>' +
          (broken ? '' : '<div class="sa-tier">' +
              (evolved ? '<span class="sa-evo">EVOLVED</span> · ' : '') + tier.name + '</div>') +
          '<div class="sa-sub">' + (broken
              ? 'Send a message today to start a new one.'
              : (evolved ? 'Your flame changed.' : 'Kept alive for another day.')) + '</div>' +
          (broken && opts.revivesLeft > 0
            ? '<button class="sa-btn" id="sa-revive"><i class="fa-solid fa-fire"></i> Revive this streak</button>' +
              '<div class="sa-left">' + opts.revivesLeft + ' of 2 revives left this week</div>'
            : (broken ? '<div class="sa-left">No revives left this week — they reset Monday.</div>' : '')) +
        '</div>' +
        '<div class="sa-hint">click anywhere to close</div>';

    document.body.appendChild(wrap);

    const fire = _saFire(wrap.querySelector('#sa-canvas'), { tier, fromTier, width: 62, height: 190 });
    if (evolved)      setTimeout(() => fire.evolve(), 520);
    else if (!broken) setTimeout(() => fire.pulse(), 520);
    if (broken)       setTimeout(() => fire.die(), 900);

    if (!broken && to > from) {
        const el = wrap.querySelector('#sa-count');
        const steps = Math.min(to - from, 12);
        let i = 0;
        setTimeout(() => {
            const tick = setInterval(() => {
                i++;
                el.textContent = (i >= steps) ? to : Math.round(from + (to - from) * (i / steps));
                if (i >= steps) clearInterval(tick);
            }, 70);
        }, 600);
    }

    return new Promise(resolve => {
        let done = false;
        const close = () => {
            if (done) return; done = true;
            wrap.classList.add('out');
            setTimeout(() => { fire.stop(); wrap.remove(); resolve(); }, 450);
        };
        wrap.onclick = (e) => { if (e.target.id !== 'sa-revive') close(); };
        const rev = wrap.querySelector('#sa-revive');
        if (rev) rev.onclick = () => { close(); opts.onRevive && opts.onRevive(); };
        setTimeout(close, broken ? 7000 : (evolved ? 5200 : 3800));
    });
};


 

const STREAK_EXPIRY_MS = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

function _streakDayKey(d) {
    return d.getFullYear() + '-' + String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0') +
           '-' + String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
}
function _streakToday() { return _streakDayKey(new Date()); }
function _streakIsWeekend(d) { const w = d.getDay(); return w === 0 || w === 6; }

 
function _streakActiveMs(fromMs, toMs) {
    if (!fromMs || toMs <= fromMs) return 0;
    const HOUR = 3600000;
    let active = 0;
    const end = Math.min(toMs, fromMs + 21 * 24 * HOUR);
    for (let t = fromMs; t < end; t += HOUR) {
        if (!_streakIsWeekend(new Date(t))) active += Math.min(HOUR, end - t);
    }
    return active + (toMs > end ? toMs - end : 0);
}

 
function _streakExpired(s, nowMs) {
    if (!s || !s.count || s.frozen || window.streaksFrozen) return false;
    const from = s.lastMutualAt || _streakLegacyAnchor(s);
    if (!from) return false;
    return _streakActiveMs(from, nowMs || Date.now()) >= STREAK_EXPIRY_MS;
}

function _streakLegacyAnchor(s) {
    if (!s || !s.lastDate) return 0;
    const parts = String(s.lastDate).split('-').map(Number);
    if (parts.length !== 3 || !parts[0]) return 0;
    return new Date(parts[0], parts[1] - 1, parts[2], 23, 59, 59).getTime();
}

 
function _streakEvent(kind, from, to) {
    return { kind, from, to, at: Date.now() };
}
function _streakEventUnseen(s, uid) {
    const ev = s && s.lastEvent;
    if (!ev || !ev.at) return null;
    const seen = (s.seenEvent || {})[uid];
    return seen === ev.at ? null : ev;
}

 
async function _streakPlayEvent(chatId, s, ev) {
    if (!ev || !window.playStreakAnimation) return;
    const revivesLeft = _streakRevivesLeft(s);
    try {
        await window.playStreakAnimation({
            kind: ev.kind, from: ev.from, to: ev.to, revivesLeft,
            onRevive: () => window.reviveStreak(chatId)
        });
    } catch (_) {}
    try {
        await setDoc(doc(db, 'chats', chatId),
            { streak: { seenEvent: { [myUID]: ev.at } } }, { merge: true });
    } catch (e) { console.warn('[streak] could not mark event seen:', e); }
}

function _streakRevivesLeft(s) {
    if (!s) return 0;
    if (window.isAdmin) return 2;
    const weekStart = _streakWeekStart();
    const mine = (s.revives || {})[myUID];
    const used = (mine && mine.weekStart === weekStart) ? (mine.count || 0) : 0;
    return Math.max(0, 2 - used);
}

 
window._streakOnChatOpen = async (chatId, data) => {
    try {
        if (!chatId || !data || data.isGroup || !myUID) return;
        let s = data.streak;
        if (!s) return;

        if (_streakExpired(s, Date.now())) {
            const lost = s.count;
            s = {
                ...s, count: 0, brokenCount: lost,
                lastEvent: _streakEvent('break', lost, 0),
                seenEvent: {}
            };
            try {
                await setDoc(doc(db, 'chats', chatId), { streak: s }, { merge: true });
                if (currentChatId === chatId) { currentChatData.streak = s; _renderChatHeaderStreak(s); }
            } catch (e) { console.warn('[streak] could not burn expired streak:', e); }
        }

        const ev = _streakEventUnseen(s, myUID);
        if (ev) await _streakPlayEvent(chatId, s, ev);
    } catch (e) { console.warn('[streak] open check failed:', e); }
};

function _streakYesterday() { return _streakDayKey(new Date(Date.now() - 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000)); }
function _streakWeekStart() { const d = new Date(); const diff = (d.getUTCDay() === 0 ? 6 : d.getUTCDay() - 1); d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate() - diff); return d.toISOString().slice(0, 10); }
function getStreakVisual(count) {
    if (!count || count < 1) return null;
    if (count < 3)   return { emoji: '🔥', color: '#f97316', label: 'Spark' };
    if (count < 7)   return { emoji: '🔥', color: '#facc15', label: 'Gold' };
    if (count < 14)  return { emoji: '🔥', color: '#38bdf8', label: 'Ice' };
    if (count < 30)  return { emoji: '🔥', color: '#a78bfa', label: 'Violet' };
    if (count < 60)  return { emoji: '🔥', color: '#f472b6', label: 'Legendary' };
    if (count < 100) return {
        emoji: '⚡🔥', color: '#fb7185', label: 'Inferno', glow: true,
        gradient: 'linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(251,113,133,0.18), rgba(244,63,94,0.05))'
    };
    if (count < 200) return {
        emoji: '💎🔥', color: '#fbbf24', label: 'Mythic', glow: true,
        gradient: 'linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(251,191,36,0.2), rgba(217,119,6,0.06))'
    };
    return {
        emoji: '👑🔥', color: '#f0abfc', label: 'Eternal', glow: true,
        gradient: 'linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(240,171,252,0.22), rgba(129,140,248,0.12), rgba(56,189,248,0.12))'
    };
}

window.PUBLIC_PROFILE_FIELDS = [
    'uid','username','lower_username','pfp','pfp_chunked','pfp_chunk_count',
    'bio','customStatus','interests','role','badges','streakBadges','onboarding',

let _ppSig = null, _ppTimer = null;
window._syncPublicProfile = (uid, uData) => {
    if (!uid || !uData) return;
    const out = {};
    window.PUBLIC_PROFILE_FIELDS.forEach(k => { if (uData[k] !== undefined) out[k] = uData[k]; });
    let sig;
    try { sig = JSON.stringify(out); } catch (_) { return; }
    if (sig === _ppSig) return;
    _ppSig = sig;
    clearTimeout(_ppTimer);
    _ppTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        setDoc(doc(db, 'public_profiles', uid), out).catch(e =>
            console.warn('[public profile] mirror write failed:', e.code || e.message));
    }, 1200);
};

    const bio = (uData && typeof uData.bio === 'string') ? uData.bio.trim() : '';
    el.innerText = bio.slice(0, window.MAX_BIO_LEN);
    el.classList.toggle('hidden', !bio);
};

window._MUTUALS_SHOWN = 5;
window._renderProfileMutuals = async (targetUid) => {
    const wrap = document.getElementById('profile-page-mutuals');
    if (!wrap) return;
    wrap.classList.add('hidden');
    if (!window.myUID || !targetUid || window.myUID === targetUid) return;
    try {
        const [mineSnap, theirsSnap] = await Promise.all([
            getDocs(query(collection(db, 'follows'), where('followerId', '==', window.myUID))),
            getDocs(query(collection(db, 'follows'), where('followerId', '==', targetUid)))
        ]);
        const mine = new Set(mineSnap.docs.map(d => d.data().followingId));
        const mutualIds = theirsSnap.docs
            .map(d => d.data().followingId)
            .filter(id => mine.has(id) && id !== window.myUID && id !== targetUid);
        if (!mutualIds.length) return;

        const shown = mutualIds.slice(0, window._MUTUALS_SHOWN);
        const docs = await Promise.all(shown.map(id => getDoc(doc(db, 'users', id)).catch(() => null)));
        const people = docs
            .map((s, i) => (s && s.exists()) ? { uid: shown[i], ...s.data() } : null)
            .filter(Boolean);
        if (!people.length) return;

        const row = document.getElementById('profile-page-mutuals-row');
        const label = document.getElementById('profile-page-mutuals-label');
        label.innerText = `${mutualIds.length} mutual connection${mutualIds.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}`;
        row.innerHTML = '';

        const stack = document.createElement('div');
        stack.className = 'profile-mutuals-stack';
        people.forEach(p => {
            const img = document.createElement('img');
            img.className = 'profile-mutual-av';
            img.title = p.username || 'User';
            img.alt = p.username || 'User';
            img.onclick = () => window.openProfilePage(p.uid);
            img.src = window._DEFAULT_PFP || '';
            window.resolvePfp(p.pfp, p.uid)
                .then(src => { if (src) img.src = src; })
                .catch(() => {});
            if (typeof window._attachPfpFallback === 'function') {
                window._attachPfpFallback(img, p.uid, p.pfp === '__chunked_gif__', p.pfp || '');
            }
            stack.appendChild(img);
        });
        row.appendChild(stack);

        const names = people.slice(0, 2).map(p => p.username || 'User');
        const rest = mutualIds.length - names.length;
        const txt = document.createElement('div');
        txt.className = 'profile-mutuals-text';
        txt.append('Followed by ');
        names.forEach((n, i) => {
            if (i > 0) txt.append(rest > 0 ? ', ' : ' and ');
            const b = document.createElement('b'); b.innerText = n; txt.appendChild(b);
        });
        if (rest > 0) txt.append(` and ${rest} other${rest === 1 ? '' : 's'} you follow`);
        else txt.append(' — who you also follow');
        row.appendChild(txt);

        wrap.classList.remove('hidden');
    } catch (e) {
        if (typeof _dbShow === 'function') _dbShow(`⚠️ MUTUALS ERROR — ${e.message}`, 'warn');
    }
};

function _renderProfileStreakBadges(uData) {
    const el = document.getElementById('profile-page-streak-badges');
    if (!el) return;
    const earned = uData?.streakBadges || {};
    let html = STREAK_MILESTONES
        .filter(m => earned[m.id])
        .map((m, i) => `<span class="badge-streak badge-streak-${m.count}" style="animation-delay:${i * 70}ms" title="${m.label} — earned via a ${m.count}-day DM streak, kept forever"><span class="bs-emoji">${m.emoji}</span>${m.count}+ Streak</span>`)
        .join('');
    const ob = uData?.onboarding;
    if (ob?.completedTut && !window._newcomerExpired(ob)) {
        html += `<span class="badge-streak badge-streak-10" style="animation-delay:0ms" title="Newcomer — completed the first-login tutorial, badge fades after 7 days"><span class="bs-emoji">🌱</span>Newcomer</span>`;
    }
    el.innerHTML = html;
}
async function _awardStreakMilestones(chatId, cData, prevPeak, newPeak) {
    if (newPeak <= prevPeak) return;
    const newlyHit = STREAK_MILESTONES.filter(m => newPeak >= m.count && prevPeak < m.count);
    if (!newlyHit.length) return;
    const participants = cData.participants || [];
    for (const m of newlyHit) {
        for (const uid of participants) {
            try {
                await setDoc(doc(db, 'users', uid), {
                    streakBadges: { [m.id]: { count: m.count, chatId, earnedAt: serverTimestamp() } }
                }, { merge: true });
            } catch(e) { console.warn('[streak] badge award failed:', e); }
        }
        _postStreakSystemMessage(chatId, cData, `${m.emoji} Milestone unlocked — ${m.label}! This badge is yours to keep.`);
    }
    if (typeof window.trackQuestAction === 'function') {
        window.trackQuestAction('streakMilestoneHit', newlyHit.length).catch(() => {});
    }
}
async function _postStreakSystemMessage(chatId, cData, text) {
    try {
        const others = (cData.participants || []).filter(id => id !== myUID);
        await updateDoc(doc(db, 'chats', chatId), { unreadBy: others, lastActivity: serverTimestamp() });
        await addDoc(collection(db, `chats/${chatId}/messages`), { type: 'system', text, uid: 'system', timestamp: serverTimestamp() });
    } catch(e) { console.warn('[streak] system message failed:', e); }
}
async function _updateStreakOnSend(chatId, chatDataHint) {
    if (!chatId) return;
    try {
        if (window.streaksFrozen) return;
        const snap = await getDoc(doc(db, 'chats', chatId));
        if (!snap.exists()) return;
        const cData = snap.data();
        if (cData.isGroup) return;
        const s = cData.streak || {};
        if (s.frozen) return;

        const today = _streakToday(), yesterday = _streakYesterday();
        const otherId = (cData.participants || []).find(id => id !== myUID);
        let sentToday = (s.sentTodayDate === today) ? { ...(s.sentToday || {}) } : {};
        sentToday[myUID] = true;

        let count = s.count || 0, brokenCount = s.brokenCount || 0;
        const prevCount = count;
        const prevPeak = s.peakCount || 0;
        let expired = false;
        if (_streakExpired(s, Date.now())) { brokenCount = count; count = 0; expired = true; }
        let justStarted = false, advanced = false;
        if (sentToday[myUID] && sentToday[otherId] && s.lastDate !== today) {
            count += 1; brokenCount = 0; advanced = true; expired = false;
            if (prevCount === 0 && count === 1) justStarted = true;
        }
        const peakCount = Math.max(prevPeak, count);
        let ev = null;
        if (advanced) {
            const tierChanged = window.streakTier(count).key !== window.streakTier(prevCount).key;
            ev = _streakEvent(tierChanged ? 'evolve' : 'grow', prevCount, count);
        } else if (expired && prevCount > 0) {
            ev = _streakEvent('break', prevCount, 0);
        }
        const newStreak = {
            ...s, count, brokenCount, peakCount, sentToday, sentTodayDate: today,
            lastDate: (sentToday[myUID] && sentToday[otherId]) ? today : (s.lastDate || null),
            lastMutualAt: advanced ? Date.now() : (s.lastMutualAt || _streakLegacyAnchor(s) || null),
            ...(ev ? { lastEvent: ev, seenEvent: {} } : {}),
            revives: s.revives || {},
            remindersSentDate: (count > prevCount) ? null : (s.remindersSentDate || null),
            remindersSentWindows: (count > prevCount) ? [] : (s.remindersSentWindows || [])
        };
        await setDoc(doc(db, 'chats', chatId), { streak: newStreak }, { merge: true });
        if (currentChatId === chatId) { currentChatData.streak = newStreak; _renderChatHeaderStreak(newStreak); }
        if (justStarted) {
            const otherName = cData.names?.[otherId] || 'them';
            const myName = cData.names?.[myUID] || myUsername || 'You';
            _postStreakSystemMessage(chatId, cData, `🔥 ${myName} and ${otherName} started a streak!`);
        }
        if (ev) _streakPlayEvent(chatId, newStreak, ev);
        _awardStreakMilestones(chatId, cData, prevPeak, peakCount);
    } catch(e) { console.warn('[streak] update failed:', e); }
}
function _renderChatHeaderStreak(streak) {
    const el = document.getElementById('chat-streak-badge');
    if (!el) return;
    const v = getStreakVisual(streak?.count);
    if (!v) {
        if (streak?.brokenCount > 0) {
            el.style.display = 'inline-flex'; el.style.color = '#555566'; el.style.borderColor = '#333345';
            const _left = _streakRevivesLeft(streak);
            el.innerHTML = `<i class="fa-solid fa-heart-crack"></i> <span style="margin-left:3px;">Revive` +
                (_left > 0 ? ` (${_left})` : '') + `</span>`;
            el.onclick = () => window.reviveStreak(currentChatId);
        } else { el.style.display = 'none'; }
        return;
    }
    el.style.display = 'inline-flex'; el.style.color = v.color; el.style.borderColor = v.color + '55';
    el.style.background = v.gradient || 'rgba(255,255,255,0.03)';
    el.style.textShadow = v.glow ? `0 0 6px ${v.color}99` : 'none';
    el.style.boxShadow = v.glow ? `0 0 10px ${v.color}44` : 'none';
    el.innerHTML = `${v.emoji} <span style="margin-left:3px;">${streak.count}</span>`;
    el.onclick = () => showCooldownToast(`${v.emoji} ${streak.count}-day streak (${v.label}) — keep messaging daily to grow it!`);
}
function _checkStreakExpiry(chatId, data) {
    const streak = data?.streak;
    if (!streak?.count || window.streaksFrozen || streak.frozen) return;
    const anchor = streak.lastMutualAt || _streakLegacyAnchor(streak);
    if (!anchor) return;
    const left = STREAK_EXPIRY_MS - _streakActiveMs(anchor, Date.now());
    if (left <= 0 || left > 6 * 60 * 60 * 1000) return;
    const hrs = Math.max(1, Math.round(left / 3600000));
    showCooldownToast(`Your ${streak.count}-day streak ends in about ${hrs} hour${hrs === 1 ? '' : 's'} — send a message!`);
}

const _STREAK_REMINDER_WINDOWS = [
    { key: 'w1', hour: 13, minMin: 0,  minMax: 30 },
    { key: 'w2', hour: 17, minMin: 0,  minMax: 59 },
    { key: 'w3', hour: 20, minMin: 0,  minMax: 59 },
];
async function _scanStreakReminders() {
    if (window.streaksFrozen) return;
    const now = new Date();
    const win = _STREAK_REMINDER_WINDOWS.find(w => now.getHours() === w.hour && now.getMinutes() >= w.minMin && now.getMinutes() <= w.minMax);
    if (!win) return;
    const today = _streakToday();
    const chats = window._myDmChatsCache || [];
    for (const { id: chatId, data } of chats) {
        const streak = data.streak;
        if (!streak?.count || streak.frozen) continue;
        const anchor = streak.lastMutualAt || _streakLegacyAnchor(streak);
        const left = anchor ? (STREAK_EXPIRY_MS - _streakActiveMs(anchor, Date.now())) : STREAK_EXPIRY_MS;
        if (left <= 0 || left > 8 * 60 * 60 * 1000) continue;
        const sentToday = (streak.sentTodayDate === today) ? (streak.sentToday || {}) : {};
        const otherId = data.participants.find(id => id !== myUID);
        if (sentToday[myUID] && sentToday[otherId]) continue;
        const sentWindows = (streak.remindersSentDate === today) ? (streak.remindersSentWindows || []) : [];
        if (sentWindows.includes(win.key)) continue;
        try {
            await setDoc(doc(db, 'chats', chatId), { streak: { ...streak, remindersSentDate: today, remindersSentWindows: [...sentWindows, win.key] } }, { merge: true });
            await _postStreakSystemMessage(chatId, data, `⏳ Your ${streak.count}-day streak is about to expire — send a message!`);
        } catch(e) { console.warn('[streak] reminder scan failed:', e); }
    }
}
if (!window._streakReminderInterval) {
    window._streakReminderInterval = setInterval(_scanStreakReminders, 5 * 60 * 1000);
    setTimeout(_scanStreakReminders, 4000);
}

    }, { merge: true });

};

};

function _bqEl(id) {
    const activeView = document.querySelector('#view-admin.active, #view-subadmin.active');
    if (activeView) {
        const scoped = activeView.querySelector('#' + CSS.escape(id));
        if (scoped) return scoped;
    }
    return document.getElementById(id);
}
window._bqEl = _bqEl;

window._bqGrantSelectedUid = null;
window._bqInitGrantBox = function(_db) {
    const input = _bqEl('bq-grant-usersearch');
    const resultsEl = _bqEl('bq-grant-userresults');
    const badgeSel = _bqEl('bq-grant-badgeid');
    const statusEl = _bqEl('bq-grant-status');
    if (!input || input._bqWired) return;
    input._bqWired = true;


    (async () => {
        try {
            const snap = await getDocs(collection(_db, 'badge_defs'));
            badgeSel.innerHTML = '<option value="">Select a badge...</option>' +
                snap.docs.map(d => {
                    const b = d.data();
                    return `<option value="${d.id}">${b.emoji || ''} ${b.name || d.id}</option>`;
                }).join('');
        } catch (e) { console.warn('[badges] grant box: badge list load failed', e); }
    })();

    let debounceT = null;
    input.addEventListener('input', () => {
        clearTimeout(debounceT);
        const val = input.value.trim().toLowerCase();
        window._bqGrantSelectedUid = null;
        _bqEl('bq-grant-selected').style.display = 'none';
        input.style.display = 'block';
        if (!val) { resultsEl.innerHTML = ''; return; }
        debounceT = setTimeout(async () => {
            try {
                const snap = await getDocs(query(
                    collection(_db, 'users'),
                    where('lower_username', '>=', val),
                    where('lower_username', '<=', val + '\uf8ff'),
                    limit(8)
                ));
                if (snap.empty) {
                    resultsEl.innerHTML = `<div style="font-size:11px;color:#444455;padding:4px 2px;">No users found</div>`;
                    return;
                }
                resultsEl.innerHTML = snap.docs.map(d => {
                    const u = d.data();
                    const uid = u.uid || d.id;
                    const uname = (u.username || u.lower_username || uid).replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
                    return `<button onclick='window._bqSelectGrantUser("${uid}", "${uname}")' class="ap-pill" style="font-size:11px;text-align:left;justify-content:flex-start;">${uname}</button>`;
                }).join('');
            } catch (e) {
                console.warn('[badges] grant box: user search failed', e);
                resultsEl.innerHTML = `<div style="font-size:11px;color:#f87171;padding:4px 2px;">Search failed</div>`;
            }
        }, 250);
    });
}

    _bqEl('bq-grant-selected-name').textContent = uname;

    const input = _bqEl('bq-grant-usersearch');
    input.style.display = 'block';
    input.value = '';
    input.focus();
};
window._bqDoGrant = async function() {
    const statusEl = _bqEl('bq-grant-status');
    const uid = window._bqGrantSelectedUid;
    const badgeId = _bqEl('bq-grant-badgeid').value;
    if (!uid) { statusEl.style.color = '#f87171'; statusEl.textContent = 'Select a user first.'; return; }
    if (!badgeId) { statusEl.style.color = '#f87171'; statusEl.textContent = 'Select a badge first.'; return; }
    statusEl.style.color = '#818cf8'; statusEl.textContent = 'Granting...';
    try {
        await window.grantBadge(uid, badgeId, 'admin-panel');
        statusEl.style.color = '#4ade80'; statusEl.textContent = 'Badge granted ✓';
    } catch (e) {
        console.warn('[badges] grant failed', e);
        statusEl.style.color = '#f87171'; statusEl.textContent = 'Grant failed — check permissions/rules.';
    }
};
window._bqDoRevoke = async function() {
    const statusEl = _bqEl('bq-grant-status');
    const uid = window._bqGrantSelectedUid;
    const badgeId = _bqEl('bq-grant-badgeid').value;
    if (!uid) { statusEl.style.color = '#f87171'; statusEl.textContent = 'Select a user first.'; return; }
    if (!badgeId) { statusEl.style.color = '#f87171'; statusEl.textContent = 'Select a badge first.'; return; }
    statusEl.style.color = '#818cf8'; statusEl.textContent = 'Revoking...';
    try {
        await window.revokeBadge(uid, badgeId);
        statusEl.style.color = '#4ade80'; statusEl.textContent = 'Badge revoked ✓';
    } catch (e) {
        console.warn('[badges] revoke failed', e);
        statusEl.style.color = '#f87171'; statusEl.textContent = 'Revoke failed — check permissions/rules.';
    }
};

window._activeQuestDefsCache = null;
window._activeQuestDefsCacheAt = 0;
async function _getActiveQuestDefs() {
    const now = Date.now();
    if (window._activeQuestDefsCache && (now - window._activeQuestDefsCacheAt) < 60000) return window._activeQuestDefsCache;
    try {
        const q = query(collection(db, 'quest_defs'), where('status', '==', 'active'));
        const snap = await getDocs(q);
        window._activeQuestDefsCache = snap.docs.map(d => d.data());
        window._activeQuestDefsCacheAt = now;
    } catch (e) { console.warn('[quests] fetch active failed:', e); window._activeQuestDefsCache = window._activeQuestDefsCache || []; }
    return window._activeQuestDefsCache;
}
window.trackQuestAction = async function(actionType, amount = 1) {
    if (!myUID || !actionType) return;
    const quests = (await _getActiveQuestDefs()).filter(q => q.type === 'action' && q.actionType === actionType);
    for (const q of quests) await _bumpQuestProgress(q, amount);
};
window.trackQuestTime = async function(minutesElapsed = 1) {
    if (!myUID) return;
    const quests = (await _getActiveQuestDefs()).filter(q => q.type === 'time');
    for (const q of quests) await _bumpQuestProgress(q, minutesElapsed);
};
const QUEST_BUMP_COOLDOWN_MS  = 2500;
const QUEST_SPAM_STRIKE_LIMIT = 4;
const QUEST_SPAM_WINDOW_MS    = 10000;
const QUEST_LOCKOUT_MS        = 5 * 60 * 1000;
const _questBumpInFlight = new Set();
const _questSpamStrikes  = new Map();
const _questLockToastAt  = new Map();
async function _bumpQuestProgress(questDef, amount) {
    if (_questBumpInFlight.has(questDef.id)) return;
    _questBumpInFlight.add(questDef.id);
    try {
        const uRef = doc(db, 'users', myUID);
        const uSnap = await getDoc(uRef);
        const existing = uSnap.exists() ? (uSnap.data().questProgress?.[questDef.id]) : null;
        if (existing?.completedAt) return;

        const now = Date.now();

        if (existing?.lockedUntil && now < existing.lockedUntil) {
            const lastToast = _questLockToastAt.get(questDef.id) || 0;
            if (now - lastToast > 10000) {
                _questLockToastAt.set(questDef.id, now);
                const minsLeft = Math.ceil((existing.lockedUntil - now) / 60000);
                showCooldownToast?.(`🚫 "${questDef.name}" is locked for spamming — ${minsLeft}m left.`);
            }
            return;
        }

        if (existing?.lastBumpAt && (now - existing.lastBumpAt) < QUEST_BUMP_COOLDOWN_MS) {
            const strikeRec = _questSpamStrikes.get(questDef.id);
            const rec = (strikeRec && (now - strikeRec.firstAt) < QUEST_SPAM_WINDOW_MS)
                ? strikeRec
                : { count: 0, firstAt: now };
            rec.count++;
            _questSpamStrikes.set(questDef.id, rec);

            if (rec.count >= QUEST_SPAM_STRIKE_LIMIT) {
                _questSpamStrikes.delete(questDef.id);
                const lockedUntil = now + QUEST_LOCKOUT_MS;
                await setDoc(uRef, {
                    questProgress: { [questDef.id]: { lockedUntil } }
                }, { merge: true });
                addDoc(collection(db, 'quest_spam_flags'), {
                    uid: myUID, questId: questDef.id, at: serverTimestamp(),
                    strikeCount: QUEST_SPAM_STRIKE_LIMIT
                }).catch(() => {});
                const mins = Math.round(QUEST_LOCKOUT_MS / 60000);
                showCooldownToast?.(`🚫 Slow down — "${questDef.name}" locked for ${mins}m for spamming.`);
            }
            return;
        }

        _questSpamStrikes.delete(questDef.id);

        const newProgress = (existing?.progress || 0) + amount;
        const completed = newProgress >= questDef.goal;
        await setDoc(uRef, {
            questProgress: { [questDef.id]: {
                progress: Math.min(newProgress, questDef.goal),
                startedAt: existing?.startedAt || serverTimestamp(),
                lastBumpAt: now,
                ...(completed ? { completedAt: serverTimestamp() } : {})
            } }
        }, { merge: true });
        if (completed && questDef.reward?.badgeId) {
            if (window.EchoSFX) window.EchoSFX.play('powerup');
            if (questDef.autoGrant) {
                await window.grantBadge(myUID, questDef.reward.badgeId, `quest-auto:${questDef.id}`);
                showCooldownToast?.(`🏆 Quest complete — "${questDef.name}"! Badge awarded.`, true);
            } else {
                await addDoc(collection(db, 'badge_award_requests'), {
                    uid: myUID, badgeId: questDef.reward.badgeId, questId: questDef.id,
                    status: 'pending', createdAt: serverTimestamp()
                });
                showCooldownToast?.(`🏆 Quest complete — "${questDef.name}"! Badge pending approval.`, true);
            }
        }
    } catch (e) { console.warn('[quests] progress bump failed:', e); }
    finally { _questBumpInFlight.delete(questDef.id); }
}

window._myQuestListOpen = false;
window._toggleMyQuestList = function() {
    window._myQuestListOpen = !window._myQuestListOpen;
    const el = document.getElementById('profile-page-quest-list');
