window._renderMyQuestList = async function(uid, uData) {
    const el = document.getElementById('profile-page-quest-list');
    if (!el) return;
    if (!window.myUID || uid !== window.myUID) { el.style.display = 'none'; el.innerHTML = ''; return; }
    try {
        const quests = (await _getActiveQuestDefs()).filter(q => !q.hidden);
        el.style.display = window._myQuestListOpen ? 'flex' : 'none';
        if (!quests.length) { el.innerHTML = ''; return; }
        const progress = uData?.questProgress || {};
        el.innerHTML = `<div style="font-size:12px;font-weight:800;color:#818cf8;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.05em;margin-bottom:2px;"><i class="fa-solid fa-compass"></i> Active Quests</div>` +
            quests.map(q => {
                const p = progress[q.id];
                const done = !!p?.completedAt;
                const cur = Math.min(p?.progress || 0, q.goal);
                const pct = Math.round((cur / q.goal) * 100);
                return `<div style="background:#0a0a17;border:1px solid #1a1a2e;border-radius:10px;padding:10px 12px;">
                    <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:#e2e2f0;">
                        <span>${q.emoji || '🧭'} ${window.escHtml(q.name)}</span>
                        <span style="font-size:11px;color:${done ? '#4ade80' : '#818cf8'};">${done ? '✓ Done' : `${cur}/${q.goal}`}</span>
                    </div>
                    ${q.desc ? `<div style="font-size:11px;color:#666677;margin-top:2px;">${window.escHtml(q.desc)}</div>` : ''}
                    <div style="height:5px;background:#1a1a2e;border-radius:3px;margin-top:6px;overflow:hidden;">
                        <div style="height:100%;width:${done ? 100 : pct}%;background:${done ? '#22c55e' : '#6366f1'};border-radius:3px;"></div>
                    </div>
                </div>`;
            }).join('');
    } catch (e) { console.warn('[quests] profile list render failed', e); }
};


async function _renderExtraProfileBadges(uData, containerEl) {
    const el = containerEl || document.getElementById('profile-page-streak-badges');
    if (!el) return;
    const earned = uData?.badges || {};
    const ids = Object.keys(earned);
    if (!ids.length) return;
    try {
        const defs = window._badgeDefCache || (window._badgeDefCache = {});
        const missing = ids.filter(id => !defs[id]);
        for (const id of missing) {
            const snap = await getDoc(doc(db, 'badge_defs', id));
            if (snap.exists()) defs[id] = snap.data();
        }
        const now = Date.now();
        const html = ids
            .map(id => defs[id])
            .filter(d => d && (d.kind !== 'seasonal' || (
                (!d.startAt || d.startAt.toMillis?.() <= now) && (!d.endAt || d.endAt.toMillis?.() >= now)
            )))
            .map(d => `<span class="badge-streak badge-streak-50" title="${d.desc || d.name}"><span class="bs-emoji">${d.emoji || '🏅'}</span>${d.name}</span>`)
            .join('');
        el.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', html);
    } catch (e) { console.warn('[badges] render extra failed:', e); }
}

    _renderExtraProfileBadges(uData);
};

window.reviveStreak = async (chatId) => {
    chatId = chatId || currentChatId;
    if (!chatId) return;
    try {
        const snap = await getDoc(doc(db, 'chats', chatId));
        if (!snap.exists()) return;
        const cData = snap.data();
        const s = cData.streak || {};
        if (!s.brokenCount || s.brokenCount < 1) return showCooldownToast('No broken streak to revive here.');

        const weekStart = _streakWeekStart();
        const revives = { ...(s.revives || {}) };
        const mine = (revives[myUID]?.weekStart === weekStart) ? revives[myUID] : { count: 0, weekStart };
        if (!isAdmin && mine.count >= 2) return showCooldownToast('No revives left this week for this chat.');
        if (!isAdmin) { mine.count += 1; revives[myUID] = mine; }

        const restored = {
            ...s, count: s.brokenCount, brokenCount: 0, lastDate: _streakToday(), revives,
            lastMutualAt: Date.now(), lastEvent: null, seenEvent: {}
        };
        await setDoc(doc(db, 'chats', chatId), { streak: restored }, { merge: true });
        if (currentChatId === chatId) { currentChatData.streak = restored; _renderChatHeaderStreak(restored); }
        const left = _streakRevivesLeft(restored);
        showCooldownToast(`Streak revived — back to ${restored.count} days. ` +
            (isAdmin ? '' : `${left} revive${left === 1 ? '' : 's'} left this week.`), true);
    } catch(e) { console.warn('[streak] revive failed:', e); showCooldownToast('Could not revive streak.'); }
};

 
function _previewTextForMessage(m) {
    if (!m) return null;
    if (m.imageBase64) return '\uD83D\uDCF7 Photo';
    if (m.gifUrl)      return '\uD83C\uDFAC GIF';
    if (m.voiceBase64 || m.voiceChunked) return '\uD83C\uDF99\uFE0F Voice message';
    if (m.fileName)    return '\uD83D\uDCCE ' + m.fileName;
    if (typeof m.text === 'string') return m.text.length > 100 ? m.text.slice(0, 100) + '\u2026' : m.text;
    return null;
}

window.deleteMessage = async (msgId, chatId, senderName) => {
    if (!msgId || !chatId) return;
    const mRef = doc(db, `chats/${chatId}/messages`, msgId);
    let deleted = null;
    try { const mSnap = await getDoc(mRef); if (mSnap.exists()) deleted = mSnap.data(); else return; } catch (_) {}
    try {
        await deleteDoc(mRef);
        await addDoc(collection(db, `chats/${chatId}/messages`), {
            type: 'system', text: `${senderName} deleted a message`, uid: 'system', timestamp: serverTimestamp()
        });
    } catch(e) { console.warn('Delete failed:', e); return; }

     
    try {
        const wasPreview = _previewTextForMessage(deleted);
        if (wasPreview === null) return;
        const cRef = doc(db, 'chats', chatId);
        const cSnap = await getDoc(cRef);
        if (!cSnap.exists()) return;
        const cData = cSnap.data();
        if (cData.lastMessageText !== wasPreview) return;
        if (deleted.uid && cData.lastMessageSenderId && cData.lastMessageSenderId !== deleted.uid) return;
        await updateDoc(cRef, { lastMessageText: 'Deleted message', lastMessageDeleted: true });
    } catch (_) {   }
};

let typingTimeout = null;
let typingUnsub = null;

let _lastTypingWriteAt = 0;
function setTyping() {
    if (!currentChatId || !myUID) return;
    clearTimeout(typingTimeout);
    typingTimeout = setTimeout(() => clearTyping(), 3000);
    const now = Date.now();
    if (now - _lastTypingWriteAt < 1500) return;
    _lastTypingWriteAt = now;
    setDoc(doc(db, 'typing', currentChatId), { [myUID]: { name: myUsername, ts: now } }, { merge: true }).catch(() => {});
}
function clearTyping() {
    clearTimeout(typingTimeout);
    if (!currentChatId || !myUID) return;
    const update = {}; update[myUID] = null;
    setDoc(doc(db, 'typing', currentChatId), update, { merge: true }).catch(() => {});
}
function watchTyping(chatId) {
    if (typingUnsub) { typingUnsub(); typingUnsub = null; }
    typingUnsub = onSnapshot(doc(db, 'typing', chatId), (snap) => {
        const val = snap.exists() ? snap.data() : {};
        const now = Date.now();
        const others = Object.entries(val).filter(([uid, v]) => uid !== myUID && v && (now - v.ts) < 5000);
        const bar = document.getElementById('typing-bar');
        const nameEl = document.getElementById('typing-name');
        const verbEl = document.getElementById('typing-verb');
        if (others.length > 0) {
            const names = others.map(([, v]) => v.name).filter(Boolean);
            if (names.length === 1) {
                nameEl.innerText = names[0];
                if (verbEl) verbEl.innerText = ' is typing';
            } else if (names.length === 2) {
                nameEl.innerText = names[0] + ' and ' + names[1];
                if (verbEl) verbEl.innerText = ' are typing';
            } else {
                nameEl.innerText = names[0] + ' and ' + (names.length - 1) + ' others';
                if (verbEl) verbEl.innerText = ' are typing';
            }
            const wasHidden = bar.classList.contains('hidden');
            bar.classList.remove('hidden');
            if (wasHidden) {
                const bub = bar.querySelector('.typing-bubble');
                if (bub) { bub.style.animation = 'none'; void bub.offsetWidth; bub.style.animation = ''; }
            }
        } else {
            bar.classList.add('hidden');
        }
    });
}

document.getElementById('message-input').addEventListener('input', () => {
    if (document.getElementById('message-input').value.length > 0) setTyping();
    else clearTyping();
});

document.getElementById('file-input').addEventListener('change', (e) => {
    const _selFiles = Array.from(e.target.files || []);
    if (!_selFiles.length || !currentChatId) return;
    e.target.value = '';
    _selFiles.forEach(f => _sendPickedMedia(f));
});
function _sendPickedMedia(file) {
    if (window._isTimedOut && window._isTimedOut()) { showCooldownToast('⏳ You are timed out and cannot send media right now.'); return; }
    if (!file.type?.startsWith('image/')) { _sendChunkedFile(file); return; }
    if (currentChatData?.isGroup && !isGroupOwner()) {
        if (!cooldownCheck('send_image', 5000)) {
            showCooldownToast('Wait a moment before sending another image.');
            return;
        }
    }
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = function(event) {
        const img = new Image();
        img.onload = async function() {
            const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
            const MAX_WIDTH = 1024;
            let width = img.width, height = img.height;
            if (width > MAX_WIDTH) { height *= MAX_WIDTH / width; width = MAX_WIDTH; }
            canvas.width = width; canvas.height = height;
            const cctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
            cctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
            cctx.imageSmoothingQuality = 'high';
            cctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, width, height);
            let base64String = canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.72);
            for (const q of [0.6, 0.5, 0.4]) {
                if (base64String.length < 900000) break;
                base64String = canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', q);
            }
            await updateDoc(doc(db, "chats", currentChatId), {
                unreadBy: currentChatData.participants.filter(id => id !== myUID),
                lastActivity: serverTimestamp(),
                lastMessageText: '📷 Photo',
                lastMessageSenderId: myUID
            });
            await addDoc(collection(db, `chats/${currentChatId}/messages`), { text: "Sent an image", imageBase64: base64String, uid: window.myUID, timestamp: serverTimestamp() });
            if (typeof window.trackQuestAction === 'function') {
                window.trackQuestAction('imagesShared', 1).catch(() => {});
            }
        }
        img.src = event.target.result;
    }
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
}
window._sendPickedMedia = _sendPickedMedia;

function _todayLocalStr() {
    const d = new Date();
    return `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

}

function _setUploadQueueRow(rowId, label, pct, state, etaText) {
    _ensureUploadQueuePanel();
    let row = document.getElementById(rowId);
    if (!row) {
        row = document.createElement('div');
        row.id = rowId;
        row.style.cssText = 'margin:4px 0;';
        row.innerHTML = '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:6px;"><span class="uq-name" style="overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;max-width:150px;"></span><span class="uq-pct" style="color:#a78bfa;font-weight:700;flex-shrink:0;"></span><button type="button" class="uq-cancel" style="background:none;border:none;color:#888899;font-size:14px;cursor:pointer;padding:0 2px;line-height:1;flex-shrink:0;" title="Cancel upload">✕</button></div><div style="background:#0f0f1a;border-radius:6px;height:5px;margin-top:3px;overflow:hidden;"><div class="uq-bar" style="height:100%;background:#a78bfa;width:0%;transition:width 0.2s;"></div></div><div class="uq-eta" style="font-size:10px;color:#666677;margin-top:2px;text-align:right;"></div>';
        row.querySelector('.uq-cancel').onclick = () => window._cancelUpload(rowId);
        document.getElementById('upload-queue-rows').appendChild(row);
    }
    row.querySelector('.uq-name').textContent = label;
    const pctText = { failed: 'Failed', cancelling: 'Cancelling…', cancelled: 'Cancelled' }[state];
    row.querySelector('.uq-pct').textContent = pctText || (pct >= 100 ? 'Done' : pct + '%');
    row.querySelector('.uq-bar').style.width = Math.min(100, pct) + '%';
    row.querySelector('.uq-bar').style.background = state === 'failed' ? '#f87171' : (state ? '#888899' : '#a78bfa');
    row.querySelector('.uq-eta').textContent = etaText || '';
    const cancelBtn = row.querySelector('.uq-cancel');
    if (cancelBtn) cancelBtn.style.display = (!state && pct < 100) ? '' : 'none';
}
function _removeUploadQueueRow(rowId, delay) {
    setTimeout(() => {
        const row = document.getElementById(rowId);
        if (row) row.remove();
        _hideUploadQueuePanelIfEmpty();
    }, delay == null ? 1000 : delay);
}
async function _refreshUploadQuotaBadge() {
    try {
        const qRef = doc(db, 'upload_quota', myUID);
        const qSnap = await getDoc(qRef);
        const today = _todayLocalStr();
        const used = (qSnap.exists() && qSnap.data().date === today) ? (qSnap.data().bytesUsed || 0) : 0;
        const remaining = Math.max(0, DAILY_UPLOAD_LIMIT_BYTES - used);
        const usageEl = document.getElementById('upload-queue-usage');
        if (usageEl) usageEl.textContent = `${(used / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(0)}MB / ${DAILY_UPLOAD_LIMIT_BYTES / 1024 / 1024}MB used today`;
        return { used, remaining };
    } catch (_) { return null; }
}
window._checkMyUploadUsage = async function() {
    const q = await _refreshUploadQuotaBadge();
    if (!q) return;
    _showUploadQueuePanel();
    const panel = document.getElementById('upload-queue-panel');
    clearTimeout(panel._peekT);
    const rows = document.getElementById('upload-queue-rows');
    if (!rows.children.length) {
        panel._peekT = setTimeout(() => _hideUploadQueuePanelIfEmpty(), 2500);
    }
};

async function _sha256Hex(str) {
    const buf = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', new TextEncoder().encode(str));
    return Array.from(new Uint8Array(buf)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
}
const RKX_ITERS = 120000;

async function _rkxKey(recoveryKey, salt) {
    const base = await crypto.subtle.importKey('raw', new TextEncoder().encode(recoveryKey), 'PBKDF2', false, ['deriveKey']);
    return crypto.subtle.deriveKey(
        { name: 'PBKDF2', salt: salt, iterations: RKX_ITERS, hash: 'SHA-256' },
        base, { name: 'AES-GCM', length: 256 }, false, ['encrypt', 'decrypt']);
}

async function _rkxSeal(recoveryKey, uid, email, password, altEmail) {
    const salt = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(16));
    const iv   = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(12));
    const key  = await _rkxKey(recoveryKey, salt);
    const ct   = await crypto.subtle.encrypt({ name: 'AES-GCM', iv: iv },
                    key, new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(altEmail ? { email: email, password: password, altEmail: altEmail } : { email: email, password: password })));
    return {
        uid: uid,
        enc:  _pwvB64e(ct),
        salt: _pwvB64e(salt),
        iv:   _pwvB64e(iv),
        iters: RKX_ITERS,
        updatedAt: serverTimestamp()
    };
}

async function _rkxOpen(recoveryKey, data) {
    if (!data) return null;
    if (data.enc) {
        try {
            const key = await _rkxKey(recoveryKey, _pwvB64d(data.salt));
            const pt  = await crypto.subtle.decrypt({ name: 'AES-GCM', iv: _pwvB64d(data.iv) }, key, _pwvB64d(data.enc));
            return JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(pt));
        } catch (_) { return null; }
    }
    if (data.email && data.password) return { email: data.email, password: data.password, legacy: true };
    return null;
}
function _genRecoveryKey() {
    const alphabet = 'ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789';
    const bytes = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(25));
    let raw = '';
    for (let i = 0; i < 25; i++) raw += alphabet[bytes[i] % alphabet.length];
    return raw.match(/.{1,5}/g).join('-');
}
function _rkResetSteps() {
    ['rk-step-confirm', 'rk-step-warning', 'rk-step-none', 'rk-step-show'].forEach(id => document.getElementById(id).classList.add('hidden'));
}
function _rkOpen() {
    _rkResetSteps();
    document.getElementById('rk-step-confirm').classList.remove('hidden');
    document.getElementById('rk-confirm-password').value = '';
    document.getElementById('rk-confirm-msg').classList.add('hidden');
    document.getElementById('recovery-key-modal').style.display = 'flex';
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
}


async function _rkCreateFor(uid, email, password, altEmail) {
    const rkSnap = await getDoc(doc(db, 'recovery_keys', uid));
    const oldHash = rkSnap.exists() ? rkSnap.data().hash : null;
    const key = _genRecoveryKey();
    const hash = await _sha256Hex(key);
    await setDoc(doc(db, 'recovery_lookup', hash), await _rkxSeal(key, uid, email, password, altEmail));
    await setDoc(doc(db, 'recovery_keys', uid), { key, hash, updatedAt: serverTimestamp() });
    if (oldHash && oldHash !== hash) { try { await deleteDoc(doc(db, 'recovery_lookup', oldHash)); } catch (_) {} }
    try { await updateDoc(doc(db, 'users', uid), { hasRecoveryKey: true }); } catch (_) {}
    document.getElementById('rk-nudge')?.remove();
    return key;
}

async function _rkReseal(password, altEmail) {
    const user = auth.currentUser;
    if (!user || !password) return false;
    const rkSnap = await getDoc(doc(db, 'recovery_keys', user.uid));
    if (!rkSnap.exists() || !rkSnap.data().key || !rkSnap.data().hash) return false;
    const { key, hash } = rkSnap.data();
    await setDoc(doc(db, 'recovery_lookup', hash), await _rkxSeal(key, user.uid, user.email, password, altEmail));
    return true;
}

const _isNoEmail = (e) => /@echo\.local$/i.test(String(e || ''));

function _rkLayer(innerHtml) {
    const wrap = document.createElement('div');
    wrap.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:2147483000;background:rgba(3,3,10,0.86);backdrop-filter:blur(6px);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:16px;';
    wrap.innerHTML = '<div style="background:#0d0d1a;border:1px solid #1e1e2e;border-radius:16px;width:min(460px,100%);max-height:92vh;overflow-y:auto;padding:22px;box-shadow:0 24px 64px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);color:#c4c4d4;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5;">' + innerHtml + '</div>';
    document.body.appendChild(wrap);
    return wrap;
}

function _rkReveal(key, opts) {

    return new Promise((resolve) => {
        const esc = window.escHtml || (s => String(s));
        const lead = opts.lead || 'Your account is ready. One more thing, and it matters.';
        const noEmailLine = opts.noEmail
            ? '<p style="margin:0 0 10px;color:#fbbf24;font-weight:700;">You didn’t add an email, so this key is the <u>only</u> way back in if you forget your password.</p>'
            : '';
        const el = _rkLayer(
            '<div style="text-align:center;font-size:26px;color:#fbbf24;margin-bottom:6px;"><i class="fa-solid fa-key"></i></div>' +
            '<div style="font-size:17px;font-weight:900;color:#e2e2f0;text-align:center;margin-bottom:6px;">Save your recovery key</div>' +
            '<p style="margin:0 0 10px;text-align:center;">' + esc(lead) + '</p>' +
            noEmailLine +
            '<p style="margin:0 0 12px;">If you ever forget your password, this key gets you back in. <b style="color:#f87171;">Staff only reset passwords for people they know personally, and only with your login PIN.</b> Everyone else won\u2019t get one, so if you lose this key and your password, expect the account to be gone.</p>' +
            '<div id="rkr-key" style="background:#08080f;border:1px solid #2a2a3e;border-radius:10px;padding:14px 8px;font-family:monospace;font-size:clamp(12px,3.9vw,16px);color:#22d3ee;text-align:center;letter-spacing:0.5px;word-break:break-all;margin-bottom:10px;user-select:all;">' + esc(key) + '</div>' +
            '<div style="display:flex;gap:8px;margin-bottom:12px;">' +
                '<button type="button" id="rkr-copy" class="btn-ghost" style="flex:1;font-size:12px;padding:9px;"><i class="fa-solid fa-clipboard"></i> Copy key</button>' +
                '<button type="button" id="rkr-doc" class="btn-ghost" style="flex:1;font-size:12px;padding:9px;"><i class="fa-solid fa-file-lines"></i> Open a Google Doc</button>' +
            '</div>' +
            '<p style="margin:0 0 12px;font-size:12px;color:#9a9ab0;"><b style="color:#e2e2f0;">Do this now:</b> copy the key, open a Google Doc, paste it in, and name the doc something like “EchoSpace recovery key”. A screenshot works too. You can also see it again later in Settings → Recovery Key while you’re logged in.</p>' +
            '<label style="display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:flex-start;cursor:pointer;margin-bottom:12px;font-size:12px;color:#e2e2f0;font-weight:700;">' +
                '<input type="checkbox" id="rkr-ok" style="margin-top:2px;width:16px;height:16px;flex-shrink:0;"> I saved my recovery key somewhere I can find it later.' +
            '</label>' +
            '<button type="button" id="rkr-go" class="btn-primary w-full" disabled style="opacity:0.45;">Continue</button>'
        );
        const ok = el.querySelector('#rkr-ok'), go = el.querySelector('#rkr-go');
        el.querySelector('#rkr-copy').onclick = (e) => {
            try { navigator.clipboard?.writeText(key); } catch (_) {}
            e.currentTarget.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-check"></i> Copied';
        };
        el.querySelector('#rkr-doc').onclick = () => {
            try { navigator.clipboard?.writeText(key); } catch (_) {}
            window._allowNextOpen = true;
            window.open('https://docs.new', '_blank', 'noopener');
        };
        ok.onchange = () => { go.disabled = !ok.checked; go.style.opacity = ok.checked ? '1' : '0.45'; };
        go.onclick = () => { if (!ok.checked) return; el.remove(); resolve(); };
    });
}
window._rkReveal = _rkReveal;

function _rkForceNewPassword(mode) {
    const byAdmin = mode === 'admin';
    if (document.getElementById('rkf-layer')) return;
    const el = _rkLayer(
        '<div style="text-align:center;font-size:26px;color:#818cf8;margin-bottom:6px;"><i class="fa-solid fa-lock"></i></div>' +
        '<div style="font-size:17px;font-weight:900;color:#e2e2f0;text-align:center;margin-bottom:6px;">Choose a new password</div>' +
        '<p style="margin:0 0 12px;text-align:center;">' + (byAdmin
            ? 'An admin reset your password. Choose your own now \u2014 the one they gave you stops working.'
            : 'You got in with your recovery key. Set a new password now. You\u2019ll get a fresh recovery key right after.') + '</p>' +
        '<input id="rkf-pw" type="password" placeholder="New password" class="inp mb-2" autocomplete="new-password">' +
        '<input id="rkf-pw2" type="password" placeholder="Type it again" class="inp mb-2" autocomplete="new-password">' +
        '<button type="button" id="rkf-go" class="btn-primary w-full">Save new password</button>' +
        '<p id="rkf-msg" class="text-xs mt-2 font-bold" style="display:none;"></p>'
    );
    el.id = 'rkf-layer';
    const msg = el.querySelector('#rkf-msg');
    const say = (t, good) => { msg.textContent = t; msg.style.color = good ? '#22c55e' : '#f87171'; msg.style.display = 'block'; };
    el.querySelector('#rkf-go').onclick = async (e) => {
        const btn = e.currentTarget;
        const pw = el.querySelector('#rkf-pw').value, pw2 = el.querySelector('#rkf-pw2').value;
        if (pw.length < 6) return say('Use at least 6 characters.');
        if (pw !== pw2) return say('Those don’t match.');
        const user = auth.currentUser;
        if (!user) return say('You were signed out. Log in with your recovery key again.');
        btn.disabled = true; say('Saving…', true);
        try {
            const { updatePassword } = await import("https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.11.0/firebase-auth.js");
            await updatePassword(user, pw);
        } catch (err) {
            btn.disabled = false;
            if (String(err && err.code) === 'auth/requires-recent-login')
                return say('That took too long. Log out and log in with your recovery key again.');
            return say('Could not change it: ' + ((err && err.message) || err));
        }
        sessionStorage.removeItem('echo_rk_forcepw');
        try { await _pwvStore(user.uid, pw); } catch (_) {}
        try { window._rsHavePassword && window._rsHavePassword(pw, user.uid); } catch (_) {}
        if (byAdmin) {
            try { await _rkReseal(pw); } catch (_) {}
            try { await updateDoc(doc(db, 'users', user.uid), { mustChangePassword: deleteField() }); } catch (_) {}
            el.remove();
            return;
        }
        let key = null;
        try { key = await _rkCreateFor(user.uid, user.email, pw); } catch (err) { console.warn('[rk] rotate after recovery failed', err); }
        el.remove();
        if (key) await _rkReveal(key, { lead: 'Password changed. Your old recovery key no longer works — here is your new one.', noEmail: _isNoEmail(user.email) });
    };
}
window._rkForceNewPassword = _rkForceNewPassword;

window._addEmailOpen = function () {
    if (document.getElementById('addemail-layer')) return;
    const el = _rkLayer(
        '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:8px;">' +
            '<div style="font-size:16px;font-weight:900;color:#e2e2f0;"><i class="fa-solid fa-envelope"></i> Add an email</div>' +
            '<button type="button" id="ae-x" style="background:#1a1a2e;border:1px solid #2a2a3e;color:#888899;width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;">✕</button>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<p style="margin:0 0 12px;">With an email you can reset your password if you forget it. Use your <b>personal</b> email — school accounts often block the link.</p>' +
        '<input id="ae-email" type="email" placeholder="you@example.com" class="inp mb-2" autocomplete="email">' +
        '<input id="ae-pw" type="password" placeholder="Your current password" class="inp mb-2" autocomplete="current-password">' +
        '<button type="button" id="ae-go" class="btn-primary w-full">Send confirmation link</button>' +
        '<p id="ae-msg" class="text-xs mt-2 font-bold" style="display:none;"></p>'
    );
    el.id = 'addemail-layer';
    const msg = el.querySelector('#ae-msg');
    const say = (t, good) => { msg.textContent = t; msg.style.color = good ? '#22c55e' : '#f87171'; msg.style.display = 'block'; };
    el.querySelector('#ae-x').onclick = () => el.remove();
    el.querySelector('#ae-go').onclick = async (e) => {
        const btn = e.currentTarget;
        const email = el.querySelector('#ae-email').value.trim();
        const pw = el.querySelector('#ae-pw').value;
        if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email) || _isNoEmail(email)) return say('Enter a real email address.');
        if (_isBlockedEmail(email)) return say(_BLOCKED_EMAIL_MSG);
        if (!pw) return say('Enter your current password.');
        const user = auth.currentUser;
        if (!user) return say('You are signed out.');
        btn.disabled = true; say('Checking…', true);
        try {
            await reauthenticateWithCredential(user, EmailAuthProvider.credential(user.email, pw));
        } catch (_) { btn.disabled = false; return say('Incorrect password.'); }
        try {
            const { verifyBeforeUpdateEmail } = await import("https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.11.0/firebase-auth.js");
            await verifyBeforeUpdateEmail(user, email);
        } catch (err) {
            btn.disabled = false;
            const c = String(err && err.code);
            if (c === 'auth/email-already-in-use') return say('That email is already used by another account.');
            if (c === 'auth/invalid-email') return say('That email address is not valid.');
            return say('Could not send the link: ' + ((err && err.message) || err));
        }
        const lower = (window.myUsername || '').toLowerCase();
        if (lower) { try { await setDoc(doc(db, 'usernames', lower), { pendingEmail: email, uid: user.uid }, { merge: true }); } catch (_) {} }
        try { await _rkReseal(pw, email); } catch (_) {}
        try { await updateDoc(doc(db, 'users', user.uid), { pendingRealEmail: email }); } catch (_) {}
        el.querySelector('#ae-go').remove();
        say('Link sent to ' + email + '. Open it to finish. Until you do, nothing changes and you keep logging in the same way.', true);
    };
};

async function _noEmailSync(user, meData) {
    if (!user || !meData) return;
    if (_isNoEmail(user.email) || !_isNoEmail(meData.email)) return;
    try { await updateDoc(doc(db, 'users', user.uid), { email: user.email, pendingRealEmail: deleteField() }); } catch (_) {}
    if (meData.lower_username) {
        try { await setDoc(doc(db, 'usernames', meData.lower_username), { email: user.email, uid: user.uid, pendingEmail: deleteField() }, { merge: true }); } catch (_) {}
    }
    document.getElementById('noemail-banner')?.remove();
}

async function _schoolEmailSync(user, meData) {
    if (!user || !meData) return;
    if (_isBlockedEmail(user.email) || !_isBlockedEmail(meData.email)) return;
    try { await updateDoc(doc(db, 'users', user.uid), { email: user.email, pendingRealEmail: deleteField() }); } catch (_) {}
    if (meData.lower_username) {
        try { await setDoc(doc(db, 'usernames', meData.lower_username), { email: user.email, uid: user.uid, pendingEmail: deleteField() }, { merge: true }); } catch (_) {}
    }
}

let _rsPw = null, _rsPin = null;
const RS_ITERS = 200000;

async function _rsKey(pin, salt) {
    const base = await crypto.subtle.importKey('raw', new TextEncoder().encode(String(pin)), 'PBKDF2', false, ['deriveKey']);
    return crypto.subtle.deriveKey({ name: 'PBKDF2', salt, iterations: RS_ITERS, hash: 'SHA-256' },
        base, { name: 'AES-GCM', length: 256 }, false, ['encrypt', 'decrypt']);
}
async function _rsSealWrite() {
    const user = auth.currentUser;
    if (!user || !_rsPw || !_rsPin) return;
    if (_rsPw.uid !== user.uid || _rsPin.uid !== user.uid) return;
    try {
        const salt = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(16));
        const iv = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(12));
        const key = await _rsKey(_rsPin.pin, salt);
        const ct = await crypto.subtle.encrypt({ name: 'AES-GCM', iv }, key, new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify({ p: _rsPw.pw })));
        await setDoc(doc(db, 'reset_seal', user.uid), {
            enc: _pwvB64e(ct), iv: _pwvB64e(iv), salt: _pwvB64e(salt), iters: RS_ITERS, at: serverTimestamp()
        });
    } catch (e) { console.warn('[reset seal] not written:', e && (e.code || e.message)); }
}
window._rsHavePassword = (pw, uid) => { if (pw && uid) { _rsPw = { pw, uid }; _rsSealWrite(); } };
window._rsHavePin = (pin, uid) => { if (pin && uid) { _rsPin = { pin, uid }; _rsSealWrite(); } };
window._rsDropSeal = async () => {
    _rsPin = null;
    const u = auth.currentUser;
    if (u) { try { await deleteDoc(doc(db, 'reset_seal', u.uid)); } catch (_) {} }
};

async function _rsOpen(pin, data) {
    try {
        const key = await _rsKey(pin, _pwvB64d(data.salt));
        const pt = await crypto.subtle.decrypt({ name: 'AES-GCM', iv: _pwvB64d(data.iv) }, key, _pwvB64d(data.enc));
        return JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(pt)).p || null;
    } catch (_) { return null; }
}

async function _pinHashFor(uid, pin) {
    const key = await crypto.subtle.importKey('raw', new TextEncoder().encode(pin), 'PBKDF2', false, ['deriveBits']);
    const bits = await crypto.subtle.deriveBits({ name: 'PBKDF2', hash: 'SHA-256', salt: new TextEncoder().encode('echospace-pin:' + uid), iterations: 150000 }, key, 256);
    return [...new Uint8Array(bits)].map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
}

async function _rsAdminUnlock(uid, pin) {
    const aRef = doc(db, 'reset_attempts', uid);
    let n = 0;
    try { const s = await getDoc(aRef); if (s.exists()) n = Number(s.data().n) || 0; } catch (_) {}
    if (n >= 5) throw new Error('Locked after 5 wrong PINs. It clears when they log in with their password, or when the owner resets it.');
    try { await setDoc(aRef, { n: n + 1, at: serverTimestamp() }); }
    catch (_) { throw new Error('Too fast. Wait a second and try again.'); }
    const h = await _pinHashFor(uid, pin);
    try {
        const b = writeBatch(db);
        b.set(doc(db, 'reset_proof', uid), { hash: h, by: auth.currentUser.uid, at: serverTimestamp() });
        b.set(aRef, { n: 0, at: serverTimestamp() });
        await b.commit();
    } catch (e) {
        if (e && e.code === 'permission-denied') {
            const left = Math.max(0, 4 - n);
            throw new Error('Wrong PIN, or this account has no login PIN. ' + left + (left === 1 ? ' try' : ' tries') + ' left.');
        }
        throw e;
    }
    let snap;
    try { snap = await getDoc(doc(db, 'reset_seal', uid)); }
    catch (e) { throw new Error('PIN accepted, but the reset data could not be read (' + (e.code || e.message) + ').'); }
    if (!snap.exists()) throw new Error('PIN accepted, but this account has no saved reset data yet. It is created the next time they log in with their password and PIN.');
    const pw = await _rsOpen(pin, snap.data());
    if (!pw) throw new Error('PIN accepted, but the saved reset data would not open.');
    return pw;
}

async function _rsAdminReset(uid, targetData, pin, newPassword, systemMessage, setMsg) {
    let current;
    try { current = await _rsAdminUnlock(uid, pin); }
    catch (e) { setMsg(e.message || String(e), 'text-red-500'); return false; }
    try {
        const { updatePassword } = await import("https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.11.0/firebase-auth.js");
        const realEmail = await resolveLoginEmail(targetData.email || ((targetData.lower_username || '') + '@echo.local'));
        const cred = await signInWithEmailAndPassword(secondaryAuth, realEmail, current);
        await updatePassword(cred.user, newPassword);
        await signOut(secondaryAuth);
    } catch (e) {
        try { await signOut(secondaryAuth); } catch (_) {}
        const c = String(e && e.code);
        if (c === 'auth/invalid-credential' || c === 'auth/wrong-password') {
            setMsg('The PIN was right, but the saved password is out of date. They need to log in once with their current password and PIN, then this works.', 'text-red-500');
        } else setMsg('Error: ' + (e.message || e), 'text-red-500');
        return false;
    }
    const upd = { mustChangePassword: true, pendingPassword: null };
    if (systemMessage) upd.systemMessage = systemMessage;
    try { await updateDoc(doc(db, 'users', uid), upd); } catch (_) {}
    window.logAdminAction && window.logAdminAction('password_reset_pin', { target: targetData.username, systemMessageSet: !!systemMessage });
    setMsg('✅ "' + targetData.username + '" can log in with the password you typed. They’ll have to choose their own right after.', 'text-green-500');
    return true;
}

async function _rkxUpgrade(uid, rkData) {
    if (!rkData || !rkData.key || !rkData.hash) return;
    const ref = doc(db, 'recovery_lookup', rkData.hash);
    const snap = await getDoc(ref);
    if (!snap.exists()) return;
    const d = snap.data();
    if (d.enc) return;
    if (!d.email || !d.password) return;
    await setDoc(ref, await _rkxSeal(rkData.key, uid, d.email, d.password));
    console.info('[rk] recovery lookup upgraded to encrypted payload');
}
async function _rkSyncFlag() {
    const user = auth.currentUser;
    if (!user) return null;
    try {
        const rkSnap = await getDoc(doc(db, 'recovery_keys', user.uid));
        const has = rkSnap.exists();
        if (has) { try { await _rkxUpgrade(user.uid, rkSnap.data()); } catch (_) {} }
        const meRef = doc(db, 'users', user.uid);
        const meSnap = await getDoc(meRef);
        const me = meSnap.exists() ? meSnap.data() : null;
        if (me && me.hasRecoveryKey !== has) {
            await updateDoc(meRef, { hasRecoveryKey: has });
        }
        sessionStorage.removeItem('echo_rk_forcepw');
        if (me && me.mustChangePassword) _rkForceNewPassword('admin');
        try {
            const ra = await getDoc(doc(db, 'reset_attempts', user.uid));
            if (ra.exists() && Number(ra.data().n) > 0) await setDoc(ra.ref, { n: 0, at: serverTimestamp() });
        } catch (_) {}
        if (me) {
            await _noEmailSync(user, me);
            await _schoolEmailSync(user, me);
            if (_isBlockedEmail(user.email)) _schoolEmailGate();
            if (_isNoEmail(user.email) && _isNoEmail(me.email)) {
                _noEmailBanner();
                const _ae = document.getElementById('st-add-email-btn');
                if (_ae) _ae.style.display = '';
            }
        }
        if (!has && me && !me.rkPrompted) {
            _rkNudge(true);
            try { await updateDoc(meRef, { rkPrompted: true }); } catch (_) {}
        }
        return has;
    } catch (e) { console.warn('[rk] flag sync failed:', e?.code || e); return null; }
}
window._rkSyncFlag = _rkSyncFlag;

function _rkNudge(force) {
    try {
        if (document.getElementById('rk-nudge')) return;
        const last = Number(localStorage.getItem('rk_nudge_at') || 0);
        if (!force && Date.now() - last < 7 * 24 * 3600 * 1000) return;
        const el = document.createElement('div');
        el.id = 'rk-nudge';
        el.innerHTML =
            '<i class="fa-solid fa-key" style="color:#fbbf24;"></i>' +
            '<span><b>No recovery key yet.</b><br>Without one, a lost password means a lost account.</span>' +
            '<button class="btn-primary" style="font-size:11px;padding:7px 13px;white-space:nowrap;">Set one up</button>' +
            '<button class="rk-nudge-x" aria-label="Dismiss">✕</button>';
        const close = () => { localStorage.setItem('rk_nudge_at', String(Date.now())); el.remove(); };
        el.querySelector('.btn-primary').onclick = () => { close(); window._recoveryKeyStartRegen(); };
        el.querySelector('.rk-nudge-x').onclick = close;
        document.body.appendChild(el);
    } catch (_) {}
}

window._loginWithRecoveryKey = async function() {
    const raw = document.getElementById('recovery-key-input').value.trim().toUpperCase();
    const msgEl = document.getElementById('recovery-login-msg');
    if (!raw) { msgEl.textContent = 'Enter your recovery key.'; msgEl.className = 'text-red-500 text-xs text-center font-bold'; msgEl.classList.remove('hidden'); return; }
    try {
        const hash = await _sha256Hex(raw);
        const snap = await getDoc(doc(db, 'recovery_lookup', hash));
        if (!snap.exists()) {
            msgEl.textContent = 'Invalid recovery key, or it was already used to generate a newer one.';
            msgEl.className = 'text-red-500 text-xs text-center font-bold'; msgEl.classList.remove('hidden');
            return;
        }
        const creds = await _rkxOpen(raw, snap.data());
        if (!creds) {
            msgEl.textContent = 'That key matched, but its stored data could not be read. Use "Request Admin Reset" below.';
            msgEl.className = 'text-red-500 text-xs text-center font-bold'; msgEl.classList.remove('hidden');
            return;
        }
        localStorage.removeItem('echo_face_pending');
        window._faceGateInFlight = false;
        sessionStorage.removeItem('echo_rk_forcepw');
        try {
            await signInWithEmailAndPassword(auth, creds.email, creds.password);
        } catch (_e1) {
            if (!creds.altEmail) throw _e1;
            await signInWithEmailAndPassword(auth, creds.altEmail, creds.password);
        }
        if (creds.legacy) {
            try { await setDoc(doc(db, 'recovery_lookup', hash), await _rkxSeal(raw, snap.data().uid, creds.email, creds.password)); } catch (_) {}
        }
    } catch (e) {
        msgEl.textContent = 'Login failed: ' + e.message;
        msgEl.className = 'text-red-500 text-xs text-center font-bold'; msgEl.classList.remove('hidden');
    }
};

window._submitContactRequest = async function() {
    const catEl = document.getElementById('contact-request-category');
    const msgEl = document.getElementById('contact-request-message');
    const statusEl = document.getElementById('contact-request-status');
    const btn = document.getElementById('contact-request-submit-btn');
    const message = msgEl.value.trim();
    if (!message) {
        statusEl.textContent = 'Write a message first.';
        statusEl.style.color = '#f87171';
        statusEl.classList.remove('hidden');
        return;
    }
    if (!cooldownCheck('contact_request', 60000)) {
        statusEl.textContent = 'Please wait a bit before sending another request.';
        statusEl.style.color = '#fbbf24';
        statusEl.classList.remove('hidden');
        return;
    }
    btn.disabled = true; btn.style.opacity = '0.5';
    try {
        await addDoc(collection(db, 'contact_requests'), {
            uid: myUID,
            username: myUsername || 'Unknown',
            category: catEl.value,
            message,
            status: 'open',
            timestamp: serverTimestamp()
        });
        msgEl.value = '';
        statusEl.textContent = 'Sent — thanks, we\'ll take a look.';
        statusEl.style.color = '#22c55e';
        statusEl.classList.remove('hidden');
    } catch (e) {
        statusEl.textContent = 'Couldn\'t send: ' + e.message;
        statusEl.style.color = '#f87171';
        statusEl.classList.remove('hidden');
    } finally {
        btn.disabled = false; btn.style.opacity = '';
        setTimeout(() => statusEl.classList.add('hidden'), 4000);
    }
};

let _myTicketsUnsub = null;

    if (_myTicketsUnsub || !window.myUID) return;
    const box = document.getElementById('my-tickets-list');
    try {
        _myTicketsUnsub = onSnapshot(
            query(collection(db, 'contact_requests'), where('uid', '==', window.myUID)),
            (snap) => _renderMyTickets(snap),
            (err) => {
                console.warn('[Tickets] listener error:', err);
                if (box) box.innerHTML = `<div style="font-size:11px;color:#f87171;">Couldn't load your requests (${err.code || err.message}).</div>`;

        );

};

function _ticketTime(v) {
    if (!v) return '';
    const d = v.toDate ? v.toDate() : new Date(v);
    return isNaN(d) ? '' : d.toLocaleString([], { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
}

function _renderMyTickets(snap) {
    const box = document.getElementById('my-tickets-list');
    const badge = document.getElementById('my-tickets-badge');
    if (!box) return;
    const esc = window.escHtml || (x => String(x));
    const catLabels = { bug: '🐞 Bug report', privacy: '🔒 Privacy', deletion: '🗑️ Deletion', copyright: '©️ Copyright', support: '🛠️ Support', other: '💬 Other' };
    const docs = snap.docs.slice().sort((a, b) => {
        const ta = a.data().timestamp?.toMillis ? a.data().timestamp.toMillis() : 0;
        const tb = b.data().timestamp?.toMillis ? b.data().timestamp.toMillis() : 0;
        return tb - ta;
    });
    if (!docs.length) {
        box.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:12px;color:#444455;">You haven\'t sent any requests yet.</div>';
        if (badge) badge.classList.add('hidden');
        return;
    }
    let unread = 0;
    box.innerHTML = '';
    docs.forEach(d => {
        const r = d.data();
        const replies = Array.isArray(r.replies) ? r.replies : [];
        const resolved = r.status === 'resolved';
        const lastStaff = [...replies].reverse().find(x => x.from === 'staff');
        if (lastStaff && !resolved) unread++;
        const thread = [
            `<div style="align-self:flex-start;max-width:88%;background:#0d0d1a;border-left:2px solid #22d3ee;border-radius:6px;padding:5px 8px;">
                <div style="font-size:9px;font-weight:800;color:#22d3ee;margin-bottom:2px;">You · ${_ticketTime(r.timestamp)}</div>
                <div style="font-size:11px;color:#c8c8d8;white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-word;">${esc(r.message || '')}</div>
            </div>`
        ].concat(replies.map(rep => {
            const staff = rep.from === 'staff';
            return `<div style="align-self:${staff ? 'flex-end' : 'flex-start'};max-width:88%;background:${staff ? 'rgba(99,102,241,0.12)' : '#0d0d1a'};border-${staff ? 'right' : 'left'}:2px solid ${staff ? '#818cf8' : '#22d3ee'};border-radius:6px;padding:5px 8px;">
                <div style="font-size:9px;font-weight:800;color:${staff ? '#818cf8' : '#22d3ee'};margin-bottom:2px;">${staff ? '🛡️ EchoSpace Team' : 'You'} · ${_ticketTime(rep.ts)}</div>
                <div style="font-size:11px;color:#c8c8d8;white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-word;">${esc(rep.text || '')}</div>
            </div>`;
        })).join('');

        box.innerHTML += `<div style="background:#07070f;border:1px solid ${resolved ? '#1e1e2e' : 'rgba(34,211,238,0.2)'};border-radius:10px;padding:10px 12px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;">
            <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;">
                <span style="font-size:11px;font-weight:800;color:#888899;">${catLabels[r.category] || r.category || 'Request'}</span>
                <span style="font-size:9px;font-weight:800;padding:2px 7px;border-radius:8px;background:${resolved ? 'rgba(34,197,94,0.12)' : 'rgba(251,191,36,0.12)'};border:1px solid ${resolved ? 'rgba(34,197,94,0.3)' : 'rgba(251,191,36,0.3)'};color:${resolved ? '#22c55e' : '#fbbf24'};">${resolved ? 'RESOLVED' : (lastStaff ? 'STAFF REPLIED' : 'AWAITING STAFF')}</span>
            </div>
            <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;">${thread}</div>
            ${resolved ? `<div style="font-size:10px;color:#444455;">This request was closed. Send a new one if you still need help.</div>` : `
            <div style="display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:flex-end;">
                <textarea id="tk-reply-${d.id}" rows="1" maxlength="1000" placeholder="Write a reply…" class="inp text-xs" style="resize:none;flex:1;min-height:32px;"></textarea>
                <button onclick="window._sendTicketReply('${d.id}')" class="btn-primary" style="font-size:11px;padding:7px 12px;white-space:nowrap;">Reply</button>
            </div>`}
        </div>`;
    });
    if (badge) {
        badge.textContent = unread > 0 ? `${unread} replied` : 'up to date';
        badge.classList.remove('hidden');
    }
}

window._sendTicketReply = async function (id) {
    const el = document.getElementById('tk-reply-' + id);
    const text = (el?.value || '').trim();
    if (!text) return;
    el.disabled = true;
    try {
        await updateDoc(doc(db, 'contact_requests', id), {
            replies: arrayUnion({ from: 'user', name: window.myUsername || 'User', text, ts: Date.now() }),
            status: 'open'
        });
        el.value = '';
    } catch (e) {
        alert("Couldn't send that reply: " + (e.code || e.message));
    } finally { el.disabled = false; }
};

function _createEtaTracker() {
    let lastTime = performance.now();
    let lastBytes = 0;
    let emaRate = null;
    return function (bytesDone, bytesTotal) {
        const now = performance.now();
        const dt = (now - lastTime) / 1000;
        const dBytes = bytesDone - lastBytes;
        if (dt > 0.15 && dBytes > 0) {
            const instRate = dBytes / dt;
            emaRate = emaRate == null ? instRate : (emaRate * 0.65 + instRate * 0.35);
            lastTime = now;
            lastBytes = bytesDone;
        }
        if (!emaRate || emaRate <= 0) return null;
        return (bytesTotal - bytesDone) / emaRate;
    };
}
function _formatEta(secs) {
    if (secs == null || !isFinite(secs) || secs < 0) return '';
    if (secs < 1) return 'almost done…';
    if (secs < 60) return `~${Math.ceil(secs)}s left`;
    const m = Math.floor(secs / 60), s = Math.round(secs % 60);
    if (m < 60) return `~${m}m ${s}s left`;
    const h = Math.floor(m / 60), mm = m % 60;
    return `~${h}h ${mm}m left`;
}

async function _claimUploadQuota(fileSize) {
    const qRef = doc(db, 'upload_quota', myUID);
    const today = _todayLocalStr();
    await firestoreRunTransaction(db, async (tx) => {
        const snap = await tx.get(qRef);
        const used = (snap.exists() && snap.data().date === today) ? (snap.data().bytesUsed || 0) : 0;
        if (used + fileSize > DAILY_UPLOAD_LIMIT_BYTES) {
            const remaining = Math.max(0, DAILY_UPLOAD_LIMIT_BYTES - used);
            throw new Error(`Daily upload limit reached — you have ${(remaining / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1)}MB left today (resets at midnight).`);
        }
        tx.set(qRef, { date: today, bytesUsed: used + fileSize });
    });
}
async function _refundUploadQuota(fileSize) {
    const qRef = doc(db, 'upload_quota', myUID);
    const today = _todayLocalStr();
    try {
        await firestoreRunTransaction(db, async (tx) => {
            const snap = await tx.get(qRef);
            const used = (snap.exists() && snap.data().date === today) ? (snap.data().bytesUsed || 0) : 0;
            tx.set(qRef, { date: today, bytesUsed: Math.max(0, used - fileSize) });
        });
    } catch (_) {}
}

async function _saveFileChunked(chatId, msgId, dataUrl, onProgress, cancelToken) {
    const CHUNK = 700000;
    const chunks = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < dataUrl.length; i += CHUNK) chunks.push(dataUrl.slice(i, i + CHUNK));
    const BATCH_SIZE = 12;
    const ranges = [];
    for (let start = 0; start < chunks.length; start += BATCH_SIZE) ranges.push([start, Math.min(start + BATCH_SIZE, chunks.length)]);
    const CONCURRENCY = 3;
    const totalBytes = dataUrl.length;
    let completedBytes = 0, nextIdx = 0;
    async function _worker() {
        while (nextIdx < ranges.length) {
            if (cancelToken && cancelToken.cancelled) return;
            const [start, end] = ranges[nextIdx++];
            const batch = writeBatch(db);
            let batchBytes = 0;
            for (let i = start; i < end; i++) {
                batch.set(doc(db, 'file_chunks', `${chatId}_${msgId}`, 'chunks', `chunk_${i}`), { data: chunks[i], index: i });
                batchBytes += chunks[i].length;
            }
            await batch.commit();
            completedBytes += batchBytes;
            if (onProgress) onProgress(completedBytes, totalBytes);
        }
    }
    await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: Math.min(CONCURRENCY, ranges.length) }, _worker));
    if (cancelToken && cancelToken.cancelled) {
        const err = new Error('Upload cancelled'); err.cancelled = true; throw err;
    }
    await setDoc(doc(db, 'file_chunks', `${chatId}_${msgId}`, 'chunks', 'meta'), { total: chunks.length });
}
window.loadChunkedFile = async (chatId, msgId) => {
    if (window._fileCache && window._fileCache[msgId]) return window._fileCache[msgId];
    const metaSnap = await _getDocCached(doc(db, 'file_chunks', `${chatId}_${msgId}`, 'chunks', 'meta'));
    if (!metaSnap.exists()) throw new Error('File data missing (may have been deleted).');
    const total = metaSnap.data().total;
    const parts = await Promise.all(
        Array.from({ length: total }, (_, i) => _getDocCached(doc(db, 'file_chunks', `${chatId}_${msgId}`, 'chunks', `chunk_${i}`)))
    );
    const dataUrl = parts.map(p => p.data().data).join('');
    if (!window._fileCache) window._fileCache = {};
    window._fileCache[msgId] = dataUrl;
    return dataUrl;
};
window.downloadChunkedFile = async (chatId, msgId, fileName, btnEl) => {
    const orig = btnEl ? btnEl.textContent : null;
    if (btnEl) btnEl.textContent = 'Loading…';
    try {
        const dataUrl = await window.loadChunkedFile(chatId, msgId);
        const res = await fetch(dataUrl);
        const blob = await res.blob();
        const objUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        const a = document.createElement('a');
        a.href = objUrl; a.download = fileName || 'file';
        document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove();
        setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(objUrl), 10000);
    } catch (e) {
        alert('Could not load file: ' + e.message);
    } finally {
        if (btnEl) btnEl.textContent = orig;
    }
};

 

window._mediaCardSrc = async (card) => {
    if (card.dataset.src) return card.dataset.src;
    return await window.loadChunkedFile(card.dataset.chatid, card.dataset.msgid);
};

function _isHeic(name) { const e = _fileExt(name); return e === 'heic' || e === 'heif'; }
let _heicLibPromise = null;
function _loadHeicLib() {
    if (window.heic2any) return Promise.resolve();
    if (_heicLibPromise) return _heicLibPromise;
    _heicLibPromise = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const s = document.createElement('script');
        s.src = 'https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/heic2any/0.0.4/heic2any.min.js';
        s.onload = resolve;
        s.onerror = () => { _heicLibPromise = null; reject(new Error('HEIC decoder failed to load')); };
        document.head.appendChild(s);
    });
    return _heicLibPromise;
}

window._mediaDisplaySrc = async (card) => {
    if (card.dataset.displaySrc) return card.dataset.displaySrc;
    const raw = await window._mediaCardSrc(card);
    if (card.dataset.kind === 'image' && _isHeic(card.dataset.name)) {
        await _loadHeicLib();
        const blob = await (await fetch(raw)).blob();
        const jpegBlob = await window.heic2any({ blob, toType: 'image/jpeg', quality: 0.9 });
        const url = URL.createObjectURL(Array.isArray(jpegBlob) ? jpegBlob[0] : jpegBlob);
        card.dataset.displaySrc = url;
        return url;
    }
    card.dataset.displaySrc = raw;
    return raw;
};

async function _hydrateMediaCard(card) {
    if (!card.classList.contains('_media-pending')) return;
    card.classList.remove('_media-pending');
    const wrap = card.querySelector('._media-thumb-wrap');
    const kind = card.dataset.kind;
    try {
        const src = await window._mediaDisplaySrc(card);
        if (kind === 'video') {
            const v = document.createElement('video');
            v.className = '_media-thumb';
            v.src = src; v.muted = true; v.playsInline = true; v.preload = 'metadata';
            v.addEventListener('loadeddata', () => { try { v.currentTime = 0.05; } catch(_){} }, { once: true });
            v.onerror = () => _mediaCardFallback(card);
            wrap.innerHTML = '';
            wrap.appendChild(v);
            const play = document.createElement('div');
            play.className = '_media-play';
            play.textContent = '▶';
            wrap.appendChild(play);
        } else {
            const img = document.createElement('img');
            img.className = '_media-thumb';
            img.alt = card.dataset.name || 'image';
            img.onerror = () => _mediaCardFallback(card);
            img.src = src;
            wrap.innerHTML = '';
            wrap.appendChild(img);
        }
        card.onclick = () => window._openMediaLightbox(card);
    } catch (e) {
        _mediaCardFallback(card, e);
    }
}

function _mediaCardFallback(card) {
    const wrap = card.querySelector('._media-thumb-wrap');
    if (wrap) wrap.innerHTML = `<div class="_media-loading">${card.dataset.kind === 'video' ? '🎬' : '🖼️'}<span>Preview unavailable — tap to download</span></div>`;
    card.onclick = () => {
        const dl = card.querySelector('._media-dl');
        if (dl) window._mediaCardDownload(dl);
    };
}

window._mediaCardDownload = async (btn) => {
    const card = btn.closest('._media-card');
    if (!card) return;
    const orig = btn.textContent;
    btn.textContent = '…';
    try {
        const src = await window._mediaCardSrc(card);
        const res = await fetch(src);
        const blob = await res.blob();
        const objUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        const a = document.createElement('a');
        a.href = objUrl; a.download = card.dataset.name || 'file';
        document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove();
        setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(objUrl), 10000);
    } catch (e) {
        alert('Could not load file: ' + e.message);
    } finally {
        btn.textContent = orig;
    }
};

new MutationObserver((muts) => {
    for (const m of muts) {
        for (const node of m.addedNodes) {
            if (node.nodeType !== 1) continue;
            if (node.classList?.contains('_media-pending')) _hydrateMediaCard(node);
            node.querySelectorAll?.('._media-pending').forEach(_hydrateMediaCard);
        }
    }
}).observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });

 
let _audioNowPlaying = null;
function _fmtAudioTime(s) {
    if (!isFinite(s)) return '0:00';
    const m = Math.floor(s / 60), sec = Math.floor(s % 60);
    return `${m}:${sec < 10 ? '0' : ''}${sec}`;
}
window._audioCardToggle = async (btn) => {
    const card = btn.closest('._audio-card');
    if (!card) return;
    if (card._audio) {
        if (card._audio.paused) {
            if (_audioNowPlaying && _audioNowPlaying !== card && _audioNowPlaying._audio) {
                _audioNowPlaying._audio.pause();
            }
            _audioNowPlaying = card;
            card._audio.play();
        } else {
            card._audio.pause();
        }
        return;
    }
    btn.textContent = '…';
    try {
        const src = await window._mediaCardSrc(card);
        const a = new Audio(src);
        card._audio = a;
        const fill = card.querySelector('._audio-track-fill');
        const cur = card.querySelector('._audio-cur');
        const dur = card.querySelector('._audio-dur');
        a.addEventListener('loadedmetadata', () => { dur.textContent = _fmtAudioTime(a.duration); });
        a.addEventListener('timeupdate', () => {
            cur.textContent = _fmtAudioTime(a.currentTime);
            if (isFinite(a.duration) && a.duration > 0) fill.style.width = (a.currentTime / a.duration * 100) + '%';
        });
        a.addEventListener('play', () => { btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-pause"></i>'; card.classList.add('playing'); });
        a.addEventListener('pause', () => { btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-play"></i>'; card.classList.remove('playing'); });
        a.addEventListener('ended', () => { btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-play"></i>'; card.classList.remove('playing'); fill.style.width = '0%'; a.currentTime = 0; });
        a.onerror = () => { btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-play"></i>'; alert('This audio format could not be played — try downloading it instead.'); };
        if (_audioNowPlaying && _audioNowPlaying !== card && _audioNowPlaying._audio) {
            _audioNowPlaying._audio.pause();
        }
        _audioNowPlaying = card;
        await a.play();
    } catch (e) {
        btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-play"></i>';
        alert('Could not load audio: ' + e.message);
    }
};
window._audioCardSeek = (event, track) => {
    const card = track.closest('._audio-card');
    const a = card?._audio;
    if (!a || !isFinite(a.duration) || a.duration <= 0) return;
    const r = track.getBoundingClientRect();
    a.currentTime = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (event.clientX - r.left) / r.width)) * a.duration;
};

let _lbZoomed = false;
function _ensureLightbox() {
    let lb = document.getElementById('media-lightbox');
    if (lb) return lb;
    lb = document.createElement('div');
    lb.id = 'media-lightbox';
    lb.innerHTML = `
        <div id="media-lightbox-topbar">
            <span id="media-lightbox-name"></span>
