            <button id="media-lightbox-dl" title="Download"><i class="fa-solid fa-download"></i> Save</button>
            <button id="media-lightbox-close" title="Close">✕</button>
        </div>
        <div id="media-lightbox-stage"></div>`;
    document.body.appendChild(lb);
    lb.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        if (e.target === lb || e.target.id === 'media-lightbox-stage') window._closeMediaLightbox();
    });
    lb.querySelector('#media-lightbox-close').onclick = () => window._closeMediaLightbox();
    document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
        if (e.key === 'Escape' && lb.classList.contains('open')) window._closeMediaLightbox();
    });
    return lb;
}

 
let _upscalerLibPromise = null, _upscalerInstance = null;
const _upscaleCache = {};
function _loadScriptOnce(src) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const s = document.createElement('script');
        s.src = src; s.onload = resolve;
        s.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Failed to load ' + src));
        document.head.appendChild(s);
    });
}
async function _getUpscaler() {
    if (_upscalerInstance) return _upscalerInstance;
    if (!_upscalerLibPromise) {
        _upscalerLibPromise = (async () => {
            if (!window.tf) await _loadScriptOnce('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@tensorflow/tfjs@4.11.0/dist/tf.min.js');
            if (!window.Upscaler) await _loadScriptOnce('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/upscaler@1.0.0/dist/browser/umd/upscaler.min.js');
            if (!window.ESRGANSlim2x) {
                await _loadScriptOnce('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@upscalerjs/esrgan-slim@1.0.0/dist/umd/models/esrgan-slim/src/x2/index.min.js');
            }
        })().catch(e => { _upscalerLibPromise = null; throw e; });
    }
    await _upscalerLibPromise;
    const model = window.ESRGANSlim2x;
    if (!model) throw new Error('Upscale model not available');
    _upscalerInstance = new window.Upscaler({ model });
    return _upscalerInstance;
}

const _ENHANCE_MAX_INPUT = 960;
const _ENHANCE_SKIP_ABOVE = 1600;

function _loadCappedCanvas(src, maxSide, denoise) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const img = new Image();
        img.onload = () => {
            const scale = Math.min(1, maxSide / Math.max(img.naturalWidth, img.naturalHeight));
            const w = Math.round(img.naturalWidth * scale), h = Math.round(img.naturalHeight * scale);
            const c = document.createElement('canvas');
            c.width = w; c.height = h;
            const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
            ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
            ctx.imageSmoothingQuality = 'high';
            if (denoise) ctx.filter = 'blur(0.4px)';
            ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, w, h);
            ctx.filter = 'none';
            resolve({ canvas: c, natW: img.naturalWidth, natH: img.naturalHeight });
        };
        img.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Image failed to load for enhancement'));
        img.src = src;
    });
}

async function _canvasEnhance(src) {
    const { canvas: base } = await _loadCappedCanvas(src, 1024, true);
    const w = base.width * 2, h = base.height * 2;
    const c = document.createElement('canvas');
    c.width = w; c.height = h;
    const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
    ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
    ctx.imageSmoothingQuality = 'high';
    ctx.drawImage(base, 0, 0, w, h);
    const orig = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, w, h);
    ctx.filter = 'blur(1px)';
    ctx.drawImage(c, 0, 0);
    const blur = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, w, h);
    const od = orig.data, bd = blur.data, amt = 0.3;
    for (let i = 0; i < od.length; i += 4) {
        od[i]   = Math.max(0, Math.min(255, od[i]   + amt * (od[i]   - bd[i])));
        od[i+1] = Math.max(0, Math.min(255, od[i+1] + amt * (od[i+1] - bd[i+1])));
        od[i+2] = Math.max(0, Math.min(255, od[i+2] + amt * (od[i+2] - bd[i+2])));
    }
    ctx.filter = 'none';
    ctx.putImageData(orig, 0, 0);
    return c.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.92);
}

window._enhanceLightboxImage = async () => {
    const lb = document.getElementById('media-lightbox');
    const img = lb?.querySelector('#media-lightbox-media');
    const btn = lb?.querySelector('#media-lightbox-enhance');
    if (!img || img.tagName !== 'IMG' || !btn || btn.dataset.busy) return;
    const srcKey = img.dataset.origSrc || img.src;
    if (img.dataset.enhanced === '1') {
        img.src = img.dataset.origSrc;
        img.dataset.enhanced = '0';
        btn.textContent = 'Enhance';
        return;
    }
    if (_upscaleCache[srcKey]) {
        img.dataset.origSrc = srcKey;
        img.src = _upscaleCache[srcKey];
        img.dataset.enhanced = '1';
        btn.textContent = 'Original';
        return;
    }
    btn.dataset.busy = '1';
    btn.textContent = 'Enhancing…';
    let result = null;
    try {
        const { canvas: capped, natW, natH } = await _loadCappedCanvas(srcKey, _ENHANCE_MAX_INPUT, true);
        if (Math.max(natW, natH) >= _ENHANCE_SKIP_ABOVE) {
            delete btn.dataset.busy;
            btn.textContent = 'Enhance';
            showCooldownToast('This image is already high quality.', true);
            return;
        }
        const upscaler = await _getUpscaler();
        result = await upscaler.upscale(capped, {
            patchSize: 64,
            padding: 4,
            progress: (p) => { btn.textContent = `${Math.round(p * 100)}%`; }
        });
    } catch (e) {
        console.warn('[upscale] AI path failed, using canvas fallback:', e);
        try { result = await _canvasEnhance(srcKey); }
        catch (e2) { console.error('[upscale] fallback failed too:', e2); }
    }
    delete btn.dataset.busy;
    if (result) {
        _upscaleCache[srcKey] = result;
        img.dataset.origSrc = srcKey;
        img.src = result;
        img.dataset.enhanced = '1';
        btn.textContent = 'Original';
    } else {
        btn.textContent = 'Enhance';
        alert('Could not enhance this image.');
    }
};

async function _openLightboxWith(kind, src, name, dlFn) {
    const lb = _ensureLightbox();
    const stage = lb.querySelector('#media-lightbox-stage');
    lb.querySelector('#media-lightbox-name').textContent = name || '';
    const dlBtn = lb.querySelector('#media-lightbox-dl');
    dlBtn.style.display = dlFn ? '' : 'none';
    dlBtn.onclick = dlFn || null;
    const enhanceBtn = lb.querySelector('#media-lightbox-enhance');
    enhanceBtn.style.display = kind === 'image' ? '' : 'none';
    enhanceBtn.textContent = 'Enhance';
    delete enhanceBtn.dataset.busy;
    enhanceBtn.onclick = (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); window._enhanceLightboxImage(); };
    stage.innerHTML = '';
    _lbZoomed = false;
    if (kind === 'video') {
        const v = document.createElement('video');
        v.id = 'media-lightbox-media';
        v.src = src; v.controls = true; v.autoplay = true; v.playsInline = true;
        stage.appendChild(v);
    } else {
        const img = document.createElement('img');
        img.id = 'media-lightbox-media';
        img.src = src;
        img.alt = name || 'image';
        img.onclick = (e) => {
            e.stopPropagation();
            _lbZoomed = !_lbZoomed;
            if (_lbZoomed) {
                const r = img.getBoundingClientRect();
                img.style.transformOrigin = `${((e.clientX - r.left) / r.width) * 100}% ${((e.clientY - r.top) / r.height) * 100}%`;
                img.classList.add('zoomed');
            } else {
                img.classList.remove('zoomed');
            }
        };
        stage.appendChild(img);
    }
    lb.classList.add('open');
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
}

window._openMediaLightbox = async (card) => {
    const src = await window._mediaDisplaySrc(card);
    const dlFn = () => {
        const dl = card.querySelector('._media-dl');
        if (dl) window._mediaCardDownload(dl);
    };
    _openLightboxWith(card.dataset.kind, src, card.dataset.name, dlFn);
};

window._openInlineImageLightbox = (imgEl) => {
    _openLightboxWith('image', imgEl.src, 'Image', null);
};

window._closeMediaLightbox = () => {
    const lb = document.getElementById('media-lightbox');
    if (!lb) return;
    lb.classList.remove('open');
    document.body.style.overflow = '';
    const media = lb.querySelector('#media-lightbox-media');
    if (media && media.tagName === 'VIDEO') { try { media.pause(); } catch(_){} }
    setTimeout(() => { const s = lb.querySelector('#media-lightbox-stage'); if (s && !lb.classList.contains('open')) s.innerHTML = ''; }, 250);
};

async function _sendChunkedFile(file, rowId) {
    if (!file || !currentChatId || !currentChatData) return;
    if (window._isTimedOut && window._isTimedOut()) { showCooldownToast('⏳ You are timed out and cannot send files right now.'); return; }
    const _cap = _myUploadCeiling();
    if (file.size > _cap) {
        alert(`File too big — max ${_cap / (1024*1024)}MB. This one is ${(file.size/1024/1024).toFixed(1)}MB.`);
        return;
    }
    if (!rowId) rowId = 'uq-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2);
    let claimed = false;
    try {
        await _claimUploadQuota(file.size);
        claimed = true;
    } catch (e) {
        alert('⏳ ' + e.message);
        return;
    }
    if (currentChatData?.isGroup && !isGroupOwner()) {
        if (!cooldownCheck('send_file', 5000)) {
            showCooldownToast('Wait a moment before sending another file.');
            await _refundUploadQuota(file.size);
            return;
        }
    }
    const cancelToken = { cancelled: false };
    if (!window._uploadCancelTokens) window._uploadCancelTokens = {};
    window._uploadCancelTokens[rowId] = cancelToken;
    _showUploadQueuePanel();
    _setUploadQueueRow(rowId, file.name, 0);
    const btn = document.querySelector('[title="Send File"]');
    if (btn) btn.style.opacity = '0.4';
    let chatId = currentChatId, msgRef = null;
    try {
        const dataUrl = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
            const reader = new FileReader();
            reader.onload = () => resolve(reader.result);
            reader.onerror = reject;
            reader.readAsDataURL(file);
        });
        try {
            await updateDoc(doc(db, "chats", currentChatId), {
                unreadBy: currentChatData.participants.filter(id => id !== myUID),
                lastActivity: serverTimestamp(),
                lastMessageText: `📎 ${file.name}`,
                lastMessageSenderId: myUID
            });
        } catch (e) { throw new Error('[chat update] ' + e.message); }
        try {
            msgRef = await addDoc(collection(db, `chats/${currentChatId}/messages`), {
                text: "Sent a file", uid: window.myUID, timestamp: serverTimestamp(),
                fileChunked: true, fileName: file.name, fileSize: file.size, fileType: file.type || 'application/octet-stream'
            });
        } catch (e) { throw new Error('[message create] ' + e.message); }
        const etaTracker = _createEtaTracker();
        try {
            await _saveFileChunked(currentChatId, msgRef.id, dataUrl, (bytesDone, bytesTotal) => {
                const pct = Math.round(bytesDone / bytesTotal * 100);
                const etaSecs = etaTracker(bytesDone, bytesTotal);
                _setUploadQueueRow(rowId, file.name, pct, undefined, _formatEta(etaSecs));
            }, cancelToken);
        } catch (e) {
            if (e.cancelled) throw e;
            throw new Error('[chunk write] ' + e.message);
        }
        _setUploadQueueRow(rowId, file.name, 100);
        _removeUploadQueueRow(rowId);
        if (typeof window.trackQuestAction === 'function') {
            window.trackQuestAction('filesShared', 1).catch(() => {});
        }
    } catch (err) {
        if (err.cancelled) {
            _setUploadQueueRow(rowId, file.name, 0, 'cancelled');
            _removeUploadQueueRow(rowId, 1200);
            if (msgRef) { try { await deleteDoc(msgRef); } catch (_) {} }
            try {
                const chunksSnap = await getDocs(collection(db, 'file_chunks', `${chatId}_${msgRef?.id}`, 'chunks'));
                await Promise.all(chunksSnap.docs.map(d => deleteDoc(d.ref)));
            } catch (_) {}
        } else {
            console.error('[file-upload]', err);
            _setUploadQueueRow(rowId, file.name, 0, 'failed');
            _removeUploadQueueRow(rowId, 2500);
            alert('File upload failed: ' + err.message);
        }
        if (claimed) await _refundUploadQuota(file.size);
    } finally {
        delete window._uploadCancelTokens[rowId];
        if (btn) btn.style.opacity = '';
        _refreshUploadQuotaBadge();
    }
}
window._cancelUpload = function(rowId) {
    const t = window._uploadCancelTokens && window._uploadCancelTokens[rowId];
    if (!t) return;
    t.cancelled = true;
    const nameEl = document.querySelector(`#${rowId} .uq-name`);
    _setUploadQueueRow(rowId, nameEl ? nameEl.textContent : 'File', 0, 'cancelling');
};

document.getElementById('doc-file-input').addEventListener('change', async (e) => {
    const _docFiles = Array.from(e.target.files || []);
    e.target.value = '';
    if (!_docFiles.length) return;
    const totalSize = _docFiles.reduce((s, f) => s + f.size, 0);
    const q = await _refreshUploadQuotaBadge();
    if (q && totalSize > q.remaining) {
        alert(`That's ${(totalSize / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1)}MB total — you only have ${(q.remaining / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1)}MB left today.`);
        return;
    }
    const CONCURRENCY = 3;
    let idx = 0;
    async function _worker() {
        while (idx < _docFiles.length) {
            const f = _docFiles[idx++];
            try { await _sendChunkedFile(f); } catch (err) { console.error('[doc-upload]', err); }
        }
    }
    await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: Math.min(CONCURRENCY, _docFiles.length) }, _worker));
});
window._sendChunkedFile = _sendChunkedFile;

window.unfriend = async () => {
    if (!currentChatId || !confirm("Leave this chat?")) return;
    if (typeof window._isOnboardingBotChat === 'function' && window._isOnboardingBotChat(currentChatId)) {
        const ob = window._onboardingState;
        try { await deleteDoc(doc(db, 'users', ob.botId)); } catch(e) { console.warn('[onboarding] manual bot cleanup (user doc) failed:', e); }
        try { await updateDoc(doc(db, 'users', myUID), { 'onboarding.botRemoved': true }); ob.botRemoved = true; } catch(e) { console.warn('[onboarding] manual bot cleanup (flag) failed:', e); }
    }
    const cid = currentChatId;
    let left = false, lastErr = null;

    try {
        await updateDoc(doc(db, "chats", cid), { participants: arrayRemove(myUID) });
        left = true;
    } catch (e) { lastErr = e; console.warn('[leave] participant removal failed:', e.code || e.message); }

    if (!left) {
        try { await deleteDoc(doc(db, "chats", cid)); left = true; }
        catch (e) { lastErr = e; console.warn('[leave] delete fallback failed:', e.code || e.message); }
    }

    if (!left) {
        alert("Couldn't leave this chat" + (lastErr?.code ? ` (${lastErr.code})` : '') +
              ". Check your connection and try again.");
        return;
    }

    try { await deleteDoc(doc(db, 'typing', cid)); } catch (_) {}
    const other = (currentChatData?.participants || []).find(id => id !== myUID);
    if (other) {
        try { await deleteDoc(doc(db, 'requests', `${myUID}_${other}`)); } catch (_) {}
        try { await deleteDoc(doc(db, 'requests', `${other}_${myUID}`)); } catch (_) {}
    }
    try { if (chatUnsub) { chatUnsub(); chatUnsub = null; } } catch (_) {}
    try { clearTimeout(window._chatAttachTimer); } catch (_) {}
    if (window._friendUIDs && other) window._friendUIDs.delete(other);
    window._lastAttachedChatId = null;

    currentChatId = null; currentChatData = null; window.currentChatId = null; window.currentChatData = null;
    window._allowSwitchEmpty = true; switchView('empty');
};
window._reportSel = null;

window.reportUser = async () => {
    if (!currentChatId) return;
    if (window._reportSel) return;
    window.startReportSelection();
};

window.startReportSelection = () => {
    const box = document.getElementById('chat-box');
    if (!currentChatId || !box) return;
    window._reportSel = new Set();
    box.classList.add('report-selecting');
    if (!window._reportSelBound) {
        window._reportSelBound = true;
        box.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            if (!window._reportSel) return;
            const wrap = e.target.closest('.msg-wrap, [data-msgid]');
            if (!wrap || !wrap.dataset.msgid) return;
            e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation();
            const id = wrap.dataset.msgid;
            if (window._reportSel.has(id)) { window._reportSel.delete(id); wrap.classList.remove('report-picked'); }
            else { window._reportSel.add(id); wrap.classList.add('report-picked'); }
            const c = document.getElementById('report-sel-count');
            if (c) c.textContent = window._reportSel.size;
            const sb = document.getElementById('report-sel-submit');
            if (sb) sb.disabled = window._reportSel.size === 0;
        }, true);
    }
    let bar = document.getElementById('report-sel-bar');
    if (!bar) {
        bar = document.createElement('div');
        bar.id = 'report-sel-bar';
        bar.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);bottom:22px;z-index:9000;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:14px;background:#0d0d1a;border:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,0.35);box-shadow:0 10px 34px rgba(0,0,0,0.55);font-family:\'DM Sans\',sans-serif;max-width:94vw;';
        bar.innerHTML = `<span style="font-size:12px;color:#c8c8d8;font-weight:700;"><i class="fa-solid fa-flag" style="color:#f87171;"></i> Tap messages to report · <span id="report-sel-count">0</span> selected</span>
            <button onclick="window.cancelReportSelection()" style="font-size:11px;font-weight:800;padding:6px 12px;border-radius:9px;background:#07070f;border:1px solid #1e1e2e;color:#888899;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;">Cancel</button>
            <button id="report-sel-submit" disabled onclick="window.submitReportSelection()" style="font-size:11px;font-weight:800;padding:6px 12px;border-radius:9px;background:#ef4444;border:none;color:#fff;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;">Report</button>`;
        document.body.appendChild(bar);
    }
    bar.style.display = 'flex';
};

window.cancelReportSelection = () => {
    window._reportSel = null;
    const box = document.getElementById('chat-box');
    if (box) {
        box.classList.remove('report-selecting');
        box.querySelectorAll('.report-picked').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('report-picked'));
    }
    const bar = document.getElementById('report-sel-bar');
    if (bar) bar.style.display = 'none';
};

window.submitReportSelection = async () => {
    const sel = window._reportSel;
    if (!sel || !sel.size || !currentChatId) return;
    if (!spamGuard('report_user', 3, 60000)) return alert("You're filing reports too quickly. Slow down.");
    if (!cooldownCheck('report_user', 15000)) return alert("Wait before filing another report.");
    const btn = document.getElementById('report-sel-submit');
    if (btn) { btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = 'Filing…'; }
    const reason = prompt('What is wrong with these messages? (optional)') || '';
    const cid = currentChatId, cData = currentChatData || {};
    try {
        const ids = Array.from(sel);
        const snaps = await Promise.all(ids.map(id => getDoc(doc(db, `chats/${cid}/messages`, id)).catch(() => null)));
        let budget = 700000;
        const attached = [];
        const tally = {};
        for (const s of snaps) {
            if (!s || !s.exists()) continue;
            const m = s.data();
            if (m.uid && m.uid !== myUID) tally[m.uid] = (tally[m.uid] || 0) + 1;
            const am = {
                msgId: s.id, chatId: cid, uid: m.uid || '',
                username: cData.names?.[m.uid] || 'Unknown',
                time: m.timestamp?.toDate ? m.timestamp.toDate().toLocaleString([], { month:'short', day:'numeric', hour:'2-digit', minute:'2-digit' }) : '',
                text: m.text || ''
            };
            const heavy = (v) => { const n = (v || '').length; if (n && n < budget) { budget -= n; return true; } return false; };
            if (m.imageBase64 && heavy(m.imageBase64)) am.imageBase64 = m.imageBase64;
            else if (m.imageBase64) am.note = '[image too large to attach]';
            if (m.imageGrid?.length) {
                const kept = m.imageGrid.filter(b => heavy(b));
                if (kept.length) am.imageGrid = kept;
                if (kept.length < m.imageGrid.length) am.note = `[${m.imageGrid.length - kept.length} image(s) too large to attach]`;
            }
            if (m.voiceBase64 && heavy(m.voiceBase64)) { am.voiceBase64 = m.voiceBase64; am.voiceDuration = m.voiceDuration || 0; }
            else if (m.voiceBase64) am.note = '[voice message too large to attach]';
            if (m.gifUrl) {
                am.gifUrl = m.gifUrl;
                if (m.gifLibId) { am.gifLibId = m.gifLibId; am.gifLibChunks = m.gifLibChunks || 0; }
                if (m.gifPreview) am.gifPreview = m.gifPreview;
            }
            if (m.fileName) { am.fileName = m.fileName; am.fileSize = m.fileSize || 0; am.fileType = m.fileType || ''; if (m.fileURL) am.fileURL = m.fileURL; }
            if (m.type === 'poll' && m.poll) am.poll = m.poll;
            if (m.type && m.type !== 'text') am.type = m.type;
            attached.push(am);
        }
        if (!attached.length) throw new Error('Those messages could not be read.');
        let targetId = Object.keys(tally).sort((a, b) => tally[b] - tally[a])[0];
        if (!targetId) targetId = (cData.participants || []).find(id => id !== myUID);
        attached.forEach(a => { a.isTarget = a.uid === targetId; });
        const kind = cData.spaceId ? 'space channel' : (cData.isGroup ? 'group' : 'DM');
        await addDoc(collection(db, "reports"), {
            reporterId: myUID, reporterName: myUsername,
            targetId: targetId || '', targetName: cData.names?.[targetId] || 'Unknown',
            reason, chatId: cid,
            chatName: cData.spaceId ? (cData.channelName || cData.groupName || 'Channel') : (cData.isGroup ? (cData.groupName || 'Group') : 'Direct message'),
            chatKind: kind,
            attachedMessages: attached,
            timestamp: serverTimestamp()
        });
        window.cancelReportSelection();
        alert(`Report filed with ${attached.length} message${attached.length>1?'s':''} attached.`);
    } catch (e) {
        alert('Report failed: ' + (e.message || e));
    } finally {
        if (btn) { btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = 'Report'; }
    }
};


const CallDiag = (() => {
    const sessions = new Map();
    const MAX_EVENTS = 90;
    const TERMINAL = new Set(['connected', 'failed', 'ended']);
    const short = (v) => {
        if (v == null) return '';
        const s = typeof v === 'string' ? v : (() => { try { return JSON.stringify(v); } catch (_) { return String(v); } })();
        return s.length > 300 ? s.slice(0, 297) + '…' : s;
    };
    const uaShort = () => {
        const ua = navigator.userAgent || '';
        const b = /Edg\/(\d+)/.exec(ua) ? 'Edge ' + RegExp.$1 : /CrOS/.test(ua) ? 'ChromeOS' + (/Chrome\/(\d+)/.test(ua) ? ' ' + RegExp.$1 : '')
            : /Chrome\/(\d+)/.exec(ua) ? 'Chrome ' + RegExp.$1 : /Firefox\/(\d+)/.exec(ua) ? 'Firefox ' + RegExp.$1
            : /Safari/.test(ua) ? 'Safari' : 'other';
        const os = /CrOS/.test(ua) ? 'Chromebook' : /Android/.test(ua) ? 'Android' : /iPhone|iPad/.test(ua) ? 'iOS' : /Windows/.test(ua) ? 'Windows' : /Mac OS/.test(ua) ? 'Mac' : /Linux/.test(ua) ? 'Linux' : '?';
        return b + ' · ' + os;
    };

    function begin(key, info) {
        try {
            const prev = sessions.get(key);
            if (prev && !prev.outcome) end(key, 'superseded');
            const now = Date.now();
            const s = {
                key, startMs: now,
                id: String(key).replace(/[^\w-]/g, '_').slice(0, 120) + '_' + String(window.myUID || 'anon').slice(0, 8) + '_' + now,
                info: info || {}, events: [], outcome: null, connected: false, pair: '', errors: 0, lastError: '',
                localTypes: {}, remoteAdded: 0, flushTimer: null, peers: {}
            };
            sessions.set(key, s);
            log(key, 'begin', info);
            return s;
        } catch (_) { return null; }
    }

    function log(key, type, detail, isError) {
        try {
            const s = sessions.get(key);
            if (!s) return;
            const ev = { t: Date.now() - s.startMs, e: String(type).slice(0, 60) };
            const d = short(detail);
            if (d) ev.d = d;
            if (isError) { ev.err = true; s.errors++; s.lastError = (type + (d ? ': ' + d : '')).slice(0, 300); }
            if (s.events.length >= MAX_EVENTS) s.events.splice(10, 1);
            s.events.push(ev);
            if (TERMINAL.has(type) || isError) flush(key); else schedule(key);
        } catch (_) {}
    }
    const error = (key, type, detail) => log(key, type, detail, true);

    function schedule(key) {
        const s = sessions.get(key);
        if (!s || s.flushTimer) return;
        s.flushTimer = setTimeout(() => { s.flushTimer = null; flush(key); }, 2500);
    }

    function flush(key) {
        const s = sessions.get(key);
        if (!s || !window.myUID) return;
        if (s.flushTimer) { clearTimeout(s.flushTimer); s.flushTimer = null; }
        try {
            const i = s.info || {};
            const payload = {
                uid: window.myUID, username: window.myUsername || '', role: String(window._myRole || (window.isAdmin ? 'admin' : 'member')),
                callKey: String(s.key), kind: i.kind || '1:1', direction: i.direction || '', isVideo: !!i.isVideo,
                otherUid: i.otherUid || '', otherName: i.otherName || '',
                startedAt: new Date(s.startMs), updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
                outcome: s.outcome || 'in_progress', connected: s.connected, pair: s.pair || '',
                errors: s.errors, lastError: s.lastError || '',
                ua: uaShort(), net: (navigator.connection && (navigator.connection.effectiveType || navigator.connection.type)) || '',
                online: navigator.onLine !== false, skewMs: Math.round(typeof _rtdbSkew === 'number' ? _rtdbSkew : 0),
                turn: !!(window._activeTurn && window._activeTurn().length),
                ver: String(window._APP_VERSION || ''), events: s.events.slice(-MAX_EVENTS)
            };
            setDoc(doc(db, 'call_logs', s.id), payload).catch(e => console.warn('[CallDiag] write failed:', e && e.code || e));
        } catch (e) { console.warn('[CallDiag] flush failed:', e && e.message); }
    }

    function end(key, outcome, detail) {
        try {
            const s = sessions.get(key);
            if (!s || s.outcome) return;
            s.outcome = outcome;
            log(key, 'ended', (outcome || '') + (detail ? ' · ' + short(detail) : ''));
            flush(key);
            setTimeout(() => { if (sessions.get(key) === s) sessions.delete(key); }, 5000);
        } catch (_) {}
    }

    function note(key, type, detail, info, isError) {
        const k = key + '#note' + Date.now();
        if (!begin(k, info)) return;
        log(k, type, detail, isError);
        end(k, type);
    }

    async function _pairOf(pc) {
        try {
            const stats = await pc.getStats();
            let pair = null;
            stats.forEach(r => { if (r.type === 'transport' && r.selectedCandidatePairId) pair = stats.get(r.selectedCandidatePairId); });
            if (!pair) stats.forEach(r => { if (r.type === 'candidate-pair' && r.nominated && r.state === 'succeeded') pair = r; });
            if (!pair) return '';
            const l = stats.get(pair.localCandidateId), rm = stats.get(pair.remoteCandidateId);
            const fmt = (c) => c ? `${c.candidateType}/${c.protocol}${c.relayProtocol ? '(' + c.relayProtocol + ')' : ''}` : '?';
            return `${fmt(l)} → ${fmt(rm)}${pair.currentRoundTripTime != null ? ' · rtt ' + Math.round(pair.currentRoundTripTime * 1000) + 'ms' : ''}`;
        } catch (_) { return ''; }
    }

    function watchPc(key, pc, peerLabel) {
        try {
            const s = sessions.get(key);
            if (!s || !pc || pc._callDiagWatched) return;
            pc._callDiagWatched = true;
            const tag = peerLabel ? peerLabel + ': ' : '';
            const types = {};
            pc.addEventListener('icecandidate', (e) => {
                if (!e.candidate) { log(key, 'ice_gathering_done', tag + JSON.stringify(types)); return; }
                const typ = ((/ typ (\w+)/.exec(e.candidate.candidate || '') || [])[1] || '?') + '/' + ((/ (udp|tcp) /i.exec(e.candidate.candidate || '') || [])[1] || '?').toLowerCase();
                types[typ] = (types[typ] || 0) + 1;
                s.localTypes[typ] = (s.localTypes[typ] || 0) + 1;
            });
            pc.addEventListener('icecandidateerror', (e) => {
                log(key, 'ice_candidate_error', tag + `${e.errorCode || ''} ${e.errorText || ''} ${e.url || ''}`.trim());
            });
            pc.addEventListener('iceconnectionstatechange', async () => {
                const st = pc.iceConnectionState;
                if (st === 'connected' || st === 'completed') {
                    await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400));
                    log(key, 'ice_state', tag + st + ' · ' + ((await _pairOf(pc)) || 'pair pending') + (pc._tcpOnly ? ' · tcp-only' : ''));
                } else log(key, 'ice_state', tag + st);
            });
            pc.addEventListener('connectionstatechange', async () => {
                const st = pc.connectionState;
                if (st === 'connected') {
                    s.connected = true;
                    let p = await _pairOf(pc);
                    for (const wait of [800, 2500]) {
                        if (p || pc.connectionState !== 'connected') break;
                        await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, wait));
                        p = await _pairOf(pc);
                    }
                    s.pair = (peerLabel ? peerLabel + ' ' : '') + p;
                    log(key, 'connected', tag + (p || 'route not reported by browser'));
                } else if (st === 'failed') {
                    error(key, 'failed', tag + `local candidates ${JSON.stringify(types)} · remote candidates added ${pc._diagRemoteAdded || 0} · gathering ${pc.iceGatheringState}`);
                } else {
                    log(key, 'conn_state', tag + st);
                }
            });
        } catch (_) {}
    }

    return { begin, log, error, end, note, watchPc, has: (k) => sessions.has(k) && !sessions.get(k).outcome };
})();
window.CallDiag = CallDiag;

let _rtdbSkew = 0;

window._srvNow = _srvNow;

function _callTrack(unsub) { if (typeof unsub === 'function') _callUnsubs.push(unsub); return unsub; }

function _callIsLive() {
    if (typeof _gcActive !== 'undefined' && _gcActive) return true;
    if (window._gcActive) return true;
    if (pc && pc.connectionState !== 'closed') return true;
    if (localStream) return true;
    const vis = (id) => { const el = document.getElementById(id); return !!el && !el.classList.contains('hidden'); };
    return vis('incoming-call-modal') || vis('floating-video') || vis('audio-call-float');
}

async function postCallLog(chatId, text) {

}
async function updateCallLog(chatId, msgId, text) {
    if (!chatId || !msgId) return;
    try {
        await updateDoc(doc(db, `chats/${chatId}/messages`, msgId), { text });
        if (text.includes("Missed call")) {
            const chatSnap = await getDoc(doc(db, "chats", chatId));
            if (chatSnap.exists()) await updateDoc(doc(db, "chats", chatId), { unreadBy: chatSnap.data().participants.filter(id => id !== myUID) });
        }
    } catch(e) { console.warn("Could not update call log:", e); }
}
function formatDuration(seconds) {
    const m = Math.floor(seconds / 60), s = seconds % 60;
    return m > 0 ? `${m}m ${s}s` : `${s}s`;
}

function _callPlaceholderVideoTrack(label) {
    const c = document.createElement('canvas');
    c.width = 640; c.height = 360;
    const g = c.getContext('2d');
    const draw = () => {
        g.fillStyle = '#12121a'; g.fillRect(0, 0, 640, 360);
        const cx = 320, cy = 150;
        g.strokeStyle = '#8b8ba0'; g.lineWidth = 8; g.lineJoin = 'round';
        g.beginPath(); g.roundRect ? g.roundRect(cx - 70, cy - 40, 100, 80, 12) : g.rect(cx - 70, cy - 40, 100, 80); g.stroke();
        g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(cx + 40, cy - 12); g.lineTo(cx + 75, cy - 32); g.lineTo(cx + 75, cy + 32); g.lineTo(cx + 40, cy + 12); g.closePath(); g.stroke();
        g.strokeStyle = '#ef4444'; g.lineWidth = 10; g.lineCap = 'round';
        g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(cx - 85, cy - 60); g.lineTo(cx + 85, cy + 60); g.stroke();
        g.fillStyle = '#e8e8f0'; g.font = '600 26px system-ui, sans-serif'; g.textAlign = 'center';
        g.fillText('Camera not responding', cx, 270);
        if (label) { g.fillStyle = '#8b8ba0'; g.font = '18px system-ui, sans-serif'; g.fillText(label, cx, 302); }
    };
    draw();
    const track = c.captureStream(2).getVideoTracks()[0];
    const iv = setInterval(() => { if (track.readyState === 'ended') clearInterval(iv); else draw(); }, 500);
    track._echoPlaceholder = true;
    return track;
}
function _callSilentAudioTrack() {
    const ac = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
    const dst = ac.createMediaStreamDestination();
    const t = dst.stream.getAudioTracks()[0];
    t.addEventListener?.('ended', () => { try { ac.close(); } catch (_) {} });
    t._echoPlaceholder = true;
    return t;
}
async function _getCallMedia(wantVideo, audioC) {
    const gum = (c) => navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia(c);
    try { return await gum({ video: wantVideo, audio: audioC }); }
    catch (e) { console.warn('[Call] camera+mic failed, degrading:', e && e.name); }
    let audio = null, video = null;
    try { audio = (await gum({ audio: audioC })).getAudioTracks()[0]; } catch (e) { console.warn('[Call] mic unavailable:', e && e.name); }
    if (wantVideo) {
        try { video = (await gum({ video: true })).getVideoTracks()[0]; } catch (e) { console.warn('[Call] camera unavailable:', e && e.name); }
    }
    const s = new MediaStream();
    s.addTrack(audio || _callSilentAudioTrack());
    if (wantVideo) s.addTrack(video || _callPlaceholderVideoTrack(audio ? '' : 'Microphone not responding either'));
    return s;
}
window._getCallMedia = _getCallMedia;

let _callReneg = { path: null, peerCands: null, unsubs: [], handled: new Set(), pending: null, lastAt: 0, autos: 0, tcpTried: false };
function _callRenegReset() {
    _callReneg.unsubs.forEach(u => { try { u(); } catch (_) {} });
    _callReneg = { path: null, peerCands: null, unsubs: [], handled: new Set(), pending: null, lastAt: 0, autos: 0, tcpTried: false };
}

const _UDP_CAND = /\sudp\s/i;
function _callTcpOnlySdp(sdp) {
    return String(sdp || '').split(/\r?\n/).filter(l => !(l.startsWith('a=candidate:') && _UDP_CAND.test(l))).join('\r\n');
}
function _callArmTcpFilter(thisPc) {
    if (!thisPc || thisPc._tcpFilterArmed) return;
    thisPc._tcpFilterArmed = true;
    const orig = thisPc.addIceCandidate.bind(thisPc);
    thisPc.addIceCandidate = (c) => {
        const line = c && (c.candidate || (typeof c === 'string' ? c : ''));
        if (thisPc._tcpOnly && line && _UDP_CAND.test(line)) return Promise.resolve();
        return orig(c);
    };
}
function _callWatchForBlockedMedia(thisPc) {
    let t = null;
    const fire = (why) => {
        if (pc !== thisPc || thisPc._everConnected || thisPc._tcpOnly || _callReneg.tcpTried) return;
        try { activeCallDocId && CallDiag.error(activeCallDocId, 'udp_media_blocked', `${why} · ice ${thisPc.iceConnectionState} · conn ${thisPc.connectionState} · trying TCP`); } catch (_) {}
        window.reconnectCall('tcp_fallback');
        setTimeout(() => {
            if (pc === thisPc && !thisPc._everConnected && !EchoRelay.active) EchoRelay.start('direct and TCP both blocked');
        }, 9000);
    };
    thisPc.addEventListener('connectionstatechange', () => {
        if (thisPc.connectionState === 'connected') {
            thisPc._everConnected = true; clearTimeout(t);
            if (EchoRelay.active) { try { activeCallDocId && CallDiag.log(activeCallDocId, 'relay_off', 'direct connection came up'); } catch (_) {} EchoRelay.stop(); }
        }
    });
    thisPc.addEventListener('iceconnectionstatechange', () => {
        const st = thisPc.iceConnectionState;
        if ((st === 'connected' || st === 'completed') && !thisPc._everConnected) {
            clearTimeout(t);
            t = setTimeout(() => fire('ice ok but no DTLS after 3.5s'), 3500);
        } else if ((st === 'disconnected' || st === 'failed') && !thisPc._everConnected) {
            clearTimeout(t);
            fire('ice ' + st + ' before media ever connected');
        }
    });
}
const EchoRelay = (() => {
    const RATE = 8000, CHUNK_S = 0.2, FRAME_MS = 500, VW = 176, VH = 132;
    let on = false, base = null, other = null, ac = null, proc = null, srcNode = null, sink = null;
    let vTimer = null, unsubs = [], listenUnsub = null, playAt = 0, img = null, badge = null;
    let seqA = 0, seqV = 0, lastA = -1, lastV = -1, pending = [], pendingLen = 0;

    const b64 = (u8) => { let s = ''; for (let i = 0; i < u8.length; i += 0x8000) s += String.fromCharCode.apply(null, u8.subarray(i, i + 0x8000)); return btoa(s); };
    const unb64 = (str) => { const b = atob(str); const u = new Uint8Array(b.length); for (let i = 0; i < b.length; i++) u[i] = b.charCodeAt(i); return u; };
    function mulaw(x) {
        const s = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, x));
        const y = Math.sign(s) * Math.log(1 + 255 * Math.abs(s)) / Math.log(256);
        return Math.max(0, Math.min(255, Math.round((y + 1) * 127.5)));
    }
    function unmulaw(b) {
        const y = b / 127.5 - 1;
        return Math.sign(y) * (Math.pow(256, Math.abs(y)) - 1) / 255;
    }
    function encode(chunks, total, inRate) {
        const flat = new Float32Array(total); let o = 0;
        for (const c of chunks) { flat.set(c, o); o += c.length; }
        const step = inRate / RATE, n = Math.floor(total / step), out = new Uint8Array(n);
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            const a = Math.floor(i * step), z = Math.min(total, Math.floor((i + 1) * step));
            let sum = 0; for (let j = a; j < z; j++) sum += flat[j];
            out[i] = mulaw(sum / Math.max(1, z - a));
        }
        return out;
    }
    function play(u8) {
        if (!ac) return;
        const f = new Float32Array(u8.length);
        for (let i = 0; i < u8.length; i++) f[i] = unmulaw(u8[i]);
        const buf = ac.createBuffer(1, f.length, RATE);
        buf.copyToChannel(f, 0);
        const node = ac.createBufferSource();
        node.buffer = buf;
        node.connect(ac.destination);
        const now = ac.currentTime;
        if (playAt < now + 0.05 || playAt > now + 1.0) playAt = now + 0.12;
        node.start(playAt);
        playAt += buf.duration;
    }
    function ui(isVideo) {
        const fv = document.getElementById('floating-video');
        if (isVideo && fv) {
            const rv = document.getElementById('remote-video');
            img = document.createElement('img');
            img.id = 'relay-remote-img';
            img.alt = '';
            img.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;background:#000;z-index:1;pointer-events:none;';
            (rv && rv.parentNode ? rv.parentNode : fv).appendChild(img);
        }
        badge = document.createElement('div');
        badge.id = 'relay-badge';
        badge.textContent = 'Backup connection · school wifi';
        badge.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;top:8px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:5;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(245,158,11,0.15);border:1px solid rgba(245,158,11,0.4);color:#fbbf24;font:700 10px Inter,sans-serif;white-space:nowrap;pointer-events:none;';
        const host = isVideo ? fv : document.getElementById('audio-call-float');
        if (host) { if (getComputedStyle(host).position === 'static') host.style.position = 'relative'; host.appendChild(badge); }
    }
    async function start(reason, fromPeer) {
        if (on || !pc || !_callReneg.path || !localStream) return;
        on = true;
        window._relayActive = true;
        base = _callReneg.path + '/relay';
        const ids = String(_callReneg.path.split('/').pop() || '').split('_');
        other = activeCallOtherUid || ids.find(u => u && u !== myUID) || null;
        const isVideo = localStream.getVideoTracks().length > 0;
        try { activeCallDocId && CallDiag.log(activeCallDocId, 'relay_mode', (fromPeer ? 'peer: ' : '') + reason); } catch (_) {}
        if (!fromPeer) { try { await window.set(window.ref(window.rtdb, base + '/start'), { from: myUID, ts: _srvNow(), reason: String(reason).slice(0, 80) }); } catch (_) {} }

        try {
            ac = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
            try { await ac.resume(); } catch (_) {}
            srcNode = ac.createMediaStreamSource(localStream);
            proc = ac.createScriptProcessor(2048, 1, 1);
            sink = ac.createGain(); sink.gain.value = 0;
            const need = Math.round(ac.sampleRate * CHUNK_S);
            proc.onaudioprocess = (e) => {
                if (!on) return;
                pending.push(new Float32Array(e.inputBuffer.getChannelData(0)));
                pendingLen += e.inputBuffer.length;
                if (pendingLen < need) return;
                const u8 = encode(pending, pendingLen, ac.sampleRate);
                pending = []; pendingLen = 0;
                window.set(window.ref(window.rtdb, `${base}/a_${myUID}`), { s: seqA++, d: b64(u8) }).catch(() => {});
            };
            srcNode.connect(proc); proc.connect(sink); sink.connect(ac.destination);
        } catch (e) { console.warn('[Relay] audio capture failed:', e && e.message); }

        if (isVideo) {
            const cv = document.createElement('canvas'); cv.width = VW; cv.height = VH;
            const g = cv.getContext('2d');
            const lv = document.getElementById('local-video');
            vTimer = setInterval(() => {
                if (!on || !lv || lv.readyState < 2) return;
                const t = localStream && localStream.getVideoTracks()[0];
                if (t && !t.enabled) { g.fillStyle = '#000'; g.fillRect(0, 0, VW, VH); }
                else g.drawImage(lv, 0, 0, VW, VH);
                window.set(window.ref(window.rtdb, `${base}/v_${myUID}`), { s: seqV++, d: cv.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.5) }).catch(() => {});
            }, FRAME_MS);
        }

        let gotA = false, gotV = false;
        const relayLog = (e, d) => { try { activeCallDocId && CallDiag.log(activeCallDocId, e, d); } catch (_) {} };
        if (other) {
            unsubs.push(window.onValue(window.ref(window.rtdb, `${base}/a_${other}`), (snap) => {
                const v = snap.val();
                if (!v || typeof v.d !== 'string' || v.s <= lastA) return;
                lastA = v.s;
                if (!gotA) { gotA = true; relayLog('relay_audio_in', 'first inbound audio chunk · seq ' + v.s); }
                try { play(unb64(v.d)); } catch (_) {}
            }));
            unsubs.push(window.onValue(window.ref(window.rtdb, `${base}/v_${other}`), (snap) => {
                const v = snap.val();
                if (!v || typeof v.d !== 'string' || v.s <= lastV || !v.d.startsWith('data:image/jpeg')) return;
                lastV = v.s;
                if (!gotV) { gotV = true; relayLog('relay_video_in', 'first inbound frame · seq ' + v.s + ' · ' + Math.round(v.d.length / 1024) + 'KB'); }
                if (img) img.src = v.d;
            }));
        } else {
            relayLog('relay_no_peer', 'could not work out the other uid — relay can only send, not receive');
        }
        setTimeout(() => {
            if (!on) return;
            if (!gotA && !gotV) { try { activeCallDocId && CallDiag.error(activeCallDocId, 'relay_no_media_8s', `nothing inbound after 8s · sent a=${seqA} v=${seqV} · other=${other || 'unknown'}`); } catch (_) {} }
            else if (!gotA) { relayLog('relay_audio_missing_8s', 'video arrived but no audio'); }
        }, 8000);
        ui(isVideo);
        try { _markCallUiConnected(isVideo); } catch (_) {}
        try { window.showCooldownToast?.('Your network blocks calls, so this one is using a backup connection.', true); } catch (_) {}
    }
    function listen(signalPath) {
        if (listenUnsub) { try { listenUnsub(); } catch (_) {} }
        const joinedAt = _srvNow();
        listenUnsub = window.onValue(window.ref(window.rtdb, signalPath + '/relay/start'), (snap) => {
            const v = snap.val();
            if (!v || v.from === myUID || v.ts < joinedAt - 60000) return;
            start(v.reason || 'other side switched', true);
        });
    }
    function stop() {
        if (listenUnsub) { try { listenUnsub(); } catch (_) {} listenUnsub = null; }
        if (!on) return;
        on = false;
        window._relayActive = false;
        unsubs.forEach(u => { try { u(); } catch (_) {} }); unsubs = [];
        if (vTimer) { clearInterval(vTimer); vTimer = null; }
        try { srcNode && srcNode.disconnect(); proc && proc.disconnect(); sink && sink.disconnect(); } catch (_) {}
        try { ac && ac.close(); } catch (_) {}
        ac = proc = srcNode = sink = null;
        if (img) { img.remove(); img = null; }
        if (badge) { badge.remove(); badge = null; }
        const b = base; base = null;
        if (b) { try { window.remove(window.ref(window.rtdb, b)); } catch (_) {} }
        seqA = seqV = 0; lastA = lastV = -1; pending = []; pendingLen = 0; playAt = 0;
    }
    return { start, stop, listen, get active() { return on; } };
})();
window.EchoRelay = EchoRelay;
async function _callRenegFlushCands() {
    try {
        if (!pc || !_callReneg.peerCands) return;
        const v = (await window.get(window.ref(window.rtdb, _callReneg.peerCands))).val();
        const thisPc = pc;
        if (v) Object.values(v).forEach(c => thisPc.addIceCandidate(new RTCIceCandidate(c)).then(() => { thisPc._diagRemoteAdded = (thisPc._diagRemoteAdded || 0) + 1; }).catch(() => {}));
    } catch (_) {}
}
function _callRenegListen(signalPath, peerCandsPath) {
    EchoRelay.listen(signalPath);
    _callReneg.path = signalPath;
    _callReneg.peerCands = peerCandsPath;
    const joinedAt = _srvNow();
    _callReneg.unsubs.push(window.onValue(window.ref(window.rtdb, `${signalPath}/reneg`), async (snap) => {
        const v = snap.val();
        if (!v || !pc || v.from === myUID || _callReneg.handled.has(v.nonce) || v.ts < joinedAt - 15000) return;
        _callReneg.handled.add(v.nonce);
        try {
            if (pc.signalingState === 'have-local-offer') {
                if (String(myUID) < String(v.from)) return;
                await pc.setLocalDescription({ type: 'rollback' });
                _callReneg.pending = null;
            }
            _callRenegToast(false);
            if (v.tcp) {
                _callReneg.tcpTried = true;
                pc._tcpOnly = true;
                try { activeCallDocId && CallDiag.log(activeCallDocId, 'tcp_fallback', 'other side asked for TCP-only'); } catch (_) {}
            }
            await pc.setRemoteDescription(new RTCSessionDescription({ type: 'offer', sdp: pc._tcpOnly ? _callTcpOnlySdp(v.sdp) : v.sdp }));
            const ans = await pc.createAnswer();
            await pc.setLocalDescription(ans);
            await window.set(window.ref(window.rtdb, `${signalPath}/reneg_answer`), { from: myUID, nonce: v.nonce, sdp: pc._tcpOnly ? _callTcpOnlySdp(ans.sdp) : ans.sdp, ts: _srvNow() });
            _callRenegFlushCands();
        } catch (e) { console.warn('[Call] reconnect answer failed:', e && e.message); }
    }));
    _callReneg.unsubs.push(window.onValue(window.ref(window.rtdb, `${signalPath}/reneg_answer`), async (snap) => {
        const v = snap.val();
        if (!v || !pc || v.from === myUID || v.nonce !== _callReneg.pending) return;
        _callReneg.pending = null;
        try {
            if (pc.signalingState !== 'have-local-offer') return;
            await pc.setRemoteDescription(new RTCSessionDescription({ type: 'answer', sdp: pc._tcpOnly ? _callTcpOnlySdp(v.sdp) : v.sdp }));
            _callRenegFlushCands();
        } catch (e) { console.warn('[Call] reconnect apply-answer failed:', e && e.message); }
    }));
}
function _callRenegToast(mine) {
    try { window.showCooldownToast?.(mine ? 'Reconnecting call…' : 'Reconnecting call (started by the other person)…', true); } catch (_) {}
}
window.reconnectCall = async (why) => {
    if (!pc || !_callReneg.path || pc.connectionState === 'closed') return;
    const now = _srvNow();
    try { activeCallDocId && CallDiag.log(activeCallDocId, 'reconnect_attempt', why); } catch (_) {}
    const tcp = why === 'tcp_fallback';
    if (why === 'manual') { if (now - _callReneg.lastAt < 4000) return; }
    else if (tcp) {
        if (_callReneg.tcpTried) return;
        _callReneg.tcpTried = true;
        pc._tcpOnly = true;
    }
    else {
        if (now - _callReneg.lastAt < 20000 || _callReneg.autos >= 3) return;
        _callReneg.autos++;
    }
    if (pc.signalingState !== 'stable') return;
    _callReneg.lastAt = now;
    const nonce = now + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8);
    try {
        const offer = await pc.createOffer({ iceRestart: true });
        await pc.setLocalDescription(offer);
        _callReneg.pending = nonce;
        _callReneg.handled.add(nonce);
        await window.set(window.ref(window.rtdb, `${_callReneg.path}/reneg`), { from: myUID, nonce, sdp: pc._tcpOnly ? _callTcpOnlySdp(offer.sdp) : offer.sdp, ts: now, ...(tcp ? { tcp: true } : {}) });
        _callRenegToast(true);
        setTimeout(async () => {
            if (_callReneg.pending === nonce && pc && pc.signalingState === 'have-local-offer') {
                _callReneg.pending = null;
                try { await pc.setLocalDescription({ type: 'rollback' }); } catch (_) {}
            }
        }, 10000);
    } catch (e) { console.warn('[Call] reconnect failed:', e && e.message); }
};
function _callWatchForStall(thisPc) {
    let last = -1, flat = 0;
    const iv = setInterval(async () => {
        if (pc !== thisPc || thisPc.connectionState === 'closed') { clearInterval(iv); return; }
        if (thisPc.connectionState !== 'connected') { flat = 0; last = -1; return; }
        let bytes = 0, any = false;
        try { (await thisPc.getStats()).forEach(r => { if (r.type === 'inbound-rtp') { any = true; bytes += r.bytesReceived || 0; } }); }
        catch (_) { return; }
        if (!any) return;
        if (bytes === last) flat++; else flat = 0;
        last = bytes;
        if (flat >= 3) { flat = 0; console.warn('[Call] no media for ~12s while connected — reconnecting'); window.reconnectCall('auto'); }
    }, 4000);
}

async function setupMedia(isVideo) {
    localStream = await _getCallMedia(isVideo, _getCallAudioConstraints());
    localStream = await _cafxSetupForNewCall(localStream);
    const lv = document.getElementById('local-video');
    lv.srcObject = localStream;
    lv.style.display = isVideo ? 'block' : 'none';
    pc = new RTCPeerConnection(servers);
    remoteStream = new MediaStream();
    const rv = document.getElementById('remote-video');
    rv.srcObject = remoteStream;
    rv.style.objectFit = 'cover';
    localStream.getTracks().forEach(track => pc.addTrack(track, localStream));
    pc.ontrack = (event) => { event.streams[0].getTracks().forEach(track => remoteStream.addTrack(track)); };
    _callRenegReset();
    _callArmTcpFilter(pc);
    _callWatchForBlockedMedia(pc);
    _callWatchForStall(pc);
    document.getElementById('btn-cam').style.opacity = isVideo ? "1" : "0.5";
    document.getElementById('btn-cam').classList.toggle('active', !isVideo);
    _updateCallAudioFXButtons();

    _callUiConnectedShown = false;
    pc.oniceconnectionstatechange = () => {
        if (['connected', 'completed'].includes(pc.iceConnectionState)) {
            _markCallUiConnected(isVideo);
        }
    };
    let _reconnectGiveUpTimer = null;
    pc.onconnectionstatechange = () => {
        const state = pc.connectionState;
        const statusEl = document.getElementById(isVideo ? 'call-status' : 'acf-status');
        if (state === 'connected') {
            if (_reconnectGiveUpTimer) { clearTimeout(_reconnectGiveUpTimer); _reconnectGiveUpTimer = null; }
            if (statusEl && (statusEl.innerText === 'Reconnecting...' || statusEl.textContent === 'Reconnecting...')) {
                if (isVideo) statusEl.style.display = 'none'; else statusEl.textContent = '';
            }
        } else if (state === 'disconnected' || state === 'failed') {
            if (statusEl) {
                if (isVideo) { statusEl.innerText = 'Reconnecting...'; statusEl.style.display = 'flex'; }
                else { statusEl.textContent = 'Reconnecting...'; }
            }
            window.reconnectCall && window.reconnectCall('auto');
            if (!_reconnectGiveUpTimer) {
                _reconnectGiveUpTimer = setTimeout(() => {
                    if (pc && (pc.connectionState === 'disconnected' || pc.connectionState === 'failed')) {
                        window.hangupCall();
                        alert('Call lost connection and could not reconnect.');
                    }
                }, 20000);
            }
        }
    };
}

function _markCallUiConnected(isVideo) {
    if (_callUiConnectedShown) return;
    _callUiConnectedShown = true;
    if (isVideo) {
        const st = document.getElementById('call-status');
        if (st) st.style.display = 'none';
        if (localStream && !_vidMyDetector) _startVideoCallSpeakingGlow();
    } else {
        const st = document.getElementById('acf-status');
        const timerEl = document.getElementById('acf-timer');
        if (st && st.textContent !== 'Connected') st.textContent = 'Connected';
        if (timerEl && timerEl.style.display === 'none') { timerEl.style.display = 'block'; _startAcfTimer(); }
        if (localStream && !_acfMyDetector) _startVoiceActivityDetection();
    }
}

window.shareScreen = async () => {
    if (!pc) return;
    try {
        const s = await navigator.mediaDevices.getDisplayMedia({ video: { cursor: "always" } });
        screenTrack = s.getVideoTracks()[0];
        originalVideoTrack = localStream.getVideoTracks()[0];
        const sender = pc.getSenders().find(s => s.track?.kind === 'video');
        if (sender) sender.replaceTrack(screenTrack);
        document.getElementById('local-video').srcObject = s;
        document.getElementById('local-video').style.display = 'block';
        document.getElementById('remote-video').style.objectFit = 'contain';
        document.getElementById('btn-screen').classList.add('active');
        document.getElementById('btn-stop-screen').classList.remove('hidden');
        screenTrack.onended = stopShareScreen;
    } catch(e) {}
};

    if(!screenTrack || !pc) return;
    const sender = pc.getSenders().find(s => s.track?.kind === 'video');
    if (sender && originalVideoTrack) sender.replaceTrack(originalVideoTrack);
    document.getElementById('local-video').srcObject = localStream;
    document.getElementById('remote-video').style.objectFit = 'cover';
    screenTrack.stop(); screenTrack = null; originalVideoTrack = null;
    document.getElementById('btn-screen').classList.remove('active');
    document.getElementById('btn-stop-screen').classList.add('hidden');
};

window._initOnboarding = async function(uData, uid) {
    try {
        if (!uData || uData.onboardingVersion !== 1) return;
        let ob = uData.onboarding;
        if (!ob) {
            document.getElementById('onboarding-bot-name-input').value = window._rollOnboardingBotName();
            document.getElementById('onboarding-name-modal').classList.remove('hidden');
            return;
        }
        window._onboardingState = ob;
        window._onboardingBotUid = ob.botId || null;
        if (ob.completedTut) {
            document.getElementById('onboarding-quest-card').classList.add('hidden');
        } else {
            document.getElementById('onboarding-quest-card').classList.remove('hidden');
            window._renderOnboardingCard(ob);
        }
        window._checkNewcomerBadgeExpiry(ob, uid);
        window._checkBotAutoUnfriend(ob, uid);
    } catch(e) { console.warn('[onboarding] init failed:', e); }
};

window._confirmOnboardingBotName = async function() {
    const nameInput = document.getElementById('onboarding-bot-name-input');
    const botName = sanitizeText((nameInput.value || '').trim()).slice(0, 20) || window._rollOnboardingBotName();
    document.getElementById('onboarding-name-modal').classList.add('hidden');
    const botRef = doc(collection(db, 'users'));
    const botId = botRef.id;
    let botCreated = false, chatId = null, chatCreated = false;
    try {
        const botPfp = `data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 64 64'%3E%3Crect width='64' height='64' rx='32' fill='%236366f1' fill-opacity='0.18'/%3E%3Ctext x='32' y='42' text-anchor='middle' font-size='28'%3E%F0%9F%A4%96%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E`;
        await setDoc(botRef, {
            uid: botId, username: botName, lower_username: botName.toLowerCase(),
            isOnline: true, status: 'approved', pfp: botPfp,
            isBot: true, botOwner: myUID
        });
        botCreated = true;
        chatId = [myUID, botId].sort().join('_');
        await setDoc(doc(db, 'chats', chatId), {
            participants: [myUID, botId], names: { [myUID]: myUsername, [botId]: botName },
            pfps: { [myUID]: myPfp || '', [botId]: botPfp }, isGroup: false, lastActivity: serverTimestamp()
        });
        chatCreated = true;
        const ob = {
            startedAt: serverTimestamp(), botId, botName,
            addedFriend: true, sentFirstMessage: false, calledFriend: false, videoCalledFriend: false,
            completedTut: false, completedAt: null, botRemoved: false
        };
        await updateDoc(doc(db, 'users', myUID), { onboarding: ob });
        window._onboardingState = { ...ob, startedAt: new Date() };
        window._onboardingBotUid = botId;
        document.getElementById('onboarding-quest-card').classList.remove('hidden');
        window._renderOnboardingCard(window._onboardingState);
        setTimeout(() => _sendBotMessage(chatId, botId, botName, _pick(ONBOARDING_WELCOME_MSGS)), 5000);
    } catch(e) {
        console.error('[onboarding] bot creation failed:', e.code, e.message, e);
        if (chatCreated) await deleteDoc(doc(db, 'chats', chatId)).catch(()=>{});
        if (botCreated) await deleteDoc(botRef).catch(()=>{});
        alert('Could not set up your onboarding buddy (' + (e.code || e.message) + '). This is almost always a Firestore rules permission issue — see the /users/{botId} create rule. You can try again.');
        document.getElementById('onboarding-bot-name-input').value = botName;
        document.getElementById('onboarding-name-modal').classList.remove('hidden');
    }
};

async function _sendBotMessage(chatId, botId, botName, text) {
    try {
        await updateDoc(doc(db, 'chats', chatId), { unreadBy: [myUID], lastActivity: serverTimestamp() });
        await addDoc(collection(db, `chats/${chatId}/messages`), { text, uid: botId, timestamp: serverTimestamp() });
    } catch(e) { console.warn('[onboarding] bot message failed:', e); }
}

window._isOnboardingBotChat = (chatId) => {
    const ob = window._onboardingState;
    return !!(ob && ob.botId && chatId === [myUID, ob.botId].sort().join('_'));
};

window._onOnboardingMessageSent = async function(chatId, chatData, text) {
    let ob = window._onboardingState;
    if (!ob) {
        try {
            const snap = await getDoc(doc(db, 'users', myUID));
            const uData = snap.exists() ? snap.data() : null;
            if (uData?.onboardingVersion === 1 && uData.onboarding) {
                ob = uData.onboarding;
                window._onboardingState = ob;
                window._onboardingBotUid = ob.botId || null;
                if (!ob.completedTut) document.getElementById('onboarding-quest-card')?.classList.remove('hidden');
            }
        } catch(e) { console.warn('[onboarding] lazy-recover failed:', e); }
    }
    if (!ob || ob.sentFirstMessage) return;
    try {
        await updateDoc(doc(db, 'users', myUID), { 'onboarding.sentFirstMessage': true });
        ob.sentFirstMessage = true;
        window._maybeCompleteOnboarding(ob);
        window._renderOnboardingCard(ob);
        if (window._isOnboardingBotChat(chatId)) {
            setTimeout(() => _sendBotMessage(chatId, ob.botId, ob.botName, _pick(ONBOARDING_REPLY_MSGS)), 2500);
        }
    } catch(e) { console.warn('[onboarding] message step failed:', e); }
};

window._maybeCompleteOnboarding = async function(ob) {
    if (ob.completedTut || ob.addedFriend !== true || ob.sentFirstMessage !== true) return;
    ob.completedTut = true;
    ob.completedAt = new Date();
    try {
        await updateDoc(doc(db, 'users', myUID), { 'onboarding.completedTut': true, 'onboarding.completedAt': serverTimestamp() });
    } catch(e) { console.warn('[onboarding] completion write failed:', e); }
    if (typeof _renderProfileStreakBadges === 'function') {
        try { const uSnap = await getDoc(doc(db, 'users', myUID)); if (uSnap.exists()) _renderProfileStreakBadges(uSnap.data()); } catch(e) {}
    }
    const closeBtn = document.getElementById('oqc-close');
    if (closeBtn) closeBtn.classList.remove('hidden');
};

function _botCallCleanupVoice() {
    if (_botCallSilenceTimer) { clearTimeout(_botCallSilenceTimer); _botCallSilenceTimer = null; }
    if (botLiveSession) { botLiveSession.close(); botLiveSession = null; }
    window._botCallActive = false;
}

window._simulateBotCall = function(isVideo) {
    const ob = window._onboardingState;
    if (!ob) { console.warn('[onboarding] simulateBotCall fired with no active onboarding state'); return; }
    if (window._botCallActive) return;
    window._botCallActive = true;
    const botName = ob.botName || 'Buddy';
    const flag = isVideo ? 'videoCalledFriend' : 'calledFriend';
    const chatId = window._onboardingBotUid ? [myUID, window._onboardingBotUid].sort().join('_') : null;
    let ringLogId = null;

    if (chatId) postCallLog(chatId, isVideo ? `📹 ${myUsername} started a video call` : `📞 ${myUsername} started a call`)
        .then(id => { ringLogId = id; }).catch(()=>{});

    if (isVideo) {
        const fv = document.getElementById('floating-video');
        fv.classList.remove('hidden'); fv.style.display = 'flex';
        const status = document.getElementById('call-status');
        status.innerText = 'Dialing...'; status.style.display = 'flex';
        status.style.background = 'linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(5,5,15,0.31), rgba(5,5,15,0.546) 78%)';
        status.style.alignItems = 'flex-end';
        status.style.paddingBottom = '16px';
        const remoteVid = document.getElementById('remote-video');
        if (remoteVid) remoteVid.style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('bot-call-flame-wrapper')?.classList.remove('hidden');
    } else {
        _showAudioCallFloat(botName, '', 'Dialing...');
    }

    const setCaption = (text) => {
        if (isVideo) { const s = document.getElementById('call-status'); if (s) s.innerText = text; }
        else { const s = document.getElementById('acf-status'); if (s) s.textContent = text; }
    };

    const endCall = (logText) => {
        _botCallCleanupVoice();
        if (isVideo) {
            document.getElementById('floating-video')?.classList.add('hidden');
            const fv2 = document.getElementById('floating-video'); if (fv2) fv2.style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('bot-call-flame-wrapper')?.classList.add('hidden');
            _setBotCallFlameState('idle');
            const remoteVid = document.getElementById('remote-video'); if (remoteVid) remoteVid.style.display = '';
            const status = document.getElementById('call-status');
            if (status) { status.style.background = ''; status.style.alignItems = ''; status.style.paddingBottom = ''; }
        }
        else { document.getElementById('audio-call-float')?.classList.add('hidden'); }
        if (chatId && ringLogId) updateCallLog(chatId, ringLogId, logText);
    };

    setTimeout(async () => {
        setCaption(`🤖 ${botName} picked up`);
        if (chatId && ringLogId) updateCallLog(chatId, ringLogId, isVideo ? `📹 ${botName} answered the video call` : `📞 ${botName} answered the call`);

        if (!ob[flag]) {
            ob[flag] = true;
            try { await updateDoc(doc(db, 'users', myUID), { [`onboarding.${flag}`]: true }); } catch(e) { console.warn('[onboarding] call flag write failed:', e); }
            window._renderOnboardingCard(ob);
        }

        setCaption(`🤖 ${botName} is connecting...`);
        _setBotCallFlameState('speaking');
        let silenceArmed = false;
        let heardUser = false;

        botLiveSession = new GeminiLiveSession({
            systemInstruction:
                `You are ${botName}, EchoSpace's onboarding buddy bot, making a brief test call to a ` +
                `brand-new user to show them calls work. Open the call with almost exactly this line, ` +
                `spoken naturally in your own voice: "${ONBOARDING_CALL_GREETING(botName)}" ` +
                `If the user replies, respond warmly in one or two short sentences, mention that you're ` +
                `a lightweight test buddy bot rather than a full conversational AI, and keep things brief — ` +
                `this is a quick onboarding check, not a long conversation.`,
            onState: (state) => {
                if (state === 'connecting') return;
                _setBotCallFlameState(state === 'speaking' ? 'speaking' : 'listening');
                setCaption(state === 'speaking' ? `🤖 ${botName} is talking...` : `🤖 Listening...`);
                if (state === 'listening' && !silenceArmed) {
                    silenceArmed = true;
                    _botCallSilenceTimer = setTimeout(() => {
                        if (heardUser || !window._botCallActive) return;
                        setCaption(`🤖 ${botName} is talking...`);
                        _setBotCallFlameState('speaking');
                        setTimeout(() => endCall(isVideo ? `📹 Video call ended (no response)` : `📞 Call ended (no response)`), 2500);
                    }, 10000);
                }
            },
            onInputTranscript: (text, isFinal) => {
                if (isFinal && text.trim() && !heardUser) {
                    heardUser = true;
                    if (_botCallSilenceTimer) { clearTimeout(_botCallSilenceTimer); _botCallSilenceTimer = null; }
                    setCaption(`🤖 Connected`);
                }
            },
            onError: (err) => console.warn('[onboarding] bot call Live session error:', err),
            onClose: () => { if (window._botCallActive) endCall(isVideo ? `📹 Video call ended` : `📞 Call ended`); }
        });

        try {
            await botLiveSession.connect();
        } catch (e) {
            console.warn('[onboarding] bot call Live session failed to start:', e);
            endCall(isVideo ? `📹 Video call ended (connection error)` : `📞 Call ended (connection error)`);
        }
    }, 1800);
};

function _setBotCallFlameState(state) {
    const el = document.getElementById('bot-call-flame');
    if (!el) return;
    el.classList.remove('listening', 'speaking');
    if (state === 'listening' || state === 'speaking') el.classList.add(state);
}

window._dismissOnboardingCard = () => {
    const ob = window._onboardingState;
    if (!ob || !ob.completedTut) return;
    const card = document.getElementById('onboarding-quest-card');
    if (card) card.classList.add('hidden');
};
window._toggleOnboardingCard = () => {
    const body = document.getElementById('oqc-body');
    const chev = document.getElementById('oqc-chevron');
    const collapsed = body.style.display === 'none';
    body.style.display = collapsed ? 'flex' : 'none';
    chev.style.transform = collapsed ? 'rotate(0deg)' : 'rotate(-90deg)';
};
window._renderOnboardingCard = function(ob) {
    const body = document.getElementById('oqc-body');
    const progressText = document.getElementById('oqc-progress-text');
    const progressBar = document.getElementById('oqc-progress-bar');
    if (!body) return;
    const steps = [
        { key: 'addedFriend', label: 'Add your first friend', required: true, done: !!ob.addedFriend },
        { key: 'sentFirstMessage', label: `Reply to ${ob.botName || 'your buddy'}'s message`, required: true, done: !!ob.sentFirstMessage },
        { key: 'tourCompleted', label: 'Take a quick tour of EchoSpace', required: false, done: !!ob.tourCompleted, clickable: true, onClick: 'window._startSiteTour()', icon: '🧭', cta: true },
        { key: 'calledFriend', label: 'Call your friend', required: false, done: !!ob.calledFriend },
        { key: 'videoCalledFriend', label: 'Video call your friend', required: false, done: !!ob.videoCalledFriend },
    ];
    const requiredDone = steps.filter(s => s.required && s.done).length;
    const requiredTotal = steps.filter(s => s.required).length;
    progressText.innerText = `${requiredDone} of ${requiredTotal} done`;
    progressBar.style.width = `${Math.round((requiredDone / requiredTotal) * 100)}%`;
    body.innerHTML = steps.map(s => {
        const isCta = s.cta && !s.done;
        return `
        <div ${s.clickable && !s.done ? `onclick="${s.onClick}" style="cursor:pointer;"` : ''} class="${s.clickable && !s.done ? 'oqc-row-clickable' : ''} ${isCta ? 'oqc-row-tour' : ''}" style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:${isCta ? '10px 8px' : '8px 6px'};border-radius:12px;background:${s.done ? 'rgba(34,197,94,0.06)' : (isCta ? 'rgba(99,102,241,0.1)' : (s.clickable ? 'rgba(99,102,241,0.05)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.02)'))};transition:background 0.3s;${s.clickable && !s.done ? 'cursor:pointer;' : ''}">
            <div style="width:${isCta ? '26px' : '20px'};height:${isCta ? '26px' : '20px'};border-radius:8px;flex-shrink:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:${isCta ? '13px' : '11px'};font-weight:900;background:${s.done ? 'linear-gradient(135deg,#16a34a,#22c55e)' : (isCta ? 'linear-gradient(135deg,#4f46e5,#818cf8)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.06)')};color:${s.done ? '#fff' : '#fff'};border:1px solid ${s.done ? 'transparent' : (isCta ? 'transparent' : '#1e1e2e')};">${s.done ? '✓' : (s.icon || (s.clickable ? '▶' : ''))}</div>
            <div style="flex:1;font-size:${isCta ? '13px' : '12px'};font-weight:${isCta ? '800' : '700'};color:${s.done ? '#8ee6ac' : (isCta ? '#e8e8f0' : '#c8c8d8')};text-decoration:${s.done ? 'line-through' : 'none'};opacity:${s.done ? 0.75 : 1};">${s.label}${isCta ? ' →' : ''}</div>
            ${s.required ? '' : (isCta ? '<span style="font-size:9px;font-weight:800;color:#818cf8;background:rgba(99,102,241,0.15);border:1px solid rgba(99,102,241,0.3);padding:2px 7px;border-radius:8px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.04em;white-space:nowrap;"><i class="fa-solid fa-wand-magic-sparkles"></i> 2 min</span>' : '<span style="font-size:9px;font-weight:800;color:#818cf8;background:rgba(99,102,241,0.1);border:1px solid rgba(99,102,241,0.2);padding:1px 6px;border-radius:8px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.04em;">bonus</span>')}
        </div>`;
    }).join('');
};
