    { view: 'friends',       emoji: '🔍', title: 'Search',        tip: 'Find people by their username and send a friend request straight from here.' },
    { view: 'requests',      emoji: '🔔', title: 'Alerts',         tip: 'Incoming friend requests land here — accept or decline them anytime.' },
    { view: 'create-group',  emoji: '👥', title: 'Group Chats',    tip: 'Start a group chat with multiple friends at once from here.' },
    { view: 'music',         emoji: '🎵', title: 'Music',          tip: 'Your personal player — search tracks, build a queue, and follow along with lyrics.' },
    { view: 'watch',         emoji: '📺', title: 'Watch',          tip: 'Search YouTube, watch on your own, and save videos to catch up on later.' },
    { view: 'listenparties', emoji: '🎧', title: 'Parties',        tip: 'Create or join a room to listen or watch together, in sync, with friends. Nothing has to be live right now — starting your own room only takes a tap.' },
    { view: 'games',         emoji: '🎮', title: 'Games',          tip: 'A few built-in games you can play solo or with friends.' },
    { view: 'echoai',        emoji: '🤖', title: 'EchoAI',         tip: 'Your built-in assistant — ask it anything, including questions about EchoSpace itself.' },
    { view: 'settings',      emoji: '⚙️', title: 'Settings',       tip: 'Customize your profile picture, bio, banner, and background from here.' },
];
window._tourStepIndex = 0;
window._tourPrevView = null;
window._tourMinimized = false;
window._tourFailCount = 0;

function _tourPositionOverlay(navBtn) {
    const ring = document.getElementById('tour-spotlight-ring');
    const tip = document.getElementById('tour-tooltip');
    if (!navBtn || !ring || !tip) return;
    const r = navBtn.getBoundingClientRect();
    ring.style.left = (r.left - 6) + 'px'; ring.style.top = (r.top - 6) + 'px';
    ring.style.width = (r.width + 12) + 'px'; ring.style.height = (r.height + 12) + 'px';
    const isBottomNav = r.top > window.innerHeight * 0.7;
    let top, left;
    if (isBottomNav) { top = r.top - 180; left = Math.min(Math.max(r.left - 100, 12), window.innerWidth - 276); }
    else { top = Math.min(r.top, window.innerHeight - 220); left = r.right + 16; }
    if (left + 264 > window.innerWidth) left = window.innerWidth - 280;
    tip.style.top = Math.max(12, top) + 'px'; tip.style.left = Math.max(12, left) + 'px';
}

window._startSiteTour = function() {
    window._tourStepIndex = 0;
    window._tourFailCount = 0;
    window._tourMinimized = false;
    window._tourPrevView = window.currentView || null;
    document.getElementById('tour-resume-chip')?.classList.add('hidden');
    document.getElementById('onboarding-tour-overlay').classList.remove('hidden');
    window._tourShowStep(0);
};

function _tourAdvancePastBrokenStep() {
    window._tourFailCount++;
    if (window._tourFailCount > ONBOARDING_TOUR_STEPS.length) { window._tourFinish(); return; }
    window._tourStepIndex++;
    window._tourShowStep(window._tourStepIndex);
}

window._tourShowStep = function(i) {
    try {
        const steps = ONBOARDING_TOUR_STEPS;
        if (i >= steps.length) { window._tourFinish(); return; }
        const step = steps[i];
        const navBtn = document.querySelector(`.nav-btn[data-view="${step.view}"]`);
        if (!navBtn) { _tourAdvancePastBrokenStep(); return; }
        window._tourFailCount = 0;
        try { if (typeof switchView === 'function') switchView(step.view); } catch(e) { console.warn('[tour] switchView failed, spotlight-only fallback:', e); }
        document.getElementById('tour-step-emoji').textContent = step.emoji;
        document.getElementById('tour-step-title').textContent = step.title;
        document.getElementById('tour-step-tip').textContent = step.tip;
        document.getElementById('tour-step-count').textContent = `${i + 1} / ${steps.length}`;
        document.getElementById('tour-next-btn').textContent = (i === steps.length - 1) ? 'Finish' : 'Next';
        navBtn.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest', inline: 'nearest' });
        requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            const r = navBtn.getBoundingClientRect();
            if (r.width === 0 && r.height === 0) { _tourAdvancePastBrokenStep(); return; }
            _tourPositionOverlay(navBtn);
        }));
    } catch(e) {
        console.warn('[tour] step render failed, advancing:', e);
        _tourAdvancePastBrokenStep();
    }
};

window._tourNext = function() {
    window._tourStepIndex++;
    window._tourShowStep(window._tourStepIndex);
};

window._tourSkip = function() { window._tourFinish(); };

window._tourMinimize = function() {
    window._tourMinimized = true;
    document.getElementById('onboarding-tour-overlay')?.classList.add('hidden');
    const chip = document.getElementById('tour-resume-chip');
    const label = document.getElementById('tour-resume-label');
    if (label) label.textContent = `Tour paused — tap to resume (${window._tourStepIndex + 1}/${ONBOARDING_TOUR_STEPS.length})`;
    chip?.classList.remove('hidden');
};
window._tourResume = function() {
    window._tourMinimized = false;
    document.getElementById('tour-resume-chip')?.classList.add('hidden');
    document.getElementById('onboarding-tour-overlay')?.classList.remove('hidden');
    window._tourShowStep(window._tourStepIndex);
};

window._tourFinish = async function() {
    window._tourMinimized = false;
    document.getElementById('tour-resume-chip')?.classList.add('hidden');
    document.getElementById('onboarding-tour-overlay').classList.add('hidden');
    try { if (window._tourPrevView && typeof switchView === 'function') switchView(window._tourPrevView); } catch(e) {}
    const ob = window._onboardingState;
    if (ob && !ob.tourCompleted) {
        ob.tourCompleted = true;
        try { await updateDoc(doc(db, 'users', myUID), { 'onboarding.tourCompleted': true }); } catch(e) { console.warn('[onboarding] tour completion write failed:', e); }
        window._renderOnboardingCard(ob);
    }
};

window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
    if (window._tourMinimized) return;
    if (document.getElementById('onboarding-tour-overlay')?.classList.contains('hidden')) return;
    const step = ONBOARDING_TOUR_STEPS[window._tourStepIndex];
    if (step) _tourPositionOverlay(document.querySelector(`.nav-btn[data-view="${step.view}"]`));
});

window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.key !== 'Escape') return;
    if (document.getElementById('onboarding-tour-overlay')?.classList.contains('hidden')) return;
    window._tourMinimize();
});


window._newcomerExpired = (ob) => {
    if (!ob?.completedAt) return true;
    const completedMs = ob.completedAt?.toDate ? ob.completedAt.toDate().getTime() : new Date(ob.completedAt).getTime();
    return (Date.now() - completedMs) > (7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
};
window._checkNewcomerBadgeExpiry = function(ob, uid) {
    if (ob.completedTut && window._newcomerExpired(ob) && typeof _renderProfileStreakBadges === 'function') {
        getDoc(doc(db, 'users', uid)).then(s => { if (s.exists()) _renderProfileStreakBadges(s.data()); }).catch(()=>{});
    }
};

window._checkBotAutoUnfriend = async function(ob, uid) {
    if (!ob.completedTut || ob.botRemoved || !ob.completedAt || !ob.botId) return;
    const completedMs = ob.completedAt?.toDate ? ob.completedAt.toDate().getTime() : new Date(ob.completedAt).getTime();
    if ((Date.now() - completedMs) < (24 * 60 * 60 * 1000)) return;
    try {
        const chatId = [uid, ob.botId].sort().join('_');
        await _sendBotMessage(chatId, ob.botId, ob.botName, _pick(ONBOARDING_FAREWELL_MSGS));
        await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1200));
        await deleteDoc(doc(db, 'chats', chatId)).catch(()=>{});
        await deleteDoc(doc(db, 'users', ob.botId)).catch(e => console.warn('[onboarding] bot user doc cleanup failed (check rules):', e));
        await updateDoc(doc(db, 'users', uid), { 'onboarding.botRemoved': true });
        if (window._onboardingState) window._onboardingState.botRemoved = true;
    } catch(e) { console.warn('[onboarding] bot auto-unfriend failed:', e); }
};

let _currentCallIsVideo = true;

window.startWebRTCCall = async (isVideo) => {
    if (_gcActive) { alert('End the group call first before starting a 1:1 call.'); return; }
    if (!currentChatId) return;

    if (typeof window._isOnboardingBotChat === 'function' && window._isOnboardingBotChat(currentChatId)) {
        return window._simulateBotCall(isVideo);
    }

    const _toCheck = await _checkUserTimeout();
    if (_toCheck.blocked) {
        alert(`⏳ You are timed out for ${_fmtTimeoutRemaining(_toCheck.until)}. You cannot make calls.`);
        return;
    }

    const fid = currentChatData.participants.find(id => id !== myUID);
    const friendName = currentChatData.names?.[fid] || 'User';
    const _callId = currentChatId;
    let _ringAcked = false;
    _currentCallIsVideo = !!isVideo;
    activeCallDocId = currentChatId;
    activeCallOtherUid = fid;
    window.activeCallDocId = currentChatId;
    window.activeCallOtherUid = fid;
    CallDiag.begin(_callId, { kind: '1:1', direction: 'outgoing', isVideo: !!isVideo, otherUid: fid, otherName: friendName });
    try {
        window.get(window.ref(window.rtdb, `presence/${fid}`))
            .then(ps => CallDiag.log(_callId, 'callee_presence', ps.val()))
            .catch(e => CallDiag.log(_callId, 'callee_presence_unreadable', e && e.code));
    } catch (_) {}
    try {
        callLogMsgId = await postCallLog(currentChatId, isVideo ? `📹 ${myUsername} started a video call` : `📞 ${myUsername} started a call`);
    } catch (e) {
        callLogMsgId = null;
        CallDiag.error(_callId, 'call_log_message_failed', e && (e.code || e.message));
    }
    callStartTime = null;
    startRingtone('outgoing');

    if (isVideo) {
        const fv = document.getElementById('floating-video');
        fv.classList.remove('hidden'); fv.style.display = 'flex';
        document.getElementById('call-status').innerText = "Dialing...";
        document.getElementById('call-status').style.display = 'flex';
        document.getElementById('audio-call-float').classList.add('hidden');
    } else {
        _showAudioCallFloat(friendName, currentChatData.pfps?.[fid] || '', 'Dialing...');
    }

    let ringCount = 0;
    ringNotifInterval = setInterval(() => { ringCount++; triggerNotif(`Calling ${friendName}...`, `Ringing (${ringCount * 25}s)`, false); }, 25000);
    callRingTimer = setTimeout(async () => {
        clearRingState(); stopRingtone();
        CallDiag.end(_callId, 'no_answer', _ringAcked ? 'their device rang, nobody picked up' : 'their device never confirmed it was ringing');
        try { await window.set(window.ref(window.rtdb, `call_signaling/${activeCallDocId}/status`), 'missed'); } catch(e){}
        await updateCallLog(currentChatId, callLogMsgId, `📵 Missed call from ${myUsername}`);
        cleanupCallSignaling(activeCallDocId);
        _cleanupRtdbCallSignals(fid);
        activeCallDocId = null; activeCallOtherUid = null; hangupCallLocal();
    }, 60000);

    if (window.rtdb && window.remove && window.ref) {
        window.remove(window.ref(window.rtdb, `call_signaling/${_callId}`)).catch(()=>{});
    }

    const sig = {
        callId: currentChatId,
        callerId: myUID,
        callerName: myUsername,
        callerPfp: myPfp || '',
        isVideo: !!isVideo,
        ts: _srvNow()
    };
    if (window.rtdb && window.set && window.ref) {
        const channel = isVideo ? 'video_calls' : 'audio_calls';
        window.remove(window.ref(window.rtdb, `call_ack/${fid}`)).catch(() => {});
        window.set(window.ref(window.rtdb, `${channel}/${fid}`), sig)
            .then(() => CallDiag.log(_callId, 'ring_sent', channel))
            .catch(e => CallDiag.error(_callId, 'ring_write_failed', `${channel}: ${e && (e.code || e.message)}`));
        window.set(window.ref(window.rtdb, `call_signals/${fid}`), sig).catch(e => CallDiag.error(_callId, 'ring_write_failed', `call_signals: ${e && (e.code || e.message)}`));
        const _ackSince = sig.ts - 30000;
        _callTrack(window.onValue(window.ref(window.rtdb, `call_ack/${fid}`), (ackSnap) => {
            const ack = ackSnap.val();
            if (!ack || ack.callId !== _callId || activeCallDocId !== _callId) return;
            if ((ack.ts || 0) < _ackSince) return;
            if (ack.status === 'ringing') {
                if (!_ringAcked) { _ringAcked = true; CallDiag.log(_callId, 'callee_ringing'); }
                if (isVideo) {
                    const st = document.getElementById('call-status');
                    if (st && st.innerText === 'Dialing...') st.innerText = 'Ringing...';
                } else {
                    const st = document.getElementById('acf-status');
                    if (st && st.textContent === 'Dialing...') st.textContent = 'Ringing...';
                }
            } else if (ack.status === 'busy') {
                CallDiag.end(_callId, 'callee_busy');
                const st = document.getElementById(isVideo ? 'call-status' : 'acf-status');
                if (st) { if (isVideo) st.innerText = `${friendName} is on another call`; else st.textContent = `${friendName} is on another call`; }
                stopRingtone();
                setTimeout(() => { if (activeCallDocId === _callId) window.hangupCall(); }, 2500);
            }
        }));
        const _ackWarnTimer = setTimeout(() => {
            if (activeCallDocId === _callId && !_ringAcked) CallDiag.error(_callId, 'no_ring_ack_15s', 'callee device has not confirmed the ring');
        }, 15000);
        _callTrack(() => clearTimeout(_ackWarnTimer));
    }

    try {
        await setupMedia(isVideo);
        CallDiag.log(_callId, 'media_ready', (localStream ? localStream.getTracks().map(t => t.kind + (t._echoPlaceholder ? '(placeholder)' : '')).join(',') : ''));
        CallDiag.watchPc(_callId, pc);
    } catch(e) {
        console.error('[Call] getUserMedia failed:', e);
        CallDiag.error(_callId, 'media_failed', e && (e.name + ': ' + e.message));
        CallDiag.end(_callId, 'failed_media');
        clearRingState(); stopRingtone();
        _cleanupRtdbCallSignals(fid);
        activeCallDocId = null; activeCallOtherUid = null; hangupCallLocal();
        alert('Could not access ' + (isVideo ? 'camera and microphone' : 'microphone') + '. Please check your permissions.');
        return;
    }
    if (activeCallDocId !== _callId) {
        if (pc) { pc.close(); pc = null; }
        if (localStream) { localStream.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop()); localStream = null; }
        return;
    }
    const signalPath = `call_signaling/${_callId}`;
    pc.onicecandidate = (e) => {
        if (e.candidate) window.push(window.ref(window.rtdb, `${signalPath}/offerCandidates`), e.candidate.toJSON())
            .catch(err => CallDiag.error(_callId, 'candidate_write_failed', err && (err.code || err.message)));
    };
    _callRenegListen(signalPath, `${signalPath}/answerCandidates`);
    let offerDescription;
    try {
        offerDescription = await pc.createOffer();
        await pc.setLocalDescription(offerDescription);
    } catch (e) {
        CallDiag.error(_callId, 'create_offer_failed', e && (e.name + ': ' + e.message));
        CallDiag.end(_callId, 'failed_offer');
        clearRingState(); stopRingtone();
        _cleanupRtdbCallSignals(fid);
        activeCallDocId = null; activeCallOtherUid = null; hangupCallLocal();
        alert('Could not start the call: ' + (e && e.message || e));
        return;
    }
    try {
        await window.update(window.ref(window.rtdb, signalPath), {
            status: 'ringing',
            offer: { sdp: offerDescription.sdp, type: offerDescription.type }
        });
    } catch(e) {
        console.error('[Call] FAILED to write offer to ' + signalPath + ' (check RTDB rules):', e?.code || e?.message || e);
        CallDiag.error(_callId, 'offer_write_failed', e?.code || e?.message);
        CallDiag.end(_callId, 'failed_signaling');
        clearRingState(); stopRingtone();
        _cleanupRtdbCallSignals(fid);
        activeCallDocId = null; activeCallOtherUid = null; hangupCallLocal();
        alert('Could not start the call (signaling write failed): ' + (e?.message || e));
        return;
    }
    if (typeof window.trackQuestAction === 'function') {
        window.trackQuestAction('callsMade', 1).catch(() => {});
    }

    CallDiag.log(_callId, 'offer_sent');

    let _answerHandled = false;
    _callTrack(window.onValue(window.ref(window.rtdb, signalPath), async (snap) => {
        const data = snap.val();
        if (!data) return;
        if (data.status === 'ended' || data.status === 'missed' || data.status === 'declined') {
            CallDiag.end(_callId, data.status === 'ended' ? 'ended_by_other' : data.status);
            clearRingState(); stopRingtone();
            _cleanupRtdbCallSignals(fid);
            if (data.status === 'declined') await updateCallLog(currentChatId, callLogMsgId, `📵 Missed call from ${myUsername}`);
            cleanupCallSignaling(_callId);
            hangupCallLocal(); return;
        }
        if (!_answerHandled && data.answer && pc && !pc.currentRemoteDescription) {
            _answerHandled = true;
            try {
                await pc.setRemoteDescription(new RTCSessionDescription(data.answer));
            } catch (e) {
                CallDiag.error(_callId, 'answer_apply_failed', e && (e.name + ': ' + e.message));
                return;
            }
            CallDiag.log(_callId, 'answer_received');
            _callRenegFlushCands();
            clearRingState(); stopRingtone();
            _cleanupRtdbCallSignals(fid);
            callStartTime = Date.now();
            const st = document.getElementById(isVideo ? 'call-status' : 'acf-status');
            if (st && !_callUiConnectedShown) { if (isVideo) { st.innerText = 'Connecting...'; st.style.display = 'flex'; } else st.textContent = 'Connecting...'; }
            _callConnectWatchdog(_callId, isVideo);
            await updateCallLog(currentChatId, callLogMsgId, isVideo ? `📹 ${myUsername} started a video call` : `📞 ${myUsername} started a call`);
        }
    }));
    _callTrack(window.onValue(window.ref(window.rtdb, `${signalPath}/answerCandidates`), (snap) => {
        const val = snap.val(); if (!val || !pc || !pc.remoteDescription) return;
        Object.values(val).forEach(c => pc.addIceCandidate(new RTCIceCandidate(c)).then(() => { pc && (pc._diagRemoteAdded = (pc._diagRemoteAdded || 0) + 1); }).catch(()=>{}));
    }));
};

function _callConnectWatchdog(callId, isVideo) {
    const thisPc = pc;
    setTimeout(() => {
        if (!thisPc || pc !== thisPc || activeCallDocId !== callId) return;
        if (thisPc._everConnected || thisPc.connectionState === 'connected' || EchoRelay.active) return;
        EchoRelay.start('nothing connected after 15s');
    }, 15000);
    setTimeout(() => {
        if (!thisPc || pc !== thisPc || activeCallDocId !== callId) return;
        if (thisPc._everConnected || thisPc.connectionState === 'connected' || EchoRelay.active) return;
        CallDiag.error(callId, 'never_connected_30s', `ice ${thisPc.iceConnectionState} · conn ${thisPc.connectionState} · gathering ${thisPc.iceGatheringState} · remote candidates added ${thisPc._diagRemoteAdded || 0}`);
        CallDiag.end(callId, 'failed_to_connect');
        window.hangupCall();
        alert("The call couldn't connect. The Wi-Fi one of you is on is blocking calls. Try switching to a different Wi-Fi if you can.");
    }, 30000);
}

function _cleanupRtdbCallSignals(fid) {
    if (!window.rtdb || !window.remove || !window.ref) return;
    window.remove(window.ref(window.rtdb, `call_signals/${fid}`)).catch(()=>{});
    window.remove(window.ref(window.rtdb, `video_calls/${fid}`)).catch(()=>{});
    window.remove(window.ref(window.rtdb, `audio_calls/${fid}`)).catch(()=>{});
    window.remove(window.ref(window.rtdb, `call_ack/${fid}`)).catch(()=>{});
    if (myUID) window.remove(window.ref(window.rtdb, `call_ack/${myUID}`)).catch(()=>{});
}
function clearRingState() {
    if (callRingTimer) { clearTimeout(callRingTimer); callRingTimer = null; }
    if (ringNotifInterval) { clearInterval(ringNotifInterval); ringNotifInterval = null; }
}
async function _waitForRtdbOffer(path, timeoutMs = 8000, intervalMs = 150) {
    const start = Date.now();
    while (Date.now() - start < timeoutMs) {
        try {
            const snap = await window.get(window.ref(window.rtdb, path));
            const val = snap.val();
            if (val) return val;
        } catch(e) {
            console.error('[Call] FAILED to read ' + path + ' (check RTDB rules):', e?.code || e?.message || e);
        }
        await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, intervalMs));
    }
    return null;
}
function _showIncomingCallUI(data, docId) {
    if (activeCallDocId && activeCallDocId !== docId) { CallDiag.error(docId, 'incoming_ui_blocked', 'busy with ' + activeCallDocId); return; }
    activeCallDocId = docId;
    CallDiag.log(docId, 'incoming_shown');
    activeCallOtherUid = data.callerId || null;
    window.activeCallDocId = docId;
    window.activeCallOtherUid = data.callerId || null;
    const isVideo = !!data.isVideo;
    _currentCallIsVideo = isVideo;
    document.getElementById('incoming-name').innerText = data.callerName || 'Unknown';
    document.getElementById('incoming-call-subtitle').innerText = isVideo ? 'is video calling you...' : 'is audio calling you...';
    const iconEl = document.getElementById('incoming-call-icon');
    if (iconEl) iconEl.innerHTML = isVideo ? '<i class="fa-solid fa-video"></i>' : '<i class="fa-solid fa-phone"></i>';
    const pfpEl = document.getElementById('incoming-caller-pfp');
    if (pfpEl) { pfpEl.src = data.callerPfp || window._DEFAULT_PFP || ''; pfpEl.style.display = data.callerPfp ? 'block' : 'none'; }
    document.getElementById('incoming-call-modal').classList.remove('hidden');
    if (typeof _gamesFsToast === 'function') {
        _gamesFsToast({
            kind: 'call',
            title: (data.callerName || 'Unknown') + ' is calling',
            body: isVideo ? 'Incoming video call' : 'Incoming call',
            avatar: data.callerPfp || '',
            emoji: isVideo ? '\uD83D\uDCF9' : '\uD83D\uDCDE'
        });
    }
    startRingtone('incoming');
    triggerNotif(isVideo ? "Incoming Video Call" : "Incoming Call", `${data.callerName || 'Someone'} is calling...`, true);
    clearRingState();
    callRingTimer = setTimeout(async () => {
        document.getElementById('incoming-call-modal').classList.add('hidden');
        stopRingtone(); clearRingState();
        CallDiag.end(docId, 'missed', 'rang 60s on this device, not answered');
        if (activeCallDocId) {
            try {
                await window.set(window.ref(window.rtdb, `call_signaling/${activeCallDocId}/status`), 'missed');
                const msgSnap = await getDocs(query(collection(db, `chats/${activeCallDocId}/messages`), where("type", "==", "system"), orderBy("timestamp", "desc"), limit(1)));
                if (!msgSnap.empty) await updateDoc(doc(db, `chats/${activeCallDocId}/messages`, msgSnap.docs[0].id), { text: `📵 Missed call from ${data.callerName || 'User'}` });
                cleanupCallSignaling(activeCallDocId);
            } catch(e) { console.warn('[Call] auto-miss cleanup failed:', e.message); }
            activeCallDocId = null; activeCallOtherUid = null;
            window.activeCallDocId = null; window.activeCallOtherUid = null;
        }
    }, 60000);
}

let _incomingCallsListening = false;
function listenForIncomingCalls() {
    if (_incomingCallsListening) return;
    if (!window.rtdb || !window.ref || !window.onValue || !myUID) {
        console.warn('[Call] RTDB not ready or myUID missing — deferring listenForIncomingCalls');
        setTimeout(() => listenForIncomingCalls(), 1000);
        return;
    }
    _incomingCallsListening = true;

    window.onValue(window.ref(window.rtdb, '.info/serverTimeOffset'), (snap) => {
        const v = Number(snap.val());
        _rtdbSkew = isFinite(v) ? v : 0;
    });

    function _handleRtdbSignal(sig, callId) {
        if (!sig || !callId) return;

        if (sig.cancelled) {
            if (pc) return;
            if (activeCallDocId === callId || !activeCallDocId) {
                const wasRinging = !document.getElementById('incoming-call-modal').classList.contains('hidden');
                document.getElementById('incoming-call-modal').classList.add('hidden');
                stopRingtone(); clearRingState();
                if (wasRinging) CallDiag.end(callId, 'caller_cancelled');
                activeCallDocId = null;
            }
            return;
        }

        if (!sig.callerName) return;
        const ageMs = _srvNow() - (sig.ts || 0);
        if (ageMs > 90000) {
            if (ageMs < 15 * 60000) {
                CallDiag.note(callId, 'ring_ignored_stale', `ring is ${Math.round(ageMs / 1000)}s old by server time (this device skew ${Math.round(_rtdbSkew)}ms)`,
                    { kind: '1:1', direction: 'incoming', isVideo: !!sig.isVideo, otherUid: sig.callerId, otherName: sig.callerName });
            }
            ['video_calls', 'audio_calls', 'call_signals'].forEach(n => window.remove(window.ref(window.rtdb, `${n}/${myUID}`)).catch(() => {}));
            return;
        }

        const _live = _callIsLive();
        if (activeCallDocId && !_live) {
            CallDiag.note(callId, 'stale_call_state_cleared', `left over from call ${activeCallDocId}`,
                { kind: '1:1', direction: 'incoming', isVideo: !!sig.isVideo, otherUid: sig.callerId, otherName: sig.callerName });
            activeCallDocId = null; activeCallOtherUid = null;
            window.activeCallDocId = null; window.activeCallOtherUid = null;
        }
        if (activeCallDocId === callId) return;
        if (_live) {
            const busyKey = callId + '|' + (sig.ts || 0);
            if (_handleRtdbSignal._lastBusy === busyKey) return;
            _handleRtdbSignal._lastBusy = busyKey;
            window.set(window.ref(window.rtdb, `call_ack/${myUID}`), { callId, status: 'busy', ts: _srvNow() }).catch(() => {});
            CallDiag.note(callId, 'ring_while_busy', `on call ${activeCallDocId || (window._gcActive ? 'group call' : 'another call')}`,
                { kind: '1:1', direction: 'incoming', isVideo: !!sig.isVideo, otherUid: sig.callerId, otherName: sig.callerName });
            return;
        }

        CallDiag.begin(callId, { kind: '1:1', direction: 'incoming', isVideo: !!sig.isVideo, otherUid: sig.callerId, otherName: sig.callerName });
        CallDiag.log(callId, 'ring_received', `ring age ${Math.round(ageMs)}ms · skew ${Math.round(_rtdbSkew)}ms`);

        if (window.set && window.ref && sig.callerId) {
            window.set(window.ref(window.rtdb, `call_ack/${myUID}`), {
                callId, status: 'ringing', ts: _srvNow()
            }).catch(e => CallDiag.error(callId, 'ack_write_failed', e && (e.code || e.message)));
        }

        _showIncomingCallUI(sig, callId);
    }

    window.onValue(window.ref(window.rtdb, `video_calls/${myUID}`), (snap) => {
        const sig = snap.val();
        if (sig) _handleRtdbSignal({ ...sig, isVideo: true }, sig.callId);
    });
    window.onValue(window.ref(window.rtdb, `audio_calls/${myUID}`), (snap) => {
        const sig = snap.val();
        if (sig) _handleRtdbSignal({ ...sig, isVideo: false }, sig.callId);
    });

    window.onValue(window.ref(window.rtdb, `call_signals/${myUID}`), (snap) => {
        const sig = snap.val();
        if (sig && sig.callId) _handleRtdbSignal(sig, sig.callId);
    });
}
window.answerCall = async () => {
    if (window._isTimedOut && window._isTimedOut()) {
        window.declineCall();
        return;
    }
    document.getElementById('incoming-call-modal').classList.add('hidden');
    stopRingtone(); clearRingState();
    const isVideo = _currentCallIsVideo;
    const _chatId = activeCallDocId;
    CallDiag.log(_chatId, 'answer_clicked');
    if (window.rtdb && window.set && window.ref && myUID) {
        window.set(window.ref(window.rtdb, `call_ack/${myUID}`), { callId: _chatId, status: 'answered', ts: _srvNow() }).catch(()=>{});
    }
    if (typeof window.trackQuestAction === 'function') {
        window.trackQuestAction('callsAnswered', 1).catch(() => {});
    }
    if (window.rtdb && window.remove && window.ref && myUID) {
        window.remove(window.ref(window.rtdb, `call_signals/${myUID}`)).catch(()=>{});
        window.remove(window.ref(window.rtdb, `video_calls/${myUID}`)).catch(()=>{});
        window.remove(window.ref(window.rtdb, `audio_calls/${myUID}`)).catch(()=>{});
    }

    if (isVideo) {
        const fv = document.getElementById('floating-video');
        fv.classList.remove('hidden'); fv.style.display = 'flex';
        const _cs = document.getElementById('call-status');
        _cs.innerText = 'Connecting...'; _cs.style.display = 'flex';
        document.getElementById('audio-call-float').classList.add('hidden');
    } else {
        document.getElementById('floating-video').classList.add('hidden');
        document.getElementById('floating-video').style.display = 'none';
        const callerName = document.getElementById('incoming-name').innerText || 'Caller';
        const callerPfp = document.getElementById('incoming-caller-pfp').src || '';
        _showAudioCallFloat(callerName, callerPfp, 'Connecting...');
    }

    callStartTime = Date.now();
    try {
        await setupMedia(isVideo);
        CallDiag.log(_chatId, 'media_ready', (localStream ? localStream.getTracks().map(t => t.kind + (t._echoPlaceholder ? '(placeholder)' : '')).join(',') : ''));
        CallDiag.watchPc(_chatId, pc);
    } catch(e) {
        console.error('[Call] answerCall getUserMedia failed:', e);
        CallDiag.error(_chatId, 'media_failed', e && (e.name + ': ' + e.message));
        CallDiag.end(_chatId, 'failed_media');
        alert('Could not access ' + (isVideo ? 'camera and microphone' : 'microphone') + '. Please check your permissions.');
        activeCallDocId = null; activeCallOtherUid = null;
        window.activeCallDocId = null; window.activeCallOtherUid = null;
        hangupCallLocal();
        return;
    }
    if (activeCallDocId !== _chatId) {
        if (pc) { pc.close(); pc = null; }
        if (localStream) { localStream.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop()); localStream = null; }
        return;
    }
    const chatId = _chatId;
    const signalPath = `call_signaling/${chatId}`;
    pc.onicecandidate = (e) => {
        if (e.candidate) window.push(window.ref(window.rtdb, `${signalPath}/answerCandidates`), e.candidate.toJSON())
            .catch(err => CallDiag.error(chatId, 'candidate_write_failed', err && (err.code || err.message)));
    };
    _callRenegListen(signalPath, `${signalPath}/offerCandidates`);
    const offerDescription = await _waitForRtdbOffer(`${signalPath}/offer`, 45000, 300);
    if (activeCallDocId !== chatId) return;
    if (!offerDescription) {
        CallDiag.error(chatId, 'offer_never_arrived', 'waited 45s for the caller\'s offer');
        CallDiag.end(chatId, 'failed_no_offer');
        alert('Could not connect — the call setup info never arrived. Please try again.');
        activeCallDocId = null; activeCallOtherUid = null; hangupCallLocal();
        return;
    }
    CallDiag.log(chatId, 'offer_received');
    try {
        await pc.setRemoteDescription(new RTCSessionDescription(offerDescription));
        const answerDescription = await pc.createAnswer();
        await pc.setLocalDescription(answerDescription);
        await window.set(window.ref(window.rtdb, `${signalPath}/answer`), { type: answerDescription.type, sdp: answerDescription.sdp });
        await window.set(window.ref(window.rtdb, `${signalPath}/status`), 'answered');
    } catch (e) {
        CallDiag.error(chatId, 'answer_failed', e && (e.name ? e.name + ': ' : '') + (e && (e.code || e.message)));
        CallDiag.end(chatId, 'failed_answer');
        alert('Could not connect the call: ' + (e && e.message || e));
        window.hangupCall();
        return;
    }
    CallDiag.log(chatId, 'answer_sent');
    _callTrack(window.onValue(window.ref(window.rtdb, `${signalPath}/offerCandidates`), (snap) => {
        const val = snap.val(); if (!val || !pc) return;
        const thisPc = pc;
        Object.values(val).forEach(c => thisPc.addIceCandidate(new RTCIceCandidate(c)).then(() => { thisPc._diagRemoteAdded = (thisPc._diagRemoteAdded || 0) + 1; }).catch(()=>{}));
    }));
    _callTrack(window.onValue(window.ref(window.rtdb, `${signalPath}/status`), async (snap) => {
        if (snap.val() === 'ended' && pc) {
            CallDiag.end(chatId, 'ended_by_other');
            await finalizeCallLog(chatId); cleanupCallSignaling(chatId); hangupCallLocal();
        }
    }));
    _callConnectWatchdog(chatId, isVideo);
};
window.declineCall = async () => {
    document.getElementById('incoming-call-modal').classList.add('hidden');
    stopRingtone(); clearRingState();
    if (activeCallDocId) CallDiag.end(activeCallDocId, 'declined');
    if (window.rtdb && window.remove && window.ref && myUID) {
        window.remove(window.ref(window.rtdb, `call_signals/${myUID}`)).catch(()=>{});
        window.remove(window.ref(window.rtdb, `video_calls/${myUID}`)).catch(()=>{});
        window.remove(window.ref(window.rtdb, `audio_calls/${myUID}`)).catch(()=>{});
    }
    if (activeCallDocId) {
        const chatId = activeCallDocId;
        const callerName = document.getElementById('incoming-name')?.innerText || 'User';
        try { await window.set(window.ref(window.rtdb, `call_signaling/${chatId}/status`), 'declined'); } catch(e) {}
        activeCallDocId = null; activeCallOtherUid = null;
        window.activeCallDocId = null; window.activeCallOtherUid = null;
        try {
            const msgSnap = await getDocs(query(collection(db, `chats/${chatId}/messages`), where("type", "==", "system"), orderBy("timestamp", "desc"), limit(1)));
            if (!msgSnap.empty) {
                await updateDoc(doc(db, `chats/${chatId}/messages`, msgSnap.docs[0].id), { text: `📵 Missed call from ${callerName}` });
            }
        } catch (e) { console.warn('[Call] decline log update failed:', e && e.message); }
        cleanupCallSignaling(chatId);
    }
};
async function finalizeCallLog(callDocId) {
    if (!callDocId) return;
    try {
        const msgSnap = await getDocs(query(collection(db, `chats/${callDocId}/messages`), where("type", "==", "system"), orderBy("timestamp", "desc"), limit(1)));
        if (!msgSnap.empty) {
            const duration = callStartTime ? Math.round((Date.now() - callStartTime) / 1000) : 0;
            await updateDoc(doc(db, `chats/${callDocId}/messages`, msgSnap.docs[0].id), { text: `📞 Call ended - ${formatDuration(duration)}` });
        }
    } catch(e) { console.warn("finalizeCallLog error:", e); }
}
function cleanupCallSignaling(chatId) {
    if (!chatId || !window.rtdb || !window.remove || !window.ref) return;
    window.remove(window.ref(window.rtdb, `call_signaling/${chatId}`)).catch(()=>{});
}
window.hangupCall = async () => {
    if (window._botCallActive) {
        _botCallCleanupVoice();
        document.getElementById('floating-video')?.classList.add('hidden');
        const fv = document.getElementById('floating-video'); if (fv) fv.style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('audio-call-float')?.classList.add('hidden');
        return;
    }
    if (window._gcActive && typeof window.leaveGroupCall === 'function') {
        return window.leaveGroupCall();
    }
    clearRingState(); stopRingtone();
    const docId = activeCallDocId;
    const fid = activeCallOtherUid;
    if (docId) CallDiag.end(docId, (pc && pc.connectionState === 'connected') || _callUiConnectedShown ? 'ended_by_me' : 'cancelled_by_me');
    activeCallDocId = null; activeCallOtherUid = null;
    window.activeCallDocId = null; window.activeCallOtherUid = null;

    hangupCallLocal();

    if (docId) {
        if (fid && window.rtdb && window.set && window.ref) {
            const cancelSig = { callId: docId, cancelled: true, ts: _srvNow() };
            window.set(window.ref(window.rtdb, `call_signals/${fid}`), cancelSig).catch(()=>{});
            window.set(window.ref(window.rtdb, `video_calls/${fid}`), cancelSig).catch(()=>{});
            window.set(window.ref(window.rtdb, `audio_calls/${fid}`), cancelSig).catch(()=>{});
            setTimeout(() => {
                if (!window.rtdb || !window.remove || !window.ref) return;
                window.remove(window.ref(window.rtdb, `call_signals/${fid}`)).catch(()=>{});
                window.remove(window.ref(window.rtdb, `video_calls/${fid}`)).catch(()=>{});
                window.remove(window.ref(window.rtdb, `audio_calls/${fid}`)).catch(()=>{});
            }, 3000);
        }
        (async () => {
            try {
                const statusSnap = await window.get(window.ref(window.rtdb, `call_signaling/${docId}/status`));
                if (statusSnap.val() === 'answered') {
                    await finalizeCallLog(docId);
                } else {
                    const msgSnap = await getDocs(query(collection(db, `chats/${docId}/messages`), where("type", "==", "system"), orderBy("timestamp", "desc"), limit(1)));
                    if (!msgSnap.empty) await updateDoc(doc(db, `chats/${docId}/messages`, msgSnap.docs[0].id), { text: `📵 Missed call from ${myUsername}` });
                }
                await window.set(window.ref(window.rtdb, `call_signaling/${docId}/status`), 'ended');
                cleanupCallSignaling(docId);
            } catch(e) { console.warn("hangup error:", e); }
        })();
    }
};
function hangupCallLocal() {
    if (_gcActive) return;
    activeCallDocId = null;
    _callUntrackAll();
    EchoRelay.stop();
    _callRenegReset();
    if (pc) { pc.close(); pc = null; }
    if (localStream) { localStream.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop()); localStream = null; }
    if (screenTrack) { screenTrack.stop(); screenTrack = null; originalVideoTrack = null; }
    _stopVoiceActivityDetection();
    _stopVideoCallSpeakingGlow();
    _cleanupCallAudioFX();
    _stopAcfTimer();
    document.getElementById('call-audio-fx-popover')?.classList.add('hidden');
    document.getElementById('call-more-menu')?.classList.add('hidden');
    const fv = document.getElementById('floating-video');
    fv.classList.add('hidden'); fv.style.display = 'none';
    const acf = document.getElementById('audio-call-float');
    if (acf) acf.classList.add('hidden');
    document.getElementById('incoming-call-modal').classList.add('hidden');
    document.getElementById('local-video').srcObject = null;
    document.getElementById('remote-video').srcObject = null;
    document.getElementById('remote-video').style.objectFit = 'cover';
    document.getElementById('btn-stop-screen').classList.add('hidden');
    document.getElementById('btn-screen').classList.remove('active');
    document.getElementById('call-status').style.display = 'flex';
    document.getElementById('call-status').innerText = 'Connecting...';
    callStartTime = null; callLogMsgId = null; activeCallOtherUid = null;
    window.activeCallDocId = null; window.activeCallOtherUid = null;
    _currentCallIsVideo = true;
}

let _acfTimerInterval = null;

let _speakCtx = null;
function _getSpeakCtx() {
    if (!_speakCtx || _speakCtx.state === 'closed') {
        _speakCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
    }
    return _speakCtx;
}

function _createSpeakingDetector(getStream, onLevel) {
    let source = null, analyser = null, data = null, raf = null, addTrackHandler = null, boundStream = null;
    let _lastFrameTime = 0;
    const _FRAME_INTERVAL_MS = 80;

    function wire() {
        if (analyser) return true;
        const stream = getStream();
        if (!stream) return false;
        const tracks = stream.getAudioTracks();
        if (!tracks.length) return false;
        try {
            const ctx = _getSpeakCtx();
            source = ctx.createMediaStreamSource(stream);
            analyser = ctx.createAnalyser();
            analyser.fftSize = 256;
            source.connect(analyser);
            data = new Uint8Array(analyser.frequencyBinCount);
            return true;
        } catch (e) { console.warn('[SpeakingDetector] wire failed:', e); return false; }
    }

    function frame(now) {
        if (!raf && raf !== 0) return;
        if (now - _lastFrameTime < _FRAME_INTERVAL_MS) { raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame); return; }
        _lastFrameTime = now;
        if (analyser && data) {
            const stream = getStream();
            const track = stream && stream.getAudioTracks()[0];
            if (track && track.enabled === false) {
                onLevel(0);
            } else {
                analyser.getByteFrequencyData(data);
                const avg = data.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / data.length;
                onLevel(avg);
            }
        } else {
            onLevel(0);
        }
        raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    }

    return {
        start() {
            if (!wire()) {
                const stream = getStream();
                if (stream) {
                    boundStream = stream;
                    addTrackHandler = () => wire();
                    stream.addEventListener('addtrack', addTrackHandler);
                }
            }
            raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
        },
        stop() {
            if (raf) { cancelAnimationFrame(raf); raf = null; }
            if (boundStream && addTrackHandler) { try { boundStream.removeEventListener('addtrack', addTrackHandler); } catch (e) {} }
            addTrackHandler = null; boundStream = null;
            if (source) { try { source.disconnect(); } catch (e) {} source = null; }
            analyser = null; data = null;
        }
    };
}

function _maybeCloseSpeakCtx() {
    if (_speakCtx && !_gcActive && !localStream) {
        try { _speakCtx.close(); } catch (e) {}
        _speakCtx = null;
    }
}

    const timerEl = document.getElementById('acf-timer');
    if (!timerEl) return;
    let secs = 0;
    _stopAcfTimer();
    _acfTimerInterval = setInterval(() => {
        secs++;
        const m = Math.floor(secs / 60), s = secs % 60;
        timerEl.textContent = `${m}:${String(s).padStart(2, '0')}`;

function _applyRing(ringEl, avg) {
    if (!ringEl) return;
    const speaking = avg > 12;
    ringEl.style.background = speaking
        ? `radial-gradient(circle, rgba(52,211,153,${Math.min(avg/80,0.8)}) 0%, transparent 70%)`
        : 'transparent';
    ringEl.style.boxShadow = speaking
        ? `0 0 ${Math.min(avg/4,20)}px rgba(52,211,153,0.6)`
        : '0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.06)';
}

function _applyGlow(el, avg) {
    if (!el) return;
    if (el.dataset._glowBaseCaptured !== '1') {
        el.dataset._glowBaseBorder = el.style.borderColor || '';
        el.dataset._glowBaseShadow = el.style.boxShadow || '';
        el.dataset._glowBaseCaptured = '1';
    }
    const speaking = avg > 12;
    el.style.borderColor = speaking ? 'rgba(52,211,153,0.95)' : el.dataset._glowBaseBorder;
    el.style.boxShadow = speaking
        ? `0 0 ${Math.min(avg/3,26)}px rgba(52,211,153,0.55)`
        : el.dataset._glowBaseShadow;
}

function _applyInsetGlow(el, avg) {
    if (!el) return;
    const speaking = avg > 12;
    el.style.boxShadow = speaking
        ? `inset 0 0 0 3px rgba(52,211,153,0.9), inset 0 0 34px rgba(52,211,153,0.25)`
        : 'none';
}

window._callAudioSettings = (() => {
    let s = {};
    try { s = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('echo_call_audio_settings') || '{}'); } catch(e) {}
    if (typeof s.noiseSuppression !== 'boolean') s.noiseSuppression = true;
    if (typeof s.rnnoise !== 'boolean') s.rnnoise = false;
    return s;
})();
function _saveCallAudioSettings() {
    try { localStorage.setItem('echo_call_audio_settings', JSON.stringify(window._callAudioSettings)); } catch(e) {}
}

function _getCallAudioConstraints() {
    return {
        echoCancellation: true,
        noiseSuppression: !!window._callAudioSettings.noiseSuppression,
        autoGainControl: true
    };
}
window._getCallAudioConstraints = _getCallAudioConstraints;

const _RNNOISE_CDN = 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@shiguredo/noise-suppression@2022.4.2/dist';
let _rnnoiseScriptPromise = null;
function _loadRnnoiseScript() {
    if (window.Shiguredo && window.Shiguredo.NoiseSuppressionProcessor) return Promise.resolve();
    if (_rnnoiseScriptPromise) return _rnnoiseScriptPromise;
    _rnnoiseScriptPromise = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const s = document.createElement('script');
        s.src = `${_RNNOISE_CDN}/noise_suppression.js`;
        s.onload = () => resolve();
        s.onerror = () => { _rnnoiseScriptPromise = null; reject(new Error('Failed to load RNNoise script')); };
        document.head.appendChild(s);
    });
    return _rnnoiseScriptPromise;
}
function _rnnoiseSupported() {
    return !!(window.MediaStreamTrackProcessor && window.MediaStreamTrackGenerator);
}

window._CallAudioFX = { rawTrack: null, processedTrack: null, processor: null, rnnoiseOn: false, busy: false };

function _cafxInit(rawAudioTrack) {
    window._CallAudioFX = { rawTrack: rawAudioTrack || null, processedTrack: null, processor: null, rnnoiseOn: false, busy: false };
}

function _getActiveAudioSenders() {
    const senders = [];
    try {
        if (typeof pc !== 'undefined' && pc && typeof pc.getSenders === 'function') {
            pc.getSenders().forEach(s => { if (s.track && s.track.kind === 'audio') senders.push(s); });
        }
    } catch(e) {}
    if (_gcActive) {
        Object.values(_gcPCs).forEach(gpc => {
            try {
                if (gpc && typeof gpc.getSenders === 'function') {
                    gpc.getSenders().forEach(s => { if (s.track && s.track.kind === 'audio') senders.push(s); });
                }
            } catch(e) {}
        });
    }
    return senders;
}

async function _cafxEnableRnnoise() {
    const fx = window._CallAudioFX;
    if (fx.rnnoiseOn || fx.busy || !fx.rawTrack) return;
    if (!_rnnoiseSupported()) {
        if (typeof window.showCooldownToast === 'function') window.showCooldownToast('Advanced noise filter needs Chrome or Edge.');
        return;
    }
    fx.busy = true;
    try {
        await _loadRnnoiseScript();
        const processor = new window.Shiguredo.NoiseSuppressionProcessor(_RNNOISE_CDN);
        const processedTrack = await processor.startProcessing(fx.rawTrack);
        fx.processor = processor;
        fx.processedTrack = processedTrack;
        fx.rnnoiseOn = true;
        _getActiveAudioSenders().forEach(s => { s.replaceTrack(processedTrack).catch(()=>{}); });
        [typeof localStream !== 'undefined' ? localStream : null, _gcLocalStream].forEach(strm => {
            if (!strm) return;
            const old = strm.getAudioTracks()[0];
            if (old === fx.rawTrack) { strm.removeTrack(old); strm.addTrack(processedTrack); }
        });
    } catch(e) {
        console.warn('[RNNoise] enable failed:', e);
    } finally { fx.busy = false; }
}

function _cafxDisableRnnoise() {
    const fx = window._CallAudioFX;
    if (!fx.rnnoiseOn) return;
    if (fx.processor) { try { fx.processor.stopProcessing(); } catch(e) {} }
    const processedTrack = fx.processedTrack;
    fx.processor = null; fx.processedTrack = null; fx.rnnoiseOn = false;
    if (fx.rawTrack) {
        _getActiveAudioSenders().forEach(s => { s.replaceTrack(fx.rawTrack).catch(()=>{}); });
        [typeof localStream !== 'undefined' ? localStream : null, _gcLocalStream].forEach(strm => {
            if (!strm) return;
            const cur = strm.getAudioTracks()[0];
            if (cur === processedTrack) { strm.removeTrack(cur); strm.addTrack(fx.rawTrack); }
        });
    }
}

window.toggleRnnoise = async () => {
    if (window._CallAudioFX.rnnoiseOn) _cafxDisableRnnoise();
    else await _cafxEnableRnnoise();
    window._callAudioSettings.rnnoise = window._CallAudioFX.rnnoiseOn;
    _saveCallAudioSettings();
    _updateCallAudioFXButtons();
};

window.toggleNoiseSuppression = async () => {
    window._callAudioSettings.noiseSuppression = !window._callAudioSettings.noiseSuppression;
    _saveCallAudioSettings();
    const fx = window._CallAudioFX;
    const track = fx.rawTrack;
    if (track) {
        try { await track.applyConstraints(_getCallAudioConstraints()); }
        catch(e) { console.warn('[NoiseSuppression] applyConstraints failed:', e); }
    }
    _updateCallAudioFXButtons();
};

function _cleanupCallAudioFX() {
    const fx = window._CallAudioFX;
    if (fx.processor) { try { fx.processor.stopProcessing(); } catch(e) {} }
    window._CallAudioFX = { rawTrack: null, processedTrack: null, processor: null, rnnoiseOn: false, busy: false };
}
window._cleanupCallAudioFX = _cleanupCallAudioFX;

    if (btnFx) btnFx.classList.toggle('cafx-on', anyOn);
    if (acfBtnFx) acfBtnFx.classList.toggle('cafx-on', anyOn);
}
window._updateCallAudioFXButtons = _updateCallAudioFXButtons;

    const menuWidth = 210, menuHeight = 150;
    let left = rect.left + rect.width / 2 - menuWidth / 2;
    left = Math.max(8, Math.min(left, window.innerWidth - menuWidth - 8));

                menu.classList.add('hidden');
                document.removeEventListener('click', onDocClick);
            }
        };
        document.addEventListener('click', onDocClick);
    }, 0);
};

async function _cafxSetupForNewCall(stream) {
    const rawTrack = stream && stream.getAudioTracks()[0];
    _cafxInit(rawTrack);
    if (rawTrack && window._callAudioSettings.rnnoise && _rnnoiseSupported()) {
        try {
            await _loadRnnoiseScript();
            const processor = new window.Shiguredo.NoiseSuppressionProcessor(_RNNOISE_CDN);
            const processedTrack = await processor.startProcessing(rawTrack);
            window._CallAudioFX.processor = processor;
            window._CallAudioFX.processedTrack = processedTrack;
            window._CallAudioFX.rnnoiseOn = true;
            stream.removeTrack(rawTrack);
            stream.addTrack(processedTrack);
        } catch(e) { console.warn('[RNNoise] initial setup failed, using raw track:', e); }
    }
    return stream;
}
window._cafxSetupForNewCall = _cafxSetupForNewCall;

function _makeAcfDraggable() {
    const el = document.getElementById('audio-call-float');
    if (!el || el.dataset.acfDragBound) return;
    el.dataset.acfDragBound = '1';
    el.style.touchAction = 'none';

    let startX, startY, origLeft, origTop, dragging = false;

    el.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
        if (e.button) return;
        if (e.target.closest('button, input, select, textarea, a')) return;
        const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
        startX = e.clientX; startY = e.clientY;
        origLeft = rect.left; origTop = rect.top;
        el.style.right = 'auto'; el.style.bottom = 'auto';
        el.style.left = origLeft + 'px'; el.style.top = origTop + 'px';
        dragging = true;
        try { el.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch (_) {}
        e.preventDefault();
    });

    el.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {
        if (!dragging) return;
        const maxX = window.innerWidth - el.offsetWidth;
        const maxY = window.innerHeight - el.offsetHeight;
        el.style.left = Math.min(Math.max(0, origLeft + e.clientX - startX), Math.max(0, maxX)) + 'px';
        el.style.top  = Math.min(Math.max(0, origTop  + e.clientY - startY), Math.max(0, maxY)) + 'px';
    });

    const endDrag = (e) => {
        if (!dragging) return;
        dragging = false;
        try { el.releasePointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch (_) {}
    };
    el.addEventListener('pointerup', endDrag);
    el.addEventListener('pointercancel', endDrag);
}

window.transferGroupOwnership = async (newOwnerId, newOwnerName) => {
    if (!currentChatId || !currentChatData?.isGroup) return;
    if (currentChatData.owner !== myUID) return alert('Only the current owner can transfer ownership.');
    if (!confirm(`Transfer ownership to ${newOwnerName}? You will become a regular member and cannot undo this.`)) return;
    try {
        await updateDoc(doc(db, 'chats', currentChatId), { owner: newOwnerId });
        await addDoc(collection(db, `chats/${currentChatId}/messages`), {
            type: 'system', uid: 'system',
            text: `👑 ${newOwnerName} is now the group owner.`,
            timestamp: serverTimestamp()
        });
        currentChatData.owner = newOwnerId;
        openGroupManagement();
    } catch(e) { alert('Transfer failed: ' + e.message); }
};

    const ams = r && r.attachedMessages;
    if (!ams || !ams.length) return '';
    const E = window.escHtml || (s => s);

        let media = '';

        } else if (am.imageGrid && am.imageGrid.length) {
            media = `<div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px;margin-top:5px;">` +

            media = `<div style="margin-top:5px;"><span style="font-size:10px;color:#818cf8;font-weight:800;"><i class="fa-solid fa-microphone-lines"></i> Voice · ${Math.floor(vd/60)}:${String(vd%60).padStart(2,'0')}</span>` +

        } else if (am.fileName) {
            const card = window._renderFileCard && (am.fileURL

                    ? window._renderFileCard(am.fileName, am.fileSize, am.fileType, { chatId: am.chatId, msgId: am.msgId })

        } else if (am.poll) {
            const p = am.poll || {};
            media = `<div style="margin-top:5px;font-size:11px;color:#c8c8d8;"><b style="color:#c084fc;">Poll:</b> ${E(p.question||'')}` +
                (p.options||[]).map(o => `<div style="margin-left:10px;color:#888899;">• ${E(o.text||'')} — ${(o.voters||[]).length} vote(s)</div>`).join('') + `</div>`;
        } else if (am.note) {
            media = `<div style="margin-top:4px;font-size:10px;color:#666677;font-style:italic;">${E(am.note)}</div>`;
        }
        const txt = am.text ? `<div style="font-size:11px;color:#c8c8d8;margin-top:2px;word-break:break-word;white-space:pre-wrap;">${E(am.text)}</div>` : '';
        const flag = am.isTarget ? `<span style="font-size:9px;font-weight:800;color:#fbbf24;background:rgba(251,191,36,0.12);border-radius:4px;padding:1px 5px;margin-left:5px;">REPORTED</span>` : '';
        return `<div style="padding:6px 9px;margin-bottom:5px;background:#0d0d1a;border-left:2px solid ${am.isTarget?'#fbbf24':'#4f46e5'};border-radius:5px;">
            <span style="font-size:10px;font-weight:800;color:#818cf8;">${E(am.username||'?')}</span>
            <span style="font-size:10px;color:#333345;margin-left:4px;">${E(am.time||'')}</span>${flag}
            ${txt}${media}
        </div>`;
    }).join('');
    const id = 'rep-ev-' + (uid || Math.random().toString(36).slice(2));
    const where = r.chatName ? ` · ${E(r.chatName)}${r.chatKind ? ' (' + E(r.chatKind) + ')' : ''}` : '';
    return `<div style="margin-top:8px;">
        <button onclick="(function(b){var x=document.getElementById('${id}');var o=x.style.display==='none';x.style.display=o?'block':'none';b.querySelector('i.rep-caret').className='fa-solid rep-caret fa-chevron-'+(o?'up':'down');})(this)"
            style="width:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;padding:6px 9px;border-radius:8px;background:rgba(99,102,241,0.08);border:1px solid rgba(99,102,241,0.22);color:#818cf8;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.06em;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;">
            <span><i class="fa-solid fa-paperclip"></i> ${ams.length} selected message${ams.length>1?'s':''}${where}</span>
            <i class="fa-solid rep-caret fa-chevron-down"></i>
        </button>
        <div id="${id}" style="display:none;margin-top:6px;padding:8px;background:#07070f;border:1px solid #1e1e2e;border-radius:8px;max-height:420px;overflow-y:auto;">${body}</div>
    </div>`;
};

window._adminCounts = { pending: 0, reports: 0, pwResets: 0, emailChanges: 0, pendingActions: 0 };
window._updateAdminIndicator = function() {
    const c = window._adminCounts;
    const total = (c.pending || 0) + (c.reports || 0) + (c.pwResets || 0) + (c.emailChanges || 0) + (c.pendingActions || 0) + (c.contactRequests || 0);
    const indicator = document.getElementById('admin-indicator');
    const dot = document.getElementById('admin-dot');
    const countEl = document.getElementById('admin-pending-count');
    if (!indicator) return;
    if (total > 0) {
        indicator.classList.remove('hidden');
        indicator.classList.add('flex');
        indicator.title = `Click to open Admin Panel`;
        dot.classList.add('pulse');
        countEl.innerText = total + ' pending';
    } else {
        indicator.classList.add('hidden');
        indicator.classList.remove('flex');
        indicator.title = '';
        dot.classList.remove('pulse');
        countEl.innerText = '';
    }
}

async function migratePfpsToStorage() {
    if (window._pfpMigrationDone) return;
    window._pfpMigrationDone = true;

    try {
        const corsCheck = await fetch(
            `https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/echospace-web.appspot.com/o`,
            { method: 'GET', mode: 'cors' }
        );
        const corsHeader = corsCheck.headers.get('Access-Control-Allow-Origin');
        if (!corsHeader) {
            return;
        }
    } catch(corsErr) {
        return;
    }

    console.log("[Migration] Starting pfp migration scan...");

    try {
        const usersSnap = await getDocs(collection(db, "users"));
        let migrated = 0, skipped = 0, failed = 0;

        for (const userDoc of usersSnap.docs) {
            const data = userDoc.data();
            const pfp = data.pfp;
            if (!pfp || !pfp.startsWith('data:')) { skipped++; continue; }

            const uid = userDoc.id;
            try {
                const res = await fetch(pfp);
                const blob = await res.blob();
                const ext = blob.type === 'image/gif' ? 'gif' : 'jpg';
                const sRef = storageRef(storage, `pfps/${uid}/avatar.${ext}`);
                await uploadBytes(sRef, blob);
                const url = await getDownloadURL(sRef);

                await updateDoc(doc(db, "users", uid), { pfp: url });

                const chatsSnap = await getDocs(query(collection(db, "chats"), where("participants", "array-contains", uid)));
                await Promise.all(chatsSnap.docs.map(cd =>
                    updateDoc(doc(db, "chats", cd.id), { [`pfps.${uid}`]: url })
                ));

                migrated++;
                console.log(`[Migration] Migrated ${uid} (${ext})`);
            } catch(err) {
                failed++;
            }
        }
        if (migrated > 0 || failed > 0) {
            console.log(`[Migration] Done. Migrated: ${migrated}, Skipped: ${skipped}, Failed: ${failed}`);
        }
    } catch(err) {
    }
}

    } catch(e) { alert("Error: " + e.message); }

window.autofillOverride = (username) => { document.getElementById('admin-override-username').value = username; document.getElementById('admin-override-password').focus(); };
window.dismissReport = async (id) => deleteDoc(doc(db, "reports", id));
window.dismissPasswordRequest = async (id) => deleteDoc(doc(db, "passwordRequests", id));
async function _ticketAudit(id) {
    try {
        const snap = await getDoc(doc(db, "contact_requests", id));
        const r = snap.exists() ? snap.data() : {};
        const msg = String(r.message || '');
        return {
            ticketId: id,
            user: r.username || 'Unknown',
            userUid: r.uid || null,
            category: r.category || 'unknown',
            replies: Array.isArray(r.replies) ? r.replies.length : 0,
            message: msg.length > 140 ? msg.slice(0, 140) + '…' : msg,
        };
    } catch (_) { return { ticketId: id }; }
}

window.apResolveContactRequest = async (id) => {
    if (!(window.isAdmin || window._hasPerm?.('canHandleRequests'))) return;
    const info = await _ticketAudit(id);
    await updateDoc(doc(db, "contact_requests", id), { status: 'resolved' });
    window.logAdminAction && window.logAdminAction('resolve_contact_request', info);
};
window.apReplyContactRequest = async (id) => {
    if (!(window.isAdmin || window._hasPerm?.('canHandleRequests'))) return;
    const el = document.getElementById('ap-tk-' + id);
    const text = (el?.value || '').trim();
    if (!text) return;
    el.disabled = true;
    try {
        await updateDoc(doc(db, "contact_requests", id), {
            replies: arrayUnion({ from: 'staff', name: window.myUsername || 'Staff', text, ts: Date.now() }),
            status: 'answered'
        });
        el.value = '';
        window.logAdminAction && window.logAdminAction('reply_contact_request', {
            ticketId: id, reply: text.length > 140 ? text.slice(0, 140) + '…' : text
        });
    } catch (e) {
        alert("Couldn't send that reply: " + (e.code || e.message));
    } finally { el.disabled = false; }
};
window.apDeleteContactRequest = async (id) => {
    if (!(window.isAdmin || window._hasPerm?.('canHandleRequests'))) return;
    const info = await _ticketAudit(id);
    if (!confirm(`Delete this request from ${info.user || 'that user'} permanently?

The whole thread goes with it and they lose their copy too. Resolve instead if you just want it closed.`)) return;
    await deleteDoc(doc(db, "contact_requests", id));
    window.logAdminAction && window.logAdminAction('delete_contact_request', info);
};

async function _applyEmailAlias(uid, newEmail, targetData) {
    const oldEmail = targetData.email;
    const lowerUsername = targetData.lower_username;
    const newLower = newEmail.toLowerCase();

    const existingAlias = await getDoc(doc(db, "emailAliases", newLower));
    if (existingAlias.exists() && existingAlias.data().uid !== uid) {
        return { ok: false, error: `"${newEmail}" is already in use by another account.` };
    }
    let realEmail = oldEmail;
    if (oldEmail) {
        try {
            const oldAliasSnap = await getDoc(doc(db, "emailAliases", oldEmail.toLowerCase()));
            if (oldAliasSnap.exists() && oldAliasSnap.data().realEmail) realEmail = oldAliasSnap.data().realEmail;
        } catch(_) {}
    }

    await setDoc(doc(db, "emailAliases", newLower), { realEmail, uid });
    await updateDoc(doc(db, "users", uid), { email: newEmail, pendingEmailChange: null, pendingEmailChangeAt: null });
    if (lowerUsername) { try { await setDoc(doc(db, "usernames", lowerUsername), { email: newEmail, uid }, { merge: true }); } catch(_) {} }
    return { ok: true, realEmail };
}

window.approveEmailChange = async (uid, newEmail) => {
    if (!uid || !newEmail) return;
    if (!confirm(`Change email for user to "${newEmail}"?`)) return;
    try {
        const targetSnap = await getDoc(doc(db, "users", uid));
        if (!targetSnap.exists()) { alert("User not found."); return; }
        const targetData = targetSnap.data();
        const result = await _applyEmailAlias(uid, newEmail, targetData);
        if (!result.ok) { alert(result.error); return; }
        window.logAdminAction && window.logAdminAction('approve_email_change', { target: targetData.username, newEmail });
        alert(`✅ "${newEmail}" now works everywhere for this account — logging in, password reset, everything shown in the app. (Under the hood Firebase still has them registered as "${result.realEmail}", but they'll never need to know or type that again.)`);
    } catch(e) { alert("Error: " + (e.message || e.code || e)); }
};
window.dismissEmailChange = async (uid) => {
    try { await updateDoc(doc(db, "users", uid), { pendingEmailChange: null, pendingEmailChangeAt: null }); } catch(e) {}
};
window.adminManualEmailChange = async () => {
    const usernameInput = document.getElementById('admin-manual-email-username').value.trim();
    const newEmail = document.getElementById('admin-manual-email-new').value.trim();
    const msg = document.getElementById('admin-manual-email-msg');
    const setMsg = (text, cls) => { if (!msg) return; msg.innerText = text; msg.className = cls; msg.classList.remove('hidden'); };
    if (!usernameInput || !newEmail) return;
    if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(newEmail)) { setMsg("Enter a valid email address.", "text-red-500 text-xs font-bold"); return; }
    if (!confirm(`Change email for "${usernameInput}" to "${newEmail}"?`)) return;
    try {
        const uSnap = await getDocs(query(collection(db, "users"), where("lower_username", "==", usernameInput.toLowerCase()), limit(1)));
        if (uSnap.empty) { setMsg(`User "${usernameInput}" not found.`, "text-red-500 text-xs font-bold"); return; }
        const targetDoc = uSnap.docs[0];
        const targetData = targetDoc.data();
        const result = await _applyEmailAlias(targetDoc.id, newEmail, targetData);
        if (!result.ok) { setMsg(result.error, "text-red-500 text-xs font-bold"); return; }
        window.logAdminAction && window.logAdminAction('manual_email_change', { target: targetData.username, newEmail });
        document.getElementById('admin-manual-email-username').value = '';
        document.getElementById('admin-manual-email-new').value = '';
        setMsg(`✅ "${newEmail}" set for "${targetData.username}" — works for login, reset, everywhere.`, "text-green-500 text-xs font-bold");
    } catch(e) { setMsg("Error: " + e.message, "text-red-500 text-xs font-bold"); }
};
function _auditToastText(action, details) {
    const meta = _AUDIT_ACTION_LABELS[action];
    const label = meta ? meta.label
        : String(action || 'Action').replace(/_/g, ' ').replace(/\b\w/g, c => c.toUpperCase());
    const d = details || {};
    const who = d.target || d.targetUsername || d.username || d.user || d.botName || d.chatName || null;
    const bits = [];
    if (d.duration) bits.push(d.duration);
    if (d.reason) bits.push(`"${String(d.reason).slice(0, 60)}"`);
    if (typeof d.messagesDeleted === 'number') bits.push(`${d.messagesDeleted} message${d.messagesDeleted === 1 ? '' : 's'}`);
    if (typeof d.deleted === 'number') bits.push(`${d.deleted} removed`);
    if (typeof d.count === 'number') bits.push(String(d.count));
    if (d.role) bits.push(d.role);
    return label + (who ? ` — ${who}` : '') + (bits.length ? ` (${bits.join(', ')})` : '');
}

window.logAdminAction = async (action, details) => {
    try {
        if (!(details && details._quiet)) {
            const meta = _AUDIT_ACTION_LABELS[action] || {};
            window._adminToast && window._adminToast(
                _auditToastText(action, details),
                { icon: meta.icon, color: meta.color }
            );
        }
    } catch (e) { console.warn('[AuditLog] toast failed:', e); }

    let _auditDetails = details || {};
    if (_auditDetails._quiet !== undefined) {
        _auditDetails = { ..._auditDetails };
        delete _auditDetails._quiet;
    }

    try {
        await addDoc(collection(db, "admin_audit_log"), {
            action,
            details: _auditDetails,
            actorUid: window.myUID || myUID || null,
            actor: window.myUsername || myUsername || 'Unknown',
            role: window.isAdmin ? 'admin' : (window._myRole || 'staff'),
            timestamp: serverTimestamp(),
        });
    } catch (e) {
        console.warn('[AuditLog] Failed to record admin action:', action, e);
    }
};
