window.apLoadAuditLog = async () => {
    const box = document.getElementById('ap-audit-log');
    const filterSel = document.getElementById('ap-audit-filter');
    if (!box) return;

    if (filterSel && filterSel.options.length <= 1) {
        Object.keys(_AUDIT_ACTION_LABELS).forEach(key => {
            const opt = document.createElement('option');
            opt.value = key;
            opt.textContent = _AUDIT_ACTION_LABELS[key].label;
            filterSel.appendChild(opt);
        });
    }
    const filterVal = filterSel ? filterSel.value : '';

    box.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#2a2a40;">Loading audit log...</span>';
    try {
        const fetchN = filterVal ? 500 : 150;
        const snap = await getDocs(query(collection(db, 'admin_audit_log'), orderBy('timestamp', 'desc'), limit(fetchN)));
        let docs = snap.docs;
        if (filterVal) docs = docs.filter(d => d.data().action === filterVal);
        docs = docs.slice(0, 150);
        if (docs.length === 0) {
            box.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#2a2a40;">No audit entries found.</span>';
            return;
        }
        let html = '';
        docs.forEach(d => {
            const e = d.data();
            const meta = _AUDIT_ACTION_LABELS[e.action] || { icon: '⚙️', label: e.action || 'Unknown Action', color: '#a0a0b8' };
            const when = e.timestamp?.toDate ? e.timestamp.toDate().toLocaleString() : '—';
            const detailsStr = e.details && Object.keys(e.details).length
                ? Object.entries(e.details).map(([k, v]) => `${window.escHtml(k)}: <b>${window.escHtml(String(v))}</b>`).join(' &nbsp;·&nbsp; ')
                : '';
            html += `<div style="padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #14141f;">
                <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;">
                    <span style="color:${meta.color};font-weight:800;">${meta.icon} ${window.escHtml(meta.label)}</span>
                    <span style="color:#444455;font-size:10px;">${window.escHtml(when)}</span>
                </div>
                <div style="font-size:11px;color:#8888aa;margin-top:2px;">by <b style="color:#c7c7e0;">${window.escHtml(e.actor || 'Unknown')}</b>${e.role ? ` (${window.escHtml(e.role)})` : ''}</div>
                ${detailsStr ? `<div style="font-size:11px;color:#666680;margin-top:2px;">${detailsStr}</div>` : ''}
            </div>`;
        });
        box.innerHTML = html;
    } catch (e) {
        box.innerHTML = `<span style="color:#f87171;">Error loading audit log: ${window.escHtml(e.message)}</span>`;
    }
};


window._apRuleReports = [];
let _apRuleUnsub = null;

function _apRuleRoleColor(role) {
    return ({ owner: '#fbbf24', admin: '#f87171', moderator: '#818cf8' })[role] || '#8888aa';
}

function _apRenderRuleReports() {
    const box  = document.getElementById('ap-rules-list');
    const sum  = document.getElementById('ap-rules-summary');
    const rows = window._apRuleReports;
    if (!box) return;

    if (!rows.length) {
        box.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:12px;color:#2a2a40;">No rule failures reported. Everything users tried recently was allowed.</div>';
        if (sum) sum.textContent = '';
        return;
    }

    const total = rows.reduce((n, r) => n + (r.count || 1), 0);
    const roles = [...new Set(rows.map(r => r.role || '?'))];
    if (sum) sum.innerHTML = `<b style="color:#fbbf24;">${rows.length}</b> distinct failure${rows.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} &nbsp;·&nbsp; <b style="color:#fbbf24;">${total}</b> total occurrence${total === 1 ? '' : 's'} &nbsp;·&nbsp; affecting: ${roles.map(window.escHtml).join(', ')}`;

    box.innerHTML = rows.map(r => {
        const when = r.lastSeen?.toDate ? r.lastSeen.toDate().toLocaleString() : '—';
        const rc   = _apRuleRoleColor(r.role);
        return `<div style="background:#05050e;border:1px solid #1a1a2e;border-left:3px solid #fbbf24;border-radius:8px;padding:10px 12px;">
            <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:4px;">
                <span style="font-size:12px;font-weight:800;color:#e8e8f0;">${window.escHtml(r.feature || 'unknown')}</span>
                <span style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;flex-shrink:0;">
                    <span style="font-size:10px;font-weight:800;color:${rc};background:rgba(255,255,255,0.04);border:1px solid ${rc}44;padding:1px 7px;border-radius:10px;">${window.escHtml(r.role || '?')}</span>
                    <span style="font-size:10px;font-weight:900;color:#fbbf24;">&times;${r.count || 1}</span>
                </span>
            </div>
            ${r.path ? `<div style="font-size:11px;color:#818cf8;font-family:ui-monospace,monospace;word-break:break-all;">/${window.escHtml(r.path)}${r.op ? ` <span style="color:#555566;">&mdash; ${window.escHtml(r.op)}</span>` : ''}</div>` : ''}
            <div style="font-size:11px;color:#666680;margin-top:3px;">${window.escHtml(r.code || '')}${r.message ? ` &nbsp;·&nbsp; ${window.escHtml(r.message)}` : ''}</div>
            ${r.stack ? `<div style="font-size:10px;color:#3a3a52;font-family:ui-monospace,monospace;margin-top:3px;word-break:break-all;">${window.escHtml(r.stack)}</div>` : ''}
            <div style="font-size:10px;color:#444455;margin-top:4px;">last: ${window.escHtml(when)} &nbsp;·&nbsp; by ${window.escHtml(r.username || '?')}${r.ver ? ` &nbsp;·&nbsp; v${window.escHtml(r.ver)}` : ''}${r.url ? ` &nbsp;·&nbsp; ${window.escHtml(r.url)}` : ''}</div>
        </div>`;
    }).join('');
}

function _apRuleBadge(n) {
    const b = document.getElementById('ap-rules-badge');
    if (!b) return;
    b.textContent = n;
    b.style.display = n ? '' : 'none';
}

function _apAbsorbRuleSnap(docs) {
    window._apRuleReports = docs.map(d => ({ id: d.id, ...d.data() }))
        .sort((a, b) => (b.count || 1) - (a.count || 1));
    _apRuleBadge(window._apRuleReports.length);
    _apRenderRuleReports();
}

window._apCallLogs = [];
let _apCallUnsub = null;

const _CALL_OUTCOME = {
    in_progress:              { label: 'In progress',            color: '#38bdf8', bad: false },
    ended_by_me:              { label: 'Ended',                  color: '#4ade80', bad: false },
    ended_by_other:           { label: 'Ended',                  color: '#4ade80', bad: false },
    cancelled_by_me:          { label: 'Caller hung up first',   color: '#8888aa', bad: false },
    caller_cancelled:         { label: 'Caller hung up first',   color: '#8888aa', bad: false },
    declined:                 { label: 'Declined',               color: '#8888aa', bad: false },
    missed:                   { label: 'Missed',                 color: '#fbbf24', bad: false },
    no_answer:                { label: 'No answer',              color: '#fbbf24', bad: false },
    callee_busy:              { label: 'They were on another call', color: '#fbbf24', bad: false },
    failed_to_connect:        { label: 'Never connected',        color: '#f87171', bad: true },
    failed_media:             { label: 'Camera/mic failed',      color: '#f87171', bad: true },
    failed_offer:             { label: 'Offer failed',           color: '#f87171', bad: true },
    failed_signaling:         { label: 'Signaling write failed', color: '#f87171', bad: true },
    failed_no_offer:          { label: 'Setup info never arrived', color: '#f87171', bad: true },
    failed_answer:            { label: 'Answer failed',          color: '#f87171', bad: true },
    superseded:               { label: 'Replaced by a newer call', color: '#8888aa', bad: false },
    stale_call_state_cleared: { label: 'Stuck call state fixed', color: '#c084fc', bad: true },
    ring_ignored_stale:       { label: 'Old ring ignored',       color: '#8888aa', bad: false },
    ring_while_busy:          { label: 'Rang while busy',        color: '#fbbf24', bad: false },
    left:                     { label: 'Left',                   color: '#4ade80', bad: false },
};
function _callOutcomeMeta(r) {
    const m = _CALL_OUTCOME[r.outcome] || { label: r.outcome || '?', color: '#8888aa', bad: false };
    if ((r.outcome === 'ended_by_me' || r.outcome === 'ended_by_other' || r.outcome === 'left') && !r.connected && r.kind !== 'group') {
        return { label: 'Ended without connecting', color: '#f87171', bad: true };
    }
    return m;
}
function _callIsProblem(r) {
    return _callOutcomeMeta(r).bad || (r.errors || 0) > 0 || r.outcome === 'no_answer';
}
function _callWhen(r) {
    const d = r.startedAt?.toDate ? r.startedAt.toDate() : (r.startedAt ? new Date(r.startedAt) : null);
    return d ? d.toLocaleString() : '—';
}
function _callEventLine(ev) {
    return `+${(ev.t / 1000).toFixed(1)}s  ${ev.err ? '✗ ' : ''}${ev.e}${ev.d ? '  ' + ev.d : ''}`;
}

window._apRenderCallLogs = function () {
    const box = document.getElementById('ap-calls-list');
    const sum = document.getElementById('ap-calls-summary');
    if (!box) return;
    const all = window._apCallLogs;
    const problemsOnly = document.getElementById('ap-calls-problems')?.checked;
    const rows = problemsOnly ? all.filter(_callIsProblem) : all;
    const problems = all.filter(_callIsProblem).length;
    const connected = all.filter(r => r.connected).length;
    if (sum) sum.innerHTML = all.length
        ? `<b style="color:#e8e8f0;">${all.length}</b> log${all.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} &nbsp;·&nbsp; <b style="color:#4ade80;">${connected}</b> connected &nbsp;·&nbsp; <b style="color:#f87171;">${problems}</b> with problems${problemsOnly ? ' &nbsp;·&nbsp; showing problems only' : ''}`
        : '';
    const b = document.getElementById('ap-calls-badge');
    if (b) { b.textContent = problems; b.style.display = problems ? '' : 'none'; }
    if (!rows.length) {
        box.innerHTML = `<div style="font-size:12px;color:#2a2a40;">${all.length ? 'No problem calls in the loaded logs. Untick "Problems only" to see every call.' : 'No calls logged yet. Logs appear here as soon as anyone makes or receives a call.'}</div>`;
        return;
    }
    const esc = window.escHtml;
    box.innerHTML = rows.map(r => {
        const m = _callOutcomeMeta(r);
        const icon = r.kind === 'group' ? '👥' : (r.isVideo ? '📹' : '📞');
        const dir = r.direction === 'outgoing' ? '→' : r.direction === 'incoming' ? '←' : '·';
        const who = r.kind === 'group'
            ? `${esc(r.username || '?')} in group ${esc(r.otherName || r.callKey || '')}`
            : `${esc(r.username || '?')} <span style="color:#555566;">${dir}</span> ${esc(r.otherName || r.otherUid || '?')}`;
        const events = (r.events || []).map(ev => `<div style="color:${ev.err ? '#f87171' : '#8888aa'};">${esc(_callEventLine(ev))}</div>`).join('');
        return `<div style="background:#05050e;border:1px solid #1a1a2e;border-left:3px solid ${m.color};border-radius:8px;padding:10px 12px;">
            <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:3px;">
                <span style="font-size:12px;font-weight:800;color:#e8e8f0;">${icon} ${who} <span style="font-size:10px;color:#555566;font-weight:700;">(${esc(r.role || '?')})</span></span>
                <span style="font-size:10px;font-weight:800;color:${m.color};background:rgba(255,255,255,0.04);border:1px solid ${m.color}44;padding:1px 8px;border-radius:10px;">${esc(m.label)}</span>
            </div>
            ${r.pair ? `<div style="font-size:11px;color:#4ade80;font-family:ui-monospace,monospace;">route: ${esc(r.pair)}</div>` : ''}
            ${r.lastError ? `<div style="font-size:11px;color:#f87171;font-family:ui-monospace,monospace;word-break:break-word;">${esc(r.lastError)}</div>` : ''}
            <div style="font-size:10px;color:#444455;margin-top:4px;">${esc(_callWhen(r))} &nbsp;·&nbsp; ${esc(r.ua || '')}${r.net ? ' · ' + esc(r.net) : ''}${r.online === false ? ' · <span style="color:#f87171;">offline</span>' : ''} &nbsp;·&nbsp; clock skew ${Math.round(r.skewMs || 0)}ms${r.turn ? ' · TURN on' : ''}${r.ver ? ' · v' + esc(r.ver) : ''}</div>
            <details style="margin-top:6px;"><summary style="font-size:11px;color:#818cf8;cursor:pointer;">Timeline (${(r.events || []).length} events)</summary>
                <div style="font-size:10.5px;font-family:ui-monospace,monospace;line-height:1.55;margin-top:6px;white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-word;">${events}</div>
            </details>
        </div>`;
    }).join('');
};

window.apLoadCallLogs = async (forceRead) => {
    const box = document.getElementById('ap-calls-list');
    const q = query(collection(db, 'call_logs'), orderBy('updatedAt', 'desc'), limit(300));
    const absorb = (docs) => { window._apCallLogs = docs.map(d => ({ id: d.id, ...d.data() })); window._apRenderCallLogs(); };
    const fail = (e) => { if (box) box.innerHTML = `<span style="color:#f87171;">Error reading call logs: ${window.escHtml(e.message || String(e))}</span>`; };
    if (!_apCallUnsub) {
        try { _apCallUnsub = onSnapshot(q, snap => absorb(snap.docs), fail); } catch (e) { fail(e); }
        if (!forceRead) return;
    }
    try { absorb((await getDocs(q)).docs); } catch (e) { fail(e); }
};

window.apBuildCallLogText = () => {
    const rows = window._apCallLogs;
    if (!rows.length) return 'EchoSpace — no call logs.';
    const out = [
        'EchoSpace — call diagnostics',
        `Generated : ${new Date().toLocaleString()}`,
        `App       : v${window._APP_VERSION || '?'}`,
        `Logs      : ${rows.length} (${rows.filter(r => r.connected).length} connected, ${rows.filter(_callIsProblem).length} with problems)`,
        ''.padEnd(72, '='), ''
    ];
    rows.forEach((r, i) => {
        const m = _callOutcomeMeta(r);
        out.push(`${i + 1}) [${m.label}] ${r.kind === 'group' ? 'GROUP ' + (r.otherName || r.callKey) : (r.isVideo ? 'video' : 'audio')} · ${r.username || '?'} (${r.role || '?'}) ${r.direction === 'outgoing' ? '->' : r.direction === 'incoming' ? '<-' : '·'} ${r.otherName || r.otherUid || ''}`);
        out.push(`    when     : ${_callWhen(r)}`);
        out.push(`    outcome  : ${r.outcome}  connected=${!!r.connected}  errors=${r.errors || 0}`);
        if (r.pair) out.push(`    route    : ${r.pair}`);
        if (r.lastError) out.push(`    lastError: ${r.lastError}`);
        out.push(`    device   : ${r.ua || '?'} · net ${r.net || '?'} · online ${r.online !== false} · skew ${Math.round(r.skewMs || 0)}ms · turn ${!!r.turn} · v${r.ver || '?'}`);
        out.push(`    callKey  : ${r.callKey || ''}  uid ${r.uid || ''}  other ${r.otherUid || ''}`);
        (r.events || []).forEach(ev => out.push('      ' + _callEventLine(ev)));
        out.push('');
    });
    return out.join('\n');
};

window.apCopyCallLogs = async () => {
    const text = window.apBuildCallLogText();
    let ok = false;
    try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text); ok = true; } catch (_) {
        try {
            const ta = document.createElement('textarea');
            ta.value = text; ta.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;opacity:0;';
            document.body.appendChild(ta); ta.select();
            ok = document.execCommand('copy'); ta.remove();
        } catch (_) {}
    }
    window.showCooldownToast && window.showCooldownToast(ok ? `Copied ${window._apCallLogs.length} call log(s).` : 'Could not reach the clipboard — the dump is in the console.', ok);
    if (!ok) (console.__origError || console.error)(text);
};

window.apClearCallLogs = async () => {
    const n = window._apCallLogs.length;
    if (!n) { window.showCooldownToast && window.showCooldownToast('Nothing to clear.'); return; }
    if (!confirm(`Delete all ${n} call log(s)?`)) return;
    try {
        let i = 0;
        for (;;) {
            const snap = await getDocs(query(collection(db, 'call_logs'), limit(400)));
            if (snap.empty) break;
            const batch = writeBatch(db);
            snap.docs.forEach(d => { batch.delete(d.ref); i++; });
            await batch.commit();
            if (snap.size < 400) break;
        }
        window._apCallLogs = [];
        window._apRenderCallLogs();
        window.showCooldownToast && window.showCooldownToast(`Cleared ${i} call log(s).`, true);
    } catch (e) { window.showCooldownToast && window.showCooldownToast('Clear failed: ' + e.message); }
};

window._apSignupFailures = [];

const _SU_STAGE_META = {
    'signup':         { label: 'Sign-up failed',       color: '#f87171', icon: '\u2715' },
    'create':         { label: 'Account create failed', color: '#fbbf24', icon: '\u26a0' },
    'rescued-orphan': { label: 'Stranded account rescued', color: '#4ade80', icon: '\u2713' },
};

window.apLoadSignupFailures = async () => {
    const box = document.getElementById('ap-sufail-list');
    if (!box) return;
    try {
        const snap = await getDocs(query(collection(db, 'signup_failures'), orderBy('at', 'desc'), limit(200)));
        window._apSignupFailures = snap.docs.map(d => ({ id: d.id, ...d.data() }));
        _apRenderSignupFailures();
    } catch (e) {
        box.innerHTML = `<span style="color:#f87171;">Error: ${window.escHtml(e.message)}</span>`;
    }
};

function _apRenderSignupFailures() {
    const box = document.getElementById('ap-sufail-list');
    const rows = window._apSignupFailures;
    if (!box) return;
    if (!rows.length) {
        box.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:12px;color:#2a2a40;">No failed sign-ups recorded.</div>';
        return;
    }
    const byCode = {};
    rows.forEach(r => { const k = (r.stage || '?') + '|' + (r.code || 'no-code'); (byCode[k] = byCode[k] || []).push(r); });
    box.innerHTML = Object.entries(byCode)
        .sort((a, b) => b[1].length - a[1].length)
        .map(([k, group]) => {
            const r = group[0];
            const meta = _SU_STAGE_META[r.stage] || { label: r.stage || 'unknown', color: '#8888aa', icon: '\u2022' };
            const when = r.at?.toDate ? r.at.toDate().toLocaleString() : '\u2014';
            const browser = /Chrome\/(\d+)/.test(r.ua || '') ? 'Chrome ' + RegExp.$1
                : /Firefox\/(\d+)/.test(r.ua || '') ? 'Firefox ' + RegExp.$1
                : /Safari/.test(r.ua || '') ? 'Safari' : 'other';
            const mobile = /Mobile|Android|iPhone/.test(r.ua || '') ? ' \u00b7 mobile' : '';
            return `<div style="background:#05050e;border:1px solid #1a1a2e;border-left:3px solid ${meta.color};border-radius:8px;padding:10px 12px;">
                <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:3px;">
                    <span style="font-size:12px;font-weight:800;color:${meta.color};">${meta.icon} ${window.escHtml(meta.label)}</span>
                    <span style="font-size:10px;font-weight:900;color:${meta.color};">&times;${group.length}</span>
                </div>
                <div style="font-size:11px;color:#818cf8;font-family:ui-monospace,monospace;word-break:break-all;">${window.escHtml(r.code || '(no code)')}</div>
                <div style="font-size:11px;color:#666680;margin-top:3px;">${window.escHtml(r.message || '')}</div>
                <div style="font-size:10px;color:#444455;margin-top:4px;">last: ${window.escHtml(when)} &nbsp;\u00b7&nbsp; ${window.escHtml(browser)}${mobile} &nbsp;\u00b7&nbsp; ${r.online === false ? '<span style="color:#f87171;">was offline</span>' : 'online'}${r.tz ? ' &nbsp;\u00b7&nbsp; ' + window.escHtml(r.tz) : ''}${r.ver ? ' &nbsp;\u00b7&nbsp; v' + window.escHtml(r.ver) : ''}</div>
            </div>`;
        }).join('');
}

window.apCopySignupFailures = async () => {
    const rows = window._apSignupFailures;
    const out = ['EchoSpace \u2014 failed sign-ups', `When: ${new Date().toLocaleString()}`, `Rows: ${rows.length}`, ''.padEnd(70, '='), ''];
    rows.forEach(r => {
        out.push(`[${r.stage || '?'}] ${r.code || '(no code)'}`);
        out.push(`  message : ${r.message || ''}`);
        out.push(`  when    : ${r.at?.toDate ? r.at.toDate().toLocaleString() : '\u2014'}`);
        out.push(`  ua      : ${r.ua || ''}`);
        out.push(`  online  : ${r.online} \u00b7 tz: ${r.tz || '?'} \u00b7 v${r.ver || '?'}`);
        out.push('');
    });
    const txt = out.join('\n');
    try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(txt); window.showCooldownToast && window.showCooldownToast(`Copied ${rows.length} row(s).`, true); }
    catch (_) { console.log(txt); window.showCooldownToast && window.showCooldownToast('See console.'); }
};

window.apClearSignupFailures = async () => {
    const n = window._apSignupFailures.length;
    if (!n) { window.showCooldownToast && window.showCooldownToast('Nothing to clear.'); return; }
    if (!confirm(`Delete all ${n} failed sign-up record(s)?`)) return;
    try {
        const snap = await getDocs(query(collection(db, 'signup_failures'), limit(500)));
        let batch = writeBatch(db), i = 0;
        for (const d of snap.docs) {
            batch.delete(d.ref);
            if (++i % 400 === 0) { await batch.commit(); batch = writeBatch(db); }
        }
        if (i % 400 !== 0) await batch.commit();
        window._apSignupFailures = [];
        _apRenderSignupFailures();
        window.showCooldownToast && window.showCooldownToast(`Cleared ${i} record(s).`, true);
    } catch (e) { window.showCooldownToast && window.showCooldownToast('Clear failed: ' + e.message); }
};

window.apLoadRuleReports = async () => {
    const box = document.getElementById('ap-rules-list');
    if (!_apRuleUnsub) {
        try {
            _apRuleUnsub = onSnapshot(
                query(collection(db, 'rule_reports'), orderBy('lastSeen', 'desc'), limit(300)),
                snap => _apAbsorbRuleSnap(snap.docs),
                err => { if (box) box.innerHTML = `<span style="color:#f87171;">Error reading rule reports: ${window.escHtml(err.message)}</span>`; }
            );
        } catch (e) {
            if (box) box.innerHTML = `<span style="color:#f87171;">Error: ${window.escHtml(e.message)}</span>`;
        }

    try {

        _apAbsorbRuleSnap(snap.docs);
    } catch (e) {
        if (box) box.innerHTML = `<span style="color:#f87171;">Error: ${window.escHtml(e.message)}</span>`;
    }
};

window.apBuildRuleReportText = () => {
    const rows = window._apRuleReports;
    if (!rows.length) return 'EchoSpace — no rule failures reported.';
    const total = rows.reduce((n, r) => n + (r.count || 1), 0);
    const head = [
        'EchoSpace — Firestore rule failure report',
        `Generated : ${new Date().toLocaleString()}`,
        `App       : v${window._APP_VERSION || '?'}`,
        `Summary   : ${rows.length} distinct failure(s), ${total} total occurrence(s)`,
        `Roles hit : ${[...new Set(rows.map(r => r.role || '?'))].join(', ')}`,
        ''.padEnd(72, '='),
        ''
    ].join('\n');
    const body = rows.map((r, i) => {
        const when = r.lastSeen?.toDate ? r.lastSeen.toDate().toLocaleString() : '—';
        return [
            `${i + 1}) [x${r.count || 1}] ${r.feature || 'unknown'}`,
            `    role      : ${r.role || '?'}`,
            `    path      : ${r.path ? '/' + r.path : '(not captured — see stack)'}`,
            `    operation : ${r.op || '?'}`,
            `    code      : ${r.code || '?'}`,
            `    message   : ${r.message || ''}`,
            `    last seen : ${when}  (reported by ${r.username || '?'}, v${r.ver || '?'})`,
            `    page      : ${r.url || '?'}`,
            r.stack ? `    stack     : ${r.stack}` : null,
            ''
        ].filter(Boolean).join('\n');
    }).join('\n');
    return head + body;
};

window.apCopyRuleReports = async () => {
    const text = window.apBuildRuleReportText();
    let ok = false;
    try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text); ok = true; } catch (_) {
        try {
            const ta = document.createElement('textarea');
            ta.value = text;
            ta.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;opacity:0;';
            document.body.appendChild(ta);
            ta.select();
            ok = document.execCommand('copy');
            ta.remove();
        } catch (_) {}
    }
    if (window.showCooldownToast) {
        window.showCooldownToast(ok
            ? `Copied ${window._apRuleReports.length} rule report(s) to your clipboard.`
            : 'Could not reach the clipboard — check the console for the dump instead.', ok);
    }
    if (!ok) (console.__origError || console.error)(text);
};

window.apClearRuleReports = async () => {

    if (!n) { window.showCooldownToast && window.showCooldownToast('Nothing to clear.'); return; }

        _apRuleBadge(0);

    } catch (e) {
        window.showCooldownToast && window.showCooldownToast('Clear failed: ' + e.message);
    }
};

window.adminPasswordOverride = async () => {
    const username = document.getElementById('admin-override-username').value.trim().toLowerCase();
    const newPassword = document.getElementById('admin-override-password').value.trim();
    const systemMessage = document.getElementById('admin-override-message').value.trim();
    const msg = document.getElementById('override-msg');
    const setMsg = (t, cls) => { if (msg) { msg.innerText = t; msg.className = cls + ' text-xs font-bold'; msg.classList.remove('hidden'); } };
    if (!username || !newPassword) { setMsg("Enter username and new password.", "text-red-500"); return; }
    if (newPassword.length < 6) { setMsg("Password must be at least 6 characters.", "text-red-500"); return; }
    try {
        setMsg("Working…", "text-yellow-400");
        const q = await getDocs(query(collection(db, "users"), where("lower_username", "==", username)));
        if (q.empty) { setMsg("User not found.", "text-red-500"); return; }
        const targetDoc = q.docs[0];
        const targetData = targetDoc.data();
        const uid = targetDoc.id;
        const email = targetData.email || (username + "@echo.local");
        const _pinEl = document.getElementById('admin-override-pin');
        const _pin = (_pinEl?.value || '').trim();
        const _clearPin = () => { if (_pinEl) _pinEl.value = ''; };
        if (!(window._iAmSiteOwner && window._iAmSiteOwner())) {
            if (window._isStaffData && window._isStaffData(targetData)) { setMsg("Only the owner can reset a staff account's password.", "text-red-500"); return; }
            if (!/^[0-9]{4}$/.test(_pin)) { setMsg("Enter the user's 4-digit login PIN. They have to tell it to you.", "text-red-500"); return; }
            if (await _rsAdminReset(uid, targetData, _pin, newPassword, systemMessage, setMsg)) {
                document.getElementById('admin-override-username').value = '';
                document.getElementById('admin-override-password').value = '';
                document.getElementById('admin-override-message').value = '';
            }
            _clearPin();
            return;
        }

        let currentPw = null;
        try {
            const secSnap = await getDoc(doc(db, "user_secrets", uid));
            if (secSnap.exists()) currentPw = await _pwvOpen(secSnap.data());
        } catch(_) {}

        const applyPending = async (note) => {
            const updates = { pendingPassword: newPassword };
            if (systemMessage) updates.systemMessage = systemMessage;
            await updateDoc(doc(db, "users", uid), updates);
            window.logAdminAction('password_override', { target: targetData.username, method: 'pending', systemMessageSet: !!systemMessage });
            setMsg(note, "text-yellow-400");
            document.getElementById('admin-override-username').value = '';
            document.getElementById('admin-override-password').value = '';
            document.getElementById('admin-override-message').value = '';
        };

        if (!currentPw && /^[0-9]{4}$/.test(_pin)) {
            if (await _rsAdminReset(uid, targetData, _pin, newPassword, systemMessage, setMsg)) {
                document.getElementById('admin-override-username').value = '';
                document.getElementById('admin-override-password').value = '';
                document.getElementById('admin-override-message').value = '';
            }
            _clearPin();
            return;
        }
        if (!currentPw) {
            if (!window.pwvIsUnlocked()) {
                setMsg('Password vault is locked. Unlock it in Admin \u25b8 Password Vault for an instant reset, or continue to set this as pending.', 'text-yellow-400');
            }
            await applyPending(`No readable credential for "${targetData.username}" yet — set as PENDING. It applies the next time they log in with their current password. After that one login, resets become instant.`);
            return;
        }

        try {
            const { updatePassword } = await import("https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.11.0/firebase-auth.js");
            const realEmail = await resolveLoginEmail(email);
            const cred = await signInWithEmailAndPassword(secondaryAuth, realEmail, currentPw);
            await updatePassword(cred.user, newPassword);
            await signOut(secondaryAuth);
            try { await _pwvStore(uid, newPassword); } catch(_) {}
            try {
                const userUpdates = { pendingPassword: null };
                if (systemMessage) userUpdates.systemMessage = systemMessage;
                await updateDoc(doc(db, "users", uid), userUpdates);
            } catch(_) {}
            window.logAdminAction('password_override', { target: targetData.username, method: 'direct', systemMessageSet: !!systemMessage });
            setMsg(`✅ Password changed for "${targetData.username}". They can log in with the new password now.`, "text-green-500");
            document.getElementById('admin-override-username').value = '';
            document.getElementById('admin-override-password').value = '';
            document.getElementById('admin-override-message').value = '';
        } catch (swapErr) {
            try { await signOut(secondaryAuth); } catch(_) {}
            if (swapErr.code === 'auth/invalid-credential' || swapErr.code === 'auth/wrong-password' || swapErr.code === 'auth/user-not-found') {
                await applyPending(`Stored credential for "${targetData.username}" is out of date, so I set it as PENDING instead. It applies at their next login with their current password.`);
            } else {
                setMsg("Error: " + swapErr.message, "text-red-500");
            }
        }
    } catch(e) { setMsg("Error: " + e.message, "text-red-500"); }
};

    const msg = document.getElementById('announcement-msg');

};

function _apEnsureFlashCss() {
    if (document.getElementById('ap-search-flash-css')) return;
    const s = document.createElement('style');
    s.id = 'ap-search-flash-css';
    s.textContent =
        '@keyframes apSearchFlash{' +
        '0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(129,140,248,0);background-color:transparent;}' +
        '15%{box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(129,140,248,0.9),0 0 30px rgba(129,140,248,0.5);background-color:rgba(129,140,248,0.12);}' +
        '35%{box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(129,140,248,0.2);background-color:transparent;}' +
        '55%{box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(129,140,248,0.9),0 0 30px rgba(129,140,248,0.5);background-color:rgba(129,140,248,0.12);}' +
        '75%{box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(129,140,248,0.2);background-color:transparent;}' +
        '100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(129,140,248,0);background-color:transparent;}}' +
        '.admin-card.ap-search-flash{animation:apSearchFlash 1.9s ease-in-out 1;}' +
        '.admin-card.ap-search-hit{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(129,140,248,0.75),0 0 22px rgba(129,140,248,0.35);' +
        'background-color:rgba(129,140,248,0.07);}';
    document.head.appendChild(s);
}

function _apFlashCard(card) {
    if (!card) return;
    _apEnsureFlashCss();
    card.classList.remove('ap-search-flash');
    void card.offsetWidth;
    card.classList.add('ap-search-flash');
    setTimeout(() => card.classList.remove('ap-search-flash'), 2000);
}

window.apSearchPanel = (q) => {
    const box = document.getElementById('ap-search-results');
    if (!box) return;
    const term = (q || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (term.length < 2) {
        box.classList.add('hidden');
        document.querySelectorAll('.ap-search-hit').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('ap-search-hit'));
        return;
    }

    const hits = [];
    document.querySelectorAll('.ap-panel').forEach(panel => {
        const tab = (panel.id || '').replace('ap-panel', '').replace(/^-/, '');
        if (!tab) return;
        const tabBtn = [...document.querySelectorAll('.ap-tab')]
            .find(b => (b.getAttribute('onclick') || '').includes("'" + tab + "'"));
        const tabLabel = tabBtn ? tabBtn.innerText.replace(/\d+$/, '').trim() : tab;
        panel.querySelectorAll('.admin-card').forEach(card => {
            const titleEl = card.querySelector('.admin-card-title');
            const title = titleEl ? titleEl.innerText.trim() : '';
            if (!title) return;
            const body = card.innerText.toLowerCase();
            if (!body.includes(term)) return;
            hits.push({ title, tabLabel, tab, tabBtn, card, rank: title.toLowerCase().includes(term) ? 0 : 1 });
        });
    });
    hits.sort((a, b) => a.rank - b.rank);

    _apEnsureFlashCss();
    document.querySelectorAll('.ap-search-hit').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('ap-search-hit'));
    hits.forEach(h => {
        if (h.card.closest('.ap-panel')?.classList.contains('active')) h.card.classList.add('ap-search-hit');
    });

    if (!hits.length) {
        box.innerHTML = '<div style="padding:10px 12px;font-size:12px;color:#444455;">No matches.</div>';
        box.classList.remove('hidden');
        return;
    }
    box.innerHTML = '';
    hits.slice(0, 12).forEach(h => {
        const row = document.createElement('div');
        row.style.cssText = 'padding:8px 11px;border-radius:7px;cursor:pointer;display:flex;' +
            'align-items:center;gap:9px;font-size:12.5px;color:#e8e8f2;';
        row.onmouseenter = () => row.style.background = 'rgba(129,140,248,0.12)';
        row.onmouseleave = () => row.style.background = 'transparent';
        const t = document.createElement('span');
        t.style.cssText = 'font-weight:700;';
        t.innerText = h.title;
        const sub = document.createElement('span');
        sub.style.cssText = 'margin-left:auto;font-size:10.5px;color:#666677;font-weight:600;';
        sub.innerText = h.tabLabel;
        row.appendChild(t); row.appendChild(sub);
        row.onclick = () => {
            if (h.tabBtn && typeof window.apSwitchTab === 'function') window.apSwitchTab(h.tab, h.tabBtn);
            box.classList.add('hidden');
            document.querySelectorAll('.ap-search-hit').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('ap-search-hit'));
            const inp = document.getElementById('ap-search');
            if (inp) inp.value = '';
            setTimeout(() => {
                h.card.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
                _apFlashCard(h.card);
            }, 60);
        };
        box.appendChild(row);
    });
    box.classList.remove('hidden');
};

document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    const box = document.getElementById('ap-search-results');
    if (!box || box.classList.contains('hidden')) return;
    if (e.target.closest('#ap-search-results') || e.target.closest('#ap-search')) return;
    box.classList.add('hidden');
});

window.suspendUser = async () => {
    const userSearch = document.getElementById('suspend-user-search').value.trim().toLowerCase();
    const dur = parseInt(document.getElementById('suspend-time').value);
    const unit = document.getElementById('suspend-unit').value;
    const msg = document.getElementById('suspend-msg');
    if (!userSearch || !dur) return;
    if (!window.isAdmin) {
        if (msg) { msg.innerText = 'Sub-admins must use the Staff Panel → Moderate → Suspend Request form.'; msg.className = 'text-yellow-400 text-xs font-bold'; msg.classList.remove('hidden'); }
        return;
    }
    try {
        const q = await getDocs(query(collection(db, "users"), where("lower_username", "==", userSearch)));
        if (q.empty) { msg.innerText = "User not found."; msg.className = "text-red-500 text-xs font-bold"; msg.classList.remove('hidden'); return; }
        const mult = unit === 'm' ? 60000 : unit === 'h' ? 3600000 : unit === 'd' ? 86400000 : 604800000;
        const suspendUntil = new Date(Date.now() + dur * mult);
        await window._staffGuard(q.docs[0].data());
        await updateDoc(doc(db, "users", q.docs[0].id), { suspendedUntil: suspendUntil });
        window.logAdminAction('suspend_user', { target: q.docs[0].data().username, until: suspendUntil.toLocaleString() });
        msg.innerText = `Suspended until ${suspendUntil.toLocaleString()}`; msg.className = "text-green-500 text-xs font-bold"; msg.classList.remove('hidden');
    } catch(e) {
        if (msg) { msg.innerText = 'Error: ' + (e.code === 'permission-denied' ? 'Insufficient permissions — only owners can directly suspend users.' : e.message); msg.className = 'text-red-500 text-xs font-bold'; msg.classList.remove('hidden'); }
    }
};

let _grUnsub = null;
let _grCache = [];

const _grEl = id => document.getElementById(id);
function _grMsg(el, text, ok) {
    const m = _grEl(el);
    if (!m) return;
    m.textContent = text;
    m.style.color = ok ? '#34d399' : '#f87171';
    m.style.display = text ? 'block' : 'none';
}

window.openGameRequests = () => {
    const m = _grEl('game-req-modal');
    if (!m) return;
    m.classList.remove('hidden');
    _grMsg('game-req-msg', '');
    if (!_grUnsub) {
        try {
            _grUnsub = onSnapshot(
                query(collection(db, 'game_requests'), where('status', '==', 'open'), orderBy('votes', 'desc'), limit(60)),
                snap => { _grCache = snap.docs.map(d => ({ id: d.id, ...d.data() })); _grRender(); },
                err => {
                    console.warn('[gamereq] listener failed, falling back:', err);
                    _grUnsub = onSnapshot(query(collection(db, 'game_requests'), limit(120)), s2 => {
                        _grCache = s2.docs.map(d => ({ id: d.id, ...d.data() }))
                                          .filter(r => (r.status || 'open') === 'open')
                                          .sort((a, b) => (b.votes || 0) - (a.votes || 0));
                        _grRender();
                    }, e2 => { _grEl('game-req-list').innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:12.5px;color:#f87171;text-align:center;padding:20px 0;">Could not load requests.</div>'; });
                });
        } catch (e) { console.warn('[gamereq]', e); }
    } else { _grRender(); }
};

window.closeGameRequests = () => {
    const m = _grEl('game-req-modal');
    if (m) m.classList.add('hidden');
};

function _grRender() {
    const list = _grEl('game-req-list');
    if (!list) return;
    if (!_grCache.length) {
        list.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:12.5px;color:#8888aa;text-align:center;padding:24px 0;line-height:1.6;">No requests yet.<br>Ask for a game above and everyone else can vote it up.</div>';
        return;
    }
    const me = auth.currentUser ? auth.currentUser.uid : null;
    list.innerHTML = _grCache.map(r => {
        const voted = me && Array.isArray(r.voters) && r.voters.indexOf(me) !== -1;
        const n = r.votes || 0;
        return '<div style="display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:12px;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.035);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);">'
            + '<button onclick="window.voteGameRequest(\'' + r.id + '\')" title="' + (voted ? 'Remove your vote' : 'Vote for this') + '" '
            + 'style="flex:0 0 auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-width:44px;padding:6px 4px;border-radius:9px;cursor:pointer;'
            + 'border:1px solid ' + (voted ? 'rgba(99,102,241,0.55)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.1)') + ';'
            + 'background:' + (voted ? 'rgba(99,102,241,0.18)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.04)') + ';'
            + 'color:' + (voted ? '#a5b4fc' : '#8888aa') + ';">'
            + '<i class="fa-solid fa-caret-up" style="font-size:13px;"></i>'
            + '<span style="font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">' + n + '</span></button>'
            + '<div style="flex:1;min-width:0;">'
            + '<div style="font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:#e8e8f0;word-break:break-word;">' + _grEsc(r.title || '') + '</div>'
            + (r.note ? '<div style="font-size:11.5px;color:#8888aa;margin-top:2px;word-break:break-word;">' + _grEsc(r.note) + '</div>' : '')
            + '<div style="font-size:10.5px;color:#8888aa;opacity:.7;margin-top:3px;">by ' + _grEsc(r.requestedByName || 'someone') + '</div>'
            + '</div></div>';
    }).join('');
}

function _grEsc(t) {
    return String(t).replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;' }[c]));
}

window.submitGameRequest = async () => {
    const titleEl = _grEl('game-req-title'), noteEl = _grEl('game-req-note');
    const title = (titleEl.value || '').trim();
    const note = (noteEl.value || '').trim();
    if (!title) { _grMsg('game-req-msg', 'Type a game name first.'); return; }
    if (!auth.currentUser) { _grMsg('game-req-msg', 'You need to be logged in.'); return; }

    const dupe = _grCache.find(r => (r.title || '').trim().toLowerCase() === title.toLowerCase());
    if (dupe) {
        _grMsg('game-req-msg', 'Already requested \u2014 vote for it instead.');
        return;
    }
    try {
        await addDoc(collection(db, 'game_requests'), {
            title: title.slice(0, 80),
            note: note.slice(0, 140),
            requestedBy: auth.currentUser.uid,
            requestedByName: window.myUsername || 'someone',
            votes: 1,
            voters: [auth.currentUser.uid],
            status: 'open',
            createdAt: serverTimestamp()
        });
        titleEl.value = ''; noteEl.value = '';
        _grMsg('game-req-msg', 'Requested \u2014 thanks!', true);
        setTimeout(() => _grMsg('game-req-msg', ''), 2600);
    } catch (e) {
        _grMsg('game-req-msg', e.code === 'permission-denied' ? 'Not allowed to post right now.' : ('Failed: ' + (e.code || e.message)));
    }
};

window.voteGameRequest = async (id) => {
    if (!auth.currentUser) return;
    const uid = auth.currentUser.uid;
    const row = _grCache.find(r => r.id === id);
    if (!row) return;
    const voted = Array.isArray(row.voters) && row.voters.indexOf(uid) !== -1;
    try {
        await updateDoc(doc(db, 'game_requests', id), {
            voters: voted ? arrayRemove(uid) : arrayUnion(uid),
            votes: increment(voted ? -1 : 1)
        });
    } catch (e) {
        _grMsg('game-req-msg', 'Vote failed: ' + (e.code || e.message));
    }
};

let _apGrCache = [];

        window.apRenderGameReqs();

        const badge = document.getElementById('ap-gamereq-badge');
        if (badge) { badge.textContent = open; badge.style.display = open ? '' : 'none'; }
    } catch (e) {
        list.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:12px;color:#f87171;padding:8px 0;">Could not load: ' + (e.code || e.message) + '</div>';
    }
};

window.apRenderGameReqs = () => {
    const list = document.getElementById('ap-gamereq-list');
    if (!list) return;
    const filter = (document.getElementById('ap-gr-filter') || {}).value || 'open';
    const rows = _apGrCache.filter(r => filter === 'all' || (r.status || 'open') === filter);
    if (!rows.length) {
        list.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:12px;color:#444455;padding:8px 0;">Nothing here.</div>';
        return;
    }
    list.innerHTML = rows.map(r => {
        const st = r.status || 'open';
        const col = st === 'added' ? '#34d399' : st === 'declined' ? '#f87171' : '#818cf8';
        return '<div style="display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:10px;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.03);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);flex-wrap:wrap;">'
            + '<div style="flex:0 0 auto;min-width:42px;text-align:center;padding:5px;border-radius:8px;background:rgba(99,102,241,0.14);color:#a5b4fc;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;">' + (r.votes || 0) + '</div>'
            + '<div style="flex:1;min-width:160px;">'
            + '<div style="font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:#c8c8d8;">' + _grEsc(r.title || '') + '</div>'
            + (r.note ? '<div style="font-size:11px;color:#666677;margin-top:2px;">' + _grEsc(r.note) + '</div>' : '')
            + '<div style="font-size:10.5px;color:#444455;margin-top:3px;">by ' + _grEsc(r.requestedByName || '?') + ' \u00b7 <span style="color:' + col + ';font-weight:700;">' + st + '</span></div>'
            + '</div>'
            + '<div style="display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;">'
            + (st === 'open'

                + '<button onclick="window.apSetGameReq(\'' + r.id + '\',\'declined\')" class="ap-pill yellow">Decline</button>'
                : '<button onclick="window.apSetGameReq(\'' + r.id + '\',\'open\')" class="ap-pill">Reopen</button>')
            + '<button onclick="window.apDeleteGameReq(\'' + r.id + '\')" class="ap-pill red">Delete</button>'
            + '</div></div>';
    }).join('');
};

    let exists = false;

    if (!exists) {
        st.textContent = 'No vault yet \u2014 passwords are not being captured at all until one exists. Create one to enable instant resets and full account deletion.';
        st.style.background = 'rgba(251,191,36,0.10)'; st.style.color = '#fbbf24';
        show(unlockRow, false); show(setupRow, true); show(openRow, false);
    } else if (window.pwvIsUnlocked()) {
        st.textContent = 'Unlocked for this session. Stored credentials are readable until you lock it or reload.';
        st.style.background = 'rgba(52,211,153,0.10)'; st.style.color = '#34d399';

        st.style.background = 'rgba(120,120,140,0.08)'; st.style.color = '#666677';
        show(unlockRow, true); show(setupRow, false); show(openRow, false);
    }
};

const PWV_PUB_DOC  = ['site_config', 'pwcrypto'];
const PWV_PRIV_DOC = ['user_secrets', 'vault-keyring'];
const PWV_ITERS    = 600000;

let _pwvPubPromise = null;
let _pwvPriv       = null;

const _pwvB64e = buf => btoa(String.fromCharCode.apply(null, new Uint8Array(buf)));
const _pwvB64d = str => Uint8Array.from(atob(str), c => c.charCodeAt(0));

async function _pwvKek(passphrase, salt, iters) {
    const base = await crypto.subtle.importKey('raw', new TextEncoder().encode(passphrase), 'PBKDF2', false, ['deriveKey']);
    return crypto.subtle.deriveKey(
        { name: 'PBKDF2', salt: salt, iterations: iters || PWV_ITERS, hash: 'SHA-256' },
        base, { name: 'AES-GCM', length: 256 }, false, ['encrypt', 'decrypt']);
}

async function _pwvPublicKey() {
    if (!_pwvPubPromise) {
        _pwvPubPromise = (async () => {
            const snap = await getDoc(doc(db, PWV_PUB_DOC[0], PWV_PUB_DOC[1]));
            const spki = snap.exists() ? snap.data().pub : null;
            if (!spki) return null;
            return crypto.subtle.importKey('spki', _pwvB64d(spki), { name: 'RSA-OAEP', hash: 'SHA-256' }, false, ['encrypt']);
        })().catch(() => null);
    }
    return _pwvPubPromise;
}

async function _pwvStore(uid, plain) {
    if (!uid || !plain) return false;
    try {
        const pub = await _pwvPublicKey();
        if (!pub) return false;
        const ct = await crypto.subtle.encrypt({ name: 'RSA-OAEP' }, pub, new TextEncoder().encode(plain));
        await setDoc(doc(db, 'user_secrets', uid), {
            pwEnc: _pwvB64e(ct),
            alg: 'RSA-OAEP-256',
            pw: deleteField(),
            updatedAt: serverTimestamp()
        }, { merge: true });
        return true;
    } catch (e) { console.warn('[pwvault] store failed:', e); return false; }
}

async function _pwvOpen(data) {
    if (!data) return null;
    if (data.pwEnc) {
        if (!_pwvPriv) return null;
        try {
            const pt = await crypto.subtle.decrypt({ name: 'RSA-OAEP' }, _pwvPriv, _pwvB64d(data.pwEnc));
            return new TextDecoder().decode(pt);
        } catch (_) { return null; }
    }
    return data.pw || null;
}

window.pwvIsUnlocked = () => !!_pwvPriv;
window.pwvLock = () => { _pwvPriv = null; };

window.pwvSetup = async (passphrase) => {
    if (!passphrase || passphrase.length < 10) throw new Error('Use a passphrase of at least 10 characters.');
    const existing = await getDoc(doc(db, PWV_PRIV_DOC[0], PWV_PRIV_DOC[1]));
    if (existing.exists()) throw new Error('A vault already exists. Creating a new one would make every stored credential unreadable.');

    const pair = await crypto.subtle.generateKey(
        { name: 'RSA-OAEP', modulusLength: 2048, publicExponent: new Uint8Array([1, 0, 1]), hash: 'SHA-256' },
        true, ['encrypt', 'decrypt']);

    const spki  = await crypto.subtle.exportKey('spki', pair.publicKey);
    const pkcs8 = await crypto.subtle.exportKey('pkcs8', pair.privateKey);
    const salt  = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(16));
    const iv    = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(12));
    const kek   = await _pwvKek(passphrase, salt, PWV_ITERS);
    const wrapped = await crypto.subtle.encrypt({ name: 'AES-GCM', iv: iv }, kek, pkcs8);

    await setDoc(doc(db, PWV_PRIV_DOC[0], PWV_PRIV_DOC[1]), {
        priv: _pwvB64e(wrapped), salt: _pwvB64e(salt), iv: _pwvB64e(iv),
        iters: PWV_ITERS, alg: 'RSA-OAEP-256', createdAt: serverTimestamp()
    });
    await setDoc(doc(db, PWV_PUB_DOC[0], PWV_PUB_DOC[1]), {
        pub: _pwvB64e(spki), alg: 'RSA-OAEP-256', createdAt: serverTimestamp()
    });
    _pwvPubPromise = null;
    _pwvPriv = pair.privateKey;
    return true;
};

window.pwvUnlock = async (passphrase) => {
    const snap = await getDoc(doc(db, PWV_PRIV_DOC[0], PWV_PRIV_DOC[1]));
    if (!snap.exists()) throw new Error('No vault has been set up yet.');
    const d = snap.data();
    const kek = await _pwvKek(passphrase, _pwvB64d(d.salt), d.iters);
    let pkcs8;
    try {
        pkcs8 = await crypto.subtle.decrypt({ name: 'AES-GCM', iv: _pwvB64d(d.iv) }, kek, _pwvB64d(d.priv));
    } catch (_) {
        throw new Error('Wrong passphrase.');
    }
    _pwvPriv = await crypto.subtle.importKey('pkcs8', pkcs8, { name: 'RSA-OAEP', hash: 'SHA-256' }, false, ['decrypt']);
    return true;
};

window.pwvMigrateLegacy = async () => {
    const pub = await _pwvPublicKey();
    if (!pub) throw new Error('Set up the vault first.');
    const snap = await getDocs(collection(db, 'user_secrets'));
    let converted = 0, failed = 0, already = 0;
    for (const d of snap.docs) {
        if (d.id === 'vault-keyring') continue;
        const data = d.data();
        if (!data.pw) { already++; continue; }
        try {
            const ct = await crypto.subtle.encrypt({ name: 'RSA-OAEP' }, pub, new TextEncoder().encode(data.pw));
            await setDoc(d.ref, {
                pwEnc: _pwvB64e(ct), alg: 'RSA-OAEP-256',
                pw: deleteField(), updatedAt: serverTimestamp()
            }, { merge: true });
            converted++;
        } catch (_) { failed++; }
    }
    return { converted, already, failed };
};

async function _adminDeleteAuthAccount(uid, email) {
    let currentPw = null;
    try {
        const secSnap = await getDoc(doc(db, "user_secrets", uid));
        if (secSnap.exists()) currentPw = await _pwvOpen(secSnap.data());
    } catch(_) {}
    if (!currentPw || !email) {
        return { authDeleted: false, reason: (!email ? 'no email on record'
            : (window.pwvIsUnlocked() ? 'no stored credential' : 'vault locked — unlock it in Admin ▸ Password Vault to remove the Auth account')) };
    }
    const realEmail = await resolveLoginEmail(email);
    try {
        const cred = await signInWithEmailAndPassword(secondaryAuth, realEmail, currentPw);
        await cred.user.delete();
        try { await deleteDoc(doc(db, "user_secrets", uid)); } catch(_) {}
        return { authDeleted: true };
    } catch (e) {
        try { await signOut(secondaryAuth); } catch(_) {}
        return { authDeleted: false, reason: e.code || e.message };
    }
}
async function _adminPurgeUserData(uid, data) {
    const done = [];
    const failed = [];
    const tryDel = async (label, ref) => {
        try { await deleteDoc(ref); done.push(label); }
        catch (e) { failed.push(label + ' (' + (e.code || e.message) + ')'); }
    };
    const delAll = async (label, snap) => {
        if (!snap || snap.empty) return;
        let n = 0;
        for (const d of snap.docs) { try { await deleteDoc(d.ref); n++; } catch (_) {} }
        if (n) done.push(label + '\u00d7' + n);
    };

    if (data.lower_username) await tryDel('username', doc(db, 'usernames', data.lower_username));
    await tryDel('user_secrets',  doc(db, 'user_secrets',  uid));
    await tryDel('recovery_keys', doc(db, 'recovery_keys', uid));
    await tryDel('face_2fa',      doc(db, 'face_2fa',      uid));
    await tryDel('upload_quota',  doc(db, 'upload_quota',  uid));

    try {
        await delAll('pfp_chunks', await getDocs(collection(db, 'pfp_chunks', uid, 'chunks')));
    } catch (_) {}

    try {
        const slotKeys = new Set();
        (Array.isArray(data.profilePlaylist) ? data.profilePlaylist : []).forEach(t => {
            if (t && t.slotKey != null) slotKeys.add(String(t.slotKey));
        });
        if (data.profileMusic && data.profileMusic.slotKey != null) slotKeys.add(String(data.profileMusic.slotKey));
        for (const key of slotKeys) {
            const slotRef = doc(db, 'profile_music', uid, 'slots', 'slot_' + key);
            await delAll('music', await getDocs(collection(slotRef, 'chunks')));
            try { await deleteDoc(slotRef); } catch (_) {}
        }
    } catch (_) {}
    try { await delAll('music-legacy', await getDocs(collection(db, 'profile_music', uid, 'chunks'))); } catch (_) {}
    await tryDel('profile_music', doc(db, 'profile_music', uid));

    try {
        const bots = await getDocs(query(collection(db, 'users'), where('botOwner', '==', uid)));
        for (const b of bots.docs) {
            try {
                const botChats = await getDocs(query(collection(db, 'chats'), where('participants', 'array-contains', b.id)));
                for (const c of botChats.docs) {
                    await delAll('bot-msgs', await getDocs(collection(db, 'chats', c.id, 'messages')));
                    try { await deleteDoc(c.ref); } catch (_) {}
                }
            } catch (_) {}
            await tryDel('bot:' + (b.data().username || b.id), b.ref);
        }
    } catch (_) {}

    try { await delAll('follows-out', await getDocs(query(collection(db, 'follows'), where('followerId',  '==', uid)))); } catch (_) {}
    try { await delAll('follows-in',  await getDocs(query(collection(db, 'follows'), where('followingId', '==', uid)))); } catch (_) {}
    try { await delAll('req-sent', await getDocs(query(collection(db, 'requests'), where('senderId',   '==', uid)))); } catch (_) {}
    try { await delAll('req-recv', await getDocs(query(collection(db, 'requests'), where('receiverId', '==', uid)))); } catch (_) {}
    try { await delAll('login_events', await getDocs(query(collection(db, 'login_events'), where('uid', '==', uid)))); } catch (_) {}

    try {
        let boards = [];
        try { boards = Object.keys(ECHO_BOARD_META || {}); } catch (_) {}
        try {
            for (const g in _SCORE_RULES) (_SCORE_RULES[g].modes || []).forEach(m => boards.push(_boardDocId(g + ':' + m)));
        } catch (_) {}
        try {
            const gs = await getDocs(collection(db, 'game_stats'));
            gs.forEach(d => { if (!boards.includes(d.id)) boards.push(_boardDocId(d.id)); });
        } catch (_) {}
        let n = 0;
        for (const b of boards) {
            try { await deleteDoc(doc(db, 'leaderboards', b, 'scores', uid)); n++; } catch (_) {}
        }
        if (n) done.push('scores\u00d7' + n);
    } catch (_) {}

    try { await deleteDoc(doc(db, 'game_prefs', uid)); done.push('game_prefs'); } catch (_) {}

    try {
        const chats = await getDocs(query(collection(db, 'chats'), where('participants', 'array-contains', uid)));
        for (const c of chats.docs) {
            try {
                const names = { ...(c.data().names || {}) };
                delete names[uid];
                await updateDoc(c.ref, { names });
            } catch (_) {}
        }
        if (chats.size) done.push('chats-detached\u00d7' + chats.size);
    } catch (_) {}

    return { done, failed, summary: done.join(', ') + (failed.length ? ' | FAILED: ' + failed.join(', ') : '') };
}

window.deleteUser = async () => {
    const userSearch = document.getElementById('delete-user-search').value.trim().toLowerCase();
    const msg = document.getElementById('delete-msg');
    if (!userSearch) return;
    if (!(isAdmin || window._hasPerm?.('canDeleteAccounts'))) {
        if (msg) { msg.innerText = 'You do not have permission to delete accounts.'; msg.className = 'text-red-500 text-xs font-bold'; msg.classList.remove('hidden'); }
        return;
    }
    if (!confirm(`Permanently delete user "${userSearch}"? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
    const q = await getDocs(query(collection(db, "users"), where("lower_username", "==", userSearch)));
    if (q.empty) { msg.innerText = "User not found."; msg.className = "text-red-500 text-xs font-bold"; msg.classList.remove('hidden'); return; }
    const targetDoc = q.docs[0]; const targetUid = targetDoc.id;
    const targetData = targetDoc.data();
    const targetUsername = targetData.username;
    const authResult = await _adminDeleteAuthAccount(targetUid, targetData.email);
    const swept = await _adminPurgeUserData(targetUid, targetData);
    await deleteDoc(doc(db, "users", targetUid));
    window.logAdminAction('delete_user', { target: targetUsername, authDeleted: authResult.authDeleted, swept: swept.summary });
    if (authResult.authDeleted) {
        msg.innerText = `"${targetUsername}" fully deleted (Firestore + Authentication). Their email is free to re-register.` + (swept.failed.length ? ` Could not remove: ${swept.failed.join(', ')}` : '');
        msg.className = "text-green-500 text-xs font-bold"; msg.classList.remove('hidden');
    } else {
        msg.innerText = `"${targetUsername}" deleted from Firestore, but their Authentication account could NOT be auto-removed (${authResult.reason}). Delete it manually in the Firebase Console → Authentication before they can re-register with the same email.`;
        msg.className = "text-yellow-400 text-xs font-bold"; msg.classList.remove('hidden');
    }
};
function _wireAdminChatSearch() {
    const el = document.getElementById('admin-chat-search');
    if (!el || el._wiredChatSearch) return;
    el._wiredChatSearch = true;
    el.addEventListener('input', async (e) => {
        const val = e.target.value.trim().toLowerCase();
        const res = document.getElementById('admin-target-results'); res.innerHTML = ''; if (!val) return;
        try {
            const snap = await getDocs(query(collection(db, "users"), where("lower_username", ">=", val), where("lower_username", "<=", val + "\uf8ff"), limit(3)));
            if (snap.empty) { res.innerHTML = '<div class="text-xs text-[#444455] p-1">No matching users.</div>'; return; }
            snap.forEach(d => { res.innerHTML += `<button onclick="adminPullTargetChats('${d.id}','${window.escAttr(d.data().username)}')" class="btn-ghost text-xs text-left w-full">Load: <span class="text-indigo-400 font-bold">${window.escHtml(d.data().username)}</span></button>`; });
        } catch (err) {
            console.error('[Inspector] user search failed:', err);
            res.innerHTML = `<div class="text-xs text-red-400 p-1">Search failed: ${window.escHtml(err.message || String(err))}</div>`;
        }
    });
}

let adminInspectedChatId = null;
window.adminViewLogs = async (cid, chatName, targetName) => {
    adminInspectedChatId = cid;
    const clearBtn = document.getElementById('admin-clear-conv-btn');
    if (clearBtn) clearBtn.classList.remove('hidden');
    const reviveBtn = document.getElementById('admin-revive-streak-btn');
    if (reviveBtn) reviveBtn.classList.remove('hidden');
    const setStreakInput = document.getElementById('admin-set-streak-input');
    const setStreakBtn = document.getElementById('admin-set-streak-btn');
    const forceMilestonesBtn = document.getElementById('admin-force-milestones-btn');
    if (setStreakInput) setStreakInput.classList.remove('hidden');
    if (setStreakBtn) setStreakBtn.classList.remove('hidden');
    if (forceMilestonesBtn) forceMilestonesBtn.classList.remove('hidden');
    const removeBadgeSelect = document.getElementById('admin-remove-badge-select');
    const removeBadgeBtn = document.getElementById('admin-remove-badge-btn');
    if (removeBadgeSelect) removeBadgeSelect.classList.remove('hidden');
    if (removeBadgeBtn) removeBadgeBtn.classList.remove('hidden');

    window.logAdminAction('view_conversation', { target: targetName, chat: chatName });
    const box = document.getElementById('admin-logs');
    const _gameSummary = (g, names) => {
        const defs = window.GAMES || {};
        const def = defs[g.gid];
        const head = def ? `${def.emoji} ${def.name}` : `🎮 ${g.gid || 'Game'}`;
        const nm = uid => window.escHtml(names?.[uid] || (uid ? uid.substring(0, 6) : 'unknown'));
        const dim = t => `<span class="text-[#555566]">${t}</span>`;
        const grid = (board, w, marks) => {
            let rows = '';
            for (let i = 0; i < board.length; i += w) {
                rows += board.slice(i, i + w).split('').map(c => c === '.' ? '·' : marks[+c]).join(' ') + '\n';
            }
            return `<pre style="margin:2px 0 0 12px;font-size:11px;line-height:1.5;color:#8f8fa8;">${rows.trimEnd()}</pre>`;
        };
        let detail = '';
        switch (g.gid) {
            case 'tictactoe':
            case 'connect4': {
                const w = g.gid === 'connect4' ? 7 : 3;
                const marks = g.gid === 'connect4' ? ['O', 'X'] : ['X', 'O'];
                detail = grid(g.board || '', w, marks);
                detail += `<div style="margin-left:12px;">${dim(
                    (g.players || []).map((u, i) => `${marks[i]}=${nm(u)}`).join('  ') +
                    (g.done ? (g.winner ? ` — winner: ${nm(g.winner)}` : ' — draw') : ' — in progress')
                )}</div>`;
                break;
            }
            case 'wyr': {
                const votes = g.votes || {};
                const tally = i => Object.keys(votes).filter(u => votes[u] === i);
                detail = [g.a, g.b].map((opt, i) => {
                    const who = tally(i);
                    return `<div style="margin-left:12px;">${window.escHtml(opt)} ${dim(`— ${who.length} vote(s)${who.length ? ': ' + who.map(nm).join(', ') : ''}`)}</div>`;
                }).join('');
                break;
            }
            case 'twotruths': {
                detail = (g.items || []).map((t, i) =>
                    `<div style="margin-left:12px;">${i === g.lieIndex ? '<span class="text-red-400 font-bold">[LIE]</span>' : dim('[true]')} ${window.escHtml(t)}</div>`
                ).join('');
                const gs = g.guesses || {};
                const guessLine = Object.keys(gs).map(u => `${nm(u)}→#${gs[u] + 1}${gs[u] === g.lieIndex ? ' ✓' : ' ✗'}`).join('  ');
                detail += `<div style="margin-left:12px;">${dim(`guesses: ${guessLine || 'none'}${g.revealed ? ' · revealed' : ''}`)}</div>`;
                break;
            }
            case 'trivia': {
                const prog = g.prog || {};
                const rows = Object.keys(prog).sort((a, b) => prog[b].score - prog[a].score)
                    .map(u => `<div style="margin-left:12px;">${nm(u)} ${dim(`— ${prog[u].score}/${prog[u].i} answered${prog[u].i >= (g.qs || []).length ? ' (finished)' : ''}`)}</div>`).join('');
                detail = rows || `<div style="margin-left:12px;">${dim('nobody has answered yet')}</div>`;
                break;
            }
            case 'story': {
                detail = (g.lines || []).map(l =>
                    `<div style="margin-left:12px;"><span class="text-indigo-400">${nm(l.uid)}:</span> <span class="text-[#ccccdd]">${window.escHtml(l.text)}</span></div>`
                ).join('');
                detail += `<div style="margin-left:12px;">${dim(`${(g.lines || []).length}/${g.max || '?'} lines${g.done ? ' · finished' : ''}`)}</div>`;
                break;
            }
            default:
                detail = `<pre style="margin:2px 0 0 12px;font-size:10px;color:#666677;white-space:pre-wrap;">${window.escHtml(JSON.stringify(g, null, 1))}</pre>`;
        }
        return `<span class="text-purple-300 font-bold">${window.escHtml(head)}</span>` +
               `${g.done ? dim(' [ended]') : dim(' [active]')}${detail}`;
    };
    box.innerHTML = `<span class="text-[#444455]">Fetching ${window.escHtml(chatName)}...</span>`;
    const chatDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, "chats", cid));
    const chatData = chatDoc.exists() ? chatDoc.data() : {};

    const INSPECT_PAGE = 50;
    const _renderRow = (d) => {
        const m = d.data();
        const time = m.timestamp?.toDate()?.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }) || '--:--';
        if (m.type === 'system') return `<div class="py-0.5 text-center"><span class="text-[#444466] italic">[${time}] ${window.escHtml(m.text)}</span></div>`;
        const senderName = chatData.names?.[m.uid] || m.uid?.substring(0, 6) || 'system';
        if (typeof window._emss_seed === 'function') window._emss_seed(d.id, m);
        let bodyHtml;
        if (m.imageGrid?.length) {
            bodyHtml = typeof window._emss_renderGrid === 'function'
                ? window._emss_renderGrid(m.imageGrid, d.id)
                : m.imageGrid.map(b64 => `<img src="${b64}" style="max-width:100px;border-radius:10px;margin-top:2px;display:inline-block;">`).join('');
        } else if (m.imageBase64) {
            bodyHtml = `<img src="${m.imageBase64}" style="max-width:220px;max-height:220px;border-radius:16px;margin-top:3px;cursor:pointer;display:block;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.35);" onclick="window._openInlineImageLightbox(this)">`;
        } else if (m.fileChunked) {
            bodyHtml = _renderFileCard(m.fileName, m.fileSize, m.fileType, { chatId: cid, msgId: d.id });
        } else if (m.fileURL) {
            bodyHtml = _renderFileCard(m.fileName, m.fileSize, m.fileType, { url: m.fileURL });
        } else if (m.type === 'game') {
            bodyHtml = _gameSummary(m.game || {}, chatData.names);
        } else if (m.type === 'space_invite') {
            bodyHtml = `<span class="text-indigo-300 font-bold"><i class="fa-solid fa-layer-group"></i> Space invite</span> ` +
                `<span class="text-[#ccccdd]">${window.escHtml(m.spaceName || 'Space')}</span> ` +
                `<span class="text-[#555566]">— code ${window.escHtml(m.code || '?')}, ${m.memberCount || 0} member(s), ${m.channelCount || 0} channel(s)` +
                `${m.targetUID ? `, to ${window.escHtml(chatData.names?.[m.targetUID] || m.targetUID.substring(0, 6))}` : ''}</span>`;
        } else if (m.type === 'poll') {
            const p = m.poll || {};
            const total = p.totalVotes || 0;
            bodyHtml = `<span class="text-purple-300 font-bold"><i class="fa-solid fa-chart-simple"></i> Poll</span> <span class="text-[#ccccdd]">${window.escHtml(p.question || '')}</span>` +
                (p.options || []).map(o => {
                    const voters = o.voters || [];
                    const who = voters.map(u => window.escHtml(chatData.names?.[u] || u.substring(0, 6))).join(', ');
                    return `<div style="margin-left:12px;">${window.escHtml(o.text)} <span class="text-[#555566]">— ${voters.length} vote(s)${who ? ': ' + who : ''}</span></div>`;
                }).join('') +
                `<div style="margin-left:12px;"><span class="text-[#555566]">${total} total</span></div>`;
        } else if (m.voiceBase64) {
            const d = m.voiceDuration || 0;
            bodyHtml = `<span class="text-purple-300 font-bold"><i class="fa-solid fa-microphone-lines"></i> Voice message</span> <span class="text-[#555566]">— ${Math.floor(d / 60)}:${String(d % 60).padStart(2, '0')}</span>` +
                `<audio controls preload="none" src="${m.voiceBase64}" style="display:block;margin:3px 0 0 12px;height:28px;max-width:240px;"></audio>`;
        } else if (m.gifUrl) {
            const _lib = m.gifLibId ? ` data-giflib="${window.escHtml(m.gifLibId)}" data-gifchunks="${m.gifLibChunks || 0}" data-gifsrc="${window.escHtml(m.gifUrl)}"` : '';
            bodyHtml = `<span class="text-purple-300 font-bold">GIF${m.gifLibId ? ' <span class="text-[#555566]">· library</span>' : ''}</span> ` +
                `<img src="${m.gifPreview || window.escHtml(m.gifUrl)}"${_lib} style="max-width:180px;border-radius:12px;margin-top:3px;display:block;" loading="lazy">`;
            if (m.gifLibId) setTimeout(() => window._hydrateLibGifs && window._hydrateLibGifs(), 0);
        } else {
            bodyHtml = `<span class="text-[#ccccdd]">${window.escHtml(m.text)}</span>`;
        }
        return `<div class="py-0.5"><span class="text-[#333345]">[${time}]</span> <span class="text-indigo-400 font-bold">${window.escHtml(senderName)}:</span> ${bodyHtml}</div>`;
    };

    const header = `<div class="text-[#444455] mb-2 pb-1 border-b border-[#1e1e2e] text-[10px] uppercase tracking-widest">${window.escHtml(chatName)}</div>`;
    const msgsRef = collection(db, `chats/${cid}/messages`);
    let snap;
    try {
        snap = await getDocs(query(msgsRef, orderBy("timestamp", "desc"), limit(INSPECT_PAGE)));
    } catch (e) {
        box.innerHTML = `<span class="text-red-400">Couldn't load this chat: ${window.escHtml(e.message || String(e))}</span>`;
        return;
    }
    if (snap.empty) { box.innerHTML = '<span class="text-[#333345]">No messages in this chat.</span>'; return; }

    let oldestDoc = snap.docs[snap.docs.length - 1];
    let more = snap.docs.length === INSPECT_PAGE;
    const rows = snap.docs.slice().reverse().map(_renderRow);

    const moreBtn = () => more
        ? `<div id="admin-log-more-wrap" class="text-center py-2"><button id="admin-log-more" class="btn-ghost text-xs px-4 py-1.5">Load older messages</button></div>`
        : `<div class="text-center py-2"><span class="text-[10px] text-[#333345] uppercase tracking-widest">Start of conversation</span></div>`;

    box.innerHTML = header + moreBtn() + `<div id="admin-log-rows">${rows.join('')}</div>`;
    box.scrollTop = box.scrollHeight;

    const wireMore = () => {
        const btn = document.getElementById('admin-log-more');
        if (!btn) return;
        btn.onclick = async () => {
            btn.disabled = true; btn.innerText = 'Loading…';
            try {
                const older = await getDocs(query(msgsRef, orderBy("timestamp", "desc"), startAfter(oldestDoc), limit(INSPECT_PAGE)));
                more = older.docs.length === INSPECT_PAGE;
                if (older.docs.length) oldestDoc = older.docs[older.docs.length - 1];
                const rowsEl = document.getElementById('admin-log-rows');
                const prevH = box.scrollHeight, prevTop = box.scrollTop;
                if (rowsEl) rowsEl.insertAdjacentHTML('afterbegin', older.docs.slice().reverse().map(_renderRow).join(''));
                const wrap = document.getElementById('admin-log-more-wrap');
                if (wrap) wrap.outerHTML = moreBtn();
                wireMore();
                box.scrollTop = prevTop + (box.scrollHeight - prevH);
            } catch (e) {
                btn.disabled = false; btn.innerText = 'Load older messages';
                alert('Could not load older messages: ' + (e.message || e));
            }
        };
    };
    wireMore();
};
window.adminReviveStreak = async () => {
    if (!adminInspectedChatId) return alert('Select a chat first.');
    try {
        const snap = await getDoc(doc(db, 'chats', adminInspectedChatId));
        if (!snap.exists()) return alert('Chat not found.');
        const cData = snap.data();
        if (cData.isGroup) return alert('Streaks only apply to DMs.');
        const s = cData.streak || {};
        const restoreCount = s.brokenCount > 0 ? s.brokenCount : (s.count || 0) + 1;
        const restored = { ...s, count: restoreCount, brokenCount: 0, lastDate: _streakToday() };
        await setDoc(doc(db, 'chats', adminInspectedChatId), { streak: restored }, { merge: true });
        window.logAdminAction('revive_streak', { chatId: adminInspectedChatId, newCount: restoreCount });
        alert(`Streak revived/boosted to ${restoreCount} for this chat.`);
        if (currentChatId === adminInspectedChatId) { currentChatData.streak = restored; _renderChatHeaderStreak(restored); }
    } catch(e) { alert('Error: ' + e.message); }
};
async function _syncMissingStreakMilestones(chatId, cData, peakCount) {
    const participants = cData.participants || [];
    const checkUid = participants[0];
    let earned = {};
    if (checkUid) {
        try {
            const uSnap = await getDoc(doc(db, 'users', checkUid));
            earned = uSnap.exists() ? (uSnap.data().streakBadges || {}) : {};
        } catch(e) { console.warn('[streak] milestone check failed:', e); }
    }
    const missing = STREAK_MILESTONES.filter(m => peakCount >= m.count && !earned[m.id]);
    for (const m of missing) {
        for (const uid of participants) {
            try {
                await setDoc(doc(db, 'users', uid), {
                    streakBadges: { [m.id]: { count: m.count, chatId, earnedAt: serverTimestamp() } }
                }, { merge: true });
            } catch(e) { console.warn('[streak] badge award failed:', e); }
        }
        await _postStreakSystemMessage(chatId, cData, `${m.emoji} Milestone unlocked — ${m.label}! This badge is yours to keep.`);
    }
    return missing;
}
window.adminSetStreak = async () => {
    if (!adminInspectedChatId) return alert('Select a chat first.');
    const input = document.getElementById('admin-set-streak-input');
    const newCount = parseInt(input?.value, 10);
    if (!Number.isFinite(newCount) || newCount < 0) return alert('Enter a valid streak number (0 or higher).');
    try {
        const snap = await getDoc(doc(db, 'chats', adminInspectedChatId));
        if (!snap.exists()) return alert('Chat not found.');
        const cData = snap.data();
        if (cData.isGroup) return alert('Streaks only apply to DMs.');
        const s = cData.streak || {};
        const peakCount = Math.max(s.peakCount || 0, newCount);
        const updated = { ...s, count: newCount, brokenCount: 0, peakCount, lastDate: _streakToday() };
        await setDoc(doc(db, 'chats', adminInspectedChatId), { streak: updated }, { merge: true });
        if (currentChatId === adminInspectedChatId) { currentChatData.streak = updated; _renderChatHeaderStreak(updated); }
        const awarded = await _syncMissingStreakMilestones(adminInspectedChatId, cData, peakCount);
        window.logAdminAction('set_streak', { chatId: adminInspectedChatId, newCount, peakCount, badgesAwarded: awarded.length });
        alert(`Streak set to ${newCount} (peak: ${peakCount}) for this chat.${awarded.length ? ` Awarded ${awarded.length} new milestone badge(s).` : ''}`);
        if (input) input.value = '';
    } catch(e) { alert('Error: ' + e.message); }
};
window.adminForceAwardMilestones = async () => {
    if (!adminInspectedChatId) return alert('Select a chat first.');
    try {
        const snap = await getDoc(doc(db, 'chats', adminInspectedChatId));
        if (!snap.exists()) return alert('Chat not found.');
        const cData = snap.data();
        if (cData.isGroup) return alert('Streaks only apply to DMs.');
        const s = cData.streak || {};
        const peakCount = s.peakCount || s.count || 0;
        const awarded = await _syncMissingStreakMilestones(adminInspectedChatId, cData, peakCount);
        window.logAdminAction('force_milestones', { chatId: adminInspectedChatId, peakCount, badgesAwarded: awarded.length });
        alert(awarded.length
            ? `🏆 Awarded ${awarded.length} missing milestone badge(s) up to peak ${peakCount}.`
            : `No missing milestones — peak is ${peakCount} and all eligible badges are already awarded.`);
    } catch(e) { alert('Error: ' + e.message); }
};
window.adminRemoveMilestone = async () => {
    if (!adminInspectedChatId) return alert('Select a chat first.');
    const sel = document.getElementById('admin-remove-badge-select');
    const milestoneId = sel?.value;
    const m = STREAK_MILESTONES.find(x => x.id === milestoneId);
    if (!m) return alert('Pick a milestone to remove.');
    if (!confirm(`Remove the ${m.emoji} ${m.label} badge from both people in this chat? This can't be undone (though Force Milestones can re-award it if the peak still qualifies).`)) return;
    try {
        const snap = await getDoc(doc(db, 'chats', adminInspectedChatId));
        if (!snap.exists()) return alert('Chat not found.');
        const cData = snap.data();
        const participants = cData.participants || [];
        let removedFrom = 0;
        for (const uid of participants) {
            try {
                const uSnap = await getDoc(doc(db, 'users', uid));
                if (!uSnap.exists()) continue;
                const badges = uSnap.data().streakBadges || {};
                if (!(milestoneId in badges)) continue;
                await updateDoc(doc(db, 'users', uid), { [`streakBadges.${milestoneId}`]: deleteField() });
                removedFrom++;
            } catch(e) { console.warn('[streak] badge removal failed for', uid, e); }
        }
        window.logAdminAction('remove_milestone', { chatId: adminInspectedChatId, badge: m.label, removedFrom });
        alert(removedFrom
            ? `🗑 Removed the ${m.label} badge from ${removedFrom} participant(s).`
            : `Neither participant currently has the ${m.label} badge.`);
    } catch(e) { alert('Error: ' + e.message); }

    }
