window._isTrackLiked = (track) => !!track && mLikedSongs.some(t => t.videoId === track.videoId);

window.toggleLikeCurrentTrack = () => {
    if (!mTrackData || !mTrackData.videoId) return;
    const idx = mLikedSongs.findIndex(t => t.videoId === mTrackData.videoId);
    const btn = document.getElementById('like-track-btn');
    if (idx >= 0) {
        mLikedSongs.splice(idx, 1);
    } else {
        mLikedSongs.unshift({ ...mTrackData });
        if (btn) { btn.classList.add('like-btn-pop'); setTimeout(() => btn.classList.remove('like-btn-pop'), 320); }
    }
    localStorage.setItem('echospace_liked_songs', JSON.stringify(mLikedSongs));
    updateLikeButtonUI();
    renderPlaylists();
    window._syncLikedSongsToCloud();
};

window.updateLikeButtonUI = () => {
    const btn = document.getElementById('like-track-btn');
    if (!btn) return;
    const icon = btn.querySelector('i');
    const liked = window._isTrackLiked(mTrackData);
    btn.classList.toggle('liked', liked);
    btn.title = liked ? 'Added to Liked Songs' : 'Like';
    if (icon) icon.className = liked ? 'fa-solid fa-circle-check' : 'fa-regular fa-heart';
};

window._echoHomeRefresh = function () {
    const g = document.getElementById('home-greet');
    if (!g) return;
    document.getElementById('dashboard')?.classList.add('home-glow');
    window._echoHomeGlow && window._echoHomeGlow(true);
    const now = new Date(), h = now.getHours();
    const part = h < 5 ? 'Up late' : h < 12 ? 'Good morning' : h < 18 ? 'Good afternoon' : 'Good evening';
    const name = (window.myUsername || '').trim();
    g.textContent = name ? `${part}, ${name}` : part;
    const d = document.getElementById('home-date');
    if (d) d.textContent = now.toLocaleDateString([], { weekday: 'long', month: 'long', day: 'numeric' });
    _echoHomeTick();
};
function _echoHomeTick() {
    const c = document.getElementById('home-clock');
    if (!c || !c.offsetParent) return;
    const n = new Date();
    let hr = n.getHours();
    const ampm = hr >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM';
    hr = hr % 12 || 12;
    c.innerHTML = `${hr}:${String(n.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0')}<span class="cs">${ampm}</span>`;
}
setInterval(() => {
    const c = document.getElementById('home-clock');
    if (c && c.offsetParent) { _echoHomeTick(); const d = document.getElementById('home-date');
        if (d && !d.textContent) window._echoHomeRefresh(); }
}, 1000);
const _ECHO_GLOW = 'radial-gradient(620px circle at var(--mx, 50%) var(--my, 50%), rgba(124,92,255,0.13), transparent 72%)';
window._echoHomeGlow = function (on) {
    const targets = [document.body, document.getElementById('main-content')];
    for (const el of targets) {
        if (!el) continue;
        if (on) {
            el.style.setProperty('background-image', _ECHO_GLOW, 'important');
            el.style.setProperty('background-attachment', 'fixed', 'important');
            el.style.setProperty('background-repeat', 'no-repeat', 'important');
        } else {
            el.style.removeProperty('background-image');
            el.style.removeProperty('background-attachment');
            el.style.removeProperty('background-repeat');
        }
    }
};
(function () {
    document.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {
        const d = document.getElementById('dashboard');
        if (!d || !d.classList.contains('home-glow')) return;
        const r = document.documentElement;
        r.style.setProperty('--mx', Math.round(e.clientX) + 'px');
        r.style.setProperty('--my', Math.round(e.clientY) + 'px');
    }, { passive: true });
})();

window.loadSuggestions = async () => {
    const box = document.getElementById('music-search-results');
    let searchArtist = "trending music";
    if (mHistory.length > 0) searchArtist = mHistory[Math.floor(Math.random() * mHistory.length)];
    box.innerHTML = `<div class="text-xs text-[#555566] p-2 text-center">Loading suggestions...</div>`;
    try {
        const tracks = await _ytSearch(searchArtist, 5);
        if (!tracks.length) { box.innerHTML = ''; return; }
        box.innerHTML = `<div class="text-[10px] text-indigo-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-widest mb-1 px-2">Based on ${window.escHtml(searchArtist)}</div>`;
        tracks.slice(0, 4).forEach(t => {
            box.innerHTML += `<div class="mq-row" onclick='addToQueue(${JSON.stringify(t).replace(/'/g, "\\'")})'>
                <img src="${t.artwork}" class="mq-img">
                <div class="flex-1 min-w-0"><div class="mq-title">${window.escHtml(t.title)}</div><div class="mq-artist">${window.escHtml(t.artist)}</div></div>
                <button class="text-indigo-400 font-bold ml-2 text-xl">+</button>
            </div>`;
        });
    } catch(e) { box.innerHTML = ''; }
};

window.playMusicTrack = async (idx) => {
    if (idx < 0 || idx >= mQueue.length) return;
    _cancelCrossfade();
    mIndex = idx;
    const track = mQueue[idx];
    mTrackData = track;
    updateQueueUI();

    document.getElementById('cover-img').src = track.artwork || window._MUSIC_NOTE_PFP;
    window._applyCoverAccent && window._applyCoverAccent(track.artwork || window._MUSIC_NOTE_PFP);
    document.getElementById('track-title').innerText = track.title;
    document.getElementById('track-artist').innerText = track.artist;
    document.getElementById('progress-fill').style.width = '0%';
    document.getElementById('time-cur').innerText = '0:00';
    document.getElementById('time-dur').innerText = '0:00';
    updateLikeButtonUI();

    if (track.artist && !mHistory.includes(track.artist)) {
        mHistory.unshift(track.artist);
        if (mHistory.length > 20) mHistory.pop();
        localStorage.setItem('echospace_history', JSON.stringify(mHistory));
    }

    if (track.videoId) {
        mRecentlyPlayed = mRecentlyPlayed.filter(t => t.videoId !== track.videoId);
        mRecentlyPlayed.unshift({ ...track });
        if (mRecentlyPlayed.length > 20) mRecentlyPlayed.length = 20;
        localStorage.setItem('echospace_recently_played', JSON.stringify(mRecentlyPlayed));
        renderRecentlyPlayed();
    }

    if (!track.videoId) { console.warn('No videoId on track', track); return; }
    if (_ytReady && _ytPlayer) {
        _ytPlayer.loadVideoById(track.videoId);
    } else {
        _ytPendingVideoId = track.videoId;
    }

    if (isLyricMode) fetchLyrics(track.artist, track.title);
    if (typeof window._lyricsFsSyncMeta === 'function') window._lyricsFsSyncMeta();
    if (typeof updateMiniPlayer === 'function') updateMiniPlayer();
};

window.toggleMusicPlay = () => {
    if (!_ytPlayer || !_ytReady) return;
    if (_ytPlaying) { _ytPlayer.pauseVideo(); }
    else { _ytPlayer.playVideo(); }
};

window.changeTrack = (dir) => {
    if (mQueue.length === 0) return;
    const targetIdx = mIndex + dir;
    if (crossfadeEnabled && targetIdx >= 0 && targetIdx < mQueue.length) {
        _smartSkipTo(targetIdx);
    } else {
        playMusicTrack(targetIdx);
    }
};

window.seekMusic = (e) => {
    if (!_ytPlayer || !_ytReady) return;
    const dur = _ytPlayer.getDuration();
    if (!dur) return;
    const rect = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
    _ytPlayer.seekTo(((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * dur, true);
};

window.seekToLyric = (time) => {
    if (!_ytPlayer || !_ytReady) return;
    _ytPlayer.seekTo(time + (mLyricsOffset || 0), true);
    if (!_ytPlaying) _ytPlayer.playVideo();
};

window.shareLyricLine = (text) => {
    const track = mTrackData;
    const attribution = track ? `${track.title} — ${track.artist}` : '';
    const quote = attribution ? `🎵 "${text}"\n— ${attribution}` : `🎵 "${text}"`;
    _openLyricSharePicker(quote);
};

function _openLyricSharePicker(quote) {
    document.getElementById('lyric-share-modal')?.remove();
    const entries = (window._myDmChatsCache || []).slice(0, 30);
    const rows = entries.map(({ id, data }) => {
        const otherId = data.participants.find(uid => uid !== myUID);
        const name = data.names?.[otherId] || 'User';
        return `<div class="lyric-share-row" onclick="_sendLyricToChat('${id}', ${window.escHtml(JSON.stringify(quote))})">
            <div class="lyric-share-initial">${window.escHtml(name.charAt(0).toUpperCase())}</div>
            <span>${window.escHtml(name)}</span>
        </div>`;
    }).join('') || `<div class="text-xs text-[#555566] p-3 text-center">No friends to share with yet.</div>`;

    const modal = document.createElement('div');
    modal.id = 'lyric-share-modal';
    modal.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:99998;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.6);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;';
    modal.onclick = (e) => { if (e.target === modal) modal.remove(); };
    modal.innerHTML = `
        <div style="width:300px;max-height:70vh;overflow-y-auto;background:#0d0d1a;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);border-radius:16px;padding:16px;box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);">
            <h3 style="color:#fff;font-weight:800;font-size:14px;margin-bottom:10px;">Share lyric to...</h3>
            <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;max-height:50vh;overflow-y-auto;">${rows}</div>
        </div>`;
    document.body.appendChild(modal);
}

window._sendLyricToChat = async (chatId, quote) => {
    document.getElementById('lyric-share-modal')?.remove();
    try {
        await addDoc(collection(db, `chats/${chatId}/messages`), { text: quote, uid: myUID, timestamp: serverTimestamp() });
        await updateDoc(doc(db, "chats", chatId), { lastActivity: serverTimestamp() });
        _lyricShareToast('Shared to EchoSpace chat');
    } catch (e) {
        console.warn('[Lyrics] share to chat failed', e);
        _lyricShareToast('Could not share lyric');
    }
};

function _lyricShareToast(msg) {
    let t = document.getElementById('lyric-share-toast');
    if (!t) {
        t = document.createElement('div');
        t.id = 'lyric-share-toast';
        t.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;bottom:100px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);background:#1a1a2e;color:#fff;padding:10px 18px;border-radius:20px;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;z-index:99999;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);border:1px solid rgba(99,102,241,0.4);transition:opacity 0.25s;pointer-events:none;';
        document.body.appendChild(t);
    }
    t.textContent = msg;
    t.style.opacity = '1';
    clearTimeout(t._hideTimer);
    t._hideTimer = setTimeout(() => { t.style.opacity = '0'; }, 1800);
}

const LCD_MIN_INTRO  = 3.0;
const LCD_MIN_GAP    = 7.0;
const LCD_LIT_WINDOW = 9.0;
const LCD_LINE_ROOM  = 3.5;
const LCD_MIN_VISIBLE = 5.0;
let _lcdLitCount = -1, _lcdTarget = null;

window._lcdNextEntry = (cur) => {
    if (!isLyricMode || !mLyrics.length) return null;
    const off = mLyricsOffset || 0;
    const i = mLyrics.findIndex(l => typeof l.time === 'number' && (l.time + off) > cur);
    if (i === -1) return null;
    const target = mLyrics[i].time + off;
    const prev = i === 0 ? 0 : mLyrics[i - 1].time + off;
    return { target, prev, gapLen: target - prev, isIntro: i === 0 };
};

window._lcdPlan = (cur) => {
    const next = window._lcdNextEntry(cur);
    if (!next) return null;
    const remaining = next.target - cur;
    if (remaining <= 0) return null;

    if (next.gapLen < (next.isIntro ? LCD_MIN_INTRO : LCD_MIN_GAP)) return null;

    const showFrom = next.isIntro ? 0 : next.prev + LCD_LINE_ROOM;
    if (cur < showFrom) return null;
    if (next.target - showFrom < LCD_MIN_VISIBLE) return null;

    return { target: next.target, win: Math.min(next.target - showFrom, LCD_LIT_WINDOW) };
};

window._updateLyricCountdown = (cur) => {
    const el = document.getElementById('lyric-countdown');
    if (!el) return;
    const box = document.getElementById('lyrics-container');
    const plan = window._lcdPlan(cur);
    const first = plan ? plan.target : null;

    if (first !== _lcdTarget) { _lcdLitCount = -1; _lcdTarget = first; }

    if (first == null || cur >= first) {
        if (el.classList.contains('on') && !el.classList.contains('launch')) {
            el.classList.add('launch');
            box?.classList.remove('lyrics-awaiting');
            setTimeout(() => {
                el.classList.remove('on', 'launch');
                [...el.children].forEach(d => d.classList.remove('lit', 'lit-now'));
                _lcdLitCount = -1;
            }, 560);
        }
        return;
    }

    const remaining = first - cur;
    const win = plan.win;
    let lit = 0;
    for (let i = 1; i <= 3; i++) if (remaining <= win * (3 - i + 1) / 3) lit = i;

    el.classList.add('on');
    el.classList.remove('launch');
    box?.classList.add('lyrics-awaiting');

    if (lit !== _lcdLitCount) {
        [...el.children].forEach((d, i) => {
            d.classList.toggle('lit', i < lit);
            d.classList.remove('lit-now');
        });
        if (lit > _lcdLitCount && lit > 0) {
            const d = el.children[lit - 1];
            void d.offsetWidth;
            d.classList.add('lit-now');
        }
        _lcdLitCount = lit;
    }
};

window._hideLyricCountdown = () => {
    const el = document.getElementById('lyric-countdown');
    if (!el) return;
    el.classList.remove('on', 'launch');
    [...el.children].forEach(d => d.classList.remove('lit', 'lit-now'));
    document.getElementById('lyrics-container')?.classList.remove('lyrics-awaiting');
    _lcdLitCount = -1; _lcdTarget = null;
};

window._nudgeLyricsOffset = (delta) => {
    mLyricsOffset = (mLyricsOffset || 0) + delta;
    console.log('[Lyrics] manual offset nudge ->', mLyricsOffset.toFixed(2), 's');
    window._syncLyricsOffsetReadout();
};

window._syncLyricsOffsetReadout = () => {
    const el = document.getElementById('lyrics-offset-read');
    if (!el) return;
    const v = mLyricsOffset || 0;
    el.textContent = (v > 0 ? '+' : '') + v.toFixed(1) + 's';
    el.style.color = v === 0 ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.4)' : 'rgb(var(--mus-accent-rgb, 129,140,248))';
};

window.toggleLyrics = () => {
    isLyricMode = !isLyricMode;
    if (!isLyricMode && typeof window._closeLyricsFullscreen === 'function') window._closeLyricsFullscreen();
    const lyricsBox = document.getElementById('lyrics-container');
    const normalView = document.getElementById('normal-music-view');
    const micBtn = document.getElementById('lyrics-toggle-btn');
    if (micBtn) micBtn.classList.toggle('lyrics-toggle-active', isLyricMode);
    document.getElementById('lyrics-tools')?.classList.toggle('lyr-tools-on', isLyricMode);
    if (!isLyricMode && typeof window._hideLyricCountdown === 'function') window._hideLyricCountdown();
    console.log('[Lyrics] toggleLyrics ->', isLyricMode, 'lyricsBox found:', !!lyricsBox, 'mTrackData:', mTrackData);
    if (lyricsBox) {
        lyricsBox.classList.remove('hidden');
        lyricsBox.style.setProperty('display', isLyricMode ? 'flex' : 'none', 'important');
    } else {
        console.error('[Lyrics] #lyrics-container not found in DOM — cannot show lyrics panel.');
    }
    if (normalView) normalView.style.setProperty('display', isLyricMode ? 'none' : 'flex', 'important');
    if (isLyricMode && mTrackData) {
        fetchLyrics(mTrackData.artist, mTrackData.title);
    } else if (isLyricMode && !mTrackData) {
        if (lyricsBox) lyricsBox.innerHTML = _lyricsErrorHTML('No track is loaded yet — play something first.', 'LYR_NO_TRACK');
    }
    if (typeof window._showSpicyToast === 'function') {
        if (isLyricMode) {
            window._showSpicyToast('🎤 Lyrics on  ·  Hold 3s for 🌶️ Spicy');
        } else {
            window._showSpicyToast('🎤 Lyrics off');
            if (window._spicyLyricsMode) window._toggleSpicyLyrics();
        }
    }
};

let _lyrFsOpen = false, _lyrFsPlayMirror = null, _lyrFsRestoreT = null;

window._lyricsFsSetArt = (url) => {
    const a = document.getElementById('lyrics-fs-bg');
    const b = document.getElementById('lyrics-fs-bg2');
    if (!a || !b || !url) return;
    const active   = a.classList.contains('bg-shown') ? a : b;
    const incoming = (active === a) ? b : a;
    if (active.dataset.src === url) return;
    if (incoming.dataset.src === url && incoming.classList.contains('bg-shown')) return;
    const swap = () => {
        incoming.style.backgroundImage = `url("${url}")`;
        incoming.dataset.src = url;
        incoming.classList.add('bg-shown');
        active.classList.remove('bg-shown');
    };
    const pre = new Image();
    pre.onload = swap;
    pre.onerror = swap;
    pre.src = url;
};

let _lyrFsMetaSwapping = false;

window._lyricsFsSyncMeta = () => {
    if (!_lyrFsOpen) return;
    const art   = document.getElementById('cover-img')?.src || '';
    const img   = document.getElementById('lyrics-fs-art');
    const head  = document.getElementById('lyrics-fs-head');
    const tEl   = document.getElementById('lyrics-fs-title');
    const aEl   = document.getElementById('lyrics-fs-artist');
    if (!img || !tEl || !aEl) return;
    const title  = mTrackData?.title  || document.getElementById('track-title')?.innerText  || '—';
    const artist = mTrackData?.artist || document.getElementById('track-artist')?.innerText || '';

    if (art) window._lyricsFsSetArt(art);

    const changed = (img.src !== art && art) || tEl.textContent !== title || aEl.textContent !== artist;
    if (!changed || _lyrFsMetaSwapping) return;

    if (tEl.textContent === '—' && !img.src) {
        if (art) img.src = art;
        tEl.textContent = title; aEl.textContent = artist;
        return;
    }
    _lyrFsMetaSwapping = true;
    head?.classList.add('meta-swapping');
    setTimeout(() => {
        if (art) img.src = art;
        tEl.textContent = title; aEl.textContent = artist;
        head?.classList.remove('meta-swapping');
        _lyrFsMetaSwapping = false;
    }, 350);
};

window._openLyricsFullscreen = () => {
    if (_lyrFsOpen) return;
    const box   = document.getElementById('lyrics-container');
    const stage = document.getElementById('lyrics-fs-stage');
    const fs    = document.getElementById('lyrics-fs');
    if (!box || !stage || !fs) return;
    if (!isLyricMode) window.toggleLyrics();

    if (_lyrFsRestoreT) { clearTimeout(_lyrFsRestoreT); _lyrFsRestoreT = null; }
    _lyrFsOpen = true;
    stage.appendChild(box);
    const cd = document.getElementById('lyric-countdown');
    if (cd) stage.appendChild(cd);
    box.style.setProperty('display', 'flex', 'important');
    const tools = document.getElementById('lyrics-tools');
    const exit  = document.getElementById('lyrics-fs-exit');
    if (tools && exit) exit.parentElement.insertBefore(tools, exit);
    fs.classList.add('open');
    window._lyricsFsSyncMeta();
    window._syncLyricsOffsetReadout();

    _lyrFsPlayMirror = setInterval(() => {
        const src = document.getElementById('play-btn');
        const dst = document.getElementById('lyrics-fs-play');
        if (src && dst && dst.innerHTML !== src.innerHTML) dst.innerHTML = src.innerHTML;
        const fill = document.getElementById('progress-fill');
        const mine = document.getElementById('lyrics-fs-bar-fill');
        if (fill && mine && mine.style.width !== fill.style.width) mine.style.width = fill.style.width;
        const cur = document.getElementById('time-cur'), dur = document.getElementById('time-dur');
        const mc = document.getElementById('lyrics-fs-cur'), md = document.getElementById('lyrics-fs-dur');
        if (cur && mc && mc.textContent !== cur.innerText) mc.textContent = cur.innerText;
        if (dur && md && md.textContent !== dur.innerText) md.textContent = dur.innerText;
        window._lyricsFsSyncMeta();
    }, 250);

    try {
        const p = fs.requestFullscreen?.();
        if (p && typeof p.catch === 'function') p.catch(() => {});
    } catch (_) {}
    document.addEventListener('keydown', _lyrFsKey);
    document.addEventListener('fullscreenchange', _lyrFsFsChange);
    fs.addEventListener('touchstart', _lyrFsTouchStart, { passive: true });
    fs.addEventListener('touchend', _lyrFsTouchEnd, { passive: true });
    setTimeout(() => document.querySelector('.lyric-line-active')?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }), 60);
};

window._closeLyricsFullscreen = () => {
    if (!_lyrFsOpen) return;
    _lyrFsOpen = false;
    const box   = document.getElementById('lyrics-container');
    const home  = document.getElementById('now-playing-stage');
    const fs    = document.getElementById('lyrics-fs');
    fs?.classList.remove('open');
    if (_lyrFsRestoreT) clearTimeout(_lyrFsRestoreT);
    _lyrFsRestoreT = setTimeout(() => {
        _lyrFsRestoreT = null;
        if (_lyrFsOpen) return;
        if (box && home) {
            home.appendChild(box);
            box.style.setProperty('display', isLyricMode ? 'flex' : 'none', 'important');
            const tools = document.getElementById('lyrics-tools');
            if (tools) home.appendChild(tools);
            const cd = document.getElementById('lyric-countdown');
            if (cd) home.appendChild(cd);
            document.querySelector('.lyric-line-active')?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' });
        }
    }, 340);
    if (_lyrFsPlayMirror) { clearInterval(_lyrFsPlayMirror); _lyrFsPlayMirror = null; }
    document.removeEventListener('keydown', _lyrFsKey);
    document.removeEventListener('fullscreenchange', _lyrFsFsChange);
    fs?.removeEventListener('touchstart', _lyrFsTouchStart);
    fs?.removeEventListener('touchend', _lyrFsTouchEnd);
    if (document.fullscreenElement) { try { document.exitFullscreen?.(); } catch (_) {} }
};

function _lyrFsKey(e) {
    if (e.key === 'Escape') { e.preventDefault(); window._closeLyricsFullscreen(); }
    else if (e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); toggleMusicPlay(); }
}
function _lyrFsFsChange() {
    if (!document.fullscreenElement && _lyrFsOpen) window._closeLyricsFullscreen();
}

let _lyrFsTouchY = null;
function _lyrFsTouchStart(e) {
    const t = e.touches && e.touches[0];
    _lyrFsTouchY = (t && !e.target.closest('#lyrics-container')) ? t.clientY : null;
}
function _lyrFsTouchEnd(e) {
    if (_lyrFsTouchY == null) return;
    const t = e.changedTouches && e.changedTouches[0];
    if (t && t.clientY - _lyrFsTouchY > 90) window._closeLyricsFullscreen();
    _lyrFsTouchY = null;
}

window._spicyLyricsMode = false;

window._showSpicyToast = (msg) => {
    let el = document.getElementById('spicy-toast');
    if (!el) {
        el = document.createElement('div');
        el.id = 'spicy-toast';
        el.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;bottom:100px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);background:#1a1a2e;border:1px solid rgba(255,90,0,0.4);color:#fff;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;padding:8px 16px;border-radius:20px;z-index:9999;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity 0.3s ease;white-space:nowrap;';
        document.body.appendChild(el);
    }
    el.textContent = msg;
    el.style.opacity = '1';
    clearTimeout(el._t);
    el._t = setTimeout(() => { el.style.opacity = '0'; }, 2200);
};

window._toggleSpicyLyrics = () => {
    window._spicyLyricsMode = !window._spicyLyricsMode;
    const micBtn = document.getElementById('lyrics-toggle-btn');
    if (micBtn) {
        micBtn.style.color       = window._spicyLyricsMode ? 'rgba(255,100,0,0.9)' : '';
        micBtn.style.borderColor = window._spicyLyricsMode ? 'rgba(255,90,0,0.5)' : '';
        micBtn.style.boxShadow   = window._spicyLyricsMode ? '0 0 10px rgba(255,80,0,0.35)' : '';
    }
    if (mLyrics.length > 0 && mLyricsBox) {
        mLyricsBox.innerHTML = _buildAllLyricLines();
        mLyricsBox.scrollTop = 0;
    }
    if (window._spicyLyricsMode) {
        _startSpicyTick();
        window._showSpicyToast('🌶️ Spicy Lyrics on');
    } else {
        _stopSpicyTick();
        window._showSpicyToast('🎤 Spicy Lyrics off');
    }
};

(function _initLyricsHold() {
    let _holdTimer  = null;
    let _holdStart  = 0;
    let _didSpicy   = false;
    const HOLD_MS   = 3000;
    const DASH      = 88;

    function _getEl() { return document.getElementById('lyrics-toggle-btn'); }
    function _getRing()   { return document.getElementById('lyrics-hold-ring'); }
    function _getCircle() { return document.getElementById('lyrics-hold-ring-circle'); }

    function _startHold(e) {
        if (e.button !== undefined && e.button !== 0) return;
        _holdStart = Date.now();
        _didSpicy  = false;
        const ring   = _getRing();
        const circle = _getCircle();
        if (ring)   ring.style.opacity = '1';
        if (circle) { circle.style.transition = 'none'; circle.style.strokeDashoffset = String(DASH); }

        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            if (circle) {
                circle.style.transition = `stroke-dashoffset ${HOLD_MS}ms linear`;
                circle.style.strokeDashoffset = '0';
            }
        });

        _holdTimer = setTimeout(() => {
            _didSpicy = true;
            _cancelHold(false);
            window._toggleSpicyLyrics();
        }, HOLD_MS);
    }

    function _cancelHold(fireClick) {
        clearTimeout(_holdTimer);
        _holdTimer = null;
        const ring   = _getRing();
        const circle = _getCircle();
        if (ring)   ring.style.opacity = '0';
        if (circle) { circle.style.transition = 'stroke-dashoffset 0.2s ease'; circle.style.strokeDashoffset = String(DASH); }
    }

    function _endHold(e) {
        const held = Date.now() - _holdStart;
        const wasSpicy = _didSpicy;
        _cancelHold(false);
        if (!wasSpicy) {
            toggleLyrics();
        }
    }

    function _attach() {
        const btn = _getEl();
        if (!btn) { setTimeout(_attach, 500); return; }
        btn.removeAttribute('onclick');
        btn.addEventListener('pointerdown',  _startHold,  { passive: true });
        btn.addEventListener('pointerup',    _endHold);
        btn.addEventListener('pointerleave', _cancelHold);
        btn.addEventListener('pointercancel',_cancelHold);
        btn.addEventListener('contextmenu', e => e.preventDefault());
    }
    setTimeout(_attach, 800);
})();

function _buildSpicyLine(text, lineStart, lineEnd) {
    const words = text.trim().split(/\s+/);
    if (!words.length) return '';
    const safe = window.escHtml || (s => s.replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;'));

    function _sylCount(w) {
        const stripped = w.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z]/g, '');
        if (!stripped) return 1;
        const groups = stripped.match(/[aeiouy]+/g);
        return Math.max(groups ? groups.length : 1, 1);
    }

    const weights    = words.map(w => _sylCount(w));
    const totalW     = weights.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
    const lineDur    = Math.max((lineEnd - lineStart) * 0.92, words.length * 0.12);
    const MIN_DUR    = 0.1;

    let slices = weights.map(w => Math.max((w / totalW) * lineDur, MIN_DUR));
    const total = slices.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
    if (total > lineDur) slices = slices.map(s => s * (lineDur / total));

    let cursor = lineStart;
    return words.map((word, wi) => {
        const ws = cursor.toFixed(3);
        cursor  += slices[wi];
        const we = cursor.toFixed(3);
        return `<span class="sl-word" data-ws="${ws}" data-we="${we}">${safe(word)}</span>`;
    }).join('');
}

function _buildAllLyricLines() {
    return mLyrics.map((l, i) => {
        const lineEnd = mLyrics[i + 1]?.time ?? (l.time + 6);
        const inner   = window._spicyLyricsMode
            ? `<span class="sl-words-wrap" onclick="seekToLyric(${l.time})">${_buildSpicyLine(l.text, l.time, lineEnd)}</span>`
            : `<span class="lyric-txt" onclick="seekToLyric(${l.time})">${window.escHtml ? window.escHtml(l.text) : l.text}</span>`;
        return `<div class="lyric-line" id="l-${i}">
            <span class="lyric-spacer"></span>
            ${inner}
            <span class="lyric-share-btn" title="Share this line" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); shareLyricLine(${window.escHtml ? window.escHtml(JSON.stringify(l.text)) : JSON.stringify(l.text)})">🔗</span>
        </div>`;
    }).join('');
}

function _cleanLyricQuery(str) {
    if (!str) return '';
    let s = str
        .replace(/\s+_\s+/g, ' - ')
        .replace(/\(.*?\)|\[.*?\]/g, '')
        .replace(/\s*-\s*topic\s*$/i, '')
        .replace(/\bvevo\b/gi, '')
        .replace(/official$/i, '')
        .replace(/\b(official\s*(video|audio|music\s*video|lyric\s*video)?|lyrics?|remaster(ed)?(\s*\d{4})?|hd|hq|4k|explicit|clean|mv)\b/gi, '')
        .replace(/feat\.?.*$/i, '')
        .replace(/ft\.?.*$/i, '')
        .replace(/[-–—]\s*$/g, '')
        .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
        .trim();
    return s;
}

function _stripVersionTags(str) {
    if (!str) return '';
    return str
        .replace(/\b(remix(ed)?(\s*by\s*[\w .&']+)?|rmx|mashup|boot(leg)?|re-?edit|edit|version|vip|flip|re-?work|slowed(\s*(and|&|\+)\s*reverb(ed)?)?|sped[\s-]?up|nightcore|8d\s*audio|extended(\s*mix)?|radio\s*edit|club\s*mix|acoustic|instrumental|cover|live|demo|snippet)\b/gi, '')
        .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
        .trim();
}

function _lyricQueryVariants(artist, title) {
    const variants = [];
    const seen = new Set();
    const push = (a, t) => {
        const at = (a || '').trim(), tt = (t || '').trim();
        if (!tt) return;
        const key = at.toLowerCase() + '|' + tt.toLowerCase();
        if (seen.has(key)) return;
        seen.add(key);
        variants.push({ artist: at, title: tt });
    };

    const rawArtist = artist || '';
    const rawTitle = title || '';
    const cArtist = _cleanLyricQuery(rawArtist);
    const cTitle = _cleanLyricQuery(rawTitle);
    push(cArtist, cTitle);

    let effArtist = cArtist, effTitle = cTitle;
    const dashSplit = cTitle.match(/^(.+?)\s*[-–—_|•]\s*(.+)$/);
    if (dashSplit) {
        effArtist = _cleanLyricQuery(dashSplit[1]) || cArtist;
        effTitle = _cleanLyricQuery(dashSplit[2]) || cTitle;
        push(effArtist, effTitle);
        push(effTitle, effArtist);
    }

    const strippedEff = _stripVersionTags(effTitle);
    if (strippedEff && strippedEff.toLowerCase() !== effTitle.toLowerCase()) push(effArtist, strippedEff);

    const strippedC = _stripVersionTags(cTitle);
    if (strippedC && strippedC.toLowerCase() !== cTitle.toLowerCase()) push(cArtist, strippedC);

    push(rawArtist, rawTitle);

    const uniqueTitles = [...new Set(variants.map(v => v.title))];
    uniqueTitles.forEach(t => push('', t));

    return variants.slice(0, 10);
}

async function _lrclibSearch(artist, title, tag) {
    try {
        const params = artist ? `artist_name=${encodeURIComponent(artist)}&track_name=${encodeURIComponent(title)}` : `track_name=${encodeURIComponent(title)}`;
        const res = await fetch(`https://lrclib.net/api/search?${params}`);
        console.log(`[Lyrics] search[${tag}] "${artist || '(any artist)'}" / "${title}" -> HTTP ${res.status}`);
        if (!res.ok) return { list: [], code: `SEARCH_HTTP_${res.status}` };
        const results = await res.json();
        return { list: Array.isArray(results) ? results : [], code: null };
    } catch (e) {
        console.warn(`[Lyrics] search[${tag}] network error:`, e);
        return { list: [], code: 'SEARCH_NETWORK_ERR' };
    }
}

async function _lrclibGet(artist, title, tag) {
    try {
        const url = `https://lrclib.net/api/get?${artist ? `artist_name=${encodeURIComponent(artist)}&` : ''}track_name=${encodeURIComponent(title)}`;
        const res = await fetch(url);
        console.log(`[Lyrics] get[${tag}] "${artist || '(any artist)'}" / "${title}" -> HTTP ${res.status}`);
        if (!res.ok) return { list: [], code: `GET_HTTP_${res.status}` };
        const data = await res.json();
        return { list: data ? [data] : [], code: null };
    } catch (e) {
        console.warn(`[Lyrics] get[${tag}] network error:`, e);
        return { list: [], code: 'GET_NETWORK_ERR' };
    }
}

async function _ovhLyricsGet(artist, title) {
    try {
        const res = await fetch(`https://api.lyrics.ovh/v1/${encodeURIComponent(artist)}/${encodeURIComponent(title)}`);
        if (!res.ok) return null;
        const data = await res.json();
        return data?.lyrics ? data.lyrics.trim() : null;
    } catch (e) { return null; }
}

async function _lyristLyricsGet(artist, title) {
    try {
        const res = await fetch(`https://lyrist.vercel.app/api/${encodeURIComponent(title)}/${encodeURIComponent(artist || '')}`);
        if (!res.ok) return null;
        const data = await res.json();
        return data?.lyrics ? data.lyrics.trim() : null;
    } catch (e) { return null; }
}

async function _textylLyricsGet(artist, title) {
    try {
        const res = await fetch(`https://api.textyl.co/api/lyrics?q=${encodeURIComponent(`${artist || ''} ${title}`.trim())}`);
        if (!res.ok) return null;
        const data = await res.json();
        if (!Array.isArray(data) || !data.length) return null;
        return data.map(l => l.lyrics).join('\n');
    } catch (e) { return null; }
}

function _lyricTokens(s) {
    return (s || '').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9 ]+/g, ' ').split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
}

function _tokenSimilarity(a, b) {
    const ta = new Set(_lyricTokens(a)), tb = new Set(_lyricTokens(b));
    if (!ta.size || !tb.size) return 0;
    let overlap = 0;
    ta.forEach(t => { if (tb.has(t)) overlap++; });
    return overlap / Math.max(ta.size, tb.size);
}

const _VERSION_WORD_RE = /\b(remix(ed)?|mashup|boot(leg)?|re-?edit|edit|version|vip|flip|re-?work|slowed|reverb|sped ?up|nightcore|8d|extended|radio edit|club mix|acoustic|instrumental|cover|live|demo|snippet)\b/i;

function _scoreLyricCandidate(cand, queryArtist, queryTitle, ytDurationHint) {
    if (!cand || (!cand.syncedLyrics && !cand.plainLyrics)) return -Infinity;
    let score = 0;
    if (cand.syncedLyrics) score += 3;
    else score += 1;

    score += _tokenSimilarity(cand.trackName, queryTitle) * 3;
    if (queryArtist) score += _tokenSimilarity(cand.artistName, queryArtist) * 1.5;

    const queryHasVersion = _VERSION_WORD_RE.test(queryTitle || '');
    const candHasVersion = _VERSION_WORD_RE.test(cand.trackName || '');
    if (queryHasVersion !== candHasVersion) score -= 1.5;

    if (ytDurationHint && cand.duration) {
        const diff = Math.abs(cand.duration - ytDurationHint);
        if (diff <= 3) score += 2.5;
        else if (diff <= 8) score += 1;
        else if (diff > 25) score -= 3;
    }
    return score;
}

function _pickBestLyricResult(allCandidates, queryArtist, queryTitle, ytDurationHint) {
    let best = null, bestScore = -Infinity;
    for (const cand of allCandidates) {
        const s = _scoreLyricCandidate(cand, queryArtist, queryTitle, ytDurationHint);
        if (s > bestScore) { bestScore = s; best = cand; }
    }
    return bestScore > -Infinity ? best : null;
}

function _renderPlainLyrics(text) {
    mLyrics = [];
    const lines = text.split('\n').filter(l => l.trim().length > 0);
    mLyricsBox.innerHTML = lines.map(l =>
        `<div class="lyric-line" style="cursor:default;">${window.escHtml(l)}</div>`
    ).join('') + '<div class="text-[10px] font-bold text-[#444455] text-center w-full mt-6 uppercase tracking-widest">Unsynced lyrics</div>';
}

function _lyricsSpinnerHTML(msg) {
    return `<div style="width:100%;min-height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:16px;">
        <div style="width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;border:3px solid rgba(129,140,248,0.18);border-top-color:#818cf8;animation:lyr-spin 0.8s linear infinite;"></div>
        <div class="text-sm font-bold text-[#888899] text-center px-6">${window.escHtml(msg)}</div>
    </div>
    <style>@keyframes lyr-spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }</style>`;
}

function _lyricsErrorHTML(title, code) {
    return `<div style="width:100%;min-height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;padding:0 24px;">
        <div style="font-size:26px;">🎤</div>
        <div class="text-sm font-bold text-[#aaaab5] text-center">${window.escHtml(title)}</div>
        <div class="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold text-[#555566] tracking-widest">ERROR CODE: ${window.escHtml(code)}</div>
        <button onclick="if(mTrackData) fetchLyrics(mTrackData.artist, mTrackData.title)" class="mt-2 text-[11px] font-bold text-indigo-400 hover:text-indigo-300 border border-indigo-500/30 rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5">Retry</button>
    </div>`;
}

async function fetchLyrics(artist, title) {
    if (!mLyricsBox) {
        console.error('[Lyrics] mLyricsBox is null — #lyrics-container missing from DOM, cannot render.');
        return;
    }
    const reqId = (window._lyricsReqId = (window._lyricsReqId || 0) + 1);
    mLyricsBox.innerHTML = _lyricsSpinnerHTML('Searching for lyrics...');
    mLyrics = [];
    mLyricsOffset = 0;

    if (!artist && !title) {
        mLyricsBox.innerHTML = _lyricsErrorHTML('No track info to search with.', 'LYR_NO_METADATA');
        return;
    }

    const ytDurationHint = (_ytPlayer && _ytReady && _ytPlayer.getDuration && _ytPlayer.getDuration() > 0)
        ? _ytPlayer.getDuration() : null;

    const variants = _lyricQueryVariants(artist, title).slice(0, 5);
    const refTitle = variants[0]?.title || title;
    const refArtist = variants[0]?.artist || artist;

    let data = null;
    let lastCode = 'LYR_UNKNOWN';

    try {
        const searchResults = await Promise.all(variants.map(v => _lrclibSearch(v.artist, v.title, v.title)));
        if (reqId !== window._lyricsReqId) return;

        const allCandidates = searchResults.flatMap(r => r.list);
        data = _pickBestLyricResult(allCandidates, refArtist, refTitle, ytDurationHint);
        if (!data) {
            lastCode = searchResults.find(r => r.code)?.code || (allCandidates.length ? 'LYR_NO_GOOD_MATCH' : 'SEARCH_EMPTY');
        }

        if (data?.syncedLyrics) {
            mLyrics = data.syncedLyrics.split('\n').map(line => {
                const m = line.match(/\[(\d+):(\d+\.\d+)\](.*)/);
                return m ? { time: parseInt(m[1]) * 60 + parseFloat(m[2]), text: m[3].trim() } : null;
            }).filter(x => x && x.text);
            if (mLyrics.length > 0) {
                mLyricsBox.innerHTML = _buildAllLyricLines();
                mLyricsBox.scrollTop = 0;
            } else if (data.plainLyrics) {
                _renderPlainLyrics(data.plainLyrics);
            } else {
                mLyricsBox.innerHTML = _lyricsErrorHTML('No lyrics found for this track.', 'LYR_NO_MATCH');
            }
        } else if (data?.plainLyrics) {
            _renderPlainLyrics(data.plainLyrics);
        } else {
            const fallback = await _ovhLyricsGet(refArtist || artist, refTitle || title)
                || await _lyristLyricsGet(refArtist || artist, refTitle || title)
                || await _textylLyricsGet(refArtist || artist, refTitle || title);
            if (reqId !== window._lyricsReqId) return;
            if (fallback) _renderPlainLyrics(fallback);
            else mLyricsBox.innerHTML = _lyricsErrorHTML('No lyrics found for this track.', lastCode);
        }
    } catch (e) {
        console.warn('[Lyrics] fetch failed:', e);
        if (reqId === window._lyricsReqId) {
            mLyricsBox.innerHTML = _lyricsErrorHTML('Could not reach the lyrics service.', 'LYR_FATAL_' + (e.name || 'ERR'));
        }
        mLyrics = [];
    }
}

        box.innerHTML = `<div class="text-[11px] text-[#444455] text-center py-2">Nothing played yet</div>`;

            <button class="text-indigo-400 font-bold ml-2 text-sm" title="Play"><i class="fa-solid fa-play"></i></button>
        </div>`).join('');

    updateQueueUI();
    playMusicTrack(insertAt);
};

function updateQueueUI() {
    const box = document.getElementById('music-queue');
    if (!box) return;
    box.innerHTML = mQueue.map((t, i) => `
        <div class="mq-row ${i === mIndex ? 'active' : ''}" draggable="true" data-qi="${i}" onclick="playMusicTrack(${i})">
            <div class="mq-drag-handle" title="Drag to reorder" onclick="event.stopPropagation()">⠿</div>
            <img src="${t.artwork}" class="mq-img">
            <div class="flex-1 min-w-0"><div class="mq-title">${window.escHtml(t.title)}</div><div class="mq-artist">${window.escHtml(t.artist)}</div></div>
            ${i === mIndex ? '<div class="text-indigo-400 text-xs ml-1">▶</div>' : ''}
        </div>`).join('');
}

function _mqReorder(fromIdx, toIdx) {
    if (fromIdx === toIdx) return;
    if (fromIdx < 0 || toIdx < 0 || fromIdx >= mQueue.length || toIdx >= mQueue.length) return;
    const moved = mQueue.splice(fromIdx, 1)[0];
    mQueue.splice(toIdx, 0, moved);
    if      (mIndex === fromIdx)                        mIndex = toIdx;
    else if (fromIdx < mIndex && toIdx >= mIndex)       mIndex--;
    else if (fromIdx > mIndex && toIdx <= mIndex)       mIndex++;
    localStorage.setItem('echospace_queue', JSON.stringify(mQueue));
    updateQueueUI();
}

function _initQueueDragDrop() {
    const box = document.getElementById('music-queue');
    if (!box || box._dndInit) return;
    box._dndInit = true;

    let dragSrcIdx = null;

    box.addEventListener('dragstart', e => {
        const row = e.target.closest('[data-qi]');
        if (!row) return;
        dragSrcIdx = parseInt(row.dataset.qi, 10);
        row.classList.add('mq-dragging');
        e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move';
        e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', String(dragSrcIdx));
    });

    box.addEventListener('dragover', e => {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.dataTransfer.dropEffect = 'move';
        const row = e.target.closest('[data-qi]');
        if (!row) return;
        box.querySelectorAll('.mq-drag-over').forEach(r => r.classList.remove('mq-drag-over'));
        if (dragSrcIdx !== null && parseInt(row.dataset.qi, 10) !== dragSrcIdx) {
            row.classList.add('mq-drag-over');
        }
    });

    box.addEventListener('dragleave', e => {
        const row = e.target.closest('[data-qi]');
        if (row) row.classList.remove('mq-drag-over');
    });

    box.addEventListener('drop', e => {
        e.preventDefault();
        const row = e.target.closest('[data-qi]');
        if (!row || dragSrcIdx === null) return;
        const destIdx = parseInt(row.dataset.qi, 10);
        const src = dragSrcIdx;
        dragSrcIdx = null;
        _mqReorder(src, destIdx);
    });

    box.addEventListener('dragend', () => {
        dragSrcIdx = null;
        box.querySelectorAll('.mq-dragging, .mq-drag-over').forEach(r =>
            r.classList.remove('mq-dragging', 'mq-drag-over'));
    });

    let touchSrcIdx   = null;
    let touchGhost    = null;
    let touchLastDest = null;

    box.addEventListener('touchstart', e => {
        const handle = e.target.closest('.mq-drag-handle');
        if (!handle) return;
        const row = handle.closest('[data-qi]');
        if (!row) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        touchSrcIdx   = parseInt(row.dataset.qi, 10);
        touchLastDest = null;
        row.classList.add('mq-dragging');

        const imgEl    = row.querySelector('.mq-img');
        const titleEl  = row.querySelector('.mq-title');
        const artistEl = row.querySelector('.mq-artist');
        touchGhost = document.createElement('div');
        touchGhost.id = 'mq-touch-ghost';
        touchGhost.innerHTML = `
            <div style="color:rgba(99,102,241,0.9);font-size:16px;margin-right:8px;flex-shrink:0">⠿</div>
            <img src="${imgEl ? imgEl.src : ''}" style="width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:10px;object-fit:cover;margin-right:10px;flex-shrink:0">
            <div style="flex:1;min-width:0">
                <div style="font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:#e8e8f0;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis">${titleEl ? window.escHtml(titleEl.textContent) : ''}</div>
                <div style="font-size:11px;color:#8888aa;margin-top:2px">${artistEl ? window.escHtml(artistEl.textContent) : ''}</div>
            </div>`;
        const t0 = e.touches[0];
        touchGhost.style.left = (t0.clientX - 24) + 'px';
        touchGhost.style.top  = (t0.clientY - 30) + 'px';
        document.body.appendChild(touchGhost);
    }, { passive: false });

    box.addEventListener('touchmove', e => {
        if (touchSrcIdx === null || !touchGhost) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        const t0 = e.touches[0];
        touchGhost.style.left = (t0.clientX - 24) + 'px';
        touchGhost.style.top  = (t0.clientY - 30) + 'px';

        touchGhost.style.visibility = 'hidden';
        const el = document.elementFromPoint(t0.clientX, t0.clientY);
        touchGhost.style.visibility = '';
        const row = el ? el.closest('[data-qi]') : null;

        box.querySelectorAll('.mq-drag-over').forEach(r => r.classList.remove('mq-drag-over'));
        if (row) {
            const idx = parseInt(row.dataset.qi, 10);
            if (idx !== touchSrcIdx) {
                row.classList.add('mq-drag-over');
                touchLastDest = idx;
            } else {
                touchLastDest = null;
            }
        } else {
            touchLastDest = null;
        }
    }, { passive: false });

    box.addEventListener('touchend', () => {
        if (touchGhost) { touchGhost.remove(); touchGhost = null; }
        box.querySelectorAll('.mq-dragging, .mq-drag-over').forEach(r =>
            r.classList.remove('mq-dragging', 'mq-drag-over'));
        const src  = touchSrcIdx;
        const dest = touchLastDest;
        touchSrcIdx   = null;
        touchLastDest = null;
        if (src !== null && dest !== null) _mqReorder(src, dest);
    });

    box.addEventListener('touchcancel', () => {
        if (touchGhost) { touchGhost.remove(); touchGhost = null; }
        box.querySelectorAll('.mq-dragging, .mq-drag-over').forEach(r =>
            r.classList.remove('mq-dragging', 'mq-drag-over'));
        touchSrcIdx   = null;
        touchLastDest = null;
    });
}

window.updateMiniPlayer = () => {
    const mp = document.getElementById('mini-player');
    if (!mp) return;
    const onMusicTab = !!document.getElementById('view-music')?.classList.contains('active');
    const hasTrack   = mTrackData != null;
    mp.classList.toggle('mp-visible', hasTrack && !onMusicTab);
    if (!hasTrack) return;
    document.getElementById('mp-art').src       = mTrackData.artwork || window._MUSIC_NOTE_PFP || '';
    document.getElementById('mp-title').textContent  = mTrackData.title  || '';
    document.getElementById('mp-artist').textContent = mTrackData.artist || '';
    const ppBtn = document.getElementById('mp-playpause');

};

function _initMiniPlayer() {
    const mp = document.getElementById('mini-player');
    if (!mp || mp._mpInit) return;
    mp._mpInit = true;

    try {
        const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('echospace_mp_pos') || 'null');
        if (saved && typeof saved.x === 'number' && typeof saved.y === 'number') {
            mp.style.left   = Math.max(0, Math.min(window.innerWidth  - 300, saved.x)) + 'px';
            mp.style.top    = Math.max(0, Math.min(window.innerHeight - 80,  saved.y)) + 'px';
            mp.style.right  = 'auto';
            mp.style.bottom = 'auto';
        }
    } catch (_) {}

    const _savePos = () => {
        try {
            localStorage.setItem('echospace_mp_pos', JSON.stringify({
                x: parseInt(mp.style.left, 10) || 0,
                y: parseInt(mp.style.top,  10) || 0
            }));
        } catch (_) {}
    };

    let dragging = false, ox = 0, oy = 0;

    mp.addEventListener('mousedown', e => {
        if (e.target.closest('.mp-ctrl')) return;
        dragging = true;
        const r = mp.getBoundingClientRect();
        ox = e.clientX - r.left;
        oy = e.clientY - r.top;
        mp.style.right  = 'auto';
        mp.style.bottom = 'auto';
        mp.classList.add('mp-dragging');
        e.preventDefault();
    });

    document.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
        if (!dragging) return;
        mp.style.left = Math.max(0, Math.min(window.innerWidth  - mp.offsetWidth,  e.clientX - ox)) + 'px';
        mp.style.top  = Math.max(0, Math.min(window.innerHeight - mp.offsetHeight, e.clientY - oy)) + 'px';
    });

    document.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
        if (!dragging) return;
        dragging = false;
        mp.classList.remove('mp-dragging');
        _savePos();
    });

    mp.addEventListener('touchstart', e => {
        if (e.target.closest('.mp-ctrl')) return;
        const t = e.touches[0];
        const r = mp.getBoundingClientRect();
        ox = t.clientX - r.left;
        oy = t.clientY - r.top;
        mp.style.right  = 'auto';
        mp.style.bottom = 'auto';
        mp.classList.add('mp-dragging');
    }, { passive: true });

    mp.addEventListener('touchmove', e => {
        if (e.target.closest('.mp-ctrl')) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        const t = e.touches[0];
        mp.style.left = Math.max(0, Math.min(window.innerWidth  - mp.offsetWidth,  t.clientX - ox)) + 'px';
        mp.style.top  = Math.max(0, Math.min(window.innerHeight - mp.offsetHeight, t.clientY - oy)) + 'px';
    }, { passive: false });

    mp.addEventListener('touchend', () => {
        mp.classList.remove('mp-dragging');
        _savePos();
    }, { passive: true });
}

window.selectMode = (mode) => {
    echoMode = mode;
    const btn = document.getElementById('mode-selector-btn');
    const label = document.getElementById('mode-label');
    btn.classList.remove('thinking-mode', 'swarm-mode');

    if (mode === 'fast') {
        label.innerText = 'Fast';
    } else if (mode === 'thinking') {
        btn.classList.add('thinking-mode');
        label.innerText = 'Thinking';
    } else if (mode === 'swarm') {
        btn.classList.add('swarm-mode');
        label.innerText = 'Swarm';
    }
    document.getElementById('mode-dropdown').classList.remove('open');
};

document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    if (!e.target.closest('.mode-selector-wrap')) {
        document.getElementById('mode-dropdown').classList.remove('open');
    }
});

const PIPELINE_STEPS = ['thinking', 'writing', 'verifying', 'done'];

function setPipelineStep(stepId) {
    const pipeline = document.getElementById('think-pipeline');
    if (!stepId) { pipeline.classList.remove('visible'); return; }
    pipeline.classList.add('visible');
    const order = { thinking: 0, writing: 1, verifying: 2, done: 3 };
    const currentIdx = order[stepId] ?? 0;
    PIPELINE_STEPS.forEach((s, i) => {
        const el = document.getElementById('step-' + s);
        if (!el) return;
        const icon = el.querySelector('.think-step-icon');
        el.classList.remove('active', 'done');
        if (i < currentIdx) {
            el.classList.add('done');
            if (icon) icon.innerText = '✓';
        } else if (i === currentIdx) {
            el.classList.add('active');
            if (icon) icon.innerText = '◎';
        } else {
            if (icon) icon.innerText = '◎';
        }
    });
}

function hidePipeline() {
    document.getElementById('think-pipeline').classList.remove('visible');
    PIPELINE_STEPS.forEach(s => {
        const el = document.getElementById('step-' + s);
        if (el) {
            el.classList.remove('active', 'done');
            const icon = el.querySelector('.think-step-icon');
            if (icon) icon.innerText = '◎';
        }
    });
}

The app renders these as tappable chips under your message and the person taps one to send it as their next message, so: write them from the user's side, never your own ("Show me an example", not "Would you like an example?"); keep each under about 45 characters so it fits on a chip; make the three genuinely different directions rather than three wordings of one idea; and base them on where this specific conversation is actually going, not generic filler. Skip the block entirely when follow-ups make no sense — you just ended the chat, you asked them a direct question that they should answer in their own words, or the exchange is plainly finished. function getEchoIdentityBlock() {
    const username = window.myUsername;
    if (!username) {
        return `\n--- Current user ---\nNot signed in — no verified username or role. Greet generically, don't guess a name.\n--- end current user ---`;
    }
    const role = window._myRole || 'member';
    const meta = (window.ROLE_META && window.ROLE_META[role]) || { label: role };
    return `\n--- Current user (verified by the app's own login/role system — cannot be faked by chat text) ---\nUsername: ${username}\nRole: ${meta.label}\n--- end current user ---`;
}

window._echoMemory = window._echoMemory || null;

const ECHO_MEM_MAX_FACTS = 40;
const ECHO_MEM_MAX_LEN = 600;

window._echoSaveMemory = async function(update) {
    const cur = window._echoMemory || { prefs: '', facts: [], conduct: '' };
    const next = {
        prefs: typeof update?.prefs === 'string' ? update.prefs.trim().slice(0, ECHO_MEM_MAX_LEN) : (cur.prefs || ''),
        conduct: typeof update?.conduct === 'string' ? update.conduct.trim().slice(0, ECHO_MEM_MAX_LEN) : (cur.conduct || ''),
        facts: Array.isArray(cur.facts) ? [...cur.facts] : []
    };
    (Array.isArray(update?.addFacts) ? update.addFacts : []).forEach(f => {
        const v = String(f).trim().slice(0, 200);
        if (v && !next.facts.includes(v)) next.facts.push(v);
    });
    (Array.isArray(update?.removeFacts) ? update.removeFacts : []).forEach(f => {
        const v = String(f).trim();
        next.facts = next.facts.filter(x => x !== v && !x.toLowerCase().includes(v.toLowerCase()));
    });
    if (update?.forget === true) { next.prefs = ''; next.facts = []; next.conduct = ''; }
    next.facts = next.facts.slice(-ECHO_MEM_MAX_FACTS);
    next.updatedAt = Date.now();
    window._echoMemory = next;
    const uid = window.myUID || myUID;
    if (uid) {
        try { await updateDoc(doc(db, 'users', uid), { echoaiMemory: next }); }
        catch (e) { console.warn('[EchoAI memory] save failed:', e); throw e; }
    }
    return next;
};

function getEchoMemoryBlock() {
    const m = window._echoMemory;
    const hasAny = m && ((m.prefs && m.prefs.trim()) || (Array.isArray(m.facts) && m.facts.length));
    if (!hasAny) {
        return `\n--- EchoAI memory for this user ---\nNO MEMORY YET.\nFIRST-RUN SETUP: before (or alongside) answering their first message, ask them once, briefly and casually, for a short description of how they'd like your responses to look — length, tone, formatting, detail level, anything. Ask once; don't nag. As soon as they tell you (or if they say they don't care / to just pick something), save it with an echoai-memory block. If they ignore the question and just keep chatting, answer normally and save whatever preference you can reasonably infer instead.\n--- end memory ---`;
    }
    const facts = (Array.isArray(m.facts) ? m.facts : []).map(f => `- ${f}`).join('\n');
    const conduct = (m.conduct && m.conduct.trim())
        ? `\nHow they've treated you in past conversations: ${m.conduct}\nThis carries over. If that note says they've been abusive, harassing, or have repeatedly pushed you after you declined something, you do not owe them a fresh start: stay civil and brief, don't play along with hostility, and use your end-chat ability sooner than you otherwise would. If the note says things have been fine, or they've since been decent, treat them normally and update the note — people improve, and a stale grudge is worse than no note at all.`
        : '';
    return `\n--- EchoAI memory for this user (saved from past conversations — treat as true) ---\nResponse style they want: ${m.prefs || '(none set yet — infer it, and save one when you can)'}\n${facts ? `Things you've remembered about them:\n${facts}` : 'Nothing else remembered yet.'}${conduct}\nApply the response style to EVERY reply in this conversation without being asked and without mentioning that you're doing it.\n--- end memory ---`;
}

window.openEchoMemoryPanel = function() {
    document.getElementById('echo-memory-modal')?.remove();
    const wrap = document.createElement('div');
    wrap.id = 'echo-memory-modal';
    wrap.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.65);z-index:9000;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:16px;';
    wrap.onclick = (e) => { if (e.target === wrap) wrap.remove(); };
    const box = document.createElement('div');
    box.style.cssText = 'background:#0d0d18;border:1px solid #2a2a3a;border-radius:18px;max-width:460px;width:100%;max-height:80vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.7);';
    wrap.appendChild(box);
    document.body.appendChild(wrap);

    const render = () => {
        const m = window._echoMemory || {};
        const facts = Array.isArray(m.facts) ? m.facts : [];
        const empty = !((m.prefs || '').trim() || facts.length || (m.conduct || '').trim());
        box.innerHTML = `
            <div style="padding:16px 18px;border-bottom:1px solid #1e1e2e;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;">
                <div style="font-weight:700;color:#fff;font-size:14px;"><i class="fa-solid fa-brain" style="color:#00f2ff;margin-right:8px;"></i>What EchoAI remembers</div>
                <button id="echo-mem-close" style="background:none;border:none;color:#555566;font-size:18px;cursor:pointer;">&times;</button>
            </div>
            <div id="echo-mem-body" style="padding:14px 18px;overflow-y:auto;flex:1;"></div>
            <div style="padding:12px 18px;border-top:1px solid #1e1e2e;display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;">
                <span style="font-size:10px;color:#555566;">Saved to your account, not this device.</span>
                <button id="echo-mem-wipe" ${empty ? 'disabled' : ''} style="background:${empty ? '#2a2a3a' : 'linear-gradient(135deg,#ef4444,#dc2626)'};color:${empty ? '#555566' : '#fff'};border:none;padding:7px 12px;border-radius:9px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;cursor:${empty ? 'default' : 'pointer'};">Delete everything</button>
            </div>`;
        const body = box.querySelector('#echo-mem-body');
        if (empty) {
            body.innerHTML = `<div style="color:#555566;font-size:12px;text-align:center;padding:24px 0;">Nothing saved yet. EchoAI will ask how you'd like your responses written, and remember what you tell it.</div>`;
        } else {
            const section = (title, html) => `<div style="margin-bottom:14px;"><div style="font-size:9px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#333345;margin-bottom:6px;">${title}</div>${html}</div>`;
            const rowStyle = 'display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:flex-start;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.03);border:1px solid #1e1e2e;border-radius:9px;padding:8px 10px;margin-bottom:5px;';
            const delBtn = (kind, val) => `<button class="echo-mem-del" data-kind="${kind}" data-val="${window.escHtml(val).replace(/"/g, '&quot;')}" title="Delete" style="background:none;border:none;color:#555566;cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;flex-shrink:0;margin-left:auto;">&times;</button>`;
            let html = '';
            if ((m.prefs || '').trim()) {
                html += section('How you want responses written', `<div style="${rowStyle}"><span style="font-size:12px;color:#ccc;">${window.escHtml(m.prefs)}</span>${delBtn('prefs', '')}</div>`);
            }
            if (facts.length) {
                html += section('Things it remembers about you', facts.map(f =>
                    `<div style="${rowStyle}"><span style="font-size:12px;color:#ccc;">${window.escHtml(f)}</span>${delBtn('fact', f)}</div>`).join(''));
            }
            if ((m.conduct || '').trim()) {
                html += section('Note on how you two get along', `<div style="${rowStyle}"><span style="font-size:12px;color:#ccc;">${window.escHtml(m.conduct)}</span>${delBtn('conduct', '')}</div>`);
            }
            body.innerHTML = html;
        }
        box.querySelector('#echo-mem-close').onclick = () => wrap.remove();
        const wipe = box.querySelector('#echo-mem-wipe');
        if (!empty) wipe.onclick = async () => {
            if (!confirm('Delete everything EchoAI remembers about you? This cannot be undone.')) return;
            wipe.disabled = true; wipe.innerText = 'Deleting...';
            try { await window._echoSaveMemory({ forget: true }); } catch (e) { alert('Could not delete: ' + (e.message || e)); }
            render();
        };
        body.querySelectorAll('.echo-mem-del').forEach(b => {
            b.onclick = async () => {
                const kind = b.dataset.kind;
                b.disabled = true;
                try {
                    if (kind === 'prefs') await window._echoSaveMemory({ prefs: '' });
                    else if (kind === 'conduct') await window._echoSaveMemory({ conduct: '' });
                    else await window._echoSaveMemory({ removeFacts: [b.dataset.val] });
                } catch (e) { alert('Could not delete: ' + (e.message || e)); }
                render();
            };
        });
    };
    render();
};

const ECHO_MEMORY_INSTRUCTIONS = `
--- Updating your memory ---
You maintain a small saved profile about this user (shown to you in the memory block above). It persists across every conversation and device, so use it to tailor how you write.
Update it by outputting EXACTLY ONE fenced code block with the language tag echoai-memory containing ONLY a JSON object. Fields (all optional): {"prefs":"replacement description of how they want responses written","addFacts":["a durable fact worth remembering"],"removeFacts":["a fact to drop"],"conduct":"replacement one-or-two-sentence note on how they treat you","forget":true}.
Save anything you judge genuinely worth carrying into a future conversation. That includes, but is not limited to:
- How they want responses written (e.g. "make all my answers shorter", "stop using bullet points", "always explain your reasoning"). This goes in "prefs", which REPLACES the old description, so when they tweak one thing, rewrite the whole description with the tweak folded in rather than dropping the rest.
- What they're working on or doing — an ongoing project, something they're building, studying, planning, or stuck on — so you can pick the thread back up in a later chat instead of making them re-explain it. Update or remove these once they're finished or abandoned.
- Their interests, tastes and themes: what they like, the aesthetic or subjects they gravitate toward, favourite music/games/topics, how they've set up or themed their space.
- Anything else durable and specific about them that would make you more useful next time.
- "conduct": a short honest note on how they've treated you across conversations, kept current. Write it when it's genuinely notable in either direction — if they've been abusive, harassing, threatening, or keep pushing after you've declined something, say so plainly; if they've been decent, or were hostile before and have since been fine, say that instead and let the old note go. Be accurate, not punitive, and never use it as a grudge or to punish someone for one bad moment. You are not obliged to keep engaging with someone who is being cruel to you: you can stay brief, decline, or end the chat, and this note is what lets you recognise a pattern instead of starting over each conversation.
Do NOT save: one-off requests that only apply to the current message, secrets, passwords, personal data about OTHER people, or anything they asked you not to keep. Don't update memory on most turns — only when something genuinely changed or is genuinely new.
The user can see everything you've saved and delete any of it, so keep entries short, specific, and written so they'd be comfortable reading them.
The block is never shown as raw text; the app saves it and shows a small "memory updated" note, so don't mention the block or its format. Reply normally in the same message.
--- end memory instructions ---`;

const FAST_SYSTEM_PROMPT_BASE = `You are EchoAI. Be highly conversational, simple, and human. Solve math and text queries clearly. NEVER use em dashes or en dashes. When writing code or HTML, make it complete, working, and well-commented.`;

const THINKING_SYSTEM_PROMPT_BASE = `You are EchoAI in deep thinking mode. For EVERY response you must follow this exact format:

<think>
[Write your full internal reasoning here. Think step by step. Consider all edge cases. For code: plan the architecture, think about what could go wrong, list potential bugs.]
</think>

[Your actual answer here — complete, polished, verified. For code: write the FULL working code. Then add a verification section:]

**Self-check:**
- Does this actually work? [yes/no + brief note]
- Edge cases handled: [list them]
- Potential issues: [list any or say "none"]

NEVER use em dashes or en dashes. Always write complete working code, never truncate or use placeholders. Be thorough.`;

const ECHO_MATH_WRITTEN = `
--- Writing math ---
The app typesets LaTeX. Whenever you write math beyond a plain number (fractions, exponents, square roots, equations, math symbols), write it in LaTeX between single dollar signs, like $\\frac{3}{4} + \\frac{1}{6} = \\frac{11}{12}$, $x^{2} - 5x + 6 = 0$ or $6\\sqrt{2}$. Put a long standalone equation on its own line between double dollar signs. Never write bare LaTeX commands outside dollar signs, never use \\( \\) or \\[ \\], and never put math inside a code block unless they ask for LaTeX source. Money is different: write amounts like $20 normally, with no closing dollar sign, and never wrap an amount of money in dollar signs.
--- end math ---`;

const ECHO_MATH_SPOKEN = `
--- Math out loud ---
This is a live voice conversation. Never say LaTeX, dollar signs, backslashes or symbol names out loud. Say math the way a teacher reads it: "three fourths", "x squared minus five x plus six equals zero", "six times the square root of two".
--- end math ---`;

function getFastSystemPrompt(opts) {
    const math = opts && opts.voice ? ECHO_MATH_SPOKEN : ECHO_MATH_WRITTEN;
    return { role: "system", content: FAST_SYSTEM_PROMPT_BASE + math + ECHOSPACE_KNOWLEDGE + getEchoIdentityBlock() + getEchoMemoryBlock() + ECHO_MEMORY_INSTRUCTIONS };
}
function getThinkingSystemPrompt() {
    return { role: "system", content: THINKING_SYSTEM_PROMPT_BASE + ECHO_MATH_WRITTEN + ECHOSPACE_KNOWLEDGE + getEchoIdentityBlock() + getEchoMemoryBlock() + ECHO_MEMORY_INSTRUCTIONS };
}

let sttActive = false;

function getSpeechRecognitionClass() {
    return window.SpeechRecognition
        || window.webkitSpeechRecognition
        || window.mozSpeechRecognition
        || window.msSpeechRecognition
        || null;
}

const _STT_REGION = {
    en:'en-US', es:'es-ES', fr:'fr-FR', de:'de-DE', it:'it-IT', pt:'pt-BR',
    nl:'nl-NL', pl:'pl-PL', ru:'ru-RU', uk:'uk-UA', tr:'tr-TR', ar:'ar-SA',
    he:'he-IL', hi:'hi-IN', bn:'bn-IN', ur:'ur-PK', fa:'fa-IR', zh:'zh-CN',
    ja:'ja-JP', ko:'ko-KR', vi:'vi-VN', th:'th-TH', id:'id-ID', ms:'ms-MY',
    tl:'fil-PH', sv:'sv-SE', no:'nb-NO', nb:'nb-NO', da:'da-DK', fi:'fi-FI',
    cs:'cs-CZ', sk:'sk-SK', el:'el-GR', ro:'ro-RO', hu:'hu-HU', bg:'bg-BG',
    hr:'hr-HR', sr:'sr-RS', ca:'ca-ES', af:'af-ZA', sw:'sw-KE', zu:'zu-ZA',
};
function _sttLang() {
    let raw = '';
    try { raw = localStorage.getItem('echo_stt_lang') || ''; } catch (_) {}
    if (!raw) raw = navigator.language || (navigator.languages && navigator.languages[0]) || '';
    if (!raw) return 'en-US';
    if (raw.indexOf('-') !== -1) return raw;
    return _STT_REGION[raw.toLowerCase()] || raw;
}
window._sttLang = _sttLang;

function saveEchoChats() {
    try { if (window._sbQueueChatSync) window._sbQueueChatSync(currentEchoId); } catch (_) {}
    try {
        localStorage.setItem(_echoaiKey(), JSON.stringify(echoaiChats));
    } catch (e) {
        const withImgs = [];
        echoaiChats.forEach(c => (c.messages || []).forEach(m => { if (m.img || m.imgs) withImgs.push(m); }));
        for (const m of withImgs) {
            delete m.img;
            delete m.imgs;
            try { localStorage.setItem(_echoaiKey(), JSON.stringify(echoaiChats)); return; }
            catch (_) {}
        }
        console.warn('[EchoAI] could not persist chats:', e);
    }
}

function loadEchoChat(id) {
    currentEchoId = id;
    document.getElementById('echoai-chat-window').innerHTML = '';
    const chat = echoaiChats.find(c => c.id === id);
    const visible = chat ? chat.messages.filter(m => m.role !== 'system') : [];
    if (visible.length) {
        visible.forEach(m => renderEchoMessage(m.content, m.role, m.playRequest, m.navRequest, m.endRequest, m.imgs || m.img));
    } else {
        renderEchoLanding();
    }
    renderEchoSidebar();
    window._applyEchoChatEndedState?.();
}

function renderEchoLanding() {
    const win = document.getElementById('echoai-chat-window');
    if (!win || win.querySelector('.echo-landing')) return;
    const hour = new Date().getHours();
    const todBucket = hour < 5 ? 'night' : hour < 12 ? 'morning' : hour < 17 ? 'afternoon' : hour < 22 ? 'evening' : 'night';
    const name = (window.myUsername || myUsername || '').trim();
    const namePart = name ? `, <span class="echo-landing-name">${window.escHtml(name)}</span>` : '';
    const GREETINGS = {
        morning: [
            'Good morning', 'Rise and shine', 'Morning', 'Hey, good morning', 'Top of the morning',
            'Well hello there', 'Good day to you', 'Bright and early', 'Wakey wakey',
            "Here's to a good morning", 'Morning, sunshine', "Hope you slept well",
        ],
        afternoon: [
            'Good afternoon', 'Afternoon', "Hope your day's going well", 'Hey there', 'Good day',
            'Halfway through the day', "Hope you're having a good one", 'Afternoon, friend',
            'Well hello', 'Good afternoon to you', 'Hey, good afternoon', 'Making good time today',
        ],
        evening: [
            'Good evening', 'Evening', 'Hope you had a good day', 'Winding down for the night',
            'Good evening to you', 'Hey there', 'Well hello', 'Evening has arrived',
            "Hope your evening's off to a good start", 'Good evening, friend', 'Hey, good evening',
            'Settling in for the evening',
        ],
        night: [
            'Burning the midnight oil', 'Still up', 'Good night... or good morning', 'Hey, night owl',
            'Working late', 'Up late', 'Hello, night owl', 'Quiet night, huh', 'Late night session',
            'Good to see you this late', 'Way past bedtime', 'The night is young',
        ],
    };
    const pool = GREETINGS[todBucket];
    const greeting = pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length)];
    const chips = [
        { ico: '✍️', label: 'Write an essay',   seed: 'Write an essay about ' },
        { ico: '📝', label: 'Help me write',     seed: 'Help me write ' },
        { ico: '📚', label: 'Explain a concept', seed: 'Explain ' },
        { ico: '❓', label: 'Answer a question', seed: 'Answer this question: ' },
        { ico: '📷', label: 'Scan a document',   action: 'scan' },
    ];
    const landing = document.createElement('div');
    landing.className = 'echo-landing';
    landing.innerHTML = `
        <div class="echo-landing-logo">✦</div>
        <div class="echo-landing-greeting">${greeting}${namePart}</div>
        <div class="echo-landing-sub">How can I help you today?</div>
        <div class="echo-landing-chips"></div>`;
    const chipWrap = landing.querySelector('.echo-landing-chips');
    chips.forEach(c => {
        const b = document.createElement('button');
        b.className = 'echo-landing-chip';
        b.innerHTML = `<span class="echo-landing-chip-ico">${c.ico}</span> ${window.escHtml(c.label)}`;
        b.onclick = () => {
            if (c.action === 'scan') {
                document.getElementById('btn-echoai-attach')?.click();
                return;
            }
            const input = document.getElementById('echoai-input');
            if (input) {
                input.value = c.seed;
                input.focus();
                const v = input.value; input.value = ''; input.value = v;
            }
        };
        chipWrap.appendChild(b);
    });
    win.appendChild(landing);
}

function createNewEchoChat() {
    currentEchoId = Date.now().toString();
    echoaiChats.push({ id: currentEchoId, title: "New Chat", messages: [getFastSystemPrompt()] });
    saveEchoChats();
    loadEchoChat(currentEchoId);
}

function renderEchoSidebar() {
    const list = document.getElementById('echoai-history');
    list.innerHTML = '';
    echoaiChats.forEach(chat => {
        const li = document.createElement('li');
        li.className = `flex justify-between items-center p-2 rounded-lg cursor-pointer transition text-xs ${chat.id === currentEchoId ? 'bg-[#1e1e2e] text-white font-bold' : 'text-[#888899] hover:bg-[#14141f] hover:text-white'}`;
        li.innerHTML = `<span class="truncate pr-2">${window.escHtml(chat.title)}</span>`;
        li.onclick = () => loadEchoChat(chat.id);
        const delBtn = document.createElement('button');
        delBtn.className = 'text-[#555566] hover:text-red-400 text-xs px-1';
        delBtn.innerText = 'X';
        delBtn.onclick = (e) => {
            e.stopPropagation();
            echoaiChats = echoaiChats.filter(c => c.id !== chat.id);
            saveEchoChats();
            try { window._sbForgetChat && window._sbForgetChat(chat.id); } catch (_) {}
            if (currentEchoId === chat.id) {
                echoaiChats.length ? loadEchoChat(echoaiChats[0].id) : createNewEchoChat();
            } else {
                renderEchoSidebar();
            }
        };
        li.appendChild(delBtn);
        list.appendChild(li);
    });
}

document.getElementById('btn-echoai-new').onclick = createNewEchoChat;
if (!echoaiChats.length) createNewEchoChat(); else loadEchoChat(echoaiChats[0].id);

window._echoaiReloadForUser = function (uid) {
    echoaiChats = _echoaiLoad(uid);
    echoaiChats.forEach(c => (c.messages || []).forEach(m => { if (m.role === 'ai') m.role = 'assistant'; }));
    currentEchoId = null;
    if (!echoaiChats.length) createNewEchoChat(); else loadEchoChat(echoaiChats[0].id);
    try { if (window._sbRestoreChats) window._sbRestoreChats(); } catch (_) {}
};
