let _echoTtsPlayCtx = null;
function _getEchoTtsPlayCtx() {
    if (!_echoTtsPlayCtx) {
        const AudioCtx = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
        _echoTtsPlayCtx = new AudioCtx();
    }
    return _echoTtsPlayCtx;
}
let _echoTtsSource = null;

async function speakEchoText(text) {
    if (_echoTtsSource) { try { _echoTtsSource.stop(); } catch (e) {} _echoTtsSource = null; }
    if (!text || !text.trim()) return;
    setEchoFlameState('connecting');
    try {
        const voiceName = window.getEchoTtsVoice();
        const res = await fetch(
            `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/${ECHO_TTS_MODEL}:generateContent?key=${window.GEMINI_API_KEY}`,
            {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({
                    contents: [{ role: 'user', parts: [{ text }] }],
                    generationConfig: {
                        responseModalities: ['AUDIO'],
                        speechConfig: { voiceConfig: { prebuiltVoiceConfig: { voiceName } } }
                    }
                })
            }
        );
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`TTS request failed (${res.status})`);
        const data = await res.json();
        const part = data?.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts?.[0]?.inlineData;
        if (!part?.data) throw new Error('No audio returned');

        const rateMatch = /rate=(\d+)/.exec(part.mimeType || '');
        const rate = rateMatch ? parseInt(rateMatch[1], 10) : 24000;
        const pcm16 = _base64ToInt16(part.data);
        const float32 = new Float32Array(pcm16.length);
        for (let i = 0; i < pcm16.length; i++) float32[i] = pcm16[i] / 0x8000;

        const ctx = _getEchoTtsPlayCtx();
        const buffer = ctx.createBuffer(1, float32.length, rate);
        buffer.copyToChannel(float32, 0);

        const source = ctx.createBufferSource();
        source.buffer = buffer;
        source.connect(ctx.destination);
        _echoTtsSource = source;

        setEchoFlameState('speaking');
        source.onended = () => {
            if (_echoTtsSource === source) _echoTtsSource = null;
            setEchoFlameState('idle');
        };
        source.start();
    } catch (err) {
        console.error('[EchoAI TTS] failed:', err);
        setEchoFlameState('idle');
    }
}

function setEchoFlameState(state) {
    const flame = document.getElementById('echoai-flame');
    if (flame) {
        flame.className = 'echo-flame';
        if (state !== 'idle') flame.classList.add(state);
    }
    const floatFlame = document.getElementById('echo-live-float-flame');
    if (floatFlame) {
        floatFlame.className = 'echo-flame';
        if (state !== 'idle') floatFlame.classList.add(state);
    }
    const statusEl = document.getElementById('echoai-live-status');
    if (statusEl) {
        const labels = { idle: 'IDLE', listening: 'LISTENING...', speaking: 'SPEAKING...', connecting: 'CONNECTING...' };
        statusEl.innerText = labels[state] || 'IDLE';
    }
}

function showSttBar(text) {
    document.getElementById('stt-status-text').innerText = text;
    document.getElementById('stt-status-bar').classList.add('visible');
}
function hideSttBar() {
    document.getElementById('stt-status-bar').classList.remove('visible');
}
function setSttError(msg) {
    const input = document.getElementById('echoai-input');
    input.placeholder = msg;
    setTimeout(() => { input.placeholder = 'Message Echo...'; }, 5000);
    hideSttBar();
}

window.stopSttNow = function() {
    sttActive = false;
    if (sttRecognition) {
        try { sttRecognition.abort(); } catch(e) {}
        sttRecognition = null;
    }
    document.getElementById('btn-echoai-mic').classList.remove('recording');
    hideSttBar();
};

function doSingleShotSTT() {
    if (sttActive) { stopSttNow(); return; }
    const SR = getSpeechRecognitionClass();
    if (!SR) { setSttError('Speech recognition not supported. Use Chrome or Edge.'); return; }

    sttActive = true;
    document.getElementById('btn-echoai-mic').classList.add('recording');
    showSttBar('Listening -- speak now...');

    const rec = new SR();
    sttRecognition = rec;
    rec.lang = _sttLang();
    rec.continuous = false;
    rec.interimResults = true;
    rec.maxAlternatives = 1;
    let finalTranscript = '';

    rec.onstart = () => { showSttBar('Listening -- speak now...'); };
    rec.onresult = (e) => {
        let interim = '';
        finalTranscript = '';
        for (let i = 0; i < e.results.length; i++) {
            if (e.results[i].isFinal) finalTranscript += e.results[i][0].transcript;
            else interim += e.results[i][0].transcript;
        }
        const display = (finalTranscript + ' ' + interim).trim();
        if (display) showSttBar(display);
    };
    rec.onend = () => {
        stopSttNow();
        if (finalTranscript.trim()) {
            document.getElementById('echoai-input').value = finalTranscript.trim();
            handleEchoSend();
        }
    };
    rec.onerror = (e) => {
        stopSttNow();
        if (e.error === 'not-allowed' || e.error === 'permission-denied') setSttError('Mic blocked. Allow microphone access in your browser.');
        else if (e.error === 'no-speech') setSttError('No speech detected. Try again.');
        else if (e.error === 'network') setSttError('Network error. Check your connection.');
        else setSttError('Mic error: ' + e.error + '. Try Chrome or Edge.');
    };
    try { rec.start(); } catch(e) { stopSttNow(); setSttError('Could not start microphone: ' + e.message); }
}

document.getElementById('btn-echoai-mic').onclick = () => {
    if (isEchoLive) return;
    doSingleShotSTT();
};

}

const ECHO_NAV_VIEWS = {
    friends: 'Search', requests: 'Alerts', 'create-group': 'Group Chats',
    music: 'Music', watch: 'Watch', listenparties: 'Parties', games: 'Games',
    settings: 'Settings', echoai: 'EchoAI', global: 'Global Chat', browser: 'Browser',
    adminpanel: 'Admin Panel'
};

function _resolveEchoNavView(view, customLabel) {
    if (view === 'adminpanel') {
        const role = window._myRole || 'member';
        if (role === 'owner') return { view: 'admin', label: 'Admin Panel' };
        const perms = window._myRolePerms || {};
        const hasPanelAccess = perms.canSeeOverview || perms.canSeeUsers || perms.canSeeInspector ||
            perms.canSeeBroadcast || perms.canSeeModeration || perms.canSeeSiteConfig;
        if (hasPanelAccess) {
            const meta = (window.ROLE_META && window.ROLE_META[role]) || { label: 'Mod' };
            return { view: 'subadmin', label: meta.label + ' Panel' };
        }
        return null;
    }
    if (!ECHO_NAV_VIEWS[view]) return null;
    return { view, label: customLabel || ECHO_NAV_VIEWS[view] };
}

window._makeElDraggable = _makeElDraggable;
function _makeElDraggable(el, handle) {
    if (!el || !handle || el._echoDragBound) return;
    el._echoDragBound = true;
    let sx = 0, sy = 0, startLeft = 0, startTop = 0, dragging = false;
    const begin = (clientX, clientY) => {
        dragging = true;
        const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
        el.style.left = r.left + 'px'; el.style.top = r.top + 'px';
        el.style.right = 'auto'; el.style.bottom = 'auto';
        sx = clientX; sy = clientY; startLeft = r.left; startTop = r.top;
    };
    const move = (clientX, clientY) => {
        if (!dragging) return;
        const dx = clientX - sx, dy = clientY - sy;
        const nl = Math.max(4, Math.min(window.innerWidth - 60, startLeft + dx));
        const nt = Math.max(4, Math.min(window.innerHeight - 60, startTop + dy));
        el.style.left = nl + 'px'; el.style.top = nt + 'px';
    };
    handle.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => { begin(e.clientX, e.clientY); e.preventDefault(); });
    window.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => move(e.clientX, e.clientY));
    window.addEventListener('mouseup', () => { dragging = false; });
    handle.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => { const t = e.touches[0]; begin(t.clientX, t.clientY); }, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener('touchmove', (e) => { const t = e.touches[0]; move(t.clientX, t.clientY); }, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener('touchend', () => { dragging = false; });
}

let _echoNavPopupState = null;

function _hideEchoNavPopup() {
    const popup = document.getElementById('echoai-nav-popup');
    if (popup) popup.classList.add('hidden');
    _echoNavPopupState = null;
}

function _hideEchoLiveFloat() {
    const floatEl = document.getElementById('echo-live-float');
    if (floatEl) floatEl.classList.add('hidden');
}

function _showEchoNavPopup(rawView, customLabel, opts) {
    opts = opts || {};
    const resolved = _resolveEchoNavView(rawView, customLabel);
    const popup = document.getElementById('echoai-nav-popup');
    const textEl = document.getElementById('echoai-nav-popup-text');
    const yesBtn = document.getElementById('echoai-nav-popup-yes');
    const noBtn = document.getElementById('echoai-nav-popup-no');
    if (!popup || !resolved) {
        if (opts.live) echoLiveSession?.sendToolResponse(opts.callId, opts.fcName, { result: 'error', reason: !resolved ? 'unavailable_or_unauthorized' : 'ui_unavailable' });
        return;
    }
    _makeElDraggable(popup, document.getElementById('echoai-nav-drag-handle'));
    [yesBtn, noBtn].forEach(b => {
        if (!b || b._echoDragStopBound) return;
        b._echoDragStopBound = true;
        b.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => e.stopPropagation());
        b.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => e.stopPropagation(), { passive: true });
    });
    textEl.innerText = `Want to open the ${resolved.label} tab?`;
    popup.classList.remove('hidden');
    popup.style.opacity = '1';
    _echoNavPopupState = { resolved, live: !!opts.live, callId: opts.callId, fcName: opts.fcName };

    yesBtn.onclick = () => {
        window.switchView(resolved.view);
        if (_echoNavPopupState?.live) {
            _shrinkNavPopupIntoLiveFloat();
            echoLiveSession?.sendToolResponse(opts.callId, opts.fcName, { result: 'accepted', view: resolved.view });
        } else {
            _hideEchoNavPopup();
        }
    };
    noBtn.onclick = () => {
        if (_echoNavPopupState?.live) {
            echoLiveSession?.sendToolResponse(opts.callId, opts.fcName, { result: 'declined_by_user' });
        }
        _hideEchoNavPopup();
    };
}

function _shrinkNavPopupIntoLiveFloat() {
    const popup = document.getElementById('echoai-nav-popup');
    const floatEl = document.getElementById('echo-live-float');
    if (!popup || !floatEl) return;
    const pRect = popup.getBoundingClientRect();

    floatEl.classList.remove('hidden');
    floatEl.style.transition = 'none';
    floatEl.style.left = 'auto'; floatEl.style.top = '16px';
    floatEl.style.right = '16px'; floatEl.style.bottom = 'auto';
    floatEl.style.width = '150px'; floatEl.style.height = '150px';
    floatEl.style.opacity = '1';
    const fRect = floatEl.getBoundingClientRect();

    floatEl.style.right = 'auto';
    floatEl.style.left = pRect.left + 'px';
    floatEl.style.top = pRect.top + 'px';
    floatEl.style.width = pRect.width + 'px';
    floatEl.style.height = pRect.height + 'px';
    floatEl.style.opacity = '0.7';
    popup.classList.add('hidden');
    _makeElDraggable(floatEl, document.getElementById('echo-live-float-drag-handle'));

    void floatEl.offsetWidth;
    floatEl.style.transition = 'left .38s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1), top .38s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1), width .38s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1), height .38s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1), opacity .3s ease';
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        floatEl.style.left = fRect.left + 'px';
        floatEl.style.top = fRect.top + 'px';
        floatEl.style.width = fRect.width + 'px';
        floatEl.style.height = fRect.height + 'px';
        floatEl.style.opacity = '1';
    });
}

function _showEchoLiveFloatDirect() {
    const floatEl = document.getElementById('echo-live-float');
    if (!floatEl || !floatEl.classList.contains('hidden')) return;
    floatEl.style.transition = 'none';
    floatEl.style.left = 'auto'; floatEl.style.right = '16px';
    floatEl.style.top = '16px'; floatEl.style.bottom = 'auto';
    floatEl.style.width = '150px'; floatEl.style.height = '150px';
    floatEl.style.opacity = '0';
    floatEl.classList.remove('hidden');
    _makeElDraggable(floatEl, document.getElementById('echo-live-float-drag-handle'));
    void floatEl.offsetWidth;
    floatEl.style.transition = 'opacity .25s ease';
    requestAnimationFrame(() => { floatEl.style.opacity = '1'; });
}

function _toggleEchoLiveMute() {
    if (!echoLiveSession) return;
    const nowMuted = !echoLiveSession.muted;
    echoLiveSession.setMuted(nowMuted);
    const bigBtn = document.getElementById('btn-echoai-live-mute');
    const floatBtn = document.getElementById('echo-live-float-mute');
    if (bigBtn) { bigBtn.innerHTML = nowMuted ? '<i class="fa-solid fa-volume-xmark"></i> MUTED' : '<i class="fa-solid fa-microphone"></i> MUTE'; bigBtn.classList.toggle('muted', nowMuted); }
    if (floatBtn) { floatBtn.innerHTML = nowMuted ? '<i class="fa-solid fa-volume-xmark"></i>' : '<i class="fa-solid fa-microphone"></i>'; floatBtn.classList.toggle('muted', nowMuted); }
}
document.getElementById('btn-echoai-live-mute').onclick = _toggleEchoLiveMute;
document.getElementById('echo-live-float-mute').onclick = _toggleEchoLiveMute;
document.getElementById('echo-live-float-end').onclick = () => {
    if (isEchoLive) document.getElementById('btn-echoai-live').click();
};

window._echoAIExtractNavigateBlock = function(text) {
    let m = text.match(/```echoai-navigate\s*([\s\S]*?)```/i);
    if (!m) {
        const allBlocks = [...text.matchAll(/```[a-zA-Z0-9_-]*\s*([\s\S]*?)```/g)];
        for (const b of allBlocks) {
            try {
                const probe = JSON.parse(b[1].trim());
                if (typeof probe?.view === 'string') { m = b; break; }
            } catch (e) {   }
        }
    }
    if (!m) return { text, navRequest: null };
    const stripped = text.replace(m[0], '').trim();
    try {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(m[1].trim());
        if (parsed?.view && _resolveEchoNavView(parsed.view, parsed.label)) {
            return { text: stripped, navRequest: { view: parsed.view, label: parsed.label || null } };
        }
    } catch (e) {   }
    return { text: stripped, navRequest: null };
};

window._echoAIExtractEndChatBlock = function(text) {
    let m = text.match(/```echoai-endchat\s*([\s\S]*?)```/i);
    if (!m) {
        const allBlocks = [...text.matchAll(/```[a-zA-Z0-9_-]*\s*([\s\S]*?)```/g)];
        for (const b of allBlocks) {
            try {
                const probe = JSON.parse(b[1].trim());
                if (probe?.end_chat === true || probe?.endChat === true) { m = b; break; }
            } catch (e) {   }
        }
    }
    if (!m) return { text, endRequest: null };
    const stripped = text.replace(m[0], '').trim();
    try {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(m[1].trim());
        const reason = String(parsed?.reason || '').trim().slice(0, 300);
        return { text: stripped, endRequest: { reason: reason || 'EchoAI ended this conversation.' } };
    } catch (e) {   }
    return { text: stripped, endRequest: null };
};

function _echoStripEmptyFences(s) {
    return String(s).replace(/```+[a-zA-Z0-9_-]*[ \t]*\r?\n?[ \t\r\n]*```+/g, '').trim();
}
window._echoStripEmptyFences = _echoStripEmptyFences;

window._echoAIExtractSuggestBlock = function(text) {
    let m = text.match(/```+\s*echoai-suggest\s*([\s\S]*?)```+/i);
    if (!m) m = text.match(/```+\s*echoai-suggest\s*([\s\S]*)$/i);
    if (!m) m = text.match(/`*\s*echoai-suggest\s*`*\s*:?\s*(\[[\s\S]*?\])\s*`*/i);
    if (!m) {
        const bare = text.match(/`*\s*echoai-suggest\s*`*:?[^\n]*/i);
        if (bare) return { text: text.replace(bare[0], '').trim(), suggestions: null };
        return { text, suggestions: null };
    }
    const stripped = _echoStripEmptyFences(text.replace(m[0], ''));
    try {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(m[1].trim().replace(/^`+|`+$/g, '').trim());
        const list = Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : (Array.isArray(parsed?.suggestions) ? parsed.suggestions : null);
        if (!list) return { text: stripped, suggestions: null };
        const clean = list
            .map(s => String(s == null ? '' : s).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim())
            .filter(Boolean)
            .filter((s, i, a) => a.indexOf(s) === i)
            .slice(0, 3)
            .map(s => s.slice(0, 60));
        return { text: stripped, suggestions: clean.length ? clean : null };
    } catch (e) {   }
    return { text: stripped, suggestions: null };
};

window._renderEchoSuggestions = function(list) {
    window._clearEchoSuggestions();
    const win = document.getElementById('echoai-chat-window');
    if (!win || !Array.isArray(list) || !list.length) return;

    const tray = document.createElement('div');
    tray.className = 'echo-suggest-tray';
    tray.id = 'echo-suggest-tray';

    list.forEach((s, i) => {
        const chip = document.createElement('button');
        chip.type = 'button';
        chip.className = 'echo-suggest-chip';
        chip.style.animationDelay = (i * 60) + 'ms';
        chip.innerText = s;
        chip.title = s;
        chip.onclick = () => {
            const input = document.getElementById('echoai-input');
            const send  = document.getElementById('btn-echoai-send');
            if (!input || !send) return;
            window._clearEchoSuggestions();
            input.value = s;
            send.click();
        };
        tray.appendChild(chip);
    });

    win.appendChild(tray);
    if (win.scrollHeight - win.scrollTop - win.clientHeight < 120) {
        win.scrollTop = win.scrollHeight;
    }
};

window._clearEchoSuggestions = function() {
    document.getElementById('echo-suggest-tray')?.remove();
};

window._applyEchoChatEndedState = function() {
    const inputEl = document.getElementById('echoai-input');
    const sendBtn = document.getElementById('btn-echoai-send');
    const chat = currentEchoId && echoaiChats.find(c => c.id === currentEchoId);
    const ended = !!chat?.ended;
    if (inputEl) {
        inputEl.disabled = ended;
        inputEl.placeholder = ended ? 'EchoAI ended this chat — start a new one' : 'Message Echo...';
        inputEl.style.opacity = ended ? '0.5' : '';
    }
    if (sendBtn) {
        sendBtn.disabled = ended;
        sendBtn.style.opacity = ended ? '0.4' : '';
        sendBtn.style.cursor = ended ? 'not-allowed' : '';
    }
};

function _showEchoLivePlayRequest(queries, callId, fcName) {
    const wrap = document.getElementById('echoai-live-play-request');
    const listEl = document.getElementById('echoai-live-play-request-list');
    const acceptBtn = document.getElementById('echoai-live-play-accept');
    const declineBtn = document.getElementById('echoai-live-play-decline');
    if (!wrap || !acceptBtn || !declineBtn) {
        echoLiveSession?.sendToolResponse(callId, fcName, { result: 'error', reason: 'UI unavailable' });
        return;
    }
    _makeElDraggable(wrap, document.getElementById('echoai-live-play-drag-handle'));
    [acceptBtn, declineBtn].forEach(b => {
        if (!b || b._echoDragStopBound) return;
        b._echoDragStopBound = true;
        b.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => e.stopPropagation());
        b.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => e.stopPropagation(), { passive: true });
    });
    if (listEl) listEl.innerHTML = queries.map(q => `<div>${window.escHtml(q)}</div>`).join('');
    acceptBtn.innerText = queries.length > 1 ? 'Accept All' : 'Accept';
    wrap.classList.remove('hidden');

    const cleanup = () => { wrap.classList.add('hidden'); };

    acceptBtn.onclick = async () => {
        acceptBtn.disabled = true;
        acceptBtn.innerText = 'Loading…';
        const results = await window._echoPlaySongRequests(queries);
        acceptBtn.disabled = false;
        acceptBtn.innerText = queries.length > 1 ? 'Accept All' : 'Accept';
        cleanup();
        echoLiveSession?.sendToolResponse(callId, fcName, {
            result: 'accepted_and_queued',
            queued: results.filter(r => r.ok).map(r => r.track.title),
            failed: results.filter(r => !r.ok).map(r => r.query)
        });
    };
    declineBtn.onclick = () => {
        cleanup();
        echoLiveSession?.sendToolResponse(callId, fcName, { result: 'declined_by_user' });
    };
}

let _echoLiveEnding = false;
function _endEchoLiveCall(reason) {
    if (_echoLiveEnding) return;
    _echoLiveEnding = true;
    const transcriptEl = document.getElementById('echoai-live-transcript');
    if (transcriptEl) transcriptEl.innerText = `⛔ ${reason}`;
    const chat = currentEchoId && echoaiChats.find(c => c.id === currentEchoId);
    if (chat) {
        const line = `⛔ EchoAI ended the call: ${reason}`;
        renderEchoMessage(line, 'assistant');
        chat.messages.push({ role: 'assistant', content: line });
        saveEchoChats();
    }
    setTimeout(() => {
        _echoLiveEnding = false;
        if (isEchoLive) document.getElementById('btn-echoai-live').click();
    }, 4000);
}

async function startEchoLiveSession() {
    if (window.GUEST_MODE) {
        window._guestWall('Live Mode needs an account',
            'Talking to EchoAI live is metered per account. Guests get one typed message instead.');
        return;
    }
    const _liveLimit = await window._echoUsageBlockedAsync?.();
    if (_liveLimit) { alert(_liveLimit); return; }
    const transcriptEl = document.getElementById('echoai-live-transcript');
    let liveUserLine = '', liveAiLine = '';

    const _liveChat = currentEchoId && echoaiChats.find(c => c.id === currentEchoId);
    const initialHistory = _liveChat
        ? _liveChat.messages
            .filter(m => m.role !== 'system' && m.content)
            .map(m => ({ role: m.role === 'assistant' ? 'model' : 'user', parts: [{ text: m.content }] }))
        : [];

    echoLiveSession = new GeminiLiveSession({
        systemInstruction: getFastSystemPrompt({ voice: true }).content,
        voiceName: window.getEchoLiveVoice(),
        initialHistory,
        tools: [{
            functionDeclarations: [{
                name: 'request_play_song',
                description: 'Request to queue/play one or more songs for the user during this live conversation (a single track or a whole playlist). This never plays anything directly — the app always shows the user an Accept/Decline button first, and only queues the tracks if they tap Accept. Only include songs you are confident about; ask a clarifying question out loud instead if ambiguous.',
                parameters: {
                    type: 'OBJECT',
                    properties: {
                        queries: {
                            type: 'ARRAY',
                            items: { type: 'STRING' },
                            description: 'One or more songs as "title artist", e.g. ["Bohemian Rhapsody Queen", "Stairway to Heaven Led Zeppelin"].'
                        }
                    },
                    required: ['queries']
                }
            }, {
                name: 'request_navigate_tab',
                description: 'Propose switching the user to a different tab in the app when it would help answer their question (e.g. they ask how to watch a video, or to see their music, or to check their group settings). This never switches the tab directly — it always shows the user an Accept/Decline popup first, and only navigates if they tap Accept. Use "adminpanel" as the view value whenever suggesting the admin/moderation panel — the app resolves that to whichever specific panel the user\'s role actually has (or declines silently if they have none), so never ask the user what role they are. Only suggest a tab when it is genuinely relevant; do not suggest one on every message.',
                parameters: {
                    type: 'OBJECT',
                    properties: {
                        view: {
                            type: 'STRING',
                            description: 'One of: friends, requests, create-group, music, watch, listenparties, games, settings, echoai, global, browser, adminpanel. IMPORTANT: "watch" is the solo YouTube video player; "listenparties" is "Watch Parties"/"Listen Parties" — a shared room where people watch or listen together. Any mention of "watch party", "watch parties", "listen party", or "party" means listenparties, NOT watch.'
                        },
                        label: {
                            type: 'STRING',
                            description: 'Optional short human-friendly name for the tab, e.g. "Watch". Omit for adminpanel.'
                        }
                    },
                    required: ['view']
                }
            }, {
                name: 'end_call',
                description: 'End this live voice call yourself. Use it when the conversation is genuinely over (the user has said goodbye, or asked you to hang up) or when you should not keep talking — for example the user is being abusive or harassing, or keeps pushing for something you have already declined. This is a last resort for the latter case, not an escape from a hard question: try answering or setting a boundary out loud first. Always say a short spoken goodbye in the same turn as this call, then the app plays your goodbye and hangs up a few seconds later. Never end a call without saying anything.',
                parameters: {
                    type: 'OBJECT',
                    properties: {
                        reason: {
                            type: 'STRING',
                            description: 'One short plain-English sentence explaining why the call is ending. The user sees this on screen, so be honest and non-judgmental, e.g. "You said goodbye, so I am hanging up." or "This call stopped being respectful, so I am ending it."'
                        }
                    },
                    required: ['reason']
                }
            }, {
                name: 'update_memory',
                description: 'Save or update your long-term memory about this user (response-style preferences and durable facts). It persists across every conversation and device. Use it when they tell you how they want you to respond, share something durable worth remembering, ask you to forget something, or when you are doing first-run setup because you have no memory yet. Do not call it on most turns — only when something genuinely changed, and never for one-off requests or secrets.',
                parameters: {
                    type: 'OBJECT',
                    properties: {
                        prefs: { type: 'STRING', description: 'Replacement description of how they want responses written. REPLACES the previous description, so fold any tweak into the full description rather than dropping the rest.' },
                        addFacts: { type: 'ARRAY', items: { type: 'STRING' }, description: 'Durable facts about them worth remembering.' },
                        removeFacts: { type: 'ARRAY', items: { type: 'STRING' }, description: 'Previously remembered facts to drop.' },
                        conduct: { type: 'STRING', description: 'Replacement short note on how this user treats you across conversations. Write it when notable in either direction — abusive/harassing, or decent/improved. Accurate, not punitive; it lets you recognise a pattern rather than starting fresh each call.' },
                        forget: { type: 'BOOLEAN', description: 'Set true only if they explicitly ask you to forget everything.' }
                    }
                }
            }]
        }],
        onToolCall: (fc) => {
            if (fc.name === 'request_play_song') {
                const queries = Array.isArray(fc.args?.queries) ? fc.args.queries.map(q => String(q).slice(0, 200)).slice(0, 25) : [];
                if (queries.length) {
                    _showEchoLivePlayRequest(queries, fc.id, fc.name);
                } else {
                    echoLiveSession?.sendToolResponse(fc.id, fc.name, { result: 'error', reason: 'no_queries' });
                }
            } else if (fc.name === 'request_navigate_tab') {
                const view = String(fc.args?.view || '').trim();
                const label = fc.args?.label ? String(fc.args.label).slice(0, 60) : null;
                _showEchoNavPopup(view, label, { live: true, callId: fc.id, fcName: fc.name });
            } else if (fc.name === 'update_memory') {
                window._echoSaveMemory(fc.args || {})
                    .then(() => echoLiveSession?.sendToolResponse(fc.id, fc.name, { result: 'ok' }))
                    .catch(err => echoLiveSession?.sendToolResponse(fc.id, fc.name, { result: 'error', reason: String(err?.message || err) }));
            } else if (fc.name === 'end_call') {
                const reason = String(fc.args?.reason || '').trim().slice(0, 300) || 'EchoAI ended the call.';
                echoLiveSession?.sendToolResponse(fc.id, fc.name, { result: 'ok' });
                _endEchoLiveCall(reason);
            } else {
                echoLiveSession?.sendToolResponse(fc.id, fc.name, { result: 'error', reason: 'unsupported tool' });
            }
        },
        onState: (state) => setEchoFlameState(state === 'connecting' ? 'connecting' : state),
        onInputTranscript: (text, isFinal) => {
            liveUserLine = text;
            if (transcriptEl) transcriptEl.innerText = text;
            if (isFinal) {
                renderEchoMessage(text, 'user');
                currentEchoId && echoaiChats.find(c => c.id === currentEchoId)?.messages.push({ role: 'user', content: text });
                saveEchoChats();
                liveUserLine = '';
            }
        },
        onOutputTranscript: (text, isFinal) => {
            liveAiLine = text;
            if (transcriptEl) transcriptEl.innerHTML = window.EchoMath ? window.EchoMath.toHtml(text, !isFinal) : window.escHtml(text);
            if (isFinal) {
                renderEchoMessage(text, 'assistant');
                currentEchoId && echoaiChats.find(c => c.id === currentEchoId)?.messages.push({ role: 'assistant', content: text });
                saveEchoChats();
                liveAiLine = '';
                if (transcriptEl) transcriptEl.innerText = '';
            }
        },
        onError: (err) => {
            console.error('[EchoAI Live] session error:', err);
        },
        onClose: () => {
            if (isEchoLive) document.getElementById('btn-echoai-live').click();
        }
    });

    try {
        await echoLiveSession.connect();
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('[EchoAI Live] failed to connect:', e);
        alert('Could not start Live Mode: ' + (e.message || e) + '. Check mic permissions and your connection.');
        isEchoLive = false;
        document.getElementById('btn-echoai-live').classList.add('inactive');
        document.getElementById('echoai-live-overlay').classList.remove('active');
        setEchoFlameState('idle');
        echoLiveSession = null;
    }
}

document.getElementById('btn-echoai-live').onclick = () => {
    isEchoLive = !isEchoLive;
    const btn = document.getElementById('btn-echoai-live');
    const overlay = document.getElementById('echoai-live-overlay');
    const transcriptEl = document.getElementById('echoai-live-transcript');

    if (isEchoLive) {
        if (!window.myUID) {
            isEchoLive = false;
            alert('Please sign in to use Live Mode.');
            return;
        }
        if (!navigator.mediaDevices?.getUserMedia) {
            isEchoLive = false;
            alert('Microphone access is not supported in this browser.');
            return;
        }
        btn.classList.remove('inactive');
        overlay.classList.add('active');
        setEchoFlameState('connecting');
        if (transcriptEl) transcriptEl.innerText = '';
        startEchoLiveSession();
    } else {
        btn.classList.add('inactive');
        overlay.classList.remove('active');
        setEchoFlameState('idle');
        stopEchoLiveSession();
        if (transcriptEl) transcriptEl.innerText = '';
    }
};

document.getElementById('btn-echoai-live-exit').onclick = () => {
    document.getElementById('btn-echoai-live').click();
};

let screenAssistSession = null;

let _saCtrlCount = 0;
let _saCtrlResetTimer = null;

function _saForceFront(source) {
    if (!screenAssistPipWindow || screenAssistPipWindow.closed) {
        console.warn(`[ScreenAssist] _saForceFront(${source}): no window to focus`);
        return;
    }
    console.log(`[ScreenAssist] _saForceFront(${source}) firing, hostMode=${_saHostModeCurrent}`);
    try { screenAssistPipWindow.focus(); } catch (e) { console.warn('[ScreenAssist] .focus() threw:', e); }
    if (_saHostModeCurrent === 'popup') {
        try {
            window._allowNextOpen = true;
            window.open('', 'echospace-screen-assist');
            window._allowNextOpen = false;
        } catch (e) { console.warn('[ScreenAssist] re-open focus nudge threw:', e); }
    }
}

let _saRefocusHandler = null;
let _saRefocusTimer = null;
function _saArmRefocusLoop() {
    _saDisarmRefocusLoop();
    _saRefocusHandler = () => {
        clearTimeout(_saRefocusTimer);
        _saRefocusTimer = setTimeout(() => _saForceFront('blur-loop'), 150);
    };
    window.addEventListener('blur', _saRefocusHandler);
}
function _saDisarmRefocusLoop() {
    if (_saRefocusHandler) window.removeEventListener('blur', _saRefocusHandler);
    _saRefocusHandler = null;
    clearTimeout(_saRefocusTimer);
    _saRefocusTimer = null;
}

let _saShiftCount = 0;
let _saShiftResetTimer = null;
let _saHostModeCurrent = null;

function _saHandleKeydown(e) {
    if (e.key === 'Shift' && !e.repeat) {
        _saShiftCount++;
        console.log('[ScreenAssist] Shift tap', _saShiftCount);
        clearTimeout(_saShiftResetTimer);
        _saShiftResetTimer = setTimeout(() => { _saShiftCount = 0; }, 500);
        if (_saShiftCount >= 2) {
            _saShiftCount = 0;
            _saForceFront('shift-x2');
        }
        return;
    }
    if (e.key !== 'Control' || e.repeat) return;
    _saCtrlCount++;
    clearTimeout(_saCtrlResetTimer);
    _saCtrlResetTimer = setTimeout(() => { _saCtrlCount = 0; }, 800);
    if (_saCtrlCount >= 3) {
        _saCtrlCount = 0;
        closeScreenAssist();
    }
}

function _saAttachShortcutListener() {
    document.addEventListener('keydown', _saHandleKeydown, true);
    if (screenAssistPipWindow) {
        screenAssistPipWindow.document.addEventListener('keydown', _saHandleKeydown, true);
    }
}

function _saDetachShortcutListener() {
    document.removeEventListener('keydown', _saHandleKeydown, true);
    if (screenAssistPipWindow) {
        try { screenAssistPipWindow.document.removeEventListener('keydown', _saHandleKeydown, true); } catch (e) {}
    }
    _saCtrlCount = 0;
    clearTimeout(_saCtrlResetTimer);
    _saShiftCount = 0;
    clearTimeout(_saShiftResetTimer);
}

let _saStickNext = false;

const SA_SYSTEM_PROMPT = `You are Screen Assist, a fast, no-frills reader of whatever is on the user's shared screen. Default mode is ANSWER-ONLY: give the single shortest possible correct answer with zero setup, zero restating the question, and zero explanation — a number, a word, a short phrase, or a one-line answer. Example: if the screen or the question shows a math problem, reply with just the final result (e.g. '42' or 'x = 7'), nothing else. Only switch to a longer, explanatory, step-by-step answer when the user explicitly asks for that in their message (phrases like 'explain', 'how do I solve it', 'walk me through it', 'why', 'show your work'). If they don't ask for an explanation, never volunteer one, even for something that seems complex. For multiple choice, give the letter and the answer. Write any math beyond a plain number in LaTeX between single dollar signs so the app can typeset it, for example $\\frac{5}{6}$, $x^{7}$, $6\\sqrt{2}$ or $x = 8$. Never use \\( \\) delimiters. Write money normally, like $20, with no closing dollar sign.`;

function _saDoc() {
    return screenAssistPipWindow && !screenAssistPipWindow.closed ? screenAssistPipWindow.document : null;
}

function _saHexA(hex, a) {
    let h = String(hex || '').trim().replace('#', '');
    if (h.length === 3) h = h.split('').map(c => c + c).join('');
    const n = /^[0-9a-f]{6}/i.test(h) ? parseInt(h.slice(0, 6), 16) : NaN;
    if (isNaN(n)) return `rgba(129,140,248,${a})`;
    return `rgba(${(n >> 16) & 255},${(n >> 8) & 255},${n & 255},${a})`;
}

function _saPalette() {
    const t = window._echoThemePayload || {};
    return {
        light: t.mode === 'light',
        bg: t.bg || '#08080f', panel: t.panel || '#14141f', border: t.border || '#1e1e2e',
        text: t.text || '#e8e8f0', muted: t.muted || '#8888aa',
        a1: t.accent1 || '#4f46e5', a2: t.accent2 || t.accent1 || '#818cf8', a3: t.accent3 || t.accent2 || '#818cf8',
    };
}

function _saBusy() {
    const last = _saTranscript[_saTranscript.length - 1];
    return !!(last && last.role === 'assistant' && !last.done);
}

function _saSetStatus(kind, text) {
    const doc = _saDoc();
    const el = doc && doc.getElementById('sa-status');
    if (!el) return;
    el.dataset.kind = kind;
    const t = doc.getElementById('sa-status-text');
    if (t) t.textContent = text;
}

function _saStatusIdle() {
    if (_saVideoMode === 'continuous') _saSetStatus('live', 'Watching your screen');
    else _saSetStatus('ready', 'Ready');
}

function _saSetMode(mode) {
    _saVideoMode = mode === 'continuous' ? 'continuous' : 'onDemand';
    screenAssistSession?.setVideoMode(_saVideoMode);
    const doc = _saDoc();
    if (!doc) return;
    const seg = doc.getElementById('sa-mode');
    if (seg) seg.dataset.mode = _saVideoMode;
    doc.querySelectorAll('.sa-seg').forEach(b => b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(b.dataset.mode === _saVideoMode)));
    const hint = doc.getElementById('sa-mode-hint');
    if (hint) hint.textContent = _saVideoMode === 'continuous'
        ? 'Sees your screen the whole time. Flip through questions, then ask for all the answers.'
        : 'Reads your screen the moment you ask.';
    if (!_saBusy()) _saStatusIdle();
}

function _saPlainText(text) {
    const E = window.EchoMath;
    let s = String(text || '');
    if (E) {
        const ex = E.extract(s);
        s = ex.text.replace(/⁣EM(\d+)⁣/g, (_, i) => E.plain(ex.items[i] ? ex.items[i].tex : ''));
    }
    return s.replace(/\\\$/g, '$').replace(/\*\*(.+?)\*\*/g, '$1').replace(/^#+\s*/gm, '').trim();
}

async function _saCopy(entry, btn) {
    const text = _saPlainText(entry.text);
    let ok = false;
    try {
        const clip = (screenAssistPipWindow && screenAssistPipWindow.navigator && screenAssistPipWindow.navigator.clipboard) || navigator.clipboard;
        await clip.writeText(text);
        ok = true;
    } catch (e) {}
    if (!ok) {
        try {
            const d = btn.ownerDocument;
            const ta = d.createElement('textarea');
            ta.value = text;
            ta.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;left:-9999px;opacity:0;';
            d.body.appendChild(ta);
            ta.select();
            ok = d.execCommand('copy');
            ta.remove();
        } catch (e) {}
    }
    const label = btn.querySelector('span');
    if (label) label.textContent = ok ? 'Copied' : 'Copy failed';
    btn.classList.toggle('sa-done', ok);
    setTimeout(() => { if (label) label.textContent = 'Copy'; btn.classList.remove('sa-done'); }, 1400);
}

function _saNote(text) {
    _saTranscript.push({ role: 'note', text });
    _saStickNext = true;
    _saRenderAnswer();
}

function _saAskImage(images, text, display) {
    if (!screenAssistSession) return;
    const q = String(text || '').trim() || 'Answer the question in this image.';
    screenAssistSession.askWithImages(q, images);
    const shownImg = (images && images[0] && images[0].data) || null;
    _saTranscript.forEach(e => { if (e.role === 'assistant') e.done = true; });
    _saTranscript.push({ role: 'user', text: display || q, img: shownImg });
    _saTranscript.push({ role: 'assistant', text: '', done: false });
    _saStickNext = true;
    _saSetStatus('busy', 'Reading the photo…');
    _saRenderAnswer();
    _saMarkAsked();
    _saArmWatchdog(0);
}

function _saAsk(text, display) {
    const q = String(text || '').trim();
    if (!q || !screenAssistSession) return;
    const img = screenAssistSession.askAboutScreen(q);
    _saTranscript.forEach(e => { if (e.role === 'assistant') e.done = true; });
    _saTranscript.push({ role: 'user', text: display || q, img });
    _saTranscript.push({ role: 'assistant', text: '', done: false });
    _saStickNext = true;
    _saSetStatus('busy', 'Reading your screen…');
    _saRenderAnswer();
    _saMarkAsked();
    _saArmWatchdog(0);
}

let _saWatchTimer = null;
let _saSlowTimer = null;
function _saShowSlow(on) {
    const doc = _saDoc(); if (!doc) return;
    const pill = doc.getElementById('sa-slow'); if (pill) pill.hidden = !on;
    const btn = doc.getElementById('sa-reconnect'); if (btn) btn.classList.toggle('warn', !!on);
}
function _saMarkAsked() {
    clearTimeout(_saSlowTimer);
    _saShowSlow(false);
    _saSlowTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        const last = _saTranscript[_saTranscript.length - 1];
        if (last && last.role === 'assistant' && !last.done && !last.text) _saShowSlow(true);
    }, 6000);
}
function _saAnswerStarted() { clearTimeout(_saSlowTimer); _saShowSlow(false); }
function _saArmWatchdog(attempt) {
    clearTimeout(_saWatchTimer);
    _saWatchTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        const last = _saTranscript[_saTranscript.length - 1];
        if (!last || last.role !== 'assistant' || last.done || last.text) return;
        if (!attempt && screenAssistSession && !screenAssistSession.closed) {
            screenAssistSession._resume('no answer after 20s');
            _saArmWatchdog(1);
            return;
        }
        last.done = true;
        _saRenderAnswer();
        _saStatusIdle();
    }, 20000);
}

function _saOpenLightbox(b64) {
    const doc = _saDoc();
    const lb = doc && doc.getElementById('sa-lightbox');
    if (!lb || !b64) return;
    lb.querySelector('img').src = 'data:image/jpeg;base64,' + b64;
    lb.hidden = false;
}

function _saBuildRow(doc, entry) {
    const row = doc.createElement('div');
    row.className = 'sa-row sa-' + entry.role;
    row.dataset.role = entry.role;
    if (entry.role === 'user') {
        const bubble = doc.createElement('div');
        bubble.className = 'sa-user-bubble';
        bubble.textContent = entry.text;
        row.appendChild(bubble);
        if (entry.img) {
            const shot = doc.createElement('button');
            shot.type = 'button';
            shot.className = 'sa-shot';
            shot.title = 'The screen EchoAI read for this';
            const im = doc.createElement('img');
            im.alt = 'Screenshot';
            im.src = 'data:image/jpeg;base64,' + entry.img;
            shot.appendChild(im);
            shot.onclick = () => _saOpenLightbox(entry.img);
            row.appendChild(shot);
        }
    } else if (entry.role === 'assistant') {
        row.innerHTML = `<div class="sa-ai-avatar">${SA_ICONS.orb}</div>`
            + `<div class="sa-ai-card"><div class="sa-ai-body"></div>`
            + `<div class="sa-actions">`
            + `<button type="button" class="sa-act" data-act="copy">${SA_ICONS.copy}<span>Copy</span></button>`
            + `<button type="button" class="sa-act" data-act="explain">${SA_ICONS.spark}<span>Explain it</span></button>`
            + `</div></div>`;
        row.querySelector('[data-act="copy"]').onclick = (e) => _saCopy(entry, e.currentTarget);
        row.querySelector('[data-act="explain"]').onclick = () => _saAsk('Explain that last answer step by step.', 'Explain it step by step');
    } else {
        const pill = doc.createElement('div');
        pill.className = 'sa-note-pill';
        pill.textContent = entry.text;
        row.appendChild(pill);
    }
    return row;
}

function _saRenderAnswer() {
    const doc = _saDoc();
    const thread = doc && doc.getElementById('sa-thread');
    if (!thread) return;
    const empty = doc.getElementById('sa-empty');
    if (empty) empty.hidden = _saTranscript.length > 0;
    const nearBottom = thread.scrollHeight - thread.scrollTop - thread.clientHeight < 80;

    let rows = [...thread.querySelectorAll('.sa-row')];
    const firstBad = rows.findIndex((r, i) => !_saTranscript[i] || r.dataset.role !== _saTranscript[i].role);
    if (firstBad !== -1) { rows.slice(firstBad).forEach(r => r.remove()); rows = rows.slice(0, firstBad); }
    for (let i = rows.length; i < _saTranscript.length; i++) {
        const row = _saBuildRow(doc, _saTranscript[i]);
        thread.appendChild(row);
        rows.push(row);
    }
    _saTranscript.forEach((entry, i) => {
        if (entry.role !== 'assistant') return;
        const row = rows[i];
        const key = (entry.done ? '1' : '0') + entry.text;
        if (row._saKey === key) return;
        row._saKey = key;
        const body = row.querySelector('.sa-ai-body');
        if (!entry.text) {
            body.innerHTML = entry.done
                ? '<span class="sa-muted">No answer came back. Try asking again.</span>'
                : '<span class="sa-typing"><i></i><i></i><i></i></span>';
        } else {
            body.innerHTML = window.mdSafe ? window.mdSafe(entry.text, !entry.done) : window.escHtml(entry.text);
        }
        row.classList.toggle('sa-pending', !entry.done);
    });
    if (nearBottom || _saStickNext) {
        thread.scrollTop = thread.scrollHeight;
        _saStickNext = false;
    }
}

async function _saOpenDocumentPiP() {
    if (!window.documentPictureInPicture) return null;
    try {
        if (window.documentPictureInPicture.window && !window.documentPictureInPicture.window.closed) {
            console.warn('[ScreenAssist] closing a pre-existing Document PiP window before requesting a new one.');
            window.documentPictureInPicture.window.close();
        }
    } catch (e) {}
    try { window.focus(); } catch (e) {}
    let win;
    try {
        win = await window.documentPictureInPicture.requestWindow({ width: 380, height: 560 });
    } catch (e) {
        console.warn('[ScreenAssist] Document PiP request failed:', e);
        return null;
    }
    const _t0 = performance.now();
    const _logHide = (label) => console.warn(`[ScreenAssist][PiP-diag] ${label} @ +${(performance.now() - _t0).toFixed(0)}ms — win.closed=${win.closed}, doc.hidden=${document.hidden}, doc.visibilityState=${document.visibilityState}`);
    win.addEventListener('pagehide', () => _logHide('pipWin pagehide'));
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => _logHide('mainDoc visibilitychange'), { once: true });
    window.addEventListener('blur', () => _logHide('mainWindow blur'), { once: true });

    await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 350));
    if (win.closed) {
        console.warn('[ScreenAssist] Document PiP window closed itself right after creation.');
        return null;
    }
    return win;
}

function _saOpenPopupWindow() {
    window._allowNextOpen = true;
    let win = null;
    try {
        win = window.open('about:blank', 'echospace-screen-assist', 'width=380,height=560,popup=1');
    } catch (e) { win = null; }
    window._allowNextOpen = false;
    if (!win || win.closed) return null;
    return win;
}

function _saOpenInPageOverlay() {
    const root = document.createElement('div');
    root.id = 'sa-inline-overlay';
    root.style.cssText = 'position:fixed; bottom:16px; right:16px; width:380px; height:560px; max-width:calc(100vw - 32px); max-height:calc(100vh - 32px); z-index:99999; border-radius:22px; overflow:hidden; box-shadow:0 16px 48px rgba(0,0,0,0.55);';
    document.body.appendChild(root);
    const host = {
        closed: false,
        document: {
            readyState: 'complete',
            createElement: (tag) => document.createElement(tag),
            getElementById: (id) => root.querySelector('#' + id),
            querySelectorAll: (sel) => root.querySelectorAll(sel),
            addEventListener: () => {}, removeEventListener: () => {},
            head: root, body: root,
        },
        addEventListener: () => {},
        close: () => { host.closed = true; root.remove(); },
    };
    Object.defineProperty(host.document, 'title', { get: () => '', set: () => {} });
    return host;
}

async function _saAcquireHostWindow() {
    let win = await _saOpenDocumentPiP();
    if (win) return { win, mode: 'pip' };
    await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200));
    win = await _saOpenDocumentPiP();
    if (win) return { win, mode: 'pip-retry' };
    return { win: _saOpenInPageOverlay(), mode: 'overlay' };
}

async function openScreenAssist() {
    if (!window.myUID) {
        alert('Please sign in to use Screen Assist.');
        return;
    }
    if (window.GUEST_MODE) {
        window._guestWall('Screen Assist needs an account',
            'Sharing your screen with EchoAI is metered per account. Guests get one typed message instead.');
        return;
    }
    const _saLimit = await window._echoUsageBlockedAsync?.();
    if (_saLimit) { alert(_saLimit); return; }
    if (!navigator.mediaDevices?.getDisplayMedia) {
        alert('Screen sharing is not supported in this browser.');
        return;
    }

    let _saEarlyPopup = _saOpenPopupWindow();

    try {
        screenAssistStream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getDisplayMedia({ video: { cursor: 'always' }, audio: false });
    } catch (e) {
        if (_saEarlyPopup) { try { _saEarlyPopup.close(); } catch (err) {} }
        return;
    }

    let pipWin, _saHostMode;
    if (_saEarlyPopup && !_saEarlyPopup.closed) {
        pipWin = _saEarlyPopup;
        _saHostMode = 'popup';
    } else {
        const res = await _saAcquireHostWindow();
        pipWin = res.win;
        _saHostMode = res.mode;
    }
    console.log('[ScreenAssist] using host mode:', _saHostMode);
    screenAssistPipWindow = pipWin;
    _saHostModeCurrent = _saHostMode;
    if (_saHostMode === 'popup' || _saHostMode === 'pip' || _saHostMode === 'pip-retry') {
        _saArmRefocusLoop();

    _saViewIdx = 0;
    _saVideoMode = 'onDemand';

            </div>
            <button id="sa-reconnect" class="sa-icon-btn sa-recon-btn" type="button" title="Reconnect for a speed boost">${SA_ICONS.bolt}</button>

                    <button type="button" class="sa-chip" data-q="What's the answer?">What's the answer?</button>
                    <button type="button" class="sa-chip" data-q="Solve this step by step.">Solve step by step</button>
                    <button type="button" class="sa-chip" data-q="Explain what's on my screen in simple words.">Explain this</button>
                    <button type="button" class="sa-chip" data-q="Summarize what's on my screen.">Summarize</button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
        <button type="button" id="sa-slow" class="sa-slow" hidden>${SA_ICONS.bolt}<span>Answers slowing down? Tap to reconnect for speed</span></button>
        <form id="sa-form" class="sa-compose" autocomplete="off">
            <input id="sa-input" type="text" placeholder="Ask about your screen…" autocomplete="off" />
            <button id="sa-cam" class="sa-send" type="button" title="Take a photo of a question" style="background:transparent;color:var(--muted);border:1px solid var(--line);">${SA_ICONS.cam}</button>
            <button id="sa-send" class="sa-send" type="submit" title="Ask (Enter)">${SA_ICONS.send}</button>
        </form>
        <div class="sa-foot"><span><kbd>Shift</kbd> ×2 bring to front</span><span><kbd>Ctrl</kbd> ×3 close</span></div>
        <div id="sa-lightbox" class="sa-lightbox" hidden><img alt="The screenshot EchoAI read"></div>
    `;
    doc.body.appendChild(wrap);
    _saRenderAnswer();

    const inputEl = doc.getElementById('sa-input');
    doc.getElementById('sa-form').onsubmit = (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        const text = inputEl.value;
        if (!text.trim()) return;
        inputEl.value = '';
        _saAsk(text);
        inputEl.focus();
    };
    doc.getElementById('sa-cam').onclick = async () => {
        let shot = null;
        try { shot = await window.EchoSnap.capture(doc, pipWin); } catch (_) {}
        if (!shot) return;
        const q = (inputEl.value || '').trim();
        inputEl.value = '';
        _saAskImage([{ data: shot.b64, mime: shot.mime }], q, q || 'Photo of a question');
        inputEl.focus();
    };
    doc.querySelectorAll('.sa-chip').forEach(chip => {
        chip.onclick = () => { _saAsk(chip.dataset.q); inputEl.focus(); };
    });
    doc.querySelectorAll('.sa-seg').forEach(seg => {
        seg.onclick = () => _saSetMode(seg.dataset.mode);
    });
    const lightbox = doc.getElementById('sa-lightbox');
    lightbox.onclick = () => { lightbox.hidden = true; };
    doc.getElementById('sa-close').onclick = () => closeScreenAssist();
    doc.getElementById('sa-reconnect').onclick = () => _saHardReconnect();
    doc.getElementById('sa-slow').onclick = () => _saHardReconnect();
    inputEl.focus();

    const btn = document.getElementById('btn-echoai-screenassist');
    btn?.classList.remove('inactive');
    _saAttachShortcutListener();

    function _saMakeSession() { return new GeminiLiveSession({
        systemInstruction: SA_SYSTEM_PROMPT,
        enableMic: false,
        videoStream: screenAssistStream,
        videoStreamBorrowed: true,
        videoMode: _saVideoMode,
        autoResume: true,
        responseModalities: ['AUDIO'],
        playAudio: false,
        onOutputTranscript: (text, isFinal) => {
            let last = _saTranscript[_saTranscript.length - 1];
            if (!last || last.role !== 'assistant' || last.done) {
                last = { role: 'assistant', text: '', done: false };
                _saTranscript.push(last);
            }
            if (text && !last.text) _saAnswerStarted();
            last.text = text;
            if (isFinal) { last.done = true; _saStatusIdle(); }
            else _saSetStatus('busy', 'Answering…');
            _saRenderAnswer();
        },
        onTurnComplete: () => {
            const last = _saTranscript[_saTranscript.length - 1];
            if (last && last.role === 'assistant' && !last.done) { last.done = true; _saRenderAnswer(); }
            if (!_saBusy()) _saStatusIdle();
        },
        onError: (err) => {
            console.error('[ScreenAssist] session error:', err);
            _saNote('⚠️ ' + (err?.message || 'Connection error.'));
        },
        onResuming: () => _saSetStatus('busy', 'Reconnecting…'),
        onResumed: () => { if (_saBusy()) _saSetStatus('busy', 'Answering…'); else _saStatusIdle(); },
        onScreenShareEnded: () => closeScreenAssist(),
        onClose: () => {
            if (!screenAssistPipWindow) return;
            _saTranscript.forEach(e => { if (e.role === 'assistant') e.done = true; });
            _saNote('Screen Assist lost its connection. Close it and open it again.');
            _saSetStatus('warn', 'Disconnected');
        }
    }); }

    let _saReconnecting = false;
    async function _saHardReconnect() {
        if (_saReconnecting) return;
        _saReconnecting = true;
        _saShowSlow(false);
        _saSetStatus('busy', 'Reconnecting for speed…');
        try {
            if (screenAssistSession) { try { screenAssistSession.close(); } catch (_) {} }
            screenAssistSession = _saMakeSession();
            await screenAssistSession.connect();
            _saNote('🔄 Reconnected — answers should be fast again.');
            _saStatusIdle();
        } catch (e) {
            console.error('[ScreenAssist] hard reconnect failed:', e);
            _saNote('Reconnect failed. Try closing and reopening Screen Assist.');
            _saSetStatus('warn', 'Disconnected');
        } finally { _saReconnecting = false; }
    }
    window._saHardReconnect = _saHardReconnect;

    screenAssistSession = _saMakeSession();

    try {
        await screenAssistSession.connect();
        _saStatusIdle();
        screenAssistStream.getVideoTracks()[0]?.addEventListener('ended', () => closeScreenAssist());
        pipWin.addEventListener('pagehide', () => closeScreenAssist());
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('[ScreenAssist] failed to connect:', e);
        alert('Could not start Screen Assist: ' + (e.message || e));
        closeScreenAssist();
    }
}

function closeScreenAssist() {
    _saDetachShortcutListener();
    _saDisarmRefocusLoop();
    if (screenAssistSession) { try { screenAssistSession.close(); } catch (e) {} screenAssistSession = null; }
    if (screenAssistStream) { screenAssistStream.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop()); screenAssistStream = null; }
    if (screenAssistPipWindow) { try { screenAssistPipWindow.close(); } catch (e) {} screenAssistPipWindow = null; }
    _saHostModeCurrent = null;
    _saTranscript = [];
    _saAtLatest = true;
    _saViewIdx = 0;
    _saVideoMode = 'onDemand';
    document.getElementById('btn-echoai-screenassist')?.classList.add('inactive');
}

document.getElementById('btn-echoai-screenassist').onclick = () => {
    if (screenAssistPipWindow) {
        closeScreenAssist();
    } else {
        openScreenAssist();
    }
};
