document.getElementById('btn-echoai-camera').onclick = async () => {
    if (window.GUEST_MODE) {
        window._guestWall && window._guestWall('Camera needs an account', 'Taking a photo for EchoAI is metered per account. Guests get one typed message instead.');
        return;
    }
    if (window._echoAttachments.length >= ECHO_MAX_ATTACH) {
        setSttError(`You can attach up to ${ECHO_MAX_ATTACH} images at once.`);
        return;
    }
    window.EchoVision?.warm?.();
    let shot = null;
    try { shot = await window.EchoSnap.capture(document, window); }
    catch (e) { setSttError('Could not open the camera.'); return; }
    if (!shot) return;
    const thumb = await _echoShrinkThumb(shot.dataUrl, 420, 0.72);
    window._echoAttachments.push({ b64: shot.b64, mime: shot.mime, thumb });
    _renderAttachTray();
    document.getElementById('echoai-input')?.focus();
};

async function _echoShrinkThumb(dataUrl, max = 240, quality = 0.6) {
    try {
        const img = await new Promise((res, rej) => {
            const i = new Image();
            i.onload = () => res(i);
            i.onerror = rej;
            i.src = dataUrl;
        });
        const scale = Math.min(1, max / Math.max(img.width, img.height));
        const c = document.createElement('canvas');
        c.width  = Math.max(1, Math.round(img.width  * scale));
        c.height = Math.max(1, Math.round(img.height * scale));
        c.getContext('2d').drawImage(img, 0, 0, c.width, c.height);
        return c.toDataURL('image/jpeg', quality);
    } catch (_) {
        return dataUrl;
    }
}

async function _echoMakeThumb(file, max = 420, quality = 0.72) {
    try {
        const url = URL.createObjectURL(file);
        const img = await new Promise((res, rej) => {
            const i = new Image();
            i.onload = () => res(i);
            i.onerror = rej;
            i.src = url;
        });
        const scale = Math.min(1, max / Math.max(img.width, img.height));
        const c = document.createElement('canvas');
        c.width  = Math.max(1, Math.round(img.width  * scale));
        c.height = Math.max(1, Math.round(img.height * scale));
        c.getContext('2d').drawImage(img, 0, 0, c.width, c.height);
        URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
        return c.toDataURL('image/jpeg', quality);
    } catch (_) {
        return null;
    }
}

window._echoAttachments = [];
const ECHO_MAX_ATTACH = 4;

function _renderAttachTray() {
    const tray = document.getElementById('echoai-attach-tray');
    if (!tray) return;
    const list = window._echoAttachments;
    tray.classList.toggle('hidden', list.length === 0);
    tray.innerHTML = list.map((a, i) => `
        <div class="att-item" data-i="${i}" title="Click to preview">
            <img src="${a.thumb}" alt="Attachment ${i + 1}">
            <button class="att-x" data-x="${i}" title="Remove">&times;</button>
        </div>`).join('');
    tray.querySelectorAll('.att-x').forEach(btn => {
        btn.onclick = (ev) => {
            ev.stopPropagation();
            window._echoAttachments.splice(parseInt(btn.dataset.x, 10), 1);
            _renderAttachTray();
        };
    });
    tray.querySelectorAll('.att-item').forEach(el => {
        el.onclick = () => _openAttachPreview(list[parseInt(el.dataset.i, 10)]?.thumb);
    });
}

function _openAttachPreview(src) {
    if (!src) return;
    document.getElementById('att-lightbox')?.remove();
    const box = document.createElement('div');
    box.id = 'att-lightbox';
    box.innerHTML = `<img src="${src}" alt="Attachment preview">`;
    const close = () => { box.remove(); document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey); };
    const onKey = (e) => { if (e.key === 'Escape') close(); };
    box.onclick = close;
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    document.body.appendChild(box);
}

document.getElementById('echoai-img-upload').onchange = async (e) => {
    const files = Array.from(e.target.files || []);
    e.target.value = '';
    if (!files.length) return;
    window.EchoVision?.warm?.();

    for (const file of files) {
        if (!file.type.startsWith('image/')) { setSttError('Please upload an image file.'); continue; }
        if (window._echoAttachments.length >= ECHO_MAX_ATTACH) {
            setSttError(`You can attach up to ${ECHO_MAX_ATTACH} images at once.`);
            break;
        }
        const resized = await _echoMakeThumb(file, 1024, 0.85);
        let b64, mime;
        if (resized) {
            b64 = resized.split(',')[1];
            mime = 'image/jpeg';
        } else {
            try {
                b64 = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
                    const reader = new FileReader();
                    reader.onload  = () => resolve(reader.result.split(',')[1]);
                    reader.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Failed to read file'));
                    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
                });
            } catch (_) { setSttError('Could not read that image.'); continue; }
            mime = file.type;
        }
        let cropped = null;
        try { cropped = await window.EchoSnap.crop(document, resized || ('data:' + mime + ';base64,' + b64)); } catch (_) {}
        if (cropped) { b64 = cropped.b64; mime = cropped.mime; }
        const thumb = cropped ? await _echoShrinkThumb(cropped.dataUrl, 420, 0.72)
                              : (await _echoMakeThumb(file) || resized);
        window._echoAttachments.push({ b64, mime, thumb });
    }
    _renderAttachTray();
    document.getElementById('echoai-input')?.focus();
};

window._echoAnswerPhoto = async function (chat, images, caption) {
    const win = document.getElementById('echoai-chat-window');
    const bubble = renderEchoMessage('…', 'assistant');
    let streamed = '';
    const paint = (t) => { try { bubble.innerHTML = mdSafe(t); if (win) win.scrollTop = win.scrollHeight; } catch (_) {} };
    let answer = '';
    try {
        answer = await window.EchoVision.ask({
            text: caption, images,
            onPartial: (t) => { streamed = t; paint(t); },
        });
    } catch (e) {
        console.warn('[EchoVision] session failed, retrying on a fresh Live socket:', e && e.message);
        try {
            answer = await window._liveAsk({
                systemInstruction: ECHO_VISION_PROMPT,
                text: caption || 'Answer the question in this image.',
                images,
            });
        } catch (_) { answer = ''; }
    }
    answer = (answer || streamed || '').replace(/[—–]/g, '-').trim();
    if (!answer) answer = '*Could not read that image. Try again, or retake it a bit clearer.*';

    if (bubble.parentElement) bubble.parentElement.remove();
    const finalBubble = renderEchoMessage(answer, 'assistant');
    _echoAddExplainButton(finalBubble);

    chat.messages.push({ role: 'assistant', content: answer });
    saveEchoChats();
};

function _echoAddExplainButton(bubble) {
    if (!bubble || bubble.querySelector('.echo-explain-btn')) return;
    const btn = document.createElement('button');
    btn.className = 'echo-explain-btn text-[10px] text-[#818cf8] hover:text-white mt-2 ml-2 font-bold transition';
    btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-wand-magic-sparkles"></i> Explain it';
    btn.onclick = async () => {
        btn.disabled = true; btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-wand-magic-sparkles"></i> Explaining…';
        const chat = echoaiChats.find(c => c.id === currentEchoId);
        const win = document.getElementById('echoai-chat-window');
        const b = renderEchoMessage('…', 'assistant');
        let out = '';
        try {
            out = await window.EchoVision.explain({ onPartial: (t) => { out = t; try { b.innerHTML = mdSafe(t); if (win) win.scrollTop = win.scrollHeight; } catch (_) {} } });
        } catch (e) { out = ''; }
        out = (out || '').replace(/[—–]/g, '-').trim() || '*Could not load an explanation right now.*';
        if (b.parentElement) b.parentElement.remove();
        renderEchoMessage(out, 'assistant');
        btn.remove();
        if (chat) { chat.messages.push({ role: 'assistant', content: out }); saveEchoChats(); }
    };
    bubble.appendChild(btn);
}


window._echoSendAttachments = async (userPromptText) => {
    if (window._guestSpendPrompt && !window._guestSpendPrompt(true)) return;
    const attachments = window._echoAttachments.slice();
    if (!attachments.length) return;
    window._echoAttachments = [];
    _renderAttachTray();

    const ocrBar  = document.getElementById('ocr-status-bar');
    const ocrText = document.getElementById('ocr-progress-text');

    if (window.GUEST_MODE && window._guestSpendPrompt && !window._guestSpendPrompt(true)) return;
    const _imgLimit = window._echoRateBlocked?.() || await window._echoUsageBlockedAsync?.();
    if (_imgLimit) { setSttError(_imgLimit); return; }
    window._echoRateMark?.();
    window._echoUsageChargePrompt?.();

    ocrBar.classList.add('visible');
    ocrText.innerText = 'Preparing image for Gemini...';

    try {
        ocrText.innerText = 'Sending to Gemini...';

        if (!currentEchoId || !echoaiChats.find(c => c.id === currentEchoId)) {
            createNewEchoChat();
        }
        const chat = echoaiChats.find(c => c.id === currentEchoId);
        if (!chat) { ocrBar.classList.remove('visible'); return; }
        if (chat.ended) { ocrText.innerText = 'EchoAI ended this chat — start a new one.'; setTimeout(() => ocrBar.classList.remove('visible'), 2200); return; }

        const thumbSrc = attachments.length === 1
            ? [attachments[0].thumb]
            : await Promise.all(attachments.map(a => _echoShrinkThumb(a.thumb, 240, 0.6)));

        renderEchoMessage(userPromptText, 'user', null, null, null, thumbSrc);
        chat.messages.push({ role: 'user', content: userPromptText, imgs: thumbSrc });

        ocrBar.classList.remove('visible');

        const _visionImgs = attachments.map(a => ({ data: a.b64, mime: a.mime }));
        await window._echoAnswerPhoto(chat, _visionImgs, userPromptText);

    } catch (err) {
        ocrBar.classList.remove('visible');
        setSttError('Image upload failed. Please try again.');
        console.error('Image upload error:', err);
    }
};

function renderEchoMessage(content, role, playRequest, navRequest, endRequest, imageSrc) {
    const win = document.getElementById('echoai-chat-window');
    const _landing = win && win.querySelector('.echo-landing');
    if (_landing) _landing.remove();
    const wrapper = document.createElement('div');
    wrapper.className = `echo-msg-wrapper ${role === 'user' ? 'user' : 'assistant'}`;

    const bubble = document.createElement('div');
    bubble.className = 'echo-msg';

    let displayContent = content;
    if (role === 'assistant') {
        displayContent = displayContent.replace(/-\*(.*?)\*-/gs, '').trim();
        displayContent = displayContent
            .replace(/```+\s*echoai-suggest[\s\S]*?```+/gi, '')
            .replace(/`*\s*echoai-suggest\s*`*:?\s*\[[\s\S]*?\]\s*`*/gi, '')
            .replace(/`*\s*echoai-suggest\s*`*:?[^\n]*/gi, '')
            .trim();
        displayContent = window._echoStripEmptyFences
            ? window._echoStripEmptyFences(displayContent)
            : displayContent;
        displayContent = displayContent.replace(/<think>([\s\S]*?)<\/think>/gi, (match, innerText) => {
            const escaped = window.escHtml(innerText.trim()).replace(/\n/g, '<br>');
            return `<details class="echo-think-block"><summary>Internal reasoning</summary><div>${escaped}</div></details>`;
        });
    }

    bubble.innerHTML = mdSafe(displayContent);

    const _imgList = Array.isArray(imageSrc) ? imageSrc.filter(Boolean) : (imageSrc ? [imageSrc] : []);
    if (_imgList.length) {
        if (_imgList.length === 1) {
            const thumb = document.createElement('img');
            thumb.className = 'echo-msg-img';
            thumb.src = _imgList[0];
            thumb.alt = 'Attached image';
            thumb.onclick = () => _openAttachPreview(_imgList[0]);
            bubble.prepend(thumb);
        } else {
            const grid = document.createElement('div');
            grid.className = 'echo-msg-imgs';
            _imgList.forEach((src, i) => {
                const im = document.createElement('img');
                im.src = src;
                im.alt = `Attached image ${i + 1}`;
                im.onclick = () => _openAttachPreview(src);
                grid.appendChild(im);
            });
            bubble.prepend(grid);
        }
        if (!displayContent) bubble.classList.add('img-only');
    }

    bubble.querySelectorAll('pre').forEach(pre => {
        if (pre.querySelector('.echo-copy-btn')) return;
        const codeEl = pre.querySelector('code');
        let detectedLang = 'html';
        if (codeEl) {
            const cls = [...codeEl.classList].find(c => c.startsWith('language-'));
            if (cls) detectedLang = cls.replace('language-', '');
        }
        const btn = document.createElement('button');
        btn.className = 'echo-copy-btn';
        btn.innerText = 'Copy';
        btn.style.right = '90px';
        btn.onclick = () => {
            navigator.clipboard.writeText(codeEl ? codeEl.innerText : pre.innerText);
            btn.innerText = 'Copied!';
            setTimeout(() => { btn.innerText = 'Copy'; }, 2000);
        };
        pre.appendChild(btn);
        const canvasBtn = document.createElement('button');
        canvasBtn.className = 'echo-copy-btn';
        canvasBtn.innerText = 'Canvas';
        canvasBtn.style.right = '8px';
        canvasBtn.style.background = 'rgba(99,102,241,0.25)';
        canvasBtn.style.color = '#818cf8';
        canvasBtn.onclick = () => {
            const code = codeEl ? codeEl.innerText : pre.innerText;
            const label = detectedLang.toUpperCase() + ' ' + new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], {hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'});
            openCanvas(detectedLang, code, label);
        };
        pre.appendChild(canvasBtn);
        window._lazyLib('hljs')
            .then(() => { try { hljs.highlightElement(codeEl); } catch (e) {} })
            .catch(() => {});
    });

    if (role === 'assistant') {
        const readBtn = document.createElement('button');
        readBtn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-volume-high"></i> Read aloud';
        readBtn.className = 'text-[10px] text-[#555566] hover:text-[#00f2ff] mt-2 block transition';
        readBtn.onclick = () => {
            const plainText = bubble.innerText
                .replace('🔊 Read aloud', '')
                .replace(/Copy|Copied!|Canvas/g, '')
                .replace(/Internal reasoning/g, '')
                .trim();
            speakEchoText(plainText);
        };
        bubble.appendChild(readBtn);
    }

    if (role === 'assistant' && playRequest && playRequest.queries?.length) {
        const box = document.createElement('div');
        box.style.cssText = 'margin-top:8px;padding:8px 10px;background:rgba(0,242,255,0.06);border:1px solid rgba(0,242,255,0.18);border-radius:10px;';
        const hdr = document.createElement('div');
        hdr.style.cssText = 'font-size:11px;color:#aaa;margin-bottom:6px;';
        hdr.innerText = `EchoAI suggested ${playRequest.queries.length} song${playRequest.queries.length > 1 ? 's' : ''}:`;
        box.appendChild(hdr);
        const list = document.createElement('div');
        list.style.cssText = 'max-height:160px;overflow-y:auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;';
        playRequest.queries.forEach(q => {
            const row = document.createElement('div');
            row.style.cssText = 'display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;';
            const label = document.createElement('span');
            label.style.cssText = 'font-size:11px;color:#ccc;flex:1;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;';
            label.innerText = q;
            const btn = document.createElement('button');
            btn.className = 'bg-[#00f2ff] hover:bg-[#00d0e0] text-black font-bold text-[10px] px-3 py-1 rounded-lg transition flex-shrink-0';
            btn.innerText = 'Play';
            btn.onclick = async () => {
                btn.disabled = true; btn.innerText = '…';
                const res = await window._echoPlaySongRequest(q);
                if (res.ok) { label.innerText = `✓ ${res.track.title}`; btn.remove(); }
                else { btn.disabled = false; btn.innerText = 'Play'; label.innerText = `${q} (not found)`; }
            };
            row.appendChild(label); row.appendChild(btn);
            list.appendChild(row);
        });
        box.appendChild(list);
        if (playRequest.queries.length > 1) {
            const allBtn = document.createElement('button');
            allBtn.className = 'text-[10px] text-[#00f2ff] hover:text-white mt-2 font-bold transition';
            allBtn.innerText = '▶▶ Queue all';
            allBtn.onclick = () => list.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(b => b.click());
            box.appendChild(allBtn);
        }
        bubble.appendChild(box);
    }

    if (role === 'assistant' && navRequest) {
        const resolved = _resolveEchoNavView(navRequest.view, navRequest.label);
        if (resolved) {
            const box = document.createElement('div');
            box.style.cssText = 'margin-top:8px;padding:8px 10px;background:rgba(0,242,255,0.06);border:1px solid rgba(0,242,255,0.18);border-radius:10px;';
            const hdr = document.createElement('div');
            hdr.style.cssText = 'font-size:11px;color:#aaa;margin-bottom:6px;';
            hdr.innerText = `EchoAI suggests opening ${resolved.label}:`;
            box.appendChild(hdr);
            const row = document.createElement('div');
            row.style.cssText = 'display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;';
            const label = document.createElement('span');
            label.style.cssText = 'font-size:11px;color:#ccc;flex:1;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;';
            label.innerText = resolved.label;
            const btn = document.createElement('button');
            btn.className = 'bg-[#00f2ff] hover:bg-[#00d0e0] text-black font-bold text-[10px] px-3 py-1 rounded-lg transition flex-shrink-0';
            btn.innerText = '→ Take me there';
            btn.onclick = () => {
                window.switchView(resolved.view);
                label.innerText = `✓ Opened ${resolved.label}`;
                btn.remove();
            };
            row.appendChild(label); row.appendChild(btn);
            box.appendChild(row);
            bubble.appendChild(box);
        }
    }

    if (role === 'assistant' && endRequest) {
        const box = document.createElement('div');
        box.style.cssText = 'margin-top:8px;padding:8px 10px;background:rgba(239,68,68,0.07);border:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,0.22);border-radius:10px;';
        const hdr = document.createElement('div');
        hdr.style.cssText = 'font-size:11px;color:#f87171;margin-bottom:6px;font-weight:bold;';
        hdr.innerText = '⛔ EchoAI ended this conversation';
        box.appendChild(hdr);
        const why = document.createElement('div');
        why.style.cssText = 'font-size:11px;color:#ccc;margin-bottom:8px;';
        why.innerText = endRequest.reason;
        box.appendChild(why);
        const btn = document.createElement('button');
        btn.className = 'bg-[#00f2ff] hover:bg-[#00d0e0] text-black font-bold text-[10px] px-3 py-1 rounded-lg transition';
        btn.innerText = '+ Start a new chat';
        btn.onclick = () => createNewEchoChat();
        box.appendChild(btn);
        bubble.appendChild(box);
    }

    wrapper.appendChild(bubble);
    win.appendChild(wrapper);
    win.scrollTop = win.scrollHeight;
    return bubble;
}

window._echoAIExtractPlaySongBlock = function(text) {
    let m = text.match(/```echoai-playsong\s*([\s\S]*?)```/i);
    if (!m) {
        const allBlocks = [...text.matchAll(/```[a-zA-Z0-9_-]*\s*([\s\S]*?)```/g)];
        for (const b of allBlocks) {
            try {
                const probe = JSON.parse(b[1].trim());
                if (Array.isArray(probe?.queries) || typeof probe?.query === 'string') { m = b; break; }
            } catch (e) {   }
        }
    }
    if (!m) return { text, playRequest: null };
    const stripped = text.replace(m[0], '').trim();
    try {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(m[1].trim());
        let queries = Array.isArray(parsed?.queries) ? parsed.queries : (parsed?.query ? [parsed.query] : []);
        queries = queries.map(q => String(q).trim().slice(0, 200)).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 25);
        if (queries.length) return { text: stripped, playRequest: { queries } };
    } catch (e) {   }
    return { text: stripped, playRequest: null };
};

window._echoAIHandleMemoryBlock = async function(text) {
    const m = text.match(/```echoai-memory\s*([\s\S]*?)```/i);
    if (!m) return text;
    try {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(m[1].trim());
        await window._echoSaveMemory(parsed);
        const bits = [];
        if (typeof parsed?.prefs === 'string' && parsed.prefs.trim()) bits.push('response style');
        if (Array.isArray(parsed?.addFacts) && parsed.addFacts.length) bits.push(`${parsed.addFacts.length} note${parsed.addFacts.length > 1 ? 's' : ''}`);
        if (Array.isArray(parsed?.removeFacts) && parsed.removeFacts.length) bits.push('a removal');
        if (typeof parsed?.conduct === 'string' && parsed.conduct.trim()) bits.push('a note on how we get along');
        if (parsed?.forget === true) return text.replace(m[0], '*🧠 Memory cleared.*');
        return text.replace(m[0], `*🧠 Memory updated${bits.length ? ' (' + bits.join(', ') + ')' : ''} — this carries over to future chats.*`);
    } catch (e) {
        return text.replace(m[0], '*(Could not save that to memory - ' + (e.message || e) + '.)*');
    }
};

window._echoAIHandleDraftBlocks = async function(text) {
    const isOwner = (window._myRole === 'owner');
    let result = text;
    const matches = [...text.matchAll(/```echoai-(badge|quest)\s*([\s\S]*?)```/gi)];
    if (!matches.length) {
        const generic = text.match(/```(?:json)?\s*(\{[\s\S]*?\})\s*```/i);
        if (generic) {
            try {
                const probe = JSON.parse(generic[1]);
                if (probe.id && probe.name) {
                    const kind = (probe.goal || probe.rewardBadgeId || probe.type) ? 'quest' : 'badge';
                    matches.push([generic[0], kind, generic[1]]);
                }
            } catch (e) {   }
        }
    }
    if (!matches.length) return text;
    for (const m of matches) {
        const kind = m[1].toLowerCase();
        let parsed;
        try { parsed = JSON.parse(m[2].trim()); } catch (e) {
            result = result.replace(m[0], '*(EchoAI tried to draft a ' + kind + ' but the JSON was malformed — ask it to try again.)*');
            continue;
        }
        if (!isOwner) {
            result = result.replace(m[0], '*(Only the owner can have EchoAI draft badges or quests.)*');
            continue;
        }
        try {
            if (kind === 'badge') {
                if (!parsed.id || !parsed.name) throw new Error('missing id/name');
                const fields = { name: parsed.name, emoji: parsed.emoji || '🏅', desc: parsed.desc || '', kind: parsed.kind || 'manual' };
                if (parsed.kind === 'seasonal') {
                    if (parsed.startAt) fields.startAt = new Date(parsed.startAt);
                    if (parsed.endAt) fields.endAt = new Date(parsed.endAt);
                }
                await window.saveBadgeDraft(parsed.id, fields, 'echoai');
                result = result.replace(m[0], `✅ **Badge draft saved:** "${parsed.name}" (id: \`${parsed.id}\`) — review and publish it in the admin panel's Badges & Quests tab.`);
            } else {
                if (!parsed.id || !parsed.name || !parsed.goal || !parsed.rewardBadgeId) throw new Error('missing required fields');
                const fields = {
                    name: parsed.name, emoji: parsed.emoji || '🧭', desc: parsed.desc || '',
                    type: parsed.type || 'time', goal: Number(parsed.goal),
                    reward: { badgeId: parsed.rewardBadgeId }
                };
                if (parsed.type === 'action') fields.actionType = parsed.actionType || '';
                await window.saveQuestDraft(parsed.id, fields, 'echoai');
                result = result.replace(m[0], `✅ **Quest draft saved:** "${parsed.name}" (id: \`${parsed.id}\`) — review and start it in the admin panel's Badges & Quests tab.`);
            }
        } catch (e) {
            result = result.replace(m[0], '*(Could not save that draft — ' + e.message + '.)*');
        }
    }
    return result;
}

function _echoTypeOut(bubble, md) {
    return new Promise(resolve => {
        if (!md) { bubble.innerHTML = ''; return resolve(); }
        const win = document.getElementById('echoai-chat-window');
        const FRAMES = 55;
        const step = Math.max(2, Math.ceil(md.length / FRAMES));
        let i = 0;
        const tick = () => {
            i = Math.min(md.length, i + step);
            bubble.innerHTML = mdSafe(md.slice(0, i), i < md.length) + (i < md.length ? '<span class="echo-caret"></span>' : '');
            if (win) win.scrollTop = win.scrollHeight;
            if (i < md.length) setTimeout(tick, 28);
            else resolve();
        };
        tick();
    });
}

const ECHO_LIMITS = { prompts: 60, tokens: 120000 };

const ECHO_RATE = { perMin: 5 };
let _echoSendTimes = [];

window._echoLoadLimits = async () => {
    try {
        const s = await window.getDoc(window.doc(window.db, 'site_config', 'main'));
        const L = s.exists() && s.data().echoLimits;
        if (L && typeof L.prompts === 'number' && L.prompts > 0) ECHO_LIMITS.prompts = L.prompts;
        if (L && typeof L.tokens === 'number' && L.tokens > 0) ECHO_LIMITS.tokens = L.tokens;
        if (L && typeof L.perMin === 'number' && L.perMin > 0) ECHO_RATE.perMin = L.perMin;
        window.echoUsageRefresh?.();
    } catch (_) {   }
};

const _echoToday = () => new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

let _echoUsageMem = null;

function _echoUsageGet() {
    if (_echoUsageMem && _echoUsageMem.day === _echoToday()) return { ..._echoUsageMem };
    try {
        const raw = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('echo_usage') || '{}');
        if (raw.day !== _echoToday()) return { day: _echoToday(), prompts: 0, tokens: 0 };
        return { day: raw.day, prompts: raw.prompts || 0, tokens: raw.tokens || 0 };
    } catch (_) { return { day: _echoToday(), prompts: 0, tokens: 0 }; }
}

window._echoUsageSync = async () => {
    if (!window.myUID) return;
    try {
        const s = await window.getDoc(window.doc(window.db, 'users', window.myUID));
        const u = s.exists() && s.data().echoUsage;
        if (!u) return;
        const server = (u.day === _echoToday())
            ? { day: u.day, prompts: u.prompts || 0, tokens: u.tokens || 0 }
            : { day: _echoToday(), prompts: 0, tokens: 0 };
        const local = _echoUsageGet();
        _echoUsageMem = {
            day: _echoToday(),
            prompts: Math.max(server.prompts, local.day === _echoToday() ? local.prompts : 0),
            tokens:  Math.max(server.tokens,  local.day === _echoToday() ? local.tokens  : 0)
        };
        try { localStorage.setItem('echo_usage', JSON.stringify(_echoUsageMem)); } catch (_) {}
        window.echoUsageRefresh?.();
    } catch (_) {}
};

function _echoUsageSave(u) {
    _echoUsageMem = { ...u };
    try { localStorage.setItem('echo_usage', JSON.stringify(u)); } catch (_) {}
    try {
        if (window.myUID && window.db && window.updateDoc && window.doc) {
            window.updateDoc(window.doc(window.db, 'users', window.myUID), {
                echoUsage: { day: u.day, prompts: u.prompts, tokens: u.tokens },
                echoUsageAt: window.serverTimestamp ? window.serverTimestamp() : null
            }).catch(() => {});
        }
    } catch (_) {}
}

const _echoLimitExempt = () => window.isAdmin === true || window._hasPerm?.('canSeeSiteConfig') === true;

window.echoUsageRemaining = () => {
    const u = _echoUsageGet();
    return { prompts: Math.max(0, ECHO_LIMITS.prompts - u.prompts), tokens: Math.max(0, ECHO_LIMITS.tokens - u.tokens) };
};

function _echoUsageBlocked() {
    if (_echoLimitExempt()) return null;
    const u = _echoUsageGet();
    if (u.prompts >= ECHO_LIMITS.prompts) return `You've used all ${ECHO_LIMITS.prompts} EchoAI messages for today. Resets at midnight.`;
    if (u.tokens >= ECHO_LIMITS.tokens) return `You've hit today's EchoAI usage limit. Resets at midnight.`;
    return null;
}

function _echoRateBlocked() {
    if (_echoLimitExempt()) return null;
    const now = Date.now();
    _echoSendTimes = _echoSendTimes.filter(t => now - t < 60000);
    if (_echoSendTimes.length < ECHO_RATE.perMin) return null;
    const wait = Math.max(1, Math.ceil((60000 - (now - _echoSendTimes[0])) / 1000));
    return `Slow down — EchoAI takes ${ECHO_RATE.perMin} messages a minute. Try again in ${wait}s.`;
}
function _echoRateMark() { _echoSendTimes.push(Date.now()); }
window._echoRateBlocked = _echoRateBlocked;
window._echoRateMark = _echoRateMark;

const _echoPromptSeen = Object.create(null);
window._echoUsageTurn = (usage, key) => {
    if (!usage) return;
    const prompt = parseInt(usage.promptTokenCount, 10) || 0;
    const out    = parseInt(usage.candidatesTokenCount, 10) || 0;
    if (!prompt) { window._echoUsageExact?.(usage.totalTokenCount); return; }
    const k = key || ((typeof currentEchoId !== 'undefined' && currentEchoId) || '_');
    const seen = _echoPromptSeen[k] || 0;
    _echoPromptSeen[k] = Math.max(seen, prompt);
    const charge = Math.max(0, prompt - seen) + out;
    if (charge > 0) window._echoUsageExact?.(charge);
};

function _echoUsageAdd(chars, weight) {
    if (window.GUEST_MODE) return;
    const u = _echoUsageGet();
    u.prompts += (weight || 1);
    u.tokens += Math.ceil((chars || 0) / 4);
    _echoUsageSave(u);
    window.echoUsageRefresh();
    _echoUsageWarn();
}

window._echoUsageBlocked = _echoUsageBlocked;

window._echoUsageBlockedAsync = async () => {
    if (window.GUEST_MODE) return null;
    try { await window._echoUsageSync(); } catch (_) {}
    return _echoUsageBlocked();
};

window._echoUsageChargePrompt = () => _echoUsageAdd(0, 1);

window._echoUsageAddTokensOnly = (chars) => _echoUsageAdd(chars, 0);

window._echoUsageExact = (n) => {
    const t = parseInt(n, 10);
    if (!t || t < 1) return;
    const u = _echoUsageGet();
    u.tokens += t;
    _echoUsageSave(u);
    window.echoUsageRefresh();
    _echoUsageWarn();
};

function _echoUsageWarn() {
    const row = document.getElementById('echoai-composer-row');
    if (!row || !row.parentElement) return;
    let pill = document.getElementById('echo-usage-pill');
    const u = _echoUsageGet();
    const pct = _echoLimitExempt() ? 0
        : Math.round(Math.max((u.prompts / ECHO_LIMITS.prompts), (u.tokens / ECHO_LIMITS.tokens)) * 100);

    if (pct < 80) { if (pill) pill.remove(); return; }

    if (!pill) {
        pill = document.createElement('div');
        pill.id = 'echo-usage-pill';
        pill.style.cssText = 'display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;margin:0 0 6px;padding:5px 10px;' +
            'border-radius:999px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;width:fit-content;' +
            'border:1px solid rgba(251,191,36,0.3);background:rgba(251,191,36,0.08);color:#fbbf24;';
        row.parentElement.insertBefore(pill, row);
    }
    const over = pct >= 100;
    pill.style.borderColor = over ? 'rgba(248,113,113,0.35)' : 'rgba(251,191,36,0.3)';
    pill.style.background  = over ? 'rgba(248,113,113,0.08)' : 'rgba(251,191,36,0.08)';
    pill.style.color       = over ? '#f87171' : '#fbbf24';
    pill.innerHTML = `<span style="width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:currentColor;flex-shrink:0;"></span>` +
        `<span>${over ? 'Daily EchoAI limit reached — resets at midnight' : `${pct}% of today's EchoAI limit used`}</span>`;
}

window.echoUsageRefresh = () => {
    const bar = document.getElementById('echo-usage-bar');
    if (!bar) return;
    const u = _echoUsageGet();
    const pPct = (u.prompts / ECHO_LIMITS.prompts) * 100;
    const tPct = (u.tokens / ECHO_LIMITS.tokens) * 100;
    const pct = Math.min(100, Math.round(Math.max(pPct, tPct)));
    bar.style.width = pct + '%';
    bar.style.background = pct >= 90 ? '#f87171' : pct >= 75 ? '#fbbf24' : '#818cf8';
    const pctEl = document.getElementById('echo-usage-pct');
    const txtEl = document.getElementById('echo-usage-text');
    if (pctEl) pctEl.innerText = _echoLimitExempt() ? 'unlimited' : pct + '%';
    if (txtEl) txtEl.innerText = _echoLimitExempt()
        ? 'No limit on your account'
        : `${u.prompts} / ${ECHO_LIMITS.prompts} messages · ${Math.round(u.tokens / 1000)}k / ${Math.round(ECHO_LIMITS.tokens / 1000)}k tokens`;
    _echoUsageWarn();
};

async function handleEchoSend() {
    const inputEl = document.getElementById('echoai-input');
    const text = inputEl.value.trim();

    window._clearEchoSuggestions && window._clearEchoSuggestions();

    if (window._guestSpendPrompt && !window._guestSpendPrompt()) return;

    if (window._echoAttachments?.length) {
        inputEl.value = '';
        return window._echoSendAttachments(text);
    }

    if (!text) return;

    const _limitMsg = window.GUEST_MODE ? null : (_echoRateBlocked() || await window._echoUsageBlockedAsync());
    if (_limitMsg) {
        const win = document.getElementById('echoai-chat-window');
        if (win) {
            const warn = document.createElement('div');
            warn.className = 'echo-msg echo-msg-ai';
            warn.innerHTML = `<div style="color:#fbbf24;font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.6;">${window.escHtml(_limitMsg)}</div>`;
            win.appendChild(warn);
            win.scrollTop = 99999;
        }
        return;
    }
    if (!window.GUEST_MODE) {
        _echoRateMark();
        _echoUsageAdd(0, (window.getEchoEffort?.().key === 'ultra') ? 3 : 1);
    }

    inputEl.value = '';

    if (!currentEchoId || !echoaiChats.find(c => c.id === currentEchoId)) {
        createNewEchoChat();
    }
    const chat = echoaiChats.find(c => c.id === currentEchoId);
    if (!chat) return;

    if (chat.ended) { inputEl.value = text; window._applyEchoChatEndedState(); return; }

    const isThinkingMode = echoMode === 'thinking';
    const isSwarmMode = echoMode === 'swarm';

    if (chat.messages.length > 0 && chat.messages[0].role === 'system') {
        chat.messages[0] = isThinkingMode ? getThinkingSystemPrompt() : getFastSystemPrompt();
    }

    if (isSwarmMode) {
        const _swarmIsFirst = chat.messages.filter(m => m.role === 'user').length === 0;
        if (_swarmIsFirst) {
            (async () => {
                const _snModels = ['gemini-2.5-flash', 'gemini-2.5-flash-lite'];
                const _snSys = `You are a chat title generator. Generate a SHORT descriptive title (3-6 words max). Respond ONLY in this exact format:\n-*Title Here*-`;
                for (const _snm of _snModels) {
                    try {
                        const _snr = await fetch(
                            `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/${_snm}:generateContent?key=${GEMINI_API_KEY}`,
                            {
                                method: 'POST',
                                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                                body: JSON.stringify({
                                    system_instruction: { parts: [{ text: _snSys }] },
                                    contents: [{ role: 'user', parts: [{ text: text }] }],
                                    generationConfig: { temperature: 0.3, maxOutputTokens: 24 }
                                })
                            }
                        );
                        if (!_snr.ok) { console.warn('[Naming/Swarm]', _snm, _snr.status, '— trying next'); continue; }
                        const _snd = await _snr.json();
                        const _sraw = (_snd?.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts?.[0]?.text ?? '').trim();
                        const _sm = _sraw.match(/-\*(.*?)\*-/);
                        if (_sm && _sm[1].trim()) {
                            chat.title = _sm[1].trim();
                            saveEchoChats();
                            renderEchoSidebar();
                            console.log('[Naming/Swarm] Chat titled:', chat.title, 'via', _snm);
                            return;
                        }
                    } catch(e) { console.warn('[Naming/Swarm] error', _snm, e.message); }
                }
            })();
        }

        chat.messages.push({ role: 'user', content: text });
        renderEchoMessage(text, 'user');
        saveEchoChats();

        const swarmEl = document.createElement('div');
        swarmEl.className = 'echo-msg echo-msg-ai';
        swarmEl.innerHTML = `<div class="echo-thinking"><span>Thinking</span><span class="echo-thinking-dots"><span></span><span></span><span></span></span></div>`;
        document.getElementById('echoai-chat-window').appendChild(swarmEl);
        document.getElementById('echoai-chat-window').scrollTop = 99999;

        const SWARM_MODELS = ['gemini-2.5-flash', 'gemini-2.5-flash-lite', 'gemini-3.5-flash'];

        async function _swarmCall(preferred, systemPrompt, userText) {
            const history = chat.messages.slice(0, -1)
                .filter(m => m.role !== 'system')
                .map(m => ({ role: m.role === 'assistant' ? 'model' : 'user', parts: [{ text: m.content }] }));
            history.push({ role: 'user', parts: [{ text: userText }] });
            const tryOrder = [preferred, ...SWARM_MODELS.filter(m => m !== preferred)];
            let lastErr = null;
            for (const model of tryOrder) {
                try {
                    const r = await fetch(
                        `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/${model}:generateContent?key=${GEMINI_API_KEY}`,
                        {
                            method: 'POST',
                            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                            body: JSON.stringify({
                                system_instruction: { parts: [{ text: systemPrompt }] },
                                contents: history,
                                generationConfig: { temperature: 0.8 }
                            })
                        }
                    );
                    if (!r.ok) { lastErr = new Error('API ' + r.status); continue; }
                    const d = await r.json();
                    window._echoUsageTurn?.(d?.usageMetadata, (currentEchoId || '_') + ':' + (preferred || 'swarm'));
                    const out = (d?.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts?.[0]?.text ?? '').trim();
                    if (out) return out;
                    lastErr = new Error('empty response');
                } catch (e) { lastErr = e; }
            }
            throw lastErr || new Error('all models unavailable');
        }

        try {
            const baseSys = (chat.messages.find(m => m.role === 'system')?.content || '').trim();

            const AGENT_A_SYS = `${baseSys}\n\n---\nFor this reply: be analytical. Work through it thoroughly with clear structured reasoning. Never mention any model name or that you are one of several attempts.`;
            const AGENT_B_SYS = `${baseSys}\n\n---\nFor this reply: be practical. Prioritise clarity, concrete examples, and real-world applicability. Never mention any model name or that you are one of several attempts.`;

            const [respA, respB] = await Promise.all([
                _swarmCall('gemini-2.5-flash', AGENT_A_SYS, text),
                _swarmCall('gemini-2.5-flash-lite', AGENT_B_SYS, text)
            ]);

            const SYNTH_SYS = `${baseSys}

---
You are replying directly to the user in a normal chat. You will be shown two internal draft answers. Use whatever is best in them to write ONE excellent answer in your own voice.

Absolute rules:
- Never mention drafts, agents, swarms, models, judges, comparisons, syntheses, or that more than one answer existed.
- Never describe strengths, weaknesses, or your process.
- No headings like "Expert Synthesis" or "Analysis". No preamble.
- Just reply the way a single knowledgeable assistant would, at whatever length the question deserves.

When the answer contains code:
- Give ONE file per reply unless the user explicitly asked for more than one. Do not split a small project into separate HTML, CSS and JS files on your own — put it in a single file.
- Every code block MUST be a fenced block that opens with three backticks immediately followed by the language (\`\`\`html, \`\`\`js, \`\`\`python) and closes with three backticks on their own line. Never indent the fences, never use single backticks for a whole file, and never paste code as plain text.
- Do not repeat the same file twice in one reply, and do not show fragments of it before or after the full version.`;

            const synthPrompt = `The user asked: "${text}"\n\nDraft one:\n${respA}\n\nDraft two:\n${respB}\n\nNow write your single best answer to the user.`;
            const finalResp = await _swarmCall('gemini-2.5-flash', SYNTH_SYS, synthPrompt);

            swarmEl.innerHTML = `<div class="gc-text" style="font-size:13px;color:#c8c8d8;line-height:1.6;">${mdSafe(finalResp)}</div>`;
            document.getElementById('echoai-chat-window').scrollTop = 99999;

            chat.messages.push({ role: 'assistant', content: finalResp });
            saveEchoChats();

        } catch(e) {
            swarmEl.innerHTML = `<div style="color:#f87171;font-size:12px;">Couldn't get a reply: ${window.escHtml(e.message)}</div>`;
        }
        return;
    }

    const _isFirstMessage = chat.messages.filter(m => m.role === 'user').length === 0;
    if (_isFirstMessage) {
        (async () => {
            const _nameModels = ['gemini-2.5-flash', 'gemini-2.5-flash-lite'];
            const _nameSys = `You are a chat title generator. The user just sent their first message. Generate a SHORT descriptive title (3-6 words max). Respond ONLY in this exact format with nothing else:\n-*Title Here*-`;
            for (const _nm of _nameModels) {
                try {
                    const _nr = await fetch(
                        `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/${_nm}:generateContent?key=${GEMINI_API_KEY}`,
                        {
                            method: 'POST',
                            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                            body: JSON.stringify({
                                system_instruction: { parts: [{ text: _nameSys }] },
                                contents: [{ role: 'user', parts: [{ text: text }] }],
                                generationConfig: { temperature: 0.3, maxOutputTokens: 24 }
                            })
                        }
                    );
                    if (!_nr.ok) { console.warn('[Naming] model', _nm, 'returned', _nr.status, '— trying next'); continue; }
                    const _nd = await _nr.json();
                    const _raw = (_nd?.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts?.[0]?.text ?? '').trim();
                    const _match = _raw.match(/-\*(.*?)\*-/);
                    if (_match && _match[1].trim()) {
                        chat.title = _match[1].trim();
                        saveEchoChats();
                        renderEchoSidebar();
                        console.log('[Naming] Chat titled:', chat.title, 'via', _nm);
                        return;
                    } else {
                        console.warn('[Naming] Bad format from', _nm, ':', _raw);
                    }
                } catch(e) { console.warn('[Naming] error with', _nm, e.message); }
            }
        })();
    }

    chat.messages.push({ role: 'user', content: text });
    renderEchoMessage(text, 'user');
    saveEchoChats();


    if (isThinkingMode) {
        setPipelineStep('thinking');
    }

    const aiBubble = renderEchoMessage('...', 'assistant');
    aiBubble.innerHTML = '<span class="echo-thinking"><span class="echo-thinking-dots"><span></span><span></span><span></span></span> EchoAI is thinking...</span>';
    let fullResponse = '';

    try {
        const messages = isThinkingMode
            ? [
                ...chat.messages.slice(0, -1),
                {
                    role: 'user',
                    content: text + '\n\n[IMPORTANT: Use <think>...</think> tags for your reasoning first, then provide your full verified answer with a self-check at the end. Take your time.]'
                }
              ]
            : chat.messages;

        const _apiMessages = messages.map(m => ({ role: m.role, content: m.content }));

        let thinkPhaseComplete = false;
        let writingPhaseStarted = false;

        try {
            const geminiContents = _apiMessages
                .filter(m => m.role !== 'system')
                .map(m => ({ role: m.role === 'assistant' ? 'model' : 'user', parts: [{ text: m.content }] }));
            const systemMsg = _apiMessages.find(m => m.role === 'system');

            const echoModel = isThinkingMode ? 'gemini-2.5-flash' : 'gemini-2.5-flash-lite';
            const _callBody = {
                ...(systemMsg ? { system_instruction: { parts: [{ text: systemMsg.content }] } } : {}),
                contents: geminiContents,
                generationConfig: { temperature: 0.7 }
            };
            const _fallbackResult = await window._geminiCallWithFallback(echoModel, _callBody);
            let _liveText = '';
            if (_fallbackResult.blocked) {
                fullResponse = "*(EchoAI can't answer that one. Try rewording it.)*";
                throw new Error('blocked_by_safety');
            }
            if (!_fallbackResult.ok) {
                console.warn('[EchoAI] REST models exhausted — trying Live fallback');
                try {
                    _liveText = await window._liveAsk({
                        systemInstruction: systemMsg?.content,
                        text: geminiContents[geminiContents.length - 1]?.parts?.[0]?.text || text,
                        history: geminiContents.slice(0, -1)
                    });
                } catch (e) { console.warn('[EchoAI] live fallback failed:', e.message); }
                if (!_liveText) {
                    fullResponse = '*(EchoAI is busy right now. Give it a moment and try again.)*';
                    throw new Error('all_models_exhausted');
                }
            }
            const echoData = _fallbackResult.ok ? _fallbackResult.data : null;
            window._echoUsageTurn?.(echoData?.usageMetadata);
            fullResponse = (echoData?.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts?.[0]?.text ?? _liveText ?? '').replace(/[—–]/g, '-');

            if (isThinkingMode) {
                if (fullResponse.includes('</think>')) setPipelineStep('writing');
                if (fullResponse.includes('Self-check:')) setPipelineStep('verifying');
            }

            let displayContent = fullResponse.replace(/<think>([\s\S]*?)<\/think>/gi, (match, innerText) => {
                const escaped = window.escHtml(innerText.trim()).replace(/\n/g, '<br>');
                return `<details class="echo-think-block"><summary>Internal reasoning</summary><div>${escaped}</div></details>`;
            });
            let _typeText = displayContent
                .replace(/```+\s*echoai-[a-z]*\s*[\s\S]*?```+/gi, '')
                .replace(/```+\s*echoai-[a-z]*[\s\S]*$/i, '')
                .replace(/`*\s*echoai-[a-z]+\s*`*:?\s*[\[{][\s\S]*?[\]}]\s*`*/gi, '')
                .replace(/`*\s*echoai-[a-z]+\s*`*:?[^\n]*/gi, '')
                .trim();
            _typeText = window._echoStripEmptyFences ? window._echoStripEmptyFences(_typeText) : _typeText;
            await _echoTypeOut(aiBubble, _typeText);
        } catch(streamErr) {
            if (!fullResponse || !fullResponse.trim()) {
                fullResponse = '*(Request failed. Give it a moment and try again.)*';
            }
            console.warn('[EchoAI] send failed:', streamErr?.message || streamErr);
        }

        if (isThinkingMode) {
            setPipelineStep('done');
            setTimeout(() => hidePipeline(), 1500);
        }

        if (aiBubble.parentElement) aiBubble.parentElement.remove();
        if (!fullResponse.trim()) fullResponse = '*(No response received. Please try again.)*';

        fullResponse = await _echoAIHandleDraftBlocks(fullResponse);

        fullResponse = await window._echoAIHandleMemoryBlock(fullResponse);

        const { text: _afterPlaySong, playRequest } = window._echoAIExtractPlaySongBlock(fullResponse);
        fullResponse = _afterPlaySong;

        const { text: _afterNavigate, navRequest } = window._echoAIExtractNavigateBlock(fullResponse);
        fullResponse = _afterNavigate;

        const { text: _afterEnd, endRequest } = window._echoAIExtractEndChatBlock(fullResponse);
        fullResponse = _afterEnd;
        if (endRequest) chat.ended = { reason: endRequest.reason, at: Date.now() };

        const { text: _afterSuggest, suggestions } = window._echoAIExtractSuggestBlock(fullResponse);
        fullResponse = _afterSuggest;

        renderEchoMessage(fullResponse, 'assistant', playRequest, navRequest, endRequest);

        chat.messages.push({ role: 'assistant', content: fullResponse, ...(playRequest ? { playRequest } : {}), ...(navRequest ? { navRequest } : {}), ...(endRequest ? { endRequest } : {}) });
        saveEchoChats();
        if (endRequest) window._applyEchoChatEndedState();
        if (suggestions && !endRequest) window._renderEchoSuggestions(suggestions);

    } catch (error) {
        hidePipeline();
        if (aiBubble && aiBubble.parentElement) {
            aiBubble.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#ff4757;">Could not reach EchoAI. Check your connection and try again.</span>';
        }
        console.error('EchoAI error:', error);
    }
}


let canvasItems = [];
let activeCanvasId = null;
let canvasViewMode = 'preview';

function openCanvas(lang, code, label) {
    const id = Date.now().toString();
    canvasItems.push({ id, lang, code, label: label || lang.toUpperCase() });
    activeCanvasId = id;
    renderCanvasTabs();
    renderCanvasContent();
    document.getElementById('echo-canvas-panel').classList.add('open');
}
window.openCanvas = openCanvas;

function renderCanvasTabs() {
    const tabsEl = document.getElementById('echo-canvas-tabs');
    tabsEl.innerHTML = '';
    canvasItems.forEach(item => {
        const tab = document.createElement('div');
        tab.className = 'canvas-tab' + (item.id === activeCanvasId ? ' active' : '');
        tab.innerText = item.label;
        tab.onclick = () => { activeCanvasId = item.id; renderCanvasTabs(); renderCanvasContent(); };
        tabsEl.appendChild(tab);
    });
}

function renderCanvasContent() {
    const item = canvasItems.find(c => c.id === activeCanvasId);
    if (!item) return;
    const frame = document.getElementById('echo-canvas-frame');
    const codeEl = document.getElementById('echo-canvas-code');
    const badge = document.getElementById('canvas-lang-badge');
    badge.innerText = item.lang.toUpperCase();

    if (canvasViewMode === 'preview') {
        frame.classList.add('active'); codeEl.classList.remove('active');
        document.getElementById('canvas-btn-preview').classList.add('active-tool');
        document.getElementById('canvas-btn-source').classList.remove('active-tool');
        if (item.lang === 'html') {
            frame.srcdoc = item.code;
        } else if (item.lang === 'javascript' || item.lang === 'js') {
            frame.srcdoc = `<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"><\/script></head><body style="background:#111;color:#eee;font-family:sans-serif;padding:16px"><pre id="out" style="white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all"></pre><script>
const _log=console.log;console.log=(...a)=>{document.getElementById('out').innerText+=a.join(' ')+'\n';_log(...a)};
try{${item.code.replace(/`/g,'\`')}}catch(e){document.getElementById('out').innerText+='ERROR: '+e.message}
<\/script>

</body></html>`;
        } else if (item.lang === 'css') {
            frame.srcdoc = `<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><style>${item.code}<\/style></head><body style="background:#111;padding:24px;color:#eee"><div class="preview-root"><h1>CSS Preview</h1><p>Your styles are applied here.</p><button>Button</button><input placeholder="Input"></div></body></html>`;
        } else {
            frame.srcdoc = `<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/highlight.js/11.8.0/styles/atom-one-dark.min.css"><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/highlight.js/11.8.0/highlight.min.js"><\/script></head><body style="margin:0;background:#0d1117;padding:16px"><pre><code class="language-${item.lang}" id="c">${item.code.replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;')}<\/code><\/pre><script>hljs.highlightElement(document.getElementById('c'))<\/script></body></html>`;
        }
    } else {
        frame.classList.remove('active'); codeEl.classList.add('active');
        document.getElementById('canvas-btn-source').classList.add('active-tool');
        document.getElementById('canvas-btn-preview').classList.remove('active-tool');
        codeEl.innerText = item.code;
    }
}

window.reactionPack = () => localStorage.getItem('reaction_pack') === 'legacy' ? 'legacy' : 'polished';
window.setReactionPack = (pack) => {
    localStorage.setItem('reaction_pack', pack === 'legacy' ? 'legacy' : 'polished');
};

window.reactionHtml = (token) => {
    const p = POLISHED_REACTIONS[token];
    if (p) return `<i class="fa-solid ${p.icon}" style="color:${p.color};"></i>`;
    if (typeof token === 'string' && token.startsWith('fa:')) {
        return `<i class="fa-solid fa-circle-dot" style="color:#6b6b8a;"></i>`;
    }
    return window.escHtml ? window.escHtml(token) : token;
};
window.reactionLabel = (token) => POLISHED_REACTIONS[token]?.label
    || (typeof token === 'string' && token.startsWith('fa:') ? 'Retired reaction' : token);

window.quickReactions = () => window.reactionPack() === 'legacy'
    ? ['❤️', '👍', '😂']
    : ['fa:heart', 'fa:thumbs-up', 'fa:face-grin-squint-tears'];

let emojiPickerTargetMsgId = null;

window.openEmojiPicker = (msgId, btn) => {
    emojiPickerTargetMsgId = msgId;
    const picker = document.getElementById('emoji-picker-popup');
    renderEmojiPickerBody();
    const rect = btn.getBoundingClientRect();
    picker.classList.add('open');
    const h = picker.offsetHeight || 330;
    picker.style.top = (rect.top - h - 6 < 10 ? Math.min(rect.bottom + 6, window.innerHeight - h - 10) : rect.top - h - 6) + 'px';
    picker.style.left = Math.min(rect.left, window.innerWidth - 296) + 'px';
    if (window.EchoSFX) window.EchoSFX.play('pop');
    armPickerOutsideClick();
};

function armPickerOutsideClick() {
    document.removeEventListener('click', closeEmojiPickerOutside, true);
    setTimeout(() => document.addEventListener('click', closeEmojiPickerOutside, true), 0);
}

window.closeEmojiPicker = () => {
    document.removeEventListener('click', closeEmojiPickerOutside, true);
    document.getElementById('emoji-picker-popup')?.classList.remove('open');
};

function renderEmojiPickerBody() {
    const picker = document.getElementById('emoji-picker-popup');
    if (!picker) return;
    const pack = window.reactionPack();
    const tabs = `<div class="erp-tabs">
        <button type="button" class="${pack === 'polished' ? 'on' : ''}" onclick="switchReactionPack('polished')">Polished</button>
        <button type="button" class="${pack === 'legacy' ? 'on' : ''}" onclick="switchReactionPack('legacy')">Legacy</button>
    </div>`;
    const grid = pack === 'legacy'
        ? ALL_REACTION_EMOJIS.map(e =>
            `<button type="button" onclick="pickEmojiReaction('${window.escAttr(e)}')">${window.escHtml(e)}</button>`).join('')
        : Object.keys(POLISHED_REACTIONS).map(t =>
            `<button type="button" class="erp-fa" title="${window.escAttr(POLISHED_REACTIONS[t].label)}" onclick="pickEmojiReaction('${window.escAttr(t)}')">${window.reactionHtml(t)}</button>`).join('');
    picker.innerHTML = tabs + `<div class="erp-grid">${grid}</div>`;
}

window.switchReactionPack = (pack) => {
    window.setReactionPack(pack);
    renderEmojiPickerBody();
};

window.pickEmojiReaction = (emoji) => {
    if (emojiPickerTargetMsgId) toggleReaction(emojiPickerTargetMsgId, emoji);
    window.closeEmojiPicker();
};

function closeEmojiPickerOutside(e) {
    const picker = document.getElementById('emoji-picker-popup');
    if (!picker || !picker.classList.contains('open')) return;
    const path = typeof e.composedPath === 'function' ? e.composedPath() : [];
    if (path.indexOf(picker) !== -1 || picker.contains(e.target)) return;
    window.closeEmojiPicker();
}

window.switchCanvasView = (mode) => { canvasViewMode = mode; renderCanvasContent(); };

window.copyCanvasSource = () => {
    const item = canvasItems.find(c => c.id === activeCanvasId);
    if (!item) return;
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(item.code);
    const btn = document.getElementById('canvas-btn-copy');
    btn.innerText = 'Copied!';
    setTimeout(() => { btn.innerText = 'Copy'; }, 2000);
};

window.openCanvasNew = () => {
    const item = canvasItems.find(c => c.id === activeCanvasId);
    if (!item) return;
    const blob = new Blob([item.code], { type: item.lang === 'html' ? 'text/html' : 'text/plain' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    window._allowNextOpen = true;
    window.open(url, '_blank');
};

window._authMode = 'login';
(function () {
    'use strict';
    const ROUNDS = 2;
    const MAX_WRONG = 3;
    const COOLDOWN_MS = 45000;
    const PASS_KEY = 'echo_hg_pass';
    const SIG_STEP = 2.6;
    const NOISE_STEP = 0.85;
    const DRIFT_AMP = 7;
    const DOT = 2.4;
    const GLYPH_FRAC = 0.80;

    let dots = [], mask = null, target = null, round = 0, wrong = 0;
    let raf = null, canvas = null, ctx = null, locked = false;
    let cssW = 300, cssH = 200;

    function sizeCanvas() {
        const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
        const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
        cssW = Math.round(r.width || 300);
        cssH = Math.round(r.height || 200);
        canvas.width = Math.round(cssW * dpr);
        canvas.height = Math.round(cssH * dpr);
        ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
    }

    function buildMask(digit, w, h) {
        const off = document.createElement('canvas');
        off.width = w; off.height = h;
        const c = off.getContext('2d');
        const size = Math.round(h * (GLYPH_FRAC + Math.random() * 0.08));
        c.save();
        c.translate(w / 2 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * w * 0.06,
                    h / 2 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * h * 0.06);
        c.rotate((Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.14);
        c.font = '900 ' + size + 'px "DM Sans", system-ui, sans-serif';
        c.textAlign = 'center'; c.textBaseline = 'middle';
        c.fillStyle = '#fff';
        c.fillText(String(digit), 0, 0);
        c.restore();
        const d = c.getImageData(0, 0, w, h).data;
        return { w, h, ox: 0, oy: 0, at (x, y) {
            const xi = (x - this.ox) | 0, yi = (y - this.oy) | 0;
            if (xi < 0 || yi < 0 || xi >= w || yi >= h) return false;
            return d[(yi * w + xi) * 4 + 3] > 128;
        }};
    }

    function seedDots() {
        const w = cssW, h = cssH;
        dots = [];
        const N = Math.round((w * h) / 62);
        const ang = (Math.random() < 0.5 ? 0 : Math.PI) + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.9;
        const sx = Math.cos(ang) * SIG_STEP, sy = Math.sin(ang) * SIG_STEP;
        for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) dots.push({ x: Math.random() * w, y: Math.random() * h });
        return { sx, sy, t: Math.random() * 100 };
    }

    function draw(vel) {
        const w = cssW, h = cssH;

        vel.t += 0.016;
        mask.ox = Math.sin(vel.t * 0.55) * DRIFT_AMP + Math.sin(vel.t * 0.23) * (DRIFT_AMP * 0.4);
        mask.oy = Math.cos(vel.t * 0.43) * (DRIFT_AMP * 0.7) + Math.cos(vel.t * 0.19) * (DRIFT_AMP * 0.3);

        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#c9c9dd';
        for (const p of dots) {
            if (mask.at(p.x, p.y)) {
                p.x += vel.sx; p.y += vel.sy;
            } else {
                const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
                p.x += Math.cos(a) * NOISE_STEP; p.y += Math.sin(a) * NOISE_STEP;
            }
            if (p.x < 0) p.x += w; else if (p.x >= w) p.x -= w;
            if (p.y < 0) p.y += h; else if (p.y >= h) p.y -= h;
            ctx.fillRect(p.x, p.y, DOT, DOT);
        }
        raf = requestAnimationFrame(() => draw(vel));
    }

    function newRound() {
        if (raf) cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
        target = Math.floor(Math.random() * 10);
        mask = buildMask(target, cssW, cssH);
        const vel = seedDots();
        draw(vel);
    }

    function paintProgress() {
        const box = document.getElementById('hg-progress');
        box.innerHTML = '';
        for (let i = 0; i < ROUNDS; i++) {
            const d = document.createElement('div');
            d.className = 'hg-dot' + (i < round ? ' on' : '');
            box.appendChild(d);
        }
    }

    function msg(text, colour) {
        const el = document.getElementById('hg-msg');
        el.innerText = text;
        el.style.color = colour || '#444455';
    }

    function unlock() {
        if (raf) { cancelAnimationFrame(raf); raf = null; }
        try { sessionStorage.setItem(PASS_KEY, '1'); } catch (_) {}
        document.getElementById('auth-screen').classList.remove('hg-locked');
        if (typeof window.setAuthMode === 'function') window.setAuthMode('signup');
    }

    function isPassed() {
        try { return sessionStorage.getItem(PASS_KEY) === '1'; } catch (_) { return false; }
    }

    function guess(n) {
        if (locked) return;
        if (n === target) {
            round++;
            paintProgress();
            if (round >= ROUNDS) { msg('Verified', '#22c55e'); setTimeout(unlock, 350); return; }
            msg('Good — ' + (ROUNDS - round) + ' to go', '#22c55e');
            newRound();
            return;
        }
        wrong++;
        if (wrong >= MAX_WRONG) {
            locked = true;
            round = 0; wrong = 0;
            paintProgress();
            if (raf) { cancelAnimationFrame(raf); raf = null; }
            ctx.clearRect(0, 0, cssW, cssH);
            let left = Math.ceil(COOLDOWN_MS / 1000);
            msg('Too many misses — wait ' + left + 's', '#ef4444');
            const t = setInterval(() => {
                left--;
                if (left > 0) { msg('Too many misses — wait ' + left + 's', '#ef4444'); return; }
                clearInterval(t);
                locked = false;
                msg('Tap the digit you see');
                newRound();
            }, 1000);
            return;
        }
        msg('Not that one — try again', '#f59e0b');
        newRound();
    }

    window._hgGateSignup = function () {
        canvas = document.getElementById('hg-canvas');
        if (!canvas) return false;
        if (isPassed()) { document.getElementById('auth-screen').classList.remove('hg-locked'); return false; }

        ctx = canvas.getContext('2d', { willReadFrequently: false });
        sizeCanvas();
        const keys = document.getElementById('hg-keys');
        if (!keys.childElementCount) {
            for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
                const b = document.createElement('button');
                b.type = 'button'; b.className = 'hg-key'; b.textContent = String(i);
                b.addEventListener('click', () => guess(i));
                keys.appendChild(b);
            }
            document.getElementById('hg-replay').addEventListener('click', () => {
                if (!locked) { msg('New digit — take a look'); newRound(); }
            });
        }
        document.getElementById('auth-screen').classList.add('hg-locked');
        round = 0; wrong = 0;
        paintProgress();
        msg('Tap the digit you see');
        newRound();
        return true;
    };

    window._hgReleaseGate = function () {
        if (raf) { cancelAnimationFrame(raf); raf = null; }
        document.getElementById('auth-screen').classList.remove('hg-locked');
    };

    window._initHumanGate = function () {
        if (window._authMode !== 'signup') {
            document.getElementById('auth-screen').classList.remove('hg-locked');
        }
    };

    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
        if (document.hidden && raf) { cancelAnimationFrame(raf); raf = null; }
        else if (!document.hidden && !raf && !locked && canvas &&
                 document.getElementById('auth-screen').classList.contains('hg-locked')) {
            newRound();
        }
    });
})();

(function () {
    'use strict';
    let pushed = false;

    function tryPush(el) {
        if (pushed || !el || !el.isConnected) return;
        if (el.getBoundingClientRect().width < 50) return;
        pushed = true;
        _collapseIfUnfilled(el);
        try {
            (window.adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
        } catch (e) {
            console.warn('[ads] adsbygoogle push failed:', e);
        }
    }

    function _collapseIfUnfilled(el) {
        setTimeout(() => {
            const wrap = document.getElementById('ad-empty-wrap');
            if (!wrap || !el.isConnected) return;
            const filled = el.childElementCount > 0 ||
                           el.getAttribute('data-ad-status') === 'filled';
            if (!filled) wrap.style.display = 'none';
        }, 6000);
    }

    window._adInitEmptySlot = function () {
        const el = document.getElementById('ad-empty-slot');
        if (!el || pushed) return;
        tryPush(el);
        if (pushed) return;

        let io = null, poll = null;
        const done = () => {
            if (io) { io.disconnect(); io = null; }
            if (poll) { clearInterval(poll); poll = null; }
        };

        if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
            io = new IntersectionObserver(() => { tryPush(el); if (pushed) done(); },
                                          { threshold: 0.01 });
            io.observe(el);
        }

        poll = setInterval(() => { tryPush(el); if (pushed) done(); }, 1500);
    };

    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => window._adInitEmptySlot());
    } else {
        window._adInitEmptySlot();
    }
})();

window.setAuthMode = (mode) => {
    window._authMode = mode;
    const isSignup = mode === 'signup';
    if (isSignup) {
        if (window._hgGateSignup) window._hgGateSignup();
    } else if (window._hgReleaseGate) {
        window._hgReleaseGate();
    }
    document.getElementById('mode-btn-login').classList.toggle('active', !isSignup);
    document.getElementById('mode-btn-signup').classList.toggle('active', isSignup);
    document.getElementById('auth-mode-pill').style.transform = isSignup ? 'translateX(100%)' : 'translateX(0)';
    document.getElementById('signup-only-fields').classList.toggle('hidden', !isSignup);
    document.getElementById('signup-only-fields').classList.toggle('flex', isSignup);
    document.getElementById('login-btn').classList.toggle('hidden', isSignup);
    document.getElementById('signup-btn').classList.toggle('hidden', !isSignup);
    document.getElementById('auth-error').classList.add('hidden');
};
