let pcmPendingBg   = null;
let pcmPendingBanner = null;
let pcmPendingBannerDisabled = null;
let pcmPendingMusic = null;
let pcmPendingStars = null;
let pcmMusicRemove  = false;
let pcmSavedBio     = null;
const OWNER_EMAIL_FRAGMENT = 'gavinwllms8';

function applyProfileCustomization(uData, autoplay, ownerUID) {
    if (!uData) return;
    const pp = document.getElementById('profile-page');
    if (pp) {
        const bg = uData.profileBg;
        if (bg && bg.type === 'solid')         pp.style.background = bg.value;
        else if (bg && bg.type === 'gradient') pp.style.background = bg.value;
        else if (bg && bg.type === 'image')    pp.style.background = `url('${bg.value}') center/cover no-repeat`;
        else                                   pp.style.background = '';
    }
    const banner    = document.getElementById('profile-banner');
    const avatarWrap = document.querySelector('.profile-avatar-wrap');
    const disabled  = !!uData.bannerDisabled;
    if (banner) {
        if (disabled) {
            banner.classList.add('banner-disabled');
            banner.style.background = '';
        } else {
            banner.classList.remove('banner-disabled');
            if (uData.profileBanner && uData.profileBanner !== '__reset__') {
                banner.style.background = `url('${uData.profileBanner}') center/cover no-repeat`;
            } else {
                banner.style.background = '';
            }
        }
    }
    if (avatarWrap) {
        avatarWrap.style.marginTop = disabled ? '20px' : '';
    }
    const _profileUID = ownerUID || (typeof uid !== 'undefined' && uid) || window._viewingProfileUID;
    if (!_profileUID) return;
    uData._uid = _profileUID;
    window._viewingProfileUID = _profileUID;
    if (Array.isArray(uData.profilePlaylist) && uData.profilePlaylist.length > 0) {
        uData.profilePlaylist = uData.profilePlaylist.map(t => ({ ...t, uploader: t.uploader || _profileUID }));
        uData.profileMusic = uData.profilePlaylist[0];
    } else if (uData.profileMusic && !uData.profileMusic.uploader) {
        uData.profileMusic = { ...uData.profileMusic, uploader: _profileUID };
    }
    _applyProfileMusicBar(uData, !!autoplay);
    window._applyProfileStars && window._applyProfileStars(uData.profileStars);
}

var _vizCtx = null, _vizAnalyser = null, _vizSource = null, _vizRaf = null, _vizAudioCtx = null;

function _startVisualizer(audio) {
    const canvas = document.getElementById('profile-music-visualizer');
    if (!canvas) return;
    canvas.classList.add('active');
    try {
        if (!_vizAudioCtx) {
            _vizAudioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
            _vizAnalyser = _vizAudioCtx.createAnalyser();
            _vizAnalyser.fftSize = 64;
            window._vizAnalyser = _vizAnalyser;
            _vizSource = _vizAudioCtx.createMediaElementSource(audio);
            _vizSource.connect(_vizAnalyser);
            _vizAnalyser.connect(_vizAudioCtx.destination);
        }
        if (_vizAudioCtx.state === 'suspended') _vizAudioCtx.resume();
    } catch(e) {
        if (_vizAnalyser && _vizAudioCtx && _vizAudioCtx.state === 'suspended') _vizAudioCtx.resume();
        if (!_vizAnalyser) return;
    }
    _vizCtx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    const buf = new Uint8Array(_vizAnalyser.frequencyBinCount);
    function draw() {
        _vizRaf = requestAnimationFrame(draw);
        _vizAnalyser.getByteFrequencyData(buf);
        const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
        const W = canvas.offsetWidth, H = canvas.offsetHeight;
        canvas.width = W * dpr; canvas.height = H * dpr;
        _vizCtx.scale(dpr, dpr);
        _vizCtx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
        const bars = 28;
        const barW = (W / bars) * 0.55, gap = (W / bars) * 0.45;
        for (let i = 0; i < bars; i++) {
            const idx = Math.floor(i * buf.length / bars);
            const val = buf[idx] / 255;
            const h = Math.max(2, val * H * 0.9);
            const x = i * (barW + gap) + gap / 2;
            const grad = _vizCtx.createLinearGradient(0, H, 0, H - h);
            grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(79,70,229,0.95)');
            grad.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(129,140,248,0.85)');
            grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(196,181,253,0.7)');
            _vizCtx.fillStyle = grad;
            _vizCtx.beginPath();
            if (_vizCtx.roundRect) _vizCtx.roundRect(x, H - h, barW, h, 2);
            else { _vizCtx.rect(x, H - h, barW, h); }
            _vizCtx.fill();
        }
    }
    draw();
}

(function() {
    let _lyricsLines      = [];
    let _lyricsRaf        = null;
    let _lyricsActive     = false;
    let _lyricsLastIdx    = -1;
    let _pendingLyricsText = null;

    function _parseLrc(raw) {
        const lines = [];
        const re = /\[(\d{1,3}):(\d{2})(?:[.:](\d{1,3}))?\](.*)/g;
        let m;
        while ((m = re.exec(raw)) !== null) {
            const min = parseInt(m[1], 10);
            const sec = parseInt(m[2], 10);
            const ms  = m[3] ? parseInt(m[3].padEnd(3, '0').slice(0, 3), 10) : 0;
            const text = (m[4] || '').trim();
            if (text) lines.push({ time: min * 60 + sec + ms / 1000, text });
        }
        return lines.sort((a, b) => a.time - b.time);
    }

    function _parseSrt(raw) {
        const lines = [];
        const blocks = raw.trim().split(/\n\n+/);
        for (const block of blocks) {
            const rows = block.split('\n').map(r => r.trim()).filter(Boolean);
            if (rows.length < 2) continue;
            const timeRow = rows.find(r => r.includes('-->'));
            if (!timeRow) continue;
            const start = timeRow.split('-->')[0].trim();
            const parts = start.split(/[:,]/);
            if (parts.length < 4) continue;
            const secs = parseInt(parts[0],10)*3600 + parseInt(parts[1],10)*60 + parseInt(parts[2],10) + parseInt(parts[3],10)/1000;
            const text = rows.slice(rows.indexOf(timeRow) + 1).join(' ').replace(/<[^>]+>/g, '').trim();
            if (text) lines.push({ time: secs, text });
        }
        return lines.sort((a, b) => a.time - b.time);
    }

    function _parsePlain(raw, audioDuration) {
        const rows = raw.split('\n').map(r => r.trim()).filter(Boolean);
        const dur = audioDuration || 180;
        return rows.map((text, i) => ({ time: (i / rows.length) * dur, text }));
    }

    function _parse(raw, filename, audioDuration) {
        const ext = (filename || '').split('.').pop().toLowerCase();
        if (ext === 'lrc' || /\[\d+:\d+/.test(raw)) return _parseLrc(raw);
        if (ext === 'srt' || /-->/i.test(raw))       return _parseSrt(raw);
        return _parsePlain(raw, audioDuration);
    }

    function _buildLines(lines) {
        const scroll = document.getElementById('profile-music-lyrics-scroll');
        if (!scroll) return;
        scroll.innerHTML = '';
        const spacer = () => { const s = document.createElement('div'); s.style.cssText = 'height:10px;flex-shrink:0;'; return s; };
        scroll.appendChild(spacer());
        for (const l of lines) {
            const el = document.createElement('div');
            el.className = 'pm-lyric-line';
            el.dataset.t = l.time;
            el.textContent = l.text;
            scroll.appendChild(el);
        }
        scroll.appendChild(spacer());
    }

    function _syncTick() {
        const audio = document.getElementById('profile-music-audio');
        const panel = document.getElementById('profile-music-lyrics-panel');
        if (!audio || !panel || !_lyricsActive) { _lyricsRaf = null; return; }
        _lyricsRaf = requestAnimationFrame(_syncTick);

        const t = audio.currentTime;
        if (!_lyricsLines.length) return;

        let activeIdx = -1;
        for (let i = 0; i < _lyricsLines.length; i++) {
            if (_lyricsLines[i].time <= t + 0.15) activeIdx = i;
            else break;
        }
        if (activeIdx === _lyricsLastIdx) return;
        _lyricsLastIdx = activeIdx;

        const scroll = document.getElementById('profile-music-lyrics-scroll');
        if (!scroll) return;
        const lineDivs = scroll.querySelectorAll('.pm-lyric-line');
        lineDivs.forEach((el, i) => {
            el.classList.remove('pm-lyric-active', 'pm-lyric-near');
            if (i === activeIdx) el.classList.add('pm-lyric-active');
            else if (i === activeIdx - 1 || i === activeIdx + 1) el.classList.add('pm-lyric-near');
        });

        const panel_h = panel.offsetHeight || 40;
        if (activeIdx >= 0 && lineDivs[activeIdx]) {
            const activeEl = lineDivs[activeIdx];
            const offsetTop = activeEl.offsetTop;
            const lineH    = activeEl.offsetHeight;
            const target   = offsetTop - (panel_h / 2) + (lineH / 2);
            scroll.style.transform = `translateY(${-Math.max(0, target)}px)`;
        }
    }

    window._pmLoadLyricsText = function(rawText, filename) {
        const audio = document.getElementById('profile-music-audio');
        const panel = document.getElementById('profile-music-lyrics-panel');
        const btn   = document.getElementById('pm-lyrics-btn');
        if (!panel) return;

        if (_lyricsRaf) { cancelAnimationFrame(_lyricsRaf); _lyricsRaf = null; }
        _lyricsLastIdx = -1;

        if (!rawText) {
            _lyricsLines = [];
            if (btn) btn.classList.add('pm-lyrics-hidden');
            panel.classList.remove('active');
            const canvas = document.getElementById('profile-music-visualizer');
            if (canvas && canvas.classList.contains('was-active')) canvas.classList.add('active');
            return;
        }

        _lyricsLines = _parse(rawText, filename || '', audio?.duration || 0);
        _buildLines(_lyricsLines);

        if (btn) btn.classList.remove('pm-lyrics-hidden');
    };

    window._pmToggleLyrics = function() {
        const panel  = document.getElementById('profile-music-lyrics-panel');
        const canvas = document.getElementById('profile-music-visualizer');
        const btn    = document.getElementById('pm-lyrics-btn');
        if (!panel) return;

        const showingLyrics = panel.classList.contains('active');

        if (showingLyrics) {
            panel.style.opacity = '0';
            setTimeout(() => {
                panel.classList.remove('active');
                panel.style.opacity = '';
                _lyricsActive = false;
                if (_lyricsRaf) { cancelAnimationFrame(_lyricsRaf); _lyricsRaf = null; }
                _lyricsLastIdx = -1;
                const audio = document.getElementById('profile-music-audio');
                if (canvas && audio && !audio.paused) canvas.classList.add('active');
            }, 380);
            if (btn) btn.classList.remove('pm-lyrics-active');
        } else {
            if (canvas) canvas.classList.remove('active');
            panel.style.opacity = '0';
            panel.classList.add('active');
            void panel.offsetWidth;
            panel.style.transition = 'opacity 0.45s ease';
            panel.style.opacity = '1';
            _lyricsActive = true;
            _lyricsLastIdx = -1;
            _lyricsRaf = requestAnimationFrame(_syncTick);
            if (btn) btn.classList.add('pm-lyrics-active');
        }
    };

    window._pmStopLyrics = function() {
        _lyricsActive = false;
        _lyricsLastIdx = -1;
        if (_lyricsRaf) { cancelAnimationFrame(_lyricsRaf); _lyricsRaf = null; }
        const panel = document.getElementById('profile-music-lyrics-panel');
        if (panel) panel.classList.remove('active');
        const btn = document.getElementById('pm-lyrics-btn');
        if (btn) { btn.classList.remove('pm-lyrics-active'); btn.classList.add('pm-lyrics-hidden'); }
        const scroll = document.getElementById('profile-music-lyrics-scroll');
        if (scroll) { scroll.innerHTML = ''; scroll.style.transform = ''; }
        _lyricsLines = [];
    };

    window._pmResumeLyricsSync = function() {
        if (_lyricsActive && _lyricsLines.length && !_lyricsRaf) {
            _lyricsLastIdx = -1;
            _lyricsRaf = requestAnimationFrame(_syncTick);
        }
    };

    window._pmPendingLyricsText  = null;
    window._pmPendingLyricsName  = null;

    window._pcmClearPendingLyrics = function() {
        window._pmPendingLyricsText = null;
        window._pmPendingLyricsName = null;
        const dropRow    = document.getElementById('pcm-lyrics-drop-row');
        const loadedRow  = document.getElementById('pcm-lyrics-loaded-row');
        if (dropRow)   dropRow.style.display   = '';
        if (loadedRow) loadedRow.style.display  = 'none';
    };

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
        const lyricsInput = document.getElementById('pcm-lyrics-upload');
        if (!lyricsInput) return;
        lyricsInput.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
            const file = e.target.files[0]; if (!file) return;
            e.target.value = '';
            const reader = new FileReader();
            reader.onload = (ev) => {
                const text = ev.target.result;
                window._pmPendingLyricsText = text;
                window._pmPendingLyricsName = file.name;
                const dropRow   = document.getElementById('pcm-lyrics-drop-row');
                const loadedRow = document.getElementById('pcm-lyrics-loaded-row');
                const nameEl    = document.getElementById('pcm-lyrics-loaded-name');
                if (dropRow)   dropRow.style.display   = 'none';
                if (loadedRow) loadedRow.style.display  = '';
                if (nameEl)    nameEl.textContent        = file.name;
            };
            reader.readAsText(file, 'utf-8');
        });
    });

    window._pcmEditTrackLyrics = async function(idx) {
        const snap = await getDoc(doc(db, 'users', myUID));
        const uData = snap.exists() ? snap.data() : {};
        let playlist = Array.isArray(uData.profilePlaylist) ? [...uData.profilePlaylist] : (uData.profileMusic ? [uData.profileMusic] : []);
        const track = playlist[idx];
        if (!track) return;

        const inp = document.createElement('input');
        inp.type = 'file'; inp.accept = '.lrc,.srt,.txt';
        inp.onchange = async (e) => {
            const file = e.target.files[0]; if (!file) return;
            const reader = new FileReader();
            reader.onload = async (ev) => {
                const text = ev.target.result;
                playlist[idx] = { ...track, lyricsText: text, lyricsName: file.name };
                const updates = { profilePlaylist: playlist, profileMusic: playlist[0] };
                await updateDoc(doc(db, 'users', myUID), updates);
                const isOwnerSession = window._myRole === 'owner' || window.isAdmin === true;
                await _pcmRenderPlaylist({ ...uData, profilePlaylist: playlist, profileMusic: playlist[0] }, isOwnerSession);
                const curMu = document.getElementById('profile-music-title');
                if (curMu && curMu.textContent === (track.name || 'Profile Track')) {
                    window._pmLoadLyricsText(text, file.name);
                }
            };
            reader.readAsText(file, 'utf-8');
        };
        inp.click();
    };

})();

function _stopVisualizer() {
    if (_vizRaf) { cancelAnimationFrame(_vizRaf); _vizRaf = null; }
    const canvas = document.getElementById('profile-music-visualizer');
    if (canvas) { canvas.classList.remove('active'); if (_vizCtx) _vizCtx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height); }
}

function _applyProfileMusicBar(uData, autoplay) {
    const bar   = document.getElementById('profile-music-bar');
    const audio = document.getElementById('profile-music-audio');
    const art   = document.getElementById('profile-music-art');
    const title = document.getElementById('profile-music-title');
    const sub   = document.getElementById('profile-music-sub');
    const btn   = document.getElementById('profile-music-toggle');
    const vol   = document.getElementById('profile-music-vol');
    const progWrap = document.getElementById('profile-music-progress-wrap');
    const progFill = document.getElementById('profile-music-progress-fill');
    const elapsed  = document.getElementById('profile-music-elapsed');
    const duration = document.getElementById('profile-music-duration');
    if (!bar || !audio) return;
    if (!uData?.profileMusic) { bar.classList.remove('visible'); return; }
    const mu = uData.profileMusic;

    const targetUID = mu.uploader || uData._uid || window._viewingProfileUID;
    if (!targetUID) {
        if (sub) { sub.textContent = 'Cannot load — unknown track owner'; sub.style.color = '#f87171'; }
        return;
    }
    const targetSlotKey = mu.slotKey || null;

    const _doPlay = () => {
        if (_vizAudioCtx && _vizAudioCtx.state === 'suspended') _vizAudioCtx.resume();
        audio.play().then(() => {
            document.getElementById('pm-icon-play').style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('pm-icon-pause').style.display = '';
            if (art) art.classList.add('spinning');
            if (progWrap) progWrap.classList.add('active');
            const subEl = document.getElementById('profile-music-sub');
            if (subEl) { subEl.textContent = '♫ Now Playing'; subEl.style.color = '#6666aa'; }
            const lyrPanel = document.getElementById('profile-music-lyrics-panel');
            if (!lyrPanel || !lyrPanel.classList.contains('active')) {
                _startVisualizer(audio);
            }
            if (typeof window._pmResumeLyricsSync === 'function') window._pmResumeLyricsSync();
        }).catch(e => {
            console.warn('[Music] autoplay blocked, showing paused state:', e);
            document.getElementById('pm-icon-play').style.display = '';
            document.getElementById('pm-icon-pause').style.display = 'none';
            bar.classList.add('visible');
            if (progWrap) progWrap.classList.add('active');
            const subEl = document.getElementById('profile-music-sub');
            if (subEl) { subEl.textContent = '♫ Tap ▶ to play'; subEl.style.color = '#6666aa'; }
        });
    };

    const _setupAudio = (src) => {
        audio.src = src;
        audio.volume = vol.value / 100;
        bar.classList.add('visible');
        audio.addEventListener('loadedmetadata', () => {
            if (progWrap) progWrap.classList.add('active');
        }, { once: true });
        audio.addEventListener('error', () => {
            const err = audio.error;
            const codes = { 1: 'MEDIA_ERR_ABORTED', 2: 'MEDIA_ERR_NETWORK', 3: 'MEDIA_ERR_DECODE', 4: 'MEDIA_ERR_SRC_NOT_SUPPORTED' };
            const code = err ? (codes[err.code] || ('code ' + err.code)) : 'unknown';
            const detail = (err?.message && err.message.trim()) ? ' — ' + err.message : '';
            const subEl = document.getElementById('profile-music-sub');
            if (subEl) { subEl.textContent = 'Failed to load — ' + code + detail; subEl.style.color = '#f87171'; }
        }, { once: true });
        if (autoplay) {
            audio.addEventListener('canplay', () => { _doPlay(); }, { once: true });
        }
        audio.load();
    };

    audio.pause();
    _stopVisualizer();
    if (typeof window._pmStopLyrics === 'function') window._pmStopLyrics();
    document.getElementById('pm-icon-play').style.display = '';
    document.getElementById('pm-icon-pause').style.display = 'none';
    art.classList.remove('spinning');
    progWrap.classList.remove('active');

    if (mu.artUrl) { art.src = mu.artUrl; art.style.display = ''; }
    else { art.style.display = 'none'; }
    title.textContent = mu.name || 'Profile Track';
    bar.classList.add('visible');
    if (sub) { sub.textContent = 'Loading song…'; sub.style.color = '#6666aa'; }

    if (typeof window._pmLoadLyricsText === 'function') {
        window._pmLoadLyricsText(mu.lyricsText || null, mu.lyricsName || '');
    }

    let _musicPending = false;
    const _loadChunkedMusicNow = () => window.loadChunkedMusic(targetUID, targetSlotKey, mu.uploadedAt).then(blobUrl => {
            if (blobUrl) {
                if (sub) { sub.textContent = '♫ Now Playing'; sub.style.color = '#6666aa'; }
                _setupAudio(blobUrl);
            } else {
                if (sub) { sub.textContent = 'Failed to load — no chunks found'; sub.style.color = '#f87171'; }
            }
        }).catch(err => {
            const msg = err?.message || String(err) || 'Unknown error';
            if (sub) { sub.textContent = 'Failed to load — ' + msg; sub.style.color = '#f87171'; }
        });
    if (mu.chunked) {
        if (autoplay) _loadChunkedMusicNow();
        else { _musicPending = true; if (sub) { sub.textContent = 'Tap play to load'; sub.style.color = '#6666aa'; } }
    } else if (mu.url) {
        if (sub) { sub.textContent = '♫ Now Playing'; sub.style.color = '#6666aa'; }
        _setupAudio(mu.url);
    }

    vol.oninput = () => {
        audio.volume = vol.value / 100;
        vol.style.setProperty('--vol', vol.value + '%');
    };
    vol.style.setProperty('--vol', vol.value + '%');
    audio.volume = vol.value / 100;

    btn.onclick = () => {
        if (_musicPending) {
            _musicPending = false;
            autoplay = true;
            if (sub) { sub.textContent = 'Loading song…'; sub.style.color = '#6666aa'; }
            _loadChunkedMusicNow();
            return;
        }
        if (audio.paused) { _doPlay(); }
        else {
            audio.pause();
            document.getElementById('pm-icon-play').style.display = '';
            document.getElementById('pm-icon-pause').style.display = 'none';
            art.classList.remove('spinning');
            _stopVisualizer();
            if (typeof window._pmResumeLyricsSync === 'function') {
                if (window._pmLyricsRafCancel) window._pmLyricsRafCancel();
            }
        }
    };

    const playlist = Array.isArray(uData.profilePlaylist) ? uData.profilePlaylist : (uData.profileMusic ? [uData.profileMusic] : []);
    const currentIdx = playlist.findIndex(t =>
        (t.slotKey && t.slotKey === mu.slotKey) || (!t.slotKey && !mu.slotKey && t.name === mu.name)
    );
    const prevBtn = document.getElementById('profile-music-prev');
    const nextBtn = document.getElementById('profile-music-next');
    if (prevBtn) {
        prevBtn.disabled = playlist.length <= 1;
        prevBtn.onclick = () => {
            if (playlist.length <= 1) return;
            const idx = (currentIdx - 1 + playlist.length) % playlist.length;
            _applyProfileMusicBar({ ...uData, profileMusic: playlist[idx] }, true);
        };
    }
    if (nextBtn) {
        nextBtn.disabled = playlist.length <= 1;
        nextBtn.onclick = () => {
            if (playlist.length <= 1) return;
            const idx = (currentIdx + 1) % playlist.length;
            _applyProfileMusicBar({ ...uData, profileMusic: playlist[idx] }, true);
        };
    }

    audio.ontimeupdate = () => {
        if (!audio.duration) return;
        const pct = (audio.currentTime / audio.duration) * 100;
        if (progFill) progFill.style.width = pct + '%';
        if (elapsed)  elapsed.textContent = _fmtTime(audio.currentTime);
        if (duration) duration.textContent = _fmtTime(audio.duration);
    };

    if (progWrap) progWrap.onclick = (e) => {
        const rect = progWrap.getBoundingClientRect();
        const pct = (e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width;
        audio.currentTime = pct * audio.duration;
    };

    audio.onended = () => {
        document.getElementById('pm-icon-play').style.display = '';
        document.getElementById('pm-icon-pause').style.display = 'none';
        art.classList.remove('spinning');
        _stopVisualizer(); progWrap.classList.remove('active');
        if (progFill) progFill.style.width = '0%';

        const playlist = uData.profilePlaylist;
        if (Array.isArray(playlist) && playlist.length > 1) {
            const currentIdx = playlist.findIndex(t => t.slotKey === mu.slotKey && t.uploader === mu.uploader);
            const nextIdx = (currentIdx + 1) % playlist.length;
            const nextTrack = playlist[nextIdx];
            if (nextTrack) {
                _applyProfileMusicBar({ ...uData, profileMusic: nextTrack }, true);
            }
        }
    };
}

function applyProfileBadges(targetUID, targetEmail) {
    const ownerBadge = document.getElementById('profile-page-badge-owner');
    const adminBadge = document.getElementById('profile-page-badge-admin');
    if (!ownerBadge || !adminBadge) return;
    const isOwner = targetEmail && targetEmail.includes(OWNER_EMAIL_FRAGMENT);
    ownerBadge.classList.toggle('hidden', !isOwner);
    if (isOwner) adminBadge.classList.add('hidden');
}

window.openPCM = async () => {
    if (!window.myUID && !window.GUEST_MODE) return;
    document.getElementById('profile-customize-modal').classList.add('open');
    pcmPendingBg = null; pcmPendingBanner = null;
    pcmPendingBannerDisabled = null; pcmPendingMusic = null; pcmMusicRemove = false;
    pcmInitCanvas();
    document.getElementById('pcm-bg-preview').classList.add('hidden');
    if (window.GUEST_MODE) { _guestPrepPCM(); return; }
    if (typeof window._pcmLoadEffectsTab === 'function') window._pcmLoadEffectsTab();
    try {
        const snap = await getDoc(doc(db, 'users', myUID));
        const uData = snap.exists() ? snap.data() : {};
        const toggle = document.getElementById('pcm-banner-disabled-toggle');
        if (toggle) {
            toggle.checked = !!uData.bannerDisabled;
            _pcmUpdateBannerContent(!!uData.bannerDisabled);
        }
        const bioInput = document.getElementById('pcm-bio-input');
        if (bioInput) {
            bioInput.value = (typeof uData.bio === 'string' ? uData.bio : '');
            pcmSavedBio = bioInput.value;
            window.pcmBioCount();
        }
        const statusEl   = document.getElementById('pcm-music-status');
        const filenameEl = document.getElementById('pcm-music-filename');
        const removeBtn  = document.getElementById('pcm-music-remove');
        const isOwnerSession = window._myRole === 'owner' || window.isAdmin === true;
        const hasMusicAccess = isOwnerSession || window._hasPerm('canUploadMusic');
        const ownerGate = document.getElementById('pcm-music-owner-gate');
        const ownerContent = document.getElementById('pcm-music-owner-content');
        if (ownerGate && ownerContent) {
            ownerGate.style.display = hasMusicAccess ? 'none' : 'block';
            ownerContent.style.display = hasMusicAccess ? 'block' : 'none';
        }
        const starsRow = document.getElementById('pcm-stars-row');
        if (starsRow) starsRow.style.display = isOwnerSession ? 'block' : 'none';
        if (isOwnerSession) {
            const starsToggle = document.getElementById('pcm-stars-toggle');
            if (starsToggle) starsToggle.checked = !!uData.profileStars;
            pcmPendingStars = null;
        }
        if (hasMusicAccess) {
            const MAX_SONGS = isOwnerSession ? 10 : 3;
            const limitLabel = document.getElementById('pcm-music-limit-label');
            if (limitLabel) limitLabel.textContent = `Upload up to ${MAX_SONGS} tracks. The first track auto-plays for visitors. ${isOwnerSession ? '' : '(Limit: 3 songs)'}`;
            await _pcmRenderPlaylist(uData, isOwnerSession);
        }
    } catch(_) {}
};

window.closePCM = () => {

};

window.pcmBioCount = () => {
    const input = document.getElementById('pcm-bio-input');
    const label = document.getElementById('pcm-bio-count');
    if (!input || !label) return;
    const n = input.value.length;
    label.innerText = `${n} / ${window.MAX_BIO_LEN}`;
    label.style.color = n >= window.MAX_BIO_LEN ? '#fbbf24' : '#444455';
};
window.pcmClearBio = () => {
    const input = document.getElementById('pcm-bio-input');
    if (input) { input.value = ''; window.pcmBioCount(); }
};

    document.querySelectorAll('.pcm-tab').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
    document.querySelectorAll('.pcm-section').forEach(s => s.classList.remove('active'));
    btn.classList.add('active');
    document.getElementById('pcm-' + section).classList.add('active');
    if (section === 'banner') setTimeout(pcmInitCanvas, 50);
};

(function(){
    const QUICK = [
        {id:'dQw4w9WgXcQ',title:'Never Gonna Give You Up',ch:'Rick Astley'},
        {id:'9bZkp7q19f0',title:'GANGNAM STYLE',ch:'PSY'},
        {id:'kJQP7kiw5Fk',title:'Despacito',ch:'Luis Fonsi'},
        {id:'JGwWNGJdvx8',title:'Shape of You',ch:'Ed Sheeran'},
        {id:'OPf0YbXqDm0',title:'Uptown Funk',ch:'Mark Ronson'},
        {id:'RgKAFK5djSk',title:'See You Again',ch:'Wiz Khalifa'},
    ];
    const LS_KEY = 'echospace_watch_saved';

    function extractYtId(url){
        try{
            const u = new URL(url);
            const list = u.searchParams.get('list');
            if(list) return {type:'playlist', id:list};
            const v = u.searchParams.get('v');
            if(v) return {type:'video', id:v};
            const parts = u.pathname.split('/').filter(Boolean);
            if(parts[0]==='channel'||parts[0]==='c'||parts[0]==='user'||u.pathname.startsWith('/@')){
                const raw = parts[parts.length-1].replace(/^@/,'');
                return {type:'channel', id:'UU'+raw};
            }
        }catch(e){}
        return null;
    }

    let ytApiLoading = false;
    const ytApiCallbacks = [];
    function ensureYtApi(cb){
        if(window.YT && window.YT.Player){ cb(); return; }
        ytApiCallbacks.push(cb);
        if(ytApiLoading) return;
        ytApiLoading = true;
        const prevReady = window.onYouTubeIframeAPIReady;
        window.onYouTubeIframeAPIReady = function(){
            if(typeof prevReady === 'function') prevReady();
            ytApiCallbacks.forEach(fn=>{ try{ fn(); }catch(e){} });
            ytApiCallbacks.length = 0;
        };
        window.ECHO_YT.script('https://www.youtube.com/iframe_api', function (ok) {
            if (!ok) ytApiLoading = false;
        });
    }

    function embedSrc(parsed){
        const origin = encodeURIComponent(window.location.origin);
        if(parsed.type==='video') return window.ECHO_YT.url(`${window.ECHO_YT_HOST}/embed/${parsed.id}?autoplay=0&enablejsapi=1&origin=${origin}`);
        return window.ECHO_YT.url(`${window.ECHO_YT_HOST}/embed/videoseries?list=${parsed.id}&autoplay=0&enablejsapi=1&origin=${origin}`);
    }

    function watchUrl(parsed){
        if(parsed.type==='video') return `https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=${parsed.id}`;
        if(parsed.type==='playlist') return `https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=${parsed.id}`;
        return `https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=${parsed.id}`;
    }

    function hideWatchFallback(){
        document.getElementById('watch-fallback').classList.add('hidden');
    }

    const YT_ERROR_LABELS = {
        2: 'Invalid video ID',
        5: 'HTML5 player error',
        100: 'Video not found, private, or removed',
        101: 'Embedding disabled by uploader',
        150: 'Embedding disabled by uploader',
    };
    const READY_TIMEOUT_MS = 7000;

    function showWatchFallback(parsed, title, code){
        const thumb = document.getElementById('watch-fallback-thumb');
        const titleEl = document.getElementById('watch-fallback-title');
        const reasonEl = document.getElementById('watch-fallback-reason');
        const link = document.getElementById('watch-fallback-link');
        if(parsed.type==='video'){
            thumb.style.display='';
            thumb.dataset.fallbackStep='0';
            thumb.src = `https://img.youtube.com/vi/${parsed.id}/maxresdefault.jpg`;
            thumb.onerror = function(){
                const step = this.dataset.fallbackStep;
                if(step==='0'){ this.dataset.fallbackStep='1'; this.src=`https://img.youtube.com/vi/${parsed.id}/hqdefault.jpg`; }
                else { this.style.display='none'; }
            };
        } else {
            thumb.style.display='none';
        }
        titleEl.textContent = title || (parsed.type==='video' ? 'This video' : 'This playlist') + ' isn\u2019t available to embed.';
        if(code === 'stalled'){
            reasonEl.textContent = 'Error 153 (suspected) \u2014 player never finished loading';
            reasonEl.classList.remove('hidden');
        } else if(code !== undefined && code !== null){
            const label = YT_ERROR_LABELS[code];
            reasonEl.textContent = label ? `Error ${code} \u2014 ${label}` : `Error ${code}`;
            reasonEl.classList.remove('hidden');
        } else {
            reasonEl.classList.add('hidden');
        }
        link.href = watchUrl(parsed);
        document.getElementById('watch-fallback').classList.remove('hidden');
    }

    const LS_HIST = 'echospace_watch_history';
    const LS_TS   = 'echospace_watch_timestamps';

    function _fmtTime(s){
        s = Math.floor(s);
        const h = Math.floor(s/3600), m = Math.floor((s%3600)/60), sec = s%60;
        if(h) return `${h}:${String(m).padStart(2,'0')}:${String(sec).padStart(2,'0')}`;
        return `${m}:${String(sec).padStart(2,'0')}`;
    }

    function _getSavedTs(videoId){
        try{ return (JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(LS_TS)||'{}')||{})[videoId] || 0; }catch(e){ return 0; }
    }
    function _saveTs(videoId, seconds){
        try{
            const map = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(LS_TS)||'{}');
            map[videoId] = Math.floor(seconds);
            localStorage.setItem(LS_TS, JSON.stringify(map));
        }catch(e){}
    }

    let _tsInterval = null;

    function bindPlayerErrorDetection(parsed){
        if(!window.YT || !window.YT.Player) return;
        let settled = false;
        if(_tsInterval){ clearInterval(_tsInterval); _tsInterval = null; }
        try{
            const player = new YT.Player(document.getElementById('watch-iframe'), {
                events: {
                    onReady: () => {
                        if(settled) return;
                        settled = true;
                        hideWatchFallback();
                        if(parsed.type === 'video'){
                            _tsInterval = setInterval(()=>{
                                try{
                                    const t = player.getCurrentTime ? player.getCurrentTime() : 0;
                                    if(t > 5) _saveTs(parsed.id, t);
                                }catch(e){}
                            }, 5000);
                        }
                    },
                    onError: (e) => {
                        if(settled) return;
                        let title = null;
                        try{ title = e.target.getVideoData && e.target.getVideoData().title; }catch(err){}
                        console.warn('[watch] YouTube player error', e.data, 'for', parsed);

                        if (_watchTryProxyRetry(parsed, 'player error ' + e.data)) return;

                        settled = true;
                        showWatchFallback(parsed, title, e.data);
                    },
                    onStateChange: (e) => {
                        if(parsed.type !== 'video') return;
                        const PAUSED = 2, ENDED = 0;
                        if(e.data === ENDED){
                            let dur = 0;
                            try{ dur = (e.target.getDuration && e.target.getDuration()) || 0; }catch(err){}
                            if(dur < 1 && _watchTryProxyRetry(parsed, 'ended with no duration')) return;
                        }
                        if(e.data === PAUSED || e.data === ENDED){
                            try{
                                const t = e.target.getCurrentTime ? e.target.getCurrentTime() : 0;
                                if(t > 5) _saveTs(parsed.id, t);
                            }catch(err){}
                        }
                    }
                }
            });
        }catch(e){   }
    }

    function _watchTryProxyRetry(parsed, why) {
        const id = parsed && parsed.id;
        if (!id) return false;
        window._watchProxyRetried = window._watchProxyRetried || {};
        if (window._watchProxyRetried[id]) return false;
        if (!window.ECHO_YT || typeof window.ECHO_YT.force !== 'function') return false;
        window._watchProxyRetried[id] = 1;
        window._diag && window._diag('watch', 'proxy retry for ' + id + ' (' + why + ')');
        window.ECHO_YT.force(true).then(() => {
            const fr = document.getElementById('watch-iframe');
            if (fr) fr.src = embedSrc(parsed);
        });
        return true;
    }

    function loadIntoPlayer(parsed, meta){
        hideWatchFallback();
        if(_tsInterval){ clearInterval(_tsInterval); _tsInterval = null; }

        document.getElementById('watch-iframe').src = embedSrc(parsed);
        document.getElementById('watch-player-wrap').style.display = 'block';
        const openLink = document.getElementById('watch-open-yt');
        openLink.href = watchUrl(parsed);

        const titleEl  = document.getElementById('watch-now-title');
        const chanEl   = document.getElementById('watch-now-channel');
        const tsLabel  = document.getElementById('watch-last-ts');
        const tsValEl  = document.getElementById('watch-last-ts-val');
        if(meta){ titleEl.textContent = meta.title||''; chanEl.textContent = meta.artist||''; }
        else { titleEl.textContent = parsed.type==='video' ? '' : 'Playlist'; chanEl.textContent = ''; }

        if(parsed.type === 'video'){
            const savedSecs = _getSavedTs(parsed.id);
            if(savedSecs > 5){
                tsValEl.textContent = _fmtTime(savedSecs);
                tsLabel.style.display = 'block';
            } else {
                tsLabel.style.display = 'none';
            }
        } else {
            tsLabel.style.display = 'none';
        }

        ensureYtApi(() => bindPlayerErrorDetection(parsed));

        if(parsed.type === 'video'){
            const title   = (meta && meta.title)  || titleEl.textContent || '';
            const channel = (meta && meta.artist) || '';
            const thumb   = `https://img.youtube.com/vi/${parsed.id}/mqdefault.jpg`;
            const url     = watchUrl(parsed);
            let hist = [];
            try{ hist = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(LS_HIST)||'[]'); }catch(e){}
            hist = hist.filter(h => h.videoId !== parsed.id);
            hist.unshift({ videoId: parsed.id, url, title, channel, thumb, watchedAt: Date.now() });
            localStorage.setItem(LS_HIST, JSON.stringify(hist.slice(0, 50)));
        }
    }

    window.echoWatchLoad = function(){
        const val = (document.getElementById('watch-url-input')||{}).value?.trim();
        const err = document.getElementById('watch-err');
        err.style.display = 'none';
        if(!val){err.textContent='Paste a YouTube URL first.';err.style.display='block';return;}
        const parsed = extractYtId(val);
        if(!parsed){err.textContent='Could not read that URL. Try a video or playlist link.';err.style.display='block';return;}
        loadIntoPlayer(parsed);
    };

    window.echoWatchSaveCurrent = function(){
        const val = (document.getElementById('watch-url-input')||{}).value?.trim();
        if(!val) return;
        const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(LS_KEY)||'[]');
        if(saved.find(s=>s.url===val)) return;
        const title = document.getElementById('watch-now-title')?.textContent || val;
        const label = title.length > 50 ? title.slice(0,47)+'…' : title;
        saved.unshift({url:val, label});
        localStorage.setItem(LS_KEY, JSON.stringify(saved.slice(0,20)));
        const btn = document.getElementById('watch-save-btn');
        if(btn){ btn.textContent='✓ Saved'; setTimeout(()=>{ btn.textContent='＋ Save'; },1500); }
        renderSaved();
    };

    window.echoWatchTab = function(tab){
        document.getElementById('watch-panel-search').style.display  = tab==='search'  ? 'block' : 'none';
        document.getElementById('watch-panel-shorts').style.display  = tab==='shorts'  ? 'block' : 'none';
        document.getElementById('watch-panel-saved').style.display   = tab==='saved'   ? 'block' : 'none';
        document.getElementById('watch-panel-history').style.display = tab==='history' ? 'block' : 'none';
        const activeStyle  = 'flex:1;padding:7px 12px;border-radius:8px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0.05em;text-transform:uppercase;border:none;cursor:pointer;transition:all 0.15s;background:rgba(99,102,241,0.15);color:#818cf8;';
        const inactiveStyle= 'flex:1;padding:7px 12px;border-radius:8px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0.05em;text-transform:uppercase;border:none;cursor:pointer;transition:all 0.15s;background:transparent;color:#444455;';
        document.getElementById('watch-tab-search').style.cssText  = tab==='search'  ? activeStyle : inactiveStyle;
        document.getElementById('watch-tab-shorts').style.cssText  = tab==='shorts'  ? activeStyle : inactiveStyle;
        document.getElementById('watch-tab-saved').style.cssText   = tab==='saved'   ? activeStyle : inactiveStyle;
        document.getElementById('watch-tab-history').style.cssText = tab==='history' ? activeStyle : inactiveStyle;
        if(tab==='search')  renderQuick();
        if(tab==='shorts')  _shortsEnsureFeed();
        if(tab==='saved')   renderSaved();
        if(tab==='history') renderHistory();
    };

    const SHORTS_DEFAULTS = ['funny shorts','football shorts','gaming shorts','satisfying shorts','nba shorts','anime shorts'];
    let _shortsQuery = '', _shortsPageToken = '', _shortsLoading = false;
    let _shortsList = [], _shortsIdx = -1, _shortsSeen = new Set();

    async function _ytSearchShorts(query, pageToken){
        const key = _YT_API_KEY;
        if(!key) return { items: [], next: '' };
        const url = `https://www.googleapis.com/youtube/v3/search?part=snippet&type=video&videoDuration=short&maxResults=25`
            + `&q=${encodeURIComponent(query + ' #shorts')}${pageToken?('&pageToken='+pageToken):''}&key=${key}`;
        const res = await fetch(url);
        if(!res.ok){
            if(res.status===429) return { items: [], next: '', quota: true };
            return { items: [], next: '' };
        }
        const data = await res.json();
        const items = (data.items||[])
            .filter(it => it.id && it.id.videoId)
            .map(it => ({ id: it.id.videoId, title: it.snippet.title, ch: it.snippet.channelTitle }));
        return { items, next: data.nextPageToken || '' };
    }

    function _shortsShow(idx){
        if(idx < 0 || idx >= _shortsList.length) return;
        _shortsIdx = idx;
        const v = _shortsList[idx];
        const host = document.getElementById('watch-shorts-player');
        host.innerHTML = '';
        const f = document.createElement('iframe');
        const _o = encodeURIComponent(window.__REAL_ORIGIN__ || location.origin);
        f.src = window.ECHO_YT.url(`${window.ECHO_YT_HOST}/embed/${v.id}?playsinline=1&rel=0&modestbranding=1&autoplay=1&enablejsapi=1&origin=${_o}`);
        _shortsWatch(f, v, idx);
        f.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;border:none;';
        f.allow = 'accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; fullscreen';
        f.referrerPolicy = 'strict-origin-when-cross-origin';
        f.allowFullscreen = true;
        host.appendChild(f);
        document.getElementById('watch-shorts-title').textContent = v.title || '';
        document.getElementById('watch-shorts-ch').textContent = v.ch || '';
        document.getElementById('watch-shorts-pos').textContent = (idx+1) + ' / ' + _shortsList.length;
        const up = document.getElementById('watch-shorts-up');
        up.disabled = (idx === 0);
        up.style.opacity = idx === 0 ? '0.35' : '1';
        up.style.cursor = idx === 0 ? 'default' : 'pointer';
        if(idx >= _shortsList.length - 3 && _shortsPageToken) _shortsFetchMore();
    }

    let _shortsFrame = null, _shortsOk = false, _shortsTimer = null, _shortsPing = null;
    window._shortsProxyTried = window._shortsProxyTried || {};
    function _shortsWatch(f, v, idx){
        clearTimeout(_shortsTimer); clearInterval(_shortsPing);
        _shortsFrame = f; _shortsOk = false;
        const proxied = /\/uv\/service\//.test(f.src);
        _shortsPing = setInterval(() => {
            if (_shortsFrame !== f || _shortsOk) { clearInterval(_shortsPing); return; }
            if (proxied) {
                try {
                    const d = f.contentDocument;
                    if (d && d.querySelector('.ytp-error')) { _shortsFailed(v, idx, true, 'player error box'); return; }
                    if (d && d.querySelector('video')) _shortsOk = true;
                } catch (_) {}
                return;
            }
            try { f.contentWindow.postMessage(JSON.stringify({ event: 'listening', id: 1, channel: 'widget' }), '*'); } catch (_) {}
        }, 500);
        _shortsTimer = setTimeout(() => {
            if (_shortsFrame !== f || _shortsOk) return;
            _shortsFailed(v, idx, proxied, 'no player after 10s');
        }, 10000);
        f._shortsMeta = { v, idx, proxied };
    }
    function _shortsFailed(v, idx, proxied, why){
        clearTimeout(_shortsTimer); clearInterval(_shortsPing);
        if (_shortsIdx !== idx) return;
        window._diag && window._diag('shorts', v.id + ' failed (' + why + ')' + (proxied ? ' via proxy' : ''));
        if (!proxied && !window._shortsProxyTried[v.id] && window.ECHO_YT && window.ECHO_YT.force) {
            window._shortsProxyTried[v.id] = 1;
            window.ECHO_YT.force(true).then(() => { if (_shortsIdx === idx) _shortsShow(idx); });
            return;
        }
        if (idx + 1 < _shortsList.length) _shortsShow(idx + 1);
    }
    window.addEventListener('message', (ev) => {
        const f = _shortsFrame;
        if (!f || ev.source !== f.contentWindow) return;
        let d = ev.data;
        if (typeof d === 'string') { try { d = JSON.parse(d); } catch (_) { return; } }
        if (!d || !d.event) return;
        if (d.event === 'onReady' || d.event === 'initialDelivery' || d.event === 'infoDelivery') _shortsOk = true;
        else if (d.event === 'onError' && f._shortsMeta) {
            const m = f._shortsMeta;
            _shortsFailed(m.v, m.idx, m.proxied, 'player error ' + d.info);
        }
    });

    async function _shortsFetchMore(){
        if(_shortsLoading || !_shortsPageToken) return;
        _shortsLoading = true;
        const q = _shortsQuery || _shortsActiveDefault;
        const { items, next } = await _ytSearchShorts(q, _shortsPageToken);
        _shortsPageToken = next;
        items.forEach(v => { if(!_shortsSeen.has(v.id)){ _shortsSeen.add(v.id); _shortsList.push(v); } });
        if(_shortsIdx >= 0){ document.getElementById('watch-shorts-pos').textContent = (_shortsIdx+1)+' / '+_shortsList.length; }
        _shortsLoading = false;
    }

    let _shortsActiveDefault = SHORTS_DEFAULTS[0];
    async function _shortsStart(){
        const stage = document.getElementById('watch-shorts-stage');
        const status = document.getElementById('watch-shorts-status');
        _shortsList = []; _shortsIdx = -1; _shortsPageToken = ''; _shortsSeen = new Set();
        _shortsActiveDefault = _shortsQuery || SHORTS_DEFAULTS[Math.floor(Math.random()*SHORTS_DEFAULTS.length)];
        stage.style.display = 'none';
        status.style.display = 'block';
        status.textContent = 'Loading Shorts…';
        const { items, next, quota } = await _ytSearchShorts(_shortsActiveDefault, '');
        _shortsPageToken = next;
        items.forEach(v => { if(!_shortsSeen.has(v.id)){ _shortsSeen.add(v.id); _shortsList.push(v); } });
        if(!_shortsList.length){
            status.textContent = quota ? 'Shorts are busy right now — try again in a bit.' : 'No Shorts found. Try another search.';
            return;
        }
        status.style.display = 'none';
        stage.style.display = 'flex';
        _shortsShow(0);
    }

    function _shortsEnsureFeed(){ if(_shortsIdx === -1) _shortsStart(); }
    window.echoShortsSearch = function(){
        _shortsQuery = (document.getElementById('watch-shorts-input')?.value||'').trim();
        _shortsStart();
    };
    window.echoShortsNext = function(){
        if(_shortsIdx < _shortsList.length - 1) _shortsShow(_shortsIdx + 1);
        else if(_shortsPageToken) _shortsFetchMore().then(()=>{ if(_shortsIdx < _shortsList.length - 1) _shortsShow(_shortsIdx + 1); });
    };
    window.echoShortsPrev = function(){ if(_shortsIdx > 0) _shortsShow(_shortsIdx - 1); };

    function renderSaved(){
        const list = document.getElementById('watch-saved-list');
        const none = document.getElementById('watch-no-saved');
        const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(LS_KEY)||'[]');
        list.innerHTML='';
        if(!saved.length){none.style.display='block';return;}
        none.style.display='none';
        saved.forEach((s,i)=>{
            const row=document.createElement('div');
            row.style.cssText='display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:10px 14px;background:#0a0a15;border:1px solid #1e1e2e;border-radius:12px;cursor:pointer;transition:border-color 0.15s;';
            row.onmouseover=()=>row.style.borderColor='#2a2a4a';
            row.onmouseout=()=>row.style.borderColor='#1e1e2e';
            row.innerHTML=`<span style="font-size:18px;flex-shrink:0;">📺</span><span style="flex:1;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:#c8c8e0;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;">${s.label}</span><button style="background:none;border:none;color:#333345;cursor:pointer;font-size:14px;padding:4px;border-radius:6px;transition:color 0.12s;" onmouseover="this.style.color='#f87171'" onmouseout="this.style.color='#333345'" title="Remove">✕</button>`;
            row.querySelector('button').onclick=(e)=>{e.stopPropagation();saved.splice(i,1);localStorage.setItem(LS_KEY,JSON.stringify(saved));renderSaved();};
            row.onclick=()=>{
                document.getElementById('watch-url-input').value=s.url;
                const parsed = extractYtId(s.url);
                if(parsed){ loadIntoPlayer(parsed, {title:s.label}); echoWatchTab('search'); }
            };
            list.appendChild(row);
        });
    }

    function renderHistory(){
        const LS_HIST = 'echospace_watch_history';
        const list = document.getElementById('watch-history-list');
        const none = document.getElementById('watch-no-history');
        let hist = [];
        try{ hist = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(LS_HIST)||'[]'); }catch(e){}
        list.innerHTML = '';
        if(!hist.length){ none.style.display='block'; return; }
        none.style.display = 'none';

        function _relTime(ts){
            const diff = Date.now() - ts;
            const m = Math.floor(diff/60000);
            if(m < 1)  return 'Just now';
            if(m < 60) return `${m}m ago`;
            const h = Math.floor(m/60);
            if(h < 24) return `${h}h ago`;
            const d = Math.floor(h/24);
            if(d < 7)  return `${d}d ago`;
            return new Date(ts).toLocaleDateString([], {month:'short', day:'numeric'});
        }

        hist.forEach((h, i)=>{
            const row = document.createElement('div');
            row.style.cssText = 'display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:10px 12px;background:#0a0a15;border:1px solid #1e1e2e;border-radius:12px;cursor:pointer;transition:border-color 0.15s;';
            row.onmouseover = ()=>row.style.borderColor='#2a2a4a';
            row.onmouseout  = ()=>row.style.borderColor='#1e1e2e';

            const safeTitle   = (h.title||'Untitled').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;');
            const safeChannel = (h.channel||'').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;');
            const timeStr     = _relTime(h.watchedAt || 0);
            const savedSecs   = _getSavedTs(h.videoId);
            const tsStr       = savedSecs > 5 ? ` &nbsp;·&nbsp; <span style="color:#4f46e5;">stopped at ${_fmtTime(savedSecs)}</span>` : '';

            row.innerHTML = `
                <div style="position:relative;flex-shrink:0;width:80px;height:45px;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;background:#000;">
                    <img src="${h.thumb||''}" style="width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;" loading="lazy" onerror="this.style.display='none'">
                    <div style="position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.3);opacity:0;transition:opacity 0.15s;" class="hist-play-overlay">
                        <span style="font-size:18px;">▶</span>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div style="flex:1;min-width:0;">
                    <p style="font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:#c8c8e0;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;margin-bottom:2px;">${safeTitle}</p>
                    <p style="font-size:11px;color:#444455;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;">${safeChannel}</p>
                    <p style="font-size:10px;color:#2e2e45;margin-top:3px;font-weight:700;">🕐 ${timeStr}${tsStr}</p>
                </div>
                <button title="Remove from history" style="background:none;border:none;color:#2a2a40;cursor:pointer;font-size:14px;padding:4px 6px;border-radius:6px;transition:color 0.12s;flex-shrink:0;" onmouseover="this.style.color='#f87171'" onmouseout="this.style.color='#2a2a40'">✕</button>`;

            const overlay = row.querySelector('.hist-play-overlay');
            row.onmouseover = ()=>{ row.style.borderColor='#2a2a4a'; overlay.style.opacity='1'; };
            row.onmouseout  = ()=>{ row.style.borderColor='#1e1e2e'; overlay.style.opacity='0'; };

            row.querySelector('button').onclick = (e)=>{
                e.stopPropagation();
                let hs = [];
                try{ hs = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(LS_HIST)||'[]'); }catch(e2){}
                hs.splice(i,1);
                localStorage.setItem(LS_HIST, JSON.stringify(hs));
                renderHistory();
            };

            row.onclick = ()=>{
                document.getElementById('watch-url-input').value = h.url;
                loadIntoPlayer({type:'video', id:h.videoId}, {title:h.title, artist:h.channel});
                document.getElementById('watch-player-wrap').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth', block:'start'});
                echoWatchTab('search');
            };

            list.appendChild(row);
        });
    }

        if(!confirm('Clear all watch history?')) return;
        localStorage.removeItem('echospace_watch_history');
        renderHistory();
    };

    function renderQuick(){
        const grid=document.getElementById('watch-quick-grid');
        if(!grid)return;
        grid.style.display='grid';
        grid.innerHTML='';
        QUICK.forEach(v=>{

    window.echoWatchSearch = async function(){
        const query = (document.getElementById('watch-search-input')?.value||'').trim();
        if(!query) return;
        const status = document.getElementById('watch-search-status');
        const grid = document.getElementById('watch-search-results');
        const empty = document.getElementById('watch-search-empty');
        status.textContent = 'Searching…'; status.style.display = 'block';
        grid.innerHTML = '';
        empty.style.display = 'none';
        const quick = document.getElementById('watch-quick-grid');
        if (quick) quick.style.display = 'none';

        let results = [];
        try {
            results = await _ytSearch(query, 20);
        } catch(e){
            console.warn('[watch search] failed:', e.message);
            status.textContent = 'Search failed. Try pasting a YouTube URL instead.';
            return;
        }

        if(!results.length){
            status.textContent = 'No results found.';
            return;
        }
        status.style.display = 'none';
        results.forEach(v=>{
            const card = document.createElement('div');
            card.style.cssText='background:#0a0a15;border:1px solid #1e1e2e;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;transition:border-color 0.15s,transform 0.15s;';
            card.onmouseover=()=>{card.style.borderColor='#2a2a4e';card.style.transform='translateY(-2px)';};
            card.onmouseout=()=>{card.style.borderColor='#1e1e2e';card.style.transform='none';};
            const safeTitle = (v.title||'').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;');
            const safeArtist = (v.artist||'').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;');
            const thumb = v.artwork || `https://img.youtube.com/vi/${v.videoId}/mqdefault.jpg`;
            card.innerHTML=`<div style="position:relative;padding-top:56.25%;background:#000;"><img src="${thumb}" style="position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;" loading="lazy"><div style="position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(to top,rgba(0,0,0,0.5) 0%,transparent 50%);"></div><div style="position:absolute;bottom:6px;right:6px;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.75);border-radius:4px;padding:2px 5px;font-size:10px;color:#fff;font-weight:700;">▶</div></div><div style="padding:8px 10px;"><p style="font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:#c8c8e0;line-height:1.4;overflow:hidden;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;margin-bottom:3px;">${safeTitle}</p><span style="font-size:10px;color:#444455;font-weight:600;">${safeArtist}</span></div>`;
            card.onclick=()=>{
                document.getElementById('watch-url-input').value = v.url || `https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=${v.videoId}`;
                loadIntoPlayer({type:'video', id:v.videoId}, {title:v.title, artist:v.artist});
                document.getElementById('watch-player-wrap').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth', block:'start'});
            };
            grid.appendChild(card);
        });
    };

    window.echoWatchSearchOrLoad = function(){
        const val = (document.getElementById('watch-search-input')?.value||'').trim();
        if(!val) return;
        const parsed = extractYtId(val);
        if(parsed){
            document.getElementById('watch-url-input').value = val;
            loadIntoPlayer(parsed);
            document.getElementById('watch-player-wrap').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth', block:'start'});
        } else {
            echoWatchTab('search');
            window.echoWatchSearch();
        }
    };
