    window.switchView = function(id){
        _orig(id);
        if(id==='watch' && !window._watchInitDone){
            window._watchInitDone=true;
            renderQuick();
            setTimeout(()=>document.getElementById('watch-search-input')?.focus(), 100);
        }
    };
})();

window.pcmSetBg = (type, value, swatchEl) => {
    pcmPendingBg = { type, value };
    document.querySelectorAll('.pcm-swatch').forEach(s => s.classList.remove('selected'));
    if (swatchEl) swatchEl.classList.add('selected');
    const pp = document.getElementById('profile-page');
    if (type === 'solid')    pp.style.background = value;
    else if (type === 'gradient') pp.style.background = value;
    else if (type === 'image')   pp.style.background = `url('${value}') center/cover no-repeat`;
    else pp.style.background = '#080810';
    const prev = document.getElementById('pcm-bg-preview');
    prev.classList.remove('hidden');
    if (type === 'image') prev.style.cssText += `background:url('${value}') center/cover;border-radius:8px;`;
    else prev.style.cssText += `background:${value};border-radius:8px;`;
};

window.pcmApplyCustomGrad = () => {
    const c1 = document.getElementById('pcm-grad1').value;
    const c2 = document.getElementById('pcm-grad2').value;
    const dir = document.getElementById('pcm-grad-dir').value;
    pcmSetBg('gradient', `linear-gradient(${dir},${c1},${c2})`, null);
};

document.getElementById('pcm-bg-upload').addEventListener('change', (e) => {
    const file = e.target.files[0]; if (!file) return;
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = ev => {
        pcmSetBg('image', ev.target.result, null);
    };
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    e.target.value = '';
});

document.getElementById('pcm-banner-upload').addEventListener('change', (e) => {
    const file = e.target.files[0]; if (!file) return;
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = ev => {
        pcmPendingBanner = ev.target.result;
        const banner = document.getElementById('profile-banner');
        banner.style.background = `url('${pcmPendingBanner}') center/cover no-repeat`;
        pcmLoadImageToCanvas(pcmPendingBanner);
    };
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    e.target.value = '';
});

window.pcmResetBanner = () => {
    pcmPendingBanner = '__reset__';
    document.getElementById('profile-banner').style.background = '';
    pcmClearCanvas();
};

function _pcmUpdateBannerContent(disabled) {
    const content    = document.getElementById('pcm-banner-content');
    const banner     = document.getElementById('profile-banner');
    const avatarWrap = document.querySelector('.profile-avatar-wrap');
    if (content) { content.style.opacity = disabled ? '0.35' : '1'; content.style.pointerEvents = disabled ? 'none' : ''; }
    if (banner)  { disabled ? banner.classList.add('banner-disabled') : banner.classList.remove('banner-disabled'); }
    if (avatarWrap) { avatarWrap.style.marginTop = disabled ? '20px' : ''; }
}

window.pcmToggleStars = (checked) => {
    pcmPendingStars = checked;
    window._applyProfileStars && window._applyProfileStars(checked);
};

window.pcmToggleBannerDisabled = (checked) => {
    pcmPendingBannerDisabled = checked;
    _pcmUpdateBannerContent(checked);
};


window._pcmPlaylistPendingRemovals = [];
window._pcmPlaylistPendingAdds    = [];

let _pcmDragFrom = null;

function _pcmSetOrderHint(text) {
    const list = document.getElementById('pcm-playlist-list');
    if (!list) return;
    let el = document.getElementById('pcm-order-hint');
    if (!text) { if (el) el.remove(); return; }
    if (!el) {
        el = document.createElement('div');
        el.id = 'pcm-order-hint';
        el.style.cssText = 'font-size:10px;color:#3a3a52;text-align:center;padding:2px 0 0;font-weight:600;';
        list.parentNode.insertBefore(el, list.nextSibling);
    }
    el.textContent = text;
}

async function _pcmWriteOrder(playlist) {
    const isOwnerSession = window._myRole === 'owner' || window.isAdmin === true;
    await window._pcmRenderPlaylist({ profilePlaylist: playlist, profileMusic: playlist[0] || null }, isOwnerSession);
    try {
        await updateDoc(doc(db, 'users', window.myUID), {
            profilePlaylist: playlist,
            profileMusic: playlist[0] || null
        });
        if (playlist.length) {
            _applyProfileMusicBar({ profileMusic: playlist[0], _uid: window.myUID, profilePlaylist: playlist }, false);
        }
    } catch (e) {
        window.reportRuleDenial && window.reportRuleDenial('Profile music — reorder', e,
            { path: `users/${window.myUID}`, op: 'update(profilePlaylist)' });
        window.showCooldownToast && window.showCooldownToast('Could not save the new order.');
    }
}

async function _pcmCurrentPlaylist() {
    const snap = await getDoc(doc(db, 'users', window.myUID));
    const d = snap.exists() ? snap.data() : {};
    if (Array.isArray(d.profilePlaylist) && d.profilePlaylist.length) return [...d.profilePlaylist];
    return d.profileMusic ? [{ ...d.profileMusic, uploader: window.myUID, slotKey: '0' }] : [];
}

window._pcmReorderTracks = async (from, to) => {
    const playlist = await _pcmCurrentPlaylist();
    if (from < 0 || to < 0 || from >= playlist.length || to >= playlist.length || from === to) return;
    playlist.splice(to, 0, playlist.splice(from, 1)[0]);
    await _pcmWriteOrder(playlist);
};

window._pcmMoveTrack = async (idx, delta) => {
    const playlist = await _pcmCurrentPlaylist();
    const to = idx + delta;
    if (idx < 0 || idx >= playlist.length || to < 0 || to >= playlist.length) return;
    playlist.splice(to, 0, playlist.splice(idx, 1)[0]);
    await _pcmWriteOrder(playlist);
};

window._pcmRenderPlaylist = async (uData, isOwnerSession) => {
    const list = document.getElementById('pcm-playlist-list');
    if (!list) return;
    list.innerHTML = '';
    const MAX_SONGS = isOwnerSession ? 10 : 3;

    let playlist = [];
    if (Array.isArray(uData.profilePlaylist) && uData.profilePlaylist.length > 0) {
        playlist = uData.profilePlaylist;
    } else if (uData.profileMusic) {
        playlist = [{ ...uData.profileMusic, slot: 0 }];
    }

    if (playlist.length === 0) {
        list.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:11px;color:#444455;text-align:center;padding:10px 0;">No tracks yet — add one below.</div>';
        _pcmSetOrderHint('');
    } else {
        const esc = t => window.escHtml ? window.escHtml(t) : t;
        playlist.forEach((track, idx) => {
            const row = document.createElement('div');
            row.className = 'pcm-track';
            row.draggable = true;
            row.dataset.idx = idx;
            row.style.cssText = 'display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;background:#05050e;border:1px solid #1a1a2e;'
                + 'border-radius:10px;padding:10px 12px;transition:border-color .15s,opacity .15s,transform .15s;';
            row.innerHTML = `
                <div class="pcm-grip" title="Drag to reorder" style="flex-shrink:0;cursor:grab;color:#33334a;font-size:15px;line-height:1;padding:0 2px;user-select:none;">⠿</div>
                <div style="font-size:15px;flex-shrink:0;">${idx === 0 ? '▶️' : '🎵'}</div>
                <div style="flex:1;min-width:0;">
                    <div style="font-size:12px;font-weight:800;color:#e8e8f0;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;">${esc(track.name || 'Untitled')}</div>
                    <div style="font-size:10px;color:#444455;font-weight:600;">${idx === 0 ? 'Auto-plays first' : 'Track ' + (idx + 1)} · ${track.uploader === window.myUID ? 'You' : esc(track.uploaderName || 'Admin')}${track.lyricsText ? ' · 🎤 Lyrics' : ''}</div>
                </div>
                <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;flex-shrink:0;margin-right:2px;">
                    <button onclick="window._pcmMoveTrack(${idx},-1)" ${idx === 0 ? 'disabled' : ''} title="Move up"
                        style="background:rgba(255,255,255,0.04);border:1px solid #1e1e2e;color:${idx === 0 ? '#2a2a40' : '#8888aa'};font-size:9px;line-height:1;padding:3px 6px;border-radius:5px;cursor:${idx === 0 ? 'default' : 'pointer'};">▲</button>
                    <button onclick="window._pcmMoveTrack(${idx},1)" ${idx === playlist.length - 1 ? 'disabled' : ''} title="Move down"
                        style="background:rgba(255,255,255,0.04);border:1px solid #1e1e2e;color:${idx === playlist.length - 1 ? '#2a2a40' : '#8888aa'};font-size:9px;line-height:1;padding:3px 6px;border-radius:5px;cursor:${idx === playlist.length - 1 ? 'default' : 'pointer'};">▼</button>
                </div>
                <button onclick="window._pcmEditTrackLyrics(${idx})" title="${track.lyricsText ? 'Edit lyrics' : 'Add lyrics'}" style="flex-shrink:0;background:rgba(99,102,241,0.1);border:1px solid rgba(99,102,241,0.2);color:#818cf8;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;padding:4px 8px;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;">${track.lyricsText ? '🎤' : '+ Lyrics'}</button>
                <button onclick="window._pcmRemovePlaylistSlot(${idx})" style="flex-shrink:0;background:rgba(239,68,68,0.1);border:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,0.2);color:#f87171;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;">Remove</button>`;

            row.addEventListener('dragstart', ev => {
                _pcmDragFrom = idx;
                row.style.opacity = '.4';
                try { ev.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move'; ev.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', String(idx)); } catch (_) {}
            });
            row.addEventListener('dragend', () => {
                _pcmDragFrom = null;
                list.querySelectorAll('.pcm-track').forEach(r => {
                    r.style.opacity = ''; r.style.borderColor = '#1a1a2e'; r.style.transform = '';
                });
            });
            row.addEventListener('dragover', ev => {
                ev.preventDefault();
                if (_pcmDragFrom === null || _pcmDragFrom === idx) return;
                row.style.borderColor = '#4f46e5';
                row.style.transform = _pcmDragFrom > idx ? 'translateY(-2px)' : 'translateY(2px)';
            });
            row.addEventListener('dragleave', () => { row.style.borderColor = '#1a1a2e'; row.style.transform = ''; });
            row.addEventListener('drop', ev => {
                ev.preventDefault();
                const from = _pcmDragFrom;
                _pcmDragFrom = null;
                if (from === null || from === idx) return;
                window._pcmReorderTracks(from, idx);
            });
            list.appendChild(row);
        });
    }

    if (playlist.length > 1) {
        _pcmSetOrderHint('Drag the ⠿ handle to reorder, or use ▲▼ on touch. The top track auto-plays.');
    } else { _pcmSetOrderHint(''); }

    const addWrap = document.getElementById('pcm-add-track-wrap');
    if (addWrap) {
        const canAdd = playlist.length < MAX_SONGS;
        addWrap.style.display = canAdd ? 'block' : 'none';
        if (!canAdd) {
            const atLimit = document.createElement('div');
            atLimit.style.cssText = 'font-size:11px;color:#555566;text-align:center;padding:8px 0;';
            atLimit.textContent = `Playlist full (${MAX_SONGS}/${MAX_SONGS} tracks). Remove a track to add another.`;
            list.appendChild(atLimit);
        }
    }
};

window._pcmRemovePlaylistSlot = async (idx) => {
    if (!confirm('Remove this track from your playlist?')) return;
    try {
        const snap = await getDoc(doc(db, 'users', myUID));
        const uData = snap.exists() ? snap.data() : {};
        let playlist = Array.isArray(uData.profilePlaylist) ? [...uData.profilePlaylist] : (uData.profileMusic ? [uData.profileMusic] : []);
        const removed = playlist.splice(idx, 1)[0];

        const slotUID = (removed?.uploader === window.myUID) ? window.myUID : (removed?.uploader || window.myUID);
        const slotKey = `profile_music/${slotUID}/slots/slot_${removed?.slotKey || idx}`;
        try {
            const oldMeta = await getDoc(doc(db, 'profile_music', slotUID, 'slots', `slot_${removed?.slotKey ?? idx}`, 'chunks', 'meta'));
            if (oldMeta.exists()) {
                const oldTotal = oldMeta.data().total || 0;
                const BATCH_SIZE = 10;
                for (let start = 0; start < oldTotal; start += BATCH_SIZE) {
                    const batch = writeBatch(db);
                    for (let i = start; i < Math.min(start + BATCH_SIZE, oldTotal); i++) {
                        batch.delete(doc(db, 'profile_music', slotUID, 'slots', `slot_${removed?.slotKey ?? idx}`, 'chunks', `chunk_${i}`));
                    }
                    await batch.commit();
                }
                await deleteDoc(doc(db, 'profile_music', slotUID, 'slots', `slot_${removed?.slotKey ?? idx}`, 'chunks', 'meta'));
            }
        } catch(_) {}

        const updates = playlist.length === 0
            ? { profilePlaylist: [], profileMusic: null }
            : { profilePlaylist: playlist };
        if (playlist.length > 0) updates.profileMusic = playlist[0];
        await updateDoc(doc(db, 'users', myUID), updates);

        if (window._musicCache) delete window._musicCache[myUID + '_playlist'];

        const isOwnerSession = window._myRole === 'owner' || window.isAdmin === true;
        await _pcmRenderPlaylist({ ...uData, profilePlaylist: playlist, profileMusic: playlist[0] || null }, isOwnerSession);

        if (playlist.length > 0) {
            _applyProfileMusicBar({ profileMusic: playlist[0], _uid: window.myUID, profilePlaylist: playlist }, false);
        } else {
            const bar = document.getElementById('profile-music-bar');
            if (bar) bar.classList.remove('visible');
        }
    } catch(e) {
        alert('Error removing track: ' + e.message);
    }
};

document.getElementById('pcm-music-upload').addEventListener('change', (e) => {
    const file = e.target.files[0]; if (!file) return;
    e.target.value = '';
    if (file.size > 10 * 1024 * 1024) { alert('File too large. Max 10 MB.'); return; }
    if (!file.type.startsWith('audio/')) { alert('Please upload an audio file.'); return; }
    const songNameEl = document.getElementById('pcm-music-songname');
    const displayName = (songNameEl && songNameEl.value.trim()) ? songNameEl.value.trim() : file.name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, '');
    pcmPendingMusic = { file, name: displayName }; pcmMusicRemove = false;
    const statusEl   = document.getElementById('pcm-music-status');
    const filenameEl = document.getElementById('pcm-music-filename');
    const filesizeEl = document.getElementById('pcm-music-filesize');
    const drop       = document.getElementById('pcm-music-drop');
    const dropLabel  = document.getElementById('pcm-music-drop-label');
    if (statusEl)   statusEl.style.display = 'block';
    if (filenameEl) filenameEl.textContent = displayName;
    if (filesizeEl) filesizeEl.textContent = `${(file.size / 1024).toFixed(0)} KB — ready to save`;
    if (drop)       drop.style.borderColor = '#4f46e5';
    if (dropLabel)  dropLabel.textContent = '✅ ' + displayName;
});

document.getElementById('pcm-music-drop')?.addEventListener('dragover',  (e) => { e.preventDefault(); e.currentTarget.style.borderColor = '#818cf8'; });
document.getElementById('pcm-music-drop')?.addEventListener('dragleave', (e) => { e.currentTarget.style.borderColor = '#1e1e2e'; });
document.getElementById('pcm-music-drop')?.addEventListener('drop', (e) => {
    e.preventDefault(); e.currentTarget.style.borderColor = '#1e1e2e';
    const file = e.dataTransfer?.files?.[0]; if (!file) return;
    const dt = new DataTransfer(); dt.items.add(file);
    const inp = document.getElementById('pcm-music-upload');
    inp.files = dt.files; inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
});

window.pcmRemoveMusic = () => {
    pcmMusicRemove = true; pcmPendingMusic = null;
    const statusEl = document.getElementById('pcm-music-status');
    const drop = document.getElementById('pcm-music-drop');
    if (statusEl) statusEl.style.display = 'none';
    if (drop) { drop.style.borderColor = '#1e1e2e'; const lbl = drop.querySelector('[id="pcm-music-drop-label"]'); if (lbl) lbl.textContent = 'Click or drag to upload audio'; }
};


(function() {
    window._titleEnabled    = window._titleEnabled    ?? false;
    window._titlePhrase     = window._titlePhrase     ?? '';
    window._usernameEnabled = window._usernameEnabled ?? false;

    let _titleTW   = null;
    let _usernameTW = null;

    function _makeTypewriter(el, phrases, opts) {
        opts = opts || {};
        const typeSpeed    = opts.typeSpeed    ?? 75;
        const deleteSpeed  = opts.deleteSpeed  ?? 55;
        const pauseAfter   = opts.pauseAfter   ?? 1800;
        const pauseEmpty   = opts.pauseEmpty   ?? 400;
        const cursor       = opts.cursor       ?? true;

        let phraseIdx  = 0;
        let charIdx    = 0;
        let deleting   = false;
        let timer      = null;
        let stopped    = false;

        let cursorEl = null;
        if (cursor) {
            cursorEl = document.createElement('span');
            cursorEl.style.cssText = 'display:inline-block;width:2px;height:1em;background:currentColor;margin-left:2px;vertical-align:middle;border-radius:1px;animation:tw-cursor-blink 0.9s step-end infinite;';
            cursorEl.id = el.id + '-tw-cursor';
        }

        function _setText(text) {
            el.textContent = text;
            if (cursorEl) el.appendChild(cursorEl);
        }

        function _tick() {
            if (stopped) return;
            const phrase = phrases[phraseIdx % phrases.length];
            if (deleting) {
                charIdx = Math.max(0, charIdx - 1);
                _setText(phrase.slice(0, charIdx));
                if (charIdx === 0) {
                    deleting = false;
                    phraseIdx++;
                    timer = setTimeout(_tick, pauseEmpty);
                } else {
                    timer = setTimeout(_tick, deleteSpeed);
                }
            } else {
                charIdx++;
                _setText(phrase.slice(0, charIdx));
                if (charIdx === phrase.length) {
                    deleting = true;
                    timer = setTimeout(_tick, pauseAfter);
                } else {
                    timer = setTimeout(_tick, typeSpeed);
                }
            }
        }

        _setText('');
        timer = setTimeout(_tick, 300);

        return {
            stop() {
                stopped = true;
                clearTimeout(timer);
                if (cursorEl && cursorEl.parentNode) cursorEl.parentNode.removeChild(cursorEl);
            }
        };
    }

    function _makeTitleTypewriter(phrase) {
        let charIdx = 0;
        let deleting = false;
        let timer = null;
        let stopped = false;
        const TYPE_SPEED   = 120;
        const DELETE_SPEED = 80;
        const PAUSE_AFTER  = 1000;
        const PAUSE_EMPTY  = 500;

        function tick() {
            if (stopped) return;
            if (deleting) {
                charIdx = Math.max(0, charIdx - 1);
                document.title = phrase.slice(0, charIdx);
                if (charIdx === 0) {
                    document.title = '';
                    deleting = false;
                    timer = setTimeout(tick, PAUSE_EMPTY);
                } else {
                    timer = setTimeout(tick, DELETE_SPEED);
                }
            } else {
                charIdx++;
                document.title = phrase.slice(0, charIdx);
                if (charIdx === phrase.length) {
                    deleting = true;
                    timer = setTimeout(tick, PAUSE_AFTER);
                } else {
                    timer = setTimeout(tick, TYPE_SPEED);
                }
            }
        }

        document.title = '';
        timer = setTimeout(tick, 400);
        return { stop() { stopped = true; clearTimeout(timer); } };
    }

    if (!document.getElementById('tw-cursor-style')) {
        const s = document.createElement('style');
        s.id = 'tw-cursor-style';
        s.textContent = '@keyframes tw-cursor-blink { 0%,100%{opacity:1} 50%{opacity:0} }';
        document.head.appendChild(s);
    }


    window._startProfilePageTitleTW = (phrase) => {
        if (_titleTW) { _titleTW.stop(); _titleTW = null; }
        const p = (phrase && phrase.trim()) ? phrase.trim() : 'Epic was here';
        _titleTW = _makeTitleTypewriter(p);
    };

    window._stopProfilePageTitleTW = () => {
        if (_titleTW) { _titleTW.stop(); _titleTW = null; }
    };

    function _applyUsername() {
        const el = document.getElementById('user-display');
        if (!el) return;
        if (_usernameTW) { _usernameTW.stop(); _usernameTW = null; }
        el.textContent = window.myUsername || '';
    }

    window._startProfilePageUsernameTW = (username) => {
        if (_usernameTW) { _usernameTW.stop(); _usernameTW = null; }
        if (!username) return;
        const el = document.getElementById('profile-page-name');
        if (!el) return;
        _usernameTW = _makeTypewriter(el, [username], {
            typeSpeed: 120, deleteSpeed: 80, pauseAfter: 2000, pauseEmpty: 500, cursor: true
        });
    };

    window._stopProfilePageUsernameTW = (username) => {
        if (_usernameTW) { _usernameTW.stop(); _usernameTW = null; }
        const el = document.getElementById('profile-page-name');
        if (el && username) el.textContent = username;
    };

    window._startOwnerElectricAura = () => {
        const wrap = document.querySelector('.profile-avatar-wrap');
        if (!wrap || wrap.querySelector('.owner-electric-aura')) return;

        const aura = document.createElement('div');
        aura.className = 'owner-electric-aura';
        wrap.insertBefore(aura, wrap.firstChild);

        const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
        canvas.id = 'owner-bolt-canvas';
        wrap.appendChild(canvas);

        const img = wrap.querySelector('.profile-avatar-img');
        const INSET = 4;
        const IMG_SIZE = img ? img.offsetWidth : 108;
        const SIZE = IMG_SIZE + INSET * 2;
        const DPR = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 3);
        canvas.width  = SIZE * DPR;
        canvas.height = SIZE * DPR;
        const cx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        cx.setTransform(DPR, 0, 0, DPR, 0, 0);
        const CX = SIZE / 2, CY = SIZE / 2;
        const R = IMG_SIZE / 2 + INSET / 2;

        function randBetween(a, b) { return a + Math.random() * (b - a); }

        const pointAt = (a, r) => ({ x: CX + Math.cos(a) * r, y: CY + Math.sin(a) * r });

        function fractalPath(a0, a1, spread) {
            let pts = [pointAt(a0, R), pointAt(a1, R)];
            let offset = spread;
            for (let pass = 0; pass < 5; pass++) {
                const next = [pts[0]];
                for (let k = 1; k < pts.length; k++) {
                    const p = pts[k - 1], q = pts[k];
                    const dx = q.x - p.x, dy = q.y - p.y;
                    const len = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
                    const d = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * offset;
                    next.push({
                        x: (p.x + q.x) / 2 + (-dy / len) * d,
                        y: (p.y + q.y) / 2 + ( dx / len) * d
                    });
                    next.push(q);
                }
                pts = next;
                offset *= 0.5;
            }
            return pts;
        }

        function strokePath(pts, width, colour, blur) {
            cx.beginPath();
            cx.moveTo(pts[0].x, pts[0].y);
            for (let k = 1; k < pts.length; k++) cx.lineTo(pts[k].x, pts[k].y);
            cx.strokeStyle = colour;
            cx.lineWidth = width;
            cx.lineCap = 'round';
            cx.lineJoin = 'round';
            cx.shadowColor = 'rgba(139,92,246,0.9)';
            cx.shadowBlur = blur;
            cx.stroke();
            cx.shadowBlur = 0;
        }

        function drawBolt(startAngle) {
            const span = randBetween(0.14, 0.34);
            const dir = Math.random() < 0.5 ? 1 : -1;
            const pts = fractalPath(startAngle, startAngle + dir * span, randBetween(2.5, 5));
            const a = randBetween(0.55, 1);
            strokePath(pts, randBetween(3, 4.5),   'rgba(99,102,241,'  + (a * 0.22).toFixed(3) + ')', 7);
            strokePath(pts, randBetween(1.4, 2.1), 'rgba(167,139,250,' + (a * 0.75).toFixed(3) + ')', 5);
            strokePath(pts, randBetween(0.5, 0.9), 'rgba(245,243,255,' + a.toFixed(3) + ')', 2);
            if (Math.random() < 0.45 && pts.length > 6) {
                const root = pts[2 + Math.floor(Math.random() * (pts.length - 4))];
                const rootAngle = Math.atan2(root.y - CY, root.x - CX);
                const bDir = Math.random() < 0.5 ? 1 : -1;
                const branch = fractalPath(rootAngle, rootAngle + bDir * randBetween(0.05, 0.13), randBetween(1.5, 3));
                branch[0] = root;
                strokePath(branch, randBetween(0.9, 1.4), 'rgba(196,181,253,' + (a * 0.6).toFixed(3) + ')', 4);
                strokePath(branch, 0.5, 'rgba(245,243,255,' + (a * 0.8).toFixed(3) + ')', 2);
            }
        }

        let _boltFrame = null;
        let _boltActive = true;
        let _nextStrike = 0;
        let _burstLeft = 0;
        let _fadeFrames = 0;

        function boltLoop(ts) {
            if (!_boltActive) return;
            if (_fadeFrames > 0) {
                _fadeFrames--;
                cx.globalCompositeOperation = 'destination-out';
                cx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.28)';
                cx.fillRect(0, 0, SIZE, SIZE);
                cx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
                if (_fadeFrames === 0) cx.clearRect(0, 0, SIZE, SIZE);
            }

            if (ts >= _nextStrike) {
                for (let k = 0, n = 1 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 2); k < n; k++) {
                    drawBolt(randBetween(0, Math.PI * 2));
                }
                _fadeFrames = 26;
                aura.style.filter = 'brightness(' + randBetween(1.35, 1.9).toFixed(2) + ')';
                setTimeout(() => { if (_boltActive) aura.style.filter = ''; }, randBetween(40, 90));

                if (_burstLeft > 0) { _burstLeft--; _nextStrike = ts + randBetween(45, 110); }
                else { _burstLeft = Math.floor(randBetween(0, 4)); _nextStrike = ts + randBetween(600, 1900); }
            }
            _boltFrame = requestAnimationFrame(boltLoop);
        }

        _boltFrame = requestAnimationFrame(boltLoop);

        window._stopOwnerElectricAura = () => {
            _boltActive = false;
            if (_boltFrame) cancelAnimationFrame(_boltFrame);
            aura.remove();
            canvas.remove();
        };
    };

    window._twLoadAndApply = async () => {
        if (window._myRole !== 'owner' && !window.isAdmin) return;
        try {
            const { getFirestore, getDoc, doc: fsDoc } = await import('https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.11.0/firebase-firestore.js');
            const { getApps } = await import('https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.11.0/firebase-app.js');
            const _db = getFirestore(getApps()[0]);
            const snap = await getDoc(fsDoc(_db, 'users', window.myUID));
            if (!snap.exists()) return;
            const fx = snap.data().profileEffects || {};
            window._titleEnabled    = fx.twTitle !== false;
            window._titlePhrase     = fx.twTitlePhrase || 'Epic was here';
            window._usernameEnabled = fx.twUsername !== false;
        } catch(e) { console.warn('[TW] load failed', e); }
    };

    window._twSave = async () => {
        try {
            const { getFirestore, updateDoc, doc: fsDoc } = await import('https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.11.0/firebase-firestore.js');
            const { getApps } = await import('https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.11.0/firebase-app.js');
            const _db = getFirestore(getApps()[0]);
            await updateDoc(fsDoc(_db, 'users', window.myUID), {
                'profileEffects.twTitle':       window._titleEnabled,
                'profileEffects.twTitlePhrase': window._titlePhrase,
                'profileEffects.twUsername':    window._usernameEnabled,
            });
        } catch(e) { console.warn('[TW] save failed', e); }
    };

    window.pcmEffectChange = () => {
        const titleToggle = document.getElementById('pcm-tw-title-toggle');
        const userToggle  = document.getElementById('pcm-tw-user-toggle');
        const phraseInput = document.getElementById('pcm-tw-title-text');
        window._titleEnabled    = titleToggle?.checked ?? false;
        window._titlePhrase     = phraseInput?.value.trim() || 'Epic was here';
        window._usernameEnabled = userToggle?.checked ?? false;
        window._effectsDirty    = true;
    };

    window._pcmLoadEffectsTab = async () => {
        const tabBtn = document.getElementById('pcm-tab-effects');
        if (tabBtn) tabBtn.style.display = 'none';
    };

    window._twStopAll = () => {
        if (_titleTW)    { _titleTW.stop();    _titleTW = null; }
        if (_usernameTW) { _usernameTW.stop(); _usernameTW = null; }
    };
})();

let pcmDrawing = false, pcmCurrentTool = 'brush';
let pcmCanvas, pcmCtx;

function pcmInitCanvas() {
    pcmCanvas = document.getElementById('pcm-banner-canvas');
    if (!pcmCanvas) return;
    const rect = pcmCanvas.parentElement.getBoundingClientRect();
    const w = rect.width || 480, h = rect.height || 110;
    if (pcmCanvas.width !== Math.round(w) || pcmCanvas.height !== Math.round(h)) {
        pcmCanvas.width = Math.round(w);
        pcmCanvas.height = Math.round(h);
    }
    pcmCtx = pcmCanvas.getContext('2d');
    if (!pcmCanvas.dataset.initialized) {
        pcmCtx.fillStyle = '#1a0a2e';
        pcmCtx.fillRect(0, 0, pcmCanvas.width, pcmCanvas.height);
        pcmCanvas.dataset.initialized = '1';
    }
    pcmCanvas.onpointerdown = pcmStartDraw;
    pcmCanvas.onpointermove = pcmDoDraw;
    pcmCanvas.onpointerup = pcmEndDraw;
    pcmCanvas.onpointerleave = pcmEndDraw;
}

function pcmGetPos(e) {
    const r = pcmCanvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const scaleX = pcmCanvas.width / r.width;
    const scaleY = pcmCanvas.height / r.height;
    return { x: (e.clientX - r.left) * scaleX, y: (e.clientY - r.top) * scaleY };
}

function pcmStartDraw(e) {
    pcmDrawing = true;
    const pos = pcmGetPos(e);
    if (pcmCurrentTool === 'fill') {
        pcmFloodFill(Math.round(pos.x), Math.round(pos.y), document.getElementById('pcm-draw-color').value);
        return;
    }
    pcmCtx.beginPath();
    pcmCtx.moveTo(pos.x, pos.y);
    e.preventDefault();
}

function pcmDoDraw(e) {
    if (!pcmDrawing || pcmCurrentTool === 'fill') return;
    const pos = pcmGetPos(e);
    const size = parseInt(document.getElementById('pcm-brush-size').value);
    pcmCtx.lineWidth = size;
    pcmCtx.lineCap = 'round';
    pcmCtx.lineJoin = 'round';
    if (pcmCurrentTool === 'eraser') {
        pcmCtx.globalCompositeOperation = 'destination-out';
        pcmCtx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,1)';
    } else {
        pcmCtx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
        pcmCtx.strokeStyle = document.getElementById('pcm-draw-color').value;
    }
    pcmCtx.lineTo(pos.x, pos.y);
    pcmCtx.stroke();
    pcmCtx.beginPath();
    pcmCtx.moveTo(pos.x, pos.y);
    e.preventDefault();
}

function pcmEndDraw() {
    pcmDrawing = false;
    if (pcmCtx) { pcmCtx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over'; pcmCtx.beginPath(); }
}

function pcmFloodFill(startX, startY, fillColorHex) {
    const imgData = pcmCtx.getImageData(0, 0, pcmCanvas.width, pcmCanvas.height);
    const data = imgData.data;
    const w = pcmCanvas.width, h = pcmCanvas.height;
    const idx = (startY * w + startX) * 4;
    const tr = data[idx], tg = data[idx+1], tb = data[idx+2], ta = data[idx+3];
    const fr = parseInt(fillColorHex.slice(1,3),16), fg = parseInt(fillColorHex.slice(3,5),16), fb = parseInt(fillColorHex.slice(5,7),16);
    if (tr===fr && tg===fg && tb===fb) return;
    const stack = [[startX, startY]];
    const visited = new Uint8Array(w * h);
    while (stack.length) {
        const [cx, cy] = stack.pop();
        if (cx<0||cy<0||cx>=w||cy>=h||visited[cy*w+cx]) continue;
        const i = (cy*w+cx)*4;
        if (Math.abs(data[i]-tr)>30 || Math.abs(data[i+1]-tg)>30 || Math.abs(data[i+2]-tb)>30) continue;
        visited[cy*w+cx] = 1;
        data[i]=fr; data[i+1]=fg; data[i+2]=fb; data[i+3]=255;
        stack.push([cx+1,cy],[cx-1,cy],[cx,cy+1],[cx,cy-1]);
    }
    pcmCtx.putImageData(imgData, 0, 0);
}

function pcmLoadImageToCanvas(src) {
    pcmInitCanvas();
    const img = new Image();
    img.onload = () => { pcmCtx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, pcmCanvas.width, pcmCanvas.height); };
    img.src = src;
}

window.pcmDrawTool = (tool) => {
    pcmCurrentTool = tool;
    ['brush','fill','eraser'].forEach(t => {
        const el = document.getElementById('pcm-tool-' + t);
        if (el) el.classList.toggle('active', t === tool);
    });
};

window.pcmClearCanvas = () => {
    pcmInitCanvas();
    pcmCtx.clearRect(0, 0, pcmCanvas.width, pcmCanvas.height);
    pcmCtx.fillStyle = '#1a0a2e';
    pcmCtx.fillRect(0, 0, pcmCanvas.width, pcmCanvas.height);
    pcmCanvas.dataset.initialized = '1';
};

window.pcmSetBannerFromCanvas = () => {
    pcmInitCanvas();
    pcmPendingBanner = pcmCanvas.toDataURL('image/png');
    document.getElementById('profile-banner').style.background = `url('${pcmPendingBanner}') center/cover no-repeat`;
    const msg = document.getElementById('pcm-msg');
    msg.innerText = 'Canvas set as banner — save to apply permanently.';
    msg.classList.remove('hidden');
    setTimeout(() => msg.classList.add('hidden'), 3000);
};

const MUSIC_CACHE = 'echo-music-v1';
const _musicCacheKey = (key, stamp) => 'https://echo.local/music/' + encodeURIComponent(key) + '/' + stamp;

async function _musicDiskGet(key, stamp) {
    try {
        if (!window.caches) return null;
        const c = await caches.open(MUSIC_CACHE);
        const r = await c.match(_musicCacheKey(key, stamp));
        return r ? await r.blob() : null;
    } catch (_) { return null; }
}

async function _musicDiskPut(key, stamp, blob) {
    try {
        if (!window.caches || !stamp || !blob) return;
        const c = await caches.open(MUSIC_CACHE);
        const prefix = 'https://echo.local/music/' + encodeURIComponent(key) + '/';
        const want = _musicCacheKey(key, stamp);
        for (const req of await c.keys()) {
            if (req.url.startsWith(prefix) && req.url !== want) await c.delete(req);
        }
        await c.put(want, new Response(blob, { headers: { 'Content-Type': blob.type || 'audio/mpeg' } }));
    } catch (_) {   }
}

window._musicDiskClear = async () => {
    try { await caches.delete(MUSIC_CACHE); return true; } catch (_) { return false; }
};

window.loadChunkedMusic = async (uid, slotKey, stamp) => {
    if (!uid) throw new Error('loadChunkedMusic: uid is required — cannot load music without a specific user ID');
    const cacheKey = uid + (slotKey ? '_' + slotKey : '');
    if (window._musicCache && window._musicCache[cacheKey]) return window._musicCache[cacheKey];

    if (stamp) {
        const hit = await _musicDiskGet(cacheKey, stamp);
        if (hit) {
            const url = URL.createObjectURL(hit);
            if (!window._musicCache) window._musicCache = {};
            window._musicCache[cacheKey] = url;
            return url;
        }
    }

    let metaSnap;
    const slotMetaRef = slotKey
        ? doc(db, 'profile_music', uid, 'slots', `slot_${slotKey}`, 'chunks', 'meta')
        : doc(db, 'profile_music', uid, 'chunks', 'meta');
    try {
        metaSnap = await getDoc(slotMetaRef);
        if (!metaSnap.exists() && slotKey) {
            metaSnap = await getDoc(doc(db, 'profile_music', uid, 'chunks', 'meta'));
        }
    } catch(e) {
        throw new Error('Meta read failed — ' + (e?.code || e?.message || String(e)));
    }
    if (!metaSnap.exists()) {
        throw new Error('Meta doc missing for uid=' + uid + (slotKey ? ', slot=' + slotKey : '') + ' — check Firestore rules or upload');
    }

    const { total, type } = metaSnap.data();
    if (!total || total < 1) {
        throw new Error('Meta doc has no total — got: ' + JSON.stringify(metaSnap.data()));
    }

    const chunkPath = (slotKey && metaSnap.ref.path.includes('/slots/'))
        ? (i) => doc(db, 'profile_music', uid, 'slots', `slot_${slotKey}`, 'chunks', `chunk_${i}`)
        : (i) => doc(db, 'profile_music', uid, 'chunks', `chunk_${i}`);

    let parts;
    try {
        parts = await Promise.all(
            Array.from({ length: total }, (_, i) => getDoc(chunkPath(i)))
        );
    } catch(e) {
        throw new Error('Chunk read failed — ' + (e?.code || e?.message || String(e)));
    }
    const missing = parts.map((p, i) => p.exists() ? null : i).filter(i => i !== null);
    if (missing.length > 0) {
        throw new Error('Chunks missing — indexes ' + missing.join(',') + ' of ' + total + ' not found');
    }

    let blob;
    try {
        const isBin = parts.length > 0 && parts[0].data().bin !== undefined;
        if (isBin) {
            const arrays = parts.map(p => p.data().bin.toUint8Array());
            const totalLen = arrays.reduce((n, a) => n + a.length, 0);
            const bytes = new Uint8Array(totalLen);
            let off = 0;
            for (const a of arrays) { bytes.set(a, off); off += a.length; }
            blob = new Blob([bytes], { type: type || 'audio/mpeg' });
        } else {
            const base64 = parts.map(p => p.data().data).join('');
            if (!base64 || base64.length < 10) throw new Error('base64 string empty after join');
            const commaIdx = base64.indexOf(',');
            const b64data = commaIdx > -1 ? base64.slice(commaIdx + 1) : base64;
            const header  = commaIdx > -1 ? base64.slice(0, commaIdx) : '';
            const mimeMatch = header.match(/:(.*?);/);
            const mime = (mimeMatch && mimeMatch[1]) || type || 'audio/mpeg';
            const binary = atob(b64data);
            const bytes = new Uint8Array(binary.length);
            for (let i = 0; i < binary.length; i++) bytes[i] = binary.charCodeAt(i);
            blob = new Blob([bytes], { type: mime });
        }
        if (blob.size < 100) throw new Error('blob too small (' + blob.size + ' bytes) — decode may have failed');
    } catch(e) {
        throw new Error('Decode failed — ' + (e?.message || String(e)));
    }
    _musicDiskPut(cacheKey, stamp || metaSnap.data().uploadedAt, blob);

    const blobUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    if (!window._musicCache) window._musicCache = {};
    if (window._musicCache[cacheKey]) {
        try { URL.revokeObjectURL(window._musicCache[cacheKey]); } catch(_) {}
    }
    window._musicCache[cacheKey] = blobUrl;
    return blobUrl;
};

window.savePCM = async () => {
    if (window.GUEST_MODE) { _guestSavePCM(); return; }
    if (!window.myUID) return;
    const msg = document.getElementById('pcm-msg');
    msg.innerText = 'Saving…'; msg.classList.remove('hidden'); msg.style.color = '#818cf8';
    const updates = {};
    if (pcmPendingBg)                    updates.profileBg = pcmPendingBg;
    if (pcmPendingBanner)                updates.profileBanner = pcmPendingBanner;
    if (pcmPendingBannerDisabled !== null) updates.bannerDisabled = pcmPendingBannerDisabled;
    if (pcmPendingStars !== null)         updates.profileStars = pcmPendingStars;
    const _bioInput = document.getElementById('pcm-bio-input');
    if (_bioInput && pcmSavedBio !== null) {
        const _bio = _bioInput.value.trim().slice(0, window.MAX_BIO_LEN);
        if (_bio !== pcmSavedBio.trim()) updates.bio = _bio;
    }

    if (pcmPendingMusic) {
        try {
            const progWrap  = document.getElementById('pcm-music-progress-wrap');
            const progBar   = document.getElementById('pcm-music-progress-bar');
            const progLabel = document.getElementById('pcm-music-progress-label');
            if (progWrap) progWrap.style.display = 'block';
            msg.innerText = 'Uploading music…';

            const rawBytes = new Uint8Array(await pcmPendingMusic.file.arrayBuffer());

            const curSnap = await getDoc(doc(db, 'users', myUID));
            const curData = curSnap.exists() ? curSnap.data() : {};
            let playlist = Array.isArray(curData.profilePlaylist) ? [...curData.profilePlaylist] : (curData.profileMusic ? [{ ...curData.profileMusic, uploader: myUID, slotKey: '0' }] : []);

            const isOwnerNow = window._myRole === 'owner' || window.isAdmin === true;
            const MAX_SONGS = isOwnerNow ? 10 : 3;
            if (playlist.length >= MAX_SONGS) {
                msg.innerText = `Playlist full (${MAX_SONGS} tracks max). Remove a track first.`; msg.style.color = '#f87171'; return;
            }

            const slotKey = Date.now().toString();
            const uploaderUID = myUID;

            const CHUNK = 900000;
            const chunks = [];
            for (let i = 0; i < rawBytes.length; i += CHUNK) chunks.push(rawBytes.slice(i, i + CHUNK));
            const BATCH_SIZE = 5;
            const totalChunks = chunks.length;

            const delayPerBatch = 120;

            for (let start = 0; start < totalChunks; start += BATCH_SIZE) {
                const batch = writeBatch(db);
                const end = Math.min(start + BATCH_SIZE, totalChunks);
                for (let i = start; i < end; i++) {
                    batch.set(doc(db, 'profile_music', uploaderUID, 'slots', `slot_${slotKey}`, 'chunks', `chunk_${i}`), { bin: Bytes.fromUint8Array(chunks[i]), index: i });
                }
                if (end === totalChunks) {
                    batch.set(doc(db, 'profile_music', uploaderUID, 'slots', `slot_${slotKey}`, 'chunks', 'meta'), { total: totalChunks, type: pcmPendingMusic.file.type, name: pcmPendingMusic.name, uploadedAt: Date.now(), enc: 'bin', size: rawBytes.length });
                }
                await batch.commit();
                const pct = Math.round((end / totalChunks) * 100);
                if (progBar) progBar.style.width = pct + '%';
                if (progLabel) progLabel.textContent = `Uploading… ${pct}%`;
                if (end < totalChunks && delayPerBatch > 0) {
                    await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, delayPerBatch));
                }
            }


            if (progWrap) progWrap.style.display = 'none';
            if (window._musicCache) delete window._musicCache[uploaderUID];

            const _songNameEl = document.getElementById('pcm-music-songname');
            const _songName = (_songNameEl && _songNameEl.value.trim()) ? _songNameEl.value.trim() : pcmPendingMusic.name;

            const newEntry = { chunked: true, name: _songName, uploader: uploaderUID, uploaderName: myUsername || '', slotKey, uploadedAt: Date.now() };
            if (window._pmPendingLyricsText) {
                newEntry.lyricsText = window._pmPendingLyricsText;
                newEntry.lyricsName = window._pmPendingLyricsName || 'lyrics.lrc';
                window._pmPendingLyricsText = null;
                window._pmPendingLyricsName = null;
                const dropRow   = document.getElementById('pcm-lyrics-drop-row');
                const loadedRow = document.getElementById('pcm-lyrics-loaded-row');
                if (dropRow)   dropRow.style.display   = '';
                if (loadedRow) loadedRow.style.display  = 'none';
            }
            playlist.push(newEntry);

            updates.profilePlaylist = playlist;
            updates.profileMusic = playlist[0];
        } catch(e) {
            msg.innerText = 'Music upload failed: ' + e.message; msg.style.color = '#f87171'; return;
        }
    } else if (pcmMusicRemove) {
        updates.profileMusic = null;
        updates.profilePlaylist = [];
        try {
            const oldMeta = await getDoc(doc(db, 'profile_music', myUID, 'chunks', 'meta'));
            if (oldMeta.exists()) {
                const oldTotal = oldMeta.data().total || 0;
                const BATCH_SIZE = 10;
                for (let start = 0; start < oldTotal; start += BATCH_SIZE) {
                    const batch = writeBatch(db);
                    for (let i = start; i < Math.min(start + BATCH_SIZE, oldTotal); i++) {
                        batch.delete(doc(db, 'profile_music', myUID, 'chunks', `chunk_${i}`));
                    }
                    await batch.commit();
                }
                await deleteDoc(doc(db, 'profile_music', myUID, 'chunks', 'meta'));
            }
            if (window._musicCache) delete window._musicCache[myUID];
        } catch(_) {}
    }

    if (!Object.keys(updates).length) {
        msg.innerText = 'Nothing to save.'; msg.style.color = '#888899';
        setTimeout(() => msg.classList.add('hidden'), 2000); return;
    }
    try {
        await updateDoc(doc(db, 'users', myUID), updates);
        msg.innerText = 'Saved!'; msg.style.color = '#22c55e';
        if ('bio' in updates) {
            pcmSavedBio = updates.bio;
            window._renderProfileBio({ bio: updates.bio });
        }
        if (pcmPendingBanner && pcmPendingBanner !== '__reset__') {
            document.getElementById('profile-banner').style.background = `url('${pcmPendingBanner}') center/cover no-repeat`;
        } else if (pcmPendingBanner === '__reset__') {
            document.getElementById('profile-banner').style.background = '';
        }
        if (updates.profilePlaylist && updates.profilePlaylist.length > 0) {
            const firstTrack = updates.profilePlaylist[0];
            _applyProfileMusicBar({ profileMusic: firstTrack, _uid: firstTrack.uploader || window.myUID, profilePlaylist: updates.profilePlaylist }, false);
            const isOwnerNow = window._myRole === 'owner' || window.isAdmin === true;
            await _pcmRenderPlaylist({ profilePlaylist: updates.profilePlaylist, profileMusic: firstTrack }, isOwnerNow);
            const drop = document.getElementById('pcm-music-drop');
            const dropLabel = document.getElementById('pcm-music-drop-label');
            const statusEl = document.getElementById('pcm-music-status');
            const songNameEl = document.getElementById('pcm-music-songname');
            if (drop) drop.style.borderColor = '#1e1e2e';
            if (dropLabel) dropLabel.textContent = 'Click or drag to upload audio';
            if (statusEl) statusEl.style.display = 'none';
            if (songNameEl) songNameEl.value = '';
        } else if (updates.profileMusic) {
            _applyProfileMusicBar({ profileMusic: updates.profileMusic, _uid: window.myUID }, false);
        } else if (pcmMusicRemove) {
            const bar = document.getElementById('profile-music-bar');
            if (bar) bar.classList.remove('visible');
        }
        pcmPendingBg = null; pcmPendingBanner = null; pcmPendingBannerDisabled = null;
        pcmPendingMusic = null; pcmMusicRemove = false; pcmPendingStars = null;
        if (typeof updates.profileStars !== 'undefined') window._applyProfileStars && window._applyProfileStars(updates.profileStars);
        setTimeout(() => { msg.classList.add('hidden'); closePCM(); }, 1200);
    } catch(e) {
        msg.innerText = 'Error: ' + e.message; msg.style.color = '#f87171';
    }
};

(function() {
    const _realOpen = window.open.bind(window);

    const _POPUP_ALLOWLIST = [
        /^https?:\/\/([a-z0-9-]+\.)*puter\.com(\/|$|\?)/i,
        /^https?:\/\/([a-z0-9-]+\.)*puter\.site(\/|$|\?)/i,
    ];
    window._allowPopupUrl = (u) => _POPUP_ALLOWLIST.some(re => re.test(String(u || '')));

    window.open = function(url, target, features) {
        if (window._allowNextOpen) {
            window._allowNextOpen = false;
            return _realOpen(url, target, features);
        }
        try {
            if (window._allowPopupUrl(url)) {
                console.log('[PopupGuard] allowed trusted popup:', url);
                return _realOpen(url, target, features);
            }
        } catch(e) {}
        return null;
    };



    let _lastClickedFrame = null;
    let _lastClickedAt = 0;
    let _shieldTimer = null;
    const AD_POPUP_BLUR_WINDOW_MS = 700;

    function activateShield(frameId) {
        const shield = document.getElementById(frameId + '-ad-shield');
        if (!shield) return;
        shield.style.display = 'block';
        shield.onclick = () => deactivateShield(frameId);
        if (_shieldTimer) clearTimeout(_shieldTimer);
        _shieldTimer = setTimeout(() => deactivateShield(frameId), 3000);
    }

    function deactivateShield(frameId) {
        const shield = document.getElementById(frameId + '-ad-shield');
        if (shield) shield.style.display = 'none';
        _lastClickedFrame = null;
    }

    ['browser', 'games'].forEach(id => {
        const frame = document.getElementById(id + '-frame');
        if (!frame) return;

        frame.parentElement.addEventListener('mousedown', () => {
            _lastClickedFrame = id;
            _lastClickedAt = Date.now();
        });
        frame.parentElement.addEventListener('touchstart', () => {
            _lastClickedFrame = id;
            _lastClickedAt = Date.now();
        }, { passive: true });
    });

    window.addEventListener('blur', () => {
        if (!_lastClickedFrame) return;
        const frameId = _lastClickedFrame;
        const elapsed = Date.now() - _lastClickedAt;
        _lastClickedFrame = null;
        if (elapsed > AD_POPUP_BLUR_WINDOW_MS) return;

        setTimeout(() => {
            window.focus();
            activateShield(frameId);
        }, 50);
    });

    document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        const a = e.target.closest('a[target="_blank"], a[target="blank"]');
        if (a && !window._allowNextOpen) {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopImmediatePropagation();
        }
    }, true);

})();


const GLOBAL_BLOCKED_WORDS = [
    'nigger','nigga','faggot','fag','kike','spic','chink','gook','wetback','tranny',
    'retard','retarded','cunt','whore','slut',
    'kill yourself','kys','i will kill','gonna kill','shoot up','bomb threat',
    'rape','molest','pedophile','pedo',
    'buy followers','click here to win','free robux','free nitro','discord.gg/',
];

const URL_PATTERN = /(?:https?:\/\/|www\.)\S+/gi;

function globalContainsFlaggedWord(text) {
    const lower = text.toLowerCase();
    return GLOBAL_BLOCKED_WORDS.some(w => lower.includes(w));
}
window.globalContainsFlaggedWord = globalContainsFlaggedWord;

const _PROTECTED_NAME_HASHES = new Set([
    '1f8d16df6ff2eb98ac6f5762f492938754e2a3f773ed22b8f17c8e21707b12de',
    'd4806d1d3e7e5b2ea1cb8c809be46df18d24bd1c3cfaa43af471ac4f4dbf6fc5',
]);
const _PN_X = [61,59,44,51,52,122,45,51,54,54,51,59,55,41];
const _pnName = () => String.fromCharCode(..._PN_X.map(c => c ^ 0x5a));
function _pnNorm(text) {
    return String(text || '').toLowerCase()
        .replace(/[4@]/g, 'a').replace(/[1!|]/g, 'i').replace(/0/g, 'o')
        .replace(/3/g, 'e').replace(/[5$]/g, 's').replace(/7/g, 't')
        .replace(/[^a-z]+/g, ' ').trim();
}
function _pnKey(w) {
    return w.replace(/ph/g, 'v').replace(/[bfp]/g, 'v').replace(/ck|[cq]/g, 'k')
        .replace(/z/g, 's').replace(/[ey]/g, 'i').replace(/u/g, 'o')
        .replace(/(.)\1+/g, '$1');
}
function _pnCandidates(text) {
    const norm = _pnNorm(text);
    if (!norm) return [];
    const w = norm.split(' ');
    const c = new Set(w);
    for (let i = 0; i + 1 < w.length; i++) c.add(w[i] + w[i + 1]);
    let run = '';
    for (const x of w.concat([''])) {
        if (x.length === 1) run += x;
        else { if (run.length > 2) c.add(run); run = ''; }
    }
    c.add(norm.replace(/ /g, ''));
    return [...new Set([...c].map(_pnKey))];
}
async function _gcContainsProtectedName(text) {
    try {
        if (!text || !crypto?.subtle) return false;
        const enc = new TextEncoder();
        for (const k of _pnCandidates(text)) {
            const buf = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', enc.encode('echo-nm-v2:' + k));
            const hex = [...new Uint8Array(buf)].map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
            if (_PROTECTED_NAME_HASHES.has(hex)) return true;
        }
    } catch (_) {}
    return false;
}
window._gcContainsProtectedName = _gcContainsProtectedName;

function _pnLev(a, b) {
    const d = Array.from({ length: a.length + 1 }, (_, i) => [i]);
    for (let j = 1; j <= b.length; j++) d[0][j] = j;
    for (let i = 1; i <= a.length; i++) for (let j = 1; j <= b.length; j++)
        d[i][j] = Math.min(d[i-1][j] + 1, d[i][j-1] + 1, d[i-1][j-1] + (a[i-1] === b[j-1] ? 0 : 1));
    return d[a.length][b.length];
}
function _pnLooksClose(text) {
    const targets = _pnName().split(' ').map(_pnKey);
    return _pnCandidates(text).some(k => targets.some(t =>
        k.length >= t.length - 2 && k.length <= t.length + 3 && _pnLev(k, t) <= (t.length >= 6 ? 3 : 2)));
}
async function _pnAiSaysName(text) {
    try {
        const key = window.GEMINI_API_KEY;
        if (!key) return false;
        const name = _pnName();
        const r = await fetch(`https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-2.5-flash-lite:generateContent?key=${key}`, {
            method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify({
                contents: [{ parts: [{ text:
                    'A chat user\'s real name is private. The name is "' + name + '". Decide if the message below is trying to say this person\'s first name, last name, or full name, including misspellings, sound-alikes, spacing, symbols, leetspeak or deliberate disguises. An ordinary English word that merely looks similar (e.g. "given", "again", "will") is NOT a match. Reply with JSON only: {"match": true/false}\n\nMessage: ' + String(text).slice(0, 500)
                }] }],
                generationConfig: { temperature: 0 }
            })
        });
        const j = await r.json();
        const raw = j?.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts?.[0]?.text || '';
        return /"match"\s*:\s*true/i.test(raw);
    } catch (_) { return false; }
}

const _gcNameChecked = new Set();
async function _gcAutoRemoveProtectedName(d) {
    try {
        if (!isAdmin || _gcNameChecked.has(d.id)) return;
        _gcNameChecked.add(d.id);
        const data = d.data() || {};
        if (!data.text) return;
        let how = '';
        if (await _gcContainsProtectedName(data.text)) how = 'exact';
        else if (_pnLooksClose(data.text) && await _pnAiSaysName(data.text)) how = 'ai';
        if (!how) return;
        await deleteDoc(doc(db, 'global_chat', d.id));
        window.logAdminAction?.('auto_delete_protected_name', { how, byUid: data.uid || '', byUsername: data.username || '' });
    } catch (e) { console.warn('[GC] protected-name auto-delete failed:', e); }
}

function globalContainsUrl(text) {
    URL_PATTERN.lastIndex = 0;
    return URL_PATTERN.test(text);
}

function showGlobalBlockToast(msg) {
    const el = document.getElementById('global-block-toast');
    if (!el) return;
    el.innerText = msg;
    el.classList.remove('hidden');
    clearTimeout(el._t);
    el._t = setTimeout(() => el.classList.add('hidden'), 3500);
}

function renderGlobalMsg(docSnap, animate = false) {
    const m = docSnap.data();
    const box = document.getElementById('global-chat-box');
    if (!box) return;

    if (m.type === 'system') {
        const div = document.createElement('div');
        div.className = 'gc-system';
        div.id = 'gcmsg-' + docSnap.id;
        div.innerText = m.text;
        box.appendChild(div);
        return;
    }

    const isOwner = m.ownerAccount === true;
    const isAdminUser = m.adminAccount === true || isOwner;
    const timeStr = m.timestamp?.toDate
        ? m.timestamp.toDate().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })
        : '';
    let pfpSrc = (m.pfp && m.pfp !== '__chunked_gif__') ? m.pfp : window._DEFAULT_PFP;

    let displayText = window.escHtml(m.text);

    const badgeHtml = isOwner
        ? '<span class="gc-badge owner"><i class="fa-solid fa-crown"></i> Owner</span>'
        : isAdminUser
            ? '<span class="gc-badge admin"><i class="fa-solid fa-shield-halved"></i> Admin</span>'
            : (m.role && m.role !== 'member' && window.ROLE_META && window.ROLE_META[m.role])
                ? `<span class="role-badge ${m.role}" title="${window.ROLE_META[m.role].label}">${window.roleIconHtml(m.role) || window.ROLE_META[m.role].emoji} ${window.ROLE_META[m.role].label}</span>`
                : '';

    const canDel = isAdmin || (window._myRolePerms && window._myRolePerms.canDeleteMessages) || m.uid === myUID;

    const div = document.createElement('div');
    div.className = 'gc-msg' + (animate ? ' gc-msg-new' : '');
    div.id = 'gcmsg-' + docSnap.id;
    div.innerHTML = `
        <img src="${pfpSrc}" class="gc-pfp" data-es-uid="${m.uid}" onclick="openProfilePage('${m.uid}')" onerror="this.src=window._DEFAULT_PFP">
        <div class="gc-body">
            <div class="gc-header">
                <span class="gc-name${isOwner ? ' owner' : ''}" data-es-name="${m.uid}" onclick="openProfilePage('${m.uid}')">${window.escHtml(m.username)}</span>
                ${badgeHtml}
                <span class="gc-time">${timeStr}</span>
                ${m.text ? `<button onclick="window._translateGlobalMsg('${docSnap.id}','${window.escAttr(m.text)}')" style="margin-left:auto;font-size:10px;color:#333345;background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;font-weight:700;transition:color 0.15s;" onmouseover="this.style.color='#818cf8'" onmouseout="this.style.color='#333345'" title="Translate">🌐</button>` : ''}
                ${canDel && m.uid !== myUID ? `<button onclick="deleteGlobalMsg('${docSnap.id}')" style="${m.text ? '' : 'margin-left:auto;'}font-size:10px;color:#333345;background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;font-weight:700;transition:color 0.15s;" onmouseover="this.style.color='#f87171'" onmouseout="this.style.color='#333345'" title="Delete message">✕</button>` : ''}
                ${m.uid === myUID ? `<button onclick="deleteGlobalMsg('${docSnap.id}')" style="margin-left:auto;font-size:10px;color:#333345;background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;font-weight:700;transition:color 0.15s;" onmouseover="this.style.color='#f87171'" onmouseout="this.style.color='#333345'" title="Delete your message">✕</button>` : ''}
            </div>
            <div class="gc-text">${displayText}</div>
        </div>`;
    box.appendChild(div);
    try { window.EchoShards && window.EchoShards.decorateName(div.querySelector('.gc-name'), m.uid); } catch (_) {}

    if (m.pfp === '__chunked_gif__') {
        window._whenVisible(div, () => window.loadChunkedGif(m.uid).then(gif => {
            const img = div.querySelector('.gc-pfp');
            if (img) img.src = gif;
        }));
    }
}

let _globalUnsub = null;
let _globalSeenIds = new Set();
let _globalFirstLoad = true;

const GC_NOTIF_WINDOW = 45000;
const GC_NOTIF_SETTLE = 3000;
let _gcNotifQueue = [];
let _gcNotifTimer = null;
let _gcNotifLast  = 0;

function _gcMentionsMe(text) {
    const me = (window.myUsername || '').trim();
    if (!me || !text) return false;
    return new RegExp('@' + me.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&') + '(?![A-Za-z0-9_])', 'i').test(text);
}

function _gcFlushNotif() {
    clearTimeout(_gcNotifTimer);
    _gcNotifTimer = null;
    const n = _gcNotifQueue.length;
    if (!n) return;
    const last = _gcNotifQueue[n - 1];
    _gcNotifQueue = [];
    _gcNotifLast = Date.now();
    if (n === 1) triggerNotif('🌍 Global Chat', `${last.username}: ${last.text}`);
    else triggerNotif('🌍 Global Chat', `${n} new messages · latest from ${last.username}`);
}

function _gcQueueNotif(data) {
    if (!window._globalNotifEnabled()) return;
    const username = data.username || 'Someone';
    const text = data.text || '';

    if (_gcMentionsMe(text)) {
        _gcNotifQueue = [];
        clearTimeout(_gcNotifTimer);
        _gcNotifTimer = null;
        _gcNotifLast = Date.now();
        triggerNotif('🌍 ' + username + ' mentioned you', text, true);
        return;
    }

    _gcNotifQueue.push({ username, text });
    if (_gcNotifTimer) return;
    const since = Date.now() - _gcNotifLast;
    _gcNotifTimer = setTimeout(_gcFlushNotif, Math.max(GC_NOTIF_SETTLE, GC_NOTIF_WINDOW - since));
}

let _gcTailUnsub = null;
function _gcStartTail() {
    if (_gcTailUnsub || _globalUnsub) return;
    let newest = null;
    const seen = new Set();
    _gcTailUnsub = onSnapshot(
        query(collection(db, 'global_chat'), orderBy('timestamp', 'desc'), limit(5)),
        (snap) => {
            if (_globalUnsub) return;
            const first = newest === null;
            if (first) newest = 0;
            snap.docChanges().forEach(ch => {
                if (ch.type !== 'added' || seen.has(ch.doc.id)) return;
                seen.add(ch.doc.id);
                const data = ch.doc.data() || {};
                const ts = data.timestamp?.toMillis?.() ?? 0;
                if (first || ts <= newest) { newest = Math.max(newest, ts); return; }
                newest = ts;
                _gcAutoRemoveProtectedName(ch.doc);
                if (data.uid === myUID) return;
                if (document.getElementById('view-global')?.classList.contains('active')) return;
                document.getElementById('global-badge')?.classList.remove('hidden');
                _gcQueueNotif(data);
            });
        },
        (err) => { _gcTailUnsub = null; console.warn('[GlobalChat] tail listener error:', err); }
    );
}

function loadGlobalChat() {
    if (_globalUnsub) return;
    if (_gcTailUnsub) { _gcTailUnsub(); _gcTailUnsub = null; }
    _globalFirstLoad = true;
    _globalUnsub = onSnapshot(
        query(collection(db, 'global_chat'), orderBy('timestamp', 'asc'), limitToLast(50)),
        (snap) => {
            const box = document.getElementById('global-chat-box');
            snap.docChanges().forEach(ch => { if (ch.type === 'added') _gcAutoRemoveProtectedName(ch.doc); });
            if (!box) return;

            if (_globalFirstLoad) {
                box.innerHTML = '';
                _globalSeenIds = new Set();
                snap.forEach(d => {
                    renderGlobalMsg(d, false);
                    _globalSeenIds.add(d.id);
                });
                _globalFirstLoad = false;
                box.scrollTop = box.scrollHeight;
                return;
            }

            const wasNearBottom = box.scrollHeight - box.scrollTop - box.clientHeight < 120;
            let didAdd = false;
            snap.docChanges().forEach(change => {
                if (change.type === 'added' && !_globalSeenIds.has(change.doc.id)) {
                    renderGlobalMsg(change.doc, true);
                    _globalSeenIds.add(change.doc.id);
                    didAdd = true;
                    const globalActive = document.getElementById('view-global')?.classList.contains('active');
                    if (!globalActive && change.doc.data().uid !== myUID) {
                        document.getElementById('global-badge')?.classList.remove('hidden');
                        _gcQueueNotif(change.doc.data());
                    }
                }
                if (change.type === 'removed') {
                    const el = document.getElementById('gcmsg-' + change.doc.id);
                    if (el) el.remove();
                    _globalSeenIds.delete(change.doc.id);
                }
            });
            if (didAdd && wasNearBottom) {
                box.scrollTop = box.scrollHeight;
            }
        },
        (err) => { console.warn('[GlobalChat] listener error:', err); }
    );
}

const _origSwitchView = window.switchView;
window.switchView = (id) => {
    _origSwitchView(id);
    if (window.GUEST_MODE && GUEST_VIEWS.indexOf(id) === -1) return;
    if (id === 'settings') { try { window._stBuildNav?.(); } catch (_) {} }
    if (id === 'shop') { try { window.EchoShards && window.EchoShards.openShop(); } catch (_) {} }
    if (id === 'global') {
        document.getElementById('global-badge')?.classList.add('hidden');
        _gcNotifQueue = [];
        clearTimeout(_gcNotifTimer);
        _gcNotifTimer = null;
        if (!_globalUnsub) loadGlobalChat();
        setTimeout(() => {
            const box = document.getElementById('global-chat-box');
            if (box) box.scrollTop = box.scrollHeight;
        }, 100);
    }
};

window.sendGlobalMessage = async () => {
    const inp = document.getElementById('global-input');
    let text = inp.value.trim();
    if (!text || !myUID) return;

    const _toCheck = await _checkUserTimeout();
    if (_toCheck.blocked) {
        showGlobalBlockToast(`⏳ You are timed out for ${_fmtTimeoutRemaining(_toCheck.until)}. You cannot send messages.`);
        return;
    }

    if (!(isAdmin || window._hasPerm?.('bypassSlowmode')) && !spamGuard('global_chat', 3, 5000)) {
        showGlobalBlockToast('Slow down! You\'re sending too fast.');
        return;
    }
    if (!enforceMaxLength(text, 500, 'Global message')) return;
    text = sanitizeText(text);
    if (!text) return;

    if (globalContainsFlaggedWord(text)) {
        showGlobalBlockToast('Message contains a blocked word and was not sent.');
        return;
    }
    if (await _gcContainsProtectedName(text)) {
        inp.value = '';
        inp.style.height = 'auto';
        try {
            const now = new Date();
            renderGlobalMsg({ id: 'local-' + now.getTime(), data: () => ({
                uid: window.myUID, username: myUsername, pfp: myPfp || '', text,
                role: window._myRole || 'member',
                ownerAccount: _isSiteOwner(),
                adminAccount: isAdmin, timestamp: { toDate: () => now }
            }) }, true);
            const box = document.getElementById('global-chat-box');
            if (box) box.scrollTop = box.scrollHeight;
        } catch (_) {}
        return;
    }

    if (!(isAdmin || window._hasPerm?.('canSendLinks')) && globalContainsUrl(text)) {
        showGlobalBlockToast('Links are not allowed in Global Chat.');
        return;
    }

    inp.value = '';
    inp.style.height = 'auto';

    try {
        let globalPfp = myPfp || '';
        const _rawUserPfp = (await (async () => {
            try {
                const { getDoc, doc } = await import('https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.11.0/firebase-firestore.js');
                const snap = await getDoc(doc(db, 'users', window.myUID));
                return snap.exists() ? (snap.data().pfp || '') : '';
            } catch(e) { return ''; }
        })());
        if (_rawUserPfp === '__chunked_gif__') {
            globalPfp = '__chunked_gif__';
        } else if (globalPfp.startsWith('data:image/gif')) {
            globalPfp = '__chunked_gif__';
        } else if (globalPfp.startsWith('data:') && globalPfp.length > 8000) {
            try {
                globalPfp = await new Promise((res) => {
                    const img = new Image();
                    img.onload = () => {
                        const c = document.createElement('canvas');
                        c.width = 32; c.height = 32;
                        c.getContext('2d').drawImage(img, 0, 0, 32, 32);
                        res(c.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.6));
                    };
                    img.onerror = () => res('');
                    img.src = globalPfp;
                });
            } catch(e) { globalPfp = ''; }
        }
        await addDoc(collection(db, 'global_chat'), {
            uid: window.myUID,
            username: myUsername,
            pfp: globalPfp,
            text,
            role: window._myRole || 'member',
            ownerAccount: _isSiteOwner(),
            adminAccount: isAdmin,
            timestamp: serverTimestamp(),
        });
        if (typeof window.trackQuestAction === 'function') {
            window.trackQuestAction('globalChatMessagesSent', 1).catch(() => {});
        }
        try { window._maybeTrimChat?.('global_chat'); } catch (_) {}
    } catch(e) {
        showGlobalBlockToast('Failed to send: ' + e.message);
    }
};

document.getElementById('global-input').addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) { e.preventDefault(); sendGlobalMessage(); }
});

window.deleteGlobalMsg = async (msgId) => {
    if (!msgId) return;
    try {
        const snap = await getDoc(doc(db, 'global_chat', msgId));
        if (!snap.exists()) return;
        const hasModPerm = isAdmin || (window._myRolePerms && window._myRolePerms.canDeleteMessages);
        if (!hasModPerm && snap.data().uid !== myUID) return;
        await deleteDoc(doc(db, 'global_chat', msgId));
    } catch(e) { console.warn('Global delete failed:', e); }
};

window._startGlobalChatListener = () => {
    _gcStartTail();
    setTimeout(() => { if (window.isAdmin === true) loadGlobalChat(); }, 5000);
};


const SCAN_INTERVAL_MS  =  2 * 60 * 1000;
const LOCK_LEASE_MS     =  5 * 60 * 1000;
const LOCK_CHECK_MS     =  5 * 60 * 1000;

let _autoReportTimer    = null;
let _scannerLockHeld    = false;
let _lockCheckTimer     = null;
let _lockRenewTimer     = null;

async function _tryClaimLock() {
    if (!myUID) return false;
    const lockRef = doc(db, 'scanner_lock', 'active');
    try {
        const snap = await getDoc(lockRef);
        const now  = Date.now();
        if (snap.exists()) {
            const d = snap.data();
            const expires = d.expiresAt?.toMillis ? d.expiresAt.toMillis()
                          : d.expiresAt instanceof Date ? d.expiresAt.getTime() : 0;
            if (expires > now && d.uid !== myUID) return false;
        }
        await setDoc(lockRef, {
            uid:       myUID,
            username:  myUsername || 'unknown',
            lockedAt:  serverTimestamp(),
            expiresAt: new Date(now + LOCK_LEASE_MS)
        });
        return true;
    } catch(e) { console.warn('[EchoScanner] lock claim failed:', e); return false; }
}

async function _renewLock() {
    if (!_scannerLockHeld || !myUID) return;
    try {
        await setDoc(doc(db, 'scanner_lock', 'active'), {
            uid:       myUID,
            username:  myUsername || 'unknown',
            lockedAt:  serverTimestamp(),
            expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + LOCK_LEASE_MS)
        });
    } catch(e) { console.warn('[EchoScanner] lock renew failed:', e); }
}

async function _releaseLock() {
    if (!window.myUID) return;
    _scannerLockHeld = false;
    try {
        const snap = await getDoc(doc(db, 'scanner_lock', 'active'));
        if (snap.exists() && snap.data().uid === myUID) {
            await deleteDoc(doc(db, 'scanner_lock', 'active'));
        }
    } catch(e) {}
}

function _becomeRunner() {
    if (_autoReportTimer) clearInterval(_autoReportTimer);
    if (_lockRenewTimer)  clearInterval(_lockRenewTimer);
    _scannerLockHeld = true;
    runAutoReportNow();
    _autoReportTimer = setInterval(runAutoReportNow, SCAN_INTERVAL_MS);
    _lockRenewTimer  = setInterval(_renewLock, LOCK_LEASE_MS / 2);
    console.log('[EchoScanner] this tab is now the active background scanner');
}

function _stepDownAsRunner() {
    if (_autoReportTimer) { clearInterval(_autoReportTimer); _autoReportTimer = null; }
    if (_lockRenewTimer)  { clearInterval(_lockRenewTimer);  _lockRenewTimer  = null; }
    _releaseLock();
}

function _watchForFreeLock() {
    if (_lockCheckTimer) clearInterval(_lockCheckTimer);
    _lockCheckTimer = setInterval(async () => {
        if (_scannerLockHeld) { clearInterval(_lockCheckTimer); _lockCheckTimer = null; return; }
        const claimed = await _tryClaimLock();
        if (claimed) { clearInterval(_lockCheckTimer); _lockCheckTimer = null; _becomeRunner(); }
    }, LOCK_CHECK_MS);
}

window._initDistributedScanner = async () => {
    if (!window.myUID) return;
    try {
        const snap = await getDoc(doc(db, 'scanner_lock', 'active'));
        if (snap.exists() && snap.data().uid === myUID) { _becomeRunner(); return; }
    } catch(e) {}
    const claimed = await _tryClaimLock();
    if (claimed) { _becomeRunner(); } else { _watchForFreeLock(); }
};

window.addEventListener('beforeunload', _stepDownAsRunner);
window.addEventListener('pagehide',     _stepDownAsRunner);

async function loadAutoReports() {
    if (!isAdmin) return;
    try {
        const snap = await getDocs(query(collection(db, 'ai_reports'), orderBy('createdAt', 'desc'), limit(20)));
        renderAutoReports(snap.docs.map(d => ({ id: d.id, ...d.data() })));
    } catch(e) { console.warn('loadAutoReports:', e); }
}

function renderAutoReports(reports) {
    const box = document.getElementById('autoreport-reports-list');

    if (!reports.length) {
        box.innerHTML = '<p class="text-xs text-[#333345] text-center py-2">No reports yet.</p>';
        return;
    }
    box.innerHTML = reports.map(r => {
        const flagColor = r.flagged ? 'rgba(239,68,68,0.15)' : 'rgba(34,197,94,0.08)';

            chatWindowHtml = `
                <div style="margin-top:7px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);padding-top:6px;">
                    <button onclick="(function(el){el.nextElementSibling.style.display=el.nextElementSibling.style.display==='none'?'block':'none';el.innerText=el.innerText.includes('▾')?'Scanned Messages (${r.globalChatWindow.length}) ▸':'Scanned Messages (${r.globalChatWindow.length}) ▾'})(this)"
                        style="font-size:10px;color:#555566;background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;font-weight:700;padding:0;">
