                        ${rows}
                    </div>
                </div>`;
        }

        let historyHtml = '';
        if (r.echoHistory && r.echoHistory.length) {
            const histId = 'hist-' + r.id;
            const rows = r.echoHistory.map(m => {
                const roleColor = m.role === 'user' ? '#818cf8' : '#00f2ff';
                const roleLabel = m.role === 'user' ? 'You' : 'Echo';
                const content = window.escHtml(m.content || '').slice(0, 300);
                return `<div style="margin-bottom:4px;"><span style="font-weight:800;color:${roleColor};font-size:10px;">${roleLabel}:</span> <span style="color:#c8c8d8;">${content}${(m.content||'').length > 300 ? '…' : ''}</span></div>`;
            }).join('');
            historyHtml = `
                <div style="margin-top:7px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);padding-top:6px;">
                    <button onclick="(function(el){el.nextElementSibling.style.display=el.nextElementSibling.style.display==='none'?'block':'none';el.innerText=el.innerText.includes('▾')?'Chat History ▸':'Chat History ▾'})(this)"
                        style="font-size:10px;color:#555566;background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;font-weight:700;padding:0;">
                        📎 Chat History ▾
                    </button>
                    <div id="${histId}" style="display:none;margin-top:5px;max-height:160px;overflow-y:auto;padding:8px;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.3);border-radius:6px;font-size:11px;line-height:1.6;">
                        ${rows}
                    </div>
                </div>`;
        }

        return `<div style="background:${flagColor};border:1px solid ${flagBorder};border-radius:10px;padding:10px 12px;font-size:11px;">
            <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:5px;">
                <span style="font-weight:800;color:#e8e8f0;">${flagIcon} ${r.flagged ? '<span style="color:#f87171;">Action Needed</span>' : '<span style="color:#22c55e;">All Clear</span>'}${sourceBadge}</span>
                <span style="color:#333345;">${timeStr}</span>
            </div>
            <div style="color:#c8c8d8;line-height:1.6;">${window.escHtml(r.summary)}</div>
            ${chatWindowHtml}
            ${historyHtml}
            <button onclick="deleteAutoReport('${r.id}')" style="margin-top:6px;font-size:10px;color:#333345;background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;font-weight:700;" onmouseover="this.style.color='#888899'" onmouseout="this.style.color='#333345'">✕ Dismiss</button>
        </div>`;
    }).join('');
}

window.deleteAutoReport = async (id) => {
    try { await deleteDoc(doc(db, 'ai_reports', id)); } catch(e) {}
    loadAutoReports();
};

window._GEMINI_FALLBACK_CHAIN = ['gemini-3.6-flash', 'gemini-2.5-flash', 'gemini-2.5-flash-lite', 'gemini-3.5-flash', 'gemini-3.5-flash-lite', 'gemini-3.1-flash-lite'];
window._geminiCallWithFallback = async function(preferredModel, body) {
    const chain = [preferredModel, ...window._GEMINI_FALLBACK_CHAIN.filter(m => m !== preferredModel)];
    let lastErr = null;
    for (const model of chain) {
        try {
            const res = await fetch(
                `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/${model}:generateContent?key=${window.GEMINI_API_KEY}`,
                { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(body) }
            );
            if (res.status === 429 || res.status === 503) { lastErr = res.status; continue; }
            if (!res.ok) { lastErr = res.status; continue; }
            const data = await res.json();

            const text = data?.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts?.[0]?.text;
            if (text && text.trim()) return { ok: true, data, modelUsed: model };

            const why = data?.promptFeedback?.blockReason
                     || data?.candidates?.[0]?.finishReason || 'empty';
            if (data?.promptFeedback?.blockReason) return { ok: false, blocked: why, error: 'blocked' };
            console.warn('[Gemini]', model, '200 but no text —', why);
            lastErr = '200/' + why;
        } catch (e) { lastErr = e.message; continue; }
    }
    return { ok: false, error: lastErr };
};

const ECHO_VISION_PROMPT = `You are EchoAI's photo reader. The user sends a picture, usually a photo or screenshot of a homework or quiz question, sometimes with a message. Default mode is ANSWER-ONLY: give the single shortest correct answer with zero setup, zero restating the question and zero explanation, like '42', 'x = 7' or 'B) photosynthesis'. For multiple choice, give the letter and the answer. If several questions are visible, answer each on its own line, numbered. Only explain, step by step, when the user asks for it ('explain', 'how', 'why', 'show your work'); keep that explanation short and clear. If the picture is not a question, reply to their message about it in one or two sentences. If the picture is too blurry or cut off to read, say exactly what you can't read and ask them to retake it. Write any math beyond a plain number in LaTeX between single dollar signs so the app can typeset it, for example $\\frac{5}{6}$, $x^{7}$, $6\\sqrt{2}$ or $x = 8$. Never use \\( \\) delimiters. Write money normally, like $20, with no closing dollar sign.`;

window.EchoVision = (() => {
    let sess = null, connecting = null, idleTimer = null, current = null, chain = Promise.resolve();
    let lastImages = null, lastSess = null, uses = 0;
    const MAX_USES = 5;
    function recycle() { try { sess && sess.close(); } catch (_) {} sess = null; uses = 0; }

    function ensure() {
        if (sess && !sess.closed) return Promise.resolve(sess);
        if (connecting) return connecting;
        const s = new GeminiLiveSession({
            systemInstruction: ECHO_VISION_PROMPT,
            enableMic: false,
            responseModalities: ['AUDIO'],
            playAudio: false,
            autoResume: true,
            onOutputTranscript: (text) => {
                if (!current) return;
                current.text = text;
                try { current.onPartial?.(text); } catch (_) {}
            },
            onTurnComplete: () => {
                if (!current) return;
                const c = current; current = null;
                clearTimeout(c.timer);
                c.resolve((c.text || '').trim());
            },
            onError: (e) => console.warn('[EchoVision] session error:', e && e.message),
            onClose: () => {
                if (current) { const c = current; current = null; clearTimeout(c.timer); c.reject(new Error('Live connection closed')); }
                if (sess === s) sess = null;
            },
        });
        connecting = s.connect().then(() => { sess = s; connecting = null; return s; })
            .catch((e) => { connecting = null; try { s.close(); } catch (_) {} throw e; });
        return connecting;
    }
    function armIdle() {
        clearTimeout(idleTimer);
        idleTimer = setTimeout(() => {
            if (current || !sess) return;
            try { sess.close(); } catch (_) {}
            sess = null;
        }, 4 * 60 * 1000);
    }
    async function runOne(text, images, onPartial) {
        if (uses >= MAX_USES) recycle();
        const s = await ensure();
        uses++;
        clearTimeout(idleTimer);
        return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
            current = { text: '', resolve, reject, onPartial };
            const c = current;
            s.askWithImages(text, images);
            c.timer = setTimeout(() => {
                if (current !== c || c.text) return;
                try { s._resume('photo question unanswered after 20s'); } catch (_) {}
                c.timer = setTimeout(() => {
                    if (current !== c) return;
                    current = null;
                    if (c.text) c.resolve(c.text.trim()); else c.reject(new Error('Live took too long'));
                }, 25000);
            }, 20000);
        }).finally(armIdle);
    }
    function queue(fn) {
        const p = chain.then(fn, fn);
        chain = p.catch(() => {});
        return p;
    }
    function ask({ text, images, onPartial }) {
        const imgs = (images || []).filter(i => i && i.data);
        const q = String(text || '').trim() || (imgs.length > 1 ? 'Answer the questions in these images.' : 'Answer the question in this image.');
        return queue(async () => {
            const r = await runOne(q, imgs, onPartial);
            lastImages = imgs; lastSess = sess;
            return r;
        });
    }
    function explain({ onPartial } = {}) {
        return queue(() => {
            const again = !sess || sess !== lastSess ? (lastImages || []) : [];
            return runOne('Explain that last answer step by step, briefly.', again, onPartial);
        });
    }
    return { ask, explain, warm: () => ensure().catch(() => {}) };
})();

    function mount(doc, title, sub, icon) {
        doc.getElementById('esnap')?.remove();
        const root = doc.createElement('div');
        root.id = 'esnap';
        root.innerHTML = `<style>${CSS}</style>
            <div class="es-top">
                <div class="es-badge">${icon || ICON.cam}</div>
                <div class="es-head"><div class="es-title"></div><div class="es-sub"></div></div>
                <button class="es-ib" data-a="close" title="Cancel">${ICON.x}</button>
            </div>
            <div class="es-stage"></div><div class="es-bar"></div>`;
        root.querySelector('.es-title').textContent = title;

    function camera(doc, win) {
        return new Promise(async (resolve) => {
            const root = mount(doc, 'Take a photo', 'Line the question up inside the frame', ICON.cam);
            const stage = root.querySelector('.es-stage'), bar = root.querySelector('.es-bar');
            const guides = doc.createElement('div');
            guides.className = 'es-frame';
            guides.innerHTML = '<i></i><i></i><i></i><i></i>';
            const flash = doc.createElement('div');
            flash.className = 'es-flash';
            let stream = null, devices = [], devIdx = 0, done = false;
            const stop = () => { if (stream) stream.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop()); stream = null; };
            const finish = (v) => { if (done) return; done = true; stop(); doc.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey, true); root.remove(); resolve(v); };
            const onKey = (e) => { if (e.key === 'Escape') { e.preventDefault(); finish(null); } };
            doc.addEventListener('keydown', onKey, true);
            root.querySelector('[data-a="close"]').onclick = () => finish(null);
            const video = doc.createElement('video');
            video.autoplay = true; video.playsInline = true; video.muted = true;
            stage.append(video, guides, flash);
            bar.innerHTML = `<button class="es-shoot" title="Take photo"><span class="es-pulse"></span></button>`;
            const nav = (win || window).navigator;
            async function open(deviceId) {
                stop();
                const c = deviceId
                    ? { video: { deviceId: { exact: deviceId }, width: { ideal: 1920 }, height: { ideal: 1080 } }, audio: false }
                    : { video: { facingMode: { ideal: 'user' }, width: { ideal: 1920 }, height: { ideal: 1080 } }, audio: false };
                stream = await nav.mediaDevices.getUserMedia(c);
                video.srcObject = stream;
                try { await video.play(); } catch (_) {}
            }
            try {
                if (!nav.mediaDevices?.getUserMedia) throw Object.assign(new Error('no camera API'), { name: 'NotSupportedError' });
                await open(null);
                try {
                    devices = (await nav.mediaDevices.enumerateDevices()).filter(d => d.kind === 'videoinput');
                    const cur = stream.getVideoTracks()[0]?.getSettings?.().deviceId;
                    devIdx = Math.max(0, devices.findIndex(d => d.deviceId === cur));
                } catch (_) { devices = []; }
                if (devices.length > 1) {
                    const flip = doc.createElement('button');
                    flip.className = 'es-ib'; flip.title = 'Switch camera'; flip.innerHTML = ICON.flip;
                    flip.onclick = async () => {
                        devIdx = (devIdx + 1) % devices.length;
                        try { await open(devices[devIdx].deviceId); } catch (_) {}
                    };
                    root.querySelector('.es-top').insertBefore(flip, root.querySelector('[data-a="close"]'));
                }
            } catch (e) {
                const blocked = e && (e.name === 'NotAllowedError' || e.name === 'SecurityError');
                guides.remove(); flash.remove();
                stage.innerHTML = `<div class="es-msg">${blocked
                    ? 'Camera access is blocked. Click the camera icon in the address bar, allow it, then try again.'
                    : 'No camera was found on this device. You can upload a picture with the paperclip instead.'}</div>`;
                bar.innerHTML = `<button class="es-btn" data-a="close2">Close</button>`;
                bar.querySelector('[data-a="close2"]').onclick = () => finish(null);
                return;
            }
            bar.querySelector('.es-shoot').onclick = () => {
                const w = video.videoWidth, h = video.videoHeight;
                if (!w || !h) return;
                const cv = doc.createElement('canvas');
                cv.width = w; cv.height = h;
                cv.getContext('2d').drawImage(video, 0, 0, w, h);
                const url = cv.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.92);
                flash.classList.add('go');
                setTimeout(() => finish(url), 150);
            };
        });
    }

    function crop(doc, src, opts = {}) {
        return new Promise((resolve) => {
            const root = mount(doc, 'Crop to the question', 'Drag the corners so only the question is inside', ICON.crop);
            const stage = root.querySelector('.es-stage'), bar = root.querySelector('.es-bar');
            let done = false;
            const finish = (v) => { if (done) return; done = true; doc.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey, true); root.remove(); resolve(v); };
            const onKey = (e) => { if (e.key === 'Escape') { e.preventDefault(); finish(null); } else if (e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); output(false); } };
            doc.addEventListener('keydown', onKey, true);
            root.querySelector('[data-a="close"]').onclick = () => finish(null);

            const img = doc.createElement('img');
            img.className = 'es-img'; img.alt = ''; img.draggable = false;
            const box = doc.createElement('div');
            box.className = 'es-box';
            box.innerHTML = '<div class="es-grid"></div>'
                + '<i class="es-h" data-c="nw"></i><i class="es-h" data-c="ne"></i><i class="es-h" data-c="sw"></i><i class="es-h" data-c="se"></i>';
            const hint = doc.createElement('div');
            hint.className = 'es-hint'; hint.textContent = 'Drag the corners — drag the middle to move';
            stage.append(img, box, hint);
            bar.innerHTML = (opts.retake ? '<button class="es-btn" data-a="retake">Retake</button>' : '')
                + '<button class="es-btn" data-a="whole">Use whole image</button>'
                + '<button class="es-btn pri" data-a="use">Use crop</button>';
            if (opts.retake) bar.querySelector('[data-a="retake"]').onclick = () => finish('retake');
            bar.querySelector('[data-a="whole"]').onclick = () => output(true);
            bar.querySelector('[data-a="use"]').onclick = () => output(false);

            let r = { x: 0.08, y: 0.08, w: 0.84, h: 0.84 };
            const MIN = 0.06;
            const imgRect = () => {
                const s = stage.getBoundingClientRect(), i = img.getBoundingClientRect();
                return { left: i.left - s.left, top: i.top - s.top, width: i.width, height: i.height };
            };
            const place = () => {
                const ir = imgRect();
                if (!ir.width) return;
                box.style.left = (ir.left + r.x * ir.width) + 'px';
                box.style.top = (ir.top + r.y * ir.height) + 'px';
                box.style.width = (r.w * ir.width) + 'px';
                box.style.height = (r.h * ir.height) + 'px';
            };
            img.onload = place;
            img.src = src;
            (doc.defaultView || window).addEventListener('resize', place);

            let drag = null;
            box.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                hint.remove();
                const corner = e.target.dataset && e.target.dataset.c;
                drag = { corner, sx: e.clientX, sy: e.clientY, r0: { ...r }, ir: imgRect() };
                try { box.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch (_) {}
            });
            box.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {
                if (!drag) return;
                const dx = (e.clientX - drag.sx) / drag.ir.width, dy = (e.clientY - drag.sy) / drag.ir.height;
                const o = drag.r0;
                let { x, y, w, h } = o;
                const clamp = (v, a, b) => Math.max(a, Math.min(b, v));
                if (!drag.corner) {
                    x = clamp(o.x + dx, 0, 1 - o.w); y = clamp(o.y + dy, 0, 1 - o.h);
                } else {
                    if (drag.corner.includes('w')) { x = clamp(o.x + dx, 0, o.x + o.w - MIN); w = o.x + o.w - x; }
                    if (drag.corner.includes('e')) { w = clamp(o.w + dx, MIN, 1 - o.x); }
                    if (drag.corner.includes('n')) { y = clamp(o.y + dy, 0, o.y + o.h - MIN); h = o.y + o.h - y; }
                    if (drag.corner.includes('s')) { h = clamp(o.h + dy, MIN, 1 - o.y); }
                }
                r = { x, y, w, h };
                place();
            });
            const end = () => { drag = null; };
            box.addEventListener('pointerup', end);
            box.addEventListener('pointercancel', end);

            function output(whole) {
                const nw = img.naturalWidth, nh = img.naturalHeight;
                if (!nw || !nh) return;
                const c = whole ? { x: 0, y: 0, w: 1, h: 1 } : r;
                const sx = Math.round(c.x * nw), sy = Math.round(c.y * nh);
                const sw = Math.max(1, Math.round(c.w * nw)), sh = Math.max(1, Math.round(c.h * nh));
                const scale = Math.min(1, 1280 / Math.max(sw, sh));
                const cv = doc.createElement('canvas');
                cv.width = Math.max(1, Math.round(sw * scale)); cv.height = Math.max(1, Math.round(sh * scale));
                const g = cv.getContext('2d');
                g.fillStyle = '#fff'; g.fillRect(0, 0, cv.width, cv.height);
                g.drawImage(img, sx, sy, sw, sh, 0, 0, cv.width, cv.height);
                const dataUrl = cv.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.88);
                (doc.defaultView || window).removeEventListener('resize', place);
                finish({ b64: dataUrl.split(',')[1], mime: 'image/jpeg', dataUrl });
            }
        });
    }

    async function capture(doc, win) {
        for (;;) {
            const shot = await camera(doc || document, win || window);
            if (!shot) return null;
            const out = await crop(doc || document, shot, { retake: true });
            if (out === 'retake') continue;
            return out;
        }
    }
    return { capture, crop: (doc, src) => crop(doc || document, src, {}) };
})();

window._liveAsk = async function ({ systemInstruction, text, images = [], history = [], timeoutMs = 45000 }) {
    const sess = new GeminiLiveSession({
        systemInstruction: systemInstruction || 'Answer the user directly and completely.',
        enableMic: false,
        responseModalities: ['AUDIO'],
        playAudio: false,
        ...(history.length ? { initialHistory: history } : {}),
        onOutputTranscript: (t) => { out = t; nudge(); },
        onError: (e) => finish(e || new Error('live error'))
    });

    let out = '', settleTimer = null, done = false, resolve, reject;
    const result = new Promise((res, rej) => { resolve = res; reject = rej; });
    const finish = (err) => {
        if (done) return;
        done = true;
        clearTimeout(settleTimer);
        try { sess.close(); } catch (_) {}
        if (err && !out.trim()) reject(err); else resolve(out.trim());
    };
    const nudge = () => { clearTimeout(settleTimer); settleTimer = setTimeout(() => finish(), 1800); };

    await sess.connect();
    setTimeout(() => finish(new Error('live fallback timed out')), timeoutMs);

    const parts = [
        ...images.map(img => (typeof img === 'string'
            ? { inlineData: { mimeType: 'image/jpeg', data: img } }
            : { inlineData: { mimeType: img.mime || 'image/jpeg', data: img.data } })),
        { text: text || 'Describe this in detail.' }
    ];
    sess.ws.send(JSON.stringify({
        clientContent: { turns: [{ role: 'user', parts }], turnComplete: true }
    }));
    nudge();
    return result;
};

window.GEMINI_API_KEY = (() => {
    const enc = [36,50,70,46,17,72,51,45,83,47,83,34,31,48,7,19,52,87,10,10,41,23,41,66,35,48,35,45,87,10,38,24,23,43,34,0,38,38,47,28,6,69,80,15,42,6,40,91,32,37,63,13,34];
    const k = 'echospace';
    return enc.map((c,i) => String.fromCharCode(c ^ k.charCodeAt(i % k.length))).join('');
})();

window.runAutoReportNow = async () => {
    if (!window.myUID) return;
    const scanMsg = document.getElementById('autoreport-scanning-msg');
    if (scanMsg) { scanMsg.classList.remove('hidden'); }

    try {
        const twoMinAgo = new Date(Date.now() - 2 * 60 * 1000);
        const snap = await getDocs(query(
            collection(db, 'global_chat'),
            orderBy('timestamp', 'asc'),
            where('timestamp', '>=', twoMinAgo)
        ));

        const msgDocs = snap.docs.map(d => {
            const m = d.data();
            const t = m.timestamp?.toDate ? m.timestamp.toDate().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit' }) : '';
            return { time: t, uid: m.uid || '', username: m.username || 'Unknown', text: m.text || '' };
        });

        if (!msgDocs.length) {
            if (scanMsg) scanMsg.classList.add('hidden');
            return;
        }

        const chatLog = msgDocs.map(m => `[${m.time}] ${m.username}: ${m.text}`).join('\n');

        const geminiResp = await fetch(
            `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-2.5-flash-lite:generateContent?key=${GEMINI_API_KEY}`,
            {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({
                    contents: [{
                        parts: [{
                            text: 'You are a chat moderation assistant for EchoSpace. Review the following Global Chat messages from the last 2 minutes and write a SHORT admin report (3-5 sentences max). Flag if you see: harassment, hate speech, spam, explicit content, threats, or suspicious links. If everything looks fine, say so briefly. ALWAYS respond with valid JSON only — no markdown, no extra text: {"flagged": true/false, "summary": "your short report here"}\n\nMessages to review:\n\n' + chatLog
                        }]
                    }],
                    generationConfig: { temperature: 0.2 }
                })
            }
        );
        const geminiData = await geminiResp.json();
        const raw = geminiData?.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts?.[0]?.text ?? '{}';
        let result = { flagged: false, summary: 'Could not parse report.' };
        try {
            result = JSON.parse(raw.replace(/```json|```/g, '').trim());
        } catch(e) {
            result = { flagged: raw.toLowerCase().includes('flag') || raw.toLowerCase().includes('violation'), summary: raw.slice(0, 400) };
        }

        if (!result.flagged) {
            if (scanMsg) scanMsg.classList.add('hidden');
            return;
        }
        await addDoc(collection(db, 'ai_reports'), {
            flagged: !!result.flagged,
            summary: result.summary || 'No summary.',
            createdAt: serverTimestamp(),
            msgCount: msgDocs.length,
            windowMinutes: 2,
            globalChatWindow: msgDocs,
        });

        if (!result.flagged) {
            setTimeout(async () => {
                try {
                    const staleSnap = await getDocs(query(collection(db, 'ai_reports'), where('flagged', '==', false)));
                    const cutoff = Date.now() - 20000;
                    await Promise.all(staleSnap.docs
                        .filter(d => {
                            const ts = d.data().createdAt?.toMillis ? d.data().createdAt.toMillis() : 0;
                            return ts < cutoff || ts === 0;
                        })
                        .map(d => deleteDoc(d.ref))
                    );
                    loadAutoReports();
                } catch(e) { console.warn('[AutoReport] auto-clear failed:', e); }
            }, 25000);
        }

        const lastEl = document.getElementById('autoreport-last');
        const lastTimeEl = document.getElementById('autoreport-last-time');
        if (lastEl && lastTimeEl) {
            lastTimeEl.innerText = new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
            lastEl.classList.remove('hidden');
        }

        if (result.flagged) {
            const dot = document.getElementById('autoreport-status-dot');
            if (dot) { dot.style.background = '#ef4444'; dot.style.animation = 'adminPulse 1.4s ease-in-out infinite'; }
        }

        loadAutoReports();
    } catch(e) {
        console.warn('Auto-report scan failed:', e);
    } finally {
        if (scanMsg) scanMsg.classList.add('hidden');
    }
};

async function _sha256(str) {
    const buf = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', new TextEncoder().encode(str));
    return Array.from(new Uint8Array(buf)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');
}

async function _getAdminPwHash() {
    try {
        if (window.myUID) {
            const uSnap = await getDoc(doc(db, 'users', window.myUID));
            if (uSnap.exists() && uSnap.data().subAdminPasswordHash) return uSnap.data().subAdminPasswordHash;
        }
    } catch(e) {}
    try {
        const snap = await getDoc(doc(db, 'site_config', 'admin_lock'));
        if (snap.exists() && snap.data().adminPanelPasswordHash) return snap.data().adminPanelPasswordHash;
    } catch(e) {}
    try {
        const legacy = await getDoc(doc(db, 'site_config', 'main'));
        return legacy.exists() ? (legacy.data().adminPanelPasswordHash || null) : null;
    } catch(e) { return null; }
}

async function _migrateAdminHash() {
    try {
        const mainSnap = await getDoc(doc(db, 'site_config', 'main'));
        const legacyHash = mainSnap.exists() ? mainSnap.data().adminPanelPasswordHash : null;
        if (!legacyHash) return;
        const lockSnap = await getDoc(doc(db, 'site_config', 'admin_lock'));
        if (!(lockSnap.exists() && lockSnap.data().adminPanelPasswordHash)) {
            await setDoc(doc(db, 'site_config', 'admin_lock'), { adminPanelPasswordHash: legacyHash }, { merge: true });
        }
        await setDoc(doc(db, 'site_config', 'main'), { adminPanelPasswordHash: deleteField() }, { merge: true });
    } catch(e) {   }
}
window._migrateAdminHash = _migrateAdminHash;

}

}

window._adminUnlock = async () => {
    const input = document.getElementById('admin-lock-input');
    const err   = document.getElementById('admin-lock-err');
    const btn   = document.getElementById('admin-lock-btn');
    if (!input || !err) return;

    const entered = input.value.trim();
    if (!entered) { err.textContent = 'Enter your password.'; return; }

    const now = Date.now();
    let lockUntil = parseInt(sessionStorage.getItem('_alk_until') || '0', 10);
    if (lockUntil > now) {
        const secs = Math.ceil((lockUntil - now) / 1000);
        err.textContent = `Too many attempts — wait ${secs}s.`;
        return;
    }

    btn.textContent = 'Checking…';
    btn.disabled = true;

    const storedHash = await _getAdminPwHash();

    if (!storedHash) {
        btn.textContent = 'Unlock';
        btn.disabled = false;
        if (window._panelSetup) { window._panelSetup.run('admin'); return; }
        err.textContent = 'Panel setup unavailable — reload and try again.';
        return;
    }

    const enteredHash = await _sha256(entered);
    if (enteredHash === storedHash) {
        sessionStorage.removeItem('_alk_tries');
        sessionStorage.removeItem('_alk_until');
        window._adminMarkUnlocked && window._adminMarkUnlocked();
        input.value = '';
        err.textContent = '';
    } else {
        const tries = parseInt(sessionStorage.getItem('_alk_tries') || '0', 10) + 1;
        sessionStorage.setItem('_alk_tries', String(tries));
        if (tries >= 5) {
            const wait = Math.min(30000 * Math.pow(2, tries - 5), 300000);
            sessionStorage.setItem('_alk_until', String(Date.now() + wait));
            err.textContent = `Too many attempts — locked for ${Math.ceil(wait / 1000)}s.`;
        } else {
            err.textContent = `Incorrect password. (${5 - tries} left)`;
        }
        input.classList.add('shake');
        input.value = '';
        setTimeout(() => { input.classList.remove('shake'); input.focus(); }, 400);
    }

    btn.textContent = 'Unlock';
    btn.disabled = false;
};

window._changeAdminPassword = async () => {
    const curEl  = document.getElementById('ap-pw-current');
    const newEl  = document.getElementById('ap-pw-new');
    const conEl  = document.getElementById('ap-pw-confirm');
    const msgEl  = document.getElementById('ap-pw-msg');
    if (!curEl || !newEl || !conEl || !msgEl) return;

    const cur = curEl.value.trim();
    const nw  = newEl.value.trim();
    const con = conEl.value.trim();

    function _pwMsg(text, ok) {
        msgEl.textContent = text;
        msgEl.style.color = ok ? '#22c55e' : '#f87171';
        msgEl.classList.remove('hidden');
    }

    if (!cur) return _pwMsg('Enter your current password.', false);
    if (nw.length < 6) return _pwMsg('New password must be at least 6 characters.', false);
    if (nw !== con) return _pwMsg('New passwords do not match.', false);

    _pwMsg('Verifying…', true);

    const storedHash = await _getAdminPwHash();
    if (storedHash) {
        const curHash = await _sha256(cur);
        if (curHash !== storedHash) return _pwMsg('Current password is incorrect.', false);
    }

    try {
        const newHash = await _sha256(nw);
        await setDoc(doc(db, 'site_config', 'admin_lock'), { adminPanelPasswordHash: newHash }, { merge: true });
        setDoc(doc(db, 'site_config', 'main'), { adminPanelPasswordHash: deleteField() }, { merge: true }).catch(() => {});
        sessionStorage.setItem('adminUnlocked', '1');
        curEl.value = ''; newEl.value = ''; conEl.value = '';
        _pwMsg('✓ Password updated successfully.', true);
    } catch(e) {
        _pwMsg('Failed to save: ' + e.message, false);
    }
};

};
window._mouseTrailEnabled = () => localStorage.getItem('mouse_trail') !== '0';
window._mouseTrailStyle   = () => localStorage.getItem('mouse_trail_style') || 'comet';

(function () {
    let canvas = null, ctx = null, dpr = 1;
    let pts = [];
    let sparks = [];
    let rings  = [];
    let raf = null, lastX = null, lastY = null;
    let cw = 0, ch = 0;
    const MAX_PTS = 26;
    const LIFE = 480;
    const RING_LIFE = 540;

    const reduced = () => false;

    const onScreen = (id) => {
        const el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (!el || el.classList.contains('hidden')) return false;
        if (getComputedStyle(el).display === 'none') return false;
        const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
        return r.width > 0 && r.height > 0;
    };
    const cloaked = () => onScreen('security-gate') || onScreen('auto-cloak-prompt');

    let C1 = [129, 140, 248], C2 = [99, 102, 241], colorsFresh = false;
    function parseColor(str, fallback) {
        str = (str || '').trim();
        if (/^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/i.test(str)) {
            return [parseInt(str.slice(1, 3), 16), parseInt(str.slice(3, 5), 16), parseInt(str.slice(5, 7), 16)];
        }
        if (/^#[0-9a-f]{3}$/i.test(str)) {
            return [parseInt(str[1] + str[1], 16), parseInt(str[2] + str[2], 16), parseInt(str[3] + str[3], 16)];
        }
        const m = str.match(/(-?[\d.]+)[,\s]+(-?[\d.]+)[,\s]+(-?[\d.]+)/);
        return m ? [+m[1], +m[2], +m[3]] : fallback;
    }
    function refreshColors() {
        const cs = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement);
        C1 = parseColor(cs.getPropertyValue('--trail-1'), [129, 140, 248]);
        C2 = parseColor(cs.getPropertyValue('--trail-2'), [99, 102, 241]);
        colorsFresh = true;
    }
    const rgba = (c, a) => 'rgba(' + c[0] + ',' + c[1] + ',' + c[2] + ',' + a + ')';
    const mix  = (a, b, t) => [a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * t, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * t, a[2] + (b[2] - a[2]) * t];
    window._mouseTrailRecolor = () => { colorsFresh = false; };

    function ensureCanvas() {
        if (canvas) return canvas;
        canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
        canvas.id = 'mouse-trail';
        document.body.appendChild(canvas);
        ctx = canvas.getContext('2d', { alpha: true });
        resize();
        window.addEventListener('resize', resize, { passive: true });
        try { new ResizeObserver(resize).observe(canvas); } catch (_) {}
        return canvas;
    }

    function resize() {
        if (!canvas) return;
        dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
        const box = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
        cw = Math.round(box.width)  || document.documentElement.clientWidth;
        ch = Math.round(box.height) || document.documentElement.clientHeight;
        const bw = Math.max(1, Math.floor(cw * dpr));
        const bh = Math.max(1, Math.floor(ch * dpr));
        if (canvas.width === bw && canvas.height === bh) return;
        canvas.width = bw;
        canvas.height = bh;
        ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
    }

    function onMove(e) {
        if (!window._mouseTrailEnabled() || reduced() || cloaked()) return;
        if (e.pointerType && e.pointerType !== 'mouse') return;
        ensureCanvas().classList.add('on');
        const now = performance.now();
        const x = e.clientX, y = e.clientY;
        const dx = lastX === null ? 0 : x - lastX;
        const dy = lastY === null ? 0 : y - lastY;
        const speed = Math.min(Math.hypot(dx, dy), 60);

        if (lastX !== null && speed < 1.2) return;
        lastX = x; lastY = y;

        pts.push({ x, y, t: now, speed });
        if (pts.length > MAX_PTS) pts.shift();

        const st = window._mouseTrailStyle();
        if (st === 'sparks' && speed > 2.5) {
            const n = Math.min(1 + (speed / 16) | 0, 4);
            for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) emitSpark(x, y, now, -dx * 0.06, -dy * 0.06, 1.7);
        } else if (st === 'bubbles' && speed > 2 && Math.random() < 0.5) {
            emitBubble(x, y, now);
        } else if (st === 'fireflies' && speed > 2 && Math.random() < 0.34) {
            emitFirefly(x, y, now);
        }
        start();
    }

    function trim() {
        if (sparks.length > 260) sparks.splice(0, sparks.length - 260);
    }

    function emitSpark(x, y, now, biasX, biasY, spread, sizeBoost) {
        sparks.push({
            x, y, t: now,
            vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * spread + biasX,
            vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * spread + biasY,
            r: (0.9 + Math.random() * 1.9) * (sizeBoost || 1),
            hue: Math.random(),
            tw: 4 + Math.random() * 7
        });
        trim();
    }

    function emitBubble(x, y, now) {
        sparks.push({
            mode: 'bubble', life: LIFE * 3.2,
            x: x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 16, y: y + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 16, t: now,
            vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5,
            vy: -(0.35 + Math.random() * 0.7),
            r: 3 + Math.random() * 7,
            hue: Math.random(),
            drift: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
        });
        trim();
    }

    function emitFirefly(x, y, now) {
        sparks.push({
            mode: 'fly', life: LIFE * 3.8,
            x: x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 22, y: y + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 22, t: now,
            vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.6,
            vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.6,
            r: 1.3 + Math.random() * 1.7,
            hue: Math.random(),
            tw: 4 + Math.random() * 6,
            drift: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
        });
        trim();
    }

    function onDown(e) {
        if (!window._mouseTrailEnabled() || reduced() || cloaked()) return;
        if (e.pointerType && e.pointerType !== 'mouse') return;
        ensureCanvas().classList.add('on');
        const now = performance.now();
        const n = 22;
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            const a = (i / n) * Math.PI * 2 + Math.random() * 0.3;
            const v = 2.6 + Math.random() * 3.2;
            emitSpark(e.clientX, e.clientY, now, Math.cos(a) * v, Math.sin(a) * v, 0.6, 1.9);
        }
        rings.push({ x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY, t: now });
        start();
    }

    let lastFrameAt = 0;
    function start() {
        const now = performance.now();
        if (raf) {
            if (now - lastFrameAt < 500) return;
            cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
            raf = null;
        }
        lastFrameAt = now;
        raf = requestAnimationFrame(draw);
    }

    let dirty = null;
    function mark(x, y, pad) {
        if (!dirty) dirty = [x - pad, y - pad, x + pad, y + pad];
        else {
            if (x - pad < dirty[0]) dirty[0] = x - pad;
            if (y - pad < dirty[1]) dirty[1] = y - pad;
            if (x + pad > dirty[2]) dirty[2] = x + pad;
            if (y + pad > dirty[3]) dirty[3] = y + pad;
        }
    }

    function draw() {
        raf = null;
        if (!ctx) return;
        const now = performance.now();
        lastFrameAt = now;
        if (!colorsFresh) refreshColors();

        if (dirty) {
            ctx.clearRect(dirty[0] - 2, dirty[1] - 2, dirty[2] - dirty[0] + 4, dirty[3] - dirty[1] + 4);
        }
        dirty = null;

        while (pts.length && now - pts[0].t >= LIFE) pts.shift();
        sparks = sparks.filter(s => now - s.t < (s.life || LIFE * 1.6));
        rings  = rings.filter(r => now - r.t < RING_LIFE);

        const style = window._mouseTrailStyle();
        const on = window._mouseTrailEnabled() && !reduced();

        if (on) {
            ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
            if (style !== 'sparks' && style !== 'bubbles' && style !== 'fireflies') drawRibbon(now, style);
            drawSparks(now);
            drawRings(now);
            ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
        }

        if ((pts.length || sparks.length || rings.length) && on) start();
        else { canvas?.classList.remove('on'); pts = []; sparks = []; rings = []; dirty = null; }
    }

    function drawRibbon(now, style) {
        const n = pts.length;
        if (n < 2) return;
        const wide = style === 'ribbon';
        const neon = style === 'neon';
        const baseW = neon ? 3.2 : wide ? 11 : 6.5;
        const head = pts[n - 1];

        const L = [], R = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            const p = pts[i];
            const a = pts[i - 1] || p, b = pts[i + 1] || p;
            const sx = (a.x + p.x + b.x) / 3, sy = (a.y + p.y + b.y) / 3;
            let tx = b.x - a.x, ty = b.y - a.y;
            const len = Math.hypot(tx, ty) || 1;
            tx /= len; ty /= len;
            const life = 1 - (now - p.t) / LIFE;
            const frac = i / (n - 1);
            const speedBoost = (wide || neon) ? 1 : 0.55 + Math.min(p.speed, 45) / 60;
            const w = neon
                ? baseW * (0.4 + 0.6 * Math.pow(frac, 0.3)) * Math.max(life, 0)
                : baseW * Math.pow(frac, 0.65) * Math.max(life, 0) * speedBoost;
            L.push(sx - ty * w, sy + tx * w);
            R.push(sx + ty * w, sy - tx * w);
            mark(sx, sy, w + (neon ? 26 : 14));
        }

        const tail = pts[0];
        const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(tail.x, tail.y, head.x, head.y);
        grad.addColorStop(0, rgba(C2, 0));
        grad.addColorStop(0.35, rgba(C2, neon ? 0.48 : wide ? 0.30 : 0.34));
        grad.addColorStop(1, rgba(C1, neon ? 0.95 : wide ? 0.55 : 0.72));

        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(L[0], L[1]);
        for (let i = 2; i < L.length; i += 2) ctx.lineTo(L[i], L[i + 1]);
        for (let i = R.length - 2; i >= 0; i -= 2) ctx.lineTo(R[i], R[i + 1]);
        ctx.closePath();

        ctx.save();
        if (neon) {
            ctx.filter = 'blur(18px)';
            ctx.globalAlpha = 0.7;
            ctx.fillStyle = grad;
            ctx.fill();
        }
        ctx.filter = 'blur(' + (neon ? 6 : wide ? 7 : 5) + 'px)';
        ctx.globalAlpha = neon ? 0.9 : 0.55;
        ctx.fillStyle = grad;
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.restore();
        ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
        ctx.fillStyle = grad;
        ctx.fill();

        const orb = (neon ? 4.5 : wide ? 7 : 5.5) + Math.min(head.speed, 45) / 7;
        const g2 = ctx.createRadialGradient(head.x, head.y, 0, head.x, head.y, orb);
        g2.addColorStop(0, rgba(C1, 0.95));
        g2.addColorStop(0.35, rgba(C1, 0.42));
        g2.addColorStop(1, rgba(C1, 0));
        ctx.fillStyle = g2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(head.x, head.y, orb, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        mark(head.x, head.y, orb + 4);
    }

    function drawSparks(now) {
        for (let i = 0; i < sparks.length; i++) {
            const s = sparks[i];
            const age = (now - s.t) / (s.life || LIFE * 1.6);
            const life = 1 - age;

            if (s.mode === 'bubble') {
                s.x += s.vx + Math.sin(now / 420 + s.drift) * 0.35;
                s.y += s.vy;
                s.vy *= 0.997;
                const r = Math.max(s.r * (0.55 + life * 0.45), 0.4);
                const col = mix(C1, C2, s.hue);
                ctx.strokeStyle = rgba(col, life * 0.75);
                ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, r * 0.22);
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.stroke();
                ctx.fillStyle = rgba(C1, life * 0.5);
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(s.x - r * 0.32, s.y - r * 0.32, Math.max(r * 0.18, 0.4), 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fill();
                mark(s.x, s.y, r + 4);
                continue;
            }

            if (s.mode === 'fly') {
                s.vx += Math.sin(now / 260 + s.drift) * 0.035;
                s.vy += Math.cos(now / 310 + s.drift * 1.7) * 0.035;
                s.vx *= 0.94; s.vy *= 0.94;
                s.x += s.vx; s.y += s.vy;
                const pulse = 0.3 + 0.7 * Math.pow(0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(now / 150 * (s.tw / 5) + s.drift), 2);
                const fade = Math.min(life * 2.4, 1);
                const glow = s.r * 4.5;
                const col = mix(C1, C2, s.hue);
                const gf = ctx.createRadialGradient(s.x, s.y, 0, s.x, s.y, glow);
                gf.addColorStop(0, rgba(col, fade * pulse * 0.95));
                gf.addColorStop(0.32, rgba(col, fade * pulse * 0.3));
                gf.addColorStop(1, rgba(col, 0));
                ctx.fillStyle = gf;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, glow, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fill();
                mark(s.x, s.y, glow + 3);
                continue;
            }

            s.x += s.vx; s.y += s.vy;
            s.vy += 0.03;
            s.vx *= 0.982; s.vy *= 0.982;
            const tw = 0.65 + 0.35 * Math.sin(now / 90 * (s.tw / 6) + i);
            const r = Math.max(s.r * life, 0.2);
            ctx.fillStyle = rgba(mix(C1, C2, s.hue), life * life * 0.9 * tw);
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();
            mark(s.x, s.y, r + 3);
        }
    }

    function drawRings(now) {
        for (const ring of rings) {
            const age = (now - ring.t) / RING_LIFE;
            const life = 1 - age;
            const r = 7 + (1 - Math.pow(life, 3)) * 46;
            ctx.strokeStyle = rgba(C1, life * 0.85);
            ctx.lineWidth = 3.2 * life;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(ring.x, ring.y, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.stroke();
            if (age > 0.12) {
                const l2 = Math.max(life - 0.12, 0);
                ctx.strokeStyle = rgba(C2, l2 * 0.5);
                ctx.lineWidth = 1.8 * l2;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(ring.x, ring.y, r * 0.62, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.stroke();
            }
            mark(ring.x, ring.y, r + 6);
        }
    }

    const wipe = () => {
        if (raf) { cancelAnimationFrame(raf); raf = null; }
        pts = []; sparks = []; rings = []; dirty = null; lastX = lastY = null;
        if (ctx) ctx.clearRect(0, 0, cw, ch);
        canvas?.classList.remove('on');
    };
    document.addEventListener('pointermove', onMove, { passive: true });
    document.addEventListener('pointerdown', onDown, { passive: true });
    document.addEventListener('pointerleave', wipe, { passive: true });
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => { if (document.hidden) wipe(); });

    window._mouseTrailRefresh = () => {
        if (!window._mouseTrailEnabled() || reduced()) wipe();
    };
})();

const _giphyHostSwap = (u) => {
    try {
        const p = new URL(u);
        if (!/\.giphy\.com$/.test(p.hostname)) return [];
        return ['media0','media1','media2','media3','media4','i'].map(h => {
            const c = new URL(u); c.hostname = h + '.giphy.com'; return c.href;
        }).filter(h => h !== u);
    } catch (_) { return []; }
};

const _hostPath = (u) => String(u).replace(/^https?:\/\//, '');

function _gifUvRoute(u) {
    if (!u) return null;
    if (window.EchoProxy && window.__uv$config) {
        try { return window.EchoProxy.encode(u); } catch (_) { return null; }
    }
    if (window.ECHO_YT && typeof window.ECHO_YT.ensure === 'function') {
        try { window.ECHO_YT.ensure(); } catch (_) {}
    }
    return null;
}

function _gifChainWithUv(chain, hosts) {
    const uv = hosts.map(_gifUvRoute).filter(Boolean);
    if (!uv.length) return chain;
    const filtered = window.ECHO_YT && window.ECHO_YT.isBlocked() === true;
    return filtered ? [...uv, ...chain] : [...chain, ...uv];
}

const _GIF_PROXIES = [
    u => 'https://wsrv.nl/?url=' + encodeURIComponent(u) + '&output=gif&n=-1',
    u => 'https://images.weserv.nl/?url=' + encodeURIComponent(u) + '&output=gif&n=-1',
    u => 'https://i0.wp.com/' + _hostPath(u),
    u => 'https://i1.wp.com/' + _hostPath(u),
    u => 'https://i2.wp.com/' + _hostPath(u),
    u => 'https://i3.wp.com/' + _hostPath(u),
    u => 'https://cdn.statically.io/img/' + _hostPath(u),
    u => 'https://api.allorigins.win/raw?url=' + encodeURIComponent(u),
    u => 'https://corsproxy.io/?' + encodeURIComponent(u),
    u => 'https://api.codetabs.com/v1/proxy?quest=' + encodeURIComponent(u),
    u => 'https://api.cors.lol/?url=' + encodeURIComponent(u),
    u => 'https://proxy.corsfix.com/?' + encodeURIComponent(u),
    u => 'https://test.cors.workers.dev/?' + encodeURIComponent(u),
    u => 'https://thingproxy.freeboard.io/fetch/' + u,
];

function _gifSrcChain(url) {
    if (!url) return [];
    const hosts = [url, ..._giphyHostSwap(url)];
    const chain = [...hosts];
    for (const f of _GIF_PROXIES) for (const h of hosts) chain.push(f(h));
    return _gifChainWithUv(chain, hosts);
}

function _proxyGifUrl(url) {
    if (!url) return url;
    return _GIF_PROXIES[0](url);
}

window._gifMsgFallback = (msgId, directUrl, proxyUrl, imgEl) => {
    const chain = (imgEl._gifChain || (imgEl._gifChain = _gifSrcChain(directUrl)));
    const _tried = (imgEl._gifTried = (imgEl._gifTried || 0) + 1);
    const next = chain[_tried];
    if (next) {
        imgEl.src = next;
    } else {
        imgEl.onerror = null;
        imgEl.style.display = 'none';
        const wrap = document.getElementById('gif-wrap-' + msgId);
        if (wrap) {
            const ph = document.createElement('div');
            ph.style.cssText = 'display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:10px 14px;background:#0f0f1a;border:1px dashed #2a2a3a;border-radius:12px;margin-top:4px;max-width:220px;cursor:pointer;';
            ph.title = 'GIF blocked on this network — click to try opening directly';
            ph.onclick = () => window.open(directUrl, '_blank');
            ph.innerHTML = '<span style="font-size:20px;opacity:0.4;">🎬</span><div><div style="font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:#333345;">GIF blocked</div><div style="font-size:10px;color:#2a2a3a;">Tap to open in browser</div></div>';
            wrap.insertBefore(ph, wrap.firstChild);
        }
    }
};

async function _fetchGiphyJson(endpoint) {
    const diag = [];
    window._gifLastDiag = diag;
    const note = (route, why) => diag.push(route + ': ' + why);

    try {
        const res = await fetch(endpoint, { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(5000) });
        if (res.ok) return await res.json();
        note('direct', 'HTTP ' + res.status);
    } catch(e) { note('direct', e.name === 'TimeoutError' ? 'timeout' : (e.name || 'failed')); }
    try {
        if (!window.echoTunnelFetch) {
            note('proxy', 'loader missing');
        } else {
            const res = await window.echoTunnelFetch(endpoint, undefined, 20000);
            const ct = res.headers.get('content-type') || '';
            if (res.ok && ct.includes('json')) return await res.json();
            note('proxy', res.ok ? ('got ' + (ct.split(';')[0] || 'no type')) : ('HTTP ' + res.status));
        }
    } catch (e) {
        const st = window.EchoProxy && window.EchoProxy.status ? window.EchoProxy.status() : null;
        note('proxy', (e && e.message) || 'failed');
        if (st) note('proxy state', (st.stage || '?') + (st.endpoint ? ' via ' + st.endpoint.replace(/^wss:\/\//, '').split('/')[0] : ''));
    }

    let pubFail = 0;
    for (const p of _GIF_API_PROXIES) {
        try {
            const res = await fetch(p.url(endpoint), { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(8000) });
            if (!res.ok) { pubFail++; continue; }
            if (p.wrapped) {
                const wrapper = await res.json();
                return JSON.parse(wrapper.contents ?? wrapper.content);
            }
            return await res.json();
        } catch (e) { pubFail++;   }
    }
    note('public routes', pubFail + '/' + _GIF_API_PROXIES.length + ' failed');
    throw new Error('direct and all ' + _GIF_API_PROXIES.length + ' proxies failed');
}

const _GIF_API_PROXIES = [
    { url: u => 'https://api.allorigins.win/get?url=' + encodeURIComponent(u), wrapped: true },
    { url: u => 'https://api.allorigins.win/raw?url=' + encodeURIComponent(u) },
    { url: u => 'https://corsproxy.io/?' + encodeURIComponent(u) },
    { url: u => 'https://api.codetabs.com/v1/proxy?quest=' + encodeURIComponent(u) },
    { url: u => 'https://api.cors.lol/?url=' + encodeURIComponent(u) },
    { url: u => 'https://proxy.corsfix.com/?' + encodeURIComponent(u) },
    { url: u => 'https://test.cors.workers.dev/?' + encodeURIComponent(u) },
    { url: u => 'https://cors-anywhere.herokuapp.com/' + u },
    { url: u => 'https://thingproxy.freeboard.io/fetch/' + u },
    { url: u => 'https://whateverorigin.org/get?url=' + encodeURIComponent(u), wrapped: true },
    { url: u => 'https://yacdn.org/proxy/' + u },
    { url: u => 'https://crossorigin.me/' + u },
];

function _attachGifFallback(img, originalUrl, onFinalFail) {
    const chain = _gifSrcChain(originalUrl);
    let _tried = 0;
    img.onerror = () => {
        const next = chain[++_tried];
        if (next) {
            img.src = next;
        } else {
            img.onerror = null;
            if (onFinalFail) onFinalFail(img);
            else {
                img.style.display = 'none';
                const ph = document.createElement('div');
                ph.style.cssText = 'width:100%;height:90px;border-radius:8px;background:#0f0f1a;border:1px dashed #2a2a3a;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:4px;cursor:default;';
                ph.innerHTML = '<span style="font-size:18px;opacity:0.4;">🎬</span><span style="font-size:9px;color:#333345;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0.06em;text-transform:uppercase;">GIF blocked</span>';
                img.parentNode?.insertBefore(ph, img);
            }
        }
    };
}

window._gifLibCache = window._gifLibCache || {};

const _gifIsAdmin = () => window.isAdmin === true || window._myRole === 'owner';

function _gifLibId(url) {
    let h1 = 0x811c9dc5, h2 = 0x01000193;
    const s = String(url);
    for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
        h1 = Math.imul(h1 ^ s.charCodeAt(i), 16777619) >>> 0;
        h2 = Math.imul(h2 + s.charCodeAt(i) + i, 2246822519) >>> 0;
    }
    return 'g' + h1.toString(36) + h2.toString(36);
}

async function _gifLibTouch(url, title, thumb, w, h) {
    if (!url || !myUID) return;
    try {
        await setDoc(doc(db, 'gif_library', _gifLibId(url)), {
            url, thumb: thumb || url,
            title: (title || 'GIF').slice(0, 120),
            ...(w && h ? { w, h } : {}),
            addedBy: myUID,
            addedByName: window.myUsername || '',
            lastUsed: serverTimestamp()
        }, { merge: true });
        _gifLibDocs = null;
    } catch (e) {   }
}

async function _gifLibList(force) {
    if (_gifLibDocs && !force) return _gifLibDocs;
    const snap = await getDocs(query(
        collection(db, 'gif_library'), orderBy('lastUsed', 'desc'), limit(GIF_LIB_PAGE)
    ));
    _gifLibDocs = snap.docs.map(d => ({ id: d.id, ...d.data() }));
    return _gifLibDocs;
}

const _gifMaskCache = {};
function _gifMask(libId) {
    if (_gifMaskCache[libId]) return _gifMaskCache[libId];
    let s = 0x811c9dc5;
    for (let i = 0; i < libId.length; i++) s = Math.imul(s ^ libId.charCodeAt(i), 16777619) >>> 0;
    const k = new Uint8Array(1021);
    for (let i = 0; i < k.length; i++) {
        s ^= s << 13; s >>>= 0;
        s ^= s >>> 17;
        s ^= s << 5;  s >>>= 0;
        k[i] = s & 255;
    }
    _gifMaskCache[libId] = k;
    return k;
}
function _gifApplyMask(bytes, libId) {
    const k = _gifMask(libId), out = new Uint8Array(bytes.length);
    for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i++) out[i] = bytes[i] ^ k[i % k.length];
    return out;
}

window._loadLibGif = async (libId, chunkCount) => {
    if (window._gifLibCache[libId]) return window._gifLibCache[libId];
    const meta = await getDoc(doc(db, 'gif_library', libId));
    const md = meta.exists() ? meta.data() : {};
    const gen = md.gen || 0;
    const mime = md.mime || 'image/gif';
    const masked = md.masked !== false;
    chunkCount = md.chunkCount || chunkCount || 0;
    if (!chunkCount) throw new Error('not baked');

    const parts = await Promise.all(
        Array.from({ length: chunkCount }, (_, i) =>
            (gen ? _getDocCached : getDoc)(doc(db, `gif_library/${libId}/chunks`, gen ? _gifChunkId(gen, i) : String(i))))
    );

    if (parts.length && (parts[0].data() || {}).d !== undefined) {
        const dataUrl = parts.map(p => (p.data() || {}).d || '').join('');
        if (!dataUrl.startsWith('data:')) throw new Error('chunks incomplete');
        window._gifLibCache[libId] = dataUrl;
        return dataUrl;
    }

    const arrays = parts.map(p => {
        const b = (p.data() || {}).b;
        if (!b) throw new Error('chunks incomplete');
        return b.toUint8Array();
    });
    const total = arrays.reduce((n, a) => n + a.length, 0);
    const joined = new Uint8Array(total);
    let off = 0;
    for (const a of arrays) { joined.set(a, off); off += a.length; }

    const final = masked ? _gifApplyMask(joined, libId) : joined;

    if (md.animated === false || !_gifIsAnimated(final))
        throw new Error('stored copy is a still frame');

    const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([final], { type: mime }));
    window._gifLibCache[libId] = url;
    return url;
};

window._hydrateLibGifs = (root) => {
    (root || document).querySelectorAll('img[data-giflib]:not([data-gifhydrated])').forEach(img => {
        const id = img.dataset.giflib;
        img.dataset.gifhydrated = '1';
        window._loadLibGif(id, Number(img.dataset.gifchunks) || 0)
            .then(url => { if (img.isConnected) { img.onerror = null; img.src = url; } })
            .catch(() => {
                const live = img.dataset.gifsrc;
                if (!live || !img.isConnected) return;
                if (!img.onerror) _attachGifFallback(img, live);
                img.src = live;
                window._gifMaybeTunnel(img, live);
            });
    });
};


const _GIF_BAKE_PROXIES = [
    u => 'https://wsrv.nl/?url=' + encodeURIComponent(u) + '&output=gif&n=-1',
    u => 'https://images.weserv.nl/?url=' + encodeURIComponent(u) + '&output=gif&n=-1',
    u => 'https://api.allorigins.win/raw?url=' + encodeURIComponent(u),
    u => 'https://corsproxy.io/?' + encodeURIComponent(u),
    u => 'https://api.codetabs.com/v1/proxy?quest=' + encodeURIComponent(u),
    u => 'https://api.cors.lol/?url=' + encodeURIComponent(u),
    u => 'https://proxy.corsfix.com/?' + encodeURIComponent(u),
    u => 'https://test.cors.workers.dev/?' + encodeURIComponent(u),
    u => 'https://thingproxy.freeboard.io/fetch/' + u,
];
function _gifBakeChain(url) {
    if (!url) return [];
    const hosts = [url, ..._giphyHostSwap(url)];
    const chain = [...hosts];
    for (const f of _GIF_BAKE_PROXIES) for (const h of hosts) chain.push(f(h));
    return _gifChainWithUv(chain, hosts);
}

function _gifIsAnimated(bytes) {
    if (bytes.length < 6) return false;
    if (String.fromCharCode(bytes[0], bytes[1], bytes[2]) !== 'GIF') return false;
    let n = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length - 1; i++) {
        if (bytes[i] === 0x21 && bytes[i + 1] === 0xF9 && ++n > 1) return true;
    }
    return false;
}

const _GIPHY_MEDIA = /^https:\/\/[a-z0-9.-]*giphy\.com\//i;
let _gifFilterP = null;
window._gifFiltered = null;

const _gifSmallSample = (u) => String(u || '').replace(/\/giphy\.gif(\?.*)?$/, '/100.gif');

function _gifFilterCheck(sampleUrl) {
    if (_gifFilterP) return _gifFilterP;
    if (!sampleUrl || !_GIPHY_MEDIA.test(sampleUrl)) return Promise.resolve(false);
    _gifFilterP = (async () => {
        let filtered;
        try {
            const res = await fetch(sampleUrl, { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(8000), cache: 'no-store' });
            const bytes = new Uint8Array(await res.arrayBuffer());
            filtered = !(res.ok && _gifIsAnimated(bytes));
        } catch (_) { filtered = true; }
        window._gifFiltered = filtered;
        return filtered;
    })();
    return _gifFilterP;
}

const _gifTunnelCache = new Map();
let _gifTunnelBusy = 0;
const _gifTunnelWait = [];
function _gifTunnelSlot(fn, alive) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const run = () => {
            if (alive && !alive()) {
                reject(new Error('gone'));
                const next = _gifTunnelWait.shift();
                if (next) next();
                return;
            }
            _gifTunnelBusy++;
            fn().then(resolve, reject).finally(() => {
                _gifTunnelBusy--;
                const next = _gifTunnelWait.shift();
                if (next) next();
            });
        };
        if (_gifTunnelBusy < 4) run(); else _gifTunnelWait.push(run);
    });
}

let _gifTunnelFails = 0;
let _gifTunnelDead = null;
function _gifTunnelNote(text) {
    window._gifTunnelDiag = text;
    try {
        const grid = document.getElementById('gif-grid');
        if (!grid || !grid.parentNode) return;
        let el = document.getElementById('gif-tunnel-diag');
        if (!el) {
            el = document.createElement('div');
            el.id = 'gif-tunnel-diag';
            el.style.cssText = 'font-size:10px;color:#3a3a4a;font-family:ui-monospace,monospace;padding:6px 4px;text-align:center;';
            grid.parentNode.insertBefore(el, grid.nextSibling);
        }
        el.textContent = text;
    } catch (_) {}
}

async function _gifTunnelBytes(url) {
    if (!window.echoTunnelFetch) throw new Error('tunnel loader missing');
    const res = await window.echoTunnelFetch(url, undefined, 15000);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
    const blob = await res.blob();
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(await blob.arrayBuffer());
    if (bytes.length < 6 || String.fromCharCode(bytes[0], bytes[1], bytes[2]) !== 'GIF') throw new Error('not a GIF');
    return { blob: new Blob([bytes], { type: 'image/gif' }), bytes };
}
function _gifViaTunnel(url, alive) {
    if (_gifTunnelCache.has(url)) return _gifTunnelCache.get(url);
    const pr = _gifTunnelSlot(() => _gifTunnelBytes(url), alive).then(r => URL.createObjectURL(r.blob));
    pr.catch(() => _gifTunnelCache.delete(url));
    _gifTunnelCache.set(url, pr);
    return pr;
}

window._gifMaybeTunnel = (img, url) => {
    if (!img || !url || img.dataset.giftun || !_GIPHY_MEDIA.test(url)) return;
    img.dataset.giftun = '1';
    const swRoute = () => {
        try {
            if (navigator.serviceWorker && navigator.serviceWorker.controller && window.EchoProxy && window.__uv$config) {
                img.onerror = null;
                img.src = window.EchoProxy.encode(url);
                return true;
            }
        } catch (_) {}
        return false;
    };
    _gifFilterCheck(_gifSmallSample(url)).then(filtered => {
        if (!filtered || !img.isConnected) return;
        if (_gifTunnelDead) { swRoute(); return; }
        img.style.visibility = 'hidden';
        _gifViaTunnel(url, () => img.isConnected)
            .then(obj => {
                _gifTunnelFails = 0;
                if (img.isConnected) { img.onerror = null; img.src = obj; }
            })
            .catch(e => {
                const why = (e && e.message) || 'failed';
                if (why === 'gone') return;
                const st = window.EchoProxy && window.EchoProxy.status ? window.EchoProxy.status() : null;
                if (++_gifTunnelFails >= 3 && !_gifTunnelDead) _gifTunnelDead = why;
                _gifTunnelNote('gif tunnel: ' + why + (st ? ' | stage ' + (st.stage || '?') + (st.endpoint ? ' via ' + st.endpoint.replace(/^wss:\/\//, '').split('/')[0] : '') + (st.controlled ? ' | sw on' : ' | sw off') : ''));
                if (img.isConnected) swRoute();
            })
            .finally(() => { img.style.visibility = ''; });
    });
};

async function _gifFetchForBake(url) {
    let fallback = null;
    if (await _gifFilterCheck(_gifSmallSample(url))) {
        try {
            const r = await _gifTunnelSlot(() => _gifTunnelBytes(url));
            if (r.bytes.length > 1000) {
                if (_gifIsAnimated(r.bytes)) return { blob: r.blob, bytes: r.bytes, animated: true };
                fallback = { blob: r.blob, bytes: r.bytes, animated: false };
            }
        } catch (_) {   }
    }
    for (const src of _gifBakeChain(url)) {
        try {
            const res = await fetch(src, { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(15000) });
            if (!res.ok) continue;
            const blob = await res.blob();
            if (blob.size <= 1000) continue;
            const bytes = new Uint8Array(await blob.arrayBuffer());
            if (_gifIsAnimated(bytes)) return { blob, bytes, animated: true };
            if (!fallback) fallback = { blob, bytes, animated: false };
        } catch (e) {   }
    }
    if (fallback) return fallback;
    throw new Error('every route blocked');
}

async function _gifFetchBlob(url) {
    for (const src of _gifSrcChain(url)) {
        try {
            const res = await fetch(src, { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(15000) });
            if (!res.ok) continue;
            const blob = await res.blob();
            if (blob.size > 1000) return blob;
        } catch (e) {   }
    }
    throw new Error('every route blocked');
}

const _gifPreviewFrom = (srcUrl) => new Promise((res) => {
    const im = new Image();
    im.onload = () => {
        try {
            const scale = Math.min(1, 200 / Math.max(im.width, im.height));
            const c = document.createElement('canvas');
            c.width = Math.max(1, Math.round(im.width * scale));
            c.height = Math.max(1, Math.round(im.height * scale));
            c.getContext('2d').drawImage(im, 0, 0, c.width, c.height);
            res({ preview: c.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.6), w: im.width, h: im.height });
        } catch (e) { res({ preview: '', w: 0, h: 0 }); }
    };
    im.onerror = () => res({ preview: '', w: 0, h: 0 });
    im.src = srcUrl;
});

async function _gifPool(tasks, size, onDone) {
    let next = 0, done = 0;
    const workers = Array.from({ length: Math.min(size, tasks.length) }, async () => {
        while (next < tasks.length) await tasks[next++]().then(() => onDone && onDone(++done));
    });
    await Promise.all(workers);
}

async function _gifBakeOne(entry, onProgress) {
    let got = null, lastErr = null;
    for (const cand of [...new Set([entry.bakeUrl, entry.url].filter(Boolean))]) {
        try {
            got = await _gifFetchForBake(cand);
            if (got.animated) break;
        } catch (e) { lastErr = e; }
    }
    if (!got) throw lastErr || new Error('every route blocked');
    return _gifBakeBytes(entry, got.blob, got.bytes, got.animated, onProgress);
}

async function _gifBakeBytes(entry, blob, raw, animated, onProgress) {
    if (blob.size > GIF_LIB_MAX_BAKE_BYTES)
        throw new Error('too large (' + Math.round(blob.size / 1048576) + 'MB)');

    const libId = _gifLibId(entry.url);

    const prev = await getDoc(doc(db, 'gif_library', libId));
    const prevGen = (prev.exists() && prev.data().gen) || 0;
    const gen = prevGen + 1;

    const tmpUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const { preview, w, h } = await _gifPreviewFrom(tmpUrl);

    const masked = _gifApplyMask(raw, libId);
    const chunks = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < masked.length; i += GIF_LIB_CHUNK_BYTES)
        chunks.push(masked.subarray(i, i + GIF_LIB_CHUNK_BYTES));

    await _gifPool(
        chunks.map((c, i) => () => setDoc(
            doc(db, `gif_library/${libId}/chunks`, _gifChunkId(gen, i)),
            { b: Bytes.fromUint8Array(c) })),
        GIF_LIB_CONCURRENCY,
        (n) => onProgress && onProgress(Math.round((n / chunks.length) * 100))
    );

    await setDoc(doc(db, 'gif_library', libId), {
        url: entry.url,
        thumb: entry.thumb || entry.url,
        title: (entry.title || 'GIF').slice(0, 120),
        preview, stored: true,
        w, h,
        masked: true,
        gen,
        animated,
        mime: blob.type || 'image/gif',
        chunkCount: chunks.length,
        bytes: raw.length,
        bakedBy: myUID,
        bakedByName: window.myUsername || '',
        addedBy: myUID,
        lastUsed: serverTimestamp()
    }, { merge: true });

    await _gifPurgeChunks(libId, gen);

    window._gifLibCache[libId] = tmpUrl;
    return { libId, animated, chunks: chunks.length };
}

const GIF_UPLOAD_MAX_MEMBER = 4 * 1024 * 1024;

async function _gifReadFile(file) {
    if (!file) throw new Error('no file');
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(await file.arrayBuffer());
    const isGif = bytes[0] === 0x47 && bytes[1] === 0x49 && bytes[2] === 0x46;
    const isWebp = bytes[8] === 0x57 && bytes[9] === 0x45 && bytes[10] === 0x42 && bytes[11] === 0x50;
    const isPng = bytes[0] === 0x89 && bytes[1] === 0x50 && bytes[2] === 0x4e && bytes[3] === 0x47;
    const isJpg = bytes[0] === 0xff && bytes[1] === 0xd8 && bytes[2] === 0xff;
    if (!isGif && !isWebp && !isPng && !isJpg) throw new Error('only GIFs and images');
    const mime = isGif ? 'image/gif' : isWebp ? 'image/webp' : isPng ? 'image/png' : 'image/jpeg';
    const hash = [...new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', bytes))].map(x => x.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('').slice(0, 32);
    return {
        bytes, hash, blob: new Blob([bytes], { type: mime }),
        animated: isGif ? _gifIsAnimated(bytes) : isWebp,
        url: 'https://echospace-web.web.app/?gif=upload-' + hash,
        title: (file.name || 'GIF').replace(/\.(gif|webp|png|jpe?g)$/i, '').replace(/[_-]+/g, ' ').slice(0, 120)
    };
}
function _gifToast(msg, good) { try { window.showCooldownToast?.(msg, !!good); } catch (_) {} }

window._gifStartUpload = () => {
    if (!myUID) return;
    const ok = confirm('Heads up: anything you upload goes into the public GIF library, and EVERYBODY on EchoSpace will be able to see and send it.\n\nOnly upload things you are fine with everyone seeing. Continue?');
    if (ok) document.getElementById('gif-upload-input')?.click();
};

window._gifUploadFiles = async (files) => {
    if (!myUID || !files || !files.length) return;
    const list = [...files];
    const cap = _gifIsAdmin() ? GIF_LIB_MAX_BAKE_BYTES : GIF_UPLOAD_MAX_MEMBER;
    let ok = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
        try {
            const f = await _gifReadFile(list[i]);
            if (f.bytes.length > cap) throw new Error('too big (max ' + Math.round(cap / 1048576) + 'MB)');
            _gifToast('Uploading ' + (i + 1) + '/' + list.length + '…', true);
            await _gifBakeBytes({ url: f.url, thumb: '', title: f.title }, f.blob, f.bytes, f.animated);
            ok++;
        } catch (e) {
            _gifToast((list[i].name || 'File') + ': ' + (e.message || 'upload failed'));
        }
    }
    _gifLibDocs = null;
    if (ok) _gifToast(ok + (ok === 1 ? ' item' : ' items') + ' added to the library', true);
    if (_gifTab === 'library') renderGifLibrary('');
};

window._gifSuggestText = async () => {
    if (!myUID) return;
    const text = (prompt('What GIF should we add to the library? Describe it or paste a link.') || '').trim();
    if (!text) return;
    try {
        await addDoc(collection(db, 'gif_suggestions'), {
            by: myUID, byName: window.myUsername || '', text: text.slice(0, 300),
            status: 'pending', createdAt: serverTimestamp()
        });
        _gifToast('Thanks! Your suggestion was sent.', true);
    } catch (e) { _gifToast('Could not send suggestion: ' + (e.message || 'failed')); }
};

async function _gifRefreshSuggCount() {
    try {
        const snap = await getDocs(query(collection(db, 'gif_suggestions'), limit(50)));
        const t = document.getElementById('gif-sugg-tab');
        if (t) t.textContent = 'Suggestions' + (snap.size ? ' (' + snap.size + (snap.size === 50 ? '+' : '') + ')' : '');
    } catch (_) {}
}

async function _gifRenderSuggestions() {
    const grid = document.getElementById('gif-grid');
    if (!grid || !_gifIsAdmin()) return;
    grid.innerHTML = '<div id="gif-loading">Loading suggestions…</div>';
    let docs = [];
    try {
        const snap = await getDocs(query(collection(db, 'gif_suggestions'), limit(50)));
        docs = snap.docs.map(d => ({ id: d.id, ...d.data() }))
            .sort((x, y) => (y.createdAt?.seconds || 0) - (x.createdAt?.seconds || 0));
    } catch (e) { grid.innerHTML = '<div id="gif-loading">Could not load suggestions.</div>'; return; }
    if (_gifTab !== 'suggestions') return;
    grid.innerHTML = '';
    if (!docs.length) { grid.innerHTML = '<div id="gif-loading">No suggestions right now.</div>'; _gifRefreshSuggCount(); return; }
    const wrap = document.createElement('div');
    wrap.style.cssText = 'grid-column:1/-1;column-span:all;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;width:100%;';
    docs.forEach(d => {
        const card = document.createElement('div');
        card.style.cssText = 'display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:#12121c;border:1px solid #1e1e2e;border-radius:10px;padding:10px 12px;';
        const txt = document.createElement('div');
        txt.style.cssText = 'flex:1;min-width:0;font-size:13px;color:#e2e2f0;word-break:break-word;';
        txt.textContent = d.text || '';
        const who = document.createElement('div');
        who.style.cssText = 'font-size:10px;color:#666677;margin-top:3px;';
        who.textContent = 'from ' + (d.byName || 'someone');
        txt.appendChild(who);
        const del = document.createElement('button');
        del.type = 'button'; del.textContent = 'Done';
        del.title = 'Remove this suggestion';
        del.style.cssText = 'flex-shrink:0;border:none;border-radius:8px;padding:6px 12px;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer;color:#fff;background:#4f46e5;';
        del.onclick = async () => {
            del.disabled = true;
            try { await deleteDoc(doc(db, 'gif_suggestions', d.id)); card.remove(); _gifRefreshSuggCount();
                  if (!wrap.children.length) grid.innerHTML = '<div id="gif-loading">No suggestions right now.</div>'; }
            catch (e) { del.disabled = false; _gifToast('Could not remove: ' + (e.message || e)); }
        };
        card.append(txt, del);
        wrap.appendChild(card);
    });
    grid.appendChild(wrap);
    _gifRefreshSuggCount();
}

const _gifChunkId = (gen, i) => 'g' + gen + '_' + i;

async function _gifPurgeChunks(libId, keepGen) {
    try {
        const snap = await getDocs(collection(db, `gif_library/${libId}/chunks`));
        const stale = snap.docs.filter(d => !d.id.startsWith('g' + keepGen + '_'));
        await _gifPool(stale.map(d => () => deleteDoc(d.ref).catch(() => {})), GIF_LIB_CONCURRENCY);
        return stale.length;
    } catch (e) { return 0; }
}


function _gifDownsizedGuess(url) {
    if (!url || !/\/giphy\.gif(\?|$)/.test(url)) return null;
    return url.replace('/giphy.gif', '/giphy-downsized.gif');
}

function _gifNeedsUpgrade(d) {
    return !d.stored
        || d.masked !== true
        || !d.gen
        || d.animated === false
        || !d.preview || !d.w || !d.h;
}

async function _gifUpgradeOne(d) {
    return await _gifBakeOne({
        url: d.url, title: d.title, thumb: d.thumb,
        bakeUrl: _gifDownsizedGuess(d.url)
    });
}

window._gifFixLibrary = async () => {
    if (!_gifIsAdmin()) return;
    const st = document.getElementById('gif-bake-status');
    const bar = document.getElementById('gif-bake-bar');
    const fixBtn = document.getElementById('gif-fix-btn');
    const setStatus = (t) => { if (st) st.textContent = t; };
    const bakeBtn = document.getElementById('gif-bake-btn');
    if (bar) bar.style.display = 'flex';
    if (st) st.dataset.busy = '1';
    if (fixBtn) fixBtn.disabled = true;
    if (bakeBtn) bakeBtn.style.display = 'none';

    try {
        setStatus('Scanning library…');
        const snap = await getDocs(collection(db, 'gif_library'));
        const all = snap.docs.map(x => ({ id: x.id, ...x.data() }));
        const need = all.filter(_gifNeedsUpgrade);

        if (!need.length) {
            setStatus(`All ${all.length} GIFs are already up to date.`);
            return;
        }
        const fresh = need.filter(d => !d.stored).length;
        const stale = need.length - fresh;
        const ok = window.confirm(
            `Update ${need.length} of ${all.length} library GIFs?\n\n` +
            (stale ? `• ${stale} re-uploaded in the smaller, masked format\n` : '') +
            (fresh ? `• ${fresh} saved to Firestore for the first time\n` : '') +
            `\nThis uploads each one — it can take a while on a slow connection.`
        );
        if (!ok) { setStatus('Cancelled.'); return; }

        let good = 0, failed = 0, stills = 0, firstErr = '';
        await _gifPool(need.map(d => async () => {
            try {
                const r = await _gifUpgradeOne(d);
                good++;
                if (r && r.animated === false) stills++;
            }
            catch (e) { failed++; firstErr = firstErr || (e && e.message) || 'failed'; }
        }), 3, (n) => setStatus(`Updating ${n}/${need.length}…`));

        setStatus(`Updated ${good}`
            + (stills ? ` · ${stills} still-only` : '')
            + (failed ? ` · ${failed} failed (${firstErr})` : ''));
        _gifLibDocs = null;
        if (_gifTab === 'library')
            renderGifLibrary(document.getElementById('gif-search-input')?.value.trim() || '');
    } catch (e) {
        setStatus('Couldn\'t read the library — ' + ((e && e.message) || 'failed'));
    } finally {
        if (fixBtn) fixBtn.disabled = false;
        setTimeout(() => {
            if (st) delete st.dataset.busy;
            if (bakeBtn) bakeBtn.style.display = '';
            _gifUpdateBakeBar();
        }, 4000);
    }
};


function _gifPaintTab(btn, on, border, fill) {
    if (on) {
        btn.style.setProperty('border-color', border || '#4f46e5', 'important');
        btn.style.setProperty('border-width', '2px', 'important');
        btn.style.setProperty('background', fill || 'rgba(79,70,229,0.16)', 'important');
    } else {
        ['border-color', 'border-width', 'background'].forEach(p => btn.style.removeProperty(p));
    }
}

window._gifSetTab = (tab) => {
    _gifTab = tab;
    document.querySelectorAll('#gif-tabs .gif-tab').forEach(b => {
        if (!b.dataset.tab) return;
        const on = b.dataset.tab === tab;
        b.classList.toggle('active', on);
        _gifPaintTab(b, on);
    });
    const searchEl = document.getElementById('gif-search-input');
    if (searchEl) searchEl.placeholder = tab === 'library' ? 'Search the library…' : 'Search GIFs…';
    if (tab === 'library') renderGifLibrary(searchEl ? searchEl.value.trim() : '');
    else if (tab === 'suggestions') _gifRenderSuggestions();
    else fetchGifs(searchEl ? searchEl.value.trim() : '');
};

window._gifToggleSelect = () => {
    _gifSelectMode = !_gifSelectMode;
    _gifSelected.clear();
    document.getElementById('gif-grid')?.classList.toggle('selecting', _gifSelectMode);
    const btn = document.getElementById('gif-select-btn');
    if (btn) {
        btn.classList.toggle('active', _gifSelectMode);
        btn.textContent = _gifSelectMode ? 'Cancel' : 'Select';
        _gifPaintTab(btn, _gifSelectMode, '#ef4444', 'rgba(239,68,68,0.14)');
    }
    document.querySelectorAll('#gif-grid .gif-tile').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('selected'));
    _gifUpdateBakeBar();
};

function _gifUpdateBakeBar() {
    const bar = document.getElementById('gif-bake-bar');
    if (!bar) return;
    bar.style.display = _gifSelectMode ? 'flex' : 'none';
    const n = _gifSelected.size;
    const btn = document.getElementById('gif-bake-btn');
    if (btn) { btn.disabled = n === 0; btn.textContent = n ? `Save ${n} to Firestore` : 'Select some GIFs'; }
    const st = document.getElementById('gif-bake-status');
    if (st && !st.dataset.busy) st.textContent = n ? `${n} selected` : 'Tap GIFs to pick them';
}

function _gifToggleTile(tile, entry) {
    const id = _gifLibId(entry.url);
    if (_gifSelected.has(id)) { _gifSelected.delete(id); tile.classList.remove('selected'); }
    else { _gifSelected.set(id, entry); tile.classList.add('selected'); }
    _gifUpdateBakeBar();
}

window._gifBakeSelected = async () => {
    if (!_gifSelectMode || !_gifSelected.size) return;
