    const st = document.getElementById('gif-bake-status');
    const btn = document.getElementById('gif-bake-btn');
    const items = [..._gifSelected.values()];
    if (btn) btn.disabled = true;
    if (st) st.dataset.busy = '1';
    let ok = 0, fail = 0, firstErr = '';
    await _gifPool(items.map(it => async () => {
        try { await _gifBakeOne(it); ok++; }
        catch (e) { fail++; firstErr = firstErr || (e && e.message) || 'failed'; }
    }), 3, (n) => {
        if (st) st.textContent = `Saving ${n}/${items.length}…`;
    });
    if (st) {
        delete st.dataset.busy;
        st.textContent = `Saved ${ok}${fail ? ` · ${fail} failed (${firstErr})` : ''}`;
    }
    _gifLibDocs = null;
    _gifSelected.clear();
    document.querySelectorAll('#gif-grid .gif-tile.selected').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('selected'));
    if (btn) btn.disabled = true;
    setTimeout(() => { if (st && !st.dataset.busy) _gifUpdateBakeBar(); }, 2600);
    if (_gifTab === 'library') renderGifLibrary(document.getElementById('gif-search-input')?.value.trim() || '');
};

function _gifTile(entry, opts) {
    const wrap = document.createElement('div');
    wrap.className = 'gif-tile';
    const img = document.createElement('img');
    img.loading = 'lazy';
    img.src = opts.previewSrc || entry.thumb || entry.url;
    img.title = entry.title || 'GIF';
    img.alt = '';
    if (opts.w && opts.h) img.style.aspectRatio = opts.w + '/' + opts.h;
    if (opts.libId && opts.stored) {
        img.dataset.giflib = opts.libId;
        img.dataset.gifchunks = opts.chunkCount || 0;
        img.dataset.gifsrc = entry.url;
    }
    wrap.appendChild(img);

    if (opts.stored) {
        const badge = document.createElement('span');
        badge.className = 'gif-tile-badge';
        badge.textContent = 'SAVED';
        badge.title = 'Stored in Firestore — loads on any network';
        wrap.appendChild(badge);
    }
    const check = document.createElement('span');
    check.className = 'gif-tile-check';
    check.textContent = '✓';
    wrap.appendChild(check);

    wrap.onclick = () => {
        if (_gifSelectMode) _gifToggleTile(wrap, { url: entry.url, title: entry.title, thumb: entry.thumb || entry.url, bakeUrl: entry.bakeUrl || entry.url });
        else sendGifMessage(entry.url, entry.title || 'GIF', {
            w: opts.w, h: opts.h,
            ...(opts.stored ? { libId: opts.libId, preview: opts.previewSrc, chunkCount: opts.chunkCount } : {})
        });
    };

    if (opts.stored) window._hydrateLibGifs(wrap);
    else {
        _attachGifFallback(img, img.src, (failed) => {
            failed.style.display = 'none';
            const ph = document.createElement('div');
            ph.className = 'gif-tile-blocked';
            ph.innerHTML = '<span style="font-size:16px;opacity:0.35;">🎬</span><span>blocked</span>';
            ph.title = 'Preview blocked on this network — tap to send anyway';
            wrap.appendChild(ph);
        });
        window._gifMaybeTunnel(img, img.src);
    }
    return wrap;
}

function _gifDeleteBtn(d, tile) {
    const btn = document.createElement("button");
    btn.type = "button";
    btn.title = "Delete from library";
    btn.innerHTML = "<i class=\"fa-solid fa-trash\"></i>";
    btn.style.cssText = "position:absolute;top:5px;right:5px;z-index:3;width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;border:none;background:rgba(220,38,38,.9);color:#fff;font-size:11px;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.5);";
    btn.onclick = async (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation(); e.preventDefault();
        if (!confirm("Delete \"" + (d.title || "this GIF") + "\" from the library for everyone?")) return;
        btn.disabled = true; btn.style.opacity = ".5";
        try {
            await _gifPurgeChunks(d.id, "__none__");
            await deleteDoc(doc(db, "gif_library", d.id));
            delete window._gifLibCache[d.id];
            _gifLibDocs = (_gifLibDocs || []).filter(x => x.id !== d.id);
            tile.remove();
            window.logAdminAction?.("gif_library_delete", { libId: d.id, title: (d.title || "").slice(0, 80) });
        } catch (err) {
            btn.disabled = false; btn.style.opacity = "1";
            try { window.showCooldownToast?.("Could not delete: " + (err.message || err)); } catch (_) {}
        }
    };
    return btn;
}

async function renderGifLibrary(searchTerm) {
    const grid = document.getElementById('gif-grid');
    if (!grid) return;
    grid.innerHTML = '<div class="gif-grid-msg">Loading library…</div>';
    document.getElementById('gif-scroll')?.scrollTo(0, 0);
    let docsList;
    try { docsList = await _gifLibList(); }
    catch (e) {
        grid.innerHTML = '<div class="gif-grid-msg" style="color:#f87171;">Couldn\'t load the library.</div>';
        return;
    }
    const term = (searchTerm || '').toLowerCase();
    const rows = term ? docsList.filter(d => (d.title || '').toLowerCase().includes(term)) : docsList;
    if (!rows.length) {
        if (!term && _gifTab === 'library') { window._gifSetTab('trending'); return; }
        grid.innerHTML = `<div class="gif-grid-msg">${term ? 'Nothing in the library matches that.' : 'The library is empty — send a GIF and it lands here.'}</div>`;
        return;
    }
    grid.innerHTML = '';
    rows.forEach(d => {
        const tile = _gifTile(
            { url: d.url, title: d.title, thumb: d.thumb },
            { libId: d.id, stored: !!d.stored, chunkCount: d.chunkCount, w: d.w, h: d.h, previewSrc: d.preview || d.thumb || d.url }
        );
        if (_gifIsAdmin()) tile.appendChild(_gifDeleteBtn(d, tile));
        grid.appendChild(tile);
    });
    _gifUpdateBakeBar();
}

let _gifFetchSeq = 0;
async function fetchGifs(query) {
    const grid = document.getElementById('gif-grid');
    if (!grid) return;
    const _seq = ++_gifFetchSeq;

    grid.innerHTML = '<div class="gif-grid-msg">Loading GIFs…</div>';
    document.getElementById('gif-scroll')?.scrollTo(0, 0);

    const endpoint = query
        ? `https://api.giphy.com/v1/gifs/search?api_key=${GIPHY_API_KEY}&q=${encodeURIComponent(query)}&limit=24&rating=pg-13`
        : `https://api.giphy.com/v1/gifs/trending?api_key=${GIPHY_API_KEY}&limit=24&rating=pg-13`;

    let json;
    try {
        json = await _fetchGiphyJson(endpoint);
    } catch(e) {
        if (_seq !== _gifFetchSeq) return;
        grid.innerHTML = `<div class="gif-grid-msg" style="color:#f87171;">
            <div style="font-size:24px;margin-bottom:8px;">🚧</div>
            <strong>GIFs are blocked on this network.</strong><br>
            <span style="color:#444455;">Switch to your hotspot or a different connection and try again.</span>
            <div style="margin-top:10px;font-size:10px;color:#3a3a4a;line-height:1.5;font-family:ui-monospace,monospace;">
                ${(window._gifLastDiag || []).map(x => x.replace(/[<>&]/g, '')).join('<br>')}
            </div>
        </div>`;
        return;
    }

    if (_seq !== _gifFetchSeq) return;
    if (!json.data || json.data.length === 0) {
        grid.innerHTML = '<div class="gif-grid-msg">No GIFs found. Try a different search!</div>';
        return;
    }

    let baked = {};
    try { (await _gifLibList()).forEach(d => { if (d.stored) baked[d.id] = d; }); } catch (e) {}
    if (_seq !== _gifFetchSeq) return;

    grid.innerHTML = '';
    json.data.forEach(gif => {
        const small = gif.images.fixed_height_small || gif.images.downsized || {};
        const orig = gif.images.original || gif.images.downsized || {};
        const directUrl = small.url || orig.url;
        const originalUrl = orig.url || small.url;
        const bakeUrl = (gif.images.downsized_medium || gif.images.downsized
                      || gif.images.fixed_height || orig).url || originalUrl;
        const gw = Number(orig.width) || Number(small.width) || 0;
        const gh = Number(orig.height) || Number(small.height) || 0;
        const b = baked[_gifLibId(originalUrl)];
        grid.appendChild(_gifTile(
            { url: originalUrl, title: gif.title || 'GIF', thumb: directUrl, bakeUrl },
            b ? { libId: b.id, stored: true, chunkCount: b.chunkCount, w: b.w || gw, h: b.h || gh, previewSrc: b.preview || directUrl }
              : { w: gw, h: gh, previewSrc: directUrl }
        ));
    });
    _gifUpdateBakeBar();
}

async function _gifAutoBakeForMessage(chatId, msgId, gifUrl, gifTitle) {
    try {
        const libId = _gifLibId(gifUrl);
        let meta = null;
        try { meta = await getDoc(doc(db, 'gif_library', libId)); } catch (_) {}
        const md = (meta && meta.exists()) ? meta.data() : null;

        let info;
        if (md && md.stored && md.gen && md.animated !== false) {
            info = { libId, chunkCount: md.chunkCount, preview: md.preview, w: md.w, h: md.h };
        } else {
            const r = await _gifBakeOne({
                url: gifUrl, title: gifTitle, thumb: gifUrl,
                bakeUrl: _gifDownsizedGuess(gifUrl)
            });
            if (!r || r.animated === false) return;
            const m2 = await getDoc(doc(db, 'gif_library', r.libId));
            const d2 = m2.exists() ? m2.data() : {};
            info = { libId: r.libId, chunkCount: r.chunks, preview: d2.preview, w: d2.w, h: d2.h };
        }

        await updateDoc(doc(db, `chats/${chatId}/messages`, msgId), {
            gifLibId: info.libId,
            gifLibChunks: info.chunkCount || 0,
            ...(info.preview ? { gifPreview: info.preview } : {}),
            ...(info.w && info.h ? { gifW: info.w, gifH: info.h } : {})
        });
        _gifLibDocs = null;
    } catch (e) {
    }
}

async function sendGifMessage(gifUrl, gifTitle, lib) {
    if (!currentChatId || !myUID) return;
    if (_gifSelectMode) return;
    window.closeGifPicker();
    const replyTo = (typeof replyToMsg !== 'undefined' && replyToMsg)
        ? { id: replyToMsg.id, text: replyToMsg.text, senderName: replyToMsg.senderName }
        : null;
    const proxyUrl = _proxyGifUrl(gifUrl);
    try {
        await updateDoc(doc(db, "chats", currentChatId), {
            unreadBy: currentChatData.participants.filter(id => id !== myUID),
            lastActivity: serverTimestamp(),
            lastMessageText: '🎬 GIF',
            lastMessageSenderId: myUID
        });
        const msgRef = await addDoc(collection(db, `chats/${currentChatId}/messages`), {
            text: gifTitle || 'GIF',
            gifUrl: gifUrl,
            gifProxyUrl: proxyUrl,
            ...(lib && lib.w && lib.h ? { gifW: lib.w, gifH: lib.h } : {}),
            ...(lib && lib.libId ? {
                gifLibId: lib.libId,
                gifLibChunks: lib.chunkCount || 0,
                ...(lib.preview ? { gifPreview: lib.preview } : {})
            } : {}),
            ...(replyTo ? { replyTo } : {}),
            uid: window.myUID,
            timestamp: serverTimestamp()
        });
        _gifLibTouch(gifUrl, gifTitle, lib && lib.preview, lib && lib.w, lib && lib.h);
        if (!(lib && lib.libId)) _gifAutoBakeForMessage(currentChatId, msgRef.id, gifUrl, gifTitle);
        window.clearReply && window.clearReply();
        if (!currentChatData?.isGroup) {
            remove(ref(rtdb, `seen_by/${myUID}/${currentChatId}`)).catch(()=>{});
        }
    } catch(e) {
        showCooldownToast('Could not send GIF.');
    }
}

let _mediaRecorder = null;
let _audioChunks = [];
let _voiceRecording = false;
let _voiceTimerInterval = null;
let _voiceRecordSeconds = 0;

let _liveSR = null;
let _liveFinalText = '';
let _liveInterimText = '';

function _updateLiveTranscriptUI() {
    const el = document.getElementById('voice-live-transcript');
    if (!el) return;
    const combined = (_liveFinalText + ' ' + _liveInterimText).trim();
    el.textContent = combined || '';
    el.style.display = combined ? 'block' : 'none';
}

function _startLiveSTT() {
    const SR = window.SpeechRecognition || window.webkitSpeechRecognition;
    if (!SR) return;
    _liveFinalText = '';
    _liveInterimText = '';
    try {
        _liveSR = new SR();
        _liveSR.lang = _sttLang();
        _liveSR.continuous = true;
        _liveSR.interimResults = true;

        _liveSR.onresult = (e) => {
            let fin = '', interim = '';
            for (let i = 0; i < e.results.length; i++) {
                if (e.results[i].isFinal) fin += e.results[i][0].transcript + ' ';
                else interim += e.results[i][0].transcript;
            }
            _liveFinalText = fin;
            _liveInterimText = interim;
            _updateLiveTranscriptUI();
        };

        _liveSR.onerror = (e) => {
            if (e.error === 'no-speech' || e.error === 'aborted') return;
            console.warn('[LiveSTT] error:', e.error);
            if (_voiceRecording) {
                try { _liveSR.stop(); } catch(_) {}
                setTimeout(() => { if (_voiceRecording) _startLiveSTT(); }, 500);
            }
        };

        _liveSR.onend = () => {
            if (_voiceRecording) {
                try { _liveSR.start(); } catch(_) {}
            }
        };

        _liveSR.start();
    } catch(e) {
        console.warn('[LiveSTT] could not start:', e);
        _liveSR = null;
    }
}

function _stopLiveSTT() {
    if (_liveSR) {
        try { _liveSR.abort(); } catch(_) {}
        _liveSR = null;
    }
    const el = document.getElementById('voice-live-transcript');
    if (el) el.style.display = 'none';
}

async function _transcribeViaAI(base64Audio) {
    try {
        const src = String(base64Audio || '');
        const m = src.match(/^data:([^;,]+)[^,]*,/);
        const mimeType = (m && m[1]) || 'audio/webm';
        const data = src.replace(/^data:[^,]*,/, '');
        if (!data) return null;

        const r = await fetch(
            `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-2.5-flash:generateContent?key=${window.GEMINI_API_KEY}`,
            {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({
                    contents: [{
                        role: 'user',
                        parts: [
                            { inlineData: { mimeType, data } },
                            { text: 'Transcribe this audio message exactly as spoken. Return ONLY the transcribed text, with no preamble, labels or explanation. If there is no intelligible speech, return nothing at all.' }
                        ]
                    }],
                    generationConfig: { temperature: 0 }
                })
            }
        );
        if (!r.ok) { console.warn('[VoiceSTT] transcription failed:', r.status); return null; }
        const d = await r.json();
        window._echoUsageTurn?.(d?.usageMetadata, 'transcribe');
        const out = (d?.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts?.[0]?.text || '').trim();
        return out || null;
    } catch(e) {
        console.warn('[VoiceSTT] transcription fallback failed:', e);
        return null;
    }
}
window._transcribeViaAI = _transcribeViaAI;

window.toggleVoiceRecording = () => {
    if (_voiceRecording) {
        stopAndSendVoice();
    } else {
        startVoiceRecording();
    }
};

async function startVoiceRecording() {
    if (!currentChatId) { showCooldownToast('Open a chat first.'); return; }
    if (window._isTimedOut && window._isTimedOut()) { showCooldownToast('⏳ You are timed out and cannot send voice messages right now.'); return; }
    try {
        const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true });
        _audioChunks = [];
        _mediaRecorder = new MediaRecorder(stream, { mimeType: 'audio/webm;codecs=opus' });
        _mediaRecorder.ondataavailable = (e) => { if (e.data.size > 0) _audioChunks.push(e.data); };
        _mediaRecorder.start(100);
        _voiceRecording = true;
        _voiceRecordSeconds = 0;

        _startLiveSTT();

        const bar = document.getElementById('voice-recording-bar');
        if (bar) bar.classList.add('visible');
        const btn = document.getElementById('voice-record-btn');
        if (btn) { btn.style.color = '#f87171'; btn.title = 'Stop Recording'; }

        const timerEl = document.getElementById('voice-rec-timer');
        _voiceTimerInterval = setInterval(() => {
            _voiceRecordSeconds++;
            const m = Math.floor(_voiceRecordSeconds / 60);
            const s = _voiceRecordSeconds % 60;
            if (timerEl) timerEl.innerText = `${m}:${s.toString().padStart(2,'0')}`;
            if (_voiceRecordSeconds >= 180) stopAndSendVoice();
        }, 1000);
    } catch(e) {
        showCooldownToast('🎙️ Microphone permission denied.');
    }
}

window.stopAndSendVoice = () => {
    if (!_mediaRecorder || !_voiceRecording) return;

    const liveTranscript = (_liveFinalText + ' ' + _liveInterimText).trim();
    const hasliveTranscript = liveTranscript.length > 0;
    _stopLiveSTT();

    _mediaRecorder.onstop = async () => {
        const blob = new Blob(_audioChunks, { type: 'audio/webm' });
        _audioChunks = [];
        const reader = new FileReader();
        reader.onload = async (ev) => {
            const base64Audio = ev.target.result;
            const duration = _voiceRecordSeconds;
            if (!currentChatId || !myUID) return;

            let voiceTranscript = hasliveTranscript ? liveTranscript : null;
            if (!voiceTranscript) {
                voiceTranscript = await _transcribeViaAI(base64Audio);
            }

            try {
                await updateDoc(doc(db, "chats", currentChatId), {
                    unreadBy: currentChatData.participants.filter(id => id !== myUID),
                    lastActivity: serverTimestamp(),
                    lastMessageText: '🎙️ Voice message',
                    lastMessageSenderId: myUID
                });
                await addDoc(collection(db, `chats/${currentChatId}/messages`), {
                    text: '🎙️ Voice Message',
                    voiceBase64: base64Audio,
                    voiceDuration: duration,
                    voiceTranscript: voiceTranscript || null,
                    uid: window.myUID,
                    timestamp: serverTimestamp()
                });
                if (!currentChatData?.isGroup) {
                    remove(ref(rtdb, `seen_by/${myUID}/${currentChatId}`)).catch(()=>{});
                }
                if (typeof window.trackQuestAction === 'function') {
                    window.trackQuestAction('voiceMessagesSent', 1).catch(() => {});
                }
            } catch(e) {
                showCooldownToast('Could not send voice message.');
            }
        };
        reader.readAsDataURL(blob);
        _mediaRecorder.stream?.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop());
    };
    _mediaRecorder.stop();
    _voiceRecording = false;
    clearInterval(_voiceTimerInterval);
    const bar = document.getElementById('voice-recording-bar');
    if (bar) bar.classList.remove('visible');
    const btn = document.getElementById('voice-record-btn');
    if (btn) { btn.style.color = ''; btn.title = 'Voice Message'; }
};

window.cancelVoiceRecording = () => {
    _stopLiveSTT();
    if (_mediaRecorder) {
        _mediaRecorder.onstop = null;
        _mediaRecorder.stream?.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop());
        try { _mediaRecorder.stop(); } catch(e) {}
        _mediaRecorder = null;
    }
    _audioChunks = [];
    _voiceRecording = false;
    clearInterval(_voiceTimerInterval);
    const bar = document.getElementById('voice-recording-bar');
    if (bar) bar.classList.remove('visible');
    const btn = document.getElementById('voice-record-btn');
    if (btn) { btn.style.color = ''; btn.title = 'Voice Message'; }
};

window.playVoiceMessage = (btnEl, audioId) => {
    const audioEl = document.getElementById(audioId);
    if (!audioEl) return;
    const bubble = btnEl.closest('.voice-msg-bubble');
    const waveformBars = bubble ? bubble.querySelectorAll('.voice-waveform-bar') : [];
    let _waveAnimId = null;
    const animateWave = () => {
        if (audioEl.paused) return;
        const progress = audioEl.duration > 0 ? audioEl.currentTime / audioEl.duration : 0;
        waveformBars.forEach((bar, i) => {
            const isFilled = i / waveformBars.length <= progress;
            bar.classList.toggle('active', isFilled);
        });
        _waveAnimId = requestAnimationFrame(animateWave);
    };
    const stopWave = () => {
        if (_waveAnimId) cancelAnimationFrame(_waveAnimId);
        waveformBars.forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
    };
    if (audioEl.paused) {
        document.querySelectorAll('.voice-audio-player').forEach(a => {
            if (a !== audioEl && !a.paused) {
                a.pause(); a.currentTime = 0;
                const otherBtn = document.querySelector(`[data-audio="${a.id}"]`);
                if (otherBtn) { otherBtn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-play"></i>'; otherBtn.classList.remove('playing'); }
                const otherBubble = otherBtn?.closest('.voice-msg-bubble');
                otherBubble?.querySelectorAll('.voice-waveform-bar').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
            }
        });
        audioEl.play();
        btnEl.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-pause"></i>'; btnEl.classList.add('playing');
        animateWave();
        audioEl.onended = () => { btnEl.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-play"></i>'; btnEl.classList.remove('playing'); stopWave(); audioEl.currentTime = 0; };
    } else {
        audioEl.pause(); btnEl.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-play"></i>'; btnEl.classList.remove('playing'); stopWave();
    }
};


let _lpRoomId = null;
let _lpMeta = null;
let _lpIsOwner = false;
let _lpPendingJoinId = null;
let _lpUnsubs = [];
let _lpDriftTimer = null;
let _lpEndedWatchTimer = null;
let _lpLastVideoId = null;
let _lpServerOffset = 0;

window.onValue(window.ref(window.rtdb, '.info/serverTimeOffset'), (snap) => {
    _lpServerOffset = snap.val() || 0;
});
function _lpServerNow() { return Date.now() + _lpServerOffset; }

let _lpCurrentMode = 'listen';
function _lpErrorCodeMessage(code) {
    if (code === 101 || code === 150) return "Embedding disabled by video owner";
    if (code === 100) return 'Video removed or private';
    if (code === 2) return 'Invalid video ID parameter';
    if (code === 5) return 'HTML5 player error';
    return `Unknown code ${code}`;
}
let _lpVideoErrorRetryCounts = {};
function _lpClearVideoError() {
    const el = document.getElementById('lp-video-error');
    if (el) el.classList.add('hidden');
}
window._lpClearVideoError = _lpClearVideoError;
let _lpDurationWrittenFor = null;
window._lpRecordTrackDuration = (duration) => {
    if (!_lpRoomId || !_lpIsOwner || !duration || !_lpLastVideoId) return;
    if (_lpDurationWrittenFor === _lpLastVideoId) return;
    _lpDurationWrittenFor = _lpLastVideoId;
    window.set(window.ref(window.rtdb, `listen_parties/${_lpRoomId}/playback/trackDuration`), Math.round(duration)).catch(() => {});
};
function _lpHandlePlayerError(code) {
    _lpLastErrorInfo = { code, message: _lpErrorCodeMessage(code) };
    if (!_lpRoomId || _lpCurrentMode !== 'watch') {
        if (window._ytTryProxyRetry && window._ytTryProxyRetry(
                (typeof mTrackData !== 'undefined' && mTrackData && mTrackData.videoId) || _lpLastVideoId,
                'player error ' + code)) return;
        if (typeof mIndex !== 'undefined' && mQueue && mIndex + 1 < mQueue.length) playMusicTrack(mIndex + 1);
        return;
    }
    const videoId = _lpLastVideoId;
    const retries = _lpVideoErrorRetryCounts[videoId] || 0;
    if (retries < 1 && (code === 2 || code === 5)) {
        _lpVideoErrorRetryCounts[videoId] = retries + 1;
        setTimeout(() => { try { _ytPlayer.loadVideoById(videoId); } catch (e) {} }, 1200);
        return;
    }
    const msgEl = document.getElementById('lp-video-error-msg');
    const linkEl = document.getElementById('lp-video-error-link');
    const skipBtn = document.getElementById('lp-video-error-skip');
    const errEl = document.getElementById('lp-video-error');
    if (msgEl) {
        msgEl.textContent = (code === 101 || code === 150)
            ? "This video's owner has disabled it from playing in embedded players."
            : (code === 100 ? 'This video was removed or is unavailable.' : "This video can't be played here.");
    }
    if (linkEl) linkEl.href = videoId ? `https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=${videoId}` : '#';
    if (skipBtn) skipBtn.classList.toggle('hidden', !_lpIsOwner);
    if (errEl) errEl.classList.remove('hidden');
}
window._lpHandlePlayerError = _lpHandlePlayerError;
window._lpRetryVideo = () => {
    if (!_lpLastVideoId) return;
    delete _lpVideoErrorRetryCounts[_lpLastVideoId];
    _lpClearVideoError();
    try { _ytPlayer.loadVideoById(_lpLastVideoId); } catch (e) {}
};

let _lpLastErrorInfo = null;
let _lpOverlayRAF = null;
let _lpLastAppliedSize = null;
function _lpSyncVideoOverlay() {
    const wrap = document.getElementById('yt-player-wrap');
    const slot = document.getElementById('lp-video-wrap');
    if (!wrap) return;
    if (!slot || _lpCurrentMode !== 'watch') { _lpStopOverlaySync(); return; }
    const r = slot.getBoundingClientRect();
    const errEl = document.getElementById('lp-video-error');
    const errorShowing = !!(errEl && !errEl.classList.contains('hidden'));
    const visible = r.width > 0 && r.height > 0 && !slot.classList.contains('hidden') && !errorShowing;
    const w = Math.round(r.width), h = Math.round(r.height);
    Object.assign(wrap.style, visible ? {
        position: 'fixed', top: r.top + 'px', left: r.left + 'px', bottom: 'auto',
        width: w + 'px', height: h + 'px',
        overflow: 'hidden', pointerEvents: 'auto', zIndex: '11'
    } : {
        position: 'fixed', top: 'auto', bottom: '-9999px', left: '-9999px',
        width: '1px', height: '1px', overflow: 'hidden', pointerEvents: 'none', zIndex: '-1'
    });
    if (visible) {
        const sizeChanged = !_lpLastAppliedSize || _lpLastAppliedSize.w !== w || _lpLastAppliedSize.h !== h;
        const playerReady = !!(_ytPlayer && typeof _ytPlayer.setSize === 'function');
        if (sizeChanged && playerReady) {
            try { _ytPlayer.setSize(w, h); _lpLastAppliedSize = { w, h }; } catch (e) {}
        }
        const iframe = wrap.querySelector('iframe');
        if (iframe) { iframe.style.width = '100%'; iframe.style.height = '100%'; }
    } else if (_lpLastAppliedSize) {
        _lpLastAppliedSize = null;
        try { if (_ytPlayer && _ytPlayer.setSize) _ytPlayer.setSize(1, 1); } catch (e) {}
        const iframe = wrap.querySelector('iframe');
        if (iframe) { iframe.style.width = '1px'; iframe.style.height = '1px'; }
    }
    _lpOverlayRAF = requestAnimationFrame(_lpSyncVideoOverlay);
}
function _lpStartOverlaySync() {
    if (_lpOverlayRAF) cancelAnimationFrame(_lpOverlayRAF);
    _lpSyncVideoOverlay();
}
function _lpStopOverlaySync() {
    if (_lpOverlayRAF) cancelAnimationFrame(_lpOverlayRAF);
    _lpOverlayRAF = null;
    _lpLastAppliedSize = null;
    const wrap = document.getElementById('yt-player-wrap');
    if (wrap) {
        Object.assign(wrap.style, {
            position: 'fixed', top: 'auto', bottom: '-9999px', left: '-9999px',
            width: '1px', height: '1px', overflow: 'hidden', pointerEvents: 'none', zIndex: '-1'
        });
        const iframe = wrap.querySelector('iframe');
        if (iframe) { iframe.style.width = '1px'; iframe.style.height = '1px'; }
        try { if (_ytPlayer && _ytPlayer.setSize) _ytPlayer.setSize(1, 1); } catch (e) {}
    }
}

function _lpApplyRoomMode(mode) {
    _lpCurrentMode = mode === 'watch' ? 'watch' : 'listen';
    const videoSlot = document.getElementById('lp-video-wrap');
    const membersLabel = document.getElementById('lp-members-label');
    if (!videoSlot) return;
    if (_lpCurrentMode === 'watch') {
        videoSlot.classList.remove('hidden');
        if (membersLabel) membersLabel.textContent = 'Watching';
        _lpStartOverlaySync();
    } else {
        _lpStopOverlaySync();
        videoSlot.classList.add('hidden');
        if (membersLabel) membersLabel.textContent = 'Listeners';
    }
}

async function _lpHash(str) {
    const buf = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', new TextEncoder().encode(str));
    return Array.from(new Uint8Array(buf)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
}

let _lpPublicRooms = {};
let _lpBrowserUnsub = null;
function _lpStartBrowserListener() {
    if (_lpBrowserUnsub) return;
    _lpBrowserUnsub = window.onValue(window.ref(window.rtdb, 'listen_parties_public'), (snap) => {
        _lpPublicRooms = snap.val() || {};
        _lpRenderRoomGrid();
    });
}
function _lpStopBrowserListener() {
    if (_lpBrowserUnsub) { try { _lpBrowserUnsub(); } catch(e){} _lpBrowserUnsub = null; }
}

function _lpRenderRoomGrid() {
    const grid = document.getElementById('lp-room-grid');
    const empty = document.getElementById('lp-room-grid-empty');
    if (!grid) return;
    const rooms = Object.entries(_lpPublicRooms);
    if (rooms.length === 0) {
        grid.innerHTML = '';
        grid.classList.add('hidden');
        empty.classList.remove('hidden');
        empty.classList.add('flex');
        return;
    }
    empty.classList.add('hidden');
    empty.classList.remove('flex');
    grid.classList.remove('hidden');
    grid.innerHTML = rooms.map(([id, r]) => {
        const isWatch = r.mode === 'watch';
        return `
        <div onclick="window.lpAttemptJoin('${id}')" class="lp-card">
            <div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
                <div class="flex items-center gap-2.5 min-w-0">
                    <div class="lp-card-badge ${isWatch ? 'watch' : 'listen'}">${isWatch ? '🎬' : '🎧'}</div>
                    <div class="min-w-0">
                        <div class="font-bold text-white text-sm truncate">${window.escHtml(r.name || 'Untitled Room')}</div>
                        <div class="text-xs text-[#888899] truncate">Host: ${window.escHtml(r.ownerName || 'Unknown')}</div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                ${r.hasPassword ? '<span class="text-xs flex-shrink-0" title="Password protected">🔒</span>' : ''}
            </div>
            <div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                <span class="lp-pill">${r.memberCount || 0} ${isWatch ? 'watching' : 'listening'}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="text-xs text-[#555566] truncate mt-2.5 pt-2.5" style="border-top:1px solid #17172a;">${r.nowPlayingTitle ? (isWatch ? '▶ ' : '♪ ') + window.escHtml(r.nowPlayingTitle) : 'Nothing playing yet'}</div>
        </div>
    `;}).join('');
}

let _lpCreateMode = 'listen';
window.lpSetCreateMode = (mode) => {
    _lpCreateMode = mode;
    const listenBtn = document.getElementById('lp-mode-listen-btn');
    const watchBtn = document.getElementById('lp-mode-watch-btn');
    const active = { borderColor: '#4f46e5', background: 'rgba(79,70,229,0.15)', color: '#e8e8f0' };
    const inactive = { borderColor: '#1e1e2e', background: 'transparent', color: '#888899' };
    const apply = (el, styles) => { if (!el) return; Object.assign(el.style, styles); };
    apply(listenBtn, mode === 'listen' ? active : inactive);
    apply(watchBtn, mode === 'watch' ? active : inactive);
};
window.lpOpenCreateModal = () => {
    document.getElementById('lp-create-name').value = '';
    document.getElementById('lp-create-password').value = '';
    document.getElementById('lp-create-error').classList.add('hidden');
    window.lpSetCreateMode('listen');
    document.getElementById('lp-create-modal').classList.remove('hidden');
    document.getElementById('lp-create-modal').classList.add('flex');
};
window.lpCloseCreateModal = () => {
    document.getElementById('lp-create-modal').classList.add('hidden');
    document.getElementById('lp-create-modal').classList.remove('flex');
};
window.lpSubmitCreate = async () => {
    const name = document.getElementById('lp-create-name').value.trim();
    const pw = document.getElementById('lp-create-password').value;
    const errEl = document.getElementById('lp-create-error');
    if (!name) { errEl.textContent = 'Please enter a room name.'; errEl.classList.remove('hidden'); return; }
    if (!window.myUID) { errEl.textContent = 'You must be logged in.'; errEl.classList.remove('hidden'); return; }
    try {
        const partyId = window.push(window.ref(window.rtdb, 'listen_parties')).key;
        const passwordHash = pw ? await _lpHash(pw) : null;
        const mode = _lpCreateMode === 'watch' ? 'watch' : 'listen';
        await window.set(window.ref(window.rtdb, `listen_parties/${partyId}/meta`), {
            name, ownerUid: window.myUID, createdAt: window.rtdbTimestamp(), passwordHash, mode,
            permissions: { anyoneCanSkip: false, anyoneCanAddSongs: true }
        });
        await window.set(window.ref(window.rtdb, `listen_parties/${partyId}/members/${window.myUID}`), {
            username: window.myUsername || 'User', pfp: window.myPfp || '', joinedAt: window.rtdbTimestamp(), isOwner: true
        });
        await window.set(window.ref(window.rtdb, `listen_parties_public/${partyId}`), {
            name, ownerUid: window.myUID, ownerName: window.myUsername || 'User', mode,
            memberCount: 1, hasPassword: !!passwordHash, nowPlayingTitle: '', nowPlayingArtist: ''
        });
        window.lpCloseCreateModal();
        window.lpEnterRoom(partyId, true);
    } catch (e) {
        errEl.textContent = 'Could not create room: ' + (e.message || e);
        errEl.classList.remove('hidden');
        console.error('[ListenParty] create failed', e);
    }
};

window.lpAttemptJoin = async (partyId) => {
    const room = _lpPublicRooms[partyId];
    if (!room) return;
    if (room.hasPassword) {
        _lpPendingJoinId = partyId;
        document.getElementById('lp-password-room-name').textContent = room.name || 'Room';
        document.getElementById('lp-password-input').value = '';
        document.getElementById('lp-password-error').classList.add('hidden');
        document.getElementById('lp-password-modal').classList.remove('hidden');
        document.getElementById('lp-password-modal').classList.add('flex');
        return;
    }
    window.lpEnterRoom(partyId, false);
};
window.lpClosePasswordModal = () => {
    document.getElementById('lp-password-modal').classList.add('hidden');
    document.getElementById('lp-password-modal').classList.remove('flex');
    _lpPendingJoinId = null;
};
window.lpSubmitPassword = async () => {
    const pw = document.getElementById('lp-password-input').value;
    const errEl = document.getElementById('lp-password-error');
    const partyId = _lpPendingJoinId;
    if (!partyId) return;
    try {
        const snap = await window.get(window.ref(window.rtdb, `listen_parties/${partyId}/meta/passwordHash`));
        const storedHash = snap.val();
        const givenHash = pw ? await _lpHash(pw) : null;
        if (storedHash && storedHash !== givenHash) {
            errEl.textContent = 'Incorrect password.';
            errEl.classList.remove('hidden');
            return;
        }
        document.getElementById('lp-password-modal').classList.add('hidden');
        document.getElementById('lp-password-modal').classList.remove('flex');
        window.lpEnterRoom(partyId, false);
    } catch (e) {
        errEl.textContent = 'Could not verify password.';
        errEl.classList.remove('hidden');
    }
};

window.lpEnterRoom = async (partyId, isCreator) => {
    if (!window.myUID) return alert('You must be logged in.');
    if (_lpRoomId) window.lpLeaveRoom();
    _lpRoomId = partyId;

    const memberRef = window.ref(window.rtdb, `listen_parties/${partyId}/members/${window.myUID}`);
    if (!isCreator) {
        await window.set(memberRef, { username: window.myUsername || 'User', pfp: window.myPfp || '', joinedAt: window.rtdbTimestamp(), isOwner: false });
        await window.runTransaction(window.ref(window.rtdb, `listen_parties_public/${partyId}/memberCount`), (c) => (c || 0) + 1);
    }
    window.onDisconnect(memberRef).remove();

    document.getElementById('lp-browser-view').classList.add('hidden');
    document.getElementById('lp-room-view').classList.remove('hidden');
    document.getElementById('lp-room-view').classList.add('flex');
    document.getElementById('lp-room-name').textContent = _lpPublicRooms[partyId]?.name || 'Room';
    _lpApplyRoomMode(_lpPublicRooms[partyId]?.mode);
    _lpClearVideoError();
    _lpVideoErrorRetryCounts = {};
    _lpDurationWrittenFor = null;

    const metaRef = window.ref(window.rtdb, `listen_parties/${partyId}/meta`);
    const metaUnsub = window.onValue(metaRef, (snap) => {
        _lpMeta = snap.val() || {};
        _lpIsOwner = _lpMeta.ownerUid === window.myUID;
        const ownerBtn = document.getElementById('lp-owner-btn');
        if (ownerBtn) ownerBtn.classList.toggle('hidden', !_lpIsOwner);
        if (!_lpIsOwner) document.getElementById('lp-owner-panel').classList.add('hidden');
        const permSkip = document.getElementById('lp-perm-skip');
        const permAdd = document.getElementById('lp-perm-add');
        if (permSkip) permSkip.checked = !!_lpMeta.permissions?.anyoneCanSkip;
        if (permAdd) permAdd.checked = _lpMeta.permissions?.anyoneCanAddSongs !== false;
        document.getElementById('lp-room-name').textContent = _lpMeta.name || 'Room';
        _lpApplyRoomMode(_lpMeta.mode);
    });
    _lpUnsubs.push([metaRef, metaUnsub]);

    const playbackRef = window.ref(window.rtdb, `listen_parties/${partyId}/playback`);
    const playbackUnsub = window.onValue(playbackRef, (snap) => {
        _lpApplyPlaybackState(snap.val());
    });
    _lpUnsubs.push([playbackRef, playbackUnsub]);

    const queueRef = window.ref(window.rtdb, `listen_parties/${partyId}/queue`);
    const queueUnsub = window.onValue(queueRef, (snap) => {
        _lpRenderQueue(snap.val() || {});
    });
    _lpUnsubs.push([queueRef, queueUnsub]);

    const membersRef = window.ref(window.rtdb, `listen_parties/${partyId}/members`);
    const membersUnsub = window.onValue(membersRef, (snap) => {
        const members = snap.val() || {};
        _lpRenderMembers(members);
        _lpReconcileAfterMembersChange(partyId, members);
    });
    _lpUnsubs.push([membersRef, membersUnsub]);

    if (_lpDriftTimer) clearTimeout(_lpDriftTimer);
    _lpCheckDrift();

    if (_lpEndedWatchTimer) clearInterval(_lpEndedWatchTimer);
    _lpEndedWatchTimer = setInterval(() => {
        if (!_lpIsOwner || !_ytPlayer || !_lpRoomId) return;
        try {
            if (_ytPlayer.getPlayerState && _ytPlayer.getPlayerState() === YT.PlayerState.ENDED) {
                window.lpSkipTrack();
            }
        } catch (e) {}
    }, 2000);
};

window.lpLeaveRoom = async () => {
    const partyId = _lpRoomId;
    if (!partyId) { _lpShowBrowser(); return; }
    _lpUnsubs.forEach(([ref, unsub]) => { try { if (typeof unsub === 'function') unsub(); } catch (e) {} });
    _lpUnsubs = [];
    if (_lpDriftTimer) { clearTimeout(_lpDriftTimer); _lpDriftTimer = null; }
    if (_lpEndedWatchTimer) { clearInterval(_lpEndedWatchTimer); _lpEndedWatchTimer = null; }
    try {
        await window.runTransaction(window.ref(window.rtdb, `listen_parties_public/${partyId}/memberCount`), (c) => Math.max((c || 1) - 1, 0));
        await window.remove(window.ref(window.rtdb, `listen_parties/${partyId}/members/${window.myUID}`));
        if (_lpIsOwner) await _lpHandleOwnerVacancy(partyId);
    } catch (e) { console.warn('[ListenParty] leave cleanup failed', e); }
    _lpRoomId = null; _lpMeta = null; _lpIsOwner = false; _lpLastVideoId = null;
    _lpLastAppliedPausedAt = undefined; _lpLastAppliedStart = null;
    _lpApplyRoomMode('listen');
    _lpShowBrowser();
};

function _lpShowBrowser() {
    document.getElementById('lp-room-view').classList.add('hidden');
    document.getElementById('lp-room-view').classList.remove('flex');
    document.getElementById('lp-browser-view').classList.remove('hidden');
}

function _lpReconcileAfterMembersChange(partyId, members) {
    if (partyId !== _lpRoomId) return;
    const _lpCountRef = window.ref(window.rtdb, `listen_parties_public/${partyId}/ownerUid`);
    window.get(_lpCountRef).then(s => {
        if (!s.exists()) return;
        return window.set(window.ref(window.rtdb, `listen_parties_public/${partyId}/memberCount`), Object.keys(members).length);
    }).catch(() => {});
    if (!_lpMeta) return;
    const ownerStillPresent = _lpMeta.ownerUid && members[_lpMeta.ownerUid];
    if (ownerStillPresent || Object.keys(members).length === 0) return;
    const sorted = Object.entries(members).sort((a, b) => (a[1].joinedAt || 0) - (b[1].joinedAt || 0));
    const [longestUid] = sorted[0];
    if (longestUid !== window.myUID) return;
    window.runTransaction(window.ref(window.rtdb, `listen_parties/${partyId}/meta/ownerUid`), (current) => {
        if (current && members[current]) return;
        return longestUid;
    }).then(() => {
        window.set(window.ref(window.rtdb, `listen_parties/${partyId}/members/${longestUid}/isOwner`), true);
        window.set(window.ref(window.rtdb, `listen_parties_public/${partyId}/ownerUid`), longestUid);
        window.set(window.ref(window.rtdb, `listen_parties_public/${partyId}/ownerName`), members[longestUid].username || 'User');
    }).catch(() => {});
}

async function _lpHandleOwnerVacancy(partyId) {
    try {
        const snap = await window.get(window.ref(window.rtdb, `listen_parties/${partyId}/members`));
        const members = snap.val() || {};
        delete members[window.myUID];
        const remaining = Object.entries(members).sort((a, b) => (a[1].joinedAt || 0) - (b[1].joinedAt || 0));
        if (remaining.length > 0) {
            const [newOwnerUid, newOwnerData] = remaining[0];
            await window.set(window.ref(window.rtdb, `listen_parties/${partyId}/members/${newOwnerUid}/isOwner`), true);
            await window.set(window.ref(window.rtdb, `listen_parties/${partyId}/meta/ownerUid`), newOwnerUid);
            await window.set(window.ref(window.rtdb, `listen_parties_public/${partyId}/ownerUid`), newOwnerUid);
            await window.set(window.ref(window.rtdb, `listen_parties_public/${partyId}/ownerName`), newOwnerData.username || 'User');
        } else {
            await window.set(window.ref(window.rtdb, `listen_parties/${partyId}/meta/ownerUid`), null);
            await window.remove(window.ref(window.rtdb, `listen_parties_public/${partyId}`));
        }
    } catch (e) { console.warn('[ListenParty] owner vacancy handling failed', e); }
}

let _lpLastAppliedPausedAt = undefined;
let _lpLastAppliedStart = null;

function _lpTargetElapsed(pb) {
    return Math.max(0, (_lpServerNow() - pb.startedAtServerTime) / 1000);
}

function _lpSetProgressUI(pct) {
    pct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, pct));
    const fill = document.getElementById('lp-progress-fill');
    const handle = document.getElementById('lp-progress-handle');
    if (fill) fill.style.width = pct + '%';
    if (handle) handle.style.left = pct + '%';
}

let _lpCurrentPb = null;

function _lpApplyPlaybackState(pb) {
    _lpCurrentPb = pb || null;
    if (!pb || !pb.videoId) { _lpLastVideoId = null; _lpLastAppliedPausedAt = undefined; _lpResetRate(); _lpSetProgressUI(0); return; }
    document.getElementById('lp-np-title').textContent = pb.title || 'Untitled';
    document.getElementById('lp-np-artist').textContent = pb.artist || '';
    document.getElementById('lp-np-art').src = pb.artwork || '';
    _lpUpdatePlayPauseBtn(pb.pausedAt !== null && pb.pausedAt !== undefined);

    const isNewTrack = pb.videoId !== _lpLastVideoId;
    _lpLastVideoId = pb.videoId;
    if (isNewTrack) { _lpVideoErrorRetryCounts = {}; _lpClearVideoError(); }

    if (!_ytPlayer || !_ytReady) { _ytPendingVideoId = pb.videoId; return; }

    const isPaused = pb.pausedAt !== null && pb.pausedAt !== undefined;
    const samePauseState = !isNewTrack && isPaused === (_lpLastAppliedPausedAt !== null && _lpLastAppliedPausedAt !== undefined);
    const sameAnchor = isPaused
        ? (samePauseState && pb.pausedAt === _lpLastAppliedPausedAt)
        : (samePauseState && pb.startedAtServerTime === _lpLastAppliedStart);

    if (!isNewTrack && sameAnchor) {
    } else if (isPaused) {
        _lpResetRate();
        const safePausedAt = Math.max(0, Number(pb.pausedAt) || 0);
        if (isNewTrack) _ytPlayer.loadVideoById(pb.videoId, safePausedAt);
        else _ytPlayer.seekTo(safePausedAt, true);
        _ytPlayer.pauseVideo();
    } else {
        let elapsed = _lpTargetElapsed(pb);
        if (pb.trackDuration && elapsed > pb.trackDuration) elapsed = Math.max(0, pb.trackDuration - 1);
        if (isNewTrack) {
            _lpResetRate();
            _ytPlayer.loadVideoById(pb.videoId, elapsed);
        } else {
            _ytPlayer.seekTo(elapsed, true);
        }
        _ytPlayer.playVideo();
        if (typeof _lpScheduleDriftCheck === 'function') _lpScheduleDriftCheck(true);
    }
    _lpLastAppliedPausedAt = pb.pausedAt ?? null;
    _lpLastAppliedStart = pb.startedAtServerTime ?? null;

    if (pb.trackDuration) {
        const pct = ((pb.pausedAt ?? _lpTargetElapsed(pb)) / pb.trackDuration) * 100;
        _lpSetProgressUI(pct);
    }
}

const DRIFT_DEADZONE_SEC = 0.12;
const DRIFT_HARD_RESYNC_SEC = 1.0;
const DRIFT_CHECK_MS_IDLE = 1200;
const DRIFT_CHECK_MS_ACTIVE = 400;
const DRIFT_SAMPLE_COUNT = 3;
const DRIFT_SAMPLE_GAP_MS = 55;
let _lpDriftCorrecting = false;
function _lpResetRate() {
    _lpDriftCorrecting = false;
    try { if (_ytPlayer && _ytPlayer.getPlaybackRate && _ytPlayer.getPlaybackRate() !== 1) _ytPlayer.setPlaybackRate(1); } catch (e) {}
}

function _lpSampleCurrentTime() {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
        const samples = [];
        const take = () => {
            try { samples.push(_ytPlayer.getCurrentTime()); } catch (e) {}
            if (samples.length >= DRIFT_SAMPLE_COUNT) {
                const sorted = samples.slice().sort((a, b) => a - b);
                resolve(sorted[Math.floor(sorted.length / 2)]);
            } else {
                setTimeout(take, DRIFT_SAMPLE_GAP_MS);
            }
        };
        take();
    });
}

function _lpScheduleDriftCheck(active) {
    if (_lpDriftTimer) clearTimeout(_lpDriftTimer);
    _lpDriftTimer = setTimeout(_lpCheckDrift, active ? DRIFT_CHECK_MS_ACTIVE : DRIFT_CHECK_MS_IDLE);
}

async function _lpCheckDrift() {
    if (!_lpRoomId || !_ytPlayer || !_ytReady) { _lpScheduleDriftCheck(false); return; }

    const pb = _lpCurrentPb;

    if (!pb || (pb.pausedAt !== null && pb.pausedAt !== undefined)) { _lpResetRate(); _lpScheduleDriftCheck(false); return; }

    const state = _ytPlayer.getPlayerState ? _ytPlayer.getPlayerState() : null;
    if (state === 3   || state === -1   || state === 5  ) { _lpScheduleDriftCheck(_lpDriftCorrecting); return; }

    const actual = await _lpSampleCurrentTime();
    const expected = _lpTargetElapsed(pb);
    if (!isFinite(actual) || !isFinite(expected)) { _lpScheduleDriftCheck(_lpDriftCorrecting); return; }
    const drift = actual - expected;

    if (Math.abs(drift) > DRIFT_HARD_RESYNC_SEC) {
        _lpResetRate();
        try { _ytPlayer.seekTo(_lpTargetElapsed(pb), true); } catch (e) {}
        _lpScheduleDriftCheck(false);
        return;
    }
    if (Math.abs(drift) < DRIFT_DEADZONE_SEC) {
        _lpResetRate();
        _lpScheduleDriftCheck(false);
        return;
    }

    const rates = (_ytPlayer.getAvailablePlaybackRates && _ytPlayer.getAvailablePlaybackRates()) || [0.5, 0.75, 1, 1.25, 1.5];
    const wantStep = Math.abs(drift) >= 0.5 ? 0.5 : 0.25;
    const below = rates.filter(r => r < 1).sort((a, b) => b - a);
    const above = rates.filter(r => r > 1).sort((a, b) => a - b);
    const slower = below.find(r => (1 - r) >= wantStep - 0.001) || below[0] || 0.75;
    const faster = above.find(r => (r - 1) >= wantStep - 0.001) || above[above.length - 1] || 1.25;
    _lpDriftCorrecting = true;
    try { _ytPlayer.setPlaybackRate(drift > 0 ? slower : faster); } catch (e) {}
    _lpScheduleDriftCheck(true);
}

function _lpCanControl(permKey) {
    if (!_lpMeta) return false;
    if (_lpMeta.ownerUid === window.myUID) return true;
    return !!_lpMeta.permissions?.[permKey];
}

window.lpToggleOwnerPanel = () => {
    document.getElementById('lp-owner-panel').classList.toggle('hidden');
};

window.lpSetPermission = async (key, value) => {
    if (!_lpIsOwner || !_lpRoomId) return;
    await window.set(window.ref(window.rtdb, `listen_parties/${_lpRoomId}/meta/permissions/${key}`), value);
};

window.lpSkipTrack = async () => {
    if (!_lpRoomId || !_lpCanControl('anyoneCanSkip')) return alert('Only the owner can skip right now.');
    const snap = await window.get(window.ref(window.rtdb, `listen_parties/${_lpRoomId}/queue`));
    const queue = snap.val() || {};
    const items = Object.entries(queue).sort((a, b) => (a[1].addedAt || 0) - (b[1].addedAt || 0));
    if (items.length === 0) {
        await window.set(window.ref(window.rtdb, `listen_parties/${_lpRoomId}/playback`), null);
        return;
    }
    const [nextId, next] = items[0];
    await window.set(window.ref(window.rtdb, `listen_parties/${_lpRoomId}/playback`), {
        videoId: next.videoId, title: next.title, artist: next.artist, artwork: next.artwork,
        startedAtServerTime: _lpServerNow(), pausedAt: null, trackDuration: next.trackDuration || 0
    });
    await window.remove(window.ref(window.rtdb, `listen_parties/${_lpRoomId}/queue/${nextId}`));
    await window.set(window.ref(window.rtdb, `listen_parties_public/${_lpRoomId}/nowPlayingTitle`), next.title || '');
    await window.set(window.ref(window.rtdb, `listen_parties_public/${_lpRoomId}/nowPlayingArtist`), next.artist || '');
};

function _lpUpdatePlayPauseBtn(isPaused) {
    const btn = document.getElementById('lp-playpause-btn');
    if (!btn) return;
    btn.innerHTML = isPaused ? '<i class="fa-solid fa-play"></i>' : '<i class="fa-solid fa-pause"></i>';
    btn.title = isPaused ? 'Resume' : 'Pause';
    const eq = document.getElementById('lp-eq');
    if (eq) eq.classList.toggle('playing', !isPaused);
}

let _lpShieldPressTimer = null;
let _lpShieldRelockTimer = null;
const LP_SHIELD_HOLD_MS = 550;
const LP_SHIELD_UNLOCK_MS = 5000;

function _lpShowShieldToast() {
    const toast = document.getElementById('lp-shield-toast');
    if (!toast) return;
    toast.classList.add('show');
    clearTimeout(toast._lpHideTimer);
    toast._lpHideTimer = setTimeout(() => toast.classList.remove('show'), 4500);
}

function _lpHighlightPlayPauseBtn() {
    const btn = document.getElementById('lp-playpause-btn');
    if (!btn) return;
    btn.classList.remove('lp-pp-highlight');
    void btn.offsetWidth;
    btn.classList.add('lp-pp-highlight');
    clearTimeout(btn._lpPulseTimer);
    btn._lpPulseTimer = setTimeout(() => btn.classList.remove('lp-pp-highlight'), 1900);
}

function _lpShieldUnlock() {
    const shield = document.getElementById('lp-video-shield');
    const badge = document.getElementById('lp-shield-badge');
    if (!shield) return;
    shield.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
    shield.classList.add('lp-shield-unlocked');
    if (badge) badge.classList.add('show');
    clearTimeout(_lpShieldRelockTimer);
    _lpShieldRelockTimer = setTimeout(_lpShieldRelock, LP_SHIELD_UNLOCK_MS);
}

function _lpShieldRelock() {
    const shield = document.getElementById('lp-video-shield');
    const badge = document.getElementById('lp-shield-badge');
    if (shield) { shield.style.pointerEvents = 'auto'; shield.classList.remove('lp-shield-unlocked'); }
    if (badge) badge.classList.remove('show');
    _lpShieldRelockTimer = null;
}

(function _lpInitVideoShield() {
    const shield = document.getElementById('lp-video-shield');
    if (!shield) return;
    shield.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        clearTimeout(_lpShieldPressTimer);
        _lpShieldPressTimer = setTimeout(() => {
            _lpShieldPressTimer = null;
            _lpShieldUnlock();
        }, LP_SHIELD_HOLD_MS);
    });
    const releaseAsTap = () => {
        if (_lpShieldPressTimer) {
            clearTimeout(_lpShieldPressTimer);
            _lpShieldPressTimer = null;
            _lpShowShieldToast();
            _lpHighlightPlayPauseBtn();
        }
    };
    shield.addEventListener('pointerup', releaseAsTap);
    shield.addEventListener('pointercancel', releaseAsTap);
    shield.addEventListener('pointerleave', releaseAsTap);
})();

setInterval(() => {
    const pb = _lpCurrentPb;
    if (!pb || !pb.videoId || !pb.trackDuration) return;
    const isPaused = pb.pausedAt !== null && pb.pausedAt !== undefined;
    if (isPaused) return;
    const track = document.getElementById('lp-progress-track');
    if (track && track.classList.contains('scrubbing')) return;
    _lpSetProgressUI((_lpTargetElapsed(pb) / pb.trackDuration) * 100);
}, 250);

window.lpSeekTo = async (fraction) => {
    if (!_lpRoomId) return;
    if (!_lpCanControl('anyoneCanSkip')) return alert('Only the owner can seek right now.');
    const snap = await window.get(window.ref(window.rtdb, `listen_parties/${_lpRoomId}/playback`));
    const pb = snap.val();
    if (!pb || !pb.videoId || !pb.trackDuration) return;
    const target = Math.max(0, Math.min(pb.trackDuration, fraction * pb.trackDuration));
    const isPaused = pb.pausedAt !== null && pb.pausedAt !== undefined;
    if (isPaused) {
        await window.update(window.ref(window.rtdb, `listen_parties/${_lpRoomId}/playback`), { pausedAt: target });
    } else {
        const startedAtServerTime = _lpServerNow() - target * 1000;
        await window.update(window.ref(window.rtdb, `listen_parties/${_lpRoomId}/playback`), { startedAtServerTime });
    }
};

(function _lpSetupProgressScrub() {
    const track = document.getElementById('lp-progress-track');
    if (!track) return;
    const fractionFromEvent = (e) => {
        const rect = track.getBoundingClientRect();
        const t = (e.touches && e.touches[0]) || (e.changedTouches && e.changedTouches[0]);
        const clientX = t ? t.clientX : e.clientX;
        return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (clientX - rect.left) / rect.width));
    };
    let dragging = false;
    const start = (e) => {
        if (!_lpCurrentPb || !_lpCurrentPb.trackDuration) return;
        dragging = true;
        track.classList.add('scrubbing');
        _lpSetProgressUI(fractionFromEvent(e) * 100);
        if (e.cancelable) e.preventDefault();
    };
    const move = (e) => {
        if (!dragging) return;
        _lpSetProgressUI(fractionFromEvent(e) * 100);
        if (e.cancelable) e.preventDefault();
    };
    const end = (e) => {
        if (!dragging) return;
        dragging = false;
        track.classList.remove('scrubbing');
        window.lpSeekTo(fractionFromEvent(e));
    };
    track.addEventListener('mousedown', start);
    window.addEventListener('mousemove', move);
    window.addEventListener('mouseup', end);
    track.addEventListener('touchstart', start, { passive: false });
    track.addEventListener('touchmove', move, { passive: false });
    track.addEventListener('touchend', end);
})();

window._lpSetMobileTab = (tab) => {
    const playingTab = document.getElementById('lp-tab-playing');
    const roomTab = document.getElementById('lp-tab-room');
    const playingPane = document.getElementById('lp-pane-playing');
    const roomPane = document.getElementById('lp-pane-room');
    if (!playingTab || !roomTab || !playingPane || !roomPane) return;
    playingTab.classList.toggle('active', tab === 'playing');
    roomTab.classList.toggle('active', tab === 'room');
    playingPane.classList.toggle('active', tab === 'playing');
    roomPane.classList.toggle('active', tab === 'room');
};

window._lpToggleFullscreen = () => {
    const root = document.documentElement;
    if (!document.fullscreenElement) {
        (root.requestFullscreen || root.webkitRequestFullscreen || function(){}).call(root);
    } else {
        (document.exitFullscreen || document.webkitExitFullscreen || function(){}).call(document);
    }
};
document.addEventListener('fullscreenchange', () => {
    const isFs = !!document.fullscreenElement;
    document.body.classList.toggle('lp-fullscreen-mode', isFs);
    const fsBtn = document.getElementById('lp-fullscreen-btn');
    if (fsBtn) { fsBtn.textContent = isFs ? '⛶' : '⛶'; fsBtn.title = isFs ? 'Exit fullscreen' : 'Fullscreen'; }
});

window.lpTogglePause = async () => {
    if (!_lpRoomId || !_lpCanControl('anyoneCanSkip')) return alert('Only the owner can pause/resume right now.');
    const snap = await window.get(window.ref(window.rtdb, `listen_parties/${_lpRoomId}/playback`));
    const pb = snap.val();
    if (!pb || !pb.videoId) return;

    const isPaused = pb.pausedAt !== null && pb.pausedAt !== undefined;
    if (isPaused) {
        const startedAtServerTime = _lpServerNow() - (pb.pausedAt * 1000);
        await window.update(window.ref(window.rtdb, `listen_parties/${_lpRoomId}/playback`), {
            pausedAt: null, startedAtServerTime
        });
    } else {
        const pausedAt = _lpTargetElapsed(pb);
        await window.update(window.ref(window.rtdb, `listen_parties/${_lpRoomId}/playback`), { pausedAt });
    }
};

window.lpTransferOwnership = async (uid) => {
    if (!_lpIsOwner || !_lpRoomId || !uid) return;
    const snap = await window.get(window.ref(window.rtdb, `listen_parties/${_lpRoomId}/members/${uid}`));
    const newOwner = snap.val();
    if (!newOwner) return;
    await window.set(window.ref(window.rtdb, `listen_parties/${_lpRoomId}/meta/ownerUid`), uid);
    await window.set(window.ref(window.rtdb, `listen_parties/${_lpRoomId}/members/${window.myUID}/isOwner`), false);
    await window.set(window.ref(window.rtdb, `listen_parties/${_lpRoomId}/members/${uid}/isOwner`), true);
    await window.set(window.ref(window.rtdb, `listen_parties_public/${_lpRoomId}/ownerUid`), uid);
    await window.set(window.ref(window.rtdb, `listen_parties_public/${_lpRoomId}/ownerName`), newOwner.username || 'User');
};

window.lpKickMember = async (uid) => {
    if (!_lpIsOwner || !_lpRoomId || !uid || uid === window.myUID) return;
    await window.remove(window.ref(window.rtdb, `listen_parties/${_lpRoomId}/members/${uid}`));
    await window.runTransaction(window.ref(window.rtdb, `listen_parties_public/${_lpRoomId}/memberCount`), (c) => Math.max((c || 1) - 1, 0));
};

window.lpExecSearch = async (query) => {
    if (!query) return;
    const box = document.getElementById('lp-search-results');
    box.innerHTML = `<div class="text-xs text-[#555566] p-2 text-center">Searching YouTube...</div>`;
    try {
        const tracks = await _ytSearch(query);
        box.innerHTML = '';
        if (!tracks.length) { box.innerHTML = '<div class="text-xs text-[#555566] p-2 text-center">No results found.</div>'; return; }
        tracks.forEach(t => {
            box.innerHTML += `<div class="mq-row" onclick='window.lpAddToQueue(${JSON.stringify(t).replace(/'/g, "\\'")})'>
                <img src="${t.artwork}" class="mq-img">
                <div class="flex-1 min-w-0"><div class="mq-title">${window.escHtml(t.title)}</div><div class="mq-artist">${window.escHtml(t.artist)}</div></div>
                <button class="text-indigo-400 font-bold ml-2 text-xl">+</button>
            </div>`;
        });
    } catch (e) {
        box.innerHTML = `<div class="text-xs text-red-400 p-2 text-center">Search error: ${window.escHtml(e.message)}</div>`;
    }
};

window.lpAddToQueue = async (t) => {
    if (!_lpRoomId) return;
    if (!_lpCanControl('anyoneCanAddSongs')) return alert('The owner has disabled adding songs right now.');
    const qRef = window.push(window.ref(window.rtdb, `listen_parties/${_lpRoomId}/queue`));
    await window.set(qRef, {
        videoId: t.videoId, title: t.title, artist: t.artist, artwork: t.artwork,
        addedBy: window.myUID, addedAt: window.rtdbTimestamp()
    });
    document.getElementById('lp-search-results').innerHTML = '';
    document.getElementById('lp-search-input').value = '';
    const pbSnap = await window.get(window.ref(window.rtdb, `listen_parties/${_lpRoomId}/playback`));
    if (!pbSnap.val() && _lpCanControl('anyoneCanSkip')) window.lpSkipTrack();
};

function _lpRenderQueue(queue) {
    const list = document.getElementById('lp-queue-list');
    const empty = document.getElementById('lp-queue-empty');
    const items = Object.entries(queue).sort((a, b) => (a[1].addedAt || 0) - (b[1].addedAt || 0));
    if (items.length === 0) { list.innerHTML = ''; empty.classList.remove('hidden'); return; }
    empty.classList.add('hidden');
    list.innerHTML = items.map(([id, t]) => `
        <div class="mq-row">
            <img src="${t.artwork}" class="mq-img">
            <div class="flex-1 min-w-0"><div class="mq-title">${window.escHtml(t.title)}</div><div class="mq-artist">${window.escHtml(t.artist)}</div></div>
        </div>
    `).join('');
}

function _lpRenderMembers(members) {
    const list = document.getElementById('lp-member-list');
    const entries = Object.entries(members);
    document.getElementById('lp-room-sub').textContent = `${entries.length} ${_lpCurrentMode === 'watch' ? 'watching' : 'listening'}`;
    list.innerHTML = entries.map(([uid, m]) => `
        <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
            <img src="${m.pfp || ''}" class="w-7 h-7 rounded-full bg-[#1e1e2e] object-cover">
            <div class="flex-1 min-w-0 text-xs text-[#e8e8f0] font-bold truncate">${window.escHtml(m.username || 'User')}</div>
            ${m.isOwner ? '<span class="text-[10px] text-indigo-400 font-black"><i class="fa-solid fa-crown"></i> OWNER</span>' : ''}
            ${_lpIsOwner && uid !== window.myUID ? `
                <button onclick="window.lpTransferOwnership('${uid}')" title="Make owner" class="text-[10px] text-[#555566] hover:text-indigo-400">⇄</button>
                <button onclick="window.lpKickMember('${uid}')" title="Kick" class="text-[10px] text-[#555566] hover:text-red-400">✕</button>
            ` : ''}
        </div>
    `).join('');
}

let _sbSchools = [];
let _sbPosts = [];
let _sbSchoolKey = null;
let _sbSchoolName = '';
let _sbKind = 'answer_key';
let _sbImages = [];
let _sbOpenPost = null;
let _sbScrubCount = 0;
let _sbPostsUnsub = null;

function sbKeyOf(name) {
    const raw = String(name || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const canonical = SB_ALIASES[raw] || name;
    return String(canonical).trim().toLowerCase()
        .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '_').replace(/^_+|_+$/g, '').slice(0, 90);
}
function sbCanonicalName(name) {
    const raw = String(name || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (SB_ALIASES[raw]) return SB_ALIASES[raw];
    const hit = SB_SCHOOLS.find(s => s.toLowerCase() === raw);
    return hit || String(name || '').trim().slice(0, 80);
}
const sbEsc = (t) => String(t == null ? '' : t)
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;').replace(/'/g, '&#39;');

function sbAgo(ts) {
    if (!ts) return '';
    const d = ts.toDate ? ts.toDate() : new Date(ts);
    const s = Math.floor((Date.now() - d.getTime()) / 1000);
    if (s < 60) return 'just now';
    if (s < 3600) return Math.floor(s / 60) + 'm ago';
    if (s < 86400) return Math.floor(s / 3600) + 'h ago';
    if (s < 604800) return Math.floor(s / 86400) + 'd ago';
    return d.toLocaleDateString();
}
const SB_KIND_LABEL = { answer_key: 'Answer key', images: 'Photos', chat: 'EchoAI chat' };
const SB_KIND_ICON  = { answer_key: 'fa-list-ol', images: 'fa-image', chat: 'fa-robot' };

window.sbLoadSchools = async () => {
    const list = document.getElementById('sb-school-list');
    const empty = document.getElementById('sb-school-empty');
    if (!list) return;
    try {
        const snap = await getDocs(query(collection(db, 'schools'), orderBy('postCount', 'desc'), limit(60)));
        _sbSchools = snap.docs.map(d => ({ key: d.id, ...d.data() }));
    } catch (e) {
        console.warn('[Schools] load failed', e);
        _sbSchools = [];
    }
    if (!_sbSchools.length) {
        list.innerHTML = '';
        if (empty) empty.classList.remove('hidden');
        return;
    }
    if (empty) empty.classList.add('hidden');
    list.innerHTML = _sbSchools.map(s => `
        <div class="sb-card" onclick="sbOpenSchool('${sbEsc(s.key)}','${sbEsc(s.name)}')">
            <div class="sb-card-name">${sbEsc(s.name)}</div>
            <div class="sb-card-meta">${s.postCount || 0} post${(s.postCount || 0) === 1 ? '' : 's'}</div>
        </div>`).join('');
};

window.sbSchoolTypeahead = () => {
    const input = document.getElementById('sb-school-input');
    const box = document.getElementById('sb-school-ac');
    if (!input || !box) return;
    const q = input.value.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!q) { box.classList.add('hidden'); box.innerHTML = ''; return; }

    const existing = _sbSchools
        .filter(s => (s.name || '').toLowerCase().includes(q))
        .map(s => ({ name: s.name, key: s.key, tag: (s.postCount || 0) + ' posts' }));
    const seen = new Set(existing.map(e => e.key));
    const known = SB_SCHOOLS
        .filter(n => n.toLowerCase().includes(q) || Object.keys(SB_ALIASES).some(a => a.startsWith(q) && SB_ALIASES[a] === n))
        .map(n => ({ name: n, key: sbKeyOf(n), tag: '' }))
        .filter(n => !seen.has(n.key));

    const rows = existing.concat(known).slice(0, 12);
    if (!rows.length) { box.classList.add('hidden'); box.innerHTML = ''; return; }
    box.innerHTML = rows.map(r => `
        <div class="sb-ac-item" onclick="sbOpenSchool('${sbEsc(r.key)}','${sbEsc(r.name)}')">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-school" style="font-size:11px;opacity:.5;"></i>
            <span>${sbEsc(r.name)}</span>
            ${r.tag ? `<span class="tag">${sbEsc(r.tag)}</span>` : ''}
        </div>`).join('');
    box.classList.remove('hidden');
};

window.sbOpenTypedSchool = () => {
    const input = document.getElementById('sb-school-input');
    const typed = (input && input.value || '').trim();
    if (!typed) return;
    const name = sbCanonicalName(typed);
    const key = sbKeyOf(typed);
    if (!key) return;
    window.sbOpenSchool(key, name);
};

window.sbOpenSchool = async (key, name) => {
    _sbSchoolKey = key; _sbSchoolName = name;
    const box = document.getElementById('sb-school-ac');
    if (box) { box.classList.add('hidden'); box.innerHTML = ''; }
    document.getElementById('sb-pane-browse').classList.add('hidden');
    document.getElementById('sb-pane-school').classList.remove('hidden');
    document.getElementById('sb-school-name').textContent = name;
    document.getElementById('sb-school-meta').textContent = 'Loading…';
    const search = document.getElementById('sb-post-search');
    if (search) search.value = '';

    if (_sbPostsUnsub) { try { _sbPostsUnsub(); } catch (_) {} _sbPostsUnsub = null; }
    try {
        _sbPostsUnsub = onSnapshot(
            query(collection(db, 'schools', key, 'posts'), orderBy('createdAt', 'desc'), limit(200)),
            (snap) => {
                _sbPosts = snap.docs.map(d => ({ id: d.id, ...d.data() })).filter(p => !p.hidden);
                const meta = document.getElementById('sb-school-meta');
                if (meta) meta.textContent = _sbPosts.length
                    ? `${_sbPosts.length} post${_sbPosts.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}`
                    : 'Nothing published yet';
                window.sbRenderPosts();
                if (snap.docs.length < 200) sbReconcileCount(key, _sbPosts.length);
            },
            (e) => {
                console.warn('[Schools] post stream failed', e);
                const meta = document.getElementById('sb-school-meta');
                if (meta) meta.textContent = 'Could not load posts';
            });
    } catch (e) { console.warn('[Schools] open failed', e); }
};

async function sbReconcileCount(key, realCount) {
    if (!key || !window.myUID) return;
    try {
        const ref = doc(db, 'schools', key);
        const snap = await getDoc(ref);
        if (!snap.exists()) return;
        if ((snap.data().postCount || 0) === realCount) return;
        await updateDoc(ref, { postCount: realCount });
        const cached = _sbSchools.find(s => s.key === key);
        if (cached) cached.postCount = realCount;
    } catch (e) { console.warn('[Schools] count reconcile failed', e && e.code); }
}

window.sbBackToBrowse = () => {
    if (_sbPostsUnsub) { try { _sbPostsUnsub(); } catch (_) {} _sbPostsUnsub = null; }
    _sbSchoolKey = null; _sbPosts = [];
    document.getElementById('sb-pane-school').classList.add('hidden');
    document.getElementById('sb-pane-browse').classList.remove('hidden');
    window.sbLoadSchools();
};

window.sbRenderPosts = () => {
    const list = document.getElementById('sb-post-list');
    const empty = document.getElementById('sb-post-empty');
    if (!list) return;
    const q = (document.getElementById('sb-post-search')?.value || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const kind = document.getElementById('sb-post-kind')?.value || '';
    const rows = _sbPosts.filter(p => {
        if (kind && p.kind !== kind) return false;
        if (!q) return true;
        return (p.assignmentLower || '').includes(q) || (p.subjectLower || '').includes(q);
    });
    if (!rows.length) {
        list.innerHTML = '';
        if (empty) { empty.classList.remove('hidden'); empty.querySelector('p').textContent = q || kind ? 'Nothing matches that.' : 'Nothing published here yet. Be the first.'; }
        return;
    }
    if (empty) empty.classList.add('hidden');
    list.innerHTML = rows.map(p => {
        const count = p.kind === 'answer_key' ? `${(p.answers || []).length} answers`
                    : p.kind === 'images' ? `${(p.imageIds || []).length} photo${(p.imageIds || []).length === 1 ? '' : 's'}`
                    : `${(p.snapshot || []).length} messages`;
        return `
        <div class="sb-row" onclick="sbOpenPost('${sbEsc(p.id)}')">
            <div class="sb-row-ico"><i class="fa-solid ${SB_KIND_ICON[p.kind] || 'fa-file'}"></i></div>
            <div class="sb-row-main">
                <div class="sb-row-title">${sbEsc(p.assignment)}</div>
                <div class="sb-row-meta">${sbEsc(p.subject || 'No subject')} &middot; ${count} &middot; ${sbAgo(p.createdAt)}</div>
            </div>
            <span class="sb-chip">${SB_KIND_LABEL[p.kind] || ''}</span>
        </div>`;
    }).join('');
};
