function sbFillChatPicker() {
    const sel = document.getElementById('sb-pub-chatpick');
    const prev = document.getElementById('sb-chat-preview');
    if (!sel) return;
    const chats = (typeof echoaiChats !== 'undefined' ? echoaiChats : []) || [];
    if (!chats.length) {
        sel.innerHTML = '<option value="">No EchoAI chats yet</option>';
        if (prev) prev.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#55556a;">Start a conversation in EchoAI first.</span>';
        return;
    }
    sel.innerHTML = chats.map(c => `<option value="${sbEsc(c.id)}">${sbEsc(c.title || 'Untitled chat')}</option>`).join('');
    sel.onchange = sbPreviewChat;
    sbPreviewChat();
}
function sbPreviewChat() {
    const sel = document.getElementById('sb-pub-chatpick');
    const prev = document.getElementById('sb-chat-preview');
    if (!sel || !prev) return;
    const chat = (echoaiChats || []).find(c => c.id === sel.value);
    const msgs = sbSnapshotOf(chat);
    prev.innerHTML = msgs.length
        ? msgs.slice(0, 14).map(m => `<div class="sb-msg ${m.role === 'user' ? 'me' : ''}"><span class="who">${m.role === 'user' ? 'You' : 'EchoAI'}</span>${sbEsc(window.sbScrubKnownNames(m.text)).slice(0, 600)}</div>`).join('')
        : '<span style="color:#55556a;">This chat is empty.</span>';
}
function sbSnapshotOf(chat) {
    if (!chat || !Array.isArray(chat.messages)) return [];
    return chat.messages
        .filter(m => m && m.role !== 'system' && typeof m.content === 'string' && m.content.trim())
        .map(m => ({ role: m.role === 'user' ? 'user' : 'assistant', text: String(m.content).slice(0, 4000) }));
}

function sbSetStatus(msg, cls) {
    const el = document.getElementById('sb-pub-status');
    if (!el) return;
    el.className = 'sb-status ' + (cls || '');
    el.innerHTML = msg || '';
    el.classList.toggle('hidden', !msg);
}

function sbCompress(file, closeUp) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const img = new Image();
        const url = URL.createObjectURL(file);
        img.onload = () => {
            URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
            const MAX = closeUp ? 1800 : 1100;
            const Q = closeUp ? 0.88 : 0.62;
            let { width: w, height: h } = img;
            if (w > MAX || h > MAX) {
                if (w > h) { h = Math.round(h * MAX / w); w = MAX; }
                else { w = Math.round(w * MAX / h); h = MAX; }
            }
            const c = document.createElement('canvas');
            c.width = w; c.height = h;
            const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
            ctx.fillStyle = '#fff'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
            ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, w, h);
            let q = Q, out = c.toDataURL('image/jpeg', q);
            const cap = closeUp ? 2200000 : 900000;
            while (out.length > cap && q > 0.3) { q -= 0.08; out = c.toDataURL('image/jpeg', q); }
            resolve(out);
        };
        img.onerror = () => { URL.revokeObjectURL(url); reject(new Error('Not a readable image')); };
        img.src = url;
    });
}

const SB_MOD_PROMPT =
    'You are an image safety check for a high-school homework sharing board. ' +
    'Reply with exactly one word and nothing else: ALLOW or BLOCK. ' +
    'BLOCK if the image contains nudity or sexual content, graphic violence or gore, ' +
    'weapons brandished as a threat, hate symbols or slurs, drugs or alcohol, ' +
    'self-harm, or a photo of a person that is not schoolwork (selfies, group photos). ' +
    'ALLOW schoolwork of any kind: worksheets, notes, textbook pages, handwriting, ' +
    'diagrams, screens, whiteboards, graphs, lab work, or blank/unclear images. ' +
    'When genuinely unsure, reply ALLOW.';

async function sbModerate(dataUrl) {
    const b64 = dataUrl.split(',')[1];
    if (!b64) return { ok: false, reason: 'Could not read that image.' };
    try {
        const verdict = await window._liveAsk({
            systemInstruction: SB_MOD_PROMPT,
            text: 'Check this image.',
            images: [{ data: b64, mime: 'image/jpeg' }],
            timeoutMs: 30000
        });
        const said = String(verdict || '').trim().toUpperCase();
        if (said.includes('BLOCK')) return { ok: false, reason: 'That image did not pass the content check.' };
        return { ok: true };
    } catch (e) {
        console.warn('[Schools] moderation unavailable, allowing:', e && e.message);
        return { ok: true, degraded: true };
    }
}

window.sbAddImages = async (files) => {
    const strip = document.getElementById('sb-image-strip');
    if (!strip || !files || !files.length) return;
    for (const file of Array.from(files).slice(0, 6)) {
        if (_sbImages.length >= 8) { sbSetStatus('Eight photos is the limit for one post.', 'err'); break; }
        const id = 'i' + Date.now() + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7);
        const entry = { id, file, dataUrl: '', closeUp: false, state: 'checking' };
        _sbImages.push(entry);
        const cell = document.createElement('div');
        cell.className = 'sb-thumb pending';
        cell.id = 'sbimg_' + id;
        cell.innerHTML = '<div style="height:72px;"></div><div class="badge">Checking…</div>';
        strip.appendChild(cell);
        try {
            entry.dataUrl = await sbCompress(file, false);
            const verdict = await sbModerate(entry.dataUrl);
            if (!verdict.ok) {
                _sbImages = _sbImages.filter(i => i.id !== id);
                cell.remove();
                sbSetStatus(verdict.reason, 'err');
                continue;
            }
            entry.state = 'ok';
            cell.classList.remove('pending');
            sbPaintThumb(cell, entry);
        } catch (e) {
            _sbImages = _sbImages.filter(i => i.id !== id);
            cell.remove();
            sbSetStatus(e.message || 'That file could not be read.', 'err');
        }
    }
};

function sbPaintThumb(cell, entry) {
    cell.innerHTML = `
        <img src="${entry.dataUrl}" alt="">
        <button class="rm" title="Remove">&times;</button>
        <label class="cu"><input type="checkbox"> close-up</label>`;
    cell.querySelector('.rm').onclick = () => {
        _sbImages = _sbImages.filter(i => i.id !== entry.id);
        cell.remove();
    };
    cell.querySelector('.cu input').onchange = async (ev) => {
        const box = ev.target;
        entry.closeUp = box.checked;
        box.disabled = true;
        cell.classList.add('pending');
        try {
            entry.dataUrl = await sbCompress(entry.file, entry.closeUp);
            const img = cell.querySelector('img');
            if (img) img.src = entry.dataUrl;
            sbSetStatus(entry.closeUp ? 'Kept at full detail for handwriting.' : '', entry.closeUp ? 'wait' : '');
        } catch (_) {
            entry.closeUp = !entry.closeUp;
            box.checked = entry.closeUp;
        } finally {
            box.disabled = false;
            cell.classList.remove('pending');
        }
    };
}

async function sbUploadImage(dataUrl) {
    const fileId = `${window.myUID}_${Date.now()}${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`;
    const CHUNK = 700000;
    const chunks = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < dataUrl.length; i += CHUNK) chunks.push(dataUrl.slice(i, i + CHUNK));
    const batch = writeBatch(db);
    chunks.forEach((c, i) => batch.set(doc(db, 'school_files', fileId, 'chunks', 'chunk_' + i), { data: c, index: i }));
    await batch.commit();
    await setDoc(doc(db, 'school_files', fileId, 'chunks', 'meta'), { total: chunks.length });
    return fileId;
}
window.sbLoadImage = async (fileId) => {
    const metaSnap = await getDoc(doc(db, 'school_files', fileId, 'chunks', 'meta'));
    if (!metaSnap.exists()) throw new Error('Image missing');
    const total = metaSnap.data().total;
    const parts = await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: total }, (_, i) =>
        getDoc(doc(db, 'school_files', fileId, 'chunks', 'chunk_' + i))));
    return parts.map(p => p.data().data).join('');
};

window.sbSubmitPost = async () => {
    if (!window.myUID) return;
    const btn = document.getElementById('sb-pub-go');
    const assignment = (document.getElementById('sb-pub-assignment').value || '').trim();
    const subject = (document.getElementById('sb-pub-subject').value || '').trim();
    if (!assignment) return sbSetStatus('Give it an assignment name so people can find it.', 'err');

    let answers = [], snapshot = [], imageIds = [];
    if (_sbKind === 'answer_key') {
        answers = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#sb-answer-rows .sb-answer'))
            .map(r => ({ n: r.querySelector('.n').value.trim(), text: r.querySelector('.v').value.trim() }))
            .filter(a => a.text);
        if (!answers.length) return sbSetStatus('An answer key needs at least one typed answer.', 'err');
    }
    if (_sbKind === 'chat') {
        const sel = document.getElementById('sb-pub-chatpick');
        snapshot = sbSnapshotOf((echoaiChats || []).find(c => c.id === sel.value));
        if (!snapshot.length) return sbSetStatus('Pick a chat that has messages in it.', 'err');
    }
    if (_sbKind === 'images' && !_sbImages.length) {
        return sbSetStatus('Add at least one photo.', 'err');
    }

    btn.disabled = true;
    try {
        _sbScrubCount = 0;
        if (snapshot.length || answers.length) {
            sbSetStatus('Checking for names…', 'wait');
            if (snapshot.length) {
                const res = await window.sbScrubAll(snapshot.map(m => m.text));
                snapshot = snapshot.map((m, i) => ({ role: m.role, text: res.texts[i] }));
                _sbScrubCount += res.count;
            }
            if (answers.length) {
                const res = await window.sbScrubAll(answers.map(a => a.text));
                answers = answers.map((a, i) => ({ n: a.n, text: res.texts[i] }));
                _sbScrubCount += res.count;
            }
        }
        if (_sbImages.length) {
            sbSetStatus(`Uploading ${_sbImages.length} photo${_sbImages.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}…`, 'wait');
            for (const img of _sbImages) imageIds.push(await sbUploadImage(img.dataUrl));
        }
        sbSetStatus('Publishing…', 'wait');

        const schoolRef = doc(db, 'schools', _sbSchoolKey);
        const existing = await getDoc(schoolRef);
        if (!existing.exists()) {
            await setDoc(schoolRef, {
                name: _sbSchoolName, nameLower: _sbSchoolName.toLowerCase(),
                createdBy: window.myUID, createdAt: serverTimestamp(), postCount: 0
            });
        }

        const _sbNewPost = await addDoc(collection(db, 'schools', _sbSchoolKey, 'posts'), {
            kind: _sbKind,
            assignment, assignmentLower: assignment.toLowerCase(),
            subject, subjectLower: subject.toLowerCase(),
            authorUid: window.myUID,
            createdAt: serverTimestamp(), updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
            answers, snapshot, imageIds,
            reportCount: 0, hidden: false
        });


        const hid = _sbScrubCount;
        try { window.EchoShards && window.EchoShards.onSchoolPost(_sbSchoolKey, _sbNewPost.id); } catch (_) {}
        sbSetStatus(hid ? `Published. ${hid} name${hid === 1 ? '' : 's'} hidden.` : 'Published.', 'ok');
        setTimeout(() => window.sbClosePublish(), hid ? 1600 : 700);
    } catch (e) {
        console.warn('[Schools] publish failed', e);
        sbSetStatus('Could not publish: ' + (e.code || e.message || 'unknown error'), 'err');
    } finally {
        btn.disabled = false;
    }
};

window.sbOpenPost = async (postId) => {
    const p = _sbPosts.find(x => x.id === postId);
    if (!p) return;
    _sbOpenPost = p;
    document.getElementById('sb-detail-title').textContent = p.assignment;
    document.getElementById('sb-detail-meta').textContent =
        `${p.subject || 'No subject'} · ${SB_KIND_LABEL[p.kind] || ''} · ${sbAgo(p.createdAt)}`;
    const mine = p.authorUid === window.myUID;
    const staff = !!(window.isAdmin || window.isOwner || window.isModerator);
    document.getElementById('sb-detail-delete').classList.toggle('hidden', !(mine || staff));
    document.getElementById('sb-detail-update').classList.toggle('hidden', !(mine && p.kind === 'chat'));
    const body = document.getElementById('sb-detail-body');

    const sbFmt = (t) => {
        try { return (typeof mdSafe === 'function') ? mdSafe(String(t)) : sbEsc(t); }
        catch (_) { return sbEsc(t); }
    };
    if (p.kind === 'answer_key') {
        body.innerHTML = (p.answers || []).map(a =>
            `<div class="sb-detail-ans"><div class="n">${sbEsc(a.n)}</div><div class="v">${sbFmt(a.text)}</div></div>`).join('')
            || '<span style="color:#55556a;">No answers.</span>';
    } else if (p.kind === 'chat') {
        body.innerHTML = (p.snapshot || []).map(m =>
            `<div class="sb-msg ${m.role === 'user' ? 'me' : ''}"><span class="who">${m.role === 'user' ? 'Student' : 'EchoAI'}</span>${sbFmt(m.text)}</div>`).join('')
            || '<span style="color:#55556a;">Empty.</span>';
    } else {
        body.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#55556a;">Loading photos…</span>';
    }
    document.getElementById('sb-post-modal').classList.remove('hidden');

    if ((p.imageIds || []).length) {
        const html = [];
        for (const fid of p.imageIds) {
            try { html.push(`<img class="sb-detail-img" src="${await window.sbLoadImage(fid)}" alt="">`); }
            catch (_) { html.push('<div style="color:#55556a;font-size:12px;margin-bottom:8px;">A photo could not be loaded.</div>'); }
        }
        if (_sbOpenPost && _sbOpenPost.id === postId) {
            if (p.kind === 'images') body.innerHTML = html.join('');
            else body.innerHTML += '<div style="margin-top:12px;">' + html.join('') + '</div>';
        }
    } else if (p.kind === 'images') {
        body.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#55556a;">No photos.</span>';
    }
};

    if (!_sbOpenPost) return;

};


const SB_REDACT = '#####';

const SB_NEVER_REDACT = new Set([
    'echoai', 'echo', 'echospace', 'ai', 'assistant', 'student', 'user', 'none',
    'algebra', 'geometry', 'calculus', 'biology', 'chemistry', 'physics', 'english',
    'history', 'spanish', 'french', 'science', 'math', 'maths', 'god', 'jesus',
    'newton', 'einstein', 'pythagoras', 'euler', 'gauss', 'darwin', 'shakespeare'
]);

function sbEscapeRe(s) { return String(s).replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&'); }

function sbRedactToken(text, token) {
    const t = String(token || '').trim();
    if (t.length < 2 || t.length > 40) return text;
    if (SB_NEVER_REDACT.has(t.toLowerCase())) return text;
    const re = new RegExp('(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])' + sbEscapeRe(t) + '(?![A-Za-z0-9_])', 'gi');
    return text.replace(re, (m, pre) => pre + SB_REDACT);
}

window.sbScrubKnownNames = (text) => {
    let out = String(text == null ? '' : text);
    const known = [];
    if (window.myUsername) known.push(window.myUsername);
    try {
        const email = (auth && auth.currentUser && auth.currentUser.email) || '';
        if (email.includes('@')) known.push(email.split('@')[0]);
    } catch (_) {}
    known.sort((a, b) => b.length - a.length).forEach(n => { out = sbRedactToken(out, n); });
    return out;
};

const SB_NAME_PROMPT =
    'You find personal names in text so they can be removed before publishing. ' +
    'Reply with ONLY a comma-separated list of the personal names, usernames, ' +
    'handles or nicknames that appear, copied EXACTLY as they are written. ' +
    'Include names used in greetings. Do NOT include subject names, school ' +
    'subjects, famous scientists or mathematicians attached to a formula or law, ' +
    'product names, or the words EchoAI or EchoSpace. ' +
    'If there are none, reply with exactly: NONE. ' +
    'Never explain, never add anything else.';

window.sbDetectNames = async (text) => {
    const sample = String(text || '').slice(0, 6000);
    if (!sample.trim()) return [];
    try {
        const out = await window._liveAsk({
            systemInstruction: SB_NAME_PROMPT,
            text: sample,
            timeoutMs: 25000
        });
        const said = String(out || '').trim();
        if (!said || /^none\b/i.test(said)) return [];
        return said.split(/[,\n]/)
            .map(s => s.replace(/^[\s"'*\-•]+|[\s"'*.]+$/g, '').trim())
            .filter(s => s.length >= 2 && s.length <= 40)
            .filter(s => !SB_NEVER_REDACT.has(s.toLowerCase()))
            .filter(s => s.replace(/#/g, '').trim().length > 0)
            .filter(s => new RegExp('(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])' + sbEscapeRe(s) + '(?![A-Za-z0-9_])', 'i').test(sample))
            .slice(0, 25);
    } catch (e) {
        console.warn('[Schools] name check unavailable, keeping the known-name scrub only:', e && e.message);
        return [];
    }
};

window.sbScrubAll = async (strings) => {
    const known = strings.map(s => window.sbScrubKnownNames(s));
    const ownNameHit = known.some((t, i) => t !== strings[i]);
    const names = await window.sbDetectNames(known.join('\n'));
    const texts = names.length
        ? known.map(s => names.reduce((acc, n) => sbRedactToken(acc, n), s))
        : known;
    return { texts, found: names, count: names.length + (ownNameHit ? 1 : 0) };
};

        window.sbPickKind('chat', document.querySelector('.sb-kind[data-kind="chat"]'));
        const sel = document.getElementById('sb-pub-chatpick');
        if (sel) { sel.value = chat.id; sbPreviewChat(); }
        const a = document.getElementById('sb-pub-assignment');
        if (a && !a.value) a.value = (chat.title || '').slice(0, 120);
    }, 120);
};


let _sbSyncTimer = null;
let _sbSyncDirty = new Set();

function _sbChatForSync(c) {
    return {
        id: c.id,
        title: String(c.title || 'Untitled chat').slice(0, 200),
        updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
        messages: (c.messages || [])
            .filter(m => m && m.role !== 'system' && typeof m.content === 'string')
            .slice(-300)
            .map(m => ({ role: m.role === 'user' ? 'user' : 'assistant', content: String(m.content).slice(0, 8000) }))
    };
}

async function _sbFlushChatSync() {
    if (!window.myUID || !_sbSyncDirty.size) return;
    const ids = Array.from(_sbSyncDirty); _sbSyncDirty.clear();
    clearTimeout(_sbSyncTimer);
    for (const id of ids) {
        const c = (echoaiChats || []).find(x => x.id === id);
        if (!c || _sbTombs().includes(String(id))) continue;
        try {
            await setDoc(doc(db, 'echoai_chats', window.myUID, 'chats', String(id)), _sbChatForSync(c));
        } catch (e) { console.warn('[EchoAI sync] write failed', e && e.code); }
    }
}

window._sbQueueChatSync = (chatId) => {
    if (!window.myUID || !chatId) return;
    _sbSyncDirty.add(chatId);
    clearTimeout(_sbSyncTimer);
    _sbSyncTimer = setTimeout(_sbFlushChatSync, 4000);
};

document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => { if (document.visibilityState === 'hidden') _sbFlushChatSync(); });
window.addEventListener('pagehide', () => { _sbFlushChatSync(); });

const _sbTombKey = () => 'echoai_deleted::' + (window.myUID || 'anon');
function _sbTombs() {
    try { const a = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(_sbTombKey()) || '[]'); return Array.isArray(a) ? a : []; }
    catch (_) { return []; }
}
function _sbDeleteRemote(id) {
    if (!window.myUID) return;
    deleteDoc(doc(db, 'echoai_chats', window.myUID, 'chats', String(id)))
        .catch(e => console.warn('[EchoAI sync] delete failed', e && e.code));
}
window._sbForgetChat = (chatId) => {
    if (chatId == null) return;
    const id = String(chatId);
    _sbSyncDirty.delete(chatId); _sbSyncDirty.delete(id);
    const t = _sbTombs();
    if (!t.includes(id)) {
        t.push(id);
        try { localStorage.setItem(_sbTombKey(), JSON.stringify(t.slice(-500))); } catch (_) {}
    }
    _sbDeleteRemote(id);
};

window._sbRestoreChats = async () => {
    if (!window.myUID || typeof echoaiChats === 'undefined') return;
    try {
        const snap = await getDocs(query(collection(db, 'echoai_chats', window.myUID, 'chats'), limit(300)));
        let added = 0;
        const tombs = new Set(_sbTombs());
        snap.docs.forEach(d => {
            const remote = d.data();
            if (!remote || !Array.isArray(remote.messages)) return;
            if (tombs.has(String(remote.id || d.id)) || tombs.has(d.id)) { _sbDeleteRemote(d.id); return; }
            if (echoaiChats.some(c => String(c.id) === String(remote.id || d.id))) return;
            echoaiChats.push({
                id: remote.id || d.id,
                title: remote.title || 'Untitled chat',
                messages: remote.messages,
                _fromCloud: true
            });
            added++;
        });
        if (added) {
            try { localStorage.setItem(_echoaiKey(), JSON.stringify(echoaiChats)); } catch (_) {}
            if (typeof renderEchoSidebar === 'function') { try { renderEchoSidebar(); } catch (_) {} }
            console.log('[EchoAI sync] restored', added, 'chat(s) from Firestore');
        }
    } catch (e) { console.warn('[EchoAI sync] restore failed', e && e.code); }
};

window.apLoadSchoolReports = async () => {
    const box = document.getElementById('ap-schoolrep-list');
    const badge = document.getElementById('ap-schoolrep-badge');
    if (!box) return;
    box.innerHTML = '<div style="color:#444455;font-size:12px;padding:10px;">Loading…</div>';
    let rows = [];
    try {
        const schoolSnap = await getDocs(query(collection(db, 'schools'), limit(200)));
        const perSchool = await Promise.all(schoolSnap.docs.map(async (sd) => {
            try {
                const ps = await getDocs(query(
                    collection(db, 'schools', sd.id, 'posts'),
                    where('reportCount', '>', 0),
                    orderBy('reportCount', 'desc'),
                    limit(50)
                ));
                return ps.docs.map(d => ({ id: d.id, schoolKey: sd.id, schoolName: (sd.data() || {}).name || sd.id, ...d.data() }));
            } catch (_) { return []; }
        }));
        rows = perSchool.flat().sort((a, b) => (b.reportCount || 0) - (a.reportCount || 0));
    } catch (e) {
        console.warn('[Schools] report query failed', e);
        box.innerHTML = '<div style="color:#f87171;font-size:12px;padding:10px;">Could not load reports: ' + sbEsc(e.code || e.message) + '</div>';
        if (badge) badge.style.display = 'none';
        return;
    }
    if (badge) {
        badge.textContent = String(rows.length);
        badge.style.display = rows.length ? '' : 'none';
    }
    if (!rows.length) {
        box.innerHTML = '<div style="color:#444455;font-size:12px;padding:10px;">No reported posts.</div>';
        return;
    }
    box.innerHTML = rows.map(r => {
        const preview = r.kind === 'answer_key'
            ? (r.answers || []).slice(0, 4).map(a => `${sbEsc(a.n)}. ${sbEsc(a.text)}`).join('<br>')
            : r.kind === 'chat'
                ? (r.snapshot || []).slice(0, 3).map(m => `<b>${m.role === 'user' ? 'Student' : 'EchoAI'}:</b> ${sbEsc(String(m.text).slice(0, 180))}`).join('<br>')
                : `${(r.imageIds || []).length} photo(s)`;
        return `
        <div style="background:#0a0a15;border:1px solid #1e1e2e;border-radius:12px;padding:12px;margin-bottom:8px;">
            <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:6px;">
                <span style="color:#e8e8f0;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;">${sbEsc(r.assignment || '(no name)')}</span>
                <span class="ap-pill red" style="font-size:10px;">${r.reportCount || 0} report${(r.reportCount || 0) === 1 ? '' : 's'}</span>
                ${r.hidden ? '<span class="ap-pill yellow" style="font-size:10px;">hidden</span>' : ''}
            </div>
            <div style="color:#55556a;font-size:11px;margin-bottom:8px;">
                ${sbEsc(r.schoolKey)} &middot; ${sbEsc(r.subject || 'no subject')} &middot; ${sbEsc(SB_KIND_LABEL[r.kind] || r.kind)}
                &middot; uploader <code style="color:#6b6b85;">${sbEsc(r.authorUid || '?')}</code>
            </div>
            <div style="color:#8888a0;font-size:11.5px;line-height:1.55;background:#08080f;border-radius:8px;padding:8px;margin-bottom:8px;max-height:150px;overflow:auto;">${preview || '<i>empty</i>'}</div>
            <div style="display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;">
                <button class="ap-pill yellow" onclick="window.apHideSchoolPost('${sbEsc(r.schoolKey)}','${sbEsc(r.id)}',${r.hidden ? 'false' : 'true'})">${r.hidden ? 'Unhide' : 'Hide'}</button>
                <button class="ap-pill red" onclick="window.apDeleteSchoolPost('${sbEsc(r.schoolKey)}','${sbEsc(r.id)}')">Delete</button>
                <button class="ap-pill" onclick="window.apClearSchoolReports('${sbEsc(r.schoolKey)}','${sbEsc(r.id)}')">Clear reports</button>
            </div>
        </div>`;
    }).join('');
};

window.apHideSchoolPost = async (key, id, hide) => {
    try {
        await updateDoc(doc(db, 'schools', key, 'posts', id), { hidden: !!hide });
        window.apLoadSchoolReports();
    } catch (e) { alert('Failed: ' + (e.code || e.message)); }
};
window.apDeleteSchoolPost = async (key, id) => {
    if (!confirm('Delete this post permanently?')) return;
    try {
        await deleteDoc(doc(db, 'schools', key, 'posts', id));
        try {
            const ps = await getDocs(query(collection(db, 'schools', key, 'posts'), limit(200)));
            const live = ps.docs.filter(d => !(d.data() || {}).hidden).length;
            if (ps.docs.length < 200) await updateDoc(doc(db, 'schools', key), { postCount: live });
        } catch (_) {}
        window.apLoadSchoolReports();
    } catch (e) { alert('Failed: ' + (e.code || e.message)); }
};
window.apClearSchoolReports = async (key, id) => {
    try {
        await updateDoc(doc(db, 'schools', key, 'posts', id), { reportCount: 0 });
        window.apLoadSchoolReports();
    } catch (e) { alert('Failed: ' + (e.code || e.message)); }
};

window.showGifComingSoon = () => {
    const popup = document.getElementById('gif-coming-soon-popup');

        popup.style.bottom = (window.innerHeight - rect.top + 8) + 'px';
        popup.style.top = 'auto';

        popup.style.left = '50%';
        popup.style.transform = 'translateX(-50%)';
        popup.style.bottom = '80px';

const LIVE_CONFIG = { get iceServers() { return window.ECHO_ICE_SERVERS; }, iceCandidatePoolSize: 4 };

const _LV_UDP_CAND = /\sudp\s/i;
function _lvTcpOnlySdp(sdp) {
    return String(sdp || '').split(/\r?\n/).filter(l => !(l.startsWith('a=candidate:') && _LV_UDP_CAND.test(l))).join('\r\n');
}
function _lvArmTcpFilter(thisPc) {
    if (!thisPc || thisPc._lvTcpFilterArmed) return;
    thisPc._lvTcpFilterArmed = true;
    const orig = thisPc.addIceCandidate.bind(thisPc);
    thisPc.addIceCandidate = (c) => {
        const line = c && (c.candidate || (typeof c === 'string' ? c : ''));
        if (thisPc._tcpOnly && line && _LV_UDP_CAND.test(line)) return Promise.resolve();
        return orig(c);
    };
}

function startLiveFeed() {
    window._LIVE_DEBUG && console.log('[Live] startLiveFeed() called. rtdb:', !!window.rtdb, 'onValue:', !!window.onValue, 'ref:', !!window.ref, 'listenerAlive:', !!_liveStreamsUnsub);
    if (!window.rtdb || !window.onValue || !window.ref) {
        console.warn('[Live] startLiveFeed() aborted — RTDB not ready.');
        return;
    }
    if (_liveStreamsUnsub) {
        window._LIVE_DEBUG && console.log('[Live] Listener already active — re-rendering from cache. streams:', _liveAllStreams.length);
        renderLiveFeed(_liveAllStreams);
        updateLiveNavDot(_liveAllStreams.length > 0);
        const countEl = document.getElementById('live-online-count');
        if (countEl) countEl.innerText = _liveAllStreams.length + ' stream' + (_liveAllStreams.length !== 1 ? 's' : '') + ' active';
        return;
    }
    const streamsRef = window.ref(window.rtdb, 'live_streams');
    window._LIVE_DEBUG && console.log('[Live] Attaching onValue listener to live_streams for the first time...');
    _liveStreamsUnsub = window.onValue(streamsRef, (snap) => {
        const raw = snap.val();
        window._LIVE_DEBUG && console.log('[Live] onValue fired. raw keys:', raw ? Object.keys(raw) : 'null');
        _liveAllStreams = [];
        if (raw) {
            Object.entries(raw).forEach(([uid, data]) => {
                window._LIVE_DEBUG && console.log('[Live] stream entry uid:', uid, 'active:', data && data.active);
                if (data && data.active) _liveAllStreams.push({ uid, ...data });
            });
        }
        window._LIVE_DEBUG && console.log('[Live] active streams count:', _liveAllStreams.length);
        renderLiveFeed(_liveAllStreams);
        updateLiveNavDot(_liveAllStreams.length > 0);
        const countEl = document.getElementById('live-online-count');
        if (countEl) countEl.innerText = _liveAllStreams.length + ' stream' + (_liveAllStreams.length !== 1 ? 's' : '') + ' active';
    }, (err) => {
        console.error('[Live] onValue error on live_streams:', err.code, err.message);
        _liveStreamsUnsub = null;
    });
    window._LIVE_DEBUG && console.log('[Live] onValue listener attached. unsub type:', typeof _liveStreamsUnsub);
}

function updateLiveNavDot(hasLive) {
    const dot = document.getElementById('live-nav-dot');
    if (dot) dot.classList.toggle('hidden', !hasLive);
}

function _thumbAR(ar) {
    const n = Number(ar) || (16 / 9);
    return Math.min(16 / 9, Math.max(0.75, n));
}

function renderLiveFeed(streams) {
    window._LIVE_DEBUG && console.log('[Live] renderLiveFeed() called with', streams.length, 'streams');
    const grid = document.getElementById('live-stream-grid');
    const empty = document.getElementById('live-empty-state');
    if (!grid) { console.warn('[Live] #live-stream-grid not found in DOM'); return; }
    window._LIVE_DEBUG && console.log('[Live] grid element found. current hidden:', grid.classList.contains('hidden'), 'parent #live-feed-view display:', document.getElementById('live-feed-view')?.style.display, '#view-live active:', document.getElementById('view-live')?.classList.contains('active'));
    const searchVal = (document.getElementById('live-search-input')?.value || '').toLowerCase();
    let filtered = searchVal ? streams.filter(s => (s.username || '').toLowerCase().includes(searchVal)) : streams;
    if (!window._livePreviewsEnabled()) filtered = filtered.map(s => ({ ...s, thumb: null, thumbAR: null }));
    if (filtered.length === 0) {
        grid.innerHTML = '';
        grid._liveSig = null;
        grid.classList.add('hidden');
        if (empty) empty.classList.remove('hidden');
        return;
    }
    grid.classList.remove('hidden');
    if (empty) empty.classList.add('hidden');
    const sig = filtered.map(s => s.uid).join(',');
    if (grid._liveSig === sig) {
        filtered.forEach(s => {
            const card = grid.querySelector(`.live-stream-card[data-uid="${CSS.escape(s.uid)}"]`);
            if (!card) return;
            const img = card.querySelector('.live-thumb-img');
            const ph  = card.querySelector('.live-thumb-ph');
            if (s.thumb && img) {
                img.src = s.thumb; img.style.display = 'block';
                if (ph) ph.style.display = 'none';
                const wrap = card.querySelector('.live-stream-thumb');
                if (wrap && s.thumbAR) wrap.style.aspectRatio = String(_thumbAR(s.thumbAR));
            } else if (img) {
                img.removeAttribute('src'); img.style.display = 'none';
                if (ph) ph.style.display = 'flex';
                const wrap = card.querySelector('.live-stream-thumb');
                if (wrap) wrap.style.aspectRatio = String(16 / 9);
            }
            const vb = card.querySelector('.live-viewer-badge');
            if (vb) vb.innerText = `👁 ${s.viewers || 0}`;
            const lk = card.querySelector('.live-likes-num');
            if (lk) lk.innerText = `❤️ ${s.likes || 0} likes`;
        });
        return;
    }
    grid._liveSig = sig;

    grid.innerHTML = filtered.map(s => `
        <div class="live-stream-card" data-uid="${window.escAttr ? window.escAttr(s.uid) : s.uid}" data-username="${window.escAttr ? window.escAttr(s.username||'') : (s.username||'')}" data-pfp="${window.escAttr ? window.escAttr(s.pfp||'') : (s.pfp||'')}">
            <div class="live-stream-thumb" style="position:relative;width:100%;height:auto;aspect-ratio:${_thumbAR(s.thumbAR)};background:#080810;overflow:hidden;">
                <img class="live-thumb-img" src="${s.thumb || ''}" style="display:${s.thumb ? 'block' : 'none'};position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;" alt="">
                <div class="live-thumb-ph" style="font-size:40px;opacity:0.15;display:${s.thumb ? 'none' : 'flex'};align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:100%;">📡</div>
                <div class="live-badge">LIVE</div>
                <div class="live-viewer-badge">👁 ${s.viewers || 0}</div>
            </div>
            <div style="padding:12px;">
                <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;">
                    <div style="position:relative;flex-shrink:0;">
                        <img src="${s.pfp || window._DEFAULT_PFP}" class="w-10 h-10 rounded-full object-cover bg-[#1e1e2e]" style="border:2px solid #dc2626;" onerror="this.src=window._DEFAULT_PFP">
                    </div>
                    <div style="min-width:0;flex:1;">
                        <div style="font-weight:800;font-size:13px;color:#fff;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;">${window.escHtml ? window.escHtml(s.username||'Unknown') : (s.username||'Unknown')}</div>
                        <div class="live-likes-num" style="font-size:11px;color:#555566;">❤️ ${s.likes || 0} likes</div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    `).join('');

    if (!grid._liveClickBound) {
        grid.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            const card = e.target.closest('.live-stream-card');
            if (!card) return;
            window.watchStream(card.dataset.uid, card.dataset.username, card.dataset.pfp);
        });
        grid._liveClickBound = true;
    }
}

let _thumbReqTimer = null;
const THUMB_REQ_EVERY_MS = 10000;

function _requestThumbs() {
    if (!window._livePreviewsEnabled() || !window.rtdb || !window.myUID) return;
    if (document.hidden) return;
    const now = Date.now();
    _liveAllStreams.forEach(s => {
        if (!s.uid || s.uid === window.myUID) return;
        if (now - (s.thumbReq || 0) < THUMB_REQ_EVERY_MS) return;
        window.set(window.ref(window.rtdb, `live_streams/${s.uid}/thumbReq`), now).catch(() => {});
    });
}

const _MIRROR_KEY = 'echo_stream_mirror';

window._streamMirrorOn = function () {
    try { return localStorage.getItem(_MIRROR_KEY) !== '0'; } catch (_) { return true; }
};

function _applyStreamMirrorUI() {
    const on = window._streamMirrorOn();
    const lv = document.getElementById('live-local-video');
    if (lv) lv.style.transform = on ? 'scaleX(-1)' : 'none';
    const btn = document.getElementById('my-mirror-btn');
    if (btn) {
        btn.innerText = on ? 'Mirror: On' : 'Mirror: Off';
        btn.style.color = on ? '#c9c9d6' : '#6b6b7d';
        btn.style.background = on ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)' : 'transparent';
    }
}
window._applyStreamMirrorUI = _applyStreamMirrorUI;

window.toggleStreamMirror = async function () {
    const next = !window._streamMirrorOn();
    try { localStorage.setItem(_MIRROR_KEY, next ? '1' : '0'); } catch (_) {}
    _applyStreamMirrorUI();
    if (window.myUID && window.rtdb && window.update && window.ref) {
        try {
            await window.update(window.ref(window.rtdb, `live_streams/${window.myUID}`), { mirror: next });
        } catch (e) {
            console.warn('[Live] mirror toggle failed to publish:', e && e.message);
        }
    }
};

window._liveStartThumbRequests = () => {
