    _requestThumbs();
    _thumbReqTimer = setInterval(_requestThumbs, THUMB_REQ_EVERY_MS);
};
window._liveStopThumbRequests = () => {
    if (_thumbReqTimer) { clearInterval(_thumbReqTimer); _thumbReqTimer = null; }
};

window.watchStream = async (uid, username, pfp) => {
    if (!window.myUID) return;
    if (_currentWatchingUid) await _liveViewerTeardown();
    _currentWatchingUid = uid;
    try {
        await window.runTransaction(window.ref(window.rtdb, `live_streams/${uid}/viewers`), (cur) => (cur || 0) + 1);
    } catch(e) { console.warn('[Live] viewer increment failed:', e.message); }

    document.getElementById('live-feed-view').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('live-stream-view').classList.remove('hidden');
    const _ph = document.getElementById('live-stream-placeholder');
    if (_ph) { _ph.style.display = 'flex'; _ph.innerHTML = `<div class="text-5xl">📡</div><div class="text-sm text-[#555566] font-bold">Connecting to stream...</div>`; }

    document.getElementById('live-stream-pfp').src = pfp || window._DEFAULT_PFP;
    document.getElementById('live-stream-username').innerText = username;

    const commentsRef = window.ref(window.rtdb, `live_comments/${uid}`);
    if (_liveCommentsUnsub) { try { _liveCommentsUnsub(); } catch(e){} }
    _liveCommentsUnsub = window.onValue(commentsRef, (snap) => {
        const box = document.getElementById('live-comments-box');
        if (!box || !snap.val()) return;
        box.innerHTML = '';
        Object.values(snap.val()).slice(-50).forEach(c => {
            const el = document.createElement('div');
            el.className = 'live-comment';
            el.innerHTML = `<span class="live-comment-name">${window.escHtml ? window.escHtml(c.username||'?') : c.username}</span><span class="live-comment-text">${window.escHtml ? window.escHtml(c.text||'') : c.text}</span>`;
            box.appendChild(el);
        });
        box.scrollTop = box.scrollHeight;
    });

    const streamDataRef = window.ref(window.rtdb, `live_streams/${uid}`);
    if (_liveStreamDataUnsub) { try { _liveStreamDataUnsub(); } catch(e){} }
    _liveStreamDataUnsub = window.onValue(streamDataRef, (snap) => {
        if (_currentWatchingUid !== uid) return;
        if (!snap.val()) {
            clearTimeout(_liveViewTimer);
            if (_liveViewPc) { try { _liveViewPc.close(); } catch(e){} _liveViewPc = null; }
            const video = document.getElementById('live-remote-video');
            if (video) { try { video.pause(); } catch(e){} video.srcObject = null; }
            const ph = document.getElementById('live-stream-placeholder');
            if (ph) {
                ph.style.display = 'flex';
                ph.innerHTML = `
                    <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:14px;background:rgba(13,13,24,0.558);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);border-radius:20px;padding:36px 40px;box-shadow:0 12px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);">
                        <div style="width:64px;height:64px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(239,68,68,0.1);border:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,0.25);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:26px;">📴</div>
                        <div style="text-align:center;">
                            <div style="font-size:15px;font-weight:900;color:#e8e8f0;margin-bottom:4px;">Stream has ended</div>
                            <div style="font-size:12px;color:#555566;">${window.escHtml ? window.escHtml(document.getElementById('live-stream-username')?.innerText||'This streamer') : 'This streamer'} isn't live anymore.</div>
                        </div>
                        <button onclick="closeLiveStream()" class="btn-primary text-sm px-5 py-2.5" style="font-weight:700;">← Back to browse</button>
                    </div>`;
            }
            return;
        }
        const d = snap.val();
        const vEl = document.getElementById('live-viewer-count');
        if (vEl) vEl.innerText = (d.viewers || 0) + ' viewer' + (d.viewers !== 1 ? 's' : '');
        const lEl = document.getElementById('live-likes-num');
        if (lEl) lEl.innerText = d.likes || 0;
        const rv = document.getElementById('live-remote-video');
        if (rv) rv.style.transform = (d.mirror === false) ? 'none' : 'scaleX(-1)';
    });

    try { await _initViewerConnection(uid); } catch(e) { console.warn('[Live] WebRTC view failed:', e); }
};

async function _liveViewerTeardown() {
    _lqStopWatchMonitor();
    clearTimeout(_liveViewTimer);
    _liveViewerUnsubs.forEach(u => { try { u(); } catch(e){} });
    _liveViewerUnsubs = [];
    if (_liveStreamDataUnsub) { try { _liveStreamDataUnsub(); } catch(e){} _liveStreamDataUnsub = null; }
    if (_liveCommentsUnsub) { try { _liveCommentsUnsub(); } catch(e){} _liveCommentsUnsub = null; }
    if (_liveViewPc) { try { _liveViewPc.close(); } catch(e){} _liveViewPc = null; }
    const uid = _currentWatchingUid;
    _currentWatchingUid = null;
    if (!uid) return;
    if (window.myUID) {
        const base = `live_signaling/${uid}`;
        [`${base}/quality_req/${window.myUID}`,
         `${base}/viewer_join/${window.myUID}`,
         `${base}/answers/${window.myUID}`,
         `${base}/viewer_candidates/${window.myUID}`,
         `${base}/offers/${window.myUID}`,
         `${base}/streamer_candidates/${window.myUID}`
        ].forEach(p => window.remove(window.ref(window.rtdb, p)).catch(() => {}));
    }
    try {
        await window.runTransaction(window.ref(window.rtdb, `live_streams/${uid}/viewers`), (cur) => Math.max(0, (cur || 1) - 1));
    } catch(e) {}
}

window.closeLiveStream = async () => {
    document.getElementById('live-stream-view').classList.add('hidden');
    document.getElementById('live-feed-view').style.display = '';
    const video = document.getElementById('live-remote-video');
    if (video) { video.srcObject = null; }
    await _liveViewerTeardown();
};

const LIVE_QUALITY = {
    1080: { label: '1080p', sub: 'HD · 4 Mbps',  w: 1920, h: 1080, fps: 30, bitrate: 4000000 },
    720:  { label: '720p',  sub: '2.5 Mbps',     w: 1280, h: 720,  fps: 30, bitrate: 2500000 },
    480:  { label: '480p',  sub: '1 Mbps',       w: 854,  h: 480,  fps: 30, bitrate: 1000000 },
    360:  { label: '360p',  sub: '500 Kbps',     w: 640,  h: 360,  fps: 24, bitrate: 500000  },
    240:  { label: '240p',  sub: 'Low · 250 Kbps', w: 426, h: 240, fps: 15, bitrate: 250000  },
};
const LQ_LADDER = [240, 360, 480, 720, 1080];
const LQ_DEFAULT = 720;

function _lqNearestRung(h) {
    if (!h) return null;
    return LQ_LADDER.reduce((best, q) =>
        Math.abs(LIVE_QUALITY[q].h - h) < Math.abs(LIVE_QUALITY[best].h - h) ? q : best, LQ_LADDER[0]);
}

function _lqStep(q, dir) {
    const i = LQ_LADDER.indexOf(q);
    if (i < 0) return LQ_DEFAULT;
    return LQ_LADDER[Math.min(LQ_LADDER.length - 1, Math.max(0, i + dir))];
}

function _lqMount(hostId, opts) {
    const host = document.getElementById(hostId);
    if (!host) return null;
    const state = { pinned: opts.pinned ?? null, effective: opts.effective ?? LQ_DEFAULT, onPick: opts.onPick };
    host.innerHTML = `
        <button type="button" class="lq-dd-btn"><span class="lq-dd-label"></span><span class="lq-caret">▼</span></button>
        <div class="lq-dd-menu"></div>`;
    const btn = host.querySelector('.lq-dd-btn');
    const menu = host.querySelector('.lq-dd-menu');

    const paint = () => {
        const auto = state.pinned === null;
        const effLabel = LIVE_QUALITY[state.effective]?.label || '—';
        host.querySelector('.lq-dd-label').textContent =
            auto ? `Auto · ${effLabel}`
                 : (state.pinned === state.effective
                        ? (LIVE_QUALITY[state.pinned]?.label || '—')
                        : `${LIVE_QUALITY[state.pinned]?.label || '—'} · now ${effLabel}`);
        btn.classList.toggle('lq-auto-active', auto);
        menu.innerHTML = [
            `<div class="lq-dd-opt ${auto ? 'sel' : ''}" data-q="auto">
                <span>Auto <span class="lq-badge">SMART</span></span><span class="lq-sub">Adapts to connection</span>
             </div>`,
            ...LQ_LADDER.slice().reverse().map(q =>
                `<div class="lq-dd-opt ${state.pinned === q ? 'sel' : ''}" data-q="${q}">
                    <span>${LIVE_QUALITY[q].label}</span><span class="lq-sub">${LIVE_QUALITY[q].sub}</span>
                 </div>`)
        ].join('');
    };

    btn.onclick = (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); document.querySelectorAll('.lq-dd.open').forEach(d => { if (d !== host) d.classList.remove('open'); }); host.classList.toggle('open'); };
    menu.onclick = (e) => {
        const opt = e.target.closest('.lq-dd-opt'); if (!opt) return;
        e.stopPropagation();
        state.pinned = opt.dataset.q === 'auto' ? null : parseInt(opt.dataset.q, 10);
        if (state.pinned !== null) state.effective = state.pinned;
        host.classList.remove('open');
        paint();
        state.onPick?.(state.pinned);
    };
    paint();
    return {
        get pinned() { return state.pinned; },
        get effective() { return state.effective; },
        setEffective(q) { if (state.effective !== q) { state.effective = q; paint(); } },
        setPinned(q) { state.pinned = q; if (q !== null) state.effective = q; paint(); }
    };
}
document.addEventListener('click', () => document.querySelectorAll('.lq-dd.open').forEach(d => d.classList.remove('open')));

let _lqCaptureH = 720;
async function _lqApplySender(pc, q) {
    if (!pc) return;
    const sender = pc.getSenders?.().find(s => s.track && s.track.kind === 'video');
    const cfg = LIVE_QUALITY[q];
    if (!sender || !cfg) return;
    try {
        const params = sender.getParameters();
        if (!params.encodings || !params.encodings.length) params.encodings = [{}];
        params.encodings[0].scaleResolutionDownBy = Math.max(1, _lqCaptureH / cfg.h);
        params.encodings[0].maxBitrate = cfg.bitrate;
        params.encodings[0].maxFramerate = cfg.fps;
        params.degradationPreference = 'balanced';
        await sender.setParameters(params);
    } catch(e) { console.warn('[LiveQ] setParameters failed:', e.message); }
}

let _lqStreamDD = null, _lqGoLiveDD = null, _lqWatchDD = null;
let _lqViewerQ = {};
let _lqViewerActual = {};
let _lqViewerPinned = {};
let _lqStreamMon = null;
let _lqStreamBase = LQ_DEFAULT;

function _lqEffectiveFor(viewerUid) {
    const pinned = _lqViewerPinned[viewerUid];
    const want = pinned != null ? pinned : (_lqViewerQ[viewerUid] || _lqStreamBase);
    return Math.min(want, _lqStreamBase);
}

window._lqApplyForViewer = async (viewerUid) => {
    const pc = _peerConnections[viewerUid];
    if (!pc) return;
    const q = _lqEffectiveFor(viewerUid);
    _lqViewerQ[viewerUid] = q;
    await _lqApplySender(pc, q);
};

function _lqStartStreamerMonitor() {
    _lqStopStreamerMonitor();
    const good = {};
    _lqStreamMon = setInterval(async () => {
        for (const [viewerUid, pc] of Object.entries(_peerConnections)) {
            if (_lqViewerPinned[viewerUid] != null) continue;
            let limited = null, outH = 0;
            try {
                const stats = await pc.getStats();
                stats.forEach(r => {
                    if (r.type === 'outbound-rtp' && r.kind === 'video') {
                        limited = r.qualityLimitationReason;
                        outH = r.frameHeight || 0;
                    }
                });
            } catch(e) { continue; }
            if (outH) _lqViewerActual[viewerUid] = _lqNearestRung(outH);
            const cur = _lqViewerQ[viewerUid] || _lqStreamBase;
            if (limited === 'bandwidth' || limited === 'cpu') {
                good[viewerUid] = 0;
                const next = _lqStep(cur, -1);
                if (next !== cur) {
                    _lqViewerQ[viewerUid] = next;
                    await _lqApplySender(pc, next);
                    console.log(`[LiveQ] ${viewerUid} limited by ${limited} → ${next}p`);
                }
            } else {
                good[viewerUid] = (good[viewerUid] || 0) + 1;
                if (good[viewerUid] >= 6 && cur < _lqStreamBase) {
                    good[viewerUid] = 0;
                    const next = _lqStep(cur, +1);
                    _lqViewerQ[viewerUid] = next;
                    await _lqApplySender(pc, next);
                    console.log(`[LiveQ] ${viewerUid} recovered → ${next}p`);
                }
            }
        }
        if (_lqStreamDD) {
            const vals = Object.values(_lqViewerActual).filter(Boolean);
            _lqStreamDD.setEffective(vals.length ? Math.min(...vals) : _lqStreamBase);
        }
    }, 5000);
}
function _lqStopStreamerMonitor() { if (_lqStreamMon) { clearInterval(_lqStreamMon); _lqStreamMon = null; } }

window._lqSetStreamQuality = async (pinned) => {
    _lqStreamBase = pinned ?? LQ_DEFAULT;
    const cfg = LIVE_QUALITY[_lqStreamBase];
    const track = _myLocalStream?.getVideoTracks?.()[0];
    if (track && cfg) {
        try {
            await track.applyConstraints({
                width:  { ideal: cfg.w,  max: cfg.w },
                height: { ideal: cfg.h,  max: cfg.h },
                frameRate: { ideal: cfg.fps, max: cfg.fps }
            });
            _lqCaptureH = track.getSettings().height || cfg.h;
        } catch(e) { console.warn('[LiveQ] applyConstraints failed:', e.message); }
    }
    for (const viewerUid of Object.keys(_peerConnections)) await window._lqApplyForViewer(viewerUid);
};

window._lqCancelGoLive = () => document.getElementById('go-live-prompt')?.classList.add('hidden');
window._lqConfirmGoLive = async () => {
    document.getElementById('go-live-prompt')?.classList.add('hidden');
    _lqStreamBase = _lqGoLiveDD?.pinned ?? LQ_DEFAULT;
    _lqStreamDD?.setPinned(_lqGoLiveDD?.pinned ?? null);
    await _startMyStream();
};

let _lqWatchMon = null, _lqWatchUid = null;
window._lqRequestWatchQuality = (pinned) => {
    if (!_lqWatchUid || !window.myUID || !window.rtdb) return;
    window.set(
        window.ref(window.rtdb, `live_signaling/${_lqWatchUid}/quality_req/${window.myUID}`),
        pinned == null ? 'auto' : pinned
    ).catch(() => {});
};

function _lqStartWatchMonitor(pc) {
    _lqStopWatchMonitor();
    let lastLost = 0, lastRecv = 0, bad = 0, good = 0;
    _lqWatchMon = setInterval(async () => {
        let lost = 0, recv = 0, frameH = 0;
        try {
            const stats = await pc.getStats();
            stats.forEach(r => {
                if (r.type === 'inbound-rtp' && r.kind === 'video') {
                    lost = r.packetsLost || 0; recv = r.packetsReceived || 0;
                    frameH = r.frameHeight || 0;
                }
            });
        } catch(e) { return; }
        const rung = _lqNearestRung(frameH);
        if (rung) _lqWatchDD?.setEffective(rung);
        if (_lqWatchDD?.pinned != null) return;
        const dLost = Math.max(0, lost - lastLost), dRecv = Math.max(0, recv - lastRecv);
        lastLost = lost; lastRecv = recv;
        if (dRecv < 20) return;
        const ratio = dLost / (dLost + dRecv);
        const cur = _lqWatchDD?.effective || LQ_DEFAULT;
        if (ratio > 0.03) {
            good = 0;
            if (++bad >= 2) {
                bad = 0;
                const next = _lqStep(cur, -1);
                if (next !== cur) { _lqWatchDD?.setEffective(next); window._lqRequestWatchQuality(next); console.log(`[LiveQ] loss ${(ratio*100).toFixed(1)}% → asking ${next}p`); }
            }
        } else if (ratio < 0.005) {
            bad = 0;
            if (++good >= 6) { good = 0; const next = _lqStep(cur, +1); if (next !== cur) { _lqWatchDD?.setEffective(next); window._lqRequestWatchQuality(next); } }
        }
    }, 5000);
}
function _lqStopWatchMonitor() { if (_lqWatchMon) { clearInterval(_lqWatchMon); _lqWatchMon = null; } _lqWatchUid = null; }

window.toggleMyStream = async () => {
    if (!_myStreamActive && !(isAdmin || window._hasPerm?.('canGoLive'))) {
        alert('Your role does not have permission to go live.');
        return;
    }
    if (_myStreamActive) {
        await _endMyStream();
    } else {
        const prompt = document.getElementById('go-live-prompt');
        if (prompt) {
            if (!_lqGoLiveDD) _lqGoLiveDD = _lqMount('go-live-quality-dd', { pinned: null, effective: LQ_DEFAULT });
            prompt.classList.remove('hidden');
        } else {
            await _startMyStream();
        }
    }
};

async function _startMyStream() {
    if (!window.myUID) return;
    const _qc = LIVE_QUALITY[_lqStreamBase] || LIVE_QUALITY[LQ_DEFAULT];
    try {
        _myLocalStream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
            video: {
                width:     { ideal: _qc.w,   max: _qc.w   },
                height:    { ideal: _qc.h,   max: _qc.h   },
                frameRate: { ideal: _qc.fps, max: _qc.fps }
            },
            audio: true
        });
    } catch(e) {
        try { _myLocalStream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ video: true, audio: true }); }
        catch(e2) { alert('Camera/microphone permission required to go live.'); return; }
    }
    _lqCaptureH = _myLocalStream.getVideoTracks()[0]?.getSettings?.().height || _qc.h;
    window._myLocalStream = _myLocalStream;
    _myStreamActive = true;

    const btn = document.getElementById('go-live-btn');
    if (btn) {
        btn.style.background = 'linear-gradient(135deg,#7f1d1d,#dc2626)';
        document.getElementById('go-live-label').innerText = 'End Stream';
        document.getElementById('go-live-dot').style.animation = 'pulseRed 1s infinite';
    }
    if (!_lqStreamDD) {
        _lqStreamDD = _lqMount('live-quality-dd', {
            pinned: _lqGoLiveDD?.pinned ?? null,
            effective: _lqStreamBase,
            onPick: (pinned) => window._lqSetStreamQuality(pinned ?? LQ_DEFAULT)
        });
    }
    _lqStartStreamerMonitor();

    document.getElementById('my-live-stream-view').classList.remove('hidden');
    const localVideo = document.getElementById('live-local-video');
    if (localVideo) localVideo.srcObject = _myLocalStream;
    _applyStreamMirrorUI();

    const streamData = {
        active: true, uid: window.myUID, username: window.myUsername,
        pfp: window.myPfp || '', viewers: 0, likes: 0, startedAt: Date.now(),
        mirror: window._streamMirrorOn()
    };
    try {
        await window.set(window.ref(window.rtdb, `live_streams/${window.myUID}`), streamData);
        window._LIVE_DEBUG && console.log('[Live] Stream published to RTDB');
    } catch(e) {
        console.error('[Live] Failed to publish stream — check RTDB rules:', e.message);
        alert('Could not start stream: ' + e.message + '\n\nMake sure your Firebase RTDB rules allow writes to /live_streams.');
        _myStreamActive = false;
        if (_myLocalStream) { _myLocalStream.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop()); _myLocalStream = null; }
        document.getElementById('my-live-stream-view').classList.add('hidden');
        if (btn) { btn.style.background = 'linear-gradient(135deg,#dc2626,#ef4444)'; document.getElementById('go-live-label').innerText = 'Go Live'; document.getElementById('go-live-dot').style.animation = 'none'; }
        return;
    }

    const commentsRef = window.ref(window.rtdb, `live_comments/${window.myUID}`);
    if (_myLiveCommentsUnsub) { try { _myLiveCommentsUnsub(); } catch(e){} }
    _myLiveCommentsUnsub = window.onValue(commentsRef, (snap) => {
        const box = document.getElementById('my-live-comments-box');
        if (!box) return;
        const val = snap.val();
        if (!val) { box.innerHTML = ''; return; }
        box.innerHTML = '';
        Object.values(val).slice(-50).forEach(c => {
            const el = document.createElement('div');
            el.className = 'live-comment';
            el.innerHTML = `<span class="live-comment-name">${window.escHtml ? window.escHtml(c.username||'?') : c.username}</span><span class="live-comment-text"> ${window.escHtml ? window.escHtml(c.text||'') : c.text}</span>`;
            box.appendChild(el);
        });
        box.scrollTop = box.scrollHeight;
    });

    if (_myStreamDataUnsub) { try { _myStreamDataUnsub(); } catch(e){} }
    _myStreamDataUnsub = window.onValue(window.ref(window.rtdb, `live_streams/${window.myUID}`), (snap) => {
        if (!snap.val()) return;
        const d = snap.val();
        const vEl = document.getElementById('my-viewer-count');
        if (vEl) vEl.innerText = (d.viewers || 0) + ' viewer' + (d.viewers !== 1 ? 's' : '');
        const lEl = document.getElementById('my-likes-num');
        if (lEl) lEl.innerText = d.likes || 0;
    });

    _liveSTTStart();

    try { await _initStreamerConnection(); } catch(e) { console.warn('[Live] WebRTC offer failed (non-fatal):', e.message); }

    _startThumbPublish();
}

let _thumbReqUnsub = null;
let _thumbLastPush = 0;
const THUMB_MIN_GAP_MS = 5000;

function _startThumbPublish() {
    _stopThumbPublish();
    const vid = document.getElementById('live-local-video');
    if (!vid) return;
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    const push = () => {
        if (!_myStreamActive || !window.myUID) return _stopThumbPublish();
        if (!window._livePublishEnabled()) return;
        if (Date.now() - _thumbLastPush < THUMB_MIN_GAP_MS) return;
        if (!vid.videoWidth) return;
        _thumbLastPush = Date.now();
        try {
            const ar = vid.videoWidth / vid.videoHeight;
            const LONG = 480;
            const w = ar >= 1 ? LONG : Math.round(LONG * ar);
            const h = ar >= 1 ? Math.round(LONG / ar) : LONG;
            if (canvas.width !== w || canvas.height !== h) { canvas.width = w; canvas.height = h; }
            ctx.drawImage(vid, 0, 0, w, h);
            const data = canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.72);
            if (data.length < 160000) {
                window.update(window.ref(window.rtdb, `live_streams/${window.myUID}`), {
                    thumb: data,
                    thumbAR: Math.round(ar * 1000) / 1000
                }).catch(() => {});
            }
        } catch(e) {   }
    };

    setTimeout(push, 1200);

    _thumbReqUnsub = window.onValue(
        window.ref(window.rtdb, `live_streams/${window.myUID}/thumbReq`),
        (snap) => { if (snap.val()) push(); }
    );
}
function _stopThumbPublish() {
    if (_thumbReqUnsub) { try { _thumbReqUnsub(); } catch(e){} _thumbReqUnsub = null; }
}
window._liveClearMyThumb = () => {
    if (!window.myUID || !window.rtdb) return;
    window.remove(window.ref(window.rtdb, `live_streams/${window.myUID}/thumb`)).catch(() => {});
};

async function _endMyStream() {
    _myStreamActive = false;
    _liveSTTStop();
    _stopThumbPublish();
    _lqStopStreamerMonitor();
    _lqViewerQ = {}; _lqViewerPinned = {}; _lqViewerActual = {};
    if (_myLocalStream) { _myLocalStream.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop()); _myLocalStream = null; }
    if (_myLiveCommentsUnsub) { try { _myLiveCommentsUnsub(); } catch(e){} _myLiveCommentsUnsub = null; }
    if (_myStreamDataUnsub) { try { _myStreamDataUnsub(); } catch(e){} _myStreamDataUnsub = null; }
    _liveStreamerTeardownListeners();
    try { await window.remove(window.ref(window.rtdb, `live_streams/${window.myUID}`)); } catch(e) {}
    try { await window.remove(window.ref(window.rtdb, `live_comments/${window.myUID}`)); } catch(e) {}
    try { await window.remove(window.ref(window.rtdb, `live_signaling/${window.myUID}`)); } catch(e) {}
    Object.values(_peerConnections).forEach(pc => { try { pc.close(); } catch(e){} });
    _peerConnections = {};
    const btn = document.getElementById('go-live-btn');
    if (btn) {
        btn.style.background = 'linear-gradient(135deg,#dc2626,#ef4444)';
        document.getElementById('go-live-label').innerText = 'Go Live';
        document.getElementById('go-live-dot').style.animation = 'none';
    }
    document.getElementById('my-live-stream-view').classList.add('hidden');
    const localVideo = document.getElementById('live-local-video');
    if (localVideo) localVideo.srcObject = null;
}


let _liveSTTRecognition  = null;
let _liveSTTActive       = false;
let _liveSTTCooldown     = false;
let _liveSTTStrikes      = 0;
let _liveSTTRestarting   = false;
window._LIVE_DEBUG = window._LIVE_DEBUG || false;

let _liveSTTBackoff      = 0;
let _liveSTTErrorPending = false;

let _liveSTTFallbackOn  = false;

let _liveSTTSession = null;

function _liveSTTScan(transcript) {
    if (!transcript) return;
    const lower = transcript.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!lower) return;
    console.log('[LiveSTT] heard:', lower);
    const hit = ALL_LIVE_BLOCKED.find(w => lower.includes(w.toLowerCase()));
    if (hit && !_liveSTTCooldown) {
        _liveSTTCooldown = true;
        setTimeout(() => { _liveSTTCooldown = false; }, 8000);
        _liveSTTHandleViolation(hit, lower);
    }
}

async function _liveSTTStartFallback() {
    if (_liveSTTFallbackOn) return;
    const tracks = window._myLocalStream ? window._myLocalStream.getAudioTracks() : [];
    if (!tracks.length) { setTimeout(() => { if (_liveSTTActive) _liveSTTStartFallback(); }, 500); return; }
    if (!window.GeminiLiveSession || !window.GEMINI_API_KEY) {
        _liveSTTShowWarning('Speech moderation unavailable in this browser.');
        return;
    }
    _liveSTTFallbackOn = true;
    _liveSTTHideWarning();

    try {
        _liveSTTSession = new window.GeminiLiveSession({
            systemInstruction: 'You are a silent transcription service. Never reply.',
            responseModalities: ['TEXT'],
            playAudio: false,
            micStream: new MediaStream([tracks[0]]),
            onInputTranscript: (text, isFinal) => {
                if (!isFinal) return;
                _liveSTTScan(text);
            },
            onError: (err) => console.warn('[LiveSTT] live session error:', err.message),
            onClose: () => {
                _liveSTTSession = null;
                if (_liveSTTActive && _liveSTTFallbackOn) {
                    _liveSTTFallbackOn = false;
                    setTimeout(() => { if (_liveSTTActive) _liveSTTStartFallback(); }, 2000);
                }
            }
        });
        await _liveSTTSession.connect();
        window._LIVE_DEBUG && console.log('[LiveSTT] live-model transcription active');
    } catch(e) {
        console.warn('[LiveSTT] live session failed:', e.message);
        _liveSTTFallbackOn = false;
        _liveSTTSession = null;
        _liveSTTShowWarning('Speech moderation unavailable right now.');
    }
}

function _liveSTTStopFallback() {
    _liveSTTFallbackOn = false;
    if (_liveSTTSession) {
        try { _liveSTTSession.close(); } catch(e) {}
        _liveSTTSession = null;
    }
}

function _liveSTTShowWarning(msg) {
    const warn = document.getElementById('live-stt-warning');
    const warnMsg = document.getElementById('live-stt-warning-msg');
    if (warn && warnMsg) {
        warnMsg.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-triangle-exclamation"></i> ' + msg;
        warn.style.display = 'block';
    }
}
function _liveSTTHideWarning() {
    const warn = document.getElementById('live-stt-warning');
    if (warn) warn.style.display = 'none';
}
const _LIVE_STT_MAX_STRIKES = 3;

const LIVE_EXTRA_BLOCKED = [
    'nigger','nigga','faggot','fag',
    'i want to kill','i will shoot','going to shoot','shoot everyone',
    'i will bomb','gonna bomb','blow up',
    'i will find you','i know where you live','your address',
    'kill myself','end my life','end it all',
    'porn','nude','nudes','sex',
];
const ALL_LIVE_BLOCKED = [
    ...(typeof GLOBAL_BLOCKED_WORDS !== 'undefined' ? GLOBAL_BLOCKED_WORDS : []),
    ...LIVE_EXTRA_BLOCKED
];

let _liveSTTAudioCtx = null;
let _liveSTTSourceNode = null;

function _liveSTTCreateAndStart() {
    const SpeechRecognition = window.SpeechRecognition || window.webkitSpeechRecognition;
    if (!SpeechRecognition || !_liveSTTActive) return;

    if (_liveSTTRecognition) {
        try { _liveSTTRecognition.abort(); } catch(e) {}
        _liveSTTRecognition = null;
    }
    _liveSTTRestarting = false;

    const audioTracks = window._myLocalStream ? window._myLocalStream.getAudioTracks() : [];
    if (audioTracks.length === 0) {
        console.warn('[LiveSTT] no audio track on _myLocalStream yet, retrying in 500ms');
        setTimeout(() => { if (_liveSTTActive) _liveSTTCreateAndStart(); }, 500);
        return;
    }

    if (_liveSTTAudioCtx) { try { _liveSTTAudioCtx.close(); } catch(e) {} _liveSTTAudioCtx = null; }
    _liveSTTSourceNode = null;

    const rec = new SpeechRecognition();
    rec.continuous     = true;
    rec.interimResults = true;
    rec.maxAlternatives = 1;
    rec.lang           = 'en-US';
    _liveSTTRecognition = rec;

    rec.onresult = (event) => {
        _liveSTTBackoff = 0;
        _liveSTTHideWarning();
        for (let i = event.resultIndex; i < event.results.length; i++) {
            if (!event.results[i].isFinal) continue;
            const transcript = event.results[i][0].transcript.trim().toLowerCase();
            if (!transcript) continue;
            console.log('[LiveSTT] heard:', transcript);
            const hit = ALL_LIVE_BLOCKED.find(w => transcript.includes(w.toLowerCase()));
            if (hit && !_liveSTTCooldown) {
                _liveSTTCooldown = true;
                setTimeout(() => { _liveSTTCooldown = false; }, 8000);
                _liveSTTHandleViolation(hit, transcript);
            }
        }
    };

    rec.onerror = (e) => {
        if (e.error === 'aborted' || e.error === 'no-speech') return;
        console.warn('[LiveSTT] error:', e.error);

        if (e.error === 'not-allowed' || e.error === 'audio-capture') {
            _liveSTTShowWarning('Microphone access blocked. Live speech moderation inactive.');
            _liveSTTActive = false;
            _liveSTTRecognition = null;
            return;
        }

        if (e.error === 'network' || e.error === 'service-not-allowed') {
            _liveSTTErrorPending = true;
            _liveSTTRecognition = null;
            _liveSTTBackoff++;
            if (_liveSTTBackoff >= 2) {
                console.warn('[LiveSTT] no speech backend in this browser — switching to AI transcription.');
                _liveSTTErrorPending = false;
                _liveSTTStartFallback();
                return;
            }
            const wait = 2000;
            if (!_liveSTTRestarting) {
                _liveSTTRestarting = true;
                setTimeout(() => {
                    _liveSTTRestarting = false;
                    _liveSTTErrorPending = false;
                    if (_liveSTTActive) _liveSTTCreateAndStart();
                }, wait);
            }
        }
    };

    rec.onend = () => {
        _liveSTTRecognition = null;
        if (!_liveSTTActive) return;
        if (_liveSTTRestarting) return;
        if (_liveSTTErrorPending) return;
        if (document.hidden) {
            document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function _resume() {
                document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', _resume);
                if (_liveSTTActive && !document.hidden) _liveSTTCreateAndStart();
            });
            return;
        }
        _liveSTTRestarting = true;
        setTimeout(() => {
            _liveSTTRestarting = false;
            if (_liveSTTActive) _liveSTTCreateAndStart();
        }, 300);
    };

    try {
        rec.start();
        window._LIVE_DEBUG && console.log('[LiveSTT] listening via stream audio track...');
    } catch(e) {
        console.warn('[LiveSTT] could not start:', e.message);
        _liveSTTRecognition = null;
        if (!_liveSTTRestarting) {
            _liveSTTRestarting = true;
            setTimeout(() => { _liveSTTRestarting = false; if (_liveSTTActive) _liveSTTCreateAndStart(); }, 800);
        }
    }
}

function _liveSTTStart() {
    if (_liveSTTActive) return;
    const SpeechRecognition = window.SpeechRecognition || window.webkitSpeechRecognition;
    _liveSTTStrikes = 0;
    _liveSTTActive  = true;
    _liveSTTBackoff = 0;
    _liveSTTErrorPending = false;
    _liveSTTHideWarning();
    if (!SpeechRecognition) {
        console.warn('[LiveSTT] SpeechRecognition unavailable — using AI transcription.');
        _liveSTTStartFallback();
        return;
    }
    _liveSTTCreateAndStart();
}

function _liveSTTStop() {
    _liveSTTActive    = false;
    _liveSTTRestarting = false;
    _liveSTTBackoff = 0;
    _liveSTTErrorPending = false;
    _liveSTTStopFallback();
    if (_liveSTTRecognition) {
        try { _liveSTTRecognition.abort(); } catch(e) {}
        _liveSTTRecognition = null;
    }
    if (_liveSTTAudioCtx) { try { _liveSTTAudioCtx.close(); } catch(e) {} _liveSTTAudioCtx = null; }
    _liveSTTSourceNode = null;
    if (window._liveSTTFallbackStream) { window._liveSTTFallbackStream.getTracks().forEach(t=>t.stop()); window._liveSTTFallbackStream = null; }
    const warn = document.getElementById('live-stt-warning');
    if (warn) warn.style.display = 'none';
    window._LIVE_DEBUG && console.log('[LiveSTT] stopped');
}

window.liveSTTSimulate = function(text) {
    if (!text) { console.warn('[LiveSTT] Usage: liveSTTSimulate("text")'); return; }
    window._LIVE_DEBUG && console.log('[LiveSTT] Simulating:', text);
    const lower = text.trim().toLowerCase();
    const list = typeof ALL_LIVE_BLOCKED !== 'undefined' ? ALL_LIVE_BLOCKED : [];
    const hit = list.find(w => lower.includes(w.toLowerCase()));
    if (hit) {
        console.warn('[LiveSTT] FLAGGED:', hit);
        _liveSTTHandleViolation(hit, lower);
    } else {
        window._LIVE_DEBUG && console.log('[LiveSTT] Clean — no flagged words.');
    }
};

async function _liveSTTHandleViolation(word, fullTranscript) {
    _liveSTTStrikes++;
    const strikesLeft = _LIVE_STT_MAX_STRIKES - _liveSTTStrikes;
    const isTerminal  = _liveSTTStrikes >= _LIVE_STT_MAX_STRIKES;

    const warn    = document.getElementById('live-stt-warning');
    const warnMsg = document.getElementById('live-stt-warning-msg');
    if (warn && warnMsg) {
        const wordSafe = window.escHtml ? window.escHtml(word) : word;
        const strikeText = isTerminal
            ? `<strong style="color:#ff4757;">Your stream has been ended due to repeated violations.</strong>`
            : `Strike ${_liveSTTStrikes} of ${_LIVE_STT_MAX_STRIKES} — <strong style="color:#fca5a5;">${strikesLeft} more will end your stream.</strong>`;
        warnMsg.innerHTML = `Please refrain from saying <strong style="color:#fff;">"${wordSafe}"</strong> — this violates EchoSpace's community rules.<br><span style="font-size:11px;color:#fca5a5;margin-top:4px;display:block;">${strikeText}</span><span style="font-size:10px;color:#fca5a5;display:block;margin-top:2px;">This offence has been logged.</span>`;
        warn.classList.remove('stt-warn-enter');
        warn.style.display = 'block';
        void warn.offsetWidth;
        warn.classList.add('stt-warn-enter');
        clearTimeout(warn._hideTimer);
        warn._hideTimer = setTimeout(() => {
            warn.style.display = 'none';
            warn.classList.remove('stt-warn-enter');
        }, isTerminal ? 5000 : 9000);
    }

    try {
        const { addDoc, collection, serverTimestamp } = await import('https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.11.0/firebase-firestore.js');
        const { getFirestore } = await import('https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.11.0/firebase-firestore.js');
        const { getApps } = await import('https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.11.0/firebase-app.js');
        const _db = getFirestore(getApps()[0]);
        await addDoc(collection(_db, 'live_violations'), {
            uid:         window.myUID  || '',
            username:    window.myUsername || 'Unknown',
            flaggedWord: word,
            transcript:  fullTranscript.slice(0, 300),
            strike:      _liveSTTStrikes,
            createdAt:   serverTimestamp(),
            type:        'live_stream_stt',
        });
        window._LIVE_DEBUG && console.log('[LiveSTT] Violation logged to Firestore (strike', _liveSTTStrikes, ')');
    } catch(e) {
        console.warn('[LiveSTT] Failed to log violation:', e.message);
    }

    if (isTerminal) {
        console.warn('[LiveSTT] Max strikes reached — ending stream.');
        setTimeout(() => {
            if (typeof _endMyStream === 'function') _endMyStream();
        }, 2500);
    }
}

function _liveDropViewerSig(viewerUid) {
    const s = _liveViewerSig[viewerUid];
    if (!s) return;
    s.unsubs.forEach(u => { try { u(); } catch(e){} });
    delete _liveViewerSig[viewerUid];
}

function _liveStreamerTeardownListeners() {
    _liveStreamerUnsubs.forEach(u => { try { u(); } catch(e){} });
    _liveStreamerUnsubs = [];
    Object.keys(_liveViewerSig).forEach(_liveDropViewerSig);
}

async function _liveOfferViewer(viewerUid, joinId, tcpOnly) {
    const base = `live_signaling/${window.myUID}`;
    _liveDropViewerSig(viewerUid);
    const vPc = new RTCPeerConnection(LIVE_CONFIG);
    if (tcpOnly) { vPc._tcpOnly = true; _lvArmTcpFilter(vPc); }
    _peerConnections[viewerUid] = vPc;
    const sig = { joinId, unsubs: [] };
    _liveViewerSig[viewerUid] = sig;
    const current = () => _myStreamActive && !!_myLocalStream && _peerConnections[viewerUid] === vPc;
    const bail = () => { try { vPc.close(); } catch(e){} };

    await Promise.all([
        `${base}/offers/${viewerUid}`, `${base}/answers/${viewerUid}`,
        `${base}/viewer_candidates/${viewerUid}`, `${base}/streamer_candidates/${viewerUid}`
    ].map(p => window.remove(window.ref(window.rtdb, p)).catch(() => {})));
    if (!current()) return bail();

    _myLocalStream.getTracks().forEach(track => vPc.addTrack(track, _myLocalStream));
    await window._lqApplyForViewer(viewerUid);
    if (!current()) return bail();

    vPc.onicecandidate = (e) => {
        if (!e.candidate || !current()) return;
        const candRef = window.push(window.ref(window.rtdb, `${base}/streamer_candidates/${viewerUid}`));
        window.set(candRef, e.candidate.toJSON()).catch(() => {});
    };

    const offer = await vPc.createOffer();
    if (!current()) return bail();
    await vPc.setLocalDescription(offer);
    if (!current()) return bail();
    await window.set(
        window.ref(window.rtdb, `${base}/offers/${viewerUid}`),
        { sdp: tcpOnly ? _lvTcpOnlySdp(offer.sdp) : offer.sdp, type: offer.type, joinId }
    );
    if (!current()) return bail();

    sig.unsubs.push(window.onValue(window.ref(window.rtdb, `${base}/answers/${viewerUid}`), async (aSnap) => {
        const ans = aSnap.val();
        if (!ans || !current() || vPc.remoteDescription) return;
        if (ans.joinId != null && ans.joinId !== joinId) return;
        try {
            await vPc.setRemoteDescription(new RTCSessionDescription({ type: ans.type, sdp: ans.sdp }));
        } catch(e) { console.warn('[Live] setRemoteDescription failed:', e.message); return; }
        if (!current()) return;

        sig.unsubs.push(window.onValue(window.ref(window.rtdb, `${base}/viewer_candidates/${viewerUid}`), (cSnap) => {
            if (!cSnap.val() || !current()) return;
            Object.values(cSnap.val()).forEach(c => {
                if (vPc.remoteDescription) vPc.addIceCandidate(new RTCIceCandidate(c)).catch(()=>{});
            });
        }));
    }));
}

async function _initStreamerConnection() {
    _liveStreamerTeardownListeners();
    await window.remove(window.ref(window.rtdb, `live_signaling/${window.myUID}`));

    _liveStreamerUnsubs.push(window.onValue(window.ref(window.rtdb, `live_signaling/${window.myUID}/viewer_join`), (snap) => {
        if (!_myStreamActive || !_myLocalStream) return;
        const joined = snap.val() || {};
        for (const uid of Object.keys(_peerConnections)) {
            if (!joined[uid]) {
                try { _peerConnections[uid].close(); } catch(e) {}
                delete _peerConnections[uid];
                delete _lqViewerQ[uid]; delete _lqViewerPinned[uid]; delete _lqViewerActual[uid];
                _liveDropViewerSig(uid);
                window.remove(window.ref(window.rtdb, `live_signaling/${window.myUID}/offers/${uid}`)).catch(()=>{});
                window.remove(window.ref(window.rtdb, `live_signaling/${window.myUID}/answers/${uid}`)).catch(()=>{});
                window.remove(window.ref(window.rtdb, `live_signaling/${window.myUID}/streamer_candidates/${uid}`)).catch(()=>{});
                window._LIVE_DEBUG && console.log('[Live] reaped departed viewer', uid);
            }
        }

        for (const [viewerUid, req] of Object.entries(joined)) {
            const joinId = (req && (req.joinId ?? req.joinedAt)) ?? null;
            const existing = _peerConnections[viewerUid];
            if (existing) {
                const dead = ['failed', 'closed', 'disconnected'].includes(existing.connectionState);
                const sameJoin = _liveViewerSig[viewerUid]?.joinId === joinId;
                if (!dead && sameJoin) continue;
                try { existing.close(); } catch(e) {}
                delete _peerConnections[viewerUid];
            }
            _liveOfferViewer(viewerUid, joinId, !!(req && req.tcp))
                .catch(e => console.warn('[Live] offer for viewer failed:', viewerUid, e?.message || e));
        }
    }));

    _liveStreamerUnsubs.push(window.onValue(window.ref(window.rtdb, `live_signaling/${window.myUID}/quality_req`), (snap) => {
        const reqs = snap.val() || {};
        Object.entries(reqs).forEach(([viewerUid, val]) => {
            _lqViewerPinned[viewerUid] = (val === 'auto' || val == null) ? null : parseInt(val, 10);
            window._lqApplyForViewer(viewerUid);
        });
    }));

    await window.set(window.ref(window.rtdb, `live_signaling/${window.myUID}/ready`), true);
}

const LIVE_VIEW_CONNECT_MS = 20000;

async function _initViewerConnection(streamerUid, attempt = 0, tcpOnly = false) {
    if (!window.myUID || _currentWatchingUid !== streamerUid) return;
    const me = window.myUID;
    const base = `live_signaling/${streamerUid}`;

    _liveViewerUnsubs.forEach(u => { try { u(); } catch(e){} });
    _liveViewerUnsubs = [];
    clearTimeout(_liveViewTimer);
    if (_liveViewPc) { try { _liveViewPc.close(); } catch(e){} _liveViewPc = null; }

    const joinId = Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8);

    await Promise.all([
        `${base}/offers/${me}`, `${base}/answers/${me}`,
        `${base}/viewer_candidates/${me}`, `${base}/streamer_candidates/${me}`
    ].map(p => window.remove(window.ref(window.rtdb, p)).catch(() => {})));
    if (_currentWatchingUid !== streamerUid) return;

    const pc = new RTCPeerConnection(LIVE_CONFIG);
    if (tcpOnly) { pc._tcpOnly = true; _lvArmTcpFilter(pc); }
    _liveViewPc = pc;
    const current = () => _liveViewPc === pc && _currentWatchingUid === streamerUid;

    _lqWatchUid = streamerUid;
    if (attempt === 0 || !_lqWatchDD) {
        _lqWatchDD = _lqMount('watch-quality-dd', {
            pinned: null,
            effective: LQ_DEFAULT,
            onPick: (pinned) => window._lqRequestWatchQuality(pinned)
        });
        window._lqRequestWatchQuality(null);
    } else {
        window._lqRequestWatchQuality(_lqWatchDD.pinned);
    }
    _lqStartWatchMonitor(pc);

    const hidePlaceholder = () => {
        if (!current()) return;
        clearTimeout(_liveViewTimer);
        const placeholder = document.getElementById('live-stream-placeholder');
        if (placeholder) placeholder.style.display = 'none';
    };

    pc.ontrack = (e) => {
        if (!current()) return;
        const video = document.getElementById('live-remote-video');
        if (video && e.streams[0]) {
            video.srcObject = e.streams[0];
            video.onplaying = hidePlaceholder;
        }
    };

    let _blockT = null;
    const onState = () => {
        if (!current()) return;
        const st = pc.connectionState || pc.iceConnectionState;
        if (st === 'connected' || st === 'completed') { pc._everLiveConnected = true; clearTimeout(_blockT); hidePlaceholder(); }
        else if (st === 'failed') _liveViewFailed(streamerUid, attempt);
    };
    pc.onconnectionstatechange = onState;
    pc.oniceconnectionstatechange = onState;

    const _tcpRetry = (why) => {
        if (!current() || pc._everLiveConnected || tcpOnly) return;
        console.warn('[Live] media blocked (' + why + ') — rejoining TCP-only');
        clearTimeout(_blockT); clearTimeout(_liveViewTimer);
        const ph = document.getElementById('live-stream-placeholder');
        if (ph) { ph.style.display = 'flex'; ph.innerHTML = `<div class="text-5xl">📡</div><div class="text-sm text-[#555566] font-bold">Your network is blocking video — trying a backup route...</div>`; }
        _initViewerConnection(streamerUid, attempt, true).catch(e => console.warn('[Live] tcp retry failed:', e?.message || e));
    };
    pc.addEventListener('iceconnectionstatechange', () => {
        if (!current() || pc._everLiveConnected || tcpOnly) return;
        const st = pc.iceConnectionState;
        if (st === 'connected' || st === 'completed') {
            clearTimeout(_blockT);
            _blockT = setTimeout(() => _tcpRetry('ice ok but no DTLS after 3.5s'), 3500);
        } else if (st === 'disconnected' || st === 'failed') {
            clearTimeout(_blockT);
            _tcpRetry('ice ' + st + ' before media ever connected');
        }
    });

    pc.onicecandidate = (e) => {
        if (!e.candidate || !current()) return;
        const candRef = window.push(window.ref(window.rtdb, `${base}/viewer_candidates/${me}`));
        window.set(candRef, e.candidate.toJSON()).catch(() => {});
    };

    _liveViewerUnsubs.push(window.onValue(window.ref(window.rtdb, `${base}/offers/${me}`), async (oSnap) => {
        const offer = oSnap.val();
        if (!offer || !current() || pc.remoteDescription) return;
        if (offer.joinId != null && offer.joinId !== joinId) return;
        try {
            await pc.setRemoteDescription(new RTCSessionDescription({ type: offer.type, sdp: tcpOnly ? _lvTcpOnlySdp(offer.sdp) : offer.sdp }));
            const answer = await pc.createAnswer();
            await pc.setLocalDescription(answer);
            if (!current()) return;
            await window.set(
                window.ref(window.rtdb, `${base}/answers/${me}`),
                { sdp: tcpOnly ? _lvTcpOnlySdp(answer.sdp) : answer.sdp, type: answer.type, joinId }
            );
        } catch(e) { console.warn('[Live] viewer answer failed:', e.message); return; }
        if (!current()) return;

        _liveViewerUnsubs.push(window.onValue(window.ref(window.rtdb, `${base}/streamer_candidates/${me}`), (cSnap) => {
            if (!cSnap.val() || !current()) return;
            Object.values(cSnap.val()).forEach(c => {
                if (pc.remoteDescription) pc.addIceCandidate(new RTCIceCandidate(c)).catch(()=>{});
            });
        }));
    }));

    _liveViewTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        if (current() && !['connected', 'completed'].includes(pc.connectionState || pc.iceConnectionState)) {
            _liveViewFailed(streamerUid, attempt);
        }
    }, LIVE_VIEW_CONNECT_MS);

    await window.set(
        window.ref(window.rtdb, `${base}/viewer_join/${me}`),
        { joinedAt: Date.now(), joinId, tcp: !!tcpOnly }
    );
}

function _liveViewFailed(streamerUid, attempt) {
    if (_currentWatchingUid !== streamerUid) return;
    clearTimeout(_liveViewTimer);
    const ph = document.getElementById('live-stream-placeholder');
    if (attempt < 1) {
        if (ph) { ph.style.display = 'flex'; ph.innerHTML = `<div class="text-5xl">📡</div><div class="text-sm text-[#555566] font-bold">Reconnecting to stream...</div>`; }
        _initViewerConnection(streamerUid, attempt + 1).catch(e => console.warn('[Live] retry failed:', e?.message || e));
        return;
    }
    if (_liveViewPc) { try { _liveViewPc.close(); } catch(e){} _liveViewPc = null; }
    if (ph) {
        ph.style.display = 'flex';
        ph.innerHTML = `
            <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:12px;text-align:center;max-width:320px;padding:0 16px;">
                <div class="text-5xl">📡</div>
                <div style="font-size:15px;font-weight:900;color:#e8e8f0;">Couldn't connect to this stream</div>
                <div style="font-size:12px;color:#555566;line-height:1.5;">The network you're on may be blocking live video. This is common on school Wi-Fi.</div>
                <button onclick="window._liveRetryWatch()" class="btn-primary text-sm px-5 py-2.5" style="font-weight:700;">Try again</button>
            </div>`;
    }
}

window._liveRetryWatch = () => {
    const uid = _currentWatchingUid;
    if (!uid) return;
    const ph = document.getElementById('live-stream-placeholder');
    if (ph) { ph.style.display = 'flex'; ph.innerHTML = `<div class="text-5xl">📡</div><div class="text-sm text-[#555566] font-bold">Connecting to stream...</div>`; }
    _initViewerConnection(uid, 0).catch(e => console.warn('[Live] retry failed:', e?.message || e));
};

window.sendLiveComment = async () => {
    const input = document.getElementById('live-comment-input');
    if (!input || !input.value.trim() || !_currentWatchingUid || !window.myUID) return;
    const text = input.value.trim();
    input.value = '';
    try {
        const newRef = window.push(window.ref(window.rtdb, `live_comments/${_currentWatchingUid}`));
        await window.set(newRef, { uid: window.myUID, username: window.myUsername, pfp: window.myPfp, text, ts: Date.now() });
    } catch(e) { console.warn('[Live] comment send failed:', e.code, e.message); }
};

window.likeStream = async () => {
    if (!_currentWatchingUid) return;
    const btn = document.querySelector('[onclick="likeStream()"]');
    if (btn) { btn.disabled = true; setTimeout(() => { if(btn) btn.disabled = false; }, 2000); }
    try {
        await window.runTransaction(window.ref(window.rtdb, `live_streams/${_currentWatchingUid}/likes`), (cur) => (cur || 0) + 1);
    } catch(e) { console.warn('[Live] like failed:', e.code, e.message); }
};

window.followStreamer = async () => {
    if (!_currentWatchingUid || !window.myUID || typeof window.toggleFollow !== 'function') return;
    const btn = document.getElementById('live-follow-btn');
    await window.toggleFollow(_currentWatchingUid, btn);
};

let _currentLiveUids = new Set();

function _applyLiveRings() {
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-other-uid]').forEach(el => {
        const uid = el.getAttribute('data-other-uid');
        const isLive = _currentLiveUids.has(uid);
        const liveRing = el.querySelector('.live-ring');
        if (liveRing) liveRing.style.borderColor = isLive ? '#dc2626' : 'transparent';
        const dmItem = el.closest('.dm-item, .flex.items-center.gap-3');
        const liveLabel = dmItem ? dmItem.querySelector('.live-label') : null;
        if (liveLabel) liveLabel.style.display = isLive ? 'inline' : 'none';
    });
}

function _updateDmLiveIndicators() {
    if (!window.rtdb || !window.onValue || !window.ref) return;
    window.onValue(window.ref(window.rtdb, 'live_streams'), (snap) => {
        _currentLiveUids = new Set();
        if (snap.val()) Object.keys(snap.val()).forEach(uid => { if (snap.val()[uid]?.active) _currentLiveUids.add(uid); });
        _applyLiveRings();
        setTimeout(_applyLiveRings, 300);
    });
    if (!window._liveRingHeartbeat) {
        window._liveRingHeartbeat = setInterval(() => {
            if (typeof _applyLiveRings === 'function') _applyLiveRings();
        }, 5000);
    }
}

const _origLoadChats = window.loadChats;
const _origSwitchView = window.switchView;
window.switchView = (id) => {
    _origSwitchView(id);
    if (id !== 'live') window._liveStopThumbRequests();
    if (id === 'live') {
        window._LIVE_DEBUG && console.log('[Live] switchView(live) fired. myUID:', window.myUID);
        if (!window.myUID) { console.warn('[Live] switchView(live) skipped — no myUID yet'); return; }
        window._liveStartThumbRequests();
        const feedView = document.getElementById('live-feed-view');
        if (feedView) feedView.style.display = '';
        startLiveFeed();
        if (window.rtdb && window.ref && window.get) {
            window.get(window.ref(window.rtdb, 'live_streams')).then(snap => {
                const raw = snap.val();
                window._LIVE_DEBUG && console.log('[Live] switchView get() force-refresh. raw keys:', raw ? Object.keys(raw) : 'null');
                const fresh = [];
                if (raw) Object.entries(raw).forEach(([uid, data]) => { if (data && data.active) fresh.push({ uid, ...data }); });
                if (fresh.length !== _liveAllStreams.length) {
                    window._LIVE_DEBUG && console.log('[Live] get() found different count than cache — updating. cache:', _liveAllStreams.length, 'get:', fresh.length);
                    _liveAllStreams = fresh;
                    renderLiveFeed(_liveAllStreams);
                    updateLiveNavDot(_liveAllStreams.length > 0);
                    const countEl = document.getElementById('live-online-count');
                    if (countEl) countEl.innerText = _liveAllStreams.length + ' stream' + (_liveAllStreams.length !== 1 ? 's' : '') + ' active';
                }
            }).catch(e => console.warn('[Live] switchView get() failed:', e.code, e.message));
        }
    }
};

if (!_lqStreamDD) {
    _lqStreamDD = _lqMount('live-quality-dd', {
        pinned: null, effective: LQ_DEFAULT,
        onPick: (pinned) => { _lqStreamBase = pinned ?? LQ_DEFAULT; if (_myStreamActive) window._lqSetStreamQuality(pinned ?? LQ_DEFAULT); }
    });
}

window.startLiveFeed = startLiveFeed;
window._updateDmLiveIndicators = _updateDmLiveIndicators;
window._applyLiveRings = _applyLiveRings;

window._resetLiveFeed = () => {
    if (_liveStreamsUnsub) { try { _liveStreamsUnsub(); } catch(e){} _liveStreamsUnsub = null; }
    _liveAllStreams = [];
    _currentLiveUids = new Set();
    if (window._liveRingHeartbeat) { clearInterval(window._liveRingHeartbeat); window._liveRingHeartbeat = null; }
    window._LIVE_DEBUG && console.log('[Live] Live feed reset on logout.');
};

<script>

let _gcRoomId = null;
let _gcLocalStream = null;
let _gcPCs = {};
let _gcMicOn = true;
let _gcCamOn = true;
let _gcMembersUnsub = null;
let _gcKnownMembers = {};
let _gcSignalingUnsubs = [];
let _gcPeerListenerUnsubs = {};
function _gcClearPeerListeners(uid) {
    (_gcPeerListenerUnsubs[uid] || []).forEach(u => { try { u(); } catch(e){} });
    _gcPeerListenerUnsubs[uid] = [];
}
let _gcActive = false;
window._gcActive = false;
let _gcCallStateUnsub = null;

let _gcStates = {};

let _gcRingtonePlaying = false;

function _gcStartRingtone(kind) {
    if (_gcRingtonePlaying || window.ringtonePlaying) return;
    _gcRingtonePlaying = true;
    if (typeof window.startRingtone === 'function') window.startRingtone(kind);
}

function _gcStopRingtone() {
    _gcRingtonePlaying = false;
    if (typeof window.stopRingtone === 'function') window.stopRingtone();
}

window._declineGroupCall = () => {
    document.getElementById('gc-incoming-overlay').classList.add('hidden');
    _gcStopRingtone();
    if (_gcRoomId && window.rtdb && window.set && window.ref && window.myUID) {
        window.set(window.ref(window.rtdb, `group_calls/${_gcRoomId}/declined/${window.myUID}`), { ts: Date.now() }).catch(()=>{});
    }
};

window._joinGroupCallFromOverlay = () => {
    document.getElementById('gc-incoming-overlay').classList.add('hidden');
    _gcStopRingtone();
    window.startGroupCall();
};

let _gcGroupListeners = {};

const _GC_SIGNAL_TTL = 45000;
const _gcNow = () => (typeof window._srvNow === 'function' ? window._srvNow() : Date.now());

function _gcHandleCallState(val, roomId) {
    console.log('[GC] _gcHandleCallState fired for room', roomId, 'val:', val, 'myUID:', window.myUID, '_gcActive:', _gcActive);

    if (!val || !val.active) {
        console.log('[GC]   -> no val or not active, dismissing overlay (if any)');
        document.getElementById('gc-incoming-overlay')?.classList.add('hidden');
        if (_gcRingtonePlaying) _gcStopRingtone();
        if (typeof window._gcHideCallBanner === 'function' && window._bannerRoomId === roomId) window._gcHideCallBanner();
        if (window._bannerRingDismissTimer) { clearTimeout(window._bannerRingDismissTimer); window._bannerRingDismissTimer = null; }
        return;
    }

    if (_gcActive && roomId === _gcRoomId && val.initiatedBy !== window.myUID) {
        if (typeof window._gcShowCallBanner === 'function') window._gcShowCallBanner(roomId, val);
    }

    const age = _gcNow() - (val.startedAt || 0);
    if (age > _GC_SIGNAL_TTL) {
        console.log('[GC]   -> signal is', age, 'ms old (> ring TTL', _GC_SIGNAL_TTL, 'ms) — skipping ring, checking for abandonment');
        if (val.initiatedBy !== window.myUID && !_gcActive && typeof window._gcShowCallBanner === 'function') {
            window._gcShowCallBanner(roomId, val);
        }
        if (age > 300000 && window.rtdb && window.get && window.set && window.ref) {
            window.get(window.ref(window.rtdb, `group_call_meta/${roomId}/members`)).then(mSnap => {
                const members = mSnap.val();
                if (!members || Object.keys(members).length === 0) {
                    console.log('[GC]   -> confirmed room', roomId, 'is empty, clearing abandoned call_state');
                    window.set(window.ref(window.rtdb, `group_calls/${roomId}/call_state`), { active: false }).catch(()=>{});
                }
            }).catch(()=>{});
        }
        return;
    }

    if (val.initiatedBy === window.myUID) {
        console.log('[GC]   -> ignoring, this is my own call_state/ping (initiatedBy === myUID)');
        return;
    }
    if (_gcActive) {
        console.log('[GC]   -> ignoring, already in an active group call (_gcActive=true)');
        return;
    }

    if (val.autoJoinFor === window.myUID) {
        console.log('[GC]   -> autoJoinFor matches me, joining without prompting');
        window._gcPendingJoinRoomId = roomId;
        window.startGroupCall();
        return;
    }

    if (typeof window._gcShowCallBanner === 'function') window._gcShowCallBanner(roomId, val);

    console.log('[GC]   -> showing incoming group call overlay + ringtone for room', roomId);
    const overlay = document.getElementById('gc-incoming-overlay');
    const initiatorEl = document.getElementById('gc-incoming-initiator');
    const roomEl = document.getElementById('gc-incoming-room');
    if (initiatorEl) initiatorEl.innerText = `${val.initiatorName || 'Someone'} started a group call`;
    if (roomEl) roomEl.innerText = val.roomName || '';
    window._gcPendingJoinRoomId = roomId;
    if (overlay) overlay.classList.remove('hidden');
    _gcStartRingtone('incoming');

    if (window._bannerRingDismissTimer) clearTimeout(window._bannerRingDismissTimer);
    window._bannerRingDismissTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        const cur = document.getElementById('gc-incoming-overlay');
        if (cur && !cur.classList.contains('hidden') && window._gcPendingJoinRoomId === roomId) {
            cur.classList.add('hidden');
            _gcStopRingtone();
            const sub = document.getElementById('active-call-banner-sub');
            if (sub) sub.innerText = (val.initiatorName || 'Someone') + ' is in a call · tap to join';
        }
        window._bannerRingDismissTimer = null;
    }, 20000);
}

window._gcAttachAllGroupListeners = (() => {
    let _debounceTimer = null;
    const _fn = () => {
    if (!window.myUID || !window.rtdb || !window.onValue || !window.ref) {
        console.warn('[GC] _gcAttachAllGroupListeners: not ready yet — myUID:', window.myUID, 'rtdb:', !!window.rtdb, 'onValue:', !!window.onValue, 'ref:', !!window.ref);
        return;
    }

    let rooms = [];
    try {
        const cached = localStorage.getItem('app_friends_cache');
        if (cached) {
            const chats = JSON.parse(cached);
            rooms = chats
                .map(c => ({ id: c.id, data: typeof c.data === 'function' ? c.data() : c.data }))
                .filter(c => c.data && c.data.isGroup);
        }
    } catch(e) { console.warn('[GC] cache parse error:', e); }

    console.log('[GC] _gcAttachAllGroupListeners running for myUID', window.myUID, '— group rooms found in cache:', rooms.map(r => r.id));

    rooms.forEach(({ id: roomId }) => {
        if (!_gcGroupListeners[roomId]) {
            console.log('[GC] attaching call_state listener for room', roomId);
            _gcGroupListeners[roomId] = window.onValue(
                window.ref(window.rtdb, `group_calls/${roomId}/call_state`),
                (snap) => _gcHandleCallState(snap.val(), roomId),
                (err) => console.error('[GC] PERMISSION/READ ERROR on group_calls/' + roomId + '/call_state:', err?.code || err?.message || err)
            );
        }

        const pingKey = `ping_${roomId}`;
        if (!_gcGroupListeners[pingKey]) {
            console.log('[GC] attaching ping listener for room', roomId, 'at group_call_pings/' + window.myUID + '/' + roomId);
            _gcGroupListeners[pingKey] = window.onValue(
                window.ref(window.rtdb, `group_call_pings/${window.myUID}/${roomId}`),
                (snap) => {
                    const ping = snap.val();
                    if (!ping) return;
                    console.log('[GC] ping received for room', roomId, ':', ping);
                    if (!ping.active || (_gcNow() - (ping.startedAt || 0) > _GC_SIGNAL_TTL)) {
                        console.log('[GC] ping for room', roomId, 'is stale — clearing');
                        window.remove(window.ref(window.rtdb, `group_call_pings/${window.myUID}/${roomId}`)).catch(()=>{});
                        return;
                    }
                    _gcHandleCallState(ping, roomId);
                },
                (err) => console.error('[GC] PERMISSION/READ ERROR on group_call_pings/' + window.myUID + '/' + roomId + ':', err?.code || err?.message || err)
            );
        }
    });

    if (!_gcGroupListeners['__broad_ping__']) {
        console.log('[GC] attaching broad ping listener (onChildAdded/onChildChanged) at group_call_pings/' + window.myUID);
        const broadRef = window.ref(window.rtdb, `group_call_pings/${window.myUID}`);
        const _broadHandler = (child) => {
            const ping = child.val();
            const roomId = child.key;
            if (!ping) return;
            console.log('[GC] broad listener: ping event for room', roomId, ':', ping);
            if (!ping.active || (_gcNow() - (ping.startedAt || 0) > _GC_SIGNAL_TTL)) {
                console.log('[GC] broad listener: ping for room', roomId, 'is stale — clearing');
                window.remove(window.ref(window.rtdb, `group_call_pings/${window.myUID}/${roomId}`)).catch(()=>{});
                return;
            }
            _gcHandleCallState(ping, roomId);
        };
        const _broadErr = (err) => console.error('[GC] PERMISSION/READ ERROR on group_call_pings/' + window.myUID + ':', err?.code || err?.message || err);
        const addUnsub = (window.onChildAdded || window.onValue)(broadRef, _broadHandler, _broadErr);
        const changeUnsub = window.onChildChanged
            ? window.onChildChanged(broadRef, _broadHandler, _broadErr)
            : null;
        _gcGroupListeners['__broad_ping__'] = () => {
            try { addUnsub && addUnsub(); } catch(e){}
            try { changeUnsub && changeUnsub(); } catch(e){}
        };
    }
    };
    return () => {
        clearTimeout(_debounceTimer);
        _debounceTimer = setTimeout(_fn, 1500);
    };
})();


window._gcListenForCallState = (roomId) => {

    _gcCallStateUnsub = window.onValue(
        window.ref(window.rtdb, `group_calls/${roomId}/call_state`),
        (snap) => _gcHandleCallState(snap.val(), roomId),
        (err) => console.error('[GC] _gcListenForCallState PERMISSION/READ ERROR on room', roomId, ':', err?.code || err?.message || err)
    );
};

function _gcSetGroupMode(on) {
    const grid       = document.getElementById('gc-video-grid');
    const remVid     = document.getElementById('remote-video');
    const locVid     = document.getElementById('local-video');
    const callStatus = document.getElementById('call-status');
    const btnHangup  = document.getElementById('btn-hangup');
    const btnGcHang  = document.getElementById('btn-gc-hangup');
    const btnGcFs    = document.getElementById('btn-gc-fullscreen');
    const btnGcLay   = document.getElementById('btn-gc-layout');
    const focusWrap  = document.getElementById('gc-focus');
    const btnScreen  = document.getElementById('btn-screen');
    const btnStopScr = document.getElementById('btn-stop-screen');
    const btnPiP     = document.querySelector('[onclick="togglePiP()"]');
    const label      = document.getElementById('fv-call-label');

    if (on) {
        if (grid)       { grid.style.display = 'grid'; }
        if (remVid)     remVid.style.display = 'none';
        if (locVid)     locVid.style.display = 'none';
        if (callStatus) callStatus.style.display = 'none';
        if (btnHangup)  btnHangup.style.display = 'none';
        if (btnGcHang)  btnGcHang.style.display = 'flex';
        if (btnGcFs)    btnGcFs.style.display = 'flex';
        { const b = document.getElementById('btn-gc-reconnect'); if (b) b.style.display = 'flex'; }
        { const b = document.getElementById('btn-call-reconnect'); if (b) b.style.display = 'none'; }
        if (btnScreen)  btnScreen.style.display = 'none';
        if (btnStopScr) btnStopScr.style.display = 'none';
        if (btnPiP)     btnPiP.style.display = 'none';
        if (label)      label.innerText = 'Group Call';
    } else {
        if (grid)       { grid.style.display = 'none'; grid.innerHTML = ''; }
        if (focusWrap)  { focusWrap.classList.remove('gc-on'); focusWrap.style.display = 'none';
                          const st = document.getElementById('gc-stage'), sp = document.getElementById('gc-strip');
                          if (st) st.innerHTML = ''; if (sp) sp.innerHTML = ''; }
        if (btnGcLay)   btnGcLay.style.display = 'none';
        if (remVid)     remVid.style.display = '';
        if (locVid)     locVid.style.display = '';
        if (callStatus) callStatus.style.display = '';
        if (btnHangup)  btnHangup.style.display = '';
        if (btnGcHang)  btnGcHang.style.display = 'none';
        if (btnGcFs)    btnGcFs.style.display = 'none';
        { const b = document.getElementById('btn-gc-reconnect'); if (b) b.style.display = 'none'; }
        { const b = document.getElementById('btn-call-reconnect'); if (b) b.style.display = ''; }
        if (btnScreen)  btnScreen.style.display = '';
        if (btnStopScr) btnStopScr.style.display = '';
        if (btnPiP)     btnPiP.style.display = '';
        if (label)      label.innerText = 'Active Call';
    }
}

function _gcResizeWindow(memberCount) {
    const fv = document.getElementById('floating-video');
    if (!fv) return;
    if (memberCount <= 2) {
        fv.style.width = '520px';
        fv.style.height = '420px';
    } else if (memberCount <= 4) {
        fv.style.width = '680px';
        fv.style.height = '520px';
    } else if (memberCount <= 6) {
        fv.style.width = '860px';
        fv.style.height = '620px';
    } else {
        fv.style.width = Math.min(window.innerWidth - 40, 1060) + 'px';
        fv.style.height = Math.min(window.innerHeight - 80, 720) + 'px';
    }
    fv.style.top = '16px';
    fv.style.right = '16px';
    fv.style.left = 'auto';
}

window.gcToggleFullscreen = () => {
    const fv = document.getElementById('floating-video');
    if (!fv) return;
    if (!document.fullscreenElement) {
        fv.requestFullscreen().catch(e => {
            fv.style.width  = (window.innerWidth  - 32) + 'px';
            fv.style.height = (window.innerHeight - 32) + 'px';
            fv.style.top    = '16px';
            fv.style.left   = '16px';
            fv.style.right  = 'auto';
        });
    } else {
        document.exitFullscreen();
    }
};

window.startGroupCall = async () => {
    if (window._isTimedOut && window._isTimedOut()) {
        alert('You are timed out and cannot join calls right now.');
        window._gcPendingJoinRoomId = null;
        return;
    }
    const _pendingId = window._gcPendingJoinRoomId;
    const chatId = _pendingId || window.currentChatId || currentChatId;
    window._gcPendingJoinRoomId = null;

    let chatData;
    if (_pendingId && _pendingId !== window.currentChatId) {
        try {
            const _snap = await window.getDoc(window.doc(window.db, 'chats', _pendingId));
            chatData = _snap.exists() ? _snap.data() : null;
        } catch(e) { chatData = null; }
    } else {
        chatData = window.currentChatData || currentChatData;
    }

    if (!window.myUID || !chatId) { alert('Open a group chat first.'); return; }
    if (chatData && !chatData.isGroup) {
        alert('Group calls are only available in group chats.');
        return;
    }
    if (_gcActive) return;

    try {
        _gcLocalStream = await (window._getCallMedia ? window._getCallMedia(true, _getCallAudioConstraints()) : navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ video: true, audio: _getCallAudioConstraints() }));
        _gcLocalStream = await _cafxSetupForNewCall(_gcLocalStream);
    } catch(e) {
        const name = e && e.name;
        let msg;
        if (name === 'NotAllowedError' || name === 'PermissionDeniedError') {
            msg = 'Camera and microphone permission is required for a group call.';
        } else if (name === 'NotFoundError' || name === 'DevicesNotFoundError') {
            msg = 'No camera or microphone found on this device.';
        } else if (name === 'NotReadableError' || name === 'TrackStartError') {
            msg = 'Your camera or microphone is already in use by another app or browser tab. Close it and try again.';
        } else {
            msg = 'Could not start the group call: ' + (e && e.message || 'unknown error');
        }
        try { window.CallDiag?.note('gc_' + chatId, 'group_media_failed', (e && e.name) + ': ' + (e && e.message), { kind: 'group', direction: _pendingId ? 'incoming' : 'outgoing', isVideo: true, otherName: chatData?.groupName || '' }, true); } catch (_) {}
        alert(msg);
        return;
    }

    _gcRoomId = chatId;
    try { window.CallDiag?.begin('gc_' + chatId, { kind: 'group', direction: _pendingId ? 'incoming' : 'outgoing', isVideo: true, otherName: chatData?.groupName || 'Group' }); } catch (_) {}
    _gcMicOn = true;
    _gcCamOn = true;
    _gcPCs = {};
    _gcStates = {};
    _gcKnownMembers = {};
    _gcActive = true;
    window._gcActive = true;

    const fv = document.getElementById('floating-video');
    fv.classList.remove('hidden');
    fv.style.display = 'flex';
    _gcSetGroupMode(true);
    _gcResizeWindow(1);

    const label = document.getElementById('fv-call-label');
    if (label) label.innerText = 'Calling Group...';

    let _gcIsJoiningExisting = false;
    try {
        const _existingSnap = await window.get(window.ref(window.rtdb, `group_calls/${_gcRoomId}/call_state`));
        const _existing = _existingSnap.val();
        if (_existing && _existing.active && (_gcNow() - (_existing.startedAt || 0) < _GC_SIGNAL_TTL)) {
            _gcIsJoiningExisting = true;
        }
    } catch(e) {}

    if (_gcIsJoiningExisting) {
        if (label) label.innerText = 'Group Call';
    } else {
        _gcStartRingtone('outgoing');

        const groupName = chatData?.groupName || 'Group';
        const callStatePayload = {
            active: true,
            initiatedBy: window.myUID,
            initiatorName: window.myUsername || 'Someone',
            roomName: groupName,
            startedAt: _gcNow()
        };
        try {
            await window.set(window.ref(window.rtdb, `group_calls/${_gcRoomId}/call_state`), callStatePayload);
            console.log('[GC] call_state written for room', _gcRoomId, ':', callStatePayload);
        } catch(e) {
            console.error('[GC] FAILED to write group_calls/' + _gcRoomId + '/call_state (check RTDB rules):', e?.code || e?.message || e);
        }

        if (chatData?.participants) {
            const pingPayload = { ...callStatePayload };
            console.log('[GC] pinging participants:', chatData.participants, 'for room', _gcRoomId);
            for (const uid of chatData.participants) {
                if (uid === window.myUID) continue;
                window.set(window.ref(window.rtdb, `group_call_pings/${uid}/${_gcRoomId}`), pingPayload)
                    .then(() => console.log('[GC] ping written to group_call_pings/' + uid + '/' + _gcRoomId))
                    .catch((e) => console.error('[GC] FAILED to write group_call_pings/' + uid + '/' + _gcRoomId + ' (check RTDB rules):', e?.code || e?.message || e));
            }
        } else {
            console.warn('[GC] startGroupCall: chatData.participants missing — no pings sent. chatData:', chatData);
        }
    }

    const btnMic = document.getElementById('btn-mic');
    const btnCam = document.getElementById('btn-cam');
    if (btnMic) { btnMic.onclick = gcToggleMic; btnMic.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-microphone"></i>'; }
    if (btnCam) { btnCam.onclick = gcToggleCam; btnCam.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-video"></i>'; }

    _gcAddTile(window.myUID, window.myUsername || 'You', window.myPfp, _gcLocalStream, true);
    _updateCallAudioFXButtons();

    const _myRawPfp = window.myPfp || '';
    const _myMetaPfp = _myRawPfp.startsWith('data:image/gif') ? '__chunked_gif__' : _myRawPfp;
    const myMeta = {
        uid: window.myUID,
        username: window.myUsername || 'Me',
        pfp: _myMetaPfp,
        joinedAt: Date.now(),
        micOn: true, camOn: true
    };
    try {
        await window.set(window.ref(window.rtdb, `group_call_meta/${_gcRoomId}/members/${window.myUID}`), myMeta);
        try { window.onDisconnect(window.ref(window.rtdb, `group_call_meta/${_gcRoomId}/members/${window.myUID}`)).remove(); } catch (_) {}
        try { window.onDisconnect(window.ref(window.rtdb, `group_calls/${_gcRoomId}/signaling/${window.myUID}`)).remove(); } catch (_) {}
    } catch(e) {
        alert('Could not join group call. Check your Firebase RTDB rules. ' + e.message);
        _gcCleanup(true);
        return;
    }

    _gcStopRingtone();
    if (label) label.innerText = 'Group Call';

    try { await window.remove(window.ref(window.rtdb, `group_calls/${_gcRoomId}/signaling/${window.myUID}`)); } catch(e) {}

    _gcListenForViewerJoins();

    await window.set(window.ref(window.rtdb, `group_calls/${_gcRoomId}/signaling/${window.myUID}/ready`), true);

    _gcListenForReconnect();

    _gcListenForMembers();
};

function _gcAddTile(uid, username, pfp, stream, isLocal) {
    const grid = document.getElementById('gc-video-grid');
    if (!grid || document.getElementById(`gc-tile-${uid}`)) return;

        if (e.target.closest('button')) return;

    lbl.className = 'gc-name-pill';

                    + `<span class="gc-chip live" id="gc-livechip-${uid}" style="display:none;">Speaking</span>`;

    muteBadge.innerText = '🔇';

    const camOffOverlay = document.createElement('div');
    camOffOverlay.id = `gc-camoff-${uid}`;
    camOffOverlay.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;inset:0;display:none;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;background:#080810;z-index:2;';
    const _tileInitialPfp = (pfp && pfp !== '__chunked_gif__') ? pfp : window._DEFAULT_PFP;
    camOffOverlay.innerHTML = `<img src="${_tileInitialPfp}" style="width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;border:2px solid #1e1e2e;" onerror="this.src=window._DEFAULT_PFP"><div style="font-size:10px;font-weight:700;color:#555566;">Camera Off</div>`;
    if (pfp === '__chunked_gif__' && uid) {
        window.loadChunkedGif(uid).then(gif => {
            const imgEl = camOffOverlay.querySelector('img');
            if (imgEl) imgEl.src = gif;
        });
    }

    const reconnOverlay = document.createElement('div');
    reconnOverlay.id = `gc-reconn-${uid}`;
    reconnOverlay.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;inset:0;display:none;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;background:rgba(8,8,16,0.508);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);z-index:2;';

        ph.id = `gc-ph-${uid}`;
        ph.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;background:#080810;z-index:1;';
