window._gcLayout = (() => {
    try {
        const v = localStorage.getItem('echo_gc_layout');
        if (v === 'focus') { localStorage.removeItem('echo_gc_layout'); return 'grid'; }
        return v || 'grid';
    } catch (_) { return 'grid'; }
})();
let _gcTileSeq = 0;
let _gcPinned = null;
let _gcSpeaking = null;

function _gcStageUid() {
    const tiles = [...document.querySelectorAll('.gc-tile')].map(t => t.dataset.uid);
    if (_gcPinned && tiles.includes(_gcPinned)) return _gcPinned;
    if (_gcSpeaking && tiles.includes(_gcSpeaking)) return _gcSpeaking;
    const remote = tiles.find(u => u !== window.myUID);
    return remote || tiles[0] || null;
}

 
function _gcSizeGrid(grid, count) {
    const narrow = window.innerWidth < 640;
    let cols;
    if (narrow)        cols = count <= 1 ? 1 : 2;
    else if (count <= 1) cols = 1;
    else if (count <= 4) cols = 2;
    else if (count <= 9) cols = 3;
    else                 cols = 4;
    grid.style.gridTemplateColumns = `repeat(${cols}, 1fr)`;
    grid.style.gridAutoRows = '1fr';
    grid.style.alignContent = 'stretch';
}

function _gcApplyLayout() {
    const grid  = document.getElementById('gc-video-grid');
    const focus = document.getElementById('gc-focus');
    const stage = document.getElementById('gc-stage');
    const strip = document.getElementById('gc-strip');
    if (!grid || !focus || !stage || !strip) return;

    const tiles = [...document.querySelectorAll('.gc-tile')];
    if (!tiles.length) return;

    if (window._gcLayout !== 'focus') {
        focus.classList.remove('gc-on');
        focus.style.display = 'none';
        grid.style.display = 'grid';
        tiles.forEach(t => { if (t.parentElement !== grid) grid.appendChild(t); });
        _gcSizeGrid(grid, tiles.length);
    } else {
        grid.style.display = 'none';
        focus.classList.add('gc-on');
        const onStage = _gcStageUid();
        tiles.forEach(t => {
            const target = (t.dataset.uid === onStage) ? stage : strip;
            if (t.parentElement !== target) target.appendChild(t);
        });
        [...strip.children]
            .sort((a, b) => (+a.dataset.order || 0) - (+b.dataset.order || 0))
            .forEach(t => strip.appendChild(t));
    }

    tiles.forEach(t => {
        const u = t.dataset.uid;
        t.classList.toggle('gc-pinned', u === _gcPinned);
        const pinChip  = document.getElementById(`gc-pinchip-${u}`);
        const liveChip = document.getElementById(`gc-livechip-${u}`);
        if (pinChip)  pinChip.style.display  = (u === _gcPinned) ? 'block' : 'none';
        if (liveChip) liveChip.style.display = (u === _gcSpeaking && u !== _gcPinned) ? 'block' : 'none';
    });
}
window._gcApplyLayout = _gcApplyLayout;
window.addEventListener('resize', () => { if (window._gcActive) _gcApplyLayout(); });

window._gcTogglePin = (uid) => {
    _gcPinned = (_gcPinned === uid) ? null : uid;
    _gcApplyLayout();
};

window._gcSetSpeaking = (uid, speaking) => {
    const next = speaking ? uid : (_gcSpeaking === uid ? null : _gcSpeaking);
    if (next === _gcSpeaking) return;
    _gcSpeaking = next;
    _gcApplyLayout();
};

window.gcToggleLayout = () => {
    window._gcLayout = (window._gcLayout === 'focus') ? 'grid' : 'focus';
    try { localStorage.setItem('echo_gc_layout', window._gcLayout); } catch (_) {}
    const btn = document.getElementById('btn-gc-layout');
    if (btn) btn.title = window._gcLayout === 'focus' ? 'Switch to grid view' : 'Switch to speaker view';
    _gcApplyLayout();
};

function _gcSetTileState(uid, state) {
    const camOff = document.getElementById(`gc-camoff-${uid}`);
    const reconn = document.getElementById(`gc-reconn-${uid}`);
    const fail   = document.getElementById(`gc-fail-${uid}`);
    const vid    = document.getElementById(`gc-vid-${uid}`);
    if (!camOff || !reconn || !fail) return;
    camOff.style.display = 'none';
    reconn.style.display = 'none';
    fail.style.display   = 'none';
    if (state === 'camoff')       camOff.style.display = 'flex';
    else if (state === 'reconnecting') reconn.style.display = 'flex';
    else if (state === 'failed')  fail.style.display = 'flex';
    if (vid) vid.style.opacity = (state === 'connected' || state === 'camoff') ? '1' : '0.15';
}

window._gcRetryPeer = (uid) => {
    if (_gcStates[uid]) _gcStates[uid].state = 'reconnecting';
    _gcSetTileState(uid, 'reconnecting');
    _gcConnectToMember(uid);
};

function _gcStartRecovery(uid) {
    try { _gcRoomId && window.CallDiag?.log('gc_' + _gcRoomId, 'peer_recovery', (_gcKnownMembers[uid]?.username || uid) + ' tier ' + ((_gcStates[uid]?.tier || 0) + 1)); } catch (_) {}
    if (!_gcStates[uid]) _gcStates[uid] = { pc: _gcPCs[uid] || null, tier: 0, retryTimer: null, heartbeatInterval: null, connectDeadline: null, state: 'reconnecting' };
    const s = _gcStates[uid];
    if (s.connectDeadline) { clearTimeout(s.connectDeadline); s.connectDeadline = null; }
    s.state = 'reconnecting';
    _gcSetTileState(uid, 'reconnecting');

    function _tryTier() {
        if (!_gcActive || !_gcRoomId || !_gcStates[uid]) return;
        s.tier++;
        if (s.tier === 1) {
            s.retryTimer = setTimeout(() => _tryTier(), 8000);
            const pc = _gcPCs[uid];
            if (pc && pc.connectionState !== 'closed') {
                try { pc.restartIce(); } catch(e) { _tryTier(); }
            } else { _tryTier(); }
        } else if (s.tier === 2) {
            s.retryTimer = setTimeout(() => _tryTier(), 25000);
            if (_gcPCs[uid]) { try { _gcPCs[uid].close(); } catch(e){} delete _gcPCs[uid]; }
            _gcConnectToMember(uid);
        } else {
            s.state = 'failed';
            _gcSetTileState(uid, 'failed');
            window.gcReconnectAll && window.gcReconnectAll('auto');
            if (!window.ECHO_HAS_TURN && !window._gcNoTurnWarned) {
                window._gcNoTurnWarned = true;
                console.error('[GC] No TURN server is configured, so calls cannot connect across '
                    + 'different networks. Run window.callDiag(). Fix: window.setTurnServers([...]).');
                try { _gcRoomId && window.CallDiag?.error('gc_' + _gcRoomId, 'peer_unreachable_no_relay', _gcKnownMembers[uid]?.username || uid); } catch (_) {}
                try { showCooldownToast && showCooldownToast('Calls can\'t connect on this network — no relay server configured.'); } catch (_) {}
            }
        }
    }
    if (s.retryTimer) { clearTimeout(s.retryTimer); s.retryTimer = null; }
    _tryTier();
}

function _gcClearRecovery(uid) {
    if (!_gcStates[uid]) return;
    const s = _gcStates[uid];
    if (s.retryTimer) { clearTimeout(s.retryTimer); s.retryTimer = null; }
    if (s.heartbeatInterval) { clearInterval(s.heartbeatInterval); s.heartbeatInterval = null; }
    if (s.connectDeadline) { clearTimeout(s.connectDeadline); s.connectDeadline = null; }
    s.tier = 0;
    s.state = 'connected';
}

function _gcAttachStream(uid, stream) {
    const vid = document.getElementById(`gc-vid-${uid}`);
    const ph  = document.getElementById(`gc-ph-${uid}`);
    if (vid && stream) {
        vid.srcObject = stream;
        vid.style.display = 'block';
        vid.play().catch(()=>{});
    }
    if (ph) ph.style.display = 'none';
    _gcClearRecovery(uid);
    _gcSetTileState(uid, 'connected');
    if (stream) _gcStartTileGlow(uid, () => stream);
}

function _gcRemoveTile(uid) {
    _gcClearRecovery(uid);
    if (_gcStates[uid]) delete _gcStates[uid];
    _gcStopTileGlow(uid);
    const tile = document.getElementById(`gc-tile-${uid}`);
    if (tile) tile.remove();
    if (_gcPinned === uid) _gcPinned = null;
    if (_gcSpeaking === uid) _gcSpeaking = null;
    _gcApplyLayout();
}

let _gcReconnectHandled = new Set();
let _gcLastReconnectAt = 0;
let _gcAutoReconnects = 0;
let _gcSessionJoinedAt = 0;
window.gcReconnectAll = async (why) => {
    if (!_gcActive || !_gcRoomId || !window.myUID) return;
    const now = Date.now();
    if (why !== 'manual') {
        if (now - _gcLastReconnectAt < 45000 || _gcAutoReconnects >= 3) return;
        _gcAutoReconnects++;
    } else if (now - _gcLastReconnectAt < 4000) return;
    try {
        await window.set(window.ref(window.rtdb, `group_calls/${_gcRoomId}/reconnect`),
            { by: window.myUID, why: why || 'manual', ts: now, nonce: now + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8) });
    } catch (e) {
        console.warn('[GC] reconnect broadcast failed, reconnecting locally:', e && e.message);
        _gcDoReconnectAll(window.myUID);
    }
};
function _gcDoReconnectAll(byUid) {
    if (!_gcActive || !_gcRoomId) return;
    _gcLastReconnectAt = Date.now();
    const who = byUid === window.myUID ? 'you' : (_gcKnownMembers[byUid]?.username || 'someone');
    try { window.showCooldownToast?.('Reconnecting call (started by ' + who + ')…', true); } catch (_) {}
    Object.keys(_gcKnownMembers).filter(u => u !== window.myUID).forEach((uid, i) => {
        setTimeout(() => {
            if (!_gcActive || !_gcKnownMembers[uid]) return;
            _gcClearRecovery(uid);
            if (_gcPCs[uid]) { try { _gcPCs[uid].close(); } catch (_) {} delete _gcPCs[uid]; }
            if (!_gcStates[uid]) _gcStates[uid] = { pc: null, tier: 0, retryTimer: null, heartbeatInterval: null, state: 'reconnecting' };
            _gcStates[uid].state = 'reconnecting';
            _gcSetTileState(uid, 'reconnecting');
            _gcConnectToMember(uid);
        }, 150 * i + Math.floor(Math.random() * 250));
    });
}
function _gcListenForReconnect() {
    _gcSessionJoinedAt = Date.now();
    _gcReconnectHandled = new Set();
    _gcAutoReconnects = 0;
    const unsub = window.onValue(window.ref(window.rtdb, `group_calls/${_gcRoomId}/reconnect`), (snap) => {
        const v = snap.val();
        if (!v || !v.nonce || _gcReconnectHandled.has(v.nonce)) return;
        _gcReconnectHandled.add(v.nonce);
        if (v.ts < _gcSessionJoinedAt - 2000 || Date.now() - v.ts > 60000) return;
        _gcDoReconnectAll(v.by);
    });
    _gcSignalingUnsubs.push(unsub);
}
function _gcWatchForStall(pc, uid) {
    let last = -1, flat = 0;
    const iv = setInterval(async () => {
        if (!_gcActive || pc.connectionState === 'closed' || _gcPCs[uid] !== pc) { clearInterval(iv); return; }
        if (pc.connectionState !== 'connected' || _gcKnownMembers[uid]?.camOn === false) { flat = 0; last = -1; return; }
        let frames = null;
        try {
            (await pc.getStats()).forEach(r => {
                if (r.type === 'inbound-rtp' && r.kind === 'video') frames = (r.framesDecoded ?? r.bytesReceived ?? 0);
            });
        } catch (_) { return; }
        if (frames === null) return;
        if (frames === last) flat++; else flat = 0;
        last = frames;
        if (flat >= 3) {
            flat = 0;
            console.warn('[GC] no video from', uid, 'for ~12s while connected — reconnecting everyone');
            window.gcReconnectAll('auto');
        }
    }, 4000);
}

function _gcListenForMembers() {
    if (_gcMembersUnsub) { try { _gcMembersUnsub(); } catch(e){} }
    const ref = window.ref(window.rtdb, `group_call_meta/${_gcRoomId}/members`);
    _gcMembersUnsub = window.onValue(ref, async (snap) => {
        const val = snap.val() || {};
        const count = Object.keys(val).length;
        _gcResizeWindow(count);

        Object.keys(_gcKnownMembers).forEach(uid => {
            if (!val[uid] && uid !== window.myUID) {
                _gcRemoveTile(uid);
                ['', 'out_'].forEach(prefix => {
                    if (_gcPCs[prefix + uid]) {
                        try { _gcPCs[prefix + uid].close(); } catch(e) {}
                        delete _gcPCs[prefix + uid];
                    }
                });
                delete _gcKnownMembers[uid];
            }
        });

        for (const [uid, data] of Object.entries(val)) {
            if (uid === window.myUID) continue;
            const badge = document.getElementById(`gc-muted-${uid}`);
            if (badge) badge.style.display = data.micOn ? 'none' : 'flex';

            const s = _gcStates[uid];
            const known = _gcKnownMembers[uid];
            const isRejoin = known && data.joinedAt && known.joinedAt && data.joinedAt !== known.joinedAt;
            if (isRejoin) {
                _gcRemoveTile(uid);
                ['', 'out_'].forEach(prefix => {
                    if (_gcPCs[prefix + uid]) {
                        try { _gcPCs[prefix + uid].close(); } catch (e) {}
                        delete _gcPCs[prefix + uid];
                    }
                });
                _gcClearPeerListeners(uid);
                _gcClearPeerListeners('out_' + uid);
                delete _gcKnownMembers[uid];
            } else if (known) {
                if (data.camOn === false && s?.state === 'connected') {
                    _gcSetTileState(uid, 'camoff');
                } else if (data.camOn !== false && s?.state === 'connected') {
                    _gcSetTileState(uid, 'connected');
                }
                _gcKnownMembers[uid] = data;
                continue;
            }
            _gcKnownMembers[uid] = data;
            _gcAddTile(uid, data.username, data.pfp, null, false);
            _gcStates[uid] = { pc: null, tier: 0, retryTimer: null, heartbeatInterval: null, state: 'reconnecting' };
            _gcConnectToMember(uid);
        }
    });
}

function _gcAttachCandidates(pc, path) {
    pc._pendingCands = pc._pendingCands || [];
    pc._flushCands = () => {
        if (!pc.remoteDescription) return;
        pc._pendingCands.splice(0).forEach(c =>
            pc.addIceCandidate(new RTCIceCandidate(c)).catch(() => {}));
    };
    return window.onChildAdded(window.ref(window.rtdb, path), (snap) => {
        const c = snap.val();
        if (!c) return;
        if (pc.remoteDescription) pc.addIceCandidate(new RTCIceCandidate(c)).catch(() => {});
        else pc._pendingCands.push(c);
    });
}

async function _gcConnectToMember(streamerUid) {
    _gcClearPeerListeners(streamerUid);

    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
        try {
            const s = await window.get(window.ref(window.rtdb, `group_calls/${_gcRoomId}/signaling/${streamerUid}/ready`));
            if (s.val()) break;
        } catch(e) {}
        await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 500));
    }

    try {
        await Promise.all([
            window.remove(window.ref(window.rtdb, `group_calls/${_gcRoomId}/signaling/${streamerUid}/offers/${window.myUID}`)),
            window.remove(window.ref(window.rtdb, `group_calls/${_gcRoomId}/signaling/${streamerUid}/streamer_candidates/${window.myUID}`))
        ]);
    } catch (_) {}

    try {
        await window.set(
            window.ref(window.rtdb, `group_calls/${_gcRoomId}/signaling/${streamerUid}/viewer_join/${window.myUID}`),
            { joinedAt: Date.now() }
        );
    } catch(e) { console.warn('[GC] join request failed for', streamerUid, e.message); return; }

    const pc = new RTCPeerConnection(LIVE_CONFIG);
    _gcPCs[streamerUid] = pc;
    if (_gcStates[streamerUid]) _gcStates[streamerUid].pc = pc;
    try { window.CallDiag?.watchPc('gc_' + _gcRoomId, pc, 'from ' + (_gcKnownMembers[streamerUid]?.username || streamerUid.slice(0, 6))); } catch (_) {}
    _gcWatchForStall(pc, streamerUid);

    const _gcGiveUp = (why) => {
        if (pc.connectionState === 'connected' || !_gcActive || !_gcKnownMembers[streamerUid]) return;
        console.warn('[GC] connection to', streamerUid, why, '— recovering');
        _gcStartRecovery(streamerUid);
    };
    const _gcConnectDeadline = setTimeout(() => {
        if (pc.connectionState === 'connected') return;
        if (pc.connectionState === 'connecting') {
            const grace = setTimeout(() => _gcGiveUp('still not connected after grace period'), 15000);
            if (_gcStates[streamerUid]) _gcStates[streamerUid].connectDeadline = grace;
            return;
        }
        _gcGiveUp('never started connecting');
    }, 20000);
    if (_gcStates[streamerUid]) _gcStates[streamerUid].connectDeadline = _gcConnectDeadline;

    let _gcMuteWatchdog = null;
    pc.ontrack = (e) => {
        if (e.streams && e.streams[0]) _gcAttachStream(streamerUid, e.streams[0]);
        if (e.track && e.track.kind === 'video') {
            e.track.onmute = () => {
                if (_gcMuteWatchdog) clearTimeout(_gcMuteWatchdog);
                _gcMuteWatchdog = setTimeout(() => {
                    _gcMuteWatchdog = null;
                    if (!_gcActive || !_gcKnownMembers[streamerUid]) return;
                    if (!e.track.muted) return;
                    if (_gcKnownMembers[streamerUid]?.camOn === false) return;
                    _gcStartRecovery(streamerUid);
                }, 5000);
            };
            e.track.onunmute = () => { if (_gcMuteWatchdog) { clearTimeout(_gcMuteWatchdog); _gcMuteWatchdog = null; } };
            e.track.onended = () => {
                if (_gcMuteWatchdog) { clearTimeout(_gcMuteWatchdog); _gcMuteWatchdog = null; }
                if (_gcActive && _gcKnownMembers[streamerUid]) _gcStartRecovery(streamerUid);
            };
        }
    };

    pc.onconnectionstatechange = () => {
        const state = pc.connectionState;
        if (state === 'connected') {
            _gcClearRecovery(streamerUid);
            const memberData = _gcKnownMembers[streamerUid];
            if (memberData?.camOn === false) _gcSetTileState(streamerUid, 'camoff');
            else _gcSetTileState(streamerUid, 'connected');
        } else if (state === 'disconnected' || state === 'failed') {
            if (_gcActive && _gcKnownMembers[streamerUid]) {
                _gcStartRecovery(streamerUid);
            }
        }
    };

    pc.onicecandidate = async (e) => {
        if (!e.candidate || !_gcRoomId) return;
        const r = window.push(window.ref(window.rtdb, `group_calls/${_gcRoomId}/signaling/${streamerUid}/viewer_candidates/${window.myUID}`));
        await window.set(r, e.candidate.toJSON());
    };

    (_gcPeerListenerUnsubs[streamerUid] = _gcPeerListenerUnsubs[streamerUid] || []).push(
        _gcAttachCandidates(pc, `group_calls/${_gcRoomId}/signaling/${streamerUid}/streamer_candidates/${window.myUID}`)
    );

    const offUnsub = window.onValue(
        window.ref(window.rtdb, `group_calls/${_gcRoomId}/signaling/${streamerUid}/offers/${window.myUID}`),
        async (oSnap) => {
            if (!oSnap.val() || pc.remoteDescription) return;
            try {
                await pc.setRemoteDescription(new RTCSessionDescription(oSnap.val()));
                pc._flushCands && pc._flushCands();
                const answer = await pc.createAnswer();
                await pc.setLocalDescription(answer);
                await window.set(
                    window.ref(window.rtdb, `group_calls/${_gcRoomId}/signaling/${streamerUid}/answers/${window.myUID}`),
                    { sdp: answer.sdp, type: answer.type }
                );
            } catch(e) { console.warn('[GC] answer failed for', streamerUid, e.message); return; }
        }
    );
    (_gcPeerListenerUnsubs[streamerUid] = _gcPeerListenerUnsubs[streamerUid] || []).push(offUnsub);
    _gcSignalingUnsubs.push(offUnsub);
}

function _gcListenForViewerJoins() {
    const _handleViewerJoin = async (snap) => {
        if (!snap.val() || !_gcLocalStream) return;
        const viewerUid = snap.key;
        if (_gcPCs[`out_${viewerUid}`]) {
            try { _gcPCs[`out_${viewerUid}`].close(); } catch(e) {}
            delete _gcPCs[`out_${viewerUid}`];
        }
        _gcClearPeerListeners(`out_${viewerUid}`);
        {
            try {
                await Promise.all([
                    window.remove(window.ref(window.rtdb, `group_calls/${_gcRoomId}/signaling/${window.myUID}/answers/${viewerUid}`)),
                    window.remove(window.ref(window.rtdb, `group_calls/${_gcRoomId}/signaling/${window.myUID}/viewer_candidates/${viewerUid}`))
                ]);
            } catch (_) {}
            if (!_gcLocalStream || !_gcRoomId) return;
            const vPc = new RTCPeerConnection(LIVE_CONFIG);
            _gcPCs[`out_${viewerUid}`] = vPc;
            try { window.CallDiag?.watchPc('gc_' + _gcRoomId, vPc, 'to ' + (_gcKnownMembers[viewerUid]?.username || viewerUid.slice(0, 6))); } catch (_) {}
            _gcLocalStream.getTracks().forEach(t => vPc.addTrack(t, _gcLocalStream));

            vPc.onicecandidate = async (e) => {
                if (!e.candidate || !_gcRoomId) return;
                const r = window.push(window.ref(window.rtdb, `group_calls/${_gcRoomId}/signaling/${window.myUID}/streamer_candidates/${viewerUid}`));
                await window.set(r, e.candidate.toJSON());
            };

            (_gcPeerListenerUnsubs[`out_${viewerUid}`] = _gcPeerListenerUnsubs[`out_${viewerUid}`] || []).push(
                _gcAttachCandidates(vPc, `group_calls/${_gcRoomId}/signaling/${window.myUID}/viewer_candidates/${viewerUid}`)
            );

            try {
                const offer = await vPc.createOffer();
                await vPc.setLocalDescription(offer);
                await window.set(
                    window.ref(window.rtdb, `group_calls/${_gcRoomId}/signaling/${window.myUID}/offers/${viewerUid}`),
                    { sdp: offer.sdp, type: offer.type }
                );
            } catch(e) { console.warn('[GC] offer failed for viewer', viewerUid, e.message); return; }

            const ansUnsub = window.onValue(
                window.ref(window.rtdb, `group_calls/${_gcRoomId}/signaling/${window.myUID}/answers/${viewerUid}`),
                async (aSnap) => {
                    if (!aSnap.val() || vPc.remoteDescription) return;
                    try {
                        await vPc.setRemoteDescription(new RTCSessionDescription(aSnap.val()));
                    } catch(e) { return; }
                    vPc._flushCands && vPc._flushCands();
                }
            );
            (_gcPeerListenerUnsubs[`out_${viewerUid}`] = _gcPeerListenerUnsubs[`out_${viewerUid}`] || []).push(ansUnsub);
            _gcSignalingUnsubs.push(ansUnsub);
        }
    };

    const joinRef = window.ref(window.rtdb, `group_calls/${_gcRoomId}/signaling/${window.myUID}/viewer_join`);
    _gcSignalingUnsubs.push(window.onChildAdded(joinRef, _handleViewerJoin));
    if (window.onChildChanged) _gcSignalingUnsubs.push(window.onChildChanged(joinRef, _handleViewerJoin));
}

window.gcToggleMic = () => {
    if (!_gcLocalStream) return;
    const t = _gcLocalStream.getAudioTracks()[0];
    if (!t) return;
    _gcMicOn = !_gcMicOn;
    t.enabled = _gcMicOn;
    const btn = document.getElementById('btn-mic');
    if (btn) { btn.innerHTML = _gcMicOn ? '<i class="fa-solid fa-microphone"></i>' : '<i class="fa-solid fa-volume-xmark"></i>'; btn.classList.toggle('active', !_gcMicOn); }
    if (_gcRoomId && window.myUID)
        window.set(window.ref(window.rtdb, `group_call_meta/${_gcRoomId}/members/${window.myUID}/micOn`), _gcMicOn).catch(()=>{});
};

window.gcToggleCam = () => {
    if (!_gcLocalStream) return;
    const t = _gcLocalStream.getVideoTracks()[0];
    if (!t) return;
    _gcCamOn = !_gcCamOn;
    t.enabled = _gcCamOn;
    const btn = document.getElementById('btn-cam');
    if (btn) { btn.classList.toggle('active', !_gcCamOn); }
    const myVid = document.getElementById(`gc-vid-${window.myUID}`);
    if (myVid) myVid.style.opacity = _gcCamOn ? '1' : '0.2';
    const myCamOff = document.getElementById(`gc-camoff-${window.myUID}`);
    if (myCamOff) myCamOff.style.display = _gcCamOn ? 'none' : 'flex';
    if (_gcRoomId && window.myUID)
        window.set(window.ref(window.rtdb, `group_call_meta/${_gcRoomId}/members/${window.myUID}/camOn`), _gcCamOn).catch(()=>{});
};

window.leaveGroupCall = async () => {
    if (!_gcRoomId || !window.myUID) { _gcCleanup(true); return; }
    const roomId = _gcRoomId;
    try { window.CallDiag?.end('gc_' + roomId, 'left', Object.keys(_gcKnownMembers || {}).length + ' members known'); } catch (_) {}
    const _peers = Object.keys(_gcKnownMembers);
    try { await window.remove(window.ref(window.rtdb, `group_call_meta/${roomId}/members/${window.myUID}`)); } catch(e) {}
    try { await window.remove(window.ref(window.rtdb, `group_calls/${roomId}/signaling/${window.myUID}`)); } catch(e) {}
    for (const peer of _peers) {
        if (peer === window.myUID) continue;
        window.remove(window.ref(window.rtdb, `group_calls/${roomId}/signaling/${peer}/viewer_join/${window.myUID}`)).catch(()=>{});
    }

    try {
        const csSnap = await window.get(window.ref(window.rtdb, `group_calls/${roomId}/call_state`));
        const cs = csSnap.val();
        const isInitiator = cs && cs.initiatedBy === window.myUID;

        const membersSnap = await window.get(window.ref(window.rtdb, `group_call_meta/${roomId}/members`));
        const membersLeft = membersSnap.val() ? Object.keys(membersSnap.val()).length : 0;

        if (isInitiator || membersLeft === 0) {
            await window.set(window.ref(window.rtdb, `group_calls/${roomId}/call_state`), { active: false });

            let roomChatData = null;
            try {
                const roomSnap = await window.getDoc(window.doc(window.db, 'chats', roomId));
                if (roomSnap.exists()) roomChatData = roomSnap.data();
            } catch(e) {}

            const participants = roomChatData?.participants || [];
            for (const uid of participants) {
                window.remove(window.ref(window.rtdb, `group_call_pings/${uid}/${roomId}`)).catch(()=>{});
            }
            window.remove(window.ref(window.rtdb, `group_call_pings_room/${roomId}`)).catch(()=>{});

            if (roomChatData?.ephemeralCall) {
                try {
                    const msgsSnap = await window.getDocs(window.collection(window.db, `chats/${roomId}/messages`));
                    const batch = window.writeBatch(window.db);
                    msgsSnap.forEach(d => batch.delete(d.ref));
                    await batch.commit();
                    await window.deleteDoc(window.doc(window.db, 'chats', roomId));
                } catch(e) { console.warn('[GC] ephemeral room cleanup failed:', e); }
            }
        }
    } catch(e) { console.warn('[GC] leaveGroupCall cleanup error:', e); }

    _gcCleanup(true);
};

function _gcCleanup(hideWindow) {
    document.getElementById('call-audio-fx-popover')?.classList.add('hidden');
    document.getElementById('call-more-menu')?.classList.add('hidden');
    _cleanupCallAudioFX();
    if (_gcLocalStream) { _gcLocalStream.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop()); _gcLocalStream = null; }
    Object.values(_gcPCs).forEach(pc => { try { pc.close(); } catch(e){} });
    _gcPCs = {};
    Object.values(_gcStates).forEach(s => {
        if (s.retryTimer) clearTimeout(s.retryTimer);
        if (s.heartbeatInterval) clearInterval(s.heartbeatInterval);
        if (s.connectDeadline) clearTimeout(s.connectDeadline);
    });
    _gcStates = {};
    if (_gcMembersUnsub) { try { _gcMembersUnsub(); } catch(e){} _gcMembersUnsub = null; }
    if (_gcCallStateUnsub) { try { _gcCallStateUnsub(); } catch(e){} _gcCallStateUnsub = null; }
    _gcSignalingUnsubs.forEach(u => { try { u(); } catch(e){} });
    _gcSignalingUnsubs = [];
    _gcPeerListenerUnsubs = {};
    _gcKnownMembers = {};
    _gcRoomId = null;
    _gcActive = false;
    window._gcActive = false;
    _gcStopAllTileGlows();
    _gcRingtonePlaying = false;
    if (typeof window.stopRingtone === 'function') window.stopRingtone();

    document.getElementById('gc-incoming-overlay')?.classList.add('hidden');

    if (document.fullscreenElement) document.exitFullscreen().catch(()=>{});

    _gcSetGroupMode(false);

    const btnMic = document.getElementById('btn-mic');
    const btnCam = document.getElementById('btn-cam');
    if (btnMic) { btnMic.onclick = window.toggleMic; btnMic.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-microphone"></i>'; btnMic.classList.remove('active'); }
    if (btnCam) { btnCam.onclick = window.toggleCam; btnCam.classList.remove('active'); }

    if (hideWindow) {
        const fv = document.getElementById('floating-video');
        if (fv) { fv.classList.add('hidden'); fv.style.display = 'none'; }
    }
}


let _bannerRoomId = null;
let _bannerCallStartedAt = null;
let _bannerRingDismissTimer = null;

window._gcShowCallBanner = (roomId, callState) => {
    _bannerRoomId = roomId;
    _bannerCallStartedAt = callState?.startedAt || _bannerCallStartedAt || Date.now();
    const banner = document.getElementById('active-call-banner');
    const sub = document.getElementById('active-call-banner-sub');
    if (!banner) return;
    const name = callState?.initiatorName || 'Someone';
    if (sub) sub.innerText = `${name} started a call · tap to join`;
    banner.classList.remove('hidden');
    banner.style.display = 'flex';
};

window._gcHideCallBanner = () => {
    const banner = document.getElementById('active-call-banner');
    if (banner) { banner.classList.add('hidden'); banner.style.display = 'none'; }
    _bannerRoomId = null;
};

let _bannerCallStateUnsub = null;
window._gcRefreshBannerForChat = async (chatId) => {
    if (_bannerCallStateUnsub) { try { _bannerCallStateUnsub(); } catch(e){} _bannerCallStateUnsub = null; }
    if (!chatId || !window.rtdb || !window.onValue || !window.ref) return;

    _bannerCallStateUnsub = window.onValue(
        window.ref(window.rtdb, `group_calls/${chatId}/call_state`),
        async (snap) => {
            const cs = snap.val();
            const age = Date.now() - (cs?.startedAt || 0);
            if (cs && cs.active && age < 3600000 && !_gcActive) {
                let countText = '';
                try {
                    const mSnap = await window.get(window.ref(window.rtdb, `group_call_meta/${chatId}/members`));
                    const count = mSnap.val() ? Object.keys(mSnap.val()).length : 0;
                    countText = count > 0 ? `${count} participant${count>1?'s':''} in the call` : (cs.initiatorName || 'Someone') + ' started a call';
                } catch(e) { countText = (cs.initiatorName || 'Someone') + ' started a call'; }
                const sub = document.getElementById('active-call-banner-sub');
                if (sub) sub.innerText = countText + ' · tap to join';
                const b = document.getElementById('active-call-banner');
                if (b) { b.classList.remove('hidden'); b.style.display = 'flex'; }
                _bannerRoomId = chatId;
                _bannerCallStartedAt = cs.startedAt || _bannerCallStartedAt;
            } else if (_bannerRoomId === chatId) {
                const b = document.getElementById('active-call-banner');
                if (b) { b.classList.add('hidden'); b.style.display = 'none'; }
                _bannerRoomId = null;
            }
        },
        (err) => console.warn('[GC] banner call_state listener error:', err)
    );
};

window._joinCallFromBanner = () => {
    if (_bannerRoomId) {
        window._gcPendingJoinRoomId = _bannerRoomId;
    }
    window.startGroupCall();
};

async function _gcPostCallEndedMessage(roomId, startedAt) {
    if (!roomId || !startedAt) return;
    const elapsed = Math.round((Date.now() - startedAt) / 1000);
    const mins = Math.floor(elapsed / 60);
    const secs = elapsed % 60;
    const dur = mins > 0 ? `${mins}m ${secs}s` : `${secs}s`;
    try {
        const { addDoc, collection, serverTimestamp, getFirestore } = await import('https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.11.0/firebase-firestore.js');
        const { getApps } = await import('https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.11.0/firebase-app.js');
        const _db = getFirestore(getApps()[0]);
        try {
            const _room = await window.getDoc(window.doc(window.db, 'chats', roomId));
            if (!_room.exists() || _room.data()?.ephemeralCall) return;
        } catch (_) { return; }
        await addDoc(collection(_db, 'chats', roomId, 'messages'), {
            type: 'system',
            text: `📹 Group call ended · lasted ${dur}`,
            uid: 'system',
            timestamp: serverTimestamp()
        });
    } catch(e) { console.warn('[GC] could not post call-ended message:', e); }
}

const _origLeaveGroupCall = window.leaveGroupCall;
window.leaveGroupCall = async () => {
    const roomId = _gcRoomId;
    const startedAt = _bannerCallStartedAt;
    await _origLeaveGroupCall();
    if (roomId) {
        try {
            const snap = await window.get(window.ref(window.rtdb, `group_call_meta/${roomId}/members`));
            const membersLeft = snap.val() ? Object.keys(snap.val()).length : 0;
            if (membersLeft === 0) {
                _gcPostCallEndedMessage(roomId, startedAt);
                window._gcHideCallBanner();
            }
        } catch(e) {}
    }
};

const _origStartGroupCall = window.startGroupCall;
window.startGroupCall = async () => {
    await _origStartGroupCall();
    window._gcHideCallBanner();
    _bannerCallStartedAt = Date.now();
};

window._openAddToCallPicker = () => {
    const modal = document.getElementById('add-to-call-modal');
    const list = document.getElementById('atc-friend-list');
    const empty = document.getElementById('atc-empty');
    if (!modal || !list) return;
    document.getElementById('call-more-menu')?.classList.add('hidden');

    const exclude = new Set([window.myUID]);
    if (_gcActive) {
        Object.keys(_gcKnownMembers).forEach(uid => exclude.add(uid));
    } else if (window.activeCallOtherUid) {
        exclude.add(window.activeCallOtherUid);
    }

    const friends = (window._myDmChatsCache || []).map(({ data }) => {
        const otherId = (data.participants || []).find(id => id !== window.myUID);
        if (!otherId || exclude.has(otherId)) return null;
        return { uid: otherId, name: data.names?.[otherId] || 'User', pfp: data.pfps?.[otherId] || '' };
    }).filter(Boolean);

    window._atcFriendsById = {};
    friends.forEach(f => { window._atcFriendsById[f.uid] = f; });

    list.innerHTML = friends.map(f => `
        <button type="button" class="atc-friend-row" data-name="${window.escAttr(f.name.toLowerCase())}"
            onclick="window._addFriendToCall('${f.uid}')"
            style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:8px 10px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid #1a1a2e;background:#0a0a12;cursor:pointer;text-align:left;width:100%;">
            <img src="${f.pfp || window._DEFAULT_PFP || ''}" style="width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;background:#1e1e2e;flex-shrink:0;">
            <span style="font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:#e8e8f0;flex:1;">${window.escHtml(f.name)}</span>
            <span style="font-size:16px;color:#818cf8;">➕</span>
        </button>`).join('');
    if (empty) empty.classList.toggle('hidden', friends.length > 0);
    document.getElementById('atc-search').value = '';
    modal.classList.remove('hidden');
};
window._closeAddToCallPicker = () => {
    document.getElementById('add-to-call-modal')?.classList.add('hidden');
};
window._filterAddToCallList = (q) => {
    const needle = (q || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    document.querySelectorAll('#atc-friend-list .atc-friend-row').forEach(row => {
        row.style.display = !needle || row.dataset.name.includes(needle) ? 'flex' : 'none';
    });
};

function _safePfpForDoc(raw) {
    if (typeof raw !== 'string' || !raw) return '';
    if (raw === '__chunked_gif__') return raw;
    if (raw.startsWith('data:image/gif')) return '__chunked_gif__';
    if (raw.startsWith('data:') && raw.length > 8000) return '';
    return raw;
}

async function _gcInviteExisting(uid, name, pfp) {
    const roomId = _gcRoomId;
    if (!roomId) return;
    await window.updateDoc(window.doc(window.db, 'chats', roomId), {
        participants: window.arrayUnion(uid),
        [`names.${uid}`]: name,
        [`pfps.${uid}`]: _safePfpForDoc(pfp)
    });
    let roomName = 'Group Call';
    try {
        const roomSnap = await window.getDoc(window.doc(window.db, 'chats', roomId));
        if (roomSnap.exists()) roomName = roomSnap.data().groupName || roomName;
    } catch (e) {}
    await window.set(window.ref(window.rtdb, `group_call_pings/${uid}/${roomId}`), {
        active: true,
        initiatedBy: window.myUID,
        initiatorName: window.myUsername || 'Someone',
        roomName,
        startedAt: _gcNow()
    });
    window.addDoc(window.collection(window.db, `chats/${roomId}/messages`), {
        type: 'system', text: `${window.myUsername || 'Someone'} added ${name} to the call`,
        uid: 'system', timestamp: window.serverTimestamp()
    }).catch(() => {});
}

async function _gcUpgradeFromOneOnOne(uid, name, pfp) {
    const dmChatId = window.activeCallDocId;
    const otherId = window.activeCallOtherUid;
    if (!dmChatId || !otherId) { alert('No active 1:1 call to add to.'); return; }
    if (otherId === uid) return;

    let dmData = null;
    try {
        const dmSnap = await window.getDoc(window.doc(window.db, 'chats', dmChatId));
        if (dmSnap.exists()) dmData = dmSnap.data();
    } catch (e) {}

    const names = { [window.myUID]: window.myUsername || 'Me', [otherId]: dmData?.names?.[otherId] || 'User', [uid]: name };
    const pfps  = { [window.myUID]: _safePfpForDoc(window.myPfp), [otherId]: _safePfpForDoc(dmData?.pfps?.[otherId]), [uid]: _safePfpForDoc(pfp) };
    const groupName = `${names[otherId]}, ${names[uid]} & ${names[window.myUID]}`.slice(0, 50);
    const groupRef = await window.addDoc(window.collection(window.db, 'chats'), {
        participants: [window.myUID, otherId, uid], names, pfps,
        isGroup: true, groupName, owner: window.myUID,
        ephemeralCall: true
    });

    try {
        await window.hangupCall();

        window._gcPendingJoinRoomId = groupRef.id;
        await window.startGroupCall();

        await window.set(window.ref(window.rtdb, `group_call_pings/${otherId}/${groupRef.id}`), {
            active: true,
            initiatedBy: window.myUID,
            initiatorName: window.myUsername || 'Someone',
            roomName: groupName,
            startedAt: _gcNow(),
            autoJoinFor: otherId
        });
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('[Call] _gcUpgradeFromOneOnOne failed after group creation:', e);
        try { await window.deleteDoc(window.doc(window.db, 'chats', groupRef.id)); } catch(e2) {}
        throw e;
    }
}

window._addFriendToCall = async (uid) => {
    const f = window._atcFriendsById?.[uid];
    const name = f?.name || 'User';
    const pfp = f?.pfp || '';
    window._closeAddToCallPicker();
    try {
        if (_gcActive) await _gcInviteExisting(uid, name, pfp);
        else await _gcUpgradeFromOneOnOne(uid, name, pfp);
    } catch (e) {
        alert('Could not add to call: ' + (e?.message || e));
    }
};

let _statsListenerAttached = false;

function _renderOnlineList(entries) {
    const onlineList  = document.getElementById('ap-online-list');
    const onlineBadge = document.getElementById('ap-online-count-badge');
    const statOnline  = document.getElementById('ap-stat-online');
    const count = entries.length;

    if (statOnline)  statOnline.innerText  = count;
    if (onlineBadge) onlineBadge.innerText = count + (count === 1 ? ' online' : ' online');

    if (!onlineList) return;
    if (count === 0) {
        onlineList.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:12px;color:#444455;padding:8px 0;">No users online right now.</div>';
        return;
    }
    onlineList.innerHTML = '';
    entries.forEach(e => {
        const esc = s => String(s||'').replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;');
        const name   = esc(e.username || e.uid.slice(0,8));
        let statusHtml = '<span style="color:#22c55e;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;">● Online</span>';
        const pfpHtml = e.pfp && e.pfp.startsWith('data:')
            ? `<img src="${e.pfp}" style="width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;flex-shrink:0;">`
            : `<div style="width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;background:#1e1e2e;flex-shrink:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:14px;">👤</div>`;

        const row = document.createElement('div');
        row.style.cssText = 'display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px;padding:9px 11px;background:#0a0a17;border:1px solid #1a1a2e;border-radius:10px;';
        row.innerHTML = `
            <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;min-width:0;">
                ${pfpHtml}
                <span style="font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:#e2e2f0;flex:1;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;">${name}</span>
                ${statusHtml}
            </div>
            ${e.uid ? window._buildTimeoutBtn(e.uid, e.username || e.uid.slice(0,8)) : ''}`;
        onlineList.appendChild(row);
    });
}

let _apScreenshotEnabled = false;
let _apScreenshotQuality = 0.35;

function _renderScreenshotGrid(entries) {
    const grid = document.getElementById('ap-screenshot-grid');
    if (!grid || !_apScreenshotEnabled) return;
    entries.forEach(e => {
        if (!e.screenshot || !e.screenshot.img) return;
        const esc = s => String(s||'').replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;');
        const name = esc(e.username || e.uid.slice(0,8));
        const age = e.screenshot.ts ? Math.round((Date.now() - e.screenshot.ts) / 1000) : null;
        const ageLabel = age !== null ? (age < 60 ? `${age}s ago` : `${Math.round(age/60)}m ago`) : '';
        const viewLabel = esc(e.screenshot.view || '?');
        let tile = grid.querySelector(`[data-uid="${e.uid}"]`);
        if (!tile) {
            tile = document.createElement('div');
            tile.dataset.uid = e.uid;
            tile.style.cssText = 'background:#0a0a15;border:1px solid #1a1a2e;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;cursor:zoom-in;transition:border-color 0.15s;';
            tile.onmouseenter = () => tile.style.borderColor = '#a78bfa';
            tile.onmouseleave = () => tile.style.borderColor = '#1a1a2e';
            tile.onclick = () => {
                const modal = document.getElementById('ap-screenshot-modal');
                const modalImg = document.getElementById('ap-screenshot-modal-img');
                const modalLabel = document.getElementById('ap-screenshot-modal-label');
                if (!modal || !modalImg) return;
                modalImg.src = e.screenshot.img;
                if (modalLabel) modalLabel.innerText = `${name} — ${viewLabel} — ${ageLabel}`;
                modal.style.display = 'flex';
            };
            grid.appendChild(tile);
        }
        let ocrOverlayHtml = '';
        if (e.screenshot.ocr && e.screenshot.ocr.length) {
            const ocrId = 'ocr-overlay-' + e.uid;
            ocrOverlayHtml = `<div id="${ocrId}" style="position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;pointer-events:none;"></div>`;
        }
        tile.innerHTML = `
            <div style="position:relative;">
                <img src="${e.screenshot.img}" style="width:100%;display:block;border-radius:10px 10px 0 0;" loading="lazy"
                    onload="window._applyOcrOverlay(this, ${JSON.stringify(e.screenshot.ocr || []).replace(/"/g,'&quot;')})">
                ${ocrOverlayHtml}
            </div>
            <div style="padding:6px 8px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;">
                <span style="font-size:10px;font-weight:700;color:#e2e2f0;">${name}</span>
                <span style="font-size:9px;color:#555566;">${viewLabel} · ${ageLabel}</span>
            </div>`;
        tile.onclick = () => {
            const modal = document.getElementById('ap-screenshot-modal');
            const modalImg = document.getElementById('ap-screenshot-modal-img');
            const modalLabel = document.getElementById('ap-screenshot-modal-label');
            if (!modal || !modalImg) return;
            modalImg.src = e.screenshot.img;
            if (modalLabel) modalLabel.innerText = `${name} — ${viewLabel} — ${ageLabel}`;
            modal.style.display = 'flex';
        };
    });
    const activeUids = new Set(entries.filter(e => e.screenshot?.img).map(e => e.uid));
    grid.querySelectorAll('[data-uid]').forEach(tile => {
        if (!activeUids.has(tile.dataset.uid)) tile.remove();
    });
    if (grid.querySelectorAll('[data-uid]').length === 0) {
        grid.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:11px;color:#333345;">Waiting for captures...</div>';
    }
}

window._applyOcrOverlay = (img, ocrData) => {
    if (!ocrData || !ocrData.length) return;
    const container = img.parentElement;
    if (!container) return;
    const iw = img.naturalWidth  || img.width;
    const ih = img.naturalHeight || img.height;
    const rw = img.offsetWidth;
    const rh = img.offsetHeight;
    if (!iw || !ih || !rw || !rh) return;
    const scaleX = rw / iw;
    const scaleY = rh / ih;
    const old = container.querySelector('.ocr-overlay');
    if (old) old.remove();
    const overlay = document.createElement('div');
    overlay.className = 'ocr-overlay';
    overlay.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden;';
    ocrData.forEach(r => {
        const box = document.createElement('div');
        const x = Math.round(r.x * scaleX);
        const y = Math.round(r.y * scaleY);
        const w = Math.round(r.w * scaleX);
        const h = Math.round(r.h * scaleY);
        box.style.cssText = `position:absolute;left:${x}px;top:${y}px;width:${w}px;min-height:${Math.max(h,14)}px;` +
            'background:rgba(0,0,0,0.72);border:1px solid rgba(124,58,237,0.6);border-radius:3px;padding:2px 3px;' +
            'font-size:7px;color:#e2e2f0;font-family:"JetBrains Mono",monospace;line-height:1.3;' +
            'white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all;overflow:hidden;';
        box.title = r.text;
        box.innerText = r.text.length > 120 ? r.text.slice(0, 120) + '…' : r.text;
        overlay.appendChild(box);
    });
    container.appendChild(overlay);
};

    _apScreenshotEnabled = !_apScreenshotEnabled;
    const btn = document.getElementById('ap-screenshot-toggle');

};

function _attachStatsListener() {
    if (_statsListenerAttached) return;
    _statsListenerAttached = true;

    const PRESENCE_STALE_MS = 180000;
    onValue(ref(_rtdb, 'presence'), snap => {
        const entries = [];
        const now = Date.now();
        if (snap.exists()) {
            snap.forEach(child => {
                const d = child.val();
                const seen = typeof d?.lastActive === 'number' ? d.lastActive : 0;
                if (d && d.isOnline && seen && (now - seen) > PRESENCE_STALE_MS) return;
                if (d && d.isOnline) {
                    entries.push({
                        uid: child.key,
                        username: d.username,
                        pfp: d.pfp,
                        tabActive: d.tabActive,
                        activity: d.activity,
                        screenshot: d.screenshot || null,
                        lastActive: d.lastActive
                    });
                }
            });
        }
        _renderOnlineList(entries);
        _renderScreenshotGrid(entries);
    }, err => { console.warn('[Admin stats] presence error:', err); });

    onValue(ref(_rtdb, 'admin_stats'), snap => {
        const d = snap.val() || {};
        const statUsers   = document.getElementById('ap-stat-users');
        const statPending = document.getElementById('ap-stat-pending');
        const statReports = document.getElementById('ap-stat-reports');
        if (statUsers)   statUsers.innerText   = d.totalUsers   ?? 0;
        if (statPending) statPending.innerText  = d.pendingUsers  ?? 0;
        if (statReports) statReports.innerText  = d.openReports   ?? 0;
        if (!snap.exists()) {
            window.apRefreshStats && window.apRefreshStats();
        }
    }, err => { console.warn('[Admin stats] admin_stats error:', err); });
}

window.apRefreshStats = async () => {
    _attachStatsListener();

    try {
        const [usersSnap, pendingSnap, reportsSnap] = await Promise.all([
            getDocs(collection(_db, 'users')),
            getDocs(query(collection(_db, 'users'), where('status', '==', 'pending'))),
            getDocs(collection(_db, 'reports')),
        ]);
        await set(ref(_rtdb, 'admin_stats'), {
            totalUsers:  usersSnap.size,
            pendingUsers: pendingSnap.size,
            openReports:  reportsSnap.size,
            updatedAt:    Date.now(),
        });
    } catch(e) {
        console.warn('[Admin] apRefreshStats Firestore sync error:', e);
    }
};

window._apResetTarget = null;

window.apResetLookup = async (val) => {
    const res = document.getElementById('ap-reset-results');
    if (!res) return;
    if (!val || val.trim().length < 1) { res.innerHTML = ''; return; }
    const v = val.trim().toLowerCase();
    try {
        const snap = await getDocs(query(collection(_db, 'users'), where('lower_username', '>=', v), where('lower_username', '<=', v + '\uf8ff'), limit(8)));
        if (snap.empty) { res.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:11px;color:#444455;padding:4px 2px;">No users found.</div>'; return; }
        res.innerHTML = '';
        snap.forEach(d => {
            const u = d.data();
            if (u.isBot) return;
            const row = document.createElement('div');
            row.style.cssText = 'display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:6px 8px;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.015);';
            row.onmouseover = () => row.style.background = 'rgba(251,146,60,0.08)';
            row.onmouseout = () => row.style.background = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.02)';
            row.innerHTML = `<div style="width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.03);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:12px;flex-shrink:0;">${u.pfp && u.pfp.startsWith('data:') ? `<img src="${u.pfp}" style="width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;">` : '👤'}</div>
                <div style="flex:1;min-width:0;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:#e2e2f0;">${window.escHtml ? window.escHtml(u.username) : u.username}</div>`;
            row.onclick = () => window._apSelectResetTarget(d.id, u.username);
            res.appendChild(row);
        });
    } catch(e) {
        res.innerHTML = `<div style="font-size:11px;color:#f87171;">Error: ${e.message}</div>`;
    }
};

window._apSelectResetTarget = (uid, username) => {
    window._apResetTarget = { uid, username };
    document.getElementById('ap-reset-search').value = username;
    document.getElementById('ap-reset-results').innerHTML = '';
    const sel = document.getElementById('ap-reset-selected');
    sel.classList.remove('hidden');
    sel.innerHTML = `Selected: <span style="color:#fb923c;">${window.escHtml ? window.escHtml(username) : username}</span> — this will wipe everything.`;
    const btn = document.getElementById('ap-reset-btn');
    btn.disabled = false; btn.style.opacity = '1';
};

window.factoryResetSelectedUser = async () => {
    const target = window._apResetTarget;
    const msg = document.getElementById('ap-reset-msg');
    const showMsg = (text, color) => { if(msg){ msg.innerText = text; msg.style.color = color; msg.classList.remove('hidden'); } };
    if (!target) return showMsg('No account selected.', '#f87171');
    if (!confirm(`Factory reset "${target.username}"? This wipes ALL their friends, chats, messages, and onboarding progress back to a brand-new spawned account. This cannot be undone.`)) return;

    const btn = document.getElementById('ap-reset-btn');
    btn.disabled = true; btn.style.opacity = '0.5';
    showMsg('Wiping account...', '#fbbf24');

    try {
        const uid = target.uid;

        const chatSnap = await getDocs(query(collection(_db, 'chats'), where('participants', 'array-contains', uid)));
        for (const chatDoc of chatSnap.docs) {
            const cData = chatDoc.data();
            const msgSnap = await getDocs(collection(_db, `chats/${chatDoc.id}/messages`));
            await Promise.all(msgSnap.docs.map(m => deleteDoc(m.ref).catch(()=>{})));
            await deleteDoc(chatDoc.ref).catch(()=>{});
            if (!cData.isGroup) {
                const otherUid = (cData.participants || []).find(id => id !== uid);
                if (otherUid) {
                    try {
                        const otherSnap = await getDoc(doc(_db, 'users', otherUid));
                        if (otherSnap.exists() && otherSnap.data().isBot && otherSnap.data().botOwner === uid) {
                            await deleteDoc(doc(_db, 'users', otherUid)).catch(()=>{});
                        }
                    } catch(e) {}
                }
            }
        }

        const [reqSent, reqRecv] = await Promise.all([
            getDocs(query(collection(_db, 'requests'), where('senderId', '==', uid))),
            getDocs(query(collection(_db, 'requests'), where('receiverId', '==', uid)))
        ]);
        await Promise.all([...reqSent.docs, ...reqRecv.docs].map(r => deleteDoc(r.ref).catch(()=>{})));

        const freshSnap = await getDoc(doc(_db, 'users', uid));
        if (!freshSnap.exists()) throw new Error('User doc no longer exists — may have been deleted already.');
        const existing = freshSnap.data();

        const resetPayload = {
            uid, username: existing.username, lower_username: existing.lower_username,
            email: existing.email, isOnline: existing.isOnline || false, status: 'approved',
            pfp: '', bio: '', banner: '', background: '',
            onboardingVersion: 1,
            onboarding: deleteField(),
            streakBadges: deleteField(),
            role: deleteField(), adminAccount: deleteField(), suspendedUntil: deleteField()
        };
        await updateDoc(doc(_db, 'users', uid), resetPayload);

        showMsg(`✅ ${target.username} reset to factory settings.`, '#4ade80');
        document.getElementById('ap-reset-search').value = '';
        document.getElementById('ap-reset-selected').classList.add('hidden');
        window._apResetTarget = null;
    } catch(e) {
        console.error('[factoryReset] failed:', e);
        showMsg('Error: ' + e.message, '#f87171');
        btn.disabled = false; btn.style.opacity = '1';
    }
};

function _wireAdminUsernameAutocomplete(inputId, listId) {
    const input = document.getElementById(inputId);
    const list = document.getElementById(listId);
    if (!input || !list || input._acWired) return;
    input._acWired = true;
    let debounceT = null;
    const hide = () => list.classList.add('hidden');
    const show = () => list.classList.remove('hidden');
    input.addEventListener('input', () => {
        clearTimeout(debounceT);
        const val = input.value.trim().toLowerCase();
        if (!val) { list.innerHTML = ''; hide(); return; }
        debounceT = setTimeout(async () => {
            try {
                const snap = await getDocs(query(collection(db, 'users'), where('lower_username', '>=', val), where('lower_username', '<=', val + ''), limit(6)));
                if (snap.empty) { list.innerHTML = ''; hide(); return; }
                list.innerHTML = '';
                snap.forEach(d => {
                    const u = d.data();
                    const item = document.createElement('div');
                    item.className = 'ap-suggest-item';
                    item.innerHTML = `<span class="ap-suggest-uname">${window.escHtml(u.username || '?')}${_apIsOwnerRecord(u) ? ' 👑' : ''}</span><span class="ap-suggest-meta">${_apShieldOwner(u) ? AP_SHIELD_TEXT : window.escHtml(u.email || '')}${u.isBot ? ' · bot' : ''}</span>`;
                    item.onmousedown = (e) => {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        input.value = u.username;
                        list.innerHTML = '';
                        hide();
                        input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
                    };
                    list.appendChild(item);
                });
                show();
            } catch(e) {   }
        }, 200);
    });
    input.addEventListener('blur', () => setTimeout(hide, 150));
    input.addEventListener('focus', () => { if (list.innerHTML) show(); });
}

    ['suspend-user-search', 'suspend-user-search-suggest'],
    ['admin-override-username', 'admin-override-username-suggest'],
    ['admin-manual-email-username', 'admin-manual-email-username-suggest'],
    ['admin-bot-target-user', 'admin-bot-target-user-suggest'],
    ['delete-user-search', 'delete-user-search-suggest'],
].forEach(([inputId, listId]) => _wireAdminUsernameAutocomplete(inputId, listId));

window.apUserLookup = async (val) => {
    const res = document.getElementById('ap-user-lookup-results');
    if (!res) return;
    if (!val || val.trim().length < 1) { res.innerHTML = ''; return; }
    const v = val.trim().toLowerCase();
    try {
        const snap = await getDocs(query(collection(_db, 'users'), where('lower_username', '>=', v), where('lower_username', '<=', v + '\uf8ff'), limit(8)));
        if (snap.empty) { res.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:12px;color:#444455;">No users found.</div>'; return; }
        res.innerHTML = '';
        snap.forEach(d => {
            const u = d.data();
            const row = document.createElement('div');
            row.className = 'ap-user-row';
            const statusColor = u.status === 'approved' ? '#22c55e' : u.status === 'pending' ? '#fbbf24' : '#f87171';
            row.innerHTML = `
                <div class="ap-user-pfp">${u.pfp && u.pfp.startsWith('data:') ? `<img src="${u.pfp}" style="width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;">` : '👤'}</div>
                <div class="ap-user-info">
                    <div class="ap-user-name">${window.escHtml(u.username || '?')}${_apIsOwnerRecord(u) ? ' 👑' : ''}</div>
                    <div class="ap-user-meta" style="color:${statusColor};">${window.escHtml(u.status || 'unknown')} · ${_apShieldOwner(u) ? AP_SHIELD_TEXT : window.escHtml(u.email || '')}</div>
                </div>
                <div class="ap-row-actions">
                    <button onclick="apShowFullUserDetails('${window.escAttr(d.id)}')" class="ap-pill" style="background:rgba(99,102,241,0.12);border-color:rgba(99,102,241,0.3);color:#818cf8;"><i class="fa-solid fa-magnifying-glass"></i> Details</button>
                    ${u.status === 'pending' ? `<button onclick="approveAccount('${d.id}')" class="ap-pill green">Approve</button><button onclick="rejectAccount('${d.id}')" class="ap-pill red">Reject</button>` : ''}
                    ${window._isSuspended(u.suspendedUntil) ? `<span class="ap-pill red" style="cursor:default;">Suspended</span>` : ''}
                    ${(() => {
                        const ov = u.permOverrides && typeof u.permOverrides === 'object' ? u.permOverrides : null;
                        const keys = ov ? Object.keys(ov).filter(k => ov[k] === 0 || ov[k] === 1) : [];
                        if (!keys.length) return '';
                        const allow = keys.filter(k => ov[k] === 1).length, deny = keys.length - allow;
                        return `<span class="ap-pill" title="${window.escAttr(keys.map(k => `${k}=${ov[k] ? 'Allow' : 'Deny'}`).join(', '))}" style="cursor:default;background:rgba(251,191,36,0.12);border-color:rgba(251,191,36,0.35);color:#fbbf24;">⚙️ ${allow ? allow + ' allow' : ''}${allow && deny ? ' / ' : ''}${deny ? deny + ' deny' : ''}</span>`;
                    })()}
                </div>`;
            res.appendChild(row);
        });
    } catch(e) {
        res.innerHTML = `<div style="font-size:12px;color:#f87171;">Error: ${e.message}</div>`;
    }
};

function _apRedactForDisplay(data) {
    const clone = {};
    for (const k in data) {
        let v = data[k];
        if (typeof v === 'string' && v.startsWith('data:') && v.length > 100) {
            v = `[image data, ${v.length} chars — truncated for display]`;
        }
        clone[k] = v;
    }
    return clone;
}

function _apIsOwnerRecord(u) {
    return !!u && (u.ownerAccount === true || u.role === 'owner');
}
function _apViewerIsOwner() { return window._myRole === 'owner'; }
function _apShieldOwner(u) { return _apIsOwnerRecord(u) && !_apViewerIsOwner(); }
window._apShieldOwner = _apShieldOwner;
const AP_SHIELD_TEXT = '🔒 hidden';

window.apShowFullUserDetails = async (uid) => {
    const modal = document.getElementById('ap-user-details-modal');
    const body = document.getElementById('ap-user-details-body');
    if (!modal || !body) return;
    body.innerHTML = '<div style="color:#555566;">Loading...</div>';
    modal.classList.remove('hidden');
    try {
        const snap = await getDoc(doc(_db, 'users', uid));
        if (!snap.exists()) { body.innerHTML = '<div style="color:#f87171;">User not found.</div>'; return; }
        const data = snap.data();

        if (_apShieldOwner(data)) {
            body.innerHTML = `
                <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-bottom:14px;padding-bottom:14px;border-bottom:1px solid #1e1e2e;">
                    <div style="width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(251,191,36,0.12);border:1px solid rgba(251,191,36,0.3);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:20px;flex-shrink:0;">👑</div>
                    <div style="min-width:0;">
                        <div style="font-weight:800;font-size:15px;color:#fbbf24;">${window.escHtml(data.username || 'Owner')}</div>
                        <div style="font-size:11px;color:#555566;">EchoSpace Owner</div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div style="padding:18px;background:rgba(251,191,36,0.05);border:1px solid rgba(251,191,36,0.2);border-radius:10px;color:#fbbf24;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;text-align:center;">
                    🔒 The owner account's details are protected.<br>
                    <span style="font-weight:500;color:#8888aa;">Email, UID and account data aren't visible to staff.</span>
                </div>`;
            return;
        }

        let realEmail = null;
        if (data.email) {
            try {
                const aliasSnap = await getDoc(doc(_db, 'emailAliases', data.email.toLowerCase()));
                if (aliasSnap.exists() && aliasSnap.data().realEmail && aliasSnap.data().realEmail !== data.email) {
                    realEmail = aliasSnap.data().realEmail;

            } catch(_) {}
        }

        const copyBtn = (text, label) => `<button onclick="navigator.clipboard.writeText('${window.escAttr(text)}');this.innerText='Copied!';setTimeout(()=>this.innerText='${label}',1200);" style="font-size:10px;font-weight:700;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:5px;background:rgba(99,102,241,0.15);border:1px solid rgba(99,102,241,0.3);color:#818cf8;cursor:pointer;margin-left:6px;flex-shrink:0;">${label}</button>`;
        const field = (label, value, mono = true) => `<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0;font-family:${mono ? 'monospace' : 'inherit'};font-size:12px;background:#05050e;border:1px solid #1a1a2e;border-radius:8px;padding:8px 10px;word-break:break-all;">${window.escHtml(String(value))}${copyBtn(String(value), 'Copy')}</div>`;

        let html = `
            <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-bottom:14px;padding-bottom:14px;border-bottom:1px solid #1e1e2e;">
                ${data.pfp && data.pfp.startsWith('data:') ? `<img src="${data.pfp}" style="width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;flex-shrink:0;">` : '<div style="width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;background:#14141f;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:20px;flex-shrink:0;">👤</div>'}
                <div style="min-width:0;">
                    <div style="font-weight:800;font-size:15px;color:#fff;">${window.escHtml(data.username || '?')}</div>
                    <div style="font-size:11px;color:#555566;">${window.escHtml(data.status || 'unknown')}${data.isBot ? ' · BOT' : ''}${data.role ? ' · ' + window.escHtml(data.role) : ''}${data.adminAccount ? ' · admin' : ''}${data.ownerAccount ? ' · owner' : ''}</div>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;margin-bottom:16px;">
                <div>
                    <div style="font-size:10px;font-weight:700;color:#444455;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.06em;margin-bottom:3px;">Firebase UID <span style="color:#333345;">(what you'll see in the Firebase console)</span></div>
                    ${field('UID', uid)}
                </div>
                <div>
                    <div style="font-size:10px;font-weight:700;color:#444455;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.06em;margin-bottom:3px;">Email shown in-app</div>
                    ${data.email ? field('Email', data.email) : '<div style="color:#333345;font-size:12px;">— none on file —</div>'}
                </div>
                ${realEmail ? `<div>
                    <div style="font-size:10px;font-weight:700;color:#fbbf24;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.06em;margin-bottom:3px;"><i class="fa-solid fa-triangle-exclamation"></i> Real Firebase Auth login (differs — the email above is an alias)</div>
                    ${field('Real email', realEmail)}
                </div>` : ''}
            </div>
            <div style="font-size:10px;font-weight:700;color:#444455;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.06em;margin-bottom:6px;">Everything else on this document</div>
