window.apModSuspend = async () => {
    const username = (document.getElementById('ap-mod-user')?.value || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const dur = parseInt(document.getElementById('ap-mod-dur')?.value || '7');
    const unit = document.getElementById('ap-mod-unit')?.value || 'd';
    const msg = document.getElementById('ap-mod-status');
    if (!username) { if(msg){msg.innerText='Enter a username.';msg.className='text-red-500 text-xs font-bold';msg.classList.remove('hidden');} return; }
    const mult = unit === 'h' ? 3600000 : unit === 'd' ? 86400000 : 604800000;
    try {
        const snap = await getDocs(query(collection(_db, 'users'), where('lower_username', '==', username)));
        if (snap.empty) { if(msg){msg.innerText='User not found.';msg.className='text-red-500 text-xs font-bold';msg.classList.remove('hidden');} return; }
        const suspendUntil = new Date(Date.now() + dur * mult);
        await window._staffGuard(snap.docs[0].data());
        await updateDoc(doc(_db, 'users', snap.docs[0].id), { suspendedUntil: suspendUntil });
        window.logAdminAction && window.logAdminAction('suspend_user', { target: snap.docs[0].data().username, duration: `${dur}${unit}`, until: suspendUntil.toLocaleString() });
        if(msg){msg.innerText=`Suspended until ${suspendUntil.toLocaleString()}`;msg.className='text-green-500 text-xs font-bold';msg.classList.remove('hidden');}
        window.apRefreshMod && window.apRefreshMod();
    } catch(e) { if(msg){msg.innerText='Error: '+e.message;msg.className='text-red-500 text-xs font-bold';msg.classList.remove('hidden');} }
};

window.apModLiftSuspension = async () => {
    const username = (document.getElementById('ap-mod-user')?.value || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const msg = document.getElementById('ap-mod-status');
    if (!username) { if(msg){msg.innerText='Enter a username.';msg.className='text-red-500 text-xs font-bold';msg.classList.remove('hidden');} return; }
    try {
        const snap = await getDocs(query(collection(_db, 'users'), where('lower_username', '==', username)));
        if (snap.empty) { if(msg){msg.innerText='User not found.';msg.className='text-red-500 text-xs font-bold';msg.classList.remove('hidden');} return; }
        await window._staffGuard(snap.docs[0].data());
        await updateDoc(doc(_db, 'users', snap.docs[0].id), { suspendedUntil: null });
        window.logAdminAction && window.logAdminAction('lift_suspension', { target: snap.docs[0].data().username });
        if(msg){msg.innerText='Suspension lifted.';msg.className='text-green-500 text-xs font-bold';msg.classList.remove('hidden');}
        window.apRefreshMod && window.apRefreshMod();
    } catch(e) { if(msg){msg.innerText='Error: '+e.message;msg.className='text-red-500 text-xs font-bold';msg.classList.remove('hidden');} }
};

const _apBanMsg = (text, ok) => {
    const el = document.getElementById('ap-ban-status');
    if (!el) return;
    el.innerText = text;
    el.className = (ok ? 'text-green-500' : 'text-red-500') + ' text-xs font-bold';
    el.classList.remove('hidden');
};

window.apModBan = async () => {
    const username = (document.getElementById('ap-ban-user')?.value || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const reason   = (document.getElementById('ap-ban-reason')?.value || '').trim();
    if (!username) { _apBanMsg('Enter a username.', false); return; }
    try {
        const snap = await getDocs(query(collection(_db, 'users'), where('lower_username', '==', username)));
        if (snap.empty) { _apBanMsg('User not found.', false); return; }
        const target = snap.docs[0];
        const u = target.data();
        if (u.ownerAccount === true || u.role === 'owner') { _apBanMsg('You cannot ban the owner account.', false); return; }
        await window._staffGuard(u);
        if (target.id === window.myUID) { _apBanMsg("That's you.", false); return; }
        if (!confirm(`Ban ${u.username}? They will be unable to log in until unbanned.`)) return;
        await updateDoc(doc(_db, 'users', target.id), {
            status:    'banned',
            role:      'banned',
            prevRole:  (u.role && u.role !== 'banned') ? u.role : 'member',
            banReason: reason,
            bannedAt:  serverTimestamp(),
            bannedBy:  window.myUsername || 'Owner'
        });
        window.logAdminAction && window.logAdminAction('ban_user', { target: u.username, reason });
        _apBanMsg(`✓ ${u.username} banned.`, true);
        document.getElementById('ap-ban-user').value = '';
        document.getElementById('ap-ban-reason').value = '';
        window.apRefreshBannedList && window.apRefreshBannedList();
    } catch(e) { _apBanMsg('Error: ' + (e.code || e.message), false); }
};

window.apModUnban = async (usernameArg) => {
    const username = (usernameArg || document.getElementById('ap-ban-user')?.value || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!username) { _apBanMsg('Enter a username.', false); return; }
    try {
        const snap = await getDocs(query(collection(_db, 'users'), where('lower_username', '==', username)));
        if (snap.empty) { _apBanMsg('User not found.', false); return; }
        const target = snap.docs[0];
        const u = target.data();
        const restored = u.prevRole && u.prevRole !== 'banned' ? u.prevRole : 'member';
        await updateDoc(doc(_db, 'users', target.id), {
            status:    'approved',
            role:      restored,
            prevRole:  deleteField(),
            banReason: deleteField(),
            bannedAt:  deleteField(),
            bannedBy:  deleteField()
        });
        window.logAdminAction && window.logAdminAction('unban_user', { target: u.username, restoredRole: restored });
        _apBanMsg(`✓ ${u.username} unbanned — role restored to ${restored}.`, true);
        if (document.getElementById('ap-ban-user')) document.getElementById('ap-ban-user').value = '';
        window.apRefreshBannedList && window.apRefreshBannedList();
    } catch(e) { _apBanMsg('Error: ' + (e.code || e.message), false); }
};

window.apModDeviceBan = async () => {
    const username = (document.getElementById('ap-ban-user')?.value || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const reason   = (document.getElementById('ap-ban-reason')?.value || '').trim();
    if (!username) { _apBanMsg('Enter a username.', false); return; }
    try {
        const snap = await getDocs(query(collection(_db, 'users'), where('lower_username', '==', username)));
        if (snap.empty) { _apBanMsg('User not found.', false); return; }
        const target = snap.docs[0];
        const u = target.data();
        if (u.ownerAccount === true || u.role === 'owner') { _apBanMsg('You cannot ban the owner account.', false); return; }
        await window._staffGuard(u);
        if (target.id === window.myUID) { _apBanMsg("That's you.", false); return; }
        const tokens = Array.isArray(u.deviceTokens) ? u.deviceTokens : [];
        if (!tokens.length) {
            _apBanMsg('No devices on record for that account yet — they must log in once first. Use a normal Ban for now.', false);
            return;
        }
        if (!confirm(`Device ban ${u.username}?\n\nBans the account AND blocks ${tokens.length} device token(s). Anyone using those browsers cannot log in or make new accounts.`)) return;
        await updateDoc(doc(_db, 'users', target.id), {
            status:      'banned',
            role:        'banned',
            prevRole:    (u.role && u.role !== 'banned') ? u.role : 'member',
            banReason:   reason,
            deviceBanned: true,
            bannedAt:    serverTimestamp(),
            bannedBy:    window.myUsername || 'Owner'
        });
        await Promise.all(tokens.map(t => setDoc(doc(_db, 'bannedDevices', t), {
            reason,
            username:  u.username || '',
            uid:       target.id,
            bannedAt:  serverTimestamp(),
            bannedBy:  window.myUsername || 'Owner'
        })));
        window.logAdminAction && window.logAdminAction('device_ban_user', { target: u.username, reason, devices: tokens.length });
        _apBanMsg(`✓ ${u.username} banned and ${tokens.length} device(s) blocked.`, true);
        document.getElementById('ap-ban-user').value = '';
        document.getElementById('ap-ban-reason').value = '';
        window.apRefreshBannedList && window.apRefreshBannedList();
        window.apRefreshBlockedDevices && window.apRefreshBlockedDevices();
    } catch(e) { _apBanMsg('Error: ' + (e.code || e.message), false); }
};

window.apUnblockDevice = async (token) => {
    if (!token) return;
    if (!confirm(`Unblock device ${token}?`)) return;
    try {
        await deleteDoc(doc(_db, 'bannedDevices', token));
        window.logAdminAction && window.logAdminAction('device_unblock', { token });
        _apBanMsg(`✓ Device ${token} unblocked.`, true);
        window.apRefreshBlockedDevices && window.apRefreshBlockedDevices();
    } catch(e) { _apBanMsg('Error: ' + (e.code || e.message), false); }
};

window.apRefreshBlockedDevices = async () => {
    const box = document.getElementById('ap-blocked-devices');
    if (!box) return;
    try {
        const snap = await getDocs(collection(_db, 'bannedDevices'));
        if (snap.empty) { box.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:12px;color:#444455;">No blocked devices.</div>'; return; }
        box.innerHTML = '';
        snap.docs.forEach(d => {
            const v = d.data();
            const when = v.bannedAt?.toDate ? v.bannedAt.toDate().toLocaleDateString() : '';
            const kind = d.id.startsWith('fp_') ? 'hardware' : 'browser';
            const row = document.createElement('div');
            row.className = 'ap-user-row';
            row.innerHTML = `<div class="ap-user-info">
                    <div class="ap-user-name">${window.escHtml(v.username || 'unknown')} · <span style="font-family:monospace;font-size:10px;color:#666677;">${window.escHtml(d.id)}</span></div>
                    <div class="ap-user-meta">${kind}${v.reason ? ' · ' + window.escHtml(v.reason) : ''}${when ? ' · ' + when : ''}</div>
                </div>
                <button class="ap-pill green" style="font-size:10px;">Unblock</button>`;
            row.querySelector('button').addEventListener('click', () => window.apUnblockDevice(d.id));
            box.appendChild(row);
        });
    } catch(e) { box.innerHTML = `<div style="font-size:12px;color:#f87171;">Error: ${window.escHtml(e.code || e.message)}</div>`; }
};

window.apRefreshBannedList = async () => {
    const box = document.getElementById('ap-banned-list');
    if (!box) return;
    try {
        const snap = await getDocs(collection(_db, 'users'));
        const banned = snap.docs.filter(d => { const u = d.data(); return u.status === 'banned' || u.role === 'banned'; });
        if (!banned.length) { box.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:12px;color:#444455;">No banned accounts.</div>'; return; }
        box.innerHTML = '';
        banned.forEach(d => {
            const u = d.data();
            const row = document.createElement('div');
            row.className = 'ap-user-row';
            const when = u.bannedAt?.toDate ? u.bannedAt.toDate().toLocaleDateString() : '';
            row.innerHTML = `<div class="ap-user-info">
                    <div class="ap-user-name">${window.escHtml(u.username || d.id)}</div>
                    <div class="ap-user-meta">${window.escHtml(u.banReason || 'No reason given')}${when ? ' · ' + when : ''}${u.prevRole ? ' · was ' + window.escHtml(u.prevRole) : ''}</div>
                </div>
                <button class="ap-pill green" style="font-size:10px;">Unban</button>`;
            row.querySelector('button').addEventListener('click', () => window.apModUnban(u.lower_username || u.username));
            box.appendChild(row);
        });
    } catch(e) { box.innerHTML = `<div style="font-size:12px;color:#f87171;">Error: ${window.escHtml(e.code || e.message)}</div>`; }
};

window.apRefreshMod = async () => {
    window.apRefreshBannedList();
    window.apRefreshBlockedDevices();
    const repList = document.getElementById('ap-mod-reports-list');
    const modBadge = document.getElementById('ap-mod-badge');
    if (!window._apModReportsListening) {
        window._apModReportsListening = true;
        onSnapshot(
            query(collection(_db, 'reports'), orderBy('timestamp', 'desc')),
            (snap) => {
                if (modBadge) { modBadge.innerText = snap.size; modBadge.style.display = snap.size > 0 ? 'inline-block' : 'none'; }
                window._adminCounts.reports = snap.size;
                _updateAdminIndicator();
                const el = document.getElementById('ap-mod-reports-list');
                if (!el) return;
                el.innerHTML = snap.empty ? '<div style="font-size:12px;color:#444455;">No reports.</div>' : '';
                snap.forEach(d => {
                    const r = d.data();
                    const row = document.createElement('div');
                    row.className = 'ap-report-row';
                    const attachedHtml = window._reportEvidenceHtml(r, 'mod-' + d.id);
                    row.innerHTML = `<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;">
                        <div><span style="font-weight:700;color:#f87171;">${window.escHtml?window.escHtml(r.reporterName||'?'):r.reporterName||'?'}</span> <span style="color:#555566;font-size:11px;">reported</span> <span style="font-weight:700;color:#fbbf24;">${window.escHtml?window.escHtml(r.targetName||'?'):r.targetName||'?'}</span></div>
                        <div style="display:flex;gap:6px;">
                            <button onclick="window.suspendUser&&(document.getElementById('suspend-user-search').value='${r.targetName||''}',window.apSwitchTab('users',document.querySelectorAll('.ap-tab')[1]))" class="ap-pill yellow">Suspend</button>
                            <button onclick="window.dismissReport('${d.id}')" class="ap-pill ghost">Dismiss</button>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    ${r.reason ? `<div style="font-size:11px;color:#666680;margin-top:4px;">${window.escHtml?window.escHtml(r.reason):r.reason}</div>` : ''}
                    ${attachedHtml}`;
                    el.appendChild(row);
                });
            },
            (e) => { if(repList) repList.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:12px;color:#f87171;">Error loading reports.</div>'; }
        );
    }

    const suspList = document.getElementById('ap-suspended-list');
    try {
        const now = new Date();
        const snap = await getDocs(collection(_db, 'users'));
        const suspended = snap.docs.filter(d => {
            const until = d.data().suspendedUntil;
            if (!until) return false;
            const date = until.toDate ? until.toDate() : new Date(until);
            return date > now;
        });
        if (suspList) {
            suspList.innerHTML = suspended.length === 0 ? '<div style="font-size:12px;color:#444455;">No suspended users.</div>' : '';
            suspended.forEach(d => {
                const u = d.data();
                const until = u.suspendedUntil?.toDate ? u.suspendedUntil.toDate() : new Date(u.suspendedUntil);
                const row = document.createElement('div');
                row.className = 'ap-user-row';
                row.innerHTML = `<div class="ap-user-info"><div class="ap-user-name">${window.escHtml?window.escHtml(u.username):u.username}</div><div class="ap-user-meta">Until: ${until.toLocaleString()}</div></div>
                    <button onclick="document.getElementById('ap-mod-user').value='${u.lower_username||u.username}';window.apModLiftSuspension()" class="ap-pill green">Lift</button>`;
                suspList.appendChild(row);
            });
        }
    } catch(e) { if(suspList) suspList.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:12px;color:#f87171;">Error.</div>'; }

    const violList = document.getElementById('ap-live-violations-list');
    try {
        const vSnap = await getDocs(query(collection(_db, 'live_violations'), orderBy('createdAt', 'desc'), limit(50)));
        if (violList) {
            if (vSnap.empty) {
                violList.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:12px;color:#444455;">No violations logged.</div>';
            } else {
                violList.innerHTML = '';
                vSnap.forEach(d => {
                    const v = d.data();
                    const timeStr = v.createdAt?.toDate
                        ? v.createdAt.toDate().toLocaleString([], { month:'short', day:'numeric', hour:'2-digit', minute:'2-digit' })
                        : '';
                    const row = document.createElement('div');
                    row.style.cssText = 'background:rgba(251,146,60,0.08);border:1px solid rgba(251,146,60,0.25);border-radius:8px;padding:9px 11px;font-size:11px;';
                    row.innerHTML = `
                        <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px;margin-bottom:5px;">
                            <span style="font-weight:800;color:#fb923c;">🎙️ ${window.escHtml ? window.escHtml(v.username||'Unknown') : (v.username||'Unknown')}</span>
                            <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;">
                                <span style="color:#444455;font-size:10px;">${timeStr}</span>
                                ${v.uid ? window._buildTimeoutBtn(v.uid, v.username||'Unknown') : ''}
                                <button onclick="window.apDeleteLiveViolation('${d.id}')" style="font-size:10px;color:#333345;background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;font-weight:700;" onmouseover="this.style.color='#888899'" onmouseout="this.style.color='#333345'">✕</button>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div>Said <strong style="color:#fde68a;">"${window.escHtml ? window.escHtml(v.flaggedWord||'') : (v.flaggedWord||'')}"</strong> — violates EchoSpace rules</div>
                        ${v.transcript ? `<div style="color:#666680;margin-top:4px;font-style:italic;">"${window.escHtml ? window.escHtml(v.transcript.slice(0,200)) : v.transcript.slice(0,200)}"</div>` : ''}`;
                    violList.appendChild(row);
                });
            }
        }
    } catch(e) { if (violList) violList.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:12px;color:#f87171;">Error loading violations.</div>'; }
};

    window.apRefreshMod && window.apRefreshMod();

window.apClearLiveViolations = async () => {
    if (!confirm('Clear all live stream speech violations?')) return;

        const snap = await getDocs(collection(_db, 'live_violations'));

    } catch(e) { alert('Clear failed: ' + e.message); }
};

function _apFmtDuration(totalSeconds) {
    const h = Math.floor(totalSeconds / 3600);
    const m = Math.floor((totalSeconds % 3600) / 60);
    const s = totalSeconds % 60;
    const parts = [];
    if (h) parts.push(`${h}h`);
    if (m) parts.push(`${m}m`);
    if (s || parts.length === 0) parts.push(`${s}s`);
    return parts.join(' ');
}
window.apTimeoutUser = async (uid, username, durationSeconds) => {
    if (!uid || !durationSeconds) return;
    const until = new Date(Date.now() + durationSeconds * 1000);
    try {
        const snap = await getDocs(query(collection(_db, 'users'), where('uid', '==', uid)));
        let userRef = null;
        if (!snap.empty) {
            userRef = snap.docs[0].ref;
        } else {
            userRef = doc(_db, 'users', uid);
        }
        await window._staffGuard(snap.empty ? uid : snap.docs[0].data());
        await updateDoc(userRef, { timedOutUntil: until });
        const label = _apFmtDuration(durationSeconds);
        window.logAdminAction && window.logAdminAction('timeout_user', { target: username, duration: label, until: until.toLocaleString(), _quiet: true });
        window._adminToast(`${username} timed out for ${label}. Takes effect immediately.`,
            { icon: '⏱️', color: '#fb923c' });
        window.apRefreshMod && window.apRefreshMod();
    } catch(e) {
        alert('Timeout failed: ' + e.message);
    }
};

window.apRemoveTimeout = async (uid, username) => {
    if (!uid) return;
    try {
        const snap = await getDocs(query(collection(_db, 'users'), where('uid', '==', uid)));
        const userRef = !snap.empty ? snap.docs[0].ref : doc(_db, 'users', uid);
        await updateDoc(userRef, { timedOutUntil: deleteField() });
        window.logAdminAction && window.logAdminAction('remove_timeout', { target: username, _quiet: true });
        window._adminToast(`${username}'s timeout removed. They can chat again immediately.`,
            { icon: '✅', color: '#22c55e' });
        window.apRefreshMod && window.apRefreshMod();
    } catch(e) {
        alert('Remove timeout failed: ' + e.message);
    }
};

window._apResolveTimeoutSeconds = (uid) => {
    const safeUid = String(uid||'').replace(/'/g,"\\'");
    const sel = document.getElementById(`to-sel-${safeUid}`);
    const presetVal = sel ? parseInt(sel.value) : 0;
    if (presetVal > 0) return presetVal;
    const mins = parseInt(document.getElementById(`to-min-${safeUid}`)?.value) || 0;
    const secs = parseInt(document.getElementById(`to-sec-${safeUid}`)?.value) || 0;
    return mins * 60 + secs;
};

    const field = 'background:#0a0a15;border:1px solid #2a2a3a;color:#e8e8f0;font-size:10px;border-radius:6px;padding:3px 5px;';

        <select id="to-sel-${safeUid}" onchange="document.getElementById('to-custom-${safeUid}').style.display = this.value==='0' ? 'inline-flex' : 'none';" style="${field}cursor:pointer;">
            <option value="900">15 min</option>
            <option value="300">5 min</option>
            <option value="1800">30 min</option>
            <option value="3600">1 hr</option>
            <option value="7200">2 hr</option>
            <option value="86400">24 hr</option>
            <option value="604800">7 days</option>
            <option value="0">Custom…</option>
        </select>
        <span id="to-custom-${safeUid}" style="display:none;align-items:center;gap:3px;">
            <input type="number" id="to-min-${safeUid}" min="0" placeholder="min" style="width:44px;${field}">
            <input type="number" id="to-sec-${safeUid}" min="0" max="59" placeholder="sec" style="width:42px;${field}">

window.apWipeGlobalChat = async () => {
    const status = document.getElementById('ap-wipe-gc-status');
    if (!confirm('Wipe ALL Global Chat messages? This cannot be undone.')) return;
    if (!confirm('Are you absolutely sure? This deletes every message permanently.')) return;
    try {
        if(status){status.innerText='Wiping...';status.className='text-yellow-500 text-xs font-bold';status.classList.remove('hidden');}
        const snap = await getDocs(collection(_db, 'global_chat'));
        const batchSize = 499;
        for (let i = 0; i < snap.docs.length; i += batchSize) {
            const b = writeBatch(_db);
            snap.docs.slice(i, i + batchSize).forEach(d => b.delete(d.ref));
            await b.commit();
        }
        window.logAdminAction('wipe_global_chat', { messagesDeleted: snap.size });
        if(status){status.innerText=`Wiped ${snap.size} messages.`;status.className='text-green-500 text-xs font-bold';}
    } catch(e) { if(status){status.innerText='Error: '+e.message;status.className='text-red-500 text-xs font-bold';} }
};

window.apCleanStalePresence = async () => {
    const status = document.getElementById('ap-presence-status');
    try {
        if(status){status.innerText='Scanning...';status.className='text-yellow-500 text-xs font-bold';status.classList.remove('hidden');}
        const snap = await get(ref(_rtdb, 'presence'));
        const cutoff = Date.now() - 15 * 60 * 1000;
        let cleaned = 0;
        if (snap.exists()) {
            const promises = [];
            snap.forEach(child => {
                const data = child.val();
                const lastActive = typeof data?.lastActive === 'number' ? data.lastActive : 0;
                if (!data?.isOnline && lastActive > 0 && lastActive < cutoff) {
                    promises.push(remove(ref(_rtdb, `presence/${child.key}`)));
                    cleaned++;
                }
            });
            await Promise.all(promises);
        }
        if(status){status.innerText=`Cleaned ${cleaned} stale entries.`;status.className='text-green-500 text-xs font-bold';}
        setTimeout(() => status && status.classList.add('hidden'), 4000);
    } catch(e) { if(status){status.innerText='Error: '+e.message;status.className='text-red-500 text-xs font-bold';} }
};

(function() {

    function buildNode(key, value, depth) {
        const isObj = value !== null && typeof value === 'object';
        const wrapper = document.createElement('div');
        wrapper.style.cssText = 'padding-left:' + (depth > 0 ? 16 : 0) + 'px;';

        if (isObj) {
            const keys = Object.keys(value);
            const count = keys.length;

            const header = document.createElement('div');
            header.style.cssText = 'display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;cursor:pointer;user-select:none;padding:1px 0;';
            header.innerHTML =
                '<span class="rtdb-arrow" style="color:#4f46e5;font-size:10px;transition:transform 0.15s;display:inline-block;width:12px;">▶</span>' +
                '<span style="color:#818cf8;font-weight:700;">' + escRtdb(key) + '</span>' +
                '<span style="color:#2a2a45;font-size:10px;margin-left:4px;">{' + count + '}</span>';

            const children = document.createElement('div');
            children.style.cssText = 'border-left:1px solid #1a1a2e;margin-left:5px;padding-left:2px;';
            let open = depth < 2;

            function setOpen(v) {
                open = v;
                const arrow = header.querySelector('.rtdb-arrow');
                arrow.style.transform = open ? 'rotate(90deg)' : '';
                children.style.display = open ? '' : 'none';
            }
            setOpen(open);

            header.addEventListener('click', () => setOpen(!open));

            keys.forEach(k => children.appendChild(buildNode(k, value[k], depth + 1)));
            wrapper.appendChild(header);
            wrapper.appendChild(children);

        } else {
            const row = document.createElement('div');
            row.style.cssText = 'display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:6px;padding:1px 0;';
            const valColor = typeof value === 'string' ? '#a3e635'
                           : typeof value === 'number' ? '#fb923c'
                           : typeof value === 'boolean' ? '#38bdf8'
                           : '#888899';
            const valStr = typeof value === 'string' ? '"' + escRtdb(String(value)) + '"' : escRtdb(String(value));
            row.innerHTML =
                '<span style="width:12px;flex-shrink:0;"></span>' +
                '<span style="color:#818cf8;font-weight:600;">' + escRtdb(key) + '</span>' +
                '<span style="color:#2a2a45;">:</span>' +
                '<span style="color:' + valColor + ';word-break:break-all;">' + valStr + '</span>';
            wrapper.appendChild(row);
        }
        return wrapper;
    }

    function escRtdb(s) {
        return String(s).replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;');
    }

    window.apRtdbCollapseAll = () => {
        document.querySelectorAll('#ap-rtdb-result .rtdb-arrow').forEach(arrow => {
            const header = arrow.closest('div[style*="cursor:pointer"]');
            if (!header) return;
            const children = header.nextElementSibling;
            if (children) { children.style.display = 'none'; arrow.style.transform = ''; }
        });
    };

    window.apRtdbRead = async () => {
        const result = document.getElementById('ap-rtdb-result');
        const status = document.getElementById('ap-rtdb-status');
        const colBtn = document.getElementById('ap-rtdb-collapse-btn');
        if (!result) return;

        result.style.display = 'block';
        result.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#4f46e5;animation:pulse 1s infinite;">⟳ Loading RTDB...</span>';
        if (status) { status.style.display = 'none'; }

        try {
            const snap = await get(ref(_rtdb, '/'));
            if (!snap.exists()) {
                result.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#444455;">(no data in RTDB)</span>';
                if (colBtn) colBtn.style.display = 'none';
                return;
            }
            const data = snap.val();
            result.innerHTML = '';

            const rootKeys = Object.keys(data);
            rootKeys.forEach(k => result.appendChild(buildNode(k, data[k], 0)));

            if (colBtn) colBtn.style.display = '';
            if (status) {
                const totalKeys = rootKeys.length;
                status.textContent = '✓ Loaded ' + totalKeys + ' root key' + (totalKeys !== 1 ? 's' : '');
                status.style.display = 'block';
            }
        } catch(e) {
            result.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#f87171;">Error: ' + escRtdb(e.message) + '</span>';
            if (colBtn) colBtn.style.display = 'none';
        }
    };

    window.apRtdbDelete = async () => {
        const path = (document.getElementById('ap-rtdb-path')?.value || '').trim();
        const status = document.getElementById('ap-rtdb-status');
        if (!path) { alert('Enter a path in the field to delete.'); return; }
        if (!confirm('Delete RTDB path: "' + path + '"?')) return;
        try {
            await remove(ref(_rtdb, path));
            if (status) { status.textContent = 'Deleted: ' + path; status.style.display = 'block'; }
            window.apRtdbRead();
        } catch(e) {
            if (status) { status.textContent = 'Error: ' + e.message; status.style.display = 'block'; }
        }
    };

})();

window.apPurgeOldReports = async () => {
    const status = document.getElementById('ap-danger-status');
    const rawDays = parseInt(document.getElementById('ap-purge-days')?.value || '30', 10);
    const days = Number.isFinite(rawDays) ? Math.min(3650, Math.max(1, rawDays)) : 30;
    const dLabel = `${days} day${days > 1 ? 's' : ''}`;
    if (!confirm(`Purge all reports older than ${dLabel}? This permanently deletes them and cannot be undone.`)) return;
    if (!confirm('Are you absolutely sure? Reports newer than the window are kept; everything older is gone for good.')) return;
    try {
        if(status){status.innerText='Scanning reports...';status.className='text-yellow-500 text-xs font-bold';status.classList.remove('hidden');}
        const cutoff = Date.now() - days * 86400000;
        const snap = await getDocs(collection(_db, 'reports'));

        const doomed = snap.docs.filter(d => {
            const ts = d.data().timestamp?.toDate?.();
            return ts instanceof Date && ts.getTime() < cutoff;
        });
        const kept = snap.size - doomed.length;

        if (doomed.length === 0) {
            if(status){status.innerText=`No reports older than ${dLabel}. (${kept} kept)`;status.className='text-green-500 text-xs font-bold';}
            setTimeout(() => status && status.classList.add('hidden'), 4000);
            return;
        }

        const batchSize = 499;
        for (let i = 0; i < doomed.length; i += batchSize) {
            const b = writeBatch(_db);
            doomed.slice(i, i + batchSize).forEach(d => b.delete(d.ref));
            await b.commit();
        }

        window.logAdminAction && window.logAdminAction('purge_reports', { olderThanDays: days, deleted: doomed.length, kept });
        if(status){status.innerText=`Purged ${doomed.length} report${doomed.length>1?'s':''} older than ${dLabel} (${kept} kept).`;status.className='text-green-500 text-xs font-bold';}
        setTimeout(() => status && status.classList.add('hidden'), 5000);
    } catch(e) { if(status){status.innerText='Error: '+e.message;status.className='text-red-500 text-xs font-bold';status.classList.remove('hidden');} }
};

window.apPurgeStaleCallDocs = async () => {
    const status = document.getElementById('ap-danger-status');
    if (!confirm('Purge stale call documents (older than 1 hour)?')) return;
    try {
        const cutoff = new Date(Date.now() - 3600000);
        const snap = await getDocs(collection(_db, 'calls'));
        let count = 0;
        const b = writeBatch(_db);
        snap.docs.forEach(d => {
            const ts = d.data().createdAt?.toDate?.();
            if (!ts || ts < cutoff) { b.delete(d.ref); count++; }
        });
        await b.commit();
        if(status){status.innerText=`Purged ${count} stale call docs.`;status.className='text-green-500 text-xs font-bold';status.classList.remove('hidden');}
        setTimeout(() => status && status.classList.add('hidden'), 4000);
    } catch(e) { if(status){status.innerText='Error: '+e.message;status.className='text-red-500 text-xs font-bold';status.classList.remove('hidden');} }
};

    document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {

window._spectateRefresh = async () => {
    const grid = document.getElementById('spectate-grid');
    if (!grid) return;
    grid.innerHTML = '<div style="color:#333345;font-size:13px;grid-column:1/-1;text-align:center;padding:40px;">Collecting profiles...</div>';

    try {
        const snap = await get(ref(rtdb, 'presence'));
        if (!snap.exists()) { grid.innerHTML = '<div style="color:#333345;font-size:13px;text-align:center;padding:40px;grid-column:1/-1;">No active users.</div>'; return; }
        const entries = [];
        snap.forEach(child => {
            const d = child.val();
            if (d) entries.push({ uid: child.key, ...d });
        });
        if (!entries.length) { grid.innerHTML = '<div style="color:#333345;font-size:13px;text-align:center;padding:40px;grid-column:1/-1;">No users found.</div>'; return; }

        const profiles = await Promise.all(entries.map(async e => {
            try {
                const uSnap = await getDoc(doc(db, 'users', e.uid));
                return { ...e, firestoreData: uSnap.exists() ? uSnap.data() : {} };
            } catch(_) { return { ...e, firestoreData: {} }; }
        }));

        grid.innerHTML = '';
        profiles.forEach(p => {
            const fd = p.firestoreData || {};
            const name = fd.username || p.username || p.uid.slice(0,8);
            const email = fd.email || '—';
            const joined = fd.createdAt?.toDate ? fd.createdAt.toDate().toLocaleDateString() : '—';
            const isOnline = p.isOnline === true;
            const lastActive = p.lastActive ? new Date(p.lastActive).toLocaleString() : '—';
            const activity = p.activity || '—';
            const tabActive = isOnline ? 'Online' : 'Offline';
            const session = p.session || '—';
            const pfp = fd.pfp && !fd.pfp.startsWith('__') ? fd.pfp : '';
            const isAdminUser = fd.adminAccount === true;
            const isSuspended = window._isSuspended(fd.suspendedUntil);
            const followers = fd.followersCount || 0;
            const following = fd.followingCount || 0;
            const status = fd.customStatus || '';
            const view = p.currentView || '—';

            const onlineDot = isOnline
                ? '<span style="display:inline-block;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#22c55e;margin-right:5px;box-shadow:0 0 6px #22c55e;"></span>'
                : '<span style="display:inline-block;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#444455;margin-right:5px;"></span>';

            const pfpHtml = pfp
                ? `<img src="${pfp}" style="width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;border:2px solid #1e1e2e;flex-shrink:0;">`
                : `<div style="width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;background:#1e1e2e;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:20px;flex-shrink:0;">👤</div>`;

            const adminTag = isAdminUser ? '<span class="spectate-tag" style="background:rgba(239,68,68,0.15);color:#f87171;border:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,0.3);">Admin</span>' : '';
            const suspTag = isSuspended ? '<span class="spectate-tag" style="background:rgba(249,115,22,0.15);color:#fb923c;border:1px solid rgba(249,115,22,0.3);">Suspended</span>' : '';

            const card = document.createElement('div');
            card.className = 'spectate-card';
            card.innerHTML = `
                <div style="display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;margin-bottom:14px;">
                    ${pfpHtml}
                    <div style="flex:1;min-width:0;">
                        <div style="font-size:14px;font-weight:900;color:#e2e2f0;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;">
                            ${onlineDot}${_escHtml(name)}${adminTag}${suspTag}
                        </div>
                        <div style="font-size:11px;color:#555566;margin-top:2px;">${_escHtml(email)}</div>
                        ${status ? `<div style="font-size:11px;color:#818cf8;margin-top:3px;font-style:italic;">"${_escHtml(status)}"</div>` : ''}
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:6px;font-size:11px;">
                    ${_sRow('📅 Joined', joined)}
                    ${_sRow('⏱ Last Active', lastActive)}
                    ${_sRow('📍 Current View', view)}
                    ${_sRow('🖥 Tab Status', tabActive)}
                    ${_sRow('🎯 Activity', activity)}
                    ${_sRow('🔑 Session ID', session.slice(0,12) + (session.length > 12 ? '…' : ''))}
                    ${_sRow('👥 Followers', followers)}
                    ${_sRow('➕ Following', following)}
                    ${_sRow('🆔 UID', p.uid.slice(0,16) + '…')}
                </div>
                <div style="margin-top:10px;display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;">
                    <button onclick="window.apForceViewUser('${p.uid}')" style="background:rgba(99,102,241,0.12);border:1px solid rgba(99,102,241,0.25);color:#818cf8;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;"><i class="fa-solid fa-thumbtack"></i> Force Tab</button>
                    <button onclick="window.apOpenUserDM('${p.uid}','${_escAttr(name)}')" style="background:rgba(34,197,94,0.1);border:1px solid rgba(34,197,94,0.2);color:#22c55e;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;"><i class="fa-solid fa-comment-dots"></i> DM</button>
                </div>`;
            grid.appendChild(card);
        });
    } catch(e) {
        grid.innerHTML = `<div style="color:#f87171;font-size:13px;text-align:center;padding:40px;grid-column:1/-1;">Error: ${e.message}</div>`;
    }
};

function _escHtml(s) { return String(s||'').replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;'); }
function _escAttr(s) { return String(s||'').replace(/"/g,'&quot;'); }
function _sRow(label, val) {
    return `<div style="background:#05050e;border:1px solid #0f0f1a;border-radius:7px;padding:6px 8px;">
        <div style="color:#333345;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0.08em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:2px;">${label}</div>
        <div style="color:#c8c8d8;font-weight:600;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;">${_escHtml(String(val))}</div>
    </div>`;
}

window.apOpenUserDM = async (uid, name) => {
    document.getElementById('spectate-panel').classList.remove('open');

    try {
        const _chatData = {
            participants: [window.myUID, uid],
            names: { [window.myUID]: window.myUsername, [uid]: name },
            pfps: { [window.myUID]: window.myPfp || '', [uid]: '' },
            isGroup: false, lastActivity: serverTimestamp()
        };
        await setDoc(doc(db, 'chats', cid), _chatData, { merge: true });
        window.openChat && window.openChat(cid, _chatData, name);
        window.switchView && window.switchView('chat');
    } catch(e) {}
};

window._stBuildNav = () => {
    const view = document.getElementById('view-settings');
    const nav  = document.getElementById('st-nav');
    if (!view || !nav) return;
    const labels = [...view.querySelectorAll('.st-section-label')];
    if (!labels.length) return;

    const signature = labels.map(l => l.textContent.trim()).join('|');
    if (nav.dataset.sig === signature) return;
    nav.dataset.sig = signature;
    nav.innerHTML = '';

    labels.forEach((label, i) => {
        if (!label.id) label.id = 'st-sec-' + i + '-' + label.textContent.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-');
        const btn = document.createElement('button');
        btn.type = 'button';
        btn.textContent = label.textContent.trim();
        btn.dataset.target = label.id;
        btn.onclick = () => label.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
        nav.appendChild(btn);
    });

    if (nav._spy) nav._spy.disconnect();
    const scroller = view.classList.contains('scroll-view') ? view : (view.querySelector('.scroll-view') || null);

    let activeId = null;
    const setActive = (id) => {
        if (id === activeId) return;
        activeId = id;
        let target = null;
        nav.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(b => {
            const on = b.dataset.target === id;
            b.classList.toggle('active', on);
            if (on) target = b;
        });
        if (target && nav.scrollWidth > nav.clientWidth) {
            nav.scrollTo({ left: target.offsetLeft - (nav.clientWidth - target.offsetWidth) / 2, behavior: 'smooth' });
        }
    };

    nav._spy = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
        const visible = entries.filter(e => e.isIntersecting);
        if (!visible.length) return;
        visible.sort((a, b) => a.boundingClientRect.top - b.boundingClientRect.top);
        setActive(visible[0].target.id);
    }, { root: scroller, rootMargin: '-120px 0px -70% 0px', threshold: 0 });
    labels.forEach(l => nav._spy.observe(l));

    if (scroller && !scroller._stScrollBound) {
        scroller._stScrollBound = true;
        let idle = null;
        scroller.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
            if (!idle) scroller.classList.add('st-scrolling');
            clearTimeout(idle);
            idle = setTimeout(() => { idle = null; scroller.classList.remove('st-scrolling'); }, 140);
        }, { passive: true });
    }
};

window.filterSettings = (query, alsoClearInput) => {
    const input = document.getElementById('settings-search');
    if (alsoClearInput && input) { input.value = ''; query = ''; input.focus(); }

    const view = document.getElementById('view-settings');
    if (!view) return;
    const wrap = view.querySelector('.p-6');
    if (!wrap) return;

    const q = (query || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const field = view.querySelector('.st-search');
    if (field) field.classList.toggle('has-query', !!q);
    wrap.classList.toggle('st-searching', !!q);

    let currentLabel = null;
    let labelHasHit = false;
    let anyHit = false;

    const flushLabel = () => { if (currentLabel) currentLabel.classList.toggle('hidden', !labelHasHit); };

    for (const el of wrap.children) {
        if (el.classList.contains('st-section-label')) {
            flushLabel();
            currentLabel = el;
            labelHasHit = false;
            continue;
        }
        if (!el.classList.contains('st-card')) continue;
        if (el.dataset.stHiddenByOwner === undefined) {
            el.dataset.stHiddenByOwner = el.classList.contains('hidden') ? '1' : '0';
        }
        if (el.dataset.stHiddenByOwner === '1') { el.classList.add('hidden'); continue; }

        const hit = !q || (el.innerText || '').toLowerCase().includes(q);
        el.classList.toggle('hidden', !hit);
        if (hit) { labelHasHit = true; anyHit = true; }
    }
    flushLabel();

    const none = document.getElementById('settings-no-results');
    if (none) none.classList.toggle('hidden', !q || anyHit);
};
