window.apShowRoleCfg = (role, tabEl) => {
    _cfgActiveRole = role;
    document.querySelectorAll('.role-cfg-tab').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
    if (tabEl) tabEl.classList.add('active');

    const isOwner = role === 'owner';
    const perms = _getPermsForRole(role);
    const meta = ROLE_META[role] || { emoji: '?', label: role, color: '#888899' };
    const content = document.getElementById('role-cfg-content');
    if (!content) return;

    if (isOwner) {
        content.innerHTML = `<div style="text-align:center;padding:20px;color:#fbbf24;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;"><i class="fa-solid fa-crown"></i> Owner has all permissions by default and cannot be configured.</div>`;
        return;
    }

    let html = `<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-bottom:16px;padding:12px 14px;background:rgba(${_hexToRgbStr(meta.color)},0.06);border:1px solid rgba(${_hexToRgbStr(meta.color)},0.2);border-radius:10px;">
        <span style="font-size:20px;color:${meta.color};">${window.roleIconHtml(role) || meta.emoji}</span>
        <div>
            <div style="font-size:14px;font-weight:900;color:${meta.color};">${meta.label}</div>
            <div style="font-size:11px;color:#555566;">Configure what this role can see and do. Changes saved per-role.</div>
        </div>
    </div>`;

    if (role === 'muted' || role === 'banned') {
        html += `<div style="padding:14px;background:rgba(239,68,68,0.06);border:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,0.15);border-radius:10px;color:#f87171;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
            ${role === 'muted' ? '🔇 Muted users can view chats but cannot send messages, go live, or interact.' : '🚫 Banned users cannot access EchoSpace at all. Set via user status = banned.'}
        </div>`;
        content.innerHTML = html;
        return;
    }

    for (const [sectionKey, section] of Object.entries(ALL_PERMISSIONS)) {
        html += `<div class="perm-section"><div class="perm-section-title"><span>${section.icon}</span> ${section.label}</div><div class="perm-grid">`;
        for (const [permKey, permMeta] of Object.entries(section.perms)) {
            const checked = perms[permKey] ? 'checked' : '';
            html += `<label class="perm-item">
                <input type="checkbox" id="perm-${role}-${permKey}" ${checked} data-role="${role}" data-perm="${permKey}">
                <div><div class="perm-item-label">${permMeta.label}</div><div class="perm-item-sub">${permMeta.sub}</div></div>
            </label>`;
        }
        html += `</div></div>`;
    }
    content.innerHTML = html;
};

window.apSaveRoleConfig = async () => {
    const role = _cfgActiveRole;
    if (role === 'owner') return;
    const msgEl = document.getElementById('ap-role-cfg-save-msg');
    if (_roleConfigIsFallback) {
        if (msgEl) { msgEl.innerText = "Couldn't read the saved role config — refusing to save so the stored settings aren't overwritten with defaults. Reload and try again."; msgEl.className = 'text-red-400 text-xs font-bold mt-3'; msgEl.classList.remove('hidden'); }
        return;
    }
    const newPerms = {};
    document.querySelectorAll(`input[data-role="${role}"]`).forEach(cb => {
        newPerms[cb.dataset.perm] = cb.checked ? 1 : 0;
    });
    if (!_roleConfig[role]) _roleConfig[role] = {};
    _roleConfig[role].permissions = newPerms;
    try {
        await setDoc(doc(db, 'site_config', 'roles'), { [role]: _roleConfig[role] }, { merge: true });
        const msg = document.getElementById('ap-role-cfg-save-msg');
        if (msg) { msg.innerText = `✓ ${ROLE_META[role]?.label || role} permissions saved.`; msg.classList.remove('hidden'); setTimeout(() => msg.classList.add('hidden'), 2500); }
    } catch(e) {
        const msg = document.getElementById('ap-role-cfg-save-msg');
        if (msg) { msg.innerText = 'Save failed: ' + e.message; msg.className = 'text-red-400 text-xs font-bold mt-3'; msg.classList.remove('hidden'); }
    }
};

window.apLoadRoleHolders = async () => {
    const list = document.getElementById('ap-role-holders-list');
    if (!list) return;
    list.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:12px;color:#444455;">Loading...</div>';
    try {
        const snap = await getDocs(collection(db, 'users'));
        const special = snap.docs.filter(d => {
            const r = d.data().role;
            return r && r !== 'member' && r !== '';
        });
        if (special.length === 0) {
            list.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:12px;color:#444455;">No users with special roles.</div>';
            return;
        }
        special.sort((a, b) => {
            const ra = ROLE_META[a.data().role]?.rank || 0;
            const rb = ROLE_META[b.data().role]?.rank || 0;
            return rb - ra;
        });
        list.innerHTML = '';
        special.forEach(d => {
            const u = d.data();
            const role = u.role || 'member';
            const meta = ROLE_META[role];
            const row = document.createElement('div');
            row.className = 'ap-user-row';
            row.innerHTML = `
                <div class="ap-user-pfp">${u.pfp && u.pfp.startsWith('data:') ? `<img src="${u.pfp}" style="width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;">` : (meta?.emoji||'👤')}</div>
                <div class="ap-user-info">
                    <div class="ap-user-name" style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;">${window.escHtml(u.username||'?')} <span class="role-badge ${role}">${meta?.emoji||''} ${meta?.label||role}</span></div>
                    <div class="ap-user-meta">${_apShieldOwner(u) ? AP_SHIELD_TEXT : window.escHtml(u.email||u.lower_username||'')}</div>
                </div>
                <button onclick="window._apRevokeRole('${d.id}','${window.escAttr(u.username)}')" class="ap-pill red" style="font-size:10px;">Revoke</button>`;
            list.appendChild(row);
        });
    } catch(e) {
        list.innerHTML = `<div style="font-size:12px;color:#f87171;">Error: ${e.message}</div>`;
    }
};

window._apRevokeRole = async (uid, username) => {
    if (!confirm(`Revoke role from ${username}? They will be set to ✨ Member.`)) return;
    try {
        await window._staffGuard(uid);
        await updateDoc(doc(db, 'users', uid), { role: 'member', roleChangedAt: serverTimestamp() });
        window.apLoadRoleHolders && window.apLoadRoleHolders();
    } catch(e) { alert('Error: ' + e.message); }
};

async function _applyModAction(actionType, targetUid, targetUsername, reason, extra, actorName) {
    const _db = window.db || db;
    const durationHours = Number(extra?.durationHours) > 0 ? Number(extra.durationHours) : 24;

    const uSnap = targetUsername
        ? await getDocs(query(collection(_db, 'users'), where('lower_username', '==', targetUsername.toLowerCase())))
        : { empty: true, docs: [] };
    const uRef = !uSnap.empty ? uSnap.docs[0].ref : (targetUid ? doc(_db, 'users', targetUid) : null);
    if (!uRef) throw new Error(`Could not find the account for "${targetUsername || targetUid}" — nothing was changed.`);
    const prev = !uSnap.empty ? uSnap.docs[0].data() : (targetUid ? ((await getDoc(uRef).catch(() => null))?.data() || {}) : {});
    await window._staffGuard(prev);

    if (actionType === 'ban') {
        await updateDoc(uRef, {
            status: 'banned', role: 'banned',
            prevRole: (prev.role && prev.role !== 'banned') ? prev.role : 'member',
            banReason: reason || '', bannedAt: serverTimestamp(),
            bannedBy: actorName || 'Staff'
        });
    } else if (actionType === 'suspend') {
        await updateDoc(uRef, { suspendedUntil: new Date(Date.now() + durationHours * 3600000) });
    } else if (actionType === 'mute') {
        await updateDoc(uRef, { timedOutUntil: new Date(Date.now() + durationHours * 3600000) });
    } else {
        throw new Error('That action still needs owner approval.');
    }
}

const _DIRECT_MOD_ACTIONS = ['mute', 'suspend', 'ban'];
function _canModerateDirectly(actionType) {
    if (!_DIRECT_MOD_ACTIONS.includes(actionType)) return false;
    if (!window._hasPerm?.('canModerateDirectly')) return false;
    const need = { mute: 'canMuteUsers', suspend: 'canSuspendUsers', ban: 'canBanUsers' }[actionType];
    return !!window._hasPerm?.(need);
}
window._canModerateDirectly = _canModerateDirectly;

async function _submitPendingAction(actionType, targetUid, targetUsername, reason, extra) {
    const _db = window.db || db;

    if (_canModerateDirectly(actionType)) {
        try {
            await _applyModAction(actionType, targetUid, targetUsername, reason, extra, window.myUsername);
            await addDoc(collection(_db, 'site_config', 'pending_actions', 'queue'), {
                actionType, targetUid, targetUsername,
                reason: reason || '', ...(extra || {}),
                requesterUid: window.myUID, requesterName: window.myUsername,
                requesterRole: window._myRole || _myRole,
                timestamp: serverTimestamp(),
                status: 'approved', direct: true,
                resolvedAt: serverTimestamp(),
                resolvedBy: window.myUsername || 'Staff'
            }).catch(() => {});
            window.logAdminAction?.('direct_' + actionType, { target: targetUsername, reason: reason || '' });
            _lastPendingActionError = null;
            return 'direct';
        } catch (e) {
            _lastPendingActionError = e;
            return false;
        }
    }

    try {
        await addDoc(collection(_db, 'site_config', 'pending_actions', 'queue'), {
            actionType,
            targetUid,
            targetUsername,
            reason: reason || '',
            ...(extra || {}),
            requesterUid:  window.myUID,
            requesterName: window.myUsername,
            requesterRole: window._myRole || _myRole,
            timestamp: serverTimestamp(),
            status: 'pending'
        });
        if (window.isAdmin) _refreshPendingBadge();
        return true;
    } catch(e) {
        console.warn('[Roles] submitPendingAction failed:', e);
        _lastPendingActionError = e;
        return false;
    }
}
let _lastPendingActionError = null;
window._pendingActionErrorText = () => {
    const e = _lastPendingActionError;
    if (!e) return 'Failed to submit.';
    if (e.code === 'permission-denied') return 'Failed to submit: the database rejected the write (permission-denied). This is a Firestore rules issue, not your role — tell the Owner.';
    return 'Failed to submit: ' + (e.code || e.message);
};
window._submitPendingAction = _submitPendingAction;

async function _refreshPendingBadge() {
    const _db = window.db || db;
    try {
        const snap = await getDocs(query(collection(_db, 'site_config', 'pending_actions', 'queue'), where('status', '==', 'pending')));
        const count = snap.size;
        const badge = document.getElementById('ap-pending-badge');
        if (badge) { badge.innerText = count; badge.style.display = count > 0 ? 'inline-block' : 'none'; }
        const statPending = document.getElementById('ap-stat-pending');
        if (statPending) statPending.innerText = count;
        _renderPendingActions(snap.docs);
    } catch(e) {}
}
window._refreshPendingBadge = _refreshPendingBadge;

function _renderPendingActions(docs) {
    const list = document.getElementById('ap-pending-list');
    if (!list) return;
    const countLabel = document.getElementById('ap-pending-count-label');
    if (countLabel) countLabel.innerText = docs.length + ' pending';
    if (docs.length === 0) {
        list.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:12px;color:#444455;">No pending actions.</div>';
        return;
    }
    list.innerHTML = '';
    docs.forEach(d => {
        const a = d.data();
        const typeClass = a.actionType === 'delete' ? 'delete' : a.actionType === 'ban' ? 'ban' : 'mute';
        const typeLabel = { ban: '🚫 Ban', delete: '💀 Delete Account', suspend: '⏳ Suspend', mute: '🔇 Mute', broadcast: '📡 Broadcast' }[a.actionType] || a.actionType;
        const card = document.createElement('div');
        card.className = 'pending-action-card';
        const targetLine = a.actionType === 'broadcast'
            ? `<div class="pa-target">Message: <em style="color:#c8c8d8;">"${window.escHtml(a.broadcastText||'')}"</em></div>`
            : `<div class="pa-target">Target: ${window.escHtml(a.targetUsername||a.targetUid||'?')}${a.durationLabel ? ` <span style="color:#8888aa;">· for ${window.escHtml(a.durationLabel)}</span>` : ''}</div>`;
        card.innerHTML = `
            <div class="pa-header">
                <span class="pa-type ${typeClass}">${typeLabel}</span>
                <span class="pa-requester">Requested by <strong>${window.escHtml(a.requesterName||'?')}</strong> (${window.escHtml(a.requesterRole||'?')})</span>
            </div>
            ${targetLine}
            ${a.reason ? `<div class="pa-reason">"${window.escHtml(a.reason)}"</div>` : ''}
            <div class="pa-actions">
                <button class="pa-approve btn-primary" style="font-size:12px;padding:7px 16px;">✓ Approve</button>
                <button class="pa-deny btn-danger" style="font-size:12px;padding:7px 16px;">✕ Deny</button>
            </div>`;
        card.querySelector('.pa-approve').addEventListener('click', () => window._approvePendingAction(d.id, a));
        card.querySelector('.pa-deny').addEventListener('click',    () => window._denyPendingAction(d.id, a.requesterName || ''));
        list.appendChild(card);
    });
}

window._approvePendingAction = async (docId, action) => {
    const a = action || {};
    const actionType     = a.actionType;
    const targetUid      = a.targetUid || '';
    const targetUsername = a.targetUsername || '';
    const requesterName  = a.requesterName || '';
    const broadcastText  = a.broadcastText || '';
    const durationHours  = Number(a.durationHours) > 0 ? Number(a.durationHours) : 24;
    const durLabel       = a.durationLabel || (durationHours < 24 ? durationHours + 'h' : (durationHours / 24) + 'd');
    const confirmDetail  = (actionType === 'suspend' || actionType === 'mute') ? ` for ${durLabel}` : '';
    if (!confirm(`Approve ${actionType} action${targetUsername ? ' for ' + targetUsername : ''}${confirmDetail}? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
    const _db = window.db || db;
    try {
        if (actionType === 'broadcast') {
            await addDoc(collection(_db, 'system_announcements'), {
                message:     broadcastText || '',
                sentBy:      requesterName || 'Staff',
                active:      true,
                aiChecked:   true,
                ownerApproved: true,
                timestamp:   serverTimestamp()
            });
        } else {
            const uSnap = targetUsername
                ? await getDocs(query(collection(_db, 'users'), where('lower_username', '==', targetUsername.toLowerCase())))
                : { empty: true, docs: [] };
            const uRef = !uSnap.empty ? uSnap.docs[0].ref : (targetUid ? doc(_db, 'users', targetUid) : null);
            if (!uRef) { alert(`Could not find the account for "${targetUsername || targetUid || 'that request'}" — nothing was changed. Leaving the request pending.`); return; }
            const prev = !uSnap.empty ? uSnap.docs[0].data() : {};
            if (window._isStaffData(prev) && !window._iAmSiteOwner()) { alert('Only the owner can act on a staff account. Leaving the request pending.'); return; }
            if (actionType === 'ban') {
                await updateDoc(uRef, {
                    status:    'banned',
                    role:      'banned',
                    prevRole:  (prev.role && prev.role !== 'banned') ? prev.role : 'member',
                    banReason: a.reason || '',
                    bannedAt:  serverTimestamp(),
                    bannedBy:  requesterName || 'Staff'
                });
            } else if (actionType === 'delete') {
                await deleteDoc(uRef);
            } else if (actionType === 'suspend') {
                await updateDoc(uRef, { suspendedUntil: new Date(Date.now() + durationHours * 3600000) });
            } else if (actionType === 'mute') {
                await updateDoc(uRef, { timedOutUntil: new Date(Date.now() + durationHours * 3600000) });
            }
        }
        await updateDoc(doc(_db, 'site_config', 'pending_actions', 'queue', docId), {
            status: 'approved', resolvedAt: serverTimestamp(),
            resolvedBy: window.myUsername || 'Owner', seenByRequester: false
        });
        _refreshPendingBadge();
    } catch(e) { alert('Approve failed: ' + e.message); }
};

window._denyPendingAction = async (docId, requesterName) => {
    const reason = prompt(`Reason for denying (optional, ${requesterName} will see this):`);
    if (reason === null) return;
    const _db = window.db || db;
    try {
        await updateDoc(doc(_db, 'site_config', 'pending_actions', 'queue', docId), {
            status: 'denied',
            denyReason: reason || '',
            resolvedAt: serverTimestamp(),
            resolvedBy: window.myUsername || 'Owner',
            seenByRequester: false
        });
        _refreshPendingBadge();
    } catch(e) { alert('Deny failed: ' + e.message); }
};

function _startMyRequestOutcomeListener() {
    if (!window.myUID || window.isAdmin) return;
    if (window._myRequestOutcomeBound) return;
    window._myRequestOutcomeBound = true;
    const _db = window.db || db;
    try {
        onSnapshot(
            query(collection(_db, 'site_config', 'pending_actions', 'queue'), where('requesterUid', '==', window.myUID)),
            (snap) => {
                snap.docChanges().forEach(change => {
                    if (change.type === 'removed') return;
                    const a = change.doc.data();
                    if (a.status !== 'approved' && a.status !== 'denied') return;
                    if (a.seenByRequester) return;
                    const what = a.actionType === 'broadcast'
                        ? 'broadcast'
                        : `${a.actionType} of ${a.targetUsername || 'that user'}`;
                    const text = a.status === 'approved'
                        ? `✅ Your ${what} request was approved by ${a.resolvedBy || 'the Owner'}.`
                        : `❌ Your ${what} request was denied${a.denyReason ? ` — "${a.denyReason}"` : ''}.`;
                    window._adminToast && window._adminToast(text);
                    updateDoc(change.doc.ref, { seenByRequester: true }).catch(() => {});
                });
            },
            (e) => { console.warn('[Roles] request outcome listener error:', e); }
        );
    } catch(e) { console.warn('[Roles] request outcome listener setup failed:', e); }
}
window._startMyRequestOutcomeListener = _startMyRequestOutcomeListener;

window.apRefreshSubAdmin = async () => {
    const role  = window._myRole  || _myRole;
    const perms = window._myRolePerms || _myRolePerms;
    const meta  = ROLE_META[role] || { emoji: '⚔️', label: role, color: '#a78bfa' };
    const _db   = window.db || db;

    const titleEl = document.getElementById('subadmin-title');
    const roleLabel = document.getElementById('subadmin-role-label');
    const iconEl  = document.getElementById('subadmin-icon-header');
    if (titleEl)   titleEl.innerText  = meta.label + ' Panel';
    if (roleLabel) roleLabel.innerText = meta.label;
    if (iconEl)    iconEl.innerHTML   = window.roleIconHtml(role) || meta.emoji;

    try {
        const rtdbRef = window.rtdb || rtdb;
        const presSnap = await get(ref(rtdbRef, 'presence'));
        const onlineEl = document.getElementById('subap-stat-online');
        if (onlineEl && presSnap.exists()) {
            let count = 0;
            presSnap.forEach(c => { if (window._presenceLive(c.val())) count++; });
            onlineEl.innerText = count;
        }
    } catch(e) {}
    try {
        const repSnap = await getDocs(collection(_db, 'reports'));
        const repEl = document.getElementById('subap-stat-reports');
        if (repEl) repEl.innerText = repSnap.size;
    } catch(e) {}

    const tabBar = document.getElementById('subadmin-tabs');
    const content = document.getElementById('subadmin-panel-content');
    if (!tabBar || !content) return;
    tabBar.innerHTML = '';
    content.innerHTML = '';

    const tabs = [];
    if (perms.canSeeOverview)    tabs.push({ id:'sub-overview',    icon:'<i class="fa-solid fa-house"></i>', label:'Overview' });
    if (perms.canSeeUsers)       tabs.push({ id:'sub-users',       icon:'<i class="fa-solid fa-user-group"></i>', label:'Users' });
    if (perms.canSeeInspector)   tabs.push({ id:'sub-inspector',   icon:'<i class="fa-solid fa-magnifying-glass"></i>', label:'Inspector' });
    if (perms.canSeeBroadcast)   tabs.push({ id:'sub-broadcast',   icon:'<i class="fa-solid fa-tower-broadcast"></i>', label:'Broadcast' });
    if (perms.canSeeModeration)  tabs.push({ id:'sub-moderation',  icon:'<i class="fa-solid fa-shield-halved"></i>', label:'Moderation', badge:'subap-mod-badge' });
    if (perms.canApproveAccounts)tabs.push({ id:'sub-approvals',   icon:'<i class="fa-solid fa-circle-check"></i>', label:'Approvals' });
    if (perms.canViewReports)    tabs.push({ id:'sub-reports',     icon:'<i class="fa-solid fa-triangle-exclamation"></i>', label:'Reports',    badge:'subap-rep-badge' });
    if (perms.canManageBadges) tabs.push({ id:'sub-badges', icon:'<i class="fa-solid fa-medal"></i>', label:'Badges & Quests', badge:'subap-badgereq-badge' });

    const hasPermTabs = tabs.length > 0;

    tabs.push({ id:'sub-security', icon:'<i class="fa-solid fa-lock"></i>', label:'Security' });

    if (!hasPermTabs) {
        const note = document.createElement('div');
        note.style.cssText = 'text-align:center;padding:24px 12px;color:#444455;font-size:13px;margin-bottom:16px;';
        note.innerHTML = `<div style="font-size:34px;margin-bottom:12px;color:${meta.color};">${window.roleIconHtml(role) || meta.emoji}</div>
            <div style="font-weight:700;color:#e2e2f0;margin-bottom:8px;">${meta.label}</div>
            <div>Your role doesn't have any panel permissions yet.<br>Contact the Owner to enable access.</div>`;
        content.appendChild(note);
    }

    tabs.forEach((t, i) => {
        const btn = document.createElement('button');
        btn.className = 'ap-tab' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
        btn.id = 'subtab-btn-' + t.id;
        btn.innerHTML = `<span class="ap-tab-icon">${t.icon}</span> ${t.label}${t.badge ? ` <span id="${t.badge}" class="ap-tab-badge" style="display:none;">0</span>` : ''}`;
        btn.onclick = () => {
            document.querySelectorAll('#subadmin-tabs .ap-tab').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
            btn.classList.add('active');
            document.querySelectorAll('#subadmin-panel-content .sub-panel').forEach(p => p.style.display = 'none');
            const panel = document.getElementById('subpanel-' + t.id);
            if (panel) panel.style.display = 'flex';
        };
        tabBar.appendChild(btn);
    });

    tabs.forEach((t, i) => {
        const wrap = document.createElement('div');
        wrap.id = 'subpanel-' + t.id;
        wrap.className = 'sub-panel';
        wrap.style.cssText = 'display:' + (i===0?'flex':'none') + ';flex-direction:column;gap:16px;';
        content.appendChild(wrap);
        _subApBuildPanel(t.id, perms, wrap, _db);
    });
};

async function _subApBuildPanel(tabId, perms, wrap, _db) {

    if (tabId === 'sub-overview') {
        const grid = document.createElement('div');
        grid.className = 'admin-grid';
        grid.style.cssText = 'display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px;';

        const onlineCard = document.createElement('div');

            </div>`;
        grid.appendChild(onlineCard);

        qaCard.className = 'admin-card';
        qaCard.style.cssText = 'display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;';

            <div class="admin-card-title" style="color:#818cf8;"><span class="admin-card-title-icon"><i class="fa-solid fa-bolt"></i></span> Quick Actions</div>
            <button onclick="document.getElementById('subtab-btn-sub-moderation')?.click()" class="btn-ghost w-full text-left" style="font-size:12px;padding:9px 12px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;"><i class="fa-solid fa-shield-halved"></i> <span>Open Moderation</span></button>
            <button onclick="document.getElementById('subtab-btn-sub-reports')?.click()" class="btn-ghost w-full text-left" style="font-size:12px;padding:9px 12px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;"><i class="fa-solid fa-triangle-exclamation"></i> <span>View Reports</span></button>
            <button onclick="document.getElementById('subtab-btn-sub-approvals')?.click()" class="btn-ghost w-full text-left" style="font-size:12px;padding:9px 12px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;"><i class="fa-solid fa-circle-check"></i> <span>Pending Approvals</span></button>
            <button onclick="document.getElementById('subtab-btn-sub-broadcast')?.click()" class="btn-ghost w-full text-left" style="font-size:12px;padding:9px 12px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;"><i class="fa-solid fa-tower-broadcast"></i> <span>Send Broadcast</span></button>`;
        grid.appendChild(qaCard);
        wrap.appendChild(grid);

        const statsCard = document.createElement('div');
        statsCard.className = 'admin-card';
        statsCard.innerHTML = `
            <div class="admin-card-title" style="color:#fbbf24;"><span class="admin-card-title-icon"><i class="fa-solid fa-chart-simple"></i></span> Current Stats</div>
            <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;margin-top:4px;">
                <div style="background:#07070f;border:1px solid #1a1a2a;border-radius:10px;padding:12px;text-align:center;">
                    <div style="font-size:22px;font-weight:900;color:#22c55e;" id="subap-stat-online2">—</div>

                </div>
            </div>`;
        wrap.appendChild(statsCard);

        try {
            const rtdbRef = window.rtdb || rtdb;
            if (window._subApPresenceUnsub) { window._subApPresenceUnsub(); window._subApPresenceUnsub = null; }
            window._subApPresenceUnsub = onValue(ref(rtdbRef, 'presence'), (snap) => {
                const el = document.getElementById('subap-online-list');
                const countEl = document.getElementById('subap-online-count');
                const statEl = document.getElementById('subap-stat-online');
                const statEl2 = document.getElementById('subap-stat-online2');
                if (!el) { if (window._subApPresenceUnsub) { window._subApPresenceUnsub(); window._subApPresenceUnsub = null; } return; }
                let html = '';
                let count = 0;
                if (snap.exists()) {
                    snap.forEach(child => {
                        const d = child.val();
                        if (window._presenceLive(d)) {
                            count++;
                            html += `<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:6px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #0f0f1a;">
                                <span style="width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:#22c55e;flex-shrink:0;box-shadow:0 0 5px #22c55e;"></span>

                if (statEl2) statEl2.innerText = count;
            }, (e) => { console.warn('[SubAdmin] presence listener error:', e); });

    }

    if (tabId === 'sub-users' && perms.canSeeUsers) {

                <button onclick="window._subApPostGlobal()" class="btn-primary w-full" style="font-size:12px;padding:10px;">Send to Global Chat</button>

        }

        if (perms.canSysMessage) {
            const card = document.createElement('div');
            card.className = 'admin-card';
            card.style.borderColor = 'rgba(34,211,238,0.15)';
            card.innerHTML = `
                <div class="admin-card-title" style="color:#22d3ee;"><span class="admin-card-title-icon"><i class="fa-solid fa-paper-plane"></i></span> System Message to User</div>
                <p style="font-size:11px;color:#444455;margin-bottom:12px;">Leaves a message on one specific account, shown to them the next time they log in.</p>
                <input id="subap-sys-user" type="text" placeholder="Username" class="inp" style="margin-bottom:8px;font-size:12px;">
                <textarea id="subap-sys-body" class="inp" rows="3" placeholder="Message..." style="font-size:12px;resize:vertical;margin-bottom:10px;line-height:1.5;"></textarea>
                <button onclick="window._subApSysMessage()" class="btn-primary w-full" style="font-size:12px;padding:10px;">Send Message</button>
                <p id="subap-sys-msg" class="hidden" style="font-size:11px;font-weight:700;margin-top:8px;"></p>`;
            wrap.appendChild(card);
        }

        if (perms.canForceRefresh) {
            const card = document.createElement('div');
            card.className = 'admin-card';
            card.style.borderColor = 'rgba(249,115,22,0.2)';
            card.innerHTML = `
                <div class="admin-card-title" style="color:#f97316;"><span class="admin-card-title-icon"><i class="fa-solid fa-rotate"></i></span> Force Refresh Everyone</div>
                <p style="font-size:11px;color:#444455;margin-bottom:12px;">Reloads the page for every user online right now, after a 5-second countdown. Anything they were typing is lost — use it to push out a deploy, not casually.</p>
                <button onclick="window._subApForceRefresh()" class="btn-primary w-full" style="font-size:12px;padding:10px;"><i class="fa-solid fa-rotate"></i> Refresh All Users</button>
                <p id="subap-refresh-msg" class="hidden" style="font-size:11px;font-weight:700;margin-top:8px;"></p>`;
            wrap.appendChild(card);
        }
    }

    if (tabId === 'sub-moderation' && perms.canSeeModeration) {

        const msgCard = document.createElement('div');
        msgCard.id = 'subap-mod-msg-wrap';
        msgCard.style.cssText = 'display:none;';
        msgCard.innerHTML = `<p id="subap-mod-msg" style="font-size:12px;font-weight:700;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:10px;background:rgba(99,102,241,0.08);border:1px solid rgba(99,102,241,0.2);color:#818cf8;"></p>`;
        wrap.appendChild(msgCard);

        if (perms.canMuteUsers) {
            const card = document.createElement('div');
            card.className = 'admin-card';
            card.style.borderColor = 'rgba(251,191,36,0.15)';
            card.innerHTML = `
                <div class="admin-card-title" style="color:#fbbf24;"><span class="admin-card-title-icon"><i class="fa-solid fa-volume-xmark"></i></span> Mute User</div>
                <p style="font-size:11px;color:#444455;margin-bottom:12px;">Temporarily prevent a user from sending messages or starting calls. Runs on a timer and lifts itself.</p>
                <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;">
                    <input id="subap-mute-user" type="text" placeholder="Username..." class="inp" style="font-size:12px;flex:1;min-width:120px;">
                    <input id="subap-mute-reason" type="text" placeholder="Reason..." class="inp" style="font-size:12px;flex:2;min-width:160px;">
                    <select id="subap-mute-duration" class="inp" style="font-size:12px;flex:0 0 auto;min-width:100px;">
                        <option value="0.25">15 min</option>
                        <option value="1" selected>1 hour</option>
                        <option value="6">6 hours</option>
                        <option value="24">24 hours</option>
                        <option value="72">3 days</option>
                    </select>
                    <button onclick="window._subApRequestMute()" class="btn-primary" style="font-size:12px;padding:9px 16px;white-space:nowrap;background:rgba(251,191,36,0.15);border:1px solid rgba(251,191,36,0.3);color:#fbbf24;" onmouseover="this.style.background='rgba(251,191,36,0.25)'" onmouseout="this.style.background='rgba(251,191,36,0.15)'"><i class="fa-solid fa-volume-xmark"></i> Mute</button>
                </div>`;
            wrap.appendChild(card);
        }

        if (perms.canSuspendUsers) {

window._bqSaveBadgeDraft = async function() {
    const id = _bqEl('bq-badge-id')?.value.trim();
    const name = _bqEl('bq-badge-name')?.value.trim();
    if (!id || !name) return showCooldownToast?.('Badge needs at least an id and name.');
    const kind = _bqEl('bq-badge-kind')?.value || 'manual';
    const fields = {
        name, kind,
        emoji: _bqEl('bq-badge-emoji')?.value.trim() || '🏅',
        desc: _bqEl('bq-badge-desc')?.value.trim() || ''
    };
    if (kind === 'seasonal') {
        const startVal = _bqEl('bq-badge-start')?.value;
        const endVal = _bqEl('bq-badge-end')?.value;
        if (startVal) fields.startAt = new Date(startVal);
        if (endVal) fields.endAt = new Date(endVal);
    }
    try {
        await window.saveBadgeDraft(id, fields, 'admin');
        showCooldownToast?.('✅ Badge draft saved.');
        _bqRefreshBadgeList(window.db || db);
    } catch (e) { showCooldownToast?.('Failed: ' + e.message); }
};

window._bqEchoHistory = window._bqEchoHistory || [];
window._bqEchoSend = async function() {
    const input = document.getElementById('bq-echo-input');
    const win = document.getElementById('bq-echo-window');
    const text = input.value.trim();
    if (!text) return;
    input.value = '';
    win.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', `<div style="align-self:flex-end;background:#27272a;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:12px;font-size:12px;color:#e8e8f0;max-width:85%;">${window.escHtml(text)}</div>`);
    win.scrollTop = win.scrollHeight;
    window._bqEchoHistory.push({ role: 'user', parts: [{ text }] });
    const sysPrompt = `You are EchoAI, scoped strictly to drafting badges and quests for this admin panel — do not discuss anything else.

You already know everything about how badges and quests work here, so act like it:
- Badges have: id, name, emoji, desc, and kind ("manual" or "seasonal"). DEFAULT kind to "manual" unless the admin explicitly says something time-limited/seasonal (e.g. "for the holidays", "only during summer"). Never ask which kind — just default and move on.
- Quests have: id, name, emoji, desc, type ("time" or "action"), a goal number, an actionType (only for action quests — e.g. messagesSent, friendsAdded, reactionsGiven, callsMade, imagesShared, filesShared), and a rewardBadgeId linking to a badge.
- If the admin describes an action in plain English ("send a message", "add a friend", "make a call"), infer the correct actionType yourself. Don't ask them to name a technical key.
- If they don't give an emoji or description, invent a reasonable one yourself instead of asking.
- Only ask a clarifying question if something is truly ambiguous or missing (like what the goal number should be, or what to actually name it). Never ask about kind/type unless genuinely unclear from context. Default aggressively, ask minimally.
- If the admin's message already has enough info for BOTH a badge and a quest that rewards it, emit BOTH: one badge and one quest, as two separate fenced blocks in the same reply.

Once you have enough info for something, output it as a fenced code block using language tag echoai-badge or echoai-quest containing ONLY a JSON object, no other text inside the block. You can output one of each in the same reply if both are ready.
Badge JSON: {"id":"lowercase-no-spaces","name":"Display Name","emoji":"🏅","desc":"...","kind":"manual"|"seasonal","startAt":"YYYY-MM-DD","endAt":"YYYY-MM-DD"}
Quest JSON: {"id":"lowercase-no-spaces","name":"Display Name","emoji":"🧭","desc":"...","type":"time"|"action","actionType":"someActionKey","goal":300,"rewardBadgeId":"an-existing-or-new-badge-id"}
Keep replies short and conversational.`;
    const loadingId = 'bq-echo-loading-' + Date.now();
    win.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', `<div id="${loadingId}" style="align-self:flex-start;font-size:12px;color:#666677;">EchoAI is thinking...</div>`);
    win.scrollTop = win.scrollHeight;
    try {
        const _fallbackResult = await window._geminiCallWithFallback('gemini-2.5-flash', {
            system_instruction: { parts: [{ text: sysPrompt }] },
            contents: window._bqEchoHistory,
            generationConfig: { temperature: 0.4, maxOutputTokens: 512 }
        });
        if (!_fallbackResult.ok) throw new Error('All available models are currently rate-limited.');
        const data = _fallbackResult.data;
        let reply = data?.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts?.[0]?.text?.trim() || '(no response)';
        window._bqEchoHistory.push({ role: 'model', parts: [{ text: reply }] });
        reply = await window._echoAIHandleDraftBlocks(reply);
        document.getElementById(loadingId)?.remove();
        win.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', `<div style="align-self:flex-start;border-left:3px solid #00f2ff;padding-left:10px;font-size:12px;color:#e8e8f0;max-width:90%;white-space:pre-wrap;">${window.escHtml(reply)}</div>`);
        win.scrollTop = win.scrollHeight;
        _bqRefreshBadgeList(window.db || db);
        _bqRefreshQuestList(window.db || db);
    } catch (e) {
        document.getElementById(loadingId)?.remove();
        win.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', `<div style="color:#f87171;font-size:12px;">EchoAI request failed: ${e.message}</div>`);
    }
};

window._bqSaveQuestDraft = async function() {
    const id = _bqEl('bq-quest-id')?.value.trim();
    const name = _bqEl('bq-quest-name')?.value.trim();
    const goal = Number(_bqEl('bq-quest-goal')?.value);
    const rewardBadgeId = _bqEl('bq-quest-rewardbadge')?.value.trim();
    if (!id || !name || !goal || !rewardBadgeId) return showCooldownToast?.('Quest needs id, name, goal, and a reward badge id.');
    const type = _bqEl('bq-quest-type')?.value || 'time';
    const fields = {
        name, type, goal,
        emoji: _bqEl('bq-quest-emoji')?.value.trim() || '🧭',
        desc: _bqEl('bq-quest-desc')?.value.trim() || '',
        reward: { badgeId: rewardBadgeId },
        autoGrant: !!_bqEl('bq-quest-autogrant')?.checked,
        hidden: !!_bqEl('bq-quest-hidden')?.checked
    };
    if (type === 'action') fields.actionType = _bqEl('bq-quest-actiontype')?.value.trim() || '';
    try {
        await window.saveQuestDraft(id, fields, 'admin');
        showCooldownToast?.('✅ Quest draft saved.');
        _bqRefreshQuestList(window.db || db);
    } catch (e) { showCooldownToast?.('Failed: ' + e.message); }
};

const _BQ_BADGE_STATUS_ACTIONS = {
    draft:       [['Publish', 'publishBadgeDef', 'green']],
    published:   [['Unpublish', 'unpublishBadgeDef', 'gray']],
    unpublished: [['Publish', 'publishBadgeDef', 'green']]
};
window._bqRefreshBadgeList = async function(_db) {
    const el = _bqEl('bq-badge-list');
    if (!el) return;
    try {
        const snap = await getDocs(collection(_db, 'badge_defs'));
        if (snap.empty) { el.innerHTML = '<div style="text-align:center;padding:16px;color:#444455;font-size:12px;">No badges yet.</div>'; return; }
        el.innerHTML = '';
        snap.forEach(d => {
            const b = d.data();
            const actions = _BQ_BADGE_STATUS_ACTIONS[b.status] || [];
            const row = document.createElement('div');
            row.className = 'ap-user-row';
            row.innerHTML = `
                <div class="ap-user-info">
                    <div class="ap-user-name">${b.emoji || '🏅'} ${window.escHtml(b.name || d.id)} <span style="opacity:0.5;font-size:10px;">(${b.kind || 'manual'} · ${b.status})</span></div>
                    <div class="ap-user-meta">${window.escHtml(b.desc || '')}</div>
                </div>
                <div style="display:flex;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap;">
                    ${actions.map(([label, fn, color]) => `<button onclick="window.${fn}('${d.id}').then(()=>_bqRefreshBadgeList(window.db||db))" class="ap-pill ${color}" style="font-size:10px;">${label}</button>`).join('')}
                    <button onclick="if(confirm('Delete badge \\'${d.id}\\'? This cannot be undone.')) window.deleteBadgeDef('${d.id}').then(()=>_bqRefreshBadgeList(window.db||db))" class="ap-pill red" style="font-size:10px;">Delete</button>
                </div>`;
            el.appendChild(row);
        });
    } catch (e) { el.innerHTML = '<div style="color:#f87171;font-size:12px;padding:8px;">Failed to load: ' + e.message + '</div>'; }
}

const _BQ_QUEST_STATUS_ACTIONS = {
    draft:    [['Ready', 'publishQuestDef', 'green']],
    ready:    [['Start', 'startQuestDef', 'green']],
    active:   [['Stop', 'stopQuestDef', 'gray']],
    stopped:  [['Restart', 'startQuestDef', 'green'], ['Archive', 'archiveQuestDef', 'gray']],
    archived: []
};
window._bqRefreshQuestList = async function(_db) {
    const el = _bqEl('bq-quest-list');
    if (!el) return;
    try {
        const snap = await getDocs(collection(_db, 'quest_defs'));
        if (snap.empty) { el.innerHTML = '<div style="text-align:center;padding:16px;color:#444455;font-size:12px;">No quests yet.</div>'; return; }
        el.innerHTML = '';
        snap.forEach(d => {
            const q = d.data();
            const actions = _BQ_QUEST_STATUS_ACTIONS[q.status] || [];
            const goalLabel = q.type === 'time' ? `${q.goal} min` : `${q.goal}x ${q.actionType || 'action'}`;
            const row = document.createElement('div');
            row.className = 'ap-user-row';
            row.innerHTML = `
                <div class="ap-user-info">
                    <div class="ap-user-name">${q.emoji || '🧭'} ${window.escHtml(q.name || d.id)} <span style="opacity:0.5;font-size:10px;">(${q.status})</span></div>
                    <div class="ap-user-meta">${window.escHtml(q.desc || '')} · Goal: ${goalLabel} · Reward: ${window.escHtml(q.reward?.badgeId || '—')}</div>
                </div>
                <div style="display:flex;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap;">
                    ${actions.map(([label, fn, color]) => `<button onclick="window.${fn}('${d.id}').then(()=>_bqRefreshQuestList(window.db||db))" class="ap-pill ${color}" style="font-size:10px;">${label}</button>`).join('')}
                    <button onclick="if(confirm('Delete quest \\'${d.id}\\'? This cannot be undone.')) window.deleteQuestDef('${d.id}').then(()=>_bqRefreshQuestList(window.db||db))" class="ap-pill red" style="font-size:10px;">Delete</button>
                </div>`;
            el.appendChild(row);
        });
    } catch (e) { el.innerHTML = '<div style="color:#f87171;font-size:12px;padding:8px;">Failed to load: ' + e.message + '</div>'; }
}

window._bqRefreshAwardRequests = async function(_db) {
    const el = _bqEl('bq-award-requests');
    const badgeCount = _bqEl('subap-badgereq-badge');
    const tabBadgeCount = document.getElementById('ap-badgereq-badge');
    if (!el) return;
    try {
        const snap = await getDocs(query(collection(_db, 'badge_award_requests'), where('status', '==', 'pending')));
        if (badgeCount) { badgeCount.innerText = snap.size; badgeCount.style.display = snap.size > 0 ? 'inline-block' : 'none'; }
        if (tabBadgeCount) { tabBadgeCount.innerText = snap.size; tabBadgeCount.style.display = snap.size > 0 ? 'inline-block' : 'none'; }
        if (snap.empty) { el.innerHTML = '<div style="text-align:center;padding:16px;color:#444455;font-size:12px;">Nothing pending. 🎉</div>'; return; }
        el.innerHTML = '';
        for (const d of snap.docs) {
            const r = d.data();
            let uname = r.uid;
            try {
                const uSnap = await getDoc(doc(_db, 'users', r.uid));
                if (uSnap.exists()) uname = uSnap.data().username || r.uid;
            } catch (e) {   }
            const row = document.createElement('div');
            row.className = 'ap-user-row';
            row.innerHTML = `
                <div class="ap-user-info">
                    <div class="ap-user-name">Badge "${window.escHtml(r.badgeId)}" for user ${window.escHtml(uname)}</div>
                    <div class="ap-user-meta">Earned via quest: ${window.escHtml(r.questId || '—')}</div>
                </div>
                <div style="display:flex;gap:5px;">
                    <button onclick="window._bqApproveAward('${d.id}','${r.uid}','${r.badgeId}')" class="ap-pill green" style="font-size:10px;">✓ Approve</button>
                    <button onclick="window._bqDenyAward('${d.id}')" class="ap-pill red" style="font-size:10px;">✕ Deny</button>
                </div>`;
            el.appendChild(row);
        }
    } catch (e) { el.innerHTML = '<div style="color:#f87171;font-size:12px;padding:8px;">Failed to load: ' + e.message + '</div>'; }
}
window._bqApproveAward = async function(reqId, uid, badgeId) {
    try {
        await window.grantBadge(uid, badgeId, `quest-approved-by:${myUID}`);
        await deleteDoc(doc(db, 'badge_award_requests', reqId));
        showCooldownToast?.('✅ Badge granted.');
        _bqRefreshAwardRequests(window.db || db);
    } catch (e) { showCooldownToast?.('Failed: ' + e.message); }
};
window._bqDenyAward = async function(reqId) {
    try {
        await deleteDoc(doc(db, 'badge_award_requests', reqId));
        _bqRefreshAwardRequests(window.db || db);
    } catch (e) {}
};

window._bqRefreshSpamFlags = async function(_db) {
    const el = _bqEl('bq-spam-flags');
    const badgeCount = _bqEl('bq-spam-badge');
    if (!el) return;
    try {
        const snap = await getDocs(query(collection(_db, 'quest_spam_flags'), orderBy('at', 'desc'), limit(50)));
        if (badgeCount) { badgeCount.innerText = snap.size; badgeCount.style.display = snap.size > 0 ? 'inline-block' : 'none'; }
        if (snap.empty) { el.innerHTML = '<div style="text-align:center;padding:16px;color:#444455;font-size:12px;">No spam flags. 🎉</div>'; return; }
        el.innerHTML = '';
        for (const d of snap.docs) {
            const r = d.data();
            let uname = r.uid;
            try {
                const uSnap = await getDoc(doc(_db, 'users', r.uid));
                if (uSnap.exists()) uname = uSnap.data().username || r.uid;
            } catch (e) {   }
            const when = r.at?.toDate ? r.at.toDate().toLocaleString() : '';
            const row = document.createElement('div');
            row.className = 'ap-user-row';
            row.innerHTML = `
                <div class="ap-user-info">
                    <div class="ap-user-name">${window.escHtml(uname)} — locked out of "${window.escHtml(r.questId || '—')}"</div>
                    <div class="ap-user-meta">${r.strikeCount || '?'} cooldown-hits in ~10s · ${window.escHtml(when)}</div>
                </div>
                <div style="display:flex;gap:5px;">
                    <button onclick="window._bqUnlockQuest('${r.uid}','${r.questId}')" class="ap-pill green" style="font-size:10px;">Unlock now</button>
                    <button onclick="window._bqDismissSpamFlag('${d.id}')" class="ap-pill red" style="font-size:10px;">Dismiss</button>
                </div>`;
            el.appendChild(row);
        }
    } catch (e) { el.innerHTML = '<div style="color:#f87171;font-size:12px;padding:8px;">Failed to load: ' + e.message + '</div>'; }
};

        }, { merge: true });
        showCooldownToast?.('🔓 Lockout cleared.');
    } catch (e) { showCooldownToast?.('Failed: ' + e.message); }
};
window._bqDismissSpamFlag = async function(flagId) {
    try {
        await deleteDoc(doc(db, 'quest_spam_flags', flagId));
        _bqRefreshSpamFlags(window.db || db);
    } catch (e) {}
};

window._subApSearchUsers = async () => {
    const q = (document.getElementById('subap-user-search')?.value || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const el = document.getElementById('subap-user-results');
    if (!el || !q) return;
    el.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:11px;color:#444455;">Searching...</div>';
    try {
        const snap = await getDocs(collection(db, 'users'));
        const matches = snap.docs.filter(d => {
            const u = d.data();
            return (u.username||'').toLowerCase().includes(q) || (u.email||'').toLowerCase().includes(q);
        }).slice(0, 20);
        if (!matches.length) { el.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:11px;color:#444455;">No users found.</div>'; return; }
        el.innerHTML = '';
        matches.forEach(d => {
            const u = d.data();
            const row = document.createElement('div');
            row.className = 'ap-user-row';
            row.innerHTML = `<div class="ap-user-info">
                <div class="ap-user-name">${window.escHtml(u.username||'?')}${_apIsOwnerRecord(u) ? ' 👑' : ''}</div>
                <div class="ap-user-meta">${_apShieldOwner(u) ? AP_SHIELD_TEXT : window.escHtml(u.email||'')} · ${window.escHtml(u.status||'active')}</div>
            </div>`;
            el.appendChild(row);
        });
    } catch(e) { el.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:11px;color:#f87171;">Error loading users.</div>'; }
};

window._subApSendBroadcast = async () => {
    const text    = document.getElementById('subap-bc-text')?.value.trim();
    const msg     = document.getElementById('subap-bc-msg');
    const sendBtn = document.querySelector('[onclick="window._subApSendBroadcast()"]');
    if (!text) return;

    if (msg) { msg.innerText = 'Checking broadcast with AI...'; msg.className = 'text-blue-400 text-xs font-bold'; msg.classList.remove('hidden'); }
    if (sendBtn) { sendBtn.disabled = true; sendBtn.innerText = 'Checking...'; }

    try {
        const apiKey = window.GEMINI_API_KEY || '';
        let approved = false;
        let reason = 'Could not verify with AI moderation — blocked to be safe. Try again in a moment.';
        try {
            const aiResp = await fetch(
                `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-2.5-flash-lite:generateContent?key=${apiKey}`,
                {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify({
                        contents: [{ parts: [{ text: 'You are a STRICT content moderator for EchoSpace, a chat app. A staff member is about to broadcast this text site-wide to EVERY user instantly, with no further human review — err on the side of blocking anything even mildly questionable. Block: hate speech, harassment, slurs, sexual/explicit content, threats or violence, spam/scams/links to other sites, personal attacks on specific users, off-topic personal messages, or anything unprofessional for an official site-wide notice. Allow: genuine announcements about the site itself — features, downtime, events, rules, celebrations. Reply ONLY with valid JSON, no markdown, no other text: {"approved":true,"reason":""} or {"approved":false,"reason":"short reason"}. Message to review:\n\n' + text }] }],
                        generationConfig: { temperature: 0.1, maxOutputTokens: 150 }
                    })
                }
            );
            if (aiResp.ok) {
                const aiData = await aiResp.json();
                const raw = aiData?.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts?.[0]?.text ?? '{}';
                const result = JSON.parse(raw.replace(/```json|```/g, '').trim());
                approved = result.approved === true;
                reason = result.reason || (approved ? '' : 'Flagged by AI moderation.');
            } else {
                reason = `AI moderation check failed (HTTP ${aiResp.status}) — blocked to be safe. Try again in a moment.`;
            }
        } catch(aiErr) {
            reason = `AI moderation check failed (${aiErr.message}) — blocked to be safe. Try again in a moment.`;
        }

        if (!approved) {
            if (msg) { msg.innerHTML = `<i class="fa-solid fa-circle-xmark"></i> Broadcast blocked: <em>${window.escHtml ? window.escHtml(reason) : reason}</em>`; msg.className = 'text-red-400 text-xs font-bold'; }
            if (sendBtn) { sendBtn.disabled = false; sendBtn.innerText = 'Send Broadcast'; }
            return;
        }

        let sent = false;
        try {
            await addDoc(collection(db, 'system_announcements'), {
                message:    text,
                sentBy:     window.myUsername || 'Staff',
                uid:        window.myUID,
                active:     true,
                aiChecked:  true,
                timestamp:  serverTimestamp()
            });
            sent = true;
        } catch(writeErr) {
            if (writeErr.code === 'permission-denied' || (writeErr.message && writeErr.message.includes('permission'))) {
                await addDoc(collection(db, 'site_config', 'pending_actions', 'queue'), {
                    actionType:     'broadcast',
                    broadcastText:  text,
                    requesterName:  window.myUsername || 'Staff',
                    requesterUid:   window.myUID,
                    requesterRole:  window._myRole || 'moderator',
                    aiChecked:      true,
                    timestamp:      serverTimestamp(),
                    status:         'pending'
                });
                if (msg) { msg.innerText = 'Broadcast submitted for owner approval (you lack direct send perms).'; msg.className = 'text-yellow-400 text-xs font-bold'; }
                document.getElementById('subap-bc-text').value = '';
                sent = true;
            } else {
                throw writeErr;
            }
        }
        if (sent && msg && !msg.innerText.includes('approval')) {
            msg.innerText = 'Broadcast sent!';
            msg.className = 'text-green-400 text-xs font-bold';
            document.getElementById('subap-bc-text').value = '';
        }
    } catch(e) {
        if (msg) { msg.innerText = 'Error: ' + e.message; msg.className = 'text-red-400 text-xs font-bold'; }
    } finally {
        if (sendBtn) { sendBtn.disabled = false; sendBtn.innerText = 'Send Broadcast'; }
    }
};

function _subApMsg(id, text, tone) {
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    if (!el) return;
    el.innerText = text;
    el.className = ({ ok: 'text-green-400', warn: 'text-yellow-400', err: 'text-red-400' }[tone] || 'text-blue-400') + ' text-xs font-bold';
    el.classList.remove('hidden');
    if (tone === 'ok') setTimeout(() => el.classList.add('hidden'), 4000);
}
function _subApCan(key, msgId) {
    if (window._hasPerm?.(key)) return true;
    _subApMsg(msgId, 'Your role no longer has permission for this.', 'err');
    return false;
}

window._subApClearAnnounce = async () => {
    if (!_subApCan('canClearAnnounce', 'subap-clear-msg')) return;
    try {
        const snap = await getDocs(query(collection(db, 'system_announcements'), where('active', '==', true)));
        if (snap.empty) { _subApMsg('subap-clear-msg', 'Nothing is currently showing.', 'warn'); return; }
        await Promise.all(snap.docs.map(d => updateDoc(doc(db, 'system_announcements', d.id), { active: false })));
        window.logAdminAction?.('clear_announcement', { count: snap.size });
        _subApMsg('subap-clear-msg', `Cleared ${snap.size} announcement${snap.size === 1 ? '' : 's'}.`, 'ok');
    } catch (e) { _subApMsg('subap-clear-msg', 'Error: ' + e.message, 'err'); }
};

        _subApMsg('subap-sys-msg', 'System message queued for their next login.', 'ok');

window._subApVerify = async (on) => {
    if (!_subApCan('canVerifyUsers', 'subap-verify-msg')) return;
    const el = document.getElementById('subap-verify-user');
    const username = (el?.value || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!username) { _subApMsg('subap-verify-msg', 'Enter a username.', 'err'); return; }
    try {
        const snap = await getDocs(query(collection(db, 'users'), where('lower_username', '==', username)));
        if (snap.empty) { _subApMsg('subap-verify-msg', 'User not found.', 'err'); return; }
        const target = snap.docs[0].data().username;
        await updateDoc(snap.docs[0].ref, { verifiedBadge: !!on });
        window.logAdminAction?.(on ? 'verify_user' : 'unverify_user', { target });
        _subApMsg('subap-verify-msg', on ? `${target} is now verified.` : `Verification removed from ${target}.`, 'ok');
    } catch (e) { _subApMsg('subap-verify-msg', 'Error: ' + e.message, 'err'); }
};

window._subApAuditRecovery = async () => {
    const out = document.getElementById('subap-rk-out');
    if (!out) return;
    out.classList.remove('hidden');
    if (!window._hasPerm?.('canAuditRecoveryKeys')) {
        out.innerHTML = '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#f87171;font-weight:700;">Your role no longer has permission for this.</p>';
        return;
    }
    out.innerHTML = '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#818cf8;font-weight:700;">Scanning accounts…</p>';
    try {
        const snap = await getDocs(collection(db, 'users'));
        const missing = [], unknown = [];
        let covered = 0;
        snap.forEach(d => {
            const u = d.data();
            const name = u.username || d.id;
            if (u.hasRecoveryKey === true) covered++;
            else if (u.hasRecoveryKey === false) missing.push(name);
            else unknown.push(name);
        });
        const pct = snap.size ? Math.round((covered / snap.size) * 100) : 0;
        const list = (arr) => arr.length
            ? '<div style="max-height:160px;overflow-y:auto;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:5px;margin-top:7px;">' +
              arr.sort().map(n => `<span class="role-badge member">${window.escHtml(n)}</span>`).join('') + '</div>'
            : '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#4ade80;margin-top:6px;">None. 🎉</p>';
        out.innerHTML =
            `<p style="font-size:12px;font-weight:800;color:#e2e2f0;">${covered} of ${snap.size} accounts covered (${pct}%).</p>` +
            `<p style="font-size:10px;font-weight:800;color:#f87171;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.07em;margin-top:11px;">No recovery key — ${missing.length}</p>` + list(missing) +
            `<p style="font-size:10px;font-weight:800;color:#fbbf24;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.07em;margin-top:11px;">Unknown — ${unknown.length}</p>` +
            `<p style="font-size:10px;color:#555566;margin-top:2px;">Haven't signed in since tracking started; they resolve themselves on next login.</p>` + list(unknown);
        window.logAdminAction?.('recovery_key_audit', { count: snap.size, covered, missing: missing.length });
    } catch (e) {
        out.innerHTML = `<p style="font-size:11px;color:#f87171;font-weight:700;">Audit failed: ${window.escHtml(e.message)}</p>`;
    }
};

window._subApRequestSuspend = async () => {
    const username = (document.getElementById('subap-suspend-user')?.value || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const reason   = (document.getElementById('subap-suspend-reason')?.value || '').trim();
    const hours    = parseInt(document.getElementById('subap-suspend-duration')?.value || '24');
    if (!username) { _subApModMsg('Enter a username.', false); return; }
    const durationLabel = hours < 24 ? hours + 'h' : (hours / 24) + 'd';
    try {
        const target = await _subApResolveTarget(username);
        if (!target) { _subApModMsg('User not found.', false); return; }
        const blocked = _subApTargetBlocked(target);
        if (blocked) { _subApModMsg(blocked, false); return; }
        const ok = await _submitPendingAction('suspend', target.uid, username, reason, { durationHours: hours, durationLabel });
        _subApModMsg(ok === 'direct' ? `✓ ${username} suspended for ${durationLabel}.`
            : ok ? `✓ Suspend request (${durationLabel}) submitted — awaiting Owner approval.`
            : window._pendingActionErrorText(), !!ok);
        if (ok) {
            const uInp = document.getElementById('subap-suspend-user');
            const rInp = document.getElementById('subap-suspend-reason');
            if (uInp) uInp.value = '';
            if (rInp) rInp.value = '';
        }
    } catch(e) { _subApModMsg('Error: ' + (e.code || e.message), false); }
};

window._subApLoadRecentGcMsgs = async () => {
    const container = document.getElementById('subap-gc-msgs');
    if (!container) return;
    container.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:11px;color:#818cf8;text-align:center;padding:8px;">⟳ Loading...</div>';
    try {
        const { collection, query, orderBy, limit, getDocs, deleteDoc, doc } = await import("https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.11.0/firebase-firestore.js");
        const { getFirestore } = await import("https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.11.0/firebase-firestore.js");
        const { initializeApp, getApps } = await import("https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.11.0/firebase-app.js");
        const _fdb = getFirestore(getApps()[0]);
        const snap = await getDocs(query(collection(_fdb, 'global_chat'), orderBy('timestamp', 'desc'), limit(30)));
        if (snap.empty) { container.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:11px;color:#444455;text-align:center;padding:8px;">No messages found.</div>'; return; }
        container.innerHTML = '';
        snap.forEach(d => {
            const m = d.data();
            const esc = s => String(s||'').replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;');
            const timeStr = m.timestamp?.toDate ? m.timestamp.toDate().toLocaleTimeString([],{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'}) : '';
            const row = document.createElement('div');
            row.id = 'subap-gcmsg-' + d.id;
            row.style.cssText = 'display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:8px;padding:6px 8px;background:#0a0a15;border:1px solid #1a1a2e;border-radius:8px;';
            row.innerHTML = `<div style="flex:1;min-width:0;">
                <span style="font-size:11px;font-weight:800;color:#818cf8;">${esc(m.username||'?')}</span>
                <span style="font-size:10px;color:#333345;margin-left:5px;">${timeStr}</span>
                <div style="font-size:12px;color:#c8c8d8;margin-top:2px;word-break:break-word;">${esc(m.text||'[no text]')}</div>
            </div>
            <button title="Delete message" onclick="window._subApDeleteMsgById('${d.id}')"
                style="flex-shrink:0;background:rgba(239,68,68,0.1);border:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,0.25);color:#f87171;width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;font-weight:900;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;"
                onmouseover="this.style.background='rgba(239,68,68,0.25)'" onmouseout="this.style.background='rgba(239,68,68,0.1)'">✕</button>`;
            container.appendChild(row);
        });
    } catch(e) {
        container.innerHTML = `<div style="font-size:11px;color:#f87171;text-align:center;padding:8px;">Error: ${String(e.message||e)}</div>`;
    }
};

window._subApDeleteMsgById = async (msgId) => {
    const msg = document.getElementById('subap-mod-msg');
    const row = document.getElementById('subap-gcmsg-' + msgId);
    try {
        if (typeof window.deleteGlobalMsg === 'function') {
            await window.deleteGlobalMsg(msgId);
        } else {
            const { getFirestore, deleteDoc, doc } = await import("https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.11.0/firebase-firestore.js");
            const { getApps } = await import("https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.11.0/firebase-app.js");
            const _fdb = getFirestore(getApps()[0]);
            await deleteDoc(doc(_fdb, 'global_chat', msgId));
        }
        if (row) row.remove();
        if (msg) { msg.innerText='✓ Message deleted.'; msg.className='text-green-400 text-xs font-bold'; msg.classList.remove('hidden'); setTimeout(()=>msg.classList.add('hidden'),2500); }
    } catch(e) {
        if (msg) { msg.innerText='Error: '+e.message; msg.className='text-red-400 text-xs font-bold'; msg.classList.remove('hidden'); }
    }
};

async function _subApResolveTarget(lowerUsername) {
    if (window.db && window.getDocs && window.query && window.collection && window.where) {
        const snap = await window.getDocs(window.query(window.collection(window.db, 'users'), window.where('lower_username', '==', lowerUsername)));
        return snap.empty ? null : { uid: snap.docs[0].id, data: snap.docs[0].data() };
    }
    const { getFirestore, getDocs, query, collection, where } = await import("https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.11.0/firebase-firestore.js");
    const { getApps } = await import("https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.11.0/firebase-app.js");
    const _fdb = getFirestore(getApps()[0]);
    const snap = await getDocs(query(collection(_fdb, 'users'), where('lower_username', '==', lowerUsername)));
    return snap.empty ? null : { uid: snap.docs[0].id, data: snap.docs[0].data() };
}

function _subApModMsg(text, ok) {
    const msg = document.getElementById('subap-mod-msg');
    if (!msg) return;
    msg.innerText = text;
    msg.className = (ok ? 'text-green-400' : 'text-red-400') + ' text-xs font-bold';
    msg.classList.remove('hidden');
    const wrap = document.getElementById('subap-mod-msg-wrap');
    if (wrap) wrap.style.display = '';
}

function _subApTargetBlocked(target) {
    if (!target) return null;
    if (target.data?.ownerAccount === true || target.data?.role === 'owner') return 'You cannot action the owner account.';
    if (target.uid === window.myUID) return "That's your own account.";
    return null;
}

window._subApRequestMute = async () => {
    const username = (document.getElementById('subap-mute-user')?.value || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const reason   = (document.getElementById('subap-mute-reason')?.value || '').trim();
    const hours    = parseFloat(document.getElementById('subap-mute-duration')?.value || '1');
    if (!username) { _subApModMsg('Enter a username.', false); return; }
    try {
        const target = await _subApResolveTarget(username);
        if (!target) { _subApModMsg('User not found.', false); return; }
        const blocked = _subApTargetBlocked(target);
        if (blocked) { _subApModMsg(blocked, false); return; }
        const durationLabel = hours < 1 ? Math.round(hours * 60) + 'm' : (hours < 24 ? hours + 'h' : (hours / 24) + 'd');
        const ok = await _submitPendingAction('mute', target.uid, username, reason, { durationHours: hours, durationLabel });
        _subApModMsg(ok === 'direct' ? `✓ ${username} muted for ${durationLabel}.`
            : ok ? `✓ Mute request (${durationLabel}) submitted — awaiting Owner approval.`
            : window._pendingActionErrorText(), !!ok);
        if (ok) {
            const u = document.getElementById('subap-mute-user'); if (u) u.value = '';
            const r = document.getElementById('subap-mute-reason'); if (r) r.value = '';
        }
    } catch(e) { _subApModMsg('Error: ' + (e.code || e.message), false); }
};

window._subApRequestBan = async () => {
    const username = (document.getElementById('subap-ban-user')?.value || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const reason   = (document.getElementById('subap-ban-reason')?.value || '').trim();
    if (!username || !reason) { _subApModMsg('Enter username and reason.', false); return; }
    try {
        const target = await _subApResolveTarget(username);
        if (!target) { _subApModMsg('User not found.', false); return; }
        const blocked = _subApTargetBlocked(target);
        if (blocked) { _subApModMsg(blocked, false); return; }
        const ok = await _submitPendingAction('ban', target.uid, username, reason);
        _subApModMsg(ok === 'direct' ? `✓ ${username} has been banned.`
            : ok ? '✓ Ban request submitted — awaiting Owner approval.'
            : window._pendingActionErrorText(), !!ok);
        if (ok) {
            const u = document.getElementById('subap-ban-user'); if (u) u.value = '';
            const r = document.getElementById('subap-ban-reason'); if (r) r.value = '';
        }
    } catch(e) { _subApModMsg('Error: ' + (e.code || e.message), false); }
};

function _hexToRgbStr(hex) {
    if (!hex) return '128,128,128';
    hex = hex.replace('#','');
    if (hex.length === 3) hex = hex.split('').map(c=>c+c).join('');
    const n = parseInt(hex, 16);
    if (isNaN(n)) return '128,128,128';
    return `${(n>>16)&255},${(n>>8)&255},${n&255}`;
}

        }
    };

const _patchGcBadge = () => {
    const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
        mutations.forEach(m => {
            m.addedNodes.forEach(node => {
                if (node.nodeType !== 1) return;
                const roleEl = node.querySelector ? node.querySelector('[data-role]') : null;
                if (!roleEl) return;
                const role = roleEl.dataset.role;
                if (role && ROLE_META[role] && role !== 'member') {
                    const existing = roleEl.parentElement?.querySelector('.role-badge');
                    if (!existing) {
                        const badge = document.createElement('span');
                        badge.className = `role-badge ${role}`;
                        badge.title = ROLE_META[role].label;
                        badge.innerHTML = (window.roleIconHtml(role) || ROLE_META[role].emoji) + ' ' + ROLE_META[role].label;
                        roleEl.parentElement?.insertBefore(badge, roleEl.nextSibling);
                    }
                }
            });
        });
    });
    const gcBox = document.getElementById('global-chat-box');
    if (gcBox) observer.observe(gcBox, { childList: true, subtree: true });
};
setTimeout(_patchGcBadge, 2000);

function _startPendingActionsListener() {
    if (!window.isAdmin) return;
    const _db = window.db || db;
    let _prevPendingCount = 0;
    onSnapshot(
        query(collection(_db, 'site_config', 'pending_actions', 'queue'), where('status', '==', 'pending')),
        (snap) => {
            const count = snap.size;
            const badge = document.getElementById('ap-pending-badge');
            if (badge) { badge.innerText = count; badge.style.display = count > 0 ? 'inline-block' : 'none'; }
            window._adminCounts.pendingActions = count;
            window._updateAdminIndicator();
            const statPending = document.getElementById('ap-stat-pending');
            if (statPending) statPending.innerText = count;
            _renderPendingActions(snap.docs);
            if (count > _prevPendingCount && window.isAdmin) {
                const newCount = count - _prevPendingCount;
                window._adminToast && window._adminToast(
                    `${newCount} new pending action${newCount>1?'s':''} from staff — approval needed`);
                const dot = document.getElementById('admin-dot');
                if (dot) { dot.style.background = '#ef4444'; dot.classList.add('pulse'); }
            }
            _prevPendingCount = count;
        },
        (e) => { console.warn('[Roles] pending actions listener error:', e); }
    );
}
window._startPendingActionsListener = _startPendingActionsListener;

setTimeout(() => {
    if (window.isAdmin && window._startPendingActionsListener) {
        window._startPendingActionsListener();
    }
}, 4000);
