<script>
(function() {
    let _starsEnabled = false;
    let _starsRaf = null;
    let _stars = [];
    const STAR_COUNT = 45;

    function _initStars(canvas) {
        _stars = [];
        const W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;
        for (let i = 0; i < STAR_COUNT; i++) {
            _stars.push({
                x: Math.random() * W,
                y: Math.random() * H,
                r: Math.random() * 1.8 + 0.4,
                vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.06,
                vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.06,
                phase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
                twinkleSpeed: 0,
                frozenAlpha: 0.4 + 0.6 * Math.abs(Math.sin(Math.random() * Math.PI * 2)),
                brightness: Math.random(),
            });
        }
    }

    function _drawStars(canvas, ctx, energy) {
        const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
        const W = canvas.offsetWidth, H = canvas.offsetHeight;
        const targetW = Math.round(W * dpr), targetH = Math.round(H * dpr);
        if (canvas.width !== targetW || canvas.height !== targetH) {
            canvas.width  = targetW;
            canvas.height = targetH;
            ctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
            ctx.scale(dpr, dpr);
            _initStars({ width: W, height: H });
        }
        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);

        const boost = 1 + energy * 0.08;

        _stars.forEach(s => {

            if (energy > 0.25) {
                const nudge = (energy - 0.25) * 0.09;
                s.vx += (Math.random() - 0.5) * nudge;
                s.vy += (Math.random() - 0.5) * nudge;
            }
            const spd = Math.sqrt(s.vx * s.vx + s.vy * s.vy);
            if (spd > 0.45) { s.vx *= 0.45 / spd; s.vy *= 0.45 / spd; }
            s.vx *= 0.988;
            s.vy *= 0.988;
            s.x += s.vx;
            s.y += s.vy;
            if (s.x < -2)    s.x += W + 2;
            else if (s.x > W + 2) s.x -= W + 2;
            if (s.y < -2)    s.y += H + 2;
            else if (s.y > H + 2) s.y -= H + 2;

            const baseAlpha = s.frozenAlpha * (0.5 + s.brightness * 0.5);
            const alpha  = Math.min(1, baseAlpha * (1 + energy * 0.55));
            const radius = s.r * boost;

            const grd = ctx.createRadialGradient(s.x, s.y, 0, s.x, s.y, radius * 3.5);
            grd.addColorStop(0,   `rgba(255,255,255,${alpha})`);
            grd.addColorStop(0.4, `rgba(180,160,255,${alpha * 0.6})`);
            grd.addColorStop(1,   'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, radius * 3.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fillStyle = grd;
            ctx.fill();

            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${alpha})`;
            ctx.fill();
        });
    }

    function _getAudioEnergy() {
        if (window._vizAnalyser) {
            const buf = new Uint8Array(window._vizAnalyser.frequencyBinCount);
            window._vizAnalyser.getByteFrequencyData(buf);
            const bassEnd = Math.floor(buf.length / 4);
            let sum = 0;
            for (let i = 0; i < bassEnd; i++) sum += buf[i];
            return Math.min(1, (sum / bassEnd) / 180);
        }
        return 0;
    }

    function _loop(canvas, ctx) {
        if (!_starsEnabled) return;
        const energy = _getAudioEnergy();
        _drawStars(canvas, ctx, energy);
        _starsRaf = requestAnimationFrame(() => _loop(canvas, ctx));
    }

    window._applyProfileStars = function(enabled) {
        const canvas = document.getElementById('profile-stars-canvas');
        if (!canvas) return;

        if (!enabled) {
            _starsEnabled = false;
            if (_starsRaf) { cancelAnimationFrame(_starsRaf); _starsRaf = null; }
            canvas.style.opacity = '0';
            return;
        }

        _starsEnabled = true;
        canvas.style.opacity = '1';

        const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
        const W = canvas.offsetWidth || canvas.parentElement.offsetWidth;
        const H = canvas.offsetHeight || canvas.parentElement.offsetHeight;
        canvas.width  = W * dpr;
        canvas.height = H * dpr;
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        ctx.scale(dpr, dpr);
        _initStars({ width: W, height: H });

        if (_starsRaf) cancelAnimationFrame(_starsRaf);
        _loop(canvas, ctx);
    };
})();

(function() {
    let _selectedMsgIds = new Set();

    window.reportUser = async () => {
        if (!window.currentChatId) return;
        if (window.currentChatData?.isGroup) return alert('Reports are for DMs only.');
        if (!window.spamGuard('report_user', 3, 60000)) return alert('You\'re filing reports too quickly. Slow down.');
        if (!window.cooldownCheck('report_user', 15000)) return alert('Wait before filing another report.');
        _selectedMsgIds = new Set();
        _openReportModal();
    };

    function _openReportModal() {
        const modal = document.getElementById('report-modal');
        const list  = document.getElementById('report-msg-list');
        const countEl = document.getElementById('report-selected-count');
        const reasonInp = document.getElementById('report-reason-input');
        const statusMsg = document.getElementById('report-modal-msg');
        if (!modal || !list) return;
        reasonInp.value = '';
        statusMsg.style.display = 'none';
        countEl.textContent = '';
        list.innerHTML = '';
        _selectedMsgIds = new Set();

        const msgs = (window.cachedMessages || []).slice(-30);
        if (msgs.length === 0) {
            list.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:12px;color:#555566;padding:12px 0;text-align:center;">No messages to attach. The report will still be filed.</div>';
        } else {
            msgs.forEach(m => {
                const isMe = m.uid === window.myUID;
                const timeStr = m.timestamp?.toDate ? m.timestamp.toDate().toLocaleTimeString([],{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'}) : '';
                const div = document.createElement('div');
                div.id = 'rmsg-' + m.id;
                div.dataset.msgId = m.id;
                div.style.cssText = 'display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:8px;padding:7px 10px;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;border:1.5px solid transparent;background:#08080f;transition:all 0.12s;user-select:none;';
                div.innerHTML = `
                    <div style="width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:4px;border:2px solid #2a2a3e;background:transparent;flex-shrink:0;margin-top:2px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:10px;transition:all 0.12s;" class="rmsg-check"></div>
                    <div style="flex:1;min-width:0;">
                        <span style="font-size:10px;font-weight:800;color:${isMe ? '#6366f1' : '#f87171'};">${window.escHtml ? window.escHtml(m.username||m.uid||'?') : (m.username||'?')}</span>
                        <span style="font-size:10px;color:#333345;margin-left:5px;">${timeStr}</span>
                        <div style="font-size:12px;color:#c8c8d8;margin-top:2px;word-break:break-word;">${window.escHtml ? window.escHtml(m.text||'[media/attachment]') : (m.text||'[media/attachment]')}</div>
                    </div>`;
                div.addEventListener('click', () => _toggleMsg(m.id, m, div));
                list.appendChild(div);
            });
        }

        modal.style.display = 'flex';
        document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    }

    function _toggleMsg(id, m, el) {
        const check = el.querySelector('.rmsg-check');
        if (_selectedMsgIds.has(id)) {
            _selectedMsgIds.delete(id);
            el.style.borderColor = 'transparent';
            el.style.background = '#08080f';
            if (check) { check.style.background = 'transparent'; check.style.borderColor = '#2a2a3e'; check.textContent = ''; }
        } else {
            _selectedMsgIds.add(id);
            el.style.borderColor = 'rgba(239,68,68,0.4)';
            el.style.background = 'rgba(239,68,68,0.05)';
            if (check) { check.style.background = '#ef4444'; check.style.borderColor = '#ef4444'; check.textContent = '✓'; }
        }
        const countEl = document.getElementById('report-selected-count');
        if (countEl) countEl.textContent = _selectedMsgIds.size > 0 ? `${_selectedMsgIds.size} message${_selectedMsgIds.size>1?'s':''} selected as evidence` : '';
    }

    window._closeReportModal = () => {
        const modal = document.getElementById('report-modal');
        if (modal) modal.style.display = 'none';
        document.body.style.overflow = '';
        _selectedMsgIds = new Set();
    };

    window._submitReport = async () => {
        const btn = document.getElementById('report-submit-btn');
        const statusMsg = document.getElementById('report-modal-msg');
        const reason = (document.getElementById('report-reason-input')?.value || '').trim();
        if (btn) { btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = 'Filing...'; }
        try {
            const { addDoc, collection, serverTimestamp } = await import('https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.11.0/firebase-firestore.js');
            const { getFirestore } = await import('https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.11.0/firebase-firestore.js');
            const { getApps } = await import('https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.11.0/firebase-app.js');
            const _db = getFirestore(getApps()[0]);
            const targetId = window.currentChatData?.participants?.find(id => id !== window.myUID);
            const targetName = window.currentChatData?.names?.[targetId] || 'Unknown';
            const attachedMessages = [];
            if (_selectedMsgIds.size > 0) {
                const msgs = (window.cachedMessages || []);
                _selectedMsgIds.forEach(mid => {
                    const m = msgs.find(x => x.id === mid);
                    if (m) {
                        const timeStr = m.timestamp?.toDate ? m.timestamp.toDate().toLocaleTimeString([],{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'}) : '';
                        attachedMessages.push({ msgId: m.id, uid: m.uid, username: m.username || '?', text: m.text || '', time: timeStr });
                    }
                });
            }
            await addDoc(collection(_db, 'reports'), {
                reporterId: window.myUID,
                reporterName: window.myUsername,
                targetId,
                targetName,
                reason: reason || '',
                attachedMessages,
                timestamp: serverTimestamp()
            });
            if (statusMsg) { statusMsg.textContent = 'Report filed successfully.'; statusMsg.style.color = '#22c55e'; statusMsg.style.display = 'block'; }
            setTimeout(() => window._closeReportModal(), 1500);
        } catch(e) {
            if (statusMsg) { statusMsg.textContent = 'Error: ' + e.message; statusMsg.style.color = '#f87171'; statusMsg.style.display = 'block'; }
        } finally {
            if (btn) { btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = 'File Report'; }
        }
    };

    document.getElementById('report-modal')?.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        if (e.target === document.getElementById('report-modal')) window._closeReportModal();
    });
})();

(function () {
    'use strict';

    const RTDB_SIGNAL_ROOT = 'remote_control';
    const RC_LEGACY_DEVICE = 'home_pc';
    const RC_STORE_KEY     = 'rc_devices_v1';

    function _rcNormalizeDeviceId(id) {
        return String(id || '').trim().toLowerCase().replace(/[.$#[\]/\s]/g, '');
    }
    function _rcValidDeviceId(id) {
        const v = _rcNormalizeDeviceId(id);
        return v.length >= 4 && v.length <= 64 ? v : null;
    }

    function _rcLoadDevices() {
        try { const v = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(RC_STORE_KEY) || '[]'); return Array.isArray(v) ? v : []; }
        catch (e) { return []; }
    }
    function _rcSaveDevice(id, label, secret) {
        const list = _rcLoadDevices().filter(d => d.id !== id);
        list.unshift({ id, label: label || id, secret: secret || null, at: Date.now() });
        try { localStorage.setItem(RC_STORE_KEY, JSON.stringify(list.slice(0, 10))); } catch (e) {}
    }
    window.rcForgetDevice = function (id) {
        try { localStorage.setItem(RC_STORE_KEY, JSON.stringify(_rcLoadDevices().filter(d => d.id !== id))); } catch (e) {}
    };
    window.rcListDevices = _rcLoadDevices;

    async function _rcAuthProof(deviceId, password) {
        if (!password) return null;
        const data = new TextEncoder().encode(deviceId + ':' + password);
        const buf  = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', data);
        return [...new Uint8Array(buf)].map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    }

    const _rcIsTouch = () => ('ontouchstart' in window || navigator.maxTouchPoints > 0);

    let _rcPaneSeq = 0;
    function _rcSetPane(el, show) {
        if (!el) return;
        const visible = !el.classList.contains('rc-off');
        if (show === visible && !el.classList.contains('rc-fade')) return;
        const seq = ++_rcPaneSeq;
        el._rcSeq = seq;
        if (show) {
            el.classList.add('rc-enter');
            el.classList.remove('rc-off', 'rc-fade');
            void el.offsetWidth;
            requestAnimationFrame(() => { if (el._rcSeq === seq) el.classList.remove('rc-enter'); });
        } else {
            el.classList.remove('rc-enter');
            el.classList.add('rc-fade');
            setTimeout(() => {
                if (el._rcSeq !== seq) return;
                el.classList.add('rc-off');
                el.classList.remove('rc-fade');
            }, 240);
        }
    }

    function _rcRefreshEmptyState() {
        const empty  = document.getElementById('rc-empty');
        const grid   = document.getElementById('rc-grid');
        const picker = document.getElementById('rc-picker');

        if (!empty || !grid) return;
        const live  = grid.children.length > 0;
        const saved = _rcLoadDevices();

        _rcSetPane(grid,  live);
        _rcSetPane(empty, !live && saved.length === 0);
        _rcSetPane(picker, !live && saved.length > 0);
        if (rail) rail.classList.toggle('rc-hidden', !live || _rcUserHidRail);
        if (!live) _rcRenderPicker();
    }

    window.rcFocus = function (id) {
        const s = _rcSession(id);
        if (!s || _rcFocusId === id) return;
        if (typeof _rcReleaseAll === 'function') _rcReleaseAll('focus change');
        _rcSessions.forEach((o) => {
            if (o.videoEl) o.videoEl.removeAttribute('id');

            if (o.stageEl) o.stageEl.removeAttribute('id');

        });
        _rcFocusId = id;
        if (s.videoEl) s.videoEl.id = RC_LEGACY_IDS.video;
        if (s.overlay) s.overlay.id = RC_LEGACY_IDS.overlay;
        if (s.stageEl) s.stageEl.id = RC_LEGACY_IDS.wrap;
        s.tile?.classList.add('rc-tile-focused');
        _rcBindDC();
        if (typeof rcResetZoom === 'function') rcResetZoom();
        _rcSessions.forEach((o) => {
            if (o.overlay && o.id !== id) {
                o.overlay.style.left = ''; o.overlay.style.top = '';
                o.overlay.style.width = ''; o.overlay.style.height = '';
                o.overlay.style.right = ''; o.overlay.style.bottom = '';
            }
        });
        requestAnimationFrame(() => { if (_rcFocusId === id) _rcSyncOverlayToVideo(); });
        const label = document.getElementById('rc-device-label');
        if (label) label.textContent = '· ' + _rcLabelFor(id);
        _rcSetStatus(s.status || 'Connecting…', s.status === 'Connected' ? '#22c55e' : '#f59e0b');

        if (s.videoEl && s.videoEl.srcObject) _rcStartFpsMonitor(s.videoEl);

        if (!_rcSessions.size) _rcRenderPicker();

        const saved = _rcLoadDevices();
        if (!saved.length) {

        host.innerHTML = '';

            if (live) {

            } else {
                acts.appendChild(mk('Connect', 'Connect to this PC', () => window.rcConnectHomePc({ deviceId: d.id }), 'primary'));
                acts.appendChild(mk('✎', 'Rename', () => window.rcRenameDevice(d.id)));
                acts.appendChild(mk('🗑', 'Forget this PC', () => {
                    if (confirm('Forget "' + (d.label || d.id) + '"? The saved password goes with it.')) {
                        window.rcForgetDevice(d.id); _rcRenderSaved();
                    }
                }, 'danger'));
            }
            row.onclick = () => { if (live) window.rcFocus(d.id); else window.rcConnectHomePc({ deviceId: d.id }); };
            host.appendChild(row);
        });
        _rcRefreshEmptyState();
    }
    window.rcRenderSaved = _rcRenderSaved;

    window.rcConnectAll = async function () {

    window.rcShowConnectorSetup = function () {

                    <button id="rc-copy-btn" type="button" style="flex-shrink:0;padding:6px 11px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #1e1e2e;background:#0d0d1a;color:#c8c8d8;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;">Copy</button>
                </div>
                <p style="font-size:11.5px;color:#fbbf24;margin:12px 0 0;line-height:1.5;"><i class="fa-solid fa-triangle-exclamation"></i> Don't open it on this device — it does nothing here. Wait until you're at your home PC.</p>
                <ol style="margin:14px 0 0;padding-left:18px;font-size:12px;color:#888899;line-height:1.65;">

            const url = m.querySelector('#rc-setup-url').textContent;
            const done = () => { this.textContent = 'Copied'; setTimeout(() => { this.textContent = 'Copy'; }, 1800); };
            if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
                navigator.clipboard.writeText(url).then(done).catch(() => {
                    const t = document.createElement('textarea');

    window.rcConnectHomePc = async function (opts) {
        const o = opts || {};
        let id = _rcValidDeviceId(o.deviceId);
        let pw = o.password;
        let known = id ? _rcLoadDevices().find(d => d.id === id) : null;

        if (!id) {
            const raw = prompt('Device ID of the PC to connect to:', '');
            if (raw === null) return;
            id = _rcValidDeviceId(raw);
            if (!id) { alert('That device ID looks wrong — 4+ characters, no spaces or . $ # [ ] /'); return; }
            known = _rcLoadDevices().find(d => d.id === id);
        }
        if (_rcSessions.has(id)) {
            if (typeof window.switchView === 'function') window.switchView('remotepc');
            window.rcFocus(id);
            return;
        }

        let auth;
        if (known && known.secret && pw === undefined) {
            auth = known.secret;
        } else {
            if (pw === undefined || pw === null) {
                pw = prompt('Connection password for "' + id + '" (leave blank if none):', '');
                if (pw === null) return;
            }
            auth = await _rcAuthProof(id, pw);
        }
        _rcSaveDevice(id, (known && known.label) || id, auth);

        if (typeof window.switchView === 'function') window.switchView('remotepc');
        await _rcOpenSession(id, auth);
    };

    async function _rcOpenSession(id, auth) {
        let s = _rcSessions.get(id);
        if (!s) {
            s = { id, auth, pc: null, dc: null, rtdbRef: null, answerUnsub: null,
                  deadlineTimer: null, retryTimer: null, retryAttempt: 0,
                  manual: false, recoveryTimer: null, status: 'Connecting…', lastLog: '' };
            _rcSessions.set(id, s);
            _rcBuildTile(s);
        }
        s.auth = auth || s.auth;
        s.manual = false;
        if (!_rcFocusId) window.rcFocus(id);
        _rcSetStatus('Signalling…', '#f59e0b', id);
        _rcLog('Connecting to "' + _rcLabelFor(id) + '"…', id);
        try {
            await _rcStart(s);
        } catch (e) {
            _rcLog('Error: ' + e.message, id);
            _rcSetStatus('Error', '#f87171', id);
            _rcScheduleRetry('start error: ' + e.message, s);
        }
    }
    window.rcOpenSession = _rcOpenSession;

    function _rcScheduleRetry(reason, s) {
        if (!s) s = _rcFocused();
        if (!s || s.manual) return;
        _rcTeardown(s, true);
        if (s.retryAttempt >= MAX_RETRIES) {
            _rcSetStatus('Disconnected', '#333345', s.id);
            _rcLog('Gave up after ' + MAX_RETRIES + ' reconnect attempts (' + reason + '). Click Connect to retry.', s.id);
            return;
        }
        s.retryAttempt++;
        const delay = Math.min(2000 * (2 ** (s.retryAttempt - 1)), 30000);
        _rcSetStatus('Retrying…', '#f59e0b', s.id);
        _rcLog('Reconnect attempt ' + s.retryAttempt + '/' + MAX_RETRIES + ' in ' + Math.round(delay / 1000) + 's (' + reason + ')…', s.id);
        if (s.retryTimer) clearTimeout(s.retryTimer);
        s.retryTimer = setTimeout(() => {
            _rcStart(s).catch(e => _rcScheduleRetry('start error: ' + e.message, s));
        }, delay);
    }

    async function _rcStart(s) {
        if (!s) s = _rcFocused();
        if (!s) return;
        _rcTeardown(s, true);

        const _pcLocal = new RTCPeerConnection(ICE_CONFIG);
        s.pc = _pcLocal;
        const _pc = _pcLocal;

        const _rcVideoTransceiver = _pc.addTransceiver('video', { direction: 'recvonly' });

        if (typeof _rcVideoTransceiver.setCodecPreferences === 'function' && typeof RTCRtpReceiver !== 'undefined' && RTCRtpReceiver.getCapabilities) {
            const caps = RTCRtpReceiver.getCapabilities('video');
            if (caps) {
                const h264 = caps.codecs.filter(c => /h264/i.test(c.mimeType));
                const rest = caps.codecs.filter(c => !/h264/i.test(c.mimeType));
                if (h264.length) _rcVideoTransceiver.setCodecPreferences([...h264, ...rest]);
            }
        }

        const _rcAudioTransceiver = _pc.addTransceiver('audio', { direction: 'recvonly' });
        if (typeof _rcAudioTransceiver.setCodecPreferences === 'function' && typeof RTCRtpReceiver !== 'undefined' && RTCRtpReceiver.getCapabilities) {
            const acaps = RTCRtpReceiver.getCapabilities('audio');
            if (acaps) {
                const opus = acaps.codecs.filter(c => /opus/i.test(c.mimeType));
                const arest = acaps.codecs.filter(c => !/opus/i.test(c.mimeType));
                if (opus.length) _rcAudioTransceiver.setCodecPreferences([...opus, ...arest]);
            }
        }

        const _dcLocal = _pc.createDataChannel('remoteControl', { ordered: true });
        s.dc = _dcLocal;
        _dcLocal.onopen  = () => {
            _rcLog('DataChannel open — input forwarding active.', s.id);
            _rcBindDC();
        };
        _dcLocal.onclose = () => {
            _rcLog('DataChannel closed.', s.id);
            _rcBindDC();
            if (!s.manual) _rcScheduleRetry('data channel closed', s);
        };

        _pc.ontrack = (evt) => {
            if (evt.track && evt.track.kind === 'audio') {
                let a = document.getElementById('rc-audio-' + s.id);
                if (!a) {
                    a = document.createElement('audio');
                    a.id = 'rc-audio-' + s.id;
                    a.autoplay = true;
                    document.body.appendChild(a);
                }
                s.audioEl = a;
                a.srcObject = evt.streams[0];
                a.play().then(() => {
                    _rcLog('🔊 Desktop audio active.', s.id);
                }).catch(() => {
                    _rcLog('🔇 Audio blocked by autoplay policy — click the page once to enable sound.', s.id);
                });
                if ('playoutDelayHint' in evt.receiver) evt.receiver.playoutDelayHint = 0;
                return;
            }

            const video = s.videoEl;
            if (!video) return;
            video.srcObject = evt.streams[0];
            if (s.waitEl) s.waitEl.style.display = 'none';
            _rcRefreshEmptyState();
            _rcSetStatus('Connected', '#22c55e', s.id);
            _rcLog('🖥️  Live desktop stream active.', s.id);
            _rcWipeSignal(s);
            s.retryAttempt = 0;
            if (!_rcFocusId) window.rcFocus(s.id);

            if ('playoutDelayHint' in evt.receiver) evt.receiver.playoutDelayHint = 0;
            if ('jitterBufferTarget' in evt.receiver) evt.receiver.jitterBufferTarget = 0;

            if (_rcFocusId === s.id) {
                const fsBtn = document.getElementById('btn-fullscreen-rc');
                if (fsBtn) fsBtn.style.display = 'inline-flex';
                _rcStartFpsMonitor(video);
                _rcSyncOverlayToVideo();
            }
        };

        _pc.oniceconnectionstatechange = () => {
            const state = _pc.iceConnectionState;
            if (state === 'disconnected' || state === 'failed') {
                _rcSetStatus('Reconnecting…', '#f59e0b', s.id);
                _rcLog('ICE ' + state + ' — attempting recovery…', s.id);
                if (s.recoveryTimer) clearTimeout(s.recoveryTimer);
                if (typeof _pc.restartIce === 'function') _pc.restartIce();
                s.recoveryTimer = setTimeout(() => {
                    if (s.pc === _pc && (_pc.iceConnectionState === 'disconnected' || _pc.iceConnectionState === 'failed')) {
                        _rcScheduleRetry('ICE ' + _pc.iceConnectionState, s);
                    }
                }, 5000);
            } else if (state === 'connected' || state === 'completed') {
                if (s.recoveryTimer) { clearTimeout(s.recoveryTimer); s.recoveryTimer = null; }
            }
        };

        const offer = await _pc.createOffer();
        try {
            if (offer.sdp && /opus/i.test(offer.sdp)) {
                offer.sdp = offer.sdp.replace(/(a=fmtp:(\d+) [^\r\n]*)/g, (line, full, pt) => {
                    const rtpmap = new RegExp('a=rtpmap:' + pt + ' opus', 'i');
                    if (!rtpmap.test(offer.sdp)) return line;
                    let out = full;
                    if (!/stereo=/.test(out)) out += ';stereo=1';
                    if (!/sprop-stereo=/.test(out)) out += ';sprop-stereo=1';
                    return out;
                });
            }
        } catch (_) {   }
        await _pc.setLocalDescription(offer);

        await new Promise((resolve) => {
            if (_pc.iceGatheringState === 'complete') { resolve(); return; }
            const deadline = setTimeout(resolve, 8000);
            _pc.onicegatheringstatechange = () => {
                if (_pc.iceGatheringState === 'complete') {
                    clearTimeout(deadline);
                    resolve();
                }
            };
        });

        await _rcPushOffer(_pc.localDescription, s);
        _rcLog('Offer sent — waiting for that PC to answer…', s.id);
        _rcWatchForAnswer(s);

        s.deadlineTimer = setTimeout(() => {
            if (s.pc === _pc && !_pc.currentRemoteDescription) {
                _rcScheduleRetry('no answer from that PC', s);
            }
        }, 20000);
    }

    async function _rcGetRtdb(s) {
        if (!s) s = _rcFocused();
        if (!s) return null;
        if (s.rtdbRef) return s.rtdbRef;
        const { getDatabase, ref } = await import('https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.11.0/firebase-database.js');
        const { getApps } = await import('https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.11.0/firebase-app.js');
        const dbInst = getDatabase(getApps()[0]);
        s.rtdbRef = ref(dbInst, RTDB_SIGNAL_ROOT + '/' + s.id);
        return s.rtdbRef;
    }

    async function _rcPushOffer(offer, s) {
        const { set } = await import('https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.11.0/firebase-database.js');
        const r = await _rcGetRtdb(s);
        if (!r) return;
        await set(r, {
            offer: { sdp: offer.sdp, type: offer.type },
            auth: (s && s.auth) || null,
            from: (window.myUsername || 'EchoSpace user'),
            fromUid: (window.myUID || null),
            ts: Date.now()
        });
    }

    async function _rcWatchForAnswer(s) {
        if (!s) s = _rcFocused();
        if (!s) return;
        try {
            const { onValue } = await import('https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.11.0/firebase-database.js');
            const r = await _rcGetRtdb(s);
            if (!r) return;
            s.answerUnsub = onValue(r, async (snap) => {
                const data = snap.val();
                const pc = s.pc;
                if (data && data.answer && pc && !pc.currentRemoteDescription) {
                    if (s.answerUnsub) { try { s.answerUnsub(); } catch (_) {} s.answerUnsub = null; }
                    if (s.deadlineTimer) { clearTimeout(s.deadlineTimer); s.deadlineTimer = null; }
                    try {
                        await pc.setRemoteDescription(new RTCSessionDescription(data.answer));
                        _rcLog('Answer received — establishing P2P…', s.id);
                    } catch (e) { console.warn('[RC] setRemoteDescription failed:', e); }
                }
            });
        } catch (e) {
            console.warn('[RC] Answer listener error:', e);
        }
    }

    async function _rcWipeSignal(s) {
        if (!s) s = _rcFocused();
        if (!s) return;
        try {
            const { remove } = await import('https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.11.0/firebase-database.js');
            const r = await _rcGetRtdb(s);
            if (!r) return;
            await remove(r);
            s.rtdbRef = null;
            console.log('[RC] Signal path wiped for', s.id, '✓');
        } catch (e) {
            console.warn('[RC] Signal wipe failed:', e);
        }
    }

    function _rcTeardown(s, quiet = false, manual = false) {
        if (!s) return;
        if (manual) {
            s.manual = true;
            if (s.retryTimer) { clearTimeout(s.retryTimer); s.retryTimer = null; }
        }
        if (s.answerUnsub)   { try { s.answerUnsub(); } catch (e) {} s.answerUnsub = null; }
        if (s.deadlineTimer) { clearTimeout(s.deadlineTimer); s.deadlineTimer = null; }
        if (s.recoveryTimer) { clearTimeout(s.recoveryTimer); s.recoveryTimer = null; }
        if (s.dc) { s.dc.onclose = null; try { s.dc.close(); } catch (_) {} s.dc = null; }
        if (s.pc) { s.pc.oniceconnectionstatechange = null; try { s.pc.close(); } catch (_) {} s.pc = null; }
        s.rtdbRef = null;
        _rcBindDC();
        if (s.videoEl) s.videoEl.srcObject = null;
        if (s.audioEl) { try { s.audioEl.pause(); } catch (_) {} s.audioEl.srcObject = null; }
        if (s.waitEl)  s.waitEl.style.display = '';
        if (_rcFocusId === s.id && typeof _rcReleaseAll === 'function') _rcReleaseAll('disconnect');
        if (!quiet) {
            _rcSetStatus('Disconnected', '#333345', s.id);
            _rcLog('Session ended.', s.id);
        }
    }

    window.rcDisconnectDevice = function (id, manual = false) {
        const s = _rcSession(id);
        if (!s) return;
        _rcTeardown(s, false, manual);
        _rcWipeSignal(s).catch(() => {});
        _rcDestroyTile(s);
        _rcSessions.delete(id);
        if (_rcFocusId === id) {
            _rcFocusId = null;
            const next = _rcSessions.keys().next();
            if (!next.done) window.rcFocus(next.value);
            else {
                const label = document.getElementById('rc-device-label');
                if (label) label.textContent = '';
                _rcStopFpsMonitor();
                const fsBtn = document.getElementById('btn-fullscreen-rc');
                if (fsBtn) fsBtn.style.display = 'none';
                const fpsEl = document.getElementById('rc-fps');
                if (fpsEl) fpsEl.style.display = 'none';
                _rcSetStatus('Disconnected', '#333345');
            }
        }
        _rcRenderSaved();
    };

    window.rcDisconnect = function (quiet = false, manual = false) {
        const s = _rcFocused();
        if (!s) return;
        if (manual) { window.rcDisconnectDevice(s.id, true); return; }
        _rcTeardown(s, quiet, manual);
        if (document.fullscreenElement) {
            document.exitFullscreen?.() || document.webkitExitFullscreen?.() || document.msExitFullscreen?.();
        }
        if (typeof rcResetZoom === 'function') rcResetZoom();
        const kbInput = document.getElementById('rc-mobile-kb-input');
        if (kbInput) { kbInput.blur(); kbInput.value = ''; }
    };

    window.rcToggleFullscreen = function () {
        const target = document.getElementById('rc-video-wrap');
        if (!target) return;

        if (!document.fullscreenElement) {
            (target.requestFullscreen?.() || target.webkitRequestFullscreen?.() || target.msRequestFullscreen?.());
        } else {
            document.exitFullscreen?.() || document.webkitExitFullscreen?.() || document.msExitFullscreen?.();
        }
    };

    document.addEventListener('fullscreenchange', () => {
        const isFs = !!document.fullscreenElement;
        document.querySelectorAll('#btn-fullscreen-rc i, #rc-video-wrap i.fa-expand, #rc-video-wrap i.fa-compress').forEach(icon => {
            icon.className = isFs ? 'fas fa-compress' : 'fas fa-expand';
        });
        const video = document.getElementById('rc-video');
        if (video) {
            video.style.width  = isFs ? '100%' : '100%';
            video.style.height = isFs ? '100%' : 'auto';
            video.style.objectFit = isFs ? 'contain' : 'initial';
        }
    });

    let _fpsTimer = null;
    function _rcStartFpsMonitor(video) {
        _rcStopFpsMonitor();
        const fpsEl = document.getElementById('rc-fps');
        if (!fpsEl) return;

        const supportsQuality = typeof video.getVideoPlaybackQuality === 'function';
        fpsEl.style.display = 'inline-block';
        fpsEl.textContent = supportsQuality ? '-- FPS' : 'FPS n/a';
        if (!supportsQuality) return;

        let lastFrames = video.getVideoPlaybackQuality().totalVideoFrames;
        let lastTime   = performance.now();

        _fpsTimer = setInterval(() => {
            if (!video.isConnected || video.readyState < 2) return;
            const q    = video.getVideoPlaybackQuality();
            const now  = performance.now();
            const dFrames = q.totalVideoFrames - lastFrames;
            const dTime   = (now - lastTime) / 1000;
            const fps = dTime > 0 ? Math.round(dFrames / dTime) : 0;
            fpsEl.textContent = fps + ' FPS';
            fpsEl.style.color = fps >= 24 ? '#818cf8' : (fps >= 12 ? '#f59e0b' : '#f87171');
            lastFrames = q.totalVideoFrames;
            lastTime   = now;
        }, 1000);
    }
    function _rcStopFpsMonitor() {
        if (_fpsTimer) { clearInterval(_fpsTimer); _fpsTimer = null; }
    }


    function _rcSyncOverlayToVideo() {
        const wrap = document.getElementById('rc-video-wrap');
        const video = document.getElementById('rc-video');
        const overlay = document.getElementById('rc-overlay');
        if (!wrap || !video || !overlay) return;
        const wrapRect = wrap.getBoundingClientRect();
        const videoRect = video.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (videoRect.width === 0 || videoRect.height === 0) return;
        overlay.style.left   = (videoRect.left - wrapRect.left) + 'px';
        overlay.style.top    = (videoRect.top  - wrapRect.top)  + 'px';
        overlay.style.width  = videoRect.width  + 'px';
        overlay.style.height = videoRect.height + 'px';
        overlay.style.right  = 'auto';
        overlay.style.bottom = 'auto';
    }

    function _rcNormCoords(clientX, clientY) {
        const overlay = document.getElementById('rc-overlay');
        const rect = overlay.getBoundingClientRect();
        const contentX = (clientX - rect.left - _rcPanX) / _rcZoom;
        const contentY = (clientY - rect.top  - _rcPanY) / _rcZoom;
        return {
            nx: Math.min(1, Math.max(0, contentX / rect.width)),
            ny: Math.min(1, Math.max(0, contentY / rect.height))
        };
    }

    window.rcOnMouseMove = function (e) {
        if (!_rcInputDC()) return;
        const now = Date.now();
        if (now - _lastMove < THROTTLE_MS) return;
        _lastMove = now;
        const { nx, ny } = _rcNormCoords(e.clientX, e.clientY);
        _dc.send(`m:${nx.toFixed(4)},${ny.toFixed(4)}`);
    };

    function _rcButtonName(e) {
        return e.button === 2 ? 'right' : (e.button === 1 ? 'middle' : 'left');
    }

    const _rcHeldButtons = new Set();

    function _rcReleaseAll(why) {
        if (!_rcHeldButtons.size) return;
        if (_dc && _dc.readyState === 'open') {
            _rcHeldButtons.forEach(b => { try { _dc.send(`b:up:${b}`); } catch (_) {} });
        }
        _rcHeldButtons.clear();
        if (why) console.warn('[RC] released stuck buttons —', why);
    }
    window._rcReleaseAll = _rcReleaseAll;

    window.rcOnMouseDown = function (e) {
        if (!_rcInputDC()) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        const btn = _rcButtonName(e);
        _rcHeldButtons.add(btn);
        _dc.send(`b:down:${btn}`);
        const onUp = () => {
            document.removeEventListener('mouseup', onUp);
            if (!_rcHeldButtons.has(btn)) return;
            _rcHeldButtons.delete(btn);
            if (_dc && _dc.readyState === 'open') _dc.send(`b:up:${btn}`);
        };
        document.addEventListener('mouseup', onUp);
    };

    window.addEventListener('blur',       () => _rcReleaseAll('window blur'));
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
        if (document.hidden) _rcReleaseAll('tab hidden');
    });
    window.addEventListener('pointercancel', () => _rcReleaseAll('pointer cancelled'));
    window.addEventListener('contextmenu',   () => _rcReleaseAll('context menu'));
    document.addEventListener('click', (ev) => {
        const nav = ev.target.closest && ev.target.closest('.nav-btn[data-view]');
        if (nav && nav.dataset.view !== 'remotepc') _rcReleaseAll('left the tab');
    }, true);

    document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
        if (!_rcInputDC()) return;
        const rcView = document.getElementById('view-remotepc');
        if (!rcView || rcView.hidden) return;
        if (document.activeElement?.id === 'rc-mobile-kb-input' && e.key.length === 1) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        _dc.send(`s:down:${e.key}`);
    });
    document.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
        if (!_rcInputDC()) return;
        const rcView = document.getElementById('view-remotepc');
        if (!rcView || rcView.hidden) return;
        if (document.activeElement?.id === 'rc-mobile-kb-input' && e.key.length === 1) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        _dc.send(`s:up:${e.key}`);
    });

    window.rcToggleMobileKeyboard = function () {
        const input = document.getElementById('rc-mobile-kb-input');
        if (!input) return;
        if (document.activeElement === input) input.blur();
        else { input.value = ''; input.focus(); }
    };
    (function () {
        const input = document.getElementById('rc-mobile-kb-input');
        if (!input) return;
        input.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
            if (!_dc || _dc.readyState !== 'open') return;
            if (e.inputType === 'insertText' && e.data) {
                for (const ch of e.data) { _dc.send(`s:down:${ch}`); _dc.send(`s:up:${ch}`); }
            }
            input.value = '';
        });
    })();

    let _rcZoom = 1, _rcPanX = 0, _rcPanY = 0;
    const RC_MAX_ZOOM = 4;
    let _touchDragActive = false;
    let _pinchActive = false;
    let _pinchStartDist = 0, _pinchStartZoom = 1, _pinchStartPanX = 0, _pinchStartPanY = 0, _pinchStartMidX = 0, _pinchStartMidY = 0;

    function _rcApplyZoomTransform() {
        const video = document.getElementById('rc-video');
        const badge = document.getElementById('rc-zoom-badge');
        if (video) video.style.transform = `translate(${_rcPanX}px, ${_rcPanY}px) scale(${_rcZoom})`;
        if (badge) badge.style.display = _rcZoom > 1.01 ? 'block' : 'none';
        if (badge) badge.textContent = Math.round(_rcZoom * 100) + '%';
    }
    function _rcClampPan(rect) {
        _rcPanX = Math.min(0, Math.max(rect.width  * (1 - _rcZoom), _rcPanX));
        _rcPanY = Math.min(0, Math.max(rect.height * (1 - _rcZoom), _rcPanY));
    }
    window.rcResetZoom = function () {
        _rcZoom = 1; _rcPanX = 0; _rcPanY = 0;
        _rcApplyZoomTransform();
    };

    (function () {
        window.addEventListener('resize', _rcSyncOverlayToVideo);
        window.addEventListener('orientationchange', () => setTimeout(_rcSyncOverlayToVideo, 250));
        document.addEventListener('fullscreenchange', () => setTimeout(_rcSyncOverlayToVideo, 100));
    })();

    function _rcBindTouchHandlers(overlay) {
        if (!overlay) return;

        const PENDING_MS = 100, MOVE_COMMIT_PX = 10;
        let _pending = null, _pendingTimer = null, _pendingStartX = 0, _pendingStartY = 0;

        function _cancelPending() {
            if (_pendingTimer) { clearTimeout(_pendingTimer); _pendingTimer = null; }
            _pending = null;
        }
        function _commitDrag(t) {
            if (_pinchActive) return;
            _touchDragActive = true;
            const { nx, ny } = _rcNormCoords(t.clientX, t.clientY);
            if (_dc && _dc.readyState === 'open') {
                _dc.send(`m:${nx.toFixed(4)},${ny.toFixed(4)}`);
                _dc.send('b:down:left');
            }
        }

        overlay.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
            if (e.touches.length >= 2) {
                _cancelPending();
                if (_touchDragActive) { _touchDragActive = false; if (_dc && _dc.readyState === 'open') _dc.send('b:up:left'); }
                const [t1, t2] = e.touches;
                _pinchStartDist = Math.hypot(t2.clientX - t1.clientX, t2.clientY - t1.clientY);
                _pinchStartZoom = _rcZoom; _pinchStartPanX = _rcPanX; _pinchStartPanY = _rcPanY;
                const rect = overlay.getBoundingClientRect();
                _pinchStartMidX = (t1.clientX + t2.clientX) / 2 - rect.left;
                _pinchStartMidY = (t1.clientY + t2.clientY) / 2 - rect.top;
                _pinchActive = true;
                e.preventDefault();
            } else if (e.touches.length === 1 && !_pinchActive) {
                const t = e.touches[0];
                _pending = t; _pendingStartX = t.clientX; _pendingStartY = t.clientY;
                _pendingTimer = setTimeout(() => {
                    _pendingTimer = null;
                    if (!_pinchActive && _pending) _commitDrag(_pending);
                }, PENDING_MS);
                e.preventDefault();
            }
        }, { passive: false });

        overlay.addEventListener('touchmove', (e) => {
            if (_pinchActive && e.touches.length === 2) {
                const [t1, t2] = e.touches;
                const rect = overlay.getBoundingClientRect();
                const dist = Math.hypot(t2.clientX - t1.clientX, t2.clientY - t1.clientY);
                const midX = (t1.clientX + t2.clientX) / 2 - rect.left;
                const midY = (t1.clientY + t2.clientY) / 2 - rect.top;
                const contentX = (_pinchStartMidX - _pinchStartPanX) / _pinchStartZoom;
                const contentY = (_pinchStartMidY - _pinchStartPanY) / _pinchStartZoom;
                _rcZoom = Math.min(RC_MAX_ZOOM, Math.max(1, _pinchStartZoom * (dist / _pinchStartDist)));
                _rcPanX = midX - contentX * _rcZoom;
                _rcPanY = midY - contentY * _rcZoom;
                _rcClampPan(rect);
                _rcApplyZoomTransform();
                e.preventDefault();
            } else if (_pendingTimer && e.touches.length === 1) {
                const t = e.touches[0];
                if (Math.hypot(t.clientX - _pendingStartX, t.clientY - _pendingStartY) > MOVE_COMMIT_PX) {
                    clearTimeout(_pendingTimer); _pendingTimer = null;
                    _commitDrag(t);
                }
                e.preventDefault();
            } else if (_touchDragActive && e.touches.length === 1) {
                const now = Date.now();
                if (now - _lastMove < THROTTLE_MS) return;
                _lastMove = now;
                const { nx, ny } = _rcNormCoords(e.touches[0].clientX, e.touches[0].clientY);
                if (_dc && _dc.readyState === 'open') _dc.send(`m:${nx.toFixed(4)},${ny.toFixed(4)}`);
                e.preventDefault();
            }
        }, { passive: false });

        function _rcTouchEnd(e) {
            if (e.touches.length < 2) _pinchActive = false;
            if (e.touches.length === 0 && _pendingTimer) {
                clearTimeout(_pendingTimer); _pendingTimer = null;
                if (_pending && _dc && _dc.readyState === 'open') {
                    const { nx, ny } = _rcNormCoords(_pending.clientX, _pending.clientY);
                    _dc.send(`m:${nx.toFixed(4)},${ny.toFixed(4)}`);
                    _dc.send('b:down:left');
                    _dc.send('b:up:left');
                }
                _pending = null;
            }
            if (e.touches.length === 0 && _touchDragActive) {
                _touchDragActive = false;
                if (_dc && _dc.readyState === 'open') _dc.send('b:up:left');
            }
        }
        overlay.addEventListener('touchend', _rcTouchEnd, { passive: true });
        overlay.addEventListener('touchcancel', _rcTouchEnd, { passive: true });
    }

    function _rcBindTileInput(s) {
        if (!s || !s.videoEl || !s.overlay) return;
        const resync = () => { if (_rcFocusId === s.id) _rcSyncOverlayToVideo(); };
        s.videoEl.addEventListener('loadedmetadata', resync);
        s.videoEl.addEventListener('resize', resync);
        if (typeof ResizeObserver !== 'undefined') {
            try {
                s.resizeObs = new ResizeObserver(() => resync());
                s.resizeObs.observe(s.stageEl);
                s.resizeObs.observe(s.videoEl);
            } catch (_) {}
        }
        _rcBindTouchHandlers(s.overlay);
    }

})();
</script>

<script>
(function () {
    const LOG = [];
    const MAX = 300;
    const buf = window.__diagBuf || [];
    const t0 = buf.length ? buf[0][2] : Date.now();
    function stamp(at) { return '+' + (((at || Date.now()) - t0) / 1000).toFixed(1) + 's'; }
    buf.forEach(e => LOG.push(stamp(e[2]) + ' [' + e[0] + '] ' + e[1]));
    window.__diagBuf = null;

    window._diag = function (tag, msg) {
        LOG.push(stamp() + ' [' + tag + '] ' + msg);
        if (LOG.length > MAX) LOG.shift();
        const box = document.getElementById('diag-text');
        if (box && document.getElementById('diag-modal').style.display === 'flex') _diagRender();
    };

    function _diagRender() {
        const box = document.getElementById('diag-text');
        if (!box) return;
        const header = [
            'EchoSpace diagnostics',
            'when:        ' + new Date().toISOString(),
            'href:        ' + location.href,
            'origin:      ' + location.origin,
            'realOrigin:  ' + (window.__REAL_ORIGIN__ || '(not set)'),
            'isAboutBlank:' + !!window.isAboutBlank,
            'ytApiLoaded: ' + (typeof YT !== 'undefined' && !!(YT && YT.Player)),
            'ua:          ' + navigator.userAgent,
            '─'.repeat(40),
        ].join('\n');
        box.value = header + '\n' + (LOG.length ? LOG.join('\n') : '(no events captured yet)');
        const c = document.getElementById('diag-count');
        if (c) c.textContent = LOG.length + ' event' + (LOG.length === 1 ? '' : 's');
    }

    window._diagOpen = function () {
        _diagRender();
        document.getElementById('diag-modal').style.display = 'flex';
    };
    window._diagClose = function () {
        document.getElementById('diag-modal').style.display = 'none';
    };
    window._diagCopy = function () {
        const box = document.getElementById('diag-text');
        const btn = document.getElementById('diag-copy-btn');
        const done = ok => { if (btn) { btn.textContent = ok ? '✓ Copied!' : 'Select + copy manually'; setTimeout(() => { btn.textContent = 'Copy All'; }, 2000); } };
        try {
            if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
                navigator.clipboard.writeText(box.value).then(() => done(true)).catch(() => {
                    box.select(); done(document.execCommand && document.execCommand('copy'));
                });
                return;
            }
        } catch (_) {}
        box.select();
        try { done(document.execCommand('copy')); } catch (_) { done(false); }
    };

    window.addEventListener('error', e => {
        window._diag('error', (e.message || 'script error') + ' @ ' + (e.filename || '?') + ':' + (e.lineno || '?'));
    });
    window.addEventListener('unhandledrejection', e => {
        const r = e.reason;
        window._diag('promise', (r && (r.message || r.code)) ? (r.code ? r.code + ' ' : '') + (r.message || '') : String(r));
    });
    const _origErr = console.error;
    console.error = function (...a) {
        try { window._diag('console', a.map(x => (x && x.message) ? x.message : String(x)).join(' ').slice(0, 300)); } catch (_) {}
        return _origErr.apply(console, a);
    };

    document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
        if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.shiftKey && (e.key === 'D' || e.key === 'd')) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const m = document.getElementById('diag-modal');
            if (m && m.style.display === 'flex') window._diagClose(); else window._diagOpen();
        }
    });

    window._diag('boot', 'diagnostics ready · isAboutBlank=' + !!window.isAboutBlank + ' · origin=' + location.origin);
})();
</script>

<script>

function _updatePollBtn() {
    const btn = document.getElementById('poll-create-btn');
    if (!btn) return;
    if (window.currentChatData?.isGroup) {
        btn.classList.remove('hidden');
        btn.style.display = 'inline-flex';
    } else {
        btn.classList.add('hidden');
        btn.style.display = '';
    }
}

const _origOpenChat = window.openChat;
if (typeof _origOpenChat === 'function') {
    window.openChat = function(...args) {
        const result = _origOpenChat.apply(this, args);
        setTimeout(_updatePollBtn, 200);
        return result;
    };
} else {
    const _waitPatch = setInterval(() => {
        if (typeof window.openChat === 'function') {
            clearInterval(_waitPatch);
            const orig = window.openChat;
            window.openChat = function(...args) {
                const r = orig.apply(this, args);
                setTimeout(_updatePollBtn, 200);
                return r;
            };
        }
    }, 300);
}

window.openPollModal = function() {
    if (!window.currentChatData?.isGroup) return;
    document.getElementById('poll-question-input').value = '';
    document.querySelectorAll('.poll-opt-inp').forEach((el, i) => {
        el.value = '';
        el.placeholder = `Option ${i + 1}`;
    });
    window._pollDurationHours = 0;
    document.querySelectorAll('.poll-dur-chip').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active'));
    const noLimit = document.querySelector('.poll-dur-chip[data-hours="0"]');
    if (noLimit) noLimit.classList.add('active');
    document.getElementById('poll-modal').classList.add('open');
    document.getElementById('poll-question-input').focus();
};

window.selectPollDuration = function(chip, hours) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.poll-dur-chip').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active'));
    chip.classList.add('active');
    window._pollDurationHours = hours;
};

window.closePollModal = function() {
    document.getElementById('poll-modal').classList.remove('open');
};

document.getElementById('poll-modal').addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    if (e.target === this) window.closePollModal();
});

window.addPollOption = function() {
    const list = document.getElementById('poll-options-list');
    const count = list.querySelectorAll('.poll-option-input-row').length;
    if (count >= 6) return showCooldownToast('Max 6 options.');
    const row = document.createElement('div');
    row.className = 'poll-option-input-row';
    row.innerHTML = `<input type="text" class="inp poll-opt-inp" placeholder="Option ${count + 1}" maxlength="100"><button class="poll-option-rm" onclick="removePollOption(this)" title="Remove">✕</button>`;
    list.appendChild(row);
};

window.removePollOption = function(btn) {
    const list = document.getElementById('poll-options-list');
    if (list.querySelectorAll('.poll-option-input-row').length <= 2) return showCooldownToast('Need at least 2 options.');
    btn.closest('.poll-option-input-row').remove();
    list.querySelectorAll('.poll-opt-inp').forEach((el, i) => {
        if (!el.value) el.placeholder = `Option ${i + 1}`;
    });
};

window.submitPoll = async function() {
    if (window._isTimedOut && window._isTimedOut()) { alert('You are timed out and cannot create polls right now.'); return; }
    const question = document.getElementById('poll-question-input').value.trim();
    if (!question) return alert('Enter a question.');
    const opts = [...document.querySelectorAll('.poll-opt-inp')].map(el => el.value.trim()).filter(Boolean);
    if (opts.length < 2) return alert('Need at least 2 non-empty options.');
    if (!window.currentChatId || !window.currentChatData?.isGroup) return;

    window.closePollModal();

    const { addDoc, collection, serverTimestamp, updateDoc, doc } = await import('https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.11.0/firebase-firestore.js');
    const pollData = {
        type: 'poll',
        uid: window.myUID,
        timestamp: serverTimestamp(),
        poll: {
            question,
            options: opts.map(text => ({ text, voters: [] })),
            totalVotes: 0,
            durationHours: window._pollDurationHours || 0,
            endsAt: (window._pollDurationHours && window._pollDurationHours > 0)
                ? new Date(Date.now() + (window._pollDurationHours * 3600 * 1000))
                : null,
        }
    };
    await updateDoc(doc(window.db, 'chats', window.currentChatId), {
        unreadBy: window.currentChatData.participants.filter(id => id !== window.myUID),
        lastActivity: serverTimestamp(),
    });
    await addDoc(collection(window.db, `chats/${window.currentChatId}/messages`), pollData);
};

window.votePoll = async function(msgId, chatId, optionIndex) {
    if (!chatId || !window.myUID) return;
    try {
        const { getDoc, updateDoc, doc } = await import('https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.11.0/firebase-firestore.js');
        const msgRef = doc(window.db, `chats/${chatId}/messages`, msgId);
        const snap = await getDoc(msgRef);
        if (!snap.exists()) return;
        const poll = snap.data().poll;
        if (!poll) return;

        const alreadyVoted = poll.options.some(o => o.voters.includes(window.myUID));
        const updatedOptions = poll.options.map((opt, i) => {
            const voters = opt.voters.filter(v => v !== window.myUID);
            if (i === optionIndex && !alreadyVoted) voters.push(window.myUID);
            return { ...opt, voters };
        });
        const totalVotes = updatedOptions.reduce((sum, o) => sum + o.voters.length, 0);
        await updateDoc(msgRef, { 'poll.options': updatedOptions, 'poll.totalVotes': totalVotes });
    } catch(e) {
        window.reportRuleDenial && window.reportRuleDenial('Chat — poll vote', e,
            { path: `chats/${chatId}/messages/${msgId}`, op: 'update(poll)' });
        console.warn('[Poll] vote error:', e);
    }
};


</script>

<script>

window.GAMES = {};

let _gfsCache = null;
async function _gfs() {
    if (!_gfsCache) _gfsCache = await import('https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.11.0/firebase-firestore.js');
    return _gfsCache;
}

const _gclone = o => JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(o));
const _gesc = s => window.escHtml(String(s == null ? '' : s));

function _gname(uid, chatData) {
    if (uid === window.myUID) return 'You';
    return (chatData?.names && chatData.names[uid]) || 'Player';
}

window._gameCardHtml = function(msgId, g, chatData) {
    const def = window.GAMES[g.gid];
    if (!def) {
        return `<div class="game-bubble"><div class="game-badge">🎮 Game</div>
            <div class="game-status">This game isn't available on your version.</div></div>`;
    }
    const ctx = {
        msgId, myUID: window.myUID, chatData,
        names: chatData?.names || {},
        nameOf: uid => _gname(uid, chatData),
        seated: (g.players || []).includes(window.myUID),
    };
    const over = !!g.done;
    ctx.over = over;
    ctx.myTurn = !!(def.turnBased && !over && (g.players || [])[g.turn] === window.myUID);
    ctx.canAct = !over && (ctx.myTurn || (!ctx.seated && def.openSeats && (g.players || []).length < (def.seats || 99)) || !def.turnBased);

    let seatsHtml = '';
    if (def.showSeats) {
        const marks = def.marks || ['●', '●'];
        seatsHtml = `<div class="game-seats">${(g.players || []).map((uid, i) => {
            const isActive = def.turnBased && !over && i === g.turn;
            return `<span class="game-seat${isActive ? ' active' : ''}">
                <span class="game-seat-mark ${i === 0 ? 'p0' : 'p1'}" style="color:${i === 0 ? '#818cf8' : '#f472b6'}">${marks[i] || '●'}</span>
                <span class="game-seat-name">${_gesc(ctx.nameOf(uid))}</span></span>`;
        }).join('')}${
            (g.players || []).length < (def.seats || 0)
                ? `<span class="game-seat" style="border-style:dashed;color:#444455;">waiting for a player…</span>` : ''
        }</div>`;
    }

    const st = def.status(g, ctx) || { text: '', tone: '' };
    return `<div class="game-bubble${ctx.myTurn ? ' my-turn' : ''}${over ? ' over' : ''}">
        <div class="game-badge">${def.emoji} ${_gesc(def.name)}</div>
        ${def.title ? `<div class="game-title">${_gesc(def.title(g, ctx))}</div>` : ''}
        ${seatsHtml}
        ${def.render(g, ctx)}
        <div class="game-status ${st.tone || ''}">${st.text || ''}</div>
    </div>`;
};

window._gameSwapCard = function(wrap, html, g) {
    const sig = JSON.stringify(g || {});
    if (wrap.dataset.gsig === sig) return;
    const keep = {};
    let hadFocus = null;
    wrap.querySelectorAll('[data-keep]').forEach(el => {
        keep[el.dataset.keep] = el.value;
        if (document.activeElement === el) hadFocus = el.dataset.keep;
    });
    wrap.innerHTML = html;
    wrap.dataset.gsig = sig;
    wrap.querySelectorAll('[data-keep]').forEach(el => {
        if (keep[el.dataset.keep] != null) el.value = keep[el.dataset.keep];
        if (hadFocus === el.dataset.keep) el.focus();
    });
};

window.gplay = async function(msgId, action, arg) {
    const chatId = window.currentChatId;
    if (!chatId || !window.myUID) return;
    if (window._isTimedOut && window._isTimedOut()) {
        return showCooldownToast('You are timed out and cannot play right now.');
    }
    let ended = false;
    try {
        const { runTransaction, doc } = await _gfs();
        const ref = doc(window.db, `chats/${chatId}/messages`, msgId);
        await runTransaction(window.db, async tx => {
            const snap = await tx.get(ref);
            if (!snap.exists()) throw new Error('gone');
            const m = snap.data();
            const g = m.game;
            if (!g || m.type !== 'game') throw new Error('notgame');
            const def = window.GAMES[g.gid];
            if (!def) throw new Error('nodef');
            if (g.done) throw new Error('over');

            const chatData = window.currentChatData;
            const players = g.players || [];
            const seated = players.includes(window.myUID);

            if (def.turnBased) {
                if (seated) {
                    if (players[g.turn] !== window.myUID) throw new Error('notyourturn');
                } else if (!def.openSeats || players.length >= (def.seats || 2)) {
                    throw new Error('nofreeseat');
                }
            }

            const ctx = {
                msgId, myUID: window.myUID, chatData,
                names: chatData?.names || {},
                nameOf: uid => _gname(uid, chatData),
                seated,
                participants: chatData?.participants || [],
            };
            const next = def.act(_gclone(g), ctx, action, arg);
            if (!next) throw new Error('rejected');
            ended = !!next.done;
            tx.update(ref, { game: next });
        });
    } catch (e) {
        const quiet = ['rejected', 'notyourturn', 'over', 'nofreeseat', 'gone', 'notgame', 'nodef'];
        if (window.reportRuleDenial && window.reportRuleDenial('Chat games — move', e,
                { path: `chats/${chatId}/messages/${msgId}`, op: 'update(game)' })) return;
        if (!quiet.includes(e.message)) console.warn('[Game] move failed:', e);
        else if (e.message === 'notyourturn') showCooldownToast("Hold on — it's not your turn.");
        else if (e.message === 'nofreeseat') showCooldownToast('This game is already full.');
        return;
    }
    if (ended) _gameBumpChat(chatId);
};

async function _gameBumpChat(chatId) {
    try {
        const { updateDoc, doc, serverTimestamp } = await _gfs();
        const cd = window.currentChatData;
        if (!cd) return;
        await updateDoc(doc(window.db, 'chats', chatId), {
            unreadBy: (cd.participants || []).filter(id => id !== window.myUID),
            lastActivity: serverTimestamp(),
        });
    } catch (e) {
        window.reportRuleDenial && window.reportRuleDenial('Chat games — end bump', e,
            { path: `chats/${chatId}`, op: 'update(unreadBy,lastActivity)' });
    }
}

window.gsubmit = function(msgId, action, inputKey) {
    const wrap = document.getElementById('game-wrap-' + msgId);
    const el = wrap && wrap.querySelector(`[data-keep="${inputKey}"]`);
    if (!el) return;
    const val = el.value.trim();
    if (!val) return;
    if (window.globalContainsFlaggedWord && window.globalContainsFlaggedWord(val)) {
        return showCooldownToast("That won't fly here — keep it clean.");
    }
    el.value = '';
    window.gplay(msgId, action, val);
};
window.gkey = function(ev, msgId, action, inputKey) {
    if (ev.key === 'Enter') { ev.preventDefault(); window.gsubmit(msgId, action, inputKey); }
};


const _TTT_LINES = [[0,1,2],[3,4,5],[6,7,8],[0,3,6],[1,4,7],[2,5,8],[0,4,8],[2,4,6]];
window.GAMES.tictactoe = {

        if (!g.players.includes(ctx.myUID)) {
            if (g.players.length >= 2) return null;
            g.players.push(ctx.myUID);
        }
        const seat = g.players.indexOf(ctx.myUID);
        if (seat !== g.turn) return null;
        g.board = g.board.substring(0, i) + seat + g.board.substring(i + 1);
        const line = _TTT_LINES.find(l => l.every(x => g.board[x] === String(seat)));

        else if (!g.board.includes('.')) { g.winner = null; g.done = true; }
        else g.turn = 1 - seat;
        return g;
    },
};

const _C4_W = 7, _C4_H = 6;
function _c4Win(b, col, row, seat) {
    const at = (c, r) => (c < 0 || c >= _C4_W || r < 0 || r >= _C4_H) ? null : b[r * _C4_W + c];
    const dirs = [[1,0],[0,1],[1,1],[1,-1]];
    for (const [dc, dr] of dirs) {
        const line = [row * _C4_W + col];
        for (const sign of [1, -1]) {
            let c = col + dc * sign, r = row + dr * sign;
            while (at(c, r) === String(seat)) { line.push(r * _C4_W + c); c += dc * sign; r += dr * sign; }
        }
        if (line.length >= 4) return line;
    }
    return null;
}
window.GAMES.connect4 = {
    id: 'connect4', name: 'Connect 4', emoji: '🔴', blurb: 'Drop discs. Four in a row takes it.',
    scope: 'both', seats: 2, turnBased: true, openSeats: true, showSeats: true,
    marks: ['●', '●'],
    create(ctx) {
        const players = ctx.isGroup
            ? [ctx.myUID]
            : [ctx.myUID, ...ctx.participants.filter(u => u !== ctx.myUID)].slice(0, 2);
        return { gid: 'connect4', players, turn: 0, board: '.'.repeat(_C4_W * _C4_H), line: null, winner: null, done: false };
    },
    status(g, ctx) {
        if (g.done) {
            if (g.winner === null) return { text: 'Board full — draw.', tone: 'draw' };
            return g.winner === ctx.myUID ? { text: '🎉 You win!', tone: 'win' } : { text: `${ctx.nameOf(g.winner)} wins.`, tone: 'lose' };
        }
        if (g.players.length < 2) return { text: ctx.seated ? 'Waiting for someone to join…' : 'Tap a column to join.', tone: '' };
        return ctx.myTurn ? { text: 'Your drop.', tone: 'turn' } : { text: `Waiting on ${ctx.nameOf(g.players[g.turn])}…`, tone: '' };
    },
    render(g, ctx) {
        let cells = '';
        for (let r = 0; r < _C4_H; r++) {
            for (let c = 0; c < _C4_W; c++) {
                const i = r * _C4_W + c;
                const v = g.board[i];
                const colOpen = g.board[c] === '.';
                const live = colOpen && ctx.canAct;
                const hit = g.line && g.line.includes(i);
                cells += `<div class="game-cell${live ? ' live' : ''}${hit ? ' hit' : ''}" style="border-radius:50%;"
                    ${live ? `onclick="gplay('${ctx.msgId}','drop',${c})"` : ''}>${
                    v === '.' ? '' : `<span class="disc p${v}"></span>`
                }</div>`;
            }
        }
        return `<div class="game-grid" style="grid-template-columns:repeat(7,1fr);gap:3px;">${cells}</div>`;
    },
    act(g, ctx, action, col) {
        if (action !== 'drop') return null;
        if (typeof col !== 'number' || col < 0 || col >= _C4_W) return null;
        if (!g.players.includes(ctx.myUID)) {
            if (g.players.length >= 2) return null;
            g.players.push(ctx.myUID);
        }
        const seat = g.players.indexOf(ctx.myUID);
        if (seat !== g.turn) return null;
        let row = -1;
        for (let r = _C4_H - 1; r >= 0; r--) { if (g.board[r * _C4_W + col] === '.') { row = r; break; } }
        if (row === -1) return null;
        const i = row * _C4_W + col;
        g.board = g.board.substring(0, i) + seat + g.board.substring(i + 1);
        const line = _c4Win(g.board, col, row, seat);
        if (line) { g.line = line; g.winner = ctx.myUID; g.done = true; }
        else if (!g.board.includes('.')) { g.winner = null; g.done = true; }
        else g.turn = 1 - seat;
        return g;
    },
};

window.GAMES.twotruths = {
    id: 'twotruths', name: 'Two Truths & a Lie', emoji: '🕵️', blurb: 'Write three. They guess the lie.',
    scope: 'both', turnBased: false,
    setup: [
        { key: 't1', label: 'Truth', ph: 'Something true about you', max: 90 },

        }
        if (g.revealed) {
            const mine = g.guesses[ctx.myUID];
            if (mine == null) return { text: 'The lie is revealed.', tone: '' };
            return mine === g.lieIndex ? { text: '🎉 You spotted it!', tone: 'win' } : { text: 'Fooled you.', tone: 'lose' };
        }
        return g.guesses[ctx.myUID] != null ? { text: 'Locked in. Waiting for the reveal…', tone: '' } : { text: 'Pick the lie.', tone: 'turn' };
    },
    render(g, ctx) {

        const guessed = mine != null;

        const body = g.items.map((text, i) => {
            const n = Object.values(g.guesses).filter(v => v === i).length;
            const pct = total ? Math.round((n / total) * 100) : 0;
            const show = g.revealed;
            const isLie = show && i === g.lieIndex;
            const locked = isAuthor || guessed || g.revealed;
            let cls = 'game-choice';
            if (locked) cls += ' locked';
            if (mine === i) cls += ' picked';
            if (show && isLie) cls += ' correct';
            else if (show && mine === i) cls += ' wrong';
            return `<div class="${cls}" ${locked ? '' : `onclick="gplay('${ctx.msgId}','guess',${i})"`}>
                <div class="game-choice-bar ${show ? (isLie ? 'good' : 'bad') : ''}" style="width:${(isAuthor || show) && total ? pct : 0}%"></div>
                <div class="game-choice-inner">
                    <span class="game-choice-label">${_gesc(text)}</span>
                    ${show && isLie ? '<span class="game-choice-tag" style="color:#22c55e;">LIE</span>'
                        : (isAuthor || show) && total ? `<span class="game-choice-tag">${pct}%</span>` : ''}
                </div>
            </div>`;
        }).join('');
        const revealBtn = (isAuthor && !g.revealed)
            ? `<button class="game-btn" style="margin-top:4px;" onclick="gplay('${ctx.msgId}','reveal')">Reveal the lie</button>` : '';
        return body + revealBtn;
    },
    act(g, ctx, action, i) {
        if (action === 'reveal') {
            if (ctx.myUID !== g.author || g.revealed) return null;
            g.revealed = true; g.done = true;
            return g;
        }
        if (action !== 'guess') return null;
        if (g.revealed || ctx.myUID === g.author) return null;
        if (typeof i !== 'number' || i < 0 || i >= g.items.length) return null;
        if (g.guesses[ctx.myUID] != null) return null;
        g.guesses[ctx.myUID] = i;
        return g;
    },
};

const _TRIVIA_N = 8;
function _triviaPick() {
    const pool = _TRIVIA.map((q, i) => i);
    for (let i = pool.length - 1; i > 0; i--) { const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1)); [pool[i], pool[j]] = [pool[j], pool[i]]; }
    return pool.slice(0, _TRIVIA_N).map(idx => {
        const [q, opts, ans] = _TRIVIA[idx];
        const order = opts.map((_, i) => i);
        for (let i = order.length - 1; i > 0; i--) { const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1)); [order[i], order[j]] = [order[j], order[i]]; }
        return { q, o: order.map(i => opts[i]), a: order.indexOf(ans) };
    });
}
window.GAMES.trivia = {
    id: 'trivia', name: 'Trivia', emoji: '🧠', blurb: `${_TRIVIA_N} questions. Everyone races.`,
    scope: 'both', turnBased: false,
    create() { return { gid: 'trivia', qs: _triviaPick(), prog: {}, done: false }; },
    title(g) { return `Trivia — ${g.qs.length} questions`; },
    status(g, ctx) {
        const me = g.prog[ctx.myUID];
        if (!me) return { text: 'Tap an answer to jump in.', tone: 'turn' };
        if (me.i >= g.qs.length) return { text: `Finished — ${me.score}/${g.qs.length} correct.`, tone: me.score > g.qs.length / 2 ? 'win' : '' };
        return { text: `Question ${me.i + 1} of ${g.qs.length}`, tone: 'turn' };
    },
    render(g, ctx) {
        const me = g.prog[ctx.myUID];
        const board = Object.keys(g.prog).sort((a, b) => g.prog[b].score - g.prog[a].score);
        const boardHtml = board.length ? `<div style="margin-top:11px;">${board.map(uid => {
            const p = g.prog[uid];
            const fin = p.i >= g.qs.length;
            return `<div class="game-score-row${uid === ctx.myUID ? ' me' : ''}">
                <span style="overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;">${fin ? '🏁 ' : ''}${_gesc(ctx.nameOf(uid))}</span>
                <span class="game-score-val">${p.score}<span style="color:#3d3d52;font-weight:700;">/${fin ? g.qs.length : p.i}</span></span>
            </div>`;
        }).join('')}</div>` : '';

        if (me && me.i >= g.qs.length) {
            return `<div style="font-size:11px;color:#555566;font-weight:700;text-align:center;padding:6px 0 2px;">Final scores</div>${boardHtml}`;
        }
        const qi = me ? me.i : 0;
        const q = g.qs[qi];
        const justAnswered = me && me.last && me.last.qi === qi - 1;
        const feedback = justAnswered
            ? `<div style="font-size:10px;font-weight:800;text-align:center;margin-bottom:8px;color:${me.last.ok ? '#22c55e' : '#f87171'};">
                 ${me.last.ok ? '✓ Correct!' : `✕ It was "${_gesc(g.qs[qi - 1].o[g.qs[qi - 1].a])}"`}</div>` : '';
        return `${feedback}<div style="font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:#e8e8f0;margin-bottom:10px;line-height:1.45;">${_gesc(q.q)}</div>${
            q.o.map((opt, i) => `<div class="game-choice" onclick="gplay('${ctx.msgId}','answer',${i})">
                <div class="game-choice-inner"><span class="game-choice-label">${_gesc(opt)}</span></div>
            </div>`).join('')
        }${boardHtml}`;
    },
    act(g, ctx, action, i) {
        if (action !== 'answer') return null;
        g.prog = g.prog || {};
        const me = g.prog[ctx.myUID] || { i: 0, score: 0, last: null };
        if (me.i >= g.qs.length) return null;
        const q = g.qs[me.i];
        if (typeof i !== 'number' || i < 0 || i >= q.o.length) return null;
        const ok = i === q.a;
        g.prog[ctx.myUID] = { i: me.i + 1, score: me.score + (ok ? 1 : 0), last: { qi: me.i, ok } };
        const all = Object.values(g.prog);
        if (all.length && all.every(p => p.i >= g.qs.length)) g.done = true;
        return g;
    },
};

    status(g, ctx) {
        if (g.done) return { text: '📖 The end.', tone: 'win' };
