        const last = g.lines[g.lines.length - 1];
        const canAdd = !g.done && last.uid !== ctx.myUID;
        const linesHtml = `<div class="game-story">${g.lines.map(l =>
            `<div class="game-story-line"><span class="game-story-who">${_gesc(ctx.nameOf(l.uid))}</span>${_gesc(l.text)}</div>`
        ).join('')}</div>`;
        if (!canAdd) return linesHtml;
        return linesHtml + `<input class="game-inline-input" data-keep="line" maxlength="140"
                placeholder="Add the next line…"
                onkeydown="gkey(event,'${ctx.msgId}','add','line')">
            <div class="game-row"><button class="game-btn" onclick="gsubmit('${ctx.msgId}','add','line')">Add line</button></div>`;
    },
    act(g, ctx, action, text) {
        if (action !== 'add') return null;
        if (typeof text !== 'string') return null;
        text = text.trim().slice(0, 140);
        if (!text) return null;
        if (g.lines[g.lines.length - 1].uid === ctx.myUID) return null;
        if (g.lines.length >= g.max) return null;
        g.lines.push({ uid: ctx.myUID, text });
        if (g.lines.length >= g.max) g.done = true;
        return g;
    },
};


function _updateGameBtn() {
    const btn = document.getElementById('game-create-btn');
    if (!btn) return;
    if (window.currentChatId && window.currentChatData) {
        btn.classList.remove('hidden');
        btn.style.display = 'inline-flex';
    } else {
        btn.classList.add('hidden');
        btn.style.display = '';
    }
}
(function _patchOpenChatForGames() {
    const apply = () => {
        const orig = window.openChat;
        if (typeof orig !== 'function') return false;
        window.openChat = function(...args) {
            const r = orig.apply(this, args);
            setTimeout(_updateGameBtn, 200);
            return r;
        };
        return true;
    };
    if (!apply()) {
        const t = setInterval(() => { if (apply()) clearInterval(t); }, 300);
    }
})();

window._gamePending = null;

window.openGameModal = function() {
    if (!window.currentChatId || !window.currentChatData) return;
    if (window._isTimedOut && window._isTimedOut()) {
        return showCooldownToast('You are timed out and cannot start games right now.');
    }
    const isGroup = !!window.currentChatData.isGroup;
    const grid = document.getElementById('game-pick-grid');
    grid.innerHTML = Object.values(window.GAMES)
        .filter(d => d.scope === 'both' || d.scope === (isGroup ? 'group' : 'dm'))
        .map(d => `<button class="game-pick" onclick="pickGame('${d.id}')">
            <span class="game-pick-emoji">${d.emoji}</span>
            <span class="game-pick-name">${_gesc(d.name)}</span>
            <span class="game-pick-blurb">${_gesc(d.blurb)}</span>
        </button>`).join('');
    document.getElementById('game-modal-heading').textContent = 'Start a Game';
    document.getElementById('game-pick-step').style.display = '';
    document.getElementById('game-setup-step').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('game-setup-submit').style.display = 'none';
    window._gamePending = null;
    document.getElementById('game-modal').classList.add('open');
};

window.closeGameModal = function() {
    document.getElementById('game-modal').classList.remove('open');
    window._gamePending = null;
};
document.getElementById('game-modal').addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    if (e.target === this) window.closeGameModal();
});

window.pickGame = function(id) {
    const def = window.GAMES[id];
    if (!def) return;
    if (!def.setup || !def.setup.length) return _createGame(def, {});
    window._gamePending = id;
    document.getElementById('game-modal-heading').textContent = def.name;
    document.getElementById('game-pick-step').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('game-setup-step').style.display = '';
    document.getElementById('game-setup-hint').textContent = def.setupHint || '';
    document.getElementById('game-setup-fields').innerHTML = def.setup.map((f, i) => `
        <label class="game-setup-label">${_gesc(f.label)}</label>
        <input type="text" class="inp game-setup-inp" data-key="${f.key}" placeholder="${_gesc(f.ph || '')}"
            maxlength="${f.max || 120}" style="margin-bottom:14px;">
    `).join('');
    document.getElementById('game-setup-submit').style.display = '';
    setTimeout(() => { const f = document.querySelector('.game-setup-inp'); if (f) f.focus(); }, 60);
};

window.submitGameSetup = function() {
    const def = window.GAMES[window._gamePending];
    if (!def) return;
    const vals = {};
    let missing = false;
    document.querySelectorAll('.game-setup-inp').forEach(el => {
        const v = el.value.trim();
        if (!v) missing = true;
        vals[el.dataset.key] = v;
    });
    if (missing) return showCooldownToast('Fill in every field first.');
    const joined = Object.values(vals).join(' ');
    if (window.globalContainsFlaggedWord && window.globalContainsFlaggedWord(joined)) {
        return showCooldownToast("That won't fly here — keep it clean.");
    }
    _createGame(def, vals);
};

async function _createGame(def, vals) {
    const chatId = window.currentChatId;
    const cd = window.currentChatData;
    if (!chatId || !cd) return;
    window.closeGameModal();
    try {
        const { addDoc, collection, serverTimestamp, updateDoc, doc } = await _gfs();
        const ctx = {
            myUID: window.myUID,
            participants: cd.participants || [],
            isGroup: !!cd.isGroup,
            names: cd.names || {},
        };
        const state = def.create(ctx, vals);
        await addDoc(collection(window.db, `chats/${chatId}/messages`), {
            type: 'game', uid: window.myUID, timestamp: serverTimestamp(), game: state,
        });
        await updateDoc(doc(window.db, 'chats', chatId), {
            unreadBy: (cd.participants || []).filter(id => id !== window.myUID),
            lastActivity: serverTimestamp(),
        });
    } catch (e) {
        console.warn('[Game] create failed:', e);
        showCooldownToast("Couldn't start the game. Try again.");
    }
}

window.toggleComposerTools = function(ev) {
    if (ev) ev.stopPropagation();
    const tools = document.getElementById('composer-tools');
    const more = document.getElementById('composer-more');
    if (!tools) return;
    const open = tools.classList.toggle('open');
    if (more) more.classList.toggle('open', open);
};
window.closeComposerTools = function() {
    const tools = document.getElementById('composer-tools');
    const more = document.getElementById('composer-more');
    if (tools) tools.classList.remove('open');
    if (more) more.classList.remove('open');
};
document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    const tools = document.getElementById('composer-tools');
    if (!tools || !tools.classList.contains('open')) return;
    if (tools.contains(e.target)) return;
    if (e.target.closest && e.target.closest('#composer-more')) return;
    window.closeComposerTools();
});
</script>

<script>


window._tvMsgId = null;
window._tvChatId = null;
window._tvUnsub = null;

window.openThreadView = function(msgId, chatId, previewText, senderName) {
    window._tvMsgId = msgId;
    window._tvChatId = chatId;

    document.getElementById('tv-origin-sender').textContent = senderName || 'User';
    document.getElementById('tv-origin-text').textContent = previewText || '';
    document.getElementById('tv-sub').textContent = 'Loading…';
    document.getElementById('thread-view-messages').innerHTML =
        '<div class="tv-empty"><div class="tv-empty-icon">💬</div>No replies yet.<br>Be the first to reply!</div>';

    const panel = document.getElementById('thread-view');
    panel.style.display = 'flex';
    panel.style.animation = 'none';
    if (window.EchoSFX) window.EchoSFX.play('open');
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        panel.style.animation = 'slideInRight 0.22s cubic-bezier(0.34,1.1,0.64,1)';
    });

    setTimeout(() => document.getElementById('thread-view-input')?.focus(), 280);

    registerActiveThread(msgId, chatId, previewText, senderName);

    if (window._tvUnsub) { window._tvUnsub(); window._tvUnsub = null; }
    _watchThreadView(msgId, chatId);
};

window.closeThreadView = function() {
    const panel = document.getElementById('thread-view');
    if (!panel) return;
    panel.style.animation = 'slideOutRight 0.18s ease-in forwards';
    setTimeout(() => { panel.style.display = 'none'; panel.style.animation = ''; }, 180);
    if (window._tvUnsub) { window._tvUnsub(); window._tvUnsub = null; }
    window._tvMsgId = null;
    window._tvChatId = null;
};

window._tvSend = async function() {
    const input = document.getElementById('thread-view-input');
    const text = input?.value.trim();
    if (!text || !window._tvMsgId || !window._tvChatId || !window.myUID) return;
    input.value = '';
    try {
        const { addDoc, collection, serverTimestamp, updateDoc, doc, increment } = await import('https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.11.0/firebase-firestore.js');
        await addDoc(collection(window.db, `chats/${window._tvChatId}/messages/${window._tvMsgId}/threads`), {
            text, uid: window.myUID, timestamp: serverTimestamp(),
        });
        await updateDoc(doc(window.db, `chats/${window._tvChatId}/messages`, window._tvMsgId), {
            threadCount: increment(1)
        }).catch(e => window.reportRuleDenial && window.reportRuleDenial('Threads — reply count', e,
            { path: `chats/${window._tvChatId}/messages/${window._tvMsgId}`, op: 'update(threadCount)' }));
    } catch(e) {
        window.reportRuleDenial && window.reportRuleDenial('Threads — send reply', e,
            { path: `chats/${window._tvChatId}/messages/${window._tvMsgId}/threads`, op: 'create' });
        console.warn('[ThreadView] send error:', e);
    }
};

async function _watchThreadView(msgId, chatId) {
    try {
        const { collection, onSnapshot, orderBy, query } = await import('https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.11.0/firebase-firestore.js');
        const q = query(collection(window.db, `chats/${chatId}/messages/${msgId}/threads`), orderBy('timestamp', 'asc'));
        window._tvUnsub = onSnapshot(q, snap => {
            if (window._tvMsgId !== msgId) return;
            const box = document.getElementById('thread-view-messages');
            const sub = document.getElementById('tv-sub');
            if (!box) return;

            const count = snap.size;
            if (sub) sub.textContent = `${count} repl${count !== 1 ? 'ies' : 'y'}`;

            if (count === 0) {
                box.innerHTML = '<div class="tv-empty"><div class="tv-empty-icon">💬</div>No replies yet.<br>Be the first to reply!</div>';
                return;
            }

            const atBottom = box.scrollHeight - box.scrollTop - box.clientHeight < 60;
            box.innerHTML = '';
            snap.forEach(docSnap => {
                const d = docSnap.data();
                const isMe = d.uid === window.myUID;
                const name = window.currentChatData?.names?.[d.uid] || 'User';
                let timeStr = '';
                if (d.timestamp?.toDate) {
                    timeStr = d.timestamp.toDate().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
                }
                const wrap = document.createElement('div');
                wrap.className = `tv-msg-wrap${isMe ? ' me' : ''}`;
                wrap.innerHTML = `
                    ${!isMe ? `<div class="tv-sender">${window.escHtml(name)}</div>` : ''}
                    <div class="tv-bubble${isMe ? ' me' : ''}">${window.escHtml(d.text || '')}</div>
                    <div class="tv-time">${timeStr}</div>`;
                box.appendChild(wrap);
            });

            if (atBottom) box.scrollTop = box.scrollHeight;

            const btn = document.getElementById(`thread-toggle-${msgId}`);
            if (btn) {
                let badge = btn.querySelector('.thread-count-badge');
                if (count > 0) {
                    if (!badge) { badge = document.createElement('span'); badge.className = 'thread-count-badge'; btn.insertBefore(badge, btn.firstChild); }
                    badge.textContent = count;
                } else if (badge) badge.remove();
            }
        });
        window.registerListener && window.registerListener(`thread-${msgId}`, window._tvUnsub);
    } catch(e) { console.warn('[ThreadView] watch error:', e); }
}

window.toggleThread = function(msgId, chatId) {
    const msgEl = document.querySelector(`[data-msgid="${msgId}"]`);
    const preview = msgEl?.querySelector('.bubble-me, .bubble-them')?.textContent?.trim() || '';
    const sender = msgEl?.querySelector('.msg-sender')?.textContent?.trim() || 'User';
    window.openThreadView(msgId, chatId, preview, sender);
};

window.sendThreadReply = async function(parentMsgId, chatId, inputEl) {
    const text = inputEl.value.trim();
    if (!text || !chatId || !window.myUID) return;
    inputEl.value = '';
    try {
        const { addDoc, collection, serverTimestamp, updateDoc, doc, increment } = await import('https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.11.0/firebase-firestore.js');
        await addDoc(collection(window.db, `chats/${chatId}/messages/${parentMsgId}/threads`), {
            text, uid: window.myUID, timestamp: serverTimestamp(),
        });
        await updateDoc(doc(window.db, `chats/${chatId}/messages`, parentMsgId), {
            threadCount: increment(1)
        }).catch(e => window.reportRuleDenial && window.reportRuleDenial('Threads — reply count', e,
            { path: `chats/${chatId}/messages/${parentMsgId}`, op: 'update(threadCount)' }));
    } catch(e) {
        window.reportRuleDenial && window.reportRuleDenial('Threads — send reply', e,
            { path: `chats/${chatId}/messages/${parentMsgId}/threads`, op: 'create' });
        console.warn('[Thread] send error:', e);
    }
};

window._activeThreadsData = {};

window.registerActiveThread = async function(msgId, chatId, previewText, senderName) {
    if (!chatId || !msgId) return;
    if (window._activeThreadsData[msgId]) return;

    const creatorUid = window.myUID;
    const threadEntry = { msgId, chatId, previewText, senderName, creatorUid, createdAt: Date.now() };
    window._activeThreadsData[msgId] = threadEntry;
    _refreshThreadsBadge();

    try {
        const { updateDoc, doc, serverTimestamp, addDoc, collection } = await import('https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.11.0/firebase-firestore.js');
        await updateDoc(doc(window.db, 'chats', chatId), {
            [`activeThreads.${msgId}`]: threadEntry,
        });
        const myName = window.currentChatData?.names?.[window.myUID] || 'Someone';
        await addDoc(collection(window.db, `chats/${chatId}/messages`), {
            type: 'system',
            text: `🧵 ${myName} started a thread on: "${previewText.substring(0, 60)}${previewText.length > 60 ? '…' : ''}"`,
            uid: 'system',
            timestamp: serverTimestamp(),
        });
    } catch(e) { console.warn('[Threads] save error:', e); }
};

window.closeThreadsPanel = function() {
    const panel = document.getElementById('threads-panel');
    if (panel) panel.style.display = 'none';
};

window.openThreadsPanel = function() {
    const panel = document.getElementById('threads-panel');
    const list = document.getElementById('threads-panel-list');
    const sub = document.getElementById('threads-panel-sub');
    if (!panel) return;
    panel.style.display = 'flex';

    const threads = window._activeThreadsData || {};
    const threadArr = Object.values(threads).sort((a, b) => (b.createdAt || 0) - (a.createdAt || 0));

    if (threadArr.length === 0) {
        sub.textContent = '0 active threads';
        list.innerHTML = '<div style="text-align:center;color:#333345;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;padding:40px 20px;"><div style="font-size:32px;margin-bottom:10px;">🧵</div>No active threads yet.<br><span style="color:#2a2a3a;font-size:11px;">Hover a message and tap 🧵 to start one.</span></div>';
        return;
    }

    sub.textContent = `${threadArr.length} active thread${threadArr.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}`;
    list.innerHTML = '';
    const isOwner = window.currentChatData?.owner === window.myUID;

    threadArr.forEach(t => {
        const canRemove = isOwner || t.creatorUid === window.myUID;
        const card = document.createElement('div');
        card.className = 'thread-card';
        card.dataset.msgId = t.msgId;
        card.innerHTML = `
            <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin-bottom:6px;">
                <span style="font-size:10px;font-weight:800;color:#4f46e5;letter-spacing:0.06em;text-transform:uppercase;">Thread</span>
                <span style="font-size:10px;color:#333345;font-weight:600;">by ${window.escHtml(t.senderName || 'User')}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="thread-card-msg">${window.escHtml(t.previewText || '')}</div>
            <div class="thread-card-actions">
                <button class="thread-open-btn" onclick="closeThreadsPanel();openThreadView('${t.msgId}','${t.chatId}','${window.escAttr ? window.escAttr(t.previewText||'') : (t.previewText||'').replace(/'/g,'&apos;')}','${(t.senderName||'User').replace(/'/g,'&apos;')}')">Open →</button>
                ${canRemove ? `<button class="thread-remove-btn" onclick="removeActiveThread('${t.msgId}','${t.chatId}',this.closest('.thread-card'))">Remove</button>` : ''}
            </div>`;
        list.appendChild(card);
    });
};

window.removeActiveThread = async function(msgId, chatId, cardEl) {
    delete window._activeThreadsData[msgId];
    cardEl?.remove();
    _refreshThreadsBadge();
    const list = document.getElementById('threads-panel-list');
    const remaining = list ? list.querySelectorAll('.thread-card').length : 0;
    const sub = document.getElementById('threads-panel-sub');
    if (sub) sub.textContent = `${remaining} active thread${remaining !== 1 ? 's' : ''}`;
    if (remaining === 0 && list) {
        list.innerHTML = '<div style="text-align:center;color:#333345;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;padding:40px 20px;"><div style="font-size:32px;margin-bottom:10px;">🧵</div>No active threads yet.</div>';
    }
    try {
        const { updateDoc, doc, deleteField } = await import('https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.11.0/firebase-firestore.js');
        await updateDoc(doc(window.db, 'chats', chatId), {
            [`activeThreads.${msgId}`]: deleteField(),
        });
    } catch(e) { console.warn('[Threads] remove error:', e); }
};

function _refreshThreadsBadge() {
    const btn = document.getElementById('active-threads-btn');
    const badge = document.getElementById('threads-btn-badge');
    if (!btn || !badge) return;
    const count = Object.keys(window._activeThreadsData).length;
    if (count > 0) { badge.textContent = count; badge.style.display = 'flex'; }
    else { badge.style.display = 'none'; }
}

<script>
window.transcribeVoiceMessage = async function(msgId) {
    const btn      = document.getElementById('transcribe-btn-' + msgId);
    const resultEl = document.getElementById('transcribe-result-' + msgId);
    if (!btn || !resultEl) return;

    if (resultEl.dataset.done === 'true') {
        const hidden = resultEl.style.display === 'none';
        resultEl.style.display = hidden ? 'block' : 'none';
        btn.textContent = hidden ? 'Hide' : 'Transcript';
        return;
    }

    const stored = window._transcriptCache && window._transcriptCache[msgId];
    if (stored) {
        resultEl.dataset.done = 'true';
        resultEl.style.display = 'block';
        resultEl.innerHTML = `
            <div class="vm-transcript-text">${window.escHtml ? window.escHtml(stored) : stored}</div>
            <div class="vm-transcript-copy" onclick="window._copyTranscript('${msgId}')">Copy</div>
        `;
        btn.textContent = 'Hide';
        return;
    }

    const audioBase64 = window._voiceCache && window._voiceCache[msgId];
    if (!audioBase64) {
        resultEl.style.display = 'block';
        resultEl.innerHTML = '<div class="vm-transcript-error"><i class="fa-solid fa-triangle-exclamation"></i> Audio not available — try reloading.</div>';
        return;
    }

    btn.textContent = '...';
    btn.disabled = true;
    resultEl.style.display = 'block';
    resultEl.innerHTML = '<span class="vm-transcript-loading"><span></span><span></span><span></span></span>';

    try {
        const result = (await window._transcribeViaAI?.(audioBase64)) || '(inaudible)';

        window._transcriptCache = window._transcriptCache || {};
        window._transcriptCache[msgId] = result;

        resultEl.dataset.done = 'true';
        resultEl.innerHTML = `
            <div class="vm-transcript-text">${window.escHtml ? window.escHtml(result) : result}</div>
            <div class="vm-transcript-copy" onclick="window._copyTranscript('${msgId}')">Copy</div>
        `;
        btn.textContent = 'Hide';
        btn.disabled = false;
    } catch(e) {
        console.warn('[Transcribe] fallback error:', e);
        resultEl.innerHTML = '<div class="vm-transcript-error"><i class="fa-solid fa-triangle-exclamation"></i> Could not transcribe. Try again.</div>';
        btn.textContent = 'Retry';
        btn.disabled = false;
    }
};

window._copyTranscript = function(msgId) {
    const text = window._transcriptCache && window._transcriptCache[msgId];
    if (!text) return;
    const el = document.querySelector('#transcribe-result-' + msgId + ' .vm-transcript-copy');
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(() => {
        if (el) { el.textContent = 'Copied!'; setTimeout(() => { el.textContent = 'Copy'; }, 2000); }
    });
};
</script>

function _genToken() {
    const arr = new Uint8Array(16);
    crypto.getRandomValues(arr);
    return Array.from(arr).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');
}
function _writeToken(t) {
    _sessionToken = t;
    try { sessionStorage.setItem('_alt', t); } catch(_){}
}
function _readToken() {
    try { return sessionStorage.getItem('_alt'); } catch(_){ return null; }
}
function _clearToken() {
    _sessionToken = null;
    try { sessionStorage.removeItem('_alt'); sessionStorage.removeItem('adminUnlocked'); } catch(_){}
}

function _startTamperWatch() {
    if (_tamperObserver) _tamperObserver.disconnect();

    _tamperObserver = new MutationObserver(() => {
        if (!_adminViewOpen || !_adminLocked) return;
        const ov = document.getElementById('admin-lock-overlay');
        if (!ov || !ov.classList.contains('active') ||
            getComputedStyle(ov).display === 'none' ||
            !document.body.contains(ov)) {
            _clearToken();
            location.reload();
        }
    });

    _tamperObserver.observe(document.documentElement, {
        childList:  true,
        subtree:    true,
        attributes: true,
        attributeFilter: ['class', 'style']
    });
}

function _blockClick(e) {
    if (!_adminViewOpen || !_adminLocked) return;
    const ov = document.getElementById('admin-lock-overlay');
    if (ov && ov.contains(e.target)) return;
    e.stopImmediatePropagation();
    e.preventDefault();
}

    const ov = document.getElementById('admin-lock-overlay');
    if (ov && ov.contains(document.activeElement)) return;
    e.stopImmediatePropagation();
}, true);

    _adminLocked = locked;
    const ov = document.getElementById('admin-lock-overlay');
    if (!ov) return;
    if (locked) {
        ov.classList.add('active');
        if (window.EchoSFX) window.EchoSFX.play('lock');
        if (_adminViewOpen) _startTamperWatch();
    } else {
        ov.classList.remove('active');
        if (window.EchoSFX) window.EchoSFX.play('unlock');
        const tok = _genToken();
        _writeToken(tok);
        sessionStorage.setItem('adminUnlocked', '1');
        if (typeof window._lockStop === 'function') window._lockStop();
    }
};

        _adminViewOpen = true;
        _clearToken();

        __svBase && __svBase(id);
        window._adminSetLocked(true);
        if (typeof window._showAdminLock === 'function') {
            setTimeout(window._showAdminLock, 120);
        }
        return;

    _adminViewOpen = false;
    _adminLocked   = false;
    const ov = document.getElementById('admin-lock-overlay');
    if (ov) ov.classList.remove('active');
    if (_tamperObserver) { _tamperObserver.disconnect(); _tamperObserver = null; }
    _clearToken();
    __svBase && __svBase(id);
};

window._showAdminLock = function () {
    window._adminSetLocked(true);
};
window._hideAdminLock = function () {
    window._adminSetLocked(false);
};

    if (!_adminViewOpen || !_adminLocked) return;
    const ov = document.getElementById('admin-lock-overlay');
    if (!ov || !document.body.contains(ov) || !ov.classList.contains('active')) {
        _clearToken();
        location.reload();
    }
}, 800);

                    const btn = document.getElementById('ap-face-add-more-btn');
                    if (btn) btn.style.display = '';
                }

<script>
(function () {
'use strict';

const ASPECT_THRESHOLD  = 0.22;
const WIDTH_THRESHOLD   = 0.18;
const MAX_ATTEMPTS      = 5;
const COUNTDOWN_SECS    = 3;
const MEDIAPIPE_CDN     = 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@mediapipe/face_detection@0.4.1646425229/';

let _audioCtx = null;
function _getAudio() {
    if (!_audioCtx) _audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
    if (_audioCtx.state === 'suspended') _audioCtx.resume();
    return _audioCtx;
}
function _playTone(freq, duration, type = 'sine') {
    try {
        const ctx  = _getAudio();
        const osc  = ctx.createOscillator();
        const gain = ctx.createGain();
        osc.connect(gain); gain.connect(ctx.destination);
        osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, ctx.currentTime);
        osc.type = type;
        gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.12, ctx.currentTime);
        gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, ctx.currentTime + duration);
        osc.start(); osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + duration);
    } catch (_) {}
}
const _audioScanStart    = () => _playTone(329.63, 0.08, 'sine');
const _audioUnlock       = () => { _playTone(587.33, 0.1, 'sine'); setTimeout(() => _playTone(880.00, 0.2, 'sine'), 100); };
const _audioEnroll       = () => { _playTone(523.25, 0.1, 'sine'); setTimeout(() => _playTone(659.25, 0.15, 'sine'), 100); };
const _audioError        = () => _playTone(220.00, 0.25, 'sawtooth');

function _withTimeout(promise, ms, message) {
    let timer;
    const timeout = new Promise((_, reject) => {
        timer = setTimeout(() => reject(new Error(message || 'Timed out')), ms);
    });
    return Promise.race([promise, timeout]).finally(() => clearTimeout(timer));
}

async function _startCamera(videoEl) {
    _stopCamera(videoEl);

    if (!window.isSecureContext) {
        throw new Error('Camera requires a secure (HTTPS) connection');
    }
    if (!navigator.mediaDevices || typeof navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia !== 'function') {
        throw new Error('Camera API unavailable in this browser');
    }

    const tries = [
        { video: { facingMode: 'user', width: { ideal: 640 }, height: { ideal: 480 } } },
        { video: { facingMode: 'user' } },
        { video: true }
    ];
    let stream = null, lastErr = null;
    for (const c of tries) {
        try { stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia(c); break; }
        catch (e) { lastErr = e; }
    }
    if (!stream) {
        const name = lastErr && lastErr.name;
        let msg;
        if (name === 'NotAllowedError' || name === 'PermissionDeniedError') {
            msg = 'Camera permission denied — allow camera access for this site.';
        } else if (name === 'NotFoundError' || name === 'DevicesNotFoundError') {
            msg = 'No camera found on this device.';
        } else if (name === 'NotReadableError' || name === 'TrackStartError') {
            msg = 'Camera is in use by another app or tab.';
        } else {
            msg = 'Camera blocked: ' + (lastErr && lastErr.message || 'unknown error');
        }
        throw new Error(msg);
    }

    videoEl.srcObject = stream;
    videoEl.setAttribute('playsinline', '');
    videoEl.muted = true;
    await new Promise((res, rej) => {
        if (videoEl.readyState >= 1) { res(); return; }
        const tid = setTimeout(() => rej(new Error('Video timeout')), 20000);
        videoEl.onloadedmetadata = () => { clearTimeout(tid); res(); };
        videoEl.onerror          = () => { clearTimeout(tid); rej(new Error('Video error')); };
    });
    await videoEl.play().catch(() => {});
    await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 600));
    return stream;
}
function _stopCamera(videoEl) {
    _stopMpCamera();
    _stopManualSend();
    if (!videoEl) return;
    if (videoEl.srcObject) {
        try { videoEl.srcObject.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop()); } catch (_) {}
        videoEl.srcObject = null;
    }
}

let _mpDetector  = null;
let _mpLoading   = false;
let _mpReady     = false;

async function _loadMediaPipe() {
    if (_mpReady && _mpDetector) return true;
    if (_mpLoading) {
        await new Promise(res => {
            const iv = setInterval(() => { if (!_mpLoading) { clearInterval(iv); res(); } }, 80);
        });
        return _mpReady;
    }
    _mpLoading = true;

    const deadline = Date.now() + 10000;
    while (typeof window.FaceMesh === 'undefined') {
        if (Date.now() > deadline) {
            console.error('[FaceUnlock] FaceMesh global never appeared. Check CDN/network.');
            _mpLoading = false;
            return false;
        }
        await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 150));
    }

    try {
        _mpDetector = new window.FaceMesh({
            locateFile: f => `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@mediapipe/face_mesh@0.4.1633559619/${f}`
        });
        _mpDetector.setOptions({
            maxNumFaces: 1,
            refineLandmarks: true,
            minDetectionConfidence: 0.6,
            minTrackingConfidence: 0.6
        });
        await _withTimeout(
            new Promise((res, rej) => {
                _mpDetector.onResults(() => {});
                _mpDetector.initialize().then(res).catch(rej);
            }),
            15000,
            'Face detection model took too long to load.'
        );
        _mpReady  = true;
        _mpLoading = false;
        console.log('[FaceUnlock] MediaPipe FaceMesh ready.');
        return true;
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('[FaceUnlock] MediaPipe init failed:', e);
        _mpLoading = false;
        return false;
    }
}

const _fzState = {};
function _faceTrackZoom(key, videoEl, canvasEl, box) {
    if (!videoEl) return;
    const s = _fzState[key] || (_fzState[key] = { z: 1, x: 0.5, y: 0.5 });
    const tooFar = box && box.w < MIN_FACE_W;
    const tz = (box && !tooFar) ? Math.max(1, Math.min(1.6, 0.5 / Math.max(0.08, box.w))) : 1;
    const tx = box ? box.cx : 0.5;
    const ty = box ? box.cy : 0.5;
    const k = 0.22;
    s.z += (tz - s.z) * k;
    s.x += (tx - s.x) * k;
    s.y += (ty - s.y) * k;
    const lim = (1 - 1 / s.z) / 2;
    const px = Math.max(-lim, Math.min(lim, 0.5 - s.x)) * 100;
    const py = Math.max(-lim, Math.min(lim, 0.5 - s.y)) * 100;
    const t = `scaleX(-1) scale(${s.z.toFixed(3)}) translate(${px.toFixed(2)}%, ${py.toFixed(2)}%)`;
    videoEl.style.transform = t;
    videoEl.style.willChange = 'transform';
    if (canvasEl) canvasEl.style.transform = t;
}
function _faceTrackReset(key, videoEl, canvasEl) {
    delete _fzState[key];
    if (videoEl)  videoEl.style.transform  = 'scaleX(-1)';
    if (canvasEl) canvasEl.style.transform = 'scaleX(-1)';
}

function _drawOverlay(canvas, detection, isMatch, ringPct) {
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    if (!detection || !detection.box) return;

    const box   = detection.box;
    const cx    = (box.cx - box.w / 2) * canvas.width;
    const cy    = (box.cy - box.h / 2) * canvas.height;
    const cw    = box.w * canvas.width;
    const ch    = box.h * canvas.height;
    const color = isMatch ? '#22c55e' : '#3b82f6';

    ctx.strokeStyle = color;
    ctx.fillStyle   = color;
    ctx.lineWidth   = 2;
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.7;
    ctx.strokeRect(cx, cy, cw, ch);

    const len = Math.min(cw, ch) * 0.18;
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    [[cx, cy, 1, 1], [cx+cw, cy, -1, 1], [cx, cy+ch, 1, -1], [cx+cw, cy+ch, -1, -1]]
        .forEach(([bx, by, sx, sy]) => {
            ctx.fillRect(bx, by, sx * len, 3);
            ctx.fillRect(bx, by, 3, sy * len);
        });

    try {
    if (detection.landmarks) {
        const lm = detection.landmarks;
        const W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;
        const strokeSet = (set, style, width, alpha) => {
            if (!set || !set.length) return;
            ctx.strokeStyle = style;
            ctx.lineWidth = width;
            ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
            ctx.beginPath();
            for (let i = 0; i < set.length; i++) {
                const a = lm[set[i][0]], b = lm[set[i][1]];
                if (!a || !b) continue;
                ctx.moveTo(a.x * W, a.y * H);
                ctx.lineTo(b.x * W, b.y * H);
            }
            ctx.stroke();
        };

        let zMin = Infinity, zMax = -Infinity;
        for (let i = 0; i < lm.length; i++) {
            const z = lm[i] && lm[i].z;
            if (typeof z !== 'number') continue;
            if (z < zMin) zMin = z;
            if (z > zMax) zMax = z;
        }
        const zSpan = (zMax - zMin) || 1;
        const depthOf = p => (typeof p.z === 'number' ? 1 - (p.z - zMin) / zSpan : 0.5);
        const sweepY  = cy + ((performance.now() % 2000) / 2000) * ch;

        const tess = window.FACEMESH_TESSELATION;
        if (tess && tess.length) {
            const BUCKETS = 4;
            const paths = [];
            for (let b = 0; b < BUCKETS; b++) paths.push(new Path2D());
            const hot = new Path2D();
            for (let i = 0; i < tess.length; i++) {
                const a = lm[tess[i][0]], c = lm[tess[i][1]];
                if (!a || !c) continue;
                const ax = a.x * W, ay = a.y * H, bx = c.x * W, by = c.y * H;
                const d = (depthOf(a) + depthOf(c)) / 2;
                const target = (Math.abs(ay - sweepY) < 16 && Math.abs(by - sweepY) < 16)
                    ? hot
                    : paths[Math.min(BUCKETS - 1, Math.max(0, Math.floor(d * BUCKETS)))];
                target.moveTo(ax, ay);
                target.lineTo(bx, by);
            }
            for (let b = 0; b < BUCKETS; b++) {
                const t = b / (BUCKETS - 1);
                ctx.strokeStyle = color;
                ctx.globalAlpha = 0.07 + t * 0.30;
                ctx.lineWidth   = 0.45 + t * 0.55;
                ctx.stroke(paths[b]);
            }
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffffff';
            ctx.globalAlpha = 0.85;
            ctx.lineWidth   = 1.1;
            ctx.stroke(hot);
        }

        strokeSet(window.FACEMESH_CONTOURS, color, 4.5, 0.16);
        strokeSet(window.FACEMESH_CONTOURS, '#ffffff', 1.1, 0.55);
        strokeSet(window.FACEMESH_LEFT_IRIS,  '#e0f2fe', 1.5, 0.95);
        strokeSet(window.FACEMESH_RIGHT_IRIS, '#e0f2fe', 1.5, 0.95);

        const keyIdx = [1,152,10,234,454,33,133,362,263,61,291,13,14,98,327,105,334,
                        172,397,127,356,149,378,168,159,145,386,374,55,285,0,17];
        ctx.strokeStyle = isMatch ? '#4ade80' : '#bfdbfe';
        ctx.lineWidth   = 1;
        ctx.globalAlpha = 0.9;
        ctx.beginPath();
        for (const i of keyIdx) {
            const p = lm[i];
            if (!p) continue;
            const px = p.x * W, py = p.y * H, r = 2.6;
            ctx.moveTo(px + r, py);
            ctx.arc(px, py, r, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
            ctx.moveTo(px - r - 1.6, py); ctx.lineTo(px - r + 0.6, py);
            ctx.moveTo(px + r - 0.6, py); ctx.lineTo(px + r + 1.6, py);
        }
        ctx.stroke();

        ctx.save();
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.rect(cx, cy, cw, ch);
        ctx.clip();
        const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, sweepY - 30, 0, sweepY + 4);
        const rgb = isMatch ? '74,222,128' : '147,197,253';
        grad.addColorStop(0, `rgba(${rgb},0)`);
        grad.addColorStop(1, `rgba(${rgb},0.20)`);
        ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
        ctx.fillStyle = grad;
        ctx.fillRect(cx, sweepY - 30, cw, 34);
        ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(${rgb},0.85)`;
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(cx, sweepY); ctx.lineTo(cx + cw, sweepY);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.restore();
    }
    } catch (e) {
        console.warn('[FaceUnlock] overlay draw skipped:', e && e.message);
        try { ctx.restore(); } catch (_) {}
        ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    }

    if (typeof ringPct === 'number') {
        const rcx = cx + cw / 2, rcy = cy + ch / 2;
        const r   = Math.min(Math.max(cw, ch) * 0.62,
                             Math.min(rcx, rcy, canvas.width - rcx, canvas.height - rcy) - 4);
        ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
        ctx.lineWidth = 4;
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.18)';
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(rcx, rcy, r, 0, 2 * Math.PI); ctx.stroke();
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#22c55e';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(rcx, rcy, r, -Math.PI / 2, -Math.PI / 2 + (Math.PI * 2 * (ringPct / 100)));
        ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function _dist(a, b) { return Math.sqrt((a.x-b.x)**2 + (a.y-b.y)**2); }

const _FM = {
    NOSE_TIP: 1, CHIN: 152, FOREHEAD: 10,

    EYE_L_OUT: 33, EYE_L_IN: 133, EYE_R_IN: 362, EYE_R_OUT: 263,
    BROW_L: 105, BROW_R: 334,
    MOUTH_L: 61, MOUTH_R: 291, LIP_TOP: 13, LIP_BOT: 14,

    LIP_OUT_TOP: 0, LIP_OUT_BOT: 17,
};
const _EYE_L_EAR_PTS = [33, 160, 158, 133, 153, 144];
const _EYE_R_EAR_PTS = [362, 385, 387, 263, 373, 380];

function _ear(lm, idx) {
    const [p1, p2, p3, p4, p5, p6] = idx.map(i => lm[i]);
    if (!p1 || !p2 || !p3 || !p4 || !p5 || !p6) return null;
    return (_dist(p2, p6) + _dist(p3, p5)) / (2 * (_dist(p1, p4) || 0.001));
}

const _SKIN_PATCH_KEYS = ['CHEEK_L', 'CHEEK_R', 'FOREHEAD', 'NOSE_TIP'];
let _skinCanvas = null;

function _sampleSkin(video, lm) {
    if (!video || !video.videoWidth) return null;
    if (!_skinCanvas) _skinCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    const W = 160;
    const H = Math.round(W * (video.videoHeight / video.videoWidth)) || 120;
    if (_skinCanvas.width !== W || _skinCanvas.height !== H) {
        _skinCanvas.width = W; _skinCanvas.height = H;
    }
    const ctx = _skinCanvas.getContext('2d', { willReadFrequently: true });
    try { ctx.drawImage(video, 0, 0, W, H); } catch (_) { return null; }

    const px = [];
    for (const key of _SKIN_PATCH_KEYS) {
        const p = lm[_FM[key]];
        if (!p) continue;
        const x0 = Math.max(0, Math.min(W - 1, Math.round(p.x * W) - 3));
        const y0 = Math.max(0, Math.min(H - 1, Math.round(p.y * H) - 3));
        const w  = Math.min(7, W - x0), h = Math.min(7, H - y0);
        if (w <= 0 || h <= 0) continue;
        let d;
        try { d = ctx.getImageData(x0, y0, w, h).data; } catch (_) { return null; }
        for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i += 4) px.push([d[i], d[i + 1], d[i + 2]]);
    }
    if (px.length < 8) return null;

    const luma = c => 0.299 * c[0] + 0.587 * c[1] + 0.114 * c[2];
    px.sort((a, b) => luma(a) - luma(b));
    const lo = Math.floor(px.length * 0.2), hi = Math.ceil(px.length * 0.8);
    let r = 0, g = 0, b = 0, n = 0;
    for (let i = lo; i < hi; i++) { r += px[i][0]; g += px[i][1]; b += px[i][2]; n++; }
    if (!n) return null;
    r /= n; g /= n; b /= n;
    const sum = (r + g + b) || 1;
    return { rn: r / sum, gn: g / sum, luma: luma([r, g, b]) / 255 };
}

function _skinToneLabel(desc) {
    const L = desc && desc.r_skinLuma;
    if (L == null) return null;
    if (L < 0.20) return 'Deep';
    if (L < 0.32) return 'Dark brown';
    if (L < 0.45) return 'Brown / mixed';
    if (L < 0.58) return 'Tan / olive';
    if (L < 0.72) return 'Light';
    return 'Fair';
}

function _geoDescriptor(detection) {
    const lm = detection && detection.landmarks;
    if (!lm || lm.length < 400) return { _noLandmarks: true };
    const P = k => lm[_FM[k]];

    const d = {
        eyeOuter:   _dist(P('EYE_L_OUT'), P('EYE_R_OUT')) || 0.001,
        eyeInner:   _dist(P('EYE_L_IN'),  P('EYE_R_IN'))  || 0.001,
        cheekW:     _dist(P('CHEEK_L'),   P('CHEEK_R'))   || 0.001,

        mouthW:     _dist(P('MOUTH_L'),   P('MOUTH_R'))   || 0.001,
        noseChin:   _dist(P('NOSE_TIP'),  P('CHIN'))      || 0.001,
        foreheadChin: _dist(P('FOREHEAD'),P('CHIN'))      || 0.001,
        philtrum:   _dist(P('NOSE_TIP'),  P('LIP_TOP'))   || 0.001,
        mouthH:     _dist(P('LIP_TOP'),   P('LIP_BOT'))   || 0.001,
        noseW:      _dist(P('NOSE_ALA_L'),P('NOSE_ALA_R'))|| 0.001,
        eyeLNose:   _dist(P('EYE_L_OUT'), P('NOSE_TIP'))  || 0.001,
        eyeRNose:   _dist(P('EYE_R_OUT'), P('NOSE_TIP'))  || 0.001,
        cheekLNose: _dist(P('CHEEK_L'),   P('NOSE_TIP'))  || 0.001,
        cheekRNose: _dist(P('CHEEK_R'),   P('NOSE_TIP'))  || 0.001,
        browEyeL:   _dist(P('BROW_L'),    P('EYE_L_OUT')) || 0.001,
        browEyeR:   _dist(P('BROW_R'),    P('EYE_R_OUT')) || 0.001,
        jawW:       _dist(P('JAW_L'),     P('JAW_R'))     || 0.001,
        templeW:    _dist(P('TEMPLE_L'),  P('TEMPLE_R'))  || 0.001,
        chinW:      _dist(P('CHIN_L'),    P('CHIN_R'))    || 0.001,
        noseLen:    _dist(P('NOSE_BRIDGE'),P('NOSE_TIP')) || 0.001,
        eyeHL:      _dist(P('EYE_L_TOP'), P('EYE_L_BOT')) || 0.001,
        eyeHR:      _dist(P('EYE_R_TOP'), P('EYE_R_BOT')) || 0.001,
        eyeWL:      _dist(P('EYE_L_OUT'), P('EYE_L_IN'))  || 0.001,
        eyeWR:      _dist(P('EYE_R_OUT'), P('EYE_R_IN'))  || 0.001,
        browSep:    _dist(P('BROW_L_IN'), P('BROW_R_IN')) || 0.001,
        lipThick:   _dist(P('LIP_OUT_TOP'),P('LIP_OUT_BOT')) || 0.001,
        chinDrop:   _dist(P('LIP_BOT'),   P('CHIN'))      || 0.001,
    };

    const skin = _sampleSkin(detection._video, lm);

    return {
        r_faceShape:    d.cheekW / d.foreheadChin,
        r_eyeToFace:    d.eyeOuter / d.cheekW,
        r_eyeToBrow:    d.eyeOuter / d.browW,
        r_mouthToEye:   d.mouthW / d.eyeOuter,
        r_noseChinEye:  d.noseChin / d.eyeOuter,
        r_philtrum:     d.philtrum / d.eyeOuter,
        r_mouthShape:   d.mouthH / d.mouthW,
        r_innerOuterEye:d.eyeInner / d.eyeOuter,
        r_noseWidth:    d.noseW / d.eyeOuter,
        r_cheekInner:   d.cheekW / d.eyeInner,
        r_eyeNoseAsym:  d.eyeLNose / d.eyeRNose,
        r_cheekNoseAsym:d.cheekLNose / d.cheekRNose,
        r_browAsym:     d.browEyeL / d.browEyeR,
        r_jawToCheek:   d.jawW / d.cheekW,
        r_jawToFace:    d.jawW / d.foreheadChin,
        r_templeToCheek:d.templeW / d.cheekW,
        r_chinToJaw:    d.chinW / d.jawW,
        r_chinDrop:     d.chinDrop / d.noseChin,
        r_noseLen:      d.noseLen / d.eyeOuter,
        r_eyeOpenL:     d.eyeHL / d.eyeWL,
        r_eyeOpenR:     d.eyeHR / d.eyeWR,
        r_eyeWidthAsym: d.eyeWL / d.eyeWR,
        r_browSep:      d.browSep / d.eyeInner,
        r_lipThick:     d.lipThick / d.mouthW,
        ...(skin ? { r_skinRN: skin.rn, r_skinGN: skin.gn, r_skinLuma: skin.luma } : {}),
        _yaw: d.cheekLNose / d.cheekRNose,
        _faceW: d.cheekW,
        _ear: (() => { const l = _ear(lm, _EYE_L_EAR_PTS), r = _ear(lm, _EYE_R_EAR_PTS);
                        return (l != null && r != null) ? (l + r) / 2 : null; })(),
    };
}

const IDENTITY_KEYS = ['r_faceShape','r_eyeToFace','r_eyeToBrow','r_mouthToEye','r_noseChinEye',
    'r_philtrum','r_mouthShape','r_innerOuterEye','r_noseWidth','r_cheekInner',
    'r_eyeNoseAsym','r_cheekNoseAsym','r_browAsym',
    'r_jawToCheek','r_jawToFace','r_templeToCheek','r_chinToJaw','r_chinDrop',
    'r_noseLen','r_eyeOpenL','r_eyeOpenR','r_eyeWidthAsym','r_browSep','r_lipThick',
    'r_skinRN','r_skinGN','r_skinLuma'];
const IDENTITY_WEIGHTS = { r_faceShape:3, r_eyeToFace:2.5, r_eyeToBrow:2, r_mouthToEye:2.5,
    r_noseChinEye:2.5, r_philtrum:2.5, r_mouthShape:1.5, r_innerOuterEye:2, r_noseWidth:1.5,
    r_cheekInner:2, r_eyeNoseAsym:1, r_cheekNoseAsym:1, r_browAsym:1,
    r_jawToCheek:2.5, r_jawToFace:2.5, r_templeToCheek:2, r_chinToJaw:2, r_chinDrop:2,
    r_noseLen:2.5,
    r_eyeOpenL:1.5, r_eyeOpenR:1.5, r_eyeWidthAsym:1.5,
    r_browSep:2, r_lipThick:1.5,
    r_skinRN:2, r_skinGN:2, r_skinLuma:0.75 };

const VETO_KEYS = ['r_faceShape','r_jawToCheek','r_jawToFace','r_noseChinEye',
    'r_skinRN','r_skinGN'];
const VETO_Z          = 6.0;
const VETO_REL_ERR    = 0.30;
const SKIN_LUMA_VETO  = 0.26;

const MIN_FACE_W = 0.17;
const MAX_FACE_W = 0.92;
const ENROLL_MIN_FACE_W = 0.22;
window.__FACE_ENROLL_MIN_W = ENROLL_MIN_FACE_W;

const YAW_TOLERANCE = [0.55, 1.8];

const MATCH_THRESHOLD = 0.11;
const SCORE_SCALE     = 260;

const V2_Z_THRESHOLD = 2.6;
const V2_SCORE_SCALE = 30;
const V2_MIN_TOL_FRAC = 0.012;

function _isV2Descriptor(d) { return !!(d && d.v === 2 && d.keys); }
window._isV2Descriptor = _isV2Descriptor;

function _v2Match(live, enrolled) {
    let totalW = 0, zsum = 0, used = 0, vetoed = false;
    for (const k of IDENTITY_KEYS) {
        const ref = enrolled.keys[k];
        if (!ref || typeof ref.m !== 'number' || live[k] == null) continue;
        const tol = Math.max(ref.s || 0, Math.abs(ref.m) * V2_MIN_TOL_FRAC) || 1e-6;
        const w = IDENTITY_WEIGHTS[k] || 1;
        const z = Math.abs(live[k] - ref.m) / tol;
        if (VETO_KEYS.includes(k) && z > VETO_Z) vetoed = true;
        zsum   += w * z;
        totalW += w;
        used++;
    }
    if (enrolled.keys.r_skinLuma && live.r_skinLuma != null &&
        Math.abs(live.r_skinLuma - enrolled.keys.r_skinLuma.m) > SKIN_LUMA_VETO) vetoed = true;
    if (used < 6) return { match: false, score: 0, offFrontal: false };
    const meanZ = zsum / (totalW || 1);
    const score = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, 100 - meanZ * V2_SCORE_SCALE));
    return { match: !vetoed && meanZ < V2_Z_THRESHOLD, score: vetoed ? Math.min(score, 40) : score,
             offFrontal: false, beta: true };
}

function _landmarkMatch(live, enrolled) {
    if (live._faceW != null && live._faceW < MIN_FACE_W) {
        return { match: false, score: 0, offFrontal: false, tooFar: true };
    }
    if (live._faceW != null && live._faceW > MAX_FACE_W) {
        return { match: false, score: 0, offFrontal: false, tooClose: true };
    }
    if (_isV2Descriptor(enrolled)) {
        if (live._noLandmarks) return { match: false, score: 0, offFrontal: false };
        if (live._yaw != null && (live._yaw < YAW_TOLERANCE[0] || live._yaw > YAW_TOLERANCE[1])) {
            return { match: false, score: 0, offFrontal: true };
        }
        return _v2Match(live, enrolled);
    }
    if (live._noLandmarks || enrolled._noLandmarks || !enrolled.r_faceShape) {
        return { match: false, score: 0, offFrontal: false };
    }
    if (live._yaw != null && (live._yaw < YAW_TOLERANCE[0] || live._yaw > YAW_TOLERANCE[1])) {
        return { match: false, score: 0, offFrontal: true };
    }

    let totalW = 0, err = 0, vetoed = false;
    for (const k of IDENTITY_KEYS) {
        if (enrolled[k] == null || live[k] == null || enrolled[k] === 0) continue;
        const w = IDENTITY_WEIGHTS[k] || 1;
        const rel = Math.abs(live[k] - enrolled[k]) / Math.abs(enrolled[k]);
        if (VETO_KEYS.includes(k) && rel > VETO_REL_ERR) vetoed = true;
        err    += w * rel;
        totalW += w;
    }
    if (enrolled.r_skinLuma != null && live.r_skinLuma != null &&
        Math.abs(live.r_skinLuma - enrolled.r_skinLuma) > SKIN_LUMA_VETO) vetoed = true;
    const normErr = err / (totalW || 1);
    const score = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, 100 - normErr * SCORE_SCALE));
    return { match: !vetoed && normErr < MATCH_THRESHOLD,
             score: vetoed ? Math.min(score, 40) : score, offFrontal: false };
}

function _geoHint(live, enrolled) {
    if (live._noLandmarks) return 'Face not fully visible — look at camera';
    if (live._faceW != null && live._faceW < MIN_FACE_W) {
        return live._faceW < MIN_FACE_W * 0.65
            ? 'Too far away — move much closer to the camera'
            : 'Move closer — fill the frame with your face';
    }
    if (live._faceW != null && live._faceW > MAX_FACE_W) return 'Too close — move back a little';
    if (!enrolled.r_faceShape && !_isV2Descriptor(enrolled)) return 'Re-register your face in Admin settings';
    if (live._yaw != null && (live._yaw < YAW_TOLERANCE[0] || live._yaw > YAW_TOLERANCE[1])) {
        return 'Face the camera more directly';
    }
    return 'Hold still…';
}

let _mpCamera       = null;
let _lastDetection  = null;
let _mpCamRunning   = false;

function _startMpCamera(videoEl) {
    if (_mpCamRunning) return;
    if (typeof window.Camera === 'undefined') {
        console.warn('[FaceUnlock] Camera util not found, using manual send.');
        _manualSendLoop(videoEl);
        return;
    }
    _mpDetector.onResults(results => { _lastDetection = _parseFaceMeshResults(results); });
    _mpCamera = new window.Camera(videoEl, {
        onFrame: async () => { await _mpDetector.send({ image: videoEl }); },
        width: 640, height: 480
    });
    _mpCamera.start();
    _mpCamRunning = true;
}

function _parseFaceMeshResults(results) {
    const lm = results.multiFaceLandmarks && results.multiFaceLandmarks[0];
    if (!lm) return null;
    let minX = 1, minY = 1, maxX = 0, maxY = 0;
    for (const p of lm) {
        if (p.x < minX) minX = p.x; if (p.x > maxX) maxX = p.x;
        if (p.y < minY) minY = p.y; if (p.y > maxY) maxY = p.y;
    }
    return { landmarks: lm, box: { cx: (minX+maxX)/2, cy: (minY+maxY)/2, w: maxX-minX, h: maxY-minY } };
}

function _stopMpCamera() {
    if (_mpCamera) { try { _mpCamera.stop(); } catch (_) {} _mpCamera = null; }
    _mpCamRunning   = false;
    _lastDetection  = null;
}

let _manualSendActive = false;
async function _manualSendLoop(videoEl) {
    _manualSendActive = true;
    _mpDetector.onResults(results => { _lastDetection = _parseFaceMeshResults(results); });
    while (_manualSendActive && _mpDetector) {
        try { await _mpDetector.send({ image: videoEl }); } catch (_) {}
        await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 33));
    }
}
function _stopManualSend() { _manualSendActive = false; }

async function _detectFace(videoEl, overlayCanvas) {
    if (!_mpCamRunning && !_manualSendActive) _startMpCamera(videoEl);
    await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 30));
    const det = _lastDetection;
    if (det) det._video = videoEl;
    if (overlayCanvas) {
        if (det) _drawOverlay(overlayCanvas, det, false);
        else {
            const ctx = overlayCanvas.getContext('2d');
            ctx.clearRect(0, 0, overlayCanvas.width, overlayCanvas.height);
        }
    }
    return det;
}

window._adminRegisterFaceBeta = async function (opts) {
    opts = opts || {};
    const APPEND       = !!opts.append;
    const SESSION_GOAL = opts.target || 15;
    const MIN_GOOD     = 6;
    const RETRY_LIMIT  = SESSION_GOAL * 4;
    const FRAME_GAP_MS = 280;

    const vWrap   = document.getElementById('ap-face-reg-video-wrap');
    const videoEl = document.getElementById('ap-face-reg-video');
    const msgEl   = document.getElementById('ap-face-reg-msg');
    const btns    = document.querySelectorAll('#ap-face-register-card button');
    if (!videoEl || !msgEl) return;

    const setMsg = (t, col) => { msgEl.textContent = t; msgEl.style.color = col || '#a78bfa'; };
    btns.forEach(b => b.disabled = true);
    if (vWrap) vWrap.style.display = 'block';

    try {
        setMsg('Loading face detection\u2026');
        if (!await _loadMediaPipe()) { setMsg('Face detection failed \u2014 check the browser console.', '#f87171'); return; }

        setMsg('Opening camera\u2026');
        await _startCamera(videoEl);

        setMsg('Stabilising camera\u2026 (hold still)');
        await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 2000));
        _audioScanStart();

        var existingRawSamples = {};
        var existingSessionCount = 0;
        if (APPEND) {
            setMsg('Loading existing profile\u2026');
            try {
                var _fsMod = await import('https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.11.0/firebase-firestore.js');
                var _rfA = _fsMod.getFirestore, _rdocA = _fsMod.doc, _rgetA = _fsMod.getDoc;
                var snap = await _rgetA(_rdocA(_rfA(), 'face_2fa', window.myUID));
                if (snap.exists()) {
                    var d = snap.data();
                    var prev = d.adminFaceDescriptorV2;
                    if (prev && prev.v === 2) {
                        existingRawSamples  = prev.rawSamples  || {};
                        existingSessionCount = prev.sessions   || 0;
                    }
                }
            } catch (_) {   }
            var existingCount = (Object.values(existingRawSamples)[0] || []).length;
            setMsg('Loaded ' + existingCount + ' existing captures \u2014 adding ' + SESSION_GOAL + ' more\u2026');
            await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 800));
        }

        var newSamples = [];
        var attempts = 0;
        while (newSamples.length < SESSION_GOAL && attempts < RETRY_LIMIT) {
            attempts++;
            setMsg('Capturing ' + (newSamples.length + 1) + ' of ' + SESSION_GOAL + '\u2026 (attempt ' + attempts + ')');
            await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, FRAME_GAP_MS));
            var det = null;
            try { det = await _detectFace(videoEl, null); } catch (_) {}
            var dsc = det && _geoDescriptor(det);
            if (dsc && !dsc._noLandmarks) {
                if (dsc._faceW != null && dsc._faceW < ENROLL_MIN_FACE_W) {
                    setMsg('Move closer to the camera…');
                    continue;
                }
                newSamples.push(dsc);
            }
        }

        if (newSamples.length < MIN_GOOD) {
            throw new Error(
                'Only ' + newSamples.length + ' clear frames detected after ' + attempts + ' attempts \u2014 ' +
                'improve lighting, move closer to the camera, and try again.'
            );
        }

        var mergedRaw = {};
        for (var ki = 0; ki < IDENTITY_KEYS.length; ki++) {
            var k = IDENTITY_KEYS[ki];
            var prevVals = existingRawSamples[k] || [];
            var nextVals = newSamples.map(function(d){ return d[k]; }).filter(function(v){ return typeof v === 'number' && isFinite(v); });
            mergedRaw[k] = prevVals.concat(nextVals);
        }

        var median = function(arr) {
            var a = arr.slice().sort(function(x, y){ return x - y; });
            var mid = a.length >> 1;
            return a.length % 2 ? a[mid] : (a[mid - 1] + a[mid]) / 2;
        };

        var keys = {};
        for (var ki2 = 0; ki2 < IDENTITY_KEYS.length; ki2++) {
            var k2 = IDENTITY_KEYS[ki2];
            var vals = mergedRaw[k2] || [];
            if (vals.length < 4) continue;
            var m = median(vals);
            var mad = median(vals.map(function(v){ return Math.abs(v - m); }));
            keys[k2] = { m: m, s: mad * 1.4826 };
        }
        if (Object.keys(keys).length < 8) {
            throw new Error('Captures were too inconsistent \u2014 try again with steadier lighting.');
        }

        var totalCaptures = (Object.values(mergedRaw)[0] || []).length || newSamples.length;
        var sessionCount  = existingSessionCount + 1;

        setMsg('Saving\u2026');
        var _fsModSave = await import('https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.11.0/firebase-firestore.js');
        await _fsModSave.setDoc(_fsModSave.doc(_fsModSave.getFirestore(), 'face_2fa', window.myUID), {
            adminFaceDescriptorV2: {
                v: 2,
                keys: keys,
                samples:    totalCaptures,
                sessions:   sessionCount,
                rawSamples: mergedRaw,
                at:         Date.now()
            }
        }, { merge: true });

        _audioEnroll();
        var action = APPEND ? 'Updated' : 'Enrolled';
        setMsg(
            '\u2713 ' + action + ': ' + totalCaptures + ' total captures across ' + sessionCount +
            ' session' + (sessionCount === 1 ? '' : 's') + ', ' + Object.keys(keys).length + ' ratios.',
            '#22c55e'
        );
        var addMoreBtn = document.getElementById('ap-face-add-more-btn');
        if (addMoreBtn) addMoreBtn.style.display = '';
        setTimeout(function() { setMsg(''); if (vWrap) vWrap.style.display = 'none'; }, 7000);
    } catch (e) {
        _audioError();
        setMsg('\u26a0 ' + (e.message || 'Failed'), '#f87171');
        console.error('[FaceRegBeta]', e);
    } finally {
        _stopCamera(videoEl);
        btns.forEach(function(b){ b.disabled = false; });
    }
};

window._adminClearFaceBeta = async function () {
    const msgEl = document.getElementById('ap-face-reg-msg');
    const setMsg = (t, col) => { if (msgEl) { msgEl.textContent = t; msgEl.style.color = col || '#818cf8'; } };
    try {
        const { getFirestore: _rf, doc: _rdoc, updateDoc: _rupd, deleteField: _rdel } =
            await import('https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.11.0/firebase-firestore.js');
        await _rupd(_rdoc(_rf(), 'face_2fa', window.myUID), { adminFaceDescriptorV2: _rdel() });
        setMsg('✓ Beta enrollment removed — back to standard Face ID.', '#22c55e');
    } catch (e) {
        setMsg('⚠ ' + (e.message || 'Failed'), '#f87171');
    }
};

window._adminRegisterFace = async function () {
    const card    = document.getElementById('ap-face-register-card');
    const vWrap   = document.getElementById('ap-face-reg-video-wrap');
    const videoEl = document.getElementById('ap-face-reg-video');
    const msgEl   = document.getElementById('ap-face-reg-msg');
    const btn     = card ? card.querySelector('button') : null;
    if (!videoEl || !msgEl) return;

    const setMsg = (t, col) => { msgEl.textContent = t; msgEl.style.color = col || '#818cf8'; };
    if (btn) btn.disabled = true;
    if (vWrap) vWrap.style.display = 'block';

    try {
        setMsg('Loading face detection…');
        const mpOk = await _loadMediaPipe();
        if (!mpOk) { setMsg('Face detection failed — check browser console for CDN errors.', '#f87171'); if (btn) btn.disabled = false; return; }

        setMsg('Opening camera…');
        await _startCamera(videoEl);
        _audioScanStart();

        setMsg('Look straight at camera, close enough to fill the frame — capturing in 3…');
        await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1000));
        setMsg('2…');
        await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1000));
        setMsg('1…');
        await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1000));

        setMsg('Detecting face…');
        const samples = [];
        let tooFarCt = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
            await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 120));
            const det = await _detectFace(videoEl, null);
            const dsc = det && _geoDescriptor(det);
            if (dsc && !dsc._noLandmarks) {
                if (dsc._faceW != null && dsc._faceW < window.__FACE_ENROLL_MIN_W) tooFarCt++;
                else samples.push(dsc);
            }
        }
        if (!samples.length && tooFarCt) throw new Error('You were too far from the camera — move closer so your face fills the frame, then try again.');
        if (!samples.length) throw new Error('No face detected — check lighting and camera angle.');

        const enrolled = {};
        for (const k of IDENTITY_KEYS) {
            const _vals = samples.map(d => d[k]).filter(v => typeof v === 'number' && isFinite(v));
            if (_vals.length) enrolled[k] = _vals.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / _vals.length;
        }

        setMsg('Saving…');
        const { getFirestore: _rf, doc: _rdoc, setDoc: _rset } = await import('https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.11.0/firebase-firestore.js');
        await _rset(_rdoc(_rf(), 'face_2fa', window.myUID), { adminFaceDescriptor: enrolled }, { merge: true });
        _audioEnroll();
        setMsg('\u2713 Face registered! Panel will now use face scan.', '#22c55e');
        setTimeout(() => { setMsg(''); if (vWrap) vWrap.style.display = 'none'; }, 4000);
    } catch (e) {
        _audioError();
        setMsg('\u26a0 ' + (e.message || 'Failed'), '#f87171');
        console.error('[FaceReg]', e);
    } finally {
        _stopCamera(videoEl);
        if (btn) btn.disabled = false;
    }
};

let _lockActive  = false;
let _lockRAF     = null;
let _lockFrameCt = 0;
let _enrolledGeo = null;
let _lockStream  = null;

const _el            = id => document.getElementById(id);
const _lockSetSub    = t => { const e = _el('admin-lock-sub');         if (e) e.textContent = t; };
const _lockSetStatus = t => { const e = _el('admin-lock-face-status'); if (e) e.textContent = t; };
const _lockSetErr    = t => { const e = _el('admin-lock-err');         if (e) e.textContent = t; };

window._lockSetSub = _lockSetSub;

const _descRing = [];
const RING_SIZE  = 4;
function _smoothedDescriptor(raw) {
    if (raw._noLandmarks) return raw;
    _descRing.push(raw);
    if (_descRing.length > RING_SIZE) _descRing.shift();
    const out = { _ear: raw._ear };
    for (const k of Object.keys(raw)) {
        if (k === '_noLandmarks' || k === '_ear') continue;
        const vals = _descRing.map(d => d[k]).filter(v => v != null);
        out[k] = vals.length ? vals.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / vals.length : raw[k];
    }
    return out;
}

function _lockStop() {
    _lockActive = false;
    if (_lockRAF) { cancelAnimationFrame(_lockRAF); _lockRAF = null; }
    _stopMpCamera();
    _stopManualSend();
    _lastDetection = null;
    const vid = _el('admin-lock-video');
    _faceTrackReset('admin', vid, _el('admin-lock-canvas'));
    if (vid && vid.srcObject) { try { vid.srcObject.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop()); } catch (_) {} vid.srcObject = null; }
    if (_lockStream) { try { _lockStream.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop()); } catch (_) {} _lockStream = null; }
    const canvas = _el('admin-lock-canvas');
    if (canvas) { try { canvas.getContext('2d').clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height); canvas.style.display = 'none'; } catch (_) {} }
    const w = _el('admin-lock-face-wrap');
    if (w) { w.style.display = 'none'; w.classList.remove('scanning-active', 'match-active', 'verified', 'face-present'); }
    _descRing.length = 0;
    _lockFrameCt = 0;
}

function _lockFallback(reason) {
    _audioError();
    _lockStop();
    const inp = _el('admin-lock-input');
    const btn = _el('admin-lock-btn');
    if (inp) { inp.style.display = ''; inp.value = ''; setTimeout(() => inp.focus(), 80); }
    if (btn) { btn.textContent = 'Unlock'; btn.disabled = false; btn.onclick = () => window._adminUnlock(); }
    _lockSetSub('Enter password to continue');
    _lockSetStatus('');
    if (reason) _lockSetErr(reason);
}
window._lockFallback = _lockFallback;

const MAX_FRAMES    = Infinity;
const WARMUP_FRAMES = 6;

let _lockScanInFlight = false;

async function _lockStartFaceScan() {
    if (_lockScanInFlight) {
        console.warn('[FaceUnlock] Scan already starting — ignoring duplicate call.');
        return;
    }
    _lockScanInFlight = true;

    const wrap   = _el('admin-lock-face-wrap');
    const vid    = _el('admin-lock-video');
    const canvas = _el('admin-lock-canvas');
    const btn    = _el('admin-lock-btn');

    if (!wrap || !vid) { _lockScanInFlight = false; _lockFallback('UI elements missing.'); return; }

    _lockStop();
    _lockActive  = true;
    _lockFrameCt = 0;
    _descRing.length = 0;
    _enrolledGeo = null;

    if (btn) { btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = 'Starting…'; }
    _lockSetSub('Loading face detection…');
    _lockSetStatus('');
    _lockSetErr('');

    let _camAbandoned = false;
    const _camPromise = _startCamera(vid);
    _camPromise.then(s => {
        if (_camAbandoned) { try { s.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop()); } catch (_) {} }
    }).catch(() => {});

    const _mpPromise = _loadMediaPipe();
    const _descPromise = (async () => {
        const { getFirestore: _af, doc: _adoc, getDoc: _aget } =
            await import('https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.11.0/firebase-firestore.js');
        const snap = await _aget(_adoc(_af(), 'face_2fa', window.myUID));
        if (!snap.exists()) return null;
        const d = snap.data();
        return d.adminFaceDescriptorV2 || d.adminFaceDescriptor || null;
    })();
    _mpPromise.catch(() => {});
    _descPromise.catch(() => {});

    _lockSetSub('Preparing Face ID…');

    try {
        const mpOk = await _mpPromise;
        if (!mpOk) {
            _lockScanInFlight = false; _camAbandoned = true;
            _lockFallback('Face detection failed — check your network connection and try again.');
            return;
        }
    } catch (e) { _lockScanInFlight = false; _camAbandoned = true; _lockFallback('Detector load failed: ' + e.message); return; }

    try {
        const raw = await _descPromise;
        const isV2 = _isV2Descriptor(raw);
        const isV1 = raw && typeof raw === 'object' && !isV2 && (raw.r_faceShape || raw.r_eyeEar || raw.aspectRatio);
        if (!isV2 && !isV1) {
            _lockScanInFlight = false; _camAbandoned = true;
            _lockFallback('No face ID registered — go to Admin > Site Config to register your face.'); return;
        }
        if (!isV2 && !raw.r_faceShape) {
            _lockScanInFlight = false; _camAbandoned = true;
            _lockFallback('Face ID needs to be re-registered (upgraded accuracy model) — go to Admin > Site Config.'); return;
        }
        console.log('[FaceUnlock] Descriptor type:', isV2 ? `V2 (${Object.keys(raw.keys).length} keys, ${raw.samples} samples)` : 'V1', '| keys:', Object.keys(raw).join(', '));
        _enrolledGeo = raw;
    } catch (e) { _lockScanInFlight = false; _camAbandoned = true; _lockFallback('Could not fetch face data: ' + e.message); return; }

    _lockSetSub('Opening camera…');
    try {
        _lockStream = await _withTimeout(_camPromise, 15000,
            'Camera took too long to open — check camera permissions and try again.');
    } catch (e) { _lockScanInFlight = false; _camAbandoned = true; _lockFallback('Camera error: ' + e.message); return; }
    _lockScanInFlight = false;
    _stopMpCamera();
    _startMpCamera(vid);

    wrap.style.display = 'block';
    wrap.classList.remove('match-active');
    wrap.classList.add('scanning-active');
    if (canvas) {
        canvas.style.display   = 'block';
        canvas.style.position  = 'absolute';
        canvas.style.top       = '0';
        canvas.style.left      = '0';
        canvas.style.width     = '100%';
        canvas.style.height    = '100%';
        canvas.style.transform = 'scaleX(-1)';
    }

    if (btn) { btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = 'Use Password Instead'; btn.onclick = () => _lockFallback(''); }
    _lockSetSub('Align your face…');
    _audioScanStart();

    const CONFIRM_FRAMES_NEEDED = 22;
    const FRAME_THROTTLE_MS     = 50;
    let _confirmStreak = 0;
    let _mismatchFrames = 0;
    const MISMATCH_FRAMES_NEEDED = 80;
    let _lastFrameTime = 0;

    const EAR_CLOSED = 0.16, EAR_OPEN = 0.22;
    let _earWasClosed = false;
    let _blinkDetected = false;

    async function _frameLoop(timestamp) {
        if (!_lockActive) return;

        if (timestamp - _lastFrameTime < FRAME_THROTTLE_MS) {
            _lockRAF = requestAnimationFrame(_frameLoop);
            return;
        }
        _lastFrameTime = timestamp;
        _lockFrameCt++;

        if (canvas && vid.videoWidth > 0) {
            if (canvas.width  !== vid.videoWidth)  canvas.width  = vid.videoWidth;
            if (canvas.height !== vid.videoHeight) canvas.height = vid.videoHeight;
        }

        if (_lockFrameCt < WARMUP_FRAMES) { _lockRAF = requestAnimationFrame(_frameLoop); return; }

        if (_lockFrameCt > MAX_FRAMES + WARMUP_FRAMES) {
            _lockFallback('Face not recognised — enter password.');
            return;
        }

        let det = null;
        try { det = await _detectFace(vid, canvas || null); } catch (_) {}

        _faceTrackZoom('admin', vid, canvas, det && det.box);

        if (det && det.box) {
            { const _w = _el('admin-lock-face-wrap'); if (_w) _w.classList.add('face-present'); }
            const liveDsc  = _geoDescriptor(det);
            const smoothDsc = _smoothedDescriptor(liveDsc);
            const { match, score, offFrontal, tooFar, tooClose } = _landmarkMatch(smoothDsc, _enrolledGeo);
            const pct = score;
            const unscorable = offFrontal || tooFar || tooClose;

            if (liveDsc._ear != null) {
                if (liveDsc._ear < EAR_CLOSED) _earWasClosed = true;
                else if (liveDsc._ear > EAR_OPEN && _earWasClosed) { _blinkDetected = true; _earWasClosed = false; }
            }

            if (match) {
                _confirmStreak++;
                _mismatchFrames = Math.max(0, _mismatchFrames - 2);
                const confirmPct = Math.round((_confirmStreak / CONFIRM_FRAMES_NEEDED) * 100);

                if (canvas) _drawOverlay(canvas, det, _confirmStreak > CONFIRM_FRAMES_NEEDED * 0.5, confirmPct);

                const wrap = _el('admin-lock-face-wrap');
                if (wrap) { wrap.classList.remove('scanning-active'); wrap.classList.add('match-active'); }

                if (_confirmStreak >= CONFIRM_FRAMES_NEEDED && !_blinkDetected) {
                    _lockSetSub('Blink naturally to verify…');
                    _lockSetStatus('Liveness check…');
                    if (canvas) _drawOverlay(canvas, det, true, 100);
                    _lockRAF = requestAnimationFrame(_frameLoop);
                    return;
                }

                if (_confirmStreak >= CONFIRM_FRAMES_NEEDED) {
                    _lockActive = false;
                    if (_lockRAF) { cancelAnimationFrame(_lockRAF); _lockRAF = null; }
                    if (canvas) _drawOverlay(canvas, det, true);

                    { const _w = _el('admin-lock-face-wrap'); if (_w) _w.classList.add('verified'); }

                    _lockSetStatus('Verified ✓');
                    _lockSetErr('');

                    const iconEl = _el('admin-lock-icon');
                    if (iconEl) {
                        iconEl.classList.add('unlocking');
                    }

                    _lockSetSub('Identity confirmed');
                    setTimeout(() => _lockSetSub('Access granted ✓'), 320);

                    _audioUnlock();

                    setTimeout(() => {
                        _lockStop();
                        if (iconEl) {
                            iconEl.classList.remove('unlocking');
                            iconEl.style.color = '';
                        }
                        window._adminMarkUnlocked && window._adminMarkUnlocked();
                    }, 1800);
                    return;
                }

                _lockSetSub(`Verifying… ${confirmPct}%`)            } else {
                _confirmStreak = Math.max(0, _confirmStreak - 4);
                if (_confirmStreak === 0) {
                    _blinkDetected = false; _earWasClosed = false;
                    const wrap = _el('admin-lock-face-wrap');
                    if (wrap) { wrap.classList.remove('match-active'); wrap.classList.add('scanning-active'); }
                }

                if (!unscorable) _mismatchFrames++;
                if (_mismatchFrames >= MISMATCH_FRAMES_NEEDED) {
                    _lockActive = false;
                    if (_lockRAF) { cancelAnimationFrame(_lockRAF); _lockRAF = null; }
                    _audioError();
                    const rWrap = _el('admin-lock-face-wrap');
                    const rIcon = _el('admin-lock-icon');
                    if (rWrap) { rWrap.classList.remove('scanning-active','match-active'); rWrap.classList.add('reject-active'); }
                    if (rIcon) { rIcon.classList.add('reject-shake'); setTimeout(() => rIcon.classList.remove('reject-shake'), 500); }
                    _lockSetSub('Not you.');
                    _lockSetStatus('Identity not recognised');
                    _lockSetErr("Face ID doesn’t match the enrolled admin. Use your password.");
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        if (rWrap) { rWrap.classList.remove('reject-active'); rWrap.classList.add('scanning-active'); }
                        _lockStop();
                        const inp = _el('admin-lock-input');
                        const btn = _el('admin-lock-btn');
                        if (inp) { inp.style.display = ''; inp.value = ''; setTimeout(() => inp.focus(), 80); }
                        if (btn) { btn.textContent = 'Unlock'; btn.disabled = false; btn.onclick = () => window._adminUnlock(); }
                        _lockSetSub('Enter password to continue');
                        _lockSetStatus('');
                    }, 1800);
                    return;
                }

                _lockSetStatus(unscorable ? '' : pct.toFixed(0) + '% match');
                if (canvas) _drawOverlay(canvas, det, false);
                _lockSetSub(_geoHint(smoothDsc, _enrolledGeo));
                _lockSetErr('');
            }
        } else {
            _confirmStreak = 0;
            _mismatchFrames = 0;
            { const _w = _el('admin-lock-face-wrap'); if (_w) _w.classList.remove('face-present'); }
            _blinkDetected = false; _earWasClosed = false;
            _descRing.length = 0;
            const wrap = _el('admin-lock-face-wrap');
            if (wrap) { wrap.classList.remove('match-active'); if (!wrap.classList.contains('scanning-active')) wrap.classList.add('scanning-active'); }
            _lockSetSub('No face detected — look at the camera');
            _lockSetStatus('');
            if (canvas) { try { canvas.getContext('2d').clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height); } catch (_) {} }
        }

        _lockRAF = requestAnimationFrame(_frameLoop);
    }

    const _faceWrap = _el('admin-lock-face-wrap');
    if (_faceWrap) _faceWrap.classList.add('scanning-active');

    _lockRAF = requestAnimationFrame(_frameLoop);
}

window._lockStartFaceScan = _lockStartFaceScan;
window._lockStop = _lockStop;

window._adminLockBtnClick = async function () {
    const inp = _el('admin-lock-input');
    if (inp && inp.style.display !== 'none') { window._adminUnlock(); return; }
    await _lockStartFaceScan();
};

const _origShow = window._showAdminLock || function () {};
window._showAdminLock = function () {
    _lockStop();
    _enrolledGeo = null;
    const inp = _el('admin-lock-input');
    const err = _el('admin-lock-err');
    if (inp) { inp.style.display = 'none'; inp.value = ''; }
    if (err) err.textContent = '';
    const btn = _el('admin-lock-btn');
    if (btn) { btn.textContent = 'Unlock'; btn.disabled = false; btn.onclick = () => window._adminLockBtnClick(); }
    _lockSetSub('Opening camera…');
    _origShow.call(this);
    setTimeout(_lockStartFaceScan, 100);
};

const _origHide = window._hideAdminLock || function () {};
window._hideAdminLock = function () { _lockStop(); _origHide.call(this); };

const _origUnlock = window._adminUnlock;
window._adminUnlock = async function () {
    await (_origUnlock && _origUnlock());
    const ov = _el('admin-lock-overlay');
    if (!ov || !ov.classList.contains('active')) _lockStop();
};

window._faceUtil = {
    startCamera:    _startCamera,
    stopCamera:     _stopCamera,
    withTimeout:    _withTimeout,
    loadMediaPipe:  _loadMediaPipe,
    detectFace:     _detectFace,
    faceTrackZoom:  _faceTrackZoom,
    faceTrackReset: _faceTrackReset,
    geoDescriptor:  _geoDescriptor,
    landmarkMatch:  _landmarkMatch,
    geoHint:        _geoHint,
    drawOverlay:    _drawOverlay,
    identityKeys:   IDENTITY_KEYS,
    skinToneLabel:  _skinToneLabel,
    startMpCamera:  _startMpCamera,
    stopMpCamera:   _stopMpCamera,
    audioScanStart: _audioScanStart,
    audioUnlock:    _audioUnlock,
    audioEnroll:    _audioEnroll,
    audioError:     _audioError
};

})();
