<script>
(function () {
'use strict';

function _forceLock() {
    if (typeof window._adminSetLocked === 'function') {
        window._adminSetLocked(true);
    } else {
        const ov = document.getElementById('admin-lock-overlay');
        if (ov) ov.classList.add('active');
    }
    if (typeof window._showAdminLock === 'function') {
        setTimeout(window._showAdminLock, 80);
    }
}

document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    const btn = document.getElementById('admin-nav-btn');
    if (!btn) return;
    if (btn === e.target || btn.contains(e.target)) {
        _forceLock();
    }
}, true);

function _watchAdminView() {
    const adminView = document.getElementById('view-admin');
    if (!adminView) {
        setTimeout(_watchAdminView, 200);
        return;
    }
    let _wasActive = adminView.classList.contains('active');
    const obs = new MutationObserver(() => {
        const isActive = adminView.classList.contains('active');
        if (isActive && !_wasActive) {
            _forceLock();
        }
        _wasActive = isActive;
    });
    obs.observe(adminView, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] });
}
if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', _watchAdminView);
} else {
    _watchAdminView();
}

})();

(function () {
'use strict';
window._nativeDialogOpen = false;
['confirm', 'alert', 'prompt'].forEach(function (fnName) {
    const orig = window[fnName];
    if (typeof orig !== 'function') return;
    window[fnName] = function () {
        window._nativeDialogOpen = true;
        try {
            return orig.apply(window, arguments);
        } finally {
            window._nativeDialogOpen = false;
        }
    };
});
})();

(function () {
'use strict';

const RELOCK_DELAY_MS = 10000;
const SCAN_GRACE_MS   = 120;

let _relockPending  = null;
let _countdownTimer = null;

function _isAdminOpen() {
    const navBtn = document.getElementById('admin-nav-btn');
    if (navBtn && !navBtn.classList.contains('active-nav')) return false;
    return true;
}

function _clearRelockCountdownUI() {
    if (_countdownTimer) { clearInterval(_countdownTimer); _countdownTimer = null; }
    const el = document.getElementById('admin-relock-countdown');
    if (el) el.remove();
}

function _showRelockCountdownUI(totalMs) {
    _clearRelockCountdownUI();
    const el = document.createElement('div');
    el.id = 'admin-relock-countdown';
    el.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;top:14px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:99999;background:#1a0505;color:#f87171;border:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,0.4);font-size:12px;font-weight:800;padding:8px 16px;border-radius:20px;box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);pointer-events:none;white-space:nowrap;';
    document.body.appendChild(el);
    let remaining = Math.ceil(totalMs / 1000);
    const render = () => { el.textContent = `Admin Panel locks in ${remaining}s — return to this tab to stay unlocked`; };
    render();
    _countdownTimer = setInterval(() => {
        remaining -= 1;
        if (remaining <= 0) { _clearRelockCountdownUI(); return; }
        render();
    }, 1000);
}

function _cancelPendingRelock() {
    if (_relockPending !== null) {
        clearTimeout(_relockPending);
        _relockPending = null;
    }
    _clearRelockCountdownUI();
}

function _triggerRelock() {
    if (window._nativeDialogOpen) return;
    if (!_isAdminOpen()) return;
    if (typeof window._adminIsLocked === 'function' && window._adminIsLocked()) return;
    if (_relockPending !== null) return;

    _showRelockCountdownUI(RELOCK_DELAY_MS);

    _relockPending = setTimeout(() => {
        _relockPending = null;
        _clearRelockCountdownUI();
        if (!_isAdminOpen()) return;

        if (typeof window._adminSetLocked === 'function') {
            window._adminSetLocked(true);
        }

        if (typeof window._showAdminLock === 'function') {
            setTimeout(window._showAdminLock, SCAN_GRACE_MS);
        }

        console.log('[AdminLock] Re-locked: tab/window left admin view.');
    }, RELOCK_DELAY_MS);
}

document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
    if (document.hidden) {
        _triggerRelock();
    } else {
        _cancelPendingRelock();
    }
}, false);

window.addEventListener('blur', () => {
    _triggerRelock();
}, false);

window.addEventListener('focus', () => {
    _cancelPendingRelock();
}, false);

const __svRelock = window.switchView;
window.switchView = function (id) {
    if (id !== 'admin') _cancelPendingRelock();
    return __svRelock && __svRelock(id);
};


})();
</script>

<script>
(function () {

let _subLocked         = false;
let _subViewOpen       = false;
let _subSessionToken   = null;
let _subTamperObserver = null;

function _subGenToken() {
    const arr = new Uint8Array(16);
    crypto.getRandomValues(arr);
    return Array.from(arr).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');
}
function _subWriteToken(t) { _subSessionToken = t; try { sessionStorage.setItem('_salt', t); } catch(_){} }
function _subClearToken()  { _subSessionToken = null; try { sessionStorage.removeItem('_salt'); sessionStorage.removeItem('subAdminUnlocked'); } catch(_){} }

function _subStartTamperWatch() {
    if (_subTamperObserver) _subTamperObserver.disconnect();
    _subTamperObserver = new MutationObserver(() => {
        if (!_subViewOpen || !_subLocked) return;
        const ov = document.getElementById('subadmin-lock-overlay');
        if (!ov || !ov.classList.contains('active') || getComputedStyle(ov).display === 'none' || !document.body.contains(ov)) {
            _subClearToken();
            location.reload();
        }
    });
    _subTamperObserver.observe(document.documentElement, { childList: true, subtree: true, attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class', 'style'] });
}

function _subBlockClick(e) {
    if (!_subViewOpen || !_subLocked) return;
    const ov = document.getElementById('subadmin-lock-overlay');
    if (ov && ov.contains(e.target)) return;
    e.stopImmediatePropagation();

}
document.addEventListener('click',      _subBlockClick, true);
document.addEventListener('mousedown',  _subBlockClick, true);
document.addEventListener('touchstart', _subBlockClick, { capture: true, passive: false });

    const ov = document.getElementById('subadmin-lock-overlay');

    const ov = document.getElementById('subadmin-lock-overlay');
    if (!ov) return;
    if (locked) {
        ov.classList.add('active');
        if (_subViewOpen) _subStartTamperWatch();

        ov.classList.remove('active');

        try { sessionStorage.setItem('subAdminUnlocked', '1'); } catch(_){}
        if (typeof window._subLockStop === 'function') window._subLockStop();
    }
};

    if (id === 'subadmin') {

    }

window._subAdminIsLocked     = () => _subLocked;

async function _sha256Sub(str) {
    const buf = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', new TextEncoder().encode(str));
    return Array.from(new Uint8Array(buf)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');
}
async function _subFsDoc() {
    const { getFirestore, doc } = await import('https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.11.0/firebase-firestore.js');
    return doc(getFirestore(), 'users', window.myUID);
}
async function _subFaceDoc() {
    const { getFirestore, doc } = await import('https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.11.0/firebase-firestore.js');
    return doc(getFirestore(), 'face_2fa', window.myUID);
}
async function _getSubAdminPwHash() {
    try {
        if (!window.myUID) return null;
        const { getDoc } = await import('https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.11.0/firebase-firestore.js');
        const snap = await getDoc(await _subFsDoc());
        return snap.exists() ? (snap.data().subAdminPasswordHash || null) : null;
    } catch(e) { return null; }
}

window._subAdminUnlock = async () => {
    const input = document.getElementById('subadmin-lock-input');
    const err   = document.getElementById('subadmin-lock-err');
    const btn   = document.getElementById('subadmin-lock-btn');
    if (!input || !err) return;

    if (!window.myUID) { err.textContent = 'Not logged in.'; return; }

    const entered = input.value.trim();
    if (!entered) { err.textContent = 'Enter your password.'; return; }

    btn.textContent = 'Checking…';
    btn.disabled = true;

    const storedHash = await _getSubAdminPwHash();

    if (!storedHash) {
        btn.textContent = 'Unlock';
        btn.disabled = false;
        if (window._panelSetup) { window._panelSetup.run('sub'); return; }
        err.textContent = 'Panel setup unavailable — reload and try again.';
        return;
    }

    const enteredHash = await _sha256Sub(entered);
    if (enteredHash === storedHash) {
        window._subAdminMarkUnlocked && window._subAdminMarkUnlocked();
        input.value = '';
        err.textContent = '';
    } else {
        err.textContent = 'Incorrect password.';
        input.classList.add('shake');
        input.value = '';
        setTimeout(() => { input.classList.remove('shake'); input.focus(); }, 400);
    }

    btn.textContent = 'Unlock';
    btn.disabled = false;
};

window._changeSubAdminPassword = async () => {
    const curEl = document.getElementById('subap-pw-current');
    const newEl = document.getElementById('subap-pw-new');
    const conEl = document.getElementById('subap-pw-confirm');
    const msgEl = document.getElementById('subap-pw-msg');
    if (!curEl || !newEl || !conEl || !msgEl) return;

    const cur = curEl.value.trim();
    const nw  = newEl.value.trim();
    const con = conEl.value.trim();

    function _pwMsg(text, ok) {
        msgEl.textContent = text;
        msgEl.style.color = ok ? '#22c55e' : '#f87171';
        msgEl.classList.remove('hidden');
    }

    if (!window.myUID) return _pwMsg('Not logged in.', false);
    if (nw.length < 6) return _pwMsg('New password must be at least 6 characters.', false);
    if (nw !== con) return _pwMsg('New passwords do not match.', false);

    _pwMsg('Verifying…', true);

    const storedHash = await _getSubAdminPwHash();
    if (storedHash) {
        if (!cur) return _pwMsg('Enter your current password.', false);
        const curHash = await _sha256Sub(cur);
        if (curHash !== storedHash) return _pwMsg('Current password is incorrect.', false);
    }

    try {
        const { setDoc } = await import('https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.11.0/firebase-firestore.js');
        const newHash = await _sha256Sub(nw);
        await setDoc(await _subFsDoc(), { subAdminPasswordHash: newHash }, { merge: true });
        try { sessionStorage.setItem('subAdminUnlocked', '1'); } catch(_){}
        curEl.value = ''; newEl.value = ''; conEl.value = '';
        _pwMsg('✓ Password updated successfully.', true);
    } catch(e) {
        _pwMsg('Failed to save: ' + e.message, false);
    }
};

const _TFA_FS = 'https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.11.0/firebase-firestore.js';
async function _tfaUserDoc() {
    const { getFirestore, doc } = await import(_TFA_FS);
    return doc(getFirestore(), 'users', window.myUID);
}
async function _tfaFaceDoc(uid) {
    const { getFirestore, doc } = await import(_TFA_FS);
    return doc(getFirestore(), 'face_2fa', uid || window.myUID);
}

window._tfaSetStatus = (txt, col) => {
    const el = document.getElementById('tfa-status');
    if (!el) return;
    el.textContent = txt || '';
    el.style.color = col || '#a78bfa';
    el.classList.toggle('hidden', !txt);
};

window._tfaRefreshSettings = async () => {
    const toggle = document.getElementById('tfa-enabled-toggle');
    const sub    = document.getElementById('tfa-toggle-sub');
    const remove = document.getElementById('tfa-remove-btn');
    const regBtn = document.getElementById('tfa-register-btn');
    if (!toggle || !window.myUID) return;
    try {
        const { getDoc } = await import(_TFA_FS);
        const [snap, faceSnap] = await Promise.all([getDoc(await _tfaUserDoc()), getDoc(await _tfaFaceDoc())]);
        const d = snap.exists() ? snap.data() : {};
        const fd = faceSnap.exists() ? faceSnap.data().faceDescriptor2FA : null;
        const enrolled = !!(fd && fd.r_faceShape);
        toggle.disabled = !enrolled;
        toggle.checked  = enrolled && !!d.twoFactorFace;
        if (remove) remove.classList.toggle('hidden', !enrolled);
        if (regBtn) regBtn.innerHTML = enrolled
            ? '<i class="fa-solid fa-camera"></i> Re-register Face'
            : '<i class="fa-solid fa-camera"></i> Register Face';
        if (sub) sub.textContent = !enrolled
            ? 'Register your face to enable this.'
            : (d.twoFactorFace ? 'On — you\'ll scan your face at every login.' : 'Off — password only.');
    } catch (_) {}
};

window._tfaToggle = async (on) => {
    if (!window.myUID) return;
    try {
        const { updateDoc } = await import(_TFA_FS);
        await updateDoc(await _tfaUserDoc(), { twoFactorFace: !!on });
        window._tfaSetStatus(on ? '✓ Face ID login enabled.' : 'Face ID login disabled.', on ? '#22c55e' : '#888899');
        window._tfaRefreshSettings();
    } catch (e) {
        window._tfaSetStatus('⚠ ' + e.message, '#f87171');
        const t = document.getElementById('tfa-enabled-toggle');
        if (t) t.checked = !on;
    }
    setTimeout(() => window._tfaSetStatus(''), 4000);
};

window._tfaRemoveFace = async () => {
    if (!window.myUID) return;
    if (!confirm('Remove your registered face? This also turns off Face ID login.')) return;
    try {
        const { updateDoc, setDoc, deleteField } = await import(_TFA_FS);
        await Promise.all([
            setDoc(await _tfaFaceDoc(), { faceDescriptor2FA: deleteField() }, { merge: true }),
            updateDoc(await _tfaUserDoc(), { twoFactorFace: false })
        ]);
        window._tfaSetStatus('Face removed.', '#888899');
        window._tfaRefreshSettings();
    } catch (e) { window._tfaSetStatus('⚠ ' + e.message, '#f87171'); }
};

window._tfaRegisterFace = async () => {
    const FU = window._faceUtil;
    const wrap = document.getElementById('tfa-reg-video-wrap');
    const vid  = document.getElementById('tfa-reg-video');
    const btn  = document.getElementById('tfa-register-btn');
    if (!FU || !vid || !window.myUID) return;
    if (btn) btn.disabled = true;
    if (wrap) wrap.style.display = 'block';
    try {
        window._tfaSetStatus('Loading face detection…');
        if (!await FU.loadMediaPipe()) throw new Error('Face detection failed to load — check your connection.');
        window._tfaSetStatus('Opening camera…');
        await FU.startCamera(vid);
        FU.audioScanStart();
        for (let n = 3; n > 0; n--) {
            window._tfaSetStatus(`Look straight at the camera — capturing in ${n}…`);
            await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1000));
        }
        window._tfaSetStatus('Detecting face…');
        const samples = [];
        let tooFarCt = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
            await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 120));
            const det = await FU.detectFace(vid, null);
            const dsc = det && FU.geoDescriptor(det);
            if (dsc && !dsc._noLandmarks) {
                if (dsc._faceW != null && dsc._faceW < window.__FACE_ENROLL_MIN_W) tooFarCt++;
                else samples.push(dsc);
            }
        }
        if (!samples.length && tooFarCt) throw new Error('You were too far from the camera — move closer so your face fills the frame, then try again.');
        if (!samples.length) throw new Error('No face detected — check lighting and camera angle.');
        const enrolled = {};
        for (const k of FU.identityKeys) {
            const vals = samples.map(d => d[k]).filter(v => typeof v === 'number' && isFinite(v));
            if (vals.length) enrolled[k] = vals.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / vals.length;
        }
        const { setDoc } = await import(_TFA_FS);
        await setDoc(await _tfaFaceDoc(), { faceDescriptor2FA: enrolled }, { merge: true });
        FU.audioEnroll();
        const tone = FU.skinToneLabel && FU.skinToneLabel(enrolled);
        window._tfaSetStatus('✓ Face registered' + (tone ? ` (skin tone: ${tone})` : '') +
            ' — you can turn on Face ID login now.', '#22c55e');
        window._tfaRefreshSettings();
    } catch (e) {
        if (FU.audioError) FU.audioError();
        window._tfaSetStatus('⚠ ' + (e.message || 'Failed'), '#f87171');
    } finally {
        FU.stopCamera(vid);
        if (wrap) wrap.style.display = 'none';
        if (btn) btn.disabled = false;
    }
};

window._tfaRunGate = async (uid) => {
    const FU     = window._faceUtil;
    const gate   = document.getElementById('tfa-gate');
    const vid    = document.getElementById('tfa-gate-video');
    const canvas = document.getElementById('tfa-gate-canvas');
    const wrap   = document.getElementById('tfa-gate-video-wrap');
    const setSub = t => { const e = document.getElementById('tfa-gate-sub');    if (e) e.textContent = t; };
    const setSt  = t => { const e = document.getElementById('tfa-gate-status'); if (e) e.textContent = t; };
    const setErr = t => { const e = document.getElementById('tfa-gate-err');    if (e) e.textContent = t; };
    if (!gate || !FU) return true;

    gate.classList.add('open');
    setSt(''); setErr(''); setSub('Face ID is on for this account.');
    let raf = null, done = false;

    const cleanup = () => {
        done = true;
        if (raf) { cancelAnimationFrame(raf); raf = null; }
        try { FU.stopMpCamera(); } catch (_) {}
        try { FU.stopCamera(vid); } catch (_) {}
        gate.classList.remove('open');
        if (wrap) wrap.classList.remove('scanning-active', 'match-active', 'verified', 'face-present');
    };

    return await new Promise(async (resolve) => {
        const finish = (ok) => { if (!done) { cleanup(); resolve(ok); } };
        document.getElementById('tfa-gate-cancel').onclick = () => finish(false);

        let enrolledGeo;
        try {
            const { getFirestore, getDoc, doc: fsDoc } = await import(_TFA_FS);
            const snap = await getDoc(fsDoc(getFirestore(), 'face_2fa', uid));
            enrolledGeo = snap.exists() ? snap.data().faceDescriptor2FA : null;
            if (!enrolledGeo || !enrolledGeo.r_faceShape) return finish(true);
            setSt('Loading face detection…');
            if (!await FU.loadMediaPipe()) throw new Error('Face detection failed to load.');
            setSt('Opening camera…');
            await FU.withTimeout(FU.startCamera(vid), 15000, 'Camera took too long to open.');
        } catch (e) {
            setErr('⚠ ' + e.message + ' Use your recovery key to log in instead.');
            setSt('');
            return;
        }

        FU.stopMpCamera(); FU.startMpCamera(vid);
        if (wrap) wrap.classList.add('scanning-active');
        setSub('Align your face…'); setSt('Scanning…');
        FU.audioScanStart();

        const NEED = 18, THROTTLE = 66, WARMUP = 15;
        const EAR_CLOSED = 0.16, EAR_OPEN = 0.22;
        let streak = 0, last = 0, frames = 0, earClosed = false, blinked = false;

        const RING = [], RING_SIZE = 8;
        const smooth = (raw) => {
            if (raw._noLandmarks) return raw;
            RING.push(raw);
            if (RING.length > RING_SIZE) RING.shift();
            const out = { _ear: raw._ear };
            for (const k of Object.keys(raw)) {
                if (k === '_noLandmarks' || k === '_ear') continue;
                const vals = RING.map(d => d[k]).filter(v => v != null);
                out[k] = vals.length ? vals.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / vals.length : raw[k];
            }
            return out;
        };
        const GRACE = 6;
        let missRun = 0;
        let missScorable = 0;
        const MISS_NEEDED = 60;

        const loop = async (ts) => {
            if (done) return;
            if (ts - last < THROTTLE) { raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop); return; }
            last = ts; frames++;
            if (canvas && vid.videoWidth > 0) {
                if (canvas.width  !== vid.videoWidth)  canvas.width  = vid.videoWidth;
                if (canvas.height !== vid.videoHeight) canvas.height = vid.videoHeight;
            }
            if (frames < WARMUP) { raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop); return; }

            let det = null;
            try { det = await FU.detectFace(vid, canvas || null); } catch (_) {}
            if (det && det.box) {
                if (wrap) wrap.classList.add('face-present');
                const live = FU.geoDescriptor(det);
                const smoothed = smooth(live);
                const { match, offFrontal, tooFar, tooClose } = FU.landmarkMatch(smoothed, enrolledGeo);
                const unscorable = offFrontal || tooFar || tooClose;
                if (live._ear != null) {
                    if (live._ear < EAR_CLOSED) earClosed = true;
                    else if (live._ear > EAR_OPEN && earClosed) { blinked = true; earClosed = false; }
                }
                if (match) {
                    missRun = 0;
                    streak++;
                    missScorable = Math.max(0, missScorable - 2);
                    if (wrap) { wrap.classList.remove('scanning-active'); wrap.classList.add('match-active'); }
                    if (canvas) FU.drawOverlay(canvas, det, streak > NEED * 0.5, Math.round((streak / NEED) * 100));
                    if (streak >= NEED && !blinked) { setSt('Blink to verify…'); raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop); return; }
                    if (streak >= NEED) {
                        if (wrap) wrap.classList.add('verified');
                        setSt('Verified ✓'); setSub('Identity confirmed');
                        FU.audioUnlock();
                        setTimeout(() => finish(true), 1400);
                        return;
                    }
                } else {
                    missRun++;
                    if (missRun > GRACE) { streak = Math.max(0, streak - 1); blinked = false; earClosed = false; }

                    if (!unscorable) missScorable++;
                    if (missScorable >= MISS_NEEDED) {
                        if (raf) { cancelAnimationFrame(raf); raf = null; }
                        FU.audioError();
                        if (wrap) {
                            wrap.classList.remove('scanning-active', 'match-active', 'face-present');
                            wrap.classList.add('reject-active');
                        }
                        setSub('Not you.');
                        setSt('Face not recognised');
                        setErr('That face does not match this account. Signing out.');
                        setTimeout(() => finish(false), 1800);
                        return;
                    }

                    if (canvas) FU.drawOverlay(canvas, det, false, Math.round((streak / NEED) * 100));
                    if (missRun > GRACE) {
                        if (wrap) { wrap.classList.remove('match-active'); wrap.classList.add('scanning-active'); }
                        setSt(unscorable ? FU.geoHint(smoothed, enrolledGeo) : 'Hold still…');
                    }
                }
            } else {
                if (wrap) wrap.classList.remove('face-present');
                missScorable = 0;
                missRun++;
                if (missRun > GRACE) setSt('No face detected…');
            }
            raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
        };
        raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    });
};

window._subAdminRegisterFace = async function () {
    const FU = window._faceUtil;
    const card    = document.getElementById('subap-face-reg-video-wrap');
    const videoEl = document.getElementById('subap-face-reg-video');
    const msgEl   = document.getElementById('subap-face-reg-msg');
    const secCard = document.getElementById('subap-security-card');
    const btn     = secCard ? secCard.querySelector('button') : null;
    if (!FU || !videoEl || !msgEl) return;
    if (!window.myUID) { msgEl.textContent = 'Not logged in.'; msgEl.style.color = '#f87171'; return; }

    const setMsg = (t, col) => { msgEl.textContent = t; msgEl.style.color = col || '#a78bfa'; };
    if (btn) btn.disabled = true;
    if (card) card.style.display = 'block';

    try {
        setMsg('Loading face detection…');
        const mpOk = await FU.loadMediaPipe();
        if (!mpOk) { setMsg('Face detection failed — check your network connection.', '#f87171'); if (btn) btn.disabled = false; return; }

        setMsg('Opening camera…');
        await FU.startCamera(videoEl);
        FU.audioScanStart();

        setMsg('Look straight at camera, close enough to fill the frame — capturing in 3…');
        await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1000));
        setMsg('2…');
        await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1000));
        setMsg('1…');
        await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1000));

        setMsg('Detecting face…');
        const samples = [];
        let tooFarCt = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
            await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 120));
            const det = await FU.detectFace(videoEl, null);
            const dsc = det && FU.geoDescriptor(det);
            if (dsc && !dsc._noLandmarks) {
                if (dsc._faceW != null && dsc._faceW < window.__FACE_ENROLL_MIN_W) tooFarCt++;
                else samples.push(dsc);
            }
        }
        if (!samples.length && tooFarCt) throw new Error('You were too far from the camera — move closer so your face fills the frame, then try again.');
        if (!samples.length) throw new Error('No face detected — check lighting and camera angle.');

        const enrolled = {};
        for (const k of FU.identityKeys) {
            const _vals = samples.map(d => d[k]).filter(v => typeof v === 'number' && isFinite(v));
            if (_vals.length) enrolled[k] = _vals.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / _vals.length;
        }

        setMsg('Saving…');
        const { setDoc } = await import('https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.11.0/firebase-firestore.js');
        await setDoc(await _subFaceDoc(), { subAdminFaceDescriptor: enrolled }, { merge: true });
        FU.audioEnroll();
        setMsg('✓ Face registered! Your panel will now use face scan.', '#22c55e');
        setTimeout(() => { setMsg(''); if (card) card.style.display = 'none'; }, 4000);
    } catch (e) {
        FU.audioError();
        setMsg('⚠ ' + (e.message || 'Failed'), '#f87171');
        console.error('[SubAdminFaceReg]', e);
    } finally {
        FU.stopCamera(videoEl);
        if (btn) btn.disabled = false;
    }
};

let _subLockActive  = false;
let _subLockRAF     = null;
let _subLockFrameCt = 0;
let _subEnrolledGeo = null;
let _subLockStream  = null;

const _subEl            = id => document.getElementById(id);
const _subLockSetSub    = t => { const e = _subEl('subadmin-lock-sub');         if (e) e.textContent = t; };
const _subLockSetStatus = t => { const e = _subEl('subadmin-lock-face-status'); if (e) e.textContent = t; };
const _subLockSetErr    = t => { const e = _subEl('subadmin-lock-err');         if (e) e.textContent = t; };

const _subDescRing = [];
const SUB_RING_SIZE = 4;
function _subSmoothedDescriptor(raw) {
    if (raw._noLandmarks) return raw;
    _subDescRing.push(raw);
    if (_subDescRing.length > SUB_RING_SIZE) _subDescRing.shift();
    const out = { _ear: raw._ear };
    for (const k of Object.keys(raw)) {
        if (k === '_noLandmarks' || k === '_ear') continue;
        const vals = _subDescRing.map(d => d[k]).filter(v => v != null);
        out[k] = vals.length ? vals.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / vals.length : raw[k];
    }
    return out;
}

function _subLockStop() {
    const FU = window._faceUtil;
    _subLockActive = false;
    if (_subLockRAF) { cancelAnimationFrame(_subLockRAF); _subLockRAF = null; }
    if (FU) FU.stopMpCamera();
    const vid = _subEl('subadmin-lock-video');
    if (FU && FU.faceTrackReset) FU.faceTrackReset('staff', vid, _subEl('subadmin-lock-canvas'));
    if (vid && vid.srcObject) { try { vid.srcObject.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop()); } catch (_) {} vid.srcObject = null; }
    if (_subLockStream) { try { _subLockStream.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop()); } catch (_) {} _subLockStream = null; }
    const canvas = _subEl('subadmin-lock-canvas');
    if (canvas) { try { canvas.getContext('2d').clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height); canvas.style.display = 'none'; } catch (_) {} }
    const w = _subEl('subadmin-lock-face-wrap');
    if (w) { w.style.display = 'none'; w.classList.remove('scanning-active', 'match-active', 'verified', 'face-present'); }
    _subDescRing.length = 0;
    _subLockFrameCt = 0;
}
window._subLockStop = _subLockStop;

function _subLockFallback(reason) {
    if (window._faceUtil) window._faceUtil.audioError();
    _subLockStop();
    const inp = _subEl('subadmin-lock-input');
    const btn = _subEl('subadmin-lock-btn');
    if (inp) { inp.style.display = ''; inp.value = ''; setTimeout(() => inp.focus(), 80); }
    if (btn) { btn.textContent = 'Unlock'; btn.disabled = false; btn.onclick = () => window._subAdminUnlock(); }
    _subLockSetSub('Enter password to continue');
    _subLockSetStatus('');
    if (reason) _subLockSetErr(reason);
}
window._subLockFallback = _subLockFallback;

let _subLockScanInFlight = false;

async function _subLockStartFaceScan() {
    if (_subLockScanInFlight) {
        console.warn('[FaceUnlock] Sub-admin scan already starting — ignoring duplicate call.');
        return;
    }
    _subLockScanInFlight = true;

    const FU = window._faceUtil;
    const wrap   = _subEl('subadmin-lock-face-wrap');
    const vid    = _subEl('subadmin-lock-video');
    const canvas = _subEl('subadmin-lock-canvas');
    const btn    = _subEl('subadmin-lock-btn');

    if (!FU || !wrap || !vid) { _subLockScanInFlight = false; _subLockFallback('Face scan unavailable.'); return; }
    if (!window.myUID) { _subLockScanInFlight = false; _subLockFallback('Not logged in.'); return; }

    _subLockStop();
    _subLockActive  = true;
    _subLockFrameCt = 0;
    _subDescRing.length = 0;
    _subEnrolledGeo = null;

    if (btn) { btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = 'Starting…'; }
    _subLockSetSub('Loading face detection…');
    _subLockSetStatus('');
    _subLockSetErr('');

    let _subCamAbandoned = false;
    const _subCamPromise = FU.startCamera(vid);
    _subCamPromise.then(s => {
        if (_subCamAbandoned) { try { s.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop()); } catch (_) {} }
    }).catch(() => {});

    const _subMpPromise = FU.loadMediaPipe();
    const _subDescPromise = (async () => {
        const { getDoc: _aget } = await import('https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.11.0/firebase-firestore.js');
        const snap = await _aget(await _subFaceDoc());
        return snap.exists() ? snap.data().subAdminFaceDescriptor : null;
    })();
    _subMpPromise.catch(() => {});
    _subDescPromise.catch(() => {});

    _subLockSetSub('Preparing Face ID…');

    try {
        const mpOk = await _subMpPromise;
        if (!mpOk) { _subLockScanInFlight = false; _subCamAbandoned = true; _subLockFallback('Face detection failed — check your network connection and try again.'); return; }
    } catch (e) { _subLockScanInFlight = false; _subCamAbandoned = true; _subLockFallback('Detector load failed: ' + e.message); return; }

    try {
        const raw = await _subDescPromise;
        const isV2sub = window._isV2Descriptor(raw);
        const isV1sub = raw && typeof raw === 'object' && !isV2sub && (raw.r_faceShape || raw.r_eyeEar || raw.aspectRatio);
        if (!isV2sub && !isV1sub) {
            _subLockScanInFlight = false; _subCamAbandoned = true;
            _subLockFallback('No face ID registered — register it below in the Staff Panel.'); return;
        }
        if (!isV2sub && !raw.r_faceShape) {
            _subLockScanInFlight = false; _subCamAbandoned = true;
            _subLockFallback('Face ID needs to be re-registered (upgraded model) — register it below in the Staff Panel.'); return;
        }
        _subEnrolledGeo = raw;
    } catch (e) { _subLockScanInFlight = false; _subCamAbandoned = true; _subLockFallback('Could not fetch face data: ' + e.message); return; }

    _subLockSetSub('Opening camera…');
    try {
        _subLockStream = await FU.withTimeout(_subCamPromise, 15000,
            'Camera took too long to open — check camera permissions and try again.');
    } catch (e) { _subLockScanInFlight = false; _subCamAbandoned = true; _subLockFallback('Camera error: ' + e.message); return; }
    _subLockScanInFlight = false;
    FU.stopMpCamera();
    FU.startMpCamera(vid);

    wrap.style.display = 'block';
    wrap.classList.remove('match-active');
    wrap.classList.add('scanning-active');
    if (canvas) {
        canvas.style.display   = 'block';
        canvas.style.position  = 'absolute';
        canvas.style.top       = '0';
        canvas.style.left      = '0';
        canvas.style.width     = '100%';
        canvas.style.height    = '100%';
        canvas.style.transform = 'scaleX(-1)';
    }

    if (btn) { btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = 'Use Password Instead'; btn.onclick = () => _subLockFallback(''); }
    _subLockSetSub('Align your face…');
    FU.audioScanStart();

    const CONFIRM_FRAMES_NEEDED = 22;
    const FRAME_THROTTLE_MS     = 50;
    const WARMUP_FRAMES         = 6;
    let _confirmStreak = 0;
    let _subMismatchFrames = 0;
    const SUB_MISMATCH_NEEDED = 80;
    let _lastFrameTime = 0;
    const EAR_CLOSED = 0.16, EAR_OPEN = 0.22;
    let _earWasClosed = false;
    let _blinkDetected = false;

    async function _frameLoop(timestamp) {
        if (!_subLockActive) return;

        if (timestamp - _lastFrameTime < FRAME_THROTTLE_MS) {
            _subLockRAF = requestAnimationFrame(_frameLoop);
            return;
        }
        _lastFrameTime = timestamp;
        _subLockFrameCt++;

        if (canvas && vid.videoWidth > 0) {
            if (canvas.width  !== vid.videoWidth)  canvas.width  = vid.videoWidth;
            if (canvas.height !== vid.videoHeight) canvas.height = vid.videoHeight;
        }

        if (_subLockFrameCt < WARMUP_FRAMES) { _subLockRAF = requestAnimationFrame(_frameLoop); return; }

        let det = null;
        try { det = await FU.detectFace(vid, canvas || null); } catch (_) {}

        FU.faceTrackZoom && FU.faceTrackZoom('staff', vid, canvas, det && det.box);

        if (det && det.box) {
            if (wrap) wrap.classList.add('face-present');
            const liveDsc   = FU.geoDescriptor(det);
            const smoothDsc = _subSmoothedDescriptor(liveDsc);
            const { match, score, offFrontal, tooFar, tooClose } = FU.landmarkMatch(smoothDsc, _subEnrolledGeo);
            const pct = score;
            const unscorable = offFrontal || tooFar || tooClose;

            if (liveDsc._ear != null) {
                if (liveDsc._ear < EAR_CLOSED) _earWasClosed = true;
                else if (liveDsc._ear > EAR_OPEN && _earWasClosed) { _blinkDetected = true; _earWasClosed = false; }
            }

            if (match) {
                _confirmStreak++;
                _subMismatchFrames = Math.max(0, _subMismatchFrames - 2);
                const confirmPct = Math.round((_confirmStreak / CONFIRM_FRAMES_NEEDED) * 100);
                if (canvas) FU.drawOverlay(canvas, det, _confirmStreak > CONFIRM_FRAMES_NEEDED * 0.5, confirmPct);
                wrap.classList.remove('scanning-active'); wrap.classList.add('match-active');

                if (_confirmStreak >= CONFIRM_FRAMES_NEEDED && !_blinkDetected) {
                    _subLockSetSub('Blink naturally to verify…');
                    _subLockSetStatus('Liveness check…');
                    if (canvas) FU.drawOverlay(canvas, det, true, 100);
                    _subLockRAF = requestAnimationFrame(_frameLoop);
                    return;
                }

                if (_confirmStreak >= CONFIRM_FRAMES_NEEDED) {
                    _subLockActive = false;
                    if (_subLockRAF) { cancelAnimationFrame(_subLockRAF); _subLockRAF = null; }
                    if (canvas) FU.drawOverlay(canvas, det, true);

                    wrap.classList.add('verified');
                    _subLockSetStatus('Verified ✓');
                    _subLockSetErr('');

                    const iconEl = _subEl('subadmin-lock-icon');
                    if (iconEl) {
                        iconEl.classList.add('unlocking');
                    }

                    _subLockSetSub('Identity confirmed');
                    setTimeout(() => _subLockSetSub('Access granted ✓'), 320);
                    FU.audioUnlock();

                    setTimeout(() => {
                        _subLockStop();
                        if (iconEl) {
                            iconEl.classList.remove('unlocking');
                            iconEl.style.color = '';
                        }
                        window._subAdminMarkUnlocked && window._subAdminMarkUnlocked();
                    }, 1800);
                    return;
                }

                _subLockSetSub(`Verifying… ${confirmPct}%`);
                _subLockSetStatus(`${pct.toFixed(0)}% match · hold still`);
            } else {
                _confirmStreak = Math.max(0, _confirmStreak - 4);
                if (_confirmStreak === 0) {
                    _blinkDetected = false; _earWasClosed = false;
                    wrap.classList.remove('match-active');
                    wrap.classList.add('scanning-active');
                }
                if (!unscorable) _subMismatchFrames++;
                if (_subMismatchFrames >= SUB_MISMATCH_NEEDED) {
                    _subLockActive = false;
                    if (_subLockRAF) { cancelAnimationFrame(_subLockRAF); _subLockRAF = null; }
                    FU.audioError();
                    const rIcon = _subEl('subadmin-lock-icon');
                    wrap.classList.remove('scanning-active', 'match-active', 'face-present');
                    wrap.classList.add('reject-active');
                    if (rIcon) { rIcon.classList.add('reject-shake'); setTimeout(() => rIcon.classList.remove('reject-shake'), 500); }
                    _subLockSetSub('Not you.');
                    _subLockSetStatus('Identity not recognised');
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        wrap.classList.remove('reject-active');
                        _subLockFallback("Face ID doesn't match your enrolled face. Use your password.");
                    }, 1800);
                    return;
                }

                _subLockSetStatus(unscorable ? '' : pct.toFixed(0) + '% match');
                if (canvas) FU.drawOverlay(canvas, det, false);
                _subLockSetSub(FU.geoHint(smoothDsc, _subEnrolledGeo));
                _subLockSetErr('');
            }
        } else {
            _confirmStreak = 0;
            _blinkDetected = false; _earWasClosed = false;
            _subDescRing.length = 0;
            _subMismatchFrames = 0;
            wrap.classList.remove('face-present');
            wrap.classList.remove('match-active');
            if (!wrap.classList.contains('scanning-active')) wrap.classList.add('scanning-active');
            _subLockSetSub('No face detected — look at the camera');
            _subLockSetStatus('');
            if (canvas) { try { canvas.getContext('2d').clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height); } catch (_) {} }
        }

        _subLockRAF = requestAnimationFrame(_frameLoop);
    }

    wrap.classList.add('scanning-active');
    _subLockRAF = requestAnimationFrame(_frameLoop);
}
window._subLockStartFaceScan = _subLockStartFaceScan;

window._subAdminLockBtnClick = async function () {
    const inp = _subEl('subadmin-lock-input');
    if (inp && inp.style.display !== 'none') { window._subAdminUnlock(); return; }
    await _subLockStartFaceScan();
};

window._showSubAdminLock = function () {
    _subLockStop();
    _subEnrolledGeo = null;
    const inp = _subEl('subadmin-lock-input');
    const err = _subEl('subadmin-lock-err');
    if (inp) { inp.style.display = 'none'; inp.value = ''; }
    if (err) err.textContent = '';
    const btn = _subEl('subadmin-lock-btn');

    _subLockSetSub('Opening camera…');
    const overlay = _subEl('subadmin-lock-overlay');
    if (overlay) overlay.classList.add('active');
    if (err) err.textContent = '';
    if (inp) setTimeout(() => inp.focus(), 120);
    setTimeout(_subLockStartFaceScan, 100);
};

    _subLockStop();
    const overlay = _subEl('subadmin-lock-overlay');
    if (overlay) overlay.classList.remove('active');
};

    function _withTimeout(promise, ms, tag) {
        let t;
        return Promise.race([
            promise.finally(() => clearTimeout(t)),
            new Promise((_, rej) => { t = setTimeout(() => rej(new Error('timeout: ' + tag)), ms); })
        ]);

    function _enqueue(scanKey, el, imgSrc, ctx) {
        if (_cache.has(scanKey))                    { EMSS_D('_enqueue skip (cached): ' + scanKey); return; }
        if (_inFlight.has(scanKey))                 { EMSS_D('_enqueue skip (in-flight): ' + scanKey); return; }
        if (_queue.find(j => j.scanKey === scanKey)) { EMSS_D('_enqueue skip (queued): ' + scanKey); return; }
        if (_queue.length >= MAX_QUEUE)             { EMSS_W('_enqueue DROPPED (queue full ' + MAX_QUEUE + '): ' + scanKey); _failOpen(el); return; }
        _queue.push({ scanKey, el, imgSrc, ctx });
        EMSS_D('_enqueue added ' + scanKey + ' | queue size: ' + _queue.length);
        _drain();
    }

    let _drainTimer = null;
    function _drain() {
        if (_drainTimer || _inFlight.size >= MAX_ACTIVE || !_queue.length) return;
        _drainTimer = setTimeout(() => {
            _drainTimer = null;
            if (_inFlight.size < MAX_ACTIVE && _queue.length) _exec(_queue.shift());
            else if (_queue.length) _drain();
        }, JOB_GAP_MS);

    const PROMPT = `You are a content moderation AI. Analyze this image and respond with ONLY valid JSON (no markdown) in this exact format:
{"category":"safe|suggestive|inappropriate|explicit|flagged","confidence":0.0,"reason":"brief reason max 12 words"}

Categories:
- safe: normal content, no issues

- inappropriate: gore, violence, hate symbols, graphic injuries
- explicit: nudity, pornography, sexual content
- flagged: CSAM signals, weapons/drug trade, terrorism imagery

Be strict but fair. Return only the JSON object.`;
