    function _parseModJson(text, provider) {
        const clean = String(text || '').replace(/```json|```/g, '').trim();
        const m = clean.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/);
        if (!m) throw new Error('no JSON in ' + provider + ' response');
        let parsed;
        try { parsed = JSON.parse(m[0]); }
        catch (e) { throw new Error(provider + ' JSON.parse failed: ' + e.message); }
        if (!parsed || !CATS[parsed.category]) {
            EMSS_W(provider + ': unknown category "' + parsed?.category + '" — treating as safe');
            return { category: 'safe', confidence: 0, reason: '' };
        }
        return {
            category:   parsed.category,
            confidence: Number(parsed.confidence) || 0,
            reason:     String(parsed.reason || '').slice(0, 120)
        };
    }

     
    function _splitDataUrl(dataUrl) {
        const m = /^data:([^;,]+)?;base64,(.*)$/s.exec(dataUrl || '');
        if (!m) return null;
        return { mimeType: m[1] || 'image/jpeg', data: m[2] };
    }

    async function _scanGemini(imgSrc) {
        const key = window.GEMINI_API_KEY;
        if (!key) throw new Error('GEMINI_API_KEY not available');
        const parts = _splitDataUrl(imgSrc);
        if (!parts) throw new Error('gemini needs a base64 data URL');

        const body = {
            contents: [{
                role: 'user',
                parts: [
                    { text: PROMPT },
                    { inlineData: { mimeType: parts.mimeType, data: parts.data } }
                ]
            }],
            safetySettings: [
                { category: 'HARM_CATEGORY_HARASSMENT',        threshold: 'BLOCK_NONE' },
                { category: 'HARM_CATEGORY_HATE_SPEECH',       threshold: 'BLOCK_NONE' },
                { category: 'HARM_CATEGORY_SEXUALLY_EXPLICIT', threshold: 'BLOCK_NONE' },
                { category: 'HARM_CATEGORY_DANGEROUS_CONTENT', threshold: 'BLOCK_NONE' },
            ],
            generationConfig: { temperature: 0.1, maxOutputTokens: 2048, thinkingConfig: { thinkingBudget: 0 } }
        };

        const r0 = await _geminiModCall(body, key);
        _lastGeminiModel = r0.model;

        if (r0.blocked) {
            EMSS_D('gemini ' + r0.model + ' hard-blocked (' + r0.blockWhy + ') — treating as unsafe');
            return {
                category:   r0.blockWhy === 'PROHIBITED_CONTENT' ? 'flagged' : 'explicit',
                confidence: 0.9,
                reason:     'Blocked by Gemini safety filter',
                model:      r0.model
            };
        }

        EMSS_D('gemini responded via ' + r0.model);
        const r = _parseModJson(r0.text, 'gemini');
        r.model = r0.model;
        return r;
    }

     
    const EMSS_MODELS = [
        'gemini-2.5-flash-lite',
        'gemini-3.5-flash-lite',
        'gemini-2.5-flash',
        'gemini-3.1-flash-lite',
        'gemini-3-flash-preview',
        'gemini-3.5-flash',
    ];
    const _mBench = {};
    const _mWhy   = {};
    const _lastScanErrors = [];

    function _bench(model, ms, why) {
        _mBench[model] = Date.now() + ms;
        _mWhy[model] = why;
        EMSS_W('model ' + model + ' benched ' + Math.round(ms/1000) + 's (' + why + ')');
    }

    let _keyInvalid = false;

    function _keyLooksValid(k) { return /^AIza[0-9A-Za-z_-]{30,}$/.test(k || '') || /^AQ\.[A-Za-z0-9_.\-]{20,}$/.test(k || ''); }

    async function _geminiModCall(body, key) {
        let lastErr = null;
        _lastScanErrors.length = 0;
        if (_keyInvalid) throw new Error('GEMINI_API_KEY rejected by API — fix the key (see _EchoMod.encodeKey)');
        if (!_keyLooksValid(key)) {
            _keyInvalid = true;
            const msg = 'GEMINI_API_KEY is malformed — got ' + (key || '').length + ' chars starting "' + String(key).slice(0, 4) + '". Valid keys start "AIza" (legacy) or "AQ." (current Auth keys). Get one at aistudio.google.com/apikey then run _EchoMod.encodeKey("...") and paste the printed array into the source at PASTE_API_KEY_HERE.';
            EMSS_E(msg);
            throw new Error(msg);
        }
        for (const model of EMSS_MODELS) {
            if ((_mBench[model] || 0) > Date.now()) continue;

            for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 2; attempt++) {
                const payload = attempt === 0 ? body : (() => {
                    const b = { contents: body.contents, generationConfig: { temperature: 0.1, maxOutputTokens: 2048 } };
                    return b;
                })();
                let res;
                try {
                    res = await fetch(
                        `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/${model}:generateContent?key=${key}`,
                        { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(payload) }
                    );
                } catch (e) { lastErr = model + ': ' + e.message; _lastScanErrors.push(lastErr); break; }

                if (res.status === 400) {
                    let snippet = '';
                    try { snippet = (await res.text()).slice(0, 300); } catch {}
                    if (/API key not valid|API_KEY_INVALID|API key expired/i.test(snippet)) {
                        _keyInvalid = true;
                        const msg = 'Gemini rejected the API key: ' + snippet.slice(0, 120);
                        _lastScanErrors.push(msg);
                        EMSS_E(msg + ' — get a valid key at aistudio.google.com/apikey, then _EchoMod.encodeKey("AIza...")');
                        throw new Error(msg);
                    }
                    if (attempt === 0) {
                        EMSS_D(model + ' 400 with full config (' + snippet.slice(0, 120) + ') — retrying bare');
                        continue;
                    }
                    lastErr = model + ': HTTP 400 ' + snippet.slice(0, 160);
                    _lastScanErrors.push(lastErr);
                    break;
                }
                if (res.status === 429) {
                    let benchMs = 65 * 1000, why = '429 rate';
                    try {
                        const errTxt = JSON.stringify(await res.json());
                        if (/PerDay|per day|RequestsPerDay|daily/i.test(errTxt)) { benchMs = 3 * 60 * 60 * 1000; why = '429 daily quota'; }
                    } catch {}
                    _bench(model, benchMs, why);
                    lastErr = model + ': 429'; _lastScanErrors.push(lastErr);
                    break;
                }
                if (res.status === 404) { _bench(model, 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000, '404 no such model'); lastErr = model + ': 404'; _lastScanErrors.push(lastErr); break; }
                if (res.status === 503) { _bench(model, 30 * 1000, '503 overloaded');            lastErr = model + ': 503'; _lastScanErrors.push(lastErr); break; }
                if (!res.ok) {
                    let snippet = '';
                    try { snippet = (await res.text()).slice(0, 200); } catch {}
                    lastErr = model + ': HTTP ' + res.status + ' ' + snippet;
                    _lastScanErrors.push(lastErr);
                    break;
                }

                let d;
                try { d = await res.json(); } catch (e) { lastErr = model + ': bad JSON'; _lastScanErrors.push(lastErr); break; }

                const cand   = d?.candidates?.[0];
                const finish = cand?.finishReason || '';
                const blockReason = d?.promptFeedback?.blockReason || '';
                const text = cand?.content?.parts?.map(p => p.text || '').join('') ?? '';
                if (blockReason || ((finish === 'SAFETY' || finish === 'IMAGE_SAFETY' || finish === 'PROHIBITED_CONTENT') && !text.trim())) {
                    return { blocked: true, blockWhy: blockReason || finish, model };
                }
                if (finish === 'MAX_TOKENS' && !text.trim()) { lastErr = model + ': thinking ate the token budget'; _lastScanErrors.push(lastErr); break; }
                if (!text.trim()) { lastErr = model + ': empty response (finish=' + (finish || '?') + ')'; _lastScanErrors.push(lastErr); break; }
                return { text, model };
            }
        }
        throw new Error('all ' + EMSS_MODELS.length + ' gemini models unavailable (last: ' + lastErr + ')');
    }

     
    function _scanLocalHeuristic(imgSrc) {
        return new Promise(resolve => {
            const img = new Image();
            img.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';
            const bail = setTimeout(() => resolve(null), 4000);
            img.onerror = () => { clearTimeout(bail); resolve(null); };
            img.onload = () => {
                clearTimeout(bail);
                try {
                    const S = 96;
                    const c = document.createElement('canvas');
                    c.width = S; c.height = S;
                    const cx = c.getContext('2d', { willReadFrequently: true });
                    cx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, S, S);
                    const d = cx.getImageData(0, 0, S, S).data;

                    let skin = 0, total = 0, skinLower = 0, lowerTotal = 0;
                    for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i += 4) {
                        const r = d[i], g = d[i+1], b = d[i+2], a = d[i+3];
                        if (a < 120) continue;
                        total++;
                        const px = (i / 4) % S, py = Math.floor((i / 4) / S);
                        const isLower = py > S * 0.35;
                        if (isLower) lowerTotal++;
                        const mx = Math.max(r, g, b), mn = Math.min(r, g, b);
                        const rgbSkin = r > 95 && g > 40 && b > 20 && (mx - mn) > 15 &&
                                        Math.abs(r - g) > 15 && r > g && r > b;
                        const cb = 128 - 0.168736*r - 0.331264*g + 0.5*b;
                        const cr = 128 + 0.5*r - 0.418688*g - 0.081312*b;
                        const ycc = cb >= 77 && cb <= 127 && cr >= 133 && cr <= 173;
                        if (rgbSkin && ycc) { skin++; if (isLower) skinLower++; }
                    }
                    if (total < 100) return resolve(null);
                    const ratio      = skin / total;
                    const lowerRatio = lowerTotal > 50 ? skinLower / lowerTotal : 0;
                    EMSS_D('heuristic: skin=' + (ratio*100).toFixed(0) + '% lower=' + (lowerRatio*100).toFixed(0) + '%');

                    if (ratio > 0.42 && lowerRatio > 0.38) {
                        return resolve({
                            category: 'suggestive', confidence: 0.35,
                            reason: 'unverified — high skin detection'
                        });
                    }
                    resolve(null);
                } catch (e) {
                    EMSS_D('heuristic failed: ' + (e?.message || e));
                    resolve(null);
                }
            };
            img.src = imgSrc;
        });
    }

     
    const PROVIDERS = [
        { name: 'gemini', fn: _scanGemini },
    ];

    function _provAvailable(name) {
        const until = _provCooldown[name] || 0;
        if (until > Date.now()) {
            EMSS_D('skipping ' + name + ' (cooling down ' + Math.ceil((until - Date.now())/1000) + 's)');
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }
    function _provOk(name)   { _provFails[name] = 0; _provCooldown[name] = 0; }
    function _provFailed(name) {
        _provFails[name] = (_provFails[name] || 0) + 1;
        if (_provFails[name] >= PROVIDER_FAIL_LIMIT) {
            _provCooldown[name] = Date.now() + PROVIDER_COOLDOWN_MS;
            _provFails[name] = 0;
            EMSS_W(name + ' failed ' + PROVIDER_FAIL_LIMIT + 'x — benched for 5 min');
        }
    }

    async function _aiScan(imgSrc) {
        const errors = [];
        for (const p of PROVIDERS) {
            if (!_provAvailable(p.name)) { errors.push(p.name + ': cooling down'); continue; }
            try {
                const r = await _withTimeout(p.fn(imgSrc), PROVIDER_TIMEOUT_MS, p.name);
                if (r && r.category) {
                    _provOk(p.name);
                    r._provider = p.name;
                    EMSS_D('✓ ' + p.name + ' → ' + r.category);
                    return r;
                }
                throw new Error('empty result');
            } catch (e) {
                errors.push(p.name + ': ' + (e?.message || e));
                EMSS_W('provider ' + p.name + ' failed — ' + (e?.message || e));
                _provFailed(p.name);
            }
        }

        EMSS_W('all AI providers failed — running local heuristic');
        let local = null;
        try { local = await _withTimeout(_scanLocalHeuristic(imgSrc), 6000, 'heuristic'); }
        catch (e) { EMSS_D('heuristic errored: ' + (e?.message || e)); }

        if (local) { local._provider = 'heuristic'; return local; }
        return {
            category: 'unverified', confidence: 0,
            reason: 'Couldn\'t reach any scanner',
            _provider: 'none', _errors: errors.join(' | ')
        };
    }

     
    function _docRef(ctx) {
        try {
            if (!ctx || !ctx.msgId) return null;
            if (ctx.scope === 'global') return doc(db, 'global_chat', ctx.msgId);
            const cid = ctx.chatId || window.currentChatId;
            if (!cid) return null;
            return doc(db, `chats/${cid}/messages/${ctx.msgId}`);
        } catch { return null; }
    }

    async function _loadFromFirestore(ctx, gridIdx) {
        const ref = _docRef(ctx);
        if (!ref) return null;
        try {
            let snap = await (window._getDocCached || getDoc)(ref);
            if (!snap.exists()) return null;
            let data = snap.data();
            const _has = d => gridIdx !== undefined ? d.moderation_grid?.[String(gridIdx)] : d.moderation;
            if (!_has(data) && snap.metadata?.fromCache) { snap = await getDoc(ref); data = snap.exists() ? snap.data() : {}; }
            if (gridIdx !== undefined) return data.moderation_grid?.[String(gridIdx)] || null;
            return data.moderation || null;
        } catch { return null; }
    }

    async function _saveToFirestore(ctx, gridIdx, result) {
        const ref = _docRef(ctx);
        if (!ref) { EMSS_D('save skipped — no ref for ctx ' + JSON.stringify(ctx)); return; }
        const payload = { ...result, scannedAt: Date.now(), auto: true };
        try {
            if (gridIdx !== undefined) await updateDoc(ref, { [`moderation_grid.${gridIdx}`]: payload });
            else                       await updateDoc(ref, { moderation: payload });
        } catch (e) { EMSS_W('Firestore save failed: ' + (e?.message || e)); }
    }

     
    let _sfxLast = 0;
    function _sfx(name) {
        const t = Date.now();
        if (!window.EchoSFX || performance.now() < 15000 || t - _sfxLast < 5000) return;
        _sfxLast = t;
        window.EchoSFX.play(name);
    }

    async function _exec(job) {
        const { scanKey, el, imgSrc, ctx } = job;
        _inFlight.add(scanKey);
        _sfx('scan');
        EMSS_D('▶ Scanning ' + scanKey + ' (queue remaining: ' + _queue.length + ')...');
        try {
            const gridIdx = ctx?.gridIdx;

            let result   = await _loadFromFirestore(ctx, gridIdx);
            if (result && result.category === 'unverified') { EMSS_D('ignoring stale unverified verdict in Firestore for ' + scanKey); result = null; }
            let fromDb   = !!result;
            if (!result) result = await _withTimeout(_aiScan(imgSrc), JOB_TIMEOUT_MS, 'aiScan ' + scanKey);

            const cat = CATS[result.category] || CATS.safe;
            _cache.set(scanKey, { ...result, cat });

            if (!fromDb && result.category !== 'unverified') await _saveToFirestore(ctx, gridIdx, result);

            _applyResult(el, scanKey, result, cat);
            EMSS_D('✓ ' + scanKey + ' → ' + result.category + (result.reason ? ' (' + result.reason + ')' : ''));
        } catch (e) {
            EMSS_E('scan FAILED for ' + scanKey + ': ' + (e?.message || String(e)) + ' — staying blurred');
            const unver = { category: 'unverified', confidence: 0, reason: 'Scan failed — tap retry', cat: CATS.unverified, _err: true };
            _cache.set(scanKey, unver);
            _applyResult(el, scanKey, unver, CATS.unverified);
        } finally {
            _inFlight.delete(scanKey);
            setTimeout(_drain, 300);
        }
    }

     
    function _applyResult(el, scanKey, result, cat) {
        const wrap = el?.closest?.('.emss-wrap');
        if (!wrap) return;

        wrap.querySelector('.emss-scanning')?.remove();
        wrap.dataset.emssDone = '1';

        if (!cat || cat.sev === 0) {
            wrap.classList.remove('emss-blur');
            wrap.classList.add('emss-revealed');
            wrap.querySelector('.emss-overlay')?.remove();
            _unwatchFit(wrap);
            return;
        }

        const _alreadyFlagged = wrap.classList.contains('emss-blur') && !!wrap.querySelector('.emss-overlay');
        if (_alreadyFlagged) return;
        if (cat !== CATS.unverified) _sfx('deny');
        const tok = 'e' + (++_tokSeq);
        _tokens.set(tok, scanKey);

        wrap.classList.add('emss-blur');
        wrap.classList.remove('emss-revealed');
        wrap.querySelector('.emss-overlay')?.remove();
            _unwatchFit(wrap);
        const overlay = document.createElement('div');
        overlay.className = 'emss-overlay';
        overlay.innerHTML = `
            <div class="emss-badge" style="--ec:${cat.color};--eb:${cat.border}">
                <span class="emss-badge-icon">${cat.icon}</span>
                <span class="emss-badge-label">${_esc(cat.label)}</span>
                ${result.reason ? `<span class="emss-badge-reason">${_esc(result.reason)}</span>` : ''}
            </div>
            <div style="display:flex;gap:6px;">
                ${cat.retry ? `<button class="emss-reveal emss-retry" type="button">↻ Retry</button>` : ''}
                <button class="emss-reveal" type="button">View anyway</button>
            </div>
        `;
        overlay.querySelector('.emss-reveal:not(.emss-retry)').addEventListener('click', ev => {
            ev.preventDefault(); ev.stopPropagation();
            window._emss_reveal(tok);
        });
        overlay.querySelector('.emss-retry')?.addEventListener('click', ev => {
            ev.preventDefault(); ev.stopPropagation();
            window._emss_retry(scanKey);
        });
        overlay.addEventListener('click', ev => ev.stopPropagation());
        wrap.appendChild(overlay);
        _fitOverlay(wrap);
        _watchFit(wrap);
    }

     
    function _fitOverlay(wrap) {
        if (!wrap) return;
        const w = wrap.clientWidth, h = wrap.clientHeight;
        if (!w || !h) return;
        wrap.classList.toggle('emss-sm',    w < 200 || h < 160);
        wrap.classList.toggle('emss-xs',    w < 150 || h < 118);
        wrap.classList.toggle('emss-micro', w < 104 || h < 80);
    }

     
    const _fitObserver = typeof ResizeObserver !== 'undefined'
        ? new ResizeObserver(entries => { for (const e of entries) _fitOverlay(e.target); })
        : null;
    function _watchFit(wrap) {
        if (!_fitObserver || !wrap || wrap._emssFitWatched) return;
        wrap._emssFitWatched = true;
        try { _fitObserver.observe(wrap); } catch (_) {}
    }
    function _unwatchFit(wrap) {
        if (!_fitObserver || !wrap || !wrap._emssFitWatched) return;
        wrap._emssFitWatched = false;
        try { _fitObserver.unobserve(wrap); } catch (_) {}
        wrap.classList.remove('emss-sm', 'emss-xs', 'emss-micro');
    }

    function _markUnverified(el, scanKey, reason) {
        const r = { category: 'unverified', confidence: 0, reason: reason || 'Not scanned', cat: CATS.unverified, _err: true };
        _cache.set(scanKey, r);
        _applyResult(el, scanKey, r, CATS.unverified);
    }

    window._emss_retry = function (scanKey) {
        _cache.delete(scanKey);
        _provFails.gemini = 0; _provCooldown.gemini = 0; _keyInvalid = false;
        Object.keys(_mBench).forEach(m => { if (_mWhy[m] !== '429 daily quota') delete _mBench[m]; });
        document.querySelectorAll('.emss-wrap').forEach(wrap => {
            if (wrap.dataset.emssKey !== scanKey) return;
            const el = wrap.querySelector('img, video');
            if (!el) return;
            wrap.querySelector('.emss-overlay')?.remove();
            _unwatchFit(wrap);
            delete wrap.dataset.emssDone;
            wrap.classList.add('emss-blur');
            _showScanning(wrap);
            const parent = wrap.parentNode;
            if (parent) { parent.insertBefore(el, wrap); wrap.remove(); }
            EMSS_D('manual retry → ' + scanKey);
            _handleEl(el);
        });
    };

    function _failOpen(el) {
        const wrap = el?.closest?.('.emss-wrap');
        if (!wrap) return;
        wrap.querySelector('.emss-scanning')?.remove();
        wrap.querySelector('.emss-overlay')?.remove();
            _unwatchFit(wrap);
        wrap.classList.remove('emss-blur');
        wrap.classList.add('emss-revealed');
        wrap.dataset.emssDone = '1';
        wrap.dataset.revealed = '1';
    }
    function _removeScanning(el) { el?.closest?.('.emss-wrap')?.querySelector('.emss-scanning')?.remove(); }

     
    function _showScanning(wrap) {
        return;
        const pill = document.createElement('div');
        pill.className = 'emss-scanning';
        pill.innerHTML = `<div class="emss-dot"></div><div class="emss-dot"></div><div class="emss-dot"></div><span>scanning</span>`;
        wrap.appendChild(pill);
    }

     

    function _downscale(dataUrl) {
        return new Promise(resolve => {
            const img = new Image();
            img.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';
            const bail = setTimeout(() => resolve(dataUrl), SRC_TIMEOUT_MS);
            img.onload = () => {
                clearTimeout(bail);
                try {
                    let w = img.naturalWidth || img.width, h = img.naturalHeight || img.height;
                    if (!w || !h) return resolve(dataUrl);
                    if (w > SCAN_DIM || h > SCAN_DIM) {
                        const r = Math.min(SCAN_DIM / w, SCAN_DIM / h);
                        w = Math.max(1, Math.round(w * r));
                        h = Math.max(1, Math.round(h * r));
                    }
                    const c = document.createElement('canvas');
                    c.width = w; c.height = h;
                    const cx = c.getContext('2d');
                    cx.fillStyle = '#000'; cx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
                    cx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, w, h);
                    resolve(c.toDataURL('image/jpeg', SCAN_Q));
                } catch (e) {
                    EMSS_D('_downscale fell back to original: ' + (e?.message || e));
                    resolve(dataUrl);
                }
            };
            img.onerror = () => { clearTimeout(bail); resolve(dataUrl); };
            img.src = dataUrl;
        });
    }

    async function _toDataURL(src) {
        if (!src) return null;
        if (src.startsWith('data:')) return src;
        const res  = await _withTimeout(fetch(src, { mode: 'cors' }), SRC_TIMEOUT_MS, 'fetch src');
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error('src fetch HTTP ' + res.status);
        const blob = await res.blob();
        if (blob.type && !/^(image|video)\//.test(blob.type)) throw new Error('src fetch returned ' + blob.type);
        return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
            const fr = new FileReader();
            fr.onload  = e => resolve(e.target.result);
            fr.onerror = () => reject(new Error('FileReader failed'));
            fr.readAsDataURL(blob);
        });
    }

    function _fromElement(el) {
        try {
            const w = el.naturalWidth || el.videoWidth || el.width;
            const h = el.naturalHeight || el.videoHeight || el.height;
            if (!w || !h) return null;
            const r = Math.min(1, SCAN_DIM / Math.max(w, h));
            const c = document.createElement('canvas');
            c.width = Math.max(1, Math.round(w * r));
            c.height = Math.max(1, Math.round(h * r));
            c.getContext('2d').drawImage(el, 0, 0, c.width, c.height);
            return c.toDataURL('image/jpeg', SCAN_Q);
        } catch { return null; }
    }

    function _elSrc(el) {
        let src = el.currentSrc || el.src || el.getAttribute('src') || '';
        if (!src && el.tagName === 'VIDEO') {
            const s = el.querySelector('source');
            src = s?.src || s?.getAttribute('src') || '';
        }
        return src;
    }

    function _videoFrame(src) {
        return new Promise(resolve => {
            let settled = false;
            const done = v => { if (settled) return; settled = true; clearTimeout(hard); try { vid.remove(); } catch {} resolve(v); };

            const vid = document.createElement('video');
            vid.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';
            vid.muted = true;
            vid.defaultMuted = true;
            vid.playsInline = true;
            vid.preload = 'auto';
            vid.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;left:-9999px;top:-9999px;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;width:2px;height:2px;';

            const hard = setTimeout(() => { EMSS_W('_videoFrame: hard timeout'); done(null); }, SRC_TIMEOUT_MS);

            const capture = () => {
                try {
                    const vw = vid.videoWidth, vh = vid.videoHeight;
                    if (!vw || !vh) return done(null);
                    const r = Math.min(1, SCAN_DIM / Math.max(vw, vh));
                    const c = document.createElement('canvas');
                    c.width = Math.max(1, Math.round(vw * r));
                    c.height = Math.max(1, Math.round(vh * r));
                    const cx = c.getContext('2d');
                    cx.fillStyle = '#000'; cx.fillRect(0, 0, c.width, c.height);
                    cx.drawImage(vid, 0, 0, c.width, c.height);
                    const data = c.toDataURL('image/jpeg', SCAN_Q);
                    done(data && data.length > MIN_SRC_LEN ? data : null);
                } catch (e) {
                    EMSS_W('_videoFrame: canvas capture failed — ' + (e?.message || e));
                    done(null);
                }
            };

            vid.addEventListener('seeked', capture, { once: true });
            vid.addEventListener('error',  () => done(null), { once: true });
            vid.addEventListener('loadeddata', () => {
                const d = vid.duration;
                let t = 0.1;
                if (isFinite(d) && d > 0) t = Math.min(1.5, Math.max(0.05, d * 0.25));
                try {
                    if (Math.abs(vid.currentTime - t) < 0.02) capture();
                    else vid.currentTime = t;
                } catch { capture(); }
                setTimeout(() => { if (!settled) capture(); }, 1800);
            }, { once: true });

            document.body.appendChild(vid);
            vid.src = src;
            try { vid.load(); } catch {}
        });
    }

    async function _getSrc(el) {
        const src = _elSrc(el);
        if (!src) return null;

        if (el.tagName === 'VIDEO') {
            const frame = await _videoFrame(src);
            return frame;
        }

        try {
            const dataUrl = await _toDataURL(src);
            if (!dataUrl) return _fromElement(el);
            return await _downscale(dataUrl);
        } catch (e) {
            EMSS_D('_getSrc: fetch path failed (' + (e?.message || e) + ') — trying element draw');
            return _fromElement(el);
        }
    }

     
    window._emss_reveal = function (tokenOrKey) {
        const scanKey = _tokens.get(tokenOrKey) || tokenOrKey;
        let hit = 0;
        document.querySelectorAll('.emss-wrap').forEach(wrap => {
            if (wrap.dataset.emssKey !== scanKey) return;
            hit++;
            wrap.classList.remove('emss-blur');
            wrap.classList.add('emss-revealed');
            wrap.dataset.revealed = '1';
            wrap.querySelector('.emss-overlay')?.remove();
            _unwatchFit(wrap);
        });
        if (!hit) EMSS_W('_emss_reveal: no wrap matched key ' + scanKey);
    };

     
    function _wrapEl(el, scanKey) {
        const existing = el.closest('.emss-wrap');
        if (existing) return existing;
        if (!el.parentNode) return null;
        const wrap = document.createElement('div');
        wrap.className = 'emss-wrap emss-blur';
        wrap.dataset.emssKey = scanKey;
        el.parentNode.insertBefore(wrap, el);
        wrap.appendChild(el);
        _showScanning(wrap);
        return wrap;
    }

     
    function _getCtx(el) {
        const card = el.closest('._media-card');
        if (card && card.dataset.msgid) {
            return { msgId: card.dataset.msgid, chatId: card.dataset.chatid || window.currentChatId, scope: 'dm' };
        }
        const gc = el.closest('[id^="gcmsg-"]');
        if (gc) return { msgId: gc.id.slice(6), chatId: null, scope: 'global' };

        const dm = el.closest('[id^="msg-"]');
        if (dm) return { msgId: dm.id.slice(4), chatId: window.currentChatId, scope: 'dm' };

        const grid = el.closest('.echo-img-grid[data-gridmsg]');
        if (grid) return { msgId: grid.dataset.gridmsg, chatId: window.currentChatId, scope: 'dm' };

        const any = el.closest('[data-msgid]');
        if (any) return { msgId: any.dataset.msgid, chatId: any.dataset.chatid || window.currentChatId, scope: 'dm' };

        return null;
    }

    function _getScanKey(el, ctx) {
        if (!ctx || !ctx.msgId) return null;
        const cell = el.closest('.echo-grid-cell');
        if (cell && cell.dataset.gi != null) {
            ctx.gridIdx = parseInt(cell.dataset.gi, 10);
            return `${ctx.msgId}__g${ctx.gridIdx}`;
        }
        ctx.gridIdx = undefined;
        return ctx.msgId;
    }

     
    function _shouldScan(el) {
        if (!el || !el.isConnected) return false;
        if (el.dataset.emssIgnore) return false;
        if (el.closest('.emss-wrap')) return false;
        if (el.closest('#emss-grid-preview, #emss-retro-bg, #emss-debug-panel')) return false;

        const src = _elSrc(el);
        const srcShort = src.slice(0, 60) + (src.length > 60 ? '...' : '');

        if (!src) return false;
        if (src.startsWith('data:image/svg')) return false;
        if (src.startsWith('data:image/gif')) return false;

        if (el.classList && el.classList.contains('gif-msg-img')) return false;
        if (el.closest('[id^="gif-wrap-"], #gif-picker-modal')) return false;
        if (/(^|\/\/|\.)(giphy\.com|media[0-9]*\.giphy\.com)\//i.test(src)) return false;
        if (/wsrv\.nl|images\.weserv\.nl|imagecdn\.app|corsproxy\.io|allorigins\.win/i.test(src)) return false;
        if (src.includes('firebasestorage') && /pfp|avatar|thumb|profile/i.test(src)) return false;

        if (el.closest('.rounded-full') || el.classList.contains('rounded-full')) return false;

        const sz = ['w-5','w-6','w-7','w-8','w-9','w-10','h-5','h-6','h-7','h-8','h-9','h-10'];
        if (sz.some(c => el.classList.contains(c))) return false;

        const ow = el.offsetWidth || 0, oh = el.offsetHeight || 0;
        if (ow > 0 && ow < 48) { EMSS_D('SKIP (too small ' + ow + 'x' + oh + '): ' + srcShort); return false; }
        if (oh > 0 && oh < 48) { EMSS_D('SKIP (too small ' + ow + 'x' + oh + '): ' + srcShort); return false; }

        const msgAncestor = el.closest('[id^="msg-"], [id^="gcmsg-"], [data-msgid], .echo-img-grid');
        if (!msgAncestor) { EMSS_D('SKIP (no msg ancestor): ' + srcShort); return false; }

        return true;
    }

     
    function _handleEl(el) {
        if (!_shouldScan(el)) return;

        const ctx = _getCtx(el);
        const scanKey = _getScanKey(el, ctx);
        if (!scanKey) {
            EMSS_D('no scanKey (unowned media) — leaving unblurred: ' + _elSrc(el).slice(0, 50));
            return;
        }

        if (_cache.has(scanKey)) {
            const cached = _cache.get(scanKey);
            EMSS_D('Cache hit ' + scanKey + ' → ' + cached.category);
            const w = _wrapEl(el, scanKey);
            if (!w) return;
            _applyResult(el, scanKey, cached, cached.cat || CATS[cached.category] || CATS.safe);
            return;
        }

        const wrap = _wrapEl(el, scanKey);
        if (!wrap) return;

        setTimeout(() => {
            _withTimeout(_getSrc(el), SRC_TIMEOUT_MS + 3000, 'getSrc ' + scanKey)
                .then(src => {
                    if (src && src.length > MIN_SRC_LEN) {
                        EMSS_D('Enqueuing ' + scanKey + ' srcLen=' + src.length);
                        _enqueue(scanKey, el, src, ctx);
                    } else {
                        EMSS_W('no usable source for ' + scanKey + ' (len=' + (src?.length || 0) + ') — staying blurred');
                        _markUnverified(el, scanKey, 'Couldn\'t read image data');
                    }
                })
                .catch(e => {
                    EMSS_E('_getSrc failed for ' + scanKey + ': ' + (e?.message || String(e)) + ' — staying blurred');
                    _markUnverified(el, scanKey, 'Couldn\'t load image');
                });
        }, 120);
    }

    function _scanIn(root) {
        if (!root) return 0;
        const list = root.querySelectorAll ? root.querySelectorAll('img,video') : [];
        list.forEach(_handleEl);
        return list.length;
    }

    const SWEEP_ROOTS = ['#chat-box', '#global-chat-box', '#gc-box', '#messages', '.echo-img-grid'];
    function _sweep() {
        let n = 0;
        SWEEP_ROOTS.forEach(sel => document.querySelectorAll(sel).forEach(r => { n += _scanIn(r); }));
        return n;
    }

    function _startObserver() {
        EMSS_D('Observer starting...');

        const obs = new MutationObserver(muts => {
            for (const mut of muts) {
                if (mut.type === 'attributes') {
                    if (mut.target?.matches?.('img,video')) _handleEl(mut.target);
                    continue;
                }
                for (const node of mut.addedNodes) {
                    if (node.nodeType !== 1) continue;
                    if (node.matches?.('img,video')) _handleEl(node);
                    else node.querySelectorAll?.('img,video').forEach(_handleEl);
                }
            }
        });
        obs.observe(document.body, {
            childList: true,
            subtree: true,
            attributes: true,
            attributeFilter: ['src']
        });
        EMSS_D('Observer attached to document.body (childList + src attrs)');

        _sweep();

        setInterval(() => { try { _sweep(); } catch (e) { EMSS_W('sweep error: ' + e.message); } }, 4000);

        window._emss_scanNow = function () {
            const n = _sweep();
            console.log('[EMSS] manual sweep — ' + n + ' img/video element(s) visited');
            return n;
        };

         
        function _blocked(el) {
            const wrap = el?.closest?.('.emss-wrap') || el?.querySelector?.('.emss-wrap');
            return !!(wrap && wrap.classList.contains('emss-blur') && !wrap.dataset.revealed);
        }

        const _origInline = window._openInlineImageLightbox;
        window._openInlineImageLightbox = function (imgEl) {
            if (_blocked(imgEl)) { EMSS_D('lightbox blocked (blurred)'); return; }
            if (typeof _origInline === 'function') return _origInline.apply(this, arguments);
        };

        const _origMedia = window._openMediaLightbox;
        window._openMediaLightbox = function (card) {
            const inner = card?.querySelector?.('img,video');
            if (_blocked(card) || _blocked(inner)) { EMSS_D('media lightbox blocked (blurred)'); return; }
            if (typeof _origMedia === 'function') return _origMedia.apply(this, arguments);
        };
    }

    if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => setTimeout(_startObserver, 400));
    else setTimeout(_startObserver, 400);

     
    window._emss_seed = function (msgId, msgData) {
        if (!msgId || !msgData) return;
        if (msgData.moderation && msgData.moderation.category !== 'unverified') {
            const cat = CATS[msgData.moderation.category] || CATS.safe;
            _cache.set(msgId, { ...msgData.moderation, cat });
        }
        if (msgData.moderation_grid) {
            Object.entries(msgData.moderation_grid).forEach(([idx, mod]) => {
                if (mod.category === 'unverified') return;
                const cat = CATS[mod.category] || CATS.safe;
                _cache.set(`${msgId}__g${idx}`, { ...mod, cat });
            });
        }
    };

     
    window._emss_renderGrid = function (images, msgId) {
        const MAX_SHOWN = 9;
        const count = images.length;
        const shown = Math.min(count, MAX_SHOWN);
        const overflow = count - MAX_SHOWN;
        const countAttr = count <= 4 ? String(count) : 'many';
        let cells = '';
        for (let i = 0; i < shown; i++) {
            const isLast = i === shown - 1 && overflow > 0;
            cells += `<div class="echo-grid-cell" data-gi="${i}">
                <img src="${images[i]}" loading="lazy" onclick="if(!this.closest('.emss-wrap')?.classList.contains('emss-blur')||this.closest('.emss-wrap')?.dataset.revealed)window._openInlineImageLightbox(this)">
                ${isLast ? `<div class="echo-grid-overflow">+${overflow + 1}</div>` : ''}
            </div>`;
        }
        return `<div class="echo-img-grid mt-1" data-count="${countAttr}" data-gridmsg="${_esc(msgId)}">${cells}</div>`;
    };

     
    window._emss_retroScan = async function (targetChatId) {
        const chatId = targetChatId || window.currentChatId;
        if (!chatId) { alert('No chat selected.'); return; }

        const bg = document.createElement('div');
        bg.id = 'emss-retro-bg';
        bg.innerHTML = `<div class="emss-retro-box">
            <h3><i class="fa-solid fa-shield-halved"></i> Scanning Media</h3>
            <p>Queuing all unscanned images in this chat…</p>
            <div class="emss-retro-track"><div class="emss-retro-fill" id="emss-retro-fill" style="width:0%"></div></div>
            <p class="emss-retro-status" id="emss-retro-status">Loading messages…</p>
        </div>`;
        document.body.appendChild(bg);

        const fillEl   = document.getElementById('emss-retro-fill');
        const statusEl = document.getElementById('emss-retro-status');

        try {
            const snap = await getDocs(collection(db, `chats/${chatId}/messages`));
            const jobs = [];
            snap.forEach(d => {
                const m = d.data();
                if (m.imageBase64 && !m.moderation) jobs.push({ msgId: d.id, src: m.imageBase64, gridIdx: undefined });
                if (m.imageGrid?.length) {
                    m.imageGrid.forEach((b64, i) => {
                        if (!m.moderation_grid?.[String(i)]) jobs.push({ msgId: d.id, src: b64, gridIdx: i });
                    });
                }
            });

            let done = 0;
            const total = jobs.length;
            statusEl.textContent = `0 / ${total} scanned…`;

            if (total === 0) {
                statusEl.textContent = 'No unscanned images found!';
                setTimeout(() => bg.remove(), 1800);
                return;
            }

            for (const j of jobs) {
                try {
                    const small  = await _downscale(j.src);
                    const result = await _withTimeout(_aiScan(small), JOB_TIMEOUT_MS, 'retro ' + j.msgId);
                    const ctx    = { msgId: j.msgId, chatId, scope: 'dm' };
                    if (result.category !== 'unverified') await _saveToFirestore(ctx, j.gridIdx, result);
                    const cat = CATS[result.category] || CATS.safe;
                    const key = j.gridIdx !== undefined ? `${j.msgId}__g${j.gridIdx}` : j.msgId;
                    _cache.set(key, { ...result, cat });
                } catch (e) {
                    EMSS_W('retro error on ' + j.msgId + ': ' + (e?.message || e));
                }
                done++;
                fillEl.style.width = Math.round((done / total) * 100) + '%';
                statusEl.textContent = `${done} / ${total} scanned…`;
                await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400));
            }
            statusEl.textContent = `✓ Done — ${total} images scanned.`;
            _sweep();
            setTimeout(() => bg.remove(), 2200);
        } catch (e) {
            statusEl.textContent = 'Error: ' + e.message;
            setTimeout(() => bg.remove(), 3000);
        }
    };

     
    (function _initGridUpload() {
        const MAX_DIM = 1024;
        const JPEG_Q  = 0.72;
        const MAX_KB  = 870;

        let _stagedFiles = [];
        let _previewStrip = null;

        async function _resizeToBase64(file) {
            return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
                const img = new Image();
                const url = URL.createObjectURL(file);
                img.onload = () => {
                    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
                    let w = img.width, h = img.height;
                    if (w > MAX_DIM || h > MAX_DIM) {
                        const ratio = Math.min(MAX_DIM/w, MAX_DIM/h);
                        w = Math.round(w*ratio); h = Math.round(h*ratio);
                    }
                    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
                    canvas.width = w; canvas.height = h;
                    canvas.getContext('2d').drawImage(img, 0, 0, w, h);
                    let q = JPEG_Q;
                    let data = canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', q);
                    while (data.length > MAX_KB * 1024 * 1.37 && q > 0.3) {
                        q -= 0.07;
                        data = canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', q);
                    }
                    resolve(data);
                };
                img.onerror = reject;
                img.src = url;
            });
        }

        function _rebuildPreview() {
            if (!_previewStrip) return;
            _previewStrip.innerHTML = '';
            _stagedFiles.forEach((f, i) => {
                const wrap = document.createElement('div');
                wrap.className = 'emss-grid-thumb';
                const isVid = f.type.startsWith('video/');
                if (isVid) {
                    const vid = document.createElement('video');
                    vid.src = URL.createObjectURL(f);
                    vid.style.cssText = 'width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;';
                    wrap.appendChild(vid);
                } else {
                    const img = document.createElement('img');
                    img.src = URL.createObjectURL(f);
                    wrap.appendChild(img);
                }
                const rm = document.createElement('button');
                rm.className = 'emss-rm-thumb';
                rm.textContent = '×';
                rm.onclick = () => { _stagedFiles.splice(i, 1); _rebuildPreview(); };
                wrap.appendChild(rm);
                _previewStrip.appendChild(wrap);
            });
            if (_stagedFiles.length > 0) {
                const go = document.createElement('button');
                go.type = 'button';
                go.textContent = `Send ${_stagedFiles.length} ${_stagedFiles.length === 1 ? 'image' : 'images'} ↑`;
                go.style.cssText = 'align-self:center;flex-shrink:0;margin-left:6px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#4f46e5,#6366f1);color:#fff;border:none;padding:8px 14px;border-radius:10px;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer;font-family:\'DM Sans\',sans-serif;white-space:nowrap;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(79,70,229,0.35);';
                go.onclick = () => _flushStaged();
                _previewStrip.appendChild(go);
            }
            if (_stagedFiles.length === 0 && _previewStrip.parentNode) {
                _previewStrip.remove();
                _previewStrip = null;
            }
        }

        function _ensurePreview() {
            if (_previewStrip && _previewStrip.isConnected) return;
            const form = document.getElementById('message-form');
            if (!form) return;
            _previewStrip = document.createElement('div');
            _previewStrip.id = 'emss-grid-preview';
            form.parentNode.insertBefore(_previewStrip, form);
        }

        function _hookFileInput() {
            const fi = document.getElementById('file-input');
            if (!fi) return;
            const nfi = fi.cloneNode(true);
            fi.parentNode.replaceChild(nfi, fi);

            nfi.addEventListener('change', async e => {
                const files = Array.from(e.target.files || []);
                if (!files.length) return;
                nfi.value = '';

                const images  = files.filter(f => f.type.startsWith('image/'));
                const videos  = files.filter(f => f.type.startsWith('video/'));

                if (videos.length) {
                    if (typeof window._sendChunkedFile === 'function') {
                        (async () => { for (const v of videos) { try { await window._sendChunkedFile(v); } catch (err) { console.error('[EMSS] video send failed:', err); } } })();
                    } else {
                        const dfi = document.getElementById('doc-file-input');
                        if (dfi) {
                            const ndt = new DataTransfer();
                            videos.forEach(v => ndt.items.add(v));
                            dfi.files = ndt.files;
                            dfi.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
                        }
                    }
                }

                if (!images.length) return;

                if (images.length === 1 && _stagedFiles.length === 0) {
                    try {
                        if (!window.currentChatId) { EMSS_W('image send skipped — no chat open'); return; }
                        const b64 = await _resizeToBase64(images[0]);
                        await addDoc(collection(db, `chats/${window.currentChatId}/messages`), {
                            text: 'Sent an image',
                            imageBase64: b64,
                            uid: window.myUID,
                            timestamp: serverTimestamp()
                        });
                    } catch(e) { console.error('[EMSS] single image send failed:', e); }
                    return;
                }

                _stagedFiles.push(...images);
                _ensurePreview();
                _rebuildPreview();
                _ensureFlushHooks();
            });
        }

         
        let _flushing = false;
        async function _flushStaged() {
            if (_flushing || !_stagedFiles.length) return;
            if (!window.currentChatId) { EMSS_W('grid send skipped — no chat open'); return; }
            _flushing = true;
            const batch = _stagedFiles.slice();
            _stagedFiles = [];
            _previewStrip?.remove();
            _previewStrip = null;
            try {
                const b64s = await Promise.all(batch.map(f => _resizeToBase64(f)));
                await addDoc(collection(db, `chats/${window.currentChatId}/messages`), {
                    text: `Sent ${b64s.length} images`,
                    imageGrid: b64s,
                    uid: window.myUID,
                    timestamp: serverTimestamp()
                });
            } catch(e) {
                console.error('[EMSS] grid send failed:', e);
                _stagedFiles.push(...batch);
                _ensurePreview();
                _rebuildPreview();
            } finally { _flushing = false; }
        }
        window._emss_flushStaged = _flushStaged;

        function _ensureFlushHooks() {
            const form = document.getElementById('message-form');
            if (!form || form.dataset.emssFlushHooked) return;
            form.dataset.emssFlushHooked = '1';
            form.addEventListener('click', (ev) => {
                if (!_stagedFiles.length) return;
                if (ev.target.closest && ev.target.closest('#send-btn')) _flushStaged();
            }, true);
            form.addEventListener('keydown', (ev) => {
                if (!_stagedFiles.length) return;
                if (ev.key === 'Enter' && !ev.shiftKey) _flushStaged();
            }, true);
        }

        function _hookWhenReady() {
            if (document.getElementById('file-input')?.dataset.emssHooked) return;
            const fi = document.getElementById('file-input');
            if (fi) { fi.dataset.emssHooked = '1'; _hookFileInput(); return; }
            setTimeout(_hookWhenReady, 1500);
        }
        if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
            document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', _hookWhenReady);
        } else {
            setTimeout(_hookWhenReady, 800);
        }
    })();

     
    window._EchoMod = {

        encodeKey: (plainKey) => {

        },

        testProviders: async () => {
            const c = document.createElement('canvas');

            const out = {};
            for (const p of PROVIDERS) {
                const t0 = performance.now();

})();

<script>
(function () {
    'use strict';
    const overlay = document.getElementById('dnd-drop-overlay');
    let depth = 0;

    function chatOpen() {
        const v = document.getElementById('view-chat');
        return !!(window.currentChatId && v && v.offsetParent !== null);
    }
    function hasFiles(e) {
        return !!(e.dataTransfer && Array.from(e.dataTransfer.types || []).includes('Files'));
    }
    function show() { overlay.style.display = 'flex'; }
    function hide() { depth = 0; overlay.style.display = 'none'; }

    window.addEventListener('dragenter', (e) => {
        if (!hasFiles(e) || !chatOpen()) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        depth++;
        show();
    });
    window.addEventListener('dragover', (e) => {
        if (!hasFiles(e)) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        if (e.dataTransfer) e.dataTransfer.dropEffect = chatOpen() ? 'copy' : 'none';
    });
    window.addEventListener('dragleave', (e) => {
        if (overlay.style.display === 'none') return;
        depth = Math.max(0, depth - 1);
        if (depth === 0) hide();
    });
    window.addEventListener('drop', async (e) => {
        if (!hasFiles(e)) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        const wasOpen = chatOpen();
        hide();
        if (!wasOpen) return;

        const files = Array.from(e.dataTransfer.files || []);
        if (!files.length) return;

        const media  = files.filter(f => f.type.startsWith('image/') || f.type.startsWith('video/'));
        const others = files.filter(f => !media.includes(f));

        if (media.length) {
            const fi = document.getElementById('file-input');
            if (fi) {
                try {
                    const dt = new DataTransfer();
                    media.forEach(f => dt.items.add(f));
                    fi.files = dt.files;
                    fi.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
                } catch (err) {
                    console.error('[dnd] media dispatch failed, falling back:', err);
                    if (typeof window._sendPickedMedia === 'function') media.forEach(f => window._sendPickedMedia(f));
                }
            }
        }

        if (others.length && typeof window._sendChunkedFile === 'function') {
            for (const f of others) {
                try { await window._sendChunkedFile(f); }
                catch (err) { console.error('[dnd] file send failed:', err); }
            }
        }
    });
})();
</script>

<script type="module">
import { getFirestore, collection, doc, addDoc, setDoc, getDoc, updateDoc, deleteDoc, serverTimestamp } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.11.0/firebase-firestore.js";
