const _spDb = getFirestore(getApps()[0]);

const SP_COLORS = ['#4f46e5', '#0d9488', '#b45309', '#be185d', '#6d28d9', '#0369a1'];
const _spInitials = (n) => (n || '?').trim().replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N} ]/gu, '').split(/\s+/).slice(0, 2).map(w => w[0] || '').join('').toUpperCase() || '?';
const _spColorFor = (id) => SP_COLORS[Math.abs([...String(id)].reduce((a, c) => a + c.charCodeAt(0), 0)) % SP_COLORS.length];

let _spActiveId = localStorage.getItem('sp_active') || null;
let _spCache = { spaces: [], channels: {} };
const _spSyncing = new Set();

window._spRender = (entries) => {
    const spaces = [], channels = {};
    entries.forEach(({ id, data }) => {
        if (data.isSpace) spaces.push({ id, data });
        else if (data.spaceId) (channels[data.spaceId] = channels[data.spaceId] || []).push({ id, data });
    });
    Object.values(channels).forEach(list => list.sort((a, b) =>
        (a.data.channelName || '').localeCompare(b.data.channelName || '')));
    _spCache = { spaces, channels };

    if (_spActiveId && !spaces.some(s => s.id === _spActiveId)) _spActiveId = null;

    _spRenderRail(spaces, channels);
    _spRenderDetail(spaces, channels);
    _spSyncOwnedChannels(spaces, channels);
};

function _spShowPane(which) {
    document.getElementById('sp-browse')?.classList.toggle('hidden', which !== 'browse');
    document.getElementById('sp-detail')?.classList.toggle('hidden', which !== 'detail');
}

window.spShowBrowse = () => {
    _spActiveId = null;
    localStorage.removeItem('sp_active');
    _spShowPane('browse');
    _spRenderRail(_spCache.spaces, _spCache.channels);
};

function _spUnreadCount(list) {
    return list.reduce((n, c) => n + ((Array.isArray(c.data.unreadBy) && c.data.unreadBy.includes(window.myUID)) ? 1 : 0), 0);
}

function _spRenderRail(spaces, channels) {
    const rail = document.getElementById('sp-rail');
    if (!rail) return;
    const railEmpty = document.getElementById('sp-rail-empty');
    if (railEmpty) railEmpty.style.display = spaces.length ? 'none' : '';
    if (!spaces.length) { document.getElementById('sp-channel-panel')?.classList.add('hidden'); rail.innerHTML = ''; return; }

    rail.innerHTML = '';
    spaces.forEach(({ id, data }) => {
        const active = id === _spActiveId;
        const unread = _spUnreadCount(channels[id] || []);
        const color = data.spaceColor || _spColorFor(id);
        const b = document.createElement('button');
        b.title = data.spaceName || 'Space';
        b.style.cssText = `display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:6px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid ${active ? 'rgba(79,70,229,0.3)' : 'transparent'};background:${active ? 'rgba(79,70,229,0.12)' : 'transparent'};cursor:pointer;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;text-align:left;width:100%;transition:background 0.12s;`;
        b.innerHTML = `
            <span style="width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:11px;background:${color};color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;flex-shrink:0;">${window.escHtml(_spInitials(data.spaceName))}</span>
            <span style="flex:1;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;color:${active ? '#e8e8f0' : '#9fa0b4'};font-size:12px;font-weight:${active || unread ? '700' : '500'};">${window.escHtml(data.spaceName || 'Space')}</span>
            ${unread ? `<span style="background:#ef4444;color:#fff;font-size:9px;font-weight:800;min-width:16px;height:16px;line-height:16px;border-radius:8px;padding:0 4px;text-align:center;flex-shrink:0;">${unread > 9 ? '9+' : unread}</span>` : ''}`;
        b.onmouseover = () => { if (!active) b.style.background = '#12121f'; };
        b.onmouseout = () => { if (!active) b.style.background = 'transparent'; };
        b.onclick = () => window.spSelectSpace(id);
        rail.appendChild(b);
    });

    const panel = document.getElementById('sp-channel-panel');
    const list = document.getElementById('sp-channel-list');
    const active = spaces.find(s => s.id === _spActiveId);
    if (!active || !panel || !list) { panel?.classList.add('hidden'); return; }

    panel.classList.remove('hidden');
    document.getElementById('sp-panel-name').textContent = active.data.spaceName || 'Space';
    const addBtn = document.getElementById('sp-panel-add');
    if (addBtn) addBtn.style.display = (active.data.owner === window.myUID) ? '' : 'none';

    const chans = channels[_spActiveId] || [];
    list.innerHTML = '';
    if (!chans.length) list.innerHTML = `<div style="color:#444455;font-size:11px;padding:6px 4px;">No channels yet.</div>`;
    chans.forEach(({ id, data }) => {
        const unread = Array.isArray(data.unreadBy) && data.unreadBy.includes(window.myUID);
        const open = window.currentChatId === id;
        const row = document.createElement('button');
        row.style.cssText = `display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding:6px 8px;border-radius:8px;border:none;background:${open ? '#1a1a2e' : 'transparent'};color:${open || unread ? '#e8e8f0' : '#8a8a9e'};font-size:12px;font-weight:${unread ? '700' : '500'};cursor:pointer;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;text-align:left;width:100%;transition:background 0.12s;`;
        row.onmouseover = () => { if (!open) row.style.background = '#12121f'; };
        row.onmouseout = () => { if (!open) row.style.background = 'transparent'; };
        row.innerHTML = `<span style="color:#5f6076;font-size:11px;flex-shrink:0;"><i class="fa-solid fa-hashtag"></i></span><span style="flex:1;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;">${window.escHtml(data.channelName || 'channel')}</span>${unread ? '<span style="width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:#ef4444;flex-shrink:0;"></span>' : ''}`;
        row.onclick = () => window.spOpenChannel(id);
        list.appendChild(row);
    });
}

function _spRenderDetail(spaces, channels) {
    const pane = document.getElementById('sp-detail');
    if (!pane) return;
    const space = spaces.find(s => s.id === _spActiveId);
    if (!space) { _spShowPane('browse'); return; }
    _spShowPane('detail');

    const { id, data } = space;
    const color = data.spaceColor || _spColorFor(id);
    const chans = channels[id] || [];
    const owned = data.owner === window.myUID;
    const memberCount = (data.participants || []).length;

    pane.innerHTML = `
        <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:13px;margin-bottom:20px;">
            <div style="width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:16px;background:${color};color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:16px;font-weight:800;flex-shrink:0;">${window.escHtml(_spInitials(data.spaceName))}</div>
            <div style="min-width:0;flex:1;">
                <h2 style="font-weight:900;color:#e8e8f0;font-size:20px;letter-spacing:-0.01em;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;">${window.escHtml(data.spaceName || 'Space')}</h2>
                <div style="color:#555566;font-size:12px;">${memberCount} member${memberCount === 1 ? '' : 's'} · ${chans.length} channel${chans.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}${owned ? ' · you own this' : ''}</div>
            </div>
            <button id="sp-d-invite" style="background:rgba(79,70,229,0.12);border:1px solid rgba(79,70,229,0.3);color:#818cf8;padding:8px 14px;border-radius:11px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;flex-shrink:0;"><i class="fa-solid fa-link"></i> Invite</button>
            ${owned ? '' : `<button id="sp-d-leave" style="background:rgba(255,255,255,0.025);border:1px solid #1e1e2e;color:#8a8a9e;padding:8px 14px;border-radius:11px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;flex-shrink:0;">Leave</button>`}
        </div>

        <div class="section-label" style="margin-bottom:10px;">Channels</div>
        <div id="sp-d-chans" style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(220px,1fr));gap:10px;"></div>
        ${owned ? `<button id="sp-d-newchan" style="margin-top:14px;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.025);border:1px solid #1e1e2e;color:#8a8a9e;padding:9px 16px;border-radius:11px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;"><i class="fa-solid fa-plus"></i> New channel</button>` : ''}

        ${owned ? `
        <div class="section-label" style="margin:26px 0 10px;">Danger zone</div>
        <div style="background:rgba(239,68,68,0.05);border:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,0.18);border-radius:14px;padding:14px;max-width:520px;">
            <div style="color:#f87171;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:4px;">Delete this space</div>
            <div style="color:#555566;font-size:11px;margin-bottom:11px;">Wipes every channel and removes all ${memberCount} member${memberCount === 1 ? '' : 's'}. The invite code stops working immediately. This can't be undone.</div>
            <button id="sp-d-delete" style="background:rgba(239,68,68,0.1);border:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,0.25);color:#f87171;padding:9px 16px;border-radius:11px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;"><i class="fa-solid fa-trash"></i> Delete space</button>
        </div>` : ''}`;

    const wrap = pane.querySelector('#sp-d-chans');
    if (!chans.length) wrap.innerHTML = `<div style="color:#444455;font-size:12px;">No channels yet.</div>`;
    chans.forEach(({ id: cid, data: cd }) => {
        const isUnread = Array.isArray(cd.unreadBy) && cd.unreadBy.includes(window.myUID);
        const card = document.createElement('button');
        card.style.cssText = `display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;background:#0a0a15;border:1px solid ${isUnread ? 'rgba(79,70,229,0.3)' : '#1e1e2e'};border-radius:14px;padding:12px;cursor:pointer;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;text-align:left;width:100%;transition:border-color 0.15s;`;
        card.onmouseover = () => card.style.borderColor = color;
        card.onmouseout = () => card.style.borderColor = isUnread ? 'rgba(79,70,229,0.3)' : '#1e1e2e';
        card.innerHTML = `
            <span style="color:#5f6076;font-size:13px;flex-shrink:0;"><i class="fa-solid fa-hashtag"></i></span>
            <span style="flex:1;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;color:${isUnread ? '#e8e8f0' : '#b9b9c9'};font-size:13px;font-weight:${isUnread ? '700' : '500'};">${window.escHtml(cd.channelName || 'channel')}</span>
            ${isUnread ? '<span style="width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#ef4444;flex-shrink:0;"></span>' : ''}`;
        card.onclick = () => window.spOpenChannel(cid);
        wrap.appendChild(card);
    });

    pane.querySelector('#sp-d-invite').onclick = () => window.spOpenInvite(id);
    pane.querySelector('#sp-d-leave')?.addEventListener('click', () => window.spLeaveSpace(id));
    pane.querySelector('#sp-d-newchan')?.addEventListener('click', () => window.spPromptNewChannel(id));
    pane.querySelector('#sp-d-delete')?.addEventListener('click', () => window.spDeleteSpace(id));
}

async function _spSyncOwnedChannels(spaces, channels) {
    if (!window.myUID) return;
    for (const { id, data } of spaces) {
        if (data.owner !== window.myUID) continue;
        const want = data.participants || [];
        for (const { id: cid, data: cd } of (channels[id] || [])) {
            if (cd.spaceChannelRemoved) continue;
            const have = cd.participants || [];
            const missing = want.filter(u => !have.includes(u));
            if (!missing.length || _spSyncing.has(cid)) continue;
            _spSyncing.add(cid);
            try {
                const patch = { participants: [...have, ...missing] };
                missing.forEach(u => {
                    if (data.names?.[u]) patch[`names.${u}`] = data.names[u];
                    if (data.pfps?.[u]) patch[`pfps.${u}`] = data.pfps[u];
                });
                await updateDoc(doc(_spDb, 'chats', cid), patch);
            } catch (e) { console.warn('[spaces] channel sync failed:', cid, e); }
            finally { _spSyncing.delete(cid); }
        }
    }
}

window.spSelectSpace = (id) => {
    _spActiveId = id;
    localStorage.setItem('sp_active', id);
    _spRenderRail(_spCache.spaces, _spCache.channels);
    _spRenderDetail(_spCache.spaces, _spCache.channels);
};

window.spOpenChannel = async (cid) => {
    const entry = Object.values(_spCache.channels).flat().find(c => c.id === cid);
    if (!entry) return;
    _spActiveId = entry.data.spaceId;
    localStorage.setItem('sp_active', _spActiveId);
    if (window.innerWidth < 768 && typeof window.closeMobileDmOverlay === 'function') window.closeMobileDmOverlay();
    await window.openChat(cid, entry.data, `#${entry.data.channelName || 'channel'}`);
    _spRenderRail(_spCache.spaces, _spCache.channels);
};

function _spNewToken() {
    return Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10);
}

const _SP_LETTERS = 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ';

function _spGenCode() {
    const rnd = new Uint32Array(10);
    (crypto || window.crypto).getRandomValues(rnd);
    let out = '';
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) out += _SP_LETTERS[rnd[i] % _SP_LETTERS.length];
    for (let i = 5; i < 10; i++) out += String(rnd[i] % 10);
    return out;
}

async function _spClaimCode(spaceId, owner, token) {
    for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 5; attempt++) {
        const code = _spGenCode();
        const ref = doc(_spDb, 'spaceCodes', code);
        const existing = await getDoc(ref);
        if (existing.exists()) continue;
        await setDoc(ref, { spaceId, owner, token, createdAt: serverTimestamp() });
        return code;
    }
    throw new Error('Could not allocate an invite code — try again.');
}

async function _spCreateChannelDoc(spaceId, channelName, spaceName, participants, names, pfps) {
    return addDoc(collection(_spDb, 'chats'), {
        spaceId, isGroup: true, channelName,
        groupName: `${spaceName} #${channelName}`,
        owner: window.myUID, participants, names, pfps,
        createdAt: serverTimestamp()
    });
}

window.spCreateSpace = async () => {
    const input = document.getElementById('sp-new-name');
    const name = (input?.value || '').trim();
    if (!name) return alert('Give your space a name.');
    if (typeof window.enforceMaxLength === 'function' && !window.enforceMaxLength(name, 40, 'Space name')) return;
    if (typeof window.spamGuard === 'function' && !window.spamGuard('create_space_spam', 5, 3600000))
        return alert("You've created too many spaces recently.");

    const token = _spNewToken();
    try {
        const spaceRef = await addDoc(collection(_spDb, 'chats'), {
            isSpace: true, isGroup: true, spaceName: name,
            spaceColor: SP_COLORS[Math.floor(Math.random() * SP_COLORS.length)],
            groupName: name, owner: window.myUID,
            participants: [window.myUID],
            names: { [window.myUID]: window.myUsername },
            pfps: { [window.myUID]: window.myPfp || '' },
            inviteToken: token, createdAt: serverTimestamp()
        });
        await _spCreateChannelDoc(spaceRef.id, 'general', name, [window.myUID],
            { [window.myUID]: window.myUsername }, { [window.myUID]: window.myPfp || '' });

        try {
            const code = await _spClaimCode(spaceRef.id, window.myUID, token);
            await updateDoc(doc(_spDb, 'chats', spaceRef.id), { inviteCode: code });
        } catch (e) { console.warn('[spaces] invite code not allocated:', e); }

        if (input) input.value = '';
        _spActiveId = spaceRef.id;
        localStorage.setItem('sp_active', _spActiveId);
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('[spaces] create failed:', e);
        alert('Could not create the space. ' + (e.message || ''));
    }
};

window.spPromptNewChannel = async (spaceId) => {
    const id = spaceId || _spActiveId;
    const space = _spCache.spaces.find(s => s.id === id);
    if (!space) return;
    if (space.data.owner !== window.myUID) return alert('Only the space owner can add channels.');

    const raw = prompt('Channel name');
    if (!raw) return;
    const clean = raw.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9-]+/g, '-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '').slice(0, 24);
    if (!clean) return alert('Use letters, numbers or dashes.');
    if ((_spCache.channels[id] || []).some(c => c.data.channelName === clean))
        return alert(`#${clean} already exists in this space.`);

    try {
        await _spCreateChannelDoc(id, clean, space.data.spaceName || 'Space',
            space.data.participants || [window.myUID], space.data.names || {}, space.data.pfps || {});
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('[spaces] channel create failed:', e);
        alert('Could not create the channel. ' + (e.message || ''));
    }
};

window.spOpenInvite = async (spaceId) => {
    const id = spaceId || _spActiveId;
    const space = _spCache.spaces.find(s => s.id === id);
    if (!space) return;
    const owned = space.data.owner === window.myUID;

    const ov = document.createElement('div');
    ov.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.72);z-index:10000;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px;font-family:"DM Sans",sans-serif;';
    ov.onclick = (e) => { if (e.target === ov) ov.remove(); };
    ov.innerHTML = `
        <div style="background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0d0d1a 0%,#0a0a15 100%);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);border-radius:20px;box-shadow:0 12px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.5),0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.35);padding:22px;max-width:400px;width:100%;">
            <div style="color:#e8e8f0;font-size:16px;font-weight:900;margin-bottom:4px;">Invite to ${window.escHtml(space.data.spaceName || 'Space')}</div>
            <div style="color:#555566;font-size:12px;margin-bottom:16px;">They paste this into Spaces → Join with a code. Capitals matter.</div>
            <div id="sp-code-box" style="background:#08080f;border:1px solid #1e1e2e;border-radius:14px;padding:16px;text-align:center;margin-bottom:12px;">
                <span id="sp-code-text" style="color:#818cf8;font-size:24px;font-weight:700;font-family:monospace;letter-spacing:0.14em;">…</span>
            </div>
            <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;">
                <button id="sp-code-copy" style="flex:1;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#4f46e5,#6366f1);color:#fff;border:none;padding:9px;border-radius:10px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;">Copy code</button>
                ${owned ? `<button id="sp-code-new" title="Revoke and make a new one" style="background:rgba(255,255,255,0.025);border:1px solid #1e1e2e;color:#8a8a9e;padding:9px 14px;border-radius:10px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;"><i class="fa-solid fa-rotate"></i></button>` : ''}
                <button id="sp-code-close" style="background:rgba(255,255,255,0.025);border:1px solid #1e1e2e;color:#8a8a9e;padding:9px 16px;border-radius:10px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;">Close</button>
            </div>

            <div style="border-top:1px solid #14141f;margin-top:16px;padding-top:14px;">
                <div style="color:#e8e8f0;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:2px;">Send to a friend</div>
                <div style="color:#555566;font-size:11px;margin-bottom:10px;">Drops an invite card straight into your DM with them.</div>
                <div style="position:relative;margin-bottom:8px;">
                    <span style="position:absolute;left:10px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);color:#444455;font-size:11px;pointer-events:none;"><i class="fa-solid fa-magnifying-glass"></i></span>
                    <input id="sp-friend-search" type="text" placeholder="Search friends..."
                        style="width:100%;background:#08080f;border:1px solid #1e1e2e;border-radius:10px;color:#e8e8f0;padding:8px 11px 8px 30px;font-size:12px;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;outline:none;"
                        onfocus="this.style.borderColor='#4f46e5'" onblur="this.style.borderColor='#1e1e2e'">
                </div>
                <div id="sp-friend-list" style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;max-height:180px;overflow-y:auto;"></div>
            </div>
        </div>`;
    document.body.appendChild(ov);

    const textEl = ov.querySelector('#sp-code-text');
    let code = space.data.inviteCode || null;

    const fail = (msg) => {
        textEl.style.fontSize = '12px';
        textEl.style.letterSpacing = 'normal';
        textEl.style.color = '#f87171';
        textEl.textContent = msg;
    };

    if (!code && owned) {
        try {
            let token = space.data.inviteToken;
            if (!token) { token = _spNewToken(); await updateDoc(doc(_spDb, 'chats', id), { inviteToken: token }); }
            code = await _spClaimCode(id, window.myUID, token);
            await updateDoc(doc(_spDb, 'chats', id), { inviteCode: code });
        } catch (e) {
            console.error('[spaces] code claim failed:', e);
            fail(e.code === 'permission-denied'
                ? 'The /spaceCodes rule is not live yet — add it in the Firebase console.'
                : 'Could not create a code. Try again.');
        }
    } else if (!code) {
        fail('No code yet. Ask the owner to open this dialog once.');
    }
    if (code) textEl.textContent = code;

    ov.querySelector('#sp-code-close').onclick = () => ov.remove();
    ov.querySelector('#sp-code-copy').onclick = async (e) => {
        if (!code) return;
        try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(code); e.target.textContent = 'Copied'; }
        catch (_) { e.target.textContent = 'Select it manually'; }
    };

    const listEl = ov.querySelector('#sp-friend-list');
    const searchEl = ov.querySelector('#sp-friend-search');
    const dms = (window._myDmChatsCache || []).filter(e => !e.data.ephemeralCall);
    const sent = new Set();

    const paintFriends = (filter) => {
        const q = (filter || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        listEl.innerHTML = '';
        const rows = dms.map(e => {
            const otherId = (e.data.participants || []).find(u => u !== window.myUID);
            return { dmId: e.id, otherId, name: e.data.names?.[otherId] || 'User' };
        }).filter(r => r.otherId && (!q || r.name.toLowerCase().includes(q)));

        if (!rows.length) {
            listEl.innerHTML = `<div style="color:#444455;font-size:11px;padding:6px 2px;">${dms.length ? 'No friends match that.' : 'No DMs yet — the code above works anywhere.'}</div>`;
            return;
        }
        rows.forEach(({ dmId, otherId, name }) => {
            const done = sent.has(dmId);
            const row = document.createElement('div');
            row.style.cssText = 'display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:6px;border-radius:10px;background:#08080f;border:1px solid #14141f;';
            row.innerHTML = `
                <span style="width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;background:#1a1a2e;color:#9fa0b4;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;flex-shrink:0;">${window.escHtml((name || 'U').charAt(0).toUpperCase())}</span>
                <span style="flex:1;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;color:#b9b9c9;font-size:12px;">${window.escHtml(name)}</span>`;
            const btn = document.createElement('button');
            btn.textContent = done ? 'Sent' : 'Send';
            btn.disabled = done;
            btn.style.cssText = `background:${done ? 'rgba(34,197,94,0.1)' : 'rgba(79,70,229,0.12)'};border:1px solid ${done ? 'rgba(34,197,94,0.25)' : 'rgba(79,70,229,0.3)'};color:${done ? '#22c55e' : '#818cf8'};padding:5px 12px;border-radius:8px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;cursor:${done ? 'default' : 'pointer'};font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;flex-shrink:0;`;
            btn.onclick = async () => {
                if (!code) return alert('No invite code yet.');
                btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = '…';
                const ok = await window.spSendSpaceInvite(dmId, otherId, id, code);
                if (ok) { sent.add(dmId); paintFriends(searchEl.value); }
                else { btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = 'Send'; }
            };
            row.appendChild(btn);
            listEl.appendChild(row);
        });
    };
    paintFriends('');
    searchEl.oninput = () => paintFriends(searchEl.value);
    ov.querySelector('#sp-code-new')?.addEventListener('click', async (e) => {
        e.target.disabled = true;
        try {
            const token = _spNewToken();
            const fresh = await _spClaimCode(id, window.myUID, token);
            if (code) { try { await deleteDoc(doc(_spDb, 'spaceCodes', code)); } catch (_) {} }
            await updateDoc(doc(_spDb, 'chats', id), { inviteCode: fresh, inviteToken: token });
            code = fresh;
            textEl.textContent = fresh;
        } catch (err) {
            console.error('[spaces] regenerate failed:', err);
            fail('Could not regenerate. Try again.');
        } finally { e.target.disabled = false; }
    });
};

window.spJoinByCode = async () => {
    const input = document.getElementById('sp-join-code');
    const code = (input?.value || '').replace(/\s+/g, '');
    if (!code) return;
    const ok = await window.spRedeemCode(code);
    if (ok && input) input.value = '';
};

window._spIsMember = (spaceId) => _spCache.spaces.some(s => s.id === spaceId);

window.spGoToSpace = (spaceId) => {
    window.switchView('spaces');
    if (window._spIsMember(spaceId)) window.spSelectSpace(spaceId);
};

window.spRedeemCode = async (code) => {
    if (!/^[A-Za-z]{5}[0-9]{5}$/.test(code)) {
        alert('Codes are 5 letters then 5 numbers, and capitals matter.');
        return false;
    }

    let spaceId, owner, token;
    try {
        const snap = await getDoc(doc(_spDb, 'spaceCodes', code));
        if (!snap.exists()) { alert('No space matches that code. Check the capitals, or ask for a fresh one.'); return false; }
        ({ spaceId, owner, token } = snap.data());
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('[spaces] code lookup failed:', e);
        alert(e.code === 'permission-denied'
            ? 'Invite codes are not switched on yet — the /spaceCodes rule still needs adding in the Firebase console.'
            : 'Could not look up that code. Try again.');
        return false;
    }

    if (!spaceId || !owner) { alert('That code is malformed. Ask for a fresh one.'); return false; }
    if (owner === window.myUID) { window.spGoToSpace(spaceId); return false; }
    if (_spCache.spaces.some(s => s.id === spaceId)) { window.spGoToSpace(spaceId); return false; }

    try {
        await setDoc(doc(_spDb, 'joinRequests', `${spaceId}_${window.myUID}`), {
            chatId: spaceId, uid: window.myUID,
            username: window.myUsername, pfp: window.myPfp || '',
            token: token || '', groupName: 'Space', owner,
            status: 'pending', createdAt: serverTimestamp()
        });
        alert("Request sent. You'll drop into the space as soon as the owner's client picks it up — usually instant if they're online.");
        return true;
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('[spaces] join failed:', e);
        alert('Could not send the join request. ' + (e.message || ''));
        return false;
    }
};

window.spSendSpaceInvite = async (dmChatId, friendUID, spaceId, code) => {
    const space = _spCache.spaces.find(s => s.id === spaceId);
    if (!space) return false;
    try {
        await addDoc(collection(_spDb, `chats/${dmChatId}/messages`), {
            type: 'space_invite',
            uid: window.myUID,
            timestamp: serverTimestamp(),
            spaceId,
            spaceName: space.data.spaceName || 'Space',
            code,
            memberCount: (space.data.participants || []).length,
            channelCount: (_spCache.channels[spaceId] || []).length,
            senderName: window.myUsername,
            targetUID: friendUID
        });
        return true;
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('[spaces] invite send failed:', e);
        alert('Could not send that invite. ' + (e.message || ''));
        return false;
    }
};

window.spLeaveSpace = async (spaceId) => {
    const space = _spCache.spaces.find(s => s.id === spaceId);
    if (!space) return;
    if (space.data.owner === window.myUID)
        return alert("You own this space — delete it instead, or it'd be left with no owner.");
    const chans = _spCache.channels[spaceId] || [];
    if (!confirm(`Leave ${space.data.spaceName || 'this space'}? You'll drop out of all ${chans.length} channel${chans.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} and need a new code to come back.`)) return;

    const drop = (ref, list) => updateDoc(ref, { participants: (list || []).filter(u => u !== window.myUID) });
    try {
        await drop(doc(_spDb, 'chats', spaceId), space.data.participants);
        for (const { id: cid, data: cd } of chans) {
            try { await drop(doc(_spDb, 'chats', cid), cd.participants); }
            catch (e) { console.warn('[spaces] channel leave failed:', cid, e); }
        }
        if (_spActiveId === spaceId) { _spActiveId = null; localStorage.removeItem('sp_active'); }
        _spShowPane('browse');
        if (window.currentChatData?.spaceId === spaceId) window.switchView('spaces');
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('[spaces] leave failed:', e);
        alert('Could not leave the space. ' + (e.message || ''));
    }
};

async function _spWipeDoc(ref) {
    try { await deleteDoc(ref); return 'deleted'; }
    catch (e) {
        if (e.code !== 'permission-denied') throw e;
        await updateDoc(ref, { participants: [], spaceChannelRemoved: true });
        return 'emptied';
    }
}

window.spDeleteSpace = async (spaceId) => {
    const space = _spCache.spaces.find(s => s.id === spaceId);
    if (!space) return;
    if (space.data.owner !== window.myUID) return alert('Only the space owner can delete it.');

    const name = space.data.spaceName || 'Space';
    const chans = _spCache.channels[spaceId] || [];
    const typed = prompt(`This deletes ${name}, all ${chans.length} channel${chans.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} and removes all ${(space.data.participants || []).length} member${(space.data.participants || []).length === 1 ? '' : 's'}.\n\nType the space name to confirm:`);
    if (typed === null) return;
    if (typed.trim() !== name) return alert('That name didn\'t match — nothing was deleted.');

    try {
        if (space.data.inviteCode) {
            try { await deleteDoc(doc(_spDb, 'spaceCodes', space.data.inviteCode)); }
            catch (e) { console.warn('[spaces] invite code cleanup failed:', e); }
        }

        const failed = [];
        for (const { id: cid } of chans) {
            try { await _spWipeDoc(doc(_spDb, 'chats', cid)); }
            catch (e) { console.error('[spaces] channel wipe failed:', cid, e); failed.push(cid); }
        }
        if (failed.length) throw new Error(`${failed.length} channel(s) could not be removed — the space was left intact so you can retry.`);

        await _spWipeDoc(doc(_spDb, 'chats', spaceId));

        _spActiveId = null;
        localStorage.removeItem('sp_active');
        _spShowPane('browse');
        if (window.currentChatData?.spaceId === spaceId) window.switchView('spaces');
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('[spaces] delete failed:', e);
        alert('Could not finish deleting the space. ' + (e.message || ''));
    }
};

<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';

  var clamp = function (v, a, b) { return v < a ? a : v > b ? b : v; };
  var eOutCubic  = function (t) { return 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3); };
  var eInOutCubic= function (t) { return t < 0.5 ? 4*t*t*t : 1 - Math.pow(-2*t+2,3)/2; };
  var eOutBack   = function (t) { var c1=1.70158, c3=c1+1; return 1 + c3*Math.pow(t-1,3) + c1*Math.pow(t-1,2); };

  function ramp(t, s, e, ease) {
    if (t <= s) return 0;
    if (t >= e) return 1;
    return (ease || eOutCubic)((t - s) / (e - s));
  }
  function hexToRgb(h) { var n = parseInt(h.slice(1), 16); return [(n>>16)&255, (n>>8)&255, n&255]; }
  function mixHex(a, b, t) {
    t = clamp(t, 0, 1);
    var A = hexToRgb(a), B = hexToRgb(b);
    return 'rgb(' + Math.round(A[0]+(B[0]-A[0])*t) + ',' +
                    Math.round(A[1]+(B[1]-A[1])*t) + ',' +
                    Math.round(A[2]+(B[2]-A[2])*t) + ')';
  }

  var DENY = '#d97a72', OK = '#22c55e', CYAN = '#5ad2e0', TEAL = '#4fe0b0';
  var NS = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
  var CORNERS = [
    [-1,-1,'M12 42 L12 34 A22 22 0 0 1 34 12 L42 12'],
    [ 1,-1,'M78 12 L86 12 A22 22 0 0 1 108 34 L108 42'],
    [-1, 1,'M12 78 L12 86 A22 22 0 0 0 34 108 L42 108'],
    [ 1, 1,'M78 108 L86 108 A22 22 0 0 0 108 86 L108 78']
  ];

  function el(tag, attrs) {
    var n = document.createElementNS(NS, tag);
    for (var k in attrs) n.setAttribute(k, attrs[k]);
    return n;
  }

  function EchoFaceID(host, opts) {
    opts = opts || {};
    this.host = host;
    this.accent = opts.accent || '#c4b5fd';
    this.glowBase = opts.glow || '#9184d9';
    this.size = opts.size || 40;
    this.state = 'idle';
    this.t0 = performance.now();
    this.raf = 0;
    this._build();
    this._loop = this._loop.bind(this);
  }

  EchoFaceID.prototype._build = function () {
    var s = this.size, self = this;
    var root = document.createElement('div');
    root.className = 'efid';
    root.style.width = s + 'px';
    root.style.height = s + 'px';

    var gyro = document.createElement('div');
    gyro.className = 'efid-gyro';
    this.rings = [];
    [[212,CYAN,5,0.95],[164,TEAL,4.5,0.9],[116,this.accent,4,0.7]].forEach(function (r) {
      var d = document.createElement('i');
      d.style.border = (r[2] * s / 320) + 'px solid ' + r[1];
      d.style.boxShadow = '0 0 ' + (22*s/320) + 'px ' + r[1] + '55';
      gyro.appendChild(d);
      self.rings.push({ node: d, base: r[0] * s / 320, color: r[1], op: r[3] });
    });
    root.appendChild(gyro);
    this.gyro = gyro;

    var svg = el('svg', { viewBox: '0 0 120 120' });

    this.brackets = CORNERS.map(function (c) {
      var g = el('g', {});
      g.appendChild(el('path', { d: c[2], 'stroke-width': '5.5', fill: 'none', 'stroke-linecap': 'round' }));
      g._dx = c[0]; g._dy = c[1];
      svg.appendChild(g);
      return g;
    });

    this.rect = el('rect', { x:12, y:12, width:96, height:96, pathLength:1,
      'stroke-width':'5.5', fill:'none', 'stroke-dasharray':'1' });
    svg.appendChild(this.rect);

    this.detail = el('g', {});
    [['line',{x1:44,y1:43,x2:44,y2:57}],['line',{x1:76,y1:43,x2:76,y2:57}]].forEach(function (d) {
      var n = el(d[0], d[1]);
      n.setAttribute('stroke-width','6'); n.setAttribute('stroke-linecap','round');
      self.detail.appendChild(n);
    });
    ['M60 46 L60 61 Q60 65 55.5 65','M41 80 C48 91 72 91 79 80'].forEach(function (d) {
      var n = el('path', { d: d, 'stroke-width':'6', fill:'none', 'stroke-linecap':'round', 'stroke-linejoin':'round' });
      self.detail.appendChild(n);
    });
    svg.appendChild(this.detail);

    this.spinner = el('circle', { cx:60, cy:60, r:48, pathLength:1, 'stroke-width':'7',
      fill:'none', 'stroke-linecap':'round', 'stroke-dasharray':'0.3 0.7' });
    this.spinner.style.transformOrigin = '60px 60px';
    svg.appendChild(this.spinner);

    this.check = el('path', { d:'M38 60 L53 76 L84 38', pathLength:1, 'stroke-width':'9',
      fill:'none', 'stroke-linecap':'round', 'stroke-linejoin':'round', 'stroke-dasharray':'1', stroke: OK });
    this.check.style.transformOrigin = '60px 60px';
    svg.appendChild(this.check);

    this.xg = el('g', {});
    this.xlines = [[40,40,80,80],[80,40,40,80]].map(function (p) {
      var n = el('line', { x1:p[0], y1:p[1], x2:p[2], y2:p[3], pathLength:1,
        'stroke-width':'9', 'stroke-linecap':'round', 'stroke-dasharray':'1', stroke: DENY });
      self.xg.appendChild(n);
      return n;
    });
    svg.appendChild(this.xg);

    root.appendChild(svg);
    this.svg = svg;

    var scan = document.createElement('div');
    scan.className = 'efid-scan';
    root.appendChild(scan);
    this.scanEl = scan;

    this.host.innerHTML = '';
    this.host.appendChild(root);
    this.host.classList.add('has-efid');
    this.root = root;
  };

  var MIN_SCAN_MS = 1100;

  EchoFaceID.prototype.setState = function (next, _forced) {
    if (next === this.state) return;

    if (next === 'success' && this.state === 'scanning' && !_forced) {
      var held = performance.now() - this.t0;
      if (held < MIN_SCAN_MS) {
        var self = this;
        clearTimeout(this._okT);
        this._okT = setTimeout(function () {
          if (self.state === 'scanning') self.setState('success', true);
        }, MIN_SCAN_MS - held);
        return;
      }
    }
    clearTimeout(this._okT);

    this.prevState = this.state;
    this.state = next;
    this.t0 = performance.now();
    this.start();
  };

  EchoFaceID.prototype.start = function () {
    if (!this.raf) this.raf = requestAnimationFrame(this._loop);
  };
  EchoFaceID.prototype.stop = function () {
    if (this.raf) { cancelAnimationFrame(this.raf); this.raf = 0; }
  };

  EchoFaceID.prototype._loop = function (now) {
    this.raf = requestAnimationFrame(this._loop);
    var t = (now - this.t0) / 1000;
    var st = this.state;

    var shapeT, spin, check = 0, xmark = 0, redAmt = 0, shakeX = 0, glow = 0;
    var scanOp = 0, scanY = 0;

    if (st === 'idle') {
      shapeT = 0; spin = 0;
      glow = 0;
    } else if (st === 'scanning') {
      shapeT = ramp(t, 0, 0.55, eInOutCubic);
      spin = clamp((shapeT - 0.8) * 5, 0, 1);
      var p = (t % 1.5) / 1.5;
      scanY = p < 0.5 ? eInOutCubic(p * 2) : 1 - eInOutCubic((p - 0.5) * 2);
      scanOp = ramp(t, 0.05, 0.3) * (0.55 + 0.45 * Math.sin(t * 4));
      glow = scanOp * 0.5;
    } else if (st === 'success') {
      shapeT = 1;
      check = ramp(t, 0.15, 0.65, eOutBack);
      spin = clamp(1 - check * 2, 0, 1);
      glow = ramp(t, 0.5, 0.75) - ramp(t, 0.95, 1.5);
    } else {
      shapeT = 1;
      xmark = ramp(t, 0.1, 0.5, eOutBack);
      spin = clamp(1 - xmark * 2, 0, 1);
      redAmt = ramp(t, 0, 0.25);
      var env = ramp(t, 0.05, 0.2) - ramp(t, 0.7, 1.2);
      shakeX = Math.sin(t * 34) * (13 * this.size / 320) * clamp(env, 0, 1);
      glow = ramp(t, 0.45, 0.6) - ramp(t, 0.9, 1.4);
    }

    glow = clamp(glow, 0, 1.3);
    var checkO = clamp(check, 0, 1), xmarkO = clamp(xmark, 0, 1);
    var detail = clamp(1 - shapeT * 1.8, 0, 1);
    var bracket = clamp(1 - shapeT * 2, 0, 1);
    var stroke = mixHex(this.accent, DENY, redAmt);
    var breathe = 1 + 0.015 * Math.sin(t * 0.7);

    var s = this.size;
    this.root.style.transform = 'translateX(' + shakeX + 'px) scale(' + breathe + ')';
    this.root.style.filter = 'drop-shadow(0 0 ' + ((18 + glow * 30) * s / 320) + 'px ' +
                             mixHex(this.glowBase, DENY, redAmt) + ')';

    var spread = 10 * bracket;
    for (var i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      var g = this.brackets[i];
      g.setAttribute('opacity', bracket);
      g.setAttribute('transform', 'translate(' + (g._dx * spread) + ',' + (g._dy * spread) + ')');
      g.firstChild.setAttribute('stroke', stroke);
    }

    this.rect.setAttribute('rx', 22 + shapeT * 26);
    this.rect.setAttribute('ry', 22 + shapeT * 26);
    this.rect.setAttribute('stroke', stroke);
    this.rect.setAttribute('stroke-dashoffset', 0);
    this.rect.setAttribute('opacity', st === 'idle' ? 1 : Math.max(shapeT * (1 - spin * 0.78), 0.2));

    this.detail.setAttribute('opacity', detail);
    for (var d = 0; d < this.detail.childNodes.length; d++)
      this.detail.childNodes[d].setAttribute('stroke', stroke);

    this.spinner.setAttribute('opacity', spin);
    this.spinner.setAttribute('stroke', stroke);
    this.spinner.style.transform = 'rotate(' + ((now - this.t0) / 1000 * 230) + 'deg)';

    this.check.setAttribute('opacity', checkO);
    this.check.setAttribute('stroke-dashoffset', 1 - checkO);
    this.check.style.transform = 'scale(' + (0.75 + 0.25 * check) + ')';

    this.xg.setAttribute('opacity', xmarkO);
    this.xlines[0].setAttribute('stroke-dashoffset', 1 - xmarkO);
    this.xlines[1].setAttribute('stroke-dashoffset', 1 - xmarkO);

    this.gyro.style.opacity = spin;
    if (spin > 0) {
      this.gyro.style.display = '';
      var TT = (now - this.t0) / 1000;
      var rot = [[TT*96, TT*34],[TT*-58, TT*132],[TT*148, TT*-72]];
      for (var r = 0; r < 3; r++) {
        var ring = this.rings[r];
        ring.node.style.width = ring.node.style.height = (ring.base * spin) + 'px';
        ring.node.style.opacity = ring.op;
        ring.node.style.transform = 'rotateX(' + rot[r][0] + 'deg) rotateY(' + rot[r][1] + 'deg)';
      }
      this.rings[2].node.style.borderColor = stroke;
    } else {
      this.gyro.style.display = 'none';
    }

    this.scanEl.style.opacity = clamp(scanOp, 0, 1);
    this.scanEl.style.top = (8 + clamp(scanY, 0, 1) * 84) + '%';
    this.scanEl.style.background = stroke;
    this.scanEl.style.boxShadow = '0 0 ' + (10 * s / 320 + 4) + 'px 2px ' + stroke;

    if (st === 'idle' && t > 6) this.stop();
  };

  var MOUNTS = [
    { icon: 'admin-lock-icon',    wrap: 'admin-lock-face-wrap',    size: 40, accent: '#fca5a5', glow: '#ef4444' },
    { icon: 'subadmin-lock-icon', wrap: 'subadmin-lock-face-wrap', size: 40, accent: '#c4b5fd', glow: '#7c3aed' },
    { icon: 'tfa-gate-icon',      wrap: null,                      size: 116, accent: '#c4b5fd', glow: '#a78bfa',
      wrapSel: '.tfa-gate-video-wrap' }
  ];

  function stateFromClasses(cl) {
    if (!cl) return 'idle';
    if (cl.contains('reject-active')) return 'fail';
    if (cl.contains('verified')) return 'success';
    if (cl.contains('face-present')) return 'scanning';
    return 'idle';
  }

  var instances = {};

  function mountAll() {
    MOUNTS.forEach(function (m) {
      var icon = document.getElementById(m.icon);
      if (!icon || instances[m.icon]) return;
      var inst = new EchoFaceID(icon, { size: m.size, accent: m.accent, glow: m.glow });
      instances[m.icon] = inst;
      inst.setState('idle');
      inst.start();

      new MutationObserver(function () {
        if (!icon.contains(inst.root)) { inst._build(); inst.start(); }
      }).observe(icon, { childList: true });

      var wrap = m.wrap ? document.getElementById(m.wrap)
                        : document.querySelector(m.wrapSel);
      if (!wrap) return;

      var apply = function () {
        var next = stateFromClasses(wrap.classList);

        clearTimeout(inst._dropT);
        if (next === 'idle' && inst.state === 'scanning') {
          inst._dropT = setTimeout(function () {
            if (stateFromClasses(wrap.classList) === 'idle') inst.setState('idle');
          }, 700);
          return;
        }

        inst.setState(next);
        if (next === 'fail') {
          clearTimeout(inst._failT);
          inst._failT = setTimeout(function () {
            if (inst.state === 'fail') inst.setState('scanning');
          }, 1400);
        }
      };
      new MutationObserver(apply).observe(wrap, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] });
      apply();
    });
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading')
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', mountAll);
  else mountAll();
  var tries = 0;
  var iv = setInterval(function () { mountAll(); if (++tries > 20) clearInterval(iv); }, 500);

  window.EchoFaceID = EchoFaceID;
  window._efid = instances;
})();
</script>

function esc(s) {
    return String(s == null ? '' : s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (c) {
        return ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;' })[c];
    });
}

<script>
(function () {
'use strict';

var FS = 'https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.11.0/firebase-firestore.js';

var KINDS = {
    admin: { box: 'admin-lock-box',    overlay: 'admin-lock-overlay',
             title: 'Admin Panel',  accent: '#dc2626', markUnlocked: '_adminMarkUnlocked' },
    sub:   { box: 'subadmin-lock-box', overlay: 'subadmin-lock-overlay',
             title: 'Staff Panel',  accent: '#7c3aed', markUnlocked: '_subAdminMarkUnlocked' }

async function sha256(s) {
    var buf = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', new TextEncoder().encode(s));
    return Array.from(new Uint8Array(buf)).map(function (b) { return b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0'); }).join('');
}

async function checkSetup() {
    if (!window.myUID) return { pw: true, face: true, err: 'not-signed-in' };
    try {
        var m = await import(FS);
        var db = m.getFirestore();
        var res = await Promise.all([
            m.getDoc(m.doc(db, 'users', window.myUID)),
            m.getDoc(m.doc(db, 'face_2fa', window.myUID))
        ]);
        var u = res[0].exists() ? res[0].data() : {};
        var f = res[1].exists() ? res[1].data() : {};
        var d = f.subAdminFaceDescriptor;
        return {
            pw:   !u.subAdminPasswordHash,
            face: !(d && typeof d === 'object' && Object.keys(d).length)
        };
    } catch (e) {
        return { pw: true, face: true, err: e.message };
    }
}

var active = null;

function mount(kind) {
    var cfg = KINDS[kind];
    var box = document.getElementById(cfg.box);
    if (!box) return null;
    if (active && active.host && active.host.parentNode) unmount();
    var hidden = [];
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(box.children, function (c) {
        if (c.style.display !== 'none') { hidden.push([c, c.style.display]); c.style.display = 'none'; }
    });
    var host = document.createElement('div');
    host.className = 'pst-wrap';
    box.appendChild(host);
    active = { kind: kind, cfg: cfg, hidden: hidden, host: host };
    return host;
}
function unmount() {
    if (!active) return;
    if (active.host && active.host.parentNode) active.host.parentNode.removeChild(active.host);
    active.hidden.forEach(function (p) { p[0].style.display = p[1]; });
    active = null;
}

function dots(n) {
    return '<div class="pst-steps">'
         + [0, 1, 2].map(function (i) {
               return '<div class="pst-dot ' + (i < n ? 'done' : i === n ? 'on' : '') + '"></div>';
           }).join('')
         + '</div>';
}

    },

              + 'enroll <b>Face ID</b>. This is a one-time setup.</div>'
              + '<div class="pst-rules">'
              +   '<div><b>1.</b> Panel password — separate from your login password.</div>'
              +   '<div><b>2.</b> Face ID — how you’ll normally unlock the panel.</div>'
              +   '<div><b>3.</b> Both are required. The panel stays locked until they’re set.</div>'
              + '</div>'
              + '<button class="pst-btn" id="pst-go">Begin setup</button>'
              + '<div class="pst-msg" id="pst-m"></div>';
            document.getElementById('pst-go').onclick = function () {
                state.pw ? pwStep() : verifyStep();
            };
        }

        function pwStep() {
            host.innerHTML = dots(1)
              + '<div class="pst-h">Create a panel password</div>'
              + '<div class="pst-p">Only you will have this. It unlocks the panel when Face ID '
              + 'can’t — bad light, no camera, a borrowed device.</div>'
              + '<input class="pst-in" id="pst-p1" type="password" placeholder="New panel password" autocomplete="new-password" spellcheck="false">'
              + '<input class="pst-in" id="pst-p2" type="password" placeholder="Confirm password" autocomplete="new-password" spellcheck="false">'
              + '<div class="pst-rules">At least <b>8 characters</b>. Don’t reuse your login password.</div>'
              + '<button class="pst-btn" id="pst-go">Continue</button>'
              + '<div class="pst-msg" id="pst-m"></div>';
            var a = document.getElementById('pst-p1'), b = document.getElementById('pst-p2');
            var m = document.getElementById('pst-m');
            setTimeout(function () { a.focus(); }, 120);
            function bad(el, t) { el.classList.add('bad'); setTimeout(function () { el.classList.remove('bad'); }, 400); msg(m, t); }
            function submit() {
                var v = a.value.trim(), w = b.value.trim();
                if (v.length < 8) return bad(a, 'Use at least 8 characters.');
                if (v !== w)      return bad(b, 'The two passwords don’t match.');
                pending.hash = v;
                msg(m, '');
                faceStep();
            }
            document.getElementById('pst-go').onclick = submit;
            b.onkeydown = a.onkeydown = function (e) { if (e.key === 'Enter') submit(); };
        }

        function verifyStep() {
            host.innerHTML = dots(1)
              + '<div class="pst-h">Confirm your panel password</div>'
              + '<div class="pst-p">Your password is already set, but this account has no Face ID '
              + 'enrolled yet. Confirm the password, then enroll your face.</div>'
              + '<input class="pst-in" id="pst-p1" type="password" placeholder="Panel password" autocomplete="current-password" spellcheck="false">'
              + '<button class="pst-btn" id="pst-go">Continue</button>'
              + '<div class="pst-msg" id="pst-m"></div>';
            var a = document.getElementById('pst-p1'), m = document.getElementById('pst-m');
            setTimeout(function () { a.focus(); }, 120);
            async function submit() {
                var v = a.value.trim();
                if (!v) return;
                msg(m, 'Checking…', true);
                try {
                    var mod = await import(FS);
                    var snap = await mod.getDoc(mod.doc(mod.getFirestore(), 'users', window.myUID));
                    var stored = snap.exists() ? snap.data().subAdminPasswordHash : null;
                    if (!stored || (await sha256(v)) !== stored) {
                        a.classList.add('bad');
                        setTimeout(function () { a.classList.remove('bad'); }, 400);
                        a.value = '';
                        return msg(m, 'Incorrect password.');
                    }
                    msg(m, '');
                    faceStep();
                } catch (e) { msg(m, 'Couldn’t verify: ' + e.message); }
            }
            document.getElementById('pst-go').onclick = submit;
            a.onkeydown = function (e) { if (e.key === 'Enter') submit(); };
        }

        function faceStep() {
            host.innerHTML = dots(2)
              + '<div class="pst-h">Enroll Face ID</div>'
              + '<div class="pst-p">Look straight at the camera in good light. We store face '
              + '<b>measurements</b>, never a photo or the video.</div>'
              + '<div class="pst-vid" id="pst-vw" style="display:none"><video id="pst-v" autoplay playsinline muted></video></div>'
              + '<button class="pst-btn" id="pst-go">Start camera</button>'
              + '<div class="pst-msg" id="pst-m"></div>';
            var m = document.getElementById('pst-m');
            document.getElementById('pst-go').onclick = enroll;
            setTimeout(enroll, 400);

            async function enroll() {
                var FU  = window._faceUtil;
                var vid = document.getElementById('pst-v');
                var vw  = document.getElementById('pst-vw');
                var btn = document.getElementById('pst-go');
                if (!FU) return msg(m, 'Face detection isn’t loaded — reload the page and try again.');
                btn.disabled = true;
                btn.textContent = 'Working…';
                vw.style.display = 'block';
                try {
                    msg(m, 'Loading face detection…', true);
                    if (!await FU.loadMediaPipe()) throw new Error('Face detection failed to load — check your connection.');
                    msg(m, 'Opening camera…', true);
                    await FU.startCamera(vid);
                    FU.audioScanStart && FU.audioScanStart();
                    for (var n = 3; n > 0; n--) {
                        msg(m, 'Hold still — capturing in ' + n + '…', true);
                        await new Promise(function (r) { setTimeout(r, 1000); });
                    }
                    msg(m, 'Reading your face…', true);
                    var samples = [], tooFar = 0;
                    for (var i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
                        await new Promise(function (r) { setTimeout(r, 120); });
                        var det = await FU.detectFace(vid, null);
                        var dsc = det && FU.geoDescriptor(det);
                        if (dsc && !dsc._noLandmarks) {
                            if (dsc._faceW != null && dsc._faceW < window.__FACE_ENROLL_MIN_W) tooFar++;
                            else samples.push(dsc);
                        }
                    }
                    if (!samples.length && tooFar) throw new Error('Too far from the camera — move closer so your face fills the frame.');
                    if (!samples.length) throw new Error('No face detected — check your lighting and camera angle.');
                    var enrolled = {};
                    FU.identityKeys.forEach(function (k) {
                        var vals = samples.map(function (d) { return d[k]; })
                                          .filter(function (v) { return typeof v === 'number' && isFinite(v); });
                        if (vals.length) enrolled[k] = vals.reduce(function (x, y) { return x + y; }, 0) / vals.length;
                    });

                    msg(m, 'Saving…', true);
                    var mod = await import(FS);
                    var db  = mod.getFirestore();
                    var writes = [mod.setDoc(mod.doc(db, 'face_2fa', window.myUID),
                                             { subAdminFaceDescriptor: enrolled }, { merge: true })];
                    if (pending.hash) {
                        writes.push(mod.setDoc(mod.doc(db, 'users', window.myUID),
                                               { subAdminPasswordHash: await sha256(pending.hash) }, { merge: true }));
                    }
                    await Promise.all(writes);
                    FU.audioEnroll && FU.audioEnroll();
                    FU.stopCamera(vid);
                    done();
                } catch (e) {
                    FU.audioError && FU.audioError();
                    try { FU.stopCamera(vid); } catch (_) {}
                    vw.style.display = 'none';
                    msg(m, '⚠ ' + (e.message || 'Enrollment failed.'));
                    btn.disabled = false;
                    btn.textContent = 'Try again';
                }
            }
        }

        function done() {
            host.innerHTML = '<div class="pst-steps">'
              + '<div class="pst-dot done"></div><div class="pst-dot done"></div><div class="pst-dot done"></div></div>'
              + '<div class="pst-h" style="color:#22c55e;">✓ ' + cfg.title + ' secured</div>'
              + '<div class="pst-p">Password saved and your face is enrolled. From now on the panel '
              + 'unlocks with a face scan, and your password is the fallback.</div>'
              + '<button class="pst-btn" id="pst-go">Open the panel</button>';
            document.getElementById('pst-go').onclick = function () {
                unmount();
                var fn = window[cfg.markUnlocked];
                if (typeof fn === 'function') fn();
            };
        }

        intro();
    },

    cancel: unmount
};

function patch(showName, kind, stopName) {
    var orig = window[showName];
    if (typeof orig !== 'function') return;
    window[showName] = function () {
        var self = this, args = arguments;
        unmount();
        checkSetup().then(function (st) {
            if (st.pw || st.face) {
                var ov = document.getElementById(KINDS[kind].overlay);
                if (ov) ov.classList.add('active');
                if (typeof window[stopName] === 'function') { try { window[stopName](); } catch (_) {} }
                window._panelSetup.run(kind);
            } else {
                orig.apply(self, args);
            }
        }).catch(function () { orig.apply(self, args); });
    };
}

patch('_showAdminLock',    'admin', '_lockStop');
patch('_showSubAdminLock', 'sub',   '_subLockStop');

var _svSetup = window.switchView;
window.switchView = function (id) {
    if (id !== 'admin' && id !== 'subadmin') unmount();
    return _svSetup && _svSetup(id);
};

})();
</script>

function q(id) { return document.getElementById(id); }

function label(w) {
    if (w.cam && w.mic) return 'camera and microphone';
    if (w.cam) return 'camera';
    return 'microphone';
}

function drawLine() {
    if (!ov.classList.contains('on')) return;
    var b = q('mpc-bubble').getBoundingClientRect();
    var tx = 34, ty = 14;
    var sx = b.left + 18, sy = b.top - 4;

    q('mpc-path').setAttribute('d', 'M' + sx + ',' + sy + ' Q' + cx + ',' + cy + ' ' + (tx + 12) + ',' + (ty + 12));
    var t = q('mpc-target'); t.style.left = tx + 'px'; t.style.top = ty + 'px';
}
window.addEventListener('resize', drawLine);

function open(w, mode) {
    var host = location.hostname || 'this site';
    ov.className = 'on' + (mode === 'blocked' ? ' blocked' : mode === 'screen' ? ' screen' : '');
    requestAnimationFrame(drawLine);
    if (mode === 'blocked') {
        q('mpc-title').textContent = 'Your ' + label(w) + ' is blocked';
        q('mpc-body').innerHTML =
            'This browser has <b>' + label(w) + '</b> access permanently blocked for ' + host + ', '
          + 'so it won’t even ask. Click the <b>' + (isFirefox ? 'permissions icon' : 'tune / lock icon')
          + '</b> at the left of the address bar, set ' + label(w) + ' back to <b>Allow</b>, then reload.';
        q('mpc-foot').textContent = 'Nothing can work until that’s changed — it’s a browser setting, not a site one.';
    } else if (mode === 'screen') {

        q('mpc-body').innerHTML =
            'Your browser is asking for permission right now. It shows up '

          + ' — it’s easy to miss. ' + ADVICE;
        q('mpc-foot').textContent = 'EchoSpace never records or stores anything from your ' + label(w) + '.';
    }

function close() { ov.className = ''; }

var PERM = { cam: 'camera', mic: 'microphone' };

function probe(w) {
    if (!navigator.permissions || !navigator.permissions.query) return Promise.resolve(null);
    var keys = [];
    if (w.cam) keys.push('cam');
    if (w.mic) keys.push('mic');
    return Promise.all(keys.map(function (k) {
        return navigator.permissions.query({ name: PERM[k] }).then(
            function (r) { return r.state; }, function () { return null; });
    })).then(function (states) {
        if (!states.length || states.some(function (s) { return s === null; })) return null;
        if (states.every(function (s) { return s === 'granted'; })) return 'granted';
        if (states.some(function (s) { return s === 'denied'; }))  return 'denied';
        return 'prompt';
    });
}

function wants(c) {
    c = c || {};
    return { cam: !!c.video, mic: !!c.audio };
}

function wrap(orig, kind) {
    return function (constraints) {
        var w = kind === 'screen' ? { cam: true, mic: false } : wants(constraints);
        if (!w.cam && !w.mic) return orig.call(md, constraints);

        var dead = false;
        var showT = setTimeout(function () {
            if (!dead) open(w, kind === 'screen' ? 'screen' : 'prompt');
        }, kind === 'screen' ? 260 : 380);
        function kill() { dead = true; clearTimeout(showT); close(); }

        var p;
        try { p = orig.call(md, constraints); }
        catch (e) { kill(); throw e; }
        if (!p || typeof p.then !== 'function') { kill(); return p; }

        if (kind !== 'screen') {
            probe(w).then(function (state) {
                if (dead) return;
                if (state === 'granted') kill();
                else if (state === 'denied') { clearTimeout(showT); open(w, 'blocked'); }
            }, function () {});
        }

        return p.then(function (stream) {
            kill();
            return stream;
        }, function (err) {
            clearTimeout(showT);
            dead = true;
            var n = err && err.name;
            if (n === 'NotAllowedError' || n === 'PermissionDeniedError' || n === 'SecurityError') {
                dead = false;
                open(w, 'blocked');
                setTimeout(close, 9000);
            } else {
                close();
            }
            throw err;
        });
    };
}

if (typeof md.getUserMedia === 'function') {
    var _gum = md.getUserMedia;
    md.getUserMedia = wrap(_gum, 'media');
}
if (typeof md.getDisplayMedia === 'function') {
    var _gdm = md.getDisplayMedia;
    md.getDisplayMedia = wrap(_gdm, 'screen');
}
if (navigator.getUserMedia || navigator.webkitGetUserMedia || navigator.mozGetUserMedia) {
    var legacy = function (c, ok, fail) { md.getUserMedia(c).then(ok, fail); };
    try { navigator.getUserMedia = legacy; } catch (_) {}
    try { navigator.webkitGetUserMedia = legacy; } catch (_) {}
    try { navigator.mozGetUserMedia = legacy; } catch (_) {}
}

md._echoCoached = true;
window._mediaCoach = { open: open, close: close };

})();
</script>

'#lite-toast .lt-t { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:9px; font-size:13.5px; font-weight:800; color:#f0f0f8; margin-bottom:6px; }',
'#lite-toast .lt-t i { color:#a78bfa; }',
'#lite-toast .lt-d { font-size:12px; color:#9494ad; line-height:1.55; }',
'#lite-toast .lt-b { display:flex; gap:8px; margin-top:12px; }',
'#lite-toast button { flex:1; padding:9px; border-radius:10px; cursor:pointer; font-size:12px;',
'  font-weight:800; font-family:inherit; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);',
'  background:rgba(255,255,255,.05); color:#c8c8d8; }',
'#lite-toast button.p { background:rgba(139,92,246,.2); border-color:rgba(139,92,246,.4); color:#c4b5fd; }'
].join('\n');

var style = document.createElement('style');
style.id = 'echo-lite-css';
style.textContent = CSS;
document.head.appendChild(style);

function isOn() { return document.documentElement.classList.contains('echo-lite'); }

function rewire() {
    var trail = window._mouseTrailEnabled;
    if (trail && !trail._liteWrapped) {
        var wrapped = function () {
            if (isOn()) return false;
            return trail.apply(this, arguments);
        };
        wrapped._liteWrapped = true;
        window._mouseTrailEnabled = wrapped;
    }
    var sv = window.switchView;
    if (sv && !sv._liteWrapped) {
        var swrap = function () {
            var r = sv.apply(this, arguments);
            if (isOn()) setTimeout(sweepBlurs, 60);
            return r;
        };
        swrap._liteWrapped = true;
        window.switchView = swrap;
    }
}
window.addEventListener('load', rewire);
setTimeout(rewire, 1500);
setTimeout(rewire, 5000);

function applyRuntime(on) {
    rewire();
    try { window._mouseTrailRefresh && window._mouseTrailRefresh(); } catch (_) {}
    try { if (on && window._echoHomeGlow) window._echoHomeGlow(false); } catch (_) {}
    if (on) sweepBlurs(); else unsweepBlurs();
}

function sweepBlurs() {
    if (!isOn()) return;
    try {
        var els = document.querySelectorAll('div, section, span, canvas, img, video');
        for (var i = 0; i < els.length; i++) {
            var el = els[i];
            if (el.dataset.liteSwept === '1') continue;
            var f = getComputedStyle(el).filter;
            if (!f || f.indexOf('blur(') === -1) continue;
            el.dataset.liteSwept = '1';
            el.style.setProperty('filter', 'none', 'important');
        }
    } catch (_) {}
}

function unsweepBlurs() {
    try {
        var els = document.querySelectorAll('[data-lite-swept="1"]');
        for (var i = 0; i < els.length; i++) {
            els[i].style.removeProperty('filter');
            delete els[i].dataset.liteSwept;
        }
    } catch (_) {}
}


function set(on, why) {
    var was = isOn();
    document.documentElement.classList.toggle('echo-lite', !!on);
    window._liteMode = !!on;
    if (why) {
        try { sessionStorage.setItem('echo_lite_auto', on ? '1' : '0'); } catch (_) {}
    } else {
        lsSet(LS_ON, on ? '1' : '0');
        lsSet(LS_CHOICE, 'user');
        try { sessionStorage.removeItem('echo_lite_auto'); } catch (_) {}
    }
    applyRuntime(!!on);
    syncToggle();
    if (on && !was && why) showToast(why);
    return !!on;
}

var toast = null;
function showToast(why) {
    if (!toast) {
        toast = document.createElement('div');
        toast.id = 'lite-toast';
        document.body.appendChild(toast);
    }
    toast.innerHTML =
        '<div class="lt-t"><i class="fa-solid fa-gauge-high"></i><span>Lite Mode turned on</span></div>'
      + '<div class="lt-d">' + why + ' EchoSpace switched off the animations and blur effects to '
      + 'take the load off this device. Everything still works — it just looks flatter.</div>'
      + '<div class="lt-b"><button class="p" id="lite-keep">Keep it on</button>'
      + '<button id="lite-undo">Turn it off</button></div>';
    toast.classList.add('on');
    var hide = function () { toast.classList.remove('on'); };
    document.getElementById('lite-keep').onclick = hide;
    document.getElementById('lite-undo').onclick = function () { hide(); set(false); };
    clearTimeout(showToast._t);
    showToast._t = setTimeout(hide, 15000);
}

function syncToggle() {
    var t = document.getElementById('lite-mode-toggle');
    if (t) t.checked = isOn();
    var s = document.getElementById('lite-mode-state');
    if (s) s.textContent = isOn()
        ? 'On — animations and blur effects are off.'
        : 'Off — turns on by itself if this device starts struggling.';
}
window.saveLitePref = function (on) { set(!!on); };

var autoFired = false;
function canAuto() {
    return !autoFired && !isOn() && lsGet(LS_CHOICE) !== 'user' && !document.hidden;
}
function trigger(why) {
    if (!canAuto()) return;
    autoFired = true;
    set(true, why);
}

(function () {
    var cores = navigator.hardwareConcurrency || 0;
    var mem   = navigator.deviceMemory || 0;
    if ((cores && cores <= 2) || (mem && mem <= 2)) {
        setTimeout(function () { trigger('This device reported limited memory and processing power.'); }, 2500);
    }
})();

(function () {
    if (typeof PerformanceObserver !== 'function') return;
    var hits = [];
    try {
        var po = new PerformanceObserver(function (list) {
            if (!canAuto()) return;
            var now = Date.now();
            list.getEntries().forEach(function (e) { if (e.duration > 150) hits.push(now); });
            hits = hits.filter(function (t) { return now - t < 10000; });
            if (hits.length >= 5) trigger('This device was struggling to keep up.');
        });
        po.observe({ entryTypes: ['longtask'] });
    } catch (_) {   }
})();

(function () {
    var LOW_FPS = 20, strikes = 0;
    function sample() {
        if (!canAuto()) { schedule(); return; }
        var frames = 0, t0 = performance.now(), raf;
        function tick(now) {
            frames++;
            if (now - t0 < 2500) { raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick); return; }
            var fps = frames / ((now - t0) / 1000);
            if (fps > 0.5 && fps < LOW_FPS) strikes++; else strikes = 0;
            if (strikes >= 2) trigger('EchoSpace was running at ' + Math.round(fps) + ' frames per second here.');
            schedule();
        }
        raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    }
    function schedule() { setTimeout(sample, 20000); }
    setTimeout(sample, 15000);
})();

window.EchoLite = { isOn: isOn, set: set, sync: syncToggle };
window._liteMode = isOn();

if (isOn()) applyRuntime(true);
if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', syncToggle);
else syncToggle();

})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
